en.description: Most passages activate the spelling fragment «elling» across different meanings, languages, and styles; passage 3 instead activates numbers and letters in a legal citation, which cannot be unified with this morphological pattern.

patterns.name: -elling ending
patterns.context: Activation falls on the spelling fragment «elling», appearing in whole words or participles with varied prefixes and meanings.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain: biographies, medicine, surveying, biology, Dutch parliamentary texts

patterns.name: Numeric and legal citation format
patterns.context: An isolated passage of numeric and letter-based text, with no clear ordinary lexical context; activation falls on citation characters.

6_201.concept: 对 «elling» 字符串的词形响应
6_201.description: 多数段落激活拼写片段 «elling»，横跨不同词义、语言与文体；第3段则激活法律引文中的数字和字母，无法与该词形模式统一解释。

patterns.name: -elling 词尾
patterns.context: 激活落在拼写片段 «elling» 上；出现在完整词或分词中，前缀和含义各异。
patterns.domain: 跨领域：人物传记、医学、测绘、生物学、荷兰语议会文本

patterns.name: 数字与法律引文格式
patterns.context: 一段孤立的数字和字母编号式文本，无明显普通词汇上下文；激活分布在引文字符上。

en.description: Strongly responds primarily to the continuous substring “elling” across English and Dutch vocabulary, including smelling, dwelling, remodelling, tentoonstelling, instellingen, etc.; also shows weak, independent activation on a numeric-alphabetic sequence in a legal quotation.

patterns.name: “-elling” word ending
patterns.context: Activation concentrates on the continuous substring “elling” within English or Dutch words; stems and following suffixes may vary, and no fixed syntactic position is required.
patterns.domain: Multiple domains, including encyclopedias, medical papers, patent background sections, and Dutch parliamentary speeches

patterns.name: Numeric and legal citation format
patterns.context: Adjacent numbers, letters, and page-number/citation-style formatting in legal material; no obvious “-elling” substring.

6_201.description: 主要对跨英语、荷兰语词汇中的连续子串“elling”强烈反应，涵盖 smelling、dwelling、remodelling、tentoonstelling、instellingen 等；另对一段法律引文中的数字字母序列有弱而独立的激活。

patterns.name: -elling 词尾
patterns.context: 激活集中在英语或荷兰语单词中包含的连续子串 “elling”；词干和后续词缀可不同，且不要求固定句法位置。
patterns.domain: 多领域；包括百科、医学论文、专利背景和荷兰语议会发言

patterns.name: 数字与法律引文格式
patterns.context: 法律材料中紧邻出现的数字、字母和页码/引文式格式；没有明显的 -elling 子串。

en.description: Most activations fall within words containing “elling,” commonly dwelling, remodelling, levelling, smelling, and Snelling; sporadic activations also occur in legal numbering, German Umsetzung, and Dutch tentoonstelling.

patterns.name: Word-internal fragment in “Snelling”
patterns.context: The fragment “elling” activates in a person's name and repeated surname spelling; preceding text introduces the photographer's life, birthplace, and parents.

patterns.name: Numbers and symbols in legal citations
patterns.context: An isolated legal report citation, with activation on a numbered string composed of digits, letters, and punctuation; visible context is very limited.

patterns.name: “-elling” word ending
patterns.context: In a description of an odor experiment, activation falls on the ending of “smelling”; the context concerns odor intensity and the effect of color on perception.

patterns.name: “-elling” word ending
patterns.context: In the compound “community-dwelling,” activation falls on the ending of “dwelling”; describes a caries-prevention trial in an older population.

patterns.name: German word-form fragment
patterns.context: In a German sentence, multiple consecutive fragments cover the word “Umsetzung” (implementation), followed by text related to European security.

patterns.name: “-elling” word ending
patterns.context: Activation falls on the ending of the medical term “remodelling”; discusses atrial electrical remodelling during atrial fibrillation.

patterns.name: “-elling” word ending
patterns.context: In “levelling” in a measurement or technical description, activation falls on the ending; involves a measuring rod and automatic recognition.

patterns.name: Dutch word-ending fragment
patterns.context: In a Dutch parliamentary speech, the fragment occurs within “tentoonstelling” (exhibition).

6_201.description: 多数激活落在含“elling”的词内，常见于 dwelling、remodelling、levelling、smelling、Snelling；另有法律编号、德语 Umsetzung 和荷兰语 tentoonstelling 等零散激活。

patterns.name: “Snelling”的词中片段
patterns.trigger: «Sn»elling（段 [1] 中姓氏 Snelling 的后半部分；激活最高）
patterns.context: 人名及其重复出现的姓氏拼写中，片段“elling”被激活；前文介绍摄影师的生平、出生地和父母。

patterns.name: 法律引证中的数字与符号
patterns.trigger: «16»、« F»、«d»、«» 等数字或引证格式片段
patterns.context: 孤立的法律报告引证，激活落在数字、字母和标点组成的编号串中；可见上下文很有限。

patterns.name: “-elling”词尾
patterns.context: 气味实验描述中，激活落在“smelling”的词尾；语境涉及气味强度及颜色对感知的影响。

patterns.name: “-elling”词尾
patterns.context: 复合词“community-dwelling”中，激活落在“dwelling”的词尾；描述老年人群的龋齿预防试验。

patterns.name: 德语词形片段
patterns.context: 德语句子中，多个连续片段覆盖“Umsetzung”（实施/落实）一词，后接欧洲安全相关文字。

patterns.name: “-elling”词尾
patterns.context: 医学术语“remodelling”中，激活落在词尾；讨论房颤期间心房电重塑。

patterns.name: “-elling”词尾
patterns.context: 测量或技术描述中的“levelling”一词，激活落在词尾；涉及测量杆及自动识别。

patterns.name: 荷兰语词尾片段
patterns.context: 荷兰语议会发言中，该片段出现在“tentoonstelling”（展览）一词内。

en.concept: Preference for the elling ending fragment
en.description: Activation most consistently corresponds to word-final fragments containing “elling,” but also occurs sporadically on “peptide,” internal German word fragments, number strings, patent phrases, and proper names; these examples lack a unified semantic pattern.

patterns.name: “-elling” ending and its participial forms
patterns.context: Activation falls on word-final fragments containing the letter sequence “elling”; the words and sentence meanings vary, and the fragment is split into subword tokens within words.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain: medical papers, biographies, measurement patents

patterns.name: “peptide” word
patterns.context: The word itself is strongly activated in a phrase about atrial fibrillation.

patterns.name: Internal German word fragments
patterns.context: Activation focuses on internal subword fragments of German words, surrounded by German phrases.

patterns.name: Numeric and punctuation strings
patterns.context: Little usable context; activation appears in what seem to be identification numbers or formatted character sequences.
patterns.domain: Isolated numeric/punctuation strings in legal text

patterns.name: woven wire screens phrase
patterns.context: Describes one or more woven wire screens in a patent background; strong activation falls mainly on “more”.

patterns.name: Casper
patterns.context: A proper name is split into subwords near a title or work name; the following “Spectrals” is not marked.

6_201.description: 激活最一致地对应含“elling”的词尾片段，但也散见于“peptide”、德语词内片段、数字串、专利短语及专名；这些例子缺乏统一语义模式。

patterns.name: “-elling”词尾及其分词形式
patterns.context: 激活落在含有字母序列“elling”的词尾片段上；词本身及句义各不相同，且该片段在词内被拆分标记。
patterns.domain: 跨领域：医学论文、传记、测量专利

patterns.name: “peptide”词
patterns.context: 词本身受到强激活，出现在讨论心房颤动的短语中。

patterns.name: 德语词内片段
patterns.context: 激活集中在德语词的内部子词片段上，周围为德语短语。

patterns.name: 数字与标点串
patterns.context: 几乎没有可用语境；激活出现在疑似编号或格式化字符序列中。
patterns.domain: 法律文本中的孤立数字/标点串

patterns.name: woven wire screens短语
patterns.context: 在专利背景中描述一种或多种编织金属丝网；强激活主要落在“more”。

patterns.name: Casper
patterns.context: 专名被拆分为子词，出现在标题或作品名称附近；后续的“Spectrals”未标记。

en.concept: Mixed detection of word fragments and numbering
en.description: Activations are scattered across legal/numeric numbering, word-internal “-elling” fragments, and several isolated subwords; “-elling” recurs across multiple domains, but the other high activations share no stable semantic or syntactic condition.

patterns.name: Numeric and legal numbering formats
patterns.context: Numbers combined with letter abbreviations, volume numbers, section symbols, etc., to form citations or identifiers; also includes sequences of numeric symbols in mathematical fragments.
patterns.domain: Legal texts, mathematical texts, code, or numbering

patterns.name: “-elling” word-form fragment
patterns.context: High activation concentrates on the word-internal suffix or continuous letter sequence “-elling,” appearing in odor descriptions, names, and academic terms.

patterns.name: Casper and concatenated-word fragments
patterns.context: Activation on subword fragments of specific words; here, the proper name “Casper” and the material phrase “woven wire screens,” with no consistent context.

patterns.name: Other sporadic word fragments
patterns.context: Isolated activations on common words or stems, with no shared local semantic or syntactic condition.

6_201.concept: 词片段与编号的混合检测
6_201.description: 激活分散于法律/数字编号、词内 -elling 片段及若干孤立子词；-elling 在多领域重复，但其余高激活没有稳定共同语义或句法条件。

patterns.name: 数字及法律编号格式
patterns.context: 数字与字母缩写、卷号、法条符号等组合成引用或编号；也包括数学片段中的数字符号序列
patterns.domain: 法律文本、数学文本、代码或编号

patterns.name: -elling 词形片段
patterns.context: 高激活集中在词内后缀或连续字母片段“-elling”，出现在气味描述、人名及学术术语中
patterns.domain: 医学摘要、人物传记、一般词语

patterns.name: Casper 及拼接词片段
patterns.context: 对特定词的子词片段有激活；此处分别是专名“Casper”和材料短语“woven wire screens”，缺少一致上下文

patterns.name: 其他零散词片段
patterns.context: 孤立地落在常见词或词干上，未见共享的局部语义或句法条件
patterns.domain: 摘要、专利文本、人物传记

en.concept: Detection of word-form and punctuation fragments
en.description: The clearest repeated cues are the internal elling sequence and possessive apostrophes; there are also all-caps boilerplate in license disclaimers, several sporadic word fragments, and activation on numbering formats. The pattern in Adam’s title is difficult to explain further.

patterns.name: Spelling fragment “elling”
patterns.context: Activation focuses on the letter sequence elling inside words; it occurs in names, descriptions of smells, and organization names, without requiring a particular meaning.

patterns.name: Apostrophes
patterns.context: Marks fall on apostrophes in possessives or contractions, such as Adam’s, Trump’s, Chile’s, It’s; adjacent parts are not necessarily activated.

patterns.name: All-caps legal disclaimer fragments
patterns.context: Formatted all-caps legal boilerplate in an open-source license disclaimer; activation is distributed across multiple uppercase words and their internal fragments.

patterns.name: Fragments within specific words
patterns.context: These local word fragments are activated in the given corpus passages, but share no salient semantic or syntactic condition.
patterns.domain: Medical abstracts, organization project descriptions, titles

patterns.name: Numeric and citation numbering formats
patterns.context: Numeric markers occur in license version numbers or legal case citations; activation is sporadic, with no consistent numeric condition.

6_201.description: 较明显的重复线索是词内 elling 和所有格撇号；另有许可证免责声明大写套语、若干零散词片段及编号格式激活。Adam’s 标题中的模式难以进一步解释。

patterns.name: 拼写片段「elling」
patterns.context: 激活集中在单词内部的字母串 elling；在姓名、气味描述和机构名称中都出现，不要求特定词义。
patterns.domain: 百科人物名、摘要、法律文本

patterns.name: 撇号
patterns.context: 标记落在所有格或缩写词的撇号上，如 Adam’s、Trump’s、Chile’s、It’s；相邻部分未必激活。

patterns.name: 法律免责声明大写词片段
patterns.context: 开源许可证免责声明中，格式化的大写法律套语；激活分布在多个大写词及其内部片段。

patterns.name: 特定词内的片段
patterns.context: 在给定语料片段中，这些局部词片段有激活，但彼此没有显著共同的语义或句法条件。
patterns.domain: 医学摘要、机构项目描述、标题

patterns.name: 数字与引文编号格式
patterns.context: 数字标记出现在许可证版本号或法律判例引文中；激活较分散，未见统一数值条件。

en.description: Activation mainly falls on several English or multilingual word fragments: -elling, LD, Col, and at in two different date/time formats; these triggers are distributed across names, paper abbreviations, and time expressions, with no unified semantic condition.

patterns.name: English word-final -elling
patterns.context: High activation falls on the word-final fragment «elling»; in one case it forms the surname Snelling, and in the other it occurs in smelling.

patterns.name: English word-initial LD
patterns.context: Activation focuses on the uppercase string LD, appearing in the photoperiod abbreviation LD, protein motifs LD2/LD4, and LDPs; the following characters and meanings vary.

patterns.name: English surname fragment Col
patterns.context: High activation falls on word fragments beginning with Col, appearing in the names Colman and Colvin, and in the Portuguese form Coloco.
patterns.domain: Author lists, popular culture, Portuguese parliamentary text

patterns.name: at in time phrases
patterns.context: Appears in a colloquial construction expressing that someone will arrive at some time today: today at some point in time.

patterns.name: at in date metadata
patterns.context: Appears in the fixed publication format Published at Wednesday…

6_201.description: 激活主要落在若干英文或多语词片段：-elling、LD、Col，以及两个不同日期/时间格式中的 at；这些触发分散于姓名、论文缩写和时间表达，未见统一语义条件。

patterns.name: 英文词尾 -elling
patterns.context: 高激活落在单词后缀片段 «elling»；前者构成姓氏 Snelling，后者是 smelling。
patterns.domain: 英文姓名、感官研究摘要

patterns.name: 英文词首 LD
patterns.context: 激活集中在大写字母串 LD，出现在光周期缩写 LD、蛋白质基序 LD2/LD4 和 LDPs 中；后续字符和语义各异。

patterns.name: 英文姓氏片段 Col
patterns.context: 高激活落在 Col 开头的词片段，分别出现在人名 Colman、Colvin 和葡语形式 Coloco 中。
patterns.domain: 作者名单、流行文化、葡语议会文本

patterns.name: 时间短语中的 at
patterns.context: 出现在表达某人今天会在某个时间到达的口语句式中：today at some point in time。

patterns.name: 日期元数据中的 at
patterns.context: 出现在发布信息的固定格式 Published at Wednesday… 中。

en.description: Activation is distributed across numbering and punctuation, citations and legal formatting, table-of-contents headings, biographies, and multilingual proper names; several fragments happen to be Cal or split words, but no single stable trigger covers all passages.

patterns.name: Numeric place-name abbreviations or strings
patterns.context: Appears in addresses, publication information, biographies, or place names; often part of a proper name or a place abbreviation, with activation spanning internal word fragments and no fixed boundaries.
patterns.domain: Academic references, legal documents, biographies, addresses

patterns.name: Numbering mixing digits and punctuation
patterns.context: Digits are adjacent to punctuation or typographic symbols, forming reference volumes and issues, classification codes, case numbers, and similar identifiers; they may also simply be list numbers.
patterns.domain: Academic papers, mathematics texts, legal documents, tables of contents

patterns.name: Bibliographic citation format
patterns.context: Author names appear alongside journal titles and volume/page information, in the style of abbreviated author names and journal titles in paper references.

patterns.name: Derivative notation and terminology in mathematical definitions
patterns.context: Mathematical prose defines a function and states the order of its derivative, with formulas and punctuation interspersed.

patterns.name: Academic titles and institutional biographies
patterns.context: Positions, fields of expertise, and affiliations follow a person’s name; the text also uses a biographical-entry structure.

patterns.name: Legal court heading and case number
patterns.context: Court name, jurisdiction, location, and case number are centered and separated by underscores.

patterns.name: Vestibular vocabulary in medical text
patterns.context: Discusses the vestibular nerve, semicircular canals, and testing methods; words may be split into internal fragments.

patterns.name: Names of people and organizations and legal agent addresses
patterns.context: Lawyer, organization, or agent names are followed by organization names and city/state; character fragments often occur in proper names.
patterns.domain: Lists of parties or agents in legal documents

patterns.name: Latvian parliamentary procedural text
patterns.context: Non-English text featuring agenda numbers, legislators’ names, and meeting procedure terminology; triggered fragments are mainly Latvian internal subword strings.

patterns.name: Section numbers and table-of-contents headings
patterns.context: Sections are marked with § and numbers, followed by brief headings, forming a table of contents or section list.
patterns.domain: Novel or book table of contents

patterns.name: Plant seasons and renewal-themed headings
patterns.context: Chapter headings pair themes such as seasons, death, resurrection, or the renewal of vegetation.

patterns.name: Biographical narrative and place of birth
patterns.context: Birth information introduces a person’s hometown and name; the place name is activated in fragments.

6_201.concept: 文本片段与专名/编号格式
6_201.description: 激活分散在编号与标点、引文和法律版式、目录标题、人物履历及多语种专名中；多个片段恰为 Cal 或被拆分的词，但没有覆盖所有段的单一稳定触发条件。

patterns.name: 数字化的地名缩写或字符串
patterns.context: 出现在地址、出版信息、人物履历或地名中；常是专名的一部分或地点缩写，激活跨越词内片段，边界并不固定。
patterns.domain: 学术参考文献、法律文书、人物简介、地址

patterns.name: 数字与标点混排的编号
patterns.context: 数字紧邻标点或排版符号，组成文献卷期、分类代码、案号等编号；也可能只是列表编号。
patterns.domain: 学术文献、数学文本、法律文书、目录

patterns.name: 文献引文格式
patterns.context: 作者姓名与期刊名、卷页等信息相邻，呈现论文参考文献的姓名缩写和刊名格式。

patterns.name: 数学定义中的导数符号与术语
patterns.context: 定义函数并说明其导数阶数的数学叙述，夹有公式和标点。

patterns.name: 学术头衔及机构履历
patterns.context: 人物姓名之后列出职位、专业领域和任职机构；同时包含传记式条目结构。

patterns.name: 法律法院抬头与案件编号
patterns.context: 法院名称、辖区、地点和案号以居中排版及下划线分隔。

patterns.name: 医学文本中的 vestibular 词汇
patterns.context: 讨论前庭神经、半规管及检测方法，词语可能被拆分成词内片段。

patterns.name: 人名、机构名及法律代理地址
patterns.context: 律师、机构或代理人姓名后接组织名称和城市州名；字符片段多出现在专名中。
patterns.domain: 法律文书的当事人或代理人名单

patterns.name: 拉脱维亚语议会程序文本
patterns.context: 非英语文本，出现议程编号、议员姓名和会议程序用语；触发片段主要是拉脱维亚语词内子串。
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会记录（拉脱维亚语）

patterns.name: 章节编号及目录标题
patterns.context: 以§和数字标记章节，后接简短标题，形成目录或章节列表。

patterns.name: 植物季节与复苏主题标题
patterns.context: 章节标题中并列季节、死亡、复活或植被复苏等主题。

patterns.name: 人物出生地与传记叙述
patterns.context: 以出生信息引出人物家乡和姓名；地名被分片激活。

en.concept: Weakly unified; medical stems and code markers
en.description: Activation clusters in two types of text: “Acute” at the beginning of medical disease names, and the “Propagation” stem in semiconductor patents; it also occurs on underscore identifiers and sporadic syntax markers in various code. The code fragments vary widely in purpose and language.

patterns.name: Terms beginning with Acute
patterns.context: “Acute” begins a medical disease name and is followed by clinical terminology; examples occur in both abstract prose and tabular diagnoses.

patterns.name: Underscores in identifiers or code
patterns.context: Underscores appear in code identifiers, joining variable, function, or type names; related code concerns containers, resources, buffers, and command handling.
patterns.domain: Software source code and technical Q&A

patterns.name: Propagation-related stem
patterns.context: The stem appears in “Propagation delays,” describing signal propagation and its delay.

patterns.name: Sporadic code formatting and control-flow markers
patterns.context: Besides underscores, code contains common syntax markers such as assignments, semicolons, and return statements; these tokens are distributed across code in different languages and with different functions, with no consistent semantic condition.
patterns.domain: Source code in multiple programming languages

6_201.concept: 弱统一；医学词干与代码标记
6_201.description: 激活集中于两类：医学病名开头的“Acute”、半导体专利中的“Propagation”词干；以及多种代码里的下划线标识符和零散语法标记。代码片段用途和语言差异较大。

patterns.name: Acute（急性）开头的术语
patterns.context: “Acute”位于医学疾病名开头，后接临床术语；既有摘要正文，也有表格诊断项。
patterns.domain: 医学论文摘要、临床表格

patterns.name: 标识符或代码中的下划线
patterns.context: 下划线出现在代码标识符中，连接变量名、函数名或类型名；相关代码涉及容器、资源、缓冲区及命令处理等。

patterns.name: 传播相关词干
patterns.context: 词干位于“Propagation delays”一词中，描述信号传播及其延迟。
patterns.domain: 专利背景技术，半导体与电路

patterns.name: 零散代码格式与控制流标记
patterns.context: 除下划线外，代码中还出现赋值、分号、返回语句等常见语法标记；这些词元分散在不同语言和功能的代码中，未呈现一致的语义条件。

en.description: The most stable cue is “at” and its occurrence in phrases such as “at least”; there are also local patterns involving medical meniscal, Italian condizioni, the placeholder word condimentum, medical examination terminology, and claims. These secondary fragments are scattered and show no unified context.

patterns.name: “at” and its continuations
patterns.context: Strong activation often falls on the standalone word “at”; it also appears at the beginning of the drug name “atropine”. Surrounding context is not fixed.
patterns.domain: Multiple styles, including medical abstracts, patent text, and literature

patterns.name: Meniscal forms in medical terminology
patterns.context: Subword fragments of meniscal tear and subsequent men- forms occur in the context of a meniscal injury diagnosis.

patterns.name: Italian stem for condition
patterns.context: An internal segmentation of the Italian word “condizioni” (conditions) in an Italian sentence.

patterns.name: English condimentum form
patterns.context: A Latinized form in Lorem ipsum-style placeholder text.

patterns.name: In vitro and examination contexts in medicine
patterns.context: Medical terminology concerning malignant hyperthermia susceptibility, muscle biopsy, and in vitro testing.

patterns.name: Claims-related words
patterns.context: Use of claims in patent claims or narration; activation locations are not fully consistent.

6_201.description: 最稳定的线索是“at”及其在“at least”等短语中的出现，另有医学 meniscal、意大利语 condizioni、占位词 condimentum、医学检查术语和 claims 等局部模式；这些次级片段分散，未显出统一语境。

patterns.name: “at”及其延续形式
patterns.context: 显著激活常落在独立词“at”，也出现在药名“atropine”的开头；周围语境不固定。
patterns.domain: 医学摘要、专利文本、文学等多种文体

patterns.name: 医学术语中的 meniscal 词形
patterns.context: meniscal tear 的分词片段及后续 men- 词形，处于半月板损伤诊断语境。

patterns.name: 意大利语条件词词干
patterns.context: 意大利语句中“condizioni”（条件）的词内切分。
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会意大利语发言

patterns.name: 英文 condimentum 词形
patterns.context: Lorem ipsum 式占位文本中的拉丁化词形。

patterns.name: 医学中的 in vitro 及检查语境
patterns.context: 围绕恶性高热易感性、肌肉活检和体外检查的医学术语。

patterns.name: claims 相关词语
patterns.context: 专利权利要求或叙述中的 claims 用语；激活位置并不完全一致。
patterns.domain: 法律专利文本、历史叙述

en.concept: Internal in strings and sporadic fragments
en.description: Most passages activate on internal in strings in multilingual words, especially Italian, Portuguese, and English; a few activations instead fall on table ratings, quoted questions, and contrasts in argumentative prose, which cannot all be assigned to the same trigger pattern.

patterns.name: Internal continuations of English in
patterns.context: Activation falls on the in string inside English words, as in “in the process”, “in the absence”, and “this is in any way”; it also occurs in internal word segmentations in other languages. Context alone does not require a fixed meaning

patterns.name: Internal Italian fragments
patterns.context: Activation is distributed across internal Italian word or adjacent subword fragments; passages 2, 3, 5, and 9 contain longer internal word segmentations, with clear Italian parliamentary speech context

patterns.name: Internal Portuguese fragments
patterns.context: Activation falls on subword fragments of Portuguese words in parliamentary speech; passages 7 and 8 are especially concentrated on internal word segmentations

patterns.name: English table items and evaluation terms
patterns.context: Rating labels and personnel evaluation items in a table or questionnaire, including a question about whether to hire again; activation is not limited to in strings
patterns.domain: Employee evaluation forms in Enron emails

patterns.name: Question fragments in quotations
patterns.context: A fixed question from a Shakespeare quotation; activation covers several fragments of the question
patterns.domain: Quotation in an English business research article

patterns.name: Contrast in English argumentative prose
patterns.context: Discussion of material and spiritual matters, with negation, contrast, and argumentative expressions; activation does not fall only on in

patterns.name: Internal English in in non-fixed contexts
patterns.context: Appears in English forum text in phrases such as “this is in any way”; surrounding text also discusses interpretation, superstition, and science

6_201.concept: 词内 in 子串及零散片段
6_201.description: 多数段落在多语种词语内部的 in 子串处激活，尤见意大利语、葡萄牙语及英语；另有少数激活落在表格评分、引语问句和论说文对举等片段，无法完全归为同一触发模式。

patterns.name: 英语 in 的词内延续
patterns.context: 激活落在英语词语内部的 in 子串上，如“in the process”“in the absence”“this is in any way”；也出现在不同语言的词内切分中，单凭上下文不要求固定语义
patterns.domain: 英语散文及多语种文本

patterns.name: 意大利语词内碎片
patterns.trigger: «in»10 以及如 «azioni»、«Sosten»、«rel»、«è» 等分词片段
patterns.context: 激活分布于意大利语单词内部或相邻子词片段；段2、3、5、9含较长词内切分，意大利语议会发言语境明显
patterns.domain: EuroParl 意大利语议会记录

patterns.name: 葡萄牙语词内碎片
patterns.context: 激活落在葡萄牙语单词的子词片段中，见议会发言；段7、8尤其集中于词内切分
patterns.domain: EuroParl 葡萄牙语议会记录

patterns.name: 英文表格项目与评价词
patterns.context: 表格或问卷中的评分标签、人员考核项目及是否再次聘用的问题；激活并非仅限 in 子串
patterns.domain: Enron 邮件中的员工评价表

patterns.name: 引语中的问句片段
patterns.context: 莎士比亚引语中的固定问句，激活涵盖问句若干词片段
patterns.domain: 英文商业研究文章中的引语

patterns.name: 英文论说文中的对举
patterns.context: 关于物质与精神的论述，出现否定、对举与论证性表达；激活不只落在 in 上

patterns.name: 非固定语境中的英语词内 in
patterns.context: 英语论坛文字中出现在“this is in any way”一类短语；周边还谈到解释、迷信与科学

en.description: Responds primarily to the cross-lingual spelling fragment “in”: Italian preposition in is most prominent, with coverage of English in and Spanish word-initial in-. Also shows weak activation on Portuguese word fragments and a letter fragment in a bibliography.

patterns.name: Italian preposition in
patterns.context: Occurs as a standalone preposition in Italian or as a subword fragment at the beginning of a longer word; triggers often occur mid-sentence.
patterns.domain: Italian parliamentary speeches and forum texts

patterns.name: Spanish preposition en
patterns.context: Within the Spanish word “inaceptable”; surface spelling resembles Italian in.

patterns.name: English preposition in
patterns.context: The preposition in in an English sentence, followed by noun phrases such as “Danae's”.

patterns.name: Portuguese word-ending fragment ões
patterns.context: The word fragment occurs in Portuguese words; no standalone preposition in is observed.

patterns.name: Non-Italian text and punctuation fragments
patterns.context: Text contains mixed bibliographic/OCR-style formatting; activation falls on letters or word fragments, with no stable lexical-semantic condition.

6_201.concept: 跨语言 in 字符串
6_201.description: 主要对跨语言拼写片段 in 有反应：意大利语介词 in 最突出，也覆盖英语 in、西班牙语 in-词首；此外对葡语词片段及一段书目中的字母片段有弱激活。

patterns.name: 意大利语介词 in
patterns.context: 在意大利语词中作为完整介词，或作为更长单词开头的子词片段；触发点常出现在句中
patterns.domain: 意大利语议会发言及论坛文本

patterns.name: 西班牙语介词 en
patterns.context: 西班牙语词“inaceptable”内部；与意大利语 in 的表面拼写相近

patterns.name: 英语介词 in
patterns.context: 英语句中介词 in，后接“Danae's”等名词短语

patterns.name: 葡萄牙语词尾片段 ões
patterns.context: 词片段位于葡萄牙语词语中；未见独立介词 in

patterns.name: 非意大利语文字与标点片段
patterns.trigger: «πλοσοφία»中的希腊字母«ι»；另有«L»、«P»等零散字母片段
patterns.context: 文本含 bibliographic/OCR 式混杂排版，激活落在字母或词片段上，未见稳定词义条件

en.concept: Italian in / code parameter name in
en.description: Every passage activates either Italian in or the code parameter name in; in Italian it can take time, place, and other complements, while in code it occupies a method-parameter position.

patterns.name: Italian preposition in
patterns.context: In continuous Italian text, in can stand alone or appear near a grammatical boundary; it is followed by place, time, or other complements.
patterns.domain: Italian parliamentary speech and software strings

patterns.name: in in code parameters
patterns.context: Appears in method parameter lists as a parameter name or part of a parameter declaration, followed by parentheses, a type, or a variable name.

6_201.concept: 意大利语 in／代码参数名 in
6_201.description: 各段均激活于意大利语词 in，或代码参数名 in；意大利语中可接时间、地点等补语，代码中位于方法参数位置。

patterns.name: 意大利语介词 in
patterns.context: 意大利语连续文本中，in 可单独成词，也出现在语法边界附近；后接地点、时间或其他补语。
patterns.domain: 意大利语议会发言及软件字符串

patterns.name: 代码参数中的 in
patterns.context: 出现在方法参数列表中，作为参数名或参数声明的一部分，后接括号、类型或变量名。

en.description: All passages contain strong activation on the string “in”: it can occur as a standalone preposition, inside Portuguese and Italian words, or in code identifiers. Sporadic activations also occur on the v in the parliamentary title onorevole and on code-naming fragments.

patterns.name: Short preposition or article prefix in
patterns.context: “in” commonly occurs within words or at word boundaries in Portuguese, Italian, English, and code identifiers; corresponding contexts include «in»10«íc»6«io»5, «in»9« modo», «in»9« advance», «in»9« gi»2«oco», «in»9« discussion», «in»9«iz»2«ia»3«re»2, «in»9« set»2, «in»9«ic»5iat…, «in»9« fairness», «in»9« context».
patterns.domain: Multilingual parliamentary speeches, English prose, programming text

patterns.name: Other word-internal “in” sequences
patterns.context: In an Italian phrase, the preposition in is followed by futuro; consistent with the dominant in-substring pattern, but weaker at this location.

patterns.name: Word-internal v in a parliamentary honorific
patterns.context: When the Italian parliamentary honorific onorevole is split, activation falls on the substring v; occurs when formally addressing a member of parliament.

patterns.name: Word-internal collection fragment in a code type name
patterns.context: Swift code identifiers or type names contain naming fragments with in / collection; activation is scattered across the identifiers.

patterns.name: English Create identifier fragment
patterns.context: Create and adjacent camel-case fragments in the Swift method name findOrCreatePlaceFromProto activate; relationship to the general in pattern is unclear.

patterns.name: Word-internal Portuguese substring inic
patterns.context: In a Portuguese sentence, inicia… occurs in a context about action or initiatives; following characters in the substring also receive strong activation.

patterns.name: Word-internal Italian substring iniz
patterns.context: The Italian infinitive iniziare (to begin) is split, with strong activation on the in substring.

patterns.name: Word-internal Portuguese substring início
patterns.context: The Portuguese word início (beginning) is split, with strong activation on in and the following syllables.

patterns.name: Word-internal Italian substring in gioco
patterns.context: The preposition in activates strongly in the phrase «in gioco» (at stake / under consideration).

patterns.name: in in an English fairness expression
patterns.context: The preposition in activates strongly in the English expression «in fairness».

patterns.name: in in a code parameter
patterns.context: In the Swift method parameter «in context», in is followed by the identifier context.

6_201.description: 所有段都含强激活的 in 字符串：既可独立作介词，也可位于葡萄牙语、意大利语单词内部或代码标识符中。另有议会称谓 onorevole 的 v，以及代码命名片段等零散激活。

patterns.name: 短介词或冠词前缀 in
patterns.context: 在葡萄牙语、意大利语、英语及代码标识符中，常见于词内或词边界处的 in；对应上下文分别包括 «in»10«íc»6«io»5、«in»9« modo»、«in»9« advance»、«in»9« gi»2«oco»、«in»9« discussion»、«in»9«iz»2«ia»3«re»2、«in»9« set»2、«in»9«ic»5iat…、«in»9« fairness»、«in»9« context»。
patterns.domain: 多语种议会发言、英语散文、编程文本

patterns.name: 其他词内 in 序列
patterns.context: 意大利语短语中介词 in 后接 futuro；与主导的 in 子串模式一致，但该处强度较弱。
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会意大利语发言

patterns.name: 议会礼貌称谓中的词内 v
patterns.context: 意大利语议会称谓 onorevole 被拆分时，激活落在 v 子串；在正式称呼议员的语境出现。
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会意大利语发言

patterns.name: 代码类型名中的词内集合片段
patterns.context: Swift 代码标识符或类型名中出现包含 in / collection 的命名片段；激活分散在标识符各处。

patterns.name: 英语 Create 标识符片段
patterns.context: Swift 方法名 findOrCreatePlaceFromProto 中的 Create 及相邻驼峰命名片段被激活；与一般 in 模式关系不明确。

patterns.name: 葡语词内 inic 子串
patterns.context: 葡萄牙语句子中，inicia… 出现在行动或倡议的语境；in 子串后续字符也获得较强激活。
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会葡萄牙语发言

patterns.name: 意大利语词内 iniz 子串
patterns.context: 意大利语不定式 iniziare（开始）被切分，in 子串强激活。
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会意大利语发言

patterns.name: 葡语词内 início 子串
patterns.context: 葡萄牙语 início（开始）被切分，in 及后续音节均强激活。
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会葡萄牙语发言

patterns.name: 意大利语词内 in gioco 子串
patterns.context: 短语 «in gioco»（处于利害关系／受关注）中介词 in 强激活。
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会意大利语发言

patterns.name: 英语公平表达中的 in
patterns.context: 英语表达 «in fairness» 中介词 in 强激活。

patterns.name: 代码参数中的 in
patterns.context: Swift 方法参数 «in context» 中，in 后接 context 标识符。

en.description: The most stable common feature is the standalone token “in”, strongly activated in Italian, English, and Swift code; there are also local activations on Italian parliamentary procedure and EU-related terms, while other nearby words do not form a unified semantic pattern.

patterns.name: Italian preposition in
patterns.context: Activation focuses on the standalone in in Italian or English code; it is commonly a preposition in Italian, and appears in different syntactic positions in English legal sentences and Swift code.
patterns.domain: Multilingual parliamentary texts, legal decisions, programming Q&A and code

patterns.name: Italian parliamentary procedural terms
patterns.context: Italian European Parliament speech discusses voting, agendas, minutes, or procedure; activated words include participles, prepositions, and other items besides in.

patterns.name: Cross-border or EU-related terminology
patterns.context: European Parliament text discusses EU member states, cross-border matters, or EU policy; related activation is not limited to in.

patterns.name: Legal sentence about contract interpretation
patterns.context: Quotes a question considered by a court, discussing whether interpretation of a written contract is for the court or the jury; strong activation falls on the English preposition within.

patterns.name: in in Swift code
patterns.context: In Swift method or function signatures, in appears as a parameter label, part of an identifier, or a code marker; many code tokens are activated alongside it.
patterns.domain: StackExchange programming Q&A and Swift code

patterns.name: Other Italian narrative collocations
patterns.context: In Italian academic or parliamentary narrative, in appears in time phrases or fixed expressions; passage 5 also concerns Scheler and architectural history, and passage 6 concerns Baltic policy.
patterns.domain: PhilPapers academic text and EuroParl speech

patterns.name: Local activations without a unified explanation
patterns.context: Passages vary greatly in topic, language, and genre; the common trigger for these tokens is unclear and may depend on local collocations or tokenization.
patterns.domain: Legal, code, academic, and parliamentary texts

6_201.description: 最稳定的共同点是独立 token“in”在意大利语、英语及 Swift 代码中均强激活；另有意大利议会程序和欧盟议题词语的局部激活，其他邻近词难归为统一语义模式。

patterns.name: 意大利语介词 in
patterns.context: 激活集中在意大利语或英语代码中的独立 in；意大利语里常见介词用法，英语法律语句和 Swift 代码里也出现在不同句法位置。
patterns.domain: 多语言议会文本、法律判决、编程问答与代码

patterns.name: 意大利语议会程序词语
patterns.context: 意大利语欧洲议会发言中涉及表决、议程、会议记录或程序；激活词包括分词、介词及其他非 in 词项。
patterns.domain: EuroParl 意大利语议会记录

patterns.name: 跨境或欧盟议题用语
patterns.context: 欧洲议会文本谈及欧盟成员国、跨境事项或欧盟政策；相关激活并不局限于 in。

patterns.name: 合约解释法律句式
patterns.context: 引述法院审理的问题，讨论书面合同的解释究竟由法院还是陪审团负责；强激活落在英语介词 within。

patterns.name: Swift 代码中的 in
patterns.context: Swift 方法或函数签名中，in 作为参数标签、标识符的一部分或代码标记出现；伴随大量代码 token 激活。
patterns.domain: StackExchange 编程问答及 Swift 代码

patterns.name: 意大利语其他叙述性搭配
patterns.context: 意大利语学术或议会叙述中，in 出现在时间短语或固定搭配里；段5另涉及 Scheler 与建筑史，段6涉及波罗的海政策。
patterns.domain: PhilPapers 学术文本及 EuroParl 发言

patterns.name: 未能统一解释的局部激活
patterns.context: 各段在主题、语言和体裁上差异很大；这些 token 的共同触发条件不明确，可能是局部搭配或分词因素。
patterns.domain: 法律、代码、学术与议会文本

en.description: The main pattern is Italian in segmented as a standalone token, including word-internal fragments; also observed are of in a math-problem template, InSection as a Swift parameter label, and the superscript 2 on μ in a formula.

patterns.name: Italian preposition in
patterns.context: The sentence-level preposition in is segmented and labeled separately, especially within longer words or phrases, such as «in»« set»te, «in»« gi»oco», «in»« modo»; also occurs in «met»tere»« in»« ev»iden»za».

patterns.name: of in an English math-problem template
patterns.context: In the fixed prompt “Let [variable](...) be the third derivative of ...”, it occurs after the expression and before the function being defined.
patterns.domain: Automatically generated DM Mathematics calculus problems

patterns.name: in in a code parameter list
patterns.context: In a Swift method signature, after the parameter label “...ItemsInSection,” it is followed by an integer parameter and subsequent parameter declarations.
patterns.domain: StackExchange programming Q&A and Swift code

patterns.name: Power token for Greek subscript marker μ
patterns.context: The superscript 2 on μ in a mathematical formula, written “m_{\mu}^«2»”; activation is marked on the superscript power token.

patterns.name: in in an Italian phrase
patterns.context: The preposition in in the segmented phrase “messo in luce,” following the Italian word “ungheresi.”

6_201.description: 主要模式是意大利语中被单独切分的 in（含词内片段）；另见数学题模板的 of、Swift 参数标签 InSection，以及公式中 μ 的上标 2。

patterns.name: 意大利语介词 in
patterns.context: 句中介词 in 被单独切分标注，尤其处于较长词或短语内部，如 «in»« set»te、«in»« gi»oco»、«in»« modo»；也见于 «met»tere»« in»« ev»iden»za»。
patterns.domain: 意大利语议会发言、书评

patterns.name: 英语数学题模板中的 of
patterns.context: 固定题干“Let [变量](...) be the third derivative of ...”中，位于表达式之后、被定义函数之前。
patterns.domain: 自动生成的 DM Mathematics 微积分题

patterns.name: 代码参数列表中的 in
patterns.context: Swift 方法签名参数标签“...ItemsInSection”之后，紧接整数参数及后续参数声明。
patterns.domain: StackExchange 编程问答及 Swift 代码

patterns.name: 希腊下标标记 μ 的幂次 token
patterns.context: 出现在数学公式中的 μ 上标 2，写作“m_{\mu}^«2»”，激活标注落在上标幂次 token。

patterns.name: 希腊词语中的 in
patterns.context: 意大利语词语“ungheresi”之后，拆分词“messo in luce”中的介词 in。

en.description: Activations occur on Italian/French in, Swift parameter-label in, and exponent 2 in synthetic polynomial expressions; also includes the code variable ch. The surface spans are diverse and are mainly triggered by local strings.

patterns.name: in within an Italian word
patterns.context: An independent word or intra-word fragment; examples in the data include Italian forms such as «av»4ver»r»1«à»1« in»10« set…» and «ad»5«es»3ione…».

patterns.name: in within a French word
patterns.context: Occurs at the beginning of the French word «incompréhensible»; the preceding text discusses parliamentary decisions.

patterns.name: 2 in a polynomial variable exponent
patterns.context: A variable is followed by an exponentiation operator and the number 2; occurs in automatically generated function-polynomial expressions, often surrounded by coefficients, variables, and other exponent terms.
patterns.domain: DM Mathematics, synthetic math problems and polynomials

patterns.name: in in a Swift identifier
patterns.context: Occurs in a function parameter list, as a Swift method signature's parameter label or part of an adjacent identifier.

patterns.name: ch identifier in code
patterns.context: Variable name on the left-hand side of an assignment in hexadecimal character-decoding logic.

6_201.concept: 局部字符串 in 与幂次 2
6_201.description: 激活落在意大利语/法语中的 in、Swift 参数标签 in，以及合成多项式里的幂次 2；另有代码变量 ch。表面跨度大，主要由局部字符串触发。

patterns.name: 意大利语词内的 in
patterns.context: 独立词或词内片段；材料中同时出现「av»4ver»r»1«à»1« in»10« set…」「ad»5«es»3ione…」等意大利语词形

patterns.name: 法语词内的 in
patterns.context: 出现在法语单词「incompréhensible」的词首，前文讨论议会决策

patterns.name: 多项式变量幂次中的 2
patterns.context: 变量后接幂运算符和数字 2；出现在自动生成的函数多项式表达式中，周围常有系数、变量和其他幂项
patterns.domain: DM Mathematics，合成数学题与多项式

patterns.name: Swift 标识符中的 in
patterns.context: 出现在函数参数列表中，作为 Swift 方法签名的参数标签或相邻标识符的一部分

patterns.name: 代码中的 ch 标识符
patterns.context: 十六进制字符解码逻辑中，赋值语句左侧的变量名

en.description: The most prominent pattern is within the followed by nouns denoting authority, scope, or time limits in legal corpora; Italian in and parliamentary phrases, as well as third derivative in mathematics, also trigger scattered activations that are difficult to group under a single semantic function.

patterns.name: within phrases
patterns.context: In legal texts, indicates that something falls within a court's authority, the scope of a precedent, or a statutory scope, or must be completed within a specified time limit.
patterns.domain: U.S. decisions, appellate instructions, and legal procedure texts

patterns.name: Word-internal Italian in
patterns.context: In continuous Italian text, in occurs as a preposition or a word-internal string; its semantics are inconsistent.
patterns.domain: European Parliament Italian, Italian philosophical reviews

patterns.name: Words following Italian la
patterns.context: In an Italian parliamentary speech, the article la is followed by prima lettura, discussing the negotiation process for a joint resolution.

patterns.name: Derivative in an algebraic expression
patterns.context: Taking the third derivative of a function in a mathematical symbolic expression.

6_201.description: 最显著模式是法律语料中 within the 加权限、范围或期限名词；另有意大利语的 in 及议会词组，以及数学中的 third derivative，触发分散，难以归为同一语义功能。

patterns.name: within 短语
patterns.context: 法律文本中，表示某事属于法院权限、判例范围、法定范围，或须在规定期限内完成。
patterns.domain: 美国判决、上诉指示及法律程序文本

patterns.name: 意大利语词内 in
patterns.trigger: «in»出现在«avverrà»之前的«in»«set»«te»，以及词内切分的«in»«evidenza»
patterns.context: 意大利语连续文本中，in 作为介词或词内字符串；语义并不一致。
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会意大利语、意大利语哲学评论

patterns.name: 意大利语 la 后续词
patterns.context: 意大利语议会发言中，冠词 la 后接 prima lettura，讨论共同决议的协商进程。

patterns.name: 代数表达式中的导数
patterns.context: 数学符号表达式中，对函数求三阶导数。

en.description: Activations are scattered across Italian articles, prepositions, and parliamentary formulas; in in code, camel-case identifier fragments, square terms in formulas, and a French welcome phrase. There is no shared semantic cue between code and natural language.

patterns.name: Preposition in / size and position parameters
patterns.context: Italian preposition in occurs in syntactic contexts involving inclusion and dates; in code it occurs in parameter labels, method parameters, or annotation property names, with inconsistent capitalization and semantics.
patterns.domain: European Parliament Italian; Swift, Java, and other code

patterns.name: Italian article la
patterns.context: The Italian definite article la appears before noun phrases such as “prima lettura,” “pausa estiva,” “bienvenue,” and “délégation.”
patterns.domain: European Parliament Italian, meeting welcome speeches

patterns.name: Camel-case fragments in proper names / identifiers
patterns.context: Activations fall on subword fragments in code identifiers, often in camel-case type, method, or annotation names; not all fragments show strong activation.
patterns.domain: StackExchange / Github source code and technical documentation

patterns.name: in in code / variable and property names
patterns.context: in occurs as part of a parameter or property name in code; surrounding text includes function parameters, type names, or annotation properties.

patterns.name: Exponent 2 in a LaTeX mathematical expression
patterns.context: Occurs in a squared term of a Frobenius-norm objective function, adjacent to mathematical markup and a matrix expression.

patterns.name: della in Italian abstract discussion
patterns.context: Occurs in written abstract discussion such as “per effetto della globalizzazione neoliberista,” as a preposition-article combination before a noun.

patterns.name: déle- spelling fragment in a welcome speech
patterns.context: The French word “délégation” is split into multiple subword fragments in a title or parliamentary speech welcoming a delegation.

patterns.name: Phrases about reaching an agreement
patterns.context: Italian parliamentary speech discusses reaching an agreement in order to make a common decision before the summer recess.

patterns.name: Ordinary Italian abstract vocabulary
patterns.context: Abstract discussion of globalization's impact on work; internal fragments of several ordinary words show weak activation.

6_201.description: 激活分散于意大利语冠词、介词及议会套语，代码中的 in、驼峰标识符片段，另有公式平方幂和法语欢迎辞片段；代码与自然语言间缺少统一语义线索。

patterns.name: 介词 in / 尺寸与位置参数
patterns.context: 意大利语介词 in 出现在加入、日期等句法位置；代码中则出现在参数标签、方法参数或注解属性名中，大小写和语义并不一致。
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会意大利语；Swift、Java 等代码

patterns.name: 冠词 la 前后
patterns.context: 意大利语中定冠词 la，分别位于“prima lettura”“pausa estiva”“bienvenue”“délégation”等名词短语之前。
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会意大利语、会议欢迎辞

patterns.name: 专名／标识符中的驼峰片段
patterns.context: 激活落在代码标识符的子词片段上，常见于类型、方法名或标注名的驼峰命名；并非所有片段都显著激活。
patterns.domain: StackExchange / Github 源代码与技术文档

patterns.name: 代码中的 in / 变量与属性名
patterns.context: 代码中 in 作为参数或属性名的一部分出现；周围是函数参数、类型名或注解属性。

patterns.name: LaTeX 数学表达式中的幂次 2
patterns.context: 出现在 Frobenius 范数目标函数的平方项中，紧邻数学公式标记及矩阵表达式。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 数学／机器学习论文

patterns.name: 意大利语抽象论述中的 della
patterns.context: 位于“per effetto della globalizzazione neoliberista”一类书面抽象论述中，是名词前的介词冠词组合。
patterns.domain: 意大利语学术或思想评论

patterns.name: 欢迎辞中的 délé- 拼写片段
patterns.context: 法语“délégation”一词被分成多个子词片段，位于对代表团表示欢迎的标题／议会发言中。

patterns.name: 一致协议相关词组
patterns.context: 意大利语议会发言中谈及达成协议，以便在夏季休会前作出共同决定。

patterns.name: 普通意大利语抽象词汇
patterns.context: 关于全球化对工作造成影响的抽象论述；多个普通词的内部片段呈现弱激活。
patterns.domain: 意大利语学术或思想评论

en.concept: Structural and proper-name fragments in fragmented text
en.description: Activations occur in European parliamentary law, Italian expressions for “first/first reading” and negotiation vocabulary; functions, variables, operators, and numbers in math problems; English proper names or word-internal fragments; and range and memory-error identifiers in code and logs.

patterns.name: “première” and first/initial contexts
patterns.context: In French and Italian, denotes first or initial, or a first reading in parliamentary procedure; often occurs in contexts related to meetings, adoption of decisions, or directives.

patterns.name: Function and variable symbols in mathematical expressions
patterns.context: Near formulas, function definitions, and questions in math problems or exercises; highlights are scattered across identifiers, parentheses, variables, operators, and numbers.

patterns.name: Letter fragments split within English proper names
patterns.context: The fragment is embedded within an English word, not a standalone word: «Rach»…«ael» (Rachael) and “in-«c»«ust»ody” (custody).

patterns.name: Errors and boundary states in code or runtime logs
patterns.context: Out of Range / Out Of Memory occurs in error identifiers or exception names; the former appears in a code range check, the latter in a runtime stack log.

patterns.name: Italian meeting/parliamentary negotiation wording
patterns.context: Italian parliamentary text discusses reaching a necessary agreement or joint decision after a first reading; adjacent to the “initial/first” theme, but also covers other segmented Italian words.

6_201.concept: 碎片化文本中的结构与专名片段
6_201.description: 激活见于欧洲议会法、意语中“首次/一读”及协商词汇；数学题中函数、变量、运算符和数字；英文专名或词内片段；代码与日志中的范围及内存错误标识符。

patterns.name: “première”及首次/初次语境
patterns.trigger: « prem»…«ière»；« prima»；« première» lecture；« prem»…«ière» séance
patterns.context: 法语和意大利语中，表示第一次、初次，或议会程序中的一读；常出现在与会议、通过决定或指令相关的上下文。
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会，多语种政治文本

patterns.name: 数学表达式中的函数与变量符号
patterns.context: 数学题或练习的公式、函数定义与问句附近；高亮分散在标识符、括号、变量、运算符和数字中。

patterns.name: 英文专名中被分词切开的字母片段
patterns.context: 片段嵌在英文词内部，而非独立词：«Rach»…«ael»（Rachael）和“in-«c»«ust»ody”（custody）。
patterns.domain: Wikipedia 条目、法律/医学说明

patterns.name: 代码或运行日志中的错误与边界状态
patterns.context: 错误标识符或异常名称中出现 Out of Range / Out Of Memory；前者位于代码的范围检查，后者位于运行时堆栈日志。

patterns.name: 意大利语会议/议会协商措辞
patterns.context: 意大利语议会文本讨论一读后达成必要协议或共同决定；与“初次/第一次”主题相邻，但此处也覆盖其他被切分的意大利语词。

en.description: Activations occur mainly on within and its uses for scope or interiority, and also in prepositional phrases with in. Sporadic patterns include mathematical exponentiation, transcription-format notes, legal arguments, poetry, Italian agendas, and code identifiers.

patterns.name: within in a within phrase
patterns.context: The token within is marked as strongly activated, followed by a scope, jurisdictional basis, area of responsibility, or space; meanings vary across collocations.

patterns.name: Preposition in and response wording
patterns.context: in occurs in legal-procedure response phrases, literary metatext, or ordinary prepositional phrases; multiple highly activated words also appear near paragraph 1, so it is unclear whether a fixed phrase jointly triggers them.
patterns.domain: Legal texts, book transcription notes, and general prose

patterns.name: Exponentiation operator in numerical expressions
patterns.context: In mathematical expressions, ** is followed by an exponent, including variable and numeric powers; activation falls on the operator and adjacent exponent token.

patterns.name: Formatting markers in book transcription notes
patterns.context: Explains how italics are represented with underscores in a transcription; activation is distributed across the formatting explanation rather than a single marker.
patterns.domain: Transcriber notes for digitized historical texts

patterns.name: Ambiguity and case applicability
patterns.context: Testimony is unclear, prompting discussion of whether the case falls within the scope of existing precedent.

patterns.name: Dispute over the duty to interpret contracts
patterns.context: Discusses whether interpretation of written contracts is the responsibility of the court or jury; within province is a strongly activated phrase in the passage.

patterns.name: Inner voice and sorrow in poetry
patterns.context: A poem describes the sound of weeping as existing within or inside, linked to desolate imagery.

patterns.name: in in an Italian agenda
patterns.context: in occurs in an Italian agenda heading, with Italian and English-like segmentation mixed together; activation is stronger on in.

patterns.name: Code identifiers and date API
patterns.context: Code documentation lists a date mapper and method names; activation covers fragments of camel-case API identifiers.

6_201.description: 主要激活出现在 within 及其范围/内在含义用法，也见 in 介词短语；另有数学幂运算、转录格式说明、法律论证、诗歌、意大利语议程和代码标识符等零散模式。

patterns.name: within 短语中的 within
patterns.trigger: «within»9，尤其是“within the time remaining”“within the holdings”“within the province”“within those sombre walls”
patterns.context: token within 被标记为强激活，后接范围、管辖依据、职责领域或空间；语义与具体搭配不完全一致

patterns.name: in 介词及响应措辞
patterns.trigger: «in»6« response»3« to»1« an»1« amended»1« pleading»1« within»10；另有« in»3« ital»2ics、« in»5« its»2« vagu»2eness
patterns.context: in 出现在法律程序回应短语中，或文学元文本、普通介词短语中；第1段附近同时有多个高激活词，无法确定是否由固定短语共同触发
patterns.domain: 法律、书籍转录说明及一般散文

patterns.name: 数字表达式中的幂运算符
patterns.context: 数学表达式中 ** 后接指数，包含变量幂与数值幂；激活落在运算符及其相邻指数 token

patterns.name: 书籍转录说明中的格式标记
patterns.context: 说明转录文本如何用下划线表示斜体，激活分布在格式说明短语而非单一标记
patterns.domain: 古籍电子文本的转录者注释

patterns.name: 模糊性与案件适用
patterns.trigger: « unsatisfactory»2 ... « vagu»2eness；« case»2« within»9 the holdings
patterns.context: 证词含糊不清，进而讨论案件是否落入既有判例的适用范围

patterns.name: 合同解释职责的争议
patterns.trigger: « construction»1 of a written contract «is»2 the responsibility ... of the court, or ... a «jury»3
patterns.context: 讨论书面合同的解释属于法院还是陪审团职责；within province 是该段的强激活词

patterns.name: 诗歌中的内在声音与哀伤
patterns.context: 诗句把哭泣的声音写作存在于内在或其中，并与荒凉意象相连

patterns.name: 意大利语议程中的 in
patterns.context: 意大利语议程标题中出现 in，混有意大利语与英语式切分；更高激活集中于 in

patterns.name: 代码标识符与日期 API
patterns.context: 代码文档列出日期映射器及方法名，激活覆盖驼峰式 API 标识符的片段

en.concept: Multilingual high-frequency function words and adjacent fragments
en.description: Activations often fall on Portuguese a, common word fragments, and nearby prepositions and articles; Italian and Spanish articles, prepositions, and word fragments also occur, as do function words in an English endnote. Languages, meanings, and contexts are inconsistent.

patterns.name: Portuguese definite article a and adjacent words
patterns.context: In Portuguese EuroParl speeches, the definite article a occurs mid-sentence or at phrase boundaries, often near a following noun, adjective, or expression; activation sometimes falls on an adjacent token rather than only on a.

patterns.name: Portuguese word-internal fragments and word boundaries
patterns.context: In Portuguese, activation may fall on segmented word fragments, preposition-plus-article forms, or complete words; meanings and structures vary, and local trigger positions are not fixed.

patterns.name: Italian prepositions and adjacent fragments
patterns.context: In Italian parliamentary speeches, activation occurs on prepositions or contractions such as in and dell' and their adjacent fragments; the examples are insufficient to confirm a shared semantic condition.

patterns.name: Italian articles and common phrases
patterns.context: In philosophical discussion, activation occurs on the article la and near the time phrase “postwar”; the specific trigger locations differ from those in other Italian passages.

patterns.name: Spanish feminine article and next time
patterns.context: A parliamentary speech mentions turning off the microphone next time; activation concentrates on the feminine article la and a fragment of próxima; single example.

patterns.name: Function words and end-of-book wording in an English note
patterns.context: In a book transcription note, activation occurs near the preposition in and expressions such as at the end of the book; differs in language and topic from the other passages.
patterns.domain: English transcription notes for old books

patterns.name: Other local triggers in passages
patterns.context: In parliamentary passages, activations occur near the Italian words ancora, prossima legislatura, relazione, and delegazione, respectively; a consistent trigger condition cannot be inferred from the few examples.

6_201.concept: 多语种高频功能词及邻接片段
6_201.description: 激活多落在葡语的 a、常见词片段及介词冠词附近；另见意大利语和西班牙语冠词、介词及词片段，以及英语书末说明中的功能词。跨语言、词义和语境均不一致。

patterns.name: 葡语定冠词 a 与邻近词语
patterns.trigger: « a»8、« a»9、« a»10；另有 «esta»6、« próxima»10、« questão»9 等
patterns.context: 葡语 EuroParl 发言中，定冠词 a 出现在句中或短语边界处，常靠近后续名词、形容词或表达；激活有时落在相邻 token 上，而非只落在 a 上。

patterns.name: 葡语词内片段与词语边界
patterns.trigger: « in»7«íc»4«io»3、« da»9、« ag»3rade«ço»2、« o»1«port»3un«idade»1、« n»3«essa»9« mes»3«ma»8
patterns.context: 葡语中激活可落在拆分后的词片段、介词加冠词或完整词上；各例词义与结构不一致，局部触发位置也不固定。

patterns.name: 意大利语介词及相邻片段
patterns.context: 意大利语议会发言中，in、dell' 等介词或缩合形式及其邻接片段出现激活；可见实例不足以确认共同语义条件。
patterns.domain: 意大利语欧洲议会发言

patterns.name: 意大利语冠词与常见短语
patterns.trigger: « la»8、« la»9、« dopo»4« la»8« fine»4« della»6« seconda»5« a»9
patterns.context: 哲学论述中，冠词 la 及“战后”时间短语附近出现激活；本段与其他意大利语段落的具体触发位置不同。

patterns.name: 西班牙语阴性冠词与下一次
patterns.context: 议会发言中提到下次将关闭麦克风，激活集中在阴性冠词 la 与 próxima 的词片段；单例。
patterns.domain: 西班牙语欧洲议会发言

patterns.name: 英语说明中的功能词与书末措辞
patterns.trigger: « in»5 italics、« at»2« the»4« end»4« of»9« the»7« book»2
patterns.context: 书籍转录说明中，介词 in 和 at the end of the book 等表达附近激活；与其他段落语言及主题不同。

patterns.name: 段落中其他局部触发
patterns.trigger: « an»2«cor»5«a»4、« na»7« pró»3«xim»4«a»9、« nella»8 rel«azione»1、« partire»1« da»6
patterns.context: 议会段落中分别出现在意大利语 ancora、prossima legislatura、relazione 和 delegazione 等词语附近，无法从少数例子归纳出一致触发条件。
patterns.domain: 意大利语欧洲议会发言

en.description: Activations are scattered across multilingual parliamentary speech and a math problem: expressions about the first meeting, time or the next stage, meetings, and agendas. There is also a mathematical cube. Triggering words vary across passages.

patterns.name: “première” in a parliamentary opening address
patterns.context: Occurs in “je suis très heureux d’être ici aujourd’hui pour cette première séance plénière...”, referring to the first plenary session of a new term.

patterns.name: Time expression in Lithuanian
patterns.context: Occurs in a long sequence of subword fragments in a Lithuanian parliamentary context; the trigger corresponds to “laiką” (time), near references to members and parliament.

patterns.name: Departure time in Portuguese
patterns.context: After thanking members, mentions having had an opportunity to meet someone before the delegation departed.

patterns.name: Upcoming summit
patterns.context: A Portuguese speech discusses the “next EU-Africa summit”; strong activation falls on the word meaning “next” and the following word for summit.

patterns.name: Cubic variable in a math problem
patterns.context: A differentiation problem contains the variable d raised to the third power, followed by another problem asking for a third derivative.

patterns.name: Welcoming a delegation
patterns.context: Before the meeting agenda begins, the chair welcomes a visiting delegation.

patterns.name: Expression meaning “at the same time”
patterns.context: A Portuguese sentence describes demonstrations and members and visitors trying to enter parliament, indicating that this occurred “at the same time.”

patterns.name: Philosophical discussion of “Part Two”
patterns.context: Discusses an idea presented at the start of Part Two of Descartes's Discourse on the Method, concerning the nature of knowledge.

patterns.name: Reaching an agreement before the summer recess
patterns.context: Italian parliamentary speech discusses whether consensus can be reached after the first reading, with “before the summer recess” as the deadline.

patterns.name: Next legislative term
patterns.context: Portuguese parliamentary speech proposes postponing the vote and says the matter should be considered in the next legislative term.

6_201.description: 激活分散于多语种议会发言及一道数学题：涉及首次会议、时间或下一阶段的表达、会议与议程；另有三次幂数学式。各段触发词并不一致。

patterns.name: 议会开场致辞中的“première”
patterns.context: 出现在“je suis très heureux d’être ici aujourd’hui pour cette première séance plénière...”中，指新一届的首次全体会议。
patterns.domain: 法语欧洲议会开场发言

patterns.name: 立陶宛语中的时间表达
patterns.context: 出现在立陶宛语议会语境的长串词片中，触发点对应“laiką”（时间），附近提到议员和议会。
patterns.domain: 立陶宛语欧洲议会文本

patterns.name: 葡语离席或出发时间
patterns.context: 在感谢议员后，提及代表团出发之前曾有机会与某人会面。

patterns.name: 即将举行的峰会
patterns.context: 在葡语演讲中谈论“下一次欧盟-非洲峰会”；高激活落在表示“下一次”的词及紧随其后的峰会词上。

patterns.name: 数学题中的三次幂变量
patterns.context: 在求导题中，表达式含变量 d 的三次幂，随后还出现另一道求三阶导数的题。

patterns.name: 欢迎代表团
patterns.context: 会议议程开始前，主席向到访代表团致欢迎辞。
patterns.domain: 法语欧洲议会会议记录

patterns.name: 同一时刻的指示表达
patterns.context: 葡语句中描述示威及议员、访客试图进入议会时，指示事情发生在“同一时刻”。

patterns.name: “第二部分”的哲学论述
patterns.context: 讨论笛卡尔《谈谈方法》第二部分开头提出的观点，涉及知识的本性。

patterns.name: 暑假前达成协议
patterns.context: 意大利语议会发言中讨论一读之后能否达成共识，并以“暑假休会前”为期限。
patterns.domain: 意大利语欧洲议会发言

patterns.name: 下一届立法任期
patterns.context: 葡语议会发言中建议推迟投票，并说该问题应在下一届立法任期审议。

en.description: Activations cover Lithuanian laik- forms, Portuguese início/iniciativa and pró- fragments, formal parliamentary thanks, and party-group procedure language; English examples include beyond phrases and a single instance of in the. They span multiple languages and local word forms, with no unified context.

patterns.name: Lithuanian “laik-” forms
patterns.context: In Lithuanian, the form is concatenated with adjacent words or segmented; [1] is “laiką” (time), and [2] is “laikas” (opportunity/time).

patterns.name: Portuguese “início da”
patterns.context: Portuguese “início” (beginning) or similarly segmented “iniciativa” occurs; the adjacent function-word fragment “da” also has high activation. Note that [7] triggers on the inicia- beginning of “iniciativa,” not on “início”.
patterns.domain: [3][7] European Parliament Portuguese speeches; [10] philosophical text

patterns.name: “próxima” and adjacent word fragments
patterns.context: Portuguese word-initial pró-; strong activation concentrates on the final a of “próxima” and the initial fragment of “própria” in [10], with no fully consistent correspondence.

patterns.name: English beyond the reach / beyond all
patterns.context: In English, beyond is followed by a phrase indicating scope or degree; [4] is beyond the reach of comparison, crossing a line break; [5] is beyond all help.

patterns.name: English prepositional phrase in the
patterns.context: The ordinary English phrase “in the not too distant future” in a quotation; does not co-occur with the English beyond pattern.

patterns.name: Portuguese parliamentary expression of thanks
patterns.context: Portuguese first-person thanks “ agradeço,” followed by an opportunity or response; activation in [6] also covers speech fragments such as fal-, sobre, a próx....

patterns.name: Lithuanian parliamentary procedure text
patterns.context: The proceedings record includes “PPE frakcijos vardu” (on behalf of the PPE group), accompanied by “pirmininke” and article/speech prompts; no clear connection to the main word-form pattern is observed.

6_201.description: 激活覆盖立陶宛语 laik- 词形、葡萄牙语 início/iniciativa 与 pró- 词片、正式议会致谢和党团程序语；英语则见 beyond 短语及单例 in the。分属多种语言和局部词形，缺少统一上下文。

patterns.name: 立陶宛语“laik-”词形
patterns.context: 立陶宛语中该词形与周边词连写或分词；[1]为“laiką”（时间），[2]为“laikas”（时机/时间）。

patterns.name: 葡萄牙语“início da”
patterns.context: 葡萄牙语里出现“ início”（开始）或类似分段的“iniciativa”；紧邻的功能词片段“da”也有高激活。注意[7]触发的是 inici- 开头的“iniciativa”，并非“início”。
patterns.domain: [3][7]欧盟议会葡萄牙语发言；[10]哲学文本

patterns.name: “próxima”及邻近词片段
patterns.context: 葡萄牙语词首 pró-；强激活集中于“próxima”末尾 a，以及[10]的“própria”开头片段，具体对应关系不完全一致。

patterns.name: 英语 beyond the reach / beyond all
patterns.context: 英语中 beyond 后接范围或程度短语；[4]为 beyond the reach of comparison，跨换行；[5]为 beyond all help。

patterns.name: 英语介词短语 in the
patterns.context: 引文中的普通英语短语 “in the not too distant future”；不与英语 beyond 模式同现。
patterns.domain: Pile-CC 法律/新闻评论引文

patterns.name: 葡萄牙语议会致谢套语
patterns.trigger: « ag»3«rade»1«ço»3 esta« o»1portun«idade»1（[6]）；[3]亦有« A»3«grade»1«ço»2« uma»4« resp»3«osta»3
patterns.context: 葡萄牙语一人称致谢“ agradeço”，后接机会或回应；[6]的激活还覆盖 fal-、sobre、a próx... 等发言词片段。
patterns.domain: EuroParl 正式演讲/议会对话

patterns.name: 立陶宛语议会程序文本
patterns.context: 议事记录中出现“PPE frakcijos vardu”（以 PPE 党团名义），并伴随“pirmininke”及条文/发言提示；未见与主要词形模式的明确联系。
patterns.domain: EuroParl 立陶宛语议事记录

en.description: Activations are scattered across function words and stems in multilingual parliamentary texts: Lithuanian laik-, Portuguese da and nessa mesma, Spanish la, and English in; also sporadic fragments in a Lithuanian party-group speech and English falls. There is no single cross-lingual semantic pattern.

patterns.name: Lithuanian stem “laik-”
patterns.context: Activation falls on the Lithuanian stem laik- followed by an ending; the phrase is “per tą laiką” (during that time).

patterns.name: Lithuanian stem “laik-”
patterns.context: Activation falls on the stem laik-, forming “laikas” (time); the context discusses aid and the timing of action.

patterns.name: Portuguese “da” and meeting-time expressions
patterns.context: da is strongly activated in meeting-time expressions such as “antes do início da sessão”; “próxima cimeira” in the same passage also shows strong activation.

patterns.name: “da” in voting instructions
patterns.context: Occurs in procedural instructions before a vote or amendment, with da followed by nouns such as vote or amendment.

patterns.name: Spanish article “la”
patterns.context: Activation falls on the feminine definite article la, followed by feminine nouns such as votación and legislatura; the context involves pre-vote instructions or parliamentary scheduling.

patterns.name: Portuguese “nessa mesma”
patterns.context: Activates in the phrase “nessa mesma altura” (at that same time), describing demonstrators trying to enter parliament.

patterns.name: English “in” and “falls”
patterns.context: In English legal discussion, in occurs in “in the not too distant future” and “falls in line”; activation centers on in, but falls is also marked in the same passage.

patterns.name: Short word fragments in Lithuanian political text
patterns.context: Lithuanian parliamentary record mentions the PPE group and the word “dalies”; high activations are scattered across several word fragments and do not clearly correspond to other patterns.

6_201.description: 激活分散于多语种议会文本中的功能词或词干：立陶宛语 laik-，葡语 da、nessa mesma，西语 la，以及英语 in；另有立陶宛语党团发言中的零散片段和英语 falls。无单一跨语种语义模式。

patterns.name: 立陶宛语「laik-」词干
patterns.context: 激活落在立陶宛语中的 laik- 词干，后接词尾；句中是“per tą laiką”（在那段时间）。
patterns.domain: EuroParl 立陶宛语议事文本

patterns.name: 立陶宛语「laik-」词干
patterns.context: 激活落在 laik- 词干，构成“laikas”（时间）；上下文讨论援助及采取行动的时机。
patterns.domain: EuroParl 立陶宛语议事文本

patterns.name: 葡萄牙语「da」及会议时间表达
patterns.context: 在“antes do início da sessão”一类会议时间表达中，da 激活明显；同段“próxima cimeira”也有较强激活。

patterns.name: 表决前提示中的「da」
patterns.context: 出现在表决或修正案之前的程序性提示中，da 后接表决、修正案等名词。
patterns.domain: EuroParl 葡萄牙语议程／程序文本

patterns.name: 西班牙语冠词「la」
patterns.context: 激活落在阴性定冠词 la，后接 votación、legislatura 等阴性名词；所处语境是表决前提示或议会日程讨论。
patterns.domain: EuroParl 西班牙语程序／议事文本

patterns.name: 葡萄牙语「nessa mesma」
patterns.context: 在表示同一时刻的短语“nessa mesma altura”中激活，描述示威者试图进入议会。
patterns.domain: EuroParl 葡萄牙语议事发言

patterns.name: 英语「in」及「falls」
patterns.context: 英语法律论述中，in 出现在“in the not too distant future”和“falls in line”里；激活中心是 in，但同段 falls 也被标记。
patterns.domain: Pile-CC 英语法律／宪法评论

patterns.name: 立陶宛语政治文本中的短词片段
patterns.context: 立陶宛语议会发言记录，提及 PPE 党团及“dalies”一词；高激活分散在若干词片段，无法与其他模式明确对应。
patterns.domain: EuroParl 立陶宛语议事记录

en.description: Activations concentrate on several distinct common word fragments in different languages in European Parliament and academic texts: Lithuanian laikas, nesta, and Portuguese nesta, the beginning of início, and da; also seen are Spanish la, Portuguese enuncia, and fragments in party-group records. There is no reliable evidence that they share a single meaning.

patterns.name: Lithuanian time word „laikas“
patterns.context: Contexts in Lithuanian referring to a period of time, timing, or taking action; activation falls on the laikas stem, which is split across tokens.

patterns.name: Portuguese demonstrative nesta
patterns.context: The Portuguese form nesta, meaning “in this …,” followed by a noun such as região, questão, or acção.

patterns.name: Beginning of Portuguese início
patterns.context: The initial fragment of Portuguese início or iniciativa; they occur in contexts about the start of a meeting and taking action, respectively.

patterns.name: Beginning of Portuguese da
patterns.context: The Portuguese preposition-plus-feminine-article form da, before a time or noun phrase, as in da partida and da sessão.

patterns.name: Spanish la in a noun phrase
patterns.context: The fixed Spanish expression «merece la pena»; activation falls on the article la.
patterns.domain: Spanish text following PhilPapers bibliographic entries

patterns.name: Beginning of a Descartes-related word
patterns.context: Portuguese philosophical discussion using enuncia to refer to a point made by Descartes in Part Two of Discourse on the Method.

patterns.name: Fragments related to Lithuanian party-group names
patterns.context: Lithuanian parliamentary speeches and their written records, concerning speaking on behalf of a party group and amendments to the wording of Part Seven.

6_201.description: 激活集中于欧洲议会和学术文本中若干不同语言的常见词片段：立陶宛语 laikas、nesta 以及葡语 nesta、início 词首和 da；另见西语 la、葡语 enuncia 及党团记录片段。没有可靠证据表明它们共享单一语义。

patterns.name: 立陶宛语时间词 „laikas“
patterns.context: 立陶宛语中谈到某段时间、时机或采取行动的语境；激活落在被拆分书写的 laikas 词干上。
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会立陶宛语发言

patterns.name: 葡语指示词 nesta
patterns.context: 葡语句中表示“在这个/这项……中”的 nesta，后接 região、questão、acção 等名词。

patterns.name: 葡语 início 的词首
patterns.context: 葡语 início 或 iniciativa 的词首片段；分别出现在会议开始和采取行动的语境中。

patterns.name: 葡语 da 的词首
patterns.context: 葡语介词与阴性定冠词 da，位于时间或名词短语之前，如 da partida、da sessão。

patterns.name: 西语 la 的名词短语用法
patterns.context: 西语固定表达「merece la pena」，激活落在冠词 la 上。
patterns.domain: PhilPapers 文献条目后的西语正文

patterns.name: Descartes 相关词的词首
patterns.context: 葡语哲学论述中「enuncia」，指 Descartes 在《谈谈方法》第二部分提出某观点。

patterns.name: 立陶宛语党团名称相关片段
patterns.context: 立陶宛语议会发言及其书面记录，涉及以党团名义发言和第七部分的措辞修改。
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会立陶宛语记录

en.concept: Expressions of scope or circumstance and multilingual word-form fragments
en.description: Responses occur mainly on English within and related expressions of scope or circumstance, and also in falls in line; there is strong activation on Lithuanian laiką and Portuguese nesta, possibly reflecting responses to word-form fragments in multilingual contexts.

patterns.name: Lithuanian ending “laiką”
patterns.context: Occurs in a Lithuanian sentence as an inflected form of the word for “time”; preceding text discusses a specific period or aid.

patterns.name: English within phrases
patterns.context: English expressions of scope, standards, or circumstances introduced by within; also occurs in phrases such as falls in line. Activation falls at different positions within the phrases.
patterns.domain: Legal opinions, forum comments, film discussions, and general English text

patterns.name: Portuguese demonstrative nesta
patterns.context: Occurs in the Portuguese phrase “nesta questão” (this issue), near discussion of African governance and representation.

6_201.concept: 范围或处境表达及多语词形片段
6_201.description: 主要响应英语 within 及相近的范围、处境表达，也出现在 falls in line 中；另对立陶宛语 laiką 和葡萄牙语 nesta 有强激活，可能反映多语语境下对词形片段的响应。

patterns.name: 立陶宛语后缀“laiką”
patterns.context: 出现在立陶宛语句子中，表示“时间”一词的格变化形式；前文谈及特定期间或援助。

patterns.name: 英语 within 短语
patterns.context: 英语中 within 引出的范围、标准或处境表达；也见于 falls in line 一类短语。激活落在短语内部的不同位置。
patterns.domain: 法律意见、论坛评论、影视讨论及一般英语文本

patterns.name: 葡萄牙语指示词 nesta
patterns.context: 出现在葡萄牙语“nesta questão”（这个问题）中，邻近非洲治理与代表权议题。

en.description: The clearest repeated triggers are Lithuanian “laik-” and the English phrase “within.” Other activations are scattered across parliamentary language, Portuguese forms, and legal commentary, with no reliable shared semantic or syntactic condition.

patterns.name: Lithuanian “laik-” forms
patterns.context: Words beginning with “laik” in Lithuanian, such as “laiką” and “laikas”; in context they refer to time or mean “by the time of,” with activation on the split fragment “la.”

patterns.name: English within phrases
patterns.context: The English preposition within followed by a complement referring to scope, description, or personal control; this word is saliently activated in these samples.
patterns.domain: Web articles, patent texts, legal testimony

patterns.name: Portuguese próxima
patterns.context: The Portuguese form in “próxima legislatura” (next legislative term); activation falls on the later fragment “a” after the word’s beginning.

patterns.name: Procedural and greeting expressions in parliamentary speeches
patterns.context: Lithuanian parliamentary speeches concerning sections of a meeting, representatives, or delegations; activation falls on internal word fragments, with no unified cross-linguistic trigger word.

patterns.name: Other sporadic word-internal activations
patterns.context: Portuguese thank-you remarks and English legal commentary; apart from the identifiable forms or phrases above, the activations do not form a stable shared pattern.
patterns.domain: Portuguese European Parliament speeches, legal commentary

6_201.description: 最清晰的重复触发是立陶宛语“laik-”及英语短语“within”。其余激活散见于议会用语、葡萄牙语词形和司法评论，缺乏可靠的共同语义或句法条件。

patterns.name: 立陶宛语“laik-”词形
patterns.context: 立陶宛语中以“laik”开头的词，如“laiką”“laikas”；在句中表示时间或“趁/到……时候”，激活落在分词片段“la”。
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会立陶宛语发言

patterns.name: 英语 within 短语
patterns.context: 英语介词 within 后接范围、描述或个人掌控等补足语；本批样本中该词得到突出激活。
patterns.domain: 网络文章、专利文本、法律证词

patterns.name: 葡萄牙语 próxima
patterns.context: 葡萄牙语中“próxima legislatura”（下一届立法期）里的词形；激活落在词首后续片段“a”。
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会葡萄牙语发言

patterns.name: 议会发言中的程序与致意用语
patterns.context: 立陶宛语议会发言，涉及会议发言部分、代表或代表团；激活落在词内片段，未见跨语言统一触发词。
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会立陶宛语发言

patterns.name: 其他段落中的零散词内激活
patterns.trigger: « g»6（“gostaria”）；« within»9 以外的 « falls»3、« in»9（“in line”）
patterns.context: 葡萄牙语感谢发言，以及英语司法评论；除上述可辨的词形或短语外，激活分布不构成稳定共同模式。
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会葡萄牙语发言、法律评论

en.description: Primarily activates on English preposition within in its spatial, temporal, and scope senses; it also marks English function words and internal subword fragments in multilingual texts, the latter lacking consistent semantic or topical coherence.

patterns.name: within as a preposition
patterns.context: Within followed by a noun phrase or scope expression in descriptions of place, time, or range; includes diverse meanings such as legal standards, distance, deadlines, and ability.
patterns.domain: Legal, literary, online commentary, and sports texts

patterns.name: English word-internal fragment activation
patterns.context: Activation falls on subword fragments of English words, including morphological components or ordinary word-internal segmentation; the fragments do not form a consistent meaning.
patterns.domain: Literature, law, medical abstracts, online commentary

patterns.name: English function words and local phrase fragments
patterns.context: Various common English function words or internal phrase fragments are marked, often in prepositional phrases or syntactic linking positions; apart from within, there is no unified specific semantic condition.
patterns.domain: English legal, literary, online, and popular-science texts

patterns.name: Lithuanian morphemes and word-internal fragments
patterns.context: Many Lithuanian word-internal subword fragments are activated across a passage about parliamentary members’ offices and cleaning; no identifiable shared meaning is apparent.

patterns.name: Portuguese word-internal fragments
patterns.context: Multiple word-internal fragments are activated in Portuguese philosophical discussion, involving words such as natureza, conhecimento, Descartes, and Discurso, but the fragments have no apparent shared meaning.

6_201.concept: 英语 within 及词内片段
6_201.description: 主要对英语介词 within 在空间、时间和范围义中的用法激活；另在多语种文本中标记英语虚词及词内子词片段，后者缺乏稳定语义或主题一致性。

patterns.name: within 作介词
patterns.context: 在地点、时间或范围表达中，within 后接名词短语或范围；包括法律标准、距离、期限、能力范围等不同语义。
patterns.domain: 法律、文学、网络评论、体育文本

patterns.name: 英语词内片段激活
patterns.context: 激活落在英语单词的子词片段上，涉及词形构成或普通词内切分；片段本身未形成一致语义。
patterns.domain: 文学、法律、医学摘要、网络评论

patterns.name: 英语功能词与局部短语片段
patterns.context: 多个常见英语虚词或短语内部片段被标记，常处于介词短语或句法连接位置；除 within 外未见统一的具体语义条件。
patterns.domain: 英语法律、文学、网络及科普文本

patterns.name: 立陶宛语词素与词内片段
patterns.context: 激活大量立陶宛语词内子词片段，分布于一段关于议会成员办公室及清理的文本；未呈现可确认的共同词义。
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会文本，立陶宛语

patterns.name: 葡萄牙语词内片段
patterns.context: 激活葡萄牙语哲学论述中的多个词内片段，涉及 natureza、conhecimento、Descartes、Discurso 等词，但片段间无明显共同语义。
patterns.domain: 哲学学术文本，葡萄牙语

en.concept: Multilingual word fragments and formal contexts
en.description: Activations are scattered across word-internal fragments in Lithuanian, Portuguese, and English; within and regulatory formatting stand out in legal data, parliamentary texts concern meetings and thanks, and other instances occur in a discussion of Descartes, case headings, and literary descriptions of places.

patterns.name: Specific point in time or deadline
patterns.context: Lithuanian expressions related to “then/that period”; also Portuguese « antes»4« do»6« in»6«íc»4«io»2« da»9 (before the beginning) and « antes»1…« da»9« part»2«ida»1 (before departure), and English « within»9 (within the scope of).
patterns.domain: Multilingual parliamentary speeches, legal texts, literary prose

patterns.name: Formal fixed expressions in legal or procedural contexts
patterns.context: Formal judgments, statutory citations, and scope limitations in legal opinions or litigation materials.

patterns.name: European Parliament, meetings, and words of thanks in parliamentary speeches
patterns.context: Speeches discussing parliamentary matters, meeting proceedings, or thanking members; activations also occur on fragments within related words.

patterns.name: Internal fragments in long Lithuanian words
patterns.context: Activations are distributed across subword fragments within continuous Lithuanian text, with no stable single semantic trigger.

patterns.name: Portuguese philosophical terms and Descartes
patterns.context: Philosophical discussion of knowledge and Part Two of Discourse on the Method; strong activation falls on an internal fragment of a word meaning “declare/state.”

patterns.name: Names and dates in case headings
patterns.context: Headings, judge, and date fields on legal case-calendar pages; strong activation occurs on a fragment within the judge's name.

patterns.name: Place specified with within in English narration
patterns.context: Describes natural or built scenery within a certain distance of a location.

patterns.name: Sporadic, uninterpretable triggers
patterns.context: Occur separately in discussions of development aid and parliamentary speeches, with no clear shared local semantic condition among the other highly activated fragments.

6_201.concept: 多语种词片段与正式语境
6_201.description: 激活分散于立陶宛语、葡萄牙语和英语词内片段；法律语料中突出within及法规格式，议会文本涉及会议与致谢，另见笛卡尔论述、判例标题和文学地点描写。

patterns.name: 特定时间点或期限
patterns.context: 立陶宛语中与“当时/那段时间”有关的表达；另有葡萄牙语« antes»4« do»6« in»6«íc»4«io»2« da»9（开始之前）和« antes»1…« da»9« part»2«ida»1（出发之前），以及英语« within»9（在……范围内）
patterns.domain: 多语种议会发言、法律文本、文学散文

patterns.name: 法律或程序中的正式固定表达
patterns.trigger: « within»9« the»4 standard of care；« Pa»5«.»2«R»4«.»7«A»9«.»6«P»4«.»5« 9»102；« within»9« the»5 fair intendment
patterns.context: 法律意见或诉讼材料中的正式判断、法规引述和范围限定

patterns.name: 议会发言中的欧洲议会、会议与致谢词汇
patterns.trigger: « Parlamento»3、« Parlamento Europeu、« Pres»1idência、« sess»4«ão»1、« ag»3«rade»4«cer
patterns.context: 讨论议会事务、会议进程或向议员致谢的发言；激活还出现在相关词的词内片段

patterns.name: 立陶宛语长词内部片段
patterns.trigger: « aug»2« ia»3、« omen»3、« ib»3«rov»4«im»3«ą»2；« s»3«ute»7…« pag»4«al»4
patterns.context: 激活分布于立陶宛语连续文本中的词内子词片段，未显示稳定的单一语义词触发条件

patterns.name: 葡萄牙语哲学术语及笛卡尔
patterns.context: 哲学论述中谈论知识及《谈谈方法》第二部分；强激活落在“宣示/表述”词的内部片段

patterns.name: 判例标题中的姓名与日期
patterns.context: 法律案件日历页的标题、法官和日期栏；强激活在法官姓名的词内片段

patterns.name: 英文叙述中的 within 限定地点
patterns.context: 描述某处附近一定距离范围内的自然或人工景观

patterns.name: 非解释性零散触发
patterns.trigger: «e»5«urų»（立陶宛语“欧元”相关词内片段）；« g»5«ost»1«aria»3（葡萄牙语“想要”相关词内片段）
patterns.context: 分别出现在发展援助讨论和议会发言中，和其他高激活片段没有清晰共同的局部语义条件

en.description: The clearest triggers are Pa.R.A.P. rule citations, within, and the Lithuanian word-initial fragment laik-; there are also side in English outside, several articles, and sporadic word sequences across domains, which cannot be grouped into a unified semantic pattern.

patterns.name: High response on “la” within words
patterns.context: Strong responses fall near the short strings “la” or “laik” in continuous text; in the first two examples, “la” begins Lithuanian “laiką/laikas,” while in the third it falls on the end of “side” in English “outside of.” They are not the same word or meaning.
patterns.domain: Lithuanian parliamentary texts, English forum posts

patterns.name: Rule-number symbols in legal citations
patterns.context: Responses concentrate on formal citation strings composed of court-rule abbreviations and periods; nearby text concerns appeals and timely filing of a notice of appeal. A specific rule number follows the citation.

patterns.name: Temporal or scope use of “within”
patterns.context: The trigger is within, but the meanings differ: one example requires requesting a refund within 90 days after receiving an electronic text; another refers to the scope of whether professional standards were met.

patterns.name: Article “the” at the beginning of a sentence
patterns.context: The response falls on the and the start of the following noun phrase, in a sentence or legal argument fragment; it is not strong, and the article is unmarked in many places.

patterns.name: Legal procedure and judgment language
patterns.context: Several passages contain procedural terms such as appeal, legal test, summary judgment, or defense, but the specific marked locations vary. These phrases do not show a stable correspondence with strong activation.

patterns.name: Word sequences about funding and aid in Lithuanian parliamentary texts
patterns.context: In an EU parliamentary context, the text discusses development aid to Africa; markings are scattered within Lithuanian words, with the strongest point on “la.”

patterns.name: European Parliament speeches and session-related word sequences
patterns.context: A Portuguese parliamentary speech asks whether the European Parliament or the French presidency is responsible for filming and requests a reply before the meeting begins; response locations are scattered.

patterns.name: Word sequences related to knowledge and Descartes in philosophical text
patterns.context: Portuguese philosophical discussion of the nature of knowledge and Descartes’s account at the beginning of Part Two of Discourse on the Method; the marked locations fall in different words.

patterns.name: Electronic-text refund clause
patterns.context: States that a description must be submitted within 90 days of receiving an electronic text if a defect is found, in order to obtain a refund; apart from within, other words show no clear shared trigger.
