patterns.name: Pool repair and board approval testimony
patterns.context: Legal testimony recounts a former director, a board chair, and a contractor; only weak markings appear near two instances of without, with no clear stable pattern.

patterns.name: Politics and surveillance in a forum post
patterns.context: A Hacker News comment discusses Trump, television surveillance, and an Orwellian situation; markings concentrate on outside of rather than topic words.

6_201.description: 最清楚的触发是规则引文中的Pa.R.A.P.编号、within，以及立陶宛语laik-词首；另有英语outside中的side、若干冠词及多领域零散词串，无法归为统一语义模式。

patterns.name: “la”处于词内的高响应
patterns.context: 强响应都落在连续文本中的短字符串“la”或“laik”附近；前两例中“la”是立陶宛语“laiką/laikas”的词首，第三例则落在英语“outside of”中的“side”末尾，不能归为同一词或语义。
patterns.domain: 立陶宛语议会文本、英语论坛发言

patterns.name: 法律引文中的规则编号符号
patterns.context: 响应集中在法院规则缩写与点号构成的正式引文串中，附近涉及上诉及及时提交上诉通知；编号后还接具体规则号。

patterns.name: 句中“within”的时间或范围用法
patterns.trigger: [2] «within»6 90 days … «within»9« that»6«↵»2«time»4；[6] «within»9« the»4 standard of care
patterns.context: 触发词是within，但语义不同：一例规定收到电子文本后90天内提出退款，一例表示是否符合专业标准的范围。
patterns.domain: 电子文本许可条款、法律证词

patterns.name: 文档句首的冠词“the”
patterns.trigger: [3] « the»1 evidence；[6] « the»1 money；[8] « the»5 affirmative defense
patterns.context: 响应落在the及其后的名词短语开头，出现在句子或法律论证片段中；强度不高，且冠词在多处都未标记。

patterns.name: 法律程序与判决表述
patterns.trigger: [3] “timely notice of appeal”；[5] “four-part test”“timely notice of appeal”；[8] “summary judgment”“affirmative defense”
patterns.context: 多段包含上诉、法律测试、简易判决或抗辩等程序性措辞，但标记的具体触发位置并不一致，未见这些短语本身稳定对应强激活。

patterns.name: 立陶宛语议会文本中的资金与援助词串
patterns.context: 欧盟议会语境中谈及对非洲的发展援助；标记散布在立陶宛语词内，最强点为“la”。

patterns.name: 欧洲议会发言及会期相关词串
patterns.context: 葡萄牙语议会发言，询问负责拍摄影像的是欧洲议会还是法国主席团，并请求在会议开始前答复；响应落点零散。

patterns.name: 哲学文本中知识与笛卡尔相关词串
patterns.context: 葡萄牙语哲学论述，讨论知识的本质及《谈谈方法》第二部分开头的笛卡尔论述；各标记位于不同词中。

patterns.name: 电子文本退款条款
patterns.context: 说明发现电子文本缺陷后，在收到文本的90天内提交说明以获得退款；除within外，其他词未显示清晰共同触发。
patterns.domain: Project Gutenberg电子文本许可声明

patterns.name: 泳池维修与董事会审批证词
patterns.context: 法律证词叙述前董事、董事会主席及承包商；两个without附近仅出现低强度标记，未构成明显稳定模式。

patterns.name: 论坛发言中的政治与监控话题
patterns.context: HackerNews评论谈论特朗普、电视监控及奥威尔式情境；标记集中于outside of，而非主题词。

en.description: Activation spans Lithuanian, Portuguese, and English legal texts, mainly falling on short segmented subwords, word-internal fragments, and a few function words; it also involves names and dates, line breaks, and legal citation formats. The passages lack stable shared meanings or topical triggers.

patterns.name: Lithuanian word-internal subword activation
patterns.context: In continuous Lithuanian text, words are split into multiple subword tokens; triggers fall within words, often on suffixes or stem fragments. These examples do not establish a single semantic condition.

patterns.name: Letter/word fragments in Portuguese philosophical text
patterns.context: In Portuguese philosophical discussion, activation is scattered across common short words and word-internal fragments split by tokenization, especially in contexts such as “Descartes enuncia no início da segunda parte”; no stable semantic trigger is apparent.

patterns.name: Word-internal fragments in Portuguese parliamentary text
patterns.context: In Portuguese parliamentary speeches, activation is distributed across ordinary words and internal subwords in phrases such as “início da sessão”; it shares Portuguese and some common fragments with paragraph 3, but the contexts differ.

patterns.name: Legal-document layout and name/date fragments
patterns.context: In formatted fields such as appellate case captions, party names, calendar dates, and judges’ signatures, names are split into mixed-case fragments; line breaks and separator tokens are also activated.
patterns.domain: FreeLaw, court opinion title pages/case headers

patterns.name: Character fragments in legal rule citations
patterns.context: When appellate documents cite procedural rule numbers, activation falls on fragments comprising rule abbreviations, periods, letters, and digits.

patterns.name: Word-internal fragments and function words in ordinary English
patterns.context: In legal argumentation, activation falls on ordinary English function words or word fragments, appearing in discussions of contracts/standards of care and assessments of juror credibility; the content differs.

patterns.name: Rare word fragments in statutory interpretation
patterns.context: When discussing the literal meaning of statutes and legislative intent, triggers occur in word-internal fragments in “rare cases” and “drafters.”

patterns.name: Word-internal fragments in a Portuguese account of nuclear weapons
patterns.context: In Portuguese statements about public information and nuclear-weapons production, triggers are distributed across words such as “encerrou,” “uma parte,” and “da produção.”

6_201.concept: 跨语种子词与格式片段
6_201.description: 激活跨立陶宛语、葡萄牙语和英语法律文本，主要落在分词后的短子词、词内片段及少量功能词；还涉及姓名日期、换行和法律引证格式。各段缺少稳定共享的词义或主题触发条件。

patterns.name: 立陶宛语词内子词激活
patterns.context: 立陶宛语连续文本中，词被切分为多个子词 token；触发落在词内，常见于词尾或词根片段，无法从这些例子确认单一词义条件。

patterns.name: 葡萄牙语哲学文本中的字母/词片段
patterns.context: 葡萄牙语哲学论述中，激活分散在常见短词及被分词切开的词内片段，尤其出现在“Descartes enuncia no início da segunda parte”等语境；看不出稳定的语义触发词。

patterns.name: 葡萄牙语议会文本中的词内片段
patterns.context: 葡萄牙语议会发言中，激活分布于“início da sessão”等普通词及词内子词；与第3段共享葡语及若干常见片段，但语境不同。

patterns.name: 法律文书排版与姓名/日期片段
patterns.context: 上诉案件标题、当事人姓名、日历日期及法官署名等格式化字段中，姓名被切成大小写混合片段；也激活换行、分隔线 token。
patterns.domain: FreeLaw，法院意见书标题页/案头信息

patterns.name: 法律引用编号中的字符片段
patterns.context: 上诉文书引用程序规则编号时，激活规则简称和点号、字母、数字等切分片段。

patterns.name: 英语普通词的词内片段及功能词
patterns.context: 法律论证正文中，激活落在普通英语功能词或词片段；出现于合同/标准照护论述及陪审员可信度判断，内容并不相同。

patterns.name: 法律条文解释中的罕见词片段
patterns.context: 讨论法条字面含义及立法者意图时，触发出现在“rare cases”“drafters”中的词内片段。

patterns.name: 葡语核武器叙述中的词内片段
patterns.context: 有关国家公开信息及核武器生产的葡语陈述中，触发分布于“encerrou”“uma parte”“da produção”等词。

en.concept: multilingual short morphemes and word fragments
en.description: Activation is scattered across short words and word-internal fragments in multiple languages and genres: Portuguese, Polish, and Lithuanian fragments are dense; English includes words such as outside and within and sporadic function words, alongside numerical amounts, legal headings, and parts of poems. There is no unified semantic explanation.

patterns.name: Portuguese function words and word-internal morphemes
patterns.context: In Portuguese texts, articles, contracted prepositions, and internal fragments of common words are marked; they often occur in continuous text, and some activations cross word boundaries.
patterns.domain: Portuguese philosophical discussion, European Union parliamentary materials

patterns.name: Polish and Lithuanian word-internal fragments
patterns.context: Multiple short fragments occur densely within morphologically rich Polish or Lithuanian words; no clear semantic or syntactic trigger is apparent.

patterns.name: English outside
patterns.context: Occurs in English phrases indicating beyond a scope or into a region; the surrounding topics differ between the two examples.

patterns.name: English within
patterns.context: Occurs in English phrases referring to an internal location or scope; one example is a literary verse, and another involves an editorial-room scene.

patterns.name: Numbers, amounts, and years
patterns.context: Years, quantities, and currency fragments in numerical or monetary expressions are marked.

patterns.name: Court-document formatting and names
patterns.context: Activation occurs in document-format fields such as capitalized name headings, dates, and judges’ titles.
patterns.domain: FreeLaw legal opinions or case files

patterns.name: English possessive and title fragments
patterns.context: Pronouns, demonstratives, and prepositional fragments in poetic lines are marked, with no stable semantic condition apparent.

patterns.name: English word-form and function-word fragments
patterns.context: Common short words or internal fragments occur sporadically in English verse, without forming a clear pattern with other activations in the same passage.

patterns.name: English ordinary word fragments
patterns.context: Occur separately in the contraction “can’t” and “departments,” with no apparent shared meaning or contextual condition.

patterns.name: Unclear local English activations
patterns.context: Occur in English forum posts, but their connection to other English patterns or clear semantic conditions is unclear.

patterns.name: Indoor/interior imagery in poetry
patterns.context: Related to indoor locations or interior space, but in paragraph 9 it can also mean the more abstract “inner self”; it may be related to the spatial sense in paragraph 8.

6_201.concept: 多语种短语素与词片段
6_201.description: 激活散布于多语种、不同文体的短词与词内片段：葡语、波兰语和立陶宛语碎片较密集；英语中有 outside、within 等词及零散功能词，另见数字金额、法律标题和诗歌局部。缺乏统一语义解释。

patterns.name: 葡萄牙语虚词及词内语素
patterns.context: 葡萄牙语文本中，冠词、介词缩合及常见词内部片段被标记；常处于连续文本中，部分激活跨越词边界。
patterns.domain: 葡萄牙语哲学论述、欧盟议会材料

patterns.name: 波兰语及立陶宛语词内片段
patterns.context: 波兰语或立陶宛语的形态丰富词语中，多个短片段在词内密集出现；未见明显语义或句法触发条件。

patterns.name: 英文 outside
patterns.context: 出现在英语短语中，表示超出某种范围或进入某种地域；两例周围文本主题并不相同。

patterns.name: 英文 within
patterns.context: 出现在表示内部位置或范围的英语短语中；一例为文学诗句，一例含编辑室场景。

patterns.name: 数字、金额与年份
patterns.context: 数字或金额表达中的年份、数量级及货币词片段被标记。

patterns.name: 法庭文书格式与人名
patterns.context: 标题式大写人名、日期和法官称谓等文书格式字段中出现激活。

patterns.name: 英语所有格与称谓片段
patterns.context: 诗歌行文中的代词、指示词及介词片段被标记，未显示稳定的语义条件。

patterns.name: 英语词形和功能词片段
patterns.context: 英语诗句中常见短词或词内片段零散出现，未能与同段其他激活归为明确模式。

patterns.name: 英语普通词片段
patterns.context: 分别出现在缩写形式“can’t”和“departments”中，缺乏明显共同语义或上下文条件。

patterns.name: 未明的英语局部激活
patterns.context: 出现于英文论坛帖子中，但与其余英文模式或明确语义条件的联系不清楚。

patterns.name: 诗歌中的室内/内在意象
patterns.context: 与室内位置或内部空间相关，但在第9段也可作较抽象的“内心”用法；可能与第8段的空间义相关。

en.concept: Local word forms and phrase fragments
en.description: Activations occur mainly in Portuguese phrases such as “início da” and name fragments beginning with Gar; they also occur on within and farthest recesses in British parliamentary narratives. Trigger conditions span different languages and styles.

patterns.name: Phrase-initial fragment in Portuguese
patterns.context: Activation falls near Portuguese “início da” and the following noun phrase; neighboring words such as “enuncia” are sometimes also marked.

patterns.name: Gar surname fragment
patterns.context: A proper name begins with Gar, with activation concentrated on part of a surname or personal name; examples occur in legal names, biographical introductions, and author metadata.
patterns.domain: Legal documents, literary prefaces, web comments, academic metadata

patterns.name: British Parliament and journalism narrative
patterns.context: Describes the work and activities during recess of a member of parliament who is also a journalist, in a British Parliament / Westminster setting.

6_201.description: 主要激活于葡语“início da”一类短语及以 Gar 开头的人名片段；另在英国议会叙述中激活于 within、farthest recesses 等词。触发条件跨语言、文体不一。

patterns.name: 葡语中的短语起始片段
patterns.trigger: «en»7«unc»1«ia»2« no»2« in»5«íc»3«io»1« da»10« seg»2«unda»6；« in»7«íc»4«io»3« da»9« sess»4ão；« in»8«íc»3««io»2« a»6
patterns.context: 激活落在葡语中「início da」及其后续名词短语附近；有时连「enuncia」等邻近词也被标记。

patterns.name: Gar 姓氏片段
patterns.context: 专名以 Gar 开头，激活集中于姓氏或姓名的一部分；见于法律姓名、人物介绍及作者元数据。
patterns.domain: 法律文书、文学前言、网页评论、学术元数据

patterns.name: 英国议会与新闻工作叙述
patterns.context: 描述议员兼记者在英国议会／威斯敏斯特环境中的工作与休会期间活动。

en.concept: function words in prepositional and article phrases
en.description: Activation concentrates in prepositional phrases and their following constituents, especially English in/within; it also includes Portuguese da and uma, Italian la, and the fixed expression “All in all.” Grammatical triggers across languages are not entirely uniform.

patterns.name: Local collocations following in/within
patterns.context: Within English prepositional phrases or immediately followed by a noun/determiner; common examples include “in further proof,” “within the standard,” and “within your hands.”
patterns.domain: English poetry, legal texts, commentary, historical narrative, and online texts

patterns.name: Portuguese da phrases
patterns.context: In Portuguese “do início da segunda parte” or “antes do início da sessão,” da introduces a definite noun phrase; tokenization also highlights a word-internal fragment of início.
patterns.domain: Portuguese philosophical text, European Parliament speeches

patterns.name: Portuguese feminine singular uma
patterns.context: The Portuguese indefinite article uma followed by a noun or occurring within a noun phrase.

patterns.name: Italian feminine article la
patterns.context: In Italian “per la sua relazione,” the article la introduces a feminine noun phrase.

patterns.name: English phrase all in all
patterns.context: The fixed summarizing expression “All in all,” appearing at the end of a comment.

6_201.concept: 介词与冠词短语中的功能词
6_201.description: 激活集中在介词短语及其后续成分，尤其英语 in/within；另有葡语 da、uma、意大利语 la 等冠词，以及“All in all”固定表达。多语语法触发并不完全统一。

patterns.name: 介词 in/within 后的局部搭配
patterns.trigger: « in»、« within»，以及相邻的 « the»、« your»、« those»
patterns.context: 英语中介词短语内部或其后紧跟名词/限定词；常见于“in further proof”“within the standard”“within your hands”等。
patterns.domain: 英语诗歌、法律、评论、历史叙述及网络文本

patterns.name: 葡语定冠词 da 短语
patterns.trigger: « da»10，前有 « in»6、«íc»4，后接 « seg»/« sess»
patterns.context: 葡语“do início da segunda parte”或“antes do início da sessão”中，da 引出特定名词短语；切分 token 还突出 início 的词内片段。
patterns.domain: 葡语哲学文本、欧洲议会发言

patterns.name: 葡语阴性单数 uma
patterns.trigger: « uma»，分别出现在“uma parte da produção”和“uma resposta”中
patterns.context: 葡语不定冠词 uma 后接名词，或处于名词短语中。

patterns.name: 意大利语阴性冠词 la
patterns.context: 意大利语“per la sua relazione”中，冠词 la 引出阴性名词短语。

patterns.name: 英语短语 all in all
patterns.context: 固定总结表达“All in all”，位于评论末尾。

en.description: Activation locations are dispersed: Portuguese articles and prepositions, French scope expressions, and prepositional phrases such as within/outside, along with local words in literary and legal texts. Some examples fall at sentence ends or formatting boundaries, making them difficult to group into a unified semantic pattern.

patterns.name: Frequent sentence-initial/final structures in Portuguese phrases
patterns.context: Articles, prepositions, and sentence-initial/final phrases in Portuguese syntax; activation falls within multiple phrases and does not form a single fixed collocation.

patterns.name: Portuguese “da” and references to sections of a work
patterns.context: In discussion of Descartes and his work, refers to the beginning of Part Two of “Discurso.”

patterns.name: within your hands
patterns.context: After a spoiler warning, “within your hands” expresses that choice or responsibility lies with the reader.

patterns.name: outside the Center
patterns.context: Describes people outside a center who hope to establish a collaboration with the research center.

patterns.name: outside the scope
patterns.context: Means something is beyond the scope while discussing the responsibilities of a university IT department.

patterns.name: within the next decade
patterns.context: Predicts the arrival of solar rooftop panels within the next decade.

patterns.name: French scope phrase
patterns.context: The scope of EU rules and the marketing and use of mercury-containing measuring devices.

patterns.name: “within” and “voice” in poetry
patterns.context: Poetry describes a voice or grief inside a house or within oneself; activation is concentrated mainly on within.

patterns.name: Sentence-final ship phrase
patterns.context: In colloquial dialogue, a character says they are the last person on board anyway; a line break splits the word.

patterns.name: Legal case names and date/name fields
patterns.context: Formatting fields such as appellate case captions, calendar dates, and trial judges’ names.

6_201.description: 激活位置分散：有葡语冠词介词、法语辖域表达，也有 within/outside 等介词短语及文学、法律文本中的局部词语。部分样例落在句末或格式切分处，难以归为统一语义模式。

patterns.name: 葡语短语中的句首/句末高频结构
patterns.trigger: “da sess”之前的“da”10；“antes do início da”与“segunda parte”“Discurso”前后；“em”, “o”, “responsável”, “pela”, “captação”；“Presidente”及换行标记
patterns.context: 葡语句法中冠词、介词及句首/句末词组；激活落在多个短语内部，不构成单一固定搭配

patterns.name: 葡语中的“da”与作品分部表述
patterns.context: 讨论笛卡尔及其著作时，出现“Discurso”第二部分开头的指称

patterns.name: within your hands
patterns.context: 剧透警告后，以“within your hands”表达选择权或责任归于读者

patterns.name: outside the Center
patterns.context: 描述希望与研究中心建立合作的中心外人员

patterns.name: outside the scope
patterns.context: 谈论大学 IT 部门职责范围时，表示某事超出范围

patterns.name: within the next decade
patterns.context: 预测太阳能屋顶板在未来十年内出现

patterns.name: 法语辖域短语
patterns.trigger: “dans la mesure où”；后续“dans toute la Communauté”中的“la”9
patterns.context: 欧盟规则适用范围及含汞测量设备的商业化和使用

patterns.name: 诗歌中的“within”与“voice”
patterns.context: 诗歌描写屋内或内心的声音、哀伤；激活主要集中在 within

patterns.name: 句末船只短语
patterns.trigger: “end of the”中的“the”9；另有“next”7及句首换行后的“y”
patterns.context: 口语化对话中人物说自己反正是船上的最后一人；换行切分词语

patterns.name: 法律案名与日期/姓名
patterns.trigger: “Gar”9（姓名 Garry 被切分）；日期“June 4, 2015”及判决书格式标记
patterns.context: 上诉案件标题、日历日期、审判法官姓名等排版字段

en.description: The clearest repeated pattern is the English phrase outside the (and outside the scope/territory), used to indicate something beyond a range or domain. Other activations are scattered across Portuguese word-internal fragments, several English in sequences, and isolated words, with no unified semantic explanation.

patterns.name: outside the scope/territory
patterns.context: “outside” introduces something beyond a domain, scope, territory, or institution; activation is on the phrase around “outside the …”
patterns.domain: informal online discussion, research administration, scientific prose

patterns.name: Portuguese word-internal segmentation near phrase or clause boundaries
patterns.context: Activations fall on subword pieces within ordinary Portuguese words, especially around phrase or clause transitions; no consistent semantic trigger is evident
patterns.domain: European Parliament proceedings and Portuguese-language philosophy text

patterns.name: English ‘in the’ / ‘in’ continuation
patterns.context: A weak, inconsistent response to English prepositional or sentence-initial ‘in’ sequences, with no single shared continuation
patterns.domain: online discussion, grant-administration text, recipe/newsletter text

patterns.name: Other isolated English phrase tokens
patterns.context: One-off activations occur on ordinary words or fragments without a clear common contextual condition
patterns.domain: mixed: online discussion, philosophy, scientific prose, parliamentary text

6_201.description: 最清楚的重复模式是英语短语 outside the（及 outside the scope/territory），出现在表示超出某范围时。其余激活分散于葡语词内片段，以及多种英语 in 序列和孤立词，缺乏统一语义解释。

patterns.name: outside the scope/territory
patterns.trigger: «outside» followed by «the»; [10] also has «outside» followed by “the scope”
patterns.context: “outside” introduces something beyond a domain, scope, territory, or institution; activation is on the phrase around “outside the …”
patterns.domain: informal online discussion, research administration, scientific prose

patterns.name: Portuguese word-internal segmentation near phrase or clause boundaries
patterns.context: Activations fall on subword pieces within ordinary Portuguese words, especially around phrase or clause transitions; no consistent semantic trigger is evident
patterns.domain: European Parliament proceedings and Portuguese-language philosophy text

patterns.name: English ‘in the’ / ‘in’ continuation
patterns.context: A weak, inconsistent response to English prepositional or sentence-initial ‘in’ sequences, with no single shared continuation
patterns.domain: online discussion, grant-administration text, recipe/newsletter text

patterns.name: Other isolated English phrase tokens
patterns.context: One-off activations occur on ordinary words or fragments without a clear common contextual condition
patterns.domain: mixed: online discussion, philosophy, scientific prose, parliamentary text

en.description: Responses are scattered across English scope constructions with outside the/of and within the, Portuguese da and forms of encerrar, as well as split uppercase draft and confidentiality labels in email; the shared mechanism is unclear.

patterns.name: English collocation “outside the …”
patterns.context: Activation centers on scope-setting structures following outside, commonly “outside of + noun” or “outside the + noun”; a line break may intervene between the two.

patterns.name: Scope limitation with within the
patterns.context: within is followed by the and a noun denoting a limit, period, or scope, as in “within the limits,” “within the next decade,” and “within those…”; words may span line breaks.

patterns.name: Portuguese “da”
patterns.context: In Portuguese, contraction of de + a, occurring in noun phrases such as “início da sessão” and “início da segunda parte.”

patterns.name: Phrasal verb encerrar
patterns.context: An internal fragment of the Portuguese past-tense verb encerrar, in a context about ending or shutting down part of nuclear-weapons production.

patterns.name: English drafts and confidentiality labels
patterns.context: Uppercase, split label words in email subject lines and attorney-client confidentiality notices; activation is distributed across repeated labels such as DRAFT and PRIVILEGED.

6_201.description: 反应分散于英语 outside the/of 与 within the 范围结构、葡萄牙语 da 及 encerrar 词形，还包括邮件中拆分的大写草稿和保密标签；共同机制不明确。

patterns.name: 英文搭配“outside the …”
patterns.context: 激活集中在 outside 后的范围界定结构，常见形式为“outside of + 名词”或“outside the + 名词”；相邻换行可能插入二者之间。
patterns.domain: HackerNews 评论、机构研究介绍

patterns.name: within the 限定范围
patterns.context: within 后接 the 和表示界限、时段或范围的名词，如“within the limits”“within the next decade”“within those…”；词语可跨行。

patterns.name: 葡萄牙语“da”
patterns.context: 在葡萄牙语句中作为 de + a 的缩合形式，出现在“início da sessão”“início da segunda parte”等名词短语中。
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会葡萄牙语、哲学论述

patterns.name: 短语动词 encerrar
patterns.context: 葡萄牙语过去时动词 encerrar 的词内片段，语境为结束或关闭核武器生产的一部分。

patterns.name: 英文草稿及保密标记
patterns.context: 邮件主题及律师客户保密声明中的大写、拆分标记词；激活分布在重复的 DRAFT 和 PRIVILEGED 等标签上。

en.concept: local phrases near prepositions and articles
en.description: The strongest activations often fall on function words or near prepositions such as da, the, la, outside, and within, and are also distributed across languages and genres. Some examples involve scope expressions, while parliamentary texts show another cluster; there is no unified meaning or fixed collocation.

patterns.name: Ten or its expanded forms
patterns.context: Activation centers often fall within prepositional or article phrases, especially da, the, outside, and la; surrounding collocations vary widely, with no single fixed phrase apparent.

patterns.name: Multiword fragments in local continuations
patterns.context: High-activation points occur locally within longer phrases; some examples show morphological or subword segmentation, but the contextual meanings differ.
patterns.domain: Parliamentary speeches, philosophical texts, historical narratives, and English discussions, among others

patterns.name: Boundary or scope expressions
patterns.context: Outside/within indicates being beyond or inside a scope; examples include both metaphorical scopes and physical or narrative boundaries. It is unclear whether this is a stable semantic pattern distinct from the highly activated function words.
patterns.domain: Online comments, physics papers, entertainment discussions, and literary texts

patterns.name: Legislative and procedural language in parliamentary texts
patterns.context: Several occurrences are in Portuguese or French European Parliament texts and are adjacent to phrases about meetings, production, the Community, and voting; these texts share a genre but no obvious fixed collocation.

6_201.concept: 介词与冠词附近的局部词组
6_201.description: 最强激活常落在 da、the、la、outside、within 等功能词或介词附近，也分布于多语种、多文体。部分例子涉及范围表达，议会文本则另有聚集；缺少统一语义或固定搭配。

patterns.name: 十或其扩展形式
patterns.context: 激活中心多落在介词或冠词短语中，尤其是 da、the、outside、la；周边搭配差异很大，未显示单一固定短语。
patterns.domain: 跨领域、跨语种及多种文体

patterns.name: 局部续写中的多词片段
patterns.trigger: « in»7«íc»3«io»2« da»10« sess»4«ão»1（[1]）；« in»5«íc»2«io»1« da»10« seg»2«unda»8« parte»1（[2]）；« enc»7«err»6«ou»3« uma»3 parte« da»10« produ»2ção（[5]）；« dans»4« toute»2« la»10« Commun»1auté（[8]）；« Within»9« the»8 limits« of»3（[10]）
patterns.context: 高激活点在较长词组的局部位置；有些例子显示形态或子词切分，但上下文意义各异。
patterns.domain: 议会发言、哲学文本、历史叙述及英文讨论等

patterns.name: 边界或范围表达
patterns.context: 以 outside/within 表示处于某范围之外或之内；实例既包括比喻性的范围，也有物理或叙述边界，不能确定这是独立于高激活功能词的稳定语义模式。
patterns.domain: 网络评论、物理学论文、娱乐讨论及文学文本

patterns.name: 议会文本中的立法与程序用语
patterns.trigger: « da»10« sess»ão（[1]）；« da»10« produ»ção（[5]）；« la»10« Commun»auté（[8]）；« da»9 v«ota»ção（[9]）
patterns.context: 多处出现在欧洲议会葡萄牙语或法语文本中，并与会议、生产、共同体、表决等词组相邻；这些语料共享文体，但不共享明显的固定搭配。

en.description: Activations often fall on prepositions or prepositional phrases across languages: Portuguese da, English in, outside, of the, and French dans la. They often express scope, location, or relations, but also occur alongside sporadic word fragments and punctuation activations.

patterns.name: Portuguese “da / in / início” within words and phrases
patterns.context: In continuous Portuguese text, strong activation centers on the article/preposition fragment «da» and occurs in phrases such as “da segunda parte do Discurso”; the segmented word “início” also appears in the same passage.

patterns.name: Portuguese “da” and internal fragments
patterns.context: In Portuguese parliamentary text, «da» occurs in the structure “uma parte da produção”; there is also activation on an internal fragment of “encerrou.”

patterns.name: “in” in an English phrase
patterns.context: In an English sentence, «in» occurs in the prepositional phrase “the final piece in the puzzle”; the context discusses wages and living space.

patterns.name: Portuguese sentence-final prepositional phrase and line-break marker
patterns.context: A parliamentary text requests a response before the meeting begins; «da» in “início da sessão” is strongly activated, followed by a line break and form of address.

patterns.name: English “outside of”
patterns.context: In “well outside of … territory,” «outside» and «of» are strongly activated; there is also an isolated «↵»3 and weak «in»2.

patterns.name: English “outside the”
patterns.context: “outside the Center” means outside the center; nearby «in» has low activation.

patterns.name: English “outside a”
patterns.context: In “lie outside a single-particle description,” means beyond the scope of a particular description; «lie» is also weakly activated.

patterns.name: English “of the”
patterns.context: Noun phrase in “my own end of the ship”; other activations in the passage are scattered across dialogue and punctuation.

patterns.name: English “in line with”
patterns.context: In the rhetorical question “Is that really in line with your green approach?”, «in» occurs in a fixed prepositional phrase.

patterns.name: French “dans la”
patterns.context: In formal French text, «dans la» introduces a scope or location; related word fragments of “mesure” also occur.

6_201.description: 激活常落在多语种介词或介词短语：葡语da，英语in、outside、of the，法语dans la；多见于范围、位置、关系表达，但也伴随零散词段和标点激活。

patterns.name: 葡语词内与短语中的“da / in / início”
patterns.context: 葡语连续文本中，强激活集中在冠词/介词词段«da»，并出现在“da segunda parte do Discurso”一类短语；同段还有被切分的“início”。

patterns.name: 葡语中的“da”及词内片段
patterns.context: 葡语议会文本中，«da»位于“uma parte da produção”结构；另有“encerrou”的词内片段激活。

patterns.name: 英语短语中的“in”
patterns.context: 英语句子中，«in»处于“the final piece in the puzzle”这样的介词短语；上下文谈工资与生活空间。

patterns.name: 葡语句末介词短语与换行标记
patterns.context: 议会文本请求在会议开始前答复；“início da sessão”中的«da»强激活，随后有换行及称谓。

patterns.name: 英语“outside of”
patterns.context: 短语“well outside of … territory”中，«outside»和«of»强激活；另有孤立的«↵»3及轻微«in»2。

patterns.name: 英语“outside the”
patterns.context: “outside the Center”中表示位于中心之外；附近还有低强度«in»。

patterns.name: 英语“outside a”
patterns.context: “lie outside a single-particle description”中表示超出某种描述范围；«lie»也有轻微激活。

patterns.name: 英语“of the”
patterns.context: “my own end of the ship”中的名词短语；该段其余激活分散在口语对白及标点上。

patterns.name: 英语“in line with”
patterns.context: 修辞性提问“Is that really in line with your green approach?”中，«in»处于固定介词短语。
patterns.domain: 网络论坛中的环保倡议（HackerNews）

patterns.name: 法语“dans la”
patterns.context: 法语正式文本中，«dans la»引出适用范围或地点；还出现“mesure”相关词段。

en.description: The most consistent pattern is “supernatants” in biomedical experiments (culture or sample supernatants). The remaining activations are sporadic across subword fragments, punctuation, line breaks, numbers, and ordinary function words, with no clear shared semantics.

patterns.name: Experimental sample supernatants
patterns.context: In descriptions of experiments involving cell cultures, blood, or other biological samples, refers to supernatant collected after centrifugation or culturing for analysis or use in experiments.
patterns.domain: Biomedical papers and research project texts

patterns.name: Specific English word forms or subword fragments
patterns.context: Triggers occur at word beginnings, word endings, or in complete words, with no consistent syntactic or semantic context. Some relate to scientific texts, while others occur in emails, patents, and literary texts.

patterns.name: Colon punctuation
patterns.context: Appears after a phrase or title-like text. In one of two examples, it follows “Crosby's vow”; in the other, it introduces a research objective in a scientific text.

patterns.name: Line breaks and em-dash separators
patterns.context: A line break follows a long string of dashes, followed by the opening of an email-style message.

patterns.name: Numbers and apostrophe characters
patterns.context: Appears in the short phrase “Crosby's vow: No repeating '13'” and does not recur in other snippets.

patterns.name: Preposition by
patterns.context: Occurs in the fixed promotional phrase “brought to you by”.

patterns.name: Conjunctions and articles
patterns.context: Appear in ordinary syntactic structures in an immunology description and patent background, with no shared unusual context.

6_203.concept: 科研文本中的上清液
6_203.description: 最一致的模式是生物医学实验中“supernatants”（培养或样本上清液）；其余激活零散落在词片段、标点、换行、数字及普通功能词上，未形成明确共同语义。

patterns.name: 实验样本上清液
patterns.context: 细胞培养、血液或其他生物样本的实验描述中，指离心或培养后收集、分析或用于实验的上清液。
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文及科研项目文本

patterns.name: 特定英文词形或子词片段
patterns.trigger: «C»（Crosby's）、«leukocytes»中的« leukocytes»、«al»（mammal 的词尾）、« tau»、«Most»、« battery»、«Analy»
patterns.context: 触发分布于词首、词尾或完整词，未见一致的句法或语义上下文；部分与科学文本有关，另有邮件、专利和文学文本。
patterns.domain: 跨领域文本；规律不明确

patterns.name: 冒号标点
patterns.context: 出现在短语或标题性文本之后；两例中一例邻接“Crosby's vow”，另一例在科研文本中引出研究目的。
patterns.domain: 文学/一般文本与科研文本

patterns.name: 换行与长横线分隔符
patterns.context: 长串横线后紧接换行，随后出现邮件式正文开头。

patterns.name: 数字与撇号字符
patterns.context: 出现在“Crosby's vow: No repeating '13'”这一短句中，未在其他片段复现。

patterns.name: 介词 by
patterns.context: 处于“brought to you by”这一固定宣传语中。

patterns.name: 连接词及冠词
patterns.context: 分别出现在免疫学描述和专利背景的普通句法结构中，缺少共同的特殊语境。

en.concept: Biological experimental supernatants and miscellaneous triggers
en.description: The most stable pattern is activation on “supernatants” in biomedical experimental contexts; other activations occur on email separators, title fragments, database phrases, speaker-patent statements, and word endings in research responsibilities.

patterns.name: “supernatants” in biological experiments
patterns.context: Appears in cell culture, sample processing, or experimental testing contexts, often referring to culture medium or supernatant after centrifugation; related words include “culture,” “cells,” “protein,” and “collected”.

patterns.name: Long-dash separator
patterns.context: A long string of hyphens used as a separator in email content or formatting, followed by a newline.

patterns.name: Title-like colon and quoted fragments
patterns.context: Appears in discontinuous text fragments with titles, phrases, and line breaks; activation is distributed across punctuation, numbers, and word beginnings.
patterns.domain: Web- or book-related text; exact context unclear

patterns.name: Database documentation phrase
patterns.context: At the beginning of the noun phrase “Database documentation of marine mammal stranding”.

patterns.name: Battery-powered speakers
patterns.context: At the beginning of a sentence summarizing the situation for most battery-powered speakers on the market.

patterns.name: Word ending in “Analyze”
patterns.context: Appears in a research project responsibilities list, describing the analysis and interpretation of data.

6_203.concept: 生物实验上清液及杂项触发
6_203.description: 最稳定的模式是在生物医学实验语境中激活“supernatants”；其余激活分别落在邮件分隔线、标题片段、数据库短语、扬声器专利语句及科研职责中的词尾。

patterns.name: “supernatants”生物实验用语
patterns.context: 出现在细胞培养、样本处理或实验检测语境中，常指培养液或离心后上清液；相关词如“culture”“cells”“protein”“collected”。
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文与研究计划

patterns.name: 长横线分隔符
patterns.context: 长串连字符作为邮件内容或格式分隔线，后接换行。

patterns.name: 标题式冒号与引号片段
patterns.context: 出现在带标题、短语和换行的非连续文本片段中；激活分散在标点、数字和词首。
patterns.domain: 网页或书名相关文本，具体语境不明

patterns.name: 数据库文档短语
patterns.context: 位于“Database documentation of marine mammal stranding”这一名词短语开头。

patterns.name: 电池供电扬声器
patterns.context: 句首概述市场上多数电池供电扬声器的情况。

patterns.name: “Analyze”词尾
patterns.context: 出现在研究项目职责清单中，描述分析和解释数据。
patterns.domain: 科研项目计划或职责说明

en.concept: Culture supernatants and special text boundaries
en.description: Responds most strongly to “supernatants” (culture supernatants) in biomedical experimental contexts, especially their collection, testing, and cytokine analysis; it also responds once each to a database documentation title, an email separator and formulaic phrase, and numbered punctuation formatting.

patterns.name: Culture supernatants in immunology experiments
patterns.context: Refers to culture supernatants collected or analyzed after cells, immune cells, or tissue samples are cultured, stimulated, or treated; often adjacent to cytokines, interferons, or protein assays.
patterns.domain: Biomedical papers and research grant descriptions

patterns.name: Database documentation title
patterns.context: The phrase appears at the beginning of a sentence as the title or subject of database documentation about marine mammal strandings.

patterns.name: Email formula after a separator
patterns.context: A long-dash separator is followed by a newline and the email-style promotional phrase “This message is brought to you by”.

patterns.name: Punctuation and numbered title formatting
patterns.context: A colon is followed by “No repeating”, then a quoted number and a newline, resembling title, lyric, or text-fragment formatting.

6_203.concept: 培养上清及特殊文本边界
6_203.description: 主要对生物医学实验语境中的“supernatants”（培养上清）强烈响应，尤其是其收集、检测及细胞因子分析；另对数据库文档标题、邮件分隔符与套语、带编号的标点排版各有一次响应。

patterns.name: 免疫学实验中的培养上清
patterns.context: 细胞、免疫细胞或组织样本经培养、刺激或处理后，指收集或分析的培养上清；常与细胞因子、干扰素或蛋白检测相邻。
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文与研究资助项目描述

patterns.name: 数据库文档标题
patterns.context: 词组出现在句首，作为海洋哺乳动物搁浅相关数据库文档的标题或主题。

patterns.name: 分隔符后的邮件套语
patterns.context: 长横线分隔符后换行，接着出现邮件式宣传语“This message is brought to you by”。

patterns.name: 标点与编号式标题格式
patterns.context: 冒号后接“No repeating”，随后是引号内编号及换行，呈现标题、歌词或文本片段式排版。

en.description: Primarily responds to “supernatants” referring to cell culture supernatants in biomedical texts, especially experimental contexts where supernatants are collected and factors or proteins measured in them. It also responds weakly to a database-document phrase and an em-dash separator in an email.

patterns.name: Culture supernatants
patterns.context: In experiments involving immune cells, neurons, or other cell cultures, refers to liquid collected after stimulation, culturing, or treatment; commonly used to measure cytokines, interferons, inhibitory factors, or proteins.

patterns.name: Database-document wording
patterns.context: The phrase is about database documentation and is followed by content on marine mammal strandings; it does not depend on the culture-experiment context above.

patterns.name: Em-dash separator
patterns.context: The long dash and line break at the beginning of an email body activate, followed by “This message is brought to you by”; there is no apparent biomedical context.

6_203.concept: 培养上清液
6_203.description: 主要响应生物医学文本中表示细胞培养上清液的“supernatants”，尤其是收集上清并检测其中因子或蛋白的实验语境；另对数据库文档短语及邮件中的长横线分隔符有弱响应。

patterns.name: 培养上清液
patterns.context: 免疫细胞、神经元或其他细胞培养实验中，指刺激、培养或处理后收集的液体；常用于检测细胞因子、干扰素、抑制因子或蛋白质。
patterns.domain: 生物医学实验与论文方法/结果

patterns.name: 数据库文档措辞
patterns.context: 短语以数据库文档为主题，后接海洋哺乳动物搁浅相关内容；不依赖上述培养实验语境。
patterns.domain: 数据库或科研数据文档

patterns.name: 长横线分隔符
patterns.context: 邮件正文开头的长横线及换行被激活，后接“This message is brought to you by”；没有明显生物医学语境。

en.description: Primarily responds to OBJECTIVE/OBJECTIVES goal headings in academic text, and also to brief OK replies in email; activation also occurs on sentence-initial Database and widely in patent contexts.

patterns.name: OBJECTIVE heading
patterns.context: At the beginning of the objectives section in an abstract or research project description, followed by a research goal or action.
patterns.domain: PubMed, NIH project abstracts, and academic research text

patterns.name: OK in email
patterns.context: A brief email reply or opening of an email body, possibly followed by a salutation, version note, or original-message separator.

patterns.name: Database documentation
patterns.context: Appears sentence-initially, followed by documentation, referring to documentation for a specific database.

patterns.name: widely used
patterns.context: Describes a material as widely used in settings such as commercial and household applications.

6_203.concept: 文本段落标记与常见开头
6_203.description: 主要响应学术文本中 OBJECTIVE/OBJECTIVES 目标标题，也响应邮件中的 OK 简短回复；另对句首 Database 和专利语境中的 widely 有激活。

patterns.name: OBJECTIVE 标题
patterns.context: 出现在摘要或研究项目描述的目标部分开头，后接研究目的或行动。
patterns.domain: PubMed、NIH 项目摘要及学术研究文本

patterns.name: 邮件中的 OK
patterns.context: 作为简短邮件回复或邮件正文开头，后可接称呼、版本说明或原邮件分隔符。

patterns.name: Database documentation
patterns.context: 句首出现，后接 documentation，指向特定数据库的文档说明。
patterns.domain: PubMed 摘要或数据库描述

patterns.name: widely used
patterns.context: 描述某材料在商业和家庭等场景中广泛使用。

en.description: The main discernible pattern is widely modifying used. Other sporadic activations occur on an email question, a code string, medical terms, and specific subword fragments in proper nouns; there is no unified explanation yet.

patterns.name: Use of wide
patterns.context: The adverb widely modifies used, indicating that something is widely used; in both snippets it appears in a passive construction.
patterns.domain: Patent background and medical research abstracts

patterns.name: Wall at the beginning
patterns.context: Capitalized Wall appears at the start of a sentence, followed by the proper-name phrase “of the Ferme générale”; it has no clear semantic or syntactic connection to the other snippets.

patterns.name: Question and time
patterns.context: A first-person question in an email asks why something happened or became known only at a specific time.

patterns.name: Code identifier fragment
patterns.context: A split string in code or template text, containing snippet, Kohana, and Gitignore Template; the trigger position does not clearly correspond to complete word meanings.

patterns.name: Medical suffix -ant
patterns.context: The word concomitant is split in a medical title, with activation on the ending ant; the same sentence also contains medical terms such as cerebral infarction and hemorrhage.

patterns.name: Lehenga word fragment
patterns.context: The proper noun or clothing term Lehenga is split at the start of a sentence, followed by Collection and a line break; activation is concentrated on the ending ga.

patterns.name: Word endings in a medical paper
patterns.context: Nouns referring to blood cells and culture supernatants appear in a medical abstract; activation occurs in contexts involving cell experiments and interferon assays.

patterns.name: First person and clauses in email
patterns.context: In business emails, first-person I is followed by help, or that introduces a clause; these common words alone do not explain the activation.

6_203.concept: none
6_203.description: 主要可辨模式是 widely 修饰 used；另有零散激活落在邮件疑问句、代码字符串、医学词语及专名的特定词片段上，尚无统一解释。

patterns.name: wide 用法
patterns.context: 副词 widely 修饰 used，表示某物被广泛使用；在两个片段中都处于被动结构。
patterns.domain: 专利背景、医学研究摘要

patterns.name: Wall 开头
patterns.context: 句首大写的 Wall，后接专名短语“of the Ferme générale”；没有明显语义或句法联系到其他片段。

patterns.name: 疑问句与时间
patterns.context: 邮件中的第一人称疑问句，询问某事为何到具体时间才发生或被获知。

patterns.name: 代码标识符片段
patterns.context: 代码或模板文本中的被拆分字符串，含 snippet、Kohana 与 Gitignore Template；触发位置并不明显对应完整词义。

patterns.name: 医学词尾 -ant
patterns.context: 医学标题中单词 concomitant 被切分，激活落在词尾 ant；同句还出现 cerebral infarction、hemorrhage 等医学术语。

patterns.name: Lehenga 词片段
patterns.context: 句首专名或服饰词 Lehenga 被切分，后接 Collection 与换行；激活集中在词尾 ga。
patterns.domain: 网页集合/商品或文化文本

patterns.name: 医学论文中的长词尾部
patterns.context: 医学摘要中分别指血液细胞和培养上清液的名词；激活出现在细胞实验与干扰素测定语境。
patterns.domain: PubMed 生物医学研究摘要

patterns.name: 邮件中的第一人称与从句
patterns.context: 商务邮件里第一人称 I 后接 help，或 that 引导从句；这些常见词单独看不足以解释激活。

en.concept: Comparative expressions and occasional proper names
en.description: Primarily responds strongly to the word compared across comparative expressions in academic, patent, and news texts, especially compared with/to and as compared to. It also responds strongly to Eli in a political report.

patterns.name: Compared in comparative constructions
patterns.context: Appears in constructions comparing two objects, conditions, methods, or groups, often followed by with or to; sometimes preceded by as, with the compared item appearing later.
patterns.domain: Academic paper abstracts, computer science papers, patent background, and news reports

patterns.name: Sanders in a political report
patterns.context: In a political report, Eli Sanders is the subject of the sentence, followed by “talked to”. The passage does not contain compared.

6_203.concept: 比较表达及偶发专名
6_203.description: 主要对 compared 一词强烈响应，涵盖学术、专利和新闻中的比较表达，尤其是 compared with/to 及 as compared to；另在一段政治报道中对 Eli 强烈响应。

patterns.name: 比较结构中的 compared
patterns.context: 出现在比较两种对象、条件、方法或群体的结构中，常接 with 或 to；有时前面有 as，比较项可能在后文。
patterns.domain: 学术论文摘要、计算机科学论文、专利背景及新闻报道

patterns.name: 政治报道中的 Sanders
patterns.context: 政治报道中，Eli Sanders 是句子的主语，后接 “talked to”。该段未出现 compared。

en.description: Activations are distributed across several patterns: English word forms or endings, code if conditions, the proper name Eli, line breaks and structural markers, as well as legal wording, vulgar vocabulary, food topics, and package-name substrings. No single semantic theme explains all snippets.

patterns.name: English *-ed/-en* forms and related endings
patterns.context: Activation falls near stems or endings, appearing in inflected verbs, phrasal verbs, or derived forms, but parts of speech and syntactic positions are not fully consistent.
patterns.domain: Novels, explanatory text, code discussions, forum text

patterns.name: if conditional code
patterns.context: At the start of a conditional statement in code, followed by parentheses and a logical or bitmask expression.

patterns.name: Eli in proper names
patterns.context: At the beginning of a personal or biblical name; the two contexts involve a prophet and a political report, respectively.
patterns.domain: Religious history explanation and political report

patterns.name: Markers and structural boundaries
patterns.context: Near line breaks, paragraph boundaries, or serialized data structures; may reflect sensitivity to boundaries or formatting tokens rather than word meaning alone.
patterns.domain: Novel formatting, explanatory text, configuration data

patterns.name: Fixed legal wording
patterns.context: Appears in a formal judicial document, linking legal grounds or procedural language; the same passage also contains “determine” and “reference”.

patterns.name: Vulgar bodily and sexual terms in narrative
patterns.context: In novel dialogue or description involving the body, sex, or sexual experience; the passage also contains vulgar tone words such as “bloody”.

patterns.name: Food-topic phrase
patterns.context: Explicitly discusses food as its topic, then discusses ancient historical background.

patterns.name: Possible `tra` substring
patterns.context: Appears only within a package name, with no evidence of an independent lexical or semantic context; may be an intraword substring trigger.

6_203.concept: none
6_203.description: 激活分散于多种模式：英语词形或词尾、代码 if 条件、Eli 专名、换行与结构标记，以及法律措辞、粗俗性词汇、食物主题和包名子串。没有单一语义主题能解释全部片段。

patterns.name: 英语 *-ed/-en* 形式及相关结尾
patterns.context: 激活位置落在词干或词尾附近；出现在动词变形、短语动词或派生形式中，但词类和句法位置不完全一致。
patterns.domain: 小说、说明文字、代码讨论、论坛文字

patterns.name: if 条件代码
patterns.context: 代码中的条件判断语句起始处，后接括号及逻辑或位掩码表达式。

patterns.name: 专名中的 Eli
patterns.context: 人名或圣经人物名的词首；两处语境分别涉及先知和政治报道。

patterns.name: 标记符号及结构边界
patterns.context: 换行、段落边界或序列化数据结构附近；可能反映边界或格式 token 的敏感性，而不只是词义。
patterns.domain: 小说排版、说明文字、配置数据

patterns.name: 法律固定措辞
patterns.context: 出现在正式司法文书中，连接法律依据或程序性表述；同段还出现 “determine” 和 “reference”。

patterns.name: 叙述中的粗俗身体与性词汇
patterns.context: 小说对白或描写中，涉及身体、性或性经历；段内也有 “bloody” 等粗俗语气词。

patterns.name: 食物主题短语
patterns.context: 明确以食物为论述主题，随后讨论古代历史背景。

patterns.name: 可能的 `tra` 子串
patterns.context: 仅出现在包名内部，缺少独立词汇或语义语境证据，可能是词内子串触发。

en.description: The most common trigger is point in various syntactic positions, meaning an opinion, argument, indication, or pointlessness. Other isolated triggers include Where, a segmented fragment of the medical term Needles, and date in a paper; the contexts vary.

patterns.name: Point as an in-sentence topic-development marker
patterns.context: Appears as a noun in commentary or discussion, commonly in phrases such as “My point is”, “good point”, “The point was”, “Another point I should like to mention”, “point out”, or “no point in”; activation can occur at different positions within these phrases.
patterns.domain: HackerNews comments, academic papers, and parliamentary speeches; multiple styles

patterns.name: Paragraph or section transition cue
patterns.context: Occurs at a paragraph transition or the beginning of a new discussion, followed by a discussion of patents or medicines; the token's specific meaning differs somewhat from that of point in the other examples.

patterns.name: Segmented fragment of needles
patterns.context: The split form “Needles” appears in a medical sentence discussing foreign-body ingestion.

patterns.name: Exact date phrase
patterns.context: Used with “exact” and “predictions” when an academic paper introduces the contents of a section, discussing exact date prediction.

6_203.concept: 论述中的观点或转接标记
6_203.description: 最常见触发是多种句法位置中的 point（观点、论点、指出或无意义）；另有孤立的 Where、医学词 Needles 的分词片段及论文中的 date，语境各异。

patterns.name: 句中话题推进标记 point
patterns.context: 作为名词出现在评论或论述中，常见搭配为 “My point is”, “good point”, “The point was”, “Another point I should like to mention”, “point out” 或 “no point in”；触发可出现在搭配的不同位置。
patterns.domain: HackerNews 评论、学术论文及议会发言；覆盖多种文体

patterns.name: 段落或章节转接提示
patterns.context: 位于段落转折或新论述开头，后接有关专利、药品的讨论；该 token 的具体语义和其余实例中的 point 不完全一致。

patterns.name: needles 分词片段
patterns.context: 医学句中出现被拆分的 “Needles”；包含异物吞咽的讨论。

patterns.name: 精确日期短语
patterns.context: 学术论文介绍章节内容时，与 “exact” 和 “predictions” 连用，讨论精确日期预测。

en.concept: Discourse-linking punctuation, especially a comma after an opening word
en.description: The most stable pattern is strong activation on the comma after sentence-initial So,. Other commas after discourse markers such as And,, Well,, and Okay, also activate. Remaining activations are scattered across punctuation, CSS code, point expressions, and various technical terms, with no unified explanation.

patterns.name: Sentence or passage linking with a comma after So
patterns.context: So is followed immediately by a comma at the beginning of a sentence, serving as a transition, inference, or topic-development marker; activation is strongest on the comma.
patterns.domain: Forums, emails, and general web text

patterns.name: And after a paragraph transition
patterns.context: A paragraph begins with And to introduce an addition or rebuttal, followed by a comma.

patterns.name: Well after a question
patterns.context: Well introduces an answer or explanation after a question, followed by a comma.

patterns.name: Okay after a question
patterns.context: In technical Q&A, Okay introduces the explanation that follows a question.

patterns.name: Emphatic punctuation in discourse
patterns.context: Appears in conversational or emotionally charged, evaluative sentences; evidence is weak and does not show a consistent fixed trigger position.

patterns.name: Selectors and declaration punctuation in code
patterns.context: In CSS code, opens a rule block after a selector or introduces a hexadecimal color value in a declaration.

patterns.name: Point when discussing an argument
patterns.context: Expressions discussing a point, reason, or meaning, such as “the point was” or “no point in worrying”.

patterns.name: Activation near code symbols and technical terms
patterns.context: CSS syntax elements in code blocks; trigger positions are scattered and do not recur across snippets.

patterns.name: Email greeting and salutation
patterns.context: A greeting and salutation at the start of an informal email, followed by the body.

patterns.name: Functions and mathematical terms
patterns.context: A mathematical analogy explaining how to view a function as a type and take its Taylor series; activation is scattered.

patterns.name: Specific objects or system terms
patterns.context: Specific features, databases, and tool names in technical Q&A or product descriptions; no common local trigger form is apparent.

6_203.concept: 话语衔接标点，尤指句首逗号
6_203.description: 最稳定的模式是句首 So, 后的逗号强激活；另有 And,、Well,、Okay, 等话语衔接词后的逗号。其余激活散布于标点、CSS 代码、point 表达及各类技术词，难以统一解释。

patterns.name: So 后逗号的句段衔接
patterns.trigger: “So,”，其中 “So” 与逗号都标记激活，逗号为 9 或 10
patterns.context: 句首 So 后紧接逗号，作为转折、推论或话题推进的衔接语；激活落在逗号上最强。
patterns.domain: 论坛、邮件及一般网络文本

patterns.name: 段落转折后的 And
patterns.context: 段落开头以 And 引出补充或反驳，后接逗号。

patterns.name: 问句后的 Well
patterns.context: 问句后以 Well 引出回答或解释，后接逗号。

patterns.name: 问句后的 Okay
patterns.context: 技术问答中在问题后以 Okay 引出接下来的说明。

patterns.name: 话语中的强调性标点
patterns.context: 出现在口语化或带情绪、评价色彩的句子中；证据较弱，未体现统一的固定触发位置。

patterns.name: 代码中的选择器与声明标点
patterns.trigger: CSS 选择器后的 “{”（3、10）以及颜色值前的 “#”（5）
patterns.context: CSS 代码中，选择器后开启规则块，或声明中引入十六进制颜色值。

patterns.name: 讨论论点时的 point
patterns.context: “the point was”或“no point in worrying”等讨论观点、理由或意义的表达。
patterns.domain: HackerNews 评论及劝慰性文字

patterns.name: 代码符号及技术词附近的激活
patterns.context: 代码块中的 CSS 语法元素；各触发位置分散，未见跨段复现。

patterns.name: 邮件问候及称呼
patterns.context: 非正式邮件开头的问候和称呼，后接正文。

patterns.name: 函数与数学术语
patterns.context: 解释把函数视作类型并取泰勒级数的数学类比；激活较分散。

patterns.name: 具体对象或系统术语
patterns.context: 技术问答或产品介绍中的具体功能、数据库和工具名；未见共同的局部触发形式。

en.description: Activations occur across line breaks and code boundaries, English function words, special syntax symbols, intraword tr fragments, and comments, links, DOM, templates, and literary text. There is no stable semantic theme; formatting and subword/code-symbol patterns are prominent.

patterns.name: Line breaks and line-start/line-end boundaries
patterns.context: Activation concentrates on line breaks, comments or code line endings, and positions where punctuation or code markers follow a line break; common in code snippets, web excerpts, and verse formatting.
patterns.domain: GitHub code, webpage comments, book text

patterns.name: English function words and syntactic continuation
patterns.context: Function words, conjunctions, auxiliaries, or prepositions in ordinary English sentences; there is no stable single semantic theme, and some activations occur mid-sentence.

patterns.name: Markers and special syntax symbols in code
patterns.context: Activations occur near symbols such as comment markers, question marks, and operators in code; some are at line beginnings or after line breaks.

patterns.name: Intraword fragments containing tr
patterns.context: Strong activation falls on tr or related segmented fragments inside English words, spanning different word forms without a clear shared meaning.
patterns.domain: Literary texts, news headlines, URLs in code, poetry

patterns.name: Source-code comments and copyright/documentation blocks
patterns.context: Comment blocks and their documentation text, especially block-comment boundaries, copyright information, or explanatory paragraphs.

patterns.name: HTML/JavaScript DOM fragments
patterns.context: HTML tags and jQuery DOM operations in webpage code; activation falls near tag names or method calls.

patterns.name: Link and news-headline formatting
patterns.context: News links or headline text, including URLs, underscore-separated titles, and headline wording such as “X is in trouble”.

patterns.name: Template variables and environment conditions
patterns.context: A frontend style template reads an environment variable and selects a theme value based on a production condition.

patterns.name: Literary and archaic English expressions
patterns.context: Archaic pronouns, lyrical wording, and line-break formatting in poetry or literary prose; activation points are scattered, with no unified semantic trigger.

patterns.name: URL paths and filename fragments
patterns.context: File paths, version directories, or linked URLs in code; strong activations are distributed across path characters and near extensions.

6_203.concept: 文本边界与代码符号特征
6_203.description: 激活分布于换行和代码边界、英文功能词、特殊语法符号、词内 tr 片段，以及注释、链接、DOM、模板和文学文本；没有一个稳定的语义主题，排版与子词/代码符号模式较突出。

patterns.name: 换行及行首/行尾边界
patterns.context: 激活集中在换行、注释或代码行结束，以及换行后紧接标点或代码标记的位置；常见于代码片段、网页摘录和诗文排版。
patterns.domain: GitHub 代码、网页评论、书籍文本

patterns.name: 英文功能词与句法续接
patterns.trigger: « If»、« the»、« is»、« and»、« but»、« would»、« may»、« from»
patterns.context: 普通英文句子中的虚词、连词、助动词或介词；没有稳定的单一语义主题，部分激活落在句子内部。
patterns.domain: 评论、说明文字、文学文本

patterns.name: 代码中的标记与特殊语法符号
patterns.context: 代码中注释标记、问号及运算符等符号附近出现激活；有些位于行首或换行后。

patterns.name: 带 tr 的词内片段
patterns.context: 强激活落在英文单词内部的 tr 或相关分词片段，涉及不同词形，未显示明确共同语义。
patterns.domain: 文学文本、新闻标题、代码中的 URL、诗歌

patterns.name: 源码注释与版权/文档块
patterns.context: 注释块及其文档性文字，尤其块注释边界、版权信息或说明段落。

patterns.name: HTML/JavaScript DOM 片段
patterns.context: 网页代码中 HTML 标签和 jQuery DOM 操作；激活落在标签名或方法调用附近。

patterns.name: 链接与新闻标题格式
patterns.context: 新闻链接或标题文本，含 URL、下划线分隔标题和类似“X is in trouble”的标题措辞。

patterns.name: 模板变量与环境条件
patterns.context: 前端样式模板中读取环境变量并按 production 条件选择主题值。

patterns.name: 文学性、古旧英语表达
patterns.context: 诗歌或文学散文中的古旧代词、抒情措辞及换行排版；激活点分散，未见统一语义触发。

patterns.name: URL 路径与文件名片段
patterns.context: 代码中的文件路径、版本目录或链接 URL；强激活分布于路径字符和扩展名附近。

en.description: Contains diverse text types: code, paths, URLs, and configuration syntax; classical poetry, English forum conditional sentences, and question-mark formatting in email. Local triggers are clear, but there is no shared semantic or formal pattern that explains all segments.

patterns.name: Identifiers in a hardware description language
patterns.context: Appears in code assignments or property chains, containing identifiers such as clock domains, signals, and delay types; activation is distributed across several markers.

patterns.name: Old English poetic syntax
patterns.context: Classical spelling, poetic word order, and punctuation in a verse line; strong activation is concentrated on "from".

patterns.name: Configuration keys, quotes, and URL paths
patterns.context: Multiple configuration entries are comma-separated and followed by a documentation link; activation falls on hyphens, parts of keys, and URL components.

patterns.name: Paths and commands in build scripts
patterns.context: A shell build script sets library-linking parameters and changes directories; activation involves variables and commands.

patterns.name: URL scraping and regular expressions
patterns.context: Code uses a URL as a scraping target and a regular expression to match links, version numbers, and file extensions.

patterns.name: Paths and preprocessing steps in build configuration
patterns.context: A platform target name is followed by configure/build comments and a shell subdirectory command.

patterns.name: Device-tree path markers
patterns.context: A device-tree version declaration at the beginning of a file; activation is concentrated on slashes, dts, and version characters.

patterns.name: Conditionals and negation in English Q&A
patterns.context: Conditional if clauses, negative contractions, and rhetorical questions in conversational or comment text; activated words are not fully consistent.

patterns.name: Question-mark/formatting markers in email
patterns.context: An isolated question mark and blank formatting appear between paragraphs in an email body; activation is concentrated mainly on the question mark.

6_203.concept: none
6_203.description: 包含多种彼此差异较大的文本：代码、路径、URL 与配置语法，古典诗句、论坛英文条件句，以及邮件中的问号格式。局部触发明显，但未见能解释全部段落的共同语义或形式模式。

patterns.name: 硬件描述语言中的标识符
patterns.context: 出现在代码赋值或属性链中，包含时钟域、信号及延迟类型等标识符；激活分散在若干标记上。

patterns.name: 古英语诗歌句式
patterns.context: 诗行中的古典拼写、诗歌语序和标点；强激活集中在 "from"。

patterns.name: 配置键、引用和 URL 路径
patterns.context: 多个配置项以逗号分隔，随后接文档链接；激活落在连字符、部分键名及 URL 组件上。
patterns.domain: Pile-CC 配置片段/技术文档链接

patterns.name: 构建脚本中的路径与命令
patterns.context: shell 构建脚本中设置库链接参数并切换目录，激活涉及变量和命令。

patterns.name: URL 抓取与正则表达式
patterns.context: 代码以 URL 为抓取目标，并用正则匹配链接、版本号及文件扩展名。
patterns.domain: Github 脚本/网页抓取代码

patterns.name: 构建配置中的路径与预处理步骤
patterns.context: 平台目标名后接 configure/build 注释及 shell 子目录命令。

patterns.name: 设备树路径标记
patterns.context: 文件开头的设备树版本声明；激活集中在斜杠、dts 与版本字符。
patterns.domain: Github 嵌入式设备树源文件

patterns.name: 英文问答中的条件与否定
patterns.trigger: "if Facebook couldn't break out, who can?"、"If the Apple watch couldn't tell the time"、"If you don't agree"
patterns.context: 口语或评论文字中的 if 条件句、否定缩写和反问；激活词并不完全一致。

patterns.name: 邮件中的问号/格式标记
patterns.context: 邮件正文段落间出现孤立问号和空白格式，激活主要集中在问号。

en.description: Activations are scattered across code paths and syntax markers, English forum function words and punctuation, bibliographic terms, long-word fragments, and URL/HTML encoding; no stable semantic or domain pattern explains all samples.

patterns.name: English function words and their punctuation after spaces
patterns.context: Common function words, modal verbs, or punctuation in English sentences; activation falls on the preceding space or punctuation token and appears in HN dialogue and comments.

patterns.name: Path separators and directory changes in code
patterns.context: In command-line or script text, cd is followed by a directory path separated by slashes.

patterns.name: Code syntax and preprocessing markers
patterns.context: Structural markers in C/C++ preprocessing directives or script code.

patterns.name: Fragments in numbers and technical strings
patterns.context: Appears near code identifiers, macro names, or compiler warning text; may be a fragment caused by code tokenization.

patterns.name: Book-specification terms in bibliographic descriptions
patterns.context: Appears in descriptions of book binding or format, followed by “avo” to form octavo.

patterns.name: Letter fragment within a long word
patterns.context: Embedded within the word “congregate”, in preceding text explaining a category definition related to group gathering.
patterns.domain: Definition text quoted in an Enron email

patterns.name: URL and technical identifier fragment
patterns.context: Occurs in a path or number in an Oracle documentation URL, with no independent meaning.

patterns.name: Numeric fragment in an HTML entity
patterns.context: Occurs in the entity “'”, representing an apostrophe; the adjacent content is the encoded apostrophe in “I'm”.

6_203.concept: none
6_203.description: 激活分散在代码路径与语法标记、英文论坛虚词和标点、书目词、长词片段及 URL/HTML 编码中；未见一个能解释全部样本的稳定语义或领域模式。

patterns.name: 空格后的英文功能词及其标点
patterns.trigger: « but»、« can»、« would»、« in»、« the»；也包括«,»
patterns.context: 英文句子中常见的虚词、情态动词或标点，激活落在词前空格或标点 token 上；出现于 HN 对话和评论中

patterns.name: 代码中的路径分隔符与目录切换
patterns.context: 命令行或脚本中，cd 后接由斜杠分隔的目录路径

patterns.name: 代码语法与预处理标记
patterns.context: C/C++ 预处理指令或脚本代码中的结构标记

patterns.name: 数字与技术字符串中的碎片
patterns.context: 出现在代码标识符、宏名或编译器警告文本附近；可能是代码 token 化造成的片段

patterns.name: 书目描述中的书籍规格词
patterns.context: 出现在书籍装帧、开本等出版描述中，后接“avo”组成 octavo

patterns.name: 长词内部的字母片段
patterns.context: 嵌在“congregate”一词内部，前文说明定义类别与人群聚集相关
patterns.domain: Enron 邮件中引用的定义性文本

patterns.name: 网址与技术标识符片段
patterns.context: 位于 Oracle 文档 URL 的路径或编号中，缺乏独立语义

patterns.name: HTML 实体中的数字片段
patterns.context: 位于“'”实体中，表示撇号；相邻内容是“I'm”的撇号编码

en.description: The main pattern is English too followed by a degree or evaluative word, meaning “excessively/too…”, in everyday, news, and technical contexts. Isolated cases include cd in code and dep within the Spanish word depender and English depersonalisation.

patterns.name: too + degree or evaluative word
patterns.context: In English, too precedes an adjective or adverb to express excess or an unsuitable degree; it sometimes appears after structures such as it/seems/be.
patterns.domain: Various styles, including everyday narration, news, technical discussion, and forum dialogue

patterns.name: Directory change in code paths or commands
patterns.context: A GNU make script executes cd and enters a project subdirectory; activation falls on cd.
patterns.domain: GitHub source code/Shell and make scripts

patterns.name: Substring within a Spanish word
patterns.context: In a Spanish sentence, dep is a subword fragment within depender (to depend), not an English too construction.

patterns.name: Substring within a Spanish word (another instance)
patterns.context: A subword fragment within depersonalisation in English academic text; the passage also contains depersonalised.

6_203.concept: too 表达过度程度
6_203.description: 主要模式是英语 too 后接程度或评价词，表达“过于/太……”，见日常、新闻及技术语境。另有孤例：代码中的 cd、以及 dep 在西班牙语 depender 和英语 depersonalisation 中的词内出现。

patterns.name: too + 程度或评价词
patterns.context: 英语中 too 后接形容词或副词，表达过度、超出合适程度；有时位于 it/seems/be 等结构之后。
patterns.domain: 日常叙述、新闻、技术讨论、论坛对话等多种文体

patterns.name: 代码路径或命令中的目录切换
patterns.context: GNU make 脚本中执行 cd 并进入项目子目录；激活落在 cd 上。
patterns.domain: GitHub 源码／Shell 与 make 脚本

patterns.name: 西班牙语词内子串
patterns.context: 西班牙语句中，dep 是单词 depender（取决于）的词内片段，并非英语 too 结构。
patterns.domain: 学术论文摘要或研究文本

patterns.name: 西班牙语词内子串（另一处）
patterns.context: 英语学术文本中的 depersonalisation 词内片段；该段还出现 depersonalised。
patterns.domain: 学术论文／社会科学论述

en.description: Primarily responds strongly to the directory-change command cd in code, including build scripts, shell, terminal examples, and embedded code. It also activates on conversational too twice, poetic from once, and several code markers that do not fit the main pattern.

patterns.name: Change working directory
patterns.context: The cd command appears in commands or code with its path/arguments; surrounding text often includes directory variables, build steps, or a terminal prompt.
patterns.domain: Directory operations in Shell, build scripts, terminal examples, and embedded code

patterns.name: Conversational too
patterns.context: In natural-language sentences, too means “excessively”, followed by the adjectives easy or coincidental; passage [3] also has “that seemed too easy”, and passage [4] has “too coincidental”.

patterns.name: From in poetry
patterns.context: Appears as a preposition introducing a source in the poetic line “Heav'n, I see, / ’tis from …”.

patterns.name: unexplained
patterns.context: These markers do not clearly reflect directory changes or the other discernible patterns; they may be sporadic activations caused by context and code structure.

6_203.concept: 目录切换命令（伴随零散激活）
6_203.description: 主要对代码中的 cd 目录切换命令强烈响应，涵盖构建脚本、shell、终端示例及嵌入代码；另在两处口语 too、一次诗体 from 上激活，并有若干代码标记无法归入主模式。

patterns.name: 切换工作目录
patterns.context: 命令或代码中出现 cd 命令及其路径/参数；周围常有目录变量、构建步骤或终端提示符。
patterns.domain: Shell、构建脚本、终端示例及嵌入代码中的目录操作

patterns.name: 口语表达 too
patterns.context: 自然语言句中 too 表示“太……”，后接形容词 easy 或 coincidental；段[3]还有“that seemed too easy”，段[4]为“too coincidental”。

patterns.name: 诗歌中的 from
patterns.context: 出现在诗体台词“Heav'n, I see, / ’tis from …”中，作为介词引出来源。

patterns.name: unexplained
patterns.trigger: 无法由上述触发形式明确解释的激活位置，如段[2]«mkdir»、段[5]«IF»、段[6]«run»、段[7]«f»及段[10]«(»
patterns.context: 这些标记未明显体现目录切换或其余可辨模式，可能是上下文与代码结构带来的零散激活。

en.concept: too as a degree adverb and sporadic subword fragments
en.description: Strongly activates mainly in English too + adjective constructions; other sporadic activations include TH/THAN, code macros or commands, and fragments within Spanish and English words, without a unified semantic explanation.

patterns.name: Degree or evaluative element following too
patterns.context: In English, too functions as a degree adverb modifying a following adjective; local activation concentrates on too rather than the adjective.

patterns.name: TH/THAN letter fragments in compound strings
patterns.context: The letter sequence TH appears in English uppercase strings; activation markers fall on split subword fragments.

patterns.name: Fragments within Spanish words
patterns.context: Activation falls on subword fragments within Spanish words, without an evident shared lexical meaning or syntactic condition.

patterns.name: Paths and directory changes in code
patterns.context: A cd command in a build script is followed by a directory path; the highlighted item is the command token.

patterns.name: THR in a C++ assertion macro
patterns.context: Inside the macro name ASSERT_THROWS_WITH; activation is concentrated on the TH substring.

patterns.name: dep fragment within an English word
patterns.context: Within the word depersonalisation in an academic sentence, the activation marker falls on the initial subword fragment dep.

patterns.name: Unclear one-off fragment activations
patterns.context: The fragments occur in different words, numbers, or syntactic positions, so their shared trigger cannot be determined from the provided context.

6_203.concept: too 程度副词及零散子词片段
6_203.description: 主要在英语 too+形容词结构中强烈激活；另有 TH/THAN、代码宏或命令、西班牙语及英语词内片段等零散激活，缺少统一语义解释。

patterns.name: too 后接程度或评价成分
patterns.context: 英语中 too 作程度副词，修饰后续形容词；局部激活集中在 too，而非其后形容词。

patterns.name: 复合词中的 TH/THAN 字母片段
patterns.context: 英语大写字符串中出现 TH 字母序列；激活标记落在拆分后的子词片段。

patterns.name: 西班牙语词内片段
patterns.context: 激活落在西班牙语词汇内部的子词片段，未见明显统一的词义或句法条件。

patterns.name: 代码中的路径与目录切换
patterns.context: 构建脚本中 cd 命令后接目录路径；高亮的是命令 token。

patterns.name: C++ 断言宏中的 THR
patterns.context: ASSERT_THROWS_WITH 宏名内部；激活集中于 TH 子串。

patterns.name: 英语词内 dep 片段
patterns.context: 学术句子中的 depersonalisation 一词内部，激活标记落在词首子串 dep。

patterns.name: 未明确的单次片段激活
patterns.context: 这些片段各自处于不同词语、数字或句法位置，无法从所给上下文判断共同触发条件。
patterns.domain: 新闻、论坛对话、哲学文本

en.concept: too and dep substrings and code markers
en.description: The main pattern is too followed by a degree or evaluative word, often expressing something as too easy, too late, coincidental, or resource-intensive; code snippets also activate on commands and paths. There is also activation on the dep substring across academic words and code identifiers, which may not share the same source as the main pattern.

patterns.name: Degree or evaluative word after too
patterns.context: An adjective or evaluative phrase immediately follows too; often used to express that something is too easy, too late, too coincidental, or too resource-intensive. Activation is concentrated on too, though adjacent words may also activate.
patterns.domain: News, reviews, forum discussions, personal essays, and technical Q&A

patterns.name: Code builds and directory paths
patterns.context: Commands, paths, and configuration identifiers in code, build scripts, or dependency declarations; activation falls on cd, path fragments, or the word depends in different snippets.

patterns.name: dep substring in depersonalisation / depender
patterns.context: The activation marker falls on the string dep within English words; it is an internal substring in depersonalisation and depender, but a word-initial code identifier fragment in depends_on.

6_203.concept: too 与 dep 子串及代码标记
6_203.description: 主要模式是 too 后接程度或评价词，常表达过于容易、太晚、巧合或耗资源；代码段还会激活于命令和路径。另有跨学术词与代码标识符的 dep 子串激活，未必与上述模式同源。

patterns.name: too 后接程度或评价词
patterns.context: 在 too 后紧接形容词或评价成分；多见于表达某事太容易、太晚、太巧合或太耗资源。激活主要落在 too 上，但相邻词也可能激活。
patterns.domain: 新闻、评论、论坛对话、生活随笔和技术问答

patterns.name: 代码构建与目录路径
patterns.context: 代码、构建脚本或依赖声明中的命令、路径与配置标识符；不同片段中激活分别落在 cd、路径片段或 depends 的词内。

patterns.name: depersonalisation / depender 的 dep 子串
patterns.context: 激活标记落在英文词内的 dep 字符串上；在 depersonalisation 与 depender 中是词内子串，在 depends_on 中则是代码标识符的词首。

en.description: Activation cues are diverse: several code passages favor shell cd and build configuration; others occur in English narratives, political news, patent chemistry, loan advertisements, and Spanish emissions-reduction text. Some activations are fragments within words or paths and lack a unified semantic interpretation.

patterns.name: Directory changes in Shell commands
patterns.context: In shell scripts or build commands, cd is followed by a project path, variable, or relative path

patterns.name: Subword fragments within words
patterns.context: Activation falls on fragments within words rather than complete words; these involve English, command names, and Spanish, and the fragments themselves have no unified meaning

patterns.name: Evaluation that something is too easy
patterns.context: The narrator explains why they did not choose an apparently simple solution; earlier, they mention starting a backyard bonfire but giving up because of rain

patterns.name: Emotional pleading narrative
patterns.context: A person nearly in tears begs the other party not to criticize their project in a Slack channel

patterns.name: Polymer chemistry terminology
patterns.context: A patent background discusses polymer synthesis steps and protection/deprotection procedures

patterns.name: Delayed judgment in debate coverage
patterns.context: After a news-style subheading, the text discusses the possibility of defeating Donald Trump

patterns.name: Device-tree path fragment
patterns.context: A string resembling a Linux device-tree file path appears after the end of a C code comment

patterns.name: Spanish emissions-reduction terminology fragment
patterns.context: Discusses reducing greenhouse gas emissions and international commitments

patterns.name: Urgent loan wording in an advertisement
patterns.context: Uppercase promotional copy promises emergency funds and claims that money problems are a thing of the past

patterns.name: Shell comment or configuration directive
patterns.context: A FreeBSD ports build fragment contains a pre-configuration hook and comments describing build steps

patterns.name: Macroeconomic emissions-reduction target statement
patterns.context: A Spanish sentence proposes reducing emissions and compares them with international targets

6_203.concept: none
6_203.description: 激活线索多样：多段代码中偏好 shell 的 cd 与构建配置；其余散见英语叙事、政治新闻、专利化学、借贷广告和西班牙语减排文本。部分激活是单词或路径内部片段，缺乏统一语义。

patterns.name: Shell 命令中的目录切换
patterns.context: shell 脚本或构建命令中，cd 后跟项目路径、变量或相对路径

patterns.name: 单词内部子词片段
patterns.context: 激活落在单词内部的片段，而非完整词；涉及英文、命令名和西班牙语，片段本身不呈现统一语义
patterns.domain: 代码、广告、新闻、议会文本

patterns.name: 过于容易的评价
patterns.context: 叙述者解释为何没选择看似简单的方案；前文提到在后院生篝火，因下雨作罢

patterns.name: 情绪性求情叙述
patterns.context: 人物几乎含泪地恳求对方不要在 Slack 频道批评其项目

patterns.name: 聚合物化学术语
patterns.context: 专利背景中谈到聚合物合成步骤，以及保护／脱保护程序

patterns.name: 辩论报道中的迟晚判断
patterns.context: 新闻式小标题后讨论击败 Donald Trump 的可能性

patterns.name: 设备树路径片段

patterns.name: 西班牙语减排术语片段
patterns.context: 讨论温室气体排放的削减及国际承诺
patterns.domain: 西班牙语政策／气候文本

patterns.name: 广告中的紧急借贷措辞

patterns.name: Shell 注释或配置指令
patterns.context: FreeBSD ports 构建片段中，预配置钩子及注释说明构建步骤

patterns.name: 宏观减排目标表述
patterns.context: 西班牙语句子提出需要减少排放，并与国际目标相比较

en.description: Activation is distributed across word-internal fragments and local expressions in multilingual text: directory/configuration commands in build code, English colloquial evaluations, Italian div-, English long-word fragments, the JSON field deprecated, and Greek references to targets and time spans. There is no single clear semantic theme.

patterns.name: make/build and directory paths in code
patterns.context: Appears in shell commands, Makefile functions, or build configuration snippets, especially near directory changes and configuration/build steps.

patterns.name: Evaluations and contrast in colloquial English
patterns.context: In natural English conversation, evaluating a choice or expectation, often with contrast, doubt, or a judgment that something is unrealistic.

patterns.name: div fragments within Italian words
patterns.context: Activation falls on subword fragments beginning with div- in Italian word forms, with varying endings; it is not clearly constrained by a shared meaning or syntactic context.

patterns.name: Fragments within the English word personalisation
patterns.context: Activation is located on a fragment within the English long word personalisation; the surrounding text discusses authority and professionalisation.

patterns.name: Fragment within JSON key deprecated
patterns.context: Appears in a JSON-style object as part of the deprecated Boolean field name.

patterns.name: Greek number phrase and target reference
patterns.context: Occurs in a Greek sentence mentioning a fifteen-year time span and the projected achievement of a target.

6_203.concept: 多语种子词与局部表达
6_203.description: 激活分布于多语种文本中的词内片段及局部表达：构建代码的目录/配置命令、英语口语评价、意大利语 div-、英语长词分片、JSON 字段 deprecated，以及希腊语目标与年限表述。没有单一明显语义主题。

patterns.name: 代码中的 make/build 与目录路径
patterns.context: 出现在 shell 命令、Makefile 函数或构建配置片段中，尤其是目录切换及配置/构建步骤附近。

patterns.name: 英语口语中的评价与转折
patterns.trigger: «Yes»2«,»1 I suppose« we»2« could»3 ...«.»2« But»3« that»2« seemed»7« too»10 easy«.»3；«That»5« seems»5« a»5« bit»9↵«un»2realistic
patterns.context: 自然英语对话中，对某种选择或期待作评价，常带转折、质疑或不切实际的判断。

patterns.name: 意大利语词内部的 div 分片
patterns.context: 激活落在意大利语词形 div- 开头的子词片段中，后续词尾不同；并非明显由同一词义或句法环境限定。
patterns.domain: 意大利语议会文本与哲学文本

patterns.name: 英语 personalisation 词内部的分片
patterns.context: 激活位于英语长词 personalisation 的词内分片，周围讨论权威与专业化。

patterns.name: JSON 键名 deprecated 的词内分片
patterns.context: 出现在 JSON 风格对象中，作为 deprecated 布尔字段名的一部分。

patterns.name: 希腊语数字短语与目标表述
patterns.context: 位于希腊语句子中，提到十五年时间跨度及目标预计实现。

en.concept: Local markers in software engineering text
en.description: Primarily responds to software engineering text: directory changes in build scripts and deprecated in metadata or documentation navigation; other cases include version regexes, English word-internal fragments, and Italian parliamentary text, with no clear shared trigger pattern for the latter categories.

patterns.name: deprecated field/link
patterns.context: Appears as a deprecated Boolean field in JSON package metadata or as a deprecated-list link target in HTML navigation
patterns.domain: Package configuration and API documentation HTML

patterns.name: Directory changes in Shell build scripts
patterns.context: Appears in shell scripts or build recipes, often adjacent to directory paths, make functions, and configure/build commands
patterns.domain: Github build scripts and system software configuration

patterns.name: Version regex and fields
patterns.context: JSON metadata contains a regular expression for version strings and related fields

patterns.name: Word fragments in English prose
patterns.context: Subword fragments appear within ordinary English sentences; there is no evident shared meaning or syntactic condition

patterns.name: Italian parliamentary speech
patterns.context: Subword fragments within continuous Italian speech text

6_203.concept: 软件工程文本中的局部标记
6_203.description: 主要响应软件工程文本：构建脚本中的目录切换，以及元数据或文档导航中的 deprecated；另见版本正则、英文词内片段和意大利语议会文本，后几类缺乏清楚的共同触发模式。

patterns.name: deprecated 字段/链接
patterns.context: 在 JSON 包元数据中作为 deprecated 布尔字段，或在 HTML 导航中作为 deprecated-list 链接目标出现
patterns.domain: 软件包配置与 API 文档 HTML

patterns.name: Shell 构建脚本中的目录切换
patterns.context: 出现在 shell 脚本或构建配方中，常与目录路径、make 函数、configure/build 命令相邻
patterns.domain: Github 构建脚本与系统软件配置

patterns.name: 版本号正则与字段
patterns.context: JSON 元数据中包含针对版本字符串的正则模式及相关字段

patterns.name: 英文散文中的词片段
patterns.context: 普通英文句子中出现词内子词片段；没有明显共同语义或句法条件

patterns.name: 意大利语议会发言
patterns.context: 意大利语连续演讲文本中的词内片段

en.concept: too degree expressions and a few code commands
en.description: Primarily responds to degree-too-high or inappropriate constructions introduced by “too,” covering evaluations such as easy, late, soon, resource consuming, sweet, daunting, jaded, and arrogant; it also activates on the command “cd” in a shell code snippet.

patterns.name: “too” degree construction
patterns.context: “too” is followed by an adjective, adverb, or state expression, indicating an excessive or inappropriate degree; a reason or evaluation sometimes follows, as in “too easy,” “too soon,” “too sweet,” “too daunting,” and “too arrogant.”
patterns.domain: Everyday narratives, news, parenting, legal, and technical discussions, and reviews

patterns.name: Code marker activation
patterns.context: Appears in the command position of a shell build script, as a command for changing directories; unlike the “too” constructions in other passages.

6_203.concept: too程度表达及少量代码命令
6_203.description: 主要响应“too”引出的程度过高或不合适结构，覆盖从 easy、late、soon、resource consuming、sweet、daunting 到 jaded、arrogant 等评价；另在一段 shell 代码中激活于命令“cd”。

patterns.name: “too”程度结构
patterns.context: “too”后接形容词、副词或表达状态的词，表示程度过高或不合适；后续有时补充原因或评价，如“too easy”“too soon”“too sweet”“too daunting”“too arrogant”。
patterns.domain: 日常叙述、新闻、育儿、法律、技术讨论与评论

patterns.name: 代码中的标记激活
patterns.context: 出现在 shell 构建脚本的命令位置，作为切换目录的命令；与其他段落中“too”结构不同。

en.description: The most stable pattern is English “too + adjective”, expressing excessive degree or bad timing; other highlights occur in evaluative wording, build scripts, JavaScript modules, Italian parliamentary language, and Angular dependency lists, without a unified syntactic or semantic pattern.

patterns.name: “too + adjective” construction
patterns.context: In an English sentence, too precedes an adjective to express excessive degree or unsuitable timing; the preceding text usually describes or evaluates something.

patterns.name: Evaluative expression in English
patterns.context: Negatively evaluates a group’s ability or performance; the highlight falls on a subword fragment in embarrassed, without the same construction as “too + adjective”.

patterns.name: FreeBSD build script fragment
patterns.context: In BSD ports configuration and build scripts, the target platform name, pre-configure stage, and shell commands occur together.

patterns.name: GNU make build command
patterns.context: Near a command that changes to the project directory in GNU project build code for multimedia software.

patterns.name: JavaScript function and dependency loading
patterns.context: A JavaScript module function wrapped in define calls require to load Zepto and assign it to a variable.

patterns.name: Italian parliamentary speech
patterns.context: A speaker is addressed by the chair, with an Italian expression meaning something like “completely right”; the highlight is a fragment within pienamente.

patterns.name: Angular dependency version field
patterns.context: An Angular package name and its beta version number in a JSON-style dependency list.

6_203.concept: too + 形容词
6_203.description: 最稳定的模式是英语“too + 形容词”，表示程度过高或时机不当；其余高亮分别落在评论性措辞、构建脚本、JavaScript 模块、意大利语议会用语及 Angular 依赖清单中，未形成统一句法或语义模式。

patterns.name: “too + 形容词”结构
patterns.context: 英语句中 too 后接形容词，表达程度过高或时机不合；前文通常描述某事或评价。
patterns.domain: 叙事、法律证词、饮食博客

patterns.name: 英语评论性表达
patterns.context: 对某群体的能力或表现作负面评价；高亮落在 embarrassed 的子词片段，未见与“too + 形容词”相同句式。

patterns.name: FreeBSD 构建脚本片段
patterns.context: BSD ports 配置与构建脚本中，目标平台名、pre-configure 阶段及 shell 命令相邻出现。

patterns.name: GNU make 构建命令
patterns.context: 多媒体软件的 GNU 工程构建代码中，切换到项目目录的命令附近。

patterns.name: JavaScript 函数与依赖加载
patterns.context: 以 define 包装的 JavaScript 模块函数中，调用 require 加载 Zepto 并赋给变量。

patterns.name: 意大利语议会发言
