patterns.context: 议长回应发言者，出现意大利语“完全有道理”一类表达；高亮位于 pienamente 的词内片段。

patterns.name: Angular 依赖版本字段
patterns.context: JSON 风格的依赖清单中，Angular 包名及其 beta 版本号。

en.description: Strongly activates mainly on the English degree construction too + adjective/adverb, covering easy, daunting, coincidental, late, derisive, soon, and arrogant; there is also activation on the word-internal fragment in Spanish supuesto and the code fragment in nodeprecated.

patterns.name: too + adjective/adverb
patterns.context: An English too + complement construction expressing an excessive degree; often preceded by be, seem, or it’s in a question.
patterns.domain: English narratives, reviews, dialogue, and legal texts

patterns.name: Fragment within Spanish supuesto
patterns.context: Appears in the Spanish phrase «por supuesto», with activation on a subword fragment inside the word.

patterns.name: Fragment within configuration item deprecated
patterns.context: Appears in a Github configuration snippet, with activation on an internal fragment of the configuration identifier nodeprecated.

6_203.concept: too + 形容词程度结构
6_203.description: 主要对英语程度结构 too + 形容词/副词强烈激活，涵盖 easy、daunting、coincidental、late、derisive、soon、arrogant；另有西语 supuesto 与代码 nodeprecated 的词内片段激活。

patterns.name: too + 形容词/副词
patterns.trigger: «too» 后接形容词或副词，如 «too»10 easy、«too»9 daunting、«too»9 coincidental、«too»8 late、«too»8 derisive、«too»8 soon、«too»8 arrogant
patterns.context: 英语中表示程度过高的 too + 补语结构；前面常有 be、seem 或问句中的 it’s。
patterns.domain: 英语叙事、评论、对话及法律文本

patterns.name: 西语 supuesto 的词内片段
patterns.context: 出现在西班牙语短语 «por supuesto» 中，激活落在单词内部的子词片段。

patterns.name: 配置项 deprecated 的词内片段
patterns.context: 出现在 Github 配置片段中，激活落在配置标识符 nodeprecated 的内部片段。

en.description: All passages activate around degree uses of “too”, modifying positive, negative, or neutral evaluations; combinations include too soon, too much, and too bad. The contexts and domains vary widely.

patterns.name: too + evaluation or state
patterns.context: “too” functions as a degree adverb, modifying an adjective, state, or quantity evaluation; it is often followed by evaluative material to express excess, inopportune timing, or an undesirable outcome.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain everyday narratives, novels, forum discussions, legal records, and technical Q&A

patterns.name: too soon timing judgment
patterns.context: Judges whether it is too early to begin toilet training or perform a work task; the expression recurs in different corpora.

patterns.name: too much / too little construction cue
patterns.context: The degree phrase “a bit” precedes “too”, which is followed by the quantity word “much”, evaluating something as excessive or burdensome.
patterns.domain: Personal commentary; explanations of clock display formats

patterns.name: Fixed evaluation too bad
patterns.context: “too bad” is a brief negative exclamation, followed by “for AWS” to identify the affected party.

6_203.concept: too程度副词结构
6_203.description: 所有段都在“too”程度结构附近激活，修饰正面、负面或中性评价，也见too soon、too much、too bad等搭配；具体语境与领域多样。

patterns.name: too + 评价或状态
patterns.trigger: «too»10 easy；«too»9 late；«too»9 coincidental；«too»9 soon；«too»9 arrogant；«too»8 daunting；«too»8« much»；«too»8« bad»；«too»8 "magic"
patterns.context: “too”处于程度副词用法，修饰形容词、状态或数量评价；其后常接评价性成分，表达过度、不合时宜或不理想。
patterns.domain: 跨领域的日常叙述、小说、论坛讨论、法律记录、技术问答

patterns.name: too soon 时间判断
patterns.context: 判断开始如厕训练或执行工作任务的时机是否过早；该表达在不同语料中重复出现。
patterns.domain: 育儿论坛；法律事实叙述

patterns.name: too much / too little 结构线索
patterns.context: “too”前有程度短语“a bit”，后接数量词“much”，评价某事显得过量或负担过重。
patterns.domain: 个人评论、对钟表显示方式的说明

patterns.name: too bad 固定评价
patterns.context: “too bad”作为简短负面感叹，后接“for AWS”说明受影响对象。

en.concept: Local word-form fragments and too degree constructions
en.description: Primarily activates strongly on too in “too + evaluative adjective/participle” constructions; it also activates on several un- words containing em and on Spanish word-internal fragments, whose semantics and relationship are unclear.

patterns.name: too + adjective/participle
patterns.context: “too” is followed by an evaluative adjective or participle, often expressing an excessive, inappropriate, or unbearable degree; commonly preceded by constructions such as it was, seems, sounds, or may seem.
patterns.domain: Narratives, online reviews, dialogue, and advocacy writing

patterns.name: Word-internal fragments in un- negations/antonyms
patterns.context: Activation falls on the word-internal fragment “em” in words beginning with un-, including embarrassed, emotional, and embellished; the semantics are inconsistent, so it is unclear whether this is a morphological or local-token feature.

patterns.name: Spanish word-internal fragments
patterns.context: Activation falls on word-internal fragments in Spanish adverbs or adjectives; the same passage also contains Spanish text such as tinta, corrompa, nombres, and tienen, which is not marked.

6_203.concept: 局部词形片段与 too 程度结构
6_203.description: 主要对“too + 评价性形容词/分词”结构中的 too 强烈激活；另对若干含 em 的 un- 词及西班牙语词内片段激活，后两类语义和关系不明。

patterns.name: too + 形容词／分词
patterns.trigger: «too»10 easy；«too»10 late；«too»10 coincidental；«too»9 derisive；«too»9 arrogant；«too»9 daunting
patterns.context: “too”后接评价性形容词或分词，常表达程度过高、不合适或难以承受；前面常有 it was、seems、sounds、may seem 等结构。
patterns.domain: 叙事、网络评论、对话及倡议文字

patterns.name: un- 否定／反义词内部片段
patterns.context: 激活落在 un- 开头词的词内片段“em”，涵盖 embarrassed、emotional、embellished 等不同词；语义并不一致，无法确定是词形还是局部 token 特征。
patterns.domain: 评论性文章及历史叙述

patterns.name: 西班牙语词内片段
patterns.context: 激活落在西班牙语副词或形容词的词内片段；同段还出现 tinta、corrompa、nombres、tienen 等西班牙语文本，但未标记。

en.description: Activates mainly in English degree constructions with too + adjective or much, often expressing excess or inappropriateness; it also activates on one Russian in-word fragment and one Spanish in-word fragment, which do not fit the same pattern.

patterns.name: too + degree/evaluative adjective or adverb
patterns.context: The trigger is the English degree adverb too, followed by an adjective or much to mean “excessively…,” including time evaluations such as too late and too soon. In several examples, it follows a subject or judgment expression such as it/that/seem.
patterns.domain: English spoken language, narrative, online discussion, news, and advice texts

patterns.name: Russian word-form fragment in Cyrillic
patterns.context: Activation falls on a short letter fragment inside a Russian word written in Cyrillic; there is no apparent semantic or syntactic condition shared with the English too construction.

patterns.name: Spanish in-word fragment
patterns.context: Activation falls inside a Spanish word form; «dist» appears in «distinta» and does not reflect the English degree-adverb too pattern.

6_203.concept: 英语程度结构 too + 补语
6_203.description: 主要在英语 too + 形容词或 much 的程度结构中激活，常表达过度或不合时宜；另有一次俄语词内片段和一次西班牙语词内片段激活，无法归入同一规律。

patterns.name: too + 程度/评价形容词或副词
patterns.trigger: «too»10« easy»（1）；«too»10 late（2）；«too»10 coincidental（3）；«too»9 soon（4）；«too»9« der»isive（5）；«too»9« much»（6）；«too»9 late（9）；«too»9 daunting（10）
patterns.context: 触发词是英语程度副词 too，后接形容词或 much，表示“过于……”，包括 too late、too soon 等时间评价；在若干例子中位于 it/that/seem 等主语或判断表达之后。
patterns.domain: 英语口语、叙事、网络讨论、新闻及建议类文本

patterns.name: 西里尔字母中的俄语词形片段
patterns.context: 激活落在俄语西里尔字母单词内部的短字母片段；看不出与英语 too 构式相同的语义或句法条件。

patterns.name: 西班牙语词内片段
patterns.context: 激活落在西班牙语词形内部；«dist» 出现在 «distinta» 中，未体现英语程度副词 too 的模式。

en.description: Most passages activate in English too + adjective/quantifier constructions indicating an excessive degree, modifying late, easy, much, and similar words; letter fragments in Russian technical Q&A are not explained by this pattern.

patterns.name: too + adjective expressing excessive degree
patterns.context: English uses too to modify an adjective, indicating an excessive degree; sometimes preceded by bit, almost, quite, or seemed.
patterns.domain: Narrative, forum reviews, Q&A, and everyday texts

patterns.name: too much expressing excess
patterns.context: too modifies much to express an excessive quantity; the following text lists topics such as population.

patterns.name: Russian Cyrillic letter fragments
patterns.context: A Russian StackExchange question discussing word checks in strings; no English too construction is present, and the trigger is unclear.

6_203.concept: 英语 too 程度构式
6_203.description: 多数段落在英语 too + 形容词/数量词的过度程度构式中激活，修饰 late、easy、much 等；俄语技术问答中的字母片段无法由此模式解释。

patterns.name: too + 形容词表示过度程度
patterns.context: 英语中用 too 修饰形容词，表示程度过高；有时前有 bit、almost、quite 或 seemed。
patterns.domain: 叙事、论坛评论、问答及生活类文本

patterns.name: too much 表示过量
patterns.context: too 修饰 much，表达数量过多；后文列举谈论人口等内容。

patterns.name: 俄语西里尔字母碎片
patterns.trigger: «л»、«и»、«п»、«р»等被标记的西里尔字母或短片段
patterns.context: 俄语 StackExchange 问题，讨论字符串中的单词检查；未见英语 too 构式，触发原因不明。

en.description: Activates mainly on English too constructions and their degree-evaluative uses, including easy, late, too soon, excessive, too much, and too “magic”; it also activates on the in-word fragments «ли» and «легкий» in two Russian passages.

patterns.name: too + degree/evaluative word
patterns.context: The sentence contains too in a degree evaluation meaning “excessively, too…”; it is followed by adjectives or adverbs such as easy, late, soon, derisive, much, and magic.
patterns.domain: Everyday narrative, dialogue, literature, commentary, and technical discussion

patterns.name: Russian string character checking
patterns.context: A Russian StackExchange question discusses how to determine whether a string contains a particular letter; activation falls on «ли», meaning “whether.”

patterns.name: Fragment in a Russian technical term
patterns.context: A Russian technical text describes a tool as lightweight; activation falls on the initial fragment of the Russian adjective «легкий» (lightweight).

6_203.concept: 程度词 too
6_203.description: 主要对英语 too 结构及其程度评价用法激活，涵盖易、晚、太早、过分、太多或太“魔法”等；另对两段俄语分别在 «ли» 和 «легкий» 的词内片段激活。

patterns.name: too + 程度/评价词
patterns.context: 句中出现 too，用于“过于、太……”的程度评价；后接 easy、late、soon、derisive、much、magic 等形容词或副词。
patterns.domain: 日常叙述、对话、文学、议论、技术讨论

patterns.name: 俄语字符串逐字检查
patterns.context: 俄语 StackExchange 问题中，讨论如何判断字符串里是否含有某个字母；激活落在表示“是否”的 «ли»。

patterns.name: 俄语技术词中的片段
patterns.context: 俄语技术文本里描述工具较轻量；激活落在俄语形容词 «легкий»（轻量的）的词首片段。

en.description: Primarily responds to English too structures meaning “excessively/too…,” covering too late, too soon, and too + adjective or degree word; there is also strong activation on an in-word Cyrillic fragment in a Russian passage, possibly an independent pattern.

patterns.name: too late
patterns.context: The phrase “too late” means that it is already too late to do something; it may be preceded by a copula or a sentence contrast.

patterns.name: too + adjective/degree word
patterns.context: “too” is followed by an adjective or quantity/degree expression to mean excessive or too…; the adjective may take a complement.

patterns.name: too soon
patterns.context: Asks whether starting toilet training is too early, using the structure “too soon.”

patterns.name: Russian in-word fragment
patterns.context: In a Russian technical question, activation falls on a segmented Cyrillic letter/subword fragment; no context matching the English too phrase is apparent.

6_203.concept: 英语 too 的过度程度表达
6_203.description: 主要对英语 too 表示“过于/太……”的结构起反应，覆盖 too late、too soon 及 too+形容词或程度词；另有一段俄语中词内西里尔字母片段的强激活，可能是独立模式。

patterns.name: too late
patterns.context: “too late”连用，表示事情已经来不及；前面可有 be 动词或句子转折。
patterns.domain: 口语、小说叙事、论坛讨论

patterns.name: too + 形容词/程度词
patterns.context: “too”后接形容词或数量程度表达，表示过于、太……；形容词可接后续补语。
patterns.domain: 论坛评论、日常叙述、小说

patterns.name: too soon
patterns.context: 询问开始如厕训练是否过早，结构为“too soon”。

patterns.name: 俄语词内片段
patterns.trigger: «л»9（строке 中的字符片段）；附近还有«по»、«сл»、«пр»、«е»等
patterns.context: 俄语技术问句中，激活落在被拆分标注的西里尔字母/子词片段上，未见与英语 too 短语相同的语境。

en.description: Primarily activates on English too followed by an adjective or adverb; it also strongly activates on the word-internal mp fragment in Romanian and several substrings in Russian technical text. Other short fragments and common words activate sporadically and do not form a unified pattern.

patterns.name: Word boundary after too
patterns.context: The adverb too is immediately followed by an adjective or adverb, as in “too soon,” “too derisive,” “too easy,” and “too late”; activation falls on too, not the following word.
patterns.domain: English conversation, narratives, and online text

patterns.name: Word-internal mp in Romanian
patterns.context: The consecutive letters mp occur inside Romanian words; the two examples have different word forms, both preceded by î and followed by otriva or reună, respectively.

patterns.name: Word-internal fragments in Russian
patterns.context: Sporadic Cyrillic substrings in Russian contexts, as well as English code/library-name substrings embedded in Russian explanations; there is no clear consistent morphological position or semantic condition.
patterns.domain: StackExchange technical Q&A, Russian text mixed with code

patterns.name: Isolated word-fragment activations
patterns.context: Short fragments occur within English words, involving legal citation parentheses and narrative description; there is no shared contextual condition.

patterns.name: Other sporadic short words and punctuation
patterns.context: Activation is distributed across sentence-initial contrast markers, common function words, pronouns, quotation marks, and punctuation; no stable local combination or semantic pattern is evident.
patterns.domain: English legal, narrative, and online text

6_203.concept: 多语种局部子串与 too
6_203.description: 主要激活于英语 too 后接形容词或副词；另在罗马尼亚语 mp 词内片段及俄语技术文本的若干子串上强激活。其余短片段和常见词激活零散，难归为统一模式。

patterns.name: too后续词语边界
patterns.context: 副词 too 后紧接形容词或副词，如“too soon”“too derisive”“too easy”“too late”；激活落在 too，而非其后的词。
patterns.domain: 英语口语、叙事及网络文本

patterns.name: 罗马尼亚语词内 mp
patterns.context: 罗马尼亚语词内部连续字母 mp；两例词形不同，左侧均为 î，右侧分别接 otriva、reună。
patterns.domain: EuroParl 罗马尼亚语政治文本

patterns.name: 俄语词内字母片段
patterns.context: 俄语语境中的零散西里尔字母子串，以及夹在俄语说明中的英文代码／库名子串；没有明显一致的词法位置或语义条件。
patterns.domain: StackExchange 技术问答，俄语文本夹杂代码

patterns.name: 孤立词片段激活
patterns.trigger: «n»9 位于“[n]either”；另有«ir»3 位于“irate”、«y»1 位于“youth”
patterns.context: 出现在英文词内的短片段，分别涉及法律引文括号、叙事描写；缺乏共同上下文条件。

patterns.name: 其他零散短词与标点
patterns.context: 激活分散于句首转折词、常见虚词、代词、引号及标点等，未见稳定的局部组合或语义模式。
patterns.domain: 英语法律、叙事及网络文本

en.concept: Mixed word-form fragments and the too construction
en.description: Activation falls mainly on the English too + degree complement construction, especially the prominent subtype too late; there are also Dutch in-word ep, Russian word-initial пр, and W at the start of a legal quotation, differing in language and word position.

patterns.name: too + adjective/adverb
patterns.context: too immediately precedes a degree adjective or adverb, expressing “excessively…”; the marked focus is usually too, though activation may extend to following material.
patterns.domain: Everyday narrative, fictional dialogue, parenting discussion

patterns.name: too late
patterns.context: Describes an action or change as already being too late; may be introduced by a copula such as was or be, or modified by a bit.

patterns.name: Dutch word-internal g«ep»
patterns.context: Appears inside a Dutch verb form, preceded by g, as a spelling fragment of that word; it differs from the English too construction.
patterns.domain: Dutch academic discussion and parliamentary speech

patterns.name: Russian word-internal пр«…»
patterns.context: The trigger occurs at the beginning of a Russian word and concerns checking whether a string contains a substring.

patterns.name: W at the start of a statutory quotation
patterns.context: Appears at the beginning of an English legal quotation; it shows no lexical or syntactic condition shared with the other trigger patterns.

6_203.concept: 混合词形片段与 too 构式
6_203.description: 激活主要落在英语 too + 程度补语结构，尤以 too late 为突出子型；另有荷兰语词内 ep、俄语词首 пр及法律引文句首 W，语种和词形位置各异。

patterns.name: too + 形容词/副词
patterns.trigger: «too»（[1] 的 “too easy”，[5] 的 “too derisive”，[6] 的 “too soon”）
patterns.context: too 紧接程度形容词或副词，表达“过于……”；被标记的重点多为 too，也可能延伸到后续成分。
patterns.domain: 日常叙述、小说对白、育儿讨论

patterns.name: too late
patterns.trigger: «too» + «late»（[7] “it was too late”；[8] “be too late”；[9] “a bit too late”）
patterns.context: 描述行动或改变已经来不及；可由 was、be 等系动词引出，也可受 a bit 修饰。
patterns.domain: 小说叙述、新闻评论、技术问答

patterns.name: 荷兰语词中 g«ep»
patterns.context: 出现在荷兰语动词词形内部，前接 g，构成该词的拼写片段；与英语 too 结构不同。
patterns.domain: 荷兰语学术讨论与议会发言

patterns.name: 俄语词中 пр«…»
patterns.context: 触发部分位于俄语词的词首，涉及检查字符串中是否存在子串。
patterns.domain: 俄语 StackExchange 技术问答

patterns.name: 法条引用中的 W
patterns.context: 出现在英文法律条文引文的句首，未显示与其他触发模式相同的词汇或句法条件。

en.description: Primarily responds to English too followed by an adjective or adverb meaning “excessively, too…”; often occurs after a copula or seems. There is also activation on sentence-final too meaning “also” and on two Dutch in-word ep fragments, which may be independent or incidental patterns.

patterns.name: too + degree/adjective construction
patterns.context: In English, too is followed by an adjective or adverb and means “excessively/too…”. Some contexts contain a nearby copula or pronoun, as in “seemed too easy,” “it's too soon,” “was too late,” “seems too simple,” and “too coincidental.”
patterns.domain: Multiple styles, including spoken language, narrative, news, technical Q&A, and forums

patterns.name: Sentence-final too (“also”)
patterns.context: too occurs at the end of a sentence and means “also”; it is not immediately followed by an adjective or degree expression.

patterns.name: Dutch in-word substring op
patterns.context: The activation fragment is embedded in the Dutch past participle geprobeerd (tried), rather than in the English too construction; it appears near the context of conflict proberen te sussen.

patterns.name: Dutch in-word substring ep
patterns.context: The activation fragment is embedded in the Dutch gepresenteerd (presented); there is no apparent English too construction.

6_203.concept: 英语 too 程度结构
6_203.description: 主要响应英语 too 后接形容词或副词的“过于、太……”结构，常见于系动词或 seems 后；另在句末 too“也”及两个荷兰语词内片段 ep 上有激活，可能是独立或偶然模式。

patterns.name: too + 程度/形容词结构
patterns.context: 英语中 too 后接形容词或副词，表示“过于/太……”。有的上下文含近邻系动词或代词，如“seemed too easy”“it's too soon”“was too late”“seems too simple”“too coincidental”。
patterns.domain: 口语、叙事、新闻、技术问答、论坛等多种文体

patterns.name: 句末 too（也、还）
patterns.context: too 位于句末，表示“也”；没有紧接形容词或程度表达。

patterns.name: 荷兰语词内子串 op
patterns.context: 激活片段嵌在荷兰语过去分词 geprobeerd（尝试）中，而非英语 too 结构；该片段出现在 conflict proberen te sussen 的语境附近。

patterns.name: 荷兰语词内子串 ep
patterns.context: 激活片段嵌在荷兰语 gepresenteerd（被呈现）中；无明显英语 too 结构。

en.description: Most passages activate when too is followed by a degree or evaluative expression; there is also consistent activation on in-word ep substrings in Dutch and technical texts. Local degree or contrast words such as seem, course, and bit also accompany strong activation.

patterns.name: Degree use of too
patterns.context: too combines with an adjective or degree expression to mean “excessively/too…”; it occurs in evaluations of difficulty, timing, or burden.
patterns.domain: Everyday narrative, parenting, climate issues, news, fiction, and expository writing

patterns.name: Dutch in-word ep substring
patterns.context: Activation falls inside Dutch words or words containing a similar letter sequence; no clear shared lexical or syntactic condition is apparent.
patterns.domain: European Parliament texts, Dutch commentary, technical texts, and URLs

patterns.name: Local degree adverbs and contrastive combinations
patterns.context: Words expressing judgment, degree, or contrast occur around too; this may relate to local degree expressions, but activation remains centered mainly on too.

6_203.concept: 过度程度表达与 ep 子串
6_203.description: 多数段落在 too 后接程度或评价表达时激活；另有荷兰语及技术文本中词内 ep 子串的稳定激活。局部 seem、course、bit 等程度或转折词也伴随较强激活。

patterns.name: too 的程度用法
patterns.context: too 与形容词或程度表达连用，表示“过于／太……”；出现于评价难易、时机、负担等语境
patterns.domain: 日常叙述、育儿、气候议题、新闻、小说、说明文

patterns.name: 荷兰语词内 ep 子串
patterns.context: 激活落在荷兰语或含类似字母序列的词内部；未见明显一致的词义或句法条件
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会文本、荷兰语评论、技术文本及网址

patterns.name: 局部强度副词与转折搭配
patterns.context: too 前后出现表示判断、程度或转折的词；可能与局部程度表达有关，但激活中心仍主要落在 too

en.description: All passages contain high activation on “too,” used to express an excessive degree or an evaluation that exceeds expectations; it is followed by positive or negative adjectives or judgments of complexity and coincidence, across varied styles and topics.

patterns.name: “too” and its following evaluation
patterns.context: “too” appears in an evaluative or judgment construction, followed by an adjective (such as “easy,” “late,” “daunting,” “arrogant,” “bad,” “sweet,” or “derisive”) or a degree/complexity description (“simple,” “coincidental”); it often means excessively or too..., and is sometimes followed by a to-phrase.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain dialogue, news, fiction, reviews, and technical discussions

patterns.name: Incidental matches of “too” inside words
patterns.context: The annotation boundary may fall inside a word; “Cr”/“m” do not themselves form a unified semantic trigger, and the main activation still coincides with the “too” evaluative construction that follows.

6_203.concept: “too”程度评价
6_203.description: 全部段落都包含高激活的“too”，用于表达程度过高或出乎预期的评价；后接正负面形容词或复杂度、巧合度判断，文体与主题各异。

patterns.name: “too”字样及其后续评价
patterns.context: “too”出现在评价或判断结构中，后接形容词（如 “easy”“late”“daunting”“arrogant”“bad”“sweet”“derisive”），或程度/复杂度描述（“simple”“coincidental”）；常表示过于、太……，有时后接 to 短语。
patterns.domain: 跨领域对话、新闻、小说、评论与技术讨论

patterns.name: “too”在词内的偶然匹配
patterns.trigger: [1] 中 “chocolate.«Cr»unchy”附近的局部标记及 “s’«m»ores”中的标记；另有紧邻 “too” 的标记 token
patterns.context: 标注边界可能切在词内部；如 “Cr”/“m”本身并不构成统一语义触发，主要激活仍与随后出现的 “too” 评价结构重合。
patterns.domain: 语料 token 标注现象

en.description: Every passage contains too followed by an adjective or degree/comparison phrase, expressing excess or exceeding an appropriate degree; several passages also use a bit/a little to soften the tone, and others include coincidence judgments and two negative comparisons. The first passage also activates on the in-word fragments Cr and m.

patterns.name: Degree evaluation after too
patterns.context: Activation occurs on the degree adverb too, followed by an adjective or a phrase expressing degree, quantity, or similarity. It often evaluates something as excessive, expressing dissatisfaction, concern, opposition, or subjective judgment.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain spoken language, commentary, forum Q&A, and everyday narrative

patterns.name: little/a bit degree construction
patterns.context: A phrase expressing a small degree occurs before too. In passage 10, bit is separated from too by intervening context before “much,” but it still forms “a bit too much.”

patterns.name: Likelihood and excessive-coincidence judgment
patterns.context: States that the coincidence between two events is too strong, implying that it is not accidental; this differs from simply complaining about excess or difficulty.

patterns.name: Negative comparison to homework as excessive
patterns.context: Uses “too much like” to negatively compare an operation to homework, expressing that it is tedious or unwelcome.
patterns.domain: Everyday comments on product or user experience

patterns.name: Negative comparison to magic as excessive
patterns.context: Uses “too … magic” to criticize a technical solution as overly mysterious or opaque; the context is an opinion about how code is implemented.

patterns.name: Excessive resemblance to treating symptoms
patterns.context: Compares banning a behavior to excessively treating symptoms; “a bit too much like” expresses an excessive degree.

patterns.name: Cr and M in local fragments
patterns.context: These occur at in-word segmentation points in “Crunchy” and “s’mores”; the fragments provide insufficient evidence to link them to the other activation patterns.

6_203.concept: too 引出的过度程度评价
6_203.description: 所有段都出现 too 后接形容词或程度/类比短语，表达过度、超出合适程度；若干段另有 a bit/a little 弱化语气，另含巧合判断与两种负面类比。第1段还激活了词内碎片 Cr、m。

patterns.name: too 后接程度评价
patterns.trigger: «too»，尤见于 “too easy”“too simple”“too coincidental”“too daunting”“too much”“too late”“too arrogant”“too sweet”“too much like”
patterns.context: 在程度副词 too 后激活，后接形容词或表示程度、数量、相似性的短语；常用于评价某事过于某种程度，表达不满、顾虑、反对或主观判断。
patterns.domain: 跨领域口语、评论、论坛问答与日常叙述

patterns.name: little/a bit 程度结构
patterns.context: 在 too 前出现表示轻微程度的短语；第10段中 bit 与 too 之间有 “much” 前的上下文间隔，但同样构成 “a bit too much”。
patterns.domain: 非正式评论与会话式写作

patterns.name: 似然与过度巧合判断
patterns.context: 指出两个事件的巧合程度过高，暗示并非偶然；不同于单纯抱怨过度或太难。

patterns.name: 过度像作业的负面类比
patterns.context: 用 “too much like” 将某项操作负面类比为作业，表达其繁琐或不讨喜。
patterns.domain: 对产品或操作体验的日常评论

patterns.name: 过度像魔法的负面类比
patterns.context: 以 “too … magic” 批评技术方案显得过于神秘或隐晦；语境为对代码实现方式的意见。

patterns.name: 过度像对症状下手
patterns.context: 把禁止某种行为比作过度针对症状处理；由 “a bit too much like” 表示程度过头。

patterns.name: 局部碎片中的 Cr 与 M
patterns.context: 出现在 “Crunchy” 与 “s’mores” 的词内切分位置；片段未提供足够证据说明它们与其余激活模式有关。

en.description: The passages share the English word “too” used for degree evaluation, especially too + adjective, meaning excessively easy, late, bad, difficult, coincidental, or extreme. Structures such as too much and too soon also express burden, complexity, or inappropriate timing.

patterns.name: too + adjective/evaluation
patterns.context: “too” precedes an adjective or evaluative element, expressing a degree beyond what is appropriate, acceptable, or expected. In many passages, “too” itself is a high-activation point, and the adjacent adjective is sometimes also marked.
patterns.domain: Everyday narrative, programming Q&A, news commentary, technical discussion, forum exchanges, and articles about climate issues

patterns.name: too + quantity or burden evaluation
patterns.context: “too” occurs in a construction modified by a degree adverb or quantity word, evaluating something as overly burdensome, complex, or opaque like magic; in passage 8, it is followed by “too much like homework,” expressing annoyance.
patterns.domain: Technical discussion, forum commentary, and expressions of personal preference

patterns.name: too + time or timing evaluation
patterns.context: “too” modifies an adjective denoting timing or a temporal state, asking or judging whether something is too early or too late.

patterns.name: Non-evaluative/incomplete contexts containing “too”
patterns.context: “too” and a degree construction still occur, but the local context or annotation boundary differs: passage 1 adds a contrasting qualification afterward, passage 4 evaluates “magic,” and passage 8 continues the comparison “like homework.”

6_203.concept: 过度程度评价
6_203.description: 各段共同点是英语“too”构成程度评价，尤其是 too + 形容词，表示过于容易、晚、糟、艰巨、巧合或极端；也见于 too much、too soon 等结构，表达负担、复杂度或时机不合适。

patterns.name: too + 形容词/评价
patterns.trigger: «too»10 easy；«too»10 simple；«too»9 late；«too»9 bad；«too»9 daunting；«too»9 coincidental；«too»9 extreme
patterns.context: “too”置于形容词或评价性成分之前，表达程度超出合适、可接受或预期范围；在多段中“too”本身是高激活点，邻接形容词有时也被标记。
patterns.domain: 日常叙述、编程问答、新闻评论、技术讨论、论坛交流及气候议题文章

patterns.name: too + 数量或负担评价
patterns.context: “too”出现在程度副词或数量词修饰的结构中，评价某事过于繁重、复杂或像魔法般不透明；在第8段后接“too much like homework”，表达嫌麻烦。
patterns.domain: 技术讨论、论坛评论及个人偏好表达

patterns.name: too + 时间或时机评价
patterns.context: “too”修饰表示时机或时间状态的形容词，询问或判断是否过早、过晚。
patterns.domain: 育儿咨询、政治新闻评论

patterns.name: “too”所在的非评价性/不完整语境
patterns.trigger: «too»9（第1段：«too»10 easy 后接 «Plus»；第4段：«too»9 后接引号内的“magic”；第8段：«too»9« much»4« like»3）
patterns.context: 仍出现“too”及程度结构，但局部语境或标注边界不同：第1段后续转折补充，第4段评价“magic”，第8段继续比较“like homework”。

en.description: All passages contain “too” followed by a description of a quality, expressing that something is considered excessive, inappropriate, or too early/late; some use seems/looks to present an inference, while a bit/a little softens the tone. Sporadic activation words lack a unified pattern.

patterns.name: Degree evaluation after “too”
patterns.context: “too” occupies the degree-adverb position and modifies a following adjective or description of a quality; it often expresses the speaker’s subjective judgment about difficulty, timing, quantity, credibility, or cost.
patterns.domain: Everyday narrative, technical Q&A, forum commentary, news, and parenting discussion

patterns.name: “a bit/a little” plus “too” as a softened degree expression
patterns.context: “a bit” or “a little” occurs before “too,” softening a negative or strong evaluation into a milder judgment; “too” still introduces the quality considered excessive.

patterns.name: Inferred evaluation introduced by “seems/looks”
patterns.context: In the “seems/looks too + quality” construction, the evaluation is presented as an observation or inference rather than a direct assertion; it may also include “a bit/a little.”
patterns.domain: Narrative, forum discussion, and technical Q&A

patterns.name: Adjacent local activations without “too”
patterns.context: These marks are scattered through passages containing “too,” but do not form a clear, unified independent trigger construction; they may reflect broader contextual effects or secondary associations.

6_203.concept: too引出的过度评价
6_203.description: 全部段落都出现“too”及其后的性质描述，表达被认为过度、不合适或来得过早/过晚；有些用seems/looks呈现推断，用a bit/a little缓和语气。零散激活词缺少统一模式。

patterns.name: “too”后的程度评价
patterns.trigger: «too»10 / «too»9：too easy、too simple、too late、too much、too magic、too coincidental、too extreme、too resource consuming、too soon
patterns.context: “too”处于程度副词位置，修饰后续形容词或性质描述；常表达说话者对难度、时机、数量、可信度或代价的主观判断。
patterns.domain: 日常叙述、技术问答、论坛评论、新闻与育儿讨论

patterns.name: “a bit/a little”加“too”的弱化程度表达
patterns.context: “too”前有“a bit”或“a little”，将负面或过强评价弱化为较温和的判断；仍由“too”引出被认为过度的性质。
patterns.domain: 口语化评论与技术讨论

patterns.name: “seems/looks”引出的推断评价
patterns.context: 在“seems/looks too + 性质”结构中，评价被表述为观察或推断，而非直接断言；其中也可能伴随“a bit/a little”。
patterns.domain: 叙述、论坛讨论与技术问答

patterns.name: 不含“too”的相邻局部激活
patterns.context: 这些标记分散在含“too”的段落中，但并未形成统一、明显的独立触发结构；可能是较宽的上下文效应或次要关联。

en.description: All snippets activate on English too constructions, commonly too + adjective, adverb, or phrase, expressing excess, inappropriateness, or being too late/early; they are often preceded by judgment predicates such as seem, sound, or be.

patterns.name: too + degree or evaluative complement
patterns.context: Occurs in the English too + complement construction, indicating an excessive or inappropriate degree or that something is too late; the complement may follow immediately or be separated by a small amount of text. too has the highest annotation strength in each passage.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain English narratives, reviews, Q&A, and literary dialogue

patterns.name: Evaluative context preceding too
patterns.context: too follows a predicate that judges an object, plan, or timing; in some examples, it is introduced by degree expressions such as bit, a bit, or little.
patterns.domain: Personal opinions, explanatory writing, technical Q&A, and narratives

6_203.concept: 英语 too 程度结构
6_203.description: 所有片段都激活于英语 too 结构，常见 too + 形容词、副词或短语，表达过度、不合适或太迟太早；前文常有 seem、sound、be 等判断谓语。

patterns.name: too + 程度或评价补语
patterns.trigger: «too»，常与后面的形容词、副词或短语连用，如 «too»10 easy、«too»9 much、«too»9 daunting、«too»9 simple、«too»9 "magic"、«too»9 late、«too»9 soon
patterns.context: 出现在英语 too + 补语结构中，表示程度过高、不合适或为时已晚；补语可紧接其后，也可能跨越少量文本。各段中 too 的标注强度最高。
patterns.domain: 跨领域英语叙述、评论、问答及文学对话

patterns.name: too 的前置评价语境
patterns.trigger: «too»前的 «seemed»、«sounds»、«seems»、«is»、«was»、«might be» 等，如 «seemed»« too»10 easy、«sounds» … «too»9 much、«is» … «too»9 late
patterns.context: too 位于对某事物、方案或时机作判断的谓语之后；在部分例子中由 bit、a bit 或 little 等程度表达引出。
patterns.domain: 个人意见、解释性文字、技术问答、叙事

en.concept: too and word-initial fragments in legal quotations
en.description: Primarily activates on degree evaluations after too or on “too late,” though the words following too and its sentence position vary; it also activates on word-initial fragments after bracketed markers in three legal quotations, possibly reflecting an independent formatting/word-initial pattern.

patterns.name: too followed by a degree or judgment word
patterns.context: “too” combines with a following word to form a degree evaluation or an expression meaning “too late”; the activation falls on too, but the triggering context varies.
patterns.domain: Everyday narrative, technical Q&A, commentary, fiction, and legal texts

patterns.name: Word-initial fragments in legal texts
patterns.context: Lowercase or uppercase p/P inside a quotation’s square brackets and the word-initial fragment after the closing bracket; characters may be split by quotation editing.

6_203.concept: too及法律引文词首片段
6_203.description: 主要激活于 too 后的程度评价或“too late”，但 too 后接词及句末均有变化；另在三段法律引文中激活于方括号标记后的词首片段，可能是独立的格式/词首模式。

patterns.name: too 后接程度或判断词
patterns.context: “too”与后续词构成程度评价或“为时已晚”表达；激活落在 too，而触发语境有所不同
patterns.domain: 日常叙述、技术问答、评论、小说和法律文本

patterns.name: 法律文本中的词首片段
patterns.context: 引文方括号中的小写或大写 p/P 与右括号之后的词首片段；字符可能因引文编辑而拆分

en.concept: “too” evaluative expressions and miscellaneous word fragments
en.description: Most passages activate on English too in evaluative or comparative contexts, often followed by much, easy, or daunting to indicate excess; there are also word-internal fragment activations in Dutch, Danish, chemistry, and legal texts that are difficult to explain with this pattern.

patterns.name: Evaluative expressions near “too”
patterns.context: Occurs when comparing or evaluating something, especially in “too + degree/evaluative word” constructions; a reason, explanation, or infinitive may follow.
patterns.domain: Narratives, reviews, news, technical Q&A, and other styles

patterns.name: Word-internal Dutch fragments
patterns.context: Occurs inside Dutch words, involving spelling or word forms; there is no clear semantic connection to the English “too” pattern.

patterns.name: Word-internal chemical-term fragments
patterns.context: Occurs inside complex chemical names, next to other reagent names and concentration symbols.
patterns.domain: Biomedical methods or experimental materials descriptions

patterns.name: Fragment within a legal word
patterns.context: Occurs within an editorial insertion or revision marker for the word “prisoners” in a legal quotation.

patterns.name: Incomplete or token-boundary fragment
patterns.context: Occurs inside a Danish word, at the beginning of the word after a hyphen; there is no clear context corresponding to the main pattern.

6_203.concept: “too”评价表达及杂项词片段
6_203.description: 多数段落在评价或比较语境中激活英语 too，常接 much、easy、daunting，表示程度过高；另有荷兰语、丹麦语、化学及法律文本中的词内片段激活，难与该模式统一解释。

patterns.name: “too”附近的评价表达
patterns.trigger: « too»，常与« much»、« easy»或« daunting»相邻
patterns.context: 在比较或评价某事时，尤其是“too + 程度/评价词”；后文可能接原因、解释或不定式。
patterns.domain: 叙述、评论、新闻、技术问答等多种文体

patterns.name: 荷兰语词内片段
patterns.context: 出现在荷兰语单词内部，涉及词语拼写或词形；与英语“too”模式无明显语义联系。

patterns.name: 化学术语词内片段
patterns.context: 出现在复杂化学名称的内部，与周围试剂名称及浓度符号相邻。
patterns.domain: 生物医学方法或实验材料描述

patterns.name: 法律词语内部片段
patterns.context: 出现在法律引文中对单词“prisoners”的编辑性插入或修订标记内。
patterns.domain: 法律意见书或司法引文

patterns.name: 残缺或分词边界片段
patterns.context: 在丹麦语单词内部，且处于连字符后的词首位置；没有明显对应主模式的上下文。

en.description: Strongly responds to the section label “News” in news text, the subword fragment “iot” in medical titles, and “Application” at the start of abstracts; it also responds to a biomedical abstract containing “stimulation”.

patterns.name: News section heading
patterns.context: A standalone section label at the beginning of a sentence, often followed by a date, line break, or news item

patterns.name: Specific subword fragment in medical terms
patterns.context: Embedded in “Cardiotoxicity” and “episiotomy”, appearing in medical titles or comparison topics

patterns.name: “Application” at the start of a title
patterns.context: At the beginning of a title or abstract, followed by “of” and a technology or method name

patterns.name: Stimulation-related expressions
patterns.context: Describes increased cytokine production after lipopolysaccharide stimulation

6_432.concept: 标题与栏目开头标记
6_432.description: 强响应于新闻文本的栏目标签“News”，也响应医学标题中的“iot”词片段及摘要开头的“Application”；另对一段含“stimulation”的生物医学摘要有响应。

patterns.name: 新闻栏目标题
patterns.context: 句首独立栏目标签，常接日期、换行或新闻条目

patterns.name: 医学术语中的特定词片段
patterns.context: 嵌在“Cardiotoxicity”“episiotomy”中，出现在医学标题或比较主题里

patterns.name: 应用标题中的“Application”
patterns.context: 标题或摘要开头，后接“of”及技术或方法名称

patterns.name: 刺激相关表达
patterns.context: 描述脂多糖刺激后细胞因子产生增加

en.description: Activation is concentrated on “News” at the start of news entries, and also occurs on fragments within several terms in medical abstracts and on “Application” at the start of technical abstract titles. No stable shared lexical meaning or syntactic condition is evident across contexts.

patterns.name: “News” in titles
patterns.context: Occurs at the beginning of text or an entry, as a title, section label, or opening word of a news headline; the following content varies.

patterns.name: Word-final fragments in medical terms
patterns.context: Occurs within specialized words or terms in medical abstracts; appears in different words, with no stable full-word form or semantic theme evident.

patterns.name: “Application” in technical titles
patterns.context: At the beginning of an abstract title or title-like phrase, followed by a description of a PCR method or measurement technique.

6_432.concept: 文档标题或条目开头
6_432.description: 激活主要集中在新闻条目开头的“News”，也见于医学摘要中若干术语内部的片段，以及技术摘要标题开头的“Application”。跨模式未见稳定共同词义或句法条件。

patterns.name: 标题中的“News”
patterns.trigger: «News»；其后可接年份、换行、地点、栏目或新闻导语
patterns.context: 出现在文本或条目的开头，作为标题、栏目标签或新闻标题起始词；后续内容不固定

patterns.name: 医学术语中的词尾片段
patterns.context: 出现在医学摘要中的专业词或术语内部；不同词中出现，未见稳定的完整词形或语义主题

patterns.name: 技术标题中的“Application”
patterns.trigger: «Application»，后接 «of» 及具体技术或方法名
patterns.context: 摘要标题或标题式短语的开头，后面接 PCR 方法或测量技术描述

en.description: Strongly responds to the news website section word “News,” especially at the start of a title or section; also responds to several term fragments in medical abstracts and to abstract openings, including «iot», «stimulation», and «Application», with no stable shared medical semantics evident.

patterns.name: News headline or section opening
patterns.context: At the beginning of a news website or news section, often followed by a date, section name, or “News of the ...” introducing a news topic; activation is concentrated on the title word News.

patterns.name: Fragment «iot» in medical terms
patterns.context: Embedded in medical words such as cardiotoxicity (Cardiotoxicity) and episiotomy; not at a complete word boundary.

patterns.name: Opening fragments in proper names or terms in abstracts
patterns.context: In medical abstracts, involving stimulation experiments, species names, methods, or application titles; activation falls on specific terms or at the start of abstracts.

6_432.concept: 新闻标题/栏目起始标记
6_432.description: 强烈响应新闻网页栏目词“News”，尤其标题或栏目开头；另在医学摘要中响应若干术语片段及摘要开头，包括«iot»、«stimulation»和«Application»，未见稳定的医学语义共性。

patterns.name: 新闻标题或栏目开头
patterns.context: 新闻网页或新闻栏目开头，常接日期、栏目名或以“News of the ...”引出新闻主题；激活集中在标题词 News

patterns.name: 医学术语中的片段 «iot»
patterns.context: 嵌在心脏毒性（Cardiotoxicity）和会阴切开术（episiotomy）等医学词语中；不是完整词边界

patterns.name: 摘要中的专名或术语起始片段
patterns.context: 医学摘要中，分别涉及刺激实验、物种名、方法或应用标题；激活落在具体术语或摘要开头

en.description: Activation is concentrated in PubMed abstract titles beginning with “Application of”, the medical term cardiotoxicity, expressions about cytokines after stimulation, and the News label in web text; these are mainly formatting cues at the start of titles or sections.

patterns.name: Subword segmentation within Cardiotoxicity
patterns.context: A disease or topic term in medical abstracts; activation falls on the subword fragments into which cardiotoxicity is split.

patterns.name: Title opening with Application of
patterns.context: Abstract titles begin with “Application of”, followed by different technologies, theories, or analytical uses; the subsequent topics vary.

patterns.name: Expression about cytokines after stimulation
patterns.context: Describes increased production of pro-inflammatory cytokines in patients after LPS stimulation, involving an X-linked disease.

patterns.name: News label
patterns.context: Web content starts with a News label or section heading, followed by a date, body text, company name, financial brief, or opening announcement.

6_432.concept: 标题与栏目开头标记
6_432.description: 激活集中于 PubMed 摘要标题中“Application of”开头、医学术语 cardiotoxicity、刺激后细胞因子表述，以及网页文本的 News 标签；各处主要是标题或栏目开头的格式线索。

patterns.name: Cardiotoxicity 词内分段
patterns.context: 医学摘要中的疾病或主题术语，激活落在被拆分的 cardiotoxicity 各子词片段上。

patterns.name: Application of 标题开头
patterns.context: 摘要标题以“Application of”开头，后接不同技术、理论或分析用途；后续主题并不一致。

patterns.name: 刺激后细胞因子表述
patterns.context: 描述 LPS 刺激后患者促炎细胞因子产生增加，且涉及 X 连锁疾病。

patterns.name: News 标签
patterns.context: 网页内容以 News 标签或栏目标题起始，后接日期、正文、公司名、财经简报或开业消息。

en.description: Activation mainly corresponds to two kinds of title openings: “Application of” in PubMed paper titles and “News” in web news headlines; it also responds strongly to a fragment within the medical term “Cardiotoxicity.”

patterns.name: Application of in paper titles
patterns.context: Academic paper titles beginning with “Application of …”; subsequent topics vary and often include specialized terms.

patterns.name: News in titles
patterns.context: A news section or headline begins with “News,” possibly followed by a date, news topic, or “News of the …” construction.

patterns.name: Toxicity term fragment
patterns.context: The word “Cardiotoxicity” is split into multiple subword fragments in a medical abstract title.

6_432.concept: 标题开头及术语片段
6_432.description: 激活主要对应两种标题开头：PubMed论文题名中的“Application of”，以及网页新闻标题中的“News”；另对医学术语“Cardiotoxicity”内部片段强烈响应。

patterns.name: 论文标题中的 Application of
patterns.context: 以“Application of …”开头的学术论文标题；后续主题各异，常接专门术语。

patterns.name: 标题中的 News
patterns.context: 新闻栏目或标题以“News”开头，后续可带日期、新闻主题或“News of the …”结构。

patterns.name: 毒性术语片段
patterns.context: “Cardiotoxicity”一词被拆分成多个子词片段，处于医学摘要标题中。

en.description: Strong activation patterns are sporadic: “Application of” in paper titles, subword segmentation of specialist terms across domains, and local words in mathematical formulas, online criticism, and code comments. No unified semantic or syntactic trigger is apparent.

patterns.name: “Application of” in technical paper titles
patterns.context: Paper titles beginning with “Application of X”; activation concentrates on “Application”, followed by the subject of the application.
patterns.domain: PubMed technical paper titles; topics include PCR, spectroscopy, ionic liquids, and chromatography

patterns.name: Morpheme boundaries in technical terms
patterns.context: Specialist terms are split into multiple tokens, with local context including compounds, affixes, or proper names; the examples cover different topics.
patterns.domain: Biomedical, optical fiber communications, chemistry, and other technical texts

patterns.name: wrt in mathematical expressions
patterns.context: At the end of a formula, “wrt j” indicates differentiation with respect to j or a related operation.
patterns.domain: Mathematical formulas or computer algebra text

patterns.name: Critical tone word in CO₂ discussion
patterns.context: An informal comment uses a vulgar exclamation to express dissatisfaction, followed by sarcasm about a claim receiving approval.

patterns.name: making in a tmux configuration comment
patterns.context: A comment after a shell alias configuration describes tmux causing abnormal Vim colors.

6_432.concept: none
6_432.description: 强激活模式较分散：论文标题中的“Application of”、多领域专业词的子词切分，以及数学公式、网络批评和代码注释中的局部词语；尚无统一的语义或语法触发条件。

patterns.name: 科技论文题名中的“Application of”
patterns.context: 以“Application of X”开头的论文标题；激活集中在“Application”上，后面说明应用对象。
patterns.domain: PubMed 科技论文标题；涉及 PCR、光谱、离子液体、色谱等主题

patterns.name: 技术术语中的词素边界
patterns.context: 专业术语被切分成多个 token，且局部上下文包括复合词、词缀或专名；各例主题并不相同。
patterns.domain: 生物医学、光纤通信、化学等科技文本

patterns.name: 数学表达式中的 wrt
patterns.trigger: «wrt»，邻接含变量 j、a 的代数表达式
patterns.context: 公式末尾用“wrt j”表示对 j 求导或相关运算。
patterns.domain: 数学公式或计算机代数文本

patterns.name: CO₂ 论述中的批评语气词
patterns.trigger: «Shit»，位于对 CO₂ 循环论述的批评之后
patterns.context: 口语化评论以粗俗感叹词表达不满，后接对某种说法获得认可的讽刺。

patterns.name: tmux 配置注释中的 making
patterns.trigger: «making»，出现在“Fix tmux making vim colors funky”中
patterns.context: shell alias 配置后的注释描述 tmux 导致 Vim 颜色异常。

en.description: Activation is spread across place and personal names beginning with or containing Par; other examples include G-quadruplexes, Nickel, numbers and formulas in sequences, symmetry vocabulary, and fragments of Fireclays. The patterns are diverse and cannot be explained by a single semantic topic.

patterns.name: Par in Paraguay and related place names
patterns.context: Triggered within proper names, commonly countries, place names, and personal names beginning with or containing Par; surrounding characters split the names into multiple tokens.

patterns.name: G in molecular biology terminology
patterns.context: Appears in molecular biology titles describing G-quadruplex formation and sequence specificity.

patterns.name: Word-initial fragment of Nickel
patterns.context: Activation falls on the initial fragment of Nickel in a paper title and abstract about the biochemical effects of nickel compounds on the lungs.

patterns.name: Numbers and arithmetic expressions in sequence problems
patterns.context: Appears in questions asking for the nth term of a sequence and in their numeric or formula answers; activation is distributed over number and expression fragments.

patterns.name: Symmetry-related terminology
patterns.context: Appears in explanations of central symmetry in plane geometry and in discussions of symmetry in genetics.

patterns.name: Refractory material term in patent background
patterns.context: Located in a patent background paragraph introducing lining materials for metallurgical vessels; activation corresponds to split fragments of Fireclays.

6_432.concept: none
6_432.description: 激活分散于 Par 开头或含 Par 的地名、人名；另见 G-四链体、Nickel、数列数字与公式、对称性词汇及 Fireclays 的片段。模式多样，不能由单一语义主题解释。

patterns.name: Paraguay及相关地名中的 Par
patterns.context: 在专名内部触发，常见于以 Par 开头或含 Par 的国家、地名、人名；周边字符会把专名拆成多个 token。
patterns.domain: 医学摘要、维基百科（地理、体育、音乐）

patterns.name: 分子生物学术语中的 G
patterns.context: 出现在描述 G-四链体形成及序列特异性的分子生物学标题中。

patterns.name: Nickel 的词首片段
patterns.context: 在关于镍化合物对肺部生化反应的论文标题及摘要中，激活落在 Nickel 的词首片段。

patterns.name: 数学数列题中的数字与运算式
patterns.context: 出现在询问数列第 n 项的题目及其数字或公式答案中，激活分布于数值和算式片段。

patterns.name: 对称性相关术语
patterns.context: 出现在平面几何的中心对称性质说明，以及遗传学中关于对称性的论述中。
patterns.domain: 维基百科数学、PubMed 遗传学

patterns.name: 专利背景中的耐火材料术语
patterns.context: 位于介绍冶金容器内衬材料的专利背景段落中，激活对应 Fireclays 的拆分片段。

en.concept: Structured symbols and terminology in technical texts
en.description: Activation is heterogeneous: it highlights negative numbers, decimals, and multiplication in arithmetic problems; other examples occur in code fields, asthma terminology, paper formulas, and sporadic key terms across disciplines. No unified trigger is apparent.

patterns.name: Negative numbers and decimals in arithmetic problems
patterns.context: Negative numbers, decimals, multiplication, and results occur together in arithmetic problems or calculation tables; activation also falls on some number fragments.

patterns.name: Field values in structured data
patterns.context: In code or configuration text, field names, string values, and punctuation form a structured record; this is the only example.

patterns.name: Asthma treatment and disease terminology
patterns.context: In asthma-related medical discussion, the disease name is split into adjacent tokens and followed by epidemiological description; other medical terms also show weaker activation.

patterns.name: Symbolic expressions in mathematics and physics
patterns.context: LaTeX mathematical symbols, variables, and formula fragments appear in technical papers; activation locations are scattered, with no consistent specific symbol.
patterns.domain: Mathematics, theoretical physics, and applied physics papers

patterns.name: Research subjects or key terms in papers
patterns.context: When academic text states the research subject, set, or measured quantity, a few terms receive strong activation; the trigger words differ from one another.
patterns.domain: Mathematics, scientific papers, and research proposals

6_432.concept: 专业文本中的结构化符号与术语
6_432.description: 激活分布异质：算术题中突出负数、小数与乘法；其余见于代码字段、哮喘术语、论文公式，以及不同学科文本中的零散关键术语，未形成统一触发条件。

patterns.name: 负数与小数的算术题
patterns.trigger: «times»5、«product»4、«Multiply»2、«Work»4 out；算式中的负号和数字，如«-»3«40»3«.»1«8»4
patterns.context: 算术题或演算表中，负数、小数、乘法及其结果相邻出现；激活也落在部分数字片段上。

patterns.name: 结构化数据中的字段值
patterns.context: 代码或配置文本里，字段名、字符串值与标点构成结构化记录；目前仅此例。

patterns.name: 哮喘治疗与疾病术语
patterns.context: 哮喘相关医学论述中，疾病名称被拆分成相邻 token，且后接流行病学描述；其他医学词语也有较弱激活。

patterns.name: 数学与物理中的符号化表达
patterns.context: 专业论文中，LaTeX 数学符号、变量及公式片段出现；激活位置分散，未见统一的具体符号。
patterns.domain: 数学、理论物理及应用物理论文

patterns.name: 论文中的研究对象或关键术语
patterns.context: 学术文本中陈述研究对象、集合或测量量时，少数术语获得较强激活；触发词彼此并不一致。
patterns.domain: 数学、科学论文与研究计划

en.description: Primarily responds to LaTeX commands, delimiters, and mathematical formatting in formulas; it also responds to biomedical citation markers, escaped byte strings in code, and words in a passage about psychopathic behavior and motivational deficits.

patterns.name: LaTeX mathematical formulas and delimiters
patterns.context: Dense mathematical symbols, commands, and formula formatting; common in formula fragments, formula environments, or near formula references.

patterns.name: Braces and right-side delimiters in formulas
patterns.context: Paired or nested formula delimiters, especially large right parentheses or braces; may be a local trigger caused by formula formatting commands themselves.

patterns.name: Academic citations and reference numbers
patterns.context: Numbered reference labels, consecutive citations, or citation ranges; context contains citation markers without requiring a consistent body-text topic.

patterns.name: Escaped byte strings in generated code
patterns.context: Hexadecimal escape sequences occur consecutively with nearby machine-generated identifiers, resembling serialized or encoded data.

patterns.name: Behavior-related words in discussion of psychopathy
patterns.context: Discusses emotional, motivational, or behavioral deficits in people with psychopathy; activation is scattered across body-text words rather than formula or citation structure.
patterns.domain: Academic discussion in philosophy or psychology

6_432.concept: 结构化学术文本标记
6_432.description: 主要响应公式中的LaTeX命令、定界符及数学排版；也响应生物医学引文标记、代码转义字节串，以及一段关于心理病态行为和动机缺陷的正文词语。

patterns.name: LaTeX 数学公式与分隔符
patterns.context: 数学符号、命令和公式排版密集出现；常见于公式片段、公式环境或公式引用附近。

patterns.name: 公式中的大括号与右侧定界
patterns.context: 成对或嵌套的公式定界符，尤其是较大的右括号或右花括号；可能是公式排版命令本身带来的局部触发。

patterns.name: 学术引文与参考文献编号
patterns.context: 数字化参考文献标签、连续引文或引用范围；上下文带有引文标记而不要求正文主题一致。
patterns.domain: PubMed Central 生物医学论文

patterns.name: 生成代码中的转义字节串
patterns.context: 十六进制转义序列和紧邻的机器生成标识符连续出现，呈现序列化或编码数据的样式。

patterns.name: 心理病态讨论中的行为相关词
patterns.context: 讨论心理病态者的情绪、动机或行为缺陷；激活分散在正文词语上，而非公式或引文结构。
patterns.domain: 哲学或心理学学术论述

en.concept: Connectives and terminology in patent technical descriptions
en.description: Activation mainly occurs in patent technical descriptions, especially connective structures such as “so as to/so that/such as”; it also covers engineering components, materials, directions, and motion descriptions. A Spanish philosophical passage and fictional dialogue about the weather do not fit the same patent pattern.

patterns.name: Purpose/result connectives in patent sentences
patterns.context: In patent background or technical descriptions, connectives introduce a purpose, result, or example; “so” is especially strong in multiple passages

patterns.name: Patent technical nouns and component descriptions
patterns.context: Descriptions of devices, materials, components, and their structures or properties in patent text; the terms themselves sometimes activate

patterns.name: Descriptions of direction and motion
patterns.context: Describes the direction, displacement, and constraints of vehicle pedals, sliding shutters, or motion paths

patterns.name: Spanish philosophical discussion and intraword fragments
patterns.context: Continuous academic discussion in Spanish; words are split into subwords, with multiple subwords activating at once

patterns.name: Weather description in literary dialogue
patterns.context: Direct character dialogue discussing wind and weather in an exclamatory tone

6_432.concept: 专利技术说明中的连接与术语
6_432.description: 激活主要出现在专利技术说明中，尤其是“so as to／so that／such as”一类连接结构；也覆盖工程部件、材料、方向与运动表述。另有一段西班牙语哲学论述和一段小说天气对白，无法归入同一专利模式。

patterns.name: 专利句中的目的／结果连接结构
patterns.context: 专利背景或技术描述中，以连接词引出目的、结果或例示；“so”在多个片段中尤强

patterns.name: 专利技术名词与部件描述
patterns.trigger: “electron microscope”“electron lens”“cap assembly”“trim plate”“pedal bracket”“torsion coil springs”“artificial sea-mount”“super abrasive”“toner particles”等
patterns.context: 专利文本中的装置、材料、部件及其结构或性质描述；术语本身有时带有激活

patterns.name: 方向与运动描述
patterns.context: 描述车辆踏板、滑动快门或运动路径的方向、位移与限制

patterns.name: 西班牙语哲学论述及词内片段
patterns.trigger: “algunos de los puntos doctrinales más oscuros del sistema aristotélico”“fundamentos”；激活落在拆分的词内片段，如“fundament”与“os”
patterns.context: 连续西班牙语学术论述，词被切分成子词，多个子词同时激活

patterns.name: 文学对白中的天气描写
patterns.trigger: “Martha, Martha, come out!”及“how jolly the wind is to-day?”，尤其“wind”“is”
patterns.context: 人物直接引语中以感叹语气谈论风和天气

en.description: Activation is scattered across several syntactic and morphological forms: it commonly occurs with copulas or change expressions such as is/become(s), and also with such that, has had, prepositional phrases, subword segmentation of parish, and component numbers. The range of styles is broad, with no single stable trigger explaining the pattern.

patterns.name: Judgment or property following copular is
patterns.context: A sentence contains is followed by a judgment about the subject, a state description, or a statement of importance; in some examples activation covers multiple words after is.
patterns.domain: Multiple styles, including academic papers, patents, forum narratives, and encyclopedias

patterns.name: Perfect construction has had
patterns.context: has had occurs consecutively, followed by effects; here it describes a historical or cultural influence.

patterns.name: State change with becomes
patterns.context: become(s)/becoming is followed by a state, degree, or description of change; some contexts indicate an increase in degree or worsening property.
patterns.domain: Patent technology, astrophysics, health, and social sciences

patterns.name: is of construction after a quantity or noun
patterns.context: The subject is a technical parameter or structural relation, and is of is followed by importance to explain its significance.

patterns.name: Result/degree construction with such that
patterns.context: such that introduces a degree or result relation; activation falls on such and that.

patterns.name: Locative preposition in the
patterns.context: Opening of a prepositional phrase referring to a general place or manner; here it is followed by right way.

patterns.name: Cross-token segmentation of parish
patterns.context: parish is split into two subword tokens; it occurs in the narrative “commenced residence in my country ... parish were”.

patterns.name: Isolated numeric token 10
patterns.context: Appears after polishing cloth as a component number in patent text; activation does not show a clear syntactic pattern.

6_432.concept: none
6_432.description: 激活分散在多种句法和词形中：常见于 is/become(s) 等系词或变化表达，也涉及 such that、has had、介词短语、parish 的子词切分及部件编号；文体跨度很大，无法用单一稳定触发条件解释。

patterns.name: 系词 is 后接判断或性质
patterns.trigger: « is»、« is» ... « enhanced»、« is» ... « contradictory»、« is» ... « becoming»、« is» ... « of»
patterns.context: 句中出现 is，随后对主语作判断、描述状态或说明重要性；部分例子中激活覆盖 is 后的多个词。
patterns.domain: 学术论文、专利、论坛叙述及百科等多种文体

patterns.name: 完成时 has had
patterns.context: has had 连用，后接 effects；这里描述一种历史或文化影响。

patterns.name: becomes 状态变化
patterns.trigger: « becomes» « degraded»；« becomes» « larger»；« becoming» « increasingly»
patterns.context: become(s)/becoming 后接状态、程度或变化描述；有的上下文表示程度增加或性质恶化。
patterns.domain: 专利技术、天体物理、健康与社会科学

patterns.name: 数量或名词后的 is of 结构
patterns.context: 主语为技术参数或结构关系，is of 后接 importance，说明其重要性。

patterns.name: such that 结果／程度结构
patterns.context: such that 引出程度或结果关系；激活落在 such 和 that 上。

patterns.name: 方位介词 in the
patterns.context: 泛指地点或方式的介词短语开头；此处后接 right way。

patterns.name: parish 的跨词切分
patterns.context: parish 被拆成两个子词 token；位于 commenced residence in my country ... parish were 的叙述中。

patterns.name: 孤立的数字 token 10
patterns.context: 出现在 polishing cloth 之后，作为专利文本中的部件编号；激活不呈现清楚的句法模式。

en.concept: The verb be and its predicate structures
en.description: Activation is concentrated on the English copulas is/was, especially subject-predicate structures in which they are followed by adjectives, participles, nouns, or passive predicates; specific meanings vary across research, technical, and commentary contexts.

patterns.name: Predicate or complement after be verb is
patterns.context: In academic or technical statements, is is followed by an adjective, participle, nominal constituent, or passive predicate; commonly used to state a result, state, relation, or property.
patterns.domain: Medicine, research, technical descriptions, and commentary

patterns.name: Predicate or complement after be verb was
patterns.context: In past-tense research accounts, was is followed by a passive predicate, measurement value, or state complement.

6_432.concept: be动词及其谓语结构
6_432.description: 激活集中在英语系动词 is/was，尤其是其后接形容词、分词、名词或被动谓语的主谓结构；跨科研、技术和评论语境，具体语义各异。

patterns.name: be动词 is 后的谓语或补语
patterns.context: 学术或技术语句中，is 后接形容词、分词、名词性成分或被动谓语；常用于陈述结果、状态、关系或性质。
patterns.domain: 医学、科研、技术说明及评论

patterns.name: be动词 was 后的谓语或补语
patterns.context: 过去时科研叙述中，was 后接被动谓语、测量值或状态补语。

en.concept: Degree and state judgments introduced by copulas
en.description: Primarily responds to copulas and the properties, degrees, or trends that follow them, particularly evaluations such as low, limited, or reduced; other examples involve comparison, association, correlation, probability prediction, and increasing trends. Activation often covers consecutive predicate elements.

patterns.name: Degree/state predicate following a copula
patterns.context: A sentence states a property, state, trend, or evaluation; activation often falls on the copula and consecutive predicate elements that follow, without requiring a specific domain.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain explanatory texts, papers, and forum posts

patterns.name: Judgments of low, limited, or constrained degree
patterns.context: Describes insufficient performance, reliability, quantity, utility, affinity, or recovery; sometimes introduced by a degree adverb or comparative construction.
patterns.domain: Medical, chemical, engineering, materials, and computing texts

patterns.name: Comparisons and expressions of difference
patterns.context: Compares an object with another object or a baseline, or qualifies an evaluation with a degree word; not limited to a single syntactic form.

patterns.name: Probability, possibility, and prediction metrics
patterns.context: Discusses the likelihood of an event or the accuracy and quantitative measures of a predictor; activation may also fall on surrounding copular predicates.

patterns.name: Increasing trend
patterns.context: Uses the perfect progressive to describe the number of patients increasing over time.
patterns.domain: Medical paper on treatment of esophageal cancer in Japan

patterns.name: Expressions of association or correlation
patterns.context: States an association between variables; activation locations involve the copula, an association predicate, or a correlation expression.
patterns.domain: Physiological medicine and technical forum posts

patterns.name: Adverbs modifying intensity
patterns.context: An adverb qualifies correlation, degree of constraint, or magnitude of decline; appears in only a few contexts.
patterns.domain: Medical papers, patents, and forum posts

patterns.name: Activation on fixed or adjacent copular phrases
patterns.context: In some sentences activation extends to multiple adjacent tokens, including magnitude expressions and passive/evaluative predicates; the available passages are insufficient to establish an independent semantic trigger.

6_432.concept: 系词引出的程度与状态判断
6_432.description: 主要响应系词及其后的性质、程度或趋势陈述，尤偏向低、有限、减弱等评价；也见比较、关联、相关性、概率预测和增加趋势，激活常覆盖连续谓语成分。

patterns.name: 系词后的程度／状态谓语
patterns.context: 句子在陈述某属性、状态、趋势或评价；激活常落在系词及其后的连续谓语成分上，不要求特定领域。
patterns.domain: 跨领域说明文、论文及论坛文本

patterns.name: 低、有限或受限的程度判断
patterns.context: 描述性能、可靠性、数量、效用、亲和力或恢复程度不足；有时由程度副词或比较结构引出。
patterns.domain: 医学、化学、工程、材料与计算机文本

patterns.name: 比较与差异表达
patterns.trigger: «similar to»、«different from»、«lower than»、«slower and less complete than»、«rather low»
patterns.context: 把对象与另一对象或基准比较，或用程度词限定评价；不局限于单一句法形式。

patterns.name: 概率、可能性及预测量化
patterns.context: 讨论事件发生可能性或预测器的准确度、量化指标；激活也可能落在周边系词谓语上。
patterns.domain: 故障预测与计算机文本

patterns.name: 增加趋势
patterns.context: 以完成进行时描述患者数量随时间增加。
patterns.domain: 日本食管癌治疗的医学论文

patterns.name: 关联或相关性表达
patterns.context: 陈述变量之间的关联；激活位置涉及系词、关联谓语或相关性表达。
patterns.domain: 生理医学与技术论坛文本

patterns.name: 强度副词修饰
patterns.context: 副词限定相关性、受限程度或下降幅度；只在个别上下文出现。
patterns.domain: 医学论文、专利及论坛文本

patterns.name: 固定或邻接的系词词组激活
patterns.context: 个别句子中激活扩展到相邻多个 token，包括数量级表述及被动／评价谓语；现有片段不足以确认独立语义触发条件。

en.description: Primarily responds to judgments of low levels or decreases (low, reduced, lower), and also occurs in degree comparisons, limitations, and property evaluations; a few activations fall on experimental purity statements, statistical symbols, and equals-sign separators, without a unified explanation.

patterns.name: Low-degree judgment after a copula
patterns.context: Describes a measurement, efficiency, stability, incidence, or expression level as low; in some examples, low follows is, are, or a related predicate, and is followed by numbers, punctuation, or additional explanation.

patterns.name: Evaluation intensified by degree adverbs
patterns.context: Uses degree words to describe limitations, decreases, or differences; low need not appear and comparative constructions or orders of magnitude may be used instead.

patterns.name: Property or quality assessment
patterns.context: Evaluates sample purity, degree of recovery, or clinical outcome; activation is not limited to expressions of low values.

patterns.name: Statistical or inequality symbols
patterns.context: The symbol occurs in the significance-threshold expression “P > 0.05” in statistical results, in the same passage as a later low complication rate, but whether it directly triggers activation is uncertain.

patterns.name: Formatting separator
patterns.context: Occurs in an equals-sign separator line at the beginning of a paragraph; no clear semantic connection to the subsequent content about ocular melanoma.

6_432.concept: 低程度与负向评价
6_432.description: 主要响应低水平或下降判断（low、reduced、lower），也见程度比较、限制及性质评价；少数激活落在实验纯度语句、统计符号和等号分隔符上，缺乏统一解释。

patterns.name: 系词后的低程度判断
patterns.context: 描述某项测量、效率、稳定性、发生率或表达水平较低；部分例子中 low 前有 is、are 或相关谓语，后接数字、标点或补充说明。
patterns.domain: 生物医学、专利技术说明

patterns.name: 程度副词加强评价
patterns.context: 以程度词描述限制、降低或差异；不一定出现 low，也可能是比较结构或数量级表达。

patterns.name: 性质或质量判定
patterns.context: 对样本纯度、恢复程度或临床效果作评价，激活不局限于低值表达。
patterns.domain: 生物医学实验与临床论文

patterns.name: 统计或不等式符号
patterns.context: 符号位于统计结果中的显著性阈值表达“P > 0.05”，与后文低并发症率同段，但是否直接触发尚不确定。

patterns.name: 格式分隔符
patterns.context: 出现在段落开头的等号分隔行；与后续关于眼部黑色素瘤的内容没有明确语义联系。

en.concept: Properties and degree in scientific statements
en.description: Most passages state properties or low values in scientific or technical contexts, commonly using low/lower and copular constructions; other examples include research recommendations, epidemiological concerns, experimental quality control, and sporadic expressions involving parameters and units.

patterns.name: Statements of low levels or probabilities
patterns.context: Describes low values, ratios, risks, stability, or chances of success; a common structure is a copula followed by a degree word and low, including the comparative lower. The third passage instead describes a parameter fixed at a set value and does not contain low.
patterns.domain: Biomedical, chemical, materials physics, and patent technical writing

patterns.name: Copulas and their predicates
patterns.context: Activation often falls on is/are/were or the predicate immediately following, especially when stating scientific facts, properties, or research needs; however, the specific predicates vary across passages.
patterns.domain: Academic papers, medical abstracts, research proposals, and patent backgrounds

patterns.name: Research approaches requiring improvement
patterns.context: States that current methods are insufficiently reliable and therefore improved monitoring strategies are needed.

patterns.name: Measurement reliability and experimental quality control
patterns.context: Discusses reliability of measurements or experimental preparations, purity, and cross-contamination checks; specific activation falls in different locations, such as “remains low” or “checked”.

patterns.name: Epidemiological interest in populations or samples
patterns.context: States that healthy populations and patient samples are epidemiologically relevant, then discusses the risk of resistance-gene transfer.

patterns.name: Numerical values and plural markers without a clear main pattern
patterns.context: Includes temperature values, plural experimental sample nouns, or fixed physical parameter values; the third passage also describes a parameter with interaction is fixed, which cannot be unified with low-value expressions.

6_432.concept: 科学表述中的属性与程度
6_432.description: 多数段落在科学或技术语境中陈述属性或数值偏低，常见 low/lower 与系词结构；另覆盖需求建议、流行病学关注、实验质控及参数、单位等零散表达。

patterns.name: 低水平或低概率的表述
patterns.trigger: “low”：如“orders of magnitude lower”“stability … is rather low”“mortality rate is fairly low”“risk … is currently very low”“complication rate is low”“survival rate … is low”“relatively low”；另有“is fixed as 0.15 eV”
patterns.context: 描述数值、比率、风险、稳定性或成功可能性偏低；常见结构是系词后接程度词与 low，也包括比较级 lower。第3段则描述参数取固定值，未出现 low。
patterns.domain: 生物医学、化学、材料物理、专利技术写作

patterns.name: 系词及其后述谓
patterns.trigger: “is”：如“affinity … is orders … lower”“reliability … remains low”“is fairly low”“rate is low”“is of major … interest”；也出现“are needed”“were prepared”
patterns.context: 激活常落在 is/are/were 或紧随其后的述谓词，尤其用于陈述科学事实、属性或研究需求；但不同段落中的具体述谓并不相同。
patterns.domain: 学术论文、医学摘要、科研计划及专利背景

patterns.name: 需要或改进的研究方案
patterns.context: 提出当前方法可靠性不足，因而需要改进监测策略。
patterns.domain: NIH 研究计划／医学影像

patterns.name: 测量可靠性与实验质量控制
patterns.trigger: “reliability … remains low”；“purity … for cross contamination was checked”
patterns.context: 讨论测量或实验制备的可靠性、纯度与交叉污染检查；具体激活落在“remains low”或“checked”等不同位置。
patterns.domain: 医学影像、实验生物学方法

patterns.name: 人群或样本的流行病学关注
patterns.trigger: “people as well as primary care patients is of major epidemiological interest”
patterns.context: 说明健康人群与患者样本具有流行病学意义，并进一步讨论耐药基因转移风险。
patterns.domain: 公共卫生／微生物耐药研究

patterns.name: 无明显对应主模式的数值与复数标记
patterns.context: 出现温度数值、实验样本名词复数或物理参数定值；第3段还包含 interaction is fixed 的参数描述，无法由低值表达统一解释。

en.concept: Statements of state and degree in scientific text
en.description: Primarily responds to copulas and passive reporting structures in technical and scientific text, especially descriptions of low levels, decreases, and differences; also occurs in experimental procedures, metric assessment, and characterization of properties. The isolated activation in passage 3 has no clear corresponding pattern.

patterns.name: Low, reduced, or insufficient degree
patterns.context: A copula or degree word is followed by low/lower/reduced, describing insufficient reliability, stability, affinity, efficiency, etc.; passage [6] also has “has decreased,” describing a problem rate that has fallen but persists.

patterns.name: Quantitative descriptions of relations or differences
patterns.context: Compares objects or metrics, emphasizing differences in degree, orders of magnitude, or greater amounts; does not require a low value.

patterns.name: Reporting methods or results in passive voice
patterns.context: Experimental or analytical steps and measurements are reported in passive voice; activation falls on auxiliary verbs, copulas, and nearby words.

patterns.name: has followed by a change or state verb
patterns.context: The present perfect describes a change in a problem, with “but ... persists” adding that it remains unresolved.

patterns.name: Explanatory complement after a judgment word
patterns.context: A state or property is stated first, followed by because or by introducing a reason or characterization method.

6_432.concept: 科学文本中的状态与程度陈述
6_432.description: 主要响应技术与科学文本中系动词及被动报告结构，尤对低、降低、差异等程度描述敏感；也见于实验步骤、指标评估和性质刻画。段3的孤立激活缺乏清晰对应模式。

patterns.name: 低、减少或不足的程度
patterns.trigger: “remains low”“stability ... is rather low”“affinity ... lower”“somewhat reduced”“efficiency ... is low”
patterns.context: 系动词或程度词后接 low/lower/reduced，描述可靠性、稳定性、亲和力、效率等不足；段[6]另有“has decreased”，描述问题率下降但仍存在。
patterns.domain: 生物医学、化学、专利技术

patterns.name: 关系或差异的定量描述
patterns.trigger: “substantially different from”“orders of magnitude lower than”“greater than”
patterns.context: 比较对象或指标，强调程度上的差异、数量级差异或更大；不要求出现低值。

patterns.name: 被动语态中的方法或结果报告
patterns.context: 实验或分析步骤、测量结果以被动语态报告；激活落在助动词、系动词及其附近。
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文、计算机科学论文

patterns.name: has 后接变化或状态动词
patterns.context: 现在完成时描述某问题的变化，并由“but ... persists”补充其仍未解决。

patterns.name: 判断词后接说明性补语
patterns.context: 先陈述状态或性质，再由 because 或 by 引出原因、刻画方式。
patterns.domain: 专利背景、计算机科学论文

en.concept: Property and state judgments introduced by linking verbs
en.description: Primarily activates English linking verbs and the property, state, or quantity complements that follow them, especially descriptions using low, lower, greater, fixed, similar, and reduced; also includes sporadic activation of numerical values, units, and nearby function words across multiple technical fields.

patterns.name: Predicates with the linking verb be
patterns.context: Activations cluster at the linking-verb position in sentence predicates, connecting the subject to a state, property, or complement; examples include present tense, past tense, and become.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain academic, patent, and technical texts

patterns.name: Properties or states following linking verbs
patterns.context: A linking verb is followed by an adjective or property description expressing measurement reliability, numerical magnitude, similarity, efficiency, difficulty, or production cost; degree words may occur within the property description.
patterns.domain: Research papers, medical abstracts, patent background, and physics texts

patterns.name: Quantitative values or statistical results
patterns.context: Numerical or statistical expressions occur after a linking verb; in some fragments, values connect to units, percentages, or parallel statistical items.

patterns.name: Low-quality judgments
patterns.context: Low describes measurement reliability, research quality, or device efficiency; across different fragments, it is introduced by remains, was, or is.
patterns.domain: Medical research, systematic reviews, and solar-cell patents

patterns.name: Nonrestrictive relational or connective elements
patterns.context: These markers occur near activated predicates, comparative structures, or numerical expressions, but have no stable, consistent syntactic function that can be summarized independently.

6_432.concept: 系动词引出的性质与状态判断
6_432.description: 主要激活英语系动词及其后的性质、状态或数量补语，尤见于 low、lower、greater、fixed、similar、reduced 等描述；另有零散数值、单位及邻近功能词激活，跨多个科技领域。

patterns.name: 系动词 be 的谓语
patterns.context: 激活集中出现在句子谓语的系动词位置，连接主语与状态、性质或补语；其中有现在时、过去时及 become。
patterns.domain: 跨领域的学术、专利说明及科技文本

patterns.name: 系动词后的性质或状态
patterns.context: 系动词后接形容词或性质描述，表达测量可靠性、数值大小、相似性、效率、难易或制作成本等；程度词可插入性质描述中。
patterns.domain: 科研论文、医学摘要、专利背景及物理学文本

patterns.name: 定量数值或统计结果
patterns.context: 数值或统计表达出现在系动词之后；个别片段中数值与单位、百分比或并列统计项相连。
patterns.domain: 物理学论文与医学摘要

patterns.name: 低质量判断
patterns.context: low 描述测量可靠性、研究质量或器件效率；在不同片段中分别由 remains、was、is 引出。
patterns.domain: 医学研究、系统综述、太阳能电池专利

patterns.name: 非限定性关系或连接成分
patterns.context: 这些标记出现在被激活的谓语、比较结构或数值表达附近，但没有稳定一致的句法功能可单独归纳。

en.concept: Copular constructions in research evaluation statements
en.description: Activation often occurs at copulas or related structures linking a research subject to an evaluation, validation, quantitative comparison, test result, or conclusion yet to be determined; common in medical research and patent text, with no fixed evaluation direction.

patterns.name: Effectiveness or utility of an evaluated subject
patterns.context: Evaluates the efficacy, reliability, clinical utility, etc. of a method, measurement, treatment, or device; evaluations are often qualified, low, or unclear.
patterns.domain: Medical, research, and patent technical text

patterns.name: Copular statement of research result or property
patterns.context: The copula is followed by a research validation result, statistical result, or quantitative comparison; it does not necessarily express an efficacy evaluation.

patterns.name: Passive experimental testing statement
patterns.context: States that a sample, condition, or material was tested; activation falls on the copular position before the test result.

patterns.name: Undetermined safety or efficacy
patterns.context: States that safety and efficacy remain to be determined for a specific clinical situation.

6_432.concept: 科研评价陈述中的系词结构
6_432.description: 激活多出现在系词或相关结构处，连接研究对象与评价、验证、定量比较、测试结果或尚待确定的结论；常见于医学科研和专利文本，具体评价方向并不固定。

patterns.name: 评价对象的有效性或用途
patterns.trigger: « is»«9»；如“reliability … « remains»«9» « low»«10»”“clinical utility … « is»«9» « limited»«9»”“efficiency … « is»«9» « somewhat»«8» reduced»«9»”
patterns.context: 围绕某项方法、测量、治疗或设备，作出效能、可靠性、临床用途等评价；评价常为受限、偏低或不明确
patterns.domain: 医学、科研及专利技术文本

patterns.name: 研究结果或属性的系词陈述
patterns.trigger: « is»«9» « validated»«7»；« was»«9»；« is»«8» « orders»«5» « of»«1» « magnitude»«6» « lower»«10»
patterns.context: 系词后接研究验证结果、统计结果或定量比较，不一定表达效能评价

patterns.name: 被动实验测试陈述
patterns.context: 说明样本、条件或材料接受检测；激活落在测试结果前的系词位置

patterns.name: 未确定的安全性或疗效
patterns.context: 针对特定临床情形，指出安全性与疗效尚待确定

en.description: Activations often fall on linking verbs such as is/was/were and adjacent predicates: statements of unknown or unclear status, evaluations and comparisons, research aims, experimental tests, and passive method descriptions; also includes device-result statements in patents.

patterns.name: Linking verb “is” introducing an unknown or unclear state
patterns.context: Research background or problem statements note that a measurement, clinical significance, mutation significance, experimental result, or incidence remains unclear; common structures include “remains + adjective” or “is + unknown”.

patterns.name: Linking verb “is” introducing an evaluative or process predicate
patterns.context: In specific statements, “is” connects an evaluation, comparison, or result; its semantics and syntax differ from the “unclear” use.
patterns.domain: Research project abstracts, scientific papers, and patent background

patterns.name: “was” introducing a research aim or experimental test
patterns.context: Past-tense research narratives state the research aim or that an experimental subject underwent testing.

patterns.name: “were” introducing an experimental procedure or state
patterns.context: Passive voice describes samples, components, or experimental conditions as having been prepared or tested in the past.

patterns.name: Other highlighted linking verbs and result predicates
patterns.context: Patent technical descriptions report changes in device parameters and their consequences; activations cover linking verbs and result statements, without showing exactly the same local pattern as the other examples.

6_432.concept: 系动词与谓语陈述
6_432.description: 激活多落在 is/was/were 等系动词及相邻谓语：包括陈述未知或不明确、评价比较、研究目的、实验测试与被动方法描述；也见专利中的器件结果表述。

patterns.name: 系动词“is”引出未知或不明确状态
patterns.context: 研究背景或问题陈述中，指出某测量、临床意义、突变意义、实验结果或发生率尚不明确；常见结构为“remains + 形容词”或“is + unknown”。

patterns.name: 系动词“is”引出评价或过程谓语
patterns.trigger: “is then being evaluated”“is orders of magnitude lower”“is remarkably shortened”
patterns.context: 在具体陈述中，“is”连接评价、比较或结果；语义和句法与“不明确”用法不同。
patterns.domain: 科研项目摘要、科学论文、专利背景

patterns.name: “was”引出研究目的或实验测试
patterns.trigger: “was”与“The aim of this study was…”或“was also tested”
patterns.context: 过去时研究叙述中，交代研究目的或实验对象接受了测试。

patterns.name: “were”引出实验操作或状态
patterns.context: 被动语态描述样本、组分或实验条件在过去接受制备或检测。

patterns.name: 其他高亮系词与结果谓语
patterns.context: 专利技术说明中描述器件参数变化及其后果；激活覆盖系动词附近和结果表述，未呈现与其余实例完全相同的局部模式。

en.description: Most passages activate at a judgment or state predicate after is, covering low, unknown, limited, insufficiently attributed, shortened, and unclear; other examples include was tested, were prepared/was checked, and two within-word fragments.

patterns.name: Evaluative or state predicate after the copula “is”
patterns.context: In academic or patent technical text, judges a value, utility, limitation, causal result, or state; activation is concentrated on is and the predicate that follows.

patterns.name: Experimental predicate after the copula “was”
patterns.context: Describes testing an inhibitor in an experiment.

patterns.name: Experimental procedure after the copula “were”
patterns.context: Describes sample preparation and purity checks after separation.

patterns.name: Split fragments inside long words
patterns.context: The trigger falls within words split by tokenization, rather than an obviously independent semantic unit; one occurs in longitudinally and the other in nebulous.

6_432.concept: 系词与评价性谓语结构
6_432.description: 多数段在 is 后的判断或状态谓语处激活，涵盖低、未知、有限、归因不足、缩短及不明确；另有 was tested、were prepared/was checked，以及两个词内片段。

patterns.name: 系词“is”后接评价或状态谓语
patterns.trigger: «is» 后接 «low»、«unknown»、«limited»、«not entirely attributable»、«remarkably shortened»、«unclear» 等
patterns.context: 学术或专利科技文本中，对数值、效用、限制、因果结果或状态作判断；激活主要集中在 is 及其后续谓语
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文与专利背景

patterns.name: 系词“was”后接实验谓语
patterns.context: 描述实验中对抑制剂进行测试

patterns.name: 系词“were”后接实验操作
patterns.context: 描述样品制备及分离纯度检查

patterns.name: 长词内部的切分片段
patterns.trigger: «itud» 后接 inal；«ne» 后接 bul«ous»
patterns.context: 触发落在被分词切开的词内部，而非明显独立语义单元；前者处于 longitudinally，后者处于 nebulous

en.description: Activations are concentrated on linking verbs or state predicates in scientific texts (is, was, were, will be, remains), especially those connecting a research subject to an evaluation, state, or passive result; sporadic activations also occur on numbers, proportions, and experimental-procedure terms.

patterns.name: Main linking verb “is” in medical papers
patterns.context: Medical discussions state disease, prognosis, or genetic characteristics; followed by a state, evaluation, or negative predicate

patterns.name: Linking verb “was”
patterns.context: Connects a research subject to a past participle such as tested in the passive voice

patterns.name: Linking verb “were” and subsequent method description
patterns.context: Plural experimental subjects are followed by a passive method description; strong activation actually falls on a later word such as “fractions”

patterns.name: Auxiliary “will be”
patterns.context: Describes a future consequence in a conditional or hypothetical context

patterns.name: State verb “remains”
patterns.context: An object remains in a continuing state, followed by an evaluation such as low/unclear

patterns.name: Numbers and punctuation after survival
patterns.context: In a survival-rate results sentence, a percentage and parallel data immediately follow the linking verb

patterns.name: Proportion values and decimal point
