patterns.context: A pH value appears in a list of experimental conditions; activations fall on the number and decimal point

patterns.name: Experimental subjects and testing-procedure terms
patterns.context: Purity and cross-contamination checks are described after mitochondria/subcellular fractions are isolated

patterns.name: Percentage-related terms
patterns.context: When discussing the proportion of lung cancer cases or patient-related quantities, activations are dispersed across proportion/quantity statements

6_432.concept: 科学陈述中的状态谓语
6_432.description: 激活最集中于科学文本中的系词或状态谓语（is、was、were、will be、remains），尤其连接研究对象与评价、状态或被动结果；另有数字、比例及实验流程词的零散激活。

patterns.name: 医学论文中的主系词“is”
patterns.context: 医学论述中陈述疾病、预后或遗传特征；后接状态、评价或否定性谓语

patterns.name: 系词“was”
patterns.context: 被动语态中连接研究对象与 tested 等过去分词

patterns.name: 系词“were”及其后的方法描述
patterns.context: 复数实验对象作主语，接被动方法描述；强激活实际落在“fractions”等后续词上

patterns.name: 助动词“will be”
patterns.context: 条件或假设语境中描述未来后果

patterns.name: 状态动词“remains”
patterns.context: 对象处于仍然存在的状态，后接 low/unclear 等评价

patterns.name: survival 后的数字与标点
patterns.context: 生存率结果句中，系词后紧接百分比数字及并列数据
patterns.domain: 医学摘要中的统计结果

patterns.name: 比例数字与小数点
patterns.context: 实验条件列举中出现 pH 数值；激活分布在数字和小数点

patterns.name: 实验对象及检测流程词汇
patterns.trigger: « fractions»1« for»1 ...« was»10« checked»7« as»5« described»2
patterns.context: 分离线粒体/亚细胞组分后描述纯度与交叉污染检查

patterns.name: 百分比相关词
patterns.context: 讨论肺癌病例占比或患者相关数量时，激活分散于比例/数量表述中

en.description: Activation is concentrated on statements following be verbs in scientific text: they are commonly followed by past participles describing research or experimental procedures, and also include “remains unclear”; there are also examples of negated genetic attribution and mathematical inequalities.

patterns.name: Passive structure with a past participle after a be verb
patterns.context: The subject is a research object, method, property, or experimental material, followed by a past participle describing investigation, measurement, preparation, monitoring, or evaluation; forms include was/were/is/are.
patterns.domain: Methods, results, and abstracts in scientific papers

patterns.name: “remains unclear” indicating unresolved uncertainty
patterns.context: The subject is a scientific question, stability, or biological significance, stated to remain unclear.

patterns.name: Degree or attribution statement near a negation
patterns.context: Discusses heritability or causal attribution, denying that a factor can fully explain a phenomenon.

patterns.name: “is less than” in a mathematical inequality
patterns.context: After a mathematical expression, compares the rank and genus of a curve, forming the condition “rank … is less than the genus”.

6_432.concept: 科学陈述中的系词结构
6_432.description: 激活集中于科学文本中 be 动词后的陈述：常接过去分词描述研究或实验操作，也出现“remains unclear”；另见遗传归因否定和数学不等式表达。

patterns.name: be 动词后接过去分词的被动结构
patterns.trigger: «was»« studied»；«was»« determined»；«was»« monitored»；«was»« evaluated»；«is»« evaluated»；«were»« prepared»
patterns.context: 主语是研究对象、方法、性质或实验材料，后接过去分词描述被研究、测定、制备、监测或评价；涉及 was/were/is/are 等形式
patterns.domain: 科学论文中的方法、结果与摘要

patterns.name: “remains unclear” 表示尚不清楚
patterns.context: 主语为科学问题、稳定性或生物学意义，陈述其仍未明确
patterns.domain: 生物学与医学论文讨论

patterns.name: 否定词附近的程度或归因表述
patterns.context: 讨论遗传率或因果归因，否定某因素能完全解释某现象

patterns.name: 数学不等式中的“is less than”
patterns.context: 数学表达式后比较秩与曲线的属，形成“rank … is less than the genus”的条件

en.concept: Be-verb result statements in academic papers
en.description: Activations often fall on be verbs and the predicates that follow them in academic papers, especially sentences describing research subjects as measured, evaluated, determined, tested, or observed; also occurs in knowledge-gap statements using remains unclear.

patterns.name: Research-result predicates following be verbs
patterns.context: In academic abstracts or papers, be verbs introduce results such as measurement, evaluation, determination, testing, observation, or estimation of a research subject; also includes statements of a state or phenomenon.

patterns.name: remains unclear expressing an unknown
patterns.context: States that a question, significance, or property remains unclear; in both passages, remains introduces unclear.
patterns.domain: Research background and knowledge gaps in academic papers

patterns.name: Isolated be verbs or activation within phrases
patterns.context: Be verbs and subsequent predicates activate in different syntactic and semantic contexts; the shared feature is that papers make statements about a subject or result, while predicate content varies.
patterns.domain: Academic research methods, results, and interpretation

6_432.concept: 学术论文中的be动词结果陈述
6_432.description: 激活多落在学术论文中 be 动词及其后续谓语，尤其是描述研究对象被测量、评估、确定、检验或观察的句子；也出现在 remains unclear 的知识空缺表述中。

patterns.name: be 动词后的研究结果谓语
patterns.trigger: «was»、«were»、«is»、«are»，尤其是后接过去分词或评价性谓语
patterns.context: 学术摘要或论文叙述中，be 动词引出研究对象的测量、评估、确定、检验、观察、估计等结果；也包括说明某种状态或现象。
patterns.domain: 生物医学及生命科学论文

patterns.name: remains unclear 表示未知
patterns.context: 陈述某个问题、意义或性质仍未明了；两段中均由 remains 引出 unclear。
patterns.domain: 学术论文中的研究背景与知识空缺

patterns.name: 单独的 be 动词或短语内激活
patterns.context: be 动词及后续谓语在不同句法和语义环境中激活；共同点是论文对对象或结果作陈述，但谓语内容各异。
patterns.domain: 学术研究方法、结果与解释

en.description: Primarily responds to passive research-reporting expressions in biomedical papers: was/is/were introduces results, evaluations, comparisons, checks, or investigations; also responds to remains unclear, indicating that something is unclear.

patterns.name: was + result/evaluation predicate
patterns.context: In passive constructions, was introduces an experimental result, state, or evaluation; the strongest activation often falls on the following predicate, but may also fall on was.

patterns.name: remains unclear
patterns.context: Discusses a property, significance, or stability that remains unclear.

patterns.name: is evaluated
patterns.context: Summarizes the evaluation of efficiency or effectiveness in a study.

patterns.name: were compared
patterns.context: Describes comparison between different materials or conditions.

patterns.name: was also investigated
patterns.context: States in the research aim or methods that a certain feasibility was examined.

patterns.name: was checked
patterns.context: States in the methods section that the purity of a sample or experimental preparation was checked.

6_432.concept: 被动式研究结果陈述
6_432.description: 主要响应生物医学论文中的被动式研究报告表达：用 was/is/were 引出结果、评估、比较、检查或考察；也响应 remains unclear 表达尚不明确。

patterns.name: was + 结果/评价谓语
patterns.trigger: « was»；后接 « reduced»、« minimal»、« avoided»、« demonstrated»、« tested»
patterns.context: 被动结构中 was 引出实验结果、状态或评价；最强处常落在后续谓语，也可落在 was
patterns.domain: 生物医学研究摘要与论文

patterns.name: remains unclear
patterns.context: 讨论某性质、意义或稳定性尚未明确
patterns.domain: 生物医学研究摘要与论文

patterns.name: is evaluated
patterns.context: 概述研究中对效率或效果进行评估

patterns.name: were compared
patterns.context: 描述不同材料或条件之间的比较

patterns.name: was also investigated
patterns.context: 研究目的或方法中说明某种可行性受到考察

patterns.name: was checked
patterns.context: 方法部分说明样品或实验制备的纯度经过检查

en.concept: State and result predicates in scientific texts
en.description: Activations often fall on predicate structures in scientific, medical, and patent texts, especially be verbs and the state, evaluation, or result words that follow; sporadic coverage also includes numbers, statistical nouns, tendencies, and reporting language, so no single meaning fully captures the pattern.

patterns.name: Be verbs in passive structures
patterns.context: Often follows a subject or noun phrase and connects to a past participle, adjective, or state description; many activations cluster on the predicate core and its immediate constituents.
patterns.domain: Scientific papers and patent background texts

patterns.name: Low degree or negative results
patterns.context: Describes reduced/lower risk, reliability, quantity, or effect; sometimes introduced by a be verb or appearing in a result statement.
patterns.domain: Medical research, engineering, and patent texts

patterns.name: Results evaluated or confirmed
patterns.context: Reports accuracy, purity, efficacy, or status that was measured, checked, observed, or determined in a study.

patterns.name: Degree, manner, and connective words
patterns.context: A few activations fall on connective, explanatory, or transitional elements around predicates; no stable single collocation is evident.

patterns.name: Adjacent numbers and symbols
patterns.context: Numbers and punctuation occur in the experimental-condition expression “pH 7.24”; activations are concentrated mainly on number tokens.

patterns.name: Possibility or tendency
patterns.context: A sentence-initial fragment expresses a tendency to choose a clinical pathway; this differs from the core predicate activations later in the passage.

patterns.name: Proportion or statistical measure
patterns.context: Occurs in the noun phrase for the misdiagnosis rate; the subsequent predicate “has decreased” also activates.

patterns.name: Citation/reporting language
patterns.context: Used to report accuracy data from earlier reports; activation is followed by “has exceeded 90%”.

patterns.name: Increase
patterns.context: A nominalized change at the beginning of a sentence describes an increase in p21 levels; it co-occurs with “was observed” and “was reduced” in the same passage.

6_432.concept: 科学文本中的状态与结果谓语
6_432.description: 激活多落在科学、医学和专利文本的谓语结构，尤其 be 动词及其后的状态、评估或结果词；也零星覆盖数值、统计名词、倾向和转述用语，无法由单一词义完全概括。

patterns.name: 被动结构中的 be 动词
patterns.context: 常位于主语或名词短语之后，连接过去分词、形容词或状态描述；多处激活集中在谓语核心及其紧邻成分。
patterns.domain: 科学论文与专利背景文本

patterns.name: 低程度或否定性结果
patterns.context: 描述风险、可靠性、数量或效果下降／较低；有时由 be 动词引出，或出现在结果陈述中。
patterns.domain: 医学研究、工程与专利文本

patterns.name: 结果被评估或确认
patterns.context: 报告研究中被测定、核查、观察或判定的准确性、纯度、疗效或状态。
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文及研究计划

patterns.name: 程度、方式与承接词
patterns.context: 少量激活落在谓语周边的连接、解释或承接成分；未见稳定的单一搭配。

patterns.name: 数值与符号邻接
patterns.context: 数字和标点处于实验条件“pH 7.24”的数值表达中，激活主要集中在数字 token。

patterns.name: 可能性或倾向
patterns.context: 句首残片中表达一种临床通路选择倾向；与该段后续核心谓语激活不同。

patterns.name: 比例或统计指标
patterns.context: 出现在误诊率这一统计指标的名词短语中，后续谓语“has decreased”也有激活。

patterns.name: 引用／报告措辞
patterns.context: 用于转述早期报告中的准确性数据，激活后接“has exceeded 90%”。

patterns.name: 增加
patterns.context: 作为句首名词化变化量，描述 p21 水平升高；与同段的“was observed”“was reduced”并存。

en.concept: English Copular and Passive Result Statements
en.description: Activations occur mostly on auxiliaries in English passive or copular structures and the following states, evaluations, changes, or research results. A few present perfect examples describe metrics rising or exceeding thresholds. Spans medical, patent, and legal texts.

patterns.name: State or evaluation following a copula
patterns.context: High activation often falls on copulas or auxiliaries such as was/is/remains, followed by an evaluation, state, or past participle; it sometimes extends to the next word.

patterns.name: Proof and consistency of research results
patterns.context: Describes biopsy accuracy as proven and consistent with other test results.

patterns.name: Change in identity or status
patterns.context: A passive construction describes someone's employment status changing from one type to another.

patterns.name: Metric increase and threshold exceedance
patterns.context: The present perfect describes accuracy exceeding a percentage threshold; activation is not on the copula.

patterns.name: A value decreases but the problem remains
patterns.context: Describes an error rate decreasing while noting that the problem has not disappeared.

patterns.name: Methods or efficacy studied or determined
patterns.context: Passive constructions report that a mechanism was studied or imaging efficacy was measured.

6_432.concept: 英语系词与被动结果陈述
6_432.description: 激活多见于英语被动或系词结构中的助动词及其后续状态、评价、变化或研究结果；也覆盖少数现在完成时，描述指标升降、超阈值等。跨医学、专利与法律文本。

patterns.name: 系词后接状态或评价
patterns.trigger: «was»10« checked»8« as»4« described»3；«was»10« monitored»7« and»2« confirmed»6；«remains»10« low»8；«is»10« limited»9；«is»10« somewhat»8« reduced»9
patterns.context: 高激活常落在 was/is/remains 等系词或助动词上，后接评价、状态或过去分词；有时也覆盖紧随其后的词。

patterns.name: 研究结果的证明与一致
patterns.context: 描述活检准确性得到证明，并与其他检查结果相符。

patterns.name: 身份或状态发生改变
patterns.context: 被动语态中说明某人的雇佣状态由一种类型转为另一种。

patterns.name: 指标上升并超过阈值
patterns.context: 现在完成时描述准确率超过百分比阈值；激活不在系词上。

patterns.name: 数值下降但问题仍存
patterns.context: 描述某种错误率下降，同时指出问题未消失。

patterns.name: 方法或疗效被研究、确定
patterns.context: 被动语态报告对机制进行研究，或对成像疗效作出测定。

en.concept: Result and degree statements in be constructions
en.description: Primarily responds to be verbs and their adjacent participles, adjectives, and degree/numerical complements, especially passive, comparative, estimated, and result statements in scientific and patent texts; activation location varies with sentence structure.

patterns.name: Degree/quantity/comparative complements after be verbs
patterns.context: Activations cluster on be verbs and subsequent degree adverbs, comparatives, or estimated values, commonly in structures such as was/is + degree or evaluative element + result/value.
patterns.domain: Declarative explanations in scientific papers and patent background

patterns.name: Result or state predicates after be verbs
patterns.context: Be combines with a past participle or adjective to express a passive, result, or possibility; activation may fall on be or extend to the immediately following predicate.
patterns.domain: Scientific method descriptions, research plans, and patent technical descriptions

patterns.name: Specific evaluation/research-result expressions
patterns.context: Statements about accuracy, effects, or experimental results, with predicates expressing outcomes such as verified or reduced; activation may fall on a preceding noun or near be/the participle.

6_432.concept: be 结构中的结果与程度陈述
6_432.description: 主要响应 be 动词及其邻近的分词、形容词和程度/数值补语，尤见科学与专利文本中的被动、比较、估计及结果陈述；激活位置会随句式变化。

patterns.name: be 动词后的程度/数量/比较补语
patterns.trigger: «was»10« further»10« confirmed»8«；«was»10« greater»9« than»9« 3»8« hours；«is»10« somewhat»8« reduced»9；«is»10« estimated»9« at»9« 63»6«%
patterns.context: 激活集中在 be 动词及其后的程度副词、比较级或估计值表达中，常见结构为 was/is + 程度或评价成分 + 结果/数值。
patterns.domain: 科学论文与专利背景中的陈述性说明

patterns.name: be 动词后的结果或状态谓语
patterns.trigger: «was»10« checked»7« as»4« described；«will»8« be»10« spoiled；«will»8« be»10« determined；«can»8« be»9« enhanced
patterns.context: be 与过去分词或形容词构成被动、结果或可能性表达；有时激活落在 be 上，有时也延伸到紧邻的谓语。
patterns.domain: 科学方法描述、研究计划及专利技术说明

patterns.name: 特定评估/研究结果表达
patterns.context: 对准确性、效果或实验结果作出陈述，谓语表达被验证、降低等结果；激活可落在前置名词或 be/分词附近。

en.description: Activations concentrate mainly on copulas, auxiliaries, and following state or result predicates in English factual statements. They often co-occur with comparisons, degree expressions, and quantitative thresholds, as well as patent descriptions of differences and causality, medical accuracy evaluations, and statistical terms.

patterns.name: Degree or state predicate following a copula
patterns.context: A copula is followed directly by an adjective/adverb or participial predicate describing degree, state, or change; comparative structures are also included.
patterns.domain: Expository statements in research papers, legal judgments, and patent backgrounds

patterns.name: Auxiliary or copula forming a passive/result expression
patterns.context: A past participle follows a function word such as be/have/will to state a change of state, reported result, risk, or avoided outcome.
patterns.domain: Legal, medical research, and patent descriptions

patterns.name: Numerical comparisons and threshold statements
patterns.context: Text describing comparisons, upper or lower bounds, or quantitative results, along with nearby numbers and units.

patterns.name: Differences and causal results in patents
patterns.context: Describes differences in component properties or shrinkage rates, leading to technical difficulties.

patterns.name: Accuracy or consistency evaluation
patterns.context: Evaluates biopsy diagnostic accuracy and compares it with other test results.

patterns.name: Statistical significance terminology
patterns.context: Appears near parameter precision and cosmological detection results as part of a quantitative statistical discussion.

6_432.concept: 英语关系与结果陈述
6_432.description: 激活多集中在英语事实陈述中的系词、助动词及其后续状态或结果谓语；常伴比较、程度、定量阈值，也见专利差异因果、医学准确性评价和统计术语。

patterns.name: 系词后接程度或状态谓语
patterns.context: 系词后直接出现描述程度、状态或变化的形容词/副词及分词谓语；也包括比较结构
patterns.domain: 科研论文、法律判决和专利背景中的陈述性说明

patterns.name: 助动词或系词构成被动/结果表达
patterns.trigger: «was»« changed»；«cited»…« has»« exceeded»；«were»« reported»；«will»« be»« spoiled»；«was»« avoided»
patterns.context: be/have/will 等功能词后接过去分词，陈述状态改变、报告结果、风险或被避免的结果
patterns.domain: 法律、医学科研和专利说明

patterns.name: 数值比较与阈值陈述
patterns.trigger: « greater»…« than»…« 3»« hours»…« versus»…« 30»« minutes»；« exceeded»« 90»«%»；« below»…« 3»«%»
patterns.context: 比较、上下限或定量结果的文字及紧邻数字单位
patterns.domain: 生物医学与天体物理论文

patterns.name: 专利中的差异及因果结果
patterns.context: 描述部件性质或收缩率不同，并由此引出技术困难

patterns.name: 精度或一致性评价
patterns.context: 对活检诊断准确性作评价，并与其他检查结果比较

patterns.name: 统计显著性术语
patterns.context: 与参数精度及宇宙学探测结果相邻，属于定量统计讨论

en.concept: State and Result Statements in Formal Text
en.description: Primarily responds to combinations of copulas or auxiliaries with state, evaluation, and result predicates in formal expository writing. It also responds to comparisons, quantitative changes, and passive factual statements; passages often describe properties, reliability, or results.

patterns.name: State, judgment, or change result following a copula
patterns.context: Activation often falls on a copula or auxiliary and the following state, degree adverb, or result word; the sentence states a restriction, confirmation, reduction, low reliability, or damage.
patterns.domain: Formal expository writing, including academic papers, patent descriptions, and legal argument

patterns.name: Employment status change
patterns.context: A past-tense passive construction describes employment status changing from a temporary state; activation concentrates on was changed from.

patterns.name: Comparatives and quantitative relations
patterns.context: Involves increases or decreases in degree, numerical comparisons using greater than, or judgments below an order of magnitude.
patterns.domain: Patents, life sciences research, theoretical physics

patterns.name: Avoided intervention and confirmed accuracy
patterns.context: A passive construction states that a clinical intervention was not performed or that a certain accuracy was proven; local trigger words do not fully match the main pattern in this passage.

6_432.concept: 正式文本中的状态与结果陈述
6_432.description: 主要响应正式说明文中的系词或助动词与状态、评价及结果谓词的组合，也响应比较、数量变化和被动式事实陈述；各段常描述性质、可靠性或结果。

patterns.name: 系词后接状态、判断或变化结果
patterns.trigger: «is»10 « limited»9；«was»10 « further»9 « confirmed»8；«is»10 « somewhat»8 « reduced»9；«remains»9 « low»8；«will»8 « be»9 « spoiled»6
patterns.context: 激活常落在系词或助动词，以及其后的状态、程度副词或结果词上；句子在陈述限制、确认、降低、低可靠性或受损等判断。
patterns.domain: 学术论文、专利说明、法律论述等正式说明文

patterns.name: 就业身份变更
patterns.context: 过去时被动结构，描述雇佣身份从临时状态发生变化；激活集中于 was changed from。

patterns.name: 比较级及数量关系
patterns.trigger: « decreases»10；« was»9 « greater»9 « than»9 « 3»8 « hours»5；« below»9
patterns.context: 涉及程度增减、greater than 的数值比较或低于某数量级的判断。
patterns.domain: 专利、生命科学研究、理论物理

patterns.name: 避免干预与准确性证实
patterns.context: 被动语态陈述临床干预未实施，或某项准确性得到证明；局部触发词在本段中与主模式不完全一致。

en.concept: English linking verbs and predicate structures
en.description: Activations cluster on linking verbs and auxiliary structures in English declarative sentences, especially was/is connecting to a property, change, or evaluation, and also cover passive voice, present perfect, and experimental-method expressions; the commonality is functional words and predicate structures.

patterns.name: Linking verb was after a nominal subject
patterns.context: In past-tense statements, the subject is an object, state, or measure, and was introduces its property, change, or evaluation result; it is often followed by an adjective, comparative, or past participle.
patterns.domain: Legal, medical, and scientific papers; patent descriptions

patterns.name: Linking verb is after a subject
patterns.context: In the simple present, is connects the subject to a property, limitation, or degree description.

patterns.name: Passive structure with an auxiliary
patterns.context: A modal is followed by be and a past participle, expressing a future passive result.

patterns.name: Compound past tense and degree result
patterns.context: Has introduces the present perfect, describing accuracy exceeding a numerical threshold.

patterns.name: Unknown state after a linking verb and intervening punctuation
patterns.context: Unknown follows is, with a comma immediately after the adjective before the discussion continues.

patterns.name: Linking verb and quality check in a participial phrase
patterns.context: A past-tense passive construction states that a sample or experimental process was checked and introduces the methodological basis.

6_432.concept: 英语系词与谓语结构
6_432.description: 激活集中于英语陈述句中的系词及助动词结构，尤其是 was/is 后连接性质、变化或评价，也涵盖被动、现在完成时与实验方法表达；共同点偏向功能词和谓语结构。

patterns.name: 名词性主语后的系词 was
patterns.trigger: «was»，常见后续为描述或比较性谓语
patterns.context: 过去时陈述中，主语是某对象、状态或指标，was 引出其性质、变化或评估结果；后续常接形容词、比较级或过去分词。
patterns.domain: 法律、医学与科学论文、专利说明

patterns.name: 主语后的系词 is
patterns.context: 一般现在时中，is 连接主语与性质、限制或程度描述。

patterns.name: 含助动词的被动结构
patterns.context: 情态动词后接 be 与过去分词，表达将来的被动结果。

patterns.name: 复合过去时及程度结果
patterns.context: has 引出现在完成时，描述准确率超过数值阈值。

patterns.name: 系词后接未知状态及插入标点
patterns.context: is 后接 unknown，逗号紧随形容词，转入后续说明。

patterns.name: 分词短语中的系词及质量检查
patterns.context: 过去时被动结构说明样本或实验过程受到检查，并引出方法依据。

en.description: Primarily responds to copulas, comparisons, and evaluative words in result statements, especially those involving numbers, accuracy, efficiency, limitations, reliability, and lifespan changes. Occurs across biomedical papers, grant text, and patents, with sporadic activation in method descriptions.

patterns.name: Numerical statements of biomedical results or metrics
patterns.context: Activation falls near copulas, comparative structures, estimates, or result adjectives; mostly quantitative results, performance, or clinical utility statements.
patterns.domain: Biomedical papers and research grant text

patterns.name: Evaluative or concluding predicates in research
patterns.context: Evaluates the effects, accuracy, reliability, and limitations of experiments, diagnoses, or measurements; the predicate itself and nearby words are activated.

patterns.name: Compromised reliability or inadequate measurement quality
patterns.context: Directly discusses insufficient or reduced reliability of equipment, measurements, or standard methods; one instance concerns engineering risk, another medical imaging measurement.
patterns.domain: Patent backgrounds and medical imaging research

patterns.name: Copula is followed by a low value or low efficiency
patterns.context: States that efficiency or clinical utility is constrained by a low level or limitation; triggers concentrate around “is + low/limited”.

patterns.name: Changes in lifespan or duration
patterns.context: Concerns the duration and change of a protein half-life or device lifespan, expressed as a comparison or increase.

patterns.name: Experimental descriptions of research methods, samples, or materials
patterns.context: Weak local activation occurs in descriptions of methods or experimental subjects, with no consistent trigger word or stable context.

patterns.name: Technical background statements without a clear match to the main pattern
patterns.context: Patent background introduces electrode materials and their lifespan advantages; it resembles other patterns only broadly through result statements, such as those about clinical use and measurement reliability.

6_432.concept: 结果与性能评价陈述
6_432.description: 主要响应结果性陈述中的系词、比较和评价词，尤其是数值、准确性、效率、限制、可靠性与寿命变化；跨生物医学论文、资助文本和专利，也有零散方法描述激活。

patterns.name: biomedical结果或指标的数值陈述
patterns.trigger: « was»10 « greater»10 « than»10 « 3»8 « hours»7；« is»9 « estimated»10 « at»9 « 63»6«%»6；« has»8 « exceeded»10 « 90»8%；« is»9 « limited»9
patterns.context: 激活落在系词、比较结构、估算值或结果形容词附近；多为定量结果、性能或临床效用陈述。
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文与研究资助文本

patterns.name: 研究中的评价或结论谓词
patterns.trigger: « accuracy»1 ... « was»10 « demonstrated»8；« was»9 « tested»4；« remains»9 « low»8
patterns.context: 围绕实验、诊断或测量的效果、准确性、可靠性和限制作出评价；谓词本身及其邻近词出现激活。
patterns.domain: 生物医学研究及技术描述

patterns.name: 可靠性受损或测量质量不足
patterns.trigger: « reliability» ... « will»8 « be»9 « spoiled»7；« reliability» ... « remains»9 « low»8
patterns.context: 直接讨论设备、测量或标准方法的可靠性不足或下降；一处为工程风险，一处为医学影像测量。
patterns.domain: 专利背景与医学影像研究

patterns.name: 系词 is 后接低值或低效率
patterns.context: 说明某项效率或临床用途受到低水平/限制；触发集中在“is + low/limited”附近。

patterns.name: 寿命或持续时间的变化
patterns.trigger: « lifetime» « increases»9；« was»10 « greater»10 « than»10 « 3»8 « hours»7
patterns.context: 涉及蛋白半衰期或器件寿命的时间长度及变化，呈比较或增加表述。
patterns.domain: 生物医学实验与电极专利

patterns.name: 研究方法、样本或材料的实验描述
patterns.trigger: « modelled»1 « after»2；« accuracy»1 ... « punch biopsy»；« efficiency» ... « expression plasmids»
patterns.context: 方法或实验对象的叙述中出现局部弱激活，未见统一的触发词或稳定上下文。

patterns.name: 无明显匹配主模式的技术背景表述
patterns.context: 专利背景介绍电极材料及其寿命优势；与临床、测量可靠性等模式仅有宽泛的结果陈述相似。

en.concept: Relation and Result Statements in Scientific and Technical Text
en.description: Activations occur across statements of judgment, measurement, comparison, results, and change in scientific and technical texts, often in structures where be-copulas or modal verbs connect to a predicate. Also includes lifespan, mathematical equations, and departures from general behavior.

patterns.name: Copula linking a state or property
patterns.context: A be-verb links the subject to a property, state, or result; some sentences include comparative or evaluative elements.
patterns.domain: Biomedical experiments, clinical research, patent technical backgrounds

patterns.name: Research results and measurement judgments
patterns.context: Describes whether a clinical procedure was avoided, whether evidence confirmed something, whether a metric was measured, and the possible range of parameter precision.
patterns.domain: Clinical research, medical measurement, cosmology papers

patterns.name: Multiplicative or equality relation
patterns.context: Compares lifespans or states an equality relation between mathematical objects.

patterns.name: Lifespan change and causal explanation
patterns.context: First states that device lifespan increased, then introduces the reason.

patterns.name: Departure from general behavior
patterns.context: States that behavior under specific template parameters must differ from general behavior.

6_432.concept: 科学技术文本中的关系与结果陈述
6_432.description: 激活分布于科学与技术文本中的判断、测量、比较、结果及变化陈述，常见于 be 系词或情态词连接谓语的结构；也涉及寿命、数学等式和偏离一般行为。

patterns.name: 系词连接状态或性质
patterns.context: 主语后用 be 动词连接性质、状态或结果；部分句子带比较或评价成分。
patterns.domain: 生物医学实验、临床研究、专利技术背景

patterns.name: 研究结果与测量判断
patterns.context: 描述临床操作是否避免、证据是否证实、指标是否测量，以及参数精度可能达到的范围。
patterns.domain: 临床研究、医学测量、宇宙学论文

patterns.name: 倍数或等式关系
patterns.context: 比较寿命长短，或陈述数学对象之间的等式关系。
patterns.domain: 医学制剂研究、数学论文

patterns.name: 寿命变化与因果解释
patterns.context: 先陈述器件寿命增加，再引出原因。

patterns.name: 偏离一般行为
patterns.context: 说明特定模板参数下的行为必须不同于一般行为。

en.description: Activations concentrate on English copulas or auxiliaries such as is, was, and will be, especially adjectives and past participles that follow and convey evaluation, state, result, or estimate; common in scientific, technical, and biomedical statements.

patterns.name: was + evaluative/result adjective
patterns.context: In English past-tense passive or copular constructions, was is followed by a result, degree, or evaluative word; it may also be followed by a number, cause, or method.

patterns.name: is + property or result description
patterns.context: Present-tense statements describe the properties, state, or estimated value of a device, material, or research result, often followed by a degree adverb, cause, or number.
patterns.domain: Patent backgrounds and biomedical papers; paragraphs 4, 5, 7

patterns.name: will be + result participle
patterns.context: A past participle follows the modal will and be to predict an outcome; this example also includes the result complement as well.

6_432.concept: 系动词/被动结构中的结果描述
6_432.description: 激活集中于英语系动词或助动词 is、was、will be，尤其是其后承接评价、状态、结果或估计的形容词和过去分词；常见于科技及生物医学陈述。

patterns.name: was + 评价/结果形容词
patterns.context: 英语过去时被动或系表结构中，was 后接结果、程度或评价性词语；有时还继续接数值、原因或方法。
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文与摘要；段2、3、6、8、9、10

patterns.name: is + 性质或结果描述
patterns.context: 现在时陈述设备、材料或研究结果的性质、状态或估计值，后续常带程度副词、原因或数值。
patterns.domain: 专利背景与生物医学论文；段4、5、7

patterns.name: will be + 结果分词
patterns.context: 情态动词 will 后接 be 和过去分词，预测某种后果；本例还带结果补语 as well。

en.concept: English predicate linking and state expressions
en.description: Activations cluster on combinations of linking or auxiliary verbs such as be, was, is, and remains with subsequent predicates: these include passive voice, adjective states, and a few expressions of magnitude.

patterns.name: Passive structure after modal/future auxiliaries
patterns.context: A modal or future auxiliary is followed by be and then a past participle, forming the passive voice
patterns.domain: Patent background and research project abstracts

patterns.name: Past-tense passive voice
patterns.context: Was is followed by a past participle to state a research finding or result

patterns.name: Adjective or degree expression after be
patterns.context: Be is followed by an adjective or an adjective phrase with a degree adverb
patterns.domain: Patent background, medical paper abstracts, and online comments

patterns.name: State adjective after remain
patterns.context: Remain(s) is followed by an adjective describing a continuing state

patterns.name: Be construction describing service life
patterns.context: Should be is followed by on the order of to estimate service life or magnitude

6_432.concept: 英语谓语连接与状态表达
6_432.description: 激活集中在 be、was、is、remains 等系动词或助动词与后续谓语的组合：包括被动语态、形容词状态，以及少数数量级表达。

patterns.name: 情态/将来助动词后的被动结构
patterns.context: 情态或将来助动词后接 be，再接过去分词，构成被动语态
patterns.domain: 专利背景、科研项目摘要

patterns.name: 过去时被动语态
patterns.context: was 后接过去分词，陈述研究发现或结果

patterns.name: be 后接形容词或程度表达
patterns.context: be 后接形容词或带程度副词的形容词性表达
patterns.domain: 专利背景、医学论文摘要、网络评论

patterns.name: remain 后接状态形容词
patterns.context: remain(s) 后接形容词，描述持续存在的状态

patterns.name: 描述使用寿命的 be 结构
patterns.context: should be 后接 on the order of，估计寿命或数量级

en.concept: State and Numerical Statements Connected by Copulas
en.description: Sensitive to statements in which copulas and modal copulas connect subjects to predicates, especially be followed by a state result, or by numerical complements such as estimates, ratios, ranges, orders of magnitude, and scores; spans fields and tenses.

patterns.name: State or result predicate following a copula/auxiliary
patterns.context: A copula or auxiliary links the subject to a state, result, or property predicate; includes different meanings such as damage, maintenance/improvement, no change, and reaching zero.

patterns.name: Numerical or degree complement introduced by a copula
patterns.context: A copula or modal copula is followed by an estimate, order of magnitude, threshold, ratio, range, or score.
patterns.domain: Medicine, physics, patent technology, research abstracts

6_432.concept: 系词连接的状态与数值陈述
6_432.description: 对系词及情态系词连接主语与谓语的陈述敏感，尤其是 be 后接状态结果，或后接估计、比例、范围、数量级及评分等数值补语；涵盖不同领域和时态。

patterns.name: 系词/助动词后的状态或结果谓语
patterns.trigger: «will»« be»« spoiled»；«is»« maintained» or improved；«remains»« unchanged»；«would»« be»« zero»
patterns.context: 以系词或助动词连接主语与状态、结果或性质谓语；包括损坏、维持/改善、不变及归零等不同含义
patterns.domain: 专利技术、药理学、论坛讨论

patterns.name: 系词引出的数值或程度补语
patterns.trigger: «is»« estimated»« at»« 63»«%»；«should»« be»« on»« the»« order»；«could»« be»« below»；«is»« within»« a»« factor»« of»« ten»；«are»« 100»«%»；«was»«.87»
patterns.context: 系词或情态系词后接估计值、数量级、阈值、比例、范围或评分数值
patterns.domain: 医学、物理学、专利技术、研究摘要

en.description: Activations primarily occur in predicative positions following copulas or auxiliaries: scientific texts often have quantitative results, evaluations, or state judgments, while reviews have degree adverbs and quality assessments. The commonality is the predicate structure rather than a specific topic.

patterns.name: Quantification, evaluation, or judgment following a copula
patterns.context: In technical or academic statements, a number, degree, result, or evaluation method immediately follows a copula/auxiliary; activation may also extend to subsequent predicates.

patterns.name: Quality evaluation following a copula
patterns.context: When evaluating product or work quality, a degree adverb and positive adjective follow the copula.

6_432.concept: 系词后的述谓结构
6_432.description: 主要在系词或助动词后的述谓位置激活：科研文本中常接量化结果、评估或状态判断，评论中接程度副词与质量评价；共同点偏向谓语结构，而非特定主题。

patterns.name: 系词后的量化、评估或判断
patterns.trigger: 系词及其后续述谓，如 «is»、«was»、«will»，后接“within … factor”“orders … magnitude lower”“estimated at 63%”“evaluated by observing”等
patterns.context: 在技术或学术陈述中，系词/助动词后紧接数值、程度、结果或评估方式；触发点也可能延伸到后续谓语

patterns.name: 系词后的质量评价
patterns.context: 评价产品或作品质量时，系词后接程度副词和正面形容词

en.description: Primarily responds to copulas and their predicates in scientific and patent statements, often extending to states, evaluations, comparisons, or quantitative results; also occurs in passive constructions, past tense, and reported research results.

patterns.name: Predicate or complement following the copula “is”
patterns.context: In declarative technical or academic text, a state, evaluation, definition, or result follows the copula; activation sometimes extends to an immediately following degree word, negation, or predicate.
patterns.domain: Patents, medical papers, mathematics and computer science papers

patterns.name: Quantitative or statistical results following a copula
patterns.context: When reporting scores, ratios, measurements, or statistical values, activation may fall on the copula, result introducer, or nearby number.

patterns.name: Comparative relation following a copula
patterns.context: In comparisons, equivalences, or expressions of degree, activation covers the copula and following comparative structure.

patterns.name: Results reported in cited literature
patterns.context: Describes results such as accuracy based on literature reports or preliminary reports; strong activation falls on the result predicate.

patterns.name: Copulas other than the unmarked “is”
patterns.context: Passive or past-tense copular structures followed by observed results or property comparisons.

6_432.concept: 科学陈述中的系词谓语
6_432.description: 主要响应科学与专利陈述中的系词及其后谓语，常延伸至状态、评价、比较或数量结果；也见于被动、过去时及文献报道结果。

patterns.name: 系词“is”后的谓语或补语
patterns.context: 陈述性技术或学术文本中，系词后接状态、评价、定义或结果；有时延伸到紧随其后的程度词、否定词或谓语
patterns.domain: 专利、医学论文、数学与计算机科学论文

patterns.name: 系词后接数量或统计结果
patterns.context: 报告评分、比例、测量值或统计数值时，激活可落在系词、结果引导词或数值附近

patterns.name: 系词后接比较关系
patterns.context: 比较、等同或程度表达中，激活覆盖系词及其后的比较结构
patterns.domain: 生物医学、数学论文、专利

patterns.name: 引述文献中的结果
patterns.context: 以文献报道或初步报告为依据，描述准确率等结果；强激活落在结果谓语

patterns.name: 未标记的 “is” 以外系词
patterns.context: 被动或过去时系词结构，后接观察结果或性质比较

en.concept: Linking verbs and result statements in technical English
en.description: Activations mainly fall on technical-English linking verbs is/was and their following predicates, attributes, or comparative structures; they also involve statistical numbers, units, and quantitative result reporting. Passages also share a scientific or patent context, but their specific local topics vary.

patterns.name: Subject-predicate linking with English is/was
patterns.context: In technical or academic sentences, a linking verb connects the subject to a property, result, estimate, or comparison; it may occur in a sentence or within a phrase
patterns.domain: Technical writing such as PubMed, NIH, and patents

patterns.name: Passive auxiliary
patterns.context: When describing research methods such as measurements and observations, an auxiliary is followed by a past participle, as in “«were» «measured»”

patterns.name: Quantitative results and comparative expressions
patterns.context: Reports scale ranges, statistics, estimated proportions, orders of magnitude, multiples, durations, or correlation coefficients; numbers and symbols are marked by tokenization
patterns.domain: Scientific abstracts and patent technical descriptions

patterns.name: Evaluative results or property descriptions
patterns.context: Positively or negatively evaluates reliability, quality, performance, or change, possibly linked by is/was or appearing in an adjacent sentence
patterns.domain: Research results and patent background descriptions

patterns.name: Similarity and drug-affinity comparison for Src and Abl
patterns.context: Compares protein-drug interactions and binding affinity of imatinib for Src and Abl

patterns.name: Biomedical diagnoses and test results
patterns.context: Reports the diagnostic rate of bone marrow biopsies for amyloidosis or the half-life of p53 mutant proteins; beyond general linking-verb and quantitative expressions, no more specific shared trigger pattern is evident

6_432.concept: 科技英语系动词与结果陈述
6_432.description: 激活主要落在科技英语系动词 is/was 及其后续谓语、属性或比较结构；同时涉及统计数字、单位和定量结果报告。各段还共享科学或专利语境，但局部具体主题多样。

patterns.name: 英语系动词 is/was 的主谓连接
patterns.trigger: «is»、«was»，尤其后接描述、判断或比较成分
patterns.context: 技术或学术句中，系动词连接主语与性质、结果、估计值或比较关系；可处于句中或短语内部

patterns.name: 被动语态助动词
patterns.context: 描述测量、观察等研究方法时，助动词后接过去分词，如“«were» «measured»”

patterns.name: 定量结果与比较表达
patterns.context: 报告量表范围、统计量、估计比例、数量级、倍数、时长或相关系数；数字和符号经分词标记
patterns.domain: 科学摘要与专利技术说明

patterns.name: 评价性结果或性质描述
patterns.context: 对可靠性、质量、性能或变化作正面或负面评价，可能由 is/was 连接，也可能在相邻句中出现
patterns.domain: 研究结果与专利背景说明

patterns.name: Src 与 Abl 的相似性及亲和力对比
patterns.context: 比较 imatinib 与 Src、Abl 的蛋白药物相互作用和结合亲和力

patterns.name: 生物医学诊断与检验结果
patterns.context: 报告淀粉样变性骨髓活检诊断率，或 p53 突变蛋白半衰期；除一般系动词及定量表达外，未见更具体共同触发模式

en.description: All passages activate be-verbs in formal technical or research texts, especially when followed by result, state, evaluation, or passive predicates; some passages also emphasize numbers, comparisons, and statistical metrics.

patterns.name: Result/state predicates following be-verbs
patterns.context: Activation concentrates on be-verbs and immediately following state, evaluation, change, or result predicates; common in subject-predicate structures, with some cases of be followed by a comparison or complement.
patterns.domain: Formal styles across academic abstracts, patent backgrounds, and technical descriptions

patterns.name: Quantitative results and statistical metrics
patterns.context: When stating reliability, measurement results, lifespan, thresholds, or comparative results, numbers and statistics often occur next to the activated predicate; numbers themselves are sometimes activated too.
patterns.domain: Medical, experimental research, engineering, and patent technical writing

patterns.name: Evaluative or degree modifiers
patterns.context: Qualitatively evaluates equipment, materials, measurement performance, or biological properties, or describes degree and change; usually occurs in result statements.

patterns.name: Predicates in passive or method descriptions
patterns.context: When reporting experimental procedures, evaluations, or analytical methods, be-verbs and past participles form passive constructions.

6_432.concept: be 动词后的结果谓语
6_432.description: 所有段落均在正式技术或科研文本中激活 be 动词，尤其是其后接结果、状态、评价或被动谓语；部分段落还突出数值、比较和统计指标。

patterns.name: be 动词后续的结果/状态谓语
patterns.trigger: « was»、« is»、« will»，以及其后接的谓语，如 « was» « excellent»、« was» « greater»、« is» « deteriorated»
patterns.context: 激活集中在 be 动词及其后紧接的状态、评价、变化或结果谓语；常见于主谓结构，也有 be 后接比较或补语的情况。
patterns.domain: 跨学术摘要、专利背景与技术说明等正式文体

patterns.name: 量化结果与统计指标
patterns.context: 在陈述可靠性、测量结果、寿命、阈值或比较结果时，数字和统计量常紧邻被激活的谓语；数字本身有时也激活。
patterns.domain: 医学、实验研究、工程与专利技术文体

patterns.name: 评价或程度修饰语
patterns.trigger: « greater»« than»、« excellent»、« spoiled»、« deteriorated»、« somewhat»« reduced»
patterns.context: 对设备、材料、测量性能或生物学性质作定性评价，或描述程度及变化；多出现在结果陈述中。

patterns.name: 被动或方法描述中的谓语
patterns.trigger: « were»« measured»、« was»« evaluated»、« were»« determined»
patterns.context: 在报告实验流程、评估或分析方法时，be 动词与过去分词构成被动结构。
patterns.domain: 医学与生物学研究文本

en.concept: Property and result statements introduced by linking verbs
en.description: Across domains, activations often fall on linking verbs such as is/was/will be/should be and the predicates that follow, commonly stating properties, results, degrees, and comparisons; also includes reliability measures, service-life estimates, technical degradation, and online evaluations.

patterns.name: Linking verbs in factual, state, or property judgments
patterns.context: A linking verb is followed by a property, quantity, evaluation, or result; the linking verb itself and its following predicate are especially activated.
patterns.domain: Scientific papers, patent specifications, and online comments; passages 1–10

patterns.name: Comparisons, degrees, and quantities
patterns.context: Describes relative magnitude, degree, range, or change, often with a linking verb introducing a comparative result or quantified property.
patterns.domain: Technical papers and patent technical writing; passages 1, 3, 8, 9, 10; also evaluative judgments in passage 7

patterns.name: Reliability and measurement-result reporting
patterns.context: Reports device/scale reliability or rating measures, providing numerical values.
patterns.domain: Research abstracts, methods, or patent descriptions; passages 4, 5, 6

patterns.name: Service life and time scales
patterns.context: Discusses service life and uses a duration or order of magnitude for comparison or estimation.
patterns.domain: Biomedical research and mechanical patents; passages 1, 2

patterns.name: Degradation of structural or material properties
patterns.context: Explains reductions in reliability, efficiency, or crystallinity caused by damage, processes, or conditions.

patterns.name: Similarity and drug-affinity comparison
patterns.context: Compares protein interactions or the affinity of a drug for different targets.

patterns.name: Evaluative judgments and contrast
patterns.context: Makes subjective evaluations of a design or work, with contrasting negative and positive judgments in the same passage.

patterns.name: Local collocations of common linking verbs and predicate forms
patterns.context: Activations cluster on linking verbs and immediately adjacent degree adverbs, result adverbs, or predicates, without showing a unified specialist-noun trigger.

6_432.concept: 系词引出的属性与结果陈述
6_432.description: 跨领域激活多落在 is/was/will be/should be 等系词及后续谓语，常用于陈述属性、结果、程度和比较；另涵盖可靠性指标、寿命估计、技术劣化及网络评价。

patterns.name: 事实、状态或性质判断中的系词
patterns.context: 系词后接性质、数量、评价或结果；尤其系词本身及其后的谓语获得激活。
patterns.domain: 科学论文、专利说明书及网络评论；段1–10

patterns.name: 比较、程度与数量表达
patterns.trigger: “greater than”“orders of magnitude lower than”“somewhat reduced”“very high”“within a factor of ten”
patterns.context: 描述相对大小、程度、范围或变化；常以系词引出比较结果或量化属性。
patterns.domain: 科技论文与专利技术文体；段1、3、8、9、10；另见段7评价

patterns.name: 可靠性与测量结果报告
patterns.context: 报告设备/量表可靠性或评分指标，并给出数值。
patterns.domain: 研究摘要、方法或专利说明；段4、5、6

patterns.name: 寿命及时间尺度
patterns.trigger: “half life … was greater than 3 hours versus 30 minutes”“service life … should be on the order of several decades”
patterns.context: 讨论寿命，并用时长或数量级作比较、估计。
patterns.domain: 生物医学研究与机械专利；段1、2

patterns.name: 结构或材料性质劣化
patterns.trigger: “reliability … will be spoiled”“efficiency … is somewhat reduced”“crystallinity … is thus deteriorated”
patterns.context: 说明损伤、工艺或条件造成的可靠性、效率或结晶性下降。

patterns.name: 相似性与药物亲和力比较
patterns.trigger: “interactions similar to that of Abl”“affinity … is orders of magnitude lower than for Abl”
patterns.context: 比较蛋白质相互作用或药物对不同靶标的亲和力。

patterns.name: 评价性判断及反差
patterns.trigger: “logo really is awful”“quality … is very high”“site looks much better”
patterns.context: 对设计或作品作主观评价，且同段出现负面与正面评价的反差。

patterns.name: 常见系词及谓语形式的局部搭配
patterns.context: 激活集中在系词及其紧邻的程度副词、结果副词或谓语，未显示统一的专业名词触发条件。

en.description: The main commonality is the sequence «от» inside Russian and Bulgarian words, with no single obvious meaning. Markup markers are also noticeable: Script, line breaks, and indentation in technical snippets.

patterns.name: Русский фрагмент «от» в слове
patterns.context: Inside a Russian word; often after a preceding word part, but position and word vary. No separate stable meaning or syntactic role is required.
patterns.domain: Russian text: questions and answers, comments, and literary quotations

patterns.name: Болгарский фрагмент «от» в слове
patterns.context: Inside Bulgarian words; clearly repeated in parliamentary prose.

patterns.name: Структурные и кодовые токены
patterns.context: Markup or formatting markers activate around code/examples; the combination of «Script» and line breaks in segment 2, indentation and line breaks in segment 4.
patterns.domain: Technical text, code, and quoted examples

6_643.description: Главная общность — последовательность «от» внутри русских и болгарских слов, без единого очевидного значения. Отдельно заметны маркеры разметки: Script, переносы строк и отступы в технических фрагментах.

patterns.name: Русский фрагмент «от» в слове
patterns.context: Внутри русского слова; часто после предшествующей части слова, но позиция и слово различаются. Не требуется отдельное устойчивое значение или синтаксическая роль.
patterns.domain: Русский текст: вопросы и ответы, комментарии и художественная цитата

patterns.name: Болгарский фрагмент «от» в слове
patterns.context: Внутри болгарских слов; явное повторение в парламентской прозе.

patterns.name: Структурные и кодовые токены
patterns.context: Активируются маркеры разметки или форматирования вокруг кода/примеров; сочетание «Script» и переводов строк в сегменте 2, отступы и переносы в сегменте 4.
patterns.domain: Технический текст, код и цитируемый пример

en.description: Primarily responds to the contiguous Russian letter sequence «от» in Russian words, covering multiple word forms in Q&A, forum, and parliamentary corpora; another segment activates near code and newline markers.

patterns.name: «от» at the end or within Russian words
patterns.context: A contiguous sequence within Russian words; common in words such as «вот», «хоть», and «соответствие», not limited to a specific part of speech.
patterns.domain: Russian Q&A and forum text; parliamentary text

patterns.name: Markers in code
patterns.context: In code or at the boundary between code and prose, especially near newline markers and Java Server Pages-related text.

6_643.description: 主要对俄语词中连续字母串«от»有反应，覆盖问答、论坛和议会语料中的多种词形；另有一段在代码与换行标记附近激活。

patterns.name: 俄语词尾/词中 «от»
patterns.context: 在俄语文本中，作为词内连续字母串；常见于「вот」「хоть」「соответствие」等词，不限于特定词类。
patterns.domain: 俄语问答与论坛文本、议会文本

patterns.name: 代码中的标记
patterns.context: 代码或代码与正文交界处，尤其是换行标记及 Java Server Pages 相关文本。
patterns.domain: 英语维基百科技术条目

en.description: The most consistent trigger is the character sequence «от» within Russian and Bulgarian words, appearing in programming Q&A, forums, and parliamentary text; there are also Script, newline, several sporadic subword fragments, and formatting markers that may be unrelated to the primary pattern.

patterns.name: «от» string in Russian/Slavic words
patterns.context: The letter sequence occurs within complete words or word forms; adjacent markers in fragments sometimes include surrounding letters, but «от» is the recurring common triggering substring.
patterns.domain: Russian StackExchange, HackerNews, Bulgarian EuroParl; also Russian dialogue and parliamentary text

patterns.name: «Script» in code or markup
patterns.context: An English encyclopedia article discussing JavaServer Pages includes the technical term Scriptlet.

patterns.name: Newline markers around code examples
patterns.context: The newline itself is marked; it appears near code, forum quotations, or code examples and, in isolation, may reflect formatting structure rather than a semantic trigger.
patterns.domain: Code or quotation formatting on StackExchange, Wikipedia, and HackerNews

patterns.name: Word fragments related to the number of function arguments
patterns.context: Russian technical Q&A describing functions that can accept any number of arguments; these markers do not clearly form a stable pattern like «от».

patterns.name: Random English word fragments and quotation formatting
patterns.context: Appears in HackerNews quotations or example fragments, possibly reflecting local word forms or indentation; no stable semantic commonality is evident.

patterns.name: «Гот» in a name
patterns.context: Discussion of whether the fictional surname “Готяович” is real; it may share only the character sequence with other «от» matches.
patterns.domain: HackerNews discussion of names and pranks

patterns.name: Compound-word fragments in Bulgarian parliamentary corpora
patterns.context: Occurs alongside recurring «от» in policy, tariff, and negotiation text, but these other markers show no unified trigger condition.

6_643.description: 最稳定的触发是俄语及保加利亚语词内的字符序列«от»，见编程问答、论坛和议会文本；另有Script、换行、若干零散词片段及格式标记，未必与主模式相关。

patterns.name: 分词中的俄语/斯拉夫语 «от» 字符串
patterns.context: 该字母序列出现在完整单词或词形内部；片段中的相邻标记有时还包括周边字母，但 «от» 是反复出现的共同触发子串。
patterns.domain: 俄语 StackExchange、HackerNews、保加利亚语 EuroParl；也出现在俄语对话和议会文本中

patterns.name: 代码或标记语言中的 «Script»
patterns.context: 英文百科条目讨论 JavaServer Pages，出现技术名词 Scriptlet。

patterns.name: 代码示例前后的换行标记
patterns.context: 换行本身被标记；出现在代码、论坛引用或代码示例附近，单独看可能是格式结构而非语义触发。
patterns.domain: StackExchange、Wikipedia、HackerNews 的代码或引用格式

patterns.name: 函数参数数量相关的词内片段
patterns.context: 描述函数可接受任意数量参数的俄语技术问答；这些标记不明显构成与 «от» 相同的稳定模式。

patterns.name: 随机英文词内片段及引用格式
patterns.context: HackerNews 引文或示例片段中出现，可能反映局部词形或缩进格式，未见稳定语义共性。

patterns.name: 姓名中的 «Гот»
patterns.context: 讨论一个虚构姓氏“Готяович”是否真实；与其他 «от» 命中可能仅共享字符序列。
patterns.domain: HackerNews，关于姓名和恶作剧的讨论

patterns.name: 保加利亚语议会语料中的复合词片段
patterns.context: 与反复出现的 «от» 同处政策、关税及谈判文本，但这些其他标记未显示统一触发条件。
patterns.domain: EuroParl 保加利亚语议会文本

en.description: Most passages activate Anti/Anti- at the beginning of a term or phrase, covering antineutrophil cytoplasmic antibodies, other antibodies, anti-angiogenesis, and the proper name for anti-counterfeiting. There is also Script before code and sporadic word fragments in Russian Q&A, which are difficult to explain with this pattern.

patterns.name: Sentence-initial Anti- prefix
patterns.context: Activation clusters on Anti / Anti- at the beginning of a term or sentence, followed by different roots; it can also occur when the following word is split into multiple tokens.
patterns.domain: Term headings or body text in scientific and medical abstracts and policy documents

patterns.name: Antineutrophil cytoplasmic antibody terminology
patterns.context: The full term “Anti-neutrophil cytoplasmic antibodies” appears, whether followed by parentheses or “in Japanese”.

patterns.name: Anti-angiogenic terms
patterns.context: Anti and angiogenic form an anti-angiogenesis-related expression; one example modifies molecules, and another occurs in a title-like phrase.

patterns.name: Other Anti- medical antibody or treatment terms
patterns.context: Begins with Anti-, followed by different antibody targets or related terms; these are not the same specific entity.
patterns.domain: Medical abstracts concerning monoclonal antibodies, autoantibodies, or encephalitis

patterns.name: Proper name Anti-Counterfeiting
patterns.context: The beginning of the proper name Anti-Counterfeiting Trade Agreement; activation is on Anti, not an ordinary medical term.
patterns.domain: International trade, policy, or legal text

patterns.name: Script in code
patterns.context: Appears in “Script let” and before “In Java Server Pages” on the next line; it has no obvious lexical connection to the other Anti- patterns.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedic text concerning Java Server Pages

patterns.name: Local word fragments in Russian text
patterns.context: In Russian Q&A, local activations are scattered across Russian word fragments, the Latin-letter score, and before code examples prompted by a question; they have no obvious connection to Anti- terms.

6_643.description: 多数段落在术语或短语开头激活 Anti/Anti-，覆盖反中性粒细胞胞质抗体、其他抗体、反血管生成和反仿冒专名。另有代码前的 Script 与俄语问答中的零散词片，难以由该模式解释。

patterns.name: 句首 Anti- 前缀
patterns.context: 激活集中在术语或句子开头的 Anti / Anti-，其后接不同词根；可在后续词被拆分成多个 token 时仍出现。
patterns.domain: 科学、医学摘要及政策文件中的术语标题或正文

patterns.name: 反中性粒细胞胞质抗体术语
patterns.context: 出现完整术语“Anti-neutrophil cytoplasmic antibodies”，无论后接括号还是“in Japanese”。

patterns.name: 反血管生成词项
patterns.context: Anti 与 angiogenic 构成反血管生成相关表达；一例作定语修饰 molecules，一例出现在标题式短语中。

patterns.name: 其他 Anti- 医学抗体或治疗术语
patterns.trigger: «Anti»-«NK»«G»12D monoclonal antibody；«Anti»-«par»ietal cell antibodies；«Anti»-«neutral» glycol«ip»«id» antibodies
patterns.context: 以 Anti- 开头，后续为不同抗体靶标或相关术语；并非同一具体实体。
patterns.domain: 医学摘要，涉及单克隆抗体、自身抗体或脑炎

patterns.name: Anti-Counterfeiting 专名
patterns.context: 作为专名 Anti-Counterfeiting Trade Agreement 的开头；激活落在 Anti，而非普通医学术语。
patterns.domain: 国际贸易、政策或法律文本

patterns.name: 代码中的 Script
patterns.context: 出现在“Script let”以及下一行“In Java Server Pages”之前；与其余 Anti- 模式没有明显词面联系。
patterns.domain: 百科文本，涉及 Java Server Pages

patterns.name: 俄语文本中的局部词片
patterns.trigger: «score»及« И»«в»«ан»等俄语姓名/词片；另有“вот такой у меня:”
patterns.context: 俄语问答内容中，局部激活散布在俄语词片、拉丁字母 score 及提问引出的代码示例前；与 Anti- 术语无明显联系。

en.concept: Markers at the beginning of text fragments
en.description: Activations often occur at the beginning of text or fields, especially initial words of paragraphs and title or abstract labels; sometimes accompanied by newlines and separators. They also cover patent boilerplate, medical abstract labels, and various names, with no single semantic trigger identifiable.

patterns.name: Opening words at the start of a sentence or title
patterns.context: The neuron strongly activates on the beginnings of fragments composed of varied words, proper names, or numbers; in most examples the triggering token is at the start of a paragraph or a new title, entry, or abstract field.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedia articles, patents, books, medical abstracts

patterns.name: Near newlines or separators
patterns.context: In several examples, a newline, blank line, or asterisk separator follows the opening word, and related tokens also activate; other passages do not contain these markers.
patterns.domain: Web text, ebooks, encyclopedia articles, and formatted text

patterns.name: Volume/title formatting in book text
patterns.context: A US name is split into multiple tokens, followed by an asterisk separator or bibliographic-style markers such as numbers and colons.

patterns.name: Patent legal boilerplate
patterns.context: Fixed legal boilerplate in patent background or claims contexts; strong activation centers on sentence-initial «Those».

patterns.name: Objectives field in medical abstracts
patterns.context: The abstract field labels “Objectives:” or “Objective” and the statement of research aims that follows; the first word of the label activates most strongly.

patterns.name: Title or entity-name openings, mechanism unclear
patterns.context: Each passage begins with a technical title, a year and event name, an astronomical object name, or a person’s name; these types differ, and examples do not establish a more specific common condition.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedia titles, biographical entries, technical articles

6_643.description: 激活常出现在文本或字段开头，尤其段首词及标题、摘要标签；有时伴随换行和分隔符。也覆盖专利套语、医学摘要标签及各类名称，无法确定单一语义触发因素。

patterns.name: 句首或标题式词语开头
patterns.context: 神经元对多种词语、专名或数字构成的片段开头有强激活；多数例子中触发 token 位于段首或新标题、条目、摘要字段的开头。
patterns.domain: 百科条目、专利、书籍文本、医学摘要

patterns.name: 换行或分隔符附近
patterns.context: 在若干例子中，开头词后紧接换行、空行或星号分隔符，相关 token 也有激活；但其他段没有这类标记。
patterns.domain: 网页文本、电子书、百科条目及排版文本

patterns.name: 书籍文本中的分卷/书名格式
patterns.context: 美国名称被分成多个 token，随后出现星号分隔符或数字、冒号等书目式标记。
patterns.domain: Gutenberg 电子书及网页抓取文本

patterns.name: 专利法律套语
patterns.trigger: «Those» skilled in the art will appreciate
patterns.context: 专利背景或权利要求式语境中的固定法律套语；强激活集中在句首的 «Those»。

patterns.name: 医学摘要目标字段
patterns.context: 摘要字段标题“Objectives:”或“Objective”及其后研究目的陈述；标题首词激活最强。

patterns.name: 标题或实体名称开头，机制不明
patterns.context: 各段分别是技术标题、年份与事件名称、天体名称、人物姓名的开头；这些类型彼此不同，无法从例子确认更具体的共同条件。
patterns.domain: 百科标题、人物条目、技术条目

en.description: Primarily responds to word-final -IVE in uppercase words, often as an independent subword token, across academic, legal, email, patent, code, and medical texts; it also strongly responds to IVE in the ARRIVE flight-table field and the NARRATIVE label.

patterns.name: Word-final -IVE
patterns.context: Strong triggers usually occur in uppercase words, with «IVE» at the end; words may be split into multiple tokens. Lowercase «ive» (productive) also occurs, with slightly lower strength.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain: paper titles, legal documents, email, patents, code, medical texts, and web text

patterns.name: ARRIVE in flight tables
patterns.context: In airline itinerary tables, ARRIVE means arrival; it also appears as an uppercase table field.
patterns.domain: Airline itinerary / flight tables in email

patterns.name: Internal IVE in NARRATIVE
patterns.context: IVE occurs inside the uppercase word NARRATIVE, not at the end; it appears in a label in an NIH project narrative.

6_643.concept: 大写词中的 IVE 字符串
6_643.description: 主要响应大写词中词尾的 -IVE，常以独立子词元出现，跨学术、法律、邮件、专利、代码和医学文本；另在 ARRIVE 航班表字段及 NARRATIVE 标签中强响应 IVE。

patterns.name: 单词末尾的 -IVE
patterns.context: 强触发通常出现在大写单词中，且 «IVE» 位于词尾；词语可被拆成多个 token。还有普通大小写的 «ive»（productive），强度略低。
patterns.domain: 跨领域；论文标题、法律文书、邮件、专利、代码、医学及网页文本

patterns.name: 航班表中的 ARRIVE
patterns.context: 航空行程表的列标题中，ARRIVE 表示到达；同时处于大写排版的表格字段。
patterns.domain: 邮件中的航空行程／航班表

patterns.name: NARRATIVE 中的内部 IVE
patterns.context: IVE 位于大写词 NARRATIVE 的内部，而不是词尾；出现在 NIH 项目叙述的标签中。
patterns.domain: 公共卫生研究项目摘要

en.description: Activation is distributed across several textual cues: court orders, case names and filing formats, proper names in legal or business text, and password fields, CNN, medical abstract labels, and incident-response headings. There is no single stable meaning; several triggers are uppercase labels, proper names, or formatted fields.

patterns.name: Court orders and ruling language in judicial documents
patterns.context: The body of a court ruling or order, especially directions to the clerk to enter judgment, return documents, and similar actions.

patterns.name: Case titles and party fields in legal documents
patterns.context: Formatting for case numbers, appellants, and opposing parties, often with uppercase names and space-separated text.

patterns.name: Password field in a web-login example
patterns.context: Describes a login page or authentication flow; the password label follows the username field.

patterns.name: CNN, flow fields, and prediction terminology
patterns.context: An abstract introduces a convolutional neural network model and its predictions of flow-field velocity and pressure.

patterns.name: Abstract-style research objective label
patterns.context: A medical or epidemiological abstract uses the uppercase OBJECTIVE label to introduce the research aim.

patterns.name: Alternative wording in invoices and product/service names
patterns.context: In an invoice or work-type description, a phrase includes a proper/project name such as “ALTERNATIVE A”.
patterns.domain: Commercial invoices quoted in legal materials

patterns.name: Response subheading in incident reports
patterns.context: After describing an incident, notification, or response process, a standalone heading begins the response section.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedic accounts of accidents or medical incidents

patterns.name: Transportation company name in Tax Court case titles
patterns.context: A company name appears in uppercase in a Tax Court heading and case title.

patterns.name: The word standard in legal argument
patterns.context: Discusses whether an appellate court properly applied the legal standard to a lower court, often alongside procedural issues such as a new trial.

patterns.name: Filing mark and date on court documents
patterns.context: In the “FILED” field on the first page of a document, the date is given with an abbreviated month and day.
patterns.domain: First pages of FreeLaw court documents

6_643.description: 激活分布于多种文本线索：法院命令、案名和归档格式，法律或商业文本中的专名，以及密码字段、CNN、医学摘要标签和事件响应标题。没有单一稳定语义；若干触发点是大写标签、专名或格式化字段。

patterns.name: 裁判文书中的法院命令与判决措辞
patterns.context: 法院裁定或命令的正文，尤其是指示书记员录入判决、退还文件等语境。

patterns.name: 法律文书的案件标题与当事人栏
patterns.context: 案件编号、上诉方与对方当事人的标题排版，常有大写名称及空格分隔。

patterns.name: 网页登录示例中的密码字段
patterns.context: 说明登录页面或身份验证流程，密码标签出现在用户名字段之后。

patterns.name: CNN、流场与预测术语
patterns.context: 摘要中介绍卷积神经网络模型及其对流场速度、压力的预测。

patterns.name: 摘要式研究目标标签
patterns.context: 医学或流行病学摘要以全大写的 OBJECTIVE 标签引出研究目的。

patterns.name: 发票及商品/服务名称中的替代方案字样
patterns.context: 发票或工作类型描述中，短语包含“ALTERNATIVE A”一类专名/项目名称。
patterns.domain: 法律材料所引商业发票

patterns.name: 事件报告中的 Response 小标题
patterns.context: 叙述事件、通知或应对过程后，以独立标题开启响应部分。
patterns.domain: 百科全书式事故/医学事件叙述

patterns.name: 税务法院案名中的运输公司名称
patterns.context: 税务法院抬头及案件标题中，公司名称以全大写形式出现。
patterns.domain: FreeLaw 美国税务法院文书

patterns.name: 法律论述中的标准一词
patterns.context: 讨论上诉法院对下级法院适用法律标准是否恰当，常与新审判等程序问题连用。

patterns.name: 法院文件的归档标记与日期
patterns.context: 文书首页的“FILED”归档栏内，日期以月份缩写和日号标示。

en.concept: Proper names and parameters in structured technical text
en.description: Activation is distributed across genres: HER/ER cancer markers, quantitative values and units, legal document layout and data-rights clauses, as well as chemical processes, biomedical constructs, and product specifications. The commonality is weak; activation often occurs near structured proper names, parameters, or technical descriptions.

patterns.name: Compound lists and content variation
patterns.context: Lists plant compounds and reports content ranges for carotenoids and other substances.

6_643.concept: 结构化技术文本中的专名与参数
6_643.description: 激活分布于多种文体：HER/ER等肿瘤标记、量化数值和单位、法律文书版式与数据权利条款，以及化学工艺、生物医学构建和产品规格。共同点较弱，常出现在结构化专名、参数或技术表述附近。

patterns.name: 化合物清单与含量变异
patterns.context: 列举植物化合物并报告类胡萝卜素等含量范围

en.concept: Terminology and markers in specialized text
en.description: Activation often occurs on parenthetical abbreviations or terminology markers in specialized text, and also responds to patent titles, reference anchors, and several domain terms; formatted author strings also occur. The common pattern is weak, and not all snippets can be assigned to a single semantic theme.

patterns.name: Abbreviation definitions or parenthetical term markers
patterns.context: An abbreviation is introduced or presented in parentheses after a technical term or full form; may also be a chemical formula or hyphenated abbreviation.
patterns.domain: Biomedical, clinical research, statistics, and scientific/technical writing

patterns.name: Patent section heading
patterns.context: The numbered heading “1. Field of the Invention” in a patent text and its line-break formatting.
patterns.domain: Patent background / description of the invention

patterns.name: ATPases terminology
patterns.context: In an oncology research context, ATPases is used as the name of a cellular target and placed in parentheses.
patterns.domain: Biomedical research abstracts or project descriptions

patterns.name: Reference-link markers
patterns.context: A mixed Markdown/HTML reference anchor in PubMed Central text, containing a bib number and ref-type attribute.

patterns.name: MD computational abbreviation
patterns.context: A full term is followed by the abbreviation MD in parentheses in computational science text.
patterns.domain: ArXiv scientific papers on molecular dynamics simulations

patterns.name: Unclear alphanumeric string / person label
patterns.context: The context contains an @-marked person or username and digits, possibly an author list or special corpus formatting; it does not clearly match the parenthetical-term pattern in other snippets.
patterns.domain: Author/account labels or formatted metadata in ArXiv text

patterns.name: Scattered biomedical keywords
patterns.context: Appears respectively in an enzyme name, a tinnitus term, and the name of an oxidative bleaching agent; no shared local trigger structure explains the activation.

6_643.concept: 专业文本中的术语与标记
6_643.description: 激活多见于专业文本中的括号缩写或术语标记，也响应专利标题、参考文献锚点及若干领域术语；另有格式化作者串。共同规律较弱，不能将所有片段归为单一语义主题。

patterns.name: 缩写定义或括号中的术语标记
patterns.context: 专业术语或全称之后，在括号中引入或呈现缩写；也可能是化学式或带连字符的缩写。
patterns.domain: 生物医学、临床研究、统计学及科学技术文体

patterns.name: 专利章节标题
patterns.context: 专利文本中编号标题“1. Field of the Invention”及其换行格式。

patterns.name: ATPases术语
patterns.context: 肿瘤研究语境中，将 ATPases 作为细胞靶点名称，并置于括号内。
patterns.domain: 生物医学研究摘要或项目说明

patterns.name: 参考文献链接标记
patterns.context: PubMed Central 文本中的 Markdown/HTML 混合参考文献锚点，含 bib 编号和 ref-type 属性。
patterns.domain: 论文网页或 XML/Markdown 格式的参考文献

patterns.name: MD计算缩写
patterns.context: 计算科学文本中，完整术语后以括号给出 MD 缩写。
patterns.domain: ArXiv科学论文，分子动力学模拟

patterns.name: 未明的字母数字串/人名标注
patterns.context: 上下文为 @ 标记的人名或用户名及数字，可能是作者列表或语料中的特殊格式；与其他片段中的术语括号模式不明显相同。
patterns.domain: ArXiv文本中的作者/账户标记或格式化元数据

patterns.trigger: « cytosolic»1« isoform»5« arg»2«in»6«ase»3；« t»1«inn»4«itus»2；« hydrogen»10« peroxide»7
patterns.context: 分别出现在酶名称、耳鸣术语和氧化漂白剂名称中；没有共同的局部触发结构能解释其激活。
patterns.domain: 生物医学与专利化学文本

en.description: Activation often occurs on numbers, dates, identifiers, and adjacent punctuation; it also covers layout whitespace, sports statistics, legal formatting, mathematical subscripts, medical abbreviations, and evidence lists. The commonality among these categories is weak.

patterns.name: Date and identifier formats
patterns.context: Dates appear as month, day, year, or similar written-date formats; also includes ordinal numbers, identifiers, and parentheses near dates.
patterns.domain: Legal documents, email, encyclopedias, sports reporting, etc.

patterns.name: Layout whitespace and indentation
patterns.context: Documents preserve layout whitespace, often adjacent to headings, signature lines, or date lines.
patterns.domain: Email, legal documents, and other formatted text

patterns.name: Numeric statistics in sports reporting
patterns.context: In accounts of teams, players, or seasons, numbers are adjacent to game statistics, records, trades, or salary information.

patterns.name: Legal document headings and citation formats
patterns.context: Formatted passages such as court document headings, procedural records, judge lists, or opinion dates.

patterns.name: Numeric mathematical notation
patterns.context: Letter variables with subscripts, set or field notation, and parentheses form formulas.

patterns.name: Abbreviations and parentheses in medical research titles
patterns.context: A technical term in a research title or abstract is followed by an uppercase abbreviation in parentheses.

patterns.name: Evidence lists in case narratives
patterns.context: Repeated “no” statements list items that were not found, surrounded by a police investigation narrative.

6_643.description: 激活多见于数字、日期、编号及其相邻标点，也覆盖排版空白、体育统计、法律格式、数学下标、医学缩写和物证清单；各类共同特点较弱。

patterns.name: 日期及编号格式
patterns.trigger: “November 2, 2016”“February 15, 1957”“January 28, 2011”“April 3 deadline”“November 20, 2001”；日期中的月份、数字及标点
patterns.context: 日期以月份、日、年份或相近的书面日期格式出现，也包括日期附近的序号、编号和括号
patterns.domain: 法律文书、邮件、百科、体育报道等

patterns.name: 版面空白与缩进
patterns.trigger: 重复的长空格“                        ”及其附近的换行、缩进
patterns.context: 文档保留版式空白，常与标题、署名或日期行相邻
patterns.domain: 邮件、法律文书及其他排版文本

patterns.name: 体育报道中的数字统计
patterns.trigger: “shots 9 and 12”“19-3 start”“six hits”“a season low”“season”“$14.5 million”
patterns.context: 球队、球员或赛季叙述中，数字紧邻比赛统计、纪录、交易或薪资信息

patterns.name: 法律文书标题及引文格式
patterns.trigger: “Chief Judge”“motion for reconsideration”“ECF No. 9”“Before:”“Circuit Judges”“(Opinion filed: February 23, 2011)”
patterns.context: 法院文件的标题、程序记载、法官名单或意见书日期等格式化段落

patterns.name: 数字化数学记号
patterns.context: 字母变量带下标、集合或域记号及括号组成公式

patterns.name: 医学研究标题中的缩写与括号
patterns.context: 研究标题或摘要中，专业术语后给出大写缩写并以括号标示

patterns.name: 案件叙述中的物证清单
patterns.trigger: “no gun, no wallet, and no $… bill”
patterns.context: 以重复的“no”列举未找到的物品，周围是警方调查叙述

en.concept: Formal argument and expressions of concrete matters
en.description: Activation is distributed across legal argument, monetary amounts, and several context-specific words. Legal passages often contain that-clauses and court procedure terms; monetary passages cover salaries, compensation, prices, and expenses. There are also references to cars, sports, community responsibility, and movement.

patterns.name: That-clauses in legal argument
patterns.context: Occurs in formal legal arguments or rulings, where that introduces what a court finds, claims, or reviews; also includes relative clauses such as “claims that are so related”.

patterns.name: Questions requiring an answer or review
patterns.context: That introduces a necessary response to a question or indicates that something merits review; the tone is formal and argumentative.
patterns.domain: Academic or public policy discussion; legal argument

patterns.name: Monetary amounts and numeric expressions
patterns.context: Prices, compensation, salaries, or expenses appear; activation often falls on the currency symbol and nearby amount, with varying number formats.
patterns.domain: News, legal, consumer discussions, business information

patterns.name: Formal procedural language in legal documents
patterns.context: A formal legal context consisting of procedural terms such as court, parties, jurisdiction, or judgment.

patterns.name: Expressions of movement and change
patterns.context: Refers respectively to moving away or a price increase; the trigger words look similar, but the contexts differ in meaning.

patterns.name: Brake pads in vehicle maintenance contexts
patterns.context: Discusses regenerative braking, brake-pad wear, or vehicle maintenance, with heat and wear mentioned earlier.

patterns.name: Contracts and transactions
patterns.context: Sports news discusses a player’s expiring contract and trade rumors.

patterns.name: Corporate public responsibility for road use
patterns.context: Describes a company maintaining or using roads to oil wells and lists donations to local communities.

6_643.concept: 正式论述与具体事务表达
6_643.description: 激活分布于法律论证、数字金额及若干特定语境词。法律段常见that从句、法院程序词；金额段覆盖薪酬、赔偿、价格与支出。另有汽车、体育、社区责任及移动表达。

patterns.name: 法律论证中的 that 从句
patterns.context: 出现在正式法律论证或判决中，that 引出法院认为、主张或审查的内容；也包括“claims that are so related”一类关系从句。

patterns.name: 需要作出回答或审查的问题
patterns.context: that 引出对问题的必要回应，或说明某事项值得审查；语气偏正式、论述性。
patterns.domain: 学术或公共政策讨论；法律论证

patterns.name: 金额与数字表达
patterns.context: 出现价格、赔偿、薪酬或支出等金额；激活常落在货币符号及金额附近，数字格式并不一致。
patterns.domain: 新闻、法律、消费讨论、商业信息

patterns.name: 法律文书的正式程序表达
patterns.context: 法院、当事人、管辖权或判决等程序性词汇构成的正式法律语境。

patterns.name: 移动与变化的表达
patterns.context: 分别指搬离或价格上涨；触发词表面相近，但上下文含义不同。
patterns.domain: 网络讨论；无关具体领域

patterns.name: 车辆维护语境中的 brake pads
patterns.context: 谈论再生制动、刹车片磨损或车辆维护，前文提及热量和磨损。

patterns.name: 合同与交易语境
patterns.context: 体育新闻中讨论球员合同到期及交易传闻。

patterns.name: 企业补贴道路使用的公共责任
patterns.context: 描述企业维护或使用通往油井的道路，并列举对地方社区的捐助。

en.description: Activations are distributed across legal findings and argumentation, evaluative adverbs, medical challenges and research evaluation, and promotional prizes; no stable common trigger pattern explains all fragments.

patterns.name: Findings or determinations in judicial text
patterns.context: Legal opinions explain how a fact or legal status is determined; a common structure is Whether … is determined by …
patterns.domain: US case law and legal documents

patterns.name: Legal issues, authority, and standards of decision in legal argument
patterns.context: Discussing court authority, legal grounds, or legal claims raised on appeal
patterns.domain: US case law and legal documents

patterns.name: Emphasizing measurement, value, or importance in legal text
patterns.context: Emphasizing measurement or degree when arguing about damages, value, or legal consequences
patterns.domain: US case law and legal documents

patterns.name: Refusal or limitation in legal text
patterns.context: Stating that a certain loss cannot be measured by monetary damages
patterns.domain: US case law and legal documents

patterns.name: Emphatic adverbs in film reviews
patterns.context: Using an adverb to qualify an evaluation of a work’s production or completion

patterns.name: Moral-evaluative adverbs in political commentary
patterns.context: Evaluating a political figure with an ironic euphemism

patterns.name: Wording about challenges and importance in medical papers
patterns.context: Summarizing the significant challenge that disease prevention or treatment poses to medicine

patterns.name: Evaluation and impact wording in research plans
patterns.context: Describing experimental methods to be used and their effects on a host or human body

patterns.name: Amounts and rewards in promotional copy
patterns.context: Attracting readers to participate with quizzes, contests, and prizes

6_643.description: 激活分散于法律判断与论证、评价性副词、医学挑战与科研评估，以及促销奖金等语境；未见能解释全部片段的稳定共同触发模式。

patterns.name: 司法文本中的认定或判断
patterns.context: 法律意见书中说明某事实或法律状态如何确定；常见结构是 Whether … is determined by …

patterns.name: 法律论证中的法律问题、授权与裁判标准
patterns.trigger: “presents a question of law”；“authorized by statute”
patterns.context: 讨论法院权限、法律依据，或上诉中提出的法律主张

patterns.name: 法律文本中强调衡量、价值或重要性
patterns.context: 论证损害、价值或法律后果时，对衡量或程度作出强调

patterns.name: 法律文本中的拒绝或限制性表述
patterns.context: 说明某种损失无法用金钱损害赔偿衡量

patterns.name: 电影评论中的强调副词
patterns.context: 用副词修饰对作品制作或完成程度的评价

patterns.name: 政治评论中的道德评价副词
patterns.context: 以带有讽刺意味的委婉语评价政治人物

patterns.name: 医学论文中的挑战与重要性措辞
patterns.context: 概述疾病防治或治疗对医学界构成的重要难题

patterns.name: 科研计划中的评估与影响措辞
patterns.context: 描述将采用的实验方法，以及其对宿主或人体的影响
patterns.domain: 科研项目描述／生物医学

patterns.name: 促销文案中的金额与奖励
patterns.context: 以答题、比赛和奖金吸引读者参与

en.concept: In-phrases and ruling formulas in legal contexts
en.description: Activation occurs mainly in U.S. legal documents, especially in + noun phrases and litigation formulas (including determined by and in the light most favorable); there are also scattered local triggers in trade-secret law, political commentary, network science, and biomedicine.

patterns.name: “in the …” phrases in court rulings
patterns.context: In legal argument, the preposition in is followed by an article or demonstrative, often introducing a place, court, state, or abstract situation; segments 6 and 9 also contain the litigation phrase “in the light most favorable”.
patterns.domain: U.S. case law and litigation documents

patterns.name: “determined by” and determination contexts
patterns.context: Legal text explains what standard, factor, or legal basis determines a fact or legal status; segment 1 also introduces an issue to be decided with “Whether”.

patterns.name: “in the light most favorable” evidence-review formula
patterns.context: When reviewing facts and inferences, the court views the record in the manner most favorable to the non-moving party; adjacent to “facts and inferences” and “non-moving”.

patterns.name: Consecutive function words and legal terminology in court rulings
patterns.context: Formal legal argument in the body of a ruling, with function words connecting facts, standards, and legal conclusions; the triggers do not all correspond to the same fixed phrase.

patterns.name: Monetary valuation of trade-secret loss
patterns.context: Argues for irreparable harm by stating that the loss of a trade secret cannot be measured by monetary damages.

patterns.name: “Twitter mistakes” in political commentary
patterns.context: Comments on campaign or party errors; the phrase “run in the party” describes these mistakes.

patterns.name: Graph-network weight-ranking notation
patterns.context: Introduces a mean weight-ranking notation when discussing vertices, edge weights, and their spatial correlation.

patterns.name: Increase in variant-analysis software projects
patterns.context: Describes more projects emerging after the success of projects such as VarSifter.

6_643.concept: 法律语境中的 in 短语与判决套语
6_643.description: 激活以美国法律文书为主，尤其偏向 in + 名词短语及诉讼判决套语（包括 determined by、in the light most favorable）；另有商业秘密、政治评论、网络科学和生物医学中的零散局部触发。

patterns.name: 法律判决中的“in the …”短语
patterns.context: 法律论证中介词 in 后接冠词或指示词，常引出地点、法院、状态或抽象情境；第 6、9 段还出现“in the light most favorable”这一诉讼表述。

patterns.name: “determined by”及判定语境
patterns.context: 法律文本说明某事实或法律状态由何种标准、因素或法律依据决定；第 1 段还以“Whether”引出待判断问题。

patterns.name: “in the light most favorable”证据审查套语
patterns.context: 法院审查事实与推论时，按对非动议方最有利的方式看待记录；与“facts and inferences”“non-moving”相邻。

patterns.name: 法律判决中的连续功能词与法律术语
patterns.trigger: «facts»4« and»3« reasonable»3« inferences»3；«judgment»1 as« a»2« matter»3« of»2 law；«jurisdiction»5« lie»4
patterns.context: 判决正文中的正式法律论证，功能词连接事实、标准与法律结论；触发并不都对应同一固定短语。

patterns.name: 交易秘密损失的金钱衡量
patterns.trigger: loss of trade secrets cannot be« measured»4« in»10« money»1« damages»3
patterns.context: 论证不可弥补损害时，指出商业秘密损失无法用金钱赔偿衡量。

patterns.name: 政治评论中的 Twitter mistakes
patterns.trigger: Twitter mistakes« run»9« in»9« the»5« party»2
patterns.context: 评论竞选团队或政党失误，句中以“run in the party”描述此类错误。
patterns.domain: 政治评论/社交媒体语境

patterns.name: 图网络权重排名符号
patterns.context: 讨论顶点、边权重及其空间相关性时，介绍平均权重排名符号。

patterns.name: 变异分析软件项目增加
patterns.trigger: programs« has»9« led»1 to« an»1 increasing number of projects
patterns.context: 描述 VarSifter 等项目取得成功后，带来更多项目。

en.description: Activations are concentrated in legal text describing determinations, states, and applicable standards; other contexts include need followed by an attribute description, passage of a bill, mailing-list unsubscribing, meeting rescheduling, and scale ratings.

patterns.name: Modal auxiliary need
patterns.context: Need is followed by an indefinite article and adjective, expressing that something requires more of a certain attribute; this passage says that retaining building components requires more careful demolition.

patterns.name: State or result predicates in legal rulings
patterns.context: In legal argument, a copula or predicate is followed by a legal status, finding, or applicable standard; activation falls on the predicate and adjacent structure.

patterns.name: Argumentative wording in legal citations
patterns.context: Case citations use evaluative wording to say that a legal determination should be treated cautiously; this belongs to the same legal register as the ruling-predicate pattern, but the triggering words are not identical.

patterns.name: Whether a bill passes in a news context
patterns.context: Discussing whether a bill can pass through a political institution; the preceding context includes assault weapons ban, House of Representatives, and related political content.

patterns.name: Mailing-list unsubscribe instructions
patterns.context: An automated email footer instructs users how to unsubscribe from a mailing list and includes an email address and unsubscribe command.

patterns.name: Arrangements in a meeting rescheduling notice
patterns.context: An all-caps announcement says the current budget meeting will be postponed and rescheduled later.

patterns.name: Scale-rating statements
patterns.context: Research methods text explains how survey items are rated on a five-point Likert scale.
patterns.domain: Medical or social science research papers

6_643.description: 激活最集中于法律文本中的判定、状态和适用标准表述；另见 need 后接属性描述、法案通过、邮件列表退订、会议改期及量表评分等彼此不同的语境。

patterns.name: 情态助动词 need
patterns.context: 句中 need 后接不定冠词和形容词，表达某物需要更多某种属性；此段为保留建筑构件时需要更谨慎的拆除。

patterns.name: 法律判决中的状态或结果谓语
patterns.context: 法律论证中，系词或谓语后接法律状态、判断或适用标准；激活落在谓语及相邻结构上。

patterns.name: 法律引文中的论证性表述
patterns.context: 引述判例时使用评价性措辞，说明某项法律判断应谨慎处理；与法律判决谓语模式同属法律文体，但触发词不完全相同。

patterns.name: 新闻语境中的通过与否
patterns.context: 谈论法案能否经由政治机构通过；前文含 assault weapons ban、House of Representatives 等政治语境。

patterns.name: 邮件列表退订说明
patterns.trigger: « this»1« group»2«,»2« send»1« an»2« email»1« to»1；«subscribe»1
patterns.context: 自动邮件页脚指示用户如何退订邮件组，包含邮箱地址和退订命令。

patterns.name: 会议改期通知中的安排
