patterns.context: 大写公告说明当前预算会议将延期，并在之后重新安排。

patterns.name: 量表评分表述
patterns.trigger: « items»3 being« rated»5« on»9« a»8« five»7«-»2«point»3« Lik»1«ert»1« scale»1
patterns.context: 研究方法文本说明调查项目如何按五点 Likert 量表评分。
patterns.domain: 医学或社会科学研究论文

en.description: Activation often occurs in prepositional phrases and relational collocations that introduce a subsequent basis, path, procedure, location, or response; examples occur in legal documents, explanatory text, and paper narratives, but the trigger forms are not uniform.

patterns.name: through the
patterns.context: After a verb or modal expression, activation clusters in phrases denoting a path, procedure, or subsequent need; the trigger words are not completely consistent.

patterns.name: Legal judgments and calculations
patterns.context: In legal text, activation often occurs on a basis, method, or unit following by or in when describing a determination, calculation, or damages valuation.

patterns.name: Location or procedure in legal clauses
patterns.context: Activation occurs when contracts or judicial documents specify an arbitration venue, applicable rules, or procedure.

patterns.name: Collocations expressing outcomes or correspondence
patterns.context: When a noun or state is related to its function, response, or outcome, activation falls on the relational expression and its complement.
patterns.domain: Medical papers, historical narratives, social issues

6_643.description: 激活常落在引出后续依据、路径、程序、地点或回应的介词短语及关系搭配上；法律文书、说明文字和论文叙述中均有例子，但触发形式并不统一。

patterns.name: through the
patterns.trigger: «pass»« through»« the»；«forwarded»« to»« the»；«will»« need»« a»
patterns.context: 在动词或情态表达之后，激活集中在表示路径、程序或后续需求的短语中；触发词并不完全一致。
patterns.domain: 行政说明、新闻、操作指南

patterns.name: 法律判断与计算
patterns.trigger: «determined»« by»« examining»；«measured»« by»« calculating»；«be»« measured»« in»« money»
patterns.context: 法律文本中描述判断依据、计算方法或损害衡量方式时，常在 by 或 in 后的依据、方法、单位处激活。

patterns.name: 法律条款中的地点或程序
patterns.context: 合同或裁判文书中，规定仲裁地点、适用规则或程序时激活。

patterns.name: 搭配式结果或对应关系
patterns.trigger: «Mortality»« serves»« as»；«be»« met»« with»；«be»« met»« with»« resistance»
patterns.context: 名词或状态与其功能、回应或结果建立关系时，激活落在关系表达及其补语上。
patterns.domain: 医学论文、历史叙述、社会议题

en.concept: Continuation of predicates and statements of results
en.description: Activations often occur in continuations of predicate structures, especially be after modal/auxiliary verbs, passive expressions, and following phrases; there are also local patterns involving mortality endpoints, calorie units, and damage assessment, which cannot be unified under a single domain topic.

patterns.name: Be in a following verb phrase
patterns.context: After a modal or a structure such as needs to, be introduces a passive or stative predicate; activation is distributed over be and nearby following words.
patterns.domain: Research data management, law, medical research

patterns.name: Progressive development of a following predicate
patterns.context: After a longer auxiliary, modal, or tense structure, the predicate continues; activation falls on several words in the following phrase rather than only on domain keywords.

patterns.name: Passive calculation process
patterns.context: Legal argument describes how a value is calculated; high activation follows a sequence of passive structures and prepositional phrases.

patterns.name: Mortality outcome measure
patterns.context: A clinical trial introduces treatment and placebo groups, then states the study’s primary endpoint.

patterns.name: Measurement-unit expression
patterns.context: Nutrition guidance discusses energy obtained from food and gives a unit of measurement.

patterns.name: Immediate adverse effect
patterns.context: A legal citation describes the direct consequence of disqualification for a client.

patterns.name: Monetary measurement of damages
patterns.context: A court discusses whether trade secret losses can be measured in monetary damages.

6_643.description: 激活常见于谓语结构的延续部分，尤其是情态/助动词后的 be、被动表达及其后续短语；另有死亡率终点、热量单位和损害衡量等局部模式，不能归并为单一领域主题。

patterns.name: 后续动词短语中的 be
patterns.trigger: «be»（[2] «should be forwarded», [7] «be approached», [10] «needs to be studied»）
patterns.context: 情态词或 needs to 等结构之后，be 引出被动或状态谓语；激活分布在 be 及其邻近后续词上。
patterns.domain: 科研数据管理、法律、医学研究

patterns.name: 后续谓语的渐进展开
patterns.trigger: «will need a more careful»（[1]）；«has received more attention»（[5]）；«must be met with»（[9]）
patterns.context: 较长助动词、情态词或时态结构之后，谓语继续展开；激活落在后续短语中的若干词，而非仅落在领域关键词上。
patterns.domain: 建筑说明、新闻/能源、历史叙述

patterns.name: 被动计算过程
patterns.trigger: «are measured by calculating the amount by»
patterns.context: 法律论证描述量值如何计算，连续的被动结构和介词短语后出现高激活。

patterns.name: 死亡率结局指标
patterns.trigger: «Mortality serves as the primary end point»
patterns.context: 临床试验介绍治疗组和安慰剂组之后，说明研究的主要终点。

patterns.name: 测量单位表达
patterns.context: 营养说明谈到从食物获得的能量，并给出测量单位。

patterns.name: 即时不利影响
patterns.context: 法律引文描述取消资格对当事客户造成的直接后果。

patterns.name: 损害的金钱衡量
patterns.context: 法院讨论商业秘密损失是否能以金钱赔偿衡量。

en.description: Activations are distributed across multiple sentence types and domains: passives following modal/auxiliary verbs, expressions of obligation or results, and prominent through phrases. Other examples include the legal infringement stem viol, legal citations, formulas, patent choices, demolition recommendations, data sharing, and within-word subword fragments; no single stable theme emerges.

patterns.name: Passive or obligation structures after modal/auxiliary verbs
patterns.context: Triggers cluster after auxiliary or modal words, especially in passive structures and expressions of necessity or results; also includes “are done through”.
patterns.domain: Law, patents, technical descriptions, and general explanatory prose

patterns.name: Passage or means after the preposition through
patterns.context: “through” occurs in phrases indicating a route, procedure, or means of implementation; paragraph 3 also includes “unlikely to pass through”.
patterns.domain: Law/data management, political commentary, software documentation

patterns.name: Within-word fragment in violated
patterns.context: Activation falls on the segmented viol stem fragment, involving illegality, rights infringement, or nonviolence; it does not correspond consistently to a complete word boundary.

patterns.name: Legal judgment and proof language
patterns.context: Legal arguments discuss whether harm, procedure, or rights were violated, and whether allegations were confirmed under oath.

patterns.name: Numbers/citation formats in legal documents
patterns.context: Near statutes, case numbers, or case citations; no clear, consistent local trigger relationship with the main activation fragments.

patterns.name: Mathematical notation dense with quantities and symbols
patterns.context: Formulas and variable labels in physics papers; activation appears near these symbols, but no stable pattern involving specific symbols is evident.

patterns.name: Transfer and due-process narratives
patterns.context: Describes individuals being transferred without notice or a hearing, and related rights claims.

patterns.name: Explanation of choices and advantages
patterns.context: A technical patent description explains the advantages of a choice; activation occurs on “has the”.

patterns.name: Response structure in arguments or viewpoints
patterns.context: An abstract noun is the subject, followed by must be met with, expressing a response to oppression.

patterns.name: Pass through in a political context
patterns.context: In political commentary, indicates that a proposal is unlikely to pass through a legislature; differs from the procedural or implementation sense in paragraphs 1 and 10.

patterns.name: Plans and demolition recommendations
patterns.context: Recommends planning before demolition and preserving usable parts; activation appears near these words, but their connection to other paragraphs is unclear.

patterns.name: Occupancy term
patterns.context: Describes site occupancy in a lattice model; appears once, with no clear cross-paragraph commonality.

patterns.name: Within-word fragment ass/ault
patterns.context: Name of a weapons ban in a political context; activation falls on subword fragments, possibly due to word form or segmentation effects.

patterns.name: Data sharing and request language
patterns.context: Data can be provided on request, with an approval process for redistribution; activations are distributed across subsequent wording such as should be forwarded through.

patterns.name: Trade secrets and monetary damages
patterns.context: Discusses how trade secret losses are difficult to measure in monetary damages; in paragraph 2, this co-occurs with auxiliary passive/modal structures.

6_643.description: 激活分散于多类句式与领域：情态/助动词后的被动、义务或结果表达，以及 through 短语较突出；另见法律侵权词干 viol、法律引注、公式、专利选择、拆除建议、数据共享和词内分词片段等，未形成单一稳定主题。

patterns.name: 情态/助动词后接被动或义务结构
patterns.trigger: “should be forwarded to”“cannot be measured”“will need”“must be met with”“are done through”
patterns.context: 触发集中在助动词或情态词之后，尤其是被动结构、必要性或结果表达；也包括“are done through”。
patterns.domain: 法律、专利、技术说明及一般说明文

patterns.name: 介词 through 后的通行或手段
patterns.context: “through”处于表示经过路径、程序或实现手段的短语中；第3段另有“unlikely to pass through”。
patterns.domain: 法律/数据管理、政治评论、软件文档

patterns.name: violated 的词内片段
patterns.context: 激活落在被拆分的 viol 词干片段上，涉及违法、权利侵害或非暴力；不是一致的完整词边界。
patterns.domain: 法律判决、历史宗教叙述

patterns.name: 法律判断与证明措辞
patterns.trigger: “measured in money damages”“violated due process”“violated his equal protection rights”“failure to confirm allegations … by oath or affirmation”
patterns.context: 法律论证中讨论损害、程序或权利是否被违反，以及指控是否经宣誓确认。

patterns.name: 法律文书中的数字/引文格式
patterns.context: 法条、案号或判例引注附近；与主要激活片段并无明确统一的局部触发关系。

patterns.name: 数量与符号密集的数学记号
patterns.context: 物理学论文中的公式及变量标记；这些符号附近出现激活，但未显示稳定的特定符号规律。

patterns.name: 转移与正当程序叙述
patterns.trigger: “transfer … without prior notice or a hearing”“his transfer violated”
patterns.context: 描述个人被转移、缺少通知或听证，以及相关权利主张。

patterns.name: 选择与优势说明
patterns.trigger: “choice of beam B has the advantage”
patterns.context: 技术专利说明中解释某项选择带来的优势；激活出现在“has the”。

patterns.name: 论证或观点中的反应结构
patterns.context: 抽象名词作主语，后接 must be met with，表达对压迫的回应。

patterns.name: 政治语境中的 pass through
patterns.trigger: “unlikely to pass through the Tea Party controlled House”
patterns.context: 在政治评论中表示提案不太可能通过立法机构；与第1、10段的程序或实现义不同。

patterns.name: 计划与拆除建议
patterns.trigger: “Plan out your job”“what you can keep”“more careful demolition”
patterns.context: 建议拆除前规划、保留可用部分；这些词附近有激活，但和其他段的联系不清楚。

patterns.name: 占用量术语
patterns.context: 格点模型中描述站点占用量；仅出现一次，无明确跨段共性。

patterns.name: 词内片段 ass/ault
patterns.context: 政治语境中的武器禁令名称；激活落在分词片段上，可能是词形或分词效应。

patterns.name: 数据共享与请求措辞
patterns.trigger: “available upon request”“Any requests to redistribute these data”
patterns.context: 数据可按请求提供，并规定重新分发的审批流程；激活分布在 should be forwarded through 等后续措辞。
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文/数据管理

patterns.name: 贸易秘密与金钱损害
patterns.trigger: “trade secrets”“cannot be measured in money damages”
patterns.context: 论述商业秘密损失难以用金钱损害衡量；第2段中与助动词被动/情态结构同时出现。

en.concept: Consequences and assessment in legal argument
en.description: Primarily responds to statements about effects, legal consequences, and damages in legal documents; it also responds to holistic or contextual assessment and normative obligations, as well as commercial contract matters, promotional terms, and technical process descriptions.

patterns.name: Statements of legal effects/consequences in judicial opinions
patterns.context: A legal subject, action, or event is followed by has/has … effect, has inhibited, or similar predicates, describing its impact, legal consequence, or damage; sometimes this concerns whether damages can be measured in money.

patterns.name: Legal standards requiring holistic or contextual assessment
patterns.context: Discussing a review, assessment, or decision standard that requires considering the subject in the context of the trial as a whole or of a specific situation.

patterns.name: Instructions, requirements, or obligations in legal documents
patterns.context: Normative statements use must/should to specify procedural steps, conditions, or appropriate handling.
patterns.domain: Law, data-sharing terms, and commercial discussions

patterns.name: Judgments about commercial or contractual matters
patterns.context: Involves contract reasonableness, commercial interests, trade secrets, or promotional booking conditions; a unified legal-effects sentence pattern is not necessarily present.
patterns.domain: Law, travel promotions, and startup discussions

patterns.name: Processing workflows in technical documentation
patterns.context: Explains how a data type is generated or parsed by a particular class, using technical documentation style.

6_643.concept: 法律论证中的后果与评估
6_643.description: 主要响应法律文书中关于影响、法律后果及损害的表述，也响应整体或情境化评估、规范性义务；另见商业合同事项、促销条款和技术流程说明。

patterns.name: 司法意见中的法律效果/后果表述
patterns.trigger: “has an immediate adverse effect”“has the legal effect”“has inhibited”“has established”及“the loss … cannot be measured in money damages”
patterns.context: 法律主体、行为或事件后接 has/has … effect、has inhibited 等谓语，说明其造成的影响、法律后果或损害；有时涉及损害是否可用金钱衡量。

patterns.name: 法律标准须结合整体或情境衡量
patterns.trigger: “viewed as a whole”“evaluated in the context of the whole trial”“viewed in the light of the circumstances”
patterns.context: 讨论审查、评估或判断标准，要求将对象放在整体审判或具体情境中考量。

patterns.name: 法律文书中的指令、要求或义务
patterns.trigger: “must … be viewed”“must … be forwarded”“must be completed”“should be reflected”
patterns.context: 规范性语句中使用 must/should，规定程序步骤、条件或应有处理方式。
patterns.domain: 法律、数据共享条款及商业讨论

patterns.name: 商业或合同事项的判断
patterns.context: 涉及合同合理性、商业权益、商业秘密或促销预订条件；不必然出现统一法律效果句式。
patterns.domain: 法律、旅行促销及创业讨论

patterns.name: 技术文档中的处理流程
patterns.trigger: “generation and parsing”“done through the TypeConverter classes”
patterns.context: 说明数据类型如何由特定类生成或解析，使用技术说明文体。

en.description: Activations cluster around relational or prepositional structures in fixed collocations, especially through and have…effect/impact/consequences expressions indicating passage through a process or an impact; legal bases, assessment criteria, and licensing constraints also appear.

patterns.name: through after a modal verb
patterns.context: pass is preceded by must, and through is followed by the and a noun phrase; both indicate passage through an intermediary or process.

patterns.name: have the same effect
patterns.context: Describes an action producing the same effect as another action.

patterns.name: have a legal effect
patterns.context: The subject of have is the legal act of terminating parental rights, followed by legal effect.

patterns.name: have a／very adverse effect
patterns.context: have is followed by an adjective evaluating the severity of an outcome and a noun for the consequence.

patterns.name: have a positive impact
patterns.context: have is followed by a positive impact and an explanation of its social benefits.
patterns.domain: Health data and healthcare systems research

patterns.name: in the light of
patterns.context: In the passive voice, gives the basis or context for assessing a contract’s reasonableness.

patterns.name: have in a subject and degree phrase
patterns.context: have is followed by an indefinite article and drastic effect, split across a line break; expresses the degree of impact.

patterns.name: according to
patterns.context: Specifies the basis for assessing treatment adherence, followed by three parameters.

patterns.name: subject to clause
patterns.context: subject to is followed by license terms and conditions.

6_643.description: 激活集中于固定搭配中的关系或介词结构，尤以 through、have…effect/impact/consequences 表达经过流程或产生影响为主；另见法律依据、评估依据及许可约束搭配。

patterns.name: 情态动词后的 through
patterns.context: pass 前有 must，through 后接 the 及名词短语；两处均是经过某个中介或流程。
patterns.domain: 数据共享政策、网络技术说明

patterns.name: have the same effect
patterns.context: 描述某行为造成与另一行为相同的效果。

patterns.name: have a legal effect
patterns.context: have 的主语是终止父母权利这一法律行为，后接 legal effect。

patterns.name: have a／very adverse effect
patterns.context: have 后接评价结果严重程度的形容词及后果名词。
patterns.domain: 医学、放射性核素治疗风险

patterns.name: have a positive impact
patterns.context: have 后接正面影响及其社会效益说明。
patterns.domain: 健康数据与医疗系统研究

patterns.name: in the light of
patterns.context: 被动语态下说明判断合同合理性的依据或情境。

patterns.name: 主体与程度短语中的 have
patterns.context: have 后接不定冠词和由换行拆开的 drastic effect；表达影响程度。

patterns.name: according to
patterns.context: 说明治疗依从性的评估依据，后接 three parameters。

patterns.name: subject to 条款
patterns.trigger: «is»4« subject»5« to»9« the»7« terms»1« and»6↵ *« conditions»3
patterns.context: subject to 后接许可条款与条件。

en.description: Patterns are diverse: concentrated on “have an effect” and statements of effects, achievements, and advantages, as well as research evaluation wording and several independent legal formulae; there is also a narrative statement about keeping something unchanged.

patterns.name: have an effect
patterns.context: The modal verb will is followed by have, then a statement of an effect caused by something; effect also activates.

patterns.name: Assessment of effectiveness
patterns.context: Discussing whether an intervention is effective, using has not been demonstrated to express insufficient evidence.

patterns.name: Method description with according to
patterns.context: Explaining the basis or measurement criteria used in a study.

patterns.name: has been achieved
patterns.context: Present perfect passive construction describing an outcome that has been achieved.

patterns.name: viewed in the light of
patterns.context: Legal discussion requiring the reasonableness of a contract to be assessed in a specific context.

patterns.name: has the advantage
patterns.context: Introducing the selection and advantages of a technical solution.

patterns.name: run consecutively
patterns.context: Stating that a sentence is to be served consecutively to another sentence.

patterns.name: pursuant to Rule
patterns.context: Citing a procedural rule as the basis for dismissing a complaint.

patterns.name: Keep unchanged
patterns.context: A story states the purpose of maintaining a certain state; no clear connection to the other patterns.

6_643.description: 模式多样：集中于“have an effect”及效果、成就、优势等结果表述，也包括研究评估措辞和数种独立的法律固定表达；另有维持原状的故事表述。

patterns.name: have an effect
patterns.trigger: “will have the same effect” / “will have a drastic effect”
patterns.context: 情态动词 will 后接 have，随后说明某事造成的 effect；effect 也被标记激活。

patterns.name: effectiveness 的判断
patterns.trigger: “the effectiveness ... has not been convincingly demonstrated”
patterns.context: 讨论干预措施是否有效，以 has not been demonstrated 表达证据不足。

patterns.name: according to 的方法描述
patterns.context: 说明研究中的评估依据或测量标准。

patterns.name: has been achieved
patterns.context: 现在完成时被动结构，描述某种结果已实现。
patterns.domain: 学术论述、公共部门就业

patterns.name: viewed in the light of
patterns.trigger: “is to be viewed in the light of”
patterns.context: 法律论述中要求结合特定情境评判合同合理性。

patterns.name: has the advantage
patterns.trigger: “choice of beam B has the advantage”
patterns.context: 介绍技术方案的选择及其优势。

patterns.name: run consecutively
patterns.context: 说明刑期与另一刑期连续执行。

patterns.name: pursuant to Rule
patterns.context: 引用诉讼规则作为驳回投诉的依据。

patterns.name: 保留不变
patterns.context: 故事中说明维持某种状态的目的；与其他模式缺乏明显联系。

en.description: Primarily responds to expressions of use being constrained by terms, licenses, or conditions, especially “subject to/under the terms”; also includes data workflows, legal citations, use in social contexts, and construction contexts.

patterns.name: Use constrained by terms
patterns.context: Describes use of a product, service, subcomponent, or material as subject to terms, a license, or conditions; strong activations often occur near “to the terms”.
patterns.domain: License notices, terms of service, email footers

patterns.name: Terms and conditions in legal citations
patterns.context: Whether a court judgment or order may be cited is subject to specific terms; triggers cluster around “under the terms and conditions”.

patterns.name: Data forwarding approval process
patterns.context: Requests to redistribute data must be forwarded to the laboratory director and go through a standard process; activation clusters around “through the”.

patterns.name: Meaning of use in a social context
patterns.context: Discusses differences in interpretation when a word or expression is used by different groups; not about license terms.

patterns.name: Careful demolition needed to preserve features
patterns.context: Construction advice explains that preserving some features makes demolition more delicate.

6_643.description: 主要响应使用行为受条款、许可或条件约束的表述，尤其是“subject to/under the terms”；另见数据流程、法律引述、社会语境中的 use，以及施工语境。

patterns.name: 使用受条款约束
patterns.trigger: “use”/“Your use”及“is subject to the terms and conditions”或“subject to license terms”
patterns.context: 描述使用某产品、服务、子组件或材料受到条款、许可或条件限制；强激活常在“to the terms”附近
patterns.domain: 许可声明、服务条款、邮件页脚

patterns.name: 法律引述的条款条件
patterns.trigger: “may be cited under the terms and conditions”
patterns.context: 法院判决或命令可否引用受特定条款限制；触发词集中在“under the terms and conditions”

patterns.name: 数据转发审批流程
patterns.trigger: “must pass through the standard BCCfE data sharing”
patterns.context: 数据再分发请求须转交实验室负责人并经过标准流程；激活集中于“through the”
patterns.domain: 学术论文的数据可用性声明

patterns.name: use 在社会语境中的含义
patterns.trigger: “use by President Obama … could not be interpreted in the same way”
patterns.context: 讨论某词语或表达由不同群体使用时的解释差异，不涉及许可条款
patterns.domain: 百科全书式社会议题报道

patterns.name: 保留特征所需的谨慎拆除
patterns.trigger: “features will need a more careful demolition”
patterns.context: 施工建议中说明保留部分特征会使拆除更需谨慎

en.concept: Legal conditions and statements of results
en.description: Activations are distributed across clause constraints, claims, and procedural words in legal text, as well as consequence statements of the form “X has/will have …” across multiple domains; there are also through the, commercial management, and discussion of infection rates, making it difficult to reduce these to a single triggering feature.

patterns.name: Phrase through the
patterns.context: The verb pass is followed by through, then the and a noun phrase; activation falls mainly on through.

patterns.name: Compliance with a rule or condition
patterns.context: In legal, licensing, or order contexts, describing use, citation, or reconsideration as governed by terms or conditions; terms, conditions, and adjacent function words may activate.
patterns.domain: Software licenses, court rulings, and litigation documents

patterns.name: Assessment of results or consequences
patterns.context: This or a preceding event is followed by has/will have and then a statement of impact, result, or development.

patterns.name: Statements of legal claims or remedies
patterns.context: Involves debts, claims, or court remedies; activation is scattered across related words and nearby structures.
patterns.domain: Bankruptcy litigation and other legal documents

patterns.name: Management of change or action
patterns.context: Describing the movement and management of resources, talent, or diversity in organizational or cross-border settings.
patterns.domain: International resources, business, and organizational management articles

patterns.name: Description of quantities and declining infections
patterns.context: Discussing an epidemiological hypothesis that infection rates decline after reaching a certain proportion.

patterns.name: Sporadic legal terms and paragraph recurrence
patterns.context: Procedural, adjudicative, or legal terms in legal documents; if not grouped with rule constraints or statements of results, these appear only as sporadic activations.

6_643.description: 激活分散于法律文本的条款约束、主张与程序词，以及多领域中“X has/will have …”式后果表达；另见 through the、商业管理和疫情比例讨论，难以归结为单一触发特征。

patterns.name: 短语 through the
patterns.context: 动词 pass 后接 through，再接 the 和名词短语；激活主要落在 through。
patterns.domain: 数据共享说明 / 学术材料

patterns.name: 对某项规则或条件的服从
patterns.trigger: “subject to the terms and conditions”；另有“subject to the terms”“under the terms and conditions”
patterns.context: 法律、许可或命令语境中，描述使用、引用或重新审议受条款、条件约束；terms、conditions 及相邻功能词均可能激活。
patterns.domain: 软件许可证、法院判决与诉讼文书

patterns.name: 结果或后果的判断
patterns.trigger: “will have the same effect”；“this has inhibited”；“has become imperative”；“This has played out”
patterns.context: this 或前述事件后接 has/will have，再陈述影响、结果或发展。
patterns.domain: 法律、新闻评论、商业文章

patterns.name: 法律主张或救济的表述
patterns.trigger: “claim”“claims”“claim will have”“relief as to the Court”
patterns.context: 涉及债权、诉讼请求或法院救济；激活散落在相关词及其附近结构中。
patterns.domain: 破产诉讼及其他法律文书

patterns.name: 变化或行动的管理
patterns.trigger: “shipping them to foreign markets”；“bringing in and managing diversity”
patterns.context: 描述资源、人才或多样性在组织或跨境环境中的流动与管理。
patterns.domain: 国际资源、商业与组织管理文章

patterns.name: 数量与感染下降的描述
patterns.context: 讨论达到某比例后感染率下降的流行病学假说。

patterns.name: 零散法律词项与段落复现
patterns.context: 法律文书中的程序、裁判或法律术语；若不归入规则约束或结果表达，则仅表现为零散激活。

en.description: Primarily responds to relational and obligation expressions in legal and service terms, especially structures such as “subject to” and “governed by the”; also covers legal procedural language and a few statements about data requests, unsubscribing, and Cookie consent.

patterns.name: “subject to” legal/terms wording
patterns.context: Describes use, products, services, or fees as subject to terms, conditions, or changes; strong activations often fall on “to”, preceded by “subject”.
patterns.domain: Software licenses, website terms of service, fee descriptions

patterns.name: Fixed predicates in legal rulings
patterns.context: Legal arguments state that a rule, jurisdiction, or legal issue is governed by a principle; activations are strong near “governed” and the following “by the”.

patterns.name: Prepositional phrase “in the …” in legal text
patterns.context: Introduces a basis or background in legal discussion; activation clusters on “in”, “the”, and the following phrase.

patterns.name: “shall be” obligation structure in litigation procedures
patterns.context: Rules or regulations prescribe how a court should handle an application; “shall” is followed by “be”, then a prescriptive adverb or participle.

patterns.name: Data request and forwarding process
patterns.context: Specifies the recipient and approval/routing steps for data redistribution requests.

patterns.name: Email subscription unsubscribe instructions
patterns.context: A mailing list notice gives an infinitive instruction on how to unsubscribe and provides an address.

patterns.name: Website advertising and Cookie consent
patterns.context: Informs users that continuing to use a service indicates consent to Cookie use.

patterns.name: Legal excerpts without a stable pattern
patterns.context: May relate to legal register and common function words, but has no clear fixed trigger structure shared with other samples.

6_643.description: 主要响应法律及服务条款中的关系/义务表达，尤以“subject to”“governed by the”等结构为强；也覆盖法律程序措辞，以及少数数据请求、退订和Cookie同意说明。

patterns.name: “subject to”法律/条款措辞
patterns.trigger: “subject»… to»…”；“Your use … is subject to the terms…”（1、4、6）
patterns.context: 描述使用、产品、服务或费用受条款、条件或变更约束；重点激活常落在“to”，前接“subject”。
patterns.domain: 软件许可、网站服务条款、费用说明

patterns.name: 法律判决中的固定谓语
patterns.trigger: “governed by the same principles”（2）；“jurisdiction is governed by”（10）
patterns.context: 法律论证中说明规则、管辖权或法律问题受某原则支配；“governed”及其后的“by the”附近激活强。

patterns.name: 法律文本中的介词短语“in the …”
patterns.trigger: “viewed in the light of the circumstances”（8）；“governed by the …”之外的 “in the light”
patterns.context: 法律论述中引出评估依据或背景；激活集中于“in”“the”及其后续短语。

patterns.name: 诉讼程序中“shall be”义务结构
patterns.context: 规则或法规规定法院应如何处理申请；“shall”后接“be”，再接规定性副词或分词。
patterns.domain: 诉讼规则、法律条文引文

patterns.name: 数据请求与转交流程
patterns.trigger: “requests … should be forwarded to … and must pass through”
patterns.context: 规定数据再分发请求的提交对象及审批/流转步骤。

patterns.name: 订阅邮件退订指引
patterns.context: 邮件列表通知以不定式指令说明如何退订，并给出地址。

patterns.name: 网站广告与 Cookie 同意
patterns.trigger: “By continuing to use our service, you agree to our use of cookies”
patterns.context: 告知用户继续使用服务即表示同意 Cookie 使用。

patterns.name: 无法归入稳定模式的法律句段
patterns.trigger: “reasonableness of the contract”；“deadlines … amendments to pleadings”
patterns.context: 与法律语域及常见功能词可能有关，但没有与其他样本相同的明确固定触发结构。

en.concept: Relationships among norms, clauses, and rules
en.description: Activations often occur in statements of formal rules or clause relationships, especially governed by, subject to, according to, and use/agreement in legal and website text; there are also sporadic responses to request workflows and the research phrase “remains unclear.”

patterns.name: Jurisdictional phrasing in legal text
patterns.context: Legal discussion states that a type of jurisdiction is governed by a particular rule, often followed by the rule’s name

patterns.name: subject to clause
patterns.context: Stating that use, licensing, or service is subject to terms, conditions, or a policy referenced by a URL
patterns.domain: Email disclaimers, software licenses, website privacy/terms of service

patterns.name: Requests requiring referral or review
patterns.context: A data redistribution request must be referred to the responsible person and go through the prescribed process

patterns.name: Contextual/reasonableness assessment in law
patterns.context: Evaluating the reasonableness of a contract based on the circumstances

patterns.name: Making determinations according to law or principles
patterns.context: Stating that a legal classification or decision is made under a particular law

patterns.name: Court discretion and appeal rules
patterns.context: Discussing remedies a court may grant and whether an order can be appealed

patterns.name: Consent clause for cookie use
patterns.context: A website informs users that continuing to use the service signifies acceptance of cookie use

patterns.name: Use subject to an agreement
patterns.context: An agreement states in an all-caps heading or body text that its terms govern user access

patterns.name: Research question remains unresolved
patterns.context: Describing how a local immune response occurs as still unclear

6_643.description: 激活常见于正式规则或条款关系表述，尤其是 governed by、subject to、according to、use/agreement 等法律及网站文本；另对请求流程和科研中“仍未明”句式有零星响应。

patterns.name: 法律管辖权句式
patterns.trigger: « federal»-question« jurisdiction»« is»« governed»« by»« the»
patterns.context: 法律论述中说明某种管辖权受某规则支配，常接规则名称

patterns.name: subject to 条款
patterns.trigger: « is»« subject»« to»« the»；« is»« subject»« to»« http»
patterns.context: 说明使用、许可或服务受到条款、条件或网址所指政策约束
patterns.domain: 邮件免责声明、软件许可证、网站隐私/服务条款

patterns.name: 请求须经转交或审查
patterns.trigger: « requests» to« redistribute»…« must»« pass»« through»
patterns.context: 数据再分发申请需转交负责人并经过规定流程

patterns.name: 法律中的情境／合理性判断
patterns.trigger: « reasonableness»…« is»« to»« be»« viewed»« in»« the»…« light»
patterns.context: 以既有情形为依据评价合同合理性

patterns.name: 依照法律或原则作判断
patterns.context: 陈述某种法律分类或决定依特定法律作出

patterns.name: 法院裁量与上诉规则
patterns.trigger: « seems»« meet»…« justice»« may»« require»；« governed»« by»« the»…« principles»
patterns.context: 讨论法院可给予的救济及命令是否可上诉

patterns.name: 使用 cookies 的同意条款
patterns.trigger: « use»…« service»…« agree» to« our»« use»…« cookies»
patterns.context: 网站告知继续使用服务即表示接受 cookies 的使用

patterns.name: 使用受协议约束
patterns.context: 协议以全大写标题或正文声明其条款约束用户使用

patterns.name: 研究问题仍未解决
patterns.context: 描述局部免疫反应如何发生仍不明朗

en.concept: Use or Review Constrained by Rules
en.description: Activations are concentrated mainly on expressions in legal texts about being governed/constrained, review, and reconsideration; they also appear in use restrictions under license terms. There are sporadic responses to webpage advertising and Cookie notices and public-health prevention intervention texts.

patterns.name: License terms and constrained use
patterns.context: Describes the use of a product, service, or website as subject to an agreement, terms, or conditions; common in license notices and website legal text.
patterns.domain: Open-source licenses, website terms, mailing list notices

patterns.name: Court decisions governed by legal rules
patterns.context: Legal discussion states that jurisdiction, appealability, or review method is determined by a principle or standard.

patterns.name: Legal wording for review and reconsideration
patterns.context: Discusses review, rulings, or requests for reconsideration in administrative or judicial proceedings; governed by need not appear.

patterns.name: Web advertising, targeting, and Cookie
patterns.context: A webpage tells visitors how to opt out of targeted advertising, or describes ad sources or Cookie purposes.

patterns.name: Pregnancy and STI prevention intervention research
patterns.context: Introduces project goals, educational interventions, and their evaluation.

patterns.name: Unclear collocation in legal text
patterns.context: The paragraph concerns a court permitting a request for reconsideration subject to conditions; it shares vocabulary with other legal paragraphs, but the trigger combination is unclear.

6_643.concept: 规范与规则约束下的使用或审查
6_643.description: 激活主要集中于法律文本中“受……支配/约束”、审查与重新考虑等表达，也见于许可条款中的使用限制；另对网页广告与 Cookie、公共卫生预防干预文本有零星响应。

patterns.name: 许可条款与使用受约束
patterns.trigger: «use»…«is»…«subject»…«to»；如 «Your use of… is subject to the terms and conditions»
patterns.context: 描述产品、服务或网站的使用须遵守协议、条款或条件；常见于许可声明和网站法律文本。
patterns.domain: 开源许可、网站条款、邮件列表说明

patterns.name: 法院裁判受法律规则支配
patterns.context: 法律论述中说明管辖权、可上诉性或审查方式依据某项原则或标准决定。

patterns.name: 审查与重新考虑的法律用语
patterns.context: 行政或司法程序中讨论复审、裁定或要求重新考虑；不一定出现 governed by。

patterns.name: 网页广告、定向与 Cookie
patterns.context: 网页向访问者说明退出定向广告、广告来源或 Cookie 的用途。

patterns.name: 孕期与性病预防干预研究
patterns.context: 介绍项目目标、教学干预及其评估。

patterns.name: 不明法律文本搭配
patterns.context: 段落谈法院允许寻求重新审议及附带条件；与其他法律段落有词汇重叠，但触发组合不明确。

en.description: Activations are distributed across several fixed-purpose phrases: governed by and extent dependent upon in legal texts, explaining consequences of use or constraints imposed by terms, as well as configuration defaults, academic definitions, and outcome evaluation. Cross-passage commonality is weak.

patterns.name: Rules or principles introduced by the preposition by
patterns.context: Explains in a legal context that a matter is governed by a principle, rule, or legal standard; activations concentrate on by and the following phrase, especially in “governed by the same principles” and “governed by the well-pleaded complaint rule”.

patterns.name: Resource consumption or wear caused by use
patterns.context: use denotes an act of use, followed by its consumption, impact, or affected object; it may also simply describe using a service or cookies. The exact trigger range is not fully consistent.
patterns.domain: Consumer information, patent background, website privacy notices

patterns.name: Configuration notes using have a default
patterns.context: Technical documentation states that a configuration option has a default value, with configuration files, comments, or directory descriptions nearby.

patterns.name: Constraints imposed by terms of use or policies
patterns.context: Terms explain that a user's use of a service, platform, or product is governed by an agreement, policy, or webpage terms.
patterns.domain: Mailing-list notices and terms of service

patterns.name: Defining research terms or operational definitions
patterns.context: Academic text states that a term is defined according to guidelines or gives the operational definition of an intervention; here, this concerns CMV prevention and prophylaxis.

patterns.name: Evaluating results according to standards or conditions
patterns.context: When describing results columns, groups, or classifications, explains that evaluation considers an alignment or condition; includes pass/fail results.

patterns.name: Extent depends on multiple factors
patterns.context: Discusses how an extent or degree is determined by multiple factors; here, the degree of deference courts give to an agency's interpretation.

6_643.description: 激活分散于若干固定功能短语：法律文本中的 governed by、extent dependent upon；说明使用后果或条款约束；以及配置默认值、学术定义和结果评估。跨段共性较弱。

patterns.name: 介词 by 引出的规则或原则
patterns.context: 法律语境中说明某事项由某原则、规则或法律标准支配；激活集中在 by 及其后续短语，尤见于“governed by the same principles”“governed by the well-pleaded complaint rule”。

patterns.name: 因使用导致资源消耗或磨损
patterns.trigger: «use»…« results»…« wear»« and»« tear»；«uses»…« up»…« storage»；«use»…«cookies»
patterns.context: use 表示使用行为，后文涉及其造成的消耗、影响或对象；也可能仅是描述使用服务或 cookies。具体触发范围并不完全一致。
patterns.domain: 消费说明、专利背景、网站隐私说明

patterns.name: have a default 的配置说明
patterns.context: 技术文档说明配置项具有默认值，且附近有配置文件、注释或目录说明。

patterns.name: 使用条款或政策约束
patterns.context: 条款文本中说明用户对某服务、平台或产品的使用受协议、政策或网页条款约束。
patterns.domain: 邮件列表通知与服务条款

patterns.name: 定义研究术语或操作定义
patterns.context: 学术文本交代术语按指南定义，或说明某处理措施的操作性定义；此处涉及 CMV 预防和 prophylaxis。

patterns.name: 结果按标准或条件评估
patterns.context: 描述结果列、分组或判定时，说明评估考虑了某种对齐或条件；包含 pass/fail 结果。

patterns.name: 程度取决于多个因素
patterns.context: 论述某种程度或范围由多个因素决定；此处是法院对行政机构解释的尊重程度。

en.description: Activations cluster around “subject to” meaning constrained by, and use/USE in contexts of use; weaker responses also occur for configuration defaults, passage through a process, storage consumption, reconsideration conditions, and insurance penalties. Patterns span legal, policy, technical, and website text.

patterns.name: Subject to terms or rules
patterns.context: Describes an object as subject to rules, conditions, review, or penalties; often appears mid-sentence, followed by the specific constraint.

patterns.name: Use or conduct
patterns.context: Discusses use, rights of use, or effects of use; may also occur in tables or all-caps terms.
patterns.domain: Email terms, legal documents, website policies, tables/agreements

patterns.name: Configuration item ownership or default value
patterns.context: A configuration file describes a configuration value’s default setting, near words such as “configuration” and “values”.

patterns.name: Through a process or channel
patterns.context: States that requests must be routed or handled through a standard process.

patterns.name: Space consumption
patterns.context: States that keeping downloaded content consumes device storage space.

patterns.name: Adjournment and reconsideration conditions
patterns.context: A court order postpones final judgment and sets conditions for reconsideration.

patterns.name: Insurance payment penalty
patterns.context: When the insured value falls below a replacement-value percentage threshold, payment is subject to a penalty for underinsurance.

patterns.name: Purpose of advertising Cookie
patterns.context: A website explains that advertising uses Cookie to serve relevant ads.

patterns.name: Whether wording is correct
patterns.context: Asks whether a particular expression is used correctly.

patterns.name: Subscription emails and service terms
patterns.context: After unsubscribe instructions for a group, states that use is subject to the terms of service.

6_643.description: 激活集中于“subject to”表示受约束，以及 use/USE 表示使用的语境；另对配置默认值、经由流程、存储消耗、再审条件和保险惩罚等词句有较弱响应。模式横跨法律、政策、技术与网站文本。

patterns.name: 受条款或规则约束
patterns.context: 描述某对象受规则、条件、审查或处罚约束；多出现在句子中部，后接具体约束内容
patterns.domain: 法律、隐私政策、保险说明

patterns.name: 使用或行为
patterns.context: 谈论某种使用行为、使用权或使用影响；也可出现在表格或全大写条款中
patterns.domain: 邮件条款、法律文书、网站政策、表格/协议

patterns.name: 配置项的拥有或默认值
patterns.context: 配置文件说明配置值的默认设置，附近出现“configuration”“values”等词

patterns.name: 透过流程或渠道
patterns.context: 说明请求须经由标准流程传递或处理
patterns.domain: 生物医学数据共享政策

patterns.name: 空间占用
patterns.context: 说明保留下载内容会消耗设备存储空间

patterns.name: 延期与再审条件
patterns.context: 法院命令延期作出终局判决，并附带再审条件

patterns.name: 保险赔付惩罚
patterns.context: 保险价值低于替换价值比例门槛时，赔付适用少报惩罚

patterns.name: 广告 Cookie 的用途
patterns.context: 网站说明广告使用 Cookie 来提供相关广告

patterns.name: 用语是否正确
patterns.context: 询问某表达方式的用法是否正确

patterns.name: 订阅邮件与服务条款
patterns.context: 群组退订说明之后，提示使用须遵守服务条款

en.description: Primarily responds to use/uses/using, especially when describing the use or applicability of actions, terms, configurations, or standards; also shows sporadic responses to legal ruling language, technical rule descriptions, and “Bearing this in mind”. Some activations fall on adjacent function words or formatting fragments.

patterns.name: Use/applicability and its object
patterns.context: Explains in a sentence how an action, configuration, term, or standard is used, applies, or produces an outcome; activations often fall on use and nearby words.
patterns.domain: Patents, software documentation, webpage descriptions, legal texts

patterns.name: Legal judgments and ruling language
patterns.context: Statements in judicial opinions about legal principles, remedies, or appellate standards of review; the peak of [2] falls directly on by, which should be retained as a local pattern possibly distinct from the general use pattern.

patterns.name: Technical results, alignment, or configuration
patterns.context: Describes how email authentication results account for alignment or how a configuration value sets a default; there is no explicit use, but rules, values, or processing methods are described.

patterns.name: Indicative discourse phrase
patterns.context: Uses this in mind at the beginning or within a sentence to introduce subsequent considerations; activations fall mainly on mind, with no obvious lexical trigger shared with other passages.

patterns.name: Unclearly explained phrase combinations
patterns.context: These locations show sporadic activations, but the fragments alone do not establish a stable relationship to the main use, legal, or technical patterns.

6_643.description: 主要响应 use/uses/using，尤其在说明行为、条款、配置或标准的使用与适用时；另对法律裁判措辞、技术规则说明及“Bearing this in mind”有零散响应，部分激活落在邻近功能词或格式片段上。

patterns.name: 使用/适用及其对象
patterns.trigger: use / uses / using（[1] uses， [4] Use， [5] use， [6] USE， [7] use， [10] using）
patterns.context: 在句子中说明某行为、配置、条款或标准如何使用、适用或产生结果；激活常落在 use 及邻近词上。
patterns.domain: 专利、软件文档、网页说明、法律文本

patterns.name: 法律判断与裁判措辞
patterns.trigger: governed by（[2]）；meet and justice（[2]）；standard of review（[10]）
patterns.context: 司法意见中关于法律原则、救济或上诉审查标准的表述；[2] 的峰值直接落在 by，需保留为与一般 use 模式可能不同的局部模式。

patterns.name: 技术结果、对齐或配置
patterns.trigger: alignment into account（[8]）；configuration values have a default（[9]）
patterns.context: 描述邮件认证结果如何考虑对齐，或配置值如何设置默认值；没有显式 use，但出现有关规则、取值或处理方式的说明。

patterns.name: 指示性话语短语
patterns.context: 句首或句中以 this in mind 引出后续考虑；主要激活落在 mind，和其他段的词面触发不明显相同。

patterns.name: 未能明确解释的词组搭配
patterns.trigger: and the（[1]）；and（[2]）；and tear（[5]）；Username / Password 后的换行符（[6]）
patterns.context: 这些位置有零散激活，但无法仅凭片段确定它们与主要 use、法律或技术模式的稳定关系。

en.description: Activations span diverse genres and often fall on function words or common collocations such as to, use, have, role, and subject; expressions of use are prominent, but semantic and syntactic conditions are inconsistent, so no more specific theme can be established.

patterns.name: High-frequency function-word combinations
patterns.context: Sentences contain phrases formed from common function words and verbs/nouns. Activation locations vary, often falling on to, use, have, role, or subject; no stable syntactic or semantic requirement is apparent.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain academic writing, webpages, code comments, license text, legal documents, and general expository prose

patterns.name: Expressions related to purpose or use
patterns.context: When describing resource consumption, use of technology/services, or the purpose of something, use and nearby collocations can activate; however, the same word appears with different meanings.
patterns.domain: Patents, medical research, health services, advertising, technical discussion, license text

patterns.name: Phrases involving to
patterns.context: to can occur in infinitives, prepositional phrases, or fixed collocations, with varying spans and following words; these cannot be reduced to a single meaning.
patterns.domain: Academic papers, advertising descriptions, general explanations, and legal texts

patterns.name: Specific local words and collocations
patterns.context: Passages show sporadic local collocations, with insufficient evidence that they share a specialized theme; some overlap with common function-word patterns.
patterns.domain: Patents, research abstracts, validation descriptions, configuration code, license and legal documents

6_643.description: 激活跨多种文体分布，常落在 to、use、have、role、subject 等功能词或常见搭配上；用途表达较突出，但语义和句法条件不一致，无法确定更专一的主题。

patterns.name: 高频功能词组合
patterns.context: 句子中出现常见功能词与动词/名词构成的短语，激活位置不固定，常落在 to、use、have、role、subject 等词上；看不出稳定的句法或语义要求
patterns.domain: 跨领域的学术、网页、代码注释、许可文本、法律文书及一般说明文

patterns.name: 用途或使用相关表达
patterns.context: 描述资源消耗、技术/服务使用或某物用途时，use 及其邻近搭配可激活；但同一词也出现在不同语义中
patterns.domain: 专利、医学研究、健康服务、广告、技术讨论、许可文本

patterns.name: 涉及 to 的短语
patterns.context: to 可处于不定式、介词短语或固定搭配中，跨度和后续词各异；不能归结为单一语义
patterns.domain: 学术论文、广告说明、一般说明及法律文本

patterns.name: 特定局部词项与搭配
patterns.context: 各段呈现零散局部搭配，没有足够证据表明它们共享专门主题；其中若干与常见功能词模式重叠
patterns.domain: 专利、研究摘要、验证说明、配置代码、许可和法律文书

en.concept: Local Word Forms and Syntactic Fragments
en.description: The strongest signals are distributed: by and review standards in legal sentences, use/uses in different contexts, and technical terminology, academic passive structures, data workflows, and patent wording; no single stable semantic pattern emerges.

patterns.name: by in legal documents
patterns.context: In legal arguments, the preposition by introduces a basis or standard, often near wording about court remedies or appeals; the strongest trigger is by.

patterns.name: Use and its consequences
patterns.context: use/uses indicates using an object or function and is followed by its scope, result, or cost; [2] is the all-caps USE in a legal agreement section heading.
patterns.domain: Website terms, household instructions, patent background

patterns.name: for in a review standard
patterns.context: Fixed phrase “reviewed for an abuse of discretion” describing a court’s review of a discretionary decision.

patterns.name: Subword fragments in technical terms and compounds
patterns.context: Technical text concerns email authentication results, disconnected storage, or code event constants; activation falls on term fragments rather than a unified meaning.

patterns.name: has been in academic argumentation
patterns.context: A completed passive construction expresses that a view has been challenged while discussing model fitting and conclusions.

patterns.name: Data request and workflow obligations
patterns.context: States that data redistribution requests should be forwarded and go through a specified review process.

patterns.name: Ink diffusion and its effects
patterns.context: Describes how the degree of ink diffusion on recording material affects density and resolution.

6_643.description: 最强信号分散：法律句中的 by 与审查标准、不同语境下的 use/uses，以及技术术语、学术被动结构、数据流程和专利表述；没有单一稳定语义模式。

patterns.name: 法律文书中的 by
patterns.context: 法律论述句中，介词 by 引出依据或标准，周围常有法院救济、上诉等措辞；最强触发是 by

patterns.name: 使用及其后果
patterns.context: use/uses 表示使用某物或功能，并紧接其范围、结果或代价；[2] 是法律协议条款标题中的全大写 USE
patterns.domain: 网页条款、家居说明、专利背景

patterns.name: 审查标准中的 for
patterns.context: 法院审查裁量决定时，固定短语“reviewed for an abuse of discretion”

patterns.name: 技术术语与复合词的分词片段
patterns.context: 技术文本中涉及邮件认证结果、断连存储，或代码事件常量；激活落在术语片段而非统一词义上

patterns.name: 学术论证中的 has been
patterns.context: 讨论模型拟合与结论时，使用完成时被动结构表达某观点受到质疑

patterns.name: 数据请求与流程义务
patterns.trigger: « should»7« be»5« forwarded»6« to»8« the»5；« must»5« pass»5« through»8
patterns.context: 说明数据再分发请求应转交并经过指定审核流程
patterns.domain: 生物医学数据共享声明

patterns.name: 墨水扩散及其影响
patterns.trigger: « degree»4 of the ink« spread»2« has»6« an»8« influence»6
patterns.context: 描述记录材料上墨水扩散程度对密度、分辨率的影响

en.description: The dominant signal is use/uses/usage and actions or consequences of use; additional local patterns include the report label ORIGINAL, legal remedy language, data-transfer procedures, and terms headings.

patterns.name: Emphasis on use
patterns.context: Activations concentrate on use/uses/usage, especially in sentences describing the use, purpose, act, or consequences of using something; capitalization and word forms vary slightly.
patterns.domain: Legal texts, technical descriptions, privacy notices, everyday explanations, health research, and form terms

patterns.name: ORIGINAL in Enron report labels
patterns.context: Appears in all-caps, column-formatted operational status emails, where the label indicates viewing the original report; nearby text concerns data centers, facility operations, or server information.

patterns.name: Data request procedure language
patterns.context: Explains that data redistribution requests must be forwarded to the lab head and go through a standard process; activations fall on words about forwarding, requirements, and procedure.

patterns.name: Legal rulings and remedies
patterns.context: Concerns further remedies a court may grant, as well as the appealability of an order limiting legal action and the applicable principles.

patterns.name: Terms heading and effective language
patterns.context: After login-page fields, the Terms & Conditions heading appears alongside sentences in a legal agreement regulating user activity; activations span multiple words in the heading and body.
patterns.domain: Web forms and terms of service

patterns.name: Wear collocation
patterns.context: Explains that frequent garage use causes wear; activations include use and the statement of its consequences.

6_643.description: 主导信号是 use/uses/usage 及使用行为或后果；另有报告标签 ORIGINAL、法律救济措辞、数据转交流程和条款标题等局部模式。

patterns.name: use 的强调
patterns.context: 激活集中在 use/uses/usage，尤其是说明某物的使用、用途、使用行为或后果的句子中；大小写和词形略有变化。
patterns.domain: 法律、技术说明、隐私声明、日常说明、健康研究及表单条款

patterns.name: Enron 报告标签中的 ORIGINAL
patterns.context: 出现在全大写、分栏式运行状态邮件中，标签提示查看原始报告；邻近有数据中心、设施运营或服务器信息。

patterns.name: 数据请求流程用语
patterns.trigger: « should»7« be»5« forwarded»7 … « must»6 … « pass»6« through»9
patterns.context: 说明数据再分发请求须转交实验室负责人并经过标准流程；激活落在转交、必须、流程等词上。
patterns.domain: 生物医学数据共享声明

patterns.name: 法律裁定与救济表述
patterns.context: 涉及法院可能给予的进一步救济，以及法律行动受限命令的可上诉性和适用原则。

patterns.name: 表单条款标题与生效措辞
patterns.context: 网页登录字段后出现 Terms & Conditions 标题及法律协议规范用户使用的句子；激活覆盖标题和正文多个词。

patterns.name: 磨损搭配
patterns.context: 说明频繁使用车库进出会造成磨损；激活包括 use 及其后果表述。

en.description: Activations are scattered across to in legal texts, terms language in web agreements, use/land use, encyclopedia entry structure, and code comparison expressions; another legal sentence shows activations on multiple words, with no clear pattern unifying all phenomena.

patterns.name: to in legal phrases
patterns.context: In legal texts, to often occurs in infinitives, scope-of-application phrases, or standards of review, as in “use to any circumstances”, “applicability of … to other circumstances”, and “subject to … review”; «to» activates repeatedly across several passages.
patterns.domain: Legal opinions, statutes, and legal argument

patterns.name: use and compounds
patterns.context: Responses to forms or phrases of use refer respectively to software resource use, consequences of garage use, and land use; meanings and genres differ.
patterns.domain: Patent background, webpage descriptions, encyclopedia entries

patterns.name: Terms language in web agreements
patterns.context: The terms-of-service heading and body of a legal agreement on a login page; activations span all-caps text split into subword fragments, with “USE” especially strong.
patterns.domain: Web forms and terms of service

patterns.name: Code comparison operators and values
patterns.context: A condition in Go code checks whether a function's return value equals 0; activations concentrate around the comparison expression.

patterns.name: Document structure and heading markers
patterns.context: Entry structure in an encyclopedia page, including references, external links, and categories; it occurs in the same passage as land use, but it is unclear whether they share a trigger.

patterns.name: Unexplained sporadic legal words
patterns.context: Multiple common words activate in the same legal sentence, including the phrase “governed by the same principles”; a shared mechanism with other legal passages is difficult to infer from one passage.

6_643.description: 激活分散于法律文本中的 to、网页协议中的条款词、use/土地利用、百科条目结构及代码比较表达式；另有一段法律句中多种词项激活，缺少能统一解释所有现象的明确模式。

patterns.name: 法律短语中的 to
patterns.context: 法律文本中，to 常出现在不定式、适用范围或审查标准等结构里，如“use to any circumstances”“applicability of … to other circumstances”“subject to … review”；其中 «to» 在多段中重复激活。
patterns.domain: 法律判决、法规与法律论述

patterns.name: use 及其复合词
patterns.context: 对 use 的词形或词组的响应，分别指软件资源使用、车库使用的后果、土地利用；语义和文体不同。
patterns.domain: 专利背景、网页说明、百科条目

patterns.name: 网页协议中的条款文字
patterns.context: 登录页面的服务条款标题及法律协议正文，激活跨越被拆分成子词的全大写文字；“USE”尤强。

patterns.name: 代码比较运算符与数值
patterns.context: Go 代码中比较函数返回值是否等于 0 的条件表达式；激活集中在比较表达式附近。

patterns.name: 文档结构与标题标记
patterns.trigger: «↵»及章节/链接标题附近的标记，如«IN»«SEE»、«External»« links»
patterns.context: 百科页面的参考资料、外部链接与分类等条目结构；与土地 use 同段出现，但不能确定是否为同一触发因素。

patterns.name: 未解释的零散法律词项
patterns.context: 同一法律句中多种常见词激活，包含短语“governed by the same principles”；难以从单段判断它们与其他法律段落的共通机制。

en.description: Activations often occur in “has” phrases introducing effects or constraints, statements of results involving negation or contrast, and consequences of technical or everyday use; legal remedies, research informed consent, and encyclopedia directory formatting also appear, spanning multiple genres.

patterns.name: “has” after an abstract noun
patterns.context: “has” introduces an effect, impact, or constraint that has occurred, followed by the result or affected object.
patterns.domain: Legal texts, politics, forum discussions, patent technology

patterns.name: Negative auxiliary and contrastive result
patterns.context: A negative or contrastive construction states that an expectation, action, or condition does not lead to a particular outcome.
patterns.domain: Forum discussions, medical research, hardware discussions

patterns.name: Wear or resource consumption caused by use
patterns.context: Describes wear and tear caused by everyday use.

patterns.name: Storage consumption and retention after disconnection
patterns.context: In a technical system, data remains stored after disconnection and consequently consumes resources.

patterns.name: Directory entries and category labels
patterns.context: Sections, links, and category lists in encyclopedia entries.

patterns.name: Remedies and jurisdiction in fixed legal language
patterns.context: Phrasing about a court's discretion to grant remedies and the application of legal rules.

patterns.name: Consent to participate and consequences of refusal
patterns.context: Research participants are invited, give consent, and are told that refusal carries no penalty.

6_643.description: 激活常见于“has”引出影响或约束、否定/转折说明结果，以及技术和日常使用造成的后果；另见法律救济、研究知情同意和百科目录格式，模式横跨多种文体。

patterns.name: 抽象名词后的“has”
patterns.trigger: “has”后接过去分词或名词性影响结果，如“has been made”“has an impact”“has constrained”“has an influence”
patterns.context: “has”引出某种已发生的作用、影响或约束，后接结果或影响对象
patterns.domain: 法律、政治、论坛讨论、专利技术

patterns.name: 否定助动词与结果转折
patterns.context: 否定或转折结构说明某种预期、行为或条件并不导致特定结果
patterns.domain: 论坛讨论、医学研究、硬件讨论

patterns.name: 使用导致磨损或资源消耗
patterns.trigger: “use results in considerable wear and tear”
patterns.context: 描述日常使用带来的损耗后果

patterns.name: 存储消耗及断开连接后的保留
patterns.trigger: “after disconnection from the server uses up valuable storage space”
patterns.context: 技术系统中，断连后仍保留数据，进而占用资源

patterns.name: 目录项目与分类标签
patterns.context: 百科条目的栏目、链接和分类列表

patterns.name: 法律固定措辞中的救济与管辖
patterns.trigger: “such other and further relief as to the Court seems meet and justice may require”“governed by the same principles”
patterns.context: 法院裁量救济及法律规则适用的句式

patterns.name: 参与同意与拒绝后果
patterns.trigger: “invited to participate”“signed an informed consent form”“Refusal to participate did not entail any form of penalty”
patterns.context: 研究参与者受邀、签署同意并说明拒绝无惩罚

en.description: Activations are distributed across different domains. Clear cues include common function words such as has, may, and need, as well as words in legal procedures, terms, trademarks, and academic arguments; the paragraphs lack a unified content theme.

patterns.name: Function word has
patterns.context: Appears as an auxiliary or lexical verb in main or subordinate clauses; this word is marked as strongly activated in texts on several unrelated topics.
patterns.domain: Law, patents, website comments, academic texts

patterns.name: Modal verbs may/need
patterns.context: Expresses possibility or necessity, appearing in legal opinions and scientific research conclusions.

patterns.name: Legal terms and procedural words
patterns.context: Court documents concerning appeals, litigation, procedural errors, reconsideration of rulings, and related matters; activations are distributed across various legal words.

patterns.name: Technical description in patent text
patterns.context: Describes ink diffusion and its effects on image density and resolving power.

patterns.name: Terms headings and legal agreements
patterns.context: A website terms page heading or all-caps agreement text; words are split into subword tokens.

patterns.name: Trademark definition language
patterns.context: Explains how trademarks identify the source of goods or services and introduces the legal concept of trademark use.

patterns.name: Conclusions in research findings
patterns.context: Based on research findings, suggests that a certain impact needs to be considered in recovery trajectories.

patterns.name: Personal experience and discussion of environmental impacts
patterns.context: A forum discussion uses evidence to rebut someone and discusses the influence of environmental change on behavior.

patterns.name: Input and fitting conclusions
patterns.context: Discusses whether it is reasonable to draw conclusions based on fitting physical observables to a model.

6_643.description: 激活分布于不同领域，明显线索包括 has、may、need 等常见功能词，以及法律程序、条款、商标和学术论述中的词语；各段缺少统一的内容主题。

patterns.name: 功能词 has
patterns.context: 在主句或从句中作为助动词或实义动词出现；该词在多个不同主题文本中被标记为强激活。
patterns.domain: 法律、专利、网页评论、学术文本

patterns.name: 情态动词 may/need
patterns.context: 表达可能性或必要性，出现在法律意见及科学研究结论中。

patterns.name: 法律术语及程序词
patterns.context: 法律文书中关于上诉、诉讼、程序失误、判决复议等内容；激活分散在多种法律词语上。

patterns.name: 专利文本中的技术描述
patterns.context: 描述油墨扩散及其对图像密度、分辨能力的影响。

patterns.name: 条款标题与法律协议
patterns.context: 网页条款页面的标题或全大写协议正文；词语被拆分成子词标记。

patterns.name: 商标定义用语
patterns.context: 解释商标如何识别商品或服务来源，并介绍商标使用的法律概念。

patterns.name: 研究结果中的结论表达
patterns.trigger: “this effect may need to be considered”
patterns.context: 根据研究发现提出某种影响需要纳入恢复轨迹考量。

patterns.name: 个人经历与环境影响论述
patterns.context: 论坛讨论中以证据反驳他人，并谈及环境变化对行为的影响。

patterns.name: 输入与拟合结论
patterns.context: 讨论依据模型拟合物理观测量得出结论的合理性。

en.description: Activations often occur on predicates and their complements that describe relationships or states: use brings consequences, properties affect something or design is constrained, actions are evaluated or governed by rules, and legal procedural conditions and ongoing actions are also included.

patterns.name: Effect, review, and conditions of legal remedies or orders
patterns.context: Legal documents explain which principles, conditions, or review govern an order, remedy, or procedure; activations concentrate on relationship or constraint expressions.

patterns.name: Use of equipment or resources and its consequences
patterns.context: Describes use of an action or function and the resulting resource consumption or wear.
patterns.domain: Patent background and everyday explanatory prose

patterns.name: Technical properties, degree, or design constraints
patterns.context: Technical descriptions state the degree or impact of a property, or how product requirements constrain design.

patterns.name: Evaluation or parameterization of actions or processes
patterns.context: Research abstracts explain how an action is evaluated, classified, or measured using parameters.

patterns.name: Formation and continuation of actions or processes
patterns.context: States that an action has been continuously pursued, or that a usage has been classified or named.

patterns.name: Legal or service-terms constraints on use
patterns.context: Service notices or email footers state that user activity is governed by terms; this resembles the constrained expressions in legal documents, but the context is platform services.
patterns.domain: Group unsubscribe notices in Enron emails

6_643.description: 激活常见于说明关系或状态的谓语及其补语：使用带来后果、性质影响或设计受限、行为被评估或受规则约束，也包括法律程序条件及行动持续状态。

patterns.name: 法律救济或命令的效力、审查与条件
patterns.trigger: «governed»6« by»10 the same principles；«subject»5« to»9 multiple conditions；«Appeal»2«ability»5
patterns.context: 法律文书中说明命令、救济或程序受何种原则、条件或审查约束；激活集中在关系或约束表达上。

patterns.name: 设备或资源使用及其后果
patterns.trigger: «uses»10« up»1 valuable storage space；«use»9« results»3 in considerable wear
patterns.context: 描述某种行为或功能的使用，以及它带来的资源消耗或损耗。
patterns.domain: 专利背景与日常说明文

patterns.name: 技术性质、程度或设计约束
patterns.trigger: «degree»5 ... spread»3 ... «has»7« an»9« influence；«has»9 constrained the dimensions
patterns.context: 技术说明中陈述某种性质的程度及影响，或产品要求对设计造成的约束。

patterns.name: 行为或处理的评估、参数化
patterns.trigger: «was»5 assessed»8；«was»4 considered»8 according»3« to»6 three»7 parameters
patterns.context: 研究摘要中说明如何评估、判定或按参数衡量某项行为。

patterns.name: 行为或过程的形成与持续
patterns.context: 陈述某种行动已被持续推进，或某种用法被归类、命名。

patterns.name: 使用的法律或服务条款约束
patterns.trigger: «Your»2« use»7 of Yahoo! Groups« is»4« subject»6« to»8
patterns.context: 服务通知或邮件尾注中说明用户行为受条款约束；与法律文书的受约束表达相似，但语境为平台服务。
patterns.domain: Enron 邮件中的群组退订通知

en.description: The most prominent, but not exclusive, clue is use: it covers purpose and consumption or wear caused by use, and also appears in URLs. Other sporadic high-activation collocations involve effects, perfect constructions, definitions, conditions, and commercial statements, with no unified syntactic or domain pattern.

patterns.name: Predicate “use” after an abstract noun
patterns.context: “use” as a noun, or near a string beginning with use in a URL; it is often followed by elements related to resources, effects, or purpose.
patterns.domain: Legal texts, patents, technology reviews, forums, emails, and general explanatory prose

patterns.name: Noun followed by “uses up” and resource consumption
patterns.context: Explains that emails remain stored after a device is disconnected, taking up storage space.

patterns.name: Noun followed by “has an influence”
patterns.context: Describes the effect of a physical or technical parameter on other properties; here, the effect of ink diffusion on density and resolution.

patterns.name: “has been” in the perfect tense
patterns.context: Looks back on concepts or methods that have been shown to be useful; not necessarily related to the “use” theme.

patterns.name: “known as” after a linking verb
patterns.context: Defines or names the term for trademark use.

patterns.name: “subject to” condition expression
patterns.context: A judicial document states that a retrial is subject to several conditions.

patterns.name: Evaluation in “much more important use”
patterns.context: Compares resource uses and argues that developing a mobile client is more important.

patterns.name: “all this use” introducing wear
patterns.context: Refers to the considerable wear caused by frequent garage use.

patterns.name: use in encoded email links
patterns.context: URL parameter strings in email body text, where use and characters such as rem/ail are split into marked fragments.

patterns.name: Directional statement after “has become”
patterns.context: Discusses a company making customer orientation a key priority; activation does not fall on an obvious “use” structure.

patterns.name: Sentence-final “may require” in judicial language
patterns.context: In a court ruling, expresses that the court considers some remedy may be necessary.

6_643.description: 最突出但并非唯一线索是 use：涵盖用途、使用造成的消耗或磨损，也出现于 URL。另有影响、完成时、定义、条件及商业表述等零散高激活搭配，缺乏统一句法或领域模式。

patterns.name: 抽象名词后的谓语「use」
patterns.context: “use”作为名词，或 URL 中以 use 开头的字符串附近；其后常接资源、影响或用途相关成分。
patterns.domain: 法律、专利、科技评论、论坛、邮件及一般说明文

patterns.name: 名词后接“uses up”及资源消耗
patterns.context: 说明设备断开连接后仍保留邮件，导致存储空间被占用。

patterns.name: 名词后接“has an influence”
patterns.context: 描述某个物理或技术参数对其他性质的影响；此处是墨水扩散对密度和分辨率的影响。

patterns.name: 完成时中的“has been”
patterns.context: 回顾某些概念或方法已被证明有用；与“use”主题并非必然相关。

patterns.name: 系动词后的“known as”
patterns.context: 对商标使用这一术语作定义或命名。

patterns.name: “subject to”条件表达
patterns.context: 司法文书中说明重新审理受多个条件限制。

patterns.name: “much more important use”评价
patterns.context: 比较资源用途，认为开发移动客户端更重要。

patterns.name: “all this use”引出磨损
patterns.trigger: «all»2« this»1« use»9« results»2« in»1« considerable»2« wear»5« and»1« tear»2
patterns.context: 指频繁使用车库造成相当程度的磨损。

patterns.name: 编码式邮件链接中的 use
patterns.context: 邮件正文中的 URL 参数字符串，use 与 rem/ail 等字符被切分标记。

patterns.name: “has become”后的导向性表述
patterns.context: 论述企业将产品以客户为导向作为重要优先事项；激活未落在明显的“use”结构上。

patterns.name: 司法句末“may require”
patterns.context: 法院裁定语境中，表达法院认为可能需要给予某种救济。

en.description: The main highlights fall near have/has, use, and their following elements, but vary across syntax and domains; the legal passages also contain collocations such as subject to and governed by, while other sporadic triggers cannot be unified.

patterns.name: have/has been after a verb or adjective
patterns.context: Triggers concentrate on have/has, use, or has, followed by elements related to degree, results, state, or effects; forms and syntactic positions are not fully consistent.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain: game reviews, home advice, scientific papers, political speeches, forums, legal texts

patterns.name: Prepositions and modal/relational words in legal documents
patterns.context: In formal discussion of court orders or legal principles, triggers occur on fixed collocations and the prepositions or determiners that follow them.

patterns.name: Syntactically complex negative expression
patterns.context: A negative auxiliary combines with have much, followed by bearing; its relationship to the have/has pattern in other passages is uncertain.

patterns.name: Possessive and legal judgment language
patterns.context: A legal discussion of an attorney's failure to record a date, subsequently found to be excusable neglect; activations span the possessive suffix and the following judgment construction.

patterns.name: Sporadic highlights, unclear pattern
patterns.context: These words are scattered across passages; local highlights are insufficient to identify a shared meaning or syntactic condition.
patterns.domain: Technical patents, legal texts, reviews, home advice, science, politics, forums

6_643.description: 主要高亮落在 have/has、use 及其后续成分附近，但跨句法与领域不稳定；法律段另有 subject to、governed by 等搭配，其他零散触发无法统一解释。

patterns.name: 动词或形容词后的 have/has been
patterns.context: 触发点集中在 have/has、use 或 has 后，后接程度、结果、状态或影响相关成分；但词形和句法位置并不完全一致。
patterns.domain: 跨领域：游戏评测、家居建议、科学论文、政治演说、论坛、法律文本

patterns.name: 法律文书中的介词与情态/关系词
patterns.context: 法院命令或法律原则的正式论述中，触发于固定搭配及其后的介词、限定词。

patterns.name: 结构复杂的否定表达
patterns.context: 否定助动词与 have much 连用，后接 bearing；是否与其他段落的 have/has 模式有关不确定。

patterns.name: 所有格与法律判断措辞
patterns.context: 律师疏忽未记日期、进而被认定为可原谅疏忽的法律论述；激活横跨所有格后缀及后续判断结构。

patterns.name: 零散高亮，模式不明
patterns.context: 这些词分散在各段，局部高亮不足以确定共享的词义或句法条件。
patterns.domain: 技术专利、法律、评论、生活建议、科学、政治、论坛

en.description: Strong activations often fall on sentence-level function words: has followed by been (5, 7, 9), or use after this (6, 8); in two other court opinions they fall on by and to. The remaining examples include a sentence about environmental effects, a period, and sporadic activations near a playlist.

patterns.name: been after sentence-level is/have has
patterns.context: In present perfect constructions, activation falls on has before been; examples occur in sentences describing population participation, excusable neglect, and Iran-related preparations.
patterns.domain: Social sciences, legal, and political texts

patterns.name: this use in a sentence
patterns.context: The noun use directly follows this and describes the use of a behavior or facility and its consequences; another near-match is “Land»2« use»9”.

patterns.name: by in a court opinion
patterns.context: In legal argumentation, by introduces the applicable principle or basis, followed by the same principles.

patterns.name: to in a court opinion
patterns.context: In a judicial procedure narrative, subject to introduces a condition; to is followed across a line break by multiple conditions.

patterns.name: Different parts of speech in an environmental context
patterns.context: Discusses how changing the environment affects behavior; activation centers on has, alongside words related to environment and impact.

patterns.name: Standalone punctuation token
patterns.context: A final period is marked in specific legal or patent corpus sentences; activation is weak and no stable semantic condition is apparent.

patterns.name: Standalone phrase token
patterns.context: In a game feature description, words about custom playlists and a period show weak activation; the trigger form is inconsistent with other paragraphs.

6_643.description: 强激活多落在句中结构词：has 后接 been（5、7、9），或 this 后的 use（6、8）；另在两段法院意见中落于 by、to。其余为环境影响句、句号及播放列表附近的零散激活。

patterns.name: 句中 is/have has 后的 been
patterns.context: 现在完成时结构中，激活落在 been 前的 has 上，后接 been；分别出现在描述人口参与、可原谅的疏忽和伊朗相关准备的句子中。
patterns.domain: 社会科学、法律、政治文本

patterns.name: 句中 this use
patterns.context: this 后紧接名词 use，描述某种行为或设施的使用及其后果；另有接近但不完全相同的用例“Land»2« use»9”。

patterns.name: 法院意见中的 by
patterns.context: 法律论证中，by 引出适用的原则或依据，后接 the same principles。

patterns.name: 法院意见中的 to
patterns.context: 司法程序叙述中，subject to 引出条件；to 后换行并接 multiple conditions。

patterns.name: 不同词类的环境
patterns.context: 讨论改变环境对行为的影响；激活集中在 has，伴随环境和影响相关词。

patterns.name: 独立出现的标点 token
patterns.context: 句末句号在特定法律或专利语料句子中标记；激活较弱且未见稳定语义条件。

patterns.name: 独立出现的词组 token
patterns.context: 游戏功能介绍中，围绕自定义播放列表的词及句号有弱激活；与其他段的触发形式不一致。

en.concept: Common English collocations and syntactic continuations
en.description: Activations are scattered across several common English collocations and structures: has followed by been, a noun phrase, or resulted; prepositions and conditional structures in legal documents; and sporadic examples involving space/place/separate, weigh, and need. No unified narrow meaning is apparent.

patterns.name: has been + past participle
patterns.context: After the subject, has been introduces a past participle, often forming a present perfect passive or result state; it also occurs with following evaluations or complements.

patterns.name: has an impact
patterns.context: has is followed by the indefinite article an and the noun impact, then on introduces the affected object.

patterns.name: has resulted directly
patterns.context: has introduces resulted, followed by directly in, indicating that something directly caused an outcome.

patterns.name: to + legal action/state
patterns.context: In legal constructions, prepositions such as to and by connect matters, principles, or conditions governed by something; in [6], subject to is followed by a condition.

patterns.name: Space/disposition-related words
patterns.context: Occurs in isolated phrases such as storage space, take place, and separate notices, with no shared syntactic environment established.

patterns.name: Weak signal: weigh / need
patterns.context: Appears respectively in a weighing expression in political commentary and in need to be considered in a paper; association with other patterns is unclear.

6_643.concept: 常见英语搭配与句法延续
6_643.description: 激活分散在若干常见英语搭配与结构中：has 后接 been、名词短语或 resulted；法律文书的介词与条件结构；另有 space/place/separate 及 weigh、need 等零散词例，未见统一窄语义。

patterns.name: has been + 过去分词
patterns.context: 主语后由 has been 引出过去分词，常构成完成时被动或结果状态；也见与后续评价、补语相连。

patterns.name: has an impact
patterns.context: has 后接不定冠词 an 与名词 impact，再以 on 引出影响对象。

patterns.name: has resulted directly
patterns.context: has 引出 resulted，随后 directly in，说明某事直接导致结果。

patterns.name: to + 法律动作/状态
patterns.context: 法律句式中，to、by 等介词连接受支配的事项、原则或条件；[6]中 subject to 后接条件。

patterns.name: 空间/处置相关词
patterns.context: 孤立出现于 storage space、take place、separate notices 等短语中，没有共同句法环境可确证。

patterns.name: 弱信号：weigh / need
patterns.context: 分别出现在政治评论中的权衡表达、论文中 need to be considered；与其他模式关联不明。

en.concept: English Predicate Collocations and Result Expressions
en.description: Covers several types of fixed predicate collocations and expressions of results or constraints in technical and legal contexts; some fragments highlight has/have been, while others involve unsubscribe instructions, space consumption, material diffusion, and response delays. Commonality is weak.

patterns.name: have been after an auxiliary verb
patterns.context: A perfect or passive construction occurs in the sentence; activation often falls on been, the following word, and related structures.
patterns.domain: Legal, parliamentary, academic, and patent texts

patterns.name: be subject to conditions
patterns.context: Introduces conditions, restrictions, or constraints in court rulings or procedural descriptions.

patterns.name: governed by rules
patterns.context: Discusses how legal rules or principles apply; the phrase is followed by “the same principles” and similar wording.

patterns.name: Unsubscribe instructions
patterns.context: An email or newsletter explains how to unsubscribe, often including “to unsubscribe” and guidance on the email subject line.

patterns.name: Material diffusion and its effects
patterns.context: Describes ink spreading or blurring on a material and its effects on properties.

patterns.name: Technical integration as a research topic
patterns.context: Explains how to integrate a device or process with other devices, describing it as an important research area.

patterns.name: Occurrence of delay
patterns.context: Describes the drawback of adaptation or response not occurring in a timely manner.

patterns.name: Storage space consumption
patterns.context: States that retaining downloaded emails after disconnection consumes device storage space.

6_643.concept: 英语谓语搭配与结果表达
6_643.description: 涵盖多类固定谓语搭配及技术、法律语境中的结果或限制表达；部分片段突出 has/have been，另有退订指引、空间占用、材料扩散和响应延迟等。共同点较弱。

patterns.name: 助动词后的 have been
patterns.trigger: “has”/“have”后接“been”，或“has been”后接过去分词、形容词或介词短语
patterns.context: 句中出现完成时或被动结构；激活常落在 been、紧随其后的词及相关结构上
patterns.domain: 法律、议会、学术及专利文本

patterns.name: be subject to 条件
patterns.context: 法律判决或程序描述中，引出所受条件、限制或约束

patterns.name: governed by 规则
patterns.context: 讨论法律规则或原则如何适用，短语后接“the same principles”等

patterns.name: 退订指令
patterns.context: 邮件或新闻简报中，说明如何退订，常出现“to unsubscribe”及邮件主题指引

patterns.name: 物质扩散及其影响
patterns.context: 描述墨水在材料上扩散、模糊及其对性质的影响

patterns.name: 技术融合成为研究课题
patterns.context: 说明如何将一种器件或工艺与其他器件集成，称其已成为重要研究领域

patterns.name: 迟延发生
patterns.context: 描述适应或响应未能及时发生的缺点

patterns.name: 存储空间占用
patterns.context: 说明断开连接后保留下载邮件会消耗设备存储空间

en.description: Activations are distributed across “villages” in encyclopedic geography entries, “epidemiology” in NIH project descriptions, clinical-trial and imaging-measurement expressions in medical abstracts, Jewish religious titles, and mathematical formulas. Triggering word forms and styles vary markedly.

patterns.name: “villages” and place-name entries
patterns.context: In encyclopedic geography entries, the word for villages appears in place descriptions or entry categories; [2] also contains the strongly activated repeated place name «Eichfeld»

patterns.name: Epidemiology field terms
patterns.context: The name of the discipline epidemiology appears in lists of research funding, academic subjects, or areas of expertise
patterns.domain: NIH research funding and academic project descriptions

patterns.name: Clinical-trial terminology in medical abstracts
patterns.context: Medical abstracts describe clinical trials, control designs, or clinical outcomes; [4] also mentions glycemic control and hypoglycemia

patterns.name: Imaging and measurement expressions in medical abstracts
patterns.context: Pre- and postoperative sinus imaging results report the maxillary sinus half-life and measurements in minutes

patterns.name: Hebrew terms and religious titles
patterns.context: Descriptions of titles in rabbinical institutions or Jewish religious systems, with Hebrew and transliteration

patterns.name: Symbol sequences in mathematical formulas
patterns.context: In math problems or formula derivations, activation falls near exponentiation symbols, numbers, and variables

6_692.description: 激活分散在百科地理条目中的“villages”、NIH 项目描述中的“epidemiology”、医学摘要的临床试验与影像测量表达，以及犹太宗教职衔和数学公式。各处触发词形与文体差异明显。

patterns.name: “villages”及地名条目
patterns.trigger: «villages»（[2]）和 «villages»（[7]）；相邻的城镇、地区、人口和分类信息
patterns.context: 百科式地理条目中，村庄一词出现在地点介绍或条目分类里；[2]另有强激活的重复地名 «Eichfeld»

patterns.name: 流行病学研究领域词
patterns.context: 研究资助、课程学科或专家领域的罗列中，出现流行病学这一学科名称
patterns.domain: NIH 研究资助及学术项目描述

patterns.name: 医学摘要中的临床试验术语
patterns.context: 医学摘要描述临床试验、对照设计或临床结果；[4]还提及血糖控制和低血糖

patterns.name: 医学摘要中的影像与测量表达
patterns.context: 鼻窦术前后影像检查结果，报告上颌窦的半衰期及以分钟表示的测量值

patterns.name: 希伯来术语与宗教职衔
patterns.context: 拉比机构或犹太宗教体系的职衔说明，夹有希伯来文与音译
patterns.domain: Wikipedia 宗教／犹太历史条目

patterns.name: 数学公式中的符号序列
patterns.trigger: «**»、«3»（[9]）；并见变量 z、i 与算术表达式
patterns.context: 数学题或公式推导，激活落在幂符号、数字及变量附近

en.concept: Detection of domain terms and proper-name fragments
en.description: Responds most strongly to the word epidemiology, especially in lists of research fields; also responds to village-entry vocabulary and several sporadic proper names, clinical terms, trial phrases, numbers, and mathematical symbols. Overall, there is no single semantic pattern.

patterns.name: Epidemiology as an academic field
patterns.context: Appears as the name of a research field in academic funding descriptions, course introductions, or lists of research fields; this is the most recurrent and strongest pattern.
patterns.domain: NIH funding descriptions and research/education texts

patterns.name: Village-entry vocabulary
patterns.context: Mentions villages and their regions in place-name entries or descriptions of administrative-area populations.

patterns.name: Hebrew religious judicial titles
patterns.context: Near transliterations, transcriptions, and Hebrew text for Jewish religious judicial institutions or leaders.
patterns.domain: Introductions to Jewish religious institutions on English Wikipedia

patterns.name: Diabetes-related terms
patterns.context: Describes blood glucose control and nocturnal hypoglycemia in clinical trial results.

patterns.name: Clinical research trial wording
patterns.context: At the beginning of abstracts for randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled trials; activation is distributed across adjacent trial-design terms.

patterns.name: Imaging values and anatomical terms
patterns.context: Half-life values and units of measurement in reports of sinus imaging examinations.

patterns.name: Local algebraic-expression patterns
patterns.context: Formula fragments composed of variables, multiplication signs, and exponents; no visible natural-language topic cues.

6_692.concept: 领域词与专名片段检测
6_692.description: 最突出地响应 epidemiology 一词，尤其在科研领域列举中；也响应村镇条目词汇及若干分散的专名、临床术语、试验措辞、数值和数学符号，整体并非单一语义模式。

patterns.name: 流行病学学科词
patterns.context: 在学术资助、课程介绍或研究领域列举中，作为研究领域名称出现；这是反复出现且强度最高的模式。
patterns.domain: NIH 资助说明与科研/教育文本

patterns.name: 村镇条目词汇
patterns.context: 地名条目或行政区人口介绍中，提到村镇及其所属地区。
patterns.domain: 英文维基百科地理条目

patterns.name: 希伯来语宗教司法称谓
patterns.context: 犹太宗教司法机构或领袖称谓的音译、转写及希伯来语文字附近。
patterns.domain: 英文维基百科中的犹太宗教制度介绍

patterns.name: 糖尿病相关词
patterns.context: 临床试验结果中描述血糖控制及夜间低血糖。

patterns.name: 医学研究试验措辞
patterns.context: 随机双盲、安慰剂对照试验的摘要开头；激活分布于这些相邻试验设计词。

patterns.name: 影像检查数值与解剖词
patterns.context: 报告鼻窦影像检查的半衰期数值及测量单位。

patterns.name: 代数表达式局部模式
patterns.context: 变量、乘号和幂次构成的公式片段；没有可见的自然语言主题线索。

en.concept: Mixed intra-word fragments and academic terms
en.description: Activation is distributed across intra-word subword fragments, proper names, and academic terms; medical abstracts and NIH texts are common, but place names, Hebrew text, and personal names also occur, with no unified semantic trigger.

patterns.name: English intra-word subword fragments
