patterns.context: Activation often falls on English word fragments split by tokenization, especially in technical terms or longer words; adjacent parts of the same word are usually unmarked.
patterns.domain: Medical, academic, and general English texts

patterns.name: Proper names and non-English text fragments
patterns.context: Activation occurs on Hebrew fragments, transliterations, or intra-word parts of personal names, with no stable semantic condition.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedia entries, and introductions to people and religious institutions

patterns.name: Local fragments in place names
patterns.context: In place names or administrative geography descriptions, activation covers intra-word fragments of town names and also occurs on “villages”.

patterns.name: Iranian administrative geography terms
patterns.context: Geographic nouns or classification terms trigger activation in descriptions of Iranian counties, districts, provinces, populations, and village categories.

patterns.name: Experimental and clinical research wording
patterns.context: Clinical trial descriptions, especially wording for randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled, and comparative designs.

patterns.name: Medical conditions and clinical measurement terms
patterns.context: Activation falls on fragments of medical terms in contexts involving blood glucose control, hypoglycemia, orthopedic problems, or patient quality-of-life assessments.

patterns.name: Institutions and research-topic terms in project abstracts
patterns.context: Appears at the beginning of NIH project abstracts and in descriptions of hereditary muscle disease topics.

patterns.name: Research centers and fields of study
patterns.context: Triggered in funding applications describing competitive renewals, research center foundations, and epidemiological and clinical research outcomes.

patterns.name: Laboratory research statements
patterns.context: Triggered in research-direction statements beginning with “Work from our laboratory has focused on...”.

6_692.concept: 混合的词内片段与学术术语
6_692.description: 激活分散在词内子词片段、专名和学术术语上；医学摘要及NIH文本较多，但也见于地名、希伯来文和人名，缺少统一语义触发条件。

patterns.name: 英语词内子词片段
patterns.context: 激活常落在被分词切开的英语词片段上，尤其是专业词或较长词；同一词的相邻部分通常未标记。
patterns.domain: 医学、学术及一般英语文本

patterns.name: 专名及非英语文字片段
patterns.context: 激活出现在希伯来文片段、转写形式或人名的词内部分，未见稳定的语义条件。
patterns.domain: 百科条目、人物与宗教机构介绍

patterns.name: 地名中的局部片段
patterns.context: 地名或行政地理描述中，激活覆盖城镇名的词内片段，也出现于“villages”。

patterns.name: 伊朗行政地理词
patterns.context: 介绍伊朗县、区、省、人口及村庄分类时，地理名词或分类词触发激活。

patterns.name: 实验与临床研究措辞
patterns.context: 临床试验描述中，尤其是随机、双盲、安慰剂对照及比较设计措辞。

patterns.name: 医学病症与临床测量词
patterns.context: 涉及血糖控制、低血糖或骨科问题及患者生活质量评估时，触发落在医学术语片段上。

patterns.name: 项目摘要中的机构与研究主题词
patterns.context: NIH项目摘要开头及遗传性肌肉疾病主题介绍中出现。

patterns.name: 研究中心与研究领域措辞
patterns.context: 资助申请描述竞争性续期、研究中心基础及流行病学和临床研究成果时触发。

patterns.name: 实验室研究陈述
patterns.context: 以“Work from our laboratory has focused on...”开头的研究方向陈述中触发。

en.description: The strongest and most recurrent feature is capitalized Work at the beginning of a sentence; other activations occur on wording for randomized trials, plural geographic nouns, code namespaces, names, and years, spanning domains without a common local pattern.

patterns.name: Word-initial Work
patterns.context: The capitalized word Work appears at the beginning of a passage; it may be followed directly by a noun, prepositional phrase, or sentence content.

patterns.name: Randomized controlled trial wording
patterns.context: Appears in medical wording describing randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled trials; activation falls on an internal suffix and neighboring words.

patterns.name: Plural place noun villages
patterns.context: A plural geographic-category noun follows a definite article and is followed by a specific village name.

patterns.name: Code package name fragment org
patterns.context: Appears at the beginning of a dot-separated software package or namespace identifier.

patterns.name: Name Nielsen
patterns.context: The surname Nielsen appears in the titles and body text of biographical entries.

patterns.name: Year 2019
patterns.context: The year appears at the beginning of an election-entry title and modifies the election name.

6_692.concept: 词首 Work，另有零散模式
6_692.description: 最强且反复的特征是句首大写 Work；其余激活分别落在随机试验措辞、地理复数名词、代码命名空间、人名和年份，跨领域且缺少共同局部模式。

patterns.name: 词首 Work
patterns.context: 大写单词 Work 出现在片段开头；可直接接名词、介词短语或句子内容。

patterns.name: 随机对照试验措辞
patterns.context: 出现在描述随机、双盲、安慰剂对照试验的医学表达中；激活落在词内后缀及其邻近词上。

patterns.name: 地点名词复数 villages
patterns.context: 定冠词后出现复数地名类别名词，后接具体村庄名称。

patterns.name: 代码包名片段 org
patterns.context: 出现在点分隔的软件包或命名空间标识符开头。

patterns.name: 人名 Nielsen
patterns.context: 姓氏 Nielsen 出现在人物条目标题及正文中。

patterns.name: 年份 2019
patterns.context: 年份位于选举条目标题开头，修饰选举名称。

en.description: Responds strongly to sentence-initial Work in research and patent contexts, and also to endings of medical trial terms, several technical word fragments, and the year 2019; trigger forms and contexts are diverse.

patterns.name: Sentence-initial Work
patterns.context: Begins with Work, followed by a prepositional phrase, research subject, or technical description; sometimes immediately followed by vehicles.

patterns.name: Word endings in medical trial terminology
patterns.context: In descriptions of randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled trials, activation falls on word endings or subsequent terms.

patterns.name: Fragments/paths in technical terms
patterns.context: Activation occurs at the beginning or inside fragments of technical terms or identifiers; contexts include mass spectrometry paths, font metrics, and Java package names.

patterns.name: Year
patterns.context: The year appears at the beginning of an election heading.

6_692.description: 强烈响应句首 Work（科研、专利语境），也响应医学试验词尾、若干技术词片段及年份 2019；各类触发形式和语境分散。

patterns.name: 句首 Work
patterns.context: 以 Work 开始，后接介词短语、研究对象或技术描述；有时紧接 vehicles。

patterns.name: 医学试验术语中的词尾
patterns.context: 随机、双盲、安慰剂对照试验的描述中，激活落在词尾或后续术语上。

patterns.name: 专业词中的片段 / 路径
patterns.context: 激活出现在技术术语或标识符的词首或内部片段；上下文分别涉及质谱路径、字体度量和 Java 包名。
patterns.domain: 医学摘要、GitHub 技术文本

patterns.name: 年份
patterns.context: 年份作为选举标题的开头。

en.description: The main pattern is the analy- stem in biomedical testing contexts, involving the capture, recognition, detection, or analysis of analytes; other isolated patterns include clinical-trial terminology, Tuesday in political reporting, and font-metrics filenames and version numbers.

patterns.name: Randomized controlled trial description
patterns.context: Describes randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled trials comparing drugs; activation concentrates on Randomized and trial-design terms.

patterns.name: Analyte-related terms
patterns.context: In contexts involving detection, capture, recognition, or characterization of an object, triggers the analyte/analyze stem; includes proteins, DNA, tumor markers, and surrogate analyte.

patterns.name: Specific font metric name
patterns.context: Appears in the header of an automatically generated font metrics file; activation covers a continuous proper name and version-number token.

patterns.name: Political debate time word
patterns.context: In news sentences recounting a debate between presidential candidates, triggers a day of the week; the same passage also contains unmarked “debate” and “I called”.

6_692.concept: 部分响应生物分析词干
6_692.description: 主要模式是生物医学检测语境中的 analy- 词干，涉及分析物的捕获、识别、检测或分析；另有临床试验术语、政治报道中的 Tuesday，以及字体度量文件名和版本号等孤立模式。

patterns.name: 随机对照试验描述
patterns.context: 描述比较药物的随机、双盲、安慰剂对照试验；激活集中在 Randomized 与试验设计术语。

patterns.name: 分析物相关术语
patterns.context: 在检测、捕获、识别或表征对象的语境中，触发 analyte/analyze 的词干片段；包括蛋白质、DNA、肿瘤标志物及 surrogate analyte。
patterns.domain: 生物分析、检测与肿瘤研究

patterns.name: 特定染色字体量名称
patterns.context: 出现在自动生成的字体度量文件头部；激活覆盖连续的专名及版本号 token。

patterns.name: 政治辩论时间词
patterns.context: 在新闻叙述总统候选人辩论的句子中，触发星期名称；同段另有「debate」「I called」等未标记内容。

en.description: Activations are distributed across melanoma genetics, research and clinical medical texts, negative sentences containing “no,” discussions of cost and replacement, patients’ language status, and political debates. These passages span broad topics, with no single stable semantic trigger pattern.

patterns.name: Melanoma and genetic features
patterns.context: Discusses melanoma progression, tumor molecular characteristics, or related study designs.
patterns.domain: Biomedical research; NIH project abstracts and PubMed Central papers

patterns.name: Negation word no
patterns.context: “no” appears in expressions of explicit negation, absence, or exclusion, forming a negative relation with what follows.
patterns.domain: Medical papers, research abstracts, and general discussion

patterns.name: Cost and replacement
patterns.context: Discusses the replacement of systems or personnel, related costs, and their evaluation.
patterns.domain: Medical technology assessment, labor economics, or general policy discussion

patterns.name: Medical symptoms and treatment
patterns.context: Clinical cases or medical research describe symptoms, injuries, treatment, or histopathological findings.

patterns.name: Research institutions or activities
patterns.context: Introduces the mission, research activities, or scope of a research institution.
patterns.domain: History of science and biomedical research

patterns.name: Non-German-speaking patients’ language needs
patterns.context: Describes the proportion and language status of foreign-language patients in hospitals or medical institutions.
patterns.domain: Healthcare services and public health abstracts

patterns.name: U.S. presidential campaign debates
patterns.context: Recounts debates between U.S. presidential candidates and related commentary.

6_692.description: 激活分布于黑色素瘤遗传特征、研究与临床医学文本，也见于含“no”的否定句、成本替换讨论、患者语言状况及政治辩论；这些片段主题跨度大，未见单一稳定语义触发模式。

patterns.name: 黑色素瘤及遗传特征
patterns.context: 讨论黑色素瘤进展、肿瘤分子特征或相关研究设计。
patterns.domain: 生物医学研究；NIH 项目摘要与 PubMed Central 论文

patterns.name: 否定词 no
patterns.context: “no”出现在明确否定、缺失或排除的表达中；与后续内容形成否定关系。
patterns.domain: 医学论文、研究摘要及一般论述

patterns.name: 成本与替换
patterns.context: 谈论系统或人员替换、相关成本及其评估。
patterns.domain: 医疗技术评估、劳动经济学或一般政策论述

patterns.name: 医疗症状与治疗
patterns.context: 临床病例或医学研究中描述症状、损伤、治疗或组织病理发现。
patterns.domain: 临床医学与生物医学论文

patterns.name: 研究机构或研究活动
patterns.context: 介绍研究机构的使命、研究活动或研究范围。
patterns.domain: 科研史与生物医学研究

patterns.name: 非德语患者语言需求
patterns.context: 说明外语患者在医院或医疗机构中的比例及语言状况。
patterns.domain: 医疗服务与公共卫生摘要

patterns.name: 美国总统竞选辩论
patterns.context: 回顾美国总统候选人的辩论及相关评论。

en.description: The most stable common thread is important and its use in importance judgments, appearing across academic abstracts, research descriptions, and forum text; the remaining content concerns medicine, mathematical physics, finance, botany, and cell biology, with no unified theme.

patterns.name: Emphatic/evaluative use of important
patterns.context: Makes an importance judgment about a goal, topic, finding, or feature in a sentence; often takes a to-phrase, infinitive, or noun complement, and can also describe the importance of a finding or function.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain academic abstracts and explanatory text, as well as product discussions and forum posts

patterns.name: Melanoma and research descriptions in medical papers
patterns.context: Appears in sentences about cancer, samples, cases, or clinical research; co-occurs with importance judgments in some passages.

patterns.name: Table references and statistical-significance formatting in papers
patterns.context: Table/figure reference markers, statistical test results, and case comparisons appear together.
patterns.domain: PubMed Central medical paper body text

patterns.name: Biological classification and ethnomedicinal plant descriptions
patterns.context: First describes diagnostic features for plant classification, then distribution and traditional medicinal value.

patterns.name: Product/drug discussion in HackerNews forums
patterns.context: Passages discuss independent developers’ product trade-offs or introduce drug-metabolism points colloquially; the only common feature is the presence of important.

patterns.name: Higher structures in mathematical physics
patterns.context: Discusses the relationship between algebraic structures in homotopy theory and geometric, topological, or physical structures.

patterns.name: Financial models and market strategies
patterns.context: Abstracts discuss the evolution of quotes over time, model corrections, and traders’ strategies.

patterns.name: Polyamines and cell cycle/protective effects
patterns.context: Describes cell-cycle arrest in the absence of polyamines and reports a protective effect of polyamines on E. coli.

6_692.description: 最稳定的共同线索是 important 及其重要性判断用法，跨学术摘要、研究说明与论坛文字出现；其余内容分属医学、数学物理、金融、植物学和细胞生物学，未见统一主题。

patterns.name: important 的强调/结果判断用法
patterns.context: 在句中对目标、主题、发现或特征作重要性判断；常接 to、不定式或名词补语，也可用于说明某项发现/作用的重要性。
patterns.domain: 跨领域的学术摘要与说明文字，也见产品讨论和论坛帖子

patterns.name: 医学论文中的 melanoma 及研究表述
patterns.context: 出现在有关癌症、样本、病例或临床研究的句子中；与重要性判断共同出现于部分段落。
patterns.domain: 生物医学摘要、NIH 研究描述

patterns.name: 论文表格引用与统计显著性格式
patterns.context: 表格/图引用标记、统计检验结果和病例比较相邻出现。
patterns.domain: PubMed Central 医学论文正文

patterns.name: 生物分类与民族药用植物描述
patterns.context: 先描述植物分类鉴别特征，再说明分布及传统药用价值。
patterns.domain: 植物学与民族药用研究

patterns.name: HackerNews 论坛中的产品/药物讨论
patterns.context: 段落分别谈独立开发者的产品取舍，或以口语引出药物代谢相关要点；共同点仅是出现 important。

patterns.name: 数学物理中的 higher structures
patterns.context: 讨论同伦论中代数结构与几何、拓扑或物理结构的关系。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 数学/理论物理论文

patterns.name: 金融模型与市场策略
patterns.context: 摘要讨论报价随时间演化、模型修正及交易者策略。

patterns.name: 多胺与细胞周期/保护作用
patterns.context: 描述缺乏多胺时细胞周期停滞，并报告多胺对大肠杆菌的保护作用。
patterns.domain: 生物医学研究进展报告

en.description: Activations often occur on words of judgment and argumentation in medical or research texts, such as comparison, importance, inference, and efficacy; they also involve transplantation, insulin, medication adherence, and evidence discussion. A passage on the history of technical education is difficult to unify with the medical theme.

patterns.name: Logical relation words
patterns.context: Activates when expressing comparison, inference, reasons, or importance, often on evaluative words in argumentative sentences; not all such words necessarily trigger.
patterns.domain: Academic abstracts, research proposals, and explanatory text

patterns.name: Medication adherence and treatment efficacy
patterns.context: Discusses medication behavior, dosage, treatment plans, or factors affecting efficacy, especially when judging the importance of a factor.

patterns.name: Transplantation and graft outcomes
patterns.context: Involves organ transplantation, graft function, or recipient outcomes; in passage 5, “graft” triggers especially strongly.

patterns.name: Insulin and metabolic content
patterns.context: Appears in discussions of insulin, insulin-related states, or its use; activation may fall on an internal fragment of the word or on a nearby evaluative word.

patterns.name: Research evidence and uncertainty
patterns.context: Mentions the nature of evidence, accumulated research, or unresolved mechanistic questions; the specific trigger forms vary across passages.

patterns.name: Technical education and institutions
patterns.context: Historical accounts describe schools, educational movements, and institutional development.

6_692.concept: 论述中的判断与重要性
6_692.description: 激活多见于医学或研究文本中的判断与论证词，如比较、重要性、推论和疗效；也涉及移植、胰岛素、用药依从及证据讨论。另有技术教育史片段，难与医学主题统一。

patterns.name: 逻辑关系词
patterns.context: 在说明比较、推论、理由或重要性时激活，常见于论证句中的判断词；并非所有这些词都必然触发。
patterns.domain: 学术摘要、研究提案及说明性文字

patterns.name: 药物依从与治疗效果
patterns.context: 讨论用药行为、剂量、治疗方案或影响疗效的因素时，尤其是对某种因素作重要性判断。

patterns.name: 移植与移植物结局
patterns.context: 涉及器官移植、移植物功能或受者结局；在片段5中对“graft”激活尤其强。

patterns.name: 胰岛素与代谢相关内容
patterns.context: 讨论胰岛素、胰岛素相关状态或其使用时出现；激活可落在词内片段，也可落在临近的判断词。

patterns.name: 研究证据与不确定性
patterns.context: 提及证据性质、研究积累或尚未解决的机制问题；不同片段中具体触发形式并不相同。

patterns.name: 技术教育与机构
patterns.context: 历史叙述中说明学校、教育运动及其机构发展。

en.description: “use” strongly activates in multiple passages describing purpose or usage; isolated triggers include liquor, degree, trepanning, and though, drinking, eyedro, and replication, spanning domains without a unified condition.

patterns.name: “use” and its inflected forms
patterns.context: “use” appears as a noun or verb, often in sentences describing purpose, usage, or extent of use; local contexts include “upon use,” “increased use,” and “long term use.”

patterns.name: “liquor”
patterns.context: Appears in the pairing “taste and liquor clarity” in descriptions of beverage fermentation, aging, and flavor.
patterns.domain: Personal experience or food and beverage descriptions

patterns.name: “degree”
patterns.context: Describes extent or limit, appearing in the patent mechanical description “to a somewhat greater degree than desired”.

patterns.name: Internal fragment of “trepanning”
patterns.context: Part of “trepanning tool” in a machining step.

patterns.name: Isolated high-activation words besides “use”
patterns.context: Appear respectively in accounts of improvement in chronic symptoms, antidepressant treatment research, eye-dropper patent descriptions, and viral replication studies; no common local syntactic or semantic condition is evident.
patterns.domain: Personal narratives, medical research, and patent texts

6_692.description: 多个段落中“use”在描述用途或使用时强激活；另有 liquor、degree、trepanning 及 though、drinking、eyedro、replication 等孤立触发，跨领域且缺少统一条件。

patterns.name: “use”及其屈折形式
patterns.context: “use”作为名词或动词出现，常在描述用途、使用过程或使用程度的句中；局部上下文包括“upon use”“increased use”“long term use”。
patterns.domain: 专利、医学与科学说明文

patterns.name: “liquor”
patterns.context: 酒类发酵、熟成及口感描述中，出现在“taste and liquor clarity”这一搭配内。
patterns.domain: 个人经验或食品饮料说明

patterns.name: “degree”
patterns.context: 描述程度或限度，出现在专利机械说明的“to a somewhat greater degree than desired”中。

patterns.name: “trepanning”词内片段
patterns.context: 机械加工步骤中，作为“trepanning tool”（镗孔/套料工具）的一部分。

patterns.name: “use”以外的孤立高激活词
patterns.context: 分别出现于慢性症状改善叙述、抗抑郁治疗研究、滴眼器专利描述、病毒复制研究中；未见共同的局部句法或语义条件。
patterns.domain: 个人叙述、医学研究与专利文本

en.concept: English word continuation and suffix fragments
en.description: Activations mainly fall on subsequent subword fragments or suffixes in multisyllabic words, such as onerous, tolerable, paucity, and opportunity; complete words such as use, need, and hope also activate, often in formal exposition, but across diverse domains and meanings.

patterns.name: Medial er/er syllable
patterns.context: Activation falls on an across-word fragment or suffix, completing an English multisyllabic word; the words do not belong to the same semantic category
patterns.domain: Patents, medical abstracts, and other formal styles

patterns.name: Subsequent subword fragment of use
patterns.context: The complete word use activates in a nominal expression; one example means useful, and another refers to the use of a method

patterns.name: Subword fragments for benefits or positive evaluations
patterns.context: Concerns benefits of pet companionship or performance evaluation of transparent conductive materials; trigger locations are not entirely consistent

patterns.name: Suffix of need
patterns.context: Appears in a patent background describing increased demand for cosmetic formulations

patterns.name: Internal fragment of opportunity
patterns.context: Describes a potential opportunity for marketers to expand market share

patterns.name: Internal fragment of hope
patterns.context: Expresses the speaker’s hope in literary narration

6_692.concept: 英语词内续接与词尾片段
6_692.description: 激活主要落在多音节词的后续词片段或词尾，如 onerous、tolerable、paucity、opportunity；另激活 use、need、hope 等完整词，常见于正式论述，但跨领域且语义分散。

patterns.name: 词中 er/er 音节
patterns.trigger: “on”后接«er»，形成“onerous”；“toler”后接«able»，形成“tolerable”；“pauc”后接«ity»，形成“paucity”
patterns.context: 激活落在跨词片段或词尾，完成一个多音节英语词；词本身不属于同一语义类别
patterns.domain: 专利、医学摘要等正式文体

patterns.name: use 的后续词片段
patterns.trigger: «use»，分别出现在“of use in”“their use is”
patterns.context: 激活完整词 use，位于名词性表达中；一例表示有用，另一例指某种方法的使用
patterns.domain: 生物医学、调查研究论文

patterns.name: 好处或正向评价词片段
patterns.context: 涉及宠物陪伴带来的益处，或透明导电材料的性能评价；触发位置并不完全一致
patterns.domain: 专利背景、材料科学论文

patterns.name: need 的词尾
patterns.context: 在描述化妆品配方需求上升的专利背景中出现

patterns.name: opportunity 的词内片段
patterns.context: 描述营销者拓展市场份额的可能机会

patterns.name: hope 的词内片段
patterns.context: 文学叙述中表达说话者的希望

en.description: Activation is concentrated most strongly on thought and its compounds; other sporadic cases occur with the + noun, loss/means, degree terms, and expressions such as doubt/hope, without forming a stable unified semantic pattern.

patterns.name: thought / mental process word family
patterns.context: The noun thought appears to mean an idea, thinking, or an opinion about something; it may be preceded by the, or occur in the be thought to construction.
patterns.domain: Emails, technical commentary, scientific papers, literary narratives

patterns.name: Definite article before abstract nouns
patterns.context: In the + noun phrase, activation falls on thought or the immediately adjacent the; this also occurs with several other abstract or common nouns.

patterns.name: Loss, difficulty, and coping
patterns.context: In contexts expressing uncertainty about how to handle a problem, changes in a disease, or ways to cope, activation falls on loss or means.

patterns.name: High degree or rate of change
patterns.context: Words near degree or comparative expressions activate when comparing or describing energy requirements or rates of aging.

patterns.name: Uncertainty or lack of confidence
patterns.context: Expresses doubt about a conclusion in scientific discussion, or continued hope for a theoretical explanation.

patterns.name: Ending in afterthought
patterns.context: The thought part of the compound afterthought is marked, describing a safety consideration treated as an afterthought.

6_692.description: 激活最集中于 thought（想法、判断、思考）及其复合词；其余零散出现在 the+名词、loss/means、程度词及 doubt/hope 等表达中，未形成稳定统一的语义模式。

patterns.name: thought / mental process 词族
patterns.context: 出现名词 thought，表示想法、思考或对某事的看法；前面可由 the 限定，也可与 be thought to 结构相连。
patterns.domain: 邮件、技术评论、科学论文、文学叙述

patterns.name: 抽象名词前的定冠词
patterns.context: 在 the + 名词短语中，激活落在 thought 或紧邻的 the；该现象还见于若干其他抽象或普通名词。

patterns.name: 损失、困境及应对
patterns.context: 在表达不知道如何处理问题、疾病变化或应对办法的语境中，激活落在 loss 或 means。

patterns.name: 高程度或高变化率
patterns.context: 比较或描述能量需求、老化速率时，程度/比较表达附近的词激活。

patterns.name: 不确定或缺乏把握
patterns.context: 科学论述中表达结论存疑，或对理论解释仍抱有期待。

patterns.name: afterthought 词尾
patterns.context: 复合词 afterthought 中 thought 部分被标记，描述某项安全考虑被视为事后补充。

en.concept: Abstract nouns and expressions of salience
en.description: Primarily responds to abstract concept nouns and their modifiers of scope or degree, especially thought, attention, fear, hope, and importance; also shows local activation on words or fixed expressions such as attention, pitfall, and groundwork in research contexts.

patterns.name: Determiners before abstract nouns
patterns.context: Activation concentrates on semantic nouns in noun phrases, especially thought, attention, fear, hope, and importance; they are often preceded by an article or possessive, and may also have degree modifiers.
patterns.domain: Fiction, emails, web pages, and research texts

patterns.name: Noun attention
patterns.context: attention is split into tokens and appears in the passive expression “attention is paid to”.

patterns.name: Implementation obstacle pitfall
patterns.context: pitfall means an implementation obstacle in “delivery remains a pitfall to practical implementation”; activation covers internal word fragments and neighboring content words.

patterns.name: Internal fragment of groundwork
patterns.context: groundwork is split into tokens and appears in the expression “lay the groundwork for”.

6_692.concept: 抽象名词及其显著性表达
6_692.description: 主要对抽象概念名词及其限定、程度修饰表达有反应，尤其是 thought、attention、fear、hope、importance；另对 attention、pitfall、groundwork 等科研语境中的词或固定搭配有局部激活。

patterns.name: 抽象名词前的限定词
patterns.trigger: «the»5« thought»10« and»2« attention»4；«the»6« thought»10；«the»4« thought»9；«my»6« hope»9；«utmost»9« importance»5；«bigger»2« fear»9
patterns.context: 激活集中在名词短语中的语义性名词，尤其是 thought、attention、fear、hope、importance；前面常有冠词或所有格，也可有程度修饰语。
patterns.domain: 小说、邮件、网页及科研文本

patterns.name: 名词 attention
patterns.context: attention 被拆分标记，位于被动表达“attention is paid to”中。

patterns.name: 实践障碍 pitfall
patterns.context: pitfall 在“delivery remains a pitfall to practical implementation”中，指实施障碍；激活覆盖词内部片段和邻近内容词。

patterns.name: groundwork 词内片段
patterns.context: groundwork 被拆分标记，出现在“lay the groundwork for”这一搭配中。

en.description: Strong activations occur on expressions of obstacles, confusion, ongoing need, research foundations, attention, and labor intensity; several examples are intra-word fragments. Some share the theme of problem or importance statements, but the trigger words are not uniform.

patterns.name: stumbling block phrase
patterns.context: When describing an obstacle faced by a method, product, or project, activation falls on the split “stumbling” fragment, followed by block(s).
patterns.domain: Patent background, technology news, medical abstracts

patterns.name: Expressions of confusion or seeking help
patterns.context: “I'm at a loss of how to...” expresses not knowing how to handle something; activation falls mainly on loss.

patterns.name: Attention/importance in problem and need statements
patterns.context: Technical descriptions state that an issue merits attention or that a technology has attracted research attention; activation falls on great and the following noun.

patterns.name: Ongoing need
patterns.context: Patent background notes that despite existing technology, an ongoing need remains; activation is concentrated on continuing.

patterns.name: Research foundations and groundwork
patterns.context: Research findings are described as helping to lay the groundwork for later understanding or work; activation is concentrated on split fragments of groundwork.

patterns.name: Description of labor-intensive work
patterns.context: Describes ground operations as time-consuming and labor-intensive; activation is concentrated on labor.

patterns.name: Local intra-word activation in a verb
patterns.context: In a sentence about a surgical approach leveraging the advantages of traditional laparoscopy, strong activation is on the initial fragment of capitalizes; its semantic connection to other patterns is unclear.

6_692.description: 强激活分布于障碍、困惑、持续需求、研究基础、关注度及劳动强度等表达；若干例子是词内片段，部分共同呈现问题或重要性陈述，但触发词并不统一。

patterns.name: stumbling block 短语
patterns.context: 在描述方法、产品或项目面临的障碍时，激活落在被拆分的“stumbling”词段上；后接 block(s)。
patterns.domain: 专利背景、科技新闻、医学摘要

patterns.name: 困惑或求助表达
patterns.context: “I'm at a loss of how to...”表达不知道如何处理某事；激活主要落在 loss。

patterns.name: 问题与需求陈述中的关注/重要性
patterns.context: 在技术描述中说明某议题值得关注，或某技术受到研究关注；激活落在 great 及其后续名词。

patterns.name: 需求持续存在
patterns.context: 专利背景中指出尽管已有技术，仍存在持续需求；激活集中于 continuing。

patterns.name: 研究基础与奠基
patterns.context: 研究成果被描述为有助于为后续理解或工作奠定基础；激活集中于 groundwork 的拆分词段。

patterns.name: 密集劳动描述
patterns.context: 描述地面操作耗时且劳动密集；激活集中于 labor。

patterns.name: 动词词内局部激活
patterns.context: 出现在手术方式利用传统腹腔镜优势的句子中，强激活位于 capitalizes 的词首片段；与其他模式的语义联系不明确。

en.description: Primarily responds to the obstacle expression “stumbling block(s)”; it also responds to foundation-setting phrases, public health problem statements, the conjectural “Odds are,” and the “tip of the iceberg” metaphor, covering fixed expressions with varied meanings and collocations.

patterns.name: “stumbling block” expression
patterns.context: The phrase means an obstacle, difficulty, or factor impeding progress; it functions as a problem or hindrance in a noun phrase or sentence
patterns.domain: Forum discussions, patent background, medical abstracts, historical accounts

patterns.name: “the … foundation”
patterns.context: In the “lay the … foundation for” structure, describes research laying a foundation for future development

patterns.name: Health problem statement
patterns.context: In public health statements, describes a disease or health condition as a major problem
patterns.domain: Public health relevance abstracts for NIH projects

patterns.name: Odds expression
patterns.context: At the beginning of a sentence, “Odds are that …” expresses a conjecture or likelihood

patterns.name: Laying the foundation/groundwork
patterns.context: Describes how a type of understanding or research provides a basis for subsequent understanding, prevention, or development

patterns.name: Tip of the iceberg
patterns.context: In the metaphorical expression “the tip of the iceberg”, implies that the content mentioned is only a small part of a larger whole

6_692.description: 主要响应障碍表达“stumbling block(s)”；也响应奠基短语、公共卫生问题表述、推测用“Odds are”及“冰山一角”比喻，涉及语义与搭配各异的固定表达。

patterns.name: “stumbling block”表达
patterns.context: 该短语表示障碍、难题或妨碍进展的因素；在名词短语或句子中作问题／阻碍
patterns.domain: 论坛讨论、专利背景、医学摘要、历史叙述

patterns.name: “the … foundation”
patterns.context: “lay the … foundation for”结构中，说明研究为后续发展奠定基础

patterns.name: 健康问题表述
patterns.context: 公共卫生相关陈述中，描述疾病或健康状况构成重大问题
patterns.domain: NIH项目的公共健康相关性摘要

patterns.name: 赔率表达
patterns.context: 句首以“Odds are that …”表达推测或可能性

patterns.name: 奠定基础／groundwork
patterns.context: 说明某种理解或研究为后续认识、预防或开发提供基础

patterns.name: 冰山一角
patterns.context: 在比喻表达“the tip of the iceberg”中，暗示已提及内容只是更大整体的一小部分

en.description: Activation is concentrated mainly in two types of expressions: split-written “stumbling block(s)” meaning an obstacle, and “lay/laid the foundation, groundwork, basis” meaning to establish a foundation. It also responds strongly to “Odds are” in forum contexts.

patterns.name: “stumbling block” expression
patterns.context: Expresses that something constitutes an obstacle or difficulty; the words may be split across tokens, and the preceding text usually describes a solution, method, or issue.
patterns.domain: Academic abstracts, patent background, forum discussions, Wikipedia entries

patterns.name: “lay the foundation/groundwork/basis” expression
patterns.context: States that research or a project will lay the foundation for subsequent development, understanding, or improvement.

patterns.name: odds collocation
patterns.context: “Odds are that…” introduces a conjecture about an outcome; activation is concentrated on split odds.

6_692.description: 激活主要集中于两类表达：拆分书写的“stumbling block(s)”表示障碍；“lay/laid the foundation、groundwork、basis”表示奠定基础。另在论坛语境中，对“Odds are”也有强响应。

patterns.name: “stumbling block”表达
patterns.context: 表达某事物构成障碍或困难；词语可跨 token 拆分，前文通常说明方案、方法或议题。
patterns.domain: 学术摘要、专利背景、论坛讨论、维基条目

patterns.name: “lay the foundation/groundwork/basis”表达
patterns.trigger: « laid»/« lay» + « the» + foundation、groundwork 或 basis；如 «lay»2« the»9« chemical»6« foundation»7、«lay»2« the»9« ground»5« work»7
patterns.context: 陈述研究或项目将为后续发展、理解或改进奠定基础。

patterns.name: odds 搭配
patterns.context: 以“Odds are that…”引出对某种结果的推测；激活集中在拆分的 odds。

en.description: The strongest shared pattern is the trigger phrase “stumbling block,” used for obstacles or controversies in different domains; other activations are scattered across expressions of urgent need, economic challenges, chemical foundations, research prospects, influencing factors, and personal experience.

patterns.name: stumbling block
patterns.context: The phrase “stumbling block” appears in descriptions of problems, obstacles, or controversies; paragraph 2 refers to obstacles to oral vaccine development, paragraph 3 to mass production and cost issues, paragraph 6 to obstacles in Uber’s pricing scheme, and paragraph 10 to obstacles in a discussion of political unity.
patterns.domain: Biomedical research, patent background, online forums, historical narrative

patterns.name: pressing need
patterns.context: “pressing” emphasizes that a need is urgent; here it appears with “seemingly intractable needs.”

patterns.name: financial challenge
patterns.context: Describes the financial burden that expensive testing places on laboratories.

patterns.name: chemical foundation
patterns.context: In discussions of metabolite research and new biological development, refers to a chemical foundation for subsequent work.

patterns.name: great promise
patterns.context: Evaluates cartilage-repair research as having potential to lead to improved cell therapies; activation falls on the positive prospect expression “great promise.”

patterns.name: part of
patterns.context: When discussing introductory tools, a forum user notes that familiarity is one factor affecting the onboarding experience.

patterns.name: Personal experience statement
patterns.context: A forum user discusses personal experience making a living by working with Linux; no other clear shared trigger phrase appears in the passage.

6_692.description: 最强共同模式是触发短语“stumbling block”，用于不同领域的障碍或争议；其余激活分散在迫切需求、经济挑战、化学基础、研究前景、影响因素及个人经历等表达上。

patterns.name: stumbling block
patterns.context: 短语 “stumbling block” 出现在问题、阻碍或争议的描述中；第 2 段指口服疫苗开发障碍，第 3 段指量产和成本问题，第 6 段指 Uber 定价方案的障碍，第 10 段指政治团结讨论中的障碍。
patterns.domain: 生物医学、专利背景、网络论坛、历史叙述

patterns.name: pressing need
patterns.context: “pressing” 强调某种需求迫切；此处与“看似无法解决的需求”连用。
patterns.domain: 专利背景／技术问题陈述

patterns.name: financial challenge
patterns.context: 形容高成本检测给实验室带来的经济负担。

patterns.name: chemical foundation
patterns.context: 在介绍代谢物研究及新生物学开发时，指其为后续发展的化学基础。
patterns.domain: NIH 项目摘要／生物化学

patterns.name: great promise
patterns.context: 评价软骨修复研究成果有望转化为改进细胞治疗；激活落在“great promise”这一正向前景表达上。

patterns.name: part of
patterns.context: 论坛用户讨论入门工具时，指出熟悉程度是影响上手体验的一个因素。

patterns.name: 个人经历陈述
patterns.context: 论坛用户谈及靠 Linux 工作谋生的个人经历；该段未见其他明显共享触发词。

en.description: Activation often falls on English articles and the noun phrases that follow, especially collocations expressing a role, foundation, degree, or threshold; it also covers fixed expressions for dilemmas, obstacles, and urgent needs, across forum, academic, legal, and patent corpora.

patterns.name: Causal role or contribution
patterns.context: Explains how a factor affects an outcome, phenomenon, or judgment; “plays a ... part/role” is common, with a degree or evaluative word sometimes inserted.
patterns.domain: Forum discussions, popular science, and academic abstracts

patterns.name: Foundation, role, or development
patterns.context: Discusses research findings or technical factors providing a foundation for subsequent work or development, or playing a key role.

patterns.name: Reaching a degree or threshold
patterns.context: Describes something reaching a certain degree, level, or legal threshold; common structures include “to the level” or “to some extent”.

patterns.name: Article and noun phrase in fixed expressions
patterns.context: Activation is concentrated on the article and following elements in idiomatic or metaphorical noun phrases expressing a dilemma or obstacle.

patterns.name: Expression of urgent need
patterns.context: Uses “there is a pressing … need” to emphasize an unmet urgent need.

6_692.description: 激活常落在英语冠词及其后名词短语上，尤其是表示作用、基础、程度或门槛的搭配；也覆盖两难、障碍和迫切需求等固定表达，跨论坛、学术、法律与专利语料。

patterns.name: 因果作用或贡献
patterns.context: 说明某因素对结果、现象或判断起作用；常见于“plays a ... part/role”，程度或评价词可插入其中。
patterns.domain: 论坛讨论、科普与学术摘要

patterns.name: 基础、作用或发展
patterns.trigger: «the»10« chemical»5« foundation»7；«laying»3« the»10« ground»4«work»6；«played»2« a»10« decisive»7« role»2
patterns.context: 谈研究成果、技术因素为后续工作或发展提供基础，或发挥关键作用。
patterns.domain: 生物医学摘要、专利背景

patterns.name: 达到某种程度或门槛
patterns.context: 描述某事达到一定程度、层级或法律门槛；常见结构为“to the level”或“to some extent”。

patterns.name: 固定搭配中的冠词与名词短语
patterns.trigger: «the»5« horns»7« of»7« a»10« dilemma»4；«a»4« st»3«umbling»10« block»4
patterns.context: 激活集中在习语或隐喻性名词短语中的冠词及其后续成分，分别表达两难和障碍。

patterns.name: 迫切需求的表达
patterns.context: 用“there is a pressing … need”强调尚未满足的迫切需求。

en.description: The activation pattern is mainly composed of several fixed collocations, idioms, and local phrases, including a dilemma, obstacles, laying a foundation, touchscreen operation, and the tip of the iceberg; other scattered patterns include patent load descriptions, social-network abbreviations, line-break continuations, and characters in medical tables, with no unified semantics apparent.

patterns.name: Fixed expression “horns of a dilemma”
patterns.context: In legal reasoning, describes being caught in a dilemma if the opposite conclusion is adopted; activation is concentrated on the article, preposition, and core words of the phrase

patterns.name: Line-break boundary and continuation
patterns.context: Activation markers appear near a line break and the word continuing after it; the subsequent content itself is inconsistent

patterns.name: Idiom “stumbling block”
patterns.context: Means an obstacle or impediment; triggers span subword fragments and are used in business commentary and political-historical narratives

patterns.name: Tool-rope and load description
patterns.context: Describes workers raising and lowering tools with a rope, and the load that heavy tools place on the rope

patterns.name: Chemical foundation and development phrasing
patterns.context: In a bioactive-molecule research abstract, describes the research as laying a chemical foundation for subsequent development

patterns.name: Phrase n/w
patterns.context: An informal abbreviation for an online service or website in a social-network context

patterns.name: Touchscreen button operation
patterns.context: Asks about completing an operation with a single button tap, specifically confirming an email send

patterns.name: Tip of the iceberg metaphor
patterns.context: Uses “tip of the iceberg” to indicate that a larger problem lies behind the visible phenomenon

patterns.name: Table fields and anomalous characters
patterns.context: Blank/special spaces, abbreviations, and variant annotations in pathology or genetic-testing tables; triggers are sporadic

6_692.description: 激活模式以若干固定搭配、熟语及局部短语为主，包括两难、障碍、奠基、触屏操作和冰山一角；另有专利负载描述、社交网络缩写、换行续接及医学表格字符等分散模式，未见统一语义。

patterns.name: “horns of a dilemma”固定表达
patterns.context: 法律论证中，描述若采取相反结论将陷入两难；激活集中在冠词、介词及短语核心词

patterns.name: 换行边界与续接
patterns.context: 激活标记出现在换行符及其后续接词附近，后续内容本身并不一致

patterns.name: 熟语“stumbling block”
patterns.context: 表示阻碍或障碍；触发跨词片段，分别用于商业评论和政治历史叙述

patterns.name: 工具绳索与负载描述
patterns.trigger: « workers»« on»« l»«add»«ers»；« raise»« and»；« a»« significant»« load»
patterns.context: 描述工人用绳索升降工具，以及重工具给绳索带来的负荷

patterns.name: 化学基础与发展表述
patterns.trigger: « laid»« the»« chemical»« foundation»；« the»« development»
patterns.context: 生物活性分子研究摘要中，描述研究为后续开发奠定化学基础

patterns.name: 短语 n/w
patterns.context: 社交网络语境中对网络服务或网站的非正式缩写

patterns.name: 触屏按钮操作
patterns.trigger: « at»« the»« touch»« of»« a»« button»
patterns.context: 询问以一次按钮触碰完成操作，具体为确认发送邮件

patterns.name: 冰山一角隐喻
patterns.context: 用冰山一角表示可见现象背后还有更大问题

patterns.name: 表格字段与异常字符
patterns.context: 病理或基因检测表格中的空白/特殊空格、缩写及变异标注；触发较零散

en.concept: English fixed expressions and phrase continuations
en.description: Primarily activates on foundation words (foundation, groundwork, basis) following “the” in expressions introduced by lay/laid; it also responds to several fixed expressions and local phrases such as “a huge problem”.

patterns.name: lay the foundation/groundwork
patterns.context: The verb lay/laid is followed by the, then foundation, groundwork, or basis; often used to explain how research, a project, or a paper lays the foundation for later work.
patterns.domain: Research abstracts, medical and mental health research, theoretical papers

patterns.name: go like crazy
patterns.context: “going” is followed by “on like crazy”, describing something continuing or happening in large amounts.

patterns.name: at the touch of a button
patterns.context: Fixed expression meaning an operation can be completed with the press of a button.

patterns.name: horns of a dilemma
patterns.context: Fixed idiom appearing after “place us on”, describing being caught in a dilemma.

patterns.name: a huge problem
patterns.context: After the verb pose, “a huge problem” refers to a serious problem; this example concerns intellectual property infringement.

6_692.concept: 英语固定搭配与短语续接
6_692.description: 主要对“the”后接抽象基础词（foundation、groundwork、basis）且由 lay/laid 引出的奠基表达激活；另对若干固定搭配及“a huge problem”等局部短语有响应。

patterns.name: lay the foundation/groundwork
patterns.trigger: “lay the foundation” / “laid the groundwork” / “lay the basis”
patterns.context: 动词 lay/laid 后接 the，再接 foundation、groundwork 或 basis；常用于说明研究、项目或论文为后续工作奠基。
patterns.domain: 科研摘要、医学与心理健康研究、理论论文

patterns.name: go like crazy
patterns.context: “going”后接“on like crazy”，描述某事持续或大量发生。

patterns.name: at the touch of a button
patterns.context: 固定表达，表示只需按一下按钮即可完成操作。

patterns.name: horns of a dilemma
patterns.context: 固定习语，出现在“place us on”之后，描述陷入两难。

patterns.name: a huge problem
patterns.context: 动词 pose 后以 a huge problem 指称严重问题；此例谈知识产权侵权。
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会发言、政策讨论

en.concept: Foundation phrasing and a few local collocations
en.description: Primarily responds to expressions of “laying the foundation” for subsequent work formed by lay/laid and the foundation, groundwork, or basis; it also responds to the tip-of-the-iceberg metaphor and “significant load on the cord” in a patent context.

patterns.name: lay/laid + foundation
patterns.context: After research, a project, or a result, indicates laying the foundation for subsequent research, application, or development; word order may be lay/laid the foundation(s) for/of

patterns.name: lay + groundwork
patterns.context: Research or research results prepare the way for subsequent analysis, understanding, or research

patterns.name: lay + basis
patterns.context: A paper or derivation establishes a basis for subsequent improvement

patterns.name: tip of the iceberg
patterns.context: Fixed metaphor indicating that what is currently visible is only a small part of a larger problem or phenomenon
patterns.domain: Explanatory expression in a theoretical paper

patterns.name: significant load on cord
patterns.context: Describes the load placed on a rope when workers raise and lower tools

6_692.concept: 奠基表达及少数局部搭配
6_692.description: 主要响应 lay/laid 与 the foundation、groundwork 或 basis 构成的“为后续工作奠基”表达；另响应 tip of the iceberg 比喻及专利语境中的 significant load on the cord。

patterns.name: lay/laid + foundation
patterns.trigger: «lay»« the»« foundation»；«laid»« the»« foundation»；«lay»« the»« chemical»« foundation»
patterns.context: 在研究、项目或成果之后，表示为后续研究、应用或开发奠定基础；词序可为 lay/laid the foundation(s) for/of

patterns.name: lay + groundwork
patterns.context: 研究或研究结果为后续分析、理解或研究作准备

patterns.name: lay + basis
patterns.context: 论文或推导为后续改进建立依据

patterns.name: tip of the iceberg
patterns.context: 固定比喻，表示当前所见只是更大问题或现象的一小部分
patterns.domain: 理论论文中的说明性表达

patterns.name: significant load on cord
patterns.context: 描述工人用绳索升降工具时绳索承受的负荷

en.description: Primarily activates on the foundation-setting collocation “lay the foundation/groundwork/basis”, especially in research contexts; it also responds to several fixed expressions: shoot yourself in the foot, scratch my head, stand in tension, and tip of the iceberg.

patterns.name: lay the foundation/groundwork/basis
patterns.context: Uses lay as the verb, followed by “the foundation/groundwork/basis”, meaning to establish a basis for subsequent research, analysis, or development; the related words are strongly marked across examples.
patterns.domain: Research abstracts, project applications, academic papers

patterns.name: shooting yourself in the foot
patterns.context: Fixed idiom meaning to harm yourself through your own actions; here it concerns website design not based on actual usage data.

patterns.name: Head-scratching expression of confusion
patterns.context: An idiom expressing confusion about how to solve a programming problem.

patterns.name: stands in tension
patterns.context: Uses “stand in tension with” to express tension between a theoretical position and its philosophical or theological foundation.

patterns.name: tip of a bigger iceberg
patterns.context: Fixed metaphor meaning that what is visible is only a small part of a larger problem.
patterns.domain: Explanatory expression in theoretical physics papers

6_692.description: 主要激活于“lay the foundation/groundwork/basis”这一奠基搭配，尤见科研语境；另对若干固定表达也有反应：shoot yourself in the foot、scratch my head、stand in tension、tip of the iceberg。

patterns.name: lay the foundation/groundwork/basis
patterns.context: 以“lay”作动词，后接“the foundation/groundwork/basis”，表示为后续研究、分析或发展奠定基础；各段中相关词被强烈标记。
patterns.domain: 科研摘要、项目申请、学术论文

patterns.name: shooting yourself in the foot
patterns.context: 固定习语，表示因自身做法而损害自己；此处谈网站设计时未依据实际使用数据。

patterns.name: 抓耳挠腮式困惑
patterns.context: 习语表达对如何解决编程问题感到困惑。

patterns.name: stands in tension
patterns.context: 用“stand in tension with”表达一种理论立场与哲学、神学基础之间的张力。

patterns.name: tip of a bigger iceberg
patterns.context: 固定比喻，表示所见只是更大问题的一小部分。
patterns.domain: 理论物理论文中的说明性表达

en.description: Primarily responds to key fragments in English fixed collocations or idiomatic expressions: confusion, counterproductive actions, the tip of the iceberg, laying a foundation, conflicting views, and judging based on evidence; it also responds to technical paths and slash forms.

patterns.name: Head-scratching confusion
patterns.context: “scratching” is followed by a possessive and “head,” expressing confusion or difficulty understanding;

patterns.name: Metaphor for shooting oneself in the foot
patterns.context: Uses “shooting oneself in the foot” to describe doing something counterproductive;

patterns.name: Tip of the iceberg
patterns.context: Fixed metaphor indicating that the part revealed is only a small part of a larger whole;

patterns.name: Lay the foundation
patterns.context: “laid” is followed by “foundation” or “groundwork,” referring to establishing a basis for subsequent work;

patterns.name: In tension
patterns.context: “stands in” collocates with “tension” to describe conflict between views or theories;

patterns.name: Betting one’s judgment
patterns.context: Fixed expression which, in a negative context, indicates unwillingness to make a judgment based only on a piece of evidence;

patterns.name: Slash and path fragments
patterns.context: Slashes occur in technical paths, URLs, or abbreviations; this passage is especially concentrated in URL paths and their identifiers;

6_692.concept: 英语惯用搭配与技术斜杠
6_692.description: 主要响应英语固定搭配或惯用表达中的关键片段：困惑、适得其反、冰山一角、奠基、观点冲突及凭据判断；另对技术路径和斜杠形式有反应。

patterns.name: 抓耳挠头式困惑
patterns.context: “scratching”后接物主代词和“head”，表达困惑或难以理解；

patterns.name: 自食其果的比喻
patterns.context: 用“shooting oneself in the foot”比喻做出适得其反的行为；

patterns.name: 冰山一角
patterns.context: 固定比喻，表示显露的部分只是更大整体的一小部分；

patterns.name: 奠定基础
patterns.context: “laid”后接“foundation”或“groundwork”，指为后续工作建立基础；

patterns.name: 处于张力之中
patterns.context: “stands in”与“tension”搭配，描述观点或学说之间的冲突；

patterns.name: 押上自己的判断
patterns.context: 固定表达，否定语境中表示不愿仅凭某证据下判断；

patterns.name: 斜杠及路径片段
patterns.context: 斜杠出现在技术路径、网址或缩写中；该段尤其集中于网址路径及其标识符；

en.concept: English fixed expressions and local word forms
en.description: Activation is distributed across several fixed expressions and word forms: head-scratching, tip of the iceberg, cornerstone, bear the loss, lay the foundation(s), a huge amount, the & in AT&T, and a lot; there is no single stable triggering semantics.

patterns.name: “scratching my head” idiom
patterns.context: The fixed expression “scratching one’s head over/about this” means being confused; the trigger is concentrated on head and the preceding scratching.

patterns.name: Iceberg collocation
patterns.context: In “the tip of the iceberg”, tip/of/the before iceberg and iceberg itself activate.

patterns.name: Intra-word fragment in cornerstone
patterns.context: Plural cornerstone(s) occurs in medical discussion, with activation concentrated on the initial corner.

patterns.name: bear the loss collocation
patterns.context: A phrase assigning responsibility, “bear the loss”, in legal analysis; the is the strongest activation position.

patterns.name: lay the foundation(s) collocation
patterns.context: The structure “laid the … foundation(s) for development”; the and related forms of foundation co-occur, with or without a modifier.

patterns.name: a huge amount collocation
patterns.context: Quantity expression “a huge amount of attention”.

patterns.name: Symbol in the name AT&T
patterns.context: The & symbol activates in the company name AT&T; surrounding discussion concerns antitrust litigation.

patterns.name: a lot collocation
patterns.context: The quantity expression “paid a lot”; activation falls on the article a and lot.

6_692.concept: 英语固定搭配与局部词形
6_692.description: 激活分散于若干固定搭配及词形：挠头、tip of the iceberg、cornerstone、bear the loss、lay the foundation(s)、a huge amount、AT&T 的 &、a lot；没有单一稳定触发语义。

patterns.name: “scratching my head”习语
patterns.context: 固定表达“scratching one’s head over/about this”，表示困惑；触发点集中在 head 及前面的 scratching

patterns.name: iceberg 固定搭配
patterns.context: “the tip of the iceberg”中 iceberg 前的 tip/of/the 及 iceberg 本身激活

patterns.name: cornerstone 词内片段
patterns.context: 医学论述中出现复数 cornerstone(s)，激活集中在词首 corner

patterns.name: bear the loss 搭配
patterns.context: 法律分析中“bear the loss”责任归属表达，the 是最强激活位置

patterns.name: lay the foundation(s) 搭配
patterns.context: “laid the … foundation(s) for development”结构，the 与 foundation 相关词共同出现；修饰语可有可无

patterns.name: a huge amount 搭配
patterns.context: “a huge amount of attention”数量表达

patterns.name: AT&T 名称中的符号
patterns.context: 公司名称 AT&T 中，& 符号激活；周边讨论涉及反垄断诉讼

patterns.name: a lot 搭配
patterns.context: “paid a lot”数量表达，激活落在冠词 a 和 lot

en.description: Activations are mostly concentrated on noun heads in idiomatic collocations or fixed phrases: groundwork, foundation, basis, cornerstones, head (scratch one’s head), as well as gun (jump the gun) and hard part. The contexts and registers of the patterns differ.

patterns.name: Fixed collocations ending in noun phrases
patterns.context: The trigger word occurs after the definite article the, forming idiomatic noun phrases such as “lay the groundwork/foundation/basis for” and “the cornerstones of”; activation is mainly on the noun head or a compound fragment.
patterns.domain: Research abstracts, medical papers, theoretical physics, and clinical guidelines

patterns.name: Head in a fixed phrase
patterns.context: In “scratch one’s head over this,” activation is concentrated on head; it occurs with different pronouns and sentence structures.
patterns.domain: Q&A, forum discussions, and online comments

patterns.name: Gun in a fixed expression
patterns.context: Gun occurs in the idiom “jump the gun,” preceded by the; no other clear shared trigger appears in this passage.
patterns.domain: Online articles, product or service coverage

patterns.name: Hard in a phrase describing a difficult stage
patterns.context: Hard part refers to the more difficult aspect of a task; the trigger is concentrated on the final word, part.

6_692.concept: 惯用短语中的名词核心
6_692.description: 激活多集中在惯用搭配或固定短语的名词核心：groundwork、foundation、basis、cornerstones，head（scratch one’s head），以及 gun（jump the gun）和 hard part。各模式的语境与文体不同。

patterns.name: 名词短语中的固定搭配收尾词
patterns.context: 触发词出现在定冠词 the 后，构成惯用名词短语，如“lay the groundwork/foundation/basis for”和“the cornerstones of”；强度主要落在名词核心词或复合词片段上。
patterns.domain: 科研摘要、医学论文、理论物理及临床指南

patterns.name: 固定短语中的 head
patterns.context: “scratch one’s head over this”中，激活集中于 head；不同代词和句子结构下均出现。
patterns.domain: 问答、论坛讨论及网络评论

patterns.name: 固定表达中的 gun
patterns.context: gun 位于成语“jump the gun”中，前有 the；该段未见明显共享的其他触发词。
patterns.domain: 网络文章、产品或服务报道

patterns.name: 描述困难阶段的 hard
patterns.context: hard part 表示任务中较困难的环节，触发集中于短语末尾 part。

en.description: Primarily responds to relational or key words in idioms and fixed collocations, especially expressions involving a head, emotional reactions, and problems emerging; also found in collocations such as gold standard, proverbial cracks, and play its part, as well as line breaks and separators in a code/URL segment.

patterns.name: Fixed idioms and emotional expressions
patterns.context: Expressing confusion, anger, or dissatisfaction about a problem or controversy; activation concentrates on body-part or emotional-expression words in idioms, such as “scratching”, “head”, “crying”, “blood”, “up”, and “wrong way”
patterns.domain: HackerNews and StackExchange posts and comments

patterns.name: Plural possessive phrases with body parts
patterns.context: Variants of the “rear … head(s)” idiom, referring to a problem or phenomenon appearing again; activation falls on words such as “their”, “collective”, and “heads”

patterns.name: “gold standard” collocation
patterns.context: Indicating that a method or technology is an authoritative benchmark; activation concentrates on “gold”

patterns.name: Fixed expression “through the proverbial cracks”
patterns.context: Describing something being overlooked or missed; activation falls on the idiom segment “through the proverbial 'cracks'”

patterns.name: Code markup and path separators
patterns.context: Occurs when HTML/Apex markup is adjacent to a URL path; activation falls on line breaks and several punctuation marks and path fragments

patterns.name: Collocations with “part”
patterns.context: Indicating in a political context that a party should play a role; activation falls on “its” and “part”

patterns.name: “part” in everyday collocations
patterns.context: Indicating another important component of a problem or solution; activation is distributed across the article, adjective, and “part”

6_692.description: 主要响应习语和固定搭配中的关系词或关键词，尤其是涉及 head、情绪反应与问题出现的表达；另见 gold standard、proverbial cracks、play its part 等搭配，以及一段代码/URL中的换行和分隔符。

patterns.name: 固定习语与情绪化表达
patterns.trigger: “scratching their head” / “scratching my head over this”；“crying for blood”；“rub[s] me up the wrong way”
patterns.context: 对问题或争议表示困惑、愤怒、不满；激活集中在习语中的身体部位或情绪表达词，如“scratching”“head”“crying”“blood”“up”“wrong way”

patterns.name: body parts 的复数所有格短语
patterns.context: “rear … head(s)”习语的变体，指某种问题或现象再次出现；激活落在“their”“collective”“heads”等词

patterns.name: gold standard 搭配
patterns.context: 说明某方法或技术是权威基准；激活集中在“gold”

patterns.name: through the proverbial cracks 固定表达
patterns.context: 描述某事被忽视、遗漏；激活落在“through the proverbial 'cracks'”这一习语片段

patterns.name: 代码标记与路径分隔符
patterns.trigger: “<apex:pageBlockSection …>”中的换行符，以及“drive.google.com/drive/folders/…”中的“.”、“/”和数字
patterns.context: HTML/Apex 标记与 URL 路径相邻时出现；激活落在换行和若干标点、路径片段

patterns.name: part 的搭配
patterns.context: 政治语境中表示某方应发挥作用；激活落在“its”“part”
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会正式辩论文本

patterns.name: 日常固定搭配中的 part
patterns.context: 说明某个问题或方案的另一重要组成部分；激活分布于冠词、形容词与“part”

en.concept: Salient words in idioms and collocations
en.description: Activations often fall on keywords or body-part words in idioms, fixed collocations, and evaluative expressions; they also occur in time- and difficulty-related expressions and sporadic within-word fragments. Triggers are not fully consistent across passages.

patterns.name: Body parts in fixed collocations
patterns.context: Activation is concentrated on body-part words and nearby elements in idioms or fixed expressions; the expressions may convey confusion, indifference, aversion, or the reappearance of a problem
patterns.domain: Online comments, personal narratives, sports writing

patterns.name: Second halves of fixed collocations or idiomatic expressions
patterns.context: In common idioms, phrases, or collocations, activation falls on key content words or components of the expression; sometimes it involves participles, nouns, and prepositions
patterns.domain: Blogs, news, commentary, and forum text

patterns.name: Phrases expressing difficulty or challenge
patterns.context: Occurs in evaluative phrases describing problems, operational difficulties, or negative feelings

patterns.name: Time- or waiting-related collocations
patterns.context: Related to waiting, duration, or expectations about how long something will take; examples in this pattern are few

patterns.name: Evaluative tone and social reactions
patterns.context: Comments evaluatively on people’s attitudes, taste, or institutional behavior; activations do not always fall on the same type of word

patterns.name: Activation on participles or within-word fragments
patterns.context: Markers fall on subword fragments within words, possibly influenced by tokenization; the semantic trigger is unclear
patterns.domain: News, technical, sports, and game text

patterns.name: Weak collocations or numerals nearby
patterns.context: Occurs sporadically near ordinary phrases, numeric expressions, or high-frequency function words, making it difficult to identify an independent semantic condition

6_692.concept: 习语与搭配中的显著词
6_692.description: 激活常落在习语、固定搭配和评价性表达的关键词或身体部位词上，也见于时间、难度及零散词内片段；不同段间触发并不完全一致。

patterns.name: 固定搭配中的身体部位
patterns.context: 激活集中在习语或固定表达中的身体部位词及其邻近成分；表达可为困惑、毫不在意、惹人反感或问题再现
patterns.domain: 网络评论、个人叙述、体育文字

patterns.name: 固定搭配或惯用表达的后半段
patterns.context: 在常见习语、短语或搭配中，激活落在表达的关键实词或组成部分；有时涉及分词、名词与介词
patterns.domain: 博客、新闻、评论及论坛文字

patterns.name: 表达困难或挑战的短语
patterns.context: 出现在描述问题、操作难点或负面感受的评价性短语中

patterns.name: 时间或等待相关搭配
patterns.context: 与等待、耗时或对持续时间的预期有关；本模式例子较少

patterns.name: 语气评价与社交反应
patterns.context: 对人的态度、品味或机构行为作带评价色彩的评论，激活并不总落在同一类词上

patterns.name: 分词或词内片段被激活
patterns.context: 标记落在单词内部的子词片段，可能受分词方式影响；语义触发并不明确
patterns.domain: 新闻、技术、体育及游戏文字

patterns.name: 弱搭配或数词邻接
patterns.context: 零散出现在普通短语、数字表达或高频功能词附近，难以确定独立语义条件

en.description: Activation primarily falls on English idioms, fixed collocations, and reminders or evaluative expressions, often covering key parts of multiword phrases; there is also a localized response to the abbreviation i.e. The semantic topics of the passages are diverse.

patterns.name: Idiom “scratch one’s head over”
patterns.context: Using scratch one’s head over + a problem/this to express confusion or puzzlement; pronouns and singular/plural variants may occur in between.

patterns.name: Idiom “the icing on the cake”
patterns.context: A fixed expression followed by an addition or emphasis concerning the preceding experience.

patterns.name: Idiom “bat an eyelash”
patterns.context: In a negative sentence, indicating complete indifference or lack of reaction; the original is “did not bat an eyelash”.

patterns.name: Idiom “sound the alarm”
patterns.context: Using an alarm metaphorically to indicate warning of a risk.

patterns.name: Idiom “jump the gun”
patterns.context: Describing a service or participant acting ahead of others; here it is “was the first to jump the gun”.

patterns.name: Idiom “ugly head(s)”
patterns.context: Used with “rear ... head(s)” to refer to an unwelcome problem or phenomenon appearing again.

patterns.name: Idiomatic collocation “viewed with awe”
patterns.context: Describing observers’ awe or amazement at someone’s wide-ranging interests.

patterns.name: Abbreviation explanation “i.e.”
patterns.context: Used to explain what came before, equivalent to “that is”; the marker falls within the abbreviation and may be a localized response to that character sequence.

patterns.name: Reminder “Bear in mind”
patterns.context: A sentence-initial reminder for readers to consider a background condition.

patterns.name: Evaluative collocation “a great service”
patterns.context: In “doing us a great service”, indicating that an action benefits the public.

6_692.description: 激活主要落在英语固定习语、惯用搭配及提醒或评价语上，常覆盖多词短语的关键部分；另有对 i.e. 缩写的局部响应。各段语义主题分散。

patterns.name: 习语“scratch one’s head over”
patterns.context: 以 scratch one’s head over + 问题/this，表示困惑或苦思；中间可有代词与单复数变体。

patterns.name: 习语“the icing on the cake”
patterns.context: 固定表达，后接对前述经历的补充或强调。

patterns.name: 习语“bat an eyelash”
patterns.context: 否定句中表示毫不在意或毫无反应，原文为“did not bat an eyelash”。

patterns.name: 习语“sound the alarm”
patterns.context: 用警报作比喻，表示对某种风险发出警告。

patterns.name: 习语“jump the gun”
patterns.context: 描述某个服务或参与者抢先行动；此处为“was the first to jump the gun”。

patterns.name: 习语“ugly head(s)”
patterns.context: 与“rear ... head(s)”搭配，指不受欢迎的问题或现象再次出现。

patterns.name: 惯用搭配“viewed with awe”
patterns.context: 描述旁观者对某人广泛兴趣的敬畏或惊叹。
patterns.domain: 学术人物介绍、文化评论

patterns.name: 缩写释义“i.e.”
patterns.context: 用于解释前文，等同于“that is”；标记落在缩写内部，可能是对该字符序列的局部响应。

patterns.name: “Bear in mind”提醒语
patterns.context: 句首提醒读者考虑某项背景条件。

patterns.name: “a great service”评价搭配
patterns.context: “doing us a great service”中表示某行动对公众有益。

en.description: Primarily activates contiguous words in English idioms and fixed collocations, such as collective emergence, confusion, waiting, aversion, lack of surprise, and laying the groundwork; there are also a few ordinary words and boundary tokens with activations that do not admit a unified explanation.

patterns.name: Idiomatic expression with “collective” + a group body part
patterns.context: A group or city is portrayed as a whole, followed by collective and a body part, expressing the collective emergence of a phenomenon or a group reaction.

patterns.name: Confusion expression “scratching one’s head”
patterns.context: The idiom scratch the/one’s head, often followed by over this, expressing confusion about something.

patterns.name: Fixed collocation “lay the foundation”
patterns.context: lay the foundation for followed by the basis for a plan or subsequent work.
patterns.domain: Research project and study plan texts

patterns.name: Fixed collocation “biding our time”
patterns.context: bide one’s time, describing waiting temporarily for the right moment.

patterns.name: Aversion expression “rub me up the wrong way”
patterns.context: The idiom rub someone up the wrong way, meaning to annoy or offend someone.

patterns.name: Evaluative collocation “a great service”
patterns.context: great service refers to someone or an institution doing something beneficial; here it carries irony or reservation.

patterns.name: Fixed collocation “bat an eyelash”
patterns.context: The negative phrase did not bat an eyelash, meaning to be unsurprised or unmoved.

patterns.name: General noun phrases or syntactic tokens
patterns.context: The supplied passages do not form a clearly identifiable shared phrase or semantic condition; these activations may depend on local context not shown or on token form.
patterns.domain: Sports narratives, technical discussions, political and human-rights texts

patterns.name: Isolated activations at phrase boundaries or in ordinary words
patterns.context: Activations are scattered across line breaks, common function words, and ordinary words; the passages are insufficient to determine whether a specific syntactic or lexical pattern triggers them.
patterns.domain: Forum discussions, personal essays, literary commentary

6_692.description: 主要激活英语惯用语及固定搭配中的连续词，如集体显露、困惑、等待、反感、毫不惊讶和奠定基础；另有少量普通词与边界 token 激活，无法统一解释。

patterns.name: “collective” + 群体身体部位的惯用表达
patterns.context: 群体或城市被写成一个整体，后接 collective 与身体部位，表达某种现象集体显现或群体反应。

patterns.name: “scratching one’s head” 困惑表达
patterns.context: scratch the/one’s head 的习语，常与 over this 连用，表示对某事困惑。

patterns.name: “lay the foundation” 固定搭配
patterns.context: lay the foundation for 后接计划或后续工作的基础。
patterns.domain: 科研项目与研究计划文本

patterns.name: “biding our time” 固定搭配
patterns.context: bide one’s time，描述暂时等待合适时机。
patterns.domain: 新闻报道中的直接引语

patterns.name: “rub me up the wrong way” 反感表达
patterns.context: 惯用语 rub someone up the wrong way，表示使某人恼火或反感。

patterns.name: “a great service” 评价性搭配
patterns.context: great service 指某人或机构做了有益之事；此处带反讽或保留意味。

patterns.name: “bat an eyelash” 固定搭配
patterns.context: 否定句 did not bat an eyelash，表示毫不惊讶或不为所动。

patterns.name: 一般名词短语或句法 token
patterns.context: 所给片段中未形成可确认的共同短语或语义条件；这些激活可能依赖未显示的局部上下文或 token 形式。
patterns.domain: 体育叙述、技术讨论、政治与人权文本

patterns.name: 短语边界或普通词语中的孤立激活
patterns.context: 激活分散在换行、常见功能词及普通词语上；片段不足以判断其是否由特定句法或词汇模式触发。
patterns.domain: 论坛讨论、个人文章、文学评论

en.description: Activations are mainly concentrated on words in English idioms and fixed collocations, especially expressions involving body parts: scratching one’s head, tongue in cheek, shooting oneself in the foot, and patting oneself on the back; other fixed phrases and a few nearby colloquial words are also covered.

patterns.name: Idiom “scratching my head over”
patterns.context: Expresses confusion or puzzlement about something; both instances use the “scratch[ing] [possessive] head over [this]” structure

patterns.name: Idiom “tongue in cheek”
patterns.context: Occurs in the fixed phrase “tongue in cheek,” meaning ironic or humorous; the preceding text discusses news media and self-criticism

patterns.name: Idiom “shoot yourself in the foot”
patterns.context: Fixed phrase meaning to cause harm through one’s own actions; here it refers to designing a website without real usage data

patterns.name: Idiom “pat themselves on the back”
patterns.context: Fixed phrase describing self-congratulation; here it is a sarcastic evaluation of Haskell users

patterns.name: Idiom “icing on the cake”
patterns.context: Fixed phrase meaning an added benefit or a bonus; followed by an interview experience

patterns.name: Idiom “bat an eyelash”
patterns.context: Fixed expression “did not bat an eyelash,” meaning not to be surprised or to remain unmoved

patterns.name: Idiom “bear in mind”
patterns.context: Imperative reminder for readers to remember something, followed by advice on writing tests

patterns.name: Collocation “with some awe”
patterns.context: Describes observers’ respect or amazement at a person’s wide-ranging interests

patterns.name: Collocation “sounding the alarm”
patterns.context: Describes an NGO’s persistent warnings about violence over many years

patterns.name: Collocation “care a bit”
patterns.context: Negates or minimizes the degree of caring; here it says the child seems not to care much about their father

patterns.name: Other activations on nearby phrases
patterns.context: Apart from clear idioms, a few activations fall on common function words or colloquial collocations; these may be neighboring effects of the main pattern or independent weak patterns

6_692.concept: 英语惯用语与固定搭配
6_692.description: 激活主要集中在英语惯用语及固定搭配中的词，尤以身体部位构成的表达为突出：挠头、舌尖带讽、搬石砸脚、拍背自夸；也覆盖其他固定短语与少量邻近口语词。

patterns.name: “scratching my head over”惯用语
patterns.trigger: «scratching»7« their»8« head»10 over« this»1；«scratching»5« my»7« head»9« over»1« this»1
patterns.context: 表示对某事感到困惑、不解；两处都是“scratch[ing] [possessive] head over [this]”结构

patterns.name: “tongue in cheek”惯用语
patterns.context: 出现在“tongue in cheek”固定短语中，表示讽刺或戏谑；前文谈新闻媒体与自我批评

patterns.name: “shoot yourself in the foot”惯用语
patterns.context: 固定短语，表示因自身做法而造成损害；此处指缺少实际使用数据却进行网站设计

patterns.name: “pat themselves on the back”惯用语
patterns.context: 固定短语，形容自我表扬；此处是对 Haskell 用户的讽刺性评价

patterns.name: “icing on the cake”惯用语
patterns.context: 固定短语，指额外的好处或锦上添花；后接面试经历

patterns.name: “bat an eyelash”惯用语
patterns.context: 固定表达“did not bat an eyelash”，表示毫不惊讶或不动声色

patterns.name: “bear in mind”惯用语
patterns.context: 祈使式提醒读者记住某事，后接关于测试编写的建议

patterns.name: “with some awe”搭配
patterns.context: 描述旁观者对一个人广泛兴趣的敬畏或惊叹

patterns.name: “sounding the alarm”搭配
patterns.context: 描述 NGO 多年来就暴力问题持续发出警告

patterns.name: “care a bit”搭配
patterns.context: 否定或弱化关心程度；此处说孩子似乎不太关心父亲

patterns.name: 其他邻近词组激活
patterns.trigger: «still»1« scratching»7« their»8« head»10 over« this»1；«in»2 so that users ... «feel»3« like»2；«pretty»1« much»1
patterns.context: 除明显的惯用语外，少量激活落在常见功能词或口语搭配上；可能是主模式的邻近效应，也可能是独立弱模式

en.description: Activations often occur on the and subsequent words, especially in fixed collocations, idioms, and phrase continuations; they also appear in evaluative expressions and phrases about time and rewards. Domains and syntactic environments vary, with no single semantic theme evident.

patterns.name: Continuation after “the”
patterns.context: High activation often falls on the or the following subword fragment; the phrase continues in context.

patterns.name: Fixed expressions for laying the groundwork
patterns.context: lay the groundwork/foundation, meaning to prepare the basis for subsequent work or proposals.

patterns.name: “the” in idioms
patterns.context: The occurs within a common idiom or fixed collocation, with the surrounding words jointly forming a phrase.

patterns.name: Evaluative or emotional expressions
patterns.context: Activations occur in expressions describing reactions such as surprise, praise, or confusion.

patterns.name: Expressions of time or rewards
patterns.context: Phrases containing the express waiting for the right moment or reaping rewards, respectively.

6_692.description: 激活多见于 the 及其后续词，尤其是固定搭配、习语和短语延续；也出现在评价性表达及时间、回报短语中。领域和句法环境多样，未见单一语义主题。

patterns.name: “the”后的延续
patterns.context: 高激活常落在 the 上，或紧随其后的词片段；上下文中该短语继续展开。

patterns.name: 奠定基础的固定表达
patterns.context: lay the groundwork/foundation，表示为后续工作或提案打基础。

patterns.name: 习语中的 the
patterns.context: the 位于常见习语或固定搭配内部，前后词共同构成短语。

patterns.name: 评价或情绪表达
patterns.context: 激活出现在描述惊讶、赞许、困惑等反应的表达中。

patterns.name: 时间或回报表达
patterns.context: the 所在短语分别表达等待时机、收获回报。

en.description: Activations are scattered across line-break boundaries, English fixed collocations, and commentary tone; they also involve technical terminology, paper evaluations, and ordinary function words. No single stable theme or syntactic pattern spans the passages.

patterns.name: Fragments related to the idiom “head over ...”
patterns.context: “head over this acquisition” may be part of an idiom or phrase; “at the crossroads of” is another fixed expression.

patterns.name: Line breaks at sentence or paragraph boundaries
patterns.context: Activation appears at line-break markers, often at the boundaries of comments, quotations, or text fragments; Segment 1 also contains an isolated line-break activation.

patterns.name: Function words in expressions of degree or quantity
patterns.context: Activation falls on articles, prepositions, and nearby words within common collocations or noun phrases; the collocation types are inconsistent.

patterns.name: Contexts of evaluation, stance, and advice
patterns.context: Informal commentary with tones of puzzlement, sarcasm, self-praise, or advice.

patterns.name: Fixed collocation for reminders or warnings
patterns.context: Describing an NGO sounding the alarm about violence against a group.

patterns.name: Idiom for waiting
patterns.context: Quoting merchants who are “waiting for the right moment” when customers are scarce.

patterns.name: Data and percentile terminology
patterns.context: Describing RMS values by percentile in an audio-analysis method.

patterns.name: Method-comparison collocations in papers
patterns.context: Evaluating clustering and semi-supervised methods against state-of-the-art methods.

patterns.name: Process description of material selection and R&D
patterns.context: Outlining the role of material selection and manufacturing-process development in engine development.

patterns.name: Ordinary function words in contrast or lists
patterns.context: These activations occur respectively in literary evaluation, general syntax, service evaluation, and quantity phrases, without a clear shared semantic trigger.

6_692.concept: 英语搭配与文本边界线索
6_692.description: 激活分散于换行边界、英语固定搭配和评论语气，亦涉及技术术语、论文评价及普通功能词；不同段落间没有单一稳定的主题或句法模式。

patterns.name: 习语“head over ...”相关片段
patterns.trigger: « their» « head» « over»，以及« the» « cross»« roads»
patterns.context: “head over this acquisition”中可能是习语或短语的一部分；“at the crossroads of”则是另一种固定表达。
patterns.domain: HackerNews 评论；生物医学论文

patterns.name: 句末或段落边界换行
patterns.context: 激活出现在换行标记处，常位于评论、引文或文本片段的边界；段1还出现独立换行激活。
patterns.domain: 网页评论与多领域语料

patterns.name: 程度或数量表达中的功能词
patterns.trigger: « a»« great»« service»；« state»« of»« the»« art»；« the»« side»« of»；« a»« decisive»« role»
patterns.context: 激活落在常见搭配或名词短语内部的冠词、介词及其邻近词上，搭配类型并不一致。
patterns.domain: 评论、学术论文、技术文本

patterns.name: 评价、立场与劝告语境
patterns.trigger: « scratching»« their»« head»；« pat»« themselves»« on»« the»« back»；« a»« favor»；« bull»shit
patterns.context: 带有疑惑、嘲讽、自我赞许或劝告的非正式评论语气。

patterns.name: 提醒或警示的固定搭配
patterns.context: 描述 NGO 对针对群体的暴力发出警报。

patterns.name: 进行等待的习语
patterns.context: 引述商户在顾客稀少时“等待时机”的说法。

patterns.name: 数据与百分位术语
patterns.context: 音频分析方法中以百分位描述 RMS 值。

patterns.name: 论文中的方法比较搭配
patterns.context: 评价聚类与半监督方法相对于先进方法的表现。

patterns.name: 材料选择与研发的过程描述
patterns.context: 概述材料选择及制造工艺研发对发动机发展的作用。

patterns.name: 转折或列举中的普通功能词
patterns.trigger: « few»；« is»；« us»« a»；« a»« number»
patterns.context: 这些激活分别处于文学评价、一般句法、服务评价及数量短语中，缺少共同的明确语义触发条件。

en.description: Activations are distributed across several semantic and syntactic contexts: confusion, sarcastic or negative comments, evaluations of social reactions, and fixed collocations such as “laid the groundwork” and “biding our time”; no unified word form or single clear theme is evident.

patterns.name: Phrase “scratch my head over this”
patterns.context: Describing confusion, puzzlement, or difficulty understanding something; activation is concentrated near “head over this”.

patterns.name: Expressions of dissatisfaction or disdain
patterns.context: Comments about people, views, or suggestions conveying sarcasm, disparagement, frustration, or a negative attitude; triggers span diverse expressions rather than one fixed phrase.

patterns.name: Social evaluations and group circumstances
patterns.context: Describing public reactions to or evaluations of a phenomenon: warning of a risk of violence, or expressing awe at broad interests.
patterns.domain: Parliamentary/human-rights discourse; literary and cultural commentary

patterns.name: Fixed collocation “lay the groundwork”
patterns.context: Describing research findings as laying the groundwork for future research.

patterns.name: Fixed collocation “bide our time”
patterns.context: Indicating patient waiting when customers are scarce or circumstances are temporarily unfavorable.

6_692.description: 激活分散在若干语义与句式中：困惑不解、带讽刺或负面态度的评论、社会反应评价，以及“laid the groundwork”“biding our time”等固定搭配；未见统一词形或明确单一主题。

patterns.name: 短语“scratch my head over this”
patterns.context: 描述对某事感到困惑、不解或难以理解；激活集中在“head over this”附近。

patterns.name: 表达不满或轻蔑的评价
patterns.context: 针对人、观点或建议作带讽刺、贬抑、愤懑或负面态度的评论；触发点横跨多种表达，并非单一固定短语。
patterns.domain: 以 HackerNews 非正式评论为主

patterns.name: 社会评价与群体处境
patterns.context: 描述公众对某现象的反应或评价：对暴力风险发出警告，或对广博兴趣心怀敬畏。
patterns.domain: 议会／人权论述；文学与文化评论

patterns.name: 固定搭配“lay the groundwork”
patterns.context: 以“为未来研究奠定基础”的搭配描述研究成果。

patterns.name: 固定搭配“bide our time”
patterns.context: 在顾客稀少、情势暂时不佳时，表示耐心等待。

en.description: The most stable pattern is “lay the foundation/groundwork for” in research abstracts, meaning to lay the foundation for subsequent work; there are also a few English fixed collocations and a Russian URL path, with no clear semantic connection to the research pattern.

patterns.name: Fixed collocation lay the foundation
patterns.context: Research, a project, or a result lays the foundation for subsequent research, treatment, prevention, or analysis; includes the noun foundation and the open compound groundwork
patterns.domain: NIH project abstracts, scientific research descriptions

patterns.name: Fixed expression for collective reappearance
patterns.context: Describes a problem that had previously subsided reappearing; the sentence uses sarcastic or vivid phrasing to describe something returning one night

patterns.name: sound the alarm
patterns.context: Uses the alarm metaphor to express persistent warnings about violence or human-rights conditions

patterns.name: being a great service
patterns.context: Comments on the role of the Nobel Committee in bringing works to light, expressing that it may benefit the public

patterns.name: Russian slash and URL path
patterns.context: Russian text gives an example of regular expressions and searching for IP addresses; the trigger fragment occurs in a URL path

patterns.name: biding our time
patterns.context: Quotes a merchant waiting for an opportunity when customers are scarce; the words appear in split form

6_692.description: 最稳定的模式是科研摘要中的“lay the foundation/groundwork for”，表示为后续工作奠基；另有少量英语固定搭配及一段俄语网址路径，未见它们与科研模式有明确语义联系。

patterns.name: lay the foundation 固定搭配
patterns.context: 研究、项目或成果将为后续研究、治疗、预防或分析奠定基础；包括名词 foundation 与分写的 groundwork
patterns.domain: NIH 项目摘要、科学研究说明

patterns.name: 集体重新显现的固定表达
patterns.trigger: «re»ared« their»« collective»« ugly»« heads»（reared their collective ugly heads）
patterns.context: 描述此前消退的问题再次出现；句中以讽刺或生动修辞说明某些事情在某夜重现

patterns.name: sound the alarm
patterns.context: 以警报隐喻表达对暴力或人权状况的持续警示

patterns.name: being a great service
patterns.context: 评论诺贝尔奖委员会揭示作品的作用，表达其可能对公众有益

patterns.name: 俄语斜杠及网址路径
patterns.context: 俄语文本举例说明正则表达式与 IP 地址搜索，触发片段位于 URL 路径中

patterns.name: biding our time
patterns.context: 引述商户在顾客稀少时等待时机；词语因拆分形式呈现
patterns.domain: 新闻报道、市场状况引语

en.description: Activations are distributed across various idioms and fixed collocations: warning, helping, confusion, part and whole, problems reappearing, reaping rewards, self-congratulation, awe, and waiting. They often activate adjacent words jointly across varied contexts and styles.

patterns.name: Fixed expression “sounding the alarm”
patterns.context: “sounding” is followed by “the alarm”, meaning to issue a warning; activation is concentrated on this fixed collocation.

patterns.name: Fixed expression “a great service”
patterns.context: Evaluating someone or an institution as having provided substantial help or made a significant contribution.

patterns.name: Fixed expression “scratching my/their head(s) over”
patterns.context: Expressing confusion or difficulty understanding a problem or event; both examples use “scratch one’s head over”.

patterns.name: Fixed expression “tip of the iceberg”
patterns.context: Metaphorically indicating that what is currently visible is only a small part of a larger problem or possibility.

patterns.name: Fixed expression “reared their collective ugly heads”
patterns.context: Using “reared ... heads” to describe a problem or negative phenomenon appearing again; here it is modified by “collective ugly”.

patterns.name: Fixed expression “reaping the rewards”
patterns.context: Describing rewards resulting from earlier effort or success.

patterns.name: Fixed expression “pat themselves on the back”
patterns.context: Indicating self-congratulation; the example is sarcastic in tone.

patterns.name: Expression of admiration “with some awe”
patterns.context: Describing observers’ awe or admiration for someone’s wide-ranging interests or abilities.
patterns.domain: Commentary on academic figures, popular science or opinion articles

patterns.name: Fixed expression “biding our time”
patterns.context: The speaker indicates temporarily waiting and watching how things develop.
patterns.domain: Market interviews, direct quotations in news reports

6_692.description: 激活分布于多种惯用语和固定搭配：警告、帮助、困惑、局部与整体、问题再现、收获回报、自我称赞、敬畏及等待。多为相邻词组共同激活，语境和文体各异。

patterns.name: 固定表达“sounding the alarm”
patterns.context: “sounding”后接“the alarm”，指发出警告；激活集中在该固定搭配。

patterns.name: 固定表达“a great service”
patterns.context: 评价某人或机构提供了很大的帮助或贡献。

patterns.name: 固定表达“scratching my/their head(s) over”
patterns.context: 表示对某问题或事件困惑、难以理解；两例均为“scratch one’s head over”。

patterns.name: 固定表达“tip of the iceberg”
patterns.context: 比喻当前所见只是更大问题或可能性的很小一部分。
patterns.domain: 科技评论、口语化网络写作

patterns.name: 固定表达“reared their collective ugly heads”
patterns.context: 以“reared ... heads”描述问题或负面现象再次显现；此处带有“collective ugly”的修饰。

patterns.name: 固定表达“reaping the rewards”
patterns.context: 描述先前努力或成功带来回报。

patterns.name: 固定表达“pat themselves on the back”
patterns.context: 表示自我称赞；该例语气带讽刺。
patterns.domain: 程序员论坛、评论性网络写作

patterns.name: “with some awe”表达敬佩
patterns.context: 描述旁观者对某人广泛兴趣或能力抱有敬畏、赞叹。
patterns.domain: 学术人物评论、科普或评论文章

patterns.name: “biding our time”固定表达
patterns.context: 说话者表示暂时等待、静观其变。
patterns.domain: 市场采访、新闻报道中的直接引语

en.description: Primarily activates English idioms and their component words, including phrases expressing confusion, danger emerging, warnings, part and whole, entering a competition, and convergence; there are also several scattered word or local-phrase activations.

patterns.name: Fixed idiom: scratch one’s head
patterns.context: “scratching … head over this” expresses confusion; pronouns and punctuation may be inserted into the phrase.

patterns.name: Fixed idiom: ugly heads
