patterns.context: “reared … ugly heads” is used when plural entities reappear or emerge.

patterns.name: Fixed idiom: sound the alarm
patterns.context: Used as a verb phrase to warn of danger or a problem.

patterns.name: Idiom: tip of the iceberg
patterns.context: Indicating that the visible part is only a small portion of a larger problem; the phrase is split by a line break.

patterns.name: Idiom: throw one’s hat in the ring
patterns.context: Indicating joining a competition or committing to an initiative, often with an organization as the subject.

patterns.name: Word: crossroads
patterns.context: “at the crossroads of” means being at the convergence of multiple paths; here it is a metaphor for biological pathways.

patterns.name: Scattered word or local-phrase activations
patterns.context: Occurring respectively in “Nobel Prize Committee … doing us a great service”, “of the further opinion”, and “biding our time”, with no unified fixed structure evident.
patterns.domain: Online commentary, legal texts, news reports

6_692.description: 主要对英语习语及其组成词激活，包括表示困惑、危险显现、警告、局部与整体、加入竞争及交汇的短语；另有若干分散的词语或局部短语激活。

patterns.name: 固定习语：scratch one’s head
patterns.context: “scratching … head over this”表示困惑；人称代词和标点可插入短语中。

patterns.name: 固定习语：ugly heads
patterns.context: 复数事物再次出现或显现时，用“reared … ugly heads”。

patterns.name: 固定习语：sound the alarm
patterns.context: 警告某种危险或问题时，作为动词短语使用。

patterns.name: 习语：tip of the iceberg
patterns.context: 表示已见部分只是更大问题的一小部分；短语被换行分开。

patterns.name: 习语：throw one’s hat in the ring
patterns.context: 表示加入竞争或投入某项倡议，常由机构作主语。

patterns.name: 词语：crossroads
patterns.context: “at the crossroads of”表示处于多条路径交汇之处；此处为生物通路的比喻。

patterns.name: 零散词语／局部短语激活
patterns.context: 分别出现在“Nobel Prize Committee … doing us a great service”“of the further opinion”和“biding our time”中，未见统一固定结构。
patterns.domain: 网络评论、法律文本、新闻报道

en.concept: Local lexical patterns in English collocations and phrases
en.description: Activations often occur in reap the + result noun, and on nouns following the; they also appear sporadically in body-part expressions, idioms, and several collocations. Segment 5’s biding our time has no obvious corresponding pattern.

patterns.name: Verb phrase reap the...
patterns.context: the immediately follows reap, followed in turn by a noun denoting a result, reward, or benefit; ap within reap is marked, and the is also consistently highlighted
patterns.domain: General narrative, commentary, business, or advisory text

patterns.name: Possessive or reflexive pronoun + body/group part
patterns.context: A pronoun/article is adjacent to a body-part or personified-part noun; some occur in idioms or rhetorical expressions
patterns.domain: Sports coverage, technical commentary, idiomatic expressions

patterns.name: Strong activation on the article the
patterns.context: The definite article the precedes a specific noun, especially alarm, rewards, benefits, icing, and consequences; it may also appear with body-part phrases
patterns.domain: News, business, commentary, and general narrative

patterns.name: Localized activations in function words and idioms
patterns.context: Activations are scattered across common collocations, idioms, or adjacent function words, with no consistent single semantic condition apparent
patterns.domain: Online comments, personal narratives, product descriptions

6_692.concept: 英语搭配与短语中的局部词汇模式
6_692.description: 激活常见于 reap the + 结果名词，以及 the 后的名词；另在身体部位表达、习语和若干搭配中零散出现。第5段的 biding our time 无明显对应模式。

patterns.name: 短语动词 reap the...
patterns.trigger: re«ap»4« the»9« rewards»4；re«ap»4« the»9« consequences»2；re«ap»5« the»9« continued»6« benefits»1
patterns.context: 在 reap 后紧接 the，后续是其结果、回报或收益名词；reap 内部的 ap 被标记，the 也稳定高亮
patterns.domain: 一般叙述、评论、商业或劝诫文本

patterns.name: 所有格或反身代词 + 身体/集体部位
patterns.trigger: «their»6« collective»9« ugly»6« heads»7；«themselves»5« on»9«↵«the»7« back»8；«their»9« head»8；«an»9« eyel»3«ash»3
patterns.context: 身体部位或拟人化部位短语中，代词/冠词与部位名词相邻；有的处于习语或修辞表达中
patterns.domain: 体育报道、技术评论、习语表达

patterns.name: 冠词 the 的强激活
patterns.trigger: «the»10« alarm»6；«the»9« rewards»4；«the»9« continued»6« benefits»1；«the»9« icing»4；«the»9« consequences»2
patterns.context: 在定冠词 the 后接具体名词，尤其是 alarm、rewards、benefits、icing、consequences；也可与身体部位短语共同出现
patterns.domain: 新闻、商业、评论及一般叙述

patterns.name: 功能词与习语中的局部激活
patterns.trigger: «a»10« great»7« service»5；«on»9«↵«the»7« back»8；«but»3« good»1；«icing»4« on»5« the»7« cake»2
patterns.context: 激活散落在常见搭配、习语或相邻功能词上，未显示一致的单一语义条件
patterns.domain: 网络评论、个人叙述、产品介绍

en.description: Activations across passages fall on consecutive tokens in idiomatic expressions and fixed collocations, often involving body parts or vivid phrases; other examples include the iceberg, the reappearance of a head, and ordinary collocations, with trigger words not entirely consistent.

patterns.name: Body parts in idioms
patterns.context: Body-part words combine with action words to form fixed or idiomatic expressions, conveying confusion, indifference, or self-inflicted harm
patterns.domain: Forum discussions, personal narratives, website analysis

patterns.name: Head in an idiom and its figurative use
patterns.context: “ugly heads” is a metaphor for the reappearance of undesirable phenomena

patterns.name: “the” and following elements in fixed phrases
patterns.context: Activation falls on consecutive words in idiomatic collocations or noun phrases, especially phrases involving body parts or fixed imagery; trigger words are not always consistent

patterns.name: Idiom “hat in the ring”
patterns.context: Uses “throw one’s hat in the ring” to express joining or participating in an action

patterns.name: Word sequence in an ordinary collocation
patterns.context: Embedded in the ordinary expression “doing us a great service”; there is little evidence that the whole span is triggered by the same fixed phrase

6_692.description: 多段激活落在惯用表达及固定搭配的连续 token 上，常涉及身体部位或形象化短语；另有冰山、头部再现及普通搭配等例子，触发词并不完全一致。

patterns.name: 习语中的身体部位
patterns.context: 身体部位词与动作词组成固定或惯用表达；分别表示困惑、毫不在意、自我损害
patterns.domain: 论坛讨论、个人叙述、网页分析

patterns.name: 习语中的头部及其引申表达
patterns.context: “ugly heads”作为不良现象再次出现的比喻

patterns.name: 固定短语中的“the”及后续成分
patterns.context: 激活落在惯用搭配或名词短语中的连续词上，尤其短语中带有身体部位或固定意象；触发词并不总一致

patterns.name: 惯用表达“hat in the ring”
patterns.context: 以“throw one’s hat in the ring”表达加入或参与某项行动

patterns.name: 普通搭配中的词语序列
patterns.context: 嵌在“doing us a great service”普通表达中，缺少明确证据表明整段由同一固定短语触发

en.description: Activations concentrate on English fixed collocations and idioms: laying the groundwork, puzzling over something, sounding the alarm, self-congratulation, an added benefit, lack of surprise, and providing help; these occur across multiple domains.

patterns.name: Fixed collocation lay the foundation
patterns.context: Describing a study or project as laying the foundation for subsequent work, often in NIH project abstracts.

patterns.name: Fixed expression scratch one’s head
patterns.context: Expressing confusion or puzzlement over a problem or event.

patterns.name: Fixed collocation sound the alarm
patterns.context: Warning about violence or a social problem.

patterns.name: Fixed expression pat oneself on the back
patterns.context: Criticizing a group for congratulating itself and feeling self-satisfied.

patterns.name: Fixed expression icing on the cake
patterns.context: Introducing an added benefit or a pleasant finishing detail.

patterns.name: Fixed expression not bat an eyelash
patterns.context: In a negative context, indicating that someone is completely unsurprised or unmoved.

patterns.name: do someone a great service
patterns.context: Evaluating someone or an institution as having done something beneficial; here it is associated with uncovering certain works.

6_692.description: 激活集中于英语固定搭配和习语：奠定基础、苦思不解、发出警报、自我庆贺、额外好处、毫不惊讶及提供帮助；多种领域中均出现。

patterns.name: lay the foundation 固定搭配
patterns.context: 描述某项研究或项目为后续工作奠定基础，常出现在 NIH 项目摘要中。

patterns.name: scratch one’s head 固定表达
patterns.context: 表达对问题或事件困惑、苦思不解。

patterns.name: sound the alarm 固定搭配
patterns.context: 警示某种暴力或社会问题。

patterns.name: pat oneself on the back 固定表达
patterns.context: 批评某群体自我庆贺、自我感觉良好。

patterns.name: icing on the cake 固定表达
patterns.context: 引出额外的好处或令人愉快的收尾细节。

patterns.name: not bat an eyelash 固定表达
patterns.context: 否定式语境中表示某人毫不惊讶或不为所动。

patterns.name: do someone a great service
patterns.context: 评价某人或机构做了有益的事；此处与 uncovering 某些作品相关。

en.concept: Local phrases in English fixed collocations and idioms
en.description: Activations are most concentrated on fixed collocations and idioms, especially the alarm, scratching one’s head, pat oneself on the back, tip of the iceberg, lay the foundation, and icing on the cake; there are also several scattered word activations that are difficult to unify.

patterns.name: Expression with “the alarm”
patterns.context: In “sounding the alarm about,” means to warn about a problem or threat; activation falls on “the alarm.”

patterns.name: Fixed expression with a reflexive pronoun
patterns.context: Occurs in “scratching my/their head(s) over this,” describing confusion or deep thought; activation is concentrated on the possessive and head.

patterns.name: Collocation “patting oneself on the back”
patterns.context: Occurs in “pat themselves on the back,” meaning self-congratulation or smugness; activation covers the span on the back.

patterns.name: “A great service” and article–noun combination
patterns.context: In “doing us a great service,” the intensifying adjective great modifies service; nearby “the works” is also marked.

patterns.name: Idiom “tip of the iceberg”
patterns.context: The fixed idiom “the tip of the iceberg”; activation is concentrated around of the iceberg.

patterns.name: Collocation “lay the foundation”
patterns.context: When describing research results laying the foundation for a subsequent proposal, research, or treatment, activation falls on the and extends to foundation/groundwork.

patterns.name: Idiom “icing on the cake”
patterns.context: The fixed expression “the icing on the cake,” meaning an added benefit or a bonus.

patterns.name: Scattered expressions and boundary markers
patterns.context: These triggers occur in different expressions, including “complete disregard,” “great unwashed,” “snob,” “pure creativity,” “needed data,” “greatly improve our understanding,” and “incredible life,” with no apparent unified local collocation; some activations may involve tokenization boundaries or nearby context.
patterns.domain: Political text, online comments, research abstracts, personal narratives

6_692.concept: 英语固定搭配与习语中的局部词组
6_692.description: 激活最集中于固定搭配和习语，尤其是the alarm、scratching one’s head、pat oneself on the back、tip of the iceberg、lay the foundation及icing on the cake；另有多处分散且难统一的词项激活。

patterns.name: “the alarm”表达
patterns.context: 在“sounding the alarm about”中，表示对某种问题或威胁发出警告；激活落在“the alarm”上。

patterns.name: 反身代词固定搭配
patterns.context: 出现在“scratching my/their head(s) over this”中，描述困惑或苦思；激活集中在所有格和 head。

patterns.name: “拍自己的背”搭配
patterns.context: 出现在“pat themselves on the back”中，表示自我庆贺或自满；激活覆盖 on the back 一段。

patterns.name: “伟大的服务”及冠词-名词组合
patterns.context: “doing us a great service”中，程度形容词 great 修饰 service；另有邻近的“the works”被标记。

patterns.name: “tip of the iceberg”习语
patterns.context: 固定习语“the tip of the iceberg”，激活集中在 of the iceberg 一带。

patterns.name: “lay the foundation”搭配
patterns.context: 在描述研究成果为后续提案、研究或治疗奠定基础时，激活落在 the，并扩展到 foundation/groundwork。

patterns.name: “icing on the cake”习语
patterns.context: 固定表达“the icing on the cake”，表示额外的好处或锦上添花。

patterns.name: 零散表达与边界标记
patterns.context: 这些触发分别出现在“complete disregard”“great unwashed”“snob”“pure creativity”“needed data”“greatly improve our understanding”“incredible life”等不同表达中，未显示可统一的局部搭配；部分激活可能涉及分词边界或邻近上下文。
patterns.domain: 政治文本、网络评论、研究摘要、个人叙述

en.description: The strongest and most consistent pattern is the closing delimiter “}” in structured text, including code objects and Markdown image entries. Other activations are scattered across technical terms and Baltic-language word fragments, with no stable semantic condition observed.

patterns.name: Markdown braces and image-reference closing delimiter
patterns.context: In consecutive image or caption entries, a newline follows a closing brace; activation falls on the closing brace, while the alphanumeric portion of the image file path also shows weaker activation.
patterns.domain: Markdown-formatted chart/image references in PubMed Central

patterns.name: Structured data object closing
patterns.context: At the end of an object or array entry in structured text such as JSON, configuration files, or HTML templates; high activation is concentrated on the right brace, with some samples also activating the comma.

patterns.name: Special word-form fragments within technical terms
patterns.context: When a word is split into subwords by the tokenizer, activation appears on some internal fragments or word endings; different examples show no stable shared meaning or syntactic condition.
patterns.domain: PubMed technical abstracts and multilingual EuroParl text

6_741.description: 最强、较一致的模式是结构化文本中闭合符「}」，包括代码对象及 Markdown 图片条目；其余激活散布于技术词和波罗的海语词形片段，未见稳定语义条件。

patterns.name: Markdown花括号与图片引用闭合符
patterns.trigger: 「}»9」以及后接换行的 Markdown 图片引用「![](...)」
patterns.context: 在连续图片或图注条目中，花括号闭合后出现换行；激活落在闭合花括号，而图片文件路径的字母数字部分也有较弱激活。
patterns.domain: PubMed Central 中的 Markdown 化图表/图片引用

patterns.name: 结构化数据对象闭合
patterns.context: JSON、配置或 HTML 模板等结构化文本中，对象或数组条目结束处；高激活集中在右花括号，部分样本也激活逗号。

patterns.name: 技术词内部的特殊词形片段
patterns.trigger: 「mode」「Venturi」「mas」「spectrometry」等技术词中的分词片段；另有「Pasveik...」和「sēž...」等波罗的海语词形片段
patterns.context: 词被 tokenizer 切成若干子词时，部分内部片段或词尾出现激活；不同例子并未显示稳定的共同词义或句法条件。
patterns.domain: PubMed 技术摘要及 EuroParl 多语种文本

en.description: Primarily responds to closing curly braces in structured text (especially image references or the ends of configuration objects), and also covers HTML templates. It also activates on the term mode and several names and parliamentary terms. The triggers in paragraphs 1, 3, and 10 are difficult to reconcile with the main pattern.

patterns.name: Consecutive image/table resource references
patterns.context: In PubMed Central documents, Markdown image references and figure numbers appear consecutively, with activation near the reference closing marker `}` (9); the paths and numbers vary.
patterns.domain: Figure markers in PubMed Central papers or scanned pages

patterns.name: Closing symbols in configuration objects or structured data
patterns.context: JSON or similar object/array structures in GitHub snippets; activation is concentrated on closing braces, with weaker activation on closing array symbols.
patterns.domain: Structured configuration and metadata in code repositories

patterns.name: Line endings in parenthesized templates/markup
patterns.context: HTML template snippets mix template calls, tags, and attributes; activation is especially strong at the template expression closing `}` (9).

patterns.name: mode in compound technical terms
patterns.context: Appears as part of a technical term: once in the name of a mass spectrometry method and once as a configuration field; the two contexts differ.
patterns.domain: Analytical methods in PubMed abstracts; GitHub configuration

patterns.name: Morphemes in personal or proper names
patterns.context: Proper names occur in texts in different languages; there is no shared local syntactic or topical condition.
patterns.domain: GitHub user profiles; EuroParl names/parliamentary text

patterns.name: Member-related terms in EU/national parliamentary text
patterns.context: A Latvian parliamentary record mentions a member of parliament; this activation shows no specific semantic trigger shared with the other paragraphs.

6_741.concept: 结构化文本中的闭合标记
6_741.description: 主要响应结构化文本中的闭合大括号（尤其图像引用或配置对象末尾），也覆盖 HTML 模板；另在 mode 术语及若干人名、议会词上激活。段1、3、10的触发难以与主模式统一。

patterns.name: 连续图像/表格资源引用
patterns.trigger: 反复出现的 `![](`、`){#sp…}`，以及 `«br»foreign…`、`«br»j«cancer… .tif`、`scanned-page`、`transedinobsoc…` 等图像路径或文件名
patterns.context: 在 PubMed Central 文档中，Markdown 图片引用和图表编号连续出现，激活落在引用结束标记 `}`（9）附近；路径和编号内容各不相同
patterns.domain: PubMed Central 的论文或扫描页图表标记

patterns.name: 配置对象或结构化数据的闭合符号
patterns.context: GitHub 片段中的 JSON 或类似对象/数组结构；高激活集中于对象闭合大括号，数组闭合符号也有较弱激活
patterns.domain: 代码仓库中的结构化配置、元数据

patterns.name: 带括号的模板/标记语言行尾
patterns.trigger: `{translate module=account}` 后的 `title_password_new`；局部 HTML 标记如 `<td…>`、`<div…>`
patterns.context: HTML 模板片段中，模板调用、标签和属性混排；在模板表达式闭合 `}`（9）处尤其强
patterns.domain: GitHub 中的 HTML/模板代码

patterns.name: 复合技术术语中的 mode
patterns.context: 作为技术术语组成部分出现：一处是质谱方法名，一处是配置字段名；二者上下文不同
patterns.domain: PubMed 摘要中的分析方法；GitHub 配置

patterns.name: 人名或专名中的词素
patterns.context: 专名出现在不同语言文本中；没有共同的局部句法或主题条件
patterns.domain: GitHub 用户资料；EuroParl 人名/议会文本

patterns.name: 欧盟/国家议会文本中的议员相关词
patterns.context: 拉脱维亚语议会记录中提及议员；该激活未显示与其他段落共享的特定语义触发条件

en.concept: Boundaries and markers in structured text
en.description: Activation often occurs on boundary symbols, closing brackets, JSON fields, and image resource references in structured text. It also covers medical terminology, Lithuanian, and web templates; the commonality is weak, making it difficult to identify a single trigger.

patterns.name: Closing brackets in structured text
patterns.context: Activation often falls at the ends of objects or lists and at closing HTML tags; nearby newlines and indentation are common.
patterns.domain: Code, configuration, markup languages, and corpus dumps

patterns.name: Embedded image references
patterns.context: Markdown image references or scanned-page file paths, especially at the end of a reference, near brace attributes, or near numbers.
patterns.domain: PubMed Central document dumps, code, or document configuration

patterns.name: JSON key-value pairs and field configuration
patterns.context: Field names and values arranged in JSON style, often accompanied by array/object boundaries and indentation.
patterns.domain: Github configuration, code, or structured data

patterns.name: Proper names, identifiers, and path fragments
patterns.context: Occurs in email addresses, URLs, filenames, or identifiers for paper image resources; activation is not limited to natural-language word meanings.
patterns.domain: Github metadata and medical literature resource dumps

patterns.name: Medical terminology phrases
patterns.context: In consecutive technical noun phrases, highlights “mode” within a compound term and its neighboring elements.

patterns.name: Non-English word forms/lemmas
patterns.context: Lithuanian snippets, with activation concentrated on subword fragments within words; no structural condition can be confirmed from the other examples.

patterns.name: Template and interface text
patterns.context: Template directives surround interface heading text, showing placeholders and localization markers.

6_741.concept: 结构化文本边界与标记
6_741.description: 激活多见于结构化文本的边界符、闭合括号、JSON字段及图片资源引用，也覆盖医学术语、立陶宛语和网页模板；共同点较弱，难以确定单一触发条件。

patterns.name: 结构化文本中的闭合括号
patterns.context: 激活常落在对象或列表结束处，以及 HTML 标签闭合处；附近常有换行和缩进。
patterns.domain: 代码、配置、标记语言及语料转储

patterns.name: 嵌入式图片引用
patterns.context: Markdown 图片引用或扫描页文件路径，尤其在引用末尾、花括号属性或编号附近。
patterns.domain: PubMed Central 文档转储、代码或文档配置

patterns.name: JSON键值与字段配置
patterns.context: 字段名和值按 JSON 风格排列，常伴随数组、对象边界和缩进。
patterns.domain: Github 配置、代码或结构化数据

patterns.name: 专名、标识符及路径片段
patterns.context: 出现在邮箱、网址、文件名或论文图像资源标识符中，激活并不局限于自然语言词义。
patterns.domain: Github 元数据及医学文献资源转储

patterns.name: 医学术语短语
patterns.context: 连续的专业名词短语中，突出复合术语内部的「mode」及其邻近成分。

patterns.name: 非英语词形/词元
patterns.context: 立陶宛语片段，激活集中在词内子词片段，缺乏可从其余例子确认的结构条件。

patterns.name: 模板与界面文本
patterns.context: 模板指令包围界面标题文本，呈现占位符和本地化标记。

type

type
string



name
value

type

en.description: Responses are dispersed: sentence-initial the in mathematics, Network-related terms, fragments of medical/mass-spectrometry terminology, and near JSON closing delimiters and image markers. No unified semantics are apparent across corpora; some high-activation positions may be due to tokenization or formatting.

patterns.name: Sentence-initial definite article
patterns.context: Begins with lowercase “the,” followed by a noun phrase naming a mathematical object or operation; activation is concentrated on the article rather than the following mathematical term.

patterns.name: Split word fragments and non-English text
patterns.context: Activation falls on tokenized or uncommon word fragments in non-English text containing line breaks; no stable word meaning explains the high activation.

patterns.name: Mass spectrometry method name
patterns.context: In the analytical method name “dual-mode ambient mass spectrometry,” activation falls on mode.

patterns.name: Image markers and whitespace
patterns.context: In Markdown image embedding and similar image annotations or numbering, activation falls near the end of an image marker; the specific trigger is unclear.
patterns.domain: PubMed Central, document markup containing images

patterns.name: JSON object ending
patterns.context: In JSON-style records, an object closing delimiter follows fields such as name, email, and homepage; indentation and key-value fields in the same passage activate more weakly.

patterns.name: Medical term fragment
patterns.context: In a medical abstract, the initial token fragment of “Perforator stroke” is activated, followed by a stroke and stent-treatment context.

patterns.name: Network security terminology
patterns.context: A sentence begins with “Network security” discussing the importance of information security; activation is concentrated on Network.

patterns.name: Network visualization terminology
patterns.context: Sentence-initial “Network-based visualization” describes 3D landscape visualization; activation is concentrated on Network and the following phrase.

patterns.name: Organic cation transport terminology
patterns.context: A sentence begins by introducing organic cation transporters; activation is distributed across the split tokens organic and cation.

6_741.description: 响应模式分散：数学句首the、Network相关术语、若干医学/质谱专业词片段，以及JSON闭合符和图像标记附近；不同语料中难见统一语义，部分高激活位置可能来自分词或格式。

patterns.name: 句首定冠词
patterns.context: 以小写“the”开头，后接数学对象或运算的名词短语；激活集中在冠词而非后续数学词上。

patterns.name: 拆分词片段及非英语文本
patterns.context: 激活落在分词或不常见词片段上，处于带换行的非英语文本中；未见足以解释高激活的稳定词义。

patterns.name: 质谱方法名
patterns.context: “dual-mode ambient mass spectrometry”这一分析方法名称中，激活落在 mode。

patterns.name: 图像标记及空白区域
patterns.context: Markdown 图像嵌入及类似图像标注/编号的内容中，激活落在图像标记结束附近；其具体触发条件不明。
patterns.domain: PubMed Central，含图像的文档标记

patterns.name: JSON对象结束
patterns.context: JSON式记录中，姓名、邮箱、主页等字段结束后出现对象闭合符；同段还有缩进和键值字段，但较弱。

patterns.name: 医学术语片段
patterns.context: 医学摘要中，“Perforator stroke”一词的词首分片被激活，后接卒中及支架治疗语境。

patterns.name: 网络安全术语
patterns.context: 句首以“Network security”谈信息安全重要性；激活集中在 Network。

patterns.name: 网络可视化术语
patterns.context: 句首“Network-based visualization”描述三维景观可视化；激活集中在 Network 及其后缀短语。

patterns.name: 有机阳离子转运术语
patterns.context: 句首介绍有机阳离子转运体（organic cation transporters），激活分布于拆分的 organic 和 cation。

en.description: Activation is scattered across mathematical phrases, word-initial fragments of Network/Mont, technical compound terms, and multilingual parliamentary word forms. No unified semantics or stable domain is apparent; it may favor certain word forms and token fragments.

patterns.name: Sentence-initial definite article and mathematical terms
patterns.context: A definite article at the start of a sentence introduces a mathematical object or operation; unmarked content also intervenes between the two examples.

patterns.name: Network word-initial fragment
patterns.context: Begins with Network, followed respectively by security and a hyphenated compound; the subsequent topics are security and visualization.

patterns.name: Mont word-initial fragment and following character fragments
patterns.context: Mont at the beginning of a proper name or place name, followed by different character fragments.
patterns.domain: Wikipedia biographies and German place-name entries

patterns.name: Bottom-quark compound term
patterns.context: Bottom-quark in the particle physics term forward-backward asymmetry.

patterns.name: Organic cation compound term
patterns.context: The term organic cation is followed by the abbreviation OC and transporters.

patterns.name: Official greeting and Baltic-language word endings
patterns.context: Forms of address and greetings in multilingual parliamentary text.

patterns.name: Perforator medical word-initial fragment
patterns.context: The medical phrase perforator stroke describes an event after stent placement.

6_741.description: 激活分散于数学短语、Network/Mont 等词首片段、专业复合术语及多语种议会词形；未见统一语义或稳定领域，可能偏向若干词形与分词片段。

patterns.name: 句首定冠词与数学术语
patterns.context: 句首以定冠词引出数学对象或运算；两个例子中间还隔有未标记内容。

patterns.name: Network 词首
patterns.context: 以 Network 开头，分别接 security 和连字符复合词；后续主题分别是安全与可视化。

patterns.name: Mont 词首及后续字片
patterns.context: 专名或地名开头的 Mont，后接不同字片。
patterns.domain: Wikipedia 人物与德国地名条目

patterns.name: Bottom-quark 复合术语
patterns.context: 粒子物理术语 forward-backward asymmetry 中的 Bottom-quark。

patterns.name: Organic cation 复合术语
patterns.context: 术语 organic cation 后接缩写 OC 和 transporters。

patterns.name: Official 问候与波罗的海语词尾
patterns.context: 多语种议会文本中的称谓及问候语。

patterns.name: Perforator 医学词首
patterns.context: 医学短语 perforator stroke，描述支架术后事件。

en.concept: Terms and markers in structured text
en.description: Strong triggers include Introduction/section formatting in medical papers, sentence-initial Network phrases, and instances in two contexts. Activation also occurs on a blog URL title phrase and several medical topic terms. The triggers are not entirely consistent in surface form or semantics.

patterns.name: Document titles and section markers
patterns.context: The Introduction heading at the beginning of a medical paper’s main text appears next to Markdown-like section anchors and newline separators; across several examples, anchors contain numbers, hyphens, and paper identifiers.
patterns.domain: Structured text in PubMed Central papers

patterns.name: Network-related phrases
patterns.context: Network (including the compound Network-based) appears sentence-initially or at the beginning of a noun phrase, as well as in a paper’s opening sentence about wireless sensor networks. Network activation in paragraphs 2 and 3 is especially strong; paragraph 8 discusses a similar topic but has scattered activation.
patterns.domain: Network security, scientific visualization, wireless sensor networks

patterns.name: Fixed phrase in a technical article title link
patterns.context: HackerNews text contains a slug linking to a Medium article, with the title phrase encoded word by word using hyphens; job activates weakly in ordinary body text.

patterns.name: Narration of high-profile events
patterns.context: Introduces several noteworthy events that occurred over the past few years; activation is concentrated on instances rather than the whole sentence.

patterns.name: Biomedical topic terms and the start of title/body text
patterns.context: After a paper section marker, the body begins with different topic terms such as a disease name, immune defense, a flexible system, or a drug name; each appears in only one passage, with no consistent specific semantic trigger.

patterns.name: Time-series analysis terminology and temporal instances
patterns.context: In an academic discussion of nonparametric methods, stationarity intervals, and spectral density estimation, instances refers to different temporal instances; the same word form as in paragraph 1 appears in a different context.

6_741.concept: 结构化文本中的术语与标记
6_741.description: 强触发包括医学论文的 Introduction/分节格式、句首 Network 相关短语，以及两种语境中的 instances；另对博客 URL 标题短语及若干医学主题词有激活。各触发在表面形式和语义上并不完全统一。

patterns.name: 文档标题与分节标记
patterns.context: 医学论文正文开头的 Introduction 标题与 Markdown/类 Markdown 分节锚点、换行分隔符相邻出现；在多个例子中锚点含编号、连字符及论文标识符。
patterns.domain: PubMed Central 论文的结构化文本

patterns.name: 网络相关短语
patterns.context: 句首或名词短语开头出现 Network（包括复合词 Network-based），以及论文句首谈及无线传感器网络。第2、3段 Network 激活尤其强；第8段相似主题但激活分散。
patterns.domain: 网络安全、科学可视化、无线传感器网络

patterns.name: 技术文章标题链接中的固定短语
patterns.context: HackerNews 文本包含指向 Medium 文章的 slug，slug 将标题短语按连字符逐词编码；普通正文中的 job 激活弱。

patterns.name: 高调事件的叙述
patterns.context: 介绍过去几年发生过的若干引人注目的事件；激活集中在 instances，而不是整个句子。

patterns.name: 生物医学主题词及标题正文起始
patterns.context: 论文分节标记之后开始正文，出现疾病名、免疫防御、柔性系统或药物名等不同主题词；这些词各自只见于单段，未形成一致的具体语义触发条件。

patterns.name: 时间序列分析术语与时间实例
patterns.context: 非参数方法、平稳性区间、谱密度估计的学术讨论中，instances 指不同的时间实例；与第1段同一词形出现在不同语境。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 学术论文，时间序列/信号分析

en.description: Activation is scattered across hyphenated compounds and their fragments, Network terms, fragments of proper names/technical identifiers, and structural boundaries such as line breaks, indentation, and punctuation. Abstract headings followed by We-initial body text, IRC greetings, and court headings also appear.

patterns.name: Hyphens at word-initial or stem boundaries
patterns.context: A hyphen segments compounds, terms, or numeric identifiers; some activation falls on the hyphen and following fragment, though the position is not always consistent.
patterns.domain: Scientific papers, dates/identifiers, and general text

patterns.name: Network terms
patterns.context: Network appears sentence-initially or at the beginning of a compound term, followed by security or -based; it may also simply be part of a network-related Java constant.
patterns.domain: Network security, scientific abstracts, Java code

patterns.name: Separators and formatting markers in structured text
patterns.context: Strong activation appears near line breaks, indentation, punctuation, or field boundaries, especially in formatted code, JSON, and legal headings.

patterns.name: Internal fragments of proper names or technical identifiers
patterns.context: Technical names and abbreviations formed with capitals, camel case, or hyphens are split into multiple tokens; activation falls on some fragments or their boundaries.
patterns.domain: Java constants, HTTP configuration, network terminology, and legal case numbers

patterns.name: Sentence-initial format of abstract headings
patterns.context: In PubMed abstracts, a newline follows a title-style opening sentence, and the body begins with We.

patterns.name: Ordinary chat greetings and dates
patterns.context: IRC usernames, dates, line breaks, and speaker labels in angle brackets appear around greetings.

patterns.name: Court-heading typography
patterns.context: An uppercase court name follows the case number, with substantial whitespace at the line beginning and line breaks as separators.
patterns.domain: U.S. Courts of Appeals legal documents

patterns.name: Start of research abstract body
patterns.context: After the abstract heading or opening sentence, the body begins with first-person plural We to introduce the research activity.

6_741.description: 激活分散于连字符复合词及其片段、Network 词项、专名/技术标识符片段，以及换行、缩进和标点等结构边界；另见摘要标题与 We 开头正文、IRC 问候和法院抬头。

patterns.name: 词首或词干边界处的连字符
patterns.context: 连字符把复合词、术语或数字标识分段；部分激活落在连字符及其后片段，位置不总一致。
patterns.domain: 科学论文、日期/标识符及一般文本

patterns.name: Network 词项
patterns.context: 句首或复合术语开头出现 Network，后接 security 或 -based；也可能只是网络相关 Java 常量的一部分。
patterns.domain: 网络安全、科学摘要、Java 代码

patterns.name: 结构化文本中的分隔符与格式标记
patterns.context: 换行、缩进、标点或字段边界附近出现较强激活，尤其是格式化代码、JSON及法律抬头。

patterns.name: 专名或技术标识符的内部片段
patterns.context: 大写、驼峰或连字符构成的技术名称与缩写被拆成多个 token；激活落在部分片段或其边界。
patterns.domain: Java 常量、HTTP 配置、网络术语及法律案号

patterns.name: 摘要标题的句首格式
patterns.context: PubMed 摘要中，标题式首句后换行并以 We 开始正文。
patterns.domain: 生物医学及物理学论文摘要

patterns.name: 普通聊天问候及日期
patterns.context: IRC 用户名、日期、换行及带尖括号的发言者标签出现在问候前后。

patterns.name: 法院抬头排版
patterns.context: 案号之后是大写法院名称，行首有大量空格并以换行分隔。
patterns.domain: 美国上诉法院法律文书

patterns.name: 研究摘要正文起始
patterns.context: 摘要标题或首句之后，正文以第一人称复数 We 引入研究动作。

en.description: Activation is sporadic: it commonly appears on the “e.g.” example marker, line-break headings and statutory citations in legal documents, and term subwords, chemical names, and technical abbreviations across various professional texts. No single semantic theme is apparent.

patterns.name: e.g. example marker
patterns.context: When listing specific examples or citing example references, the marker itself is split into multiple tokens; punctuation varies slightly.
patterns.domain: Patent backgrounds, academic papers, and legal texts

patterns.name: Line breaks and heading layout in legal documents
patterns.context: A court heading follows a large blank area at the beginning of a document; activation is concentrated on line breaks and tokenized heading words.

patterns.name: Within-word fragments in biomedical terminology
patterns.context: Long biomedical words are split into subwords, and activation falls on internal term fragments; there is no shared specific meaning or fixed position.
patterns.domain: Biomedical paper titles and body text

patterns.name: Molecular formulas and chemical term fragments
patterns.context: Multiple components activate when compound names and their abbreviations appear in body text.

patterns.name: Fragments of communications technology abbreviations
patterns.context: A modulation-mode abbreviation appears in a technical context describing a data communication system.

patterns.name: Concept words in a memory research title
patterns.context: The title concerns human serial memory and the acquisition of overlapping sequences.

patterns.name: Fragments of legal citations and statutory numbers
patterns.context: When legal body text cites Georgia statutory numbers and case citations, numeric and abbreviated fragments activate.

6_741.concept: 碎片化的文本标记与子词
6_741.description: 激活分布零散：常见于“e.g.”示例标记、法律文书换行标题及法规引文，也覆盖多类专业文本中的术语子词、化学名称和技术缩写；未见单一语义主题。

patterns.name: e.g. 示例标记
patterns.context: 在列举具体例子或引用示例文献时，标记本身被拆成多个 token；标点形式略有不同。
patterns.domain: 专利背景、学术论文及法律文本

patterns.name: 法律文书的换行与标题排版
patterns.context: 文书开头的大段空行后接法院标题；激活集中在换行和标题字词的分词片段。

patterns.name: 生物医学术语中的词内片段
patterns.context: 较长的生物医学词被拆成子词，激活落在术语内部片段；没有共同的具体词义或固定位置。
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文标题及正文

patterns.name: 分子式与化学术语片段
patterns.context: 化合物名称及其缩写在正文中出现时，多个组成片段激活。
patterns.domain: PubMed Central 生物化学论文

patterns.name: 通信技术缩写片段
patterns.context: 在描述数据通信系统的技术语境中出现调制方式缩写。

patterns.name: 记忆研究标题中的概念词
patterns.context: 标题谈及人类序列记忆及重叠序列的习得。

patterns.name: 法律引文与法规编号片段
patterns.context: 法律正文引用佐治亚州法规编号及判例引文时，数字和缩写片段激活。
patterns.domain: FreeLaw 法律意见／判决文本

en.description: The clearest recurring pattern is “bona fide” in legal, contractual, and transactional texts. In addition, activation is scattered across token fragments, citations, formatting, and common words in legal documents, and appears in clinical-trial drug names and public-health abstracts; these side patterns may not share the same semantic mechanism.

patterns.name: bona fide phrase
patterns.context: The Latin phrase bona fide appears in legal, contractual, or transactional contexts; activation falls on bona, fide, and adjacent positions.

patterns.name: Tokenization and within-word fragments in legal documents
patterns.context: Proper names, legal terms, or common words in legal decisions or complaints are split into multiple subwords, with activation often falling on internal word fragments; no clear shared meaning condition links the passages.

patterns.name: English grammar/function words and collocations
patterns.context: These common function words or collocates appear in legal, contractual, or academic texts; trigger positions are scattered, with no single stable local grammatical condition.

patterns.name: Subwords in clinical trial drug names
patterns.context: In clinical trial descriptions, generic drug names are tokenized; activation is concentrated on internal drug-name subwords, with no shared medical semantic trigger across other passages.

patterns.name: U-shaped dose-response expressions
patterns.context: Academic sentences discussing dose-response curves and observed results; activation falls on fragments of U-shaped and dose-response.

patterns.name: Legal citations and statutory numbers
patterns.context: Code citations, provisions, or numeric identifiers in legal text; activation is distributed across numbers and citation components, possibly reflecting local responses to legal formatting.

patterns.name: Legal monetary amounts and penalty language
patterns.context: A tax decision states tax underpayment and accuracy-related penalties as monetary amounts; it is unclear whether the trigger is the amounts, legal vocabulary, or tokenization in combination.

patterns.name: Financial transactions and contract months
patterns.context: A contract clause explains futures contract months and price fluctuation limits; these financial terms are marked in the same passage as bona fide examples in other passages.

patterns.name: Document structure and decision formatting
patterns.context: Pagination, line breaks, headings, and case-name layout in legal materials; activation appears near formatting markers and heading fragments, possibly reflecting document formatting.

patterns.name: Public health outcome measures
patterns.context: An academic abstract lists health outcomes and measures; several measure terms activate weakly, but no clear shared trigger emerges.

6_741.concept: 法律语境中的 bona fide
6_741.description: 最清晰的重复模式是法律、合同及交易文本中的“bona fide”。此外，激活散布于法律文书的分词片段、引证、格式和常见词，也出现在临床试验药名与公共健康摘要中；这些旁支未必共享同一语义机制。

patterns.name: bona fide 短语
patterns.trigger: « bona»…« fide»（含“bona fide bid/offer”“bona fide student”“bona fide shall”）
patterns.context: 法律、合同或交易语境中出现拉丁语短语 bona fide；激活落在 bona、fide 及其相邻位置。

patterns.name: 法律文书中的分词与词内片段
patterns.context: 法律判决或诉状中的专名、法律术语或普通词被切分为多个子词，激活常落在词内片段；段间没有明显统一的词义条件。

patterns.name: 英语语法/连接词及搭配
patterns.trigger: « to»、« that»、« by»、« of»、« any»、« time»等
patterns.context: 法律、合同或学术文本中，这些常见功能词或搭配词在句中出现；触发位置分散，未见单一稳定的局部语法条件。

patterns.name: 临床试验药名中的子词
patterns.context: 临床试验描述中，药物通用名被分词；激活集中于药名内部子词，未见与其他段共享的医学语义触发。

patterns.name: U 形剂量反应相关表达
patterns.context: 讨论剂量反应曲线及其观察结果的学术句子；激活落在 U-shaped、dose-response 的片段。

patterns.name: 法律引证与法条编号
patterns.context: 法律文本中的法典引证、条款或数字编号；激活分布在编号及引证组成部分，可能是法律格式的局部响应。
patterns.domain: FreeLaw 判决、税务法律文书

patterns.name: 法律金额与罚款表述
patterns.context: 税务判决中以金额陈述税款不足及准确性相关罚款；是否由金额、法律词汇或分词共同触发不确定。

patterns.name: 金融交易与合约月份
patterns.trigger: « contract»« months»、« futures»、« price»« fluctuation»« limit»
patterns.context: 说明期货合约月份及价格波动限额的合同条款；与其他段的 bona fide 用例同处一段，但这些金融术语也被标记。
patterns.domain: 期货交易规则/合同文本

patterns.name: 文档结构及判决格式
patterns.trigger: «↵»、重复换行以及标题/案名格式（如«UNITED»« STATES»）
patterns.context: 法律材料的分页、换行、标题和案名排版；激活出现在格式标记及标题片段附近，可能受文档格式影响。

patterns.name: 公共健康结局指标
patterns.trigger: « public»« health»、« body»« weight»、« cholesterol»、« longevity»、« cancer»
patterns.context: 学术摘要列举健康结局和指标；多个指标词有弱激活，但未形成明确的共同触发词。

en.description: Activation is scattered across descriptions of medical results (seen, statistical analysis, correlations, reviews, etc.), interpreting and layout boundaries in legal documents, the locomotive term switcher, and clinical research overviews; no unified stable trigger word or semantic condition is apparent.

patterns.name: seen in results descriptions
patterns.context: Appears in academic phrasing describing observed group differences, survival rates, or outcomes, such as “mortality seen” and “survival seen”; the word itself activates most strongly in [1][2].

patterns.name: interpreting in a legal context
patterns.context: A legal opinion discusses how an agency interprets its own regulations; activation is concentrated on the split tokens “Inter”“pre”“ting”.

patterns.name: Line breaks/layout boundaries in judicial documents
patterns.context: After the end of a decision, a page break, aligned whitespace, and a new heading/factual paragraph appear; activation occurs near document-structure boundaries.

patterns.name: Locomotive terminology
patterns.context: In the railroad locomotive category term “road switcher,” activation falls on an internal fragment of “switcher.”

patterns.name: Opening of a clinical observation overview
patterns.context: A medical research overview introduces clinical observations and animal-model research data as sources of evidence.

patterns.name: Introducing results through statistical analysis
patterns.context: After reporting postoperative complications, statistical analysis introduces a comparison of survivors and non-survivors; strong activation falls on “indicated.”

patterns.name: Programmed sedation word fragment
patterns.context: A within-word fragment in “procedural sedation” activates in a context involving propofol use in children and adverse drug reactions.

patterns.name: Correlation result terminology
patterns.context: Describes VT:TI rank correlation under unloaded conditions and compares the effects of different loading conditions.

patterns.name: Research review verb fragment
patterns.context: A systematic review introduces its objective, focusing on the specific role of maternal depression and excessive infant crying; activation falls on the initial fragment of “investigates.”

6_741.description: 激活分散在医学结果叙述（seen、统计分析、相关性、综述等）、法律文书中的 interpreting 与版面边界、机车术语 switcher，以及临床研究概述；未见统一稳定的触发词或语义条件。

patterns.name: seen 结果表述
patterns.context: 出现在描述观察到的组间差异、生存率或结局的学术句式中，如“mortality seen”“survival seen”；[1][2] 中该词直接激活最强。

patterns.name: interpreting 法律语境
patterns.context: 法律意见书中讨论机构如何解释自身法规；激活集中在拆分呈现的“Inter”“pre”“ting”。

patterns.name: 裁判文书中的换行/版面边界
patterns.context: 判决结尾后出现分页符、对齐空白和新标题/事实段落，激活出现在文档结构边界附近。

patterns.name: 机车术语
patterns.context: “road switcher”这一铁路机车类别术语中，激活落在“switcher”的词内片段。

patterns.name: 临床观察开头

patterns.name: 统计分析引出结果
patterns.context: 报告术后并发症后，用统计分析引出幸存者与非幸存者比较；强激活落在“indicated”。

patterns.name: 程序镇静词片段
patterns.context: “procedural sedation”中词内片段被激活，语境为儿童使用丙泊酚及药物不良反应。

patterns.name: 相关性结果词
patterns.context: 描述未加载状态下 VT:TI 秩相关，并比较不同加载条件的影响。

patterns.name: 研究综述动词片段
patterns.context: 系统综述介绍研究目的，关注母亲抑郁与婴儿过度哭闹的特定作用；激活落在“investigates”的词首片段。

en.description: Activation is scattered across specialist papers and legal texts: microscopy magnification, numbers and units, research verbs, and experimental-result wording are evident, along with isolated signals from several fields. These patterns lack a unified semantic trigger.

patterns.name: Microscopy magnification expressions
patterns.context: In microscopy methods, a magnification symbol is adjacent to a magnification value and often accompanied by magnification(s); surrounding text may describe tissue or cell observations.

patterns.name: Decimal or scientific measurement values
patterns.context: A number appears in specific quantitative information such as dose, age, length, or amount; the number, unit, or punctuation may trigger activation, with different quantities involved.

patterns.name: Research verbs in paper narratives
patterns.context: Appears in statements of research aims or study design, often in “The present study examined…”; different research topics may occur in the same context.

patterns.name: Time and measurement analysis descriptions
patterns.context: Describes changes over time or experimental-result curves; trigger positions are near time markers or result-measurement language.

patterns.name: Laser wavelength units
patterns.context: In laser specifications, a wavelength value is paired with the unit mu, with nearby power, wavelength, or other device specifications.

patterns.name: Age and treatment start time
patterns.context: For newborns or patients, treatment start time is expressed as the number of days after birth, comparing treatment initiation timing.

patterns.name: Legal amounts and surety-bond context
patterns.context: An amount appears next to a description of a bond or contractual performance guarantee; activation in the same passage also includes «that» in legal opinion phrasing.

patterns.name: Genetic testing and chromosomal deletion
patterns.context: Genotyping reports a deletion of several Mb on a chromosome.

patterns.name: Pharmacological dose response
patterns.context: Describes a dose-response curve in a receptor agonist experiment, also involving a drug name and contraction response.

patterns.name: Paper equations and astrophysical quantities
patterns.context: Uses LaTeX mathematical symbols and units to express galaxy velocity dispersion, star formation rate, and luminosity.

patterns.name: Other specialist terms seen only in isolated passages
patterns.context: Individual passages concern clinical neurodevelopmental outcomes, blood perfusion, sleep quality, galaxy velocity, or litigants; they show no shared local trigger pattern.

6_741.description: 激活分散在专业论文与法律文本中：可见显微镜倍率、数值及单位、研究动词和实验结果措辞，也有多个孤立领域信号；这些模式缺少统一的语义触发条件。

patterns.name: 显微镜倍率表达
patterns.context: 显微镜观察方法中，倍率符号与倍率数值相邻，常伴随 magnification(s)；前后可描述组织或细胞观察。

patterns.name: 小数或科学计量数值
patterns.context: 数值处在剂量、年龄、长度或金额等具体量化信息中；数值及单位、标点可能触发，具体量纲不同。

patterns.name: 论文叙述中的研究动词
patterns.context: 出现在研究目的或研究设计表述中，常见于“The present study examined…”；同一上下文里可有不同研究主题。

patterns.name: 时间与测量分析表述
patterns.context: 描述随时间的变化或实验结果的曲线；触发位置邻近时间标记或结果测定措辞。

patterns.name: 激光波长单位
patterns.context: 激光器参数中，波长数值与单位 mu 相连，附近出现功率、wavelength 等设备规格。

patterns.name: 年龄与治疗启动时间
patterns.context: 新生儿或患者治疗开始时间以出生后天数表示，比较治疗启动时机。

patterns.name: 法律金额及担保债券语境
patterns.context: 金额紧邻债券或合同履约担保叙述；该段激活还包括法律意见表述中的«that»。

patterns.name: 遗传检测与染色体缺失
patterns.context: 基因分型检测报告染色体上的 Mb 级缺失。

patterns.name: 药理剂量反应
patterns.context: 受体激动剂实验中描述剂量反应曲线；也伴随药物名称及收缩反应。

patterns.name: 论文公式与天体物理量
patterns.context: 以 LaTeX 数学符号和单位表达星系速度弥散、恒星形成率及光度。
patterns.domain: 天体物理 ArXiv 论文

patterns.name: 仅见于片段的其他专业术语
patterns.context: 各段分别涉及临床神经发育结局、血流灌注、睡眠质量、星系速度或诉讼当事人，未显示共同的局部触发模式。

en.concept: Structure and result markers in specialist literature
en.description: Activation spans legal documents and biomedical papers, often occurring at paragraph breaks, litigation procedures, and citation formats. It also covers medical numeric units, time descriptions, and several specific clinical or experimental topics; no single semantic theme explains all activations.

patterns.name: Paragraph/section separators in legal documents
patterns.context: In legal text, new paragraphs, sections, or nearby headers/footers feature consecutive newline and formatting markers; common between paragraphs, at Roman-numeral section headings, or near page numbers.
patterns.domain: FreeLaw opinions and legal document formatting

patterns.name: Procedural language in legal decisions
patterns.context: When describing court rulings, appeals, or evidentiary motions, activation is distributed over litigation actions and neighboring words.
patterns.domain: Court decisions, appellate opinions, and evidentiary rulings

patterns.name: Legal citation and publication-number formats
patterns.context: Near citations, publication numbers, or page numbers in legal text, digits, abbreviations, and punctuation are mixed; some activations fall on citation markers.

patterns.name: Statistics and measurement units in medical research
patterns.context: When research results report values, statistics, units, measurement metrics, or percentages, activation often falls near numbers and units.

patterns.name: Descriptions of time course in medical papers
patterns.context: Occurs when describing the duration, time points, or postoperative changes in experiments or clinical observations.

patterns.name: Tumor treatment response and patient subgroups
patterns.context: When reporting tumor drug treatment, patient populations, and treatment response metrics, activation is concentrated in clinical-trial statements.

patterns.name: Legal standard for terminating child custody
patterns.context: Occurs in discussions of child placement, termination of parental rights, and best-interests-of-the-child determinations.

patterns.name: Delayed disclosure of expert testimony
patterns.context: Trial narratives concerning expert testimony, admission of evidence, or a jury being instructed to disregard an answer.

patterns.name: Medical terminology and physiological processes
patterns.context: Occurs in experimental results describing cold injury and perfusion changes in surrounding areas.

patterns.name: Polycyclic aromatic hydrocarbon pollution concentrations
patterns.context: Occurs when reporting pollutant concentrations, means, and errors during seawater contamination.

patterns.name: Imaging measurements of bone grafts
patterns.context: Occurs when discussing postoperative CT attenuation values and measurement accuracy for bone grafts within interbody fusion cages.

patterns.name: Specialist content fragments not fully explained
patterns.context: Although they occur in legal or medical specialist texts, these local triggers are not fully explained by the more specific patterns above.

6_741.concept: 专业文献结构与结果标记
6_741.description: 激活跨法律文书与生物医学论文，常见于段落换行、诉讼程序和引文格式，也覆盖医学数值单位、时间描述及多个具体临床或实验主题；没有单一语义主题能解释全部激活。

patterns.name: 法律文书中的段落/章节分隔符
patterns.context: 法律文本中换段、章节或页眉页脚附近，换行符及格式标记连续出现；常见于段落间、罗马数字章节标题或页码位置。
patterns.domain: FreeLaw 判决书及法律文书排版

patterns.name: 法律判决中的程序性措辞
patterns.trigger: “The District Court granted”“summary judgment”“timely appeal”“Defendant appeals”“moved to admit”
patterns.context: 叙述法院裁定、上诉或证据申请时，激活分布在诉讼动作及其相邻词语上。
patterns.domain: 判决书、上诉意见及证据裁定

patterns.name: 法律引文及文献编号格式
patterns.context: 法律文本引文、出版物编号或页码附近，数字、缩写和标点混杂；其中部分激活落在引文标识上。

patterns.name: 医学研究中的统计量与测量单位
patterns.trigger: “24 h UFC”“mean value”“321.0 ± 9.3 ng l⁻¹”“0.97”“Hounsfield unit”“26%”
patterns.context: 研究结果报告数值、统计量、单位、测量指标或百分比时，激活常落在数字及单位附近。

patterns.name: 医学论文中的时间进程描述
patterns.trigger: “over time (22 hours)”“postoperative period”“During the contamination period”
patterns.context: 描述实验或临床观察跨越的时间、时间点或术后变化时出现。

patterns.name: 肿瘤治疗反应与患者亚组
patterns.context: 报告肿瘤药物治疗、患者群体及治疗反应指标时，激活集中在临床试验语句。

patterns.name: 儿童监护终止的法定标准
patterns.trigger: “children could not be placed with him”“reasonable period of time”“best interests”
patterns.context: 讨论儿童安置、终止父母权利及儿童最佳利益判断时出现。

patterns.name: 延迟披露专家证词
patterns.trigger: “Expert Testimony on Delayed Disclosure”“expert”“disregard any answer entirely”
patterns.context: 关于专家证词、证据采纳或陪审团被要求忽略回答的庭审叙述。

patterns.name: 医学术语与生理过程
patterns.context: 描述冷冻损伤及其周围区域灌注变化的实验结果时出现。

patterns.name: 多环芳烃污染浓度
patterns.trigger: “16 US EPA priority poly-aromatic hydrocarbons”“mean value”“ng l⁻¹”
patterns.context: 报告海水污染期间污染物浓度及均值、误差时出现。

patterns.name: 骨移植物影像测量
patterns.context: 讨论椎间融合器内骨移植物的术后 CT 衰减值及测量准确性时出现。

patterns.name: 未充分解释的专业内容片段
patterns.trigger: “to give such testimony, under oath”及“PPNAD”“LDDST”“Dueñas”等术语
patterns.context: 虽落在法律或医学专业文本中，但这些局部触发不能由上述较具体模式完整解释。

en.description: The main response concerns courts, rulings, judgments, and appellate procedure in U.S. cases, and is especially sensitive to line breaks, headings, and layout whitespace; it also covers legal topics such as child welfare, criminal hearings, fees, evidence, and vaccine compensation.

patterns.name: Court rulings and procedural history in appellate opinions
patterns.context: Recounts rulings and judgments by trial or appellate courts and the course of an appeal, often at the end of a paragraph or after a heading; activation is not limited to any single fixed legal term

patterns.name: Court reasoning, findings, and application of law
patterns.context: Discusses whether a court made a finding, the basis for the finding, or the grounds for a ruling; often linked to case facts or evidence

patterns.name: Structural markers and pagination in judicial documents
patterns.context: Activation can occur near paragraph breaks, section headings, concluding transitions, and page numbers/layout whitespace in legal documents; formatting tokens themselves appear strongly across multiple passages

patterns.name: Court orders and enforcement of judgments
patterns.context: Explains that a clerk enters and enforces a judgment under the rules, including procedural time limits

patterns.name: Vaccine injury compensation program rulings
patterns.context: Discusses compensation amounts, recoverable damages, and approved awards under a vaccine program

patterns.name: Termination of parental rights and child placement standards
patterns.context: Applies statutory standards such as whether a child can be placed within a reasonable period and the child’s best interests

patterns.name: Criminal sentencing and hearing disputes
patterns.context: Discusses whether to hold an ability-to-pay hearing and the court’s denial of a motion, in the context of the Dueñas case

patterns.name: Comparison of evidence and witness testimony
patterns.context: Compares common factors across different abuse incidents and includes a trial testimony heading

patterns.name: Litigation cost rulings and appeals
patterns.context: After the court awards litigation costs, a party appeals the judgment

patterns.name: Failed settlement and standard of review
patterns.context: States that failure to settle may be related to uncertainty about the disputed issues, then turns to the standard of review

patterns.name: Legal citations and amended charges
patterns.context: Cites precedent and discusses whether amendment of criminal charges is permitted; also includes code section numbers and damages text

6_741.description: 主要响应美国判例中的法院、裁定、判决及上诉程序，并对换行、标题和排版空白尤其敏感；另覆盖儿童福利、刑事听证、费用、证据及疫苗赔偿等法律专题。

patterns.name: 上诉意见中的法院裁定与程序经过

patterns.name: 法院理由、认定与法律适用

patterns.name: 裁判文书的结构标记及分页格式

patterns.name: 法院命令及判决执行

patterns.context: 说明书记员依规则登记并执行判决，含程序期限条件

patterns.name: 疫苗伤害补偿计划裁决

patterns.name: 刑事量刑及听证争议

patterns.name: 证据与证人证言比较

patterns.name: 诉讼费用裁定与上诉

patterns.name: 和解未果与审查标准
patterns.context: 指出未能和解可能与争议问题的不确定性有关，随后转入审查标准

en.concept: Methods and results phrasing in academic text
en.description: Activation is scattered across common function words and academic phrasing in papers and legal documents, with more prominent patterns involving follow-up duration, experimental measurement and methods, and research evaluation. Isolated examples also include publishing, social surveys, legal narratives, and decimal values; no unified semantic trigger pattern covers all passages.

patterns.name: Follow-up duration and months
patterns.context: A clinical study describes patient follow-up duration, especially follow-up followed by of, a number, and months.

patterns.name: Common preposition of
patterns.context: In academic or legal text, of occurs inside a noun phrase, connecting a quantity, research subject, or possessive element; trigger strength and context vary.

patterns.name: Measurement and instruments in methodology
patterns.context: Descriptions of experimental methods or analytical techniques include measurements, detection instruments, or chromatography/mass spectrometry terminology.

patterns.name: Research design and evaluation phrasing
patterns.context: A paper introduces evaluation content, compares studies, or reports estimates; trigger words are scattered, with no consistent nearby collocation.

patterns.name: Decimal points in fractions
patterns.context: A decimal point separates the integer and fractional parts of a number.

patterns.name: Quotations and rulings in legal decision narratives
patterns.context: After case facts, the text recounts trial proceedings and court rulings, including quotations or line breaks.

patterns.name: Publishing markets and predatory journals
patterns.context: Discusses fake journals, journal counts, or characteristics of the publishing market.
