en.description: Primarily responds to numbers and their units, percentages, times, and sample sizes in structured text, especially experimental conditions and statistical reports in medical research. It also activates strongly on line breaks and indentation in legal documents, headings, and scientific-notation statistical output.

patterns.name: Follow-up duration and patient statistics in clinical studies
patterns.context: Medical abstracts reporting sample sizes, follow-up duration, patient survival, or study-subject statistics; numbers are adjacent to units and percentages.

patterns.name: Experimental conditions and quantitative measurements
patterns.context: Descriptions of experimental groups, dose ranges, incubation or treatment conditions, and quantitative measurements of hormones, materials, and other targets.

patterns.name: Study design and quantitative data reporting
patterns.context: Epidemiological or longitudinal studies reporting cohort size, risk-change percentages, and repeated-measure items.

patterns.name: Headings and layout formatting in legal documents
patterns.context: A judgment paragraph transitions to a section heading; strong activation also falls on newlines and indentation whitespace.

patterns.name: Numeric formatting in statistical software output
patterns.context: Values are presented in scientific notation and aligned table format, accompanied by statistical summary labels.

6_741.description: 主要响应结构化文本中的数值及其单位、百分比、时间和样本量，尤其是医学研究的实验条件与统计报告；也会在法律文书换行缩进、标题，以及科学计数法统计输出中强烈激活。

patterns.name: 临床研究中的随访时长与患者统计
patterns.context: 医学摘要中报告样本量、随访时长、患者存活或研究对象统计；数字与单位、百分比相邻

patterns.name: 实验条件与定量测量
patterns.context: 描述实验组、剂量范围、孵育或处理条件，以及对激素、材料等进行定量测量
patterns.domain: 生物医学研究摘要与方法

patterns.name: 研究设计及量化数据报告
patterns.context: 流行病学或纵向研究中报告队列规模、风险变化比例及重复测量项目

patterns.name: 法律文书的标题与版面格式
patterns.context: 判决书段落转入分节标题；强激活还落在换行和缩进空白上

patterns.name: 统计软件输出中的数字格式
patterns.context: 数值以科学计数法和对齐的表格样式呈现，并伴随统计摘要标签

en.description: All passages involve chromatography, mass spectrometry, or related instrumental analysis terminology. The most stable trigger is chromatography followed by a hyphen and mass spectrometry; related terms include compound method names such as GC/LC, tandem, ion-trap, time-of-flight, and combustion-isotope. These terms are often used in biomedical sample analysis or lists of methods.

patterns.name: Chromatography–mass spectrometry methods
patterns.context: Analyzing hormones, metabolites, amino acids, and other substances in blood, serum, culture medium, plasma, or other samples; also includes method introductions, detection targets, and method comparisons.
patterns.domain: Abstracts, methods sections, and project descriptions in biomedical and analytical chemistry research

patterns.name: Internal fragments of compound chromatography–mass spectrometry terms
patterns.context: When technical names are hyphenated, strong activation falls on internal fragments of the proper name; this is not limited to conventional LC-MS and also includes extended combinations such as isotope analysis.
patterns.domain: Instrumental analysis terminology, especially biomedical sample analysis

patterns.name: Lists of chromatography and mass spectrometry methods
patterns.context: Several identification or analytical methods are listed together, with chromatography/mass spectrometry terms appearing in the list; they are not necessarily the sole or primary methods.
patterns.domain: Research papers on drugs, lipids, and bioactive products

6_741.description: 所有段落均涉及色谱、质谱或相邻仪器分析术语；最稳定的触发是 chromatography 后接连字符及 mass spectrometry，兼及 GC/LC、tandem、ion-trap、time-of-flight、combustion-isotope 等复合方法名，常用于生物医学样品测定或方法清单。

patterns.name: 色谱-质谱分析法
patterns.trigger: “liquid chromatography-…mass spectrometry”“gas chromatography-mass spectrometry”“high-performance liquid chromatography”“LC-MS”“HPLC”“GC-MS”
patterns.context: 分析血液、血清、培养基、血浆或其他样品中的激素、代谢物、氨基酸等；也包括方法介绍、检测目标和方法比较。
patterns.domain: 生物医学与分析化学论文摘要、方法段及项目描述

patterns.name: 色谱-质谱复合术语内部片段
patterns.trigger: “chromatography-”后接仪器或分析技术名的片段，如“-tandem mass spectrometry”“-ion trap-time of flight mass spectrometry”“-combustion-high precision gas isotope”
patterns.context: 技术名称被连字符连接时，强激活落在专名内部片段；不限于常规 LC-MS，也包括同位素分析等延伸组合。
patterns.domain: 仪器分析术语，尤其生物样品测定

patterns.name: 色谱与质谱并列的分析方法清单
patterns.trigger: “UV-spectroscopy”“high pressure liquid chromatography”“photodiode array”“gas chromatography-mass spectrometry”
patterns.context: 多种鉴定或分析手段并列，色谱/质谱术语出现在清单中，不一定是唯一或主要方法。
patterns.domain: 药物、脂质及生物活性产物分析论文

en.concept: Quantitative information in technical and research reports
en.description: Covers quantitative measurements, numeric parameters, and statistical estimates in research or engineering texts, as well as survey sampling methods and Chinese serial-port debugging comments. Triggers are often around terms or numbers, with no single stable word form apparent.

patterns.name: Statistical results and ratio terminology
patterns.context: Activation falls on statistical estimates, regression analysis, and ratio terminology, usually in the results or methods narrative of medical research; also includes descriptions of experimental results.

patterns.name: Numbers and quantitative measurements
patterns.context: Experimental or engineering texts contain measured values, units, sampling parameters, repeated measurements, or means; activation is distributed across numbers, units, and measurement-related words.
patterns.domain: Biomedical experiments, signal measurement, engineering patents

patterns.name: Survey samples and polling methods
patterns.context: Describes polling methods, interview dates, and sample composition.

patterns.name: Serial-port output and observation
patterns.context: Chinese technical comments describe observing serial print output; activation falls on parts of the words for “observe” and “print.”

6_741.concept: 技术与研究报告中的量化信息
6_741.description: 涵盖研究或工程文本里的量化测量、数字参数与统计估计，也包括调查抽样方法及中文串口调试注释。触发位置多为术语或数值周边，未见单一稳定词形。

patterns.name: 统计结果与比值术语
patterns.context: 激活落在统计估计、回归分析及比值术语上，通常处于医学研究的结果或方法叙述中；也包括实验结果表述。
patterns.domain: 生物医学研究与统计报告

patterns.name: 数字与量化测量
patterns.context: 实验或工程文本中出现测量值、单位、采样参数、重复测量或平均值；激活分布在数字、单位及测量相关词上。
patterns.domain: 生物医学实验、信号测量、工程专利

patterns.name: 调查样本与民调方法
patterns.context: 描述调查的民调方法、访谈时间及抽样构成。

patterns.name: 串口输出与观察
patterns.context: 中文技术注释中描述观察串口打印输出；激活落在“观察”及“打印”的部分字词上。

en.description: Activation spans serial-port descriptions in code comments, samples and results in papers, and numerical parameters and units in experimental methods; it also covers rating explanations on review-aggregation websites. The shared theme is weak, and the passages commonly contain information-dense technical or quantitative statements.

patterns.name: Serial-port strings and log comments
patterns.context: Chinese code comments describe serial-port output, received strings, and observing serial prints; trigger terms are scattered across these expressions.

patterns.name: Quantitative research results and sample values
patterns.context: Research papers present survey participants, dataset sizes, or experimental results, with numbers adjacent to method descriptions.
patterns.domain: Public health and machine learning papers

patterns.name: Numerical parameters and units in experimental methods
patterns.context: Experimental procedures or materials and methods give specific parameters such as culture conditions, pressure, optical density, temperature, and instrument models; numbers, units, abbreviations, and punctuation often appear in sequence.
patterns.domain: Experimental methods in biomedical and materials science papers

patterns.name: Review ratings and quantitative evaluation
patterns.context: An introduction to music reviews mentions that Metacritic normalizes mainstream reviews to a 100-point rating scale.

6_741.concept: 技术文本中的量化细节
6_741.description: 激活覆盖代码注释中的串口描述、论文中的样本与结果，以及实验方法里的数值参数和单位；另覆盖评论聚合网站的评分说明。共同点较弱，常见于信息密集的技术或量化陈述。

patterns.name: 串口字符串与日志注释
patterns.context: 中文代码注释中描述串口输出、收到的字符串，以及观察串口打印；触发字分散在这些词语中

patterns.name: 定量研究结果与样本数值
patterns.context: 研究论文中呈现调查对象、数据集规模或实验结果，数字和方法描述相邻
patterns.domain: 公共卫生与机器学习论文

patterns.name: 实验方法中的数值参数与单位
patterns.context: 实验步骤或材料方法中给出培养条件、压力、光密度、温度、仪器型号等具体参数；常见数字、单位、缩写和标点连续出现
patterns.domain: 生物医学与材料科学论文实验方法

patterns.name: 评论评分与量化评价
patterns.context: 音乐评论介绍中，提及 Metacritic 将主流评论归一化为百分制评分

en.description: Activation spans a range of paper methods and results styles, especially quantitative data, measurement units, and microplate readers. It also occurs in polling, financial reporting, clinical follow-up, PCR, GNN, and analytical chemistry contexts. There is no single trigger theme.

patterns.name: poll at the end of a report or polling sentence
patterns.context: In news or narrative, “poll” means an opinion poll and often appears near the end of a sentence introducing the poll’s source or sample.

patterns.name: Microplate readings and instruments
patterns.context: Experimental methods report absorbance measurements, wavelengths, and microplate readers; adjacent instrument or manufacturer names may also occur.

patterns.name: Exact values or measurement results
patterns.context: Values are embedded in quantitative results, units, concentrations, or measurement conditions; activation falls on values, units, and adjacent punctuation.
patterns.domain: Scientific papers, including quantitative results in financial news

patterns.name: PCR markers in experimental methods
patterns.context: When describing gene-expression assays and PCR assay steps, activation is concentrated on method names and punctuation.

patterns.name: Research results and evaluation phrasing
patterns.context: Paper narratives discuss research evaluation, experimental results, or observed effects, with no stable trigger term apparent.

patterns.name: Follow-up duration and clinical sample statistics
patterns.context: Clinical studies report cases, eye counts, treatment sessions, and follow-up duration, especially follow-up data expressed in months.

patterns.name: Analytical chemistry calibration and law
patterns.context: Describes reaction conditions, specificity, and the absorbance law followed by a calibration curve.

patterns.name: Financial performance and analyst estimates
patterns.context: News reports quarterly profit changes and compares results with the average analyst forecast.

patterns.name: Graph neural network tasks and performance
patterns.context: Introduces GNN methods, prediction tasks, and experimental performance; some trigger words are generic.

patterns.name: Platelet experiments and IC50
patterns.context: Reports inhibition of platelet adhesion and related concentration/effect metrics.

patterns.name: Gene-expression assays in animal models
patterns.context: Describes gene-expression measurements and PCR arrays in the aortas of mice on a high-fat diet.

patterns.name: TSA public-opinion polling
patterns.context: In commentary about U.S. airport security, cites a Gallup poll to support claims about public attitudes.

6_741.description: 激活覆盖多种论文方法与结果写法，尤其常见定量数据、测量单位及微孔板读数仪；也出现在民调、财经报道、临床随访、PCR、GNN和分析化学语境。触发并非单一主题。

patterns.name: 报告或民调句末 poll
patterns.context: 新闻或叙述中以“poll”指民意调查，且常出现在介绍调查来源或样本的句末附近。

patterns.name: 微孔板读数与仪器
patterns.context: 实验方法描述中报告吸光度测量、波长及微孔板读数仪；相邻仪器或厂商名称也可能出现。

patterns.name: 精确数值或测量结果
patterns.context: 数值嵌入定量结果、单位、浓度或测量条件中；激活落在数值、单位及相邻标点上。
patterns.domain: 科学论文，也包括财务新闻中的量化结果

patterns.name: 实验方法中的 PCR 标记
patterns.context: 描述基因表达检测及 PCR 测定步骤时，激活集中在检测方法名称和标点。

patterns.name: 研究结果与评估措辞
patterns.context: 论文叙述研究评估、实验结果或效应观察，未见稳定的专属术语触发。
patterns.domain: 机器学习论文、生物医学摘要

patterns.name: 随访时长和临床样本统计
patterns.context: 临床研究报告病例、眼数、治疗次数及随访时长，尤其以月份表示的随访数据。

patterns.name: 分析化学校准与定律
patterns.context: 说明反应条件、特异性及校准曲线遵循的吸光度定律。

patterns.name: 财务业绩与分析师估计
patterns.context: 新闻报道季度利润变动，并将结果与分析师平均预期比较。

patterns.name: 图神经网络任务与性能
patterns.context: 介绍 GNN 方法、预测任务及实验表现；部分触发词较泛化。

patterns.name: 血小板实验与 IC50
patterns.context: 报告血小板黏附抑制及相关浓度/效应指标。

patterns.name: 动物模型基因表达检测
patterns.context: 描述高脂饮食小鼠主动脉中的基因表达测量及 PCR 阵列。

patterns.name: TSA 舆论民调
patterns.context: 在关于美国机场安检的评论中，以 Gallup 民调支持关于公众态度的说法。

en.description: Activation is distributed across scientific methods, clinical abstracts, financial news, and machine learning papers. Salient fragments are often instrument/detection terms, numbers and units, model names, and statistical results; no single narrow semantic topic explains all passages.

patterns.name: Microplate readers and absorbance detection
patterns.context: Absorbance or cell viability is measured at a specific wavelength in experimental samples; the sentence mentions a microplate reader, ELISA reader, or instrument/brand information.
patterns.domain: Biomedical experimental methods, materials and methods sections

patterns.name: Numbers, units, and statistics in methods and results
patterns.context: Quantities, measurements, time, and units appear densely in contexts such as experimental procedures, clinical follow-up, or financial results; this pattern is broad and may not represent an independent trigger mechanism.
patterns.domain: Scientific papers and news reports across fields

patterns.name: Spectrometer model and brand strings
patterns.context: When describing drug quantification or data sources, instrument names, models, database names, and brands appear as proper names with hyphens or mixed capitalization.
patterns.domain: Biomedical materials and methods, research data descriptions

patterns.name: Follow-up duration and clinical participant counts
patterns.context: Clinical research narratives report a follow-up duration immediately after mean follow-up, alongside statistics such as patient or eye counts and ranges.

patterns.name: Financial figures and forecast surveys
patterns.context: When reporting company or market results, monetary amounts, analyst estimates, and news-agency survey results appear together.

patterns.name: Machine learning experiments and dataset names
patterns.context: Introduces models, learning methods, and datasets, and discusses papers through experimental results.

patterns.name: Biological assay procedures and reagent names
patterns.context: Reagents are added to cells, followed by incubation and measurement of cell viability; concentration, time, temperature, and detection instruments often appear as well.

patterns.name: Gene expression and PCR expression profiling
patterns.context: Compares gene expression in mouse or tissue samples, involving dietary treatment, genotype, and quantitative PCR.

patterns.name: RNA-seq data sources and databases
patterns.context: Describes public sequencing data files used in a study and their download sources.

patterns.name: Ophthalmic tumor treatment and case statistics
patterns.context: A retrospective ophthalmology study describes the number of eyes, treatments, and follow-up for patients with retinoblastoma.

6_741.description: 激活分布在科学方法、临床摘要、财经新闻和机器学习论文中。显著片段多为仪器/检测词、数字与单位、型号专名及统计结果；没有一个狭窄语义主题能解释全部段落。

patterns.name: 微孔板读数仪及吸光度检测
patterns.context: 实验样品在特定波长测量吸光度或细胞活性，句中出现 microplate reader、ELISA reader，或仪器/品牌信息。
patterns.domain: 生物医学实验方法、论文材料与方法

patterns.name: 方法与结果中的数字、单位和统计数值
patterns.context: 在实验步骤、临床随访或财务结果等语境中，数量、测量值、时间和单位密集出现；此模式较宽泛，未必是独立触发机制。
patterns.domain: 跨领域的科学论文及新闻报道

patterns.name: 光谱仪器型号与品牌字符串
patterns.context: 描述药物定量或数据来源时，仪器名称、型号、数据库名及品牌以带连字符或大小写混合的专名形式出现。
patterns.domain: 生物医学材料与方法、科研数据说明

patterns.name: 随访时长及临床人数统计
patterns.context: 临床研究叙述中紧接 mean follow-up 的随访时间，并伴有患者或眼数、范围等统计信息。

patterns.name: 财务数字与预测调查报道
patterns.context: 报道公司或市场结果时，金额、分析师估计及新闻机构调查结果集中出现。

patterns.name: 机器学习实验与数据集名称
patterns.context: 介绍模型、学习方法和数据集，并以实验结果作论文论述。

patterns.name: 生物实验测定流程与试剂名称
patterns.context: 向细胞加入试剂、孵育后测量细胞活性，常伴随浓度、时间、温度和检测仪器。

patterns.name: 基因表达与 PCR 表达谱
patterns.context: 比较小鼠或组织样本的基因表达，涉及饮食处理、基因型及定量 PCR。

patterns.name: RNA-seq 数据来源与数据库
patterns.context: 说明研究所用的公开测序数据文件及其下载来源。

patterns.name: 眼科肿瘤治疗与病例统计
patterns.context: 回顾性眼科研究描述视网膜母细胞瘤患者接受治疗的眼数、治疗次数及随访。

en.description: Most paragraphs activate on experimental-result phrasing in papers (results and surrounding words); there are also two occurrences of the proper name “Lech” in different contexts, and PXRD and calibration-curve terminology in chemical research.

patterns.name: Experimental-result phrasing
patterns.context: Occurs in paper narratives introducing methods, experiments, or evaluations, often followed by results, datasets, or performance descriptions.
patterns.domain: Academic papers (machine learning, image processing, engineering, medicine, etc.)

patterns.name: Lech string
patterns.context: Activation is concentrated on the proper-name fragment “Lech” split across tokens, appearing in the name of the Polish president and in a person’s name mentioned in an email; the contexts differ in topic.

patterns.name: Other paper-method or characterization terminology
patterns.context: Descriptions of characterization methods and experimental calibration relationships in chemical or materials research; these fragments have no obvious “results” trigger.

6_741.description: 多数段落激活于论文中的实验结果表述（results及其前后词）；另有两个不同语境下的“Lech”专名，以及化学研究中的PXRD和校准曲线术语。

patterns.name: 实验结果表述
patterns.trigger: “Experimental results”或“experimental results”，以及“test results”“simulation results”；常伴随“indicate”“reveal”等结果动词
patterns.context: 出现在介绍方法、实验或评估的论文叙述中，常接结果、数据集或性能描述。
patterns.domain: 学术论文（机器学习、图像处理、工程、医学等）

patterns.name: Lech 字符串
patterns.context: 激活集中在跨 token 切分的专名片段“Lech”，分别出现在波兰总统姓名和邮件提及的人名中；上下文主题不同。

patterns.name: 其他论文方法或表征术语
patterns.trigger: 段7的“PXRD”、 “X-ray diffraction”；段8的“calibration curve”“Lambert-Beer law”
patterns.context: 化学或材料研究中对表征方法、实验校准关系的叙述；这些片段没有明显的“results”触发词。

en.description: Activation is scattered across rare abbreviations, technical terminology, standardized values, and proper names in specialized texts: biomedical experiments and statistics, spectroscopy, financial reporting, legal citations, conservation classifications, and name lists. No single semantic theme runs through all passages.

patterns.name: PCR detection terminology
patterns.context: Experimental methods mention PCR, qRT-PCR, and detection arrays.

patterns.name: ROC statistical analysis
patterns.context: Prediction, diagnosis, or evaluation discussions mention ROC curves or analysis, often alongside AUC.

patterns.name: Analytical instruments and spectroscopic methods
patterns.context: Sample composition analysis mentions specific analytical instruments or spectral measurements.

patterns.name: Biomedical numerical results
patterns.context: Pharmacological or physiological experimental results report IC50 and effect concentrations in scientific notation.

patterns.name: Analyst surveys and financial reporting
patterns.context: Reports on corporate performance and market expectations cite a news agency's survey of analysts.

patterns.name: Chemical identification abbreviations
patterns.context: Explains the basis for compound structure identification, listing methods and abbreviations such as mass spectrometry and nuclear magnetic resonance.

patterns.name: Legal case citations
patterns.context: Legal arguments cite U.S. cases, volume and page numbers, and statute-style abbreviations.

patterns.name: Conservation status and organization abbreviations
patterns.context: Descriptions of species conservation status include IUCN classification terms and organization abbreviations.

patterns.name: Rare surnames in name lists
patterns.context: The surname Leff appears in an email recipient or contact list.
patterns.domain: Email address books or email body text

6_741.description: 激活分散于专业文本的稀有缩写、技术术语、标准化数值或专名：涵盖生物医学实验与统计、光谱分析、财经报道、法律引证、保护分类及人名名单，未见贯穿各段的单一语义主题。

patterns.name: PCR 检测术语
patterns.context: 描述实验方法时，出现 PCR、qRT-PCR 及检测阵列等术语。

patterns.name: ROC 统计分析
patterns.context: 讨论预测、诊断或评估时，出现 ROC 曲线或分析；常与 AUC 并列。

patterns.name: 分析仪器与光谱方法
patterns.context: 描述样品成分测定，提及具体分析仪器或光谱测量。

patterns.name: 生物医学数值结果
patterns.context: 报告药理或生理实验结果，以 IC50 和科学计数法表示效应浓度。

patterns.name: 分析师调查与财务报道
patterns.context: 报道企业业绩及市场预期，并引用通讯社对分析师的调查。

patterns.name: 化学鉴定缩写
patterns.context: 说明化合物结构鉴定依据，列举质谱、核磁共振等方法及缩写。

patterns.name: 法律判例引证
patterns.context: 法律论证中引用美国判例、卷页及法典式缩写。

patterns.name: 保护状态与机构缩写
patterns.context: 说明物种保护现状，出现 IUCN 分类术语及机构缩写。

patterns.name: 人名名单中的罕见姓氏
patterns.context: 邮件收件人或联系人名单中出现姓氏 Leff。
patterns.domain: 邮件通讯录或邮件正文

en.description: Activation is concentrated on tokenized fragments such as proper names, links, or numbers: IUCN species conservation status, IUC-R archive URLs, and also news polling, financial forecasts, game ratings, and platelet-experiment terminology and values. The common pattern is weak.

patterns.name: IUCN conservation-status wording
patterns.context: In species-status sentences, the IUCN name or conservation-status terms are split into tokens; they are often adjacent to information about species threats, conservation measures, or distribution.

patterns.name: IUC-R electronic archive links
patterns.context: IUC-R URLs following supplementary-data descriptions, especially domain names and link identifiers; the three links are highly similar in format.
patterns.domain: Academic paper supplementary materials and reference links

patterns.name: News polling phrasing
patterns.context: Cites a poll and its sponsor in the context of U.S. airport security.

patterns.name: Financial figures and analyst forecasts
patterns.context: Quarterly company profit changes, comparing actual results with analyst estimates.

patterns.name: Game-review aggregations
patterns.context: A Reception section after game-release information describes aggregate ratings sources.

patterns.name: Platelet experimental metrics
patterns.context: Experimental research reports a drug’s inhibitory effect on platelet function and gives doses/values.

6_741.description: 激活集中于专名、链接或数值等被拆分标记的片段：IUCN物种保护等级、IUC-R档案网址，另见新闻民调、财经预测、游戏评分及血小板实验术语与数值；共同规律不强。

patterns.name: IUCN保护等级表述
patterns.context: 物种保护状态句中，IUCN 名称或保护等级词被拆分标记；常与物种威胁、保护措施或分布信息相邻
patterns.domain: 百科全书、物种保护说明

patterns.name: IUC-r电子档案链接
patterns.context: 补充数据说明后的 IUC-R 网址，尤其域名及链接标识符；三个链接格式高度相似
patterns.domain: 学术论文补充材料与参考链接

patterns.name: 新闻民调措辞
patterns.context: 美国机场安检话题中引用民调及其委托方

patterns.name: 财务数字与分析师预测
patterns.context: 公司季度利润变动、实际结果与分析师预估对比

patterns.name: 游戏评价汇总
patterns.context: 游戏发行信息之后的 Reception 段，说明综合评分来源

patterns.name: 血小板实验指标
patterns.context: 实验研究报告药物对血小板功能的抑制效果，并给出剂量/数值

en.concept: Analytical and measurement terminology in technical reports
en.description: Most passages come from scientific papers, with activation commonly occurring around analytical techniques, instrument names, method steps, and technical terms; there are also evaluation, valuation, and source terms in game reviews and financial reporting.

patterns.name: Microscopy and analytical terms in method names
patterns.context: Research methods or results introduce analytical techniques, instruments, or measurement procedures; triggers often fall within method names, especially near terms such as microscopy, spectrophotometer, and qRT-PCR.

patterns.name: Experimental steps and numerical conditions
patterns.context: Experimental procedures involve measurement, culturing, centrifugation, or quantification steps, often accompanied by instruments, units, times, or numerical parameters.

patterns.name: Specific terms or entities in scientific prose
patterns.context: Biomedical or materials science texts contain technical abbreviations, chemicals, or research subjects; some triggers may come from subword fragments within complex terms.
patterns.domain: Life sciences, chemistry, and materials science

patterns.name: Results terminology in reviews or reports
patterns.context: Encyclopedic passages introduce game reviews, review aggregations, and sources; highlights focus on evaluation-related words and proper names.

patterns.name: Statistical and source phrasing in financial reports
patterns.context: Reports on company profits and analyst expectations contain valuations, survey sources, and analyst counts.

6_741.concept: 专业报告中的分析与测量术语
6_741.description: 多数段落来自科学论文，激活常见于分析技术、仪器名称、方法步骤和专业术语；另有游戏评价与财经报道中的评价、估值及来源词。

patterns.name: 分析方法名中的显微镜与分析术语
patterns.trigger: «analysis»、«microscopy»、«spectrophotometer»、«cytometric»及相关方法名中的高亮 token
patterns.context: 论文方法或结果中介绍分析技术、仪器或测量流程；触发常落在方法名称内部，尤其是 microscopy、spectrophotometer、qRT-PCR 等术语附近
patterns.domain: 生物医学与材料科学论文

patterns.name: 实验步骤与数值条件
patterns.context: 实验操作描述中出现测量、培养、离心或定量步骤，常伴随仪器、单位、时间或数值参数

patterns.name: 科学文体中的特定术语或实体
patterns.context: 生物医学或材料科学文本中出现专业缩写、化学物质或研究对象；部分触发可能来自复杂术语内部的子词
patterns.domain: 生命科学、化学与材料科学

patterns.name: 评价或报道文本中的结果术语
patterns.context: 介绍游戏评价、评论汇总及来源的百科段落；高亮集中于评价相关词和专名

patterns.name: 财经报道中的统计与来源表述
patterns.context: 报道企业利润及分析师预期时，出现估值、调查来源和分析师数量

en.description: Primarily responds to terms for analytical instruments and measurement methods in scientific literature, especially spectrophotometers and their UV/Vis and HPLC pairings, as well as analytical abbreviations such as mass spectrometry. It also responds to medical measurement terms and to review and Metacritic contexts on Wikipedia.

patterns.name: Spectroscopic measurement terms in instrument names
patterns.context: Mentions of UV/visible spectrophotometers, spectroscopy, or detection methods used with HPLC in scientific methods or equipment lists
patterns.domain: Biomedical, chemical, and materials science experimental literature

patterns.name: Mass spectrometry and analytical instrument abbreviations
patterns.context: Descriptions of compound characterization, elemental analysis, or laboratory instruments and analytical workflows
patterns.domain: Chemical, biomedical, and laboratory facilities literature

patterns.name: Methods, measurement, and quantitative analysis contexts
patterns.context: Introduces experimental measurement, quantification, detection, or evaluation methods; does not necessarily mention the same instrument
patterns.domain: Scientific papers and medical research abstracts

patterns.name: Review-related terms and Metacritic
patterns.context: Discussions of music or game reviews, ratings, and review aggregation websites; activation centers on related terms and the string Metacritic

patterns.name: Scanning measurement terminology
patterns.context: Discussions of measurements at skeletal sites, osteoporosis assessment, and prediction

6_741.description: 主要响应科研文献中的分析仪器与测量方法术语，尤其是光谱仪及其 UV/Vis、HPLC 搭配，也涉及质谱等分析缩写；另对医学测量词和 Wikipedia 中评论、Metacritic 语境有响应。

patterns.name: 仪器名中的光谱测量术语
patterns.context: 科研方法或设备清单中提及紫外/可见光谱仪、光谱法，或与 HPLC 连用的检测方法
patterns.domain: 生物医学、化学、材料科学实验文献

patterns.name: 质谱及分析仪器缩写
patterns.context: 描述化合物表征、元素分析或实验室仪器与分析流程
patterns.domain: 化学、生物医学及实验室设施文献

patterns.name: 方法、测量与定量分析语境
patterns.context: 介绍实验测量、定量、检测或评估方法；不一定出现同一种仪器
patterns.domain: 科研论文及医学研究摘要

patterns.name: 评价与评论相关词及 Metacritic
patterns.context: 讨论音乐或游戏的评论、评价及评论聚合网站；激活集中在相关词和 Metacritic 字符串

patterns.name: 扫描测量术语
patterns.context: 讨论骨骼部位测量、骨质疏松评估及预测

en.description: The neuron primarily responds to terminology for analytical and characterization methods in experimental science texts, especially UV-Vis spectroscopy, mass spectrometry/chromatography, and microscopy; it also responds to generic analysis and lists of spectroscopic techniques.

patterns.name: UV-Vis spectrometer/spectroscopic analysis
patterns.context: In materials, chemistry, or biomedical experimental descriptions, UV/visible spectroscopy terms appear in instrument names, analytical methods, or lists of research methods; they are often adjacent to hyphens and subword fragments of spectrophotometer/spectroscopy.
patterns.domain: Experimental methods, materials characterization, drug and biochemical research

patterns.name: Mass spectrometry and chromatography methods
patterns.context: Lists of methods for analyte identification, metabolite detection, or compound structure characterization activate mass spectrometry/chromatography abbreviations and their constituent terms; they are typically adjacent to method descriptions such as analysis, determined, or structures.
patterns.domain: Drug metabolism, chemistry, biomedical experimental methods

patterns.name: Microscopic imaging characterization
patterns.context: Microscope names and abbreviations (AFM, TEM) are activated in laboratory equipment or material morphology characterization contexts.
patterns.domain: Biomedical facility descriptions, materials science research

patterns.name: Spectroscopic research and technique combinations
patterns.context: Explicit descriptions of spectroscopic research or lists of vibrational spectroscopy techniques place technique names next to terms such as and and spectroscopy; distinct from specific UV-Vis instrument/method descriptions.

patterns.name: General terminology for analytical characterization methods
patterns.context: Descriptions of methods for compound structure or elemental composition place analysis alongside or near specific analytical techniques.

6_741.description: 神经元主要响应实验科学文本中分析与表征方法的术语，尤其UV-Vis光谱、质谱/色谱及显微成像；也响应较泛的analysis和光谱技术列举。

patterns.name: UV-Vis 分光仪/光谱分析
patterns.context: 在材料、化学或生物医学实验描述中，UV/可见光光谱相关术语出现于仪器名称、分析方法或研究方法列表；常与连字符及 spectrophotometer/spectroscopy 的分词片段相邻。
patterns.domain: 实验方法、材料表征、药物与生物化学研究

patterns.name: 质谱及色谱分析方法
patterns.context: 分析物鉴定、代谢物检测或化合物结构表征的方法列表中，质谱/色谱缩写及其组成词被激活；通常与 analysis、determined、structures 等方法描述相邻。
patterns.domain: 药物代谢、化学、生物医学实验方法

patterns.name: 显微成像表征
patterns.context: 实验室设备或材料形貌表征语境中，显微镜名称及其缩写（AFM、TEM）被激活。
patterns.domain: 生物医学设施说明、材料科学研究

patterns.name: 光谱研究及技术组合
patterns.context: 明确描述光谱研究或列举振动光谱技术，技术名称与 and、spectroscopy 等相邻；不同于UV-Vis仪器/方法的具体表述。

patterns.name: 分析表征方法的一般用语
patterns.context: 化合物结构或元素组成的表征方法叙述中，analysis 与具体分析技术名称并列或相邻。
patterns.domain: 天然产物化学、材料表征

en.concept: Scientific analytical instruments and methods terminology
en.description: Primarily responds to technical name fragments in scientific methods and equipment contexts: hyphens in instrument names, the suffix in spectrophotometer, and the mass spectrometry abbreviation DI. It also covers a few methodological terms related to microscopy, chromatography, and analytical methods.

patterns.name: Hyphen in a mass spectrometry abbreviation
patterns.context: At the hyphen in an instrument name or analytical method, especially when an abbreviation is split by tokenization; the surrounding text is usually a technical abbreviation or number
patterns.domain: Experimental methods, instrument descriptions, and scientific abstracts

patterns.name: Proprietary suffix in spectrophotometer names
patterns.context: Appears in spectrophotometer names such as “UV-Vis/UV-12,” typically after an instrument model or spectral range
patterns.domain: Experimental methods and laboratory equipment descriptions

patterns.name: Specific fragment in a mass spectrometry term
patterns.context: Embedded in mass spectrometry abbreviations such as MALDI; other parts of the same abbreviation sometimes activate too, but DI is the most consistent strong trigger fragment here
patterns.domain: Mass spectrometry methods and biomedical research

patterns.name: Abbreviation fragment in a microscopy name
patterns.context: Appears in microscopy technique names, particularly the word microscopy and its adjacent technical abbreviation

patterns.name: Chromatography term in a list of analytical instruments
patterns.context: Part of an instrument name in a laboratory equipment list, with no observed direct connection to mass spectrometry or spectroscopic measurement descriptions

patterns.name: General analytical workflow vocabulary
patterns.context: Appears in descriptions of compound characterization or quantitative analysis; activation is weaker and may reflect a secondary pattern in methodological text

patterns.name: Method term in the name of a measurement method
patterns.context: Appears in names of characterization methods such as the Kubelka-Munk method; surrounding context concerns measuring material properties

6_741.concept: 科研分析仪器与方法术语
6_741.description: 主要响应科研方法和设备语境中的技术名称片段：仪器名中的断字符号、spectrophotometer 后缀及质谱缩写 DI；也覆盖显微镜、色谱和分析方法等少数方法学词汇。

patterns.name: 质谱缩写中的断字符号
patterns.context: 在仪器名称或分析方法的连字符位置，尤其缩写被分词拆开时；连字符前后通常是技术缩写或数字。
patterns.domain: 实验方法、仪器描述及科研摘要

patterns.name: 光谱仪名称的专有后缀
patterns.context: 出现在“UV-Vis/UV-12”等光谱仪名称中，通常位于仪器型号或光谱范围之后。
patterns.domain: 实验方法与实验室设备介绍

patterns.name: 质谱技术术语中的特定片段
patterns.context: 嵌在 MALDI 等质谱缩写中；同一缩写的其他部分有时也激活，但此处最稳定的强触发片段是 DI。
patterns.domain: 质谱分析方法及生物医学研究

patterns.name: 显微镜名称中的缩写片段
patterns.context: 出现在显微成像技术名称中，特别是 microscopy 一词及其紧邻的技术缩写。
patterns.domain: 材料与聚合物形貌表征

patterns.name: 分析仪器并列清单中的色谱词
patterns.context: 作为实验室设备清单中的仪器名称组成部分，未见与质谱或光谱测量叙述直接相连。

patterns.name: 一般分析流程词汇
patterns.context: 描述化合物表征或定量分析时出现；激活较弱，可能是方法学文本的次要模式。

patterns.name: 测量方法名称中的方法词
patterns.context: 出现在 Kubelka-Munk method 等表征方法名称中，周围语境是测量材料性质。

en.description: Primarily responds to analytical, characterization, and measurement methods and instrument terminology in experimental papers, especially spectroscopy, mass spectrometry, and microscopy; also covers procedures, equipment models, and contexts where spectroscopy is used to explain photochemical mechanisms.

patterns.name: Instrumental analysis/measurement methods
patterns.context: Activation often falls on letter fragments in analytical technique names, hyphens, and nearby text; the context describes using an instrument or analytical method to measure, identify, quantify, or characterize samples
patterns.domain: Methods and results sections of biomedical, chemical, and materials science papers

patterns.name: Microscopic imaging and observation
patterns.context: Mentions using microscopy to observe parasite morphology, subcellular structures, or fluorescent samples; activation centers on word fragments such as “electron” and “microscopes”

patterns.name: Experimental workflow and sample processing
patterns.context: Experimental procedures describe sample preparation, processing, detection, or data acquisition; often listed alongside specific analytical methods, reagents, or equipment

patterns.name: Spectroscopic studies and photochemical mechanisms
patterns.context: Discusses spectroscopic studies of complexes and uses spectroscopic evidence to explain NO photolysis mechanisms; this involves not only instruments and methods but also mechanistic research

patterns.name: Instrument manufacturers and models
patterns.context: Brand, model, and source information for analytical or imaging equipment appears in methods descriptions

patterns.name: Mass spectrometric identification and compound characterization
patterns.context: Identifies compounds, metabolites, or glycopeptides using mass spectrometry or hyphenated mass spectrometry methods; triggers include method abbreviations and nearby characterization language
patterns.domain: Natural products chemistry and biomedical analysis

6_741.description: 主要响应实验论文中分析、表征与测量方法及其仪器术语，尤其是光谱、质谱和显微成像；也覆盖操作步骤、设备型号，以及光谱用于解释光化学机制的语境。

patterns.name: 仪器分析/测量方法
patterns.trigger: “spectrophotometer”“spectroscopy”“analysis”“quantitatively obtained”等，以及仪器名称和方法缩写，如“UV-”“MS”“MALDI-TOF-MS”“EDX”
patterns.context: 激活常落在分析技术名称的字母片段、连字符及其附近；上下文描述用仪器或分析方法测量、鉴定、定量或表征样品。
patterns.domain: 生物医学、化学与材料科学论文的方法和结果段

patterns.name: 显微成像与观察
patterns.context: 提及借助显微镜观察寄生虫形态、亚细胞结构或荧光样品；激活集中在“electron”“microscopes”等词片段。
patterns.domain: 寄生虫学、生物医学实验方法

patterns.name: 实验流程与样品处理
patterns.context: 实验步骤中说明样品制备、处理、检测或获取数据；常与具体分析方法、试剂或设备并列。
patterns.domain: 生物医学与化学实验论文

patterns.name: 光谱研究与光化学机制
patterns.context: 讨论配合物的光谱研究，并以光谱证据解释NO光解机制；此处不只是仪器/方法描述，也涉及机制研究。

patterns.name: 仪器厂商与型号
patterns.context: 分析或成像设备的品牌、型号和来源信息出现在方法描述中。

patterns.name: 质谱鉴定与化合物表征
patterns.context: 通过质谱或质谱联用方法鉴定化合物、代谢物或糖肽；触发词包括方法缩写及其周边的表征措辞。
patterns.domain: 天然产物化学、生物医学分析

en.description: Primarily responds to methods and instrument names used for detection, identification, and characterization in experimental science, especially mass spectrometry, microscopy, and UV-Vis spectrophotometry; it is also sensitive to descriptions of analysis, quantification, and detection.

patterns.name: Mass spectrometry technique names
patterns.context: Especially mass spectrometry method names and abbreviations used to identify, quantify, or analyze the structure of peptides, compounds, or metabolites; triggers often occur in instrument or analytical-method sections.
patterns.domain: Biochemistry, drug research, and analytical chemistry papers

patterns.name: Microscopic imaging method names
patterns.context: Describes microscopic observation methods for material morphology, nanostructures, or parasite subcellular structures.

patterns.name: UV-Vis spectrophotometry
patterns.context: Mentions measurement or analysis with a UV/visible spectrophotometer; related terms often occur next to an instrument model.

patterns.name: Dense lists of scientific instruments and analytical methods
patterns.context: Methods sections or abstracts describe experimental analysis, detection, quantification, or identification approaches, often alongside instrument names, technical abbreviations, or sample subjects.
patterns.domain: Academic papers, especially experimental natural sciences

patterns.name: Specific method affixes/abbreviation fragments
patterns.context: Activated when a technical name or one of its components appears; related subword fragments can trigger even when the complete technique name and experimental context differ.

6_741.description: 主要响应实验科学文本中检测、鉴定与表征方法及仪器名称，尤其质谱、显微镜和紫外-可见分光光度法；也对分析、定量、检测等方法叙述敏感。

patterns.name: 质谱技术名称
patterns.context: 在描述肽、化合物或代谢物的鉴定、定量或结构分析时，尤其是质谱方法名及其缩写；触发位置常在仪器/分析方法段落。
patterns.domain: 生物化学、药物与分析化学论文

patterns.name: 显微成像方法名称
patterns.trigger: “AFM”“transmission electron microscopy (TEM)”“high resolution transmission electron microscopy”“electron microscopy”“scanning electron microscopes”
patterns.context: 描述材料形貌、纳米结构或寄生虫亚细胞结构的显微观察方法。
patterns.domain: 材料科学与生物医学论文

patterns.name: 紫外-可见分光光度法
patterns.context: 提及用紫外/可见分光光度计进行测量或分析；相关词常紧邻仪器型号。

patterns.name: 科学仪器与分析方法的密集列举
patterns.context: 方法部分或摘要中交代实验分析、检测、定量或鉴定手段，常伴随仪器名称、技术缩写或样品对象。
patterns.domain: 学术论文，尤其自然科学实验研究

patterns.name: 特定方法词缀/缩写片段
patterns.context: 技术名称本身或其组成部分出现时激活；即便完整技术名及实验语境不同，相关词片段仍可触发。

en.description: This neuron primarily responds to technical descriptions of experimental methods and results in scientific papers, especially analytical instruments, mass spectrometry/chromatography, microscopy, and quantitative detection methods. It also responds to terms for structural characterization, quantification, and detection, as well as fragments of numeric models. Diverse biological, chemical, and materials topics co-occur.

patterns.name: Mass spectrometry and chromatography terminology
patterns.context: In analytical methods or metabolite and compound characterization contexts, especially as part of a method or instrument name; this pattern occurs across multiple analytical techniques
patterns.domain: Methods and results sections of biomedical and chemical papers

patterns.name: Microscopic imaging techniques
patterns.context: When describing researchers using microscopy to observe material morphology or biological samples

patterns.name: Quantitative PCR method
patterns.context: When detecting or determining biological indicators such as miRNAs and gene expression

patterns.name: General analytical and characterization language
patterns.context: These terms appear in experimental results or methods descriptions, often alongside the measured object, analytical technique, or experimental result; they do not specify a single technique
patterns.domain: Scientific abstracts and methods and results sections

patterns.name: Numeric, unit, and punctuation fragments in technical names
patterns.context: Appears in durations, instrument models, percentages, or structural analysis terminology; may reflect formatting and numeric fragments rather than independent semantic triggers

patterns.name: Antioxidant experiments and reagents and instruments
patterns.context: Descriptions of antioxidant experiments and the spectrophotometer used

patterns.name: Characterization of algae or glycolipid antimicrobial compounds
patterns.context: Reports antimicrobial and hemolytic activity and preliminary characterization of candidate glycolipid compounds, alongside TLC and GC-MS

patterns.name: Structural identification of plant natural products
patterns.context: Isolates compounds from plant stem and leaf extracts and identifies their structures using mass spectrometry and NMR

patterns.name: Material morphology and thin-film blends
patterns.context: Studies the effects of solvent, composition, and block length on the morphology of copolymer blend films, followed by AFM and TEM

patterns.name: Parasite surface observation
patterns.context: Compares changes to sporocyst surfaces after treatment with immune and normal sera and uses scanning electron microscopy for observation

patterns.name: Plant miRNA responses and functional analysis
patterns.context: Describes miRNAs, target genes, and expression detection in plant responses to phytoplasma

patterns.name: Signal receptor autophosphorylation sites
patterns.context: Discusses receptor kinase signaling and localization of catalytic domain sites using MALDI-MS

patterns.name: Glycopeptide glycoform quantification
patterns.context: Isolates glycopeptides from reversed-phase pipette tips and quantifies the relative abundance of glycoforms using MALDI-TOF MS

6_741.description: 该神经元主要响应科学论文中实验方法与结果的技术性表述，尤其是分析仪器、质谱/色谱、显微镜及定量检测名称；也对结构表征、定量、检测等措辞和数字型号片段有响应。不同生物、化学和材料主题并存。

patterns.name: 质谱及色谱分析术语
patterns.context: 在分析方法、代谢物或化合物表征的语境中，尤其是方法名或仪器名的组成部分；该模式见于多种不同分析技术。
patterns.domain: 生物医学与化学论文的方法、结果段落

patterns.name: 显微成像技术名称

patterns.name: MS substring in an instrument name

patterns.name: Separation analysis abbreviation in an instrument name

patterns.name: Spectroscopic instruments and measurement methods

patterns.name: Electron microscope equipment name

patterns.name: Instrument and measurement equipment names

patterns.name: 方法学术语及测量动作

patterns.name: 专名及化合物相关词

en.description: Activation often falls on analytical techniques and method terms in experimental science contexts, especially mass spectrometry abbreviation fragments and electron microscopy; it also involves chromatography, spectrophotometric measurement, sample processing, units of measurement, and research methods. Triggers are not uniform; some are simply specific methods or terms.

patterns.name: Mass spectrometry-related method names
patterns.context: Appears in analytical method or instrument names, often adjacent to hyphens, abbreviation fragments, and method-description terms such as analysis, characterized, or detected; activation falls on components of the abbreviation.
patterns.domain: Biomedical, chemistry, and experimental methods papers

patterns.name: Electron microscopy
patterns.context: Forms terms such as electron microscopy or thin section electron microscopy, describing observation and analysis of parasites, cells, or tissues.

patterns.name: Chromatography and experimental detection
patterns.context: Chromatographic methods or spectrophotometric measurements and wavelength units appear when detecting metabolites or measuring compound concentrations.

patterns.name: Experimental workflow and sample processing
patterns.context: Describes experimental procedures such as sample concentration, elution, and separation; activation is scattered across action words and sample fractionation terms.

patterns.name: Research procedures and method terminology
patterns.context: Long-form chromatin analysis technique names appear in study plans or method introductions; generic method terms also occur.

patterns.name: Temperature and growth comparisons
patterns.context: Reports growth differences in strains or cells at different temperatures, followed by microscopy analysis.

patterns.name: Quantitative results and units
patterns.context: Antimicrobial activity results give percentages and multiples of the minimum inhibitory concentration, followed by compound characterization.

patterns.name: Neuroimaging research methods
patterns.context: Research on chronic alcohol consumption, smoking, cerebral blood flow, or cognitive function mentions magnetic resonance and cognitive studies.

patterns.name: Compound and sample terminology
patterns.context: Mentions plant extracts, glycopeptides, or glycolipids as samples/compounds; apart from co-occurrence with method analysis, there is no consistent local trigger pattern.

6_741.description: 激活多落在实验科学语境的分析技术与方法术语，尤其质谱缩写片段及电子显微镜；也涉及色谱、分光测定、样品处理、测量单位和研究方法。触发并不统一，部分只是特定方法或术语。

patterns.name: 质谱相关方法名称

en.description: Primarily responds to names of experimental analysis and characterization methods and nearby language in scientific papers, especially GC-MS, NMR, and microscopy; also involves spectroscopic measurement, quantification, and descriptions of research results. Additional patterns include MR cognition studies and several local numeric cues.

patterns.name: Microscopic imaging and morphological observation

patterns.name: Nuclear magnetic resonance characterization

patterns.name: Other instrumental chemical analysis methods

patterns.name: MR and cognition research measurements

patterns.name: Quantitative measurements and descriptions of research results

patterns.name: General language for experimental methods and compound characterization

patterns.name: Unexplained local lexical cues

6_741.description: 主要响应科研文本中分析仪器方法的表述，尤其GC-MS用于样品分析；也响应电子显微镜观察，以及磁共振与认知研究的描述。

patterns.name: GC-MS分析方法
patterns.trigger: “GC”“GC-”或“gas chromatography-mass spectrometry”，常与“by”“analysis”等方法描述相连
patterns.context: 在科研摘要或项目文本中，描述用气相色谱-质谱鉴定、分析或定量化合物、代谢物及生物样本；包括GC-MS、GC/MS及其变体
patterns.domain: 生物医学、化学分析与科研项目文本

patterns.name: 电子显微镜观察
patterns.context: 在生物医学研究中描述对细胞或寄生虫进行显微观察；相关段落还出现显微技术及实验对象
patterns.domain: 细胞生物学、寄生虫学科研文本

patterns.name: 磁共振研究
patterns.context: 报告酒精依赖与慢性吸烟相关的脑血流和认知研究；触发点是磁共振及认知研究表述
patterns.domain: 神经科学、临床研究项目文本

en.description: Primarily responds to names of instrumental analytical methods and technical terminology used for detection, identification, or characterization in scientific research: chromatography–mass spectrometry is the main focus, with electron microscopy and PCR-RFLP genotyping also covered. These commonly appear in methods descriptions and results analysis.

patterns.name: Chromatography–mass spectrometry analysis
patterns.context: Describes using chromatography, mass spectrometry, or coupled techniques to detect, identify, or quantify metabolites, compounds, or amino acids; sometimes listed alongside other analytical methods.
patterns.domain: Biomedical and chemistry research abstracts, paper methods descriptions

patterns.name: Electron microscopy observation
patterns.context: Describes using electron microscopy to observe or compare bacteriophage structure, cell morphology, or ultrastructure; often co-occurs with actions such as measurement and comparison.

patterns.name: PCR-RFLP genotyping
patterns.context: Used to genotype placental samples.

6_741.description: 主要对科学研究中用于检测、鉴定或表征的仪器分析方法名称及其技术术语起反应：以色谱-质谱联用为主，也覆盖电子显微镜和PCR-RFLP分型；常见于方法描述及结果分析语境。

patterns.name: 色谱-质谱分析
patterns.trigger: «GC»-«MS»、«radio»-«H»«PLC»、«T»«LC»、«HR»-«ES»«I»-«MS»、«U»«PLC»-«ES»«I»-«Q»«TOF»-«MS»/«MS»；常见于“by/using … analysis”或分析平台的列举中
patterns.context: 描述用色谱、质谱或联用技术检测、鉴定、定量代谢物、化合物或氨基酸；有时与其他分析方法并列
patterns.domain: 生物医学与化学研究摘要、论文方法描述

patterns.name: 电子显微镜观察
patterns.context: 描述用电子显微镜观察或比较噬菌体结构、细胞形态或超微结构；常和测量、比较等操作同现
patterns.domain: 病毒学、细胞生物学研究

patterns.name: PCR-RFLP分型
patterns.context: 用于对胎盘样本进行基因分型
patterns.domain: 产科或遗传学研究摘要

en.description: Primarily responds to analytical characterization terminology in scientific text, most prominently GC-MS and variants of mass spectrometry, as well as electron microscopy methods. It also responds to radiolabeled chromatography workflows, experimental concentration values, and a few duration expressions.

patterns.name: GC-MS and variants
patterns.context: Used to identify, analyze, or confirm metabolites, compounds, oxidation products, or photoproducts in samples, often alongside other analytical methods
patterns.domain: Biomedical and chemical analysis papers and scientific project descriptions

patterns.name: Other mass spectrometry methods
patterns.context: Mass spectrometry or chromatography-mass spectrometry is used for compound structural identification, protein/peptide analysis, or photoproduct analysis; some abbreviations are marked in a dispersed pattern
patterns.domain: Biochemistry, natural products, protein, and analytical chemistry papers

patterns.name: Electron microscopy and microscopic analysis
patterns.context: Studies cell or phage structure and describes electron microscopic observation, imaging, or quantitative measurement
patterns.domain: Cell biology, structural biology, and virology papers/project abstracts

patterns.name: Radiolabeling analysis workflow
patterns.context: Radiolabeled metabolites are detected by chromatography and then structurally identified
patterns.domain: Drug metabolism and biomedical research abstracts

patterns.name: Experimental values and concentration descriptions
patterns.context: Reports antimicrobial assay results at the minimum inhibitory concentration and its multiples; markers focus on numerical values and condition expressions

patterns.name: Experimental duration expressions
patterns.context: Appears near “for up to 13 h”; marking covers the time range and unit, rather than the name of an analytical method

6_741.description: 主要响应科研文本中的分析表征术语，尤以GC-MS及质谱变体最突出，也响应电子显微成像方法；另对放射性色谱流程、实验浓度数值及少量时长表达有反应。

patterns.name: GC-MS及其变体
patterns.context: 用于鉴定、分析或确认样品中的代谢物、化合物、氧化产物或光产物，常与其他分析方法并列
patterns.domain: 生物医学、化学分析论文及科研项目描述

patterns.name: 其他质谱分析方法
patterns.context: 质谱或色谱质谱用于化合物结构鉴定、蛋白/肽段分析或光产物分析；部分缩写被分散标记
patterns.domain: 生物化学、天然产物、蛋白质及分析化学论文

patterns.name: 电子显微成像与显微分析
patterns.context: 研究细胞或噬菌体结构，描述电子显微镜观察、成像或定量测量
patterns.domain: 细胞生物学、结构生物学及病毒学论文/项目摘要

patterns.name: 放射性标记分析流程
patterns.context: 放射性标记代谢物经色谱检测并进一步确定结构
patterns.domain: 药物代谢与生物医学研究摘要

patterns.name: 实验数值与浓度表述
patterns.context: 报告抗菌实验在最低抑菌浓度及其倍数下的结果；标记集中于数值和条件表达

patterns.name: 实验时长表达
patterns.context: 出现在“for up to 13 h”附近，标记覆盖时间范围及单位，而非分析方法名称

en.concept: Scientific research methods and instrument characterization
en.description: Primarily responds to methodological and characterization contexts in scientific abstracts, especially mass spectrometry (GC-MS, MALDI-TOF, ESI-MS) and analysis/measurement descriptions; it also covers electron microscopy imaging, spectroscopy, and magnetic resonance cognitive research.

patterns.name: GC-MS analysis descriptions
patterns.context: GC-MS is used as an analytical method to detect, identify, or characterize metabolites, antimicrobial compounds, or drugs in urine.

patterns.name: Mass spectrometry and molecular structure characterization
patterns.context: Mass spectrometry is used to identify or quantify biomolecules, compounds, fragments, or glycopeptides; no specific mass spectrometry technique is required.

patterns.name: Instrument method lists and characterization
patterns.context: Research abstracts use instruments or experimental methods to support detection, structural analysis, or quantification; instrument names are often listed together.

patterns.name: Microscopic imaging and structural observation
patterns.context: Electron microscopy-related imaging or tomography is used to observe cells or bacteriophage tail structures.

patterns.name: Spectroscopic method combinations
patterns.context: Multiple spectroscopic techniques are listed together to study interactions between compounds and human serum albumin.

patterns.name: Magnetic resonance and cognitive research
patterns.context: Research context involving sustained smoking, alcohol consumption, cerebral blood flow, or neurocognitive measures.

6_741.concept: 科学研究方法与仪器表征
6_741.description: 主要响应科学摘要中方法学及表征语境，尤其质谱（GC-MS、MALDI-TOF、ESI-MS）及分析/测量表述；也覆盖电子显微成像、光谱学和磁共振认知研究。

patterns.name: GC-MS分析表述
patterns.context: GC-MS作为分析方法，用于代谢物、抗菌化合物或尿液中药物的检测、鉴定或表征。
patterns.domain: 生物化学、药物分析、分析化学

patterns.name: 质谱及分子结构表征
patterns.context: 质谱用于鉴定或定量生物分子、化合物、片段或糖肽；不要求特定质谱技术。
patterns.domain: 生物化学、蛋白质组学、天然产物研究

patterns.name: 仪器方法枚举与表征
patterns.trigger: “«by»…«analysis»”“«by» using… approaches”及“«were» determined «by»”等方法描述
patterns.context: 研究摘要中以仪器或实验方法支撑检测、结构解析或定量；常与仪器名称并列。

patterns.name: 显微成像与结构观察
patterns.context: 电子显微镜相关成像或断层成像，用于观察细胞或噬菌体尾部结构。
patterns.domain: 细胞生物学、结构生物学

patterns.name: 光谱学方法组合
patterns.context: 多种光谱技术并列，用于研究化合物与人血清白蛋白的相互作用。

patterns.name: 磁共振与认知研究
patterns.context: 持续吸烟、饮酒与脑血流或神经认知指标的研究背景。

en.description: Activation mainly concerns women and their social and political identities, and also appears in biographical entries, professional behavior, research abstracts, and discussions of consent. Sporadic triggers also occur in project progress, protein engineering, cancer models, lists of Romanian sea names, and arithmetic questions; they do not form a unified semantic pattern.

patterns.name: Women’s identity and women as a group
patterns.context: Mentions women, girls, or women’s identity, often in connection with choice, representation, consent, or social views; activation strength varies.
patterns.domain: Social issues, news discussions, biographical and historical entries, medical research abstracts

patterns.name: Women’s political representation and historical figures
patterns.context: Women appear as first elected officeholders, political figures, or subjects of biographies and plays.
patterns.domain: Wikipedia biographical entries and play descriptions

patterns.name: Biographical entries and classification information
patterns.context: Biographical entries describe a person’s life, followed by references and categories; activation is distributed across multiple words.

patterns.name: Digital media and professional behavior
patterns.context: An abstract discusses how digital media affect people’s views of professional behavior.

patterns.name: Research progress involving humans
patterns.context: Research projects or collaborative studies advance as projects progress; the term appears in different research abstracts.

patterns.name: Consent and gender issues
patterns.context: Discusses consent, exploitation, or post hoc choice in sexual activity, with the relationship between women and consent as the focus.

patterns.name: Romanian geography and seas
patterns.context: Romanian sentences list seas around the EU and discuss oil drilling in European waters.

patterns.name: Arithmetic division question
patterns.context: A single sentence directly asks about dividing two integers, with no other clear thematic clues.

patterns.name: Protein engineering and antibody screening
patterns.context: Describes engineered protein scaffolds and molecular screening used to rapidly generate antibody-like molecules.

patterns.name: Animal models and cancer research
patterns.context: Discusses large-animal models in carcinogenesis research, tumor lesion development, and subsequent treatment studies.

6_794.concept: 女性与社会议题（不完整）
6_794.description: 激活主要涉及女性及其社会、政治身份，也出现在人物条目、职业行为、研究摘要和同意讨论中；另有项目进展、蛋白质工程、癌症模型、罗马尼亚语海域列举及算术提问等零散触发，未形成统一词义模式。

patterns.name: 女性身份与女性群体
patterns.context: 谈及女性、女孩或女性身份，常与选择、代表性、同意或社会看法相连；触发强度不一。

patterns.name: 数字媒体与职业行为

patterns.domain: PubMed 医学/职业研究摘要

patterns.name: 与人类相关的研究进展
patterns.context: 研究项目或合作研究随项目进展而推进；该词出现在不同研究摘要中。

patterns.name: 同意与性别议题

patterns.name: 罗马尼亚语地理与海域
patterns.context: 罗马尼亚语句子列举欧盟周边海域，并谈及欧洲水域的石油钻探。

patterns.context: 描述工程化蛋白支架及分子筛选，用于快速生成抗体样分子。

Other examples involve biographical entries, math questions, protein and cancer research, pharmaceutical media, and Romanian names for seas, with no unified semantic cue.

patterns.name: Cancer animal models and research progress

en.description: The most salient activations occur on female terms such as woman/women and the demographic subword fragment teen-agers. Other sporadic patterns include pharmaceutical terminology, several numerical expressions, and the Romanian word ending europene. These span multiple genres and lack a unified semantic trigger.

patterns.name: Female identity terms
patterns.context: Terms for women or age-related terms associated with women appear in context; sometimes linked to introductions of specific women, their actions, or social identities.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedia biographies and plot summaries, social issues, medical cases

patterns.name: Occupational and professional-conduct terms
patterns.context: Discusses pharmaceutical professionalism, digital media, and their effects on professional conduct.

patterns.name: Numerical or quantitative expressions
patterns.context: Numbers appear in math problems or encyclopedia entries about biographies, sports events, and dates.

patterns.name: Romanian European place-name ending
patterns.context: A Romanian sentence discusses seas within the EU and oil extraction; the highlighted portion is an adjective-ending fragment.

6_794.description: 激活最醒目地落在 woman/women 等女性称谓及 teen-agers 的人群词片段；另有药学专业术语、若干数字表达和罗马尼亚语 europene 词尾等零散模式，跨越多种文体，缺乏统一的语义触发条件。

patterns.name: 女性身份词
patterns.context: 女性称谓或与女性相关的年龄词出现在上下文中；有时与具体女性的介绍、行为或社会身份相连
patterns.domain: 百科传记与剧情、社会议题、医学病例

patterns.name: 职业与专业行为词

patterns.name: 数字或数值表达

patterns.context: 罗马尼亚语句子谈论欧盟内部海域及石油开采；高亮部分是形容词词尾片段
patterns.domain: EuroParl 罗马尼亚语议会文本

en.description: The clearest activations are for the English words woman and people; there are also the europ substring in a cross-lingual European word, a subword fragment in Teenagers, and isolated instances such as en and sprinter. The triggers are mixed and difficult to group.

patterns.name: High activation on English woman
patterns.context: woman appears as a complete English word, often referring to a person’s identity or description; there is no consistent requirement for preceding modifiers or surrounding biographical context.
patterns.domain: PubMed abstracts, Wikipedia biographical entries or lists

patterns.name: High activation on English people
patterns.context: In “how people view professional behaviour,” people is a generic subject referring to a group; it appears only in this passage.
patterns.domain: PubMed abstract on pharmacy professional behavior and digital media

patterns.name: Subword fragment within Europe-related words
patterns.context: Appears within the Romanian “europene” and German “europäischen,” both in Europe-related adjectives or word forms; it is not a complete standalone word.

patterns.name: Subword fragment in an English age-related word
patterns.context: Together the fragments form “Teenagers”; activation falls on the segmented ending fragments “en” and “agers,” in a context about teenagers’ choices.

patterns.name: en fragment in an English numeric phrase
patterns.context: The en in “en 17066 is divided by 20 31?”; this example alone cannot establish whether it is part of the question, a segmentation remnant, or part of the number format.

patterns.name: Fragment at the beginning of an entry starting with en
patterns.context: Appears at the beginning of a Wikipedia episode entry; it may be a word or title truncated by segmentation. No other shared trigger conditions are evident.

patterns.name: en substring in a person’s surname
patterns.context: Appears within a segmented fragment of the proper name “Jeannette Rankin”; it resembles the en fragment in segment 5 but occurs in a different context.

patterns.name: Person description in an entry about a Swiss sprinter
patterns.context: Both parts of “sprinter” activate after segmentation; the same passage also contains the ending fragment «people»9 in “possibly living people,” but there is no evidence of a stable connection between the two.

6_794.description: 最明显的是对英文 woman、people 的激活；另有跨语言欧洲词中的 europ 子串、Teenagers 的分词片段，以及若干 en、sprinter 等孤例。触发依据混杂，难以归并。

patterns.name: 英文 woman 的高激活
patterns.context: woman 作为完整英文词出现，常指人物身份或人物描述；对前面的 woman 修饰语及周围人物背景并无一致要求。
patterns.domain: PubMed 摘要、Wikipedia 人物条目或列表

patterns.name: 英语 people 的高激活
patterns.context: 在“how people view professional behaviour”中，people 作泛指人群主语；只见于此段。
patterns.domain: PubMed 摘要，药学职业行为与数字媒体

patterns.name: 欧洲相关词内部的子词片段
patterns.context: 出现在罗马尼亚语“europene”和德语“europäischen”内部，均处于欧洲相关的形容词或词形中；不是完整独立词。

patterns.name: 英语年龄词的分词片段
patterns.context: 合起来构成“Teenagers”；激活落在被分词的词尾片段“en”及“agers”，上下文谈青少年的选择。
patterns.domain: PubMed 摘要，家庭相关议题

patterns.name: 英文数字短语中的 en 片段
patterns.context: “en 17066 is divided by 20 31?”中的 en；仅凭此例无法确定它是题目文字、分词残片还是数字格式的一部分。

patterns.name: 以 en 开头的条目残片
patterns.context: 出现在维基百科剧集条目开头，可能是词语或标题被截断后的片段；未见其他共同触发条件。

patterns.name: 人物姓氏中的 en 子串
patterns.context: 出现在专名“Jeannette Rankin”的分词片段内；与第5段的 en 片段形式相似，但语境不同。

patterns.name: 瑞士短跑运动员条目中的人物描述
patterns.context: “sprinter”被拆分后两部分均激活；同段还出现“people”词尾片段«people»9于“possibly living people”中，但没有证据表明两者有稳定联系。
patterns.domain: Wikipedia 运动员传记及分类

en.description: The most stable trigger is the multilingual europ root, especially in European Parliament, European identity, or research contexts. Other activations are scattered across subword fragments in names, titles, medical terms, and research terms, with no unified semantic or syntactic condition.

patterns.name: Europe-related root
patterns.context: Words beginning with europ appear in English, Romanian, Italian, German, and other texts; activation is concentrated on the root fragment.
patterns.domain: European Parliament texts, philosophical discussion, and medical papers

patterns.name: Token fragments within proper names
patterns.context: Activations concentrate on subword fragments within proper names or compounds, including Nikolai, Teenagers, Pharmacy; no clear shared syntactic condition.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedia entries, webpage titles, and medical abstracts

patterns.name: Fragments in medical or research terms
patterns.context: In medical abstracts or research discussion, activation falls on technical terms or their morphemic fragments; no shared context beyond their intra-word position is apparent.

patterns.name: Title-like phrases and word boundaries
patterns.context: In a webpage title, a person’s name is followed by the phrase “Net Worth”, producing title/search-style text; activation is distributed across multiple fragments of the name and phrase.

patterns.name: Romanian lists of sea names
patterns.context: Romanian text lists European seas in sequence, then discusses oil extraction in European waters.
patterns.domain: European Parliament text, geography and energy

patterns.name: Morphemic fragments in German long words
patterns.context: In formal German sentences, activation falls on internal subword fragments of compounds or long words; the same passage also contains the europ root.
patterns.domain: European Parliament reports or policy texts

patterns.name: Independent occurrence of the europe root across languages
patterns.context: The root occurs in a philosophical discussion of Western European history and shared European identity, without an obvious medical or geographic-list context.

6_794.description: 最稳定的触发是多语种 europ 词根，尤其出现在欧洲议会、欧洲身份或科研语境；其余激活分散在姓名、标题、医学及科研词的子词片段，缺少统一语义或句法条件。

patterns.name: 欧洲相关词根
patterns.context: 在英语、罗马尼亚语、意大利语、德语等文本中，词语以 europ 开头；高激活落在词根片段。
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会文本、哲学论述及医学论文

patterns.name: 专名内部的 token 片段
patterns.context: 激活集中于专名或复合词内部的子词片段，包括 Nikolai、Teenagers、Pharmacy；没有明显共享的句法条件。
patterns.domain: 百科条目、网页标题及医学摘要

patterns.name: 医学或科研词中的片段
patterns.context: 出现在医学摘要或科研论述中，激活落在专业词或其词素片段上；除词形内部位置外，未见共同上下文。
patterns.domain: 医学摘要、材料物理研究

patterns.name: 标题式词组与词界
patterns.context: 网页标题中人物姓名后接短语“Net Worth”，呈现标题/搜索式文本；激活分布在姓名及短语多个片段。

patterns.name: 罗马尼亚语海域名称列表
patterns.trigger: « M»7«area»5« Nord»4«ului»3«», « M»7«area»5« Baltic»3«ă»6«», « M»7«area»5« Med»5«iter»4«an»4«ă»6«»
patterns.context: 罗马尼亚语文本连续列举欧洲海域名称，随后谈及欧洲水域中的石油开采。
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会文本、地理与能源

patterns.name: 德语长词中的词素片段
patterns.context: 德语正式句子中，激活落在复合词或长词的内部子词片段；同段亦出现 europ 词根。
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会报告或政策文本

patterns.name: 跨语种 europe 词根的独立出现
patterns.context: 该词根出现在关于西欧历史与欧洲共同身份的哲学论述中，周边没有明显医学或地理列表语境。

en.description: The most consistent clues are reduce (lowering risk, mortality, or noise) and among (relationships across groups); the AP string activates in medical abbreviations and code identifiers. The remaining highlights are scattered across different genres and lack a unified explanation.

patterns.name: Semantic activation of reduce
patterns.context: The verb reduce appears in structures such as “reduce the risk / mortality / the inlet noise”; preceding modifiers vary.

patterns.name: Group or distribution contexts with among
patterns.context: among introduces the scope or distribution among multiple entities such as people, species, or servers.
patterns.domain: Medical, genomics, and computer science papers

patterns.name: AP string
patterns.context: The letter string AP appears in the abbreviation CPAP, the Android identifier APPLICATION_NAME, and the DATAPACK identifier; contexts and meanings differ.
patterns.domain: Medical abstracts, Android resource files, C header files

patterns.name: Sporadic lexical triggers for other
patterns.context: Each occurs in a different word or expression; no shared local syntactic or semantic conditions are evident.
patterns.domain: Medical abstracts, emails, animal science papers, mathematics papers

6_794.concept: 零散词形与字符串触发
6_794.description: 最稳定的线索是 reduce（降低风险、死亡率或噪声）及 among（群体间关系）；AP 字符串在医学缩写和代码标识符中触发。其余高亮分散于不同文体，缺少统一解释。

patterns.name: reduce 的语义激活
patterns.context: 动词 reduce 出现在“reduce the risk / mortality / the inlet noise”结构中；前置修饰语各异。
patterns.domain: 医学摘要、汽车维护说明

patterns.name: among 的群体或分布语境
patterns.context: among 引出人群、物种或服务器等多个实体之间的范围或分布关系。
patterns.domain: 医学、基因组学、计算机科学论文

patterns.name: AP 字符串
patterns.context: 字母串 AP 出现在缩写 CPAP、Android 标识符 APPLICATION_NAME，以及 DATAPACK 标识符中；上下文和含义不同。
patterns.domain: 医学摘要、Android 资源文件、C 头文件

patterns.name: other 的零散词法触发
patterns.context: 各自位于不同词或表达中；未见共同的局部句法或语义条件。
patterns.domain: 医学摘要、邮件、畜牧学论文、数学论文

en.description: Except for implements in code declarations, all passages show strong activation on reduce; its objects include mortality, risk, damage, resistance, levels, or distributions being lowered. The genres range from research abstracts to proposals.

patterns.name: Beneficial outcomes following reduce
patterns.context: Appears in descriptions of aims, efficacy, mechanisms, or results; the trigger is the verb reduce, not a domain-specific noun.
patterns.domain: Biomedical, public health, and engineering research abstracts and proposals

patterns.name: implements in code
patterns.context: In a class declaration, implements is followed by an interface name, near a class name, braces, and line breaks.

6_794.description: 除代码类声明中的 implements 外，其余段均在 reduce 处强激活，后续对象是被降低的死亡率、风险、损伤、阻力、水平或分布；文体横跨科研摘要与提案。

patterns.name: reduce 后的受益结果
patterns.context: 出现在目的、疗效、机制或结果描述中；触发点是动词 reduce，而不是某个特定领域名词
patterns.domain: 生物医学、公共卫生、工程研究摘要及提案

patterns.name: 代码中的 implements
patterns.context: 类声明中 implements 后接接口名，邻近有类名、花括号和换行
patterns.domain: GitHub 源码（Java 风格代码）

en.concept: The word reference and its contexts
en.description: All passages show strong activation on “reference”; it covers reference materials, benchmark signals or measurements, figure labels, and expressions such as “with reference to” and “incorporated by reference.” The genres are mostly patent or technical texts.

patterns.name: The word reference in academic and patent genres
patterns.context: Appears in technical descriptions, patent background sections, citations, or general academic discussion; collocations and meanings vary, with activation concentrated near the word itself.
patterns.domain: Patent technology, engineering, academic discussion, and list descriptions

6_794.description: 所有片段均在“reference”处有强激活；它涵盖参考资料、基准信号或测量、图中标记，以及“with reference to”和“incorporated by reference”等表达，文体多为专利或技术文本。

patterns.name: reference一词在学术与专利文体中的出现
patterns.trigger: “reference”，尤其是“with reference to”“According to … reference”“incorporated by reference”“reference signals”“reference characters”“reference … efficiency”等搭配
patterns.context: 在技术说明、专利背景、引文或一般学术论述中；搭配与含义多样，激活集中在该词本身附近
patterns.domain: 专利技术、工程、学术论述及列表说明

en.concept: Passages containing structured formulas or fixed formal text
en.description: The strongest recurring pattern is email disclaimers, especially fixed wording about contacting the sender, replying, and deleting copies. Other activations occur in logical formulas, email confidentiality clauses, patent optics, Go error handling, and physics formulas.

patterns.name: Fixed wording in email disclaimers
patterns.context: Occurs in email disclaimers or confidentiality notices, typically instructing recipients who received an email in error to contact the sender, reply, and delete copies; may include company email addresses, line breaks, or quotation marks.
patterns.domain: Enron company emails and forwarded or quoted text

patterns.name: Another type of email confidentiality disclaimer
patterns.context: A confidentiality and disclaimer notice at the end of an email, with formal legal wording such as “either whole or partial.”
patterns.domain: Financial institution email disclaimers; this example mentions BNP PARIBAS

patterns.name: Symbolic expansion in propositional logic
patterns.context: Symbolic transformations such as conjunction and disjunction applied to implication or equivalence formulas.

patterns.name: Scanning optical device in patent text
patterns.context: Technical description of imaging device components and beam detection processes.

patterns.name: Error handling and token creation in code
patterns.context: Go code creates a JWT token and checks and reports errors; includes «cannot»10

patterns.name: Spherical coordinates and magnetic field symbols in physics formulas
patterns.context: Formulas use angular variables and trigonometric functions to represent vectors or field quantities.

6_794.concept: 含结构化公式或固定正式文本的片段
6_794.description: 最强且重复的模式是邮件免责声明，尤其是联系发件人、回复、删除副本等固定措辞；其余激活分布于逻辑公式、邮件保密条款、专利光学、Go 错误处理和物理公式。

patterns.name: 邮件免责声明中的固定措辞
patterns.trigger: “recipient), please contact the sender or reply to Enron Corp. at … and delete all copies of the message. This e-mail (and any attachments hereto)”；反复出现的强触发包括 «and»10、«reply»5/6、«delete»5、«all»6
patterns.context: 位于邮件免责声明或保密提示中，通常在说明误收邮件时要求联系发件人、回复并删除副本；可含公司邮箱地址、换行或引用符号
patterns.domain: Enron 公司邮件及其转发、引用文本

patterns.name: 另一种邮件保密免责声明
patterns.trigger: “any dissemination or disclosure, either whole or partial, is prohibited except formal approval”及“internet cannot guarantee the integrity of this message”
patterns.context: 邮件末尾的保密与免责声明，出现“either whole or partial”等正式法律措辞
patterns.domain: 金融机构邮件免责声明；此例提到 BNP PARIBAS

patterns.name: 命题逻辑中的符号展开
patterns.trigger: «neg»、«vee»、«rightarrow»、«equiv»、«wedge»，以及含 p、q、r 的括号表达式
patterns.context: 逻辑公式中对蕴含或等价式进行合取、析取等符号变换

patterns.name: 专利文本中的扫描光学装置
patterns.trigger: “rotating polygonal mirror”“scanning the photosensitive member”“deflected light beam”及«beam»10
patterns.context: 描述成像装置部件及光束检测过程的技术说明

patterns.name: 代码中的错误处理与令牌创建
patterns.trigger: “token := tok.SignedString([]byte(c.secret))”及“if err != nil”“cannot create jwt token”
patterns.context: Go 代码创建 JWT 令牌并检查、报告错误；其中 «cannot»10

patterns.name: 物理公式中的球坐标与磁场符号
patterns.trigger: 含«sin»、«theta»、«phi»、«bm»及 B_0、B_1 的 LaTeX 数学式
patterns.context: 公式以角变量和三角函数表示矢量或场量

en.description: Strong activations are scattered across the list-ending word “others,” mathematical variables or symbols, and various unrelated technical or rare words; the available contexts are insufficient to unify these triggers into a stable semantic pattern.

patterns.name: List-ending others
patterns.context: Ends a list of objects, categories, or examples with others; note that the activation marker is attached to others.
patterns.domain: Technical descriptions, medical abstracts, website copy

patterns.name: Mathematical variables or symbols
patterns.context: Variables or formula symbols in mathematical or scientific discussion; the specific subjects differ between the two passages.

patterns.name: Technical terms or rare words
patterns.context: Activation falls on technical nouns, less common words, or segmented word fragments; the available context is insufficient to determine whether they share trigger conditions.
patterns.domain: Mathematics papers, patents, wood encyclopedias, medical abstracts

6_794.description: 强激活分散在列举收尾词“others”、数学变量或符号，以及多个互不相同的专业词与罕见词上；现有上下文不足以将这些触发统一为稳定语义模式。

patterns.name: others 列举收尾
patterns.context: 列举若干对象、类别或例子后，以 others 收尾；需注意激活标记附在 others 上
patterns.domain: 技术说明、医学摘要、网页文案

patterns.name: 数学变量或符号
patterns.context: 数学或科学论述中的变量、公式符号；两段的具体对象不同

patterns.name: 专业术语或罕见词
patterns.context: 激活落在专业名词、较少见词，或被拆分标注的词片段上；可见上下文不足以确认它们是否共享触发条件
patterns.domain: 数学论文、专利、木材百科、医学摘要

en.concept: Descriptions of properties and content in text
en.description: Activations are distributed across various contexts: possible properties, explanatory qualifications, and concealed locations in patent texts, as well as evaluations, narration, or title wording in academic, popular science, and encyclopedic texts. No single trigger pattern covers all examples.

patterns.name: Continuation after “have” describing suitability or properties
patterns.context: In patent background writing, explains that something may have a feature, scope of applicability, or defect; activation falls on “have.”

patterns.name: Qualifying use of illustrative
patterns.context: A patent specification states that the drawings are illustrative only and should not be construed otherwise.

patterns.name: Location description with obscure
patterns.context: Describes an equipment component (a status switch) as being in a hard-to-notice or hard-to-reach location.

patterns.name: Argumentative use of trivial
patterns.context: A philosophical discussion considers whether a claim is trivial; it also occurs in “non-trivial” in a physics title.

patterns.name: Narrating or conveying content
patterns.context: Introduces the plot of a television series or the content conveyed by a work in a book.

patterns.name: interesting in a paper abstract
patterns.context: A research abstract evaluates the properties of a collective phenomenon.

patterns.name: Its in a citation title
patterns.context: Part of a book title in an encyclopedic reference entry.

6_794.concept: 文本中的性质与内容描述
6_794.description: 激活分散于多种语境：专利文本中的可能性质、说明性限定和隐蔽位置，及学术、科普与百科文本中的评价、叙述或标题措辞；没有一个触发模式能覆盖全部例子。

patterns.name: “have”后接适用性或性质的延续
patterns.trigger: “may have”及紧随其后的性质描述，如“may have applicability”“may have crackings”
patterns.context: 专利背景文体中，说明某物可能具有某种特征、适用范围或缺陷；激活落在“have”上

patterns.name: illustrative 的限定用法
patterns.context: 专利说明书中指出附图仅供说明，不应作其他解释

patterns.name: obscure 的位置描述
patterns.context: 描述设备部件（状态开关）处于不易察觉或不便接近的位置

patterns.name: trivial 的论证用法
patterns.context: 哲学论述中讨论某项主张是否平凡；另一次出现在物理学标题的“non-trivial”中

patterns.name: 叙述或传达内容
patterns.context: 介绍电视剧剧情或书中作品传达的内容

patterns.name: 论文摘要中的 interesting
patterns.context: 科研摘要评价集体现象的性质

patterns.name: 引文标题中的 Its
patterns.context: 百科参考文献条目中的书名组成部分

en.concept: Descriptions of attributes after possessive reference
en.description: The most stable pattern is its followed by a description of the properties, results, forms, or components of something, across several genres. Other activations include it/an object has complements, the narrative phrase tells the story of, and one low-intensity activation on ate within inviolable.

patterns.name: Words or phrases following its
patterns.context: After the possessive pronoun its, in a sentence or at the beginning of one, text often describes an entity’s properties, results, form, proof, or components; the response is not limited to a single following word.
patterns.domain: Across legal, forum, social science, philosophy, mathematical physics, and medical texts

patterns.name: it has and its complement
patterns.context: With it or a specific object as the subject, has is followed by a property, effect, or noun phrase; adjacent to the primary its pattern, but syntactically distinct.
patterns.domain: Philosophical and humanistic discussion, and scientific writing

patterns.name: Narrative story expression
patterns.context: Introductions describing a work or play that tells a character’s story.

patterns.name: Local trigger on the word form ate
patterns.context: Occurs within inviolable; may be an incidental, low-intensity subword activation, with no confirmed independent semantic pattern.

6_794.concept: 所有格指代后的属性描述
6_794.description: 最稳定的模式是 its 后接对所属对象的性质、结果、形式或组成的描述，跨多种文体出现；另有 it/对象 has 补语、叙事性的 tells the story of，以及一次低强度的 inviolable 内部 ate 激活。

patterns.name: its 后的词汇或短语
patterns.context: 句中或句首的所有格代词 its 后，常继续描述某事物的属性、结果、形式、证明或组成部分；并非只对单一后续词反应
patterns.domain: 跨法律、论坛、社会科学、哲学、数学物理及医学文本

patterns.name: it has 及其补语
patterns.context: 以 it 或具体对象作主语，has 后接性质、影响或名词短语；与其主要的 its 模式相邻但句法不同
patterns.domain: 哲学、人文论述及科学写作

patterns.name: 叙述性故事表达
patterns.context: 叙述作品或戏剧讲述人物故事的介绍语境
patterns.domain: 百科全书式影视作品介绍

patterns.name: 文中词形 ate 的局部触发
patterns.context: 处于 inviolable 一词内部，可能是低强度的偶发子词激活，缺乏可确认的独立语义模式

en.description: All passages strongly activate the lowercase possessive pronoun “its,” which refers to an entity mentioned earlier; it precedes noun phrases referring to meaning, purpose, proof, popularity, provisions, importance, acceptance, or book attributes.

patterns.name: The possessive pronoun its
patterns.context: The core trigger is the lowercase possessive pronoun “its,” often appearing in a noun or prepositional phrase and referring to something mentioned earlier; what follows varies.
patterns.domain: Legal, technological, mathematical, social science, literary, and book-review genres

patterns.name: Statutory language in legal texts
patterns.context: In legal discussion, its refers to a rule or statute; it often appears near words such as statutory, meaning, and implications.

patterns.name: Purpose or attributes of an argument or result
patterns.context: its refers to the preceding statute, result, or technique, followed by its purpose, proof, or reason for popularity.
patterns.domain: Law, mathematics papers, patent technology background

patterns.name: Further explanation of an institution, concept, or view
patterns.context: its refers to a preceding bill, concept, or doctrine, followed by its subsequent provisions, importance, or conditions for acceptance.
patterns.domain: Public finance, social science papers, essays

patterns.name: Expressions related to books and audiences
patterns.context: its refers to a book, appearing in an evaluation of the book from title page to ending, or a description of its suitability for its intended audience.

6_794.description: 所有片段都强烈激活小写所有格代词“its”，指代前文实体；后接含义、目的、证明、流行、规定、重要性、接受度或书籍属性等不同名词短语。

patterns.name: its 所有格代词
patterns.context: 核心触发是小写所有格代词“its”，常出现在名词短语或介词短语中，指向前文事物；后续成分不固定。
patterns.domain: 法律、科技、数学、社科、文学及书评等多种文体

patterns.name: 法律文本中的法定措辞
patterns.context: 法律论述中，its 指代规则或法条；常邻近 statutory、meaning、implications 等词。

patterns.name: 论证或结果的用途、属性
patterns.context: its 指代前述 statute、result 或 technique，随后说明目的、证明或流行原因。
patterns.domain: 法律、数学论文、专利技术背景

patterns.name: 制度、概念或观点的后续说明
patterns.context: its 指代前文的法案、概念或学说，后接其后续规定、重要性或被接受的条件。
patterns.domain: 公共财政、社科论文、论说文

patterns.name: 书籍及受众相关表达
patterns.context: its 指代一本书，出现在书籍从标题页到结尾的评价，或适合其目标读者的描述中。

en.concept: References and statutory citations in legal texts
en.description: Primarily responds to the possessive “its” in legal discussion and expressions that introduce provisions in statutes, rules, or clauses. Also appears in statutory interpretation, structural citations, and one etymological discussion. Paragraph 5 contains only version citations and formatting markers, with unclear association.

patterns.name: “its” and its referent in legal texts
patterns.context: The possessive pronoun refers to a previously mentioned rule, regulation, statutory provision, doctrine, or root; especially common in legal arguments.
