patterns.name: As in patent boilerplate
patterns.context: The sentence begins with the common patent background phrase “As is well known”.

patterns.name: Makhoul name and entry opening
patterns.context: The name Makhoul appears in an entry title and again at the beginning of the introduction after a line break.

patterns.name: Names or proper-noun titles beginning with William
patterns.context: Wikipedia entries or titles begin with William, followed by a name, abbreviation, or proper noun; examples include William Reid Dick, William Jay Bolton, William L. Hadden, William Bassett, William and Mary Jane Louden House, William H. Summers.

6_817.description: 激活集中在词首大写字母或词条标题：生物医学词中的 C、专利套语“As is well known”，以及 Wikipedia 中以 Makhoul 或 William 开头的人名和专名。

patterns.name: 化学术语中的字母 C
patterns.context: C 出现在词首，后接化合物名称中的 Cytotoxicity 或基因符号 Cdk5；触发可能与大写字母 C 及其后续字符有关。
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文及研究摘要

patterns.name: 专利惯用语中的 As
patterns.context: 句首出现“As is well known”这一专利背景技术常见套语。

patterns.name: Makhoul 姓名及词条开头
patterns.context: 词条标题处出现人名 Makhoul，并在换行后的简介开头再次出现。

patterns.name: William 开头的人名或专名标题
patterns.context: Wikipedia 条目或标题以 William 开头，后续可接人名、缩写或专名；片段中有 William Reid Dick、William Jay Bolton、William L. Hadden、William Bassett、William and Mary Jane Louden House、William H. Summers。

en.description: Activation appears on numbers and punctuation in dates and times, comma-separated terms or proper names, and email and code fragments. A possible common cue is separators such as commas, but trigger locations and contexts are not consistent.

patterns.name: Numbers separated by date, time, and punctuation
patterns.context: Months, dates, years, times, and similar elements appear in sequence, often separated by punctuation such as commas and colons; especially prominent in segments 1 and 2.

patterns.name: Comma-separated lists of terms
patterns.context: Commas separate coordinated terms, or appear after place names and technical terms before supplementary information.
patterns.domain: Finance, place names, scientific texts, and titles

patterns.name: Word fragments within proper names
patterns.context: Activation falls within rare proper names, entity names, or mixed-case strings, with no consistent semantic context.

patterns.name: Email attachment-related wording
patterns.context: Short email or opening of an email body, mentioning an attachment and a contract.

patterns.name: Import statements and commas in code
patterns.context: Python statements importing multiple modules, with module names separated by commas.

6_817.concept: 分隔标点及其邻近文本
6_817.description: 激活分布在日期时间中的数字与标点、逗号分隔的词项或专名，以及邮件和代码片段；共同线索可能是逗号等分隔符，但触发位置和语境并不统一。

patterns.name: 日期、时间及标点分隔的数字
patterns.context: 月份、日期、年份、时间等连续出现，常由逗号、冒号等标点分隔；第1、2段尤其明显。

patterns.name: 逗号分隔的词项列表
patterns.trigger: “Assets, liabilities, expenses and revenues”；“Riverside, Kanawha County, West Virginia”；“Ric(in), a natural product of the castor bean”；“Construction, gene delivery, and expression”
patterns.context: 逗号分隔并列词项，或地名、术语后接逗号及补充说明。
patterns.domain: 财务、地名、科研文本及标题

patterns.name: 专名内部的词片段
patterns.context: 激活落在罕见专名、实体名或大小写混杂的字符串内部，未见一致的语义上下文。

patterns.name: 邮件附件相关表述
patterns.context: 短邮件或邮件正文开头，出现附件提示及合同。

patterns.name: 代码导入语句与逗号
patterns.context: Python 导入多个模块的语句，模块名以逗号分隔。

en.description: The most stable pattern is the web sentence construction beginning with “You” followed by may/can/could, along with academic text beginning with “Early”. Other activations are sporadic across biomedical word fragments, research terminology, citation formats, and classification descriptions, with no clear unifying explanation.

patterns.name: Conversational suggestions or narration beginning with You
patterns.context: A sentence begins with You, followed by a modal verb expressing possibility, ability, or advice; activation is concentrated on the modal verb.
patterns.domain: Web text, conversation, or reader-facing explanations

patterns.name: Sentence-initial Early
patterns.context: Early appears at the beginning of a sentence or new sentence; once it is followed by a geological period name, and once by a sperm-cell developmental stage.

patterns.name: Letter fragments within biomedical words
patterns.context: Activation falls on subword fragments of proper nouns, abbreviations, or biomedical terms; markers are affected by tokenization boundaries, with no consistent meaning or position observed.

patterns.name: Word fragments in anomalous markers or mixed web text
patterns.context: Occurs in web text after an exclamation and with an awkward transition to the following phrase; there is only one low-strength marker, making a stable trigger condition difficult to establish.

patterns.name: Function-related fragment in a research-purpose sentence
patterns.context: Occurs in an NIH-funded project description, modifying development; the surrounding text concerns a research plan and cardiac innervation.

patterns.name: Structural markers at paragraph openings and near citations
patterns.context: At the start of a PubMed Central paper paragraph, with in-text citations and a paragraph break; activation may involve formatting or structure.

patterns.name: Classification description in a species entry
patterns.context: An encyclopedia entry uses a name as its title and explains the corresponding biological classification and possible referents; line breaks and repeated word forms also occur.

6_817.description: 最稳定的是句首“You”后接 may/can/could 的网页句式，以及学术文本中的句首“Early”。其余激活零散落在生物医学词片段、研究用语、引文格式和分类说明中，难以统一解释。

patterns.name: You 开头的对话式建议或叙述
patterns.context: 句子以 You 起头，后接情态动词，表达可能性、能力或建议；激活集中在情态动词。
patterns.domain: 网页文本、对话或面向读者的说明

patterns.name: 特定句首词 Early
patterns.context: Early 出现在句首或新句开头；一次接地质时期名称，一次接精子细胞发育阶段。

patterns.name: 生物医学词内的字母片段
patterns.context: 激活落在专名、缩写或生物医学术语的子词片段上；标记受分词边界影响，未见一致的词义或位置。
patterns.domain: 生物医学摘要、百科条目

patterns.name: 异常标记或混杂网页文本中的词片段
patterns.context: 出现在感叹句后、与后续短语衔接突兀的网页文本中；只有一个低强度标记，难以确认稳定触发条件。

patterns.name: 研究目的句中的功能相关片段
patterns.context: 出现在 NIH 资助项目描述中，修饰 development；周围是研究计划与心脏神经支配。

patterns.name: 段落开头及引文附近的结构标记
patterns.context: PubMed Central 论文段落开头，含文内引文及段落换行；激活可能涉及格式或结构。

patterns.name: 物种条目中的分类说明
patterns.context: 百科条目以名称为题，说明其对应的生物分类及可能指代；同时有换行和重复词形。

en.description: Activations are scattered across various technical and academic texts: they commonly occur around Markdown italicized terms and adjacent punctuation, and also at line breaks, heading structures, and HTML/XML tags. Mathematical formulas, French fragments, and word fragments in medical titles are weaker or isolated examples and cannot be explained by a single semantic theme.

patterns.name: Italic markers before terms or keywords
patterns.context: In technical, academic, or documentation text, Markdown asterisks enclose terms, error categories, gene names, or species names; activation often falls on the closing asterisk or the following word.
patterns.domain: Code documentation, mathematics papers, biomedical papers, taxonomy texts

patterns.name: Period or sentence-final punctuation
patterns.context: Near the end of a sentence or title fragment; some examples also contain Markdown emphasis, citations, or line breaks.
patterns.domain: Technical documentation, paper body text and abstracts

patterns.name: Line breaks and structural markers
patterns.context: Structural boundaries in paragraphs, sections, or code documentation; headings or lists may also appear near these markers.

patterns.name: XML/HTML tags and attribute formatting
patterns.context: In tags, attributes, or markup fragments, activation falls on tag names or strings related to HTML attributes.

patterns.name: Word-form fragments in French text
patterns.context: Non-English text embedded in an HTML paragraph; tokenization yields French word fragments, with the trigger unclear.

patterns.name: vagal word fragment in a medical title
patterns.context: In a medical abstract title, it occurs in the phrase «cervical vagal stimulation»; no other instance of the same word form was observed.

patterns.name: Mathematical symbols and formal notation
patterns.context: LaTeX formulas and formal definitions in mathematics papers; activation also occurs in adjacent text, without forming a clear, distinctive pattern.

6_817.concept: 技术文本标记与格式边界
6_817.description: 激活分散于多种技术和学术文本：常见于 Markdown 斜体术语及其邻近标点，也见于换行、标题结构和 HTML/XML 标签；数学公式、法语片段及医学标题词片段是较弱或孤立的例子，不能由单一语义主题解释。

patterns.name: 术语或关键词前的斜体标记
patterns.trigger: «*»，以及其后被强调的术语，如 «GCC», «critical error», «update rules», «ATΜ», «non-autonomous sesquilinear form», «Hordeum» 和 «Triticum»
patterns.context: 技术、学术或文档文本中，Markdown 星号包住术语、错误类别、基因名或物种名；激活常落在闭合星号或紧随其后的词上。
patterns.domain: 代码说明、数学论文、生物医学论文、分类学文本

patterns.name: 句点或句末标点
patterns.trigger: «.»，以及标点邻接的文本，如 [7] 的 «metabolites [@bb0005].»
patterns.context: 句子或标题片段的收尾附近；部分例子同时有 Markdown 强调、引用或换行。
patterns.domain: 技术文档、论文正文与摘要

patterns.name: 换行及结构标记
patterns.context: 段落、章节或代码文档的结构边界；这些标记附近也可能出现标题或列表。

patterns.name: XML/HTML 标签与属性格式
patterns.context: 标签、属性或标记语言片段中，激活落在标签名或 HTML 属性相关字符串上。

patterns.name: 法语文本中的词形片段
patterns.context: 嵌在 HTML 段落中的非英语文本；分词结果呈现为法语词片段，触发原因不明确。
patterns.domain: HTML 文档中的法语文本

patterns.name: 医学标题中的 vagal 词片段
patterns.context: 医学摘要标题中，出现在短语 «cervical vagal stimulation» 内；未见其他相同词形实例。

patterns.name: 数学符号与形式化记号
patterns.context: 数学论文中的 LaTeX 公式和形式化定义；激活也出现在相邻文字中，未形成清楚的专属模式。

en.concept: Local formatting and terminology in academic text
en.description: Activations are distributed across several types of medical academic text and commonly occur on citation markers and adjacent punctuation; other local patterns include medical terminology, numerical statistics, abbreviations, and sentence-final line breaks. Wikipedia football season entries show a separate pattern involving years and league names.

patterns.name: Line break after a sentence-final period
patterns.context: Two line breaks immediately follow a period ending body text; activation is concentrated on the period and line-break tokens, while the first word of the new paragraph is unmarked.
patterns.domain: PubMed Central academic paper body text

patterns.name: Citation markers in medical papers
patterns.context: When citing references in the body text, square brackets, author/number markers, and adjacent tokens such as commas and periods activate; this occurs across different citation formats.

patterns.name: Numerical ranges and statistics in medical abstracts
patterns.context: When papers report prevalence, age, year, or other numbers and ranges, some numbers and separators activate; not all numbers do.

patterns.name: Years and name fragments in football competition names
patterns.context: Multiple subwords activate when years, season ranges, and league names appear together; this pattern is inconsistent with the themes of other passages.

patterns.name: Cancer and RNA splicing terminology
patterns.context: Discusses the relationship between aberrant pre-mRNA splicing, genetic diseases, and cancer; citation markers also activate in addition to the terminology.

patterns.name: Morpheme in a protease name
patterns.context: A protease name is split by tokenization and appears in a discussion of protease inhibition; citation markers and a contrastive word also activate in the same passage.

patterns.name: Obesity and health burden phrasing
patterns.context: Describes overweight or obesity as a public health challenge and reports population and year data.

patterns.name: Paresis of the upper limb after stroke
patterns.context: Describes the prevalence of upper-limb weakness after stroke and the proportion during the acute phase.

patterns.name: AMA abbreviation for advanced maternal age
patterns.context: Reviews advanced maternal age and its obstetric consequences; a paragraph break follows a citation at the sentence end.

patterns.name: Chemotherapy or ionizing radiation
patterns.context: Set against a background of patients receiving chemotherapy and/or ionizing radiation; only a sentence-initial fragment is visible.

patterns.name: Alcohol use disorder and hospitalization
patterns.context: Discusses the lifetime diagnostic prevalence of alcohol use disorder and patient hospitalization.

patterns.name: Signaling pathway abbreviation and enzyme
patterns.context: Discusses activation of a downstream enzyme in molecular signaling; a literature citation and the phrase 「Mer behaves」 occur nearby.

patterns.name: ESD trial and institutional care
patterns.context: Discusses institutional care, a randomized controlled trial of ESD services, and its publication period; sentence-final Today introduces the following text.

6_817.concept: 学术文本中的局部格式与术语
6_817.description: 激活分布于多类医学学术文本，常见于文献引用标记及邻近标点；另有医学术语、数字统计、缩写和句末换行等局部模式。维基百科足球赛季条目则呈现独立的年份与联赛名称模式。

patterns.name: 句末句点后换行
patterns.context: 句点结束一段正文后紧接两个换行；激活集中在句点及换行 token 上，换行后的新段首词未标记。
patterns.domain: PubMed Central 学术论文正文

patterns.name: 医学论文中的引用标记
patterns.context: 正文引用文献编号时，方括号、作者/编号标记及逗号、句点等邻接 token 激活；不同引用格式均出现。
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文及学术文本

patterns.name: 医学摘要中的数字范围与统计数字
patterns.context: 论文叙述患病率、年龄、年份等数字或数值范围时，部分数字及分隔符激活；并非所有数字都激活。

patterns.name: 足球赛事名称中的年份与名称片段
patterns.context: 年份、赛季范围及联赛名称连写时多个子词激活；与其他段落主题不一致。

patterns.name: 癌症与 RNA 剪接术语
patterns.context: 讨论异常 pre-mRNA 剪接与遗传病、癌症的关系；除术语外也有引文标记激活。

patterns.name: 蛋白酶名称中的词素
patterns.context: 蛋白酶名称被分词拆开，并处于抑制蛋白酶的论述中；同段还有引文标记和转折词激活。

patterns.name: 肥胖与健康负担表述
patterns.context: 描述超重或肥胖作为公共卫生挑战，并报告人群和年份数据。

patterns.name: 卒中后上肢 paresis 表述
patterns.context: 叙述卒中后上肢无力的常见程度及急性期比例。

patterns.name: 高龄产妇缩写 AMA
patterns.context: 综述高龄产妇及其产科后果，句末引文之后出现段落换行。

patterns.name: 化疗或电离辐射
patterns.context: 以患者接受化疗和/或电离辐射为背景；只有句子开头片段可见。

patterns.name: 酒精使用障碍及住院
patterns.context: 讨论酒精使用障碍的终生诊断比例及患者住院情况。

patterns.name: 信号通路缩写与酶
patterns.context: 讨论分子信号下游酶的激活；邻近有文献引用及「Mer behaves」表述。

patterns.name: ESD 试验与机构照护
patterns.context: 讨论机构照护、ESD 服务的随机对照试验及其发表年代；句末 Today 引出后文。

en.description: Activations occur across many text types and commonly involve that introducing explanations, conditions, or consequences, as well as hypothetical or advisory expressions with would/if; other topics include medical disclosure, emotions, misunderstandings, finances, accidents, software, funerals, and firearms.

patterns.name: Explanation of conditions, causes, and consequences
patterns.context: Explains that something is true, may happen, or leads to a consequence; common in explanatory or argumentative statements and in sentences offering readers a basis for judgment.
patterns.domain: Medical conversations, opinion pieces, news, and analytical explanations

patterns.name: Hypotheticals and advice constructions
patterns.context: Offers advice under a condition, a possible outcome, or a counterfactual plan, often co-occurring with if, better, or a decision-making context.
patterns.domain: Conversation, commentary, policy discussion, practical advice

patterns.name: Expressions about emotions, family, and happiness
patterns.context: Discusses the psychological consequences of intimate relationships, emotions, or pursuing ideals; not necessarily an advice construction.

patterns.name: Correcting misunderstandings or gaps between intent and interpretation
patterns.context: Contrasts original intent with outside interpretation, describing misunderstandings in communication or dissemination.
patterns.domain: Social media, advertising, and news reports

patterns.name: Costs, grants, and spending plans
patterns.context: Discusses insufficient project funding and proposes or reviews policy plans to control spending.

patterns.name: Accidents, losses, and data reports
patterns.context: Reports natural gas losses caused by a valve left open between facilities and cites data to explain the situation.
patterns.domain: Corporate emails, energy operations incident records

patterns.name: Software tool selection and preferences
patterns.context: Compares software or learning platforms and expresses users’ preferences or needs when choosing tools.

patterns.name: Funeral rites and human remains
patterns.context: Describes burial objects and the social significance of continued interaction with human remains.

patterns.name: Firearms, suicide, and policy debate
patterns.context: Discusses firearm-related suicide and whether gun control can prevent such behavior.

patterns.name: Explanation and informed consent
patterns.context: Medical personnel explain possible complications before a procedure to ensure the patient is informed.

patterns.name: Emphasis on an expression or claim in a quotation
patterns.context: Introduces an explanation, specifies a referent, or emphasizes a conclusion in a longer sentence; overlaps with other patterns and shows no unified theme.

6_817.description: 激活分布于多类文本，常见于引出解释、条件或后果的that，以及would/if等假设建议表达；另涉及医疗告知、情绪、误解、财政、事故、软件、殡葬和枪支议题。

patterns.name: 条件、因果与后果的解释
patterns.trigger: «that»（尤其紧接说明、判断或可能性，如“make sure that”“understand that”“indicates that”）
patterns.context: 说明某事成立、可能发生或导致后果；常见于解释、论证或向读者提供判断依据的语句。
patterns.domain: 医疗对话、评论文章、新闻及分析性说明

patterns.name: 假设与建议句式
patterns.trigger: «would»、«if»、«better»，如“would be better if”“would have”“it would be easier”
patterns.context: 提出条件下的建议、可能结果或反事实方案，常与 if、better 或决策语境共现。
patterns.domain: 对话、评论、政策讨论、实用建议

patterns.name: 情绪、家庭与幸福相关表达
patterns.context: 谈论亲密关系、情绪或追求理想带来的心理后果；不必然属于建议句式。
patterns.domain: 个人对话、心理／人生评论

patterns.name: 纠正误解或意图与解读的落差
patterns.trigger: “It was interpreted”“Instead it was interpreted”及“intention … communicate”
patterns.context: 对比原本意图与外界解读，描述沟通或传播上的误会。
patterns.domain: 社交媒体、广告及新闻报道

patterns.name: 费用、拨款与支出方案
patterns.trigger: “unfunded mandate”“revenue source”“solution would have slowed down spending”

patterns.name: 事故、损失与数据报告
patterns.trigger: “gas loss data indicates that”“inadvertently got into”

patterns.name: 软件工具的选择与偏好
patterns.trigger: “different software”“compare one package against the other”“use Dropbox”
patterns.context: 比较软件或学习平台，并表达使用者对工具的偏好或选择需求。
patterns.domain: 技术建议、教育论坛讨论

patterns.name: 殡葬仪式与死者遗骸
patterns.context: 描写墓葬器物及与遗骸持续互动所承载的社会意义。

patterns.name: 枪支、自杀与政策争论

patterns.name: 解释与知情同意

patterns.context: 医疗人员在操作前说明可能并发症，确保患者知情。

patterns.name: 引语中对表达或主张的强调
patterns.trigger: «that»与“the only thing that can cause depression”“that decision”等结构

patterns.domain: 评论、建议及论述性文字

en.description: Strong responses occur mainly for the demonstrative or clause-linking uses of that and the contextual demonstrative use of this, across multiple genres; activation also occurs on perceptually in an acoustics term and on own in a thermodynamics statement.

patterns.name: Demonstrative/clause-linking that
patterns.context: that refers to a preceding object or situation, or introduces a clause; it can occur in prepositional phrases, noun phrases, and conditional/result structures
patterns.domain: Forums, novels, popular science, political commentary, academic text

patterns.name: Demonstrative this
patterns.context: this refers back to or points to a manner, degree, or object in the immediate context
patterns.domain: Spiritual promotional material, forum discussions, emails

patterns.name: perceptually
patterns.context: Occurs in a technical statement describing auditory perceptual equivalence

patterns.name: own
patterns.context: own modifies the object referred to by a possessive, emphasizing its respective state

6_817.description: 主要对 that 的指示或从句连接用法，以及 this 的语境指示用法有强反应，跨多种文体；另在声学术语 perceptually 和热力学语句中的 own 上激活。

patterns.name: 指示/从句连接词 that
patterns.trigger: «that»，包括“that quote”“in that case”“in that moment”“such that”“that ... would be”等
patterns.context: that 指向前文对象或情境，或引出从句；可出现在介词短语、名词短语及条件/结果结构中
patterns.domain: 论坛、小说、科普、政治评论、学术文本

patterns.name: 指示词 this
patterns.context: this 回指或指示紧邻语境中的方式、程度或对象
patterns.domain: 灵性宣传、论坛讨论、邮件

patterns.name: perceptually
patterns.context: 出现在描述声音感知等效的技术语句中
patterns.domain: 论坛中的音响/声学讨论

patterns.name: own
patterns.context: own 修饰所有格所指对象，强调各自的状态
patterns.domain: 热力学定义或百科式说明

en.concept: Degree emphasis and common function words
en.description: Activations occur in diverse contexts: expressions of degree or quantity, comparative more, evaluative reactions, the ends of negative contractions, and words such as free and pretty much; no single stable semantics covers all examples.

patterns.name: Degree or quantity interrogatives
patterns.context: In expressions of thanks or questions about training volume, much emphasizes degree or quantity; the two instances have different grammatical functions.

patterns.name: More in comparatives
patterns.context: more modifies an adjective or describes an improved quality, appearing in expressions meaning “more cost-effective” and “more efficient”.

patterns.name: Emphasizing an evaluation or reaction
patterns.context: Evaluates or responds to preceding text: really emphasizes interest, while that introduces a rhetorical evaluation.

patterns.name: Word in a spoken negative contraction
patterns.context: Falls on the end of wouldn’t, forming a counterfactual or persuasive rhetorical question; the surrounding text concerns relationship repair and changes in the world.

patterns.name: Quoted term about free energy
patterns.context: Modifies energy in a writer’s claim that free energy would threaten elite power.

patterns.name: Emphasizing phrase pretty much
patterns.context: Appears with pretty to mean “that’s more or less it,” summarizing the limited benefits of Authorship.

6_817.concept: 程度强调与常见功能词
6_817.description: 激活分布在多种语境：程度或数量表达、more 比较、评价反应、否定缩写末尾，以及 free 和 pretty much 等词；没有单一稳定语义能覆盖全部例子。

patterns.name: 程度或数量疑问词
patterns.context: 在表达感谢或询问训练量时，much 强调程度或数量；两处语法功能不同。

patterns.name: 比较级中的更多
patterns.context: more 修饰形容词或描述提升的性质，出现在「更具成本效益」和「更高效」的表达中。
patterns.domain: NIH 项目说明、商业宣传

patterns.name: 强调评价或反应
patterns.context: 对前文作评价或回应：really 强调感兴趣，that 引出反问式评价。

patterns.name: 口语否定缩写中的词
patterns.context: 落在 wouldn’t 的末尾，构成反事实或劝说式反问；周围谈关系修复与世界变化。

patterns.name: 免费能源的引述词
patterns.context: 修饰能源，论述者声称免费能源会威胁精英权力。

patterns.name: 强调词 pretty much
patterns.context: 与 pretty 连用，表示“差不多就是这样”，总结 Authorship 的益处有限。
patterns.domain: 网络内容／搜索可见度说明

en.concept: Conversational explanations and localized word forms
en.description: Activation is most consistent in informal expressions used to explain, evaluate, or summarize, especially wording such as “that makes…” and “pretty much”. However, it also covers “uld” within Cauldron, technical terms, formulas, product introductions, and titles, so no single semantic pattern fully explains it.

patterns.name: Substrings containing “ould” across spellings
patterns.context: Activation marks the letter fragment “uld” inside words, in both cases within “Cauldron”; segment [3] is prose about global health, and segment [4] is a list of works.

patterns.name: “makes” in conversational speech
patterns.context: Stronger activation is concentrated in conversational or informal explanations, especially expressions such as “that makes …”; [9] and [10] contain similar “pretty much” expressions, but the activation annotations do not fully match.
patterns.domain: Forum comments, technical discussion, and conversational explanations

patterns.name: Analysis/trading-oriented contrast
patterns.context: Distinguishes analytical from transactional approaches when discussing the nature of data; these words have weaker activation.

patterns.name: Mobile web and AMP
patterns.context: Technical link titles and comments on mobile web loading speed and reading news; “Quick” in the title also activates.

patterns.name: Numerical expressions in physical quantities and formulas
patterns.context: Activation appears in mathematical formulas and subsequent descriptions of transition scales and values.

patterns.name: Author identity and search visibility
patterns.context: Discusses product features for displaying author identity and avatars, and visibility in search results; activation is scattered across the explanatory text.

patterns.name: Evaluation and summary in programming comments
patterns.context: A brief evaluation or self-deprecating remark is followed by a conversational summary; [9] also includes a Vue code example.

patterns.name: Left/right floats in web layouts
patterns.context: Discusses CSS left/right column layouts and explains that the right column unexpectedly sticks to the right edge of the page; strong activation falls near “#right”.

patterns.name: Work titles in a list
patterns.context: Work or item names appear in a list of titles; activation falls on the “uld” fragment within a title.

6_817.description: 激活最一致地出现在非正式讨论中解释、评价或总结的表达，尤其是“that makes…”及“pretty much”一类措辞；但也覆盖 Cauldron 内的“uld”、技术术语、公式、产品介绍和标题，无法由单一语义模式完全解释。

patterns.name: 多种拼写中包含「ould」的子串
patterns.context: 激活标在词内部的字母片段“uld”，两处都位于“Cauldron”中；段[3]为全球健康领域散文，段[4]为作品名列表。

patterns.name: 口语中的“makes”
patterns.trigger: [1] “that« makes»10 #right”；[2] “that« makes»9 sense”；[5] “that« makes»9 it”；[8] “that« makes»9 me”；[9] “that«'s»4 pretty« much»9 how”；[10] “That is pretty much why”
patterns.context: 较强激活集中在口语或非正式解释中，尤其是“that makes …”一类表达；[9]、[10]出现相近的“pretty much”表达，但激活标注并不完全相同。
patterns.domain: 论坛评论、技术讨论及解释性口语

patterns.name: 分析／交易导向的对照
patterns.context: 在讨论数据性质时，将分析型与交易型并列区分；这些词本身有较弱激活。

patterns.name: 移动网页与 AMP
patterns.context: 技术链接标题及对移动网页加载速度、阅读新闻的评论；标题中的“Quick”也有激活。

patterns.name: 物理量和公式中的数值表达
patterns.context: 激活出现在数学公式及其后对转变尺度和数值的说明中。

patterns.name: 作者身份与搜索可见性
patterns.context: 讨论作者身份展示、头像与搜索结果可见性的产品功能；激活分散在说明文字中。

patterns.name: 编程评语中的评价和总结
patterns.trigger: [8] “Yikes.”“Looks like that makes me a ‘fast bad programmer’”；[9] “And that’s pretty much how it works”
patterns.context: 先有简短评价或自嘲，再用总结性口语解释；[9]还包含 Vue 代码示例。

patterns.name: 网页布局中的左右浮动
patterns.context: 讨论 CSS 左右栏布局，并说明右栏意外贴到页面右侧；强激活落在“#right”附近。

patterns.name: 清单中的作品名
patterns.context: 作品或条目名称出现在一串标题列表中；激活落在标题内部的“uld”片段。

en.description: Strong activation is concentrated on constructions where makes/made expresses a result or forms a judgment; there is also activation on split word endings of could/would and a few proper nouns, terms, and evaluative looks contexts, across fields and with patterns of varying strength.

patterns.name: Sentence continuation or contrastive follow-up
patterns.context: The trigger make(s)/made is followed by an object or result, often in a clause explaining how a factor causes an effect, judgment, or outcome; the preceding text may contain but, that said, or this.
patterns.domain: Forum conversations, technical Q&A, design descriptions

patterns.name: Local trigger on would
patterns.context: Activation falls on a could/would ending fragment separated by a space or split into subwords; semantics and syntax are not consistent.
patterns.domain: Academic text, legal text, Wikipedia entries

patterns.name: Local trigger in lists or proper nouns
patterns.context: Occurs in proper nouns, titles, or chemical/legal terminology; activation may be driven by word fragments rather than a complete semantic pattern.

patterns.name: Local trigger on evaluative looks
patterns.context: looks is followed by a judgment or evaluation, but makes is also strongly activated in the same passage, making it unclear whether this is an independent stable pattern.

6_817.description: 强激活最集中于 makes/made 表示造成结果或形成判断的结构；另有 could/would 的拆分词尾激活，以及少量专名、术语和 looks 评价语境，跨领域且模式强弱不一。

patterns.name: 句子补充或转折后续
patterns.context: 触发词 make(s)/made 后接宾语或结果，常出现在解释某种因素造成影响、判断或结果的分句中；前文可有 but、that said 或 this。
patterns.domain: 论坛对话、技术问答、设计描述

patterns.name: would 的局部触发
patterns.context: 激活落在被空格或子词拆分的 could/would 词尾片段；语义和句法并不统一。
patterns.domain: 学术文本、法律文本、Wikipedia 条目

patterns.name: 列举或专名中的局部触发
patterns.context: 出现在专名、标题或化学/法律术语中，激活可能由字词片段而非完整语义模式驱动。

patterns.name: 评价词 looks 的局部触发
patterns.context: looks 后接判断或评价，但同时段内还出现 makes 强激活，无法确认是否为独立稳定模式。

en.description: Activation is scattered across expressions of degree, time, or certainty; phrases that introduce conclusions or contrasts; and several domain-specific expressions. It spans conversational, comment, scientific, and statistical texts, without a unified, stable trigger condition.

patterns.name: Emphasis of degree or state
patterns.context: After a degree adverb or time expression, emphasizes a subsequent judgment, state, or change; in some examples, activation falls on an adjacent quantifier or time word.
patterns.domain: Conversational speech, online discussions, and general narrative

patterns.name: Connectives introducing results or inferences
patterns.context: Introduces a conclusion, inference, or exclusion based on preceding facts; activation is concentrated near the connective or result expression.

patterns.name: Contrast or unexpected association
patterns.context: A contrastive word is followed by an association not yet found, highlighting a lack of discovery or an unexpected relationship.
patterns.domain: Patent background, medical and scientific discourse

patterns.name: Embryo generation in experimental procedures
patterns.context: Describes an experimental method for producing embryos from specific cells by somatic cell nuclear transfer.

patterns.name: Models and variables in statistical analysis
patterns.context: Refers to bivariate analysis and its significant variables in regression results.

patterns.name: Emphasizing feelings and expectations
patterns.context: Describes positive feelings produced by a product and how those feelings encourage expectations of future use.

patterns.name: Redeployment of resources after change
patterns.context: Considers a scenario in which technical or human resources previously invested have been reallocated following a periodic change.

patterns.name: Localized emphasis in subordinate or conditional expressions
patterns.context: Embedded in conversational wording that explains or qualifies a judgment; it has no stable shared theme with the other activation fragments.

6_817.concept: 强调性语境中的局部词汇
6_817.description: 激活分散于强调程度、时间或确定性的表达，以及承接结论、转折和若干领域专用短语；涉及口语、评论、科学与统计文本，未呈现统一且稳定的触发条件。

patterns.name: 程度或状态的强化
patterns.context: 在程度、副词或时间成分之后，强调后续判断、状态或变化；部分例子中激活落在相邻的量化或时间词上。
patterns.domain: 口语、网络讨论及一般叙述

patterns.name: 结果或推断中的承接词
patterns.context: 从前文事实引出结论、推断或排除项，激活集中在承接词或结果表达附近。

patterns.name: 转折或意外关联
patterns.context: 转折词后接尚未发现的关联，突出发现不足或出乎预期的关系。
patterns.domain: 专利背景、医学科学论述

patterns.name: 实验流程中的胚胎生成
patterns.trigger: «from» these hGCase fetal cells by SCNT
patterns.context: 描述由特定细胞通过体细胞核移植产生胚胎的实验方法。

patterns.name: 统计分析中的模型与变量
patterns.context: 在回归分析结果中指向双变量分析及其显著变量。

patterns.name: 强调感觉与期待
patterns.trigger: «really» «helps» me；«that» this feels so nice «makes» me look forward to
patterns.context: 描述产品带来的积极感受，以及感受如何促使期待后续使用。

patterns.name: 变化后的资源重新部署
patterns.context: 设想周期性变化之后，过去投入的技术或人力资源已被重新分配。

patterns.name: 从句或条件表达中的局部强调
patterns.context: 嵌在对判断作解释或限定的口语表达中；与其他激活片段并无稳定共同主题。

en.description: The samples show sporadic patterns such as the contrastive “but”, result/state expressions, degree words, and forum line-break markers; there are also one-off instances of “begs” and “into the”. Triggers are scattered and cannot be adequately explained by a single semantic or syntactic concept.

patterns.name: Contrastive word “but”
patterns.context: After preceding exposition, a contrastive word introduces a limitation, contrast, or addition; paragraph 1 also contains “but what about”, while paragraph 5 has “but the fact that”.
patterns.domain: Expository writing, commentary, and everyday narration

patterns.name: Introducing results and progression in degree
patterns.context: These words occur in statements of results or states, such as “ruled out”, “made getting … easier”, “blows up”, and “thrown up”; their meanings and contexts do not fully align.

patterns.name: Subword fragment “begs”
patterns.context: In the fixed phrase “begs the question”, activation falls on the word ending and its subword fragment; the preceding text discusses small numerical values.

patterns.name: Fragments near a preposition and article
patterns.context: In “introduce … residues into the DNA fragments”, activation is concentrated on the preposition and article; it may also be influenced by the following noun phrase.

patterns.name: Line-break markers
patterns.context: Occurs at line breaks or Q&A format boundaries in forum text; paragraph 4 also contains an ASCII divider and username, while paragraph 9 has an answer marker.

patterns.name: Comparisons and degree expressions
patterns.context: Occurs in descriptions of feelings, degree, or states, but contexts vary and no unified syntactic function is apparent.

patterns.name: Opaque or incidental activation
patterns.context: The positive activation tokens provided are insufficient to identify a reliable trigger rule from context alone.

6_817.description: 样本中有“but”转折、结果/状态表达、程度词及论坛换行标记等零散模式；另有“begs”和“into the”等单例。触发分散，无法由单一语义或句法概念充分解释。

patterns.name: 转折词“but”
patterns.context: 前文铺陈后用转折词引出限制、反差或补充；第1段也出现“but what about”，第5段为“but the fact that”。
patterns.domain: 说明文、评论与日常叙述

patterns.name: 结果引出与程度递进
patterns.context: 这些词出现在结果或状态形成的表述中，如“ruled out”“made getting … easier”“blows up”“thrown up”；词义和语境并不完全一致。
patterns.domain: 多领域散文、问答及叙事

patterns.name: 词内子词片段“begs”
patterns.context: “begs the question”固定搭配中，激活落在词尾及其子词片段；前文谈小规模数值。

patterns.name: 介词与冠词附近的片段
patterns.context: 在“introduce … residues into the DNA fragments”中，激活集中于介词和冠词；也可能受随后名词短语影响。

patterns.name: 换行标记
patterns.context: 出现在论坛文本的换行或问答格式边界；第4段还伴随 ASCII 分隔符和用户名，第9段为答案标记。

patterns.name: 比较与程度表达
patterns.context: 出现在感受、程度或状态描述中，但上下文各异，未见统一句法功能。

patterns.name: 不透明或偶然的激活
patterns.trigger: « ought»?（原文无此 token）；主要可见触发为“«»”附近的零散标记
patterns.context: 仅凭给出的正激活 token 难以从上下文确定可靠触发规则。

en.description: Activation is scattered across ruled (including ruled out/by), into phrases, judgment and causative expressions, and several verbs, adverbs, and within-word fragments; no single stable semantic or syntactic trigger pattern is evident.

patterns.name: Participle/verb following an adverb or time word
patterns.context: Highlights a verb, preposition, or phrase transition in a sentence, often followed by a complement; trigger locations vary, with no stable local morphological pattern.
patterns.domain: Fictional narration, home/product reviews, scientific abstracts, explanatory prose, memoir, game settings

patterns.name: Judgment after negation or contrast
patterns.context: Activates when excluding an option, emphasizing a state, or making a cautionary judgment.
patterns.domain: Everyday narratives, literary narration, forum comments

patterns.name: Causative or experiential expressions
patterns.context: Describes a feeling produced by something or an action it prompts; the main activation in this fragment falls on makes.

patterns.name: into phrases across word boundaries
patterns.context: into is followed by the and a noun, expressing introduction/application into something; activation strength varies markedly across the two segments.

patterns.name: Irregular forms and character fragments
patterns.context: Activation falls on a tokenized within-word fragment or word-form fragment; its connection to neighboring semantic patterns is unclear.

patterns.name: Other scattered highlighted words
patterns.context: Locally prominent activation appears in each context, but there are insufficiently consistent trigger conditions across them.
patterns.domain: Everyday narratives, literature, comments, explanatory prose, game settings

6_817.description: 激活分散于 ruled（含 ruled out/by）、into 短语、判断与使役表达，以及若干动词、副词和词内片段；未见单一稳定的语义或句法触发模式。

patterns.name: 副词或时间词后接分词/动词
patterns.trigger: [3] «long»8« ago»3« ceased»5«; [5] «makes»8« for»5« a»3« more»4« modern»2« touch»; [6] «into»8« the»6« DNA»; [7] «off»8«; [8] «blew»8« my»3« mind»; [9] «ruled»8« by»
patterns.context: 在句子中突出一个动词、介词或短语转折点，常接后续补语；触发位置并不统一，未见稳定的局部词法模式。
patterns.domain: 小说叙述、家居/产品评论、科研摘要、说明文、回忆叙述、游戏设定

patterns.name: 否定或转折后的判断
patterns.context: 在排除某选项、强调某种状态，或提出警示性判断时激活。
patterns.domain: 生活类叙述、文学叙述、论坛评论

patterns.name: 使役或感受表达
patterns.context: 描述某事物带来的感受或促使后续行为；该片段中的主要激活落在 makes。

patterns.name: 跨词边界的 into 短语
patterns.context: into 后接 the 加名词，表达引入/施加到某物中；强度在两段差异明显。
patterns.domain: 科研方法、产品维修说明

patterns.name: 不规则形态与字符片段
patterns.context: 激活落在被拆分的词内片段或词形片段上；与相邻语义模式的对应关系不明确。

patterns.name: 其他分散的高亮词
patterns.context: 在各自语境中有局部显著激活，但彼此缺乏足够一致的触发条件。
patterns.domain: 生活叙述、文学、评论、说明文、游戏设定

en.concept: Expressions of outcomes or state transitions
en.description: Activation is relatively sporadic: common in evaluations where make introduces a result, and also in expressions of exclusion, fading, stopping, or denying that something should be a reason; a proper name, Chauvet, and a design comment are difficult to classify.

patterns.name: Emphatic causal result after an evaluation
patterns.context: The preceding text presents a quality or fact, followed by make(s) introducing an evaluative or emotional result; degree adverbs such as really and definitely are common.
patterns.domain: Consumer reviews of home goods, skincare, fashion, and similar topics

patterns.name: Termination of a past state or process
patterns.context: Describes something being excluded, gradually fading, dominating a situation, or emphasizes that a situation should not be a reason; often occurs in contrastive or evaluative contexts.

patterns.name: Continuation or accumulation over a long period
patterns.context: The perfect tense with long ago describes a process that stopped long ago; the excerpt also contains a series of participles describing traffic sounds.

patterns.name: Localized strong activation on a proper name or rare word
patterns.context: A proper name appears in a description of prehistoric cave paintings; activation falls on a subword fragment within the word.

6_817.description: 激活较分散：常见于评价句中 make 引出的结果，也出现在排除、消退、停止或否定应有理由等表达；另有 Chauvet 专名及一段设计评论无法明确归类。

patterns.name: 评价后的强调性因果结果
patterns.trigger: “makes”后接“for a more modern touch”（2）、“makes me look forward”（3）；“makes this somehow really appealing”（6）
patterns.context: 前文给出某种性质或事实，随后用 make(s) 引出评价或情绪上的结果；常见程度副词 really、definitely 等
patterns.domain: 家居、护肤、时尚等消费评论

patterns.name: 过去状态或过程的终结
patterns.context: 叙述某事物被排除、逐渐消退、占据局面，或强调某种情况不应成为理由；常在转折或判断语境中

patterns.name: 延续或累积到较长时段
patterns.context: 完成时态加 long ago，描述某种过程早已停止；片段中同时有一串描写交通声响的分词

patterns.name: 专名或罕见词的局部强激活
patterns.context: 专名出现在史前洞穴绘画的说明中；激活落在词内部子词片段

en.description: Activation is most prominent on “ruled” and following fragments, and is widely scattered across within-word fragments; formatting markers, food descriptions, and the place name Hubei also appear. The examples lack a unified semantic or syntactic condition.

patterns.name: Negation or judgment following “ruled”
patterns.context: “ruled” appears in a sentence, followed by a negative result or a period; the two examples differ semantically and syntactically.

patterns.name: Localized within-word fragments
patterns.context: Activation falls on tokenized word fragments or phrases, broadly distributed with no unified meaning or stable syntactic condition.

patterns.name: Formatting markers and line breaks
patterns.context: In forum comments, activation appears around separators or line-break markers; [10] has only weak line-break activation.

patterns.name: Food and drinking experiences
patterns.context: Descriptions of food or drink mention preparation, taste, and the experience after drinking; there are only two segments, and the precise locations of strong activation differ.

patterns.name: ube fragment in the place name Hubei
patterns.context: The place name “Hubei” in a Chinese ethnic or geographic context is tokenized; both instances activate on “ube”.

6_817.description: 激活最突出地出现在“ruled”及其后续片段，并广泛散布于词内片段；另见格式标记、饮食描述和地名 Hubei。各例缺乏统一语义或句法条件。

patterns.name: “ruled”后的否定或判断
patterns.context: “ruled”出现在句中，接否定结果或句号；目前两例的语义和句法并不相同。

patterns.name: 词内局部片段
patterns.trigger: [2] mib«ef»9«rad»3il；[3] h«ic»3cups；[4] shouldn’«t»9；[5] far« outwe»5ighed»8；[6] H«ube»8«i»1；[7]« around»8；[8] H«ube»8«i»1；[9] «Then»8；[10]« faded»8« out»7« from»5« a»4« vivid»4« red»3
patterns.context: 激活落在被拆分标记的词片段或短语上，分布广，未见统一词义或稳定句法条件。

patterns.name: 格式标记与换行
patterns.context: 论坛评论中可见分隔符或换行标记处激活；[10] 仅有较弱换行激活。

patterns.name: 饮食与饮酒体验
patterns.trigger: [1] « a»3 s’«more»3；[7] « steep»4«ings»2、« flavor»2« hangs»3« around»8
patterns.context: 食物或饮品描述中出现制作、味道和饮用后的体验；仅两段，且强激活具体位置不同。

patterns.name: 地名中的 Hubei 词片段
patterns.context: 中国族群或地理语境中的地名“Hubei”被拆分标记，两个实例都激活于“ube”。

en.description: High activation often falls on verbs of result or influence (makes, produced, fuelled), the modal could, and adverbs or predicates (hardly, negatively, long, ruled, guide); these occur across domains and show semantically sporadic patterns.

patterns.name: Bring about / cause a result
patterns.context: A verb is followed by a result or effect; [1] makes someone look forward to applying lotion, [2] creates a more modern feel, [6] makes a contrast seem appealing, and [8] produces hiccups. The results are not uniformly positive.
patterns.domain: Everyday reviews, interior design descriptions, literary narrative

patterns.name: Modal or conditional word could
patterns.context: Indicates possibility or potential impact; [3] concerns an optional regular-expression modification, while [5] concerns a negative review potentially affecting grades or teacher-student relationships.
patterns.domain: Technical Q&A, reviews, or news-style commentary

patterns.name: Degree / manner adverbs before result verbs or predicates
patterns.context: An adverb immediately precedes a predicate or participle, modifying its extent, direction, or duration; triggers vary, with no stable semantic category apparent.
patterns.domain: Historical discussion, educational commentary, literary narrative

patterns.name: Predicates expressing prominence or guidance
patterns.context: Predicates describe a factor dominating a situation or guiding a judgment; the former describes stillness dominating a room's atmosphere, and the latter describes legal factors guiding a court's consideration.

patterns.name: Expressions of research outcomes / drivers
patterns.context: A past participle describes commercial, legal, and self-interest demands driving the formation of a narrow researcher culture; a singleton.

6_817.description: 高激活多落在结果或影响动词（makes、produced、fuelled）、情态词 could、副词及谓语（hardly、negatively、long、ruled、guide）上；这些分布跨领域，语义较分散。

patterns.name: 使得／导致某结果
patterns.context: 动词后接结果或影响；[1] 使人期待涂乳液，[2] 形成更现代的感觉，[6] 使反差显得有吸引力，[8] 产生 hiccups。语义并不都表示正面结果。
patterns.domain: 日常评论、室内设计描述、文学叙述

patterns.name: 情态或条件词 could
patterns.context: 表示可能性或潜在影响；[3] 是可选的正则表达式修改，[5] 是给差评可能负面影响成绩或师生关系。
patterns.domain: 技术问答、评论或新闻式议论

patterns.name: 结果动词或谓语前的程度／方式副词
patterns.context: 副词紧邻谓语或分词，修饰其发生程度、方向或持续时间；触发点不同，未见稳定的语义类别。
patterns.domain: 历史论述、教育议论、文学叙述

patterns.name: 显著性或指引性谓语
patterns.context: 谓语描述某因素支配局面或引导判断；前者写沉静主导房间氛围，后者写法律因素指导法院考虑。

patterns.name: 研究活动的结果／驱动表达
patterns.context: 过去分词描述商业、法律与自利要求推动狭窄研究者文化的形成；孤例。

en.description: Activation is scattered across several local structures: in research contexts, guide introduces a subsequent use; makes expresses a result; other examples include fuelled, imagery of trauma moving through someone, a regular expression phrase, and HTML boundaries. There is no overall unified meaning.

patterns.name: Research use following guide
patterns.context: guide is a verb whose subject or preceding context is a research finding, knowledge, or factor; it is followed by the analysis, consideration, or design it will guide
patterns.domain: Academic research, public health, and law

patterns.name: Result or utility following makes
patterns.context: makes introduces a resulting effect, experience, or inclination to act; its object may be a for phrase or a person

patterns.name: Within-word fragment fu + elled
patterns.context: The within-word fragment forms fuelled, describing a factor driving a phenomenon

patterns.name: Imagery of past trauma moving through someone
patterns.context: In a recollection or narrative, past trauma and emotion are depicted as passing through the narrator

patterns.name: Regular expression suggestion for in the matched group
patterns.context: A prepositional phrase before a comma explains how to modify a regular expression to exclude commas

patterns.name: HTML tag closing symbols and indentation
patterns.context: Near tag boundaries, line breaks, or tabs in an HTML fragment

patterns.name: Research object phrase for outcomes
patterns.context: A medical research title examines the effect of for-profit hospital status on patient care and outcomes; strong activation actually falls on influenced

6_817.description: 激活分散在多类局部结构：研究语境中 guide 引出后续用途；makes 表示造成结果；另见 fuelled、创伤移动意象、正则短语及 HTML 边界。整体无统一词义。

patterns.name: guide 后的研究用途
patterns.context: guide 作动词，主语或前文是研究发现、知识或因素，后接将指导的分析、考量或设计
patterns.domain: 学术研究、公共卫生与法律

patterns.name: makes 后的结果或效用
patterns.context: makes 引出带来某种结果、体验或行动倾向；对象可为 for 短语或人

patterns.name: fu + elled 的词内片段
patterns.context: 词内片段组成 fuelled，描述因素推动某种现象

patterns.name: 过去创伤的移动意象
patterns.context: 回忆或叙述中，过去的创伤与情绪被描写为穿过叙述者
patterns.domain: 个人叙事、心理／疗愈文体

patterns.name: in the matched group 的正则表达式建议
patterns.context: 逗号前的介词短语，说明如何修改正则表达式以排除逗号

patterns.name: HTML 标签闭合符号及缩进
patterns.context: HTML 片段中标签边界、换行或制表符附近

patterns.name: outcomes 的研究对象短语
patterns.context: 医学研究标题中，考察营利医院状态对患者照护与结局的影响；强激活实际落在 influenced

en.description: Activation is distributed across varied contexts: notably, guide introducing analysis, design, or judicial consideration, as well as localized words and phrases in narrative, legal, philosophical, and academic texts; no unified semantic pattern is apparent.

patterns.name: Object following guide
patterns.context: The subject denotes information, knowledge, a factor, or experience; it is followed by an object, often in constructions such as guide our analysis, guide the design, or guide a court's consideration.

patterns.name: Emotional or experiential flow across a long time span
patterns.context: A narrator recalls or feels past trauma, emotions, or experiences surfacing in the present.
patterns.domain: Personal narrative, psychological or spiritual writing

patterns.name: Pronoun into our analysis
patterns.context: In technical discussion, refers to incorporating known workload into an analysis.

patterns.name: Legal defect leading to reversal
patterns.context: A defect in the record or procedural safeguards supports an appeal reversing a decision.

patterns.name: Argumentative relationship between inform and intelligible
patterns.context: Discusses how a background or perspective shapes and makes religious practice intelligible.

patterns.name: Idiomatic expression for a verbal slip
patterns.context: Self-reflectively describes saying something without thinking.

patterns.name: fu…elled the cult
patterns.context: Criticizes commercial, legal, and other pressures for fostering a narrow researcher culture; the activated word form is marked as split.

patterns.name: Closing line describing a still atmosphere
patterns.context: Uses Otherwise stillness ruled. to describe a room's calm or still atmosphere.

6_817.description: 激活分散在多种语境中：尤其包括 guide 引出分析、设计或司法考量，也包括若干叙事、法律、哲学和学术文本中的局部词句；未见统一语义模式。

patterns.name: guide 后接对象
patterns.context: 主语表示信息、知识、因素或经验；后接宾语，常见结构为 guide our analysis、guide the design、guide a court's consideration。

patterns.name: 长时间跨度的情绪或经历流动
patterns.context: 叙述者回忆或感受过去的创伤、情绪或经历在当下涌现。
patterns.domain: 个人叙事、心理或灵性写作

patterns.name: 代词 into our analysis
patterns.context: 在技术论述中，指把已知的工作量纳入分析。

patterns.name: 法律上的缺陷导致撤销
patterns.context: 记录或程序保障存在缺陷，并据此支持上诉撤销裁决。

patterns.name: inform 与 intelligible 的论证关系
patterns.context: 论述某种背景或观点如何塑造并使宗教实践可理解。

patterns.name: 口头失言的惯用表达
patterns.context: 自我反省地描述未经思索说出口的话。

patterns.name: fu…elled the cult
patterns.context: 批评商业、法律等压力助长狭窄研究者文化；激活词形被拆分标记。

patterns.name: 静止氛围的句末收束
patterns.context: 以 Otherwise stillness ruled. 描写房间气氛平静或静止。

en.description: Activation appears in prepositional phrases with into/out, make result structures, the legal verb guide, and HTML tag boundaries. The commonality is weak, centering mainly on local function words, phrase structures, and structural boundaries.

patterns.name: Integration/embedding after the preposition into
patterns.context: Indicates incorporating content, factors, or work into an analysis, model, progress, or solution process; a common structure is into + noun/gerund.

patterns.name: Verb followed by an of phrase
patterns.context: Emphasizes removal from, production by, or feedback to a source; the trigger is often a phrasal verb or a word following the verb.
patterns.domain: Marketing copy, personal narratives, research discourse

patterns.name: Make in causative/result structures
patterns.context: make functions as a causative or result verb, followed by a prepositional phrase or an object plus verb phrase, expressing that it causes or brings about a result.

patterns.name: guide in legal provisions
patterns.context: guide is a verb meaning that a factor directs or constrains a decision; it occurs in legal phrasing.

patterns.name: HTML tag boundaries and attribute descriptions
patterns.context: Markers occur near line breaks, indentation, and tag-closing boundaries, interspersed with UI attribute descriptions; this does not match the natural-language phrase patterns.

6_817.description: 激活分布在 into/out 等介词短语、make 结果结构、法律动词 guide，以及 HTML 标签边界；共同点较弱，主要集中于局部功能词、短语结构和结构边界。

patterns.name: 介词 into 后的整合/嵌入
patterns.context: 表示把某项内容、因素或工作纳入分析、模型、进展或求解过程；常见结构为 into + 名词/动名词。

patterns.name: 动词后接 of 短语
patterns.trigger: «out»10 of price lists；«out»10 «of»4 «our»4 «mouths»；«out»9« into»（第5段另有“feeds back into”）
patterns.context: 强调从某来源移出、产生或反馈至某处；触发位置多在短语动词或动词之后。
patterns.domain: 营销文案、个人叙述、研究论述

patterns.name: 使役/结果结构中的 make
patterns.context: make 作为使役或结果动词，后接介词短语或宾语加动词短语，表达导致、促成某结果。
patterns.domain: 家居描述、消费体验文案

patterns.name: 法律条文中的 guide
patterns.context: guide 作动词，表示因素引导或约束决策；位于法律句式中。

patterns.name: HTML 标签边界与属性说明
patterns.context: 标记集中在换行、缩进及标签闭合边界附近，夹有 UI 属性说明文本；与自然语言短语模式不一致。

en.concept: Prepositional phrase, with a preference for into
en.description: Activation is more clearly biased toward prepositions and their objects or following elements, especially into; it appears repeatedly in integration constructions of the form incorporate X into Y. Other examples are dispersed across common prepositions, fixed phrases, and narrative expressions, with no single semantic pattern.

patterns.name: into / incorporated in analysis
patterns.context: Describes incorporating known workload into an analysis; the trigger is concentrated on “into” and its following elements.

patterns.name: Bringing about or introducing an effect
patterns.context: “onto” indicates research affecting rankings and income; activation is weaker and differs from the main into pattern.

patterns.name: Common prepositions and expressions
patterns.context: Across several contexts, activation appears near prepositions or phrase boundaries, including through, in, of, or, and out of; these do not represent a single meaning.
patterns.domain: Food narrative, forums, academic papers, licenses, personal narrative

patterns.name: Incorporating into a structure or process
patterns.context: Integrates a structure or dimension into an object or process; the core form is incorporate … into.

patterns.name: in in a multiword fixed legal clause
patterns.context: A license requires the copyright notice and permission notice to be included in all copies; activation falls on “in”.

patterns.name: Expressions of outcomes or state transitions
patterns.context: Describes melting, blurting something out, exclusion, or a state prevailing; activation is distributed across prepositions, verbs, and nearby words in the phrases, with no unified meaning.

6_817.description: 激活较明显地偏向介词及其宾语/后续成分，尤其是 into；多次出现在 incorporate X into Y 的整合结构中。其余样例分散于常见介词、固定短语和叙事表达，难以归为同一语义模式。

patterns.name: into / incorporated in analysis
patterns.context: 描述把已知工作量纳入分析；触发点集中在“into”及其后续成分。

patterns.name: 载入或带来影响
patterns.context: “onto”表示研究对排名和收入造成影响；激活较弱且与主要 into 模式不同。

patterns.name: 常见介词与表达
patterns.trigger: “through the marshmallow”“in large discussions”“in isolation”“in all copies”“of our mouths”“or not”“in a room”
patterns.context: 多个语境中，介词或短语边界附近出现激活，包括 through、in、of、or、out of；并非单一语义。
patterns.domain: 美食叙述、论坛、学术论文、许可证、个人叙述

patterns.name: 纳入某个结构或过程
patterns.trigger: “incorporate the cyclic structure … into the colored operad”“incorporate the temporal dimension into solving”
patterns.context: 将结构或维度整合进对象或过程；核心形式是 incorporate … into。
patterns.domain: 数学论文、计算机视觉论文

patterns.name: 多词固定法律条款中的 in
patterns.context: 许可证要求在所有副本中包含版权声明和许可通知；激活落在“in”。

patterns.name: 结果或状态转变表达
patterns.context: 描述融化、脱口而出、排除或某种状态占上风；激活分散在短语中的介词、动词及邻近词，语义不统一。

en.description: The most stable cue is into, especially in license wording about “including all copies” and technical contexts about “incorporating into a calculation/analysis”; other fragments are scattered across words such as of, make, and well, without forming a unified semantic pattern.

patterns.name: Preposition into
patterns.context: In phrases such as “into all copies”, “factored into”, “incorporate that into”, “makes for”, and “tumble out of”, activation falls on into; makes for and out of may be neighboring phrase or sequence cues, not the same trigger word.
patterns.domain: Open-source licenses, research, technical Q&A, comments, narratives, and other genres

patterns.name: Scope of copying in license terms
patterns.context: An MIT-style license requires including copyright and license notices in all copies or substantial portions; activation is concentrated on “in”, alongside words such as all/copies.

patterns.name: Including quantities or expressions in consideration
patterns.context: Explains that a variable, known workload, or information is included in an analysis, calculation, or consideration.
patterns.domain: Biomedical papers and programming language/computer science Q&A

patterns.name: Progression of conclusions or expression
patterns.context: In fixed prepositional phrases, describes an argument departing from a simple interpretation or speech coming out unprompted; the main highlight remains of.

patterns.name: Expected results in a review
patterns.context: In a game review, should make introduces the possibility that a work could become a strong contender in a product category.

patterns.name: Evaluative predicates in home reviews
patterns.context: Evaluates how colors coordinate with an interior and the effect of a design feature; the highlighted word forms do not correspond consistently with those in other fragments.

6_817.description: 最稳定的线索是 into，尤其出现在许可证“纳入所有副本”及技术语境“纳入计算/分析”中；其余片段分散高亮于 of、make、well 等词，未形成统一语义模式。

patterns.name: 介词 into
patterns.context: 在短语“into all copies”“factored into”“incorporate that into”“makes for”“tumble out of”等中，激活落在 into；其中 makes for、out of 是可能的相邻短语或序列线索，并非同一触发词。
patterns.domain: 开源许可证、科研、技术问答、评论与叙事等多种文体

patterns.name: 许可条款中的复制范围
patterns.trigger: «in»10« all»6 copies« or»3« substantial»1« portions»1« of»3
patterns.context: MIT 风格许可证中，要求将版权和许可声明纳入所有副本或实质部分；激活集中在“in”，并伴随 all/copies 等词。

patterns.name: 数量或表达纳入考量
patterns.context: 说明某个变量、已知工作量或信息被纳入分析、计算或考虑。
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文与编程语言/计算机科学问答

patterns.name: 结论或表达的推进
patterns.context: 固定介词短语中，描述论述偏离简单解读，或话语脱口而出；核心高亮仍是 of。

patterns.name: 评测中的结果预期
patterns.context: 在游戏评测中，should make 引出某作品可能成为某类产品的有力竞争者。

patterns.name: 家居评论中的评价谓语
patterns.context: 评价颜色与室内环境的协调，以及某种设计特征带来的效果；与其他片段的高亮词形没有稳定对应。

en.concept: Preposition introducing inclusion or a spatial relation
en.description: Primarily responds to the prepositions “in/into” and the phrases they introduce denoting inclusion or an object of incorporation, most notably the license phrase “included in all copies” and “factor/incorporate into” constructions; there is also a penetrating use of through.

patterns.name: Fixed phrase “into”
patterns.context: A verb or expression introduces inclusion in an object; activation is concentrated on “into” and the local material following it, as in “incorporate that into our analysis”, “factor that into her record”, and “factored into”.

patterns.name: “included in all” in license text
patterns.context: Software license terms require copyright and license notices to be included in copies or substantial portions of the software; the same template recurs.

patterns.name: “in the” in a prepositional phrase
patterns.context: Generally indicates that something is located in or incorporated into a noun referent; appears in “context in the analysis”.

patterns.name: “through” meaning passing through or penetrating
patterns.context: Describes melted chocolate penetrating a marshmallow; activation falls on “through”.

patterns.name: “in your” meaning included in a personal total
patterns.context: Fitness or dietary advice reminds readers to include extra carbohydrate calories in their daily total.

6_817.concept: 介词引出的纳入或空间关系
6_817.description: 主要响应介词“in/into”及其引出的归属、纳入对象的短语，尤以许可证“included in all copies”和“factor/incorporate into”结构最突出；另有through的穿透用法。

patterns.name: 固定短语“into”
patterns.context: 动词或表述引出纳入、计入某个对象；激活集中在“into”及其后的局部，如“incorporate that into our analysis”“factor that into her record”“factored into”
patterns.domain: 技术讨论、评论、科学论文

patterns.name: 许可证文本中的“included in all”
patterns.trigger: “shall be included in all copies”及相邻的“included in”“all”
patterns.context: 软件许可证条款要求将版权与许可声明纳入副本或软件的重要部分；同一模板重复出现

patterns.name: 介词短语中的“in the”
patterns.context: 一般性地表示某事物处于或纳入某个名词对象中；出现在“context in the analysis”中

patterns.name: “through”表示穿过或渗透
patterns.context: 描述融化的巧克力穿透棉花糖；激活落在“through”

patterns.name: “in your”表示计入个人总量
patterns.context: 健身或饮食建议中，提醒将额外碳水热量计入每日总量

en.description: Activations mainly occur in two prepositional constructions: “into,” meaning to include something in consideration in technical, scientific, or commentary texts; and “in” in the license phrase “included in all copies.” They share the relation of inclusion or containment, but differ in construction and context.

patterns.name: Preposition “into” followed by an object of analysis or consideration
patterns.context: “Into” is followed by a noun or noun phrase to express including a factor in analysis, records, calculations, or consideration; in the relevant examples, “into” itself is a salient trigger.
patterns.domain: Technical discussions, medical papers, news commentary

patterns.name: “In all copies” in license text
patterns.context: Copyright or software license terms requiring copyright and license notices to appear in all copies or substantial portions of the software; often follows “shall be included.”

6_817.description: 激活主要出现在两种介词搭配中：技术、科学或评论文本里表示纳入考量的“into”；以及许可证中“included in all copies”的“in”。共同点是介词引出纳入或包含关系，但具体搭配与语境不同。

patterns.name: 介词 into 后接分析/考虑对象
patterns.trigger: “into”9；附近常见“incorporate that into our analysis”“factor(ed) into …”
patterns.context: “into”后接名词或名词短语，表达将某因素纳入分析、记录、计算或考量；在相关样例中，into 本身是显著触发点。
patterns.domain: 技术讨论、医学论文、新闻评论

patterns.name: 许可证文本中的 in all copies
patterns.context: 版权或软件许可证条款中，要求版权与许可声明出现在所有副本或软件的重要部分中；常位于“shall be included”之后。

en.concept: in introducing a range or object
en.description: Primarily responds to the preposition in, especially in “included in all copies” in licenses; also activates in “factor/incorporate into” constructions and “radiation in the system” in astrophysics, across legal, technical, discussion, and research texts.

patterns.name: Inclusion requirement in the MIT license
patterns.context: The MIT license requires the copyright and license notices to be retained when software is copied or distributed; activation is concentrated on “in” (especially “in»9/10”) and also involves the adjacent “included”, “all”, and “copies”.

patterns.name: Including something in a record or consideration
patterns.context: The preposition “into” indicates incorporating information into an object such as a record or analysis; it appears in a sentence about parole assessment and in technical analysis text.

patterns.name: Radiation in an astrophysical system
patterns.context: Describes infrared radiation in a quasar system and its source; this use of the preposition “in” differs somewhat from its use in the other passages.

6_817.concept: 介词 in 引入范围或对象
6_817.description: 主要响应介词 in，尤其许可证中“included in all copies”；另在“factor/incorporate into”结构及天体物理“radiation in the system”中激活，分布于法律、技术、讨论和论文文本。

patterns.name: MIT 许可中的包含要求
patterns.trigger: “included in all copies”及其前文“The above copyright notice and this permission notice shall be”
patterns.context: MIT 许可证要求复制或分发软件时保留版权与许可声明；激活集中在“in”（尤其“in»9/10”），并涉及相邻的“included”“all”“copies”。
patterns.domain: GitHub 代码库中的许可证文本

patterns.name: 将某事纳入记录或考量
patterns.trigger: “factor that into her record”中的“into”，以及“incorporate that into our analysis”中的“into”
patterns.context: 介词“into”表示把某信息纳入记录、分析等对象；分别出现在讨论假释评估的句子和技术分析文字中。
patterns.domain: HackerNews 讨论；StackExchange 技术问答

patterns.name: 天体系统中的辐射
patterns.trigger: “radiation in the system”，其中“in”及周边“the system”被标记
patterns.context: 描述类星体系统中的红外辐射及其来源；与其他段落中介词“in”的用法不完全相同。

en.description: Activations mainly occur on “in” in the MIT license phrase “included in all copies”; other examples include “in your calorie total” in fitness text and “into our analysis” in technical documentation, all expressing inclusion in a set or total.

patterns.name: “In” in MIT license terms
patterns.context: Copyright and license terms require notices to be included in all copies or substantial portions; activation centers on the preposition “in,” often near code comments, line breaks, and list formatting.
patterns.domain: MIT license text in GitHub source code

patterns.name: “In” in a diet plan
patterns.context: Advice for people losing weight to count extra calories from carbohydrates toward their daily calorie total; activation falls on “in,” indicating inclusion in a total.

patterns.name: “Into” in technical documentation
patterns.context: Explains that known workload can be incorporated into an analysis; the trigger is “into,” not the “in” in license terms.
patterns.domain: StackExchange technical Q&A, Simplicity/Bit Machine discussion

6_817.description: 主要激活在 MIT 许可证“included in all copies”中的 in；另见健身文本“in your calorie total”和技术说明“into our analysis”，均表示纳入某个集合或总量。

patterns.name: MIT 许可条款中的 in
patterns.trigger: «in»（位于 “shall be included in all copies” 中；部分上下文为换行后接 “* all” 或 “// included”）
patterns.context: 版权与许可声明规定必须将通知包含在所有副本或实质性部分中；激活集中于介词 in，附近常有代码注释、换行和列表格式。
patterns.domain: GitHub 源码中的 MIT 许可证文本

patterns.name: 饮食计划中的 in
patterns.context: 建议减脂者将碳水带来的额外热量计入当天总热量；激活落在表示计入某个总量的 in。

patterns.name: 技术说明中的 into
patterns.context: 说明可将已知的工作量纳入分析；触发词是 into，而非许可条款中的 in。
patterns.domain: StackExchange 技术问答，Simplicity/Bit Machine 讨论

en.description: All samples are MIT-style license text. The core trigger is the clause requiring copyright and license notices to be included in all copies, especially “included,” “in,” and “all”; line breaks and variants that include the following paragraph also accompany activation.

patterns.name: MIT license conditions text
patterns.context: In an MIT-style license, especially the “included in all copies” passage; activation centers on words such as “included,” “in,” and “all,” often spanning paragraphs or line breaks.

patterns.name: License clause formatting and line breaks
patterns.context: License terms are formatted with asterisks or comment markers; conditions and copyright notices follow after line breaks. In some samples, these formatting tokens activate alongside “included” in the text.
patterns.domain: License text in Github license comments/source code

patterns.name: Variant with an additional paragraph
patterns.context: The license notice limits or supplements “following conditions” with the next paragraph; the same notice is followed by “shall be included in all copies.”

6_817.concept: MIT许可证的副本声明条款
6_817.description: 全部样本均为 MIT 风格许可文本，核心触发于版权及许可声明须包含在所有副本中的条款，尤其 included、in、all；排版换行和包括下一段的变体也伴随激活。

patterns.name: MIT 许可条件正文
patterns.trigger: “The above copyright notice and this permission notice shall be included in all copies or substantial portions of the Software”
patterns.context: 在 MIT 风格许可证中，尤其是“included in all copies”一段；激活集中在 included、in、all 等词，且多处跨段或换行排版

patterns.name: 许可证条款格式与换行
patterns.context: 许可证条款以星号或注释符号排版，换行后进入条件和版权声明；在部分样本中这些格式 token 与正文中的 included 一同激活
patterns.domain: Github 许可证注释/源代码中的许可证文本

patterns.name: 包含附加段落的变体
patterns.context: 许可声明把“following conditions”限定或补充到下一段；同一声明后接 shall be included in all copies

en.description: The main pattern is in MIT-style licenses, responding to in in “shall be included in all copies”; isolated activations also occur in inform what in a technical discussion and in your calorie total in nutrition advice. The latter two have no clear semantic connection to the main pattern.

patterns.name: “included in” in license text
patterns.context: In the terms of an MIT-style software license, the copyright and license notices must be included in all copies or substantial portions; especially the preposition in followed by all copies.

patterns.name: what in a category-theory context
patterns.context: The sentence discusses how day-to-day work affects what people can do with category theory; activation falls on what after inform.
patterns.domain: Hacker News technical discussion, category theory and software work

patterns.name: in in a fitness nutrition context
patterns.context: Advises people losing weight to include extra carbohydrate calories consumed on exercise days in that day's total calories; activation falls on in.

6_817.description: 主要模式是在 MIT 风格许可证中，响应“shall be included in all copies”里的 in；另在技术讨论的 inform what 和营养建议的 in your calorie total 中孤立激活。后两者与主模式缺乏明确语义联系。

patterns.name: 许可证文本中的“included in”
patterns.trigger: « in»10（[1]、[2]），以及 « in»9（[3]–[8]）；紧邻 “shall be included”
patterns.context: MIT 风格软件许可证的条件条款中，说明版权与许可声明必须包含在所有副本或实质性部分中；尤其是介词 in 后接 all copies。
patterns.domain: GitHub 代码仓库中的许可证文本

patterns.name: 类别理论语境中的 what
patterns.context: 句子谈日常工作如何影响人们能用范畴论做什么；激活落在 inform 后的 what。
patterns.domain: Hacker News 技术讨论，范畴论与软件工作

patterns.name: 健身营养语境中的 in
patterns.context: 建议减脂者把运动日额外摄入的碳水热量计入当天总热量；激活落在 in。

en.description: The main peak falls on the prepositions “in/into”: in licenses, “included in all”; elsewhere, counting something in a record or including an ingredient. A few examples strongly activate “ruled,” which has a different meaning from the main pattern.

patterns.name: “Included in all” in MIT licenses
patterns.context: License terms require copyright and license notices to be included in copies or substantial portions of software; high activation centers on the phrase “included in all.”

patterns.name: Including something in a record or consideration in narratives
patterns.context: A verb is followed by “into,” introducing a result, container, or object of inclusion: counting an action in someone’s record, or choosing chocolate as an ingredient; not a license context.

patterns.name: “Ruled” in literary narration
patterns.context: “Ruled” means dominated, determined, or eliminated options; two examples involve choosing chocolate ingredients and describing a still state. The word’s meaning differs from “included/in” in licenses.

6_817.description: 主峰落在介词 in/into：许可证中是“included in all”，另见计入记录、纳入配料；少数例子则强烈激活 ruled，含义与主模式不同。

patterns.name: MIT许可证中的“included in all”
patterns.trigger: «in»10« all»；上下文通常是«The above copyright notice»…«shall be included in all copies»
patterns.context: 许可证条款中，要求将版权与许可声明包含在软件副本或实质部分中；高激活集中在短语“included in all”。

patterns.name: 叙事中表示纳入记录或考量
patterns.context: 动词后接 into 引出的结果、容器或纳入对象：将行为计入某人记录，或把巧克力选作配料；并非许可证语境。

patterns.name: 文学叙述中的 ruled
patterns.context: “ruled”表示支配、主导或排除选项；两例分别涉及选择巧克力配料和描写静止状态，词义与许可证中的 included/in 不同。

en.description: The most salient pattern is “in” in the license phrase “in all copies.” The feature also responds to “into,” “inform/informed,” and other words expressing inclusion or influence, as well as commas separating code configuration fields, across different genres.

patterns.name: “In” indicating inclusion in copies in license terms
patterns.context: Occurs in license sentences requiring copyright and license notices to be “included” or “appear” in all copies; high activation centers on the preposition “in.”
patterns.domain: Software license text in GitHub source code, especially MIT-style license terms

patterns.name: “Into” in an abstract relation
patterns.context: Indicates including a factor in a record or consideration; unrelated to license text.
patterns.domain: Hacker News comment discussing incarceration, parole, and work experience

patterns.name: “Inform” in a category-theory discussion
patterns.context: Indicates that everyday work affects or shapes what can be done; not a license context.
patterns.domain: Hacker News technical discussion involving category theory

patterns.name: Comma in code configuration
patterns.context: Occurs in multiline CMS configuration assignments, separating parameters or fields.

patterns.name: “Inform” in a personal introduction
patterns.context: Indicates that life experiences influence a person’s application choices; unlike technical or license text.
patterns.domain: Personal profile or career introduction article

6_817.description: 最显著模式是许可证条款中“in all copies”的 in；此外也响应 into、inform/informed 等表示纳入或影响的词，以及代码配置项分隔逗号，出现于不同文体。

patterns.name: 许可证条款中表示纳入副本的 in
patterns.context: 出现在许可证要求版权声明和许可声明“included”或“appear”于所有副本的句子中；高激活集中在介词 in。
patterns.domain: GitHub 源代码中的软件许可证文本，尤其是 MIT 风格许可条款

patterns.name: 抽象关系中的 into
patterns.context: 表示把某因素纳入记录或考虑之中；与许可证文本无关。
patterns.domain: Hacker News 评论，讨论监禁、假释与工作经历

patterns.name: 类别论讨论中的 inform
patterns.trigger: “inform”，如“work will inform what you can do”
patterns.context: 表示日常工作会影响或塑造可做之事；不是许可证语境。
patterns.domain: Hacker News 技术讨论，涉及范畴论

patterns.name: 代码配置中的逗号
patterns.trigger: “),”后的逗号，标记配置项之间的分隔；该逗号被标为4
patterns.context: 出现在多行 CMS 配置赋值中，分隔参数或字段。

patterns.name: 人物介绍中的 inform
patterns.context: 表示成长经历影响人物的申请选择；与技术和许可证文本不同。
patterns.domain: 人物简介或职业介绍文章

en.description: Activations center on several English function words and phrases: content following “inform,” “in all copies” in licenses, and collocations such as “makes for” and “factor into.” License samples are highly repetitive, and line-break markers also show weak activation.

patterns.name: Content complement after “inform”
patterns.context: The verb “inform” takes an object or clause specifying what it affects, communicates, or supports as an inference; activation falls on “inform.”

patterns.name: “In all” in license terms
patterns.context: Software license or copyright notices require copyright and license notices to be included in all copies; activation mainly falls on the preposition “in,” and also on the nearby “all.”
patterns.domain: GitHub code comments, software license legal text

patterns.name: “Makes” in the “make for” construction
patterns.context: Describes how a design feature gives a space a certain effect; “make for” is followed by a result or evaluation.

patterns.name: “Into” in the “factor into” construction
patterns.context: “Factor into” means to include a factor in a record or equation; strong activation is on “into.”

patterns.name: Formatting markers near line breaks
patterns.context: Some code license snippets show weak activation near line breaks and comment markers, but these occur next to the core “in all copies” construction, making an independent trigger difficult to establish.

6_817.description: 激活集中于若干英语功能词／词组：inform 后接内容，许可证固定语 in all copies，以及 makes for、factor into 等搭配；许可证样本重复度高，换行标记也有弱激活。

patterns.name: “inform”后的内容补足
patterns.context: 动词 inform 后接说明其影响、告知内容或推断依据的宾语／从句；激活落在 inform 上。
patterns.domain: 讨论、人物介绍、宗教文本分析

patterns.name: 许可证条款中的“in all”
patterns.context: 软件许可或版权声明要求将版权与许可通知包含在所有副本中；激活主要落在介词 in，也出现在紧邻的 all。
patterns.domain: GitHub 代码注释、软件许可证法律文本

patterns.name: “make for”结构中的 makes
patterns.context: 描述某设计特征使空间呈现某种效果，make for 后接结果或评价。

patterns.name: “factor into”结构中的 into
patterns.trigger: «factor» into« her» record；«factor» into« the» equation
patterns.context: factor into 表示把某项因素纳入记录或方程考量；强激活在 into。

patterns.name: 换行附近的格式标记
patterns.context: 部分代码许可证片段在换行、注释标记附近有弱激活，但与核心 in all copies 结构相邻，难以确认独立触发。

en.description: Strongly responds mainly to in in the fixed license phrase included in all; it also responds strongly to factor into, meaning including something in an assessment, and worth in worth it. The former recurs across licenses, while the latter two occur in only a few contexts each.

patterns.name: in in an MIT license
patterns.context: Appears in the fixed license clause “shall be included in all copies or substantial portions of the Software”; activation is concentrated on the preposition in. It also occurs across different line breaks and comment formats of the same clause.
patterns.domain: MIT-style license text in GitHub repositories

patterns.name: Including something in an assessment
patterns.context: into is followed by an assessment, record, or calculation framework, expressing the inclusion of something in consideration; the two examples concern parole assessment and a trader's pricing judgment.
patterns.domain: HackerNews comments; Pile-CC text about trading and property assessment

patterns.name: worth it construction
patterns.context: worth is followed by it, evaluating whether an experience or effort was worthwhile; the surrounding context reflects on stress and time investment.

6_817.description: 主要对许可证固定句式中 included in all 的 in 强烈响应；另对表示纳入评估的 factor into，以及 worth it 中的 worth 有较强响应。前者跨许可证复现，后两者各仅见少数语境。

patterns.name: MIT 许可证中的 in
patterns.trigger: «in»10 all copies or substantial portions of the Software
patterns.context: 出现在“shall be included in all copies or substantial portions of the Software”这一固定许可条款中，激活集中于介词 in；同一条款的不同换行及注释格式均出现。
patterns.domain: GitHub 代码仓库中的 MIT 风格许可证文本

patterns.name: 将某事计入某项评估
patterns.context: into 后接评估、记录或计算框架，表达把某事纳入考虑；两例分别涉及假释评估与交易者的定价判断。
patterns.domain: HackerNews 评论；Pile-CC 关于交易和房产评估的文字

patterns.name: worth it 结构
patterns.context: worth 后接 it，评价一段经历或付出是否值得；周围语境是在反思压力和时间投入。

en.description: Strong activations center on relational words in several common collocations or templates: “in all copies” in licenses, “into” for including something in a calculation or record, and expressions such as “a long way.” Other examples involve influencing choices and an individual overshadowing a group.

patterns.name: “In all” in fixed license wording
patterns.context: Software licenses or copyright notices require copyright and license notices to be included with software copies; nearly identical template sentences occur repeatedly.

patterns.name: “Into” introducing a calculation or consideration
patterns.context: Discusses factors such as costs that should be included in a calculation; strong activation falls on “into,” accompanied by the definite article “the.”

patterns.name: Fixed expression “go a long way”
patterns.context: “Long way” indicates providing substantial help or having a significant effect; it sometimes occurs in “in improving” and sometimes in “toward showing.”

patterns.name: Including something in an evaluation record
patterns.context: Including a person’s experience or participation in a record for later parole review or consideration of early release.

patterns.name: Life experiences influencing choices
patterns.context: Experiences or interests while growing up influence later choices; strong activation falls on “informed.”

patterns.name: An individual overshadowing a group
patterns.context: A person’s individuality is described as overshadowing or dominating the group they lead.

6_817.description: 强激活集中于若干常见搭配或模板中的关系词：许可证里的“in all copies”、纳入计算或记录的“into”，以及“a long way”等表达；另见影响选择和个性盖过团体。

patterns.name: 固定许可证措辞中的 in all
patterns.context: 软件许可或版权声明要求版权及许可通知随软件副本一并包含；多处出现几乎相同的模板句。

patterns.name: 介词 in 引出计算或考量
patterns.context: 讨论成本等因素应被纳入计算；强激活落在 into，并伴随定冠词 the。
patterns.domain: 专利背景技术或成本分析

patterns.name: go a long way 固定表达
patterns.context: long way 表示产生显著帮助或影响；有时接 in improving，有时接 toward showing。
patterns.domain: 评论写作建议、法律论证

patterns.name: 记录纳入某项评估
patterns.context: 把某人的经历或参与情况纳入记录，以供后续假释审查或提前释放考虑。
patterns.domain: 新闻评论或叙事性文本

patterns.name: 成长经历影响选择
patterns.context: 成长期间的经历或兴趣影响后来作出的选择；强激活落在 informed。

patterns.name: 群体遮蔽个体
patterns.context: 人物个性被描述为盖过或压过其所领导的团体。

en.concept: Multiple local lexical and contextual triggers
en.description: The activation pattern is distributed: license text highlights “in/include”; “inform” often indicates that information or experiences influence understanding, judgment, and choices; other examples include counting costs, the argumentative use of “make,” the dot in a C struct, and descriptions of wood properties.

patterns.name: Preposition “in” (license text)
patterns.context: In copyright license terms, describing copyright and license notices that must be included in copies or substantial portions of the software; nearby text often contains “shall be included in all copies.”

patterns.name: “Inform” and information influencing judgment
patterns.context: Indicates that an action, evidence, or experience affects understanding, inference, or choice; in [3] it concerns scriptural interpretation, in [7] personal experience influencing an application choice, and in [9] everyday work affecting what can be done.

patterns.name: “Make” in a causative or negative judgment
patterns.context: Rebuts the claim that mental illness makes hate speech justifiable; activation falls on “make” and nearby negation and possessive pronouns.

patterns.name: Struct member access symbol
patterns.context: In C struct initialization, a dot introduces a designated member, followed by an assignment and a function name.

patterns.name: “Into” in cost calculation
patterns.context: Explains that factors such as energy may need to be included in total cost calculations.

patterns.name: Wood and its treatment properties
patterns.context: Explains that wood absorbs liquids and harbors bacteria, making it difficult to clean or disinfect.

6_817.concept: 多种局部词法与语境触发
6_817.description: 激活模式分散：许可文本中突出 in/include；多处 inform 表示信息或经历影响理解、判断与选择；另见成本计入、make 的论证用法、C 结构体点号，以及木材特性描述。

patterns.name: 介词 in（许可文本）
patterns.context: 版权许可条款中，描述版权与许可声明必须包含在副本或软件实质部分中；相邻上下文常见 “shall be included in all copies”。

patterns.name: inform 及信息影响判断
patterns.context: 表示某种行为、证据或经历将影响理解、推断或选择；在 [3] 中为经文解释，在 [7] 中为个人经历影响申请选择，在 [9] 中为日常工作影响可做之事。

patterns.name: 使役或否定判断中的 make
patterns.context: 反驳“精神疾病使仇恨言论正当”的说法；激活落在 make 及其附近的否定和所有格代词上。

patterns.name: 结构体成员访问符号
patterns.context: C 语言结构体初始化中，点号引出指定成员，后接赋值与函数名。

patterns.name: 成本计算中的 into
patterns.context: 说明能源等因素可能需要计入总成本计算。
patterns.domain: 专利背景技术、成本管理

patterns.name: 木材及其处理特性
patterns.context: 说明木材吸收液体、滋生细菌，因而难以清洁或消毒。
patterns.domain: 专利背景技术、动物运输箱

en.description: Activations mainly center on prepositions such as “into” and “in”: the former occurs in “factored into,” which means including factors in consideration; the latter occurs in license requirements for content to be “included in” copies. There are also two examples of “inform/informed.”

patterns.name: “Factored into” construction
patterns.context: The preceding text introduces a factor, cost, or background, and the following text explains that it should be included in a record, calculation, or judgment; [2] uses the participial variant “factored into.”
patterns.domain: News commentary, scientific papers, patent background, sports commentary; covers [1][2][5][6]

patterns.name: “Included in” in license terms
patterns.context: Copyright license text stipulates that copyright and license notices must be included in copies or substantial portions of the software, often directly after “shall be” and before “all copies”;
patterns.domain: Github software license legal text; covers [3][8][9][10]

patterns.name: “Inform” in “inform us”
patterns.context: In discussions of scriptural or textual interpretation, a passage or example helps explain another passage;

patterns.name: “Informed”
patterns.context: Describes literary interests influencing someone’s choices; related in form to the “inform” in [7], but used with a different meaning;

6_817.concept: 介词 in/into 及相关结构
