6_817.description: 激活主要集中于“into”和“in”这类介词：前者出现在将因素纳入考量的“factored into”结构，后者出现在许可证要求内容“included in”副本的结构；另有 inform/informed 两例。

patterns.name: “factored into”结构
patterns.context: 前文提出某种因素、成本或背景，后文说明要将其纳入记录、计算或判断；[2]中为分词变体“factored into”。
patterns.domain: 新闻评论、科学论文、专利背景、体育评论；覆盖 [1][2][5][6]

patterns.name: 许可证条款中的“included in”
patterns.context: 版权许可文本规定版权声明和许可声明必须包含在副本或软件的重要部分中，常紧接“shall be”及“all copies”；
patterns.domain: Github 软件许可证法律文本；覆盖 [3][8][9][10]

patterns.name: “inform us”中的 inform
patterns.context: 关于经文或文本解释的论述中，某一段落或例子将帮助说明另一段落；
patterns.domain: StackExchange 宗教／经文讨论；覆盖 [7]

patterns.name: “informed”中的 informed
patterns.context: 描述文学兴趣影响某人的选择；与 [7] 的 inform 词形相关，但语义用法不同；
patterns.domain: 人物简介／设计行业文章；覆盖 [4]

en.concept: Inclusion or influence on subsequent judgment
en.description: One set of excerpts activates on “factored into”, meaning to include a factor in consideration; another set of license clauses activates on “included in”, meaning content is contained in a copy. Two other examples activate on the influence or explanatory sense of inform(ed).

patterns.name: “factored into” phrase
patterns.context: Means taking a factor into consideration, a calculation, record, or assessment; activation falls on into, often near objects such as calculation, equation, or record.
patterns.domain: Academic writing, cost analysis, forum discussions

patterns.name: “included in” in license text
patterns.context: Software license terms stipulate that copyright and license notices must be included in copies; it recurs in similar MIT-style license texts.

patterns.name: “informed” in a person's experience
patterns.context: Describes how a person's background or interests influenced a choice; activation falls on informed.

patterns.name: “inform us” in scriptural interpretation
patterns.context: Uses correspondences in one passage of scripture to help interpret another; activation falls on inform.

6_817.description: 一组片段在“factored into”中激活，表示将因素纳入考虑；另一组许可证条款在“included in”中激活，表示内容包含于副本。另有两例在 inform(ed) 的影响或说明义中激活。

patterns.name: “factored into”短语
patterns.context: 表示把某因素纳入考虑、计算、记录或评估；激活落在 into 上，邻近宾语常为 calculation、equation、record 等
patterns.domain: 学术写作、成本分析、论坛讨论

patterns.name: 许可证文本中的“included in”
patterns.trigger: «included» in«（常见完整片段“shall be included in all copies”）
patterns.context: 软件许可证条款规定版权和许可声明须包含在副本中；重复出现于相近的 MIT 风格许可文本
patterns.domain: Github 软件许可证法律文本

patterns.name: 人物经历中的“informed”
patterns.context: 描述成长经历或兴趣影响某项选择，激活位于 informed

patterns.name: 经文释义中的“inform us”
patterns.context: 以一段经文的对应关系帮助解释另一段经文；激活落在 inform

en.description: Mainly responds to expressions for including factors in a record, calculation, or analysis, especially “factor(ed) into the”; weaker sporadic responses also occur to “included in all” in licenses, the code member-access dot, and a “worth it” context.

patterns.name: Including in consideration
patterns.context: A factor, cost, data point, or condition is included in a record, calculation, equation, or analysis; “into” is often followed by “the,” but may also be followed by a noun
patterns.domain: General discussion, research, business, sports commentary; paragraphs 1, 2, 3, 5, 9, 10

patterns.name: Inclusion in license terms
patterns.context: Software licenses require copyright and license notices to be included in software copies; activation centers near “in all”

patterns.name: Struct member access symbol
patterns.context: In C struct initialization, a dot introduces a member name, followed by an assignment

patterns.name: Age and worth-it expression
patterns.context: Reflects on stress and free time during youth, asking whether the effort was worth it

6_817.description: 主要响应把因素纳入记录、计算或分析的表达，尤其是“factor(ed) into the”；另对许可证中“included in all”、代码成员点号及“worth it”语境有较弱的零散响应。

patterns.name: 纳入考量
patterns.trigger: “factored into the”“factor into the equation”“taking ... into consideration”
patterns.context: 某因素、成本、数据或条件被纳入记录、计算、方程或分析；“into”后常接“the”，也可接名词
patterns.domain: 一般论述、科研、商业、体育评论；段1、2、3、5、9、10

patterns.name: 许可证条款中的纳入
patterns.context: 软件许可证要求版权与许可声明包含在软件副本中，激活集中在“in all”附近
patterns.domain: 开源软件许可证文本；段4、8

patterns.name: 结构体成员访问符号
patterns.context: C 语言结构体初始化中，点号引出成员名，后接赋值

patterns.name: 年龄与值得性表达
patterns.context: 回顾年轻时期的压力与空闲时间，询问付出是否值得

en.concept: Predictive words in common English collocations
en.description: Activation is concentrated in several common collocation positions: elements following factor(ed) into, the license boilerplate included in all, worth it, and aid in. Some passages share local word order, while others appear to be sporadic collocational triggers.

patterns.name: “into the” sequence
patterns.context: Strong activation falls on the after into, or on a word immediately following into; [3] has a similar over + shadow + the sequence.
patterns.domain: Reviews, cost analysis, academic papers, and news reports

patterns.name: included in all in licenses
patterns.context: In software license terms, copyright notices and license notices must be included in copies; activation is concentrated on in, near all.

patterns.name: Whether youthful experiences are worth it
patterns.context: After “all the stress and lack of free time during ages 18-22”, asks whether these costs were worthwhile.

patterns.name: aid in construction
patterns.context: Research findings will help identify therapeutic targets; strong activation is on aid, followed by in + a gerund.

6_817.concept: 常见英语搭配中的预测词
6_817.description: 激活集中在若干常见搭配位置：factor(ed) into 后的成分、许可证套语 included in all、worth it，以及 aid in。部分段落共享局部词序，其余更像分散的搭配触发。

patterns.name: “into the”序列
patterns.trigger: [1] “factor that« into»10« her»1 record”；[4] “factored»2« into»8« the»5« calculation”；[5] “factor« into»8« the»4« equation”；[6] “factored»4« into»8«”；以及 [3] “personalities« over»2«shadow»8« the”
patterns.context: 较强激活落在 into 后的 the，或在 into 后紧邻的词；[3] 是相近的 over + shadow + the 序列。
patterns.domain: 评论、成本分析、学术论文及新闻报道

patterns.name: 许可证中的 included in all
patterns.trigger: “« included»3« in»9« all”[2]；“« included»2« in»8« all”[8]；“« included»2« in»8«↵…« *»4« all”[9]
patterns.context: 软件许可证条款中，版权声明与许可声明须包含在副本中；激活集中在 in，邻近 all。
patterns.domain: Github 软件许可证法律文本

patterns.name: 年少经历是否值得
patterns.context: “all the stress and lack of free time during ages 18-22”之后，询问这些代价是否值得。

patterns.name: aid in 结构
patterns.context: 研究成果将帮助识别治疗靶点；强激活在 aid，后接 in + 动名词。
patterns.domain: NIH 生物医学研究摘要

en.description: Activations concentrate on subword fragments of Savannah, successful, code import syntax, and a few proper names/identifiers and mathematical sequence fragments; these triggers are scattered and cannot be explained by a single semantic pattern.

patterns.name: Subword fragments of the place name Savannah
patterns.context: When Savannah is split into tokens such as Sav and anna(h), the later fragment anna(h) activates noticeably; g'th in [6] also activates strongly, but is only a local match
patterns.domain: Biographies, ecology, legal documents, instrument making; also math problems

patterns.name: Words related to success
patterns.context: successful activates strongly when describing treatment management outcomes or reproducing experimental results; in [8], it is also adjacent to only

patterns.name: Code import syntax
patterns.context: In Python import statements, import and from occur together; [1] also contains the module path common/notify

patterns.name: Proper names and intraword segmentation
patterns.context: Names or identifiers consist of multiple subword tokens, with activations distributed over proper names, module names, or their internal fragments; this superficially resembles the Savannah segmentation pattern, but the triggering content differs

patterns.name: Incomplete mathematical sequences and symbol patterns
patterns.context: In mathematical text containing lists of negative numbers, powers or recurrence formulas, and questions about the g'th term, several number and variable fragments activate, with no single stable trigger

6_836.description: 激活集中在 Savannah 的分词片段、successful、代码导入语法，以及少量专名/标识符和数学数列片段；这些触发分散，不能用单一语义模式解释。

patterns.name: Savannah 地名的分词片段
patterns.context: Savannah 被拆分为 Sav 与 anna(h) 等 token 时，后续片段 anna(h) 明显激活；[6] 的 g'th 也有较强激活，但只是局部吻合
patterns.domain: 人物简介、生态学、法律文书、乐器制造；另有数学题

patterns.name: 成功相关词
patterns.context: 在描述治疗管理结果或复现实验结果时，successful 受到强激活；[8]还紧邻 only

patterns.name: 代码导入语法
patterns.context: Python 导入语句中，import 和 from 一起出现；[1]还包含模块路径 common/notify

patterns.name: 专名及词内切分
patterns.context: 人名或标识符由多个子词 token 组成，激活分布在专名、模块名或其内部片段上；与 Savannah 分词现象有表面相似，但触发内容不一致
patterns.domain: 维基百科人物条目、代码

patterns.name: 残缺数学序列与符号模式
patterns.context: 负数列表、幂或递推式以及询问第 g'th 项的数学文本中，若干数字和变量片段激活，未见单一稳定触发项

en.description: Activations occur on the Savannah substring, code import syntax, successful, Gregory, rail in names/species, and the mathematical symbol g; these triggers span semantic domains and are difficult to explain with a single topic.

patterns.name: Savannah substring
patterns.context: Activation falls on the latter part of the place name Savannah, where it appears as a city name.
patterns.domain: Biographical profiles, legal documents, encyclopedia entries

patterns.name: Code import statements
patterns.context: In JavaScript import statements, between import and from or near the module path.

patterns.name: successful
patterns.context: Appears in contexts describing management outcomes or replication results.

patterns.name: Gregory in names
patterns.context: Appears as part of a person's name, at the beginning of an entry and in later references.

patterns.name: g in mathematical expressions
patterns.context: The letter g recurs as a variable or function symbol in sequences or recurrence expressions.

patterns.name: Tokenized rail
patterns.context: In natural history descriptions, appears in the bird name black rail; activation is concentrated on the rail substring.

6_836.description: 激活分布于 Savannah 的子串、代码导入语法、successful、Gregory、人名/物种中的 rail，以及数学符号 g；这些触发条件跨语义领域，难以由单一主题解释。

patterns.name: 子串 Savannah
patterns.context: 激活落在地名 Savannah 的后半部分；在文本中作为城市名出现。
patterns.domain: 人物简介、法律文书、百科条目

patterns.name: 代码导入语句
patterns.context: JavaScript 导入语句中，import 与 from 之间或模块路径附近。

patterns.name: successful
patterns.context: 出现在描述管理结果或复现结果的语境中。

patterns.name: 人名中的 Gregory
patterns.context: 作为人物姓名的一部分，出现在条目开头及后续重述中。

patterns.name: 数学表达式中的 g
patterns.context: 数列或递推表达式中，字母 g 作为变量或函数符号反复出现。

patterns.name: 被拆分标记的 rail
patterns.context: 自然史描述中，出现在鸟类名称 black rail 内；激活集中于 rail 子串。
patterns.domain: 百科自然地理/生态文本

en.concept: Savannah subword and sporadic word forms
en.description: The most stable trigger is the «annah» subword in Savannah, appearing across multiple genres; other activations include successful, several split names, ecological terms, date fragments, and sporadic structural tokens in code, with no single consistent semantics.

patterns.name: Savannah word form and tokenization
patterns.context: In the place name Savannah, activation is concentrated on the split final fragment «annah»; it occurs in different syntactic positions, and prefixes are sometimes also marked as split.
patterns.domain: Multiple genres, including biographical profiles, ecological geography, legal documents, musician biographies, and historical battles

patterns.name: successful and derived forms
patterns.context: The word form successful is strongly activated when describing successful treatment management or experimental replication; paragraph 1 also marks the preceding “successful management”.

patterns.name: Code punctuation and structural tokens
patterns.context: In code, activation falls on path separators, import statements, and syntax fragments such as array declarations and methods; trigger points vary across passages.
patterns.domain: GitHub code and StackExchange programming Q&A

patterns.name: Split fragments in names
patterns.context: Several fragments activate when names are tokenized into multiple subwords; not all name fragments are equally strong, and these examples do not fully match the Savannah pattern.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedia biographical entries and personal profiles

patterns.name: Place names and ecological vocabulary
patterns.context: When describing California upland ecosystems and vegetation types, subword fragments of several ecological or geographical terms show weak to moderate activation; Savannah fragments also match the main place-name pattern.

patterns.name: Date fragments in battle timelines
patterns.context: In chronologically ordered battle names and dates, months, numbers, and hyphens activate, but weakly and without a clearly consistent specific token.

6_836.description: 最稳定的触发是地名 Savannah 中的 «annah» 子词，跨多种文体出现；另有 successful、若干拆分人名、生态词和日期片段，以及代码中的零散结构 token 激活，未见单一一致语义。

patterns.name: Savannah 的词形与分词
patterns.context: 在地名 Savannah 中，激活集中于被拆分的词尾片段 «annah»；出现于不同句法位置，前缀有时也被拆分标记。
patterns.domain: 人物简介、生态地理、法律文件、音乐家传记、历史战役等多种文体

patterns.name: 成功一词及其派生形式
patterns.context: 在描述治疗管理成功或实验室复现成功时，词形 successful 被强烈激活；第1段还标记了前面的 “successful management”。

patterns.name: 代码标点与结构 token
patterns.context: 在代码中，激活落在路径分隔符、导入语句及数组声明、方法等语法片段上；各段触发点并不完全相同。
patterns.domain: GitHub 代码与 StackExchange 编程问答

patterns.name: 人名中的拆分片段
patterns.context: 人名被分词为多个子词时有若干片段激活；但并非所有人名片段都同等强，且这些例子与 Savannah 模式不完全一致。
patterns.domain: 百科人物条目与个人简介

patterns.name: 地名与生态环境词汇
patterns.context: 描述加州高地生态系统及植被类型时，多个生态或地理词汇的子词片段出现弱至中等激活；其中 Savannah 片段也符合主地名模式。

patterns.name: 战役年表中的日期片段
patterns.context: 在按时间排列的战役名称与日期中，月份、数字和连接号有激活，但强度较弱且没有明显统一的具体 token。

en.concept: Mixed response to intraword fragments and domain templates
en.description: Activations occur on fragments such as successful in research texts, NIH proposal boilerplate and immunology vocabulary, clinical terminology, Java lifecycle code, and internal fragments of names and module paths; the cross-domain common trigger is unclear.

patterns.name: English suffix or fragment “ful”
patterns.context: Activations are scattered within complete words or across word fragments and do not necessarily occur at word onset; strong examples include successful and fundamentally, with invaluable also present.

patterns.name: Android Java lifecycle code
patterns.context: Near the onCreate method, Bundle parameters, and member fields in Java/Android classes; activations fall on common code identifier fragments.

patterns.name: Internal fragments in names
patterns.context: Internal subword fragments of names activate in names or related addresses/signatures; found in biographies and lists of parties/lawyers in legal documents.

patterns.name: Path and module identifier fragments
patterns.context: Activations occur near module path separators in code import statements, and also across path components.

patterns.name: Research proposal and abstract boilerplate
patterns.context: Formal statements in project abstracts describing proposals, renewals, ongoing research, or research directions.

patterns.name: Medical immunology terminology
patterns.context: Accounts of bone marrow transplantation, immune function, and host-versus-graft reactions; occurs alongside successful in research abstracts.

patterns.name: Diabetic ketoacidosis case report
patterns.context: Describes insulin infusion and intraosseous access in a case of diabetic ketoacidosis in a child.

patterns.name: General syntactic and common code words
patterns.context: Highly activated words are scattered across research prose and source code; these fragments alone do not establish a common semantic trigger.

6_836.concept: 词内片段与领域模板的混合响应
6_836.description: 激活分布于科研文本中的 successful 等词片段、NIH 提案套语与免疫学词汇、临床术语、Java 生命周期代码，以及人名和模块路径内部片段；跨领域的共同触发条件不明确。

patterns.name: 英文后缀或片段“ful”
patterns.context: 激活散布在完整词内部或跨词片段上，未必对应词首；样本中强例包括 successful 和 fundamentally，另有 invaluable。
patterns.domain: 医学摘要、NIH 项目摘要

patterns.name: Android Java 生命周期代码
patterns.context: Java/Android 类中 onCreate 方法、Bundle 参数及成员字段附近；激活落在常见代码标识符片段上。

patterns.name: 人名中的内部片段
patterns.context: 姓名或姓名相关地址／署名中，姓名内部子词片段被激活；出现于人物条目和法律文件当事人／律师名单。
patterns.domain: Wikipedia 人物条目、法律文本

patterns.name: 路径与模块标识符片段
patterns.context: 代码 import 语句的模块路径分隔符附近，路径各部分也有激活。

patterns.name: 科研提案与摘要套语
patterns.context: 项目摘要中描述提案、续期、持续研究或研究方向的正式陈述。

patterns.name: 医学免疫学术语
patterns.context: 骨髓移植、免疫功能及宿主抗移植物反应的叙述；与科研摘要中的 successful 同时出现。
patterns.domain: NIH 生物医学项目摘要

patterns.name: 糖尿病酮症酸中毒病例报告
patterns.context: 描述胰岛素输注及骨内针用于儿童糖尿病酮症酸中毒病例。

patterns.name: 泛化的句法与代码常见词
patterns.context: 高激活词分散在科研散文和源码中，无法仅凭这些片段确定共同语义触发条件。

en.description: Activations occur in code imports, entries for names containing Jack, botanical taxonomic names, and NIH funding and research proposal texts; the trigger forms differ substantially, with no shared local semantic or syntactic feature.

patterns.name: notify import in code
patterns.context: Python-style import statement with common/notify in the path, followed by a newline and variable assignment

patterns.name: Jack in name entries
patterns.context: A name appears as an entry title or at the start of a sentence, followed by a newline and another name/entry; also appears in an abstract sentence

patterns.name: Botanical name fragments
patterns.context: A binomial nomenclature entry title, with the name split into tokens

patterns.name: NIH funding information
patterns.context: Research funding acknowledgments or grant descriptions, followed by NIH, a grant number, and a project name

patterns.name: NIH project proposals and research descriptions
patterns.context: Formal statements in project proposals/abstracts about research objectives, project continuation, or responses to funding announcements

6_836.description: 激活分布于代码导入、含 Jack 的人名条目、植物分类名，以及 NIH 资助与研究提案文本；各类触发形式差异明显，未见统一的局部语义或句法特征。

patterns.name: 代码中的 notify 导入
patterns.context: Python 风格的导入语句，路径中含 common/notify，后接换行及变量赋值

patterns.name: 姓名条目中的 Jack
patterns.context: 姓名作为条目标题或句首，后接换行和另一姓名/条目内容；也见于论文摘要句中
patterns.domain: Wikipedia 人物条目、PubMed 摘要

patterns.name: 植物学名称片段
patterns.context: 植物学双名法条目标题，名称被分词切开

patterns.name: NIH 资助信息
patterns.context: 研究资助致谢或资助项目描述，后接 NIH、资助编号及项目名称

patterns.name: NIH 项目提案与研究描述
patterns.trigger: «is» a continuation of our ongoing studies；«is» a response to Notice Number；«well»-«character»ized model system
patterns.context: 项目提案/摘要中的研究目标、项目延续或对资助公告的响应等正式表述

en.concept: Cross-domain text fragments and format sensitivity
en.description: Activations are cross-domain and scattered across intraword segments, proper names and terms, numbered labels, and ordinary sentence words; some passages also show local structures such as announcements, ratings, research results, parliamentary evaluations, or web news, with no stable unified semantic trigger.

patterns.name: Activations at token or marker boundaries
patterns.context: Activations often fall on segmented word fragments, and also occur on substrings within words or next to punctuation and spaces; there is no single fixed lexical or syntactic condition.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain; NIH administrative texts, financial lists, emails, webpages, and papers

patterns.name: Formatted proper names, numbers, and project labels
patterns.context: Occurs in structured strings such as announcement numbers, dates, grant project titles, or administrative headings.
patterns.domain: NIH announcements, financial research lists, NIH project directories

patterns.name: Rating or evaluation language
patterns.context: Brief entries describing financial institutions’ stock ratings or coverage; rating words and segmented word fragments are prominent.

patterns.name: Intraword fragments in proper names and technical terms
patterns.context: When long or compound proper names and terms are split into multiple tokens, their fragments activate; this is not limited to a particular language or field.
patterns.domain: Swedish parliamentary texts, condensed matter physics papers

patterns.name: Ordinary words and phrases in cross-line prose
patterns.context: In ordinary sentence narratives, activations are distributed across function words, common words, and intraword fragments, with inconsistent local topic conditions.

patterns.name: Reporting results in research abstracts
patterns.context: Medical abstracts describe interventions and outcomes, with activations on relational and outcome words; the passage is densely packed with scientific terminology.

patterns.name: Webpage remnants and reporting language in news
patterns.context: Web-scraped text contains URLs and HTML/XML remnants, followed by news article text; some words in both the markers and body activate.

patterns.name: Conventional phrasing in administrative announcements
patterns.context: Opening response/publication phrasing in announcements; the organization name and subsequent publication action activate strongly.

patterns.name: Research objective phrasing
patterns.context: Project descriptions use goal is to to introduce research objectives or methods.

patterns.name: Swedish parliamentary evaluations and time expressions
patterns.context: Parliamentary speech looks back at the state a project should have been in the past and evaluates it against the current year.

patterns.name: Molecular and immunological terms in scientific text
patterns.context: Specialized medical content on corneal angiogenesis, inhibitors, and transplant survival.

patterns.name: Biomedical project names and committee labels
patterns.context: Project titles are followed by administrative headings such as research core, services, and committees.

patterns.name: Topological quantum computing terminology
patterns.context: Physics papers describe topological superconducting islands, Majorana modes, and qubit operations.

patterns.name: Presidential inauguration narrative in web news
patterns.context: The news article reports a president being sworn into office and mentions the speech; occurs alongside page-scraping markers.

6_836.concept: 跨域文本片段与格式敏感
6_836.description: 激活跨领域且分散于词内切分片段、专名术语、编号标签及普通句词；部分段落还呈现公告、评级、科研结果、议会评价或网页新闻等各自局部结构，未见稳定统一语义触发条件。

patterns.name: 分词或标记边界处激活
patterns.trigger: 分词内部或相邻片段，如 «Ann»5«ounces»7、«char»9«ized»6、«Att»7«ractive»4、«pharm»5«aceuticals»5、«MP»8«3»7、«Vi»9«rology»4、«Q»7«ub»4«it»9
patterns.context: 激活常落在被切分的词片段上，也见于词内子串或词与标点、空格相邻处；没有单一固定词汇或句法条件。
patterns.domain: 跨领域；NIH 行政文本、金融列表、邮件、网页、论文均有

patterns.name: 格式化专名、编号与项目标签
patterns.context: 出现在公告编号、日期、基金项目标题或行政栏目等结构化字符串中。
patterns.domain: NIH公告、金融研究列表、NIH项目目录

patterns.name: 等级或评估措辞
patterns.trigger: «Up»3«graded»7« to»4« Buy»6、«Up»3«graded»7« to»4« Strong»3« Buy»6、«Cover»4«age»3« Init»3«iated»3« at»3« Buy»6
patterns.context: 金融机构对股票评级或覆盖情况的简短条目；评级词及拆分词段显著。

patterns.name: 专名与专业术语中的词内片段
patterns.context: 较长或复合专名、术语被切成多个 token 时，片段获得激活；并不限于某种语言或专业领域。
patterns.domain: 瑞典语议会文本、凝聚态物理论文

patterns.name: 跨行散文中的普通词及词组
patterns.trigger: «When»6« you»8« download»9« MP»8«3»7« files»6« you»7« should»6« download»9；«previous»2« job»4« I»3« did»7« consulting»3；«these»7« companies»5
patterns.context: 普通句子叙述中，激活分布在功能词、常见词和词内切分片段，局部主题条件不一致。

patterns.name: 科研摘要中的结果表述
patterns.trigger: «is»5« blocked»4« by»6« VEGFR-tyrosine kinase inhibitor… «resulting»5« in»4« improved»6« graft»4« survival»9
patterns.context: 医学摘要陈述干预及结果时，激活落在关系词和结果词上；该段整体科学术语密集。

patterns.name: 新闻网页残留标记与报道用语
patterns.context: 网页抓取文本含 URL、HTML/XML 残留标记，随后接新闻报道正文；标记和正文中的部分词均激活。

patterns.name: 行政公告中的惯用句式
patterns.trigger: «This»3« is»6« a»5« response»6« to»5…« NIH»10« Announces»7« the»1« Availability»5
patterns.context: 公告开头的回应/发布句式，机构名称及其后发布动作较强。

patterns.name: 研究目标句式
patterns.trigger: «project»5«'s»4« goal»2« is»7« to»5« use»6…« define»5« processes»2
patterns.context: 项目说明中以 goal is to 引出研究目标或方法。

patterns.name: 瑞典语议会评价与时间表达
patterns.context: 议会发言中回顾某项目过去应有的状态，并对照当前年份作评价。

patterns.name: 科学文本中的分子与免疫术语
patterns.context: 角膜血管生成、抑制剂及移植存活等专业医学内容。

patterns.name: 生物医学项目名与委员会标签
patterns.context: 项目标题后接研究核心、服务及委员会等行政栏目。

patterns.name: 拓扑量子计算术语
patterns.context: 物理学论文描述拓扑超导岛、Majorana模式及量子比特操作。

patterns.name: 网页报道中总统就职叙述
patterns.trigger: «Donald»7« Trump»4« was»5« officially»4« sworn»5« in»4…«President»…«taking»9« the»4« oath»4
patterns.context: 新闻正文报道总统宣誓就职并提及其讲话；与页面抓取标记共现。

en.concept: Recency and the Vi character fragment
en.description: The most stable pattern is the recent-time use of recently, found in multiple types of academic narratives and biographies; in two other passages, the initial Vi fragment activates in Viña and Virology. The pattern spans all passages, but the semantic relationship between the Vi fragment and recently is unclear.

patterns.name: Temporal marker recently
patterns.context: Occurs in sentences describing recent discoveries, proposals, studies, implementations, or reports; the form and meaning are generally stable, often with passive voice or academic verbs nearby, but also appears in biographies.
patterns.domain: Primarily academic papers, also encyclopedia biographies; covers passages [1]–[8], [10]

patterns.name: Token fragment of Viña
patterns.context: Embedded in the place name “Viña del Mar”, followed by the unmarked remainder “ña”; no clear semantic connection to recently in other passages.

patterns.name: Intraword fragment in Virology
patterns.context: Occurs in the institution name “The Virology Laboratory”, followed by the unmarked remainder “rology”; part of a specialized laboratory name.

6_836.concept: 近期性及 Vi 字符片段
6_836.description: 最稳定模式是 recently 的新近时间用法，见于多类学术叙述及人物简介；另两段在 Viña、Virology 的词首 Vi 片段激活。模式覆盖全部段，但 Vi 片段与 recently 的语义关系不明。

patterns.name: recently 的时间标记
patterns.context: 出现在描述新近发现、提出、研究、实现或报道的句子中；词形与词义基本稳定，周围常有被动语态或学术动词，但也见于人物介绍。
patterns.domain: 以学术论文为主，也包括百科人物介绍；覆盖段 [1]–[8]、[10]

patterns.name: Viña 的分词片段
patterns.context: 嵌在地名“Viña del Mar”中，紧接着的未标记部分为“ña”；与其他段落中的 recently 无明显语义联系。
patterns.domain: Pile-CC 的活动报道或介绍文本

patterns.name: Virology 的词内片段
patterns.context: 出现在机构名称“The Virology Laboratory”中，后续未标记部分为“rology”；属于专业实验室名称。
patterns.domain: PubMed Central 的生物医学方法描述

en.description: Activations mainly fall on several complete words or intraword substrings: character and Exhaustion in legal contexts, hol and kick in violence narratives, as well as proper/common words such as Go and medical fragments such as nex and rect. They span domains and lack consistent semantics.

patterns.name: character substring in characterize
patterns.context: Used with mis- to mean misdescribing or distorting; activation concentrates on the segmented character substring

patterns.name: hol in hol-lering
patterns.context: A witness hears shouting in a violent incident narrative; strong activation falls on the initial substring

patterns.name: Go substring in a proper name
patterns.context: Lists the names of boats seized in an immigration enforcement case

patterns.name: nex medical terminology substring
patterns.context: Medical records are juxtaposed with legal causation standards; the term occurs in “loose nexus”

patterns.name: Dolma name substring
patterns.context: Describes a singer’s vocal training and mentor

patterns.name: Go song-title substring
patterns.context: A common verb in the name of a church radio program; Go also appears in [4], but in a different context

patterns.name: Initial substring of Exhaustion
patterns.context: The heading “Exhaustion of pro rata shares” in a regulation

patterns.name: kick substring
patterns.context: In an account of an assault, describes the defendant kicking the victim

patterns.name: Initial/intraword substring rect
patterns.context: Occurs in anatomical terms such as rectocele and rectum in a description of an obstetric injury

6_836.description: 激活主要落在若干完整词或词内子串上：法律语境中的character、Exhaustion及暴力叙述中的hol、kick，也包括Go等专名/普通词和医学词nex、rect。它们跨领域且缺少一致语义。

patterns.name: characterize 词形
patterns.context: 与 mis- 连用，表示错误描述或歪曲；激活集中在被拆分出的 character 子串

patterns.name: hol-lering 中的 hol
patterns.context: 暴力事件叙述中，证人听到的叫喊声；强激活落在词首子串

patterns.name: Go 专名子串
patterns.trigger: [4] «Go»9« Get»7« Em»7，船名“Go Get Em”的首词
patterns.context: 移民执法案件中，列举被没收船只的名称

patterns.name: nex 医学术语子串
patterns.context: 医疗记录与法律因果关系标准并置，术语出现在“loose nexus”中

patterns.name: Dolma 人名子串
patterns.context: 介绍歌手声乐训练经历及其导师

patterns.name: Go 歌曲名子串
patterns.context: 教会广播节目名称中的普通动词；与[4]同样出现 Go，但语境不同

patterns.name: Exhaustion 词首
patterns.context: 法规条文的小标题“Exhaustion of pro rata shares”

patterns.name: kick 词内子串
patterns.context: 殴打事实叙述中，描述被告踢受害人

patterns.name: rect 词首/词内子串
patterns.context: 产科损伤描述中，出现在 rectocele、rectum 等解剖学术语内

en.description: Strong activations often fall on intraword fragments: exhaustion (in both legal and resource contexts); there are also local fragments in Valderrama, dimeric, Go Get Em, memoranda, and Licensed, scattered across domains and meanings.

patterns.name: Word form exhaustion
patterns.context: Activations on intraword fragments of exhaustion; occurs near words such as remedies and claim in legal contexts, and near aquifer in a natural resources context.
patterns.domain: Legal documents and general explanatory text

patterns.name: Surname fragment Valderrama
patterns.context: The name Valderrama occurs in accounts of sentencing and prison terms.

patterns.name: Intraword fragment in dimeric
patterns.context: Occurs in the phrase “dimeric intermediates”, describing a genetic recombination pathway.

patterns.name: Boat name Go Get Em
patterns.context: The beginning of the boat name “Go Get Em”, followed by «Get» and «Em»; the same sentence concerns boats, prosecution, and forfeiture.

patterns.name: Intraword fragment in memoranda
patterns.context: Occurs in “memoranda” in a discussion of the parties’ intent regarding documents.

patterns.name: Intraword fragment in Licensed
patterns.context: Occurs in the code comment “Licensed under the Apache License”.

6_836.description: 强激活多落在词内片段：exhaustion（含法律与资源语境）；另有 Valderrama、dimeric、Go Get Em、memoranda、Licensed 的局部片段，领域与语义分散。

patterns.name: exhaustion 词形
patterns.context: 对 exhaustion 的词内片段激活；出现在法律语境的 remedies、claim 等词附近，也出现在自然资源语境的 aquifer 附近。
patterns.domain: 法律文书及一般说明文字

patterns.name: Valderrama 姓氏片段
patterns.context: 人名 Valderrama 出现在量刑、刑期叙述中。

patterns.name: dimeric 词内片段
patterns.context: 出现在短语 “dimeric intermediates” 中，描述遗传重组路径。

patterns.name: Go Get Em 船名
patterns.context: 船名 “Go Get Em” 的开头，后接 «Get»、«Em»；同句涉及船只、起诉及没收。

patterns.name: memoranda 词内片段
patterns.context: 出现在 “memoranda” 中，讨论双方对文件的意图。

patterns.name: Licensed 词内片段
patterns.context: 出现在代码注释中的 “Licensed under the Apache License”。
patterns.domain: 软件代码与许可证注释

en.concept: migr stem fragment and scattered word fragments
en.description: The clearest common trigger is the intraword fragment «migr», covering data migration and animal migration. Other highly activated fragments are scattered across chemical symbols, week numbers, disease terms, animal names, numeric units, sample sizes, and project names, with no consistent cross-passage condition.

patterns.name: “migration” stem fragment within words
patterns.context: Part of an English word, followed by unmarked letters indicating inflection; occurs in different senses such as data migration and species migration

patterns.name: Fe in the Ni-Fe-S chemical symbol
patterns.context: Occurs in the chemical structure name “Ni-Fe-S cluster/site”

patterns.name: ence in population/disease-related words
patterns.context: Mentions TB incidence; passage 2 also contains “cannibalism” and passage 9 “syndromes”, but no clear common triggering fragment is evident
patterns.domain: Public health; other passages concern behavioral ecology and clinical medicine

patterns.name: Word form week for “week”
patterns.context: Week-number markers for dietary interventions in laboratory animals and subsequent time points

patterns.name: Numbers and unit/range expressions
patterns.context: Quantitative descriptions of animal weight, habitat depth, and similar measures; activations are scattered across numbers and adjacent units

patterns.name: Fragments in biological names or taxonomic terms
patterns.context: Activations fall on internal fragments of several words in descriptions of fish diets and bird names

patterns.name: Coronary syndrome clinical terminology
patterns.context: Occurs alongside descriptions of coronary syndromes, PCI, and clinical trials; other markers are distributed throughout the terminology, with no single common stem

patterns.name: Photovoice project word-form fragments
patterns.context: In the context of mental health organizations and project evaluation; activations concentrate on fragments of proper names or titles

patterns.name: Experimental sample size markers
patterns.context: Animal or patient sample size/experimental design notation in parentheses

6_836.concept: migr 词干片段及杂散词片段
6_836.description: 最明确的共同触发是词内片段 «migr»，涵盖数据迁移与动物迁徙。其余高激活分散于化学符号、周数、疾病术语、动物名称、数字单位、样本量和项目专名，缺少跨段一致条件。

patterns.name: 单词内部的「迁移」词干片段
patterns.context: 作为英文单词词干的一部分，后接表示词形变化的未标记字母；出现在数据迁移、物种迁徙等不同语义中
patterns.domain: 企业 IT、动物学/自然地理

patterns.name: Ni-Fe-S 化学符号中的 Fe
patterns.context: 出现在“Ni-Fe-S cluster/site”化学结构名称中

patterns.name: 种群/疾病相关词中的 ence
patterns.context: 提及 TB 发病率；此外第 2 段有“cannibalism”，第 9 段有“syndromes”，但未显示清晰共同触发片段
patterns.domain: 公共卫生；其他段分别为行为生态学和临床医学

patterns.name: 表示「周」的 week 词形
patterns.context: 实验动物饮食干预及后续时间点的周数标记

patterns.name: 数字与单位/范围表达
patterns.context: 动物体重、栖息深度等定量描述；激活分散在数字及相邻单位

patterns.name: 生物名称或分类词片段
patterns.context: 鱼类食性及鸟类名称、描述中，激活落在若干词的内部片段

patterns.name: 冠脉综合征临床术语
patterns.context: 与冠脉综合征、PCI 和临床试验描述同现；其余标记多分布于术语各处，未见单一共同词干

patterns.name: Photovoice 项目词形片段
patterns.context: 心理健康机构与项目评估背景；激活集中在专名或名称的部分词段
patterns.domain: 心理健康研究项目简介

patterns.name: 实验样本量标记
patterns.context: 括号中的动物或患者样本量/实验设计记法

en.concept: Heterogeneous local word forms and connective features
en.description: Activations mainly fall on the result connector resulting, the compositional phrase composed of, and sprained and born in sports texts; other local triggers include medical intraword fragments, disease descriptions, names, and patent phrases, which cannot be explained by a single semantic pattern.

patterns.name: Result connector resulting
patterns.context: Occurs after a cause, condition, or event to connect to a subsequent result, often followed by «in»; in passage 3 it is followed by «a».
patterns.domain: Medical abstracts, public health, news/sports narratives

patterns.name: Past participle composed
patterns.context: «composed of» introduces materials or components.

patterns.name: born year in sports player names
patterns.context: A player identification in parentheses after a name, followed by a birth year.

patterns.name: Injury stem in segmented spelling
patterns.context: Sports injury reports describe a player suffering a knee or ankle sprain; activation falls on the word formed by merging the segmented forms “sp” and “rained”.
patterns.domain: Sports news or player update lists

patterns.name: Causal/source entries in lists
patterns.context: In an etiology classification context, lists causes and then introduces related reasons.

patterns.name: Outcome description of an abnormal anatomical phenotype
patterns.context: In a disease phenotype introduction, a relative clause introduces a refractory abnormality; occurs in the same passage as the highly activated result connector resulting.

patterns.name: Local characters in a player name
patterns.context: Occurs in the segmented spelling of the Croatian/Montenegrin surname Željko Vuković.

patterns.name: plate in a patent phrase
patterns.context: Part of a device name in the patent title “Ceramic Face Plate”.

patterns.name: Intraword fragments in biomedical terms
patterns.context: Occurs in terms for etiology or vascular disease as intraword segmentation activations.

patterns.name: Description of a mass in a rare case
patterns.context: A case report describes a polypoid mass composed of ectopic pancreatic tissue.

6_836.concept: 异质的局部词形与连接词特征
6_836.description: 激活主要落在结果连接词 resulting、组成关系 composed of，以及体育语料中的 sprained 和 born；另有医学词内片段、疾病描述、姓名和专利短语等局部触发，无法由单一语义模式解释。

patterns.name: resulting 的结果连接
patterns.context: 出现在描述原因、病症或事件后，连接后续结果，常接 «in»；例外段3中接 «a»。
patterns.domain: 医学摘要、公共卫生、新闻/体育叙述

patterns.name: 过去分词 composed
patterns.context: «composed of» 引出材料或组成成分。
patterns.domain: 专利文本、医学病例摘要

patterns.name: 体育球员姓名中的 born 年份
patterns.context: 姓名后括号内的球员身份说明，紧接出生年份。

patterns.name: 拼写分词中的受伤词干
patterns.context: 体育伤病报道中描述球员遭受膝或踝扭伤；激活落在分词形式“sp”“rained”合并后的单词上。
patterns.domain: 体育新闻或球员动态列表

patterns.name: 列表中因果/来源条目
patterns.context: 病因分类语境中，列举病因后引出相关原因。

patterns.name: 异常解剖表型的结果描述
patterns.context: 疾病表型介绍中，关系从句引出难治性异常；与高强度 resulting 结果连接同段出现。

patterns.name: 球员姓名局部字符
patterns.context: 出现在克罗地亚语/黑山语姓氏 Željko Vuković 的分段拼写中。

patterns.name: 专利短语中的 plate
patterns.context: 专利标题“Ceramic Face Plate”中，作为器件名称的一部分。

patterns.name: 生物医学词内部片段
patterns.context: 在病因或血管疾病术语中出现，属于词内分段激活。

patterns.name: 稀有病例的肿块描述
patterns.context: 病例报告中描述由异位胰腺组织构成的息肉样肿块。

en.description: Most passages concern causes, disease or state development, and consequences, especially negative health or damage outcomes; other examples include viral evolution, injury descriptions, and an academic citation fragment that is difficult to explain.

patterns.name: Causal consequences
patterns.context: First states a problem, process, or cause, then introduces subsequent effects, outcomes, or serious consequences; often linked by arising, leading to, which, cause, and similar terms

patterns.name: Disease recurrence and resistance development
patterns.context: Describes disease recurrence in patients or pests developing resistance after repeated exposure

patterns.name: Evolving into a type
patterns.context: Predicts that a virus will later evolve into a particular strain

patterns.name: Injury or severe symptoms
patterns.context: suffer from followed by a specific injury or functional impairment

patterns.name: Predictability and citation fragments
patterns.context: Discusses word predictability alongside names, years, and literature citations; strong activation falls on tokenization fragments and punctuation, making the semantic trigger difficult to identify

6_836.description: 多数段落涉及原因、疾病或状态发展及其后果，尤其是负面健康或损害结果；另有病毒演化、受伤描述和一段难解释的学术引文碎片。

patterns.name: 因果后果展开
patterns.trigger: “arising … all over the place”“leading to the infiltration”“which sometimes result in death”“can cause a disseminated, potentially fatal form”
patterns.context: 先陈述问题、过程或原因，再引出后续影响、结果或严重后果；常由 arising、leading to、which、cause 等连接
patterns.domain: 新闻、医学论文、专利背景

patterns.name: 疾病复发与耐药发展
patterns.context: 描述患者疾病复发，或害虫在反复暴露后产生抗性

patterns.name: 演化为某种类型
patterns.context: 预测病毒后续演变成某一毒株
patterns.domain: 公共卫生评论、网络讨论

patterns.name: 受伤或严重症状
patterns.trigger: “suffering from a sprained left ankle”“suffer from crippling skeletal abnormalities”
patterns.context: suffer from 后接具体伤病或功能障碍

patterns.name: 预测性与引文碎片
patterns.trigger: “words and sentences”“Florentine,”“Kalikow et al., 1977; Bilger et al., 1984”中的词片及标点
patterns.context: 讨论词语可预测性，伴随姓名、年份和文献引文；强激活落在分词碎片和标点上，难以确定语义触发项

en.description: High activations often fall on “going on”, which expresses an event or abnormal occurrence, especially when pointing to a complex, suspicious, or internal situation; other scattered patterns occur on also, because of, that can mean, could not, and consists.

patterns.name: “going on” for ongoing or abnormal situations
patterns.context: “going on” means that something is happening or continuing, often emphasizing an abnormal, complex, or unclear situation behind it; also appears in expressions such as “what is going on inside”.

patterns.name: can + also
patterns.context: A patent technical description presents another property or issue that a structure or pattern may cause; activation falls on “also”.

patterns.name: because of
patterns.context: A causal phrase introduces the reason for assembly difficulties; activation falls on “of”.

patterns.name: that can mean
patterns.context: After describing damage, an inferential phrase introduces the consequence; activation falls on “mean”.

patterns.name: could not be read
patterns.context: A file read failure message in exception-handling code; activation falls on “could”.

patterns.name: consists of three steps
patterns.context: A paper describes a classification task as comprising three stages; activation falls on “consists”.

6_836.concept: 事件发生与关系连接词
6_836.description: 高激活常落在表达事件或异常正在发生的“going on”中，尤其用于指出复杂、可疑或内在情况；另有若干分散模式，落在 also、because of、that can mean、could not、consists 等词上。

patterns.name: “going on”进展或异常情况
patterns.context: “going on”表示某事正在发生、持续，常用于强调背后有异常、复杂或未明的情况；也出现在“what is going on inside”这类表达中。
patterns.domain: 论坛对话、人物描述、邮件

patterns.name: can + also
patterns.context: 专利技术说明中描述结构或图案可能带来的另一项性质或问题；激活落在“also”。

patterns.name: because of
patterns.context: 在说明装配困难原因时，用因果短语引出原因；激活落在“of”。

patterns.name: that can mean
patterns.context: 前文描述损坏后，以推论短语引出后果；激活落在“mean”。

patterns.name: could not be read
patterns.context: 异常处理代码中的文件读取失败提示；激活落在“could”。

patterns.name: consists of three steps
patterns.context: 论文中描述分类任务包含三个阶段；激活落在“consists”。

en.description: Most passages emphasize the modal verbs can/could, describing possible properties, consequences, or limitations; in code, could not error messages are a particularly prominent pattern. A few passages also contain local triggers such as often, suffers, serious problems, or consists, and do not fully fit the same pattern.

patterns.name: Modal can
patterns.context: Followed by ability, possibility, difficulty, impact, or error outcomes; often appears in the main-clause predicate position
patterns.domain: Patents, medical and technical descriptions, and code error messages

patterns.name: can with subsequent outcomes/impacts
patterns.context: Describes possible consequences caused by a factor or properties an entity may have; contexts are mostly explanatory

patterns.name: could not error expressions
patterns.context: Code or log strings report being unable to detect, determine, or read an object

patterns.name: Modal clauses introduced by that
patterns.context: A that-clause describes possible changes or outcomes for a disease, factor, or object

patterns.name: Serious problems or adverse consequences
patterns.context: Describes obstacles, pressure, or adverse effects; these words do not fully match the main can/could pattern in the passages

patterns.name: often and consists in noun clauses
patterns.context: Describes a category of object as usually consisting of several steps; contains no clear can/could error expression

6_836.description: 多数片段突出情态词 can/could：说明可能的性质、后果或限制，代码中尤以 could not 报错为显著模式。另有少数片段含 often、suffers、严重问题或 consists 等局部触发，不能完全归入同一模式。

patterns.name: 情态词 can
patterns.context: 后接能力、可能性、困难、影响或错误结果；常出现在主句谓语位置
patterns.domain: 专利、医学、技术说明及代码错误信息

patterns.name: can 与后续结果/影响
patterns.trigger: «can» 前后出现 «often»、«also»、«that» 或结果性谓语，如 «can» «also» «present»、«can» «adversely» «change»
patterns.context: 描述某因素可能造成的后果或某对象具备的性质；语境多为说明性论述

patterns.name: could not 错误表达
patterns.context: 代码或日志字符串报告无法检测、确定或读取某对象

patterns.name: 由 that 引导的情态从句
patterns.context: that 从句描述疾病、因素或对象可能发生的变化或结果

patterns.name: 严重问题或不利后果语境
patterns.context: 描述阻碍、压力或不利影响；这些词在片段中与 can/could 这一主模式不完全一致

patterns.name: 名词从句中的 often 与 consists
patterns.context: 描述分类对象通常由若干步骤构成；不含明显的 can/could 错误表达

en.description: Most passages activate on result expressions such as end up, especially possible outcomes with could/may; other local patterns concern indeterminate file paths, the development of drug resistance, employee departures, and power transmission bottlenecks.

patterns.name: Result phrase “end up”
patterns.context: Describes the outcome that a choice, process, or situation ultimately leads to; common full collocations are “could end up” and “may end up”, though “end up” also occurs without a modal.
patterns.domain: Forum comments, technical discussions, research texts

patterns.name: Negative outcome in file path determination
patterns.context: After checking a parameter path, a program cannot determine whether it is a file or directory; activation falls on the outcome expression in an error message.

patterns.name: Emergence or development of multidrug resistance
patterns.context: Describes treatment-related resistance that may develop in patients and complicate medication use.

patterns.name: Employee departures and team sentiment
patterns.context: Discusses company compensation and performance requirements, describing excellent employees leaving and the feelings of those who remain.

patterns.name: Transportation bottleneck
patterns.context: An infrastructure constraint caused by insufficient power transmission capacity; activation covers the segmented word bottlenecks.

6_836.description: 多数段落激活于 end up 一类表示最终结果的表达，尤其是带 could/may 的可能结果；另有路径无法判定、耐药发展、人才离职及电力输送瓶颈等局部模式。

patterns.name: 结果性短语“end up”
patterns.context: 描述某种选择、过程或情况最终导致的结果；常见完整搭配是 “could end up”“may end up”，但也出现不带情态词的 “end up”。
patterns.domain: 论坛评论、技术讨论、科研文本

patterns.name: 文件路径判定中的否定结果
patterns.context: 程序对参数路径进行判断后，无法确定其是文件还是目录；激活落在错误消息中的结果表达。

patterns.name: 多药耐药的出现或发展
patterns.context: 描述治疗相关耐药性可能在患者中发展，并使药物使用复杂化。

patterns.name: 人才离职与团队感受
patterns.context: 讨论公司薪酬和绩效要求时，描述优秀员工离开及留任者的感受。

patterns.name: 运输瓶颈
patterns.context: 电力输送能力不足造成的基础设施约束；激活覆盖被拆分呈现的 bottlenecks 一词。

en.description: Activations are distributed across varied contexts: verb phrases express continuation, transfer, or results; technical texts introduce defects and risks; other examples include code path classification, experiences of poverty, and photon scattering mechanisms. No single semantic pattern adequately covers all passages.

patterns.name: Continuation or result with go
patterns.context: Triggers combine verbs such as go, give, and pass with directional or continuative particles, followed by a result, subsequent action, or state; activation sometimes falls on the particle or an adjacent word.
patterns.domain: Multiple genres, including patents, news, and medicine

patterns.name: Introducing problems/risks
patterns.context: Describes defects, risks, adverse consequences, or problems to be solved in existing solutions, materials, or devices; activation often occurs on the problem term or nearby context.
patterns.domain: Patent background sections and technical descriptions

patterns.name: Path checking and classification
patterns.context: Code checks a path and determines whether it is a file or directory, including a path string and an either…or classification structure.

patterns.name: People in poverty and their experiences
patterns.context: Discusses social statistics and effects of poverty among U.S. newborns and persistent poverty during childhood.

patterns.name: Choice of photon scattering mechanism
patterns.context: Describes the generation mechanism of IC photons in a leptonic scenario, using may either be generated by to introduce alternatives.

6_836.description: 激活分散于多种语境：动词短语表示延续、转移或结果；技术文本引出缺陷与风险；另见代码路径分类、贫困经历和光子散射机制。尚无单一语义模式能充分覆盖全部段落。

patterns.name: go 的延续或结果
patterns.trigger: «go»10« beyond»4；«went»7« on»10« to»8；«go»6« on»9« to»7；«gave»1« up»3；«passed»1« on»1
patterns.context: 触发词是 go、give、pass 等动词与方向或延续性小品词的组合，后接结果、后续行动或状态；有时激活落在小品词或相邻词上。
patterns.domain: 专利、新闻、医学等多种文体

patterns.name: problem / 风险引出
patterns.context: 描述既有方案、材料或设备的缺陷、风险、不利后果或待解决问题；激活常出现在问题词或其邻近上下文。
patterns.domain: 专利背景技术及技术说明

patterns.name: 路径判断与分类
patterns.trigger: «path»1«.»2isdir(arg)；«path»4« '%»5«s»2«'»2« could»10« not»6« be»1 determined as« either»2
patterns.context: 代码中检查路径并判断其属于文件还是目录，包含路径字符串及 either…or 分类结构。

patterns.name: 贫困群体及其经历
patterns.context: 讨论美国新生儿贫困及其童年时期持续贫困的社会统计与影响。

patterns.name: 光子散射机制的选择
patterns.trigger: «may»4« either»9« be»4« generated»2« by»6 the« up»2-sc«attering»2
patterns.context: 在 leptonic scenario 中说明 IC 光子的生成机制，采用 may either be generated by 引出选项。

en.description: Activations commonly occur in contexts introducing problems, defects, failures, and their causes or consequences, especially “problem/defect(s)” and “due to” in technical descriptions; they also respond to expressions of contrast, addition, results, and subsequent developments in some biographies or commentary.

patterns.name: Introducing problems, defects, or failures
patterns.context: Describes problems, defects, failures, or their causes in a device, design, or situation; common structures include problem(s)/defect(s) followed by a cause or consequence
patterns.domain: Patent background and failure descriptions; also blog comments

patterns.name: Causal connector due to
patterns.context: Uses due to to introduce the cause of an adverse condition, defect, or failure; often appears in technical causal statements

patterns.name: Contrast or concession marker However
patterns.context: Introduces a limitation, problem, or contrary situation after a previously described condition or design

patterns.name: Contrast connector yet
patterns.context: Introduces a contrary result or unmet condition after acknowledging an advantage or stating a fact

patterns.name: Expressions of subsequent developments
patterns.context: Describes something going beyond a scope, a problem arising later, continued development, or an eventual outcome; forms vary

patterns.name: Coordination and additive transitions
patterns.context: Adds related effects or another statement

patterns.name: Outcome reversal in personal experience
patterns.context: A biography states that an accident caused a disability, then recounts subsequent experiences

patterns.name: Near sentence-final punctuation
patterns.context: Inter-sentence punctuation occurs at a transition in a technical statement

patterns.name: Unexplained local trigger within a paragraph
patterns.context: The paragraph comments on the aviation industry and investment performance, but the activating word has a weaker connection to the explicit triggers in other paragraphs

6_836.description: 激活常见于引出问题、缺陷、故障及其原因或后果的语境，尤其是技术说明中的“problem/defect(s)”和“due to”；也响应转折、补充、结果及个别传记或评论中的后续发展表达。

patterns.name: 问题、缺陷或故障的引出
patterns.trigger: “problem”后接“starts”“that”；“defect(s)”“flaws”；“fails frequently due to a blockage condition”
patterns.context: 说明某种设备、方案或情形存在问题、缺陷、故障或原因，常见结构为 problem(s)/defect(s) 加原因或后果
patterns.domain: 专利背景技术及故障说明；也见博客评论

patterns.name: 因果连接词 due to
patterns.trigger: “due”及后续“to”（如“unstable due to the presence”“defects may be due to flaws”“fails frequently due to a blockage”）
patterns.context: 以 due to 引出不良状态、缺陷或故障的原因；常位于技术性因果陈述中
patterns.domain: 专利背景技术；医学摘要

patterns.name: 转折或让步词 However
patterns.context: 在先述情形或方案之后引出限制、问题或相反情况
patterns.domain: 专利背景技术、医学摘要

patterns.name: 转折连接词 yet
patterns.context: 在承认优点或陈述事实后，引出与之相反的结果或未达成的状态

patterns.name: 后续发展表达
patterns.trigger: “go beyond”“starts after”“went on to represent”“end up being”
patterns.context: 描述超出范围、问题随后出现、继续发展或最终成为某种结果；形式不完全一致

patterns.name: 并列及递进衔接
patterns.context: 补充列举相关影响或另一项陈述

patterns.name: 个人经历中的结果转折
patterns.trigger: “as a result of a car accident”
patterns.context: 人物传记中交代事故造成残疾，之后叙述其后续经历

patterns.name: 句末标点附近
patterns.context: 句间标点处于技术性陈述转换位置

patterns.name: 未充分解释的段落内局部触发
patterns.context: 段落涉及航空业与投资表现的评论，但激活词与其他段落的明确触发关系较弱

en.description: Activations commonly occur in contexts that identify problems, drawbacks, or possible failures, and describe adverse consequences such as deviation from an expected range, damage, contamination, or leakage; especially common in patent backgrounds, but also found in papers and forum texts.

patterns.name: Possible occurrence of problems or failures
patterns.context: First identifies a problem or drawback in a design, operation, or arrangement, then describes where or under what circumstances it may occur; the trigger need not be adjacent.
patterns.domain: Problem statements in patent background sections, also discussions of method limitations in academic papers

patterns.name: Exceeding or deviating from an expected range
patterns.context: Describes a size exceeding the field of view, movement deviating from a direction, or an operating range; the shared feature is deviation from an expected boundary or range, though contexts vary.
patterns.domain: Patent optical inspection, academic physics, and instrument descriptions

patterns.name: Causing or potentially causing adverse consequences
patterns.context: Explains that a condition may cause damage, failure, contamination, or another undesired outcome; this may be presented in a conditional sentence, an expression of concern, or a causal chain.
patterns.domain: Patent failure and contamination descriptions, forum help requests, general risk descriptions

patterns.name: Physical leakage or seepage
patterns.context: Unavoidable slight leakage of air or fuel gas inside a burner; the trigger is a technical description of leakage, not general problem wording.
patterns.domain: Patent background sections, burners and fluid systems

patterns.name: Possibility of high-risk consequences
patterns.context: A damaged or vulnerable component may break and cause property damage, emphasizing risk consequences rather than merely identifying a problem.
patterns.domain: General explanatory text, mechanical spring safety risks

6_836.description: 激活常见于指出问题、缺点或故障可能发生，以及描述偏离预期范围、损坏、污染或泄漏等不良后果的语境；尤其常见于专利背景技术，也见论文与论坛文本。

patterns.name: 问题或故障可能发生
patterns.context: 先指出设计、操作或安排存在问题或缺点，再描述问题可能发生、出现的位置或情形；不要求触发词紧邻。
patterns.domain: 专利背景技术中的问题陈述，也见学术论文对方法局限的讨论

patterns.name: 超出或偏离预期范围
patterns.context: 描述尺寸超出视野、运动偏离方向，或可操作范围；共同点是偏离某种预期边界或范围，但语境各异。
patterns.domain: 专利光学检测、学术物理与仪器说明

patterns.name: 导致或可能导致不良后果
patterns.context: 说明某条件可能造成损坏、失效、污染或其他不希望发生的结果；可用条件句、担忧表达或因果链呈现。
patterns.domain: 专利故障与污染描述、论坛求助、一般风险说明

patterns.name: 物理泄漏或渗漏
patterns.context: 燃烧器内部空气或燃料气流发生不可避免的轻微泄漏；触发是技术性泄漏描述，并非一般问题措辞。
patterns.domain: 专利背景技术，燃烧器与流体系统

patterns.name: 高风险后果的可能性
patterns.context: 受损或脆弱部件可能断裂并造成财产损害，强调风险后果，而非仅仅指出存在问题。
patterns.domain: 一般说明文，机械弹簧安全风险

en.description: Primarily responds to causal descriptions of problems, failures, or limitations, especially negative outcomes caused by a condition in a technical design; often near words such as occur, problem, and due to. Also covers contamination/clogging, performance costs, exceeding the field of view, and one historical change in terminology.

patterns.name: Causal connections and problem outcomes
patterns.context: Explains how a method, device, or condition causes a defect, failure, limitation, or problem; common forms place a problem or result after its cause, with activations concentrated on causal connectors and nearby words, such as “occur” and “prone to overfit.”
patterns.domain: Patent background; technical discussion in papers; paragraph 6 has “began to be referred to” in a historical narrative

patterns.name: Material leakage, clogging, and contaminants
patterns.context: Describes adverse phenomena such as fluid, ink, or particle leakage; drying and clogging; contamination; deposits; or material discoloration; often co-occurs with “occur,” “fall,” or “problem.”
patterns.domain: Patent background on inkjet devices, lidar, tool cleaning, materials, and optical applications

patterns.name: Crossing boundaries and exceeding the visible range
patterns.context: A defect is too large and therefore falls outside the scanning lens's field of view; a distinctive expression of a spatial-range limitation
patterns.domain: Patent background on scanning inspection technology

patterns.name: Insufficient resources and technical costs
patterns.context: States that a technical solution is constrained by computational cost, risk of overfitting, difficulty collecting data, or legal restrictions; the problem is caused by resource or external conditions
patterns.domain: Computer vision papers; medical imaging data research

patterns.name: Change in terminology in historical narratives
patterns.context: Describes a group later beginning to be called by a certain name; differs from patent and technical failure contexts

6_836.description: 主要响应因果性的问题、故障或限制表述，尤其是技术方案中由某条件引发的负面结果；常邻近 occur、problem、due to 等词。也覆盖污染/堵塞、性能代价、超出视野及一处历史称谓变化。

patterns.name: 因果连接与问题后果
patterns.trigger: “due to”“results in”“leads to”“problem”“problem arises”“reason is”“fails frequently”
patterns.context: 说明某种方法、设备或条件导致缺陷、故障、限制或问题；常见形式为原因后接问题/结果，激活集中在因果连接词及其邻近词，如“occur”“prone to overfit”。
patterns.domain: 专利背景技术、论文中的技术论述；段6为历史叙述中的“began to be referred to”

patterns.name: 物质泄漏、堵塞与污染物
patterns.context: 描述流体、墨水或颗粒物的泄漏、干燥堵塞、污染、沉积或材料变色等不利现象；常与“occur”“fall”“problem”同现。
patterns.domain: 喷墨设备、激光雷达、工具清洗、材料与光学应用的专利背景

patterns.name: 越界、超出可见范围
patterns.context: 缺陷尺寸过大，以致超出扫描镜头的视野；较独特的空间范围限制表达。
patterns.domain: 扫描检测技术专利背景

patterns.name: 资源不足与技术代价
patterns.context: 陈述技术方案受计算成本、过拟合风险、数据收集困难或法律限制约束；问题由资源或外部条件造成。
patterns.domain: 计算机视觉论文、医学影像数据研究

patterns.name: 历史叙述中的称谓变化
patterns.context: 描述群体后来开始被称为某一名称；与专利及技术故障语境不同。

en.description: Primarily responds to negative outcomes and their causes in technical discourse: the occurrence, possibility, and attribution of problems, defects, failures, or performance degradation. There is also a single example concerning “differences that may merely be an artifact caused by some factor.”

patterns.name: Occurrence of a problem or negative outcome
patterns.context: Usually, a problem appears as a possible or actual outcome when describing defects, risks, or adverse consequences of equipment, processes, or designs.
patterns.domain: Patent background sections and technical discussions in papers

patterns.name: Failures caused by reasons or conditions
patterns.context: Explains that an adverse outcome is caused by a reason or condition, including size exceeding the field of view, drying, overfitting, increased line resistance, or an increased number of magnetic heads.
patterns.domain: Patent background sections and papers on machine learning and storage technology

patterns.name: Failure, damage, or performance degradation
patterns.context: Centers on negative technical outcomes such as equipment defects, clogging, overfitting, image quality degradation, or reliability problems.
patterns.domain: Patent background sections and computer science papers

patterns.name: Expressions of occurrence or tendency to occur
patterns.context: Describes the appearance of a problem, failure, or adverse phenomenon; “tend to” or “can” may express a tendency or possibility.

patterns.name: Sentences describing consequences that cause problems
patterns.context: The preceding text proposes a countermeasure or design choice, then notes that it instead causes a problem.

patterns.name: Suffering damage or reliability problems
patterns.context: Uses “suffer from” to describe components or systems experiencing adverse conditions such as leakage or reduced reliability.
patterns.domain: Patent background sections and storage technology papers

patterns.name: Differences attributed to nontechnical factors
patterns.context: Discusses how an observed difference may not be due to the apparent skill, but may instead be an artifact caused by other factors.

6_836.description: 主要响应技术论述中负面结果及其原因：问题、缺陷、故障或性能退化的发生、可能性与归因。另对“差异可能只是某因素造成的假象”有单例响应。

patterns.name: 问题或负面结果的发生
patterns.context: 通常在描述某种设备、工艺或设计的缺陷、风险或不利后果时，问题作为可能发生或已发生的结果出现。
patterns.domain: 专利背景技术及论文中的技术论述

patterns.name: 原因或条件引出的故障
patterns.context: 说明不良结果由某种原因或条件导致，涉及尺寸超出视野、干燥、过拟合、线路电阻增加或磁头数量增加等不同原因。
patterns.domain: 专利背景技术与机器学习、存储技术论文

patterns.name: 故障、损害或性能退化
patterns.context: 围绕设备缺陷、堵塞、过拟合、图像质量退化或可靠性问题等负面技术结果展开。
patterns.domain: 专利背景技术与计算机科学论文

patterns.name: 发生或趋于发生的表达
patterns.context: 描述问题、故障或不利现象出现；可由“tend to”或“can”表达倾向或可能性。

patterns.name: 导致问题的后果句式
patterns.context: 前文提出应对措施或设计选择，随后指出它反而带来问题。

patterns.name: 遭受损害或可靠性问题
patterns.context: 以“suffer from”描述部件或系统遭遇泄漏、可靠性下降等不利状况。
patterns.domain: 专利背景技术与存储技术论文

patterns.name: 归因于非技术因素的差异
patterns.context: 讨论观察到的差异可能并非表面上的技能所致，而是由其他因素造成的假象。

en.concept: Occurrence, accumulation, and consequences of problems
en.description: Primarily responds to defects, losses, accumulation, and explanations of causes in technical contexts; prominent local forms include build up, go/goes complements, occur, and due to. Also covers anxiety going sky-high, which does not fit a unified technical theme.

patterns.name: Up in verb phrases
patterns.context: “up” immediately follows a verb to indicate gradual accumulation of a substance, component, or phenomenon; in the given samples, the up in this phrase is always a high-activation token.
patterns.domain: Patent technical background describing deposits inside devices, rising gas concentrations, or frost formation

patterns.name: Go followed by a direction or result
patterns.context: Go/goes is followed by a complement indicating crossing a boundary, a destination, or rising intensity; activations fall on key result words in the following expressions, whose meanings are not identical.
patterns.domain: Patent technical descriptions and a passage of popular psychology prose

patterns.name: An event occurring or tending to occur
patterns.context: Describes an adverse phenomenon occurring or a system being prone to a problem; activations in [1] and [6] concentrate on occur, while [2] activates on due.

patterns.name: Due in causal explanations
patterns.context: Due and nearby tokens activate in causal structures explaining defects, losses, or difficulties; [2] also includes a cause of overfitting.
patterns.domain: Patent background, machine-learning papers, NIH project descriptions

patterns.name: Technical defects or adverse consequences
patterns.context: Limitations, failures, losses, or adverse effects in technical systems, materials, or biomedical solutions; these passages have no single shared trigger token and are related at the content level.
patterns.domain: Patent technical background, machine-learning papers, NIH project descriptions

patterns.name: Increased intensity in a nontechnical context
patterns.context: Goes and sky-high form an intensifying expression describing worsening anxiety; unlike technical contexts involving accumulation or failure.

6_836.concept: 问题发生、积累及其后果
6_836.description: 主要响应技术语境中缺陷、损耗、积累及原因说明；突出的局部形式包括 build up、go/goes 补语、occur 与 due to。另覆盖焦虑 goes sky-high，难以归入统一技术主题。

patterns.name: 动词短语中的 up
patterns.trigger: “build up”（[4] coatings build up；[8] can build up；[10] builds up）
patterns.context: “up”紧接动词，表示物质、成分或现象逐渐积累；在给出的样本中该短语的 up 均为高激活 token。
patterns.domain: 专利技术背景，描述设备内部沉积、气体浓度增加或结霜

patterns.name: go 后接方向或结果
patterns.trigger: “go beyond”（[3] defect may go beyond）；“goes to waste”（[5] goes to waste）；“goes sky-high”（[9] anxiety goes sky-high）
patterns.context: go/goes 后接表示越界、归宿或程度上升的补语；激活落在后续表达的关键结果词上，语义并不完全相同。
patterns.domain: 专利技术说明及一段通俗心理类 prose

patterns.name: 事件发生或趋于发生
patterns.trigger: “occur”（[1] inevitably occur；[6] tend to occur）；“prone to overfit due to”（[2]）
patterns.context: 描述不良现象发生或系统容易出现某种问题；[1]、[6] 的激活集中在 occur，[2] 激活在 due。
patterns.domain: 专利背景及机器学习论文

patterns.name: 因果解释中的 due
patterns.trigger: “due to”（[4] due to filler particles；[5] due to total reflection；[7] due to the lack）；另见“due to”后接“their large number”[2]
patterns.context: 在解释缺陷、损耗或困难原因的因果结构中，due 及其邻近 token 激活；[2] 还包含过拟合原因。
patterns.domain: 专利背景、机器学习论文、NIH 项目简介

patterns.name: 技术缺陷或不良后果
patterns.trigger: “suffer from light leakages”（[1]）；“deterioration”（[4]）；“fails to be coupled out”“waste”（[5]）；“clogging”“drying”（[6]）；“difficult to produce”（[7]）；“difficult to eliminate”“reduces operating efficiency”（[10]）
patterns.context: 技术系统、材料或生物医学方案的限制、故障、损耗或不利影响；这些片段没有一个共同的特定触发 token，属于内容层面的共同点。
patterns.domain: 专利技术背景、机器学习论文、NIH 项目简介

patterns.name: 非技术语境中的程度升高
patterns.context: goes 与 sky-high 构成程度夸张表达，描述焦虑加剧；与技术中的积累或故障语境不同。
patterns.domain: 通俗心理或自助类文本

en.description: Primarily responds to outcomes, state changes, and adverse consequences in causal or conditional contexts; prominent themes include events occurring, exceeding boundaries, accumulation, failures, and death. of is especially prominent in phrases describing causes of death. Examples span multiple fields.

patterns.name: Events or states in causal outcomes
patterns.context: The trigger appears in causal, conditional, or process descriptions and highlights an occurrence, attainment, fall, death, or other outcome or state change; it often occurs near the predicate core.
patterns.domain: Academic papers, patent backgrounds, medical surveys and case reports, technical discussions, and forum narratives

patterns.name: Consequences of problems, limitations, or failures
patterns.context: Context first describes a cause, defect, difficulty, or anomaly, followed by an adverse result; examples include model overfitting, light leakage, exceeding the field of view, production difficulties, stuck relays, and death.
patterns.domain: Computer vision papers, patents, gene therapy, electronics repair, medicine, and personal narratives

patterns.name: Quantity or degree reaching an accumulation threshold
patterns.context: A process or object reaches a limit, range, or degree, followed by a numerical value or spatial boundary; this appears explicitly in only a few passages.

patterns.name: Expressions of death and its cause
patterns.context: The verb died is followed by of and a cause of death; activation is concentrated on of across public health statistics, personal accounts, and case reports.
patterns.domain: Public health surveys, online personal narratives, pathology abstracts

6_836.description: 主要对因果或条件语境中的结果、状态变化及不利后果起反应；突出事件发生、超出边界、累积、故障或死亡。死亡原因短语中 of 尤其突出。各例跨多个领域。

patterns.name: 因果结果中的事件或状态
patterns.context: 触发词位于因果、条件或过程描述中，突出发生、达到、落下、死亡等结果或状态变化；常见于谓语核心附近。
patterns.domain: 学术论文、专利背景、医学调查与病例、技术讨论及论坛叙述

patterns.name: 问题、限制或故障后果
patterns.trigger: 「prone»5 to overfit」「suffer»5 from light leakages」「too large … go»10 beyond」「difficult … due»9 to the lack」「stuck»9 on」「died»9 of」
patterns.context: 上下文先述原因、缺陷、困难或异常，再出现不利结果；包括模型过拟合、漏光、超出视野、生产困难、继电器卡住及死亡。
patterns.domain: 计算机视觉论文、专利、基因治疗、电子维修、医学与个人叙述

patterns.name: 量或程度达到累积阈值
patterns.trigger: 「build»10 up to concentrations」「go»10 beyond the field of vision」
patterns.context: 过程或对象达到某个上限、范围或程度，后接数值或空间边界；只在少数段明确出现。

patterns.name: 死亡及其原因的表达
patterns.trigger: 「had died»6 of»9 pregnancy and childbirth related complications」「died»6 of»9 unrelated causes」「has died»5 of»9 melanoma」
patterns.context: 动词 died 后接 of 和死亡原因；激活集中在 of，跨医学统计、个人经历和病例报告。
patterns.domain: 公共卫生调查、网络个人叙述、病理学摘要

en.description: Activations commonly occur in expressions of negative consequences or changes: end up introduces an undesirable outcome, build up describes accumulation, and go beyond indicates exceeding a limit; also appears in contexts explaining how a defect occurs and how someone consequently begins to dislike something.

patterns.name: End up outcome structure
patterns.context: End up introduces an unintended, negative, or undesirable outcome; outcomes include damaging code, getting a poor result, or a page slowing down due to insufficient resources

patterns.name: Gradual accumulation or reaching a level
patterns.context: Describes substances or problems accumulating, concentrations rising, or something exceeding a limit or expectation

patterns.name: Damage, failure, or adverse consequences
patterns.context: Explains that an adverse condition occurs, may occur, or causes an impact due to a cause, defect, or limitation; does not necessarily contain the fixed phrases end up/build up

patterns.name: Outcome reversal with start disliking
patterns.context: The preceding text describes a user becoming frustrated or annoyed, and consequently beginning to dislike an activity

6_836.description: 激活常见于负面后果或变化结果的表达：end up 引出不理想结果，build up 描述累积，go beyond 表示超限；也见于解释缺陷发生及因此开始不喜欢的语境。

patterns.name: end up 后果结构
patterns.trigger: “end”6 后接 “up”9/8，再接结果或负面后果
patterns.context: end up 引出非预期、负面或不理想的结果；结果可以是破坏代码、获得较差成果、资源不足导致页面变慢

patterns.name: 逐渐累积或发展到程度
patterns.context: 描述物质或问题累积、浓度升高，或某事超出限制/预期范围

patterns.name: 损害、失效或不利后果
patterns.trigger: “prone to overfit”中的 “due”10；“inevitably occur”中的 “occur”10；“may go beyond”中的 “go”9
patterns.context: 围绕原因、缺陷或限制，说明某种不利情况发生、可能发生或造成影响；未必含固定短语 end up/build up

patterns.name: start disliking 的结果转折
patterns.context: 前文描述用户受挫或恼火，因而开始不喜欢某项活动

en.description: Strong triggers center on cumulative formation expressions such as “build up” and “form a…”, as well as final outcomes introduced by “end up”; other examples involve events occurring, damage, degree, and sporadic local word activations, without a stable unified pattern.

patterns.name: Gradual accumulation or formation
patterns.context: Something accumulates, forms, or takes on a structure over time, through a process, or from multiple components; includes both explicit “build up” and “form a …”
patterns.domain: Patent technical descriptions, forum discussions, astrophysics

patterns.name: Outcome expressions with end up
patterns.context: “end up” is followed by a final result, state, or experience; often occurs in statements of concern, causality, or consequences

patterns.name: Events occurring or reaching a critical degree
patterns.context: Describes an event occurring, a sudden failure, or a severe outcome; triggers are dispersed, with no shared sentence pattern

patterns.name: Localized damage or adverse outcomes
patterns.context: Mentions damage or an undesired consequence, but shows no clear stable trigger structure shared with the other patterns

patterns.name: Comparisons and degree structures
patterns.context: Local descriptions of degree or comparison; activation is dispersed and may represent a non-dominant pattern

patterns.name: Rare phrases or other insufficiently explained fragments
patterns.context: These local word or tokenization activations show no consistent contextual conditions; they should not be forced into the accumulation or outcome patterns

6_836.description: 强触发集中在“build up”“form a…”等累积形成表达，以及“end up”引出的最终结果；另有事件发生、损害、程度及零散局部词激活，未能归为稳定统一模式。

patterns.name: 逐渐累积或形成
patterns.trigger: «build»5« up»10；«build»2« up»9；«builds»5« up»9« over»6« time；«build»2« up»9« gradually；«form»9
patterns.context: 某物随时间、过程或多个组成部分累积、形成或呈现出结构；既包括明确的“build up”，也包括“form a …”
patterns.domain: 专利技术说明、论坛讨论、天体物理

patterns.name: end up 结果表达
patterns.context: “end up”后接最终出现的结果、状态或遭遇；常见于担忧、因果或后果陈述
patterns.domain: 问答、论坛、网页技术建议

patterns.name: 事件发生或达到临界程度
patterns.context: 描述事件发生、突然失效或达到严重结果；触发分散，缺少共同句式
patterns.domain: 专利技术说明、个人经历

patterns.name: 局部损害或不良结果
patterns.context: 提及损坏或不希望发生的后果，但与其他模式没有明显稳定的共享触发结构

patterns.name: 比较与程度结构
patterns.context: 局部程度或比较性描述，激活分散，可能是非主导模式

patterns.name: 稀有短语或其他未充分解释片段
patterns.context: 这些局部词或分词激活未呈现一致的上下文条件；不宜强行并入累积或结果模式

en.concept: Formation of states and changes in outcomes
en.description: Activations often fall on verb phrases expressing formation, accumulation, progress, or eventual outcomes, especially end up and build up; also covers materials forming droplets, disease worsening, and groups splitting off to establish an organization.

patterns.name: Outcome expressions with end up
patterns.context: The phrase indicates eventually reaching an outcome or state; the two words may be separated by punctuation or intervening text.
patterns.domain: HackerNews, StackExchange; informal narratives and technical help requests

patterns.name: Material formation or dispersion
patterns.context: Liquid crystals are incompatible during polymer curing and form droplets; activations concentrate on the material state change and resulting formation.
patterns.domain: USPTO patent background, materials and liquid crystals

patterns.name: Gradually rising concentration
patterns.context: Carbon dioxide accumulates in a fractionation device until its concentration reaches a certain level.

patterns.name: Gradual accumulation or development
patterns.context: A problem, habit, or deposit gradually forms or accumulates, or occurs in a device; not necessarily literal “upward” movement.
patterns.domain: HackerNews comments and USPTO patent background

patterns.name: Rapid worsening of disease
patterns.context: A disease rapidly progresses from a rash to a severe lesion; activations fall on verbs and prepositions expressing the course of the change.

patterns.name: An organization splits off and is established separately
patterns.context: Members split off from a group and establish a new organization.
patterns.domain: Wikipedia historical and political movement narratives

6_836.description: 激活常落在表示形成、累积、进展或最终结果的动词短语，尤其是 end up 与 build up；也覆盖材料成滴、疾病恶化及团体分裂后成立等语境。

patterns.name: end up 的结果表达
patterns.context: 短语表示最终落入某种结果或状态；两词可被标点或文本间隔分开。

patterns.name: 物质形成或分散
patterns.context: 液晶在聚合物固化过程中不相容并形成液滴；激活集中于材料状态变化及形成结果。
patterns.domain: USPTO 专利背景，材料与液晶

patterns.name: 浓度逐渐升高
patterns.context: 二氧化碳在分馏设备中累积，浓度升至一定水平。
patterns.domain: USPTO 专利背景，气体处理

patterns.name: 逐渐累积或发展
patterns.context: 某种问题、习惯或沉积逐步形成、累积，或在设备中发生；不一定是字面上的“向上”。
patterns.domain: HackerNews 评论与 USPTO 专利背景

patterns.name: 疾病迅速恶化
patterns.context: 病情从皮疹迅速进展为严重病变；激活落在表示变化进程的动词及介词上。

patterns.name: 组织分裂并另行成立
patterns.context: 团体成员分裂出去并成立新组织。
patterns.domain: Wikipedia 历史与政治运动叙述

en.concept: Gradually accumulating or forming a result
en.description: Primarily activates on build up expressions for gradual accumulation or increase, and end up structures expressing a result; in a few examples, activation falls on form or wording describing the formation of a new group after an organizational split.

patterns.name: Phrasal verb build up
patterns.context: Indicates gradual accumulation, increase, or gathering; the object may be a concentration, sugar chain, deposit, sediment, pollutant, or an abstract problem or situation. In segments 1, 2, 4, 7, 8, and 9, the phrase itself or its participial form is a salient trigger; segment 3 instead has «end»…«up».
patterns.domain: Patent technology, medicine, online discussions, everyday life, and social commentary

patterns.name: end up expressing a result
patterns.context: Describes an action or concern ultimately leading to a result; the result may be undesirable or involve damaged code.

patterns.name: form expressing formation
patterns.context: Describes liquid crystals forming droplets during curing; activation falls on the verb expressing this result.
patterns.domain: Patent technology, polymers and liquid-crystal materials

patterns.name: Formation of a new group after an organizational split
patterns.context: In historical accounts, members split from an existing group and form a new organization; the trigger is the process of splitting, separating, and forming.
patterns.domain: Wikipedia accounts of historical and political organizations

6_836.description: 主要对表示逐步累积、增加的 build up 及结果结构 end up 激活；少数例子中，激活落在 form 或组织分裂后形成新团体的表述上。

patterns.name: 短语动词 build up
patterns.context: 表示逐渐积累、增加或聚集；宾语可以是浓度、糖链、存款、沉积物、污染物，也可以是抽象问题或情势。第 1、2、4、7、8、9 段中，词组本身或其分词形式是突出的触发点；第 3 段则是 «end»…«up»。
patterns.domain: 专利技术、医学、网络讨论、生活及社会评论

patterns.name: end up 表示结果
patterns.context: 描述某种行为或担忧最终导致某种结果；结果可以是不理想的结果，也可以是损坏代码。

patterns.name: form 表示形成
patterns.context: 描述液晶在固化过程中形成液滴；激活落在形成这一结果的动词上。
patterns.domain: 专利技术，聚合物与液晶材料

patterns.name: 组织分裂后形成新团体
patterns.context: 历史叙述中，成员从原有团体分出并组成新组织；触发的是分裂、分离和形成的过程。
patterns.domain: 维基百科历史与政治组织叙述

en.description: Most paragraphs activate where an outcome or consequence appears, especially with go, end up, form, build up, and die from/of; specific meanings span accumulation, formation, return, exceeding a boundary, and death, while the paragraph about printhead nozzle clogging has no clear correspondence.

patterns.name: Appearance of an outcome or consequence
patterns.context: Activations often fall on verbs indicating the appearance of an outcome, state, or consequence, introduced by a preceding cause. Triggers are not fixed and include go, end up, form, build up, and die.
patterns.domain: Patent technical descriptions, online discussions, medical papers, Q&A

patterns.name: Accumulation and buildup
patterns.context: A substance or component gradually accumulates in equipment, a medium, or a system; the preceding text usually explains its source or conditions.
patterns.domain: Oil refining and natural gas processing patents

patterns.name: Formation or aggregation into a substance
patterns.context: Describes a structure being produced, dispersed, or formed during a material change.

patterns.name: Failure, damage, or death as an outcome
patterns.context: A negative consequence results from disease, equipment failure, or operational error; high-activation words occur on the outcome or the phrase introducing it.
patterns.domain: Medical papers, personal technical experiences, StackExchange Q&A

patterns.name: Return outcome with go back
patterns.context: Describes a user returning to an old language or previous solution after becoming frustrated; not material accumulation or formation.

patterns.name: Outcome of exceeding a boundary
patterns.context: When a defect is too large, it may exceed the scanning lens's field of view.

6_836.description: 多数段落在结果或后果出现处激活，尤其是 go、end up、form、build up、die from/of；但具体语义跨越累积、形成、返回、越界及死亡等，且印刷头喷嘴堵塞段无明显对应。

patterns.name: 结果或后果的出现
patterns.context: 激活常落在表示某种结果、状态或后果出现的动词上；结果由前文原因引出。触发词并不固定，包含 go、end up、form、build up、die 等。
patterns.domain: 专利技术描述、网络讨论、医学论文、问答

patterns.name: 累积与堆积
patterns.context: 物质或成分在设备、介质或系统中逐渐积累；前文通常说明来源或条件。
patterns.domain: 石油炼制与天然气处理专利

patterns.name: 形成或凝聚成物
patterns.context: 描述材料变化过程中产生、分散或形成某种结构。

patterns.name: 故障、损害或死亡结果
patterns.context: 负面后果由疾病、设备故障或操作失误导致；高激活词落在结果或结果引介短语上。
patterns.domain: 医学论文、个人技术经历、StackExchange 问答

patterns.name: go back 的返回结果
patterns.context: 描述用户受挫后回到旧语言或旧方案；不是物质累积或形成。

patterns.name: 越出范围的结果
patterns.context: 缺陷尺寸过大时，缺陷可能超出扫描镜头视野。

en.description: Activation primarily falls on verbs and particles in resultative or directional phrases: go beyond/back, end up, build up. The medical cause-of-death expression die of/from also occurs, along with a one-off instance of form droplets. The commonality is loose, centering on expressions of results, changes, or accumulation.

patterns.name: go + direction/result
patterns.context: In modal or discursive contexts, go combines with directional/result complements such as beyond or back; activation centers on go

patterns.name: Resultative up
patterns.context: up combines with verbs to express accumulation, reaching a state, or eventual occurrence; especially recurrent in “build up”

patterns.name: Resultative of
patterns.context: In expressions of death outcomes and their causes or diseases, of or the near-synonymous preposition from follows die; strong activation is observed only on of

patterns.name: Forming/producing droplets
patterns.context: A causal description of droplet formation due to polymer curing and liquid-crystal incompatibility

6_836.description: 激活主要落在结果或方向性短语中的动词及小品词：go beyond/back、end up、build up；医学死亡原因表达 die of/from 也出现，另有 form droplets 的孤例。共同点较松散，偏向结果、变化或累积表达。

patterns.name: go + direction/结果
patterns.context: 情态或论述性上下文中，go 与 beyond、back 等方向/结果补语构成短语；激活集中在 go
patterns.domain: 专利技术说明、论坛讨论

patterns.name: 结果性 up
patterns.context: up 与动词组合，表示累积、达到某状态或最终发生；在“build up”中尤其反复出现
patterns.domain: 论坛讨论、专利背景技术

patterns.name: 结果性 of
patterns.context: 死亡结果及其原因/疾病表达中，of 或近义介词 from 紧随 die；仅强激活见于 of

patterns.name: 形成/产生 droplet
patterns.context: 聚合物固化与液晶不相容导致液滴形成的因果描述
patterns.domain: 专利背景技术，材料科学

en.concept: Expressions of change, accumulation, and results
en.description: Strong activation often falls on function words or change verbs in polysemous phrases: the accumulation sense of build up, phrases such as go/end up, and result or change expressions such as develop, form, and die from; the topics span multiple domains.

patterns.name: up/build up (accumulation, increase)
patterns.context: Something gradually accumulates or its concentration rises; segments 1 and 4 directly contain “build up,” while segment 5 has the inflected form “builds up.”
patterns.domain: Patent technical background, involving gas components, refinery deposits, and frost

patterns.name: up (direction or result in verb phrases)
patterns.context: “up” combines with verbs to form phrases expressing a return to an old language, an eventual result, or exceeding a boundary; includes activation within the phrase and in subsequent result expressions.
patterns.domain: Online discussions, web marketing, troubleshooting, and patent texts

patterns.name: develop (appear, form)
