patterns.context: Describes damage gradually appearing in human tissue; activation falls on develop.

patterns.name: form (formation)
patterns.context: Describes liquid crystals forming droplets during polymer curing; activation falls on form.

patterns.name: die from (die of)
patterns.context: Describes cancer patients dying and the cause; activation falls on from.

6_836.description: 强激活多落在多义词组中的功能词或变化动词：build up 的积聚义、go/end up 等短语，以及 develop、form、die from 等结果或变化表达；主题跨领域。

patterns.name: up/build up（聚积、增加）
patterns.trigger: “build up to concentrations”“build up solid deposits”“builds up”
patterns.context: 某物逐步积聚或浓度上升；第1、4段直接出现“build up”，第5段为其变形“builds up”。
patterns.domain: 专利技术背景，涉及气体组分、炼油沉积物和霜

patterns.name: up（动词短语中的方向或结果）
patterns.context: “up”与动词组成短语，分别表示回到旧语言、最终得到某种结果、超出范围；包括词组内部激活及其后续结果表达。
patterns.domain: 网络讨论、网页营销、故障排查及专利文本

patterns.name: develop（出现、形成）
patterns.context: 描述人体组织逐渐出现损伤；激活落在 develop。
patterns.domain: 专利背景中的医学/生物描述

patterns.name: form（形成）
patterns.context: 描述液晶在聚合物固化过程中形成液滴；激活落在 form。
patterns.domain: 专利背景中的材料科学

patterns.name: die from（死于）
patterns.context: 描述癌症患者死亡及其原因；激活落在 from。

en.description: Often responds to predicates and complements indicating outcomes, changes, failures, or accumulation, especially go, die, develop, succumb, form, and build up; spans genres, with some activations on phrasal verbs or result expressions.

patterns.name: Outcome or state change
patterns.context: Describes something or someone entering an outcome, crossing a boundary, failing, dying, or yielding; verbs are often adjacent to complements such as to, from, of, back, and beyond
patterns.domain: Patents, medicine, forums, news commentary, and legal texts

patterns.name: Phrasal verb up
patterns.context: Describes impurities or deposits accumulating in equipment; activation concentrates on up

patterns.name: Concern about causing a worse outcome
patterns.context: First-person expression of concern, with end up introducing an unexpected negative outcome

patterns.name: Outcome introducing droplet formation
patterns.context: Liquid crystals form dispersed droplets after becoming incompatible with the curing polymer

6_836.description: 常响应表示结果、变化、失效或累积的谓语及其补语，尤其 go、die、develop、succumb、form、build up；跨领域文体，部分激活落在短语动词或结果表达上。

patterns.name: 结果或状态变化
patterns.trigger: “become incompatible … form droplets”“may go beyond the field”“die from uncontrolled…”“go back”“die of infections”“develop a tear”“[fell] on deaf ears”“succumb to the disease”
patterns.context: 描述事物或人进入某种结果、越界、失败、死亡或屈服；动词常邻接 to、from、of、back、beyond 等补语
patterns.domain: 专利、医学、论坛、新闻评论及法律文本

patterns.name: 短语动词 up
patterns.context: 描述杂质或沉积物在设备中累积；激活集中在 up

patterns.name: 担心造成更坏后果
patterns.trigger: “afraid … end up breaking my code further”
patterns.context: 第一人称表达担忧，end up 引出意外负面结果

patterns.name: 结果引出 droplet 形成
patterns.context: 液晶与固化聚合物不相容后形成分散液滴

en.description: Activation often falls on expressions of results or change, especially phrasal verbs with up/out and the formation or development of disease or structures; it also appears in contexts involving a shift to coping strategies and negative consequences. However, triggers and domains are sporadic, and some examples are difficult to fit into a unified pattern.

patterns.name: Following particle in phrasal verbs with up
patterns.context: Activation falls on phrasal verbs expressing results, transitions, or emergence, especially particles such as up/out; the forms and meanings of the examples are not fully consistent.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain: technical commentary, code Q&A, sports reporting, patent texts, social commentary

patterns.name: Formation and development of disease or negative outcomes
patterns.context: Describes changes or consequences such as cell metastasis, liquid-crystal droplet formation, patients developing resistance, or blood vessels developing tears.

patterns.name: Shift toward an object or action
patterns.context: A subject turns to a coping strategy because of hardship or dissatisfaction, or reverts to a prior choice.

patterns.name: Expressions of negative states and consequences
patterns.context: Describes setbacks, limited functionality, concerns about damage, or poor performance; activation locations are inconsistent.
patterns.domain: Commentary, medical social research, Q&A, sports reporting

6_836.description: 激活常落在结果或变化表达中，尤其是 up/out 短语动词及疾病、结构形成或发展；也见于转向应对方式和负面后果的语境。但触发词与领域分散，部分例子难以归入统一规律。

patterns.name: 短语动词 up 的后续成分
patterns.context: 激活落在表示结果、转变或出现的短语动词中，尤其是 up/out 一类小品词；例中形式和语义并不完全一致。
patterns.domain: 跨领域：技术评论、代码问答、体育报道、专利文本、社会评论

patterns.name: 疾病或负面结果的形成与发展
patterns.context: 描述细胞转移、液晶形成液滴、患者产生耐受或血管发展出撕裂等变化或后果。
patterns.domain: 生物医学与专利技术文本

patterns.name: 转向某种对象或行为
patterns.context: 主体因困境或不满而转向某种应对方式，或退回原有选择。
patterns.domain: 医学社会研究、技术评论

patterns.name: 负面状态与后果表达
patterns.context: 描述受挫、功能受限、担心破坏或表现不佳；激活位置并不一致。
patterns.domain: 评论、医学社会研究、问答、体育报道

en.description: The most salient pattern is “verb + up” expressing accumulation or a result (build up, end up), also including structures such as develop, form, and go beyond that introduce a subsequent state or change; these occur across domains, without consistent specific meanings.

patterns.name: Result or state after “end up”
patterns.context: A result, action, or state follows “end up”; “go back to” also occurs, meaning a return to an old language.
patterns.domain: Forum conversations, technical support, medical papers

patterns.name: “build up” meaning accumulation
patterns.context: Describes deposits, gas concentrations, or frost accumulating gradually; up is central to the phrase.

patterns.name: “develop” introducing a subsequent change
patterns.context: Disease recurs or patients develop drug resistance; develop is followed by an adverse result or state.

patterns.name: “form” introducing a product
patterns.context: Droplets form during material transformation.

patterns.name: Outside the field of view
patterns.context: A defect is too large and may extend beyond the inspection lens’s field of view.

6_836.description: 最突出的是“动词＋up”表达积聚或结果（build up、end up），也包括 develop、form、go beyond 等引出后续状态或变化的结构；不同领域中均出现，具体语义并不统一。

patterns.name: “end up”后的结果或状态
patterns.context: 在“end up”后接结果、动作或状态；也出现“go back to”表示返回旧语言。
patterns.domain: 论坛对话、技术求助、医学论文

patterns.name: “build up”表示积聚
patterns.context: 描述沉积物、气体浓度或霜逐渐累积，短语中心是 up。

patterns.name: “develop”引出后续变化
patterns.context: 疾病复发或患者产生对药物的耐受；develop 后接不良结果或状态。

patterns.name: “form”引出生成物
patterns.context: 材料变化过程中形成液滴。

patterns.name: 视野边界之外
patterns.context: 缺陷尺寸过大，可能超出检测镜头的视野范围。

en.concept: Expressions of results or state changes
en.description: Activation is distributed across result expressions: up acts as a result complement, while go is followed by a direction or boundary; to, develop, become, and others introduce disease, injury, or other adverse states. Negative consequences worsening also occur. The form droplets example in segment 3 cannot be reliably assigned to these patterns.

patterns.name: “up” as a result complement
patterns.context: Indicates that a process ultimately leads to formation, destruction, or an outcome; verb collocations vary

patterns.name: Directional results of crossing a boundary or returning
patterns.context: go is followed by a directional or range phrase, describing a return to an old state or exceeding a boundary

patterns.name: Suffering adverse consequences or physiological effects
patterns.context: Describes people or body structures developing diseases, resistance, injuries, or similar states; trigger words include succumbing to, develop, and become
patterns.domain: Encyclopedic accounts, medical papers, HackerNews comments, patent background

patterns.name: Leading to deterioration or a more severe outcome
patterns.context: The following text indicates worsening negative effects; strong activation falls on to or the subsequent result expression

6_836.description: 激活分布于结果表达：up 构成结果补语，go 后接方向或边界；to、develop、become 等引出疾病、损伤或其他不良状态，也见负面后果加重。第3段的 form droplets 无法可靠归入这些模式。

patterns.name: “up”作为结果补语
patterns.context: 表示某种过程最终导致形成、破坏或出现结果；动词搭配不同

patterns.name: 越界或退回的方向性结果
patterns.context: go 后接方向或范围短语，描述回到旧状态或超出边界

patterns.name: 受到不良后果或生理影响
patterns.context: 描述人或身体结构发展出疾病、耐受、损伤等状态，触发词包括 succumbing to、develop、become
patterns.domain: 百科、医学论文、HackerNews评论、专利背景

patterns.name: 导致恶化或更严重结果
patterns.context: 后文表示负面影响加重；强激活落在 to 或其后续结果表达上

en.description: Activations are distributed across several patent and technical contexts: accumulation, excess, or mismatch causes deposits, damage, failure, discomfort, exceeding a range, or errors; isolated patterns also include droplet formation in polymers and blood vessel rupture.

patterns.name: Discomfort worsened by an uncomfortable posture
patterns.context: A patient changes posture to avoid a body fold effect, but the body is not properly supported, resulting in increased discomfort.
patterns.domain: Patent background, human support or comfort

patterns.name: Deposit buildup
patterns.context: Impurities in crude oil corrode or accumulate, forming solid deposits that adhere to refinery equipment; also includes gas component concentrations gradually rising.
patterns.domain: Patent background, oil refining and natural gas processing

patterns.name: Risk of process or equipment failure
patterns.context: Abnormal process conditions cause equipment damage or user discomfort, or operational errors damage code; the common theme is adverse consequences or risk of failure.
patterns.domain: Patent background, online discussions, StackExchange technical Q&A

patterns.name: Droplet formation during liquid polymer curing
patterns.context: Liquid crystals are incompatible with solid polymer and form droplets as the polymer changes from liquid to solid.

patterns.name: Vessel or conduit weakening and rupture
patterns.context: Functional blood vessels or conduits in humans or animals weaken, develop aneurysms, or tear.

patterns.name: Defect exceeding the field of view
patterns.context: The scanning lens has a limited field of view, and a defect may exceed it if it is too large.

patterns.name: Error-prone data processing
patterns.context: Associating multiple metrics is time-consuming and prone to errors when handling large amounts of data.
patterns.domain: Patent background, patient monitoring and data processing

6_836.description: 激活分布于多类专利及技术语境：累积、过量或不匹配引发沉积、损伤、故障、不适、超出范围或误差；另有聚合物成滴和血管破裂等孤立模式。

patterns.name: 不适姿势导致不适加剧
patterns.context: 患者为避开身体某处的皱褶效应而改变姿势，身体未获妥善支撑，结果不适加重。
patterns.domain: 专利背景，人体支撑或舒适性

patterns.name: 沉积物积聚
patterns.context: 原油杂质腐蚀或累积，形成固体沉积物并附着于炼油设备；另见气体组分浓度逐渐升高。
patterns.domain: 专利背景，炼油与天然气处理

patterns.name: 过程或设备失效风险
patterns.context: 异常过程条件造成设备损坏、使用者不适，或操作失误造成代码损坏；共同点是负面后果或故障风险。
patterns.domain: 专利背景、在线讨论、StackExchange 技术问答

patterns.name: 液体聚合物固化时形成液滴
patterns.context: 液晶与固态聚合物不相容，在聚合物由液态转为固态时形成液滴。
patterns.domain: 专利背景，材料与聚合物

patterns.name: 血管或管道弱化、破裂
patterns.context: 人体或动物体内的功能性血管、导管发生弱化、动脉瘤或撕裂。

patterns.name: 缺陷超出视野范围
patterns.context: 扫描镜头的视野有限，缺陷尺寸过大时可能超出视野。

patterns.name: 数据处理易出错
patterns.context: 关联多种指标耗时，且面对大量数据时容易出错。
patterns.domain: 专利背景，患者监测与数据处理

en.description: Activation is sporadic across words associated with actions, changes, and adverse consequences, often in contexts of movement, accumulation, exceeding boundaries, mistakes, injury, or damage; however, triggers and sentence structures vary widely across domains, with no single stable phrasal pattern.

patterns.name: Consequences of movement or action results
patterns.context: Describes people or objects moving or changing, or an action leading to a consequence; some triggers are component words of action phrases rather than a single fixed phrase.
patterns.domain: News discussions, patents, legal accounts, and encyclopedic accounts

patterns.name: Risks, damage, and adverse outcomes
patterns.context: Appears near contexts describing errors, bodily injury, danger, malfunctions, or material damage; forms and syntax are not uniform.
patterns.domain: Patents, law, technical Q&A, and narrative texts

patterns.name: Persistence/accumulation of results or states
patterns.context: Often occurs in expressions of state change, accumulation, or result formation, such as “get frustrated” and “build up”; however, these words do not form stable collocations across segments.
patterns.domain: Forum discussions, patents, and technical descriptions

patterns.name: Exceeding a boundary or range
patterns.context: An object extends beyond the field of view; this pattern appears only once.

patterns.name: Fleeing and climbing over obstacles
patterns.context: Narrates a character fleeing across a parking lot and climbing a fence; activation centers on action words.

patterns.name: Concern about causing further damage
patterns.context: The speaker worries that an operational mistake will further damage the code.

patterns.name: Danger expressions in mental illness assessment
patterns.context: Legal text lists the danger of ongoing harm to oneself or others; activation falls on “danger”.

6_836.description: 激活分散于动作、变化及不良后果相关词语，常见于移动、累积、超界、失误、伤害或损坏语境；但触发词和句式多样，跨领域且无单一稳定短语模式。

patterns.name: 运动后果或动作结果
patterns.context: 描述人或物体移动、变化，或某种行为导致后果；部分触发点是动作短语的组成词，而非单一固定短语。
patterns.domain: 新闻讨论、专利、法律叙述及百科叙述

patterns.name: 风险、损害与不良结果
patterns.context: 邻近描述错误、身体伤害、危险、故障或物质损坏的语境；词形和句法不统一。
patterns.domain: 专利、法律、技术问答及叙述文本

patterns.name: 结果或状态持续／累积
patterns.context: 常出现在状态变化、累积或结果形成的表达中，如“get frustrated”“build up”；但这些词在片段间并未形成稳定搭配。
patterns.domain: 论坛讨论、专利及技术说明

patterns.name: 越界或超出范围
patterns.context: 对象超出视野范围；此模式仅见于这一处。

patterns.name: 逃跑及攀越障碍
patterns.context: 叙述人物逃离并跨越停车场、攀爬围栏；激活集中在动作词。

patterns.name: 担忧造成进一步损害
patterns.context: 说话者担心操作失误，结果进一步破坏代码。

patterns.name: 精神疾病评估中的危险表述
patterns.context: 法律文本列举持续伤害自己或他人的危险，激活落在“danger”上。

en.description: Activation often occurs in causal, conditional, and result expressions, especially those followed by negative consequences, risks, or damage; it also covers state development/loss, exceeding limits, corrosion, danger, and narrative actions. Triggers and styles vary widely, and no single clear semantic feature explains all segments.

patterns.name: Result markers in causal or conditional relations
patterns.context: Activation often falls on phrases introducing a result, consequence, or risk, especially to/of followed by a negative outcome; sometimes the result is introduced by may.
patterns.domain: Expository, narrative, and legal texts across domains

patterns.name: Development, change, or failure
patterns.context: Involves a state beginning or gradually forming, or being lost due to changed conditions; also occurs in expressions such as “up to their potential”.
patterns.domain: Narrative, medical abstracts, technical descriptions, and organizational management texts

patterns.name: Exceeding limits and physical damage
patterns.context: Describes an object or process exceeding permitted limits, being damaged, or forming harmful deposits; activation spans adjacent words related to exceeding limits, overheating, and corrosion.

patterns.name: Negative emotions, danger, or adverse outcomes
patterns.context: Involves cold causing death, concerns about causing damage, danger of self-harm or harming others, or treatment being affected by drug resistance.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedic narratives, Q&A, legal, and medical texts

patterns.name: Local connective or collocational activation in expressions
patterns.context: Some activation falls on common grammatical connectives or phrase components, adjacent to a following result, state, or action; the narrower semantic condition is difficult to determine from the local segment alone.

patterns.name: Character behavior and event progression
patterns.context: In narratives, characters flee, begin an action, or run a business; “starts” occurs alongside a hotel startup scenario.

6_836.description: 激活常见于因果、条件及结果表达，尤其后接负面后果、风险或损害；也覆盖状态发展/丧失、超限与腐蚀、危险和叙事行动。触发词和文体跨度较大，尚无单一明确语义特征能解释所有片段。

patterns.name: 因果或条件关系中的结果标记
patterns.trigger: «to»10« the»6« cold»3；«due»2« to»10；«risk»5« of»10；«may»4« go»10；«danger»4« of»9
patterns.context: 激活常落在引出结果、后果或风险的短语上，尤其是 to/of 后接负面结果；有时结果由 may 引出。
patterns.domain: 跨领域说明性、叙事及法律文本

patterns.name: 发展、变化或失效
patterns.context: 涉及某种状态开始、逐渐形成，或因条件变化而丧失；也见于“up to their potential”等表达。
patterns.domain: 叙事、医学摘要、技术说明及组织管理文本

patterns.name: 范围超限与实体损害
patterns.trigger: «too»4« large»1；«go»10« beyond»6« the»2 field；«over»4«heating»3；«severe»5« damage»4；«corro»2«de»2；«build»6« up»9« solid»1« deposits»3
patterns.context: 描述物体或过程超出允许范围、受损，或形成有害沉积；激活覆盖超限、过热及腐蚀等相邻词。

patterns.name: 负面情绪、危险或不良结果
patterns.trigger: «succ»3«umbing»3« to»10« the»6« cold»3；«breaking»5« my»1« code»；«danger»4« of»9« hurting»6；«multidrug»« resistance»3
patterns.context: 涉及寒冷致死、担心造成损害、对自伤或伤人构成危险，或治疗受耐药影响等不利后果。
patterns.domain: 百科叙事、问答、法律、医学

patterns.name: 表达中的局部连接词或固定搭配激活
patterns.context: 部分激活落在常见语法连接或短语组成部分上，紧邻后续的结果、状态或动作；单靠局部片段难以确定更窄的语义条件。

patterns.name: 人物行为与事件推进
patterns.context: 叙事中人物逃离、开始某项行动或经营；「starts」与酒店创业场景同时出现。

en.description: The strongest activation falls on function words expressing direction, change, or results: mostly to, but also go, become, and into. Contexts involve reaching a state, location, or result, though syntax and meaning are not fully consistent.

patterns.name: to in causal or tendency structures
patterns.context: to is followed by errors, systematic bias, harm, cold, or verb phrases related to degree/results; the syntactic functions are not fully identical across examples.
patterns.domain: Various styles, including organizational behavior, patents, academic writing, law, news, and online discussions

patterns.name: go in verb phrases
patterns.context: [2] is “may go beyond the field”; [10] is “go back to their old language”; both express change or movement toward a result/state.

patterns.name: Resultative state verb become
patterns.context: After excessive rotation, the user loses balance or becomes nauseous; activation falls on become.

patterns.name: Resultative preposition into
patterns.context: People fall into a river; activation falls on into, which expresses entering or falling into a resulting location.

6_836.description: 最强激活落在表达趋向、变化或结果的功能词上：多为 to，也包括 go、become、into；上下文涉及到达某种状态、位置或结果，但句法和语义不完全一致。

patterns.name: 原因或倾向结构中的 to
patterns.trigger: «to»10，常见搭配包括“prone to …”“due to …”“go beyond …”“succumbing to …”
patterns.context: to 后接错误、系统性误差、伤害、寒冷，或与程度/结果相关的动词短语；各例句法功能并不完全相同。
patterns.domain: 组织行为、专利、学术、法律、新闻与网络讨论等多种文体

patterns.name: 动词短语中的 go
patterns.context: [2] 是“may go beyond the field”；[10] 是“go back to their old language”，均表示变化或移动到某种结果/状态。

patterns.name: 结果性状态动词 become
patterns.context: 转动过多后用户失去平衡或变得恶心；激活落在 become 上。

patterns.name: 结果性介词 into
patterns.context: 人群落入河中；激活落在表示进入或坠入结果位置的 into 上。

en.description: Activations concentrate on expressions of outcomes and state changes (form, become, go back/beyond, result), as well as error-prone collocations and descriptions of physical discomfort, injury, or exposure to cold; these patterns span technical, patent, and narrative contexts.

patterns.name: Prone to errors
patterns.context: Describes a process or task as prone to errors; error may be countable or uncountable.
patterns.domain: Patent background, measurement and equipment configuration

patterns.name: Formation of an outcome or state
patterns.context: A process causes a state, product, or outcome to form; sometimes become introduces the state after the change.
patterns.domain: Patent technical narratives; also virtual reality experience discussions

patterns.name: Subsequent outcome or direction with go
patterns.context: Go combines with directional or result components such as back and beyond to express returning or exceeding a range.
patterns.domain: Technical discussions; defect detection in patents

patterns.name: Discomfort or bodily injury
patterns.context: Involves physical discomfort or injury such as nausea, abrasions, or exposure to cold.
patterns.domain: User experience, medical care, historical narratives

patterns.name: Action expression with turn
patterns.context: Turning combines with too much to describe excessive movement or turning in virtual reality.

patterns.name: Result-introducing word result
patterns.context: Result is used as a noun to introduce the consequences of a preceding technical change.

6_836.description: 激活集中于结果与状态变化的表达（form、become、go back/beyond、result），也包括易出错搭配及身体不适、受伤或受寒的描述；这些模式跨技术、专利与叙事语境。

patterns.name: 容易发生错误
patterns.context: 描述某个过程或任务容易出错；错误可数或不可数。
patterns.domain: 专利背景技术，测量与设备配置

patterns.name: 结果或状态的形成
patterns.context: 过程导致某种状态、产物或结果形成；有时以 become 引出变化后的状态。
patterns.domain: 专利技术叙述；另有虚拟现实体验讨论

patterns.name: go 的后续结果或方向
patterns.context: go 与 back、beyond 等方向或结果成分搭配，表达返回或超出范围。
patterns.domain: 技术讨论；专利中的缺陷检测

patterns.name: 不适或身体受损
patterns.context: 涉及恶心、擦伤、受寒等身体不适或伤害。
patterns.domain: 用户体验、医疗护理、历史叙述

patterns.name: turn 的动作表达
patterns.context: turning 与 too much 连用，描述虚拟现实中移动或转向过多。

patterns.name: 结果引出词 result
patterns.context: result 作为名词引出前述技术变化的后果。

en.description: Activation often falls near expressions of results or direction: prone to error, go back/beyond, fall into, end up in, and develop/risk/lead to adverse outcomes; there are also sporadic activations on connectives in negative-state expressions.

patterns.name: Prone to errors or adverse outcomes
patterns.context: Describes a method, degree, or system configuration as leading to errors, imbalance, or other adverse outcomes; [1][7] explicitly contain prone to error(s), while [5] describes a risk caused by excessive degree

patterns.name: Subsequent result or movement of go
patterns.context: go or a similar movement/result expression is followed by a direction, boundary, or circumstance; trigger positions vary and do not share a fixed phrase
patterns.domain: Technical forums, patents, historical accounts, legal advice

patterns.name: Developing an adverse state
patterns.context: Describes an action or condition causing, triggering, or leading to an adverse outcome
patterns.domain: Medical papers, patent background, personal accounts

patterns.name: Other local collocations
patterns.context: Local activation falls on expressions involving conjunctions, falling into/entering a situation, and similar constructions; the patterns above do not fully explain them

6_836.description: 激活多落在结果或趋向表达附近：prone to error、go back/beyond、fall into、end up in，以及 develop/risk/lead to 不良后果；也有零散的负面状态连接词激活。

patterns.name: 易出现错误或不良结果
patterns.context: 描述某做法、程度或系统配置会带来错误、失衡等负面后果；[1][7] 明确出现 prone to error(s)，[5] 是程度过大造成的风险

patterns.name: go 的后续结果或移动
patterns.context: go 或相近的移动/结果表达后接方向、边界或处境；触发位置各异，不共享固定短语
patterns.domain: 技术论坛、专利、历史叙述、法律建议

patterns.name: 发展为负面状态
patterns.context: 描述某行动或状况导致、引发或带来不利后果
patterns.domain: 医学论文、专利背景、个人叙述

patterns.name: 其他局部搭配
patterns.context: 局部激活落在并列连接、坠入/进入某处境等表达中，无法由以上模式完全解释
patterns.domain: 论坛、历史叙述、专利背景

en.description: Activations often fall on words for actions, movement, or state transitions, and also occur near risks, predicaments, and negative outcomes; technical texts additionally show risk of errors. Triggers vary across corpora, with spatial movement as only one subpattern.

patterns.name: Go/leave or move somewhere
patterns.context: An event or state changes, especially when a subject leaves, moves, begins acting, or enters an outcome; [1] “go back” returns to an old language, and [2] “go beyond” exceeds a range.
patterns.domain: Forum discussions, patents, news, and encyclopedia narratives

patterns.name: Difficulty, risk, or negative outcome
patterns.context: An adverse situation, danger, loss of control, or undesirable outcome; often linked to an action or state change, but with no single shared fixed trigger.
patterns.domain: Technical descriptions, social issues, and news/encyclopedia narratives

patterns.name: Movement paths and crossing boundaries
patterns.context: Spatial movement, crossing a boundary, or advancing along a path; sometimes literal physical movement and sometimes figurative exceeding of a range.

patterns.name: Highlighted words at outcomes or turning points
patterns.context: A key turning point in an account of an action, risk, or fate; activations fall on different words and cannot be explained by a single word form.

6_836.description: 激活多落在行动、移动或状态转变词上，也常出现在风险、困境和负面结果附近；另有技术文本中的错误风险。跨语料触发词分散，空间移动只是部分子模式。

patterns.name: go/离开或移向某处
patterns.trigger: “go” [1、2]；“moving” [4]；“moved onto” [5]；“starts” [6]；“become” [7]；“attempted to arrest” [8]；“escape by running across … and climbing” [9]；“had fled” [10]
patterns.context: 事件或状态发生转变，尤其是主体离开、移动、开始行动或进入某种结果；[1]“go back”回到旧语言，[2]“go beyond”超出范围。
patterns.domain: 论坛讨论、专利、新闻与百科叙事

patterns.name: 困难、风险或负面结果
patterns.trigger: “frustrated” [1]；“too large” [2]；“prone … to errors” [3]；“risk homelessness” [4]；“fired … machine-guns, killing” [5]；“quarrels” [6]；“lose balance”“become nauseous” [7]；“committed suicide” [8]；“tried to escape” [9]；“succumbing to the cold” [10]
patterns.context: 负面处境、危险、失控或不良结果；常与行动或状态变化相连，但没有一个共同的固定触发词。
patterns.domain: 技术说明、社会议题及新闻/百科叙事

patterns.name: 移动路径与越界
patterns.trigger: “go beyond” [2]；“moved onto” [5]；“turning too much” [7]；“running across … and climbing … fence” [9]；“covered six … miles” [10]
patterns.context: 空间移动、跨越边界或沿路径前进；有时是物理移动，有时是超出范围的比喻。

patterns.name: 结果或转折处的高亮词
patterns.context: 叙述中行动、风险或命运的关键转折处；激活落在不同词上，无法由单一词形解释。

en.description: The most stable pattern is the auth substring: it appears in authentication code, APIs, certificates, and security discussions. There are also activations on specialized term substrings in two biomedical texts and on a webpage title fragment; the relationship of these latter two types to the main pattern is unclear.

patterns.name: auth identifiers
patterns.context: In code identifiers, API/login flows, certificate domains, or discussions of authentication; includes standalone words and compound identifiers.
patterns.domain: Software development, cybersecurity, and technical discussions

patterns.name: Specific subwords in scientific terminology
patterns.context: Appears in specialized terms in biomedical abstracts; activation may relate to a token substring or word form rather than an authentication meaning.

patterns.name: Webpage title and typography fragments
patterns.context: A webpage promotional title is split into uppercase tokens and a date; no auth context or clearly related code pattern is evident.

6_1053.description: 最稳定的模式是 auth 子串：出现在身份验证代码、API、证书及安全讨论中。另有两段生物医学文本的专业词子串激活，以及一段网页标题碎片，后两类与主模式的关系不明。

patterns.name: auth 标识符
patterns.trigger: “auth”，以及拆分 token “auth”10；如“authData”“authType”“auth.company.com”“use JWT auth”“two factor auth”
patterns.context: 在代码标识符、API/登录流程、证书域名或关于身份验证的讨论中；含独立词和复合标识符。
patterns.domain: 软件开发、网络安全与技术讨论

patterns.name: 科学术语中的特定子词
patterns.trigger: “apo”3（apolipoprotein）、“glycos”3（glycosylated）等子词片段；无明确 auth 语义
patterns.context: 出现在生物医学摘要的专业词中，激活可能与 token 子串或词形有关，而非身份验证含义。

patterns.name: 网页标题与排版碎片
patterns.context: 网页宣传标题被拆分成大写 token 与日期；未见 auth 语境或与其明确相连的代码模式。

en.concept: auth terms and heterogeneous high-frequency terminology
en.description: Most fragments mark auth, covering authentication fields, JWTs, certificates, JSON data, two-factor authentication, third-party login, and login code; other heterogeneous activations include medical abstract terminology and educational infographic headlines.

patterns.name: auth terms
patterns.context: Marked across diverse contexts: code identifiers, comments, configuration fields, or authentication-related words in natural language; no specific sentence form is required.
patterns.domain: Code, technical Q&A, and technology discussions

patterns.name: Medical protein-sequence terminology
patterns.context: Biomedical abstracts contain terms related to proteins, amino acid variants, or glycosylation; activation falls on different words, with no auth present.

patterns.name: Educational data headlines
patterns.context: News- or webpage-headline-style text about school district test scores.

6_1053.concept: auth 词项及异质高频术语
6_1053.description: 多数片段标记 auth，涵盖认证字段、JWT、证书、JSON 数据、双因素认证、第三方登录及登录代码；另有医学摘要术语和教育图文标题等异质激活。

patterns.name: auth 词项
patterns.context: 在多种语境中均被标记：代码标识符、注释、配置字段或自然语言中的认证相关词；不要求特定句式。
patterns.domain: 代码、技术问答及科技讨论

patterns.name: 医学蛋白序列术语
patterns.context: 生物医学摘要中出现蛋白质、氨基酸变体或糖基化相关术语；激活具体落在不同词上，未见 auth。

patterns.name: 教育数据标题
patterns.trigger: INTERACTIVE GRAPHIC: Find out how your school district did on the 2017 MCAS
patterns.context: 新闻或网页标题式文本，涉及学区考试成绩。

en.concept: Local word forms and authentication-related vocabulary
en.description: Primarily responds to auth forms related to authentication, especially in code and cybersecurity contexts; it also responds strongly to variant and defective in medical texts and year numbers in educational copy, which the main pattern does not adequately explain.

patterns.name: auth in authentication contexts
patterns.context: Appears in contexts involving APIs, user login/registration, tokens, certificates, third-party authentication, and similar topics; locally may occur in code identifiers, comments, or ordinary text
patterns.domain: Software development and cybersecurity; also forum text discussing authentication services

patterns.name: Defective variants and abnormal phenotypes
patterns.context: Medical papers describing defective protein variants or defective biological responses

patterns.name: Numeric years or test identifiers
patterns.context: Numbers embedded in promotional copy for interactive school district charts and test names

6_1053.concept: 局部词形与认证相关词汇
6_1053.description: 主要响应认证相关的 auth 词形，尤其是代码和网络安全语境；另对医学文本中的 variant、defective 及教育文案中的年份数字有强响应，无法由主模式充分解释。

patterns.name: 认证语境中的 auth
patterns.context: 出现在 API、用户登录/注册、令牌、证书、第三方认证等语境；局部可为代码标识符、注释或普通文本
patterns.domain: 软件开发与网络安全；也包括讨论认证服务的论坛文本

patterns.name: 缺陷变体与异常表型
patterns.context: 医学论文中描述有缺陷的蛋白变体或缺陷性生物学反应

patterns.name: 数字化年份或考试编号
patterns.context: 数字嵌入学校学区互动图表及考试名称的宣传文案中

en.description: Responds strongly primarily to cooling/cooler/cooled and other cooling terms, covering materials, power-generation equipment, and motor cooling in patents, as well as therapeutic cooling and risks in medicine; there are also sporadic triggers for defective, peptides, wildlife, Estonian vaid, and foolish.

patterns.name: Cooling-related terminology
patterns.context: In engineering or medical texts, discussing cooling of materials, equipment, the human body, or systems, and their components, media, effects, or risks; “cooling” strongly activates.

patterns.name: Defective variants and peptide libraries
patterns.context: Biomedical abstracts describing abnormal protein variants or screening peptides from phage-display peptide libraries; these two isolated trigger words have no apparent shared local pattern.

patterns.name: Wildlife
patterns.context: News or webpage text about wildlife habitats, conservation areas, or visitors viewing wildlife; the word itself strongly activates.

patterns.name: Estonian “vaid”
patterns.context: The word appears in an Estonian parliamentary speech excerpt; the context has no apparent connection to other activation excerpts.

patterns.name: “foolish”
patterns.context: A forum text uses “so foolish to accept” to evaluate accepting a task; an isolated word-level trigger.

6_1053.description: 主要对 cooling/cooler/cooled 等降温词强烈响应，覆盖专利中的材料、发电设备和电机冷却，也包括医学中的治疗性降温及风险；另有 defective、peptides、wildlife、爱沙尼语 vaid 和 foolish 等零散触发。

patterns.name: 冷却相关术语
patterns.context: 工程或医学文本中，谈材料、设备、人体或系统的降温过程及其部件、介质、效果或风险；“cooling”均为强激活。

patterns.name: 缺陷变体与肽库
patterns.context: 生物医学摘要中描述异常蛋白变体，或从噬菌体展示肽库中筛选肽；这两个孤立触发词没有明显共同局部模式。

patterns.name: 野生动物
patterns.context: 新闻或网页文本谈到野生动物栖息地、保护区或观赏野生动物的游客；该词直接强激活。

patterns.name: 爱沙尼语“vaid”
patterns.context: 爱沙尼语议会发言片段中出现该词；上下文与其他激活段没有明显联系。

patterns.name: “foolish”
patterns.context: 论坛文本中以“so foolish to accept”评价接受一项任务；孤立词级触发。

en.concept: Activation of specific English subword fragments
en.description: Activation centers on cooling (patented technologies and therapeutic hypothermia) and development (biomedical research and development, physiological or neural development); there is also Fried in the linguistics proper name Friederike. The trigger words and contexts are not consistent.

patterns.name: Technical descriptions of cooling in patents
patterns.context: Patent background paragraphs introduce a device, system, or method with “The [present] invention relates to...”; activation falls on cooling

patterns.name: cooling in medical abstracts
patterns.context: Discusses therapeutic hypothermia, outcomes, or monitoring in cardiac arrest patients

patterns.name: Biomedical uses of development
patterns.context: development refers to vaccine development, biological structures or phylogeny, or physiological measures; no fixed sentence form is required
patterns.domain: NIH research abstracts and PubMed abstracts

patterns.name: development of new therapies
patterns.context: Explains the need to develop new therapies in the context of drug resistance

patterns.name: Fried in a personal name
patterns.context: Appears in the name of a scholar in linguistics text, not with its ordinary English meaning

6_1053.concept: 特定英语词片段的激活
6_1053.description: 激活集中在 cooling（专利技术及低温治疗）和 development（生物医学研发、生理或神经发育）；另有语言学专名 Friederike 中的 Fried。触发词与语境并不统一。

patterns.name: 专利中 cooling 的技术表述
patterns.trigger: “cooling”10；附近有“cooling device”“cooling grate”“cooling medium”，或“cooling”与 turbine、motor 等设备词共现
patterns.context: 专利背景段以“The [present] invention relates to...”引出装置、系统或方法；激活落在 cooling 上

patterns.name: 医学摘要中的 cooling
patterns.context: 讨论心脏骤停患者的治疗性低温、效果或监测

patterns.name: development 的生物医学用法
patterns.trigger: “development”10，分别见“development of a vaccine”“early development of nerve-muscle synapses”“development of the central nervous system”“adrenal development”
patterns.context: development 指疫苗研发、生物结构或系统发育，或生理指标；不要求固定句式
patterns.domain: NIH 研究摘要及 PubMed 摘要

patterns.name: development of new therapies
patterns.context: 说明耐药背景下开发新疗法的必要性
patterns.domain: NIH 生物医学研究摘要

patterns.name: 人名中的 Fried
patterns.context: 出现在语言学文本中的学者姓名，而非普通英语词义

en.description: The most stable trigger is the word wildlife, across news, research, encyclopedias, and biographies; there are also conservation and environmental expressions without this word. Excerpt 10 highlights only development and is difficult to relate to the other patterns.

patterns.name: wildlife lexical trigger
patterns.context: The English word wildlife appears directly; it can function as a noun, modifier, or compound component, with no uniform syntactic-position requirement.
patterns.domain: Various genres, including news, encyclopedias, research abstracts, biographies, and conservation-area descriptions

patterns.name: Nature conservation and wildlife contexts
patterns.context: Discusses wildlife, habitats, conservation, trade, or environmental impacts; some examples do not contain the complete word wildlife.
patterns.domain: Environmental and wildlife conservation, news, and academic texts

patterns.name: Development-related, with no clear corresponding trigger
patterns.context: The excerpt contains neither wildlife nor clearly related wildlife or environmental vocabulary; the provided excerpt is insufficient to determine other contexts.

6_1053.description: 最稳定的触发是单词 wildlife，涵盖新闻、科研、百科和简介等语境；另有非该词面的保护与环境表述。第10段只突出 development，难与其余模式对应。

patterns.name: wildlife 词面触发
patterns.context: 直接出现英文单词 wildlife；可作名词、定语或复合词成分，未见统一的句法位置要求。
patterns.domain: 新闻、百科、科研摘要、人物简介及保护区介绍等多种文体

patterns.name: 自然保护与野生动物语境
patterns.context: 讨论野生动物、栖息地、保护、贸易或环境影响；部分例子没有 wildlife 这个完整词。
patterns.domain: 环境与野生动物保护、新闻及学术文本

patterns.name: 发展相关但无明显对应触发
patterns.context: 片段中未出现 wildlife 或明显相关的野生动物、环境词汇；所给截取内容不足以判断其他上下文。
patterns.domain: 神经发育/生物医学文本

en.description: Primarily sensitive to spectral and its compound terms in academic texts, spanning multiple scientific fields; it also strongly activates the legal formula hereby and wildlife in conservation contexts, which are superficially different from the main pattern.

patterns.name: Spectral terms in scientific contexts
patterns.context: In scientific or mathematical texts, spectral occurs in noun phrases describing spectra, spectral features, spectral estimation, or spectral parameters; no specific discipline is required.
patterns.domain: ArXiv academic papers on infrared optics, nuclear magnetic resonance, particle physics, signal processing, astrophysics, mathematics, and equations

patterns.name: Patent legal formula hereby
patterns.context: Fixed phrasing in legal or formal declarations: paragraph 4 has the grant-of-rights phrase «you hereby grant», and paragraph 8 has the patent citation formula «are hereby incorporated».
patterns.domain: Social media terms of service, patent backgrounds, or legal texts

patterns.name: wildlife in wildlife-related topics
patterns.context: News/quoted text about the African forest elephant trade or conservation, in «wildlife trade initiative».

6_1053.concept: 谱相关术语及正式领域词
6_1053.description: 主要对学术文本中 spectral 及其复合术语敏感，涵盖多种科学领域；另对法律套语 hereby 和保护语境中的 wildlife 有强激活，二者与主模式表面上不同。

patterns.name: 科学语境中的 spectral 系词
patterns.context: 在科学或数学文本中，spectral 出现在名词短语里，描述光谱、谱特征、谱估计或谱参数；不要求具体学科相同。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 学术论文，涉及红外光学、核磁共振、粒子物理、信号处理、天体物理、数学及方程

patterns.name: 专利法律套语 hereby
patterns.context: 法律或正式声明中的固定措辞：第 4 段为授予权利的 «you hereby grant»，第 8 段为专利引用套语 «are hereby incorporated»。
patterns.domain: 社交媒体服务条款、专利背景或法律文本

patterns.name: 野生动物议题中的 wildlife
patterns.context: 关于非洲森林象贸易或保护的新闻/引述文本，位于 «wildlife trade initiative»。
patterns.domain: 环境新闻、野生动物保护

en.description: Activations are scattered across scientific papers, hardware specifications, biomedical abstracts, and metadata; local patterns often involve the ly substring, proper nouns, terms following numbers, or paper-structure words, but no single stable semantic pattern explains them.

patterns.name: ly substring in cross-domain proper nouns
patterns.context: A ly substring appears in fragmented tokens, often at word endings, but not all ly word endings trigger.

patterns.name: Paper-structure markers
patterns.context: Near academic paper metadata, section headings, or the beginning of a section.

patterns.name: Surname or name fragments in personal names
patterns.context: Personal names in author lists, bylines, or contact information; activation is inconsistent.

patterns.name: Numbers and hardware specification lists
patterns.context: When listing processor configurations, execution units, or memory parameters, especially when a number is adjacent to a hardware category name.

patterns.name: Introducing mathematical definitions and results
patterns.context: Mathematical papers introduce a main result and then define objects such as rings and ideals; activations are scattered through sentences.

patterns.name: Drug inhibitor title terms
patterns.context: Titles or abstracts of medicinal chemistry papers comparing branched and linear derivatives.

patterns.name: Domain terminology in scientific texts
patterns.context: Terminology appears in academic discussions of physics, cosmology, or quantum theory.

patterns.name: Medical research-plan wording
patterns.context: When clinical projects or research plans describe phases, patient groups, and research questions.

patterns.name: Kinematics and scaling-relation wording
patterns.context: When discussing scaling relations for rapidity and velocity variables and transitioning to future work.

6_1053.description: 激活分散于科学论文、硬件规格、生物医学摘要及元数据；局部常见于 ly 子串、专名、数字后术语或论文结构词，但无法由单一稳定语义模式解释。

patterns.name: 跨领域专名中的 ly 子串
patterns.context: 片段化 token 中出现拼写 ly 的子串，常位于词尾，但不是所有 ly 词尾都触发

patterns.name: 论文结构标记
patterns.trigger: «title»、«Introduction»、«Future»及其后的标题分隔线或章节文本
patterns.context: 学术论文元数据、章节标题或章节开头附近

patterns.name: 人名中的姓氏或名字片段
patterns.trigger: « Zhang»10；«-»与姓名片段相邻；«D»«oun» 等姓名拼写片段
patterns.context: 作者列表、署名或联系信息中的人名；触发并不稳定

patterns.name: 数字与硬件规格列表
patterns.context: 列举处理器配置、执行单元或内存参数时，尤其数字紧邻硬件类别名

patterns.name: 数学定义与结果引入
patterns.context: 数学论文先引入主要结果，再定义环、理想等对象；触发散布于句中

patterns.name: 药物抑制剂标题术语
patterns.context: 比较分支与线性衍生物的药物化学论文标题或摘要

patterns.name: 科学文本中的领域术语
patterns.context: 术语出现在物理、宇宙学或量子理论的学术叙述中
patterns.domain: 理论物理与宇宙学论文

patterns.name: 医学研究方案措辞
patterns.context: 临床项目或研究计划描述阶段、患者群体及研究问题时

patterns.name: 运动学与尺度关系表述
patterns.context: 讨论快度、速度变量的标度关系并转入未来工作时

en.description: Activations often fall inside tokenized academic vocabulary or at word boundaries, especially in theoretic-related words and several scientific terms; there are also sporadic activations on articles, symbols, and formatting boundaries. The examples do not reduce to a stable semantic category.

patterns.name: Morphological fragments within words
patterns.context: The activated fragment is often a suffix or internal subword fragment in a longer word; complete words include Weakly, theoretic, close-by, underlie, commensurate. Some annotations also involve token-boundary splits.

patterns.name: the/oretic in theory-related words
patterns.context: Occurs at split points in theoretic/theoretical-related words or in the theoretic prefix; however, it triggers only in some instances, and the same letter sequence sometimes does not activate.

patterns.name: Atypical fragments within scientific terminology
patterns.context: Occurs inside complete scientific terms concerning weakly interacting particles, physical properties, or charge-density waves; the triggers do not form a stable, complete-word semantic category.

patterns.name: Local fragments in astrophysics and galaxy contexts
patterns.context: Occurs in phrases related to galaxies, distances, or stellar brightness; the activation fragments are short and do not show a clear semantic feature shared by these astronomical terms.

patterns.name: English spelling fragments and occasional triggers in academic texts
patterns.context: Occurs in the names of mathematical equations and adjacent articles; triggers on K within a word and on articles do not form a clear, consistent pattern.

patterns.name: Sporadic activations adjacent to numbers or symbols
patterns.context: Activations occur near general articles, ordinals, or formula fragments; the given contexts lack a determinable shared trigger condition.
patterns.domain: Number theory, molecular physics, and formula texts

patterns.name: Activations near citation markers and formatting boundaries
patterns.context: Some activations fall near citations, paragraphs, or separators, but these markers occur across excerpts and show no stable formatting-trigger pattern.

6_1053.description: 激活多落在被切分的学术词汇内部或词边界，尤其可见于 theoretic 相关词及若干科学术语；另有冠词、符号和格式边界的零散激活。各例难以归结为稳定语义类别。

patterns.name: 分词内部的构词片段
patterns.context: 激活片段常是较长词中的后缀或内部子词片段，所在完整词包括 Weakly、theoretic、close-by、underlie、commensurate；部分标注还涉及 token 边界切分。

patterns.name: 理论相关词中的 the/oretic
patterns.context: 出现在 theoretic/theoretical 相关词的切分处，或 theoretic 前缀中；但只在部分实例触发，且同一串字母有时并不激活。

patterns.name: 科学术语内部的非典型片段
patterns.context: 出现在完整科学词汇的内部，分别谈弱相互作用粒子、物理性质，或电荷密度波；触发并非完整词级别的稳定语义类别。

patterns.name: 天体物理与星系语境中的局部片段
patterns.context: 处于星系、距离或恒星亮度相关短语中；激活片段短，未显示这些天文学词汇共享的明确语义特征。

patterns.name: 英文拼写片段与学术文本中的偶发触发
patterns.context: 出现在数学方程名称及相邻冠词中；词内 K 与冠词的触发不构成清晰一致的模式。

patterns.name: 数字或符号相邻位置的零散激活
patterns.context: 激活位于一般冠词、序数或公式片段附近；给定上下文中缺少可确定的共同触发条件。
patterns.domain: 数论、分子物理及公式文本

patterns.name: 文献标记及格式边界附近激活
patterns.context: 若干激活落在引用、段落或分隔符附近，但这些标记跨段出现，未表现出稳定的格式触发模式。

en.concept: Word form homogeneously and heterogeneous word fragments
en.description: The most stable word-form cue is homogeneously (including non-homogeneously), alongside an internal fragment in a Latvian word. The remaining activations occur across chemical patents, astrophysics, nuclear physics, electronic structure, and philosophy, with no shared semantics or clear contextual pattern.

patterns.name: Non-homogeneously, homogeneously
patterns.context: A fragment within the adverb homogeneously is highly activated; it appears both in the negative form non-homogeneously and in the affirmative form.

patterns.name: Latvian word-form fragment
patterns.context: An internal fragment of a Latvian word; both samples are from EuroParl, with no apparent semantic connection to English homogeneously.

patterns.name: Palladium and introduction of a chemical formula
patterns.context: Patent background describing a reaction involving palladium and introducing a general formula for isoindoline-boronic acid derivatives.

patterns.name: Astrophysical metallicity terminology
patterns.context: Titles and body text discuss the relationship between iron abundance [Fe/H] and metallicity.

patterns.name: Phase structure and event fluctuations
patterns.context: Discusses the progression from phase structure through σ dynamics to observables, as well as proton-number fluctuations.

patterns.name: Ground-state density and LDA
patterns.context: Discusses electron density, orthogonal subspaces, and ground-state density in the local density approximation.

patterns.name: Dühem and scientific realism
patterns.context: Philosophical discussion of scientific realism and the place of Dühem in related debates.

6_1053.concept: 词形 homogeneously 与异质词片段
6_1053.description: 最稳定的词形线索是 homogeneously（含 non-homogeneously），另有拉脱维亚语词内片段。其余激活散见化学专利、天体物理、核物理、电子结构和哲学，未见共同语义或明确上下文模式。

patterns.name: 非齐次地、同质地
patterns.context: 对副词 homogeneously 的词内片段 highly activated；既出现在 non-homogeneously 的否定形式，也出现在正向形式。
patterns.domain: 跨学科论文及评论性 prose

patterns.name: 拉脱维亚语词形片段
patterns.trigger: 拉脱维亚语中带变音符号、拆分为多个 token 的词形，如 «ī»3«s»3« ar»2（[4]）及 «att»3«ī»2«st»7«ī»4«b»3ā»（[10]）
patterns.context: 拉脱维亚语正文的词内片段；两个样本均来自 EuroParl，未见与英语 homogeneously 的语义联系。
patterns.domain: EuroParl 拉脱维亚语议会文本

patterns.name: 金属钯及化学式引介
patterns.context: 专利背景中描述钯参与的反应，并引出 isoindoline-boronic acid 衍生物的通式。

patterns.name: 天体物理学金属丰度术语
patterns.context: 标题及正文讨论铁丰度 [Fe/H] 与 metallicity 的关系。

patterns.name: 相结构与事件涨落
patterns.context: 讨论从相结构经 σ 动力学到可观测量，以及质子数涨落。

patterns.name: 基态密度与 LDA
patterns.context: 讨论电子密度、正交子空间及局域密度近似中的基态密度。

patterns.name: Dühem 与科学实在论
patterns.context: 哲学讨论科学实在论及 Dühem 在相关争论中的位置。

en.concept: Terms and collocations in scientific texts
en.description: Activations are scattered across physics and scientific texts: prominent examples include flow, glass, and quantum systems/coupling, alongside hemoglobin, odor gases, fixed expressions, and argumentation words. No single trigger pattern covers all excerpts.

patterns.name: Outflow/flow-related words
patterns.context: Flow words occur in a solar-wind physics context or in the instrument name “stopped flow”; split token forms may trigger jointly.

patterns.name: Odors and trace gases
patterns.context: Describes the sensitivity of smell to extremely small quantities of gas; activation falls on degree adverbs and related sentence fragments.

patterns.name: Glassy state/spin glass
patterns.context: Physics discussions include the spin-glass model or liquid-glass transition; activation is mainly on glass.

patterns.name: Quantum systems and environmental coupling
patterns.context: Discusses open quantum systems, quantum observables, or coupling between quantum dots and their physical properties.

patterns.name: Hb variants and comparison
patterns.context: Compares abnormal human hemoglobin variants and their properties, mentioning organophosphates.

patterns.name: state-of-the-art collocation
patterns.context: Describes advanced instruments and equipment proposed for purchase; activation is concentrated on “the” in the fixed expression.

patterns.name: Etymology and linguistic analogy
patterns.context: Explains word cognates and compares several languages, then turns to the science of smell.

patterns.name: Quantifier-like methodological wording
patterns.context: Introduces an analytical method for studying disordered systems and its applications.

patterns.name: General argumentation/inference words
patterns.context: Occurs in inference or conditional descriptions in scientific arguments, without a clear shared topic word.

patterns.name: Analogy between molecules and artificial atoms
patterns.context: Uses tunable coupling in quantum dots to draw an analogy between artificial and natural atoms and molecules.

6_1053.concept: 科学文本中的术语与搭配
6_1053.description: 激活零散分布于物理与科学文本：突出 flow、glass、量子系统/耦合等术语，也出现血红蛋白、气味气体、固定搭配和论证词；未见能覆盖全部段落的单一触发模式。

patterns.name: 流出/流动相关词
patterns.context: 流动词出现在太阳风物理语境，或作为仪器名称“stopped flow”；词件拆分形式可能共同触发。
patterns.domain: 太阳物理、分析仪器说明

patterns.name: 气味与气体痕量
patterns.context: 描述嗅觉对极微量气体的敏感性，激活落在程度副词及其相关句段。

patterns.name: 玻璃态/自旋玻璃
patterns.context: 物理讨论中出现 spin-glass 模型或液体-玻璃转变；激活主要落在 glass。

patterns.name: 量子系统及环境耦合
patterns.context: 讨论开放量子系统、量子可观测量或量子点间耦合及其物理性质。

patterns.name: Hb变体与比较
patterns.context: 比较异常人类血红蛋白变体及其性质，提及有机磷酸盐。

patterns.name: state-of-the-art搭配
patterns.context: 用于描述拟添置的先进仪器设备；激活集中在固定搭配中的“the”。

patterns.name: 词源与语言类比
patterns.context: 说明词语同源关系并比较多种语言，随后转入嗅觉科学。

patterns.name: 量词式方法表述
patterns.context: 介绍一种用于无序系统研究的分析方法及其应用。

patterns.name: 一般论证/推论词
patterns.context: 出现在科学论述的推论或条件描述中，缺少明确的共同主题词。
patterns.domain: 生物医学、量子物理论文

patterns.name: 分子与人工原子类比
patterns.context: 以量子点可调耦合类比人工与天然原子、分子。

en.concept: Local relational words and structural fragments
en.description: Activation shows several local patterns: infinitival to, closer/restricted relations, and code conditions and configuration; there are also paper titles, author citations, and literary character text. Patterns span domains and are not fully consistent; the first passage is nearly blank, making the trigger difficult to determine.

patterns.name: Nearness/proximity relation
patterns.context: Describes objects as closer to one another, or water in a confined space; the first two examples directly express proximity, while the third describes confined water molecules

patterns.name: Infinitive marker to
patterns.context: to precedes a verb in an infinitive construction; sometimes activation falls on to itself

patterns.name: Numeric/time-conditioned code
patterns.context: Code branches on an hour condition and returns a string, then enters a week field

patterns.name: Keys and regex configuration in code
patterns.context: String keys, regular expressions, and comment fields in configuration or serialized objects

patterns.name: Reference or author-name fragments
patterns.context: References, author, or institution information in medical papers; the text is fragmentary

patterns.name: Entities and theoretical terminology in academic text
patterns.context: Specialized papers contain proper names of theories, scales, or diseases; no consistent local syntactic trigger is evident

patterns.name: English literature/character introductions
patterns.context: Narrative passages in literary history or character introductions

6_1053.concept: 局部关系词与结构片段
6_1053.description: 激活呈多种局部模式：to 不定式、closer/受限关系，以及代码条件与配置；另见论文专名、作者引文和文学人物文本。模式跨域且不完全统一，首段近乎空白，难以判定触发原因。

patterns.name: 靠近／接近关系
patterns.context: 描述对象彼此更接近，或水处于受限空间中；前两例直接表达接近，第三例是受限水分子

patterns.name: 不定式标记 to
patterns.trigger: “to”及其后续动词，如“to take”“to evaluate”“to include”“to offer”
patterns.context: 不定式结构中 to 后接动词；有时激活落在 to 本身

patterns.name: 数字／时间条件代码
patterns.context: 代码中按小时条件分支并返回字符串，随后进入 week 字段

patterns.name: 代码中的键名与正则配置
patterns.context: 配置或序列化对象中的字符串键、正则表达式与注释字段

patterns.name: 参考文献或作者姓名片段
patterns.context: 医学论文的参考文献、作者或机构信息，文本呈碎片化

patterns.name: 学术文本中的实体与理论术语
patterns.context: 专业论文中出现理论、量表或疾病专名；未见统一的局部句法触发

patterns.name: 英语文学／人物介绍
patterns.context: 文学史或人物介绍的叙述段落

en.concept: Boundaries and compound strings in structured text
en.description: Activations occur on indentation, brackets, punctuation, and identifiers in code and configuration files, as well as hyphenated proper nouns, repeated words, mathematical symbols, and chemical formulas in papers; the commonality is weak, though some show structural boundaries or fragments within compound strings.

patterns.name: Repeated word fragments and hyphenated compounds
patterns.context: Expressions repeat the same root or are compounds joined by a hyphen or the preposition to; trigger points occur in the repeated roots and connecting parts.
patterns.domain: Scientific papers: environmental research and biology

patterns.name: Indentation and field boundaries in structured code
patterns.context: Near indentation, brackets, quotation marks, and fields in code or JSON-like configurations; specific field contents differ across examples.

patterns.name: Hyphenated compound identifiers
patterns.context: Underscore-connected identifiers in configurations or data objects, especially names of game objects, components, or factions.

patterns.name: Matrices, identity matrices, and powers in mathematical expressions
patterns.context: Near matrix equations, identity matrices, or conditions on values in mathematical formulas.

patterns.name: Proper-name fragments in scientific measurements and spectral-line names
patterns.context: Wavelength measurements, error values, and author/spectral-line proper names in papers; activation is concentrated within proper-name fragments.

patterns.name: Rare proper-name fragments in equation or author names
patterns.context: Hyphenated proper names of equations or research subjects in abstracts; activations are scattered within the names.

patterns.name: Element and oxidation-state markers in chemical formulas
patterns.context: Near element symbols, parentheses, and Roman-numeral oxidation states in complex chemical formulas and descriptions of redox processes.

patterns.name: Formatted strings and regular-expression syntax
patterns.context: Date-format templates or regular expressions within code strings; activation falls on format specifiers, escape characters, and punctuation.

6_1053.concept: 结构化文本中的边界与复合串
6_1053.description: 激活分布在代码与配置的缩进、括号、标点和标识符，以及论文中的连字符专名、重复词、数学符号、化学式等；共同点较弱，部分表现为结构边界或复合串内部片段。

patterns.name: 重复词片段与连字符复合形式
patterns.context: 重复同一词根、由连字符或介词 to 串接的复合表达；触发点落在重复词根及连接部分。
patterns.domain: 科学论文：环境研究与生物学

patterns.name: 结构化代码中的缩进与字段边界
patterns.context: 代码或类 JSON 配置中，缩进、括号、引号及字段附近；不同示例中具体字段内容不同。

patterns.name: 含连字符的复合标识符
patterns.context: 配置或数据对象中的下划线连接标识符，尤其是游戏对象、部件或阵营名称。

patterns.name: 数学表达式中的矩阵、单位矩阵与幂
patterns.context: 数学公式中矩阵等式、恒等矩阵或取值条件附近。

patterns.name: 科学计量与谱线名称中的专名片段
patterns.context: 论文中的波长测量、误差数值及作者/谱线专名；激活集中于专名内部片段。

patterns.name: 方程或作者名中的罕见专名片段
patterns.context: 摘要中以连字符连接的方程或研究对象专名，激活分散在名称内部。
patterns.domain: 非线性波研究论文摘要

patterns.name: 化学式中的元素与氧化态标记
patterns.context: 配合物化学式及氧化还原过程描述中，元素符号、括号和罗马数字氧化态附近。

patterns.name: 格式化字符串与正则表达式语法
patterns.context: 代码字符串内的日期格式模板或正则表达式，激活落在格式符、转义符和标点处。

en.description: Primarily responds to closer/closely, indicating proximity, similarity, or relevance; other activations include left-to-right shunting, code hour and parentheses, room temperature exceeding a range, and sporadic chemical notation and word-symbol activations.

patterns.name: Proximity, closeness
patterns.context: Describes elements, frequencies, search results, or arguments as closer, similar, or related; also includes the repeated comparative structure “closer and closer”.
patterns.domain: Mathematics, patents, online comments, academic discussion

patterns.name: Left-to-right shunting
patterns.context: Patent text describes a left-to-right shunt caused by an arterial duct.

patterns.name: hour in code
patterns.context: Reads or returns an hour variable in JavaScript time-handling logic.

patterns.name: Room temperature and exceeding a range
patterns.context: Describes equipment operation causing room temperature to move outside the comfort range.

patterns.name: Highlight markers and parentheses
patterns.context: Oxidation-state notation for metal complexes in chemical formulas.

patterns.name: Nested code structure
patterns.context: Indentation, closing parentheses, and conditional statements in code; no obvious semantic trigger word.

patterns.name: Sporadic function words and symbols
patterns.context: Marks are scattered across mathematical notation, patent phrasing, and chemical abstracts, with no shared context or stable combination.

6_1053.description: 主要响应 closer/closely，表示接近、相似或相关；另有左向右分流、代码 hour 与括号结构、室温越界，以及若干化学记号和零散词符号激活。

patterns.name: 邻近、接近
patterns.context: 描述元素、频率、搜索结果或论证彼此更接近、相似或相关；也有重复比较结构“closer and closer”。
patterns.domain: 数学、专利、网络评论、学术论述

patterns.name: 左右分流方向
patterns.context: 专利文本中描述动脉导管造成的左向右分流。

patterns.name: 代码中的 hour
patterns.context: JavaScript 时间处理逻辑中读取或返回 hour 变量。

patterns.name: 室温及越界
patterns.context: 描述设备运行导致室温偏离舒适区。

patterns.name: 高亮标记及括号
patterns.context: 化学式中金属配合物的氧化态标记。

patterns.name: 嵌套代码结构
patterns.context: 代码中的缩进、闭合括号及条件语句；未见明显语义触发词。

patterns.name: 零散功能词及符号
patterns.context: 标记分散在数学记号、专利措辞和化学摘要中，缺乏共同上下文或稳定组合。

en.description: Primarily responds to clos(e)-related expressions, especially closer and closely, meaning near, close, or approaching gradually; there are also sporadic strong responses to tokenized fragments of Drinfeld, expressions of wave direction, and first-person terminology.

patterns.name: Approaching, drawing near
patterns.context: Describes objects drawing near each other, gradually approaching a target or state; sometimes includes comparison or a change in degree.
patterns.domain: Mathematical explanations, signal processing, philosophy, historical narratives, online comments

patterns.name: Drinfeld name
patterns.context: The name Drinfeld is split into multiple tokens in academic papers.

patterns.name: Wave propagation and direction
patterns.context: Explains seismic wave types, propagation paths, or direction of motion.

patterns.name: First person and personal sensory states
patterns.context: Discusses arguments appealing to first-person sensory states.

6_1053.description: 主要响应 clos(e) 相关表达，尤其是 closer、closely，表示靠近、接近或逐渐趋近；另对 Drinfeld 的分词片段、波的方向表达及 first-person 术语有零星强响应。

patterns.name: 接近、靠拢
patterns.trigger: « closer»10« together»4；« closely»9；« more»2« closely»8；« closer»8« and»2↵«cl»2«oser»6
patterns.context: 描述对象彼此靠近、逐步接近某目标或状态；有时带比较或程度变化。
patterns.domain: 数学解释、信号处理、哲学、历史叙述、网络评论

patterns.name: Drinfeld 姓名
patterns.context: 姓名 Drinfeld 被拆分成多个 token，出现在学术论文中。

patterns.name: 波的传播与方向
patterns.context: 说明地震波的类型、传播路径或运动方向。
patterns.domain: 专利背景技术、地球物理说明

patterns.name: 第一人称与人称感官状态
patterns.context: 讨论诉诸第一人称感官状态的论证。

en.description: The clearest recurring trigger is closer and expressions of proximity, involving distance, aggregation, or approach; other activations are scattered across patent text on smooth starts, mathematical generalization, fish feed, Estonian parliamentary word forms, and plant toxicity, with no unified semantics evident.

patterns.name: Nearness, convergence, or approach
patterns.context: Describes decreasing distance between objects, numerical convergence, or a gap that can shrink; also includes gradually approaching a state.
patterns.domain: Mathematics, medical research, online discussions, patents

patterns.name: Smooth start and changes in degree
patterns.context: Vehicle drive control enables a smooth start even on low-traction surfaces; “delicately or finely” also appears nearby.

patterns.name: Generalization, proposal, or extension
patterns.context: Introduces generalization relationships between mathematical objects and their proponents, alongside technical wording such as “arbitrary level”.

patterns.name: Fish-feed replacement ratios and effects
patterns.context: Reports the proportion at which a dietary ingredient is replaced with a certain fat and evaluates fish growth, feed efficiency, and fillet composition.

patterns.name: Social security in an Estonian compound word
patterns.context: A compound word related to the social security system appears in Estonian parliamentary text; no clear semantic connection to other patterns is evident.

patterns.name: Estonian parliamentary procedural word form
patterns.context: An Estonian word form in parliamentary speech concerning holding a hearing or addressing an issue; it belongs to the same parliamentary corpus as passage 4 but has a different topic.

patterns.name: Medicinal plant toxicity and constituents
patterns.context: Reviews plant toxicity, traditional uses, and identified major chemical constituents.

6_1053.description: 最明显的重复触发是 closer 及其邻近表达，涉及距离、聚集或趋近；其余激活分散于专利平顺起步、数学推广、鱼类饲料、爱沙尼亚语议会词形和植物毒性等语境，未见统一语义。

patterns.name: 靠近、聚拢或趋近
patterns.trigger: “closer”/“closer together”；“breath-by-breath values to cluster closer to the minimum”；“getting closer and closer to being”；“closer frequency spacing”
patterns.context: 描述对象间距离减小、数值聚集，或间隔可以缩小；也包括逐步趋近某状态。
patterns.domain: 数学、医学研究、网络讨论、专利

patterns.name: 平顺启动与程度变化
patterns.trigger: “smoothly start even on a low-… road”
patterns.context: 车辆驱动控制使车辆在低附着路面也能平稳起步；附近还出现“delicately or finely”。

patterns.name: 一般化、提出或扩展
patterns.trigger: “generalizations of classical Lie algebras”；“were proposed by”
patterns.context: 介绍数学对象的推广关系及其提出者，伴随“arbitrary level”等技术文字。

patterns.name: 鱼类饲料替代比例与影响
patterns.trigger: “up 100% S in diets”；“did not find negative effects”
patterns.context: 报告以某脂肪替代日粮成分的比例，并评估鱼类生长、饲料效率和鱼片成分。

patterns.name: 爱沙尼亚语复合词中的社会保障
patterns.context: 爱沙尼亚语议会文本中出现有关社会保障系统的复合词；未见与其他模式明显的语义联系。
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会文本、爱沙尼亚语

patterns.name: 爱沙尼亚语议会程序词形
patterns.context: 议会发言中关于组织听证会、处理某议题的爱沙尼亚语词形；与第4段同属议会语料，但主题不同。
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会文本、爱沙尼亚语

patterns.name: 药用植物毒性与成分
patterns.context: 综述植物毒性、传统用途及识别出的主要化学成分。

en.concept: Proximity and depth, with sporadic phrase triggers
en.description: Primarily responds to the proximity, approach, or greater alignment with a target state expressed by closer; also appears with the sense of going deeper in deeper inside. Additional sporadic triggers include phrasal verbs, idioms, rhetorical phrases, subword fragments in philosophical terms, and code hide; these cannot be fully grouped into a single semantic pattern.

patterns.name: Comparative/proximity sense of closer
patterns.context: Appears in comparative or approach expressions, indicating that a position, value, or state is closer to an object or boundary; sometimes preceded by change expressions such as get/end up/tendency.
patterns.domain: Expository texts in mathematics, medicine, graphics technology, patents, etc.

patterns.name: Greater depth or entering an interior
patterns.context: Describes investigating a mechanism in depth or entering the interior of something; shares a spatial or scalar image of approach/depth with closer, but is not the same fixed collocation.

patterns.name: Participle in the phrasal verb out of
patterns.context: Appears in running out of in a URL title, meaning resources are about to be depleted; activation is concentrated around out/of in the phrase.

patterns.name: Verb phrase go hand in hand
patterns.context: A fixed idiom meaning that two ideas complement each other; activation falls on the hand side.

patterns.name: Semantically associated words in idioms
patterns.context: Lists paired words or phrases with rhetorical or idiomatic properties; activation is concentrated on some words in these phrases.

patterns.name: Negative tendency or unwillingness
patterns.context: In abstract discussions such as epistemic entrenchment, describes unwillingness to accept counterevidence; the marker falls on a subword fragment in unwillingness.

patterns.name: hide in a Boolean option name
patterns.context: In code comments and field names, hide refers to hiding the built-in help command or flag; hide also appears in ordinary prose, but activation is weaker.

patterns.name: Unclear degree- or change-related use
patterns.context: Describes elements of a Cauchy sequence gradually converging; closer fits the main pattern, but it is unclear whether graduality or convergence itself is an independent trigger.

6_1053.concept: 接近与深入，兼有零散词组触发
6_1053.description: 主要响应 closer 所表达的接近、趋近或更符合目标状态，也见于 deeper inside 的深入义；另有短语动词、习语、修辞词组、哲学词内片段和代码 hide 等零散触发，不能完全归为同一语义模式。

patterns.name: closer 的比较/接近义
patterns.context: 出现在比较或趋近表达中，表示位置、数值或状态更接近某对象或界限；有时前接 get/end up/tendency 等变化表达。
patterns.domain: 数学、医学、图形技术、专利等说明性文本

patterns.name: 程度加深或进入内部
patterns.context: 描述深入研究机制或进入某物内部；与 closer 共享趋近/深入的空间或程度意象，但不是同一固定搭配。

patterns.name: 短语动词 out of 的分词
patterns.context: URL 标题中出现 running out of，表示资源即将耗尽；激活集中在短语的 out/of 附近。

patterns.name: 动词短语 go hand in hand
patterns.context: 固定习语表示两个观念相辅相成；激活落在 hand 一侧。
patterns.domain: 个人发展类访谈或评论

patterns.name: 习语中的语义关联词
patterns.trigger: « cat» and « mouse»、« sick» and « tired»
patterns.context: 列举成对出现、带修辞或习语性质的词组；激活集中在这些词组的部分词项。

patterns.name: 否定倾向或不愿意
patterns.context: 在 epistemic entrenchment 等抽象论述中，描述不愿接受反证；标记落在 unwillingness 的词内部分。

patterns.name: 布尔选项名称中的 hide
patterns.context: 代码注释和字段名中，hide 指隐藏内置 help 命令或标志；另有普通正文中的 hide，但激活较弱。

patterns.name: 程度或变化相关但不明确
patterns.context: 描述 Cauchy 序列元素逐渐聚拢；closer 与主模式相符，但渐进、聚拢本身是否独立触发不清楚。

en.description: Activations are distributed across heterogeneous text: HTML script tags and indentation, code punctuation and configuration fields, comment headers, and contexts near English collocations and technical terms. No stable semantic or syntactic pattern unifies these triggers.

patterns.name: HTML script tags and indentation
patterns.context: Consecutive script tags inserted in HTML/templates, often with indentation or conditional comments

patterns.name: English function words and collocations
patterns.context: Common collocations, degree expressions, or relational expressions in continuous English text; no single fixed trigger word

patterns.name: Punctuation and structural symbols in code
patterns.context: Symbols mixed with identifiers near code, regular expressions, or configuration values

patterns.name: Formatting tokens near highlight markers
patterns.context: A format name appears as a field or tag in key-value configuration content
patterns.domain: Github configuration code, including Khmer text

patterns.name: Measurement terminology in technical text
patterns.context: Activation near terminology and directional expressions in discussions of polymer degradation mechanisms and analytical methods

patterns.name: Code comments and project copyright headers
patterns.context: Explanatory comments or copyright statements at the beginning of source files

6_1053.description: 激活分布在异质文本中：HTML脚本标签与缩进、代码标点和配置字段、注释头，以及英语搭配和专业术语附近。未见足以统一这些触发点的稳定语义或句法模式。

patterns.name: HTML 脚本标签与缩进
patterns.context: HTML/模板中连续插入脚本标签，常伴有缩进或条件注释

patterns.name: 英语中间词及词间搭配
patterns.trigger: 例如 “sick and tired”“closer together”“side by side”中的词，激活集中在相邻词或短语内部
patterns.context: 英语连续文本中出现常见搭配、程度或关系表达；没有单一固定触发词

patterns.name: 编程代码中的标点与结构符号
patterns.trigger: `&`、`&&`、正则表达式斜杠与括号、冒号，以及 `"dmy"` 等代码符号
patterns.context: 代码、正则表达式或配置值附近，符号与标识符混合出现

patterns.name: 高亮标记附近的格式 token
patterns.trigger: `bold`、`italic`及其相邻的制表符、冒号和引号
patterns.context: 键值式配置内容中，格式名称作为字段或标签出现
patterns.domain: Github 配置代码，含高棉文字

patterns.name: 专业文本中的测量术语
patterns.context: 讨论聚合物降解机制及分析方法时，术语和方向性表达附近激活

patterns.name: 代码注释与项目版权头
patterns.trigger: 注释行的 `*`、`//`，以及版权信息中的年份、逗号和姓名
patterns.context: 源文件开头的说明性注释或版权声明

en.description: Activation is distributed across longer/durative expressions, the scalar use of deeper, indentation spaces and markers in code, and specific phrases, proper names, and sporadic code fragments; the trigger forms are not consistent across instances.

patterns.name: Longer duration/continuity
patterns.context: Contrasts a longer, extended, or continuing time/state with its comparison or background; also includes an expression in a song meaning “still alive.”

patterns.name: Scalar use of deeper
patterns.context: Compares the depth of research or analysis into a mechanism; deeper is followed by inside the degradation mechanism.

patterns.name: Whitespace indentation and asterisk markers
patterns.context: Line-leading whitespace, asterisk list markers, and indentation structures in code or marked-up text; multiple very strong activations fall on spaces.

patterns.name: Word in a specific idiom
patterns.context: In the paired idiom “sick and tired,” activation is concentrated on tired, as well as on other rhetorical examples in the passage.

patterns.name: Subword fragment within a taxonomic name
patterns.context: The insect genus name Acupalpus appears in article text and classification labels; activation is distributed across subword fragments of the token.

patterns.name: Other sporadic code and language fragments
patterns.context: Sporadic activations in code identifiers, format strings, and ordinary English phrases, with no shared and stable local trigger condition.

6_1053.description: 激活分布于较长/持续性表达、deeper 的程度用法、代码中的缩进空格与标记，以及特定短语、专名和零散代码片段；各处触发形式并不统一。

patterns.name: 较长时间/持续性
patterns.context: 较长、延续或持续的时间/状态与其比较对象或背景相对照；也包括歌词中“仍然活着”的表达。
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文、宗教歌词

patterns.name: deeper 的程度用法
patterns.context: 比较研究或分析深入机制的程度，deeper 后接 inside the degradation mechanism。

patterns.name: 空白缩进及星号标记
patterns.context: 代码或标记文本中的行首空白、星号列表符号与缩进结构；多个极强激活落在空格上。

patterns.name: 特定惯用短语中的词
patterns.context: 成对惯用表达“sick and tired”中，激活集中在 tired，也有该段其他修辞例词。
patterns.domain: Wikipedia 对修辞手法的说明

patterns.name: 分类名内部子词片段
patterns.context: 昆虫属名 Acupalpus 出现在条目正文及分类标签中，激活分布在被切分的词内片段。

patterns.name: 其余零散代码与语言片段
patterns.context: 代码标识符、格式字符串与普通英文短语中出现的零散激活，没有共同而稳定的局部触发条件。

en.description: Strong activations are scattered across again in literary contexts, longer in patents and several other technical words, copyright comment formatting, and older in medical contexts; no stable semantic pattern explains all fragments.

patterns.name: again in chapter titles or literary contexts
patterns.context: The word again itself is strongly marked in narrative, verse, or table-of-contents-style chapter titles; surrounding content varies widely.

patterns.name: longer for longer duration/interval
patterns.context: The comparative longer modifies term or indicates a longer time span; [8] is followed by the lower-intensity «lower».

patterns.name: Locally strongly marked words in technical text
patterns.context: The words occur in different technical descriptions, involving a connector coming loose, panel structure, and out-of-plane deformation of a frame, respectively; no clear shared semantic or syntactic condition is evident.

patterns.name: Punctuation/formatting tokens in copyright statements
patterns.context: A copyright line in a GitHub file header; activation centers on symbols, year ranges, commas, and other formatting content.

patterns.name: older in medical age descriptions
patterns.context: older modifies maternal age in an academic sentence discussing pregnancy risk factors.

6_1053.description: 强激活分散在文学语境的 again、专利中的 longer 及若干不同技术词、版权注释格式，以及医学语境的 older；未见能统一解释全部片段的稳定语义模式。

patterns.name: again 出现在章节标题或文学语境
patterns.context: 词 again 本身被强标记，出现在叙述、诗句或目录式章节标题中；周围内容差异很大。

patterns.name: 长时程/较长间隔的 longer
patterns.context: 比较级 longer 修饰 term 或表示更长的时间跨度；[8]紧接着还有较低强度的 «lower»。

patterns.name: 技术文本中的局部强标记词
patterns.context: 各词处于不同技术描述中，分别涉及连接器松脱、面板结构、框架平面外变形；没有明显共同的语义或句法条件。

patterns.name: 版权声明中的标点/格式 token
patterns.context: GitHub 文件头的版权行；激活集中在符号、年份范围和逗号等格式内容。

patterns.name: 医学年龄表述中的 older
patterns.context: older 修饰 maternal age，位于讨论孕产风险因素的学术句子中。

en.description: Activation is diffuse: it often appears on sentence-final again (especially for something happening again or no longer happening) and on still meaning a state continues; other instances include distance comparisons, a subword fragment in stillbirth, and local activations in code.

patterns.name: Sentence-final continuation with again
patterns.context: again occurs at the end of a sentence or clause; in [1][2], again itself activates strongly, while [3] has a related “once … still” expression of continuation.
patterns.domain: Literary poetry, narrative prose, literary criticism

patterns.name: Spatial distance comparison
patterns.context: Describes distance groupings or relative spatial position, especially involving thresholds, categories, and distance from an object.

patterns.name: Subword fragment in stillbirth
patterns.context: still is joined with birth in the medical term stillbirth; the activation marker falls within the word.

patterns.name: still indicating a continuing state
patterns.context: still occurs within a sentence to indicate that a state or activity continues, rather than being motionless; appears in contexts involving controlling growth, continuing discussion, or code granting capabilities.
patterns.domain: Business emails, philosophical articles, technical discussions

patterns.name: still at a code-block boundary
patterns.context: A natural-language comment opening remains visible in the code context, but activation falls on return nil; its semantic connection to the clues in other passages is unclear.

patterns.name: Unclear expression of degree of certainty
patterns.context: Discusses how someone's judgment about literary attribution changes over time; “still” does not express its usual sense of continuation.

6_1053.description: 激活较分散：多见于句末 again（尤指再次发生或不再发生），以及 still 表示状态延续；另有距离比较、stillbirth 词内片段和代码中的局部激活。

patterns.name: again 后的终结/延续
patterns.context: again 位于句末或分句收尾处；在[1][2]中 again 本身强激活，在[3]中相近的“once … still”表达延续
patterns.domain: 文学诗歌、叙事散文、文学评论

patterns.name: 空间距离比较
patterns.context: 描述距离分组或相对空间位置，尤其涉及阈值、类别及与某对象的距离

patterns.name: stillbirth 词内片段
patterns.context: still 与 birth 连成医学术语 stillbirth；激活标记落在词内

patterns.name: still 表示持续状态
patterns.context: still 位于句中，表示某种状态或活动继续存在，而非静止；出现在控制增长、持续讨论或代码许可能力的语境
patterns.domain: 商业邮件、哲学文章、技术讨论

patterns.name: still 位于代码块边界
patterns.context: 代码上下文中仍可见自然语言注释起始，但激活落在 return nil；与其他段落的词义线索不明确

patterns.name: 未明确的决定程度表达
patterns.context: 讨论某人对文学归属问题的判断随时间变化；“still”不表示通常的持续状态

en.description: Primarily activates on uses of still indicating that a state or action continues up to a reference point, across various styles; other patterns include and in lists of paired words, copyright years in code, and off in the phrase go off.

patterns.name: still meaning continuing/still to this day
patterns.context: still follows be or another predicate and modifies a subsequent state, action, or process; it indicates that the state continues at the reference point.
patterns.domain: News, encyclopedias, technology discussions, historical and literary prose

patterns.name: and between paired words
patterns.context: Connects two items in coordinated words, phrases, or fixed expressions; the passage contains many lists of paired expressions.

patterns.name: Copyright years in code comments
patterns.context: Appears in the copyright statement of a C-style code comment, marking a copyright year range.

patterns.name: off in the phrasal verb
patterns.context: off combines with go in a phrasal verb, followed by half-cocked, describing research going off course or proceeding rashly and improperly.

6_1053.description: 主要对 still 表示状态或动作持续到参照时点的用法激活，跨多种文体；另有并列词语清单、代码版权年份，以及 go off 短语中的 off 等少数模式。

patterns.name: still 用于表示持续、至今仍然
patterns.context: still 位于 be 或其他谓词之后，修饰后续状态、动作或进程；表示该状态在参照时点仍持续。
patterns.domain: 新闻、百科、科技讨论、历史与文学散文

patterns.name: 成对词语间的 and
patterns.trigger: 反复出现的 «and»，如 «head»«over»«heels»、«Heaven» and «Hell»、«his» and «hers»
patterns.context: 在并列词、短语或固定表达之间连接两项；该段呈现大量并列搭配清单。
patterns.domain: 词语搭配或韵文式清单

patterns.name: 代码注释中的版权年份
patterns.context: 出现在 C 风格代码注释的版权声明中，标记版权年份区间。

patterns.name: 短语动词中的 off
patterns.context: off 与 go 构成短语动词，后接 half-cocked，描述研究偏离方向或仓促失当。

en.description: The main pattern is still in expressions of a continuing state, coexistence, or temporal progression; there is also a separate activation at the attribution position after the year in a code copyright line.

patterns.name: still followed by a predicate/state
patterns.context: still occurs within a clause, indicating that a state continues or coexists with another situation; it can be followed by speaking, keeping, reigning, suffering, on, allowing, thinking, etc.
patterns.domain: Philosophy, business, history, biographies, and general expository prose

patterns.name: Temporal progression in Later still
patterns.context: still follows Later to mean “at an even later time”; this differs from still modifying a continuing state.

patterns.name: Space/attribution position after the year in a copyright line
patterns.context: A code comment's copyright notice has a space and author or organization name after the year; activation is concentrated at this formatting position, with no context related to still.

6_1053.description: 主要模式是 still 出现在持续状态、并存关系或时间递进表达中；另有代码版权行年份后署名位置的独立激活。

patterns.name: still 后接谓语/状态
patterns.context: still 位于分句中，表示某状态持续或与另一情况并存；可后接 speaking、keeping、reigning、suffering、on、allowing、thinking 等。
patterns.domain: 哲学、商业、历史、生平叙述及一般说明文

patterns.name: Later still 的时间递进
patterns.context: still 跟在 Later 后，表示“更晚些时候”；不同于 still 修饰持续状态的用法。

patterns.name: 版权行中年份后的空格/署名位置
patterns.context: 代码注释的版权声明中，年份后出现空格及作者或机构名称；激活集中在该格式位置，未见与 still 相关的上下文。

en.concept: Continuative and progressive uses of still
en.description: All fragments mark still. It usually indicates that a state, activity, or existence continues, and can also express a counterexpectation; in a few uses it modifies a comparative, or is shaped by poetic word order and meter.

patterns.name: still followed by a continuing state or activity
patterns.context: still indicates that a state or activity continues to the present, a given time, or under a given condition; it often occurs between the subject and predicate/state, but also appears sentence-finally or in poetic lines
patterns.domain: Cross-domain narrative, literature, poetry, historical and philosophical texts

patterns.name: still in concessive or counterexpectational relations
patterns.context: A continuing state contrasts with the passage of time, opposing views, or adversity, emphasizing “still the case”

patterns.name: still in degree progression
patterns.context: still modifies the comparative greater, indicating a further increase in degree rather than simple continuation

patterns.name: still in poetic lines and syntactic inversion
patterns.context: In poetry or verse, still appears near a verb because of word order, rhythm, or line-final placement; its primary meaning is still continuative

patterns.name: Possible anomalous segmentation or nonsemantic trigger
patterns.context: The local collocations do not share a salient meaning: diffuse is a parenthetical description, keeping refers to the continuation of business operations, and here is a future time point at which something remains; strong activation may be related to the position or form of still
patterns.domain: Academic introductions, business emails, historical prose

6_1053.concept: still 的延续与递进用法
6_1053.description: 所有片段都标记了 still。它多表示某状态、活动或存在延续，也可表达逆预期；少数用法中修饰比较级，或受诗歌语序与韵律影响。

patterns.name: still 后接持续状态或活动
patterns.trigger: «still»9/10，后接 speaking、keeping、for Sale、the heaviest sleep、be King George's boys、here、diffuse、reigning、living
patterns.context: still 表示某状态或活动延续至今、某时点或某条件下；常出现在主语与谓语/状态之间，也有句末或诗行中的用法
patterns.domain: 跨领域叙述、文学、诗歌、历史与哲学文本

patterns.name: still 与让步、反预期关系
patterns.trigger: «still»10 speaking about quantum paradoxes；«still»9 greater absurdity；«still»9 reigning；«living» still «In spite»
patterns.context: 延续状态与时间流逝、反对意见或逆境形成对照，突出“仍然如此”

patterns.name: 程度递进中的 still
patterns.context: still 修饰比较级 greater，表示程度进一步增加，而非单纯持续

patterns.name: still 出现在诗行及句法倒装中
patterns.context: 诗歌或韵文中，still 因语序、节奏或行末安排置于动词附近；主要仍表示持续

patterns.name: 异常的断词或非语义触发可能
patterns.context: 局部搭配并不突出同一种语义：diffuse 是括号内描述，keeping 表示经营活动持续，here 是未来时间点的存留状态；强激活或与 still 的位置、词形相关
patterns.domain: 学术介绍、商业邮件、历史散文

en.description: Most passages activate in collocations where still indicates continuation or intensification, especially while still describing a continuing state; other uses include still greater, still no idea, would still be, and are still speaking. The code-comment passage shows different formatting and copyright-text features.

patterns.name: Collocations of still with degree/comparative words
patterns.context: “still” indicates a further increase in degree or intensifies the following adjective; passage 1 has “still greater,” while passage 2, though containing “with still no idea,” has a separate semantic collocation in no idea.
