patterns.name: Continuing state in while still
patterns.context: still occurs in a while clause, indicating that a person's identity, state, or activity continues; other words may intervene, as in “while still keeping,” “while still reigning,” and “while still a Westminster schoolboy.”
patterns.domain: Narrative, encyclopedic, business analysis, and technical discussion

patterns.name: Counterfactual/continuative expression with would still be
patterns.context: still occurs between would and be, indicating that a state would continue under a hypothetical condition.

patterns.name: Continuing action in still speaking
patterns.context: still occurs between be and a present participle, modifying an ongoing action.

patterns.name: Documentation markers and copyright text in source code comments
patterns.context: Asterisks at the start of C-style comments, underscore identifiers, copyright parentheses, and years; activation may fall on formatting markers and documentation content, unlike the natural-language use of still.

6_1053.description: 多数段落在 still 表示持续或加强的搭配中激活，尤以 while still 描述某状态持续为主；另有 still greater、still no idea、would still be、are still speaking 等用法。代码注释段呈现不同的格式与版权文本特征。

patterns.name: still 与程度/比较词构成的搭配
patterns.trigger: “still” 后接 “greater” 或与 “still” 相邻
patterns.context: “still”表示程度继续增加，或加强后续形容词；第1段为“still greater”，第2段虽有“with still no idea”，其中 no idea 构成另一语义搭配

patterns.name: while still 持续状态
patterns.context: still 位于 while 从句中，说明某人在某身份、状态或活动持续期间；间隔可含其他词，如“while still keeping”“while still reigning”“while still a Westminster schoolboy”
patterns.domain: 叙事、百科、商业分析及技术讨论

patterns.name: would still be 的反事实/延续表达
patterns.context: still 位于 would 与 be 之间，表示假设条件下某状态仍会持续

patterns.name: still speaking 的持续动作
patterns.context: still 位于 be 与现在分词之间，修饰持续进行的动作

patterns.name: 源代码注释中的文档标记与版权文本
patterns.context: C 风格注释开头的星号、下划线标识符、版权括号和年份；激活可能落在格式标记与文档内容上，与自然语言 still 用法不同

en.concept: Local formatting and postposed structure triggers
en.description: Activations occur most consistently on indented asterisk bullets in source-code license comments; other cases include the discourse connectives again/still and complements following is in academic prose, as well as isolated instances involving company suffixes, JavaScript callbacks, Go type expressions, and gene-regulation statements.

patterns.name: Indented asterisks in license condition lists
patterns.context: Multiline license or copyright text in code comments, with asterisks used as bullets, often indented and introducing terms
patterns.domain: GitHub source code and license comments

patterns.name: Discourse connectives again/still
patterns.context: Connecting preceding and following reasoning in academic discussion, especially again between is and left, and still between it and enhances

patterns.name: Complement position after is
patterns.context: Marked after is, where the complement is delayed or distributed across following structure; examples include “reader is referred” and “one is again left”

patterns.name: Company suffixes in copyright lines
patterns.context: Company names and their legal suffixes in copyright notices

patterns.name: function callbacks in script dependency lists
patterns.context: JavaScript callback function parameters following a require dependency list

patterns.name: Go pointer types and size expressions
patterns.context: Expressions returning unsafe.Pointer and Sizeof near a SockaddrInet4 structure

patterns.name: Up- and down-regulation statements
patterns.context: Research proposals use parentheses to explain that gene expression can be down- or up-regulated

6_1053.concept: 局部格式与后置结构触发
6_1053.description: 激活最一致地出现在源码注释许可证条款的缩进星号项目符号；另见学术文中的again/still衔接及is后补语，并有公司后缀、JavaScript回调、Go类型表达式和基因调控表述等孤例。

patterns.name: 许可证条件列表中的缩进星号
patterns.context: 代码注释中的多行许可证或版权文本，星号作为项目符号，常跟随缩进并引出条款
patterns.domain: GitHub 源码与许可证注释

patterns.name: 再次／仍然的篇章衔接词
patterns.trigger: “«again»”“«still»”；如“one is … again … left”“while it still enhances”
patterns.context: 学术论述中连接前后推理，尤其again位于is与left之间、still位于it与enhances之间

patterns.name: is后的系词补语位置
patterns.context: 标记在is之后，补语被延后或分布于后续结构；样本中包括“reader is referred”和“one is again left”

patterns.name: 版权行中的公司后缀
patterns.context: 版权声明中的公司名称及其法律后缀

patterns.name: 脚本依赖列表中的function回调
patterns.context: require依赖列表之后的JavaScript回调函数参数

patterns.name: Go地址类型与长度表达式
patterns.context: SockaddrInet4结构附近，返回unsafe.Pointer及Sizeof表达式

patterns.name: 上下调控表述
patterns.context: 研究计划用括号说明基因表达可被下调或上调

en.description: All passages contain still, indicating that a state, action, or property continues; most occur in while still structures followed by a verb phrase or an identity noun, with some examples where still directly modifies a verb or adjective.

patterns.name: while still + verb phrase
patterns.context: while introduces a concessive or parallel context, and still indicates that a state or action continues in that context; it may include the negative not or be followed by being.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedic narrative, business commentary, technical discussion, patents, and medical abstracts

patterns.name: while still + identity or state noun
patterns.context: while is followed by still and then an article and identity noun, indicating that the identity remains unchanged when an action occurs.

patterns.name: still + verb
patterns.context: still directly modifies the predicate verb, indicating that an effect remains present under the stated conditions; there is no while here.

patterns.name: still + adjective
patterns.context: still modifies an adjective, indicating that task performance remains robust; there is no while here.

6_1053.description: 所有段都包含 still，表示状态、行为或性质持续存在；多数出现在 while still 结构中，后接动词短语或身份名词，也有 still 直接修饰动词或形容词的例子。

patterns.name: while still + 动词短语
patterns.trigger: «while»…«still» + 动词，如“while still reigning”“while still keeping”“while still not providing”“while still allowing”“while still maintaining”“while still being”
patterns.context: while 引导让步或并行情境，still 表示在该情境下某状态或行为仍然持续；可带否定词 not，也可接 being
patterns.domain: 百科叙述、商业评论、技术讨论、专利和医学摘要

patterns.name: while still + 身份或状态名词
patterns.context: while 后接 still，再接冠词和身份名词，表示某行为发生时身份仍未改变

patterns.name: still + 动词
patterns.context: still 直接修饰谓语动词，表示某作用在所述条件下仍然存在；此处没有 while

patterns.name: still + 形容词
patterns.context: still 修饰形容词，表示任务表现依然稳健；此处没有 while

en.concept: still contexts expressing a persistent state
en.description: Most segments activate in contexts where still denotes a persistent state or property, across diverse genres; other triggers include source-code header formatting, commas, several proper-name fragments, and a few domain-specific terms, which are difficult to explain uniformly.

patterns.name: still followed by a state or conclusion
patterns.context: still indicates that a state, ability, or property continues to hold, commonly in the structure still + verb/participle/adjective; the trigger is not always immediately adjacent to still
patterns.domain: Encyclopedias, email, forums, fiction, academic texts

patterns.name: Separators and copyright years in code comments
patterns.context: File headers in code, including copyright notices, years, or comment-block formatting

patterns.name: Special punctuation: comma
patterns.context: A comma appears mid-sentence, possibly after a list, subordinate clause, or parenthetical; found in diverse unrelated contexts

patterns.name: Specific fragments in names
patterns.context: Local subword fragments in proper names, without an obvious shared meaning or stable syntactic condition

patterns.name: Dollar amounts
patterns.context: Numerical amounts in financial or business narratives

patterns.name: Terms related to noise models and estimation
patterns.context: Technical discussion of model changes, prior estimates, and task performance

6_1053.description: 多数段在 still 表示持续状态或性质的语境中激活，覆盖多种文体；另有源码头部格式、逗号、若干专名片段及少量领域词触发，难以统一解释。

patterns.name: still 后接状态或结论
patterns.context: still 表示某种状态、能力或性质持续存在，常见结构为 still + 动词/分词/形容词；触发位置不总是紧跟 still
patterns.domain: 百科、邮件、论坛、小说、学术文本

patterns.name: 代码注释中的分隔符与版权年份
patterns.context: 代码文件头部，版权声明、年份或注释块格式

patterns.name: 特殊标点逗号
patterns.context: 逗号位于句中，可能出现在列举、从句或插入语之后；见于多种不相关上下文

patterns.name: 姓名中的特定片段
patterns.context: 专名中的局部子词片段，缺少明显共同语义或稳定句法条件

patterns.name: 美元金额表达
patterns.context: 金融或商业叙述中的金额数字

patterns.name: 噪声模型与估计相关术语
patterns.context: 讨论模型变化、先验估计与任务表现的技术论述

en.description: Activations are concentrated mainly in contexts where still expresses a persistent state or continuation despite contrast, often after while/although; repeated activations also occur on asterisks, parentheses, and copyright information at the beginning of C-style copyright comments. Other still examples span different genres.

patterns.name: State persistence or contrast near still
patterns.context: Expresses a continuing state or a result that still holds after while, although, or in a main clause; may also occur with negation. The trigger is not always still itself and often falls in the following context.

patterns.name: Code-comment separators and copyright information
patterns.context: The beginning of a C-style block comment, followed by a copyright year and organization name; activation markers include comment asterisks and parentheses.

patterns.name: while still structure in code descriptions
patterns.context: Describes a language or system retaining some capability while extending or integrating other technologies; this matches the main still-continuation pattern, but the marker falls on while before still.

patterns.name: Political correctness and still-continuing historical counterfactuals
patterns.context: In a counterfactual sentence, still indicates that a historical state would persist to the present if political correctness were followed.
patterns.domain: Political satire or debate in email

6_1053.concept: 持续状态与代码注释标记
6_1053.description: 激活主要集中在 still 表示状态持续或转折性延续的语境，常见于 while/although 后；另对 C 风格版权注释开头的星号、括号及版权信息有反复激活。其余 still 例句各有不同文体。

patterns.name: still 附近的状态延续或转折
patterns.trigger: “still”及其相邻 token（如 [1] “while «still» not”；[2] “would «still» be”；[4] “while «still» reign…”；[5] “while «still» maintaining”；[6] “while «still» keeping”；[7] “although «still» comical”）
patterns.context: 在 while、although 或主句中表示某状态持续、结果仍成立；也可与否定词连用。触发位置不总是 still 本身，常落在其后续语境。
patterns.domain: 跨领域叙述、论述与评论

patterns.name: 代码注释分隔符与版权信息
patterns.context: C 风格块注释的开头，随后出现版权年份和组织名称；激活标记包括注释星号与括号等。

patterns.name: while still 的代码说明结构
patterns.context: 描述语言或系统在扩展、集成其他技术时仍保留某种能力；此例与主模式的 still 延续结构相符，但标记落在 still 之前的 while。
patterns.domain: 技术论坛中的编程讨论

patterns.name: 政治正确性与仍然的历史反事实
patterns.context: 反事实句中 still 表示若遵循政治正确性，某种历史状态至今仍会延续。
patterns.domain: 邮件中的政治讽刺或争辩

en.description: Primarily responds to still, especially while still: a state continues despite a background, contrast, or concessive condition. It also responds to standalone continuing states, still in hypothetical contexts, and a few instances of again and sporadic word fragments.

patterns.name: Combination of still with while
patterns.context: while introduces a background, contrast, or concessive clause, and still indicates that a state remains true during it; followed by a verb or state description.
patterns.domain: Narrative and expository texts across domains

patterns.name: Continuing state
patterns.context: still modifies an ongoing state or action; the context emphasizes that something has not ended.

patterns.name: Emphatic use of still
patterns.context: still indicates that a state would continue under a hypothetical condition; the preceding sentence discusses political correctness and speech.

patterns.name: again indicating recurrence
patterns.context: Describes a result recurring in a calculation or argument, with no clear semantic connection to the neighboring still.

patterns.name: Sporadic highlights in the first passage
patterns.context: Fragments at token boundaries and still in the narrative; the first instances do not form a clear shared phrase.

6_1053.description: 主要响应 still，尤其是 while still：表示某状态在背景、对照或让步条件下仍持续；也响应独立的持续状态、假设中的 still，以及少量 again 和零散词片段。

patterns.name: still 与 while 的组合
patterns.trigger: “while” + «still»，随后描述并存、持续或让步的结果；«while»、«still»在多段中均被标记
patterns.context: while 引出背景、对照或让步从句，still 表示某状态在此期间仍然成立；后接动词或状态描述
patterns.domain: 跨领域的叙述与说明文字

patterns.name: 仍在持续的状态
patterns.context: still 修饰持续中的状态或动作，语境强调某事尚未结束

patterns.name: still 的强调用法
patterns.context: still 表示假设条件下某种状态会继续存在；该句前文谈政治正确与言论

patterns.name: 再次出现 again
patterns.context: 描述计算或论证中重复发生的结果，与相邻 still 无明显语义联系

patterns.name: 首段零散高亮
patterns.context: 分词边界上的片段及叙述中的 still；前几处未构成清晰共同短语

en.description: Most segments emphasize that a result still holds against a background of concession, condition, or possibility (still, would); other cases involve again continuing a result and local activations on paper section separators and code return statements.

patterns.name: Continued validity after a condition or concession
patterns.context: After a concessive or conditional background such as even if/even when/although, emphasizes that a result still holds; also occurs in speculation about counterfactual conditions.

patterns.name: Continuation of a result after again
patterns.context: Describes a process occurring again, then states that it still yields a result; similar to still usage in other segments, but the explicit trigger here is again.

patterns.name: Paper separator and section heading
patterns.context: A long-dash separator and the following section heading appear in the paper body; activation is concentrated at the end of the separator.

patterns.name: Return statement in code
patterns.context: A return statement at the end of a function or code block, preceded by field assignment and followed by a closing brace.

6_1053.description: 多数片段在让步、条件或可能性背景下强调结果仍成立（still、would）；另有 again 延续结果，以及论文分隔标题和代码返回语句的局部激活。

patterns.name: 条件让步后的仍然成立
patterns.trigger: “we'd still”, “would still be”, “you still get”, “is still robust”, “it still enhances”, “she’d be”
patterns.context: 在 even if/even when/although 等让步或条件背景后，强调某结果依然成立；也见于对反事实条件的推测。
patterns.domain: 跨文体：对话、学术论文、评论

patterns.name: again 后的结果延续
patterns.trigger: “again improves … and one is again left with”
patterns.context: 描述某过程再次发生，继而说明仍得到某结果；与其他段的 still 用法相近，但此处显式触发词是 again。

patterns.name: 论文分隔线及章节标题
patterns.context: 长横线分隔符与其后的章节标题出现在论文正文中；激活集中在分隔线末尾。

patterns.name: 代码中的返回语句
patterns.context: 函数或代码块结尾处的 return 语句，前有字段赋值、后有右花括号。

en.description: Most samples activate when still indicates a persistent state; other cases include again indicating repetition, the ing suffix in reigning, code indentation/line breaks, and a few intraword segmentation or punctuation activations, with no unified semantic explanation.

patterns.name: Word-order position of still
patterns.context: In English sentences, still indicates that a state or result persists, commonly placed before be, a verb, or another predicate.

patterns.name: again indicating repetition or continued progress
patterns.context: again appears mid-sentence to indicate repetition or continuation; samples mention the same operation or process earlier.

patterns.name: The participial suffix ing
patterns.context: The root reign and suffix ing span tokens to express continued rule; may co-occur with still.

patterns.name: Indentation and line-break structure in code
patterns.context: Indented statement lines and end-of-line punctuation in code snippets; nearby text may include field assignments and closing braces.

patterns.name: Three-word subword fragment flippases
patterns.context: The biomedical term flippases is split into multiple subword tokens in a discussion of ER lipid transport proteins.

patterns.name: Scattered activations near punctuation and word boundaries
patterns.context: Punctuation, intraword segmentation, and neighboring words co-occur in several different texts; no clear, consistent semantic condition.

6_1053.description: 多数样本在 still 表示状态持续时激活；另有 again 表示重复、reigning 的 ing 后缀，以及代码缩进/换行和少数词内切分或标点激活，未见统一语义解释。

patterns.name: 仍然／依然的词序位置
patterns.trigger: “still”及其后的谓语或补语，如 “still«10» be”、“still«10» reign”、“still«10» get”
patterns.context: 在英语句子中，still 表示某状态或结果持续，常置于 be、动词或其他谓语之前。
patterns.domain: 英语叙述、议论、学术文本

patterns.name: 再次／持续推进的 again
patterns.context: again 位于句中，表示重复或继续发生；样本中前文有相同操作或过程。
patterns.domain: 学术论文，尤其技术论述

patterns.name: 分词后缀 ing
patterns.context: 词根 reign 与后缀 ing 跨 token 表示持续统治；可能与 still 共现。

patterns.name: 代码中的缩进与换行结构
patterns.trigger: 重复的空格、制表符及换行，尤其 “  return«9» ret;”
patterns.context: 代码片段中缩进的语句行及行尾标点；附近可见字段赋值和闭合大括号。

patterns.name: 三词母片段 flippases
patterns.context: 生物医学术语 flippases 被拆成多个子词 token，位于 ER 脂质转运蛋白的讨论中。

patterns.name: 标点与词界附近的离散激活
patterns.trigger: 逗号“,”、“;”及词内子词边界，如 “Charles” 后的逗号、 “Meath” 内部切分
patterns.context: 若干不同文本中，标点、词内切分与邻近词同时出现；没有清楚一致的语义条件。

en.concept: Local morphological and syntactic boundary cues
en.description: Activations are scattered across text types: still be/d after concessive or counterfactual conditions, C++ identifiers and statement boundaries, the words up to, comma, and even, as well as citations, time fields, inspection comments, and literary wording; the patterns are not fully unified.

patterns.name: Participle and “still be/d” structure
patterns.context: A concessive or conditional lead-in (if/even if, negation, or a counterfactual condition) is followed by “still” and a verb such as be/get, emphasizing that the result still holds; in the first two examples activation is concentrated on the auxiliary morpheme «'d»/«’d» and «still be», while the third has «you still».
patterns.domain: Email conversation, astrophysics papers, film reviews, literary criticism

patterns.name: Category-label identifiers in code
patterns.context: In C++ template declarations or typedefs, activation falls on type, label, or category identifiers composed of multiple morphemes.

patterns.name: Semicolons and statement boundaries in code
patterns.context: A code line ends with a semicolon, followed immediately by a line break or closing bracket; this activation occurs in several independent code snippets, but also falls on statement content.

patterns.name: C/C++ member and time-field access
patterns.context: A struct member access operator is used to read or assign an underscored time field, with the field value copied in an adjacent statement.

patterns.name: Restrictions and error checks in code comments
patterns.context: A comment describes error/sanity checks and the maximum number of groups allowed by Solaris; clear punctuation activations also appear near a function call.
patterns.domain: Github C source code and comments

patterns.name: English phrase “up to”
patterns.context: Means “latest” in ordinary paper text (up-to-date), or a numerical limit in code comments (up to 1024); the hyphenation differs.

patterns.name: Comma after numbers and list boundaries
patterns.context: Comma activation is high in mid-sentence contrast/additional information, lists of candidate numbers, and parenthetical or coordinated structures in literary discussion.

patterns.name: Academic citation markers and adjacent separators
patterns.context: Bibliographic citation keys are separated by semicolons and include an @ marker; activation is weak and mainly occurs within citation strings.

patterns.name: General emphasis or concessive wording
patterns.context: Words such as even, if, and not occur in different syntactic environments, but activations are scattered and do not form a stable phrase pattern.
patterns.domain: Scientific papers, literary criticism, narrative prose

patterns.name: Restraint or concealment in narrative text
patterns.context: Prose narration about self-knowledge, hiding secrets, and facing death; the highest activation falls on the less common «fain».

patterns.name: Extraneous opening bracket or fragment
patterns.context: An isolated short fragment or code array declaration appears at a truncated context boundary, without enough information to determine a more specific trigger condition.

patterns.name: Authorization wording in imperative dialogue
patterns.context: In a dialogue criticizing someone's public expression, the wording means “authorized for public consumption”; activation is concentrated on authorized.

6_1053.concept: 局部词形与句法边界线索
6_1053.description: 激活分散于多类文本：让步/反事实条件后的 still be/d，C++ 标识符与语句边界，up to、逗号及 even 等词，还有引文、时间字段、检查注释和文学措辞；各模式并不完全统一。

patterns.name: 分词 and “still be/d”结构
patterns.context: 句中出现让步或条件前置（if/even if、否定或反事实条件）后，接“still”及 be/get 等动词，强调结果仍然成立；前两例中激活集中在助动词词素 «'d»/«’d» 和 «still be»，第三例是 «you still»。
patterns.domain: 邮件对话、天体物理论文、电影评论、文学评论

patterns.name: 代码中的类别标签标识符
patterns.context: C++ 模板声明或 typedef 中，激活落在由多个词素拼成的类型名、标签名或分类标识符上。

patterns.name: 代码中的分号及语句边界
patterns.context: 代码行以分号结束、紧接换行或闭合括号；多个独立代码片段都出现此类激活，但强度也落在语句内容上。

patterns.name: C/C++ 成员和时间字段访问
patterns.context: 通过结构体成员访问运算符读取或赋值带下划线的时间字段，并在相邻语句中复制字段值。

patterns.name: 代码注释中的限制与错误检查
patterns.trigger: «//»2 Check« for»3« error»2« and»2 sanity« check»1；«allow»1« up»6« to»5« 1024»2
patterns.context: 注释说明错误/合理性检查及 Solaris 允许的组数上限；同时函数调用附近有明显标点激活。

patterns.name: 英语词组“up to”
patterns.context: 普通论文文本中表示“最新的”（up-to-date），或代码注释中表示数值上限（up to 1024）；连接符形态不同。

patterns.name: 数字后的逗号及列举边界
patterns.context: 逗号处激活较高，见于句中转折/补充说明、候选人数列举以及文学作品论述中的插入或并列结构。
patterns.domain: 邮件、电影评论、文学评论

patterns.name: 学术引文标记和紧邻分隔符
patterns.context: 文献引用键以分号分隔，并带有 @ 标记；激活较弱，主要出现在引用串中。

patterns.name: 一般性的强调或让步措辞
patterns.context: 在不同句法环境中出现 even、if、not 等强调或让步词，但激活分散，未形成稳定的单一词组模式。
patterns.domain: 科学论文、文学评论、叙述性散文

patterns.name: 叙述文本中的保留或隐瞒
patterns.context: 关于人物自我认识、隐瞒秘密及面对死亡的散文叙述；最高激活落在较少见的 «fain»。

patterns.name: 开头的多余括号或片段
patterns.context: 上下文截断处出现孤立的短片段或代码数组声明，缺少足够信息判断更具体触发条件。

patterns.name: 命令式对话中的授权词
patterns.context: 对话中批评他人公开表达时，用“未经授权供公众接受”的措辞；激活集中在 authorized。
patterns.domain: Enron 邮件中的戏剧化对话

en.concept: Continuing result after a concessive condition
en.description: Primarily responds to structures expressing a continuing result after a concessive or hypothetical condition, especially forms such as still be/get; there are also two types of C++ code identifiers/statements, as well as sporadic colloquial collocations, dialogue wording, and punctuation activations.

patterns.name: still followed by a modal/copula and its complement
patterns.context: In contrastive, concessive, or hypothetical contexts, still indicates that a result remains valid; activation often falls on the following phrase, not just on still.
patterns.domain: Narrative, argumentation, scientific writing, and forum text across domains

patterns.name: Result clause after a counterfactual condition
patterns.context: Describes a result that remains valid after a hypothetical or concessive condition introduced by if/even if; overlaps with the still pattern.
patterns.domain: Argumentation, scientific discussion, literary criticism, entertainment commentary

patterns.name: C++ callback-related identifiers
patterns.context: Class names, template parameters, or type aliases in code; activation covers different tokens within identifiers and cannot simply be classified as the English still pattern.

patterns.name: C/C++ time fields and return statements
patterns.context: Struct field assignments and function return statements; code-token activation differs from the natural-language pattern.

patterns.name: Function words in inverted or unusual word order
patterns.context: Common collocations or descriptions of physical appearance in colloquial disparaging remarks; these collocations do not appear to share a clear trigger condition with the rest of the corpus.

patterns.name: Language of authorization and public expression
patterns.context: Dramatic dialogue about speech, political correctness, and public expression; activation is distributed around phrases and punctuation, with unclear links to other patterns.

patterns.name: Contrastive transition marker
patterns.context: Introduces a contrasting conclusion after a preceding concession or condition; appears in only a few passages and may be related to the concession/result structure, but evidence is limited.

patterns.name: Local activation on prepositions/conjunctions and punctuation
patterns.context: In a Shakespeare review, activation is concentrated on local punctuation and short function words; no independent semantic regularity has been established.

6_1053.concept: 让步条件后的持续结果
6_1053.description: 主要响应让步或假设条件后的持续结果结构，尤以 still be/get 等为显著形式；另有两类 C++ 代码标识符/语句，以及零散口语搭配、对话措辞和标点激活。

patterns.name: still 后接情态/系词及其补语
patterns.trigger: “still”后接“be”“get”或动词短语，如 “still be”“still got”“still get”
patterns.context: 转折、让步或假设语境中，still 表示某种结果依然成立；激活常落在后续词组上，而非仅落在 still 上。
patterns.domain: 跨领域叙述、议论、科学写作及论坛文本

patterns.name: 反事实条件后的结果句
patterns.trigger: “if …, we’d still …”“if …, she’d be …”“even if … would still …”
patterns.context: if/even if 引出的假设或让步条件之后，描述仍然成立的结果；与 still 模式重叠。
patterns.domain: 议论、科学论述、文学评论、娱乐评论

patterns.name: C++ 回调相关标识符
patterns.context: 代码中的类名、模板参数或类型别名；激活覆盖标识符内部不同 token，不能简单归为英语的 still 模式。

patterns.name: C/C++ 时间字段与返回语句
patterns.context: 结构体字段赋值及函数返回语句；代码 token 的激活与自然语言模式不同。
patterns.domain: Github 系统/时间相关代码

patterns.name: 反向或异常语序中的功能词
patterns.trigger: “fall into a rut”“takes a back seat”“got a pencil neck”
patterns.context: 口语化贬评中出现常见搭配或身体外貌描述；未见这些搭配与其余语料共享明确触发条件。

patterns.name: 授权与公共表达用语
patterns.context: 对言论、政治正确及公共表达的戏剧化对话；激活分布在短语及标点附近，和其他模式关联不明。

patterns.name: 对比转折标记
patterns.context: 前述让步或条件后引出对比结论；只在少数段落出现，可能与让步/结果结构相关但证据有限。

patterns.name: 介词/连词及标点的局部激活
patterns.context: 《莎士比亚》评论中，激活集中在局部标点和短功能词；未能确定独立语义规律。

en.description: Activations are scattered across genres, occurring relatively often in continuation expressions such as still/again, clauses after commas, and states or properties introduced by be; other cases cover conditional quantification, code assignment, changes in physical quantities, license ownership, and network bottlenecks, and cannot be reduced to one clear semantic concept.

patterns.name: still / again and contrastive contexts
patterns.context: When stating continuation, counterfactual outcomes, or repeated states, the adverb and following predicate activate strongly; local collocations are not fully consistent.

patterns.name: Clause or parenthetical after a comma
patterns.context: After a mid-sentence comma, a following clause, explanation, or quantification is prominent; the comma itself activates strongly multiple times, but not every comma does so.
patterns.domain: Email, film reviews, medical papers, patent background, physics papers

patterns.name: be with result or property expressions
patterns.context: be is followed by a description of state, qualification, ownership, or property; these examples span different syntactic structures and show no more specific shared semantics.
patterns.domain: Email, entertainment reviews, academic papers, open-source license discussions

patterns.name: Clauses in comparison or quantification conditions
patterns.context: A condition, concession, or degree relation introduces a result; activation occurs near the condition word, quantity, or result expression.

patterns.name: Legal ownership and owner expressions
patterns.context: When discussing license exceptions, a passive construction specifies code ownership and authorship.

patterns.name: Physical quantities and their changes in scientific papers
patterns.context: Discusses how the sensitivity, amplitude, or sign of a quantity is affected by physical factors; activation is concentrated on these relational descriptions.

patterns.name: Property assignment and defaults in code
patterns.context: JavaScript-style code defines a route lookup function and uses logical OR to provide a default empty array.

patterns.name: Costs and bottlenecks in technical systems
patterns.context: Describes the deployment and maintenance costs of video infrastructure and access-link limitations.

6_1053.description: 激活跨文体分散，较常见于 still/again 等延续表达、逗号后的从句，以及 be 引出的状态或属性；另覆盖条件量化、代码赋值、物理量变化、许可归属和网络瓶颈，无法归结为单一明确语义。

patterns.name: still / again 与对比语境
patterns.context: 在陈述延续、反事实结果或重复发生的状态时，副词及其后的谓语获得较强激活；局部搭配并不完全一致。
patterns.domain: 邮件、天体物理、几何物理、评论

patterns.name: 逗号后的从句或插入语
patterns.trigger: 逗号“,”，尤其是随后接“we’d”“she’d”“an OR”等内容（[1][3][6]）；另有“shortcomings,”（[8]）、“amplitude,”（[9]）
patterns.context: 句中逗号之后，后续从句、解释或量化内容较突出；逗号本身多次获得高激活，但并非所有逗号都如此。
patterns.domain: 邮件、影评、医学论文、专利背景、物理论文

patterns.name: be 与结果或属性表达
patterns.trigger: “be authorized”（[1]）、“be up for”（[3]）、“be left with”（[4]）、“be owned by”（[5]）、“be clinically relevant”（[6]）
patterns.context: be 后接状态、资格、归属或性质描述；这些实例跨不同句法结构，未显示更具体的共同语义。
patterns.domain: 邮件、娱乐评论、学术论文、开源许可讨论

patterns.name: 比较或量化条件中的从句
patterns.trigger: “even if … homogeneous”（[2]）、“If there were … nominees”（[3]）、“sample size was large … enough to detect”（[6]）
patterns.context: 以条件、让步或程度关系引出结果；激活出现在条件词、数量或结果表达附近。
patterns.domain: 天体物理、影评、医学论文

patterns.name: 法律归属与所有者表达
patterns.trigger: “owned by the person who wrote it”（[5]）
patterns.context: 讨论许可证例外时，以被动式说明代码归属及作者。

patterns.name: 科学论文中的物理量及其变化
patterns.trigger: “fluctuations … are sensitive … interactions and magnetic field”，以及“their sign is easily changed”（[9]）
patterns.context: 讨论量的敏感性、振幅或符号受物理因素影响；激活集中于这些关系描述。

patterns.name: 代码中的属性赋值与默认值
patterns.context: JavaScript 风格代码中定义路由查找函数，并用逻辑或提供默认空数组。

patterns.name: 技术系统的成本与瓶颈
patterns.context: 描述视频基础设施部署维护成本及接入链路限制。

en.description: Activations are concentrated mainly on still and the following predicate: after a concession, limitation, or contrast, they emphasize that a state, result, or ability still holds. This occurs across genres; a few examples mark nearby pronouns or additive words for uncertain reasons.

patterns.name: still + following judgment or state
patterns.context: After a concession, contrast, or previously mentioned limitation, still introduces a state, ability, result, or defect that continues to hold; in some samples strong activation extends to following words.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain: email, literary criticism, scientific papers, forum discussions, biographies, and fitness articles

patterns.name: Narrative about a person still being so
patterns.context: A biographical passage recounts personal characteristics during a person's life or after death; still is not explicitly present and a pronoun or nearby narrative context may be responsible.

patterns.name: Weak local triggers without still
patterns.context: Semantically similar to common still usage, possibly involving repetition, progression, or continuation, but insufficient to confirm the same trigger pattern.

6_1053.description: 激活主要集中在 still 及其后续谓语：让步、限制或对比之后，强调某状态、结果、能力仍成立。跨多种文体；少数样例标记邻近的人称或递进词，原因不确定。

patterns.name: still + 后续判断或状态
patterns.trigger: “still”及其后的谓语，如 “we'd still be”、“you still get”、“would still be”、“will still be”、“is still able”、“you still wouldn't”、“one still lacks”、“he still got”
patterns.context: 在让步、对比或前述限制之后，still 引出仍然成立的状态、能力、结果或缺陷；部分样例中强激活延伸到后续词。
patterns.domain: 跨领域：邮件、文学评论、科学论文、论坛讨论、传记及健身文章

patterns.name: 仍然如此的人物叙述
patterns.trigger: “he”与“still”出现在描述人物的句子中；[9] 实际标记为 “he”
patterns.context: 传记式段落转述人物生前或死后的个人特征；没有明确出现 still，可能是代词或邻近叙述语境引发。
patterns.domain: 人物传记或信仰主题散文

patterns.name: still 缺席时的局部弱触发
patterns.context: 与 still 的常见语义相近，可能处在反复、递进或延续的表达中，但不足以确认是同一触发模式。

en.description: All segments highlight still, typically linking a subject to a predicate to indicate that a state or result remains valid despite conditions, counterexamples, or changes; a few express continuation or contrastive emphasis. Segment 8 additionally highlights again, which may be related but is weakly supported.

patterns.name: still with a following predicate
patterns.context: In a main or conditional clause, still precedes a verb or predicate to express that a state, result, or ability continues to hold; some examples have subjects such as you/we/I’d/we’d, while others lack an explicit subject.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain; email, books, forum discussions, technology, and academic texts

patterns.name: still in conditional or concessive contexts
patterns.context: A following result still holds even if a condition is met or circumstances change; the conditional phrase is not always immediately adjacent to still.

patterns.name: Continuation or contrast outside conditional contexts
patterns.context: Without an obvious if-condition, expresses continuation of a prior state, added emphasis, or reaffirmation after contrast.

patterns.name: again for repetition or progression
patterns.context: Describes a process occurring again or a result being derived again; does not contain the target word still.

patterns.name: Scattered highlights and syntactic boundaries
patterns.context: These markers are scattered and often co-occur with punctuation, the subject, or adjacent structures in sentences containing still; individually, they do not establish a stable semantic pattern.

6_1053.description: 所有段均突出 still，通常连接主语与谓语，表示即使有条件、反例或变化，某状态或结果仍成立；少数为延续、转折强调。第8段另突出 again，可能相关但证据较弱。

patterns.name: still 与后续谓语
patterns.context: 在主句或条件句中，still 后接动词或谓语，表达某状态、结果或能力持续成立；部分例子有 you/we/I’d/we’d 等主语，另有无显式主语的句式。
patterns.domain: 跨领域；邮件、书籍、论坛讨论、科技与学术文本

patterns.name: still 与条件或让步语境
patterns.trigger: «still» 与 «if»、«even if»、«as long as»、«if» 等条件或让步表达共现
patterns.context: 即使条件成立或情形改变，后续结果仍成立；条件短语不总是紧邻 still。

patterns.name: 非条件语境中的持续或转折
patterns.trigger: «still»，如 «still be King George's boys»、«still got a pencil neck»、«Still, the point is the same»
patterns.context: 没有明显 if 条件，表示延续先前状态、补充强调或转折后重申。
patterns.domain: 邮件、网络评论、论坛讨论

patterns.name: again 与重复或递进
patterns.context: 描述过程再次发生或推导再次得到某结果；不含目标词 still。
patterns.domain: 学术论文，尤其理论物理文本

patterns.name: 零散高亮及句法边界
patterns.trigger: «.»、«!»、«!»后的换行标记，以及 «we»、«you»、«I» 等代词
patterns.context: 这些标记分散出现，常与 still 所在句的标点、主语或相邻结构共现，单独不足以构成稳定语义模式。

en.concept: Continuing result under a concessive condition
en.description: Primarily responds to still in concessive, conditional, or contrastive contexts, emphasizing that a result remains valid or a state continues, especially still be; surface triggers often occur on still and nearby elements, across diverse topics and styles.

patterns.name: still + be / would + still + be
patterns.context: Expresses a continuing state, result, or judgment after a concessive, hypothetical, or counterfactual condition; the most typical form is still be, with occasional still get.
patterns.domain: Narrative, argumentation, and commentary across domains

patterns.name: Concessive condition Even if ... still
patterns.context: First presents a hypothetical or concessive condition, then emphasizes that the result remains valid; still often appears in the main clause.
patterns.domain: Scientific discussion, forum discussions, literary criticism

patterns.name: Contrastive continuation in but ... still
patterns.context: Indicates that a state or conclusion remains valid after a contrast; does not require even if.

patterns.name: Counterfactual continuation in wouldn't ... still
patterns.context: In a hypothetical or counterfactual context, negates an outcome or action while describing another state that would continue.

6_1053.concept: 让步条件下的持续结果
6_1053.description: 主要响应让步、条件或转折语境中强调结果仍成立或状态持续的 still，尤其是 still be；表面触发点多在 still 及其邻近成分，具体主题和文体多样。

patterns.name: still + be / would + still + be
patterns.trigger: “still” followed by “be” (如 “we'd still be”, “would still be”, “you still get”)
patterns.context: 句子表达让步、假设或反事实条件后的持续状态、结果或判断；最典型形式为 still be，偶见 still get。
patterns.domain: 跨领域叙述、论证和评论

patterns.name: 让步条件 Even if ... still
patterns.context: 先提出假设或让步条件，再强调结果仍然成立；该结构中 still 往往出现在主句。
patterns.domain: 科学论述、论坛讨论、文学评论

patterns.name: but ... still 的转折延续
patterns.trigger: “but”及后续“still”：如 “but … faults …” 和 “But we'd still get”
patterns.context: 转折后指出某状态或结论依然成立，不要求出现 even if。

patterns.name: wouldn't ... still 的反事实延续
patterns.trigger: “wouldn't”与“still”：如 “wouldn't … still stand” 和 “wouldn't … I'd still be trying”
patterns.context: 假设或反事实语境中，否定一种结果或行动，同时描述另一种仍会持续的状态。

en.description: Primarily sensitive to still and its following predicate in concessive or contrastive contexts, expressing “despite that, still…”; also activates on code indentation, separators, and field definitions in code or formatting snippets.

patterns.name: still followed by be or a finite verb
patterns.context: Often in concessive or contrastive structures (such as even if, while, or however-like meanings), expressing that a result remains true despite a condition or obstacle; [1] is a modal phrase before “still”
patterns.domain: Cross-domain English prose, papers, forum conversations, and email

patterns.name: Blank lines and code indentation
patterns.context: Appears at indentation in code lines or document layout separators; activation covers whitespace and adjacent punctuation and identifiers

patterns.name: List-style academic keywords
patterns.context: A list of keywords before the introduction, followed by a separator and the “Introduction” heading

patterns.name: Code fields and type definitions
patterns.context: Field assignments, return statements, or type definitions in code; it is not possible to determine whether the trigger is indentation, symbols, or identifiers

6_1053.description: 主要对让步或对比语境中表达“尽管如此仍然……”的 still 及其后续谓语敏感；另在代码缩进、分隔线和字段定义等代码或排版片段中激活。

patterns.name: still 后接 be 或限定动词
patterns.context: 多在让步或对比结构中（如 even if、while、however 含义），表达条件成立或障碍存在时，结果仍然如此；[1]则是“still”前的情态短语
patterns.domain: 跨领域英语散文、论文、论坛对话与邮件

patterns.name: 空白行与代码缩进
patterns.context: 出现在代码行缩进或文档排版分隔处；激活覆盖空白及邻接的标点和标识符

patterns.name: 清单式学术关键词
patterns.trigger: “nucleon polarizabilities, spin polarizabilities, Chiral Perturbation Theory”
patterns.context: 引言前的主题词或关键词列表，后接分隔线与“Introduction”标题

patterns.name: 代码字段与类型定义
patterns.context: 代码中结构体字段赋值、返回语句或类型定义；对触发究竟来自缩进、符号还是标识符无法单独确定

en.description: Most passages activate on still, indicating across contexts that something remains true under a condition or change; there are also a few patterns involving again left with, contrastive but, and code-alignment spaces, with no unified semantic explanation.

patterns.name: Continuative structure with still be
patterns.context: Across different meanings, still indicates that a situation or ability remains true under a condition, counterexpectation, or change; it is usually followed by be/a copula, then a description of the state or result.
patterns.domain: Narrative, argumentation, and expository prose across domains

patterns.name: again left with
patterns.context: again co-occurs with left with to describe obtaining or facing an outcome again after some process.

patterns.name: Concessive contrast with but
patterns.context: but introduces a limitation or contrast to a preceding advantage or evaluation. Activation falls on but, not on the following faults.

patterns.name: Code-formatting spaces
patterns.context: Leading indentation and field-alignment spaces in code or structured text; nearby are typedef and side category/tag identifiers.

6_1053.description: 多数段落在 still 后激活，跨语境表示条件或变化下仍成立；另有 again left with、but 转折及代码对齐空格等少数模式，未见统一语义解释。

patterns.name: still be 延续结构
patterns.context: 不同语义中，still 表示某种情形或能力在条件、反预期或变化下仍然成立；通常后接 be/系词，后面继续说明状态或结果。
patterns.domain: 跨领域叙述、论证与说明文

patterns.name: again left with
patterns.context: again 与 left with 连用，描述经过某种过程后再次得到或面临某结果。

patterns.name: but 让步转折
patterns.context: but 引出对前述优点或评价的限制、转折。激活落在 but，而不是其后的 faults。

patterns.name: 代码排版空格
patterns.context: 代码或结构化文本中，行首缩进及字段对齐的空格；附近是 typedef 与 side category/tag 标识符。

en.concept: Local word forms and numeric fragments
en.description: Activation does not reflect a single semantic theme: salient points include 207 in numbers, the tokenized form of Chromatin, possessive apostrophes, and the appet stem. The rest is scattered across emails, legal formatting, math problems, sports lists, and academic text, with no clear unifying pattern.

patterns.name: 207 in numbers and text
patterns.context: The substring 207 appears in digit strings; not all occurrences are equally strong, and surrounding number formats vary.

patterns.name: Chromatin word form
patterns.context: Chromatin is split into multiple subword tokens; it appears in statements about structural research or titles of detection methods.

patterns.name: Possessive marker with apostrophe
patterns.context: The apostrophe occurs in possessive forms following plural nouns or names, such as Girls', Boys'.

patterns.name: appet in food words
patterns.context: Appears in the stem of appetites or appetizers, referring respectively to desire and a menu category.

patterns.name: Document and email formatting fragments
patterns.context: Paragraph 1 contains a citation and web-archive formatting; paragraph 2 is an email request with line breaks, paraphrased options, and a fax number. Activation is scattered, with no clear common trigger.

patterns.name: Math question-and-answer template
patterns.context: Questions pose a number-theoretic judgment or unit conversion in a short question, followed by an answer; strong activation is concentrated mainly on numeric fragments, while template words activate weakly.

patterns.name: Academic paper citation and terminology
patterns.context: The physics paper body discusses matrix-element effects and contains reference markers; activation points are scattered, and shared features with other fragments are unclear.

patterns.name: Line-separated menu items
patterns.context: A list of food names separated by blank lines; some words are split into multiple tokens. There is a limited lexical connection to the appet stem in paragraph 6.

patterns.name: Years and event lists
patterns.context: Events and years are listed by gender and sport; apart from the numeric substring also present in paragraph 1, there is no clear common trigger.

6_1317.concept: 局部词形与数字片段
6_1317.description: 激活并非单一语义主题：显著点包括数字中的207、Chromatin拆分词形、所有格撇号及appet词干；其余分散于邮件、法律格式、数学题、体育列表和学术文本，统一规律不明显。

patterns.name: 数字与文本中的 207
patterns.context: 在数字串中出现子串 207；并非每个出现都同样强，周围数字格式不一。

patterns.name: Chromatin 词形
patterns.context: Chromatin 被拆分为多个子词 token；出现在结构研究陈述或检测方法标题中。

patterns.name: 含撇号的所有格标记
patterns.context: 撇号位于复数或名词后的所有格形式中，如 Girls'、Boys'。
patterns.domain: 维基百科式体育项目列表

patterns.name: 食物词中的 appet
patterns.context: 出现在 appetites 或 appetizers 的词干部分，分别涉及欲望和菜单类别。

patterns.name: 文档与邮件格式片段
patterns.context: 第1段包含引文与网页存档格式；第2段是邮件请求，含换行、转述选项及传真号码。激活分散，缺少明确共同触发项。

patterns.name: 数学问答模板
patterns.context: 题目以简短问句提出数论判断或单位换算，后接答案；明显激活主要集中在数字片段，模板词激活较弱。

patterns.name: 学术论文引文与术语
patterns.context: 物理学论文正文讨论矩阵元效应并含参考文献标记；激活点分散，和其他片段的共享特征不明确。

patterns.name: 分行的菜单品项
patterns.context: 空行分隔的食品名称列表，部分词被拆成多个 token；与段6的 appet 词干有有限词汇联系。

patterns.name: 年份与赛事清单
patterns.context: 按性别和运动项目列出赛事及年份；除第1段也出现的数字子串外，无明显共同触发。

en.description: Activation examples are heterogeneous: Chromatin is repeatedly prominent, while the rest are scattered across numeric strings, split word fragments, email numbers, math problems, menus, sports lists, and terms from different styles, with no single stable trigger pattern.

patterns.name: Hyphen-Connected Word Fragments
patterns.context: In legal opinions, labels or terms split by hyphens appear before a colon; it is unclear whether fragments such as “-Pre” trigger activation.

patterns.name: Numeric Strings in Email Requests
patterns.context: A business email asks the recipient to send a file and provides a fax number; activation is concentrated on a segment of the number.

patterns.name: Chromatin String
patterns.context: Chromatin appears in a biomedical context: one passage concerns its structure, and another is a ChIP assay title.

patterns.name: Numbers and Arithmetic Problems
patterns.context: A math exercise contains numeric strings; [5] asks about factors/multiples, and [10] is a unit-conversion problem. The specific highlighted numbers may be coincidental.

patterns.name: Negation or Concession and appetite
patterns.context: Prose discusses habits, civilization, self-restraint, and desire; activation is scattered across several words, with no single stable trigger.

patterns.name: Physics Terms and Citation Numbers
patterns.context: A sentence from a condensed-matter physics paper and its reference marker; highlights are distributed across terms and citation numbers.

patterns.name: Possessive Apostrophes and Sports Lists
patterns.context: A list of intercollegiate sports organized by gender and year; apostrophes mark possession.

patterns.name: Word Fragments in Food Names
patterns.context: A menu or food catalog with entries such as muffins, biscuits, and dips; activation falls on food-word fragments and a fragment of appetizers.

6_1317.concept: 异质词片与数字模式
6_1317.description: 激活样例异质：重复突出 Chromatin；其余分散于数字串、拆分词片、邮件号码、数学题、菜单、体育列表和不同文体词项，尚无统一稳定触发规律。

patterns.name: 连字符接续的词项片段
patterns.context: 法律判决文本中，冒号前有被连字符拆分的标签或词项；是否触发于“-Pre”一类片段不确定。

patterns.name: 邮件请求中的数字串
patterns.context: 商务邮件请求对方发送文件，并给出传真号码；激活集中在号码的一段数字。

patterns.name: Chromatin 字符串
patterns.context: 生物医学语境中出现 Chromatin；一段是关于其结构的句子，另一段是 ChIP 检测标题。

patterns.name: 数字与算术题项
patterns.context: 数学练习中出现数字串；[5]为因数/倍数判断，[10]为单位换算问题。具体高亮数字可能只是偶合。

patterns.name: 否定或让步表达及 appetite
patterns.context: 散文讨论习惯、文明、自我克制与欲望；激活分散在若干词上，未见单一稳定触发项。

patterns.name: 物理学术语与引文数字
patterns.context: 凝聚态物理论文句子及参考文献标记；高亮分布在术语和引文编号。

patterns.name: 所有格撇号与体育列表
patterns.context: 按性别列出的校际体育项目及年份清单；撇号标记所有格。

patterns.name: 食物名称中的词片
patterns.context: 菜单或食品目录，含松饼、饼干、蘸酱等条目；激活落在食物词片及 appetizers 的词片上。

en.concept: Cross-Domain Word Fragments and Formatting Features
en.description: Activation is scattered across subword fragments in chromatin and various biomedical terms, title/abstract openings, and numeric and identifier fragments. It also appears in math true/false questions, business emails, and literary discussions of ethics; there is no single stable semantic theme.

patterns.name: Internal Fragments of Chromatin
patterns.context: The English word chromatin is split into multiple subword tokens; examples include terminology headings and body text.

patterns.name: Specific Numeric Fragments
patterns.context: After tokenization, 207 appears as an internal fragment in both a fax number and an integer in a math problem.

patterns.name: Opening Words of Titles or Labels
patterns.context: The opening of a title, abstract label, or story title; activation falls on subword fragments and may be followed by a line break or body text.
patterns.domain: Legal text, medical abstracts, story titles

patterns.name: Numeric Year and Adjacent Title Formatting
patterns.context: Appears in the heading of a legal opinion, adjacent to a line break and the title text “Decisions”.

patterns.name: Numeric Suffix Fragment
patterns.context: Embedded in a space-grouped phone number, near the end of a fax number.

patterns.name: Literary Moral Self-Restraint
patterns.context: “gratification of appetites” is contrasted with disregard for others; activation falls on an internal fragment of appetites.

patterns.name: Numeric Fragment in a Reference Identifier
patterns.context: Embedded in a PhysRev.Lett. citation identifier as part of a paper number.

patterns.name: Subword Fragments in Biomedical Words
patterns.context: Appears at the beginning of an abstract sentence describing the protective effects of shrimp carotenoids on the developing rat cerebral cortex.

patterns.name: Math Operation Terms and Q&A Format
patterns.context: A sequence of true/false questions checks factor or multiple relationships for integers, with numbers and line breaks.

patterns.name: Polite Wording in Formal Requests
patterns.context: Requests that the recipient send a file by email or fax, using polite business-email phrasing.

patterns.name: Treatment Context in a Medical Abstract
patterns.context: The abstract opening describes patients with severe pancreatitis and a lack of response to conventional treatment.

6_1317.concept: 多领域词片段与格式特征
6_1317.description: 激活分散于 chromatin 及多种生物医学词的分词片段、标题/摘要开头、数字与编号片段，也见数学真假问答、商务邮件和文学伦理论述；没有单一稳定的语义主题。

patterns.name: Chromatin 词形内部片段
patterns.context: 英语中 chromatin 一词被切分成多个子词 token；包括术语标题和正文。

patterns.name: 数字中的特定数字片段
patterns.context: 数字串被分词后，207 作为内部片段出现；分别处于传真号码和数学题中的整数。

patterns.name: 句首标题或标签
patterns.context: 标题、摘要标签或故事标题开头，触发落在词语的分词片段上；标题后可接换行或正文。
patterns.domain: 法律文本、医学摘要、故事标题

patterns.name: 数字年份及其相邻标题格式
patterns.context: 出现在法律意见标题中，邻接换行和“Decisions”等标题文字。

patterns.name: 数字后缀片段
patterns.context: 嵌在带空格分组的电话号码中，位于传真号码末尾附近。

patterns.name: 文学中的道德自我克制
patterns.context: “gratification of appetites”与不顾他人相对照；激活落在 appetites 的词内片段。

patterns.name: 文献标识中的数字片段
patterns.context: 嵌在 PhysRev.Lett. 引文标识中，作为论文编号的一部分。
patterns.domain: 物理学论文及参考文献

patterns.name: 生物医学词语的分词片段
patterns.context: 出现在摘要句首，描述虾类类胡萝卜素对发育中大鼠脑皮层的保护作用。

patterns.name: 数学运算词与问答格式
patterns.context: 连续的真假问答中检查整数因数或倍数关系，伴随数字和换行。

patterns.name: 正式请求中的礼貌表达
patterns.context: 请求对方通过邮件或传真发送文件，使用商务邮件礼貌措辞。

patterns.name: 医学摘要中的治疗背景
patterns.trigger: “patients with severe pancreatitis refractory to medical…”
patterns.context: 摘要开头描述重症胰腺炎患者及对常规治疗无效的情况。

en.description: Activation is concentrated on several word-initial fragments: Chromatin, New, Dauphin, and the year 2001 in a legal title. Most fragments have word-initial or token-boundary characteristics, but their semantics and domains are not consistent.

patterns.name: “Dauphin” across tokens
patterns.context: Tokenization forms the proper name “Dauphin Island”, followed by “Ghost Stories”; the same paragraph also repeats Da up.

patterns.name: Chromatin terms
patterns.context: Tokens combine to form “Chromatin”, appearing in a sentence about chromatin structural regulation or a ChIP assay title.

patterns.name: Year and legal title
patterns.context: A numeric year appears in title-like text, “Opinions of the United … Decisions”.

patterns.name: Words or phrases beginning with New
patterns.context: “New” appears at the beginning of various titles, sentences, or phrases, followed by varied content; examples include Newborn, New antimicrobials, and New molecular information.

6_1317.concept: 词语/片段起始
6_1317.description: 激活集中在若干词语起始片段：Chromatin、New、Dauphin，以及法律标题中的年份 2001。多数片段有词首或分词边界特征，但语义和领域并不统一。

patterns.name: “Dauphin”跨 token 片段
patterns.context: 分词 token 拼成专名“Dauphin Island”，后文为“Ghost Stories”；同一段还重复出现 Da up。

patterns.name: 染色质词语
patterns.context: token 连成“Chromatin”，出现在染色质结构调控的句子或 ChIP assay 标题中。

patterns.name: 年份及法律标题
patterns.context: 数字年份出现在“Opinions of the United … Decisions”标题式文本中。

patterns.name: New 开头的词语或短语
patterns.trigger: «New»（分别接 “port”“born”“ antimicrobials”“ molecular information”“ patient-reported outcome measure”“ research”）
patterns.context: “New”位于多种标题、句子或短语开头，后续内容各异；包括 Newborn、New antimicrobials、New molecular information 等。
patterns.domain: 跨领域；网页文本及生物医学文本

en.description: Activation occurs in short words, proper names, and internal fragments of technical terms in headings and entries, as well as include directives and directory paths in code. It spans multiple styles, with no unified semantic trigger condition.

patterns.name: Short Words or Punctuation in Document Titles
patterns.context: Short words in titles, headers, or standalone entries, near title boundaries, line breaks, or parentheses; activation sometimes falls on an internal subword fragment.
patterns.domain: Legal text, web entries, date headings, beverage recipes

patterns.name: Internal Fragments of Proper Names or Technical Terms
patterns.context: Longer proper names or technical terms are split into multiple subword tokens, with activation on initial, medial, or final fragments; examples occur in both body text and headings.
patterns.domain: Scientific abstracts, research terminology, football club names

patterns.name: Directives or Path Components in Code
patterns.context: Activation appears near include directives and subsequent paths or directory-related identifiers in code or build files.

6_1317.concept: 文本片段与边界标记
6_1317.description: 激活分布在标题条目中的短词、专名和专业术语的词内片段，以及代码里的 include 指令和目录路径；跨多种文体，未见统一语义触发条件。

patterns.name: 文档标题中的短词或标点
patterns.context: 标题、页眉或独立条目中的短词，在标题边界、换行附近或括号前后出现；触发位置有时落在词内分词上。
patterns.domain: 法律文本、网页条目、日期标题、饮品配方

patterns.name: 专名或专业术语的词内片段
patterns.context: 较长的专名或技术词被分成多个子词 token，激活落在词首、词中或词尾；既见于正文也见于标题。
patterns.domain: 科学摘要、科研术语、足球俱乐部名称

patterns.name: 代码中的指令或路径成分
patterns.context: 代码或构建文件中，include 指令及其后路径、目录相关标识符附近出现激活。

en.concept: Specific word fragments and formatting markers
en.description: Activation is scattered across scientific terms, Perfect titles, names, legal document formatting, quoted email text, and slashes in math/report text. No stable shared semantic theme is apparent; triggers are often specific word fragments or layout markers.

patterns.name: Analytical instrument name
patterns.context: In a scientific sentence, “spectrometry” at the end of the name receives the strongest activation; the preceding terms form Electron spin resonance spectrometry.

patterns.name: The English word Perfect
patterns.context: The standalone title-like word “Perfect” appears at the beginning of a paragraph, followed by an explanation or product name in parentheses; the word appears again later.

patterns.name: The English word Perfect and a drink recipe
patterns.context: “Perfect” begins a drink name or recipe title, followed by Drink® recipe.

patterns.name: Name Kai Tate
patterns.context: In the attorney signature area at the end of a judgment, the surname “Tate” in the indented name “Kai Tate Mann” stands out in activation.

patterns.name: Name Zecchino
patterns.context: When the name “Zecchino” appears at the beginning of a paragraph and is repeated later, the subword fragment “ch” stands out; nearby text includes line breaks and list-like formatting.

patterns.name: Court opinion title and year
patterns.context: In a court opinion directory or title with extensive spacing, the year “2001” stands out, surrounded by Opinions of the United States.

patterns.name: Court docket number
patterns.context: A Slip Op. case number appears in a court document header, followed by the court name on the next line; the number’s ending digits and hyphen stand out.

patterns.name: Email quotation separator
patterns.context: After a brief email reply, a blank line and a horizontal line mark the forwarded or quoted original email.

patterns.name: Fraction formatting in a math string
patterns.context: In a jumbled string of symbols/numbers before the body of a math problem, the slash “/” stands out; nearby numbers may form a fraction or identifier.

patterns.name: Slash in a report title
patterns.context: In the project summary/report title “PROJECT SUMMARY/ABSTRACT”, the slash stands out; the body turns to a mental-health topic.

6_1317.concept: 特定词片段与格式标记
6_1317.description: 激活分散在科学术语、Perfect 标题、人名、法律文档格式、邮件引用及数学/报告中的斜杠等局部片段；未见稳定共享的语义主题，触发条件多为具体词片段或版式标记。

patterns.name: 分析仪器名称
patterns.context: 在科学句子中，名称末尾的“spectrometry”获得最强激活，前面的术语组成 Electron spin resonance spectrometry。

patterns.name: 英文词 Perfect
patterns.context: 段首出现独立的标题式词语“Perfect”，后接括号中的说明或产品名；其后又再次出现该词。

patterns.name: 英文词 Perfect 与饮品配方
patterns.context: “Perfect”位于饮品名称或配方标题开头，后接 Drink® recipe。

patterns.name: 人名 Kai Tate
patterns.context: 判决书末尾律师署名区域，缩进后的姓名“Kai Tate Mann”中姓氏“Tate”激活突出。

patterns.name: 人名 Zecchino
patterns.context: 人名“Zecchino”在段首及后续重复出现时，子词片段“ch”突出；附近有换行和条目式文本。

patterns.name: 法院意见标题与年份
patterns.context: 大量空格排版的法院意见目录或标题中，年份“2001”突出，周围出现 Opinions of the United States。

patterns.name: 法院案卷编号
patterns.context: 法院文件页眉中的 Slip Op. 案号，换行后接法院名称；案号末尾数字及连字符突出。

patterns.name: 邮件引用分隔符
patterns.context: 简短邮件回复之后，以空行和横线标记转发或引用的原始邮件。

patterns.name: 数学字符串中的分数格式
patterns.context: 数学题正文前的杂乱符号/数字串中，斜杠“/”突出，邻近数字可能组成分数或编号。

patterns.name: 报告标题中的斜杠
patterns.context: 项目摘要/报告标题“PROJECT SUMMARY/ABSTRACT”中，斜杠突出；正文转入心理健康主题。

en.description: Activation is scattered across code method names, URL paths, legal action words, and fragments of various proper names and strings; it also appears in chemical formula letters, Polish interface text, and garbled text. There is no stable cross-paragraph semantic or morphological pattern.

patterns.name: Interface and method strings in code
patterns.context: An asynchronous call name appears in a C# interface or method signature and its exception message; activation is concentrated on the method name and parentheses.

patterns.name: mbox in a URL path
patterns.context: A webpage link contains a mail archive or data-file path; the trigger falls on a path component.

patterns.name: tablesaw in a URL path
patterns.context: A Markdown table-of-contents link points to a GitHub project page; activation is in the URL path.

patterns.name: Action words in legal text
patterns.context: A judgment describes an appellant’s actions, including an action or exception; activation falls on the action word.

patterns.name: Garbled or anomalous character sequence
patterns.context: A math-problem context contains a seemingly corrupted, meaningless character sequence, followed by numbers and a probability question.

patterns.name: Polish interface text
patterns.context: Code constructs interface column headers containing Polish diacritics; activation is concentrated within the string.

patterns.name: Al/O composition in chemical terminology
patterns.context: Describes aluminosilicates, zeolites, and their synthesis; activation is especially strong on the letter O in numeric chemical formulas.

patterns.name: Letter strings in names and salutations
patterns.context: An email salutation contains the recipient’s name in uppercase; activation is distributed across letter fragments in the name.

patterns.name: Syllable fragments in proper names
patterns.context: A Wikipedia entry begins with a person’s name, which is repeated after a line break; activation falls on subword fragments of the name.

patterns.name: Court name and case-name fragments
patterns.context: The first page of a legal judgment contains the court heading, location, and party names; activation is scattered across proper names and uppercase abbreviations.
patterns.domain: First page of a legal judgment

6_1317.concept: none
6_1317.description: 激活分散于代码方法名、URL路径、法律动作词及多类专名/字符串片段，也见化学式字母、波兰语界面和乱码；没有跨段稳定的语义或词形模式。

patterns.name: 代码中的接口与方法字符串
patterns.context: C# 接口或方法签名及其异常消息中出现异步调用名称；激活集中于方法名和括号

patterns.name: URL 路径中的 mbox
patterns.context: 网页链接包含邮件归档或数据文件路径；触发点落在路径组件

patterns.name: URL 路径中的 tablesaw
patterns.context: Markdown 目录链接指向 GitHub 项目页面，激活在 URL 路径

patterns.name: 法律文本中的动作词
patterns.context: 判决叙述上诉人行为，描述其动作或例外情况；激活落在动作词

patterns.name: 乱码或异常字符序列
patterns.context: 数学题上下文中出现疑似损坏、无意义的字符序列，随后是数字和概率问题

patterns.name: 波兰语界面文本
patterns.context: 代码构造界面列标题，包含波兰语变音符号；激活集中在字符串内

patterns.name: 化学术语中的 Al/O 组成
patterns.context: 描述铝硅酸盐、沸石及其合成；激活尤其强于数字化学式中的字母 O

patterns.name: 姓名及称呼中的字母串
patterns.context: 邮件称呼中出现大写收件人姓名；激活分布于姓名字母片段

patterns.name: 专名中的音节片段
patterns.context: 维基百科条目以人名开头，姓名在换行后重复；激活落在姓名的子词片段

patterns.name: 法院名称与案件姓名片段
patterns.context: 法律判决首页的法院抬头、地点与当事人姓名；激活分散在专名和大写缩写

en.description: Activation is distributed within words across multiple domains, including medical abbreviations and terminology, ordinary word forms, category titles, phylogenetic terms, database fields, service statuses, and brand names. No stable cross-paragraph semantic or syntactic trigger is apparent.

patterns.name: Word forms related to conducting, evaluation, and eliciting
patterns.context: Trigger locations include the compound-word fragment planning, evaluation, and the verbs elicits/eliciting; there is no stable shared local syntactic context.

patterns.name: Internal subwords in medical names or abbreviations
patterns.context: Markers fall on parts of word forms in medical terms or abbreviations; these examples do not establish a common semantic condition.
patterns.domain: Ophthalmology, osteoporosis, immunology, and molecular biology

patterns.name: Within-word fragments in category titles
patterns.context: In Wikipedia category lists, activation is scattered within words in titles or category names; it is not limited to a particular part of speech.

patterns.name: Within-word fragments in phylogenetic terminology
patterns.context: In descriptions of phylogenetic analysis methods, activation occurs within model or statistical terms.

patterns.name: Within-word fragments in database fields and identifiers
patterns.context: In database schemas or SQL examples, activation involves field names, SQL terms, and their context; strength and within-word position vary.

patterns.name: Within-word fragments in service names and failure statuses
patterns.context: Service status output repeatedly lists statuses such as not found, disabled, or closed, as well as specific service identifiers.

patterns.name: Fragments in device brands or product names
patterns.context: In descriptions of devices and experimental procedures, activation falls within manufacturer/brand names or ordinary word-form fragments.

6_1317.concept: none
6_1317.description: 激活分布于多领域词语内部，含医学缩写与术语、普通词形、分类标题、系统发育术语、数据库字段、服务状态及品牌名；未见跨段稳定的语义或句法触发条件。

patterns.name: 进行、评估及引发类词形
patterns.context: 触发位置分别涉及复合词片段 planning、evaluation，以及动词 elicits/eliciting；没有稳定的共同局部句法上下文。
patterns.domain: NIH 项目摘要、生物医学论文

patterns.name: 医学专名或缩写中的内部子词
patterns.context: 标记落在医学术语或缩写的部分词形上；无法从这些例子确定共同语义条件。
patterns.domain: 眼科、骨质疏松、免疫学及分子生物学

patterns.name: 分类标题中的词内片段
patterns.context: 维基百科分类列表中，激活分散在标题或分类名称的词内；不局限于某一种词类。

patterns.name: 系统发育术语的词内片段
patterns.context: 系统发育分析方法描述中，激活出现在模型或统计术语内部。

patterns.name: 数据库字段与标识符词内片段
patterns.context: 数据库表结构或 SQL 示例中，激活涉及字段名、SQL 词及其上下文；强弱和词内位置不一。

patterns.name: 服务名及故障状态词内片段
patterns.context: 服务状态输出反复列出未找到、停用或关闭等状态，且出现具体服务标识。

patterns.name: 设备品牌或产品名中的片段
patterns.context: 设备与实验流程描述中，激活落在厂商/品牌名称或普通词形片段内。

en.concept: Salient terms and process phrasing in research text
en.description: Activation is distributed across terms in specialized research text, continuous medical phrases, and wording about restriction/exclusion. It also appears in fragments within Russian words and a few verbs expressing intervention or results; there is no single stable semantic trigger across paragraphs.

patterns.name: Restriction, inhibition, or exclusion
patterns.context: Verbs describe factors that limit a biological process or an estimate’s range; also includes rejection in a technical context.

patterns.name: Medical title-like phrases
patterns.context: Activation falls on continuous clinical descriptive phrases in a title or at the beginning of an abstract.

patterns.name: Biomedical terms and compounds
patterns.context: Multiple consecutive word segments activate within technical terms, tissue/physiology terms, or disease-related compound expressions.
patterns.domain: Biochemistry, clinical medicine, ophthalmology, and liver disease research

patterns.name: Within-word Russian fragments and code segmentation
patterns.context: Russian Cyrillic words are split into multiple tokens, with activation scattered across within-word fragments; the beginning of the paragraph also contains number/letter-code-like content.

patterns.name: Method or result phrasing in research text
patterns.context: Verbs in research abstracts express timely intervention or a method producing an outcome; the trigger words differ, with no unified domain mechanism apparent.

6_1317.concept: 研究文本中的显著术语与过程措辞
6_1317.description: 激活分布于专业研究文本中的术语、连续医学短语及限制/排斥措辞，也见于俄语词内片段和少数表示干预或结果的动词；不同段落间没有单一稳定的语义触发条件。

patterns.name: 限制、抑制或排斥
patterns.context: 动词描述因素限制生物过程或估计范围；也包括技术语境中的 rejection（排斥）
patterns.domain: 生物医学与信号处理论文

patterns.name: 医学标题式短语
patterns.context: 激活落在标题或摘要开头的连续临床描述短语上

patterns.name: 生物医学术语与复合词
patterns.trigger: “fatty acid synthetase”“ventricular fluid pressure”“Macular Photocoagulation Study”“saturated free fatty acids”
patterns.context: 专业名词、组织/生理术语或疾病相关复合表达中，多个词段连续获得激活
patterns.domain: 生物化学、临床医学、眼科及肝病研究

patterns.name: 俄语词内片段与代码切分
patterns.trigger: “больше”“Пробовал анализаторы”“Создание индекса”中的词内子词片段
patterns.context: 俄语西里尔字母词被切分为多个 token，激活散布于词内片段；段首还含类似数字/字母代码的内容

patterns.name: 研究文本中的方法或结果措辞
patterns.context: 研究摘要中表达及时干预或某种方法造成结果的动词；触发词彼此不同，且未见统一领域机制
patterns.domain: 医学研究与建筑环境研究

en.concept: Key roles and processes in biomedical research
en.description: Strong activation is scattered across key predicates or terms in biomedical papers: immune stimulation/recruitment/response, blood flow and perfusion, detection capability, surgical outcomes, effects on drug clearance, and penicillin biosynthesis. No single stable trigger word is apparent.

patterns.name: Immune regulation and inflammation
patterns.context: Tachykinins act on immune cells; other contexts involve recruitment of RA, ICAM-1, and Th1-like cells, as well as immune responses involving HBV, PRRs, and cytokine response.

patterns.name: Blood flow and perfusion
patterns.context: Describes blood flow, perfusion, or the range of blood-flow measurements, including inner-ear/cerebral blood flow and Doppler flow estimates.

patterns.name: Statements about research use or capability
patterns.context: Describes antibodies enabling radioimmunolocalization or ELISA detecting collagen fragments.

patterns.name: Surgical procedure and scope of indications
patterns.context: Describes a cross-finger flap procedure and its effect in expanding the range of indications.

patterns.name: Pharmacokinetic variation
patterns.context: Factors such as body weight and liver and kidney function affect clearance parameters.

patterns.name: Biosynthetic pathway
patterns.context: Chemical analysis confirms benzylpenicillin biosynthesis in yeast.

6_1317.concept: 生物医学研究中的关键作用与过程
6_1317.description: 强激活分散于生物医学论文中的关键谓词或术语：免疫刺激/招募/应答、血流与灌注、检测能力、手术效果、药物清除率影响及青霉素生物合成；未见单一稳定触发词。

patterns.name: 免疫调节与炎症
patterns.context: tachykinins 作用于免疫细胞；另有 RA、ICAM-1、Th1-like cells 的招募，以及 HBV、PRRs、cytokine response 等免疫反应语境。

patterns.name: 血流与灌注
patterns.context: 描述血流、灌注或血流测量范围；包括内耳/脑血流和多普勒血流估计。
patterns.domain: 生理学与医学仪器研究

patterns.name: 研究用途或能力表述
patterns.context: 描述抗体可实现放射定位，或 ELISA 可检测胶原片段。

patterns.name: 手术操作与适应范围
patterns.context: 描述交叉手指皮瓣术式及其扩大适应范围的效果。

patterns.name: 药代动力学变异
patterns.context: 体重、肝肾功能等因素影响清除率参数。

patterns.name: 生物合成途径
patterns.context: 化学分析确认酵母中的 benzylpenicillin 生物合成。
patterns.domain: 微生物代谢与合成生物学

en.description: Activation is concentrated on statements of future actions or outcomes in formal medical research text, especially structures such as will aid/allow/permit: these explain how research, interventions, or technologies will support diagnosis, analysis, treatment, and subsequent choices. Activation also falls on connectives and continuation words around these structures.

patterns.name: will/allow introducing research aims or capabilities
patterns.context: In a research plan or technical description, an action is described as facilitating, supporting, or permitting subsequent analysis, evaluation, treatment, or research.
patterns.domain: NIH project summaries, medical research abstracts

patterns.name: aid in analysis or diagnosis
patterns.context: The structure “will aid in” connects to diagnostic or analytical work.
patterns.domain: PubMed medical abstracts, NIH project descriptions

patterns.name: allow/permit enabling subsequent actions
patterns.context: A method, technology, or result provides the conditions for subsequent treatment, analysis, or choices.
patterns.domain: Medical technology and clinical research abstracts

patterns.name: will introducing research implementation or evaluation
patterns.context: A research plan describes future research, optimization, observation, or intervention steps.

patterns.name: Token boundaries and continuation after introductory words
patterns.context: Activation often falls on function words or the content words immediately following them; the text is formal medical prose. The lexical semantic trigger is difficult to determine from the shown context alone.

6_1317.concept: 研究计划的促成与使能
6_1317.description: 激活集中于正式医学研究文本中对未来行动或结果的表述，尤其是 will aid/allow/permit 等结构：说明研究、干预或技术将支持诊断、分析、治疗及后续选择；激活也落在这些结构周边的连接词与续接词上。

patterns.name: will/allow 引出研究目的或能力
patterns.context: 研究计划或技术说明中，描述某项行动将促成、支持或允许后续分析、评估、治疗或研究
patterns.domain: NIH 项目摘要、医学研究摘要

patterns.name: aid in 分析诊断
patterns.trigger: “aid”及其相邻的“in the differential diagnosis”或“in the analysis”
patterns.context: “will aid in”结构连接诊断或分析工作
patterns.domain: PubMed 医学摘要、NIH 项目描述

patterns.name: allow/permit 使能后续行动
patterns.trigger: “allow”或“permit”，尤其是“allow patients to be treated”“allow … analyses to proceed”“permit the selection”
patterns.context: 某方法、技术或结果为后续治疗、分析或选择提供条件
patterns.domain: 医学技术与临床研究摘要

patterns.name: will 引出研究实施或评估
patterns.context: 研究计划描述未来将开展的研究、优化、观察或干预步骤

patterns.name: 引导词后的 token 边界与续接
patterns.trigger: 标记落在常见连接语中，如“in the”“the …”“a …”，并跨越后续词片段
patterns.context: 激活位置多在功能词或其后紧邻内容词，文本呈正式医学散文；仅凭所示上下文难以判定词汇语义触发条件

en.description: Primarily responds to allow(s) in medical research contexts, meaning that a treatment, analysis, assessment, or consultation is made possible, and also to aid in; sporadic activation also occurs in dosage text and an internal fragment of Tetrodotoxin.

patterns.name: Allowing, Enabling, and Their Outcomes
patterns.context: Describes a method, device, study design, or information enabling an analysis, treatment, or assessment; often followed by an object or infinitive.
patterns.domain: NIH-funded project abstracts, medical research abstracts

patterns.name: Aid and Diagnostic Assistance
patterns.context: A short-term medication supplement aids differential diagnosis.

patterns.name: Medication Dosage Expressions
patterns.context: Administration instructions for adult acute gout and prophylactic doses, followed by a statement that the dose must…

patterns.name: Toxin Name Fragment
patterns.context: A toxin name and its concentration appear in experimental results; activation falls on a split word fragment.

6_1317.concept: 医学语境中的促成/辅助
6_1317.description: 主要响应医学研究语境中表示“使某项治疗、分析、评估或咨询成为可能”的 allow(s)，也响应 aid in；另有剂量文本及 Tetrodotoxin 词内片段的零星激活。

patterns.name: 允许、使能及其结果
patterns.trigger: “will allow,” “allows,” “protocol allows,” “would allow”；多处在 allow(s) 后激活
patterns.context: 描述某方法、设备、研究方案或信息使某项分析、治疗、评估得以进行；常接宾语或不定式
patterns.domain: NIH 资助项目摘要、医学研究摘要

patterns.name: 帮助与辅助诊断
patterns.context: 短期药物补充有助于鉴别诊断

patterns.name: 药物剂量表达
patterns.context: 成人急性痛风剂量与预防剂量的给药说明，剂量后接剂量必须……

patterns.name: 毒素名称片段
patterns.context: 实验结果中出现毒素名称及其浓度；激活落在被拆分的词内

en.concept: Feasibility and requirement statements in research
en.description: Activation is mainly concentrated on require (especially the strongest require) and allow: the former introduces required experimental samples, steps, or subsequent procedures, while the latter introduces analyses, operations, or aims that research can undertake. It also occurs in non-NIH medical text.

patterns.name: require followed by experimental materials/steps
patterns.context: require functions as a predicate followed by preparation, samples, procedures, or conditions; [1], [2], [6], and [7] activate directly after require, while [8] is somewhat weaker.
patterns.domain: Research plans, medical reports, or explanatory text

patterns.name: allow followed by research aims or analysis
patterns.context: will/This/These technique(s) allow is followed by aims or outcomes such as examination, us to dissect, and aid; [3][4] are strongest.

patterns.name: will allow structure in research plans
patterns.context: The future-tense will allow introduces analyses, experimental procedures, or evaluations enabled by the research; it overlaps with the allow pattern, but in [5] only allow is marked.

patterns.name: Low-strength allow for structure
patterns.context: allow for is followed by further analysis; it is related to the strongly activated allow, but here the following phrase is for neuroendocrine analyses.

6_1317.concept: 科研可行性与需求表述
6_1317.description: 激活主要集中于 require（尤其强度最高的 require）和 allow：前者引出实验所需样本、步骤或后续程序，后者引出研究可进行的分析、操作或目的。也见于非 NIH 医学文本。

patterns.name: require 后接实验材料/步骤
patterns.context: require 作谓语，后接准备、样本、操作或条件；[1]、[2]、[6]、[7]均在 require 后直接激活，[8]则强度稍低。
patterns.domain: 科研计划、医学报道或说明文

patterns.name: allow 后接研究目的或分析
patterns.context: will/This/These technique(s) allow 后接 examination、us to dissect、aid 等目的或结果；[3][4]最强。
patterns.domain: 科研项目摘要、医学论文

patterns.name: 科研计划中的 will allow 结构
patterns.context: 未来时 will allow 引出研究可实现的分析、实验操作或评估；与 allow 模式重叠，但其中 [5] 只有 allow 被标记。

patterns.name: 低强度 allow for 结构
patterns.context: allow for 后接分析推进；与强激活的 allow 相关，但该处后续搭配为 for neuroendocrine analyses。

en.description: Primarily responds to “allow” meaning to enable an analysis, assessment, or application in research or clinical contexts, and to “require” indicating necessary conditions or subsequent actions. It also covers related wording about examination, analysis, investigation, and future research plans, as well as specific clinical outcomes and testing requirements.

patterns.name: allow Followed by Research Outcomes or Uses
patterns.context: A study plan or abstract explains how a method, intervention, or information will enable subsequent analysis, assessment, application, or clinical decision-making; high activation often falls on allow and following words.

patterns.name: require Followed by Necessary Conditions
patterns.context: Describes subsequent actions, research conditions, or samples required for a result; activation occurs on require and nearby objects.

patterns.name: Research Assessment, Analysis, and Investigation Wording
patterns.context: Involves systematic examination, assessment, analysis, or investigation of a research subject and its changes; allow/require need not appear.

patterns.name: Modal or Future-Oriented Research Statements
patterns.context: A research plan or discussion uses future tense to describe methods, analyses, applications, or work to be undertaken.

patterns.name: Clinical Outcomes of Closure and Repeat Procedures
patterns.context: Describes restenosis, closure, and repeat procedures following a stent-related intervention; activation is concentrated on outcome and subsequent management wording.

patterns.name: Clinical Trial Design and Nutrition Topics
patterns.context: Discusses nutritional issues in older patients with heart failure and emphasizes the need for well-designed clinical studies.

patterns.name: News-Style Testing Requirements
patterns.context: A news report describes a newly approved test and specifies requirements for blood sample collection.

6_1317.concept: 研究行动与必要条件
6_1317.description: 主要响应研究或临床语境中表示使某分析、评估、应用成为可能的“allow”，以及表示必要条件或后续操作的“require”；也覆盖相关的检查、分析、调查、未来研究方案表述，并兼及具体临床结局与检测要求。

patterns.name: allow 后接研究结果或用途
patterns.context: 研究计划或摘要中说明某方法、干预或信息将使后续分析、评估、应用或临床决策成为可能；高激活常落在 allow 及其后续词上。
patterns.domain: 生物医学研究计划、论文摘要

patterns.name: require 后接必要条件
patterns.trigger: “require repeat procedures” / “will require well-designed clinical investigations” / “tests require blood samples”
patterns.context: 描述某结果所需的后续操作、研究条件或样本；require 本身及其宾语附近激活。

patterns.name: 研究评估、分析与调查措辞
patterns.trigger: “allow examination” / “evaluation” / “dissect” / “Quantitative proteome analysis” / “enabled us to investigate”
patterns.context: 涉及系统检查、评估、解析或调查研究对象及其变化；不一定出现 allow/require。

patterns.name: 带情态或未来导向的研究陈述
patterns.trigger: “will be monitored” / “will be used” / “will allow” / “will require”
patterns.context: 研究方案或论述以未来时描述将要开展的方法、分析、应用或所需工作。
patterns.domain: 资助申请、临床研究论述

patterns.name: 关闭与重复操作的临床结局
patterns.context: 支架相关干预后描述再狭窄、闭合及再次操作，激活集中于结果及后续处置表达。

patterns.name: 临床试验设计及营养议题
patterns.context: 讨论老年心衰患者营养问题，并强调需要设计良好的临床研究。

patterns.name: 新闻式检测要求
patterns.context: 新闻报道新获批检测，并说明采集血样的要求。

en.concept: Requirements and detection in medical research
en.description: Covers expressions of requirements, capabilities, and subsequent actions in medical research: methods can detect targets, experiments require a dose or patient preparation, and research needs to be conducted or its results enable analysis. It also involves clinical monitoring, examinations, and repeated procedures.

patterns.name: Research actions following will/require/allow
patterns.context: In research plans or papers, an objective, condition, or outstanding task is introduced, followed by require; similarly, will allow appears in inferences from research results or plans.
patterns.domain: Biomedical research plans, paper abstracts, and grant applications

patterns.name: Detection capability and methods
patterns.context: Describes detection methods, assays, or diagnostic tools capable of detecting targets such as low-level infection or collagen fragments.

patterns.name: Dose or necessary condition with required
patterns.context: required directly follows an antibody dose and indicates the dose needed to achieve an experimental effect; this differs from the general use of require in other fragments.

patterns.name: Measurement methods and detection equipment
patterns.context: Introduces analytical methods for monitoring neurochemicals, including chromatography and electrochemical detection.

patterns.name: Uroflowmetry examination
patterns.context: Focuses on uroflowmetry, describing it as noninvasive and noting that the patient must drink fluids during the examination process.

patterns.name: Research use or analysis following allow
patterns.context: Assays or receptor detection methods serve as tools that allow researchers to examine changes in receptor binding; syntactically, this resembles will allow in enabling research analysis.

patterns.name: Clinical research still needed
patterns.context: States that progress in a research area requires well-designed clinical studies, rather than a specific experimental test or dose.
patterns.domain: Review of nutrition in heart failure among older adults

patterns.name: Repeat procedure still needed after treatment
patterns.context: Describes a stent treatment as less likely to close, but notes that another procedure may still be needed.

6_1317.concept: 医学研究中的需求与检测
6_1317.description: 覆盖医学研究中需求、能力与后续动作的表达：方法可检测对象，实验需某剂量或患者准备，研究需开展或由结果促成分析；也涉及临床监测、检查和重复操作。

patterns.name: will/require/allow 后的研究动作
patterns.context: 在科研计划或论文中，前文提出目标、条件或待完成事项，后接 require；类似的 will allow 也出现在研究结果或计划的推论中。
patterns.domain: 生物医学研究计划、论文摘要及资助申请

patterns.name: 检测能力与检测方法
patterns.trigger: « capable»10« of»6« detecting»3；« diagnostic»2« methods»3« which»6« can»6 detect
patterns.context: 描述检测方法、测定或诊断工具能够检测某种低水平感染、胶原片段等对象。
patterns.domain: 生物医学诊断与实验检测

patterns.name: required 的剂量或必要条件
patterns.context: required 紧接抗体用量，说明达到实验效应所需的剂量；不同于其他片段中一般性的 require。
patterns.domain: 肿瘤放射免疫治疗研究

patterns.name: 测量方法与检测设备
patterns.context: 介绍监测神经化学物质的分析方法，出现 chromatography 与 electrochemical detection。
patterns.domain: 神经内分泌与生化分析

patterns.name: 尿流测定检查
patterns.context: 以尿流测定为主题，说明其非侵入性及检查流程中患者需口服液体。
patterns.domain: 泌尿医学病例/临床摘要

patterns.name: allow 后接研究用途或分析
patterns.context: assays 或受体检测方法作为手段，使研究者能够检查受体结合变化；句法上与 will allow 表示促成研究分析。

patterns.name: 临床研究仍需开展
patterns.context: 指出某研究领域的进展需要设计良好的临床研究，而非具体实验检测或剂量。
patterns.domain: 老年人心衰营养研究综述

patterns.name: 治疗后仍需重复操作
patterns.context: 描述支架治疗后较不易闭合，但仍可能需要再次操作。

en.description: All passages contain highly activated require/requires (including internal subword fragments). Most describe necessary conditions for examination or research and often occur alongside testing methods, capabilities, or experimental procedures.

patterns.name: Lexical Trigger “require”
patterns.context: When describing conditions, materials, capabilities, or patient cooperation required for examinations, experiments, methods, monitoring, or tests; in [4], it occurs inside the tokenization of “subclavian,” with a different trigger form.
patterns.domain: Primarily biomedical abstracts, research, or patent descriptions; also encyclopedic and news text

patterns.name: Testing Capabilities and Analytical Methods
patterns.context: Describes the capabilities of detection, measurement, or diagnostic methods, often involving a target, sensitivity, or low-level infection; [6] contains no require but still has related testing semantics.
patterns.domain: Biomedical research, disease monitoring, and patented diagnostic technology

patterns.name: Methods or Steps Enabling Procedures
