patterns.context: In descriptions of research methods, experiments, or testing procedures, expressions such as “will require” or “allow/enable” appear.
patterns.domain: NIH research abstracts and experimental methods

patterns.name: Internal Subword Fragments in Catheterization Terms
patterns.context: The medical term “subclavian vein catheters” is split into multiple tokens; high activation falls on internal fragments of “subclavian” and “catheters,” rather than on an explicit use of require.

6_1317.concept: 必要性与方法需求
6_1317.description: 所有段均含高激活的 require/requires（含分词内部片段）；多数描述检查或研究的必要条件，也常伴随检测方法、能力或实验步骤语境。

patterns.name: “require”词汇触发
patterns.context: 在描述检查、实验、方法、监测或测试所需条件、材料、能力或患者配合时；[4]中位于“subclavian”一词的分词内部，触发形态不同。
patterns.domain: 主要为生物医学摘要、研究或专利说明；也见于百科及新闻文本

patterns.name: 检测能力与分析方法
patterns.trigger: « capable»9« of»5« detecting»4（[5]）；« methods»3« which»5« can»5« detect»1（[6]）；« assay»2« capable»8« of»5（[9]）
patterns.context: 描述检测、测量或诊断方法具备某种能力，常与检测对象、灵敏度或低水平感染相连；其中[6]没有 require，仍出现相关检测语义。
patterns.domain: 生物医学研究、疾病监测及专利诊断技术

patterns.name: 方法或步骤允许进行
patterns.trigger: « assays»5« will»7« require»9（[3]）；« method»3« allows»9« for»6« the»6« measurement»1（[7]）；« These»4« technique»4« allow»9« for»7（[2]）
patterns.context: 研究方法、实验或检测程序的说明中，出现“将需要”或“允许/能够进行”一类表述。
patterns.domain: NIH研究摘要及实验方法描述

patterns.name: 插管相关词内部分词
patterns.context: 医学术语“subclavian vein catheters”被拆成多个 token；高激活落在“subclavian”和“catheters”的内部片段，而非明确的 require 用法。

en.concept: Expressing the efficacy and requirements of biomedical methods
en.description: The strongest responses are concentrated in expressions in biomedical texts that indicate a method or design “makes … possible” (allow), what a method requires (require), and what results a method can achieve (permit); localized patterns such as ECG chart labels and uroflowmetry terminology also appear.

patterns.name: Research applications following allow
patterns.context: Describes a method, study design, or information that makes subsequent evaluation, analysis, or examination possible; activation is strongest near allow.
patterns.domain: Biomedical research proposals and scientific papers

patterns.name: require expressing method requirements
patterns.context: The subject is a diagnostic method, experimental procedure, or experimental preparation, followed by required steps, materials, or participants; also appears at truncated sentence endings.

patterns.name: permit expressing what a method enables
patterns.context: A method or tissue-processing approach is the subject, followed by an achievable advantage or result.

patterns.name: Method efficacy expressions without allow
patterns.context: Introduces experimental methods and their limitations; appears in descriptions of procedures for detecting gene expression or biomarkers.

patterns.name: Figure and table labels in medical literature
patterns.context: Main-text labels referring to figures follow electrocardiogram results; activation is distributed across split ECG tokens and figure references.
patterns.domain: PubMed Central case reports and figure text

patterns.name: Uroflowmetry and hydration requirements
patterns.context: Describes uroflowmetry, a urological examination, and mentions that patients must drink fluids before the exam; strong activation falls on uro and requires.

patterns.name: Future tense in proposal text
patterns.context: In research proposals or expected results, will often occurs near allow or require; it is itself a moderately strong marker.

patterns.name: Neuroendocrine analysis terminology
patterns.context: Describes brain and pituitary receptor assays and neuroendocrine analysis; occurs in the same paragraph as allow, but activation is weaker.

6_1317.concept: 生物医学方法的效能与需求表达
6_1317.description: 最强响应集中在生物医学文本中表示方法或设计“使……成为可能”（allow）、方法所需事项（require）及方法可实现结果（permit）的表达；另有 ECG 图表标记、尿流测定术语等局部模式。

patterns.name: allow 后接研究用途
patterns.trigger: « allow»9 / « allow»10，常见完整形式为“This will allow…”或“will allow the evaluation/examination…”
patterns.context: 描述某方法、研究设计或信息使后续评估、分析、检查成为可能；allow 附近激活最强。
patterns.domain: 生物医学研究计划与科研论文

patterns.name: require 表示方法需求
patterns.context: 主语为检测方法、实验流程或实验准备，后接所需的步骤、材料或参与者；段末截断处也可见。
patterns.domain: 生物医学方法与实验描述

patterns.name: permit 表示方法所能实现
patterns.context: 方法或组织处理方式作为主语，后接可实现的优势或结果。

patterns.name: 非 allow 的方法效能表述
patterns.context: 介绍实验方法及其限制；出现于描述检测基因表达或生物标志物的流程中。

patterns.name: 医学文献中的图表标记
patterns.context: 心电图结果后带有指向图表的正文标记；激活分布在被拆分的 ECG 词和图表引用中。
patterns.domain: PubMed Central 病例报告与图表文本

patterns.name: 尿流量测定及饮水要求
patterns.trigger: « uro»6« flow»1metry，及« requires»9 patients to consume
patterns.context: 描述尿流量测定这一泌尿系统检查，并提到检查前需患者饮水；强激活落在 uro 和 requires。

patterns.name: 项目文本中的未来时态
patterns.context: 研究计划或预期结果中，will 常紧邻 allow 或 require；本身有中等强度标记。

patterns.name: 神经内分泌分析术语
patterns.context: 描述脑与垂体受体检测及神经内分泌分析；与 allow 同段出现，但激活较弱。

en.description: Activation spans neuropharmacology, cardiovascular medicine, clinical protocols, metabolic experiments, and figure and numeric markers in biomedical text; several strong markers fall on internal word fragments or function words, without consistent local trigger conditions.

patterns.name: Word Fragment Following an Article
patterns.context: Spans sentence-initial, word-initial, and medial positions; the provided activation annotations do not show consistent local trigger conditions.
patterns.domain: Biomedical abstracts, NIH project text, and paper body text

patterns.name: Neurotransmitter and Neuroendocrine Research
patterns.context: When discussing the brain, pituitary, neural mechanisms, hormone axes, or catecholamine measurement.
patterns.domain: Neuroscience and pharmacology abstracts, research project descriptions

patterns.name: Receptors and Pharmacological Interventions
patterns.context: When introducing receptor assays, drug effects, or pharmacological blockade and control conditions.

patterns.name: Cardiovascular Measurements and Support Technologies
patterns.context: When describing electrocardiograms, mechanical cardiac support, blood flow, or ventricular pressure/volume measurements.

patterns.name: Medication Regimens and Clinical Trials
patterns.context: When introducing treatment regimens or study designs for patients with myocardial infarction.

patterns.name: Insulin Infusion and Metabolic Measures
patterns.context: When comparing insulin infusion, glucose levels, and their relationship to MAC.

patterns.name: Numbers, Units, and Experimental Results
patterns.context: When numerical values, units, and quantitative reports appear in experimental results or equipment parameters.
patterns.domain: Biomedical paper abstracts and body text

patterns.name: Literature Structure and Figure Markers
patterns.context: When the body text cites figures and includes image or caption markers.

patterns.name: Technical Internal Word Fragments
patterns.context: These fragments occur within various proper names, drug names, or medical terms, with no stable shared semantic condition.

6_1317.concept: 生物医学文本片段
6_1317.description: 激活覆盖生物医学文本中神经药理、心血管、临床方案、代谢实验及图表和数值标记；若干强标记落在词内片段或功能词上，缺乏一致局部触发条件。

patterns.name: 冠词后接词元片段
patterns.trigger: « an»、« the»、« a» 等功能词，以及后续词的片段，如 «Intr»、«Ret»、«De»
patterns.context: 跨越句子、词首和词中多种位置；所给激活标注并未呈现一致的局部触发条件
patterns.domain: 生物医学摘要、NIH 项目文本及论文正文

patterns.name: 神经递质与神经内分泌研究
patterns.context: 讨论脑、垂体、神经机制、激素轴或儿茶酚胺测量时
patterns.domain: 神经科学与药理学摘要、研究项目描述

patterns.name: 受体与药理干预
patterns.context: 介绍受体检测、药物作用或药理阻断及其对照条件时
patterns.domain: 药理学与神经药理学摘要

patterns.name: 心血管测量与支持技术
patterns.context: 描述心电图、心脏机械支持、血流或心室压力/容积测量时
patterns.domain: 心血管医学论文与项目文本

patterns.name: 药物方案与临床试验
patterns.context: 介绍心肌梗死患者的治疗方案或研究设计时

patterns.name: 胰岛素输注与代谢指标
patterns.context: 比较胰岛素输注、葡萄糖水平及其与 MAC 的关系时

patterns.name: 数字、单位与实验结果
patterns.context: 实验结果或设备参数中出现数值、单位和量化报告时
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文摘要及正文

patterns.name: 文献结构与图示标记
patterns.context: 正文引用图表并附带图像或图注标记时

patterns.name: 技术性词内片段
patterns.context: 这些片段出现在多种专名、药物名或医学术语内部，未见稳定的共同语义条件
patterns.domain: 跨医学领域的分词片段

en.concept: Biomedical word forms and method terms
en.description: Activation occurs most consistently on allow/allowed/allows and several substrings within medical terms: trans-, son, cav, fet/fent, electro, I, and others. These are distributed across experimental methods, imaging, clinical cases, and device studies; no single semantic condition covers them all.

patterns.name: Research capabilities following allow(s/ed)
patterns.context: The verbs allow/allowed/allows form the activation core, followed by research, measurement, imaging, or experimental results; no specific condition beyond the general syntax is required.
patterns.domain: Biomedical papers, research methods, and results

patterns.name: trans in transmembrane transport compounds
patterns.context: trans- occurs within medical terms relating to routes of administration, cerebral blood flow, or transvalvular gradients; this substring is highlighted in these words.

patterns.name: Sonography ultrasound imaging terminology
patterns.context: Describes the visualization of structures or edema using three-dimensional ultrasound.

patterns.name: Cavopulmonary cardiopulmonary support terminology
patterns.context: Refers to bilateral cavopulmonary shunts and mechanical support in a neonatal pig model.

patterns.name: Transducer terminology in ultrasound ablation
patterns.context: High-intensity focused ultrasound ablation equipment and its frequency settings.

patterns.name: I-containing radiolabeled reagents
patterns.context: Describes an iodine-labeled reagent in an AFP binding assay.
patterns.domain: Clinical laboratory testing and liver disease research

patterns.name: Fragments of alpha-1-antitrypsin/AFP names
patterns.context: Serum-binding proteins and their detection methods.

patterns.name: Fentanyl analgesic name fragment
patterns.context: Transmucosal sedation and analgesia regimens for children.

patterns.name: Electrocardiograph terminology
patterns.context: Electrocardiographic and imaging descriptions of a case of dextrocardia.

patterns.name: Tumor marker assay name fragment
patterns.context: Descriptions of receptor or neuroendocrine assay methods.

patterns.name: Unclassified residual fragments
patterns.context: May be subword fragments within medical vocabulary or context-dependent activations, but current examples are insufficient to confirm a shared trigger.

6_1317.concept: 生物医学词形与方法词
6_1317.description: 激活最稳定地出现在 allow/allowed/allows 及若干医学术语内部子串：trans-、son、cav、fet/fent、electro、I 等；分布于实验方法、影像、临床病例和设备研究，尚无单一语义条件能涵盖全部。

patterns.name: allow(s/ed) 后续研究能力
patterns.trigger: “allow9 examination”“allow10 for neuroendocrine analyses”“allowed9 visualization”“allowed9 a maximum”“allows9 us to measure”
patterns.context: 动词 allow/allowed/allows 是激活核心，后接研究、测量、成像或实验结果；无需固定句法以外的明确条件。
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文、研究方法与结果

patterns.name: 跨膜转运相关复合词中的 trans
patterns.context: trans- 位于医学术语内部，涉及给药途径、脑血流或跨瓣梯度；在这些词中该子串被高亮。

patterns.name: 超声成像术语 sonography
patterns.context: 描述三维超声对结构或水肿的可视化。

patterns.name: 心肺辅助术语 cavopulmonary
patterns.context: 指新生猪模型中的双侧腔肺分流及机械辅助。
patterns.domain: 心胸外科与循环生理学

patterns.name: 超声消融术语 transducer
patterns.context: 高强度聚焦超声消融设备及其频率设置。

patterns.name: 含 I 的放射性标记试剂
patterns.context: AFP 结合试验中描述碘标记的试剂。

patterns.name: alpha-1-antitrypsin/AFP 名称碎片
patterns.context: 血清结合蛋白及其检测方法。

patterns.name: 镇痛药 fentanyl 名称碎片
patterns.context: 儿童口腔经黏膜镇静镇痛方案。

patterns.name: 心电图术语 electrocardiograph
patterns.context: 右位心病例的心电图及影像学描述。

patterns.name: 肿瘤标志物 assay 名称碎片
patterns.context: 受体或神经内分泌分析方法的描述。

patterns.name: 未能归入的残余片段
patterns.trigger: “sonication”中的“son”及“transducers”以外的高亮词形，以及各段零散标记
patterns.context: 可能是医学词汇内部子词或上下文相关激活，但现有例子不足以确认共同触发条件。

en.description: Activation often occurs in biomedical methods and research text: especially technical-capability descriptions introduced by “allow/allows,” as well as assay/binding, brain measurements, electrocardiograms, dosing, pharmacology, and clinical terminology. Some patterns occur in only one passage and cannot be assigned to a single theme.

patterns.name: allows as a Methodological Verb
patterns.context: Appears in sentences describing a method, technology, or study design enabling a measurement, analysis, or individualized procedure; often occurs in methods introductions or explanations of results.
patterns.domain: Biomedical research abstracts, NIH project text

patterns.name: assay and binding
patterns.context: Assay, binding analysis, and related labeled reagents appear in experimental methods descriptions; this pattern does not require allow.

patterns.name: Neuroendocrine and Receptor Research
patterns.context: Describes receptor binding in the brain or pituitary, neuroendocrine analysis, and animal tissue sampling.

patterns.name: Multiparametric Brain Chemistry Measurement
patterns.context: Introduces an imaging method that can simultaneously measure concentrations of multiple brain chemicals or relaxation times in one scan.

patterns.name: Medical Imaging and Examination Vocabulary
patterns.context: Focuses on electrocardiogram examinations, findings, or imaging; triggers include split compound medical terms.
patterns.domain: Emergency case reports, clinical medical text

patterns.name: Intramuscular/Intrathecal Dosing and Pharmacology Research
patterns.context: Discusses routes of administration, infusion rates, and their relationship to blood glucose or anesthesia-related measures.

patterns.name: Neurotransmitter Measurement and Toxins
patterns.context: Describes measurement of acetylcholine in perfusate and experiments involving inhibitors or toxins.

patterns.name: Sedative and Analgesic Drugs
patterns.context: Discusses transmucosal administration, dosage, or safety in procedural sedation and analgesia regimens for children.

6_1317.concept: 生物医学研究方法与术语
6_1317.description: 激活常见于生物医学方法和研究文本：尤其是“allow/allows”引出的技术能力描述，也涉及 assay/binding、脑测量、心电图、给药、药理及临床术语。部分模式仅见单段，无法归为单一主题。

patterns.name: allows 方法性动词
patterns.context: 出现在描述方法、技术或研究方案能够实现某种测量、分析或个体化操作的句子中；多位于方法介绍或结果阐释部分。
patterns.domain: 生物医学研究摘要、NIH 项目文本

patterns.name: assay 与 binding
patterns.context: 实验方法描述中出现检测、结合分析及相关标记试剂；本模式与“allows”模式不同，不要求出现 allow。

patterns.name: 神经内分泌与受体研究
patterns.context: 描述脑或垂体的受体结合、神经内分泌分析及动物组织取样。
patterns.domain: 神经科学、内分泌学研究文本

patterns.name: 多参数脑化学测量
patterns.context: 介绍可在一次扫描中同时测量脑内多种化学物质浓度或弛豫时间的成像方法。

patterns.name: 医学影像与检查词汇
patterns.context: 围绕心电图检查、心电图表现或影像呈现展开；触发处包括被拆分的复合医学词。
patterns.domain: 急诊病例报告、临床医学文本

patterns.name: 肌内/鞘内给药与药理研究
patterns.context: 讨论给药途径、输注速率及其与血糖或麻醉相关指标的关系。

patterns.name: 神经递质测定与毒素
patterns.context: 描述灌流液中乙酰胆碱的测定，以及抑制剂或毒素相关实验。

patterns.name: 镇静镇痛药物
patterns.context: 儿童操作镇静、镇痛方案中讨论经黏膜给药及剂量或安全性。

en.description: Primarily activates on allow/permit expressions of research feasibility in scientific texts, especially when followed by examination, analysis, or surrogate measures. Other sporadic medical experimental contexts include assay performance, clinical administration and risks, urological examinations, electrocardiograms, intrathecal infusion, and metabolic pathways; these cannot be explained by one shared word-form pattern.

patterns.name: Possibility or research applications following allow
patterns.context: allow is followed by for, examination, or a specific action, indicating that a method, information, or technology makes subsequent research or action possible; this may also simply be common proposal wording.
patterns.domain: Biomedical abstracts and NIH research proposals

patterns.name: Research actions following will permit
patterns.context: Future measurements or study designs are described as enabling researchers to examine surrogate measures; similar to “making … possible,” but without allow.
patterns.domain: NIH research proposals, alcohol intervention studies

patterns.name: Sensitivity and ease in method evaluation
patterns.context: Introduces assay performance and procedures, emphasizing sensitivity, few operations, and simplicity; allow does not occur here.
patterns.domain: PubMed biomedical abstracts, DNA detection methods

patterns.name: Administration and risk descriptions for clinical interventions
patterns.context: Discusses pediatric sedation/analgesia regimens, transmucosal administration, dose reduction, and hemodynamic or respiratory risks; allow/permit do not occur.

patterns.name: Urological examination names and requirements
patterns.context: Descriptions related to uroflowmetry mention the noninvasive nature of the examination and that patients must drink fluids; the preceding text also reports water intoxication as a complication.

patterns.name: Electrocardiogram terminology fragments
patterns.context: Describes electrocardiograms and ST-segment elevation in the inferior leads in figure captions or case text; no clear correspondence with the wording in other passages.

patterns.name: Intrathecal insulin and infusion experiments
patterns.context: Discusses different infusion rates, glucose concentrations, and MAC changes, and reports results of intrathecal insulin experiments; no clear shared wording cues.

patterns.name: Metabolic pathways and experimental assays
patterns.context: Describes the TCA cycle, malate-shuttle-related enzymes, and required assay materials; consistent with a methods/experimental context, but without allow/permit.

6_1317.concept: 医学研究可行性表述
6_1317.description: 主要对科研文本中表示研究可行性的 allow/permit 表达激活，尤其是后接检查、分析或替代指标。另有检测方法性能、临床给药与风险、泌尿检查、心电图、鞘内输注及代谢通路等零散医学实验语境，无法由同一词面模式解释。

patterns.name: allow 后接可能性或研究用途
patterns.context: allow 后接 for、examination 或具体行动，表示某种方法、信息或技术使后续研究/行动成为可能；也可能只是常见的科研计划书措辞。
patterns.domain: 生物医学摘要、NIH 研究计划

patterns.name: will permit 后接研究行动
patterns.context: 将来的测量或研究设计被描述为可使研究者检查替代指标；与“使……能够进行”的措辞相近，但没有 allow。
patterns.domain: NIH 研究计划，酒精干预研究

patterns.name: 方法评价中的敏感性与简便性
patterns.trigger: « highly»4 « sensitive»8；« involves»9 few and simple operations
patterns.context: 介绍检测方法的性能和操作流程，强调灵敏、操作少且简单；此处不含 allow。
patterns.domain: PubMed 生物医学摘要，DNA 检测方法

patterns.name: 临床干预的给药与风险描述
patterns.context: 讨论儿童镇静/镇痛方案、经黏膜给药、减量以及血流动力学或呼吸风险；不见 allow/permit。

patterns.name: 泌尿检查名称及检查要求
patterns.context: 尿流率测定相关描述，提到检查的无创性及患者需口服液体；前文还报告水中毒并发症。

patterns.name: 心电图术语片段
patterns.context: 图注或病例文本中描述心电图及下壁导联 ST 段抬高；与其他段的表述没有明显对应。

patterns.name: 鞘内胰岛素与输注实验
patterns.context: 讨论不同输注速率、葡萄糖浓度及 MAC 变化，并报告鞘内胰岛素实验结果；无明显共同措辞线索。

patterns.name: 代谢通路及实验检测
patterns.context: 描述 TCA 循环、苹果酸穿梭相关酶及所需检测材料；虽与方法/实验语境相符，但不含 allow/permit。

en.description: Activation is scattered mainly within technical terms in medical text, especially trans-initial terms related to administration, anatomy, or transplantation, as well as electrophysiology, diagnostic, and procedural terminology. Trigger positions vary across passages, with no single clear semantic condition.

patterns.name: Transcutaneous/Trans-tissue Administration or Delivery
patterns.context: Medical text contains anatomical or trans-tissue terms beginning with trans-; activation falls on different internal token fragments.
patterns.domain: Biomedical, drug delivery, and clinical research

patterns.name: Electrophysiology and Physiological Measurement Terms
patterns.context: Technical medical terms contain similar letter sequences or internal splits; there is no apparent unified physiological-process condition.
patterns.domain: Biomedical research, clinical cases, and diagnosis

patterns.name: Specific Internal Fragments in Medical Vocabulary
patterns.context: Activation occurs within medical terms or common compound words; some fragments may reflect word form or tokenization boundaries alone.

6_1317.concept: 医学专业词形片段
6_1317.description: 激活主要散落在医学文本的专业词内：尤其是 trans- 开头的给药、解剖或移植相关词，以及电生理、诊断和操作术语。各段触发位置不一，未显出单一明确语义条件。

patterns.name: 经皮/跨组织给药或递送
patterns.context: 医学文本中出现以 trans- 开头的解剖部位或跨组织术语；激活落在词内不同 token 片段上。
patterns.domain: 生物医学、药物递送与临床研究

patterns.name: 电生理与生理测量术语
patterns.context: 专业医学术语含有相似的字母片段或词内分段；没有明显统一的生理过程条件。
patterns.domain: 生物医学研究、临床病例与诊断

patterns.name: 医学词汇中的特定词内片段
patterns.context: 激活出现在医学术语或常见复合词内部，部分片段可能只是词形或分词边界效应。

en.concept: Medical technology terminology and method expressions
en.description: Activation primarily falls on word-initial or internal fragments of technical terms such as electro- and trans-, as well as method efficacy expressions with “allows” in medical abstracts; it also responds to uroflowmetry terms and method-evaluation terms, and appears at a paper metadata boundary in one instance.

patterns.name: Electro- prefix and internal word segmentation
patterns.context: Medical or technical texts contain terms beginning with electro-; activation falls on word-initial or multiple internal subword fragments; [1], [2], [5], [10]
patterns.domain: Biomedical texts, sensors, electrocardiograms, EEG, and speech recognition

patterns.name: Internal segmentation of trans-
patterns.context: trans- forms part of a technical or medical term, especially when describing sensors or administration routes; [2], [6], [7]
patterns.domain: Biosensing, vaccine delivery, sedation and analgesia

patterns.name: Allow expressions of method efficacy
patterns.context: A method or research plan is followed by allows, introducing an outcome the method can achieve; see “This approach allows…” and “The method allows…”; [3], [4], [8]

patterns.name: Uroflowmetry terminology
patterns.context: Describes uroflowmetry and its examination procedure; the term is repeated at the beginning of a sentence or in a title; [1]

patterns.name: simple / rapid method evaluation
patterns.context: Evaluates the simplicity, speed, and other properties of an analytical method; [9]
patterns.domain: Drug monitoring and analytical method abstracts

patterns.name: BibTeX entry ending
patterns.context: An ArXiv document ends a reference entry and then proceeds to the title and main text; activation is concentrated on electroencephalography in the title; [10]

6_1317.concept: 医学技术术语与方法表述
6_1317.description: 激活主要落在 electro-、trans- 等技术词的词首或词内片段，以及医学摘要中 “allows” 方法效用表述；另对尿流测定词和分析方法评价词有反应，并出现在一处论文元数据边界。

patterns.name: Electro- 前缀与词内切分
patterns.context: 医学或技术文本中出现以 electro- 开头的术语，激活落在词首或词内多个子词片段；[1]、[2]、[5]、[10]
patterns.domain: 生物医学、传感器、心电图、脑电与语音识别

patterns.name: trans- 词内切分
patterns.context: trans- 构成技术或医学术语的一部分，尤其描述传感器或给药途径；[2]、[6]、[7]
patterns.domain: 生物传感、疫苗递送、镇静镇痛

patterns.name: 允许与方法表述
patterns.context: 方法或研究方案后接 allows，引出方法所能实现的结果；见 “This approach allows…”、“The method allows…”；[3]、[4]、[8]

patterns.name: 尿流测定术语
patterns.context: 描述尿流测定及其检查流程，术语在句首或标题中重复出现；[1]

patterns.name: simple / rapid 方法评价
patterns.context: 评价分析方法的简便、快速等性质；[9]
patterns.domain: 药物监测与分析方法摘要

patterns.name: BibTeX 条目结尾
patterns.context: ArXiv 文档中参考文献条目结束、随后进入标题和正文；激活集中在标题中的 electroencephalography；[10]
patterns.domain: ArXiv 元数据与论文正文

en.description: Most passages concern biomedical experimental methods, testing technologies, and their operation, performance, or results; there are also PCR steps, numerical parameters, drug names, and scattered technical terms. Triggers are distributed across term subwords and methodological descriptions and cannot be fully reduced to a single semantic category.

patterns.name: Experimental Method or Testing Technology Names
patterns.context: A technology or method name appears as the subject of a sentence or as a key noun in an experimental workflow, often with descriptions of performance, use, or experimental operation; activation may span subword fragments within terms.
patterns.domain: Biomedical research, experimental methods, and testing technologies

patterns.name: requires and Conditions for Method Implementation
patterns.context: Describes the objects, operations, or equipment required for a test or procedure; the activation word occurs in a methods description.
patterns.domain: Medical examinations and molecular testing method descriptions

patterns.name: PCR and Related Experimental Steps
patterns.context: The context involves nucleic acid amplification, primers, or PCR workflows.

patterns.name: Quantitative Results and Measurement Parameters
patterns.context: Numbers, units, sample sizes, or performance comparisons appear in experimental results or study designs; no uniform numeric semantics are present.

patterns.name: Chemical or Pharmacological Intervention Names
patterns.context: Compounds, toxins, or drug names appear in pharmacological experimental results or lists of drug classes.

patterns.name: Specific Technical Advantages or Performance Descriptions
patterns.context: A method description compares a new technology with existing methods or states its sensitivity, speed, or ease of use.

patterns.name: Immunohistochemical Staining Workflow
patterns.context: A workflow comprising tissue arrays, antibody incubation, buffer, and temperature and time conditions.

patterns.name: Neuromuscular Mechanism Categories
patterns.context: Neuromuscular or neuronal mechanisms are listed among treatment or drug categories.
patterns.domain: Pharmacology reviews or clinical research abstracts

patterns.name: Unusual Urodynamic Test and Complications
patterns.context: Uroflowmetry requires patients to drink water; the text discusses resulting water intoxication, hyponatremia, and seizures.

patterns.name: Other Biomedical Terms and Context Fragments
patterns.context: Specific genes, pathogens, pharmacokinetic descriptions, or term fragments appear, but each is insufficient to establish a shared trigger condition.
patterns.domain: Molecular biology, microbiology, pharmacokinetics, and experimental methods

6_1317.concept: 生物医学实验方法与检测
6_1317.description: 多数片段涉及生物医学实验方法、检测技术及其操作、性能或结果；也有PCR步骤、数值参数、药物名称和零散专业术语。触发分散在术语子词及方法描述中，不能完全归为单一语义。

patterns.name: 实验方法或检测技术名称
patterns.context: 技术或方法名称作为句子主语或实验流程中的核心名词出现，常伴随性能、用途或实验操作描述；术语内部可跨子词片段激活。
patterns.domain: 生物医学研究、实验方法与检测技术

patterns.name: requires 与方法实施条件
patterns.trigger: «requires»；«requires» patients to «consume» fluid；«requires» much simpler equipment
patterns.context: 描述检测或程序所需的对象、操作或设备；激活词位于方法说明中。
patterns.domain: 医学检查及分子检测方法描述

patterns.name: PCR及相关实验步骤
patterns.context: 出现核酸扩增、引物或PCR实验流程的上下文。
patterns.domain: 分子生物学与病原检测

patterns.name: 定量结果与测量参数
patterns.context: 实验结果或研究设计中出现数值、单位、样本量或性能比较；没有统一的数值语义。
patterns.domain: 生物医学摘要及研究计划

patterns.name: 化学或药理干预物名称
patterns.context: 在药理实验结果或药物类别枚举中出现化合物、毒素或药物名称。
patterns.domain: 药理学与临床研究摘要

patterns.name: 特定技术优势或性能表述
patterns.trigger: «faster» than traditional PCR；«50» fold more «sensitive»；«permits» direct «on»-«column» injection
patterns.context: 方法描述中将新技术与既有方法比较，或陈述灵敏度、速度、操作便利性。

patterns.name: 免疫组织化学染色流程
patterns.context: 组织芯片与抗体孵育、缓冲液及温度时间条件组成的实验步骤。
patterns.domain: 组织学与免疫检测方法

patterns.name: 神经肌肉机制分类
patterns.context: 在治疗或药物类别列表中列举神经肌肉或神经元机制。
patterns.domain: 药理学综述或临床研究摘要

patterns.name: 非常规尿动力学检查及并发症
patterns.context: 尿流率检查要求患者饮水，文中讨论由此导致的水中毒、低钠血症和癫痫发作。

patterns.name: 其他生物医学术语及上下文碎片
patterns.context: 出现特定基因、病原体、药代动力学描述或术语片段，但各自不足以形成共同触发条件。
patterns.domain: 分子生物学、微生物学、药代动力学及实验方法

en.description: Activation commonly occurs in biomedical method descriptions, especially “requires,” “allows,” “involves,” and statements about method function, simplicity, and performance; measurement terminology and several distinct technical topics also appear, while some passages cannot be explained by the main pattern.

patterns.name: Strong activation on “requires”
patterns.context: In descriptions of methods or technologies, states what patients, conditions, equipment, or operations they require; in [1] it is followed by “patients,” while the other examples describe method characteristics.
patterns.domain: Biomedical paper abstracts and method introductions

patterns.name: Strong activation on “allows”
patterns.context: Introduces what a method, technology, or measurement approach can achieve.

patterns.name: Strong activation on “involves”
patterns.context: Explains which steps, operations, or burdens an experimental method or clinical procedure includes.

patterns.name: Simplicity and low burden in method evaluation
patterns.context: A method or procedure is described as simple, easy to implement, requiring few operations, or imposing a low burden on patients; this pattern does not occur in every passage.
patterns.domain: Clinical testing and introductions to biomedical methods

patterns.name: Method performance and measurement accuracy
patterns.context: Describes the performance, speed, or reliability of a detection or measurement method.

patterns.name: Technical terms containing “-metry”
patterns.context: Terms contain “metry/metric,” related to measurement; “uroflowmetry” also appears in [1].

patterns.name: Generic reference to a method or technology
patterns.context: Following an earlier introduction of a technology or experimental procedure, describes its speed, requirements, uses, or performance.

patterns.name: Transducer-related terminology
patterns.context: The paragraph opens with electrochemical sensing/transducers; no clear local trigger words correspond to those in other passages.

patterns.name: Gel electrophoresis experimental terminology
patterns.context: A detection technique listed in studies of DNA damage or related experimental protocols; its notable local word-form relationship to the other passages is unclear.

patterns.name: Transdermal delivery terminology
patterns.context: Discusses delivery of vaccines or drugs through the skin and their immune effects; no clear trigger shared with the other passages is evident.

patterns.name: Neuromuscular stimulation terminology
patterns.context: Discusses exercise fatigue and motor neuron firing following a single TMS session; apart from method expressions, this is a distinct research topic.

6_1317.concept: 生物医学方法描述
6_1317.description: 激活常见于生物医学方法描述，尤其是“requires”“allows”“involves”及对方法功能、简便性和性能的说明；另见计量术语和若干独特技术主题，部分段落无法由主模式解释。

patterns.name: “requires”的突出激活
patterns.context: 方法或技术说明中，描述其需要患者、条件、设备或操作；[1]中后接“patients”，其余为方法特征。
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文摘要及方法介绍

patterns.name: “allows”的突出激活
patterns.context: 介绍某种方法、技术或测量手段所能实现的功能或结果。

patterns.name: “involves”的突出激活
patterns.context: 说明实验方法或临床操作包含哪些步骤、操作或负担。
patterns.domain: 生物医学方法与临床研究

patterns.name: 方法评价中的简便性与低负担
patterns.context: 方法或操作被描述为简单、易实施、操作少或患者负担低；不是所有段都出现此模式。
patterns.domain: 临床检测与生物医学方法介绍

patterns.name: 方法性能与测量准确性
patterns.context: 描述检测或测量方法的性能、速度或可靠性。
patterns.domain: 生物医学技术与测量研究

patterns.name: 含“-metry”的技术术语
patterns.context: 术语含有计量/测量相关的“metry/metric”字样；在[1]也出现“uroflowmetry”。

patterns.name: 方法或技术的泛指提及
patterns.context: 承接先前提出的技术或实验流程，转而陈述其速度、需求、用途或性能。

patterns.name: 转导器相关术语
patterns.context: 段落开头以电化学传感/转导器为主题；没有明显对应其他段的局部触发词。

patterns.name: 凝胶电泳实验术语
patterns.context: 研究DNA损伤或相关实验方案中列举的检测技术；与其余段落的显著局部词形关系不明。

patterns.name: 经皮递送术语
patterns.context: 讨论疫苗或药物通过皮肤递送及其免疫效果；未见与其他段相同的明显触发词。

patterns.name: 神经肌肉刺激术语
patterns.context: 讨论运动疲劳及单次TMS后的运动神经元放电；除方法表述外，是独特的研究内容。

en.description: Activations occur within subword fragments of words, especially in medical and biochemical terminology, method names, and chemical names; they also cover numerical units and procedural expressions in experimental methods. A separate instance involves a math problem, so the feature cannot be assigned to a single semantic topic.

patterns.name: Subword fragments and intraword boundaries
patterns.context: Activations fall on internal fragments of continuous alphabetic words, components of chemical names, or portions of number strings; common in terms with complex subword segmentation, but also seen in numerical sequences.
patterns.domain: Biomedical terminology, chemical names, math problems

patterns.name: Methods, tests, or instrument-related expressions
patterns.context: Occurs when biomedical papers introduce detection, analysis, or experimental methods; activations cover method names, related terminology, and performance descriptions, without consistently identifying one specific technique.

patterns.name: Experimental procedures and measurement expressions
patterns.context: Numbers, units, reagent concentrations, times, or procedural steps occur in methods descriptions; markers are distributed across numbers, units, and nearby text, and not all measurement expressions activate equally.

patterns.name: Biochemical assays and enzymology terminology
patterns.context: Glutathione, GST, and the names of their substrates or products appear, especially subword fragments within chemical names.

patterns.name: Uroflowmetry and water-intake-induced complications
patterns.context: In a uroflowmetry context, describes patients drinking fluids and subsequent water intoxication, hyponatremia, or seizures.

patterns.name: PCR, DNA, and genetic testing
patterns.context: Descriptions of nucleic acid quality, amplification, PCR techniques, or genetic features; activation targets include abbreviations and surrounding methodological text.

patterns.name: Flow cytometry and immunoassay markers
patterns.context: Describes fluorescent labeling, staining, or cell markers in neutrophil experiments related to Mycobacterium tuberculosis.

patterns.name: Breast cancer radiotherapy and DNA damage assessment
patterns.context: Introduces a study of skin reactions to radiotherapy in breast cancer patients and proposed DNA damage detection methods.

patterns.name: Mathematical sequences and algebraic expressions
patterns.context: Numbers, operators, and polynomial expressions in sequence or algebra problems; clearly differs from the biomedical corpus topic.

patterns.name: Rare segmentation within compounds
patterns.context: Activations concentrate on internal fragments of chemical compound names; connected to adjacent biochemical assay text, but the specific compound appears only here.

6_1317.concept: 复杂术语与子词片段
6_1317.description: 激活分布于词内子词片段，尤其是医学、生化术语、方法名及化学名称；也覆盖实验方法中的数字单位和操作表达。另有独立数学题实例，故无法归为单一语义主题。

patterns.name: 子词片段与词内边界
patterns.trigger: 词内被分段标记的片段，如 «ro»5«flow»2«metry»1、«non»7«invasive»5、«init»2«ro»9benz«ene»1，以及 «12»191、«540»269
patterns.context: 激活落在连续字母词的内部片段、化学名称的组成部分，或数字串的一段；常见于子词切分复杂的术语，也有数字序列实例。
patterns.domain: 生物医学术语、化学名称、数学题

patterns.name: 方法、测试或仪器相关表述
patterns.trigger: «U»1«ro»5«flow»3«metry»3« is»4；«The»1« nested»« RT»«-»«PCR»；«This»« technique»« is»« faster»；«The»« new»« method»
patterns.context: 生物医学论文中介绍检测、分析或实验方法时出现；激活覆盖方法名、相关术语及其性能描述，未稳定限定某一种技术。
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文与研究摘要

patterns.name: 实验流程与计量表达
patterns.context: 方法学描述中出现数字、单位、试剂浓度、时间或操作步骤；标记分布于数字、单位和邻近文字，且并非每处计量表达都同样激活。

patterns.name: 生化测定与酶学术语
patterns.context: 出现谷胱甘肽、GST及其底物或产物名称，尤其是化学名称内部的子词片段。

patterns.name: 尿流测定与饮水诱发并发症
patterns.trigger: « unusual complication« following»« u»«ro»«flow»«metry»；« requires»« patients» to« consume» fluid« orally»
patterns.context: 尿流测定语境中描述患者饮液及随后的水中毒、低钠血症或癫痫发作。

patterns.name: PCR、DNA与遗传检测
patterns.context: 核酸质量、扩增、PCR 技术或遗传特征的描述；激活对象包括缩写和其周边方法文本。
patterns.domain: 分子生物学与微生物学

patterns.name: 流式细胞与免疫实验标记
patterns.context: 结核分枝杆菌相关中性粒细胞实验中，描述荧光标记、染色或细胞标志物。

patterns.name: 乳腺癌放疗与DNA损伤评估
patterns.trigger: « breast cancer»、« radiation»« fraction»«ation»、« pulse»«-»«field»« gel»« electrophoresis»
patterns.context: 介绍乳腺癌患者放疗皮肤反应研究及拟采用的DNA损伤检测方法。
patterns.domain: 临床研究计划与放射生物学

patterns.name: 数学序列与代数表达
patterns.context: 数列或代数题中的数字、运算符及多项式表达；与生物医学语料主题明显不同。

patterns.name: 化合物内部的罕见切分
patterns.context: 激活集中在化学化合物名称的内部片段；与相邻的生化测定文本相连，但该具体化合物仅此处出现。

en.description: Activation is distributed across English morphemes, word beginnings, and punctuation boundaries, covering medical conditions and treatments, research methods, patent formulations, and minus signs and operators in math problems. Trigger words differ by domain, with no single stable semantic theme.

patterns.name: English internal word and interword boundaries
patterns.context: Activation often falls on split morphemes, word beginnings, or positions adjacent to punctuation; the locations vary across passages and show no stable single lexical trigger.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain English texts and mathematical notation

patterns.name: Negative numbers and sequence problems in mathematics
patterns.context: Appears in questions asking for the next term or the cth term of a sequence; activation usually concentrates on minus signs or number fragments, insufficient to confirm a response to the sequence rule itself.

patterns.name: Minus signs and operators in mathematical expressions
patterns.context: Appears in fractions, negative numbers, algebraic expressions, or true/false questions; activation locations vary and may be related to mathematical notation or symbol tokenization.

patterns.name: Morpheme fragments in clinical descriptions
patterns.context: Occurs in clinical narratives about diseases, drugs, treatments, or medical devices; activation is distributed across local fragments of different medical terms.
patterns.domain: PubMed medical abstracts and case descriptions

patterns.name: Research methods and detection terminology
patterns.context: In descriptions of methods, detection techniques, or research procedures, activation occurs on method names or words expressing speed or requirements.

patterns.name: Property descriptions in patent formulations
patterns.context: Describes desired properties of formulations for topical or oral preparations.

6_1317.concept: 词片段与符号边界
6_1317.description: 激活分散在英语词素、词首和标点边界，覆盖医学病情与治疗、研究方法、专利配方及数学题中的负号和运算符。各领域触发词不同，未见单一稳定语义主题。

patterns.name: 英语词内及词间边界
patterns.trigger: 单词开头、词内片段或标点边界，如 «u»«ro»«flow»、«non»«invasive»、« -»、«/»、«*»、«=»、«(»
patterns.context: 激活常落在拆分的词素、单词开头或紧邻标点处；不同段中落点并不固定，也未显示稳定的单一词汇触发条件。
patterns.domain: 跨领域英语文本与数学符号文本

patterns.name: 数学负数与序列题
patterns.context: 出现在问下一个项、求数列第 c 项等题目中；激活通常集中在负号或数字片段，不足以确认其对数列规律本身有反应。

patterns.name: 数学表达式中的负号与运算符
patterns.context: 出现在分数、负数、代数式或真假判断中；具体激活位置各异，可能与数学标记或符号分词有关。

patterns.name: 临床描述中的词素片段
patterns.context: 位于疾病、药物、治疗或医疗器械的临床叙述中；激活分布于不同医学词汇的局部片段。
patterns.domain: PubMed 医学摘要与病例描述

patterns.name: 研究方法与检测术语
patterns.context: 方法、检测技术或研究流程描述中，激活出现在方法名称或表示速度、要求的词上。

patterns.name: 专利配方的性质描述
patterns.context: 描述用于外用或口腔制剂的期望配方性质。

en.description: Primarily responds to descriptions of procedures, performance, and ease of use in biomedical methods and detection texts, often alongside HPLC, detection, or sample-processing terminology; sporadic triggers also include equipment, molecular mechanisms, and mathematical symbols.

patterns.name: Uroflowmetry terminology
patterns.context: The term uroflowmetry is marked as a split word in a medical abstract; the same passage then describes the examination procedure and complications.

patterns.name: Detection workflows and method descriptions
patterns.context: Describes steps, procedures, or sample processing required for detection or experimental methods; also occurs in statements about method sensitivity and ease of operation.

patterns.name: Evaluation of method performance and usability
patterns.context: Evaluates the sensitivity, simplicity, speed, robustness, or ease of operation of medical or experimental methods, equipment, or kits; activation strength varies.

patterns.name: HPLC analysis and detection
patterns.context: Descriptions of liquid chromatography or related detection methods, sample analysis, and quantitative performance.

patterns.name: Medical equipment usability attributes
patterns.context: Describes the convenience of inhaler administration, along with attributes such as lightweight, sturdy, and rapid pain relief.

patterns.name: Operators in math problems
patterns.context: Symbols such as multiplication and minus signs are marked in algebraic expressions and sequence problems; differs from the medical-methods context.

patterns.name: Terms related to plasminogen activation
patterns.context: Biochemical descriptions involving streptokinase, fibrinolysis, and plasminogen activation mechanisms.

patterns.name: Biotin–avidin detection systems
patterns.context: Describes molecular detection using biotin–avidin interactions and mentions particles or microplates.

patterns.name: Abdominal fat-pad aspiration
patterns.context: Describes a tissue-sampling procedure as easy to perform, safe, and associated with little discomfort.

patterns.name: Information systems and kit project goals
patterns.context: Project descriptions propose interfaces for hospital information-management equipment and the development of easy-to-use, low-cost kits.

6_1317.concept: 方法与检测描述
6_1317.description: 主要响应生物医学方法与检测文本中的操作、性能和易用性描述，常伴随HPLC、检测或样本处理术语；另有设备、分子机制及数学符号等零散触发。

patterns.name: 尿流测定术语
patterns.context: 在医学摘要中，术语 uroflowmetry 被拆分标记；同段随后描述检查流程及并发症。

patterns.name: 检测流程与方法描述
patterns.context: 描述检测或实验方法所需步骤、操作或样本处理；也见于方法灵敏度、操作简便性的表述。
patterns.domain: 生物医学方法与检测摘要

patterns.name: 方法性能与易用性评价
patterns.context: 评价医疗或实验方法、设备、试剂盒的灵敏度、简便性、速度、稳健性或易操作性；触发强度并不都相同。
patterns.domain: 生物医学摘要及项目说明

patterns.name: HPLC分析及检测
patterns.context: 液相色谱或相关检测方法、样本分析及定量性能的描述。

patterns.name: 医疗设备操作属性
patterns.context: 描述吸入器给药便利性，并连带出现轻便、坚固、快速镇痛等属性。

patterns.name: 数学题中的运算符号
patterns.context: 代数表达式与数列题中，乘号和负号等符号被标记；与医学方法语境不同。

patterns.name: 止血酶原激活相关术语
patterns.context: 涉及链激酶、纤溶及纤溶酶原激活机制的生化描述。

patterns.name: 生物素-亲和素检测体系
patterns.context: 描述用生物素-亲和素相互作用进行分子检测，并提及微粒或微孔板。

patterns.name: 腹部脂肪垫抽吸
patterns.context: 说明组织取样程序的易操作、安全及低不适感。

patterns.name: 信息系统与试剂盒项目目标
patterns.context: 项目说明中提出医院信息管理设备接口及开发易用、低成本试剂盒。

en.description: Primarily responds to descriptions of the practicality and performance of methods, techniques, or tools, especially simplicity, speed, and ease of use; also involves procedural requirements and detection metrics. Additional contexts include analgesic administration and cancer research, while segment 3 lacks a clear corresponding signal.

patterns.name: Method performance and simplicity descriptions
patterns.context: Describes advantages of detection, experimental, or operational methods; often paired with “method/technique/protocol” or “easy to + verb.”
patterns.domain: Biomedical papers, experimental method abstracts, and product reviews; segments 1, 4, 5, 7, 8, 10

patterns.name: Time and requirements of a method or procedure
patterns.context: States how much time, effort, or participant cooperation an examination, experiment, or intervention requires; sometimes listed alongside simplicity.
patterns.domain: Clinical abstracts and experimental procedure descriptions; segments 1, 2, 6, 8

patterns.name: Technical, reagent, and detection equipment terminology
patterns.context: Context contains specific experimental techniques, measurement equipment, materials, or detection targets; may co-occur with method performance descriptions.
patterns.domain: Molecular biology, clinical testing, and biomedical research texts; segments 3, 4, 5, 6, 8, 9, 10

patterns.name: Portability and ease of carrying
patterns.context: Evaluates a jump rope as suitable for carrying, travel, or packing in luggage; non-academic context.

patterns.name: Pain relief and ease of administration
patterns.context: Describes a methoxyflurane inhaler providing analgesia to patients and evaluates it as easy to administer.

patterns.name: Quantitative and analytical performance metrics
patterns.context: Reports performance data such as detection limits, coefficients of variation, or sensitivity.

patterns.name: Detection or tool requirements in cancer research
patterns.context: Describes measurement methods, research goals, or needed tools in cancer-related research plans or background; does not always evaluate ease of use.

6_1317.concept: 方法的实用性与性能
6_1317.description: 主要响应对方法、技术或工具的实用性与性能描述，尤其简便、快速、易操作、易携带；也涉及流程要求和检测指标。另有镇痛给药及癌症研究语境，段3缺乏明显对应信号。

patterns.name: 方法性能与简便性描述
patterns.context: 描述检测、实验或操作方法的优点；常与“method/technique/protocol”或“easy to + 动词”搭配。
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文、实验方法摘要及产品评论；段1、4、5、7、8、10

patterns.name: 方法或流程的耗时、所需条件
patterns.context: 交代某项检查、实验或干预需要的时间、操作或参与者配合；有时与简便性评价并列。
patterns.domain: 临床摘要与实验操作说明；段1、2、6、8

patterns.name: 技术、试剂与检测设备术语
patterns.context: 上下文集中出现具体实验技术、测量设备、材料或检测对象；可能与方法性能描述同现。
patterns.domain: 分子生物学、临床检验及生物医学研究文本；段3、4、5、6、8、9、10

patterns.name: 便携、轻便与易携带
patterns.trigger: “super light”“easy to bring”“bring in your luggage”
patterns.context: 评价跳绳适合携带、旅行或放入行李；非学术语境。

patterns.name: 疼痛缓解与给药便利
patterns.context: 描述甲氧氟烷吸入器为患者提供镇痛，并评价其易于施用。

patterns.name: 量化与分析性能指标
patterns.trigger: “limit of quantification”“coefficients of variation”“highly sensitive”“detection of 30 molecules of DNA”
patterns.context: 报告检测方法的定量限、变异系数或灵敏度等性能数据。
patterns.domain: 生物医学分析方法摘要；段4、8

patterns.name: 癌症研究中的检测或工具需求
patterns.context: 癌症相关研究计划或研究背景中，描述测量方法、研究目标或所需工具；并不总是评价方法简便性。

en.concept: Ease of use and simplicity, with number-string responses
en.description: Activation is distributed across number strings in math sequence problems and words or phrases in biomedical texts expressing ease of use, simplicity, speed, sensitivity, or safety; there is no single stable trigger pattern across passages.

patterns.name: “easy to” phrases
patterns.context: Describes a product, device, or method as easy to implement, use, or operate; followed by “express” in [1], “administer” in [3], and “use” in [9].
patterns.domain: Biomedical abstracts and NIH project descriptions

patterns.name: Number strings in math sequence problems
patterns.context: Math problems ask for the next term or a specific term in a sequence; numbers and their internal fragments show sporadic strong activation, with no clear, uniform numerical rule.

patterns.name: Comparative speed and equipment simplification
patterns.context: Emphasizes that a detection technology is faster than traditional methods and requires simpler equipment.

patterns.name: Detection sensitivity and operational simplicity
patterns.context: Describes the sensitivity of a detection method, the number of operations, and ease of use.

patterns.name: Vaccine safety
patterns.context: Discusses obstacles and safety risks in vaccine development, mentioning formalin-inactivated vaccines.

6_1317.concept: 易用性与简便性，兼有数字串响应
6_1317.description: 激活分散于数学数列题中的数字串，以及生物医学文本里表示易用、简便、快速、灵敏或安全的词句；各段没有单一稳定的触发模式。

patterns.name: “easy to”短语
patterns.context: 描述产品、设备或方法容易实现、使用或操作；在[1]后接“express”，[3]后接“administer”，[9]后接“use”。
patterns.domain: 生物医学摘要、NIH项目说明

patterns.name: 数学序列题中的数字串
patterns.context: 数学题中询问数列下一项或某项，数字及其内部片段呈现离散的强激活；未见统一的明确数值规则。

patterns.name: 比较速度与设备简化
patterns.context: 强调某检测技术较传统方法更快、所需设备更简单。

patterns.name: 检测灵敏度与简便操作
patterns.context: 描述检测方法的灵敏度、操作数量及简便性。

patterns.name: 疫苗安全性
patterns.context: 讨论疫苗开发的障碍与安全风险，提及福尔马林灭活疫苗。

en.description: Primarily responds to descriptions of methods, devices, products, or treatments as easy to use or operate, often alongside advantages such as speed, high sensitivity, or resource efficiency; also includes negative-number arithmetic problems and introductions to chromatography methods.

patterns.name: Ease of use or operation
patterns.context: Describes methods, devices, reagents, or treatments as easy to implement or operate; typically occurs in statements of advantages or requirements.
patterns.domain: Biomedical, product/device patents, technical evaluations, and online discussions

patterns.name: Speed or efficiency
patterns.context: Emphasizes the speed, sensitivity, or resource efficiency of detection methods, treatments, or software.

patterns.name: Negative numbers in math problems
patterns.context: Minus signs, fractions, and magnitude comparisons appear in arithmetic problems; differs from the usability descriptions in the other passages.

patterns.name: Chromatographic analysis methods
patterns.context: Introduces a developed analytical detection method using abbreviations and technical terminology; usability is not clearly emphasized.

6_1317.concept: 易用性与实用性能
6_1317.description: 主要响应对方法、设备、产品或治疗易于使用、操作简单的描述，也常伴随快速、高灵敏或省资源等优点；另有负数算术题和色谱方法介绍。

patterns.name: 容易使用或操作
patterns.trigger: “easy to express”“easy to use”“easy to administer”，以及“simpler equipment”“few and simple operations”
patterns.context: 描述方法、设备、试剂或治疗方案易于实施、操作简单；通常出现在优点或需求的陈述中。
patterns.domain: 生物医学、产品/设备专利、技术评价与网络讨论

patterns.name: 快速或高效
patterns.context: 强调检测方法、治疗或软件的速度、灵敏度或资源效率。
patterns.domain: 生物医学、计算机使用经验

patterns.name: 数学题中的负数表达
patterns.trigger: “u = - - - / 5. Which is smaller: u or -717?”及后续分数算式
patterns.context: 算术题中出现负号、分数和大小比较；与其余段落的易用性描述不同。

patterns.name: 色谱分析方法
patterns.context: 以缩写和专业术语介绍已开发的分析检测方法；未明显体现易用性。

en.concept: Simple and easy-to-use methods or tools
en.description: Primarily responds to advantages of biomedical detection, reagents, experiments, or clinical methods being easy to use, simple, and requiring little equipment or effort; also covers tool performance and quantitative metrics. It also responds to math problem prompts and nearby numbers.

patterns.name: Ease of use, operation, or implementation
patterns.context: Describes kits, inhalers, binding agents, or clinical procedures as easy to use, administer, express, or perform; nearby text often lists advantages.
patterns.domain: Biomedical abstracts and medical project descriptions

patterns.name: Simple methods with little equipment or few steps
patterns.context: Emphasizes that a technique, detection method, or medical procedure requires little equipment, few operations, or little effort; often listed with ease of use and speed.

patterns.name: Development and application of detection/analysis tools
patterns.context: Introduces detection methods, experimental workflows, diagnostics, or research tools and their uses or performance.
patterns.domain: Biomedical abstracts and grant project descriptions

patterns.name: Sequence or arithmetic questions in math problems
patterns.context: Prompt wording appears next to numbers, fractions, or sequences; activation also falls on or near numbers and symbols in the problem.

patterns.name: Rapid or effective clinical outcomes
patterns.context: Describes a methoxyflurane inhaler relieving pain in high-altitude patients; appears alongside ease of administration.

patterns.name: Quantified metrics in time- and number-based chemical experiment procedures
patterns.context: Detection limits, required days, and other quantitative metrics are mentioned in method or experiment descriptions.

6_1317.concept: 简便易用的方法或工具
6_1317.description: 主要响应生物医学检测、试剂、实验或临床方法的易用、简便、少设备/少负担等优点，也覆盖工具性能与量化指标；另对数学题提示语及邻近数字有响应。

patterns.name: 易于使用、操作或实施
patterns.context: 描述试剂盒、吸入器、结合剂或临床操作易于使用、给药、表达或执行；邻近常有对优点的列举。
patterns.domain: 生物医学摘要、医疗项目说明

patterns.name: 简便、低设备或省步骤的方法
patterns.context: 强调技术、检测或医疗程序所需设备、操作或负担较少；常与易用、快速等优点并列。
patterns.domain: 生物医学研究与临床描述

patterns.name: 检测/分析工具的开发与应用
patterns.context: 介绍检测方法、实验流程、诊断或研究工具及其用途或性能。
patterns.domain: 生物医学摘要、资助项目说明

patterns.name: 数学题中的数列或算术问句
patterns.trigger: «What is next»（[6][8]）；«What is the common denominator»（[5]）
patterns.context: 紧邻数字、分数或数列，呈现题目提示语；激活也落在题目中的数字或符号附近。

patterns.name: 快速或有效的临床效果
patterns.context: 描述高海拔患者使用甲氧氟烷吸入器缓解疼痛，属于病例报告；与易于给药同时出现。

patterns.name: 时间/数量表达中的数字化学实验流程
patterns.context: 方法或实验描述中提及检测限、所需天数等量化指标。

en.concept: Local technical text and symbol-string features
en.description: Activations are distributed across two prominent contexts: biomedical text evaluating method advantages and usability, and negative numbers, number strings, and general terms in automatically generated sequence problems. There are also sporadic responses to PCR formatting, quantitative units, and subword fragments of drug names.

patterns.name: Evaluative words in method performance descriptions
patterns.context: Summary evaluations of research or technical methods, often following method names, uses, or research needs; evaluative words and their collocations are marked, while most surrounding words are not.
patterns.domain: Biomedical abstracts and NIH research project descriptions

patterns.name: Nested RT-PCR and instrument model formatting
patterns.context: PCR terminology and names or model numbers composed of digits and hyphens in experimental method passages; activation falls on part of the formatted string, not the entire biological passage.

patterns.name: Negative numbers and symbol-number strings in sequence problems
patterns.context: Sequence terms or target terms are presented as negative numbers or comma-separated number lists; typically embedded in a “what is the …'th term” question and answer, with activations concentrated unevenly on symbol and number fragments.

patterns.name: Linear expressions in sequence problem answers
patterns.context: The general-term answer following a sequence problem contains a negative coefficient, variable, and additive constant; only some symbols, variables, or numbers are marked.

patterns.name: Squared variables in algebraic expressions
patterns.context: An expression containing a squared variable occurs near a sequence Q&A; in this example, activation covers the coefficient, squared variable, and constant.

patterns.name: Units and quantitative terms in medical numerical reports
patterns.context: Detection or quantification limits appear next to concentration units in reports of analytical method performance; the passage also contains other method evaluation terms, but the numerical unit fragment is a distinct trigger form.

patterns.name: Internal fragments of anesthetic names
patterns.context: A drug name is segmented into multiple subwords in a case description of analgesic effects.

6_1317.concept: 局部技术文本与符号串特征
6_1317.description: 激活分散于两类显著情境：方法优劣及易用性评价的生物医学文字，以及自动生成数列题中的负数、数字串和通项式；另对PCR格式、量化单位和药名子词有零星响应。

patterns.name: 方法性能描述中的评价词
patterns.context: 研究或技术方法的总结性评价，常在方法名称、用途或研究需求之后；评价词及其搭配被标记，周围其他词多未标记。
patterns.domain: 生物医学摘要、NIH研究项目描述

patterns.name: 嵌套RT-PCR与仪器型号格式
patterns.context: 实验方法段落中，PCR术语和由数字、连字符构成的型号或名称；激活落在格式片段的一部分，并非整段生物学内容。

patterns.name: 数学数列题中的负数与符号数字串
patterns.context: 数列项或待求项以负数、逗号分隔数字列呈现；通常嵌在“what is the …'th term”题目及答案中，激活集中在符号和数字片段，不均匀覆盖。
patterns.domain: 自动生成的数学数列问答

patterns.name: 数列题答案中的线性表达式
patterns.context: 数列题后给出的通项答案，包含负系数、变量及加法常数；仅部分符号、变量或数字被标记。
patterns.domain: 自动生成的数学数列问答

patterns.name: 代数式中的平方变量
patterns.context: 数列问答附近出现含变量平方的表达式；该例中激活覆盖系数、变量平方和常数。
patterns.domain: 数学表达式／自动生成题目

patterns.name: 医学数值报告中的单位与量化词
patterns.context: 分析方法性能报告中，检出或定量限与浓度单位相邻；同段还有其他方法评价用语，但该数值单位片段是可区分的触发形式。
patterns.domain: 生物医学摘要、分析化学

patterns.name: 麻醉药名称内部片段
patterns.context: 药物名称被拆分为多个子词，出现在关于镇痛效果的病例描述中。

en.description: Often responds to speed, simplicity, ease of use, and other practical advantages of methods or tools in technical and medical contexts; it also covers experimental parameters, molecular detection, clinical administration, sequence problems, and quantitative results, without a single stable trigger pattern.

patterns.name: Simple, rapid, easy-to-use methods
patterns.context: Highlights speed, operational simplicity, or ease of use when describing method, device, or product performance; often connected to other advantages by “and.”
patterns.domain: Biomedical abstracts, research project descriptions, and personal technical experience

patterns.name: Parallel presentation of performance and practical advantages
patterns.context: Describes advantages of technologies, reagents, devices, or software, often with “easy/rapid/simple” nearby, although these words are not always present.
patterns.domain: Research methods, medical technology, software, and hardware experience

patterns.name: PCR experimental procedures and conditions
patterns.context: The methods section specifies environmental DNA templates, instruments, or cycling conditions; activation falls on procedural words and nearby punctuation.

patterns.name: Number grouping in math sequence problems
patterns.context: Several groups of integers with no readily apparent pattern appear before and after the prompt in sequence problems; activation is concentrated on minus signs, some numbers, and connecting words in the prompt.

patterns.name: Quantitative results and statistical symbols in papers
patterns.context: Reports quantitative results such as limits of detection and analytical variation; activation is distributed around numbers, units, statistical terms, and percent signs.
patterns.domain: Analytical method validation in PubMed abstracts

patterns.name: Medical pain management and administration descriptions
patterns.context: A case description covers pain management in a remote, high-altitude setting and evaluates the ease of using an inhaler.

patterns.name: Biomedical molecular detection and capture
patterns.context: Discusses DNA detection, protein-capture arrays, or affinity binders and their research methods and application requirements.
patterns.domain: Biomedical research abstracts and grant applications

patterns.name: High-altitude location information
patterns.context: A clinical case specifies the patient’s high-altitude location; this occurs alongside evaluations of simplicity and speed, but the role of the location itself is unclear.

6_1317.concept: 科技方法的实用性优势
6_1317.description: 多在科技、医疗语境中响应方法或工具的快速、简单、易用及其他实用优势；也覆盖实验参数、分子检测、临床给药、数列题和定量结果，非单一稳定触发模式。

patterns.name: 方法简单、快速、易用
patterns.trigger: “simple”, “rapid”, “fast”, “faster”, “easy to use”, “easy to express”, “easy to administer”
patterns.context: 在介绍方法、设备或产品的性能时，突出速度、操作简便或易用性；常与“and”连接其他优点。
patterns.domain: 生物医学摘要、科研项目描述及个人技术经验

patterns.name: 性能与实用性优势并列
patterns.trigger: “robust”, “highly sensitive”, “inexpensive”, “smaller in size”, “highly stable”, “takes up little memory”
patterns.context: 描述技术、试剂、设备或软件的优势，常在“easy/rapid/simple”附近并列出现，但这些词本身并不总是出现。
patterns.domain: 科研方法、医疗技术、软件与硬件经验

patterns.name: PCR实验流程与条件
patterns.context: 实验方法部分交代环境DNA模板、仪器或循环条件；激活落在流程描述词及标点附近。

patterns.name: 数学数列题中的数字分组
patterns.trigger: “What is the next term”, “What comes next”, 以及带连字符、逗号的数字串
patterns.context: 数列题题干前后出现多组难以直接辨认规律的整数；激活集中于负号、部分数字及题干连接词。

patterns.name: 论文定量结果与统计符号
patterns.context: 报告检测限、分析变异等定量结果；激活分布在数字单位、统计术语和百分号附近。
patterns.domain: PubMed摘要中的分析方法验证

patterns.name: 医学疼痛处理与给药描述
patterns.context: 病例描述偏远高海拔环境下的疼痛处理，并评价吸入器的使用便利性。

patterns.name: 生物医学分子检测与捕获
patterns.trigger: “biotin-avidin interaction”, “detection of 30 molecules of DNA”, “Robust protein capture arrays”, “affinity binders”
patterns.context: 讨论DNA检测、蛋白捕获阵列或亲和结合剂的研究方法和应用需求。
patterns.domain: 生物医学研究摘要及项目申请

patterns.name: 高海拔地点信息
patterns.context: 临床病例中交代患者所在的高海拔地点；与方法简便、快速等评价同时出现，但地点本身的作用不明。

en.description: Primarily responds to descriptions of method performance, simplicity, and requirements (e.g., simple, rapid, requires); it also activates in math sequence problems and formulas, and in patent process and toxicity contexts, showing several patterns that are not fully unified.

patterns.name: Method advantages and performance descriptions
patterns.context: Describes the simplicity, speed, sensitivity, robustness, or low equipment and operation requirements of detection, biological, or analytical methods.

patterns.name: Requirements or operations involved
patterns.context: Method descriptions state the time, equipment, operations, or processing required; [9] says that an existing process “require the handling” of toxic substances.

patterns.name: Negative-number sequences and finding terms in math problems
patterns.context: A math problem asks for the pattern in a sequence or a particular term; often followed by a question, line break, and formula-like answer.

patterns.name: Quantitative detection performance metrics
patterns.context: Reports the quantification limit, coefficient of variation, and interference in an analytical method.
patterns.domain: Analytical method validation in PubMed abstracts

patterns.name: Binding and DNA detection in biological assays
patterns.context: Explains how a workflow captures hybrids and reports DNA detection sensitivity.

patterns.name: ChIP experimental protocol and duration
patterns.context: Introduces an experimental protocol optimized for a specific fungus and the time required to complete it.

patterns.name: Patent process and toxicity issues
patterns.context: Describes an existing sludge-to-fertilizer process and points out the hazard of using formaldehyde.

patterns.name: Sporadic mathematical formulas and solution instructions
patterns.context: Mathematical setups and algebraic expressions occur, but do not follow the explicit sequence-term Q&A pattern seen in the other passages.

6_1317.concept: 方法与问题的特征描述
6_1317.description: 主要响应方法描述中的性能、简便性和需求用语（如 simple、rapid、requires）；另在数学数列题、公式，以及专利工艺与毒性背景中激活，呈现多种不完全统一的模式。

patterns.name: 方法优势与性能描述
patterns.trigger: “The method is simple, rapid, and robust”; “highly sensitive”; “faster than traditional PCR”; “much simpler equipment”
patterns.context: 介绍检测、生物实验或分析方法时，描述其简便、快速、灵敏、稳健，或所需设备、操作较少。

patterns.name: 需要／涉及的要求或操作
patterns.context: 方法描述中说明所需时间、设备、操作或处理；[9]则说既有工艺“require the handling”有毒物质。
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文及专利背景

patterns.name: 数学题中的负数数列与求项
patterns.trigger: “What is the … term of”、 “What is the next term”，以及连续的负数和数字串
patterns.context: 数学题要求识别数列规律或求某项；常紧接问句、换行及类似公式的答案。

patterns.name: 定量检测性能指标
patterns.trigger: “The limit of quantification was 28 ng/mL”及“coefficients of variation”
patterns.context: 报告分析方法的定量下限、变异系数与干扰情况。
patterns.domain: PubMed 摘要中的分析方法验证

patterns.name: 生物检测中的结合与 DNA 检出
patterns.trigger: “microtitre wells”、“biotin-avidin interaction”、“detection of 30 molecules of DNA”
patterns.context: 说明检测流程如何捕获杂交物并报告 DNA 检测灵敏度。
patterns.domain: PubMed 摘要中的分子检测

patterns.name: ChIP 实验方案与耗时
patterns.trigger: “a ChIP protocol”、“optimized for Candida albicans”及“requires 4-5 days”
patterns.context: 介绍针对特定真菌优化的实验方案及完成时间。
patterns.domain: PubMed 生物医学方法论文

patterns.name: 专利工艺及毒性问题
patterns.trigger: “converting sewage sludge to fertilizer”及“require the handling of formaldehyde”
patterns.context: 描述污泥制肥的既有工艺，并指出使用甲醛的危险。

patterns.name: 零散数学公式与求解指令
patterns.context: 出现数学设定和代数表达，但不属于其余段落中明确的数列求项问答模式。

en.concept: Task or method descriptions in number-dense text
en.description: Activations occur in prompts and dense numerical notation in math sequence problems, and in descriptions of methods, processes, performance, and quantitative measurements in papers and patents. Numbers and commas are common across these text types, but the patterns cannot all be assigned to a single semantic topic.

patterns.name: Sequence problem prompts
patterns.context: A question asking for the next term or general term follows a numerical sequence; nearby words such as in/of also activate

patterns.name: Numbers, symbols, and comma-separated mathematical notation
patterns.context: Numbers, minus signs, operators, and commas appear densely, often forming irregular sequences or algebraic expressions; also occurs around problem-solving instructions

patterns.name: Method performance and advantage descriptions
patterns.context: Introduces the performance, ease of operation, sensitivity, or advantages of analytical methods or processes
patterns.domain: Medical abstracts, clinical research, and patent background

patterns.name: Processes, chemicals, and treatment workflows
patterns.context: Describes material conversion, chemical treatment steps, or substances and constraints involved in a process

patterns.name: Quantitative measurements and analytical experiment details
patterns.context: Mentions detection limits, coefficients of variation, analytical instruments, detection sensitivity, or experimental measurement targets

patterns.name: Time, numerical values, and pharmacokinetic descriptions
patterns.context: Uses numerical values and times to describe the elimination or distribution of a drug or compound and compare methods

patterns.name: Patent-style background and invention descriptions
patterns.context: Organizes statements using formulations that introduce a process, prior methods, or advantages of an invention

6_1317.concept: 数字密集文本中的任务或方法描述
6_1317.description: 激活分布在数学数列题的提示语与密集数字符号，以及论文和专利中方法、工艺、性能和定量测量的叙述；各类文本中的数字与逗号也常见，但不能将全部模式归为单一语义主题。

patterns.name: 数列题提示语
patterns.trigger: “What comes next”“What is next in”“What is the next term”“What is the b'th term of”
patterns.context: 在数值序列之后提出求下一项或通项的问题；提示语附近的 in/of 等词也有激活

patterns.name: 数值、符号及逗号分隔的数学记号
patterns.context: 数字、负号、运算符和逗号密集出现，常组成不规则数列或代数表达式；也出现于解题指令周围

patterns.name: 方法性能与优势描述
patterns.trigger: “method”“simple”“rapid”“robust”“highly sensitive”“few and simple operations”“advantage”“does not involve”
patterns.context: 介绍分析方法或工艺的性能、操作简便性、灵敏度或优势
patterns.domain: 医学摘要、临床研究及专利背景

patterns.name: 工艺、化学物质及处理流程
patterns.trigger: “processes”“converting sewage sludge to fertilizer”“urea-formaldehyde condensation product”“handling of formaldehyde”“metal-containing catalysts”
patterns.context: 描述材料转化、化学处理步骤或工艺中涉及的物质和限制

patterns.name: 定量测量及分析实验细节
patterns.trigger: “limit of quantification”“ng/mL”“coefficients of variation”“HPLC”“detection of 30 molecules of DNA”“Permeability”“FITC-labeled dextran”
patterns.context: 提及检测限、变异系数、分析仪器、检测灵敏度或实验测量对象

patterns.name: 时间、数值及药代动力学描述
patterns.trigger: “45 minutes”“50 fold”“0 and 30 minutes”“initial distribution phase”“elimination”
patterns.context: 以数值和时间描述药物或化合物的消除、分布过程及方法比较

patterns.name: 专利式背景与发明叙述
patterns.trigger: “describe processes”“In each of these processes”“according to the invention”
patterns.context: 以流程介绍、先前工艺或发明优点的句式组织陈述

en.concept: Method evaluation terms and math problem instructions
en.description: Activations occur in two types of text: biomedical method descriptions listing advantages such as simplicity, speed, and sensitivity; and math problems containing variables, negative-number expressions, and instructions to solve or continue a sequence. The shared signal is weak.

patterns.name: Method performance and simplicity descriptions
patterns.context: Describes advantages of detection or experimental methods in biomedical abstracts or research plans; often uses parallel evaluative adjectives, especially simple/rapid.

patterns.name: Short instructions or questions in math problems
patterns.context: Introduces variables in math exercises, presents an expression, then asks for a solution or the next sequence term; activation occurs near instruction words, and the expression itself often also activates.

patterns.name: Negative numbers and expression symbols
patterns.context: Number sequences, fractions, or algebraic expressions in math problems; minus signs and numerical fragments recur.

6_1317.concept: 方法评价词与数学题指令
6_1317.description: 激活见于两类文本：生物医学方法描述中列举简单、快速、灵敏等优点；数学题中出现变量、负数算式及求解、续项等指令。共同线索较弱。

patterns.name: 方法性能与简便性描述
patterns.context: 生物医学摘要或研究计划中，描述检测、实验方法的优点；常出现并列的评价形容词，尤其是 simple/rapid。
patterns.domain: PubMed 摘要、NIH 研究计划

patterns.name: 数学题中的短指令或提问
patterns.trigger: “What is the next term”, “What comes next”, “Which is bigger”, “Solve”, “Let”, “Suppose”
patterns.context: 数学练习题中引入变量、给出算式后提出求解或数列续项问题；指令词附近激活，算式本身也常伴随激活。

patterns.name: 负数与算式符号
patterns.context: 数学题中的数字序列、分数或代数表达式；负号和数值片段反复出现。

en.description: Activation is concentrated on descriptions of the simplicity, ease of operation, and performance of methods or tools; math problems also show comparison, common-denominator/multiple, and solving language, as well as a clinical context involving uroflowmetry. Across different materials, activation appears more consistent with local words and sentence structures than with a single semantic concept.

patterns.name: Ease of method operation
patterns.context: Describes a detection, analytical, or teaching method and identifies simplicity and ease of operation as advantages; sometimes listed alongside speed, robustness, or flexibility.
patterns.domain: Biomedical abstracts and research project descriptions

patterns.name: Capability or property descriptions following “to”
patterns.context: Methods, proteins, or learning tools are described as easy to perform, express, or update; activation falls on neighboring function words and not only on “simple.”

patterns.name: Technology or method performance evaluation
patterns.context: Research abstracts report performance measures such as limits of quantitation, variation, sensitivity, and robustness.

patterns.name: Requirements for developing research tools or technologies
patterns.context: Proposes needs or ideal properties for research tools, emphasizing practicality, ease of expression, small size, or stability.

patterns.name: Relational terms in fraction arithmetic and math problems
patterns.context: DM Mathematics problems ask about common denominators, least common multiples, or fraction comparisons; activation often occurs near the problem wording and mathematical symbols.

patterns.name: Algebra equation-solving instructions
patterns.context: A direct solving instruction follows an algebraic expression.

patterns.name: Uroflowmetry and its clinical evaluation
patterns.context: Introduces uroflowmetry as an examination for evaluating urinary symptoms and describes it as simple and noninvasive; the same passage also mentions hyponatremia and seizure following fluid intake as a complication.

6_1317.concept: 方法简便性及任务措辞
6_1317.description: 激活集中于方法或工具的简便、易操作及性能描述；另见数学题中的比较、共同分母/倍数和求解措辞，以及尿流量测定的临床语境。不同材料中更像是局部词语与句式触发，不能确定为单一语义。

patterns.name: 方法操作简便
patterns.context: 描述一种检测、分析或教学方法时，将简单、易操作作为优点；有时与快速、稳健、灵活等性质并列。
patterns.domain: 生物医学摘要、科研项目描述

patterns.name: “to”后的能力或性质描述
patterns.context: 方法、蛋白或学习工具被描述为易于执行、表达或更新；激活落在相邻功能词上，而不只落在“simple”。
patterns.domain: 生物医学与教育项目描述

patterns.name: 技术或方法性能评估
patterns.context: 科研摘要陈述检测方法的定量限、变异、灵敏度、稳健性等性能指标。
patterns.domain: 实验方法与生物医学摘要

patterns.name: 研究工具或技术的构建需求
patterns.trigger: «Robust protein capture arrays»；«acute need»；«easy to express»
patterns.context: 提出研究工具的需求或理想属性，强调实用性、易表达、小尺寸或稳定性。

patterns.name: 分数运算与数学题中的关系词
patterns.context: DM Mathematics题目中询问分数的共同分母、最小公倍数或大小比较；激活多出现在题目措辞及数学符号附近。

patterns.name: 代数方程求解指令
patterns.context: 代数表达式之后出现直接的求解命令。

patterns.name: 尿流量测定及其临床评价
patterns.context: 介绍尿流量测定作为评估泌尿症状的检查，并描述其简单、无创；同段也提到饮水后出现低钠血症和癫痫这一并发症。
patterns.domain: 临床病例与泌尿科摘要

en.description: Activations involve evaluations of methods and detection procedures for ease of operation, simplicity, speed, and robustness, as well as procedural requirements; they also occur in the fixed wording of math problems that use Let to introduce variables. Cross-domain commonality is limited.

patterns.name: Evaluation of method or technique simplicity
patterns.context: Evaluates experimental methods, detection workflows, or clinical examinations as simple to operate or implement; in segments 1, 2, 3, 7, and 8, this is listed alongside advantages such as speed, robustness, sensitivity, and noninvasiveness.
patterns.domain: Biomedical abstracts, research plans, and clinical case literature

patterns.name: Let-introduction in math problems
patterns.context: A math exercise introduces or defines a variable using Let, followed by an equation, fraction, or comparison problem; activation falls on Let.

patterns.name: Time requirements for experimental protocols
patterns.context: States the conditions or duration required for an experimental or examination workflow; segment 6 says a ChIP protocol requires 4–5 days, while segment 8 mentions patients drinking fluids.
patterns.domain: Biomedical method descriptions and clinical examination literature

patterns.name: Method/detection performance and operational characteristics
patterns.context: Adjectives evaluate the speed, robustness, sensitivity, invasiveness, or usability of detection, analytical, or related tools; simple need not also occur.

patterns.name: Few and simple operational steps
patterns.context: Explicitly describes a method as requiring few operations and having a simple workflow.

6_1317.concept: 方法描述及定义引入词
6_1317.description: 激活涉及方法与检测的易操作、简单、快速、稳健等评价及流程需求，也出现在数学题用 Let 引入变量的固定句式中；跨领域共享性有限。

patterns.name: 方法或技术的简单性评价
patterns.context: 描述实验方法、检测流程或临床检查时，评价操作简单或易于实施；段1、2、3、7、8中与快速、稳健、敏感、无创等优点并列。
patterns.domain: 生物医学摘要、研究计划及临床病例文献

patterns.name: 数学题中的 Let 引入
patterns.context: 数学练习中以 Let 引入变量或定义，后接等式、分数或比较求解问题；激活落在 Let。

patterns.name: 实验方案的时间需求
patterns.context: 说明实验或检查流程所需条件或时长；段6给出 ChIP protocol 需要 4–5 天，段8提到患者需饮水。
patterns.domain: 生物医学方法描述、临床检查文献

patterns.name: 方法/检测性能与操作特性
patterns.context: 以形容词评价检测、分析或相关工具的速度、稳健性、灵敏度、侵入性或易用性；不要求同时出现 simple。
patterns.domain: 生物医学摘要与研究计划

patterns.name: 操作步骤少且简单
patterns.context: 明确描述方法所需操作数量少、流程简单。

en.concept: Practicality descriptions of methods and testing
en.description: Most passages concern biomedical methods or testing and emphasize features such as simplicity, speed, sensitivity, robustness, and noninvasiveness; they also include quantitative performance and protocol descriptions. Negative fractions in math problems and legal case citations do not fit this main pattern.

patterns.name: Descriptions of method or test simplicity
patterns.context: When introducing an experimental method, test, protocol, or technology, describes ease of operation, speed, or low invasiveness; commonly occurs with “is,” “to perform,” or “test.”
patterns.domain: Biomedical abstracts and research funding texts

patterns.name: Test method performance and suitability
patterns.context: Describes quantitative performance, sensitivity, stability, interference, or suitability of analytical methods, assays, or experimental procedures.
patterns.domain: Biomedical abstracts and research funding texts

patterns.name: Hyphenated negative prefixes / compounds
patterns.context: A hyphenated term occurs in a technical or medical context; activation falls within the word or on nearby fragments rather than being triggered only by the sentence meaning.

patterns.name: Negative numbers and fractional expressions in math problems
patterns.context: Arithmetic problems place fractions, minus signs, and parentheses together, and ask about comparisons or common denominators.

patterns.name: Legal case citation format
patterns.context: A standard citation format in a judicial decision, consisting of a case name, court abbreviation, volume and page numbers, and reporter series.

6_1317.concept: 方法与检测的实用性描述
6_1317.description: 多数段落涉及生物医学方法或检测，强调其简单、快速、敏感、稳健、非侵入性等特征，也包括定量性能和protocol描述；另有数学负分数及法律判例引文，不能归入该主模式。

patterns.name: 方法或检测的简便性描述
patterns.context: 介绍一种实验方法、检测、protocol 或技术时，描述其操作便利、速度快或侵入性低；常与 “is”“to perform”“test” 等搭配。
patterns.domain: 生物医学摘要与研究资助文本

patterns.name: 检测方法的性能与适用性
patterns.context: 描述分析方法、检测试验或实验流程的定量性能、灵敏度、稳定性、干扰或适用性。
patterns.domain: 生物医学摘要与研究资助文本

patterns.name: 带连字符的否定前缀 / 复合词
patterns.context: 技术或医学语境中出现连字符相连的术语；激活落在词内或邻近片段，而非仅由完整句意触发。

patterns.name: 数学题中的负数与分数表达式
patterns.context: 算术题中分数、负号与括号相邻，包含比较或求公分母等提问。

patterns.name: 法律判例引文格式
patterns.context: 判决引用中以案件名、法院缩写、卷页码及报告系列构成的标准引文格式。

en.description: The most stable pattern is the fragment “verting” within English words, appearing across domains with different prefixes and meanings. Other activations include the Red fragment, biographical names and years, and weaker punctuation and newline activations.

patterns.name: “-verting” fragment within words
patterns.context: Activation falls on the suffix fragment “verting” in English words. Prefixes and meanings vary, as in prod rug-converting, inverting, perverting, converting, reverting, and mean-reverting.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain: biomedical abstracts, forum discussions, news narratives, software discussions, financial emails

patterns.name: Red-related word fragments
patterns.context: Activation falls on the Red fragment in proper nouns or compound words, with no apparent shared semantic function.
patterns.domain: Forum link titles, mycology paper titles

patterns.name: Numbers in names and dates
patterns.context: Activation appears near names and birth years in biographical entries; other names and dates in the same passage also activate.

patterns.name: Punctuation and sentence endings
patterns.context: Punctuation and newlines activate across multiple genres, but their strength and distribution are unstable and may be secondary effects accompanying the subword-fragment pattern.

6_1511.description: 最稳定的模式是英文词中包含“verting”的片段，跨领域出现且前缀、词义不同；另有 Red 片段、传记姓名与年份，以及较弱的标点和换行激活。

patterns.name: 词中“-verting”片段
patterns.context: 激活落在英文单词的后缀片段“verting”；前缀和词义各异，见于 prod rug-converting、inverting、perverting、converting、reverting、mean-reverting 等词。
patterns.domain: 跨领域：生物医学摘要、论坛对话、新闻叙述、软件讨论、金融邮件

patterns.name: Red 相关词片段
patterns.context: 激活落在专名或复合词中的 Red 片段；没有明显共同语义功能。
patterns.domain: 论坛链接标题、真菌学论文标题

patterns.name: 人名与日期中的数字
patterns.context: 人物传记条目中，姓名和出生年份附近出现激活；同段其他姓名与日期也有激活。

patterns.name: 标点与句末
patterns.context: 标点和换行在多种文体中激活，但强度和分布不稳定，可能是伴随词片段模式的次要现象。

en.concept: Word forms containing -verting and a few proper-name fragments
en.description: The main pattern is fragments containing -verting within or at the end of words, appearing across domains. Weaker or isolated triggers include Red fragments, biographical dates, and bacteriophage P1.

patterns.name: English word forms with -verting
patterns.context: A word contains -verting or ends in -verting; prefixes and sentence meanings vary widely, and examples include both internal fragments and capitalized word-initial forms.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain: biomedicine, forum discussions, news narratives, technical texts, financial emails

patterns.name: Proper name in a Redbay title
patterns.context: Red and the following letters form a proper name or part of a word; both segments contain Red with varying capitalization, but the following forms differ.

patterns.name: Personal names and biographical dates
patterns.context: A personal name and birth/death dates in parentheses form a biographical entry.

patterns.name: Bacteriophage identifier P1
patterns.context: P1 appears in paper abstracts about bacteriophage genes and recombinases.

patterns.name: Other fragment-level strong activations
patterns.context: Activations fall on local concatenated fragments of title text; this segment does not reveal whether they are related to the -verting or Redbay patterns.
patterns.domain: HackerNews link titles; PubMed paper titles

6_1511.concept: 含 -verting 的词形及少数专名片段
6_1511.description: 主模式是词中或词尾含 -verting 的片段，跨领域出现；另有 Red 片段、人物传记日期及噬菌体 P1 等较弱或孤立触发。

patterns.name: 英文词形 -verting
patterns.context: 词中包含或以 -verting 结尾；前缀和句义变化较大，既有词中片段也有词首大写形式。
patterns.domain: 跨领域：生物医学、论坛讨论、新闻叙事、技术文本、金融邮件

patterns.name: Redbay 标题中的专名
patterns.context: Red 与后续字母连成专名或词的一部分；两段均有大小写 Red，但后续形式不同。
patterns.domain: HackerNews 标题；PubMed 生物学标题

patterns.name: 人名及传记日期
patterns.context: 人名及括号中的出生、逝世日期形成传记式条目。

patterns.name: 噬菌体编号 P1
patterns.context: P1 出现在噬菌体基因、重组酶的论文摘要中。

patterns.name: 其他片段级强激活
patterns.context: 激活落在标题文本的局部拼接片段；无法从该段判断是否与 -verting 或 Redbay 模式有关。
patterns.domain: HackerNews 链接标题；PubMed 论文标题

en.description: Activations fall mainly on Red (including proper names or compounds) and the word-final fragment «verting»; a few fall on fragments related to personal names. The high-activation positions in two PubMed abstracts cannot be explained by these patterns.

patterns.name: Red substring in words related to ‘Red’
patterns.context: Activations fall on tokens spelled Red; they may be followed by a proper name or part of an ordinary word, such as Redaction, Redekopp, Redbay, Red Bank, Red Bull.
patterns.domain: Forum text, encyclopedias, paper titles, and place/proper names

patterns.name: Stem fragment in perverting
patterns.context: The same token fragment occurs in words with different prefixes; one passage discusses causal direction, while another discusses obstruction of justice.
patterns.domain: Forum discussions, news, or legal reporting

patterns.name: Specific token fragments in names
patterns.context: Activations occur in personal names or related entries, but there is no shared visible word form or semantic condition.

6_1511.description: 激活主要落在 Red（含专名或复合词）和词尾片段 «verting»；少数落在人名相关片段上。两篇 PubMed 摘要中的高激活位置无法由这些模式解释。

patterns.name: ‘Red’相关词中的 Red 子串
patterns.context: 激活落在大小写为 Red 的 token 上；后续可接专名或普通词的一部分，如 Redaction、Redekopp、Redbay、Red Bank、Red Bull。
patterns.domain: 论坛文本、百科、论文标题及地点/专名

patterns.name: perverting 中的词干片段
patterns.context: 相同 token 片段出现在不同前缀构成的词中；一处谈因果方向，另一处谈妨碍司法。
patterns.domain: 论坛讨论、新闻或法律报道

patterns.name: 姓名中的特定 token 片段
patterns.context: 激活出现在人物姓名或姓名相关条目中，但缺少共同的可见词形或语义条件。
patterns.domain: 百科人物传记、乐队条目

en.concept: Red strings and sporadic formatting features
en.description: Primarily responds to “Red” and following letter sequences in proper nouns across titles, personal names, place names, and biomedical terms.
