There are also isolated activations for date years, HTML color values, and apostrophes in contractions. No clear corresponding trigger appears in segments 4 and 10.

patterns.name: Names beginning with Red
patterns.context: Red is part of a proper noun, followed by a common word or a proper-noun suffix. Examples include “Redaction” in titles, the place names “Red Bank” and “Redbay,” the name “Redekopp,” and the biological pathway “Red.”
patterns.domain: Webpage titles, business locations, band-member entries, biomedical papers

patterns.name: Year digits in dates
patterns.context: A birth date in biographical format, with the digits between the month and day.

patterns.name: Specific HTML color values
patterns.context: A hexadecimal color value in the color attribute of an HTML font tag begins with a hash and digits.

patterns.name: Letter sequence within a contraction
patterns.context: In spoken-language quotes, the contraction “We’ve” is split into multiple tokens, with activation on the apostrophe; no stable semantic condition is evident.

6_1511.concept: Red 字符串及零散格式特征
6_1511.description: 主要响应专名中的“Red”及其后续字母序列，跨标题、人名、地名和生物医学术语；另有日期年份、HTML 色值和缩写撇号的孤立激活。第4、10段无明显对应触发。

patterns.name: 专名中以 Red 开头的名称
patterns.context: Red 作为专名的一部分，后接普通词或专名后缀；包括标题中的“Redaction”、地名“Red Bank”“Redbay”、人名“Redekopp”以及生物学路径“Red”。
patterns.domain: 网页标题、商业地点、乐队人物条目、生物医学论文

patterns.name: 日期中的年份数字
patterns.context: 人物传记格式中的出生日期，数字处于月份与日期之间。

patterns.name: 特定 HTML 色值
patterns.context: HTML 字体标签的 color 属性中，十六进制颜色值以井号及数字开头。

patterns.name: 扩展词内部的字母序列
patterns.context: 口语引语中缩写词 “We’ve” 被拆分成多个 token，激活落在撇号上；未见稳定的语义条件。

en.description: Activations are scattered across line breaks, periods, and fragments of various proper names, identifiers, and web text. Periods and line breaks occur across domains, but the other triggers vary, making it difficult to reduce them to a single semantic feature.

patterns.name: Period punctuation
patterns.context: The period itself is marked; it sometimes occurs in a domain name, title, sentence ending, or digit string, with no unified semantic condition observed.

patterns.name: Newline character
patterns.context: Line breaks between paragraphs, lists, or entries are activated, often at the start of or between lines.
patterns.domain: Web pages, encyclopedias, legal, mathematical, and general text

patterns.name: Personal names and name entries
patterns.context: Activations occur around names and dates in encyclopedia biographies; however, the same pattern appears in only one passage.

patterns.name: Red in titles
patterns.context: Occurs in Hacker News titles, specifically “The Leaky Redaction” and “Reduce Inequality”; activations are concentrated on the word-initial fragment.

patterns.name: photosoft subdomain list
patterns.context: The repeated domain stem is followed by different subdomains (healthcare, style, coop, gift, pet, etc.); both the stem and period are activated.

patterns.name: Legal citation format
patterns.context: Periods after letters in court/case identifiers and adjacent digit fragments in legal citations.

patterns.name: Decimal points in digit strings
patterns.context: Periods within numerical sequences and nearby digits are activated in mathematical text.

patterns.name: End-of-year period and new-school-year narrative
patterns.context: A standalone year appears first, followed by a narrative about a new school year and organizing belongings; the period, year, and “new” are all activated.

patterns.name: Place-name endings and proper names
patterns.context: Parts of proper names in encyclopedia entry titles are activated, especially the “fig” fragment; it is difficult to distinguish this from general proper names or word boundaries.

patterns.name: Medical-term titles
patterns.context: Periods and nearby disease names are activated in abstract-style text, but it is unclear whether the trigger is medical semantics.

patterns.name: Username separator fragments
patterns.context: Multiple internal fragments of usernames containing underscores in Hacker News page content are activated; this may simply reflect mixed-character or tokenization effects.

6_1511.description: 激活分散在换行、句点及多种专名、编号和网页文本片段；句点与换行跨域出现，但其余触发条件各异，难以归结为单一语义特征。

patterns.name: 句点标点
patterns.context: 句点本身被标记；有时出现在域名、标题、句子结尾或数字串中，未见统一语义条件。

patterns.name: 换行符
patterns.context: 多段落、列表或条目之间的换行被激活，常位于行首或行间。
patterns.domain: 网页、百科、法律、数学及一般文本

patterns.name: 人名及姓名条目
patterns.context: 百科人物条目中姓名及日期附近激活；但相同模式仅见一段。

patterns.name: 标题中的 Red
patterns.context: 出现在 Hacker News 标题中，分别是“The Leaky Redaction”和“Reduce Inequality”；激活集中于词首片段。

patterns.name: photosoft 子域名列表
patterns.context: 重复的域名词干后接不同子域（healthcare、style、coop、gift、pet 等），词干与点均激活。

patterns.name: 法规编号格式
patterns.context: 法律引文中法院/判例编号的字母后句点及相邻数字片段。

patterns.name: 数字串中的小数点
patterns.context: 数学文本中数字序列里的句点及其邻近数字被激活。

patterns.name: 年末句点与新学年叙述
patterns.context: 文段先出现独立年份，随后叙述新学年及整理物品；句点、年份和“new”均有激活。

patterns.name: 地名词尾及专名
patterns.context: 百科条目标题中专名各部分有激活，尤其“fig”片段；难与一般专名或分词边界区分。

patterns.name: 医学术语标题
patterns.context: 摘要式文本中句点及疾病名称附近激活，但触发是否为医学语义不明确。

patterns.name: 用户名分隔符片段
patterns.context: Hacker News 页面内容中的下划线用户名，多个内部片段激活；可能只是混合字符/分词效应。

en.description: Primarily responds to the PHP object-creation keyword new, especially when followed by a class name. Isolated responses also occur for new in UI English, the C identifier bob, l in garbled text, and the JavaScript identifier STRING.

patterns.name: Constructor calls in PHP classes and test code
patterns.context: Occurs in PHP classes, methods, or test code, usually in object-creation statements; the “new” tokens in segments 1, 2, 4, 5, and 7 are marked 10, and a marked “new” also appears in segment 6.
patterns.domain: PHP code and tests on Github

patterns.name: new in English prompts
patterns.context: In ordinary English UI prompts, new modifies update; distinct from object creation in code.

patterns.name: C struct variable name Bob
patterns.context: In a C struct/array initialization snippet, bob appears in “&bob.animal”.

patterns.name: l in corrupted or garbled text
patterns.context: A single l is marked strongest within an unrecognizable encoded or garbled character sequence; no interpretable semantic context is available.

patterns.name: STRING in a JavaScript constant identifier
patterns.context: STRING is part of an underscore-separated identifier in a JavaScript variable name or type-constant definition.

6_1511.concept: new 及代码标识符片段
6_1511.description: 主要响应 PHP 代码中对象创建关键字 new，尤其是 new 后接类名；另有孤立响应：UI 英文中的 new、C 代码标识符 bob、乱码中的 l，以及 JavaScript 标识符 STRING。

patterns.name: PHP 类与测试代码中的构造调用
patterns.trigger: 「new」后接类名，如「new Webhook」、「new Collection」、「new \DateTime()」、「new StatusRepository」；另有「new Hob…」
patterns.context: 出现在 PHP 类、方法或测试代码中，通常是对象创建语句；第 1、2、4、5、7 段的「new」标记为 10，第 6 段亦出现标记的「new」
patterns.domain: Github 上的 PHP 代码与测试

patterns.name: 英文提示中的 new
patterns.context: 普通英文 UI 提示中，new 修饰 update；与代码对象创建不同

patterns.name: C 结构体变量名 Bob
patterns.context: C 代码的结构体/数组初始化片段中，bob 出现在「&bob.animal」处
patterns.domain: StackExchange 上的 C 代码

patterns.name: 损坏或乱码文本中的 l
patterns.context: 无法辨认的编码或乱码字符序列中，单个 l 被标记为最强；缺乏可判定的语义上下文

patterns.name: JavaScript 常量标识符中的 STRING
patterns.context: JavaScript 变量名或类型常量定义中，STRING 是下划线分隔标识符的一部分
patterns.domain: Github 上的 JavaScript 代码

en.description: Primarily responds to formatting and structural markers in PHP source, especially indentation whitespace, newlines, and braces. Sporadic triggers also include test comments, method names, emphatic evaluations in forum text, and ingredient names in data lists.

patterns.name: Whitespace and braces in PHP code
patterns.context: Appears in PHP source indentation, statement boundaries, or method/conditional blocks; these markers and surrounding code tokens have positive activations across multiple snippets.
patterns.domain: PHP code and tests on Github

patterns.name: each in test lifecycle comments
patterns.context: The phrase «Before each test» in a test-class comment describes setup performed before each test run.

patterns.name: alreadyApplied method name
patterns.context: A PHP method that returns a boolean and checks «$this->times_left < 1».

patterns.name: Emphasis and evaluative words in English opinion text
patterns.context: An English forum comment uses italics to emphasize a negative evaluation and discusses a requirement and its impact on the United States' overseas reputation.

patterns.name: Malic in structured nutrition data
patterns.context: The name «Malic» appears in a comma-separated ingredient/value list, near entries such as «Alcohol» and «Proanthocyanins».
patterns.domain: Tabular or data text on Github

6_1511.description: 主要响应 PHP 源码的格式与结构标记，尤其是缩进空白、换行和花括号；另有测试注释短语、方法名、论坛文本的强调评价，以及数据列表中的成分名等零散触发。

patterns.name: PHP 代码的空白与大括号
patterns.trigger: 空格、换行及代码块中的 «{»、«}»；常与 «public»、«function»、«new»、«throw»、«return» 等 PHP 结构相邻
patterns.context: 处于 PHP 源码的缩进、语句边界或方法/条件代码块中；多个片段中这些标记及其周边代码 token 都有正激活
patterns.domain: Github 上的 PHP 代码与测试

patterns.name: 测试生命周期中的 each
patterns.context: 测试类注释中的短语 «Before each test»，描述每个测试运行前的准备操作
patterns.domain: Github 上的测试代码注释

patterns.name: alreadyApplied 方法名
patterns.context: 作为 PHP 方法名，方法返回布尔值并检查 «$this->times_left < 1»

patterns.name: 英语观点文本中的强调与评价词
patterns.context: 英文论坛评论中以斜体强调负面评价，并谈论某项要求及其对美国海外声誉的影响

patterns.name: 结构化营养数据中的 Malic
patterns.context: 逗号分隔的成分/数值列表中出现名称 «Malic»，邻近 «Alcohol»、«Proanthocyanins» 等项目
patterns.domain: Github 中的表格或数据文本

en.concept: Source code and structured technical text boundaries
en.description: Activation spans multiple programming languages and mathematical text. It commonly occurs on source-code newlines, semicolons, tests, and identifiers, and also appears sporadically on build macros, configuration fields, encoding checks, Unity lifecycle code, and formula symbols. There is no single stable semantic trigger.

patterns.name: Delimiters and newlines in code
patterns.context: Activation often falls on statement-ending semicolons, newlines, and code-block boundaries, especially indentation after a newline or structured code snippets.
patterns.domain: Primarily GitHub source code; also configuration-style data

patterns.name: Test code and assertions
patterns.context: Appears in test classes, test methods, or code checking expected behavior, without requiring a particular language or test framework.
patterns.domain: Software testing source code and test data

patterns.name: PHP identifiers and member access
patterns.context: Near PHP variables, object members, or test-object-related identifiers; some identifiers are split across tokens in sentences.

patterns.name: Configuration key-value pairs and file lists
patterns.context: In array/object-style entries, keys and values are grouped by field, with repeated records.
patterns.domain: JSON-like configuration or resource lists on GitHub

patterns.name: Compiler macros and command-line arguments
patterns.context: Macro calls and their bracketed arguments and explanatory text, involving package configuration and compiler options.

patterns.name: ASCII character checks and exception handling
patterns.context: An encoder rejects non-ASCII characters, then checks whether the input string contains non-ASCII characters.
patterns.domain: Address encoding and validation logic in PHP source code

patterns.name: Component lifecycle and conditional compilation
patterns.context: Component initialization/attachment logic and a conditional branch enabled only for editor builds.

patterns.name: Numbers and operations in mathematical formulas
patterns.context: Substitutes π≈3.14 into a fraction to calculate a percentage, mixing formulas with explanatory text.

patterns.name: LaTeX mathematical symbols and component expressions
patterns.context: Mathematical expressions typeset in LaTeX, with indices, superscripts, and component forms.

patterns.name: Import-state checks and not found sentinel values
patterns.context: Checks the state before a Python module has been imported, using “not found” as a default/sentinel value.

patterns.name: Expired-user tests and data fixtures
patterns.context: Loads expired-user test data and tests behavior for deactivating expired users.

6_1511.concept: 源码与结构化技术文本边界
6_1511.description: 激活覆盖多种编程语言和数学文本：常见于源码换行、分号、测试与标识符，也散见构建宏、配置字段、编码校验、Unity 生命周期及公式符号；没有单一稳定的语义触发点。

patterns.name: 代码中的分隔符与换行
patterns.context: 激活常落在程序语句结束分号、换行和代码块边界，尤其是换行后的缩进或结构化代码片段。
patterns.domain: 以 GitHub 源码为主；也见于配置式数据

patterns.name: 测试代码与断言
patterns.context: 出现在测试类、测试方法或检查预期行为的测试代码中，未必要求特定语言或测试框架。
patterns.domain: 软件测试源码与测试数据

patterns.name: PHP 标识符和成员访问
patterns.context: PHP 变量、对象成员或测试对象相关标识符附近；部分标识符在句子中跨 token 切分。

patterns.name: 配置键值与文件清单
patterns.context: 数组/对象式条目中，键和值按字段成组排列，并出现重复记录。
patterns.domain: GitHub 上的 JSON 类配置或资源清单

patterns.name: 编译器宏与命令行参数
patterns.context: 宏调用及其方括号参数、说明文字，涉及包配置和编译选项。

patterns.name: ASCII 字符校验与异常处理
patterns.context: 编码器拒绝非 ASCII 字符，随后检查输入字符串是否含非 ASCII 字符。
patterns.domain: PHP 源码中的地址编码与校验逻辑

patterns.name: 组件生命周期与条件编译
patterns.context: 组件初始化/附加逻辑及仅编辑器构建启用的条件分支。

patterns.name: 数学公式中的数字与运算
patterns.context: 用 π≈3.14 代入分数计算百分比，公式与解释文字混排。

patterns.name: LaTeX 数学符号与分量表达式
patterns.context: 以 LaTeX 排版的带指标、上标及分量形式的数学表达式。

patterns.name: 导入状态检查与 not found 哨兵值
patterns.context: 测试 Python 模块尚未导入时的状态，以“not found”作为缺省/哨兵值。
patterns.domain: GitHub 上的 TensorFlow 测试代码

patterns.name: 过期用户测试与数据夹具
patterns.context: 加载过期用户测试数据，并测试停用过期用户的行为。

en.description: Responses are sporadic: formulas, parameters, numerical results, and technical terminology in physics and astronomy papers are most common. There is also a strong response to a string containing backslash-digit sequences. No single semantic trigger condition is evident.

patterns.name: α physical quantities and power laws
patterns.context: Physics text discussing power laws, critical exponents, or transport properties, especially the α parameter and its measured values.
patterns.domain: Condensed matter physics, nanomaterials; ArXiv papers

patterns.name: Piecewise definitions and arrays in mathematical formulas
patterns.context: LaTeX mathematical expressions showing matrices, piecewise functions, or conditional definitions; activation falls near formula symbols and numbers.
patterns.domain: Mathematics or theoretical physics papers; ArXiv papers

patterns.name: Fits, intercepts, and numerical results
patterns.context: Paper text describing linear relationships or fit results and giving specific values and units.

patterns.name: Backslash-digit encoded strings
patterns.context: A continuous encoding with many backslashes followed by three digits, interspersed with percent signs, hashes, and whitespace; no recognizable natural-language semantics are apparent.
patterns.domain: StackExchange content, possibly encoded or formatted data

patterns.name: Cosmic dust and reddening
patterns.context: Discusses quasar dust distributions and the resulting reddening, with a spectral-index value.

patterns.name: Parameterized threshold conditions
patterns.context: A formula uses relationships among parameters such as r, σ, and Δ to define conditions, assigning values such as infinity or zero.
patterns.domain: Theoretical or mathematical physics; ArXiv papers

patterns.name: Energy differences and empirical piecewise values
patterns.context: An energy expression is followed by numerical terms distinguished by conditions or categories; abbreviations and truncated context do not identify the specific physical quantity.
patterns.domain: Scientific papers, specific subfield unclear; ArXiv papers

patterns.name: Galaxy observations
patterns.context: Introduces observational context such as a specific galaxy, its morphology, and its distance.

patterns.name: Correlation functions and liquid field configurations
patterns.context: Describes field configurations, correlation lengths, or correlation parameters, and refers to an illustrative figure.

6_1511.concept: 科学论文中的符号密集片段
6_1511.description: 响应分散：物理与天文论文中的公式、参数、数值结果及专业术语最常见；另对一段含反斜杠数字的编码串强烈响应。没有单一语义触发条件。

patterns.name: α 物理量及幂律
patterns.context: 物理文本中讨论幂律、临界指数或输运特征，尤其是 α 参数及其测量值。
patterns.domain: 凝聚态物理、纳米材料；ArXiv 论文

patterns.name: 数学公式中的分段定义与数组
patterns.context: LaTeX 数学表达式，呈现矩阵、分段函数或条件定义；激活落在公式符号及数字附近。
patterns.domain: 数学或理论物理论文；ArXiv 论文

patterns.name: 拟合、截距与数值结果
patterns.context: 论文叙述线性关系或拟合结果，并给出具体数值和单位。

patterns.name: 反斜杠数字编码串
patterns.context: 大量反斜杠加三位数字的连续编码，夹有百分号、井号和空白；未见可辨识的自然语言语义。
patterns.domain: StackExchange 内容，可能是编码或格式化数据

patterns.name: 天体尘埃与红化
patterns.context: 讨论类星体尘埃分布及其导致的红化，并给出光谱指数数值。

patterns.name: 参数化阈值条件
patterns.context: 公式以 r 和 σ、Δ 等参数的关系划分条件，分别指定无穷大或零等取值。
patterns.domain: 理论或数学物理；ArXiv 论文

patterns.name: 能量差与经验分段数值
patterns.context: 能量表达式后接由条件或类别区分的数值项；缩写和截断上下文不足以确定具体物理量。
patterns.domain: 科学论文，具体子领域不明；ArXiv 论文

patterns.name: 星系观测描述
patterns.context: 介绍具体星系、形态和距离等观测背景。

patterns.name: 关联函数与液体场型
patterns.context: 描述场型、相关长度或关联参数，并提及插图示意。

en.description: Activations are scattered across genres: they clearly cover integer-arithmetic Q&A and legal judgments, and also occur in technical, patent, and scientific texts. Locally they often accompany values, degree, or quantitative metrics, but there is no unified, stable semantic trigger pattern.

patterns.name: Magnitude, degree, and threshold expressions
patterns.context: Describes a degree, speed, data rate, or threshold, especially in technical or scientific discussion; triggers are often degree adverbs/adjectives and their nearby quantitative objects.

patterns.name: Damages and adequacy judgments in legal text
patterns.context: Discusses compensation standards, repair costs, and their adequacy after infringement or damage.

patterns.name: Rights shares and proportional amounts in legal text
patterns.context: States rights or revenue shares, precise decimal proportions, and agreement modifications.

patterns.name: Fact-finding and vacatur of orders in legal proceedings
patterns.context: Describes how a court handles established facts, admissions, and vacatur of orders during a trial.

patterns.name: Operations and answers in arithmetic problems
patterns.context: Presents consecutive integer arithmetic problems involving addition, subtraction, and nested parentheses; answers usually appear alone on the next line.

patterns.name: Degree of human intervention in automated systems
patterns.context: Compares the amount of human involvement required for normal operation or demonstrations of a system.

patterns.name: Network device connectivity and high-speed data requirements
patterns.context: Describes wireless networks and device connectivity, and notes the need for high data rates.

patterns.name: Diffusion and protein motion in fluorescence analysis
patterns.context: Fits a model to fluorescence fluctuation data and discusses the detectable range of protein movement speeds.

patterns.name: Write pulses and error rates in patents
patterns.context: Explains how the amplitude of a memory-cell write signal is selected to reduce the error rate.

6_1511.description: 激活分散于多种文体：明显覆盖整数算术问答和法律判决，也出现在技术、专利与科学文本中；局部常伴数值、程度或量化指标，但没有统一的稳定语义触发模式。

patterns.name: 数值/程度高低及阈值表达
patterns.trigger: “very little”“particularly high”“very slowly”“relatively fast”“high enough”“reduce or minimize”
patterns.context: 描述某种程度、速度、数据率或阈值，尤其在技术或科学论述中；触发点多为程度副词/形容词及其紧邻的量化对象。

patterns.name: 法律文本中的损害赔偿金额与适当性判断
patterns.trigger: “measure of damages”“cost of repair”“appropriate measure”“adequately compensate”
patterns.context: 讨论侵权或损害后的赔偿标准、修复成本及其是否充分。

patterns.name: 法律文本中的权利份额与比例金额
patterns.context: 陈述权利或收益份额、精确小数比例及协议变更。
patterns.domain: 判决书、产权/能源权益争议

patterns.name: 法律程序中证据认定与撤销命令
patterns.trigger: “vacating its order”“facts established”“deemed admitted”“did not challenge the accuracy”
patterns.context: 叙述审判中法院对既定事实、承认与撤销命令的处理。

patterns.name: 算术题中的运算表达式与答案
patterns.trigger: “What is the value of”“Calculate”，以及多层括号、正负整数算式和换行后的数值答案
patterns.context: 连续呈现整数算术题，含加减与嵌套括号；答案通常单独出现在下一行。

patterns.name: 自动化系统中的人工介入程度
patterns.context: 比较系统正常运行或演示时所需的人类参与程度。
patterns.domain: 新闻评论、自动驾驶/自动化讨论

patterns.name: 网络设备互联与高速数据需求
patterns.context: 介绍无线网络及设备互联，并指出对高数据率的需求。

patterns.name: 荧光相关分析中的扩散与蛋白运动
patterns.context: 以荧光波动数据拟合模型，讨论可检测的蛋白移动速度范围。

patterns.name: 专利写入脉冲与错误率
patterns.trigger: “writing a STT cell”“write pulse”“bit error rate (BER)”
patterns.context: 说明存储单元写入信号的幅度如何选择，以降低错误率。

en.description: Activation patterns are mixed: several passages center on constructions where is introduces supplementary explanation. Others involve mathematical formulas, path identifiers, Python iteration code, and numeric model or time expressions; no unified trigger mechanism is evident.

patterns.name: Copula followed by a complement or reason
patterns.context: A sentence first states a property, cause, design, or judgment, then uses is to introduce an explanation such as a that/to clause or a full clause; often accompanied by contexts involving way/reason/assumption.
patterns.domain: Patent technical explanations, forum discussions, and general English prose

patterns.name: Numbers and symbolic structures in mathematical expressions
patterns.context: Activation falls on values, operators, or structural symbols in mathematical formulas, near derivations or calculation results.

patterns.name: Punctuation-delimited paths or identifiers
patterns.context: Describes a string format composed of hostnames, path components, and labels, with punctuation separating fields.

patterns.name: Iteration variables and indexing in code
patterns.context: Python-style code iterates over data and extracts columns and values; activation is distributed across keywords, variables, indices, and punctuation.

patterns.name: Numbers, units, and model strings
patterns.context: A number is embedded in an alphanumeric model string or appears as a time quantity; the contexts of the two examples differ, so a shared condition cannot be confirmed.

6_1511.concept: 混合的结构与延续模式
6_1511.description: 激活模式混杂：多段集中在 is 引出补充说明的句式；另见数学公式、路径标识符、Python 迭代代码及数字型号或时间表达，尚无统一触发机制。

patterns.name: 系动词后接系词或原因说明
patterns.trigger: «is»…«that»、«is»…«to»、«is»…«they»；如「is that carbon dioxide」「is to form」「is they tax」
patterns.context: 句子先提出某事物的性质、原因、设计或判断，再由 is 引出 that/to/完整从句等补充说明；常伴随 way/reason/assumption 等语境
patterns.domain: 专利技术说明、论坛讨论及一般英语散文

patterns.name: 数学表达式中的数字与符号结构
patterns.context: 激活落在数学公式的数值、运算符或结构符号上，处于推导或计算结果附近
patterns.domain: StackExchange 数学问答、LaTeX 公式

patterns.name: 标点分隔的路径或标识符
patterns.context: 描述由主机名、路径组件和标签组成的字符串格式，标点承担字段分隔作用

patterns.name: 代码中的迭代变量及索引
patterns.trigger: 「columns = list(initial.columns.values)[1:]」「for values in initial.values」「for column, value in zip(columns, values)」
patterns.context: Python 风格代码中遍历数据并提取列和值；激活分布于关键字、变量、索引和标点

patterns.name: 数字与单位、型号字符串
patterns.context: 数字嵌在字母数字型号中，或作为时间数量出现；两例语境不同，无法确认共享条件

en.concept: Local syntax and symbols in technical text
en.description: Activations occur in patents, research texts, code, and technical forums, covering formulas, indices, identifiers, assignment, function calls, passive sentences, and common English words. No single semantic trigger runs through all passages.

patterns.name: Preposition “in” in technical text
patterns.context: “in” introduces the location of a material, a solution environment, or another technical condition; it appears only in technical descriptions.

patterns.name: Array indexing and bracket expressions in code
patterns.context: Numbers or variables occur in square or round brackets, often involving indexing, slicing, or parameters.
patterns.domain: Code Q&A, Python/R arrays and indexing

patterns.name: Comparison/degree words in technical text
patterns.context: Expresses degree, a lower bound, or a period of uncertain duration; the words themselves differ.

patterns.name: LaTeX mathematical symbols and subscripts/superscripts
patterns.context: Mathematical variables, subscripts/superscripts, or symbols occur in formulas or reaction equations.
patterns.domain: ArXiv mathematical formulas, PubMed chemistry abstracts

patterns.name: Separators in code identifiers
patterns.context: A period or underscore occurs inside a code identifier, separating its components.

patterns.name: Passive or modal constructions in patent prose
patterns.context: Technical objects or operations are described in the passive voice, including auxiliaries such as must/can/are.

patterns.name: Function calls and attribute access in code
patterns.context: Code accesses an attribute or method using a period, or calls a function followed by arguments.

patterns.name: Small words and punctuation in English sentences
patterns.context: Copulas, colons, or common grammatical words in general English sentences; no stable specific semantic context is apparent.

patterns.name: Phrases containing the English token “of”
patterns.context: “of” connects noun phrases to express quantity composition or a technical object's property.

patterns.name: Variable assignment in code
patterns.context: An assignment operator follows a variable or index expression in code.

patterns.name: Preposition expressing how code is executed
patterns.context: “via” introduces the means of execution when discussing running Python code by translating a string.

patterns.name: Socket and buffer terminology
patterns.context: Describes a server receiving client commands and processing buffer data.

6_1511.concept: 技术文本中的局部语法与符号
6_1511.description: 激活分布于专利、科研文本、代码及技术论坛，覆盖公式、索引、标识符、赋值、函数调用、被动句和常见英语词；没有贯穿各段的单一语义触发点。

patterns.name: 技术文本中的介词“in”
patterns.trigger: « in»2« a»4 conductive；« in»2« aqueous»2« solution
patterns.context: “in”引出材料所在位置、溶液环境或其他技术条件；只在技术描述中出现。

patterns.name: 代码中的数组索引与括号表达式
patterns.context: 数值或变量位于方括号、圆括号中，常涉及索引、切片或参数。
patterns.domain: 代码问答、Python/R 数组与索引

patterns.name: 技术文本中的比较／程度词
patterns.trigger: « very»8« complicated»10；« at»9« least»2；« a»8« certain»9« time
patterns.context: 说明程度、下限或一段不确定时长；词汇并不相同。

patterns.name: LaTeX 数学符号与下标上标
patterns.context: 公式或反应式中出现数学变量、上下标或符号。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 数学公式、PubMed 化学摘要

patterns.name: 代码标识符中的分隔符
patterns.context: 句点或下划线处于代码标识符内部，分隔名称组成部分。

patterns.name: 专利语句中的被动或情态结构
patterns.trigger: « must»3« be»3« performed；« can»2« be»4« prevented；« are»3« followed
patterns.context: 技术对象或操作以被动结构描述，包含 must/can/are 等助动词。

patterns.name: 代码中的函数调用与属性访问
patterns.context: 代码中以点访问属性或方法，或调用函数并跟随参数。

patterns.name: 英语句子中的小词与标点
patterns.context: 一般英语句子中的系词、冒号或常见语法词；未见稳定的特定语义环境。

patterns.name: 英文 token“of”所在短语
patterns.context: “of”连接名词短语，分别表示数量构成或技术对象的属性。

patterns.name: 代码中的变量赋值
patterns.context: 代码中变量或索引表达式后出现赋值符号。

patterns.name: 表达代码执行方式的介词
patterns.context: 在讨论翻译字符串执行 Python 代码时，“via”引出执行途径。

patterns.name: Socket 与缓冲区术语
patterns.context: 描述服务器接收客户端命令及缓冲区数据处理。

en.concept: Relational and evaluative markers in explanatory sentences
en.description: Activations are heterogeneous: they often occur in explanatory sentences expressing contrast, evaluation, or degree of difficulty, and also cover a specific negative counterexample. Sporadic patterns include configuration keys, code identifiers, figure references, and physical symbols.

patterns.name: However contrast
patterns.context: The preceding text describes a method, result, or structure, followed by a limitation, counterexample, or evaluation; activation falls on the contrast word.

patterns.name: Evaluation or judgment expressions
patterns.context: Explains how a measure or condition affects a result, judgment, reconstruction, or ease of operation; often appears in functional or causal statements.

patterns.name: Emphasis on degree and necessity
patterns.context: Emphasizes effort, difficulty, interference, or necessity, usually to describe the burden or shortcomings of an existing approach.

patterns.name: Exception or negative judgment
patterns.context: First presents a general measurement or judgment method, then states that a particular object does not conform; activation concentrates on the negation/counterexample expression.

patterns.name: English keys in structured data
patterns.context: English keys and values appear alongside null values and empty keys in YAML/YAML-like mappings; activation is concentrated on subword fragments of the English keys.

patterns.name: addr inside a code identifier
patterns.context: Appears as part of an address-related variable name in a C system-call function signature.

patterns.name: Percentages and figure references
patterns.context: Paper text discusses prediction results in connection with figures and mentions a sampling scheme and its cost or interference.

patterns.name: Physical quantity symbols and reconstruction
patterns.context: Describes quasi-elastic scattering and reconstructs neutrino energy by measuring muon energy and angle.

6_1511.concept: 说明性语句中的关系与评价标记
6_1511.description: 激活分布较杂：多见于转折、评价功能或难易程度的说明性语句，也覆盖特定否定反例；另有配置键、代码标识符、图表引用及物理符号等零散模式。

patterns.name: However 转折
patterns.context: 前文先描述方法、结果或结构，随后引出局限、反例或评价；激活落在转折词上。

patterns.name: 评价或判断表达
patterns.trigger: “critical in completing”“helpful in determining”“allows to reconstruct”“intended to facilitate”“complicated”
patterns.context: 说明某措施或条件对结果、判断、重建或操作难易的作用；常见于功能性或因果性表述。

patterns.name: 程度与必要性强调
patterns.trigger: “so much effort”“so disruptive”“extremely difficult”“very complicated”“must be performed separately”
patterns.context: 突出耗费、难度、干扰或必要性，通常用于说明既有方案的负担或缺陷。
patterns.domain: 专利背景及说明性 prose

patterns.name: 例外或否定判断
patterns.trigger: “This was not so in the case of”
patterns.context: 先提出一般测量或判断方式，再指出特定对象不符合；激活集中在否定/反例表达。

patterns.name: 结构化数据中的英文键
patterns.context: YAML/类 YAML 映射中，英文键值与空值、空键并列；激活集中在英文键的子词片段。

patterns.name: 代码标识符内部的 addr
patterns.context: C 语言系统调用函数签名中，作为地址相关变量名的一部分出现。

patterns.name: 百分比与图表引用
patterns.context: 论文正文结合图表说明预测结果，并提及抽样方案及其成本或干扰。

patterns.name: 物理量符号与重建
patterns.context: 描述准弹性散射，通过测量缪子能量和角度重建中微子能量。

en.concept: Difficult phrasing in English technical text
en.description: Activations are scattered across function words and syntactic constructions in English prose, and also commonly occur around difficulty, complexity, or negative evaluations. Other examples include explanations of default behavior, mathematical formulas, and various technical terms and word fragments, making a single semantic trigger difficult to identify.

patterns.name: English function words and local syntactic structures
patterns.context: Prepositions, conjunctions, and articles occur in specific syntactic constructions in technical or expository sentences; the marked words are not all the same.
patterns.domain: English text such as forum comments, papers, patents, and reports

patterns.name: Words expressing difficulty, complexity, or negative evaluation
patterns.context: Describes the difficulty, negativity, or importance of a problem, method, condition, or consequence.
patterns.domain: Forum comments, administrative reports, patent background, and academic papers

patterns.name: Default behavior and operational instructions
patterns.context: Explains how to set default behavior or what a default implementation does in code.
patterns.domain: Forum technical Q&A, software code comments

patterns.name: Variables and symbol structures in mathematical formulas
patterns.context: Variables, powers, fractions, and formula notation occur adjacent to one another.

patterns.name: Rare word fragments and proper-name remnants
patterns.context: Words are split into subword fragments, or occur in usernames, proper names, code identifiers, and technical terms; triggers are scattered.

patterns.name: Technical operations or specialized terminology
patterns.context: Passages contain specific configuration instructions, organization names, material terminology, code identifiers, or cultural terminology.
patterns.domain: Technical forums, public health reports, patents, code, and forum comments

6_1511.concept: 英文技术文本中的难点表述
6_1511.description: 激活分散于英文论述中的虚词和句法搭配，也常见于困难、复杂或负面评价；另有默认行为说明、数学公式及多种专业术语、词片段，难以由单一语义触发解释。

patterns.name: 英文虚词与局部语法结构
patterns.trigger: “on”“with”“in”“is”“but”“however”等；段[2]中还有“in the light of”，段[5]中有“in a relatively easy manner”
patterns.context: 技术或论述性句子中，介词、连词及冠词处于具体句法搭配中；被标记的词不完全相同
patterns.domain: 论坛评论、论文、专利及报告等英文文本

patterns.name: 困难、复杂或负面评价词
patterns.context: 描述问题、方法、条件或后果的困难、负面性或重要性
patterns.domain: 论坛评论、行政报告、专利背景及学术论文

patterns.name: 默认行为与操作说明
patterns.trigger: “make this the default behavior”“default behavior is to do nothing”
patterns.context: 说明如何设置默认行为，或代码中默认实现为何
patterns.domain: 论坛技术答疑、软件代码注释

patterns.name: 数学公式中的变量与符号结构
patterns.context: 变量、幂次、分式和公式标记相邻出现

patterns.name: 罕见词片段及专名残片
patterns.context: 词被切分成子词片段，或出现在用户名、专名、代码标识符及学科术语中；触发点分散
patterns.domain: 论坛文本、代码、学术论文

patterns.name: 技术操作或专业术语
patterns.context: 各段中出现具体的配置指令、机构名、材料术语、代码标识符或文化术语
patterns.domain: 技术论坛、公共卫生报告、专利、代码及论坛评论

en.description: Primarily responds to words denoting difficulty, flaws, and limitations, along with their causal or qualifying structures, especially in patent problem statements. Sporadic responses also occur for success or importance evaluations, workload and disruption burdens, and the introduction of analytical results.

patterns.name: Expressions of difficulty/limitation
patterns.context: Describes flaws, implementation obstacles, or limitations of a technology, method, or solution; often follows the contrast word “However” or the construction “is … in that”.
patterns.domain: Patent background technology; also signal-processing patent [9]

patterns.name: Causal or degree modifiers of difficulty-related words
patterns.context: A difficulty or flaw is explicitly attributed to manufacturing, positioning, operation, or scanning conditions; [9] introduces a limitation with “limited in the sense that”.

patterns.name: Success/importance evaluations
patterns.context: Evaluates a solution or the role of feedback: a network-multicast buffering solution achieves some success, while project feedback is crucial to completing a management system.
patterns.domain: Patent background technology [2]; public health/institutional report [8]

patterns.name: Workload or disruption burden
patterns.context: Discusses a random sampling scheme, emphasizing the substantial workload and disruption it entails.
patterns.domain: Biomedical paper discussing prediction evaluation methods

patterns.name: Introducing analytical results
patterns.context: In chemical reaction mechanisms or energy analysis, introduces subsequent conclusions with analytical results; no difficulty/flaw wording is present.

6_1511.description: 主要响应困难、缺陷与局限的词及其因果/限定结构，集中于专利问题陈述；另对成功或关键性评价、工作量与扰动负担、分析结果引出有零星响应。

patterns.name: 困难/限制的表述
patterns.context: 描述某种技术、方法或方案的缺陷、实施障碍或局限；常出现在转折词“However”或结构“is … in that”之后。
patterns.domain: 专利背景技术；另见信号处理专利[9]

patterns.name: 困难相关词的因果或程度修饰
patterns.trigger: “causes difficulties in”[1]、“difficult”后接“since”因果解释[3]、“presents difficulties in forming”[5]、“disadvantageous in that”[7][10]
patterns.context: 困难或缺陷被明确归因于制造、定位、操作或扫描条件；[9]则以“limited in the sense that”引出局限。
patterns.domain: 专利说明书中的问题陈述

patterns.name: 成功/关键性评价
patterns.context: 对方案或反馈作用作评价；分别为网络多播缓冲方案取得一定成功，以及项目反馈对完成管理系统至关重要。
patterns.domain: 专利背景技术[2]；公共卫生/机构报告[8]

patterns.name: 工作量或扰动的负担描述
patterns.context: 讨论随机抽样方案，强调其所需工作量大、造成的干扰强。
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文，讨论预测评估方法

patterns.name: 分析结果引出
patterns.context: 化学反应机理或能量分析中，以分析结果引出后续结论；未呈现困难/缺陷措辞。

en.description: Primarily responds to explanations of structures, operations, and their limitations in technical contexts, especially difficulties, necessary conditions, and manufacturing or configuration constraints. It also covers evaluations of process impacts in academic text and one passage of OpenCV contour-processing code.

patterns.name: Technical failures, difficulties, or shortcomings in patent background
patterns.context: After describing a technical structure, operation, or known approach, points out limitations, difficulties, necessary conditions, or effects; also includes qualifications on the conditions for a solution to succeed.

patterns.name: Descriptions of technical solutions and component/signal relationships
patterns.context: Describes the structure, configuration, or operation of devices, components, materials, or data transmission, often using patent-style component nouns and passive voice.

patterns.name: Quantity, measurement, and manufacturing constraints
patterns.context: Involves precision measurement, manufacturing difficulty, or numerous components in a device and their capacity or mounting method.

patterns.name: Statements about cost, disruption, or key roles in academic arguments
patterns.context: Evaluates the cost, impact, or importance of sampling or institutional feedback in academic discussion.

patterns.name: OpenCV contour processing in code
patterns.context: Python/OpenCV code iterates over contours and uses contour retrieval or approximation parameters.

6_1511.description: 主要响应技术背景中对结构、操作及其局限的说明，尤其是困难、必要条件和制造或配置限制；也覆盖学术文本中的流程影响评价，以及一段 OpenCV 轮廓处理代码。

patterns.name: 专利背景中的技术性失败、困难或不足
patterns.trigger: “This causes difficulties”, “presents difficulties”, “is difficult”, “is necessary that”, “is not affected”
patterns.context: 在描述某种技术结构、操作或已知方案后，指出其限制、困难、必要条件或效果；也包括对方案成功条件的限定。

patterns.name: 技术方案与部件/信号关系的说明
patterns.trigger: “radio wave … is directed to”, “data transfer capacity”, “are coupled to each other by bolts”, “formed in correspondence with opposite side edges”
patterns.context: 围绕设备、部件、材料或数据传输说明结构关系、配置或工作方式，常出现专利式部件名词及被动语态。

patterns.name: 数量、测量与制造限制
patterns.trigger: “fine pitches”, “amount of fine deformation”, “manufacturing the original plate”, “many pins”, “four corners”
patterns.context: 涉及精细测量、制造难度，或器件中数量较多的部件及其容量/固定方式。

patterns.name: 论文论证中的成本、扰动或关键作用表述
patterns.trigger: “would require so much effort”, “would be so disruptive”, “was critical in completing”
patterns.context: 在论文叙述中评价抽样或机构反馈对工作流程的成本、影响或重要性。

patterns.name: 代码中的 OpenCV 轮廓处理
patterns.context: Python/OpenCV 代码中遍历轮廓并使用轮廓检索或近似参数。

en.description: Activation samples span patent backgrounds, paper equations, and technical Q&A, covering device descriptions, measurements, vehicles, SQL, Python, and HTML. Local cues include visible numbers, the letter a, and code markers, but there is no unified, stable semantic or formatting pattern.

patterns.name: Programmatic code and query delimiters
patterns.context: Commonly appears around statement delimiters, line breaks, and keywords in SQL queries, code snippets, or structured output; not necessarily the direct cause of every activation.

patterns.name: The letter a in technical text
patterns.context: Appears near articles or mathematical variables in patent descriptions; there is no consistent local context.

patterns.name: The number 1 and neighboring numbers
patterns.context: Appears in different structures, such as Python slicing «[»:«1»]», «=»«0» in formulas, and «id: 1» in table fields.

patterns.name: Technical narrative in patent backgrounds
patterns.context: Patent background sections describe manufacturing difficulties, drawbacks of methods, or problems with prior art, but activation does not always fall on these words; the specific trigger is uncertain.

patterns.name: Vertical sealing and packaging equipment terminology
patterns.context: Appears as a directional or equipment qualifier in technical descriptions of packaging materials, sealing devices, and guide rollers.

patterns.name: Reflectors and radio-wave paths
patterns.context: Describes beam paths among horn antennas, focusing reflectors, and main reflectors.

patterns.name: Moiré measurement and fine deformation
patterns.context: Discusses measurement range, fine grating pitch, and difficulties in manufacturing originals.

patterns.name: Bold a and equation labels in formulas
patterns.context: Near vector variables and their equations of motion in mathematical expressions.

patterns.name: ROC-AUC and probability prediction code
patterns.context: StackExchange answers explain computing ROC-AUC from model probabilities and show Python slicing.

patterns.name: SQL date conditions and sorting
patterns.context: Queries aggregate supplier prices under date conditions, then sort and limit the number of returned rows.

patterns.name: Vehicle lateral acceleration and steering torque
patterns.context: Describes how the required manual torque changes as vehicle lateral acceleration increases, independently of vehicle speed.

patterns.name: Bolted connections in air-filter components
patterns.context: In prior art, the body and cover are bolted together, followed by discussion of bolt locations.

patterns.name: SQL element-count question
patterns.context: The asker attempts to count elements in a database table and reports that the query did not work.

patterns.name: HTML table examples and count result
patterns.context: Shows two table examples, followed by a result-count expression.

6_1511.description: 激活样本跨专利背景、论文公式和技术问答，涉及设备描述、测量、车辆、SQL、Python及HTML；可见数字、字母a、代码标记等局部线索，但没有统一稳定的语义或格式模式。

patterns.name: 程序化代码与查询分隔符
patterns.context: 在 SQL 查询、代码片段或结构化输出中，常见于语句分隔、换行及关键字附近；未必是每段激活的直接原因。

patterns.name: 技术文本中的字母 a
patterns.context: 出现在专利技术描述中的冠词或数学公式变量附近；没有一致的局部上下文。

patterns.name: 数值 1 及其邻近数字
patterns.context: 出现在 Python 切片«[»:«1»]»、公式中的«=»«0»、表格字段«id: 1»等不同结构中。

patterns.name: 专利背景中的技术叙述
patterns.context: 专利背景部分说明制造困难、方法缺点或现有技术问题，但激活位置并不总落在这些词上，具体触发机制不确定。

patterns.name: 纵向密封与包装设备术语
patterns.context: 包装材料、密封装置及导向辊的技术描述中，作为方向或设备限定词出现。
patterns.domain: USPTO 专利背景：包装机械

patterns.name: 反射器与无线电波路径
patterns.context: 描述喇叭天线、聚焦反射器及主反射器之间的波束路径。

patterns.name: 莫尔测量与精细变形
patterns.context: 讨论测量范围、光栅精细间距及原版制造困难。
patterns.domain: USPTO 专利背景：测量技术

patterns.name: 公式中的粗体 a 与方程标记
patterns.context: 数学表达式中向量变量及其运动方程标签附近。

patterns.name: ROC-AUC 与概率预测代码
patterns.context: StackExchange 回答中说明用模型概率计算 ROC-AUC，并展示 Python 切片。

patterns.name: SQL 日期条件与排序
patterns.context: 查询按日期条件汇总供应价格并排序、限制返回行数。

patterns.name: 车辆横向加速度与转向扭矩
patterns.context: 描述车辆横向加速度增加时所需手动扭矩的变化及其与车速无关。
patterns.domain: USPTO 专利背景：车辆控制

patterns.name: 空气滤清器部件用螺栓连接
patterns.context: 现有技术中本体与盖部通过螺栓连接，随后讨论螺栓固定位置。
patterns.domain: USPTO 专利背景：空气滤清器

patterns.name: SQL 元素计数问题
patterns.context: 提问者试图统计数据库表中的元素数量，并报告查询未成功。

patterns.name: HTML 表格样例与计数结果
patterns.context: 展示两个表格样例，随后给出结果计数表达式。

en.description: Activations are scattered across subwords within words, numbers and formula symbols, English function words, and descriptions of technical process defects in patents. The passages lack a unified trigger condition; segment 6 consists mainly of formula formatting, with no stable semantic pattern observed.

patterns.name: English word-final fragments and token boundaries
patterns.context: Activations often fall on subword fragments within words rather than complete words; these fragments may occur in different domains and syntactic positions.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain English text, code, and mathematical notation

patterns.name: Numbers, symbols, and formula fragments in technical text
patterns.context: When values, monetary amounts, equations, and notation symbols occur in technical or legal text, some numbers or symbols are marked; their positions vary.

patterns.name: Problem and defect descriptions in patent background
patterns.context: Describes shortcomings, complexity, cost, or difficulty in manufacturing or processing, often introduced in a contrastive or causal context.

patterns.name: Local syntactic function words and collocations
patterns.context: Activations are scattered across prepositions, conjunctions, time expressions, modals, and evaluative words in various sentences; no consistent fixed-phrase condition is apparent.
patterns.domain: Legal, medical, philosophy, experimental descriptions, Q&A

6_1511.description: 激活零散分布于词内子词、数字与公式符号、英文功能词，以及专利中对技术流程缺陷的描述。片段间缺乏统一触发条件；第6段主要是公式排版，未见稳定语义模式。

patterns.name: 英文词尾片段与分词边界
patterns.context: 激活常落在词内部的子词片段，而非完整词；这些片段可能出现在不同领域和句法位置。
patterns.domain: 跨领域英文文本、代码与数学排版

patterns.name: 技术文本中的数字、符号与公式片段
patterns.context: 技术或法律文本中出现数值、货币金额、方程及排版符号时，若干数字或符号被标记；触发位置不一致。
patterns.domain: 法律、医学、化学、数学公式

patterns.name: 专利背景中的问题与缺陷描述
patterns.context: 描述制造或处理流程的不足、复杂性、成本或困难，通常以转折或因果语境引出。

patterns.name: 局部句法功能词及搭配
patterns.context: 在各类句子中，激活分散于介词、连接词、时间表达、情态或评价词；没有明显一致的固定短语条件。
patterns.domain: 法律、医学、哲学、实验描述、问答

en.description: One pattern is the except clause in Python exception handling; another is statements of drawbacks of prior methods in patent backgrounds, especially reasons introduced by in that, as well as direct assessments such as describing a process as complex.

patterns.name: Exception-handling clause
patterns.context: In Python code, except is followed by an exception type and optional variable, usually introducing an exception-handling block with a colon; activation is concentrated on except.

patterns.name: Statements of drawbacks in patent backgrounds
patterns.context: Describes defects, limitations, or adverse consequences of existing processes or methods. Common phrasing includes “disadvantageous in that” or “drawback ... in that,” as well as direct claims that a process is complex or costly.
