6_1511.description: 主要响应 Especially（以及跨词片段 specially），用于突出前述内容中的特定情形或对象；另对 Python 异常分支、数学公式符号和伪代码 IF 有零星强激活。

patterns.name: Especially 的语篇强调用法
patterns.context: 在句中或句首引出对前文主张、结果、条件或对象的特别强调；后面常接 since、逗号或名词短语。出现于自然语言叙述和论文表述中。

patterns.name: 代码中的异常处理结构
patterns.context: Python 风格代码中，except 后接冒号并开始异常处理分支；周围有 try、if 或 print 等代码。

patterns.name: 数学表达式中的指数与根式符号
patterns.context: LaTeX 数学公式中，幂次和平方根符号嵌在误差函数上界公式里。

patterns.name: 条件选择语句的 IF 关键字
patterns.context: 伪代码或类 SQL 的条件示例中，IF 后接括号内条件，再接 then。

en.concept: Lexical forms across domains and parameter-documentation markers
en.description: Activations are scattered across various source code, comments, configuration, and natural-language text, including looking for, .SH, except, .xml, and the medical word worsens; there is also a strong response to @param/\param in several documentation comments.

patterns.name: Fixed phrase in requests/project descriptions
patterns.context: Politely states a need or describes a project, especially system requirements following "looking for"; activation also covers nearby "description.", not only the complete phrase.

patterns.name: .SH marker in code
patterns.context: Appears in a path or section marker resembling a configuration file, followed by "DESCRIPTION"; this marker activates very strongly.

patterns.name: Doxygen parameter documentation marker
patterns.context: Introduces function parameters in code comments, typically followed by the parameter name and meaning.

patterns.name: PHPUnit parameter comment marker
patterns.context: Parameter types and descriptions in PHPDoc comments; also appears in documentation blocks in other languages.

patterns.name: PHPDoc parameter field
patterns.context: Documentation comments for user-registration-related methods, followed by parameter information such as array or $data.

patterns.name: Exception-handling keyword
patterns.context: In Python try/except code, except is followed by an exception type.

patterns.name: PHPDoc parameter field (property setter)
patterns.context: Documentation comments for property setters, followed by int, $val, and parameter descriptions.
patterns.domain: PHP SDK source code and PHPDoc

patterns.name: PHPDoc parameter field (generator)
patterns.context: Documentation comments for parameter-generator initialization methods, followed by the parameter specification name and description.

patterns.name: XML file extension
patterns.context: In project steps or file lists, filenames end in .xml.

patterns.name: Muscle-wasting-related word
patterns.context: A scientific statement describing alcohol as exacerbating HIV-related muscle wasting.

6_1511.concept: 多领域词形与参数文档标记
6_1511.description: 激活散布于多种源码、注释、配置及自然语言文本：包括 looking for、.SH、except、.xml、医学词 worsens；另对多处文档注释中的 @param/\param 强烈响应。

patterns.name: 请求/项目描述中的固定短语
patterns.context: 礼貌陈述需求或项目描述，尤其是 "looking for" 后接系统需求；激活不只落在完整短语上，也覆盖附近的 "description."
patterns.domain: 项目需求、对话式软件委托

patterns.name: 代码中的 .SH 标记
patterns.context: 出现在类似配置文件的路径或分节标记中，后接 "DESCRIPTION"；该标记激活极强

patterns.name: Doxygen 参数文档标记
patterns.context: 代码注释中介绍函数参数，后续通常说明参数名及含义

patterns.name: PHPUnit 参数注释标记
patterns.context: PHPDoc 注释中的参数类型与参数说明；也出现在其他语言的文档块中

patterns.name: PHPDoc 参数字段
patterns.context: 用户注册相关方法的文档注释，后接 array、$data 等参数信息

patterns.name: 异常处理关键词
patterns.context: Python try/except 代码中，except 后接异常类型

patterns.name: PHPDoc 参数字段（属性 setter）
patterns.context: 属性 setter 的文档注释中，后接 int、$val 及参数说明

patterns.name: PHPDoc 参数字段（生成器）
patterns.context: 参数生成器初始化方法的文档注释中，后接参数规格名称和说明

patterns.name: XML 文件扩展名
patterns.context: 项目步骤或文件清单中，文件名以 .xml 结尾

patterns.name: 肌肉消耗相关词
patterns.context: 描述酒精加重 HIV 感染相关肌肉消耗的科研陈述

en.description: Activations cover mathematical formulas, parameter descriptions in code comments, exception handling, PHP database and form code, and wording about exacerbating effects in biomedical research; no clear common trigger spans all the text.

patterns.name: Functions and inequalities in mathematical formulas
patterns.context: A function symbol appears in a mathematical expression, especially a formula for erf and its upper-bound inequality.

patterns.name: Parameter descriptions in documentation comments
patterns.context: A code comment explains a method or property and uses @param to describe a parameter.

patterns.name: Exception handling and error branches
patterns.context: Code catches exceptions with try/except, handles specific errors, or rethrows exceptions.

patterns.name: Database result iteration and form output
patterns.context: PHP code queries image data, iterates over results, and outputs a submission form.

patterns.name: Muscle wasting and HIV research
patterns.context: A research abstract proposes the hypothesis that alcohol exacerbates HIV-related muscle wasting.

6_1511.description: 激活覆盖数学公式、代码注释参数说明、异常处理、PHP 数据库与表单代码，以及生物医学研究中的加重效应措辞；未见贯穿全部文本的明确共同触发特征。

patterns.name: 数学公式中的函数与不等式
patterns.context: 数学表达式中出现函数符号，尤其是 erf 的公式及其上界不等式。

patterns.name: 文档注释中的参数说明
patterns.context: 代码注释说明方法或属性的功能，并以 @param 描述参数。

patterns.name: 异常处理与错误分支
patterns.context: 代码通过 try/except 捕获异常、处理特定错误，或重新抛出异常。

patterns.name: 数据库结果遍历及表单输出
patterns.context: PHP 代码查询图像数据，遍历结果并输出提交表单。

patterns.name: 肌肉消耗与 HIV 研究
patterns.context: 研究摘要提出酒精加重 HIV 感染相关肌肉消耗的假设。

en.description: Activations are distributed across multiple types of technical text: LaTeX mathematical formulas, code and API documentation comments, Python exception handling, biomedical research narratives, engineering patent descriptions, and a piece of website-development marketing copy. The segments have no clear specialized topic in common.

patterns.name: LaTeX mathematical expressions
patterns.context: In mathematical formulas, especially around radicals, logarithms, and fractions; segment 1 also contains an error-function expression, while segment 4 contains a hyperbolic cosine identity.
patterns.domain: LaTeX in mathematics- and physics-related papers or Q&A

patterns.name: Code documentation comments and parameter descriptions
patterns.context: Documentation comments in code blocks, often adjacent to method definitions, describing parameters, return values, or class properties.
patterns.domain: Software development, especially Java/PHP-style code and API documentation

patterns.name: English business service introduction
patterns.context: After a polite greeting, a company or service provider paraphrases a customer's needs and introduces website development services.
patterns.domain: Business proposals, website development marketing copy

patterns.name: Biomedical research narrative
patterns.context: A continuous account of research background, pathological changes, and a research hypothesis involving alcohol, muscle wasting, and HIV.
patterns.domain: Biomedical research abstracts or grant applications

patterns.name: Control-system description in a patent
patterns.context: Explains the delays and consequences that changes in target speed may cause in brake control, using causal relations.

patterns.name: Storage and path-optimization description in a patent
patterns.context: Explains how an operation uses stored data to find a path and discusses the necessary hardware.

patterns.name: Exception handling and output in a Python script
patterns.context: Extracts content from a compressed file or similar object, outputs the result, and prints an error before exiting in an exception branch.

6_1511.concept: 技术文档与结构化文本
6_1511.description: 激活分布于多种技术文本：LaTeX 数学公式、代码及 API 文档注释、Python 异常处理、生物医学研究叙述、工程专利说明，以及一段网站开发商业文案。各段没有明显共享的专门主题。

patterns.name: LaTeX 数学表达式
patterns.context: 数学公式中，尤其是根式、对数和分式周围；第 1 段还出现误差函数表达式，第 4 段出现双曲余弦恒等式。
patterns.domain: 数学、物理类论文或问答中的 LaTeX

patterns.name: 代码文档注释与参数说明
patterns.trigger: «/**»、«*»、«@param»、«Sets»，以及说明属性或方法功能的英文注释
patterns.context: 代码块中的文档注释，常紧邻方法定义，并描述参数、返回值或类属性。
patterns.domain: 软件开发，尤其是 Java/PHP 风格代码及 API 文档

patterns.name: 英文商业服务介绍
patterns.context: 礼貌问候后，以公司或服务提供者口吻复述客户需求并介绍网站开发服务。
patterns.domain: 商业提案、网站开发宣传文案

patterns.name: 生物医学研究叙述
patterns.context: 连续陈述研究背景、病理变化与研究假设，涉及酒精、肌肉消耗及 HIV。
patterns.domain: 生物医学研究摘要或项目申请

patterns.name: 专利中的控制系统描述
patterns.context: 以因果关系解释制动控制中目标速度变化可能造成的延迟及后果。
patterns.domain: 汽车工程专利背景技术

patterns.name: 专利中的存储与路径优化描述
patterns.context: 说明操作过程如何利用存储数据寻找路径，并讨论所需硬件。
patterns.domain: 计算机或硬件相关专利

patterns.name: Python 脚本中的异常处理与输出
patterns.context: 从压缩文件或类似对象提取内容，输出结果，并在异常分支中打印错误后退出。

en.description: The activation pattern is scattered: it highlights negative impacts and technical shortcomings in patents, and also appears in PHP return statements, Rust generic syntax, algebraic geometry mapping descriptions, and Q&A examples. No single semantic feature or genre covers all segments.

patterns.name: Expressions of negative impact
patterns.context: Describes a factor having a negative impact on an object; nearby words often include impact, on, and negative evaluative terms.

patterns.name: Problems and drawbacks in patent backgrounds
patterns.context: Describes the drawbacks of a technical solution, method, or parameter and problems in its practical application.

patterns.name: return in code
patterns.context: Appears within a PHP method body, returning a property value or null; member access and method comments occur nearby.

patterns.name: Rust types and generic syntax
patterns.context: Occurs in Rust code types, trait expressions, or generic expressions.

patterns.name: Mapping notation in algebraic geometry
patterns.context: Discusses polynomials, affine algebraic varieties, and functions on them.

patterns.name: Example tables and query requests in Q&A
patterns.context: Shows sample output and then asks how to modify a query.

6_1511.description: 激活模式分散：突出负面影响及专利技术缺陷，也出现在 PHP 返回语句、Rust 泛型语法、代数几何映射描述和查询问答案例中。没有单一语义或文体能覆盖全部片段。

patterns.name: negative impact 表达
patterns.trigger: “negative impact on”及其变体“serious impact on”
patterns.context: 描述某因素对对象造成负面影响；附近常有 impact、on 及负面评价词。

patterns.name: 专利背景中的问题与缺点
patterns.context: 说明技术方案、方法或参数的弊端及其实际应用问题。

patterns.name: 代码中的 return
patterns.context: 出现在 PHP 方法体内，返回属性值或 null；附近有成员访问和方法注释。

patterns.name: Rust 类型与泛型语法
patterns.context: 位于 Rust 代码的类型、trait 或泛型表达式中。

patterns.name: 代数几何中的映射符号
patterns.context: 讨论多项式、仿射代数簇及其上的函数。

patterns.name: 问答中的示例表格与查询请求
patterns.trigger: “like this:”后的对齐数据表，以及“I want to modify the query and output it”
patterns.context: 先展示示例输出，再询问如何修改查询。

en.description: The clearest strong activation occurs on except in code exception handling; other cases include not in patents, too much in a post, the final s in costs, and an internal fragment of worsens. The remaining markers are sporadic and cannot be explained by a single semantic pattern.

patterns.name: except in exception handling
patterns.context: Appears in Python-style code exception clauses, followed by an exception type or colon; similar structures occur in samples 3, 4, 6, 7, and 10.
patterns.domain: Program code, Python or Python-style code

patterns.name: not in contrastive structures
patterns.context: In English sentences, not introduces a negative judgment or degree contrast; “not the case” in sample 1 and “not so important” in sample 2 differ in form but both show strong activation.

patterns.name: Word-final substring in works
patterns.context: The final s is marked separately in “it costs in customer acquisition”; activation falls on a split plural/third-person ending.

patterns.name: The phrase too much
patterns.context: In a comment, “too much credit” expresses an excessive degree; activation is concentrated on too and much.

patterns.name: Internal fragment wor
patterns.context: Occurs inside the word “worsens,” which is split into tokens; there is insufficient evidence that activation is related to the full meaning of the word.
patterns.domain: Medical research abstracts or grant applications

6_1511.description: 强激活最明确地出现在代码异常处理的 except；另有专利中的 not、帖子里的 too much、costs 词尾 s 及 worsens 词内片段。其余标记零散，无法由单一语义模式解释。

patterns.name: 异常处理中的 except
patterns.context: 出现在 Python 风格代码的异常处理子句中，后面跟异常类型或冒号；第 3、4、6、7、10 段均有相近结构。
patterns.domain: 编程代码、Python 或 Python 风格代码

patterns.name: 转折或对照结构中的 not
patterns.context: 英语句子中 not 引出否定判断或程度对照；第 1 段的 “not the case” 与第 2 段的 “not so important” 形式不同，均含有较强激活。

patterns.name: works 的词尾子串
patterns.context: 词尾 s 单独标记，位于 “it costs in customer acquisition” 中；激活落在被拆分的复数／第三人称词尾上。
patterns.domain: 商业讨论、社交网站帖子

patterns.name: too much 短语
patterns.context: 评论中以 “too much credit” 表达程度过量；激活集中在 too 和 much。

patterns.name: wor 的词内片段
patterns.context: 位于 “worsens” 一词内部，词被拆分标记；没有足够证据说明激活与该词的完整语义有关。
patterns.domain: 医学研究摘要或基金申请

en.description: Primarily sensitive to Python except exception branches and exception types, and also covers error-handling operations within branches; it also appears on sentence-initial Except in a medical abstract and on contrastive expressions in a forum post, possibly related to the English contrastive use.

patterns.name: Exception-handling keyword
patterns.context: An except branch in Python code, usually following a try block and followed by an exception type, a colon, or exception-handling code.

patterns.name: Exception types and their components
patterns.context: Appears after except as the type of exception being caught; some exception names are split into multiple tokens.

patterns.name: Error handling within an exception branch
patterns.context: Located within an except branch, used to print an error, exit the program, or perform a rollback; local activation also covers code near the same branch.

patterns.name: Contrastive expression
patterns.context: Used as an ordinary English contrast word, followed by a risk or exception, rather than as Python syntax.

patterns.name: English contrastive phrase
patterns.context: Introduces another perspective in a narrative; activation also falls on nearby ordinary English and punctuation.

6_1511.description: 主要对 Python 的 except 异常分支及异常类型敏感，也覆盖分支内的错误处理操作；另有医学摘要中句首 Except 和论坛文中的转折表达，可能与英文转折用法有关。

patterns.name: 异常处理关键字
patterns.context: Python 代码中出现 except 分支，通常紧跟 try 块，后面可接异常类型、冒号或异常处理代码。

patterns.name: 异常类型及其组成
patterns.context: 出现在 except 之后，作为被捕获的异常类型；有的异常名被拆成多个 token。

patterns.name: 异常分支内的错误处理
patterns.context: 位于 except 分支内，用于打印错误、退出程序或执行回滚；局部激活也覆盖同一分支附近的代码。

patterns.name: 对比转折表达
patterns.context: 作为普通英文转折词，后接风险或例外情形，而非 Python 语法。

patterns.name: 英文转折短语
patterns.context: 叙述中引出另一种看法；激活同时落在邻近普通英文和标点上。

en.concept: Exception-handling code (with an isolated patent word)
en.description: Primarily activates on Python except exception branches, their exception types, and nearby error recovery and control-flow contexts; it also activates on complicated (describing structural complexity) in a patent background segment.

patterns.name: except keyword
patterns.context: Follows a try block in Python and introduces an exception-handling branch; activation often falls on except and the following exception type or nearby colon.

patterns.name: Exception types and handling context
patterns.context: An exception class name follows except in an exception-handling branch; it may also be accompanied by catching exceptions, printing messages, or continuing execution.

patterns.name: Control flow and error recovery in exception handling
patterns.context: Appears near an exception branch or in a related code flow; these words do not occur in every segment and may not be independent triggers.

patterns.name: Multiline indented code structure
patterns.context: try/except or similar branches are organized with newlines and indentation; the code context is salient but may merely accompany the primary trigger word.

patterns.name: Complexity wording in a patent background
patterns.context: Describes the structure of conventional equipment as complicated, in a patent background passage about adhesive/container; it does not fit the code exception-handling pattern.

6_1511.concept: 异常处理代码（另含孤立专利词）
6_1511.description: 主要对 Python 代码中的 except 异常分支及其异常类型、附近的错误恢复和控制流语境激活；另在一段专利背景的 complicated（描述结构复杂）处激活。

patterns.name: except 关键词
patterns.context: 位于 Python try 块之后，引出异常处理分支；激活常落在 except 及其后面的异常类型或冒号附近。

patterns.name: 异常类型与处理语境
patterns.context: 异常处理分支中，异常类名紧随 except；也可能伴随捕获异常、打印信息或继续执行。

patterns.name: 异常处理中的控制流与错误恢复
patterns.context: 出现在异常分支附近或相关代码流程中；这些词并非每段都出现，且未必是独立触发因素。

patterns.name: 多行缩进代码结构
patterns.context: try/except 或类似分支以换行和缩进组织；代码上下文较明显，但可能只是伴随主触发词。

patterns.name: 专利背景中的复杂性措辞
patterns.context: 描述常规设备结构复杂，出现在 adhesive/container 的专利背景叙述中；与代码异常处理模式不吻合。

en.description: Activation points are scattered across several local expressions: descriptions of structures, process burdens, and drawbacks in patents; code exception handling; legal discretion; proposal wording; naming evaluations; and experimental procedures. No single semantic trigger is stable across domains.

patterns.name: Structure-related expressions
patterns.context: A patent background passage describes a device or structure as complicated; the strong trigger falls on the preposition in, preceded by “complicated”

patterns.name: Evaluations of being time-consuming, expensive, or cumbersome
patterns.context: Describes the burden of a process or test, often concluding with negative evaluations such as time-consuming, inefficient, expensive, or difficult to perform; the strong trigger is on to

patterns.name: except exception handling
patterns.context: An except clause in code, followed by exception-handling code

patterns.name: Judicial discretion context for discretion
patterns.context: A legal opinion discusses whether a court abused its discretion; discretion is followed by in introducing the disputed matter

patterns.name: in that introducing a drawback or reason
patterns.context: A patent background first evaluates a process negatively, then uses in that to explain its reason or drawback

patterns.name: Project requirements after looking for
patterns.context: A response to a freelance proposal says it is looking for or offering a project/system that meets the requirements; the strong trigger is on for

patterns.name: Code documentation evaluation of poorly named
patterns.context: Discusses function naming and comprehensibility, evaluating how poor naming can also make documentation unclear

patterns.name: carefully modifying experimental procedures
patterns.context: A research plan describes an experimental measurement method; carefully emphasizes that injection timing is precisely controlled

6_1511.description: 激活点分散在多种局部表达中：专利中的结构、流程负担及缺点说明，代码异常处理，法律裁量，提案用语，命名评价和实验操作。未见跨领域稳定的单一语义触发。

patterns.name: 结构相关表达
patterns.context: 专利背景段中描述装置或结构复杂；强触发落在介词 in，前文有“complicated”

patterns.name: 费时、昂贵或繁琐的评价
patterns.trigger: time-«consuming»5« … expensive»6« to»10« the»4« US»1PS»；« highly»2« cumbersome»5« … expensive»5« to»10« perform
patterns.context: 描述流程或测试的负担，常以耗时、低效、昂贵、难以执行等负面评价收束；强触发在 to

patterns.name: except 异常处理
patterns.context: 代码中的 except 子句，后接异常处理代码

patterns.name: discretion 的司法裁量语境
patterns.context: 法律意见书中论述法院是否滥用裁量权，discretion 后接 in 引出争议事项

patterns.name: in that 引出缺点或原因
patterns.context: 专利背景中先评价工艺不利，再用 in that 说明其原因或缺点

patterns.name: looking for 后的项目需求
patterns.context: 自由职业提案回复中表示正在寻找或提供符合需求的项目／系统；强触发在 for

patterns.name: poorly named 的代码文档评价
patterns.trigger: poorly»9« named»2« and»4« thus« poorly»5« documented
patterns.context: 讨论函数命名和可理解性，评价命名不佳会导致文档也不清楚

patterns.name: carefully 修饰实验操作
patterns.context: 研究计划中描述实验测量方法，carefully 强调注射时序经过精确控制

en.description: The strongest and most consistent trigger is except in Python exception handling, especially when followed by an exception type. Other positive activations are scattered across patent technical descriptions, connectives, degree evaluations, and quantity expressions, without a unified and compelling lexical pattern; some passages have only weak, incidental activations.

patterns.name: Exception-handling clause
patterns.context: An exception-catching statement following a try block in code; the strongest response is concentrated on except and the immediately following exception type.

patterns.name: Functional/structural discussion in patent backgrounds
patterns.context: Formal explanatory discussion of devices, substrates, methods, or drawbacks in patent background sections; triggers are scattered across technical relationships and evaluative statements.

patterns.name: Emphasis or degree expressions in general English
patterns.context: Describes degree, evaluation, or manner in natural language; the triggering words vary across examples, with no stable common collocation.
patterns.domain: Research plans, technical descriptions, dialogue, and strings within code

patterns.name: English continuation/discourse-linking expressions
patterns.context: Connectives at the beginning of or between sentences introduce grounds, results, additions, or concessions; responses are weak and scattered.
patterns.domain: Formal explanatory prose, especially patent text

patterns.name: Expressions for quantities or groups of objects
patterns.context: Involves multiple technical components identified by ordinal numbers or quantities of many objects; the signal is weak.
patterns.domain: Patents, technical test descriptions, and online discussions

6_1511.description: 最强且一致的触发是 Python 异常处理中的 except，尤其后接异常类型。其余正激活分散于专利技术说明、连接词、程度评价及数量表达，缺乏统一而有力的词汇模式；部分段落仅有弱杂散激活。

patterns.name: 异常处理子句
patterns.context: 代码中 try 块之后的 except 异常捕获语句；最强响应集中在 except 及其后紧随的异常类型

patterns.name: 专利背景中的功能／结构论述
patterns.trigger: «necessary»6« to»5« provide»2« the»5« container…« sealing»2« structure»3«；« complicated»6« in»10« structure»2«；« and»9« fourth»2« substrates»2«；« disadvantage»9« that»6
patterns.context: 专利背景部分以正式说明文讨论装置、基板、方法或缺点；触发分散在技术关系和评价性表述中

patterns.name: 一般英语中的强调或程度表达
patterns.trigger: «carefully»9« timed»2；« extremely»5« expensive»5« to»9« perform»；« good»1«.'»4
patterns.context: 自然语言中描述程度、评价或执行方式；各例触发词不同，未见稳定共同搭配
patterns.domain: 科研计划、技术说明、对话及代码内字符串

patterns.name: 英文续接／篇章连接表达
patterns.context: 句首或句间使用连接词引入依据、结果、补充或让步；响应较弱且分散
patterns.domain: 正式说明文，尤其专利文本

patterns.name: 数量或成组对象表达
patterns.trigger: «third»4« substrate»1…« fourth»3« substrate»2；« hundreds»1« of»1；« thousands»2 of people
patterns.context: 涉及序数标识的多个技术部件，或大量对象的数量描述；信号较弱
patterns.domain: 专利、技术测试说明及网络讨论

en.description: The main pattern is Python exception-handling code (1, 5, 7, 9); other activations include nested C++ template types (2), patent descriptions of complex, time-consuming, and expensive prior art (3, 4, 6), a compressed-file password script (5), Markdown fences in an incomplete post (8), and a JSX delete button (10). There is no unified semantics across these patterns.

patterns.name: except exception handling
patterns.context: The start of an exception-handling branch or the capture of a specific exception in Python code; the code often prints an error, handles an exception, or continues execution.

patterns.name: C++ template type structure
patterns.context: Long, nested C++ type names with repeated scopes, template parameters, and angle brackets.

patterns.name: Descriptions of complex, expensive, or inefficient problems in patent backgrounds
patterns.context: Describes shortcomings in existing devices, processes, or test procedures, especially emphasizing structural complexity, time consumption, inefficiency, or high cost.

patterns.name: Extraction and password script
patterns.context: A Python script extracts content from a compressed file, uses a password, and catches exceptions.

patterns.name: Markdown code fences and incomplete text
patterns.context: A post contains Markdown fences, surrounded by misspelled, broken, or unfinished text.

patterns.name: JSX dangerous button and removal operation
patterns.context: React/JSX UI code defines a danger-styled button that removes an element or box when clicked.

6_1511.description: 主要模式是 Python 异常处理代码（1、5、7、9）；另有 C++ 嵌套模板类型（2）、专利对复杂耗时昂贵现有技术的描述（3、4、6）、压缩文件密码脚本（5）、残缺帖子中的 Markdown 围栏（8）和 JSX 删除按钮（10）。跨模式无统一语义。

patterns.name: except 异常处理
patterns.context: Python 代码中，异常处理分支开始或捕获特定异常；代码往往打印错误、处理异常或继续执行。

patterns.name: C++ 模板类型结构
patterns.context: 长而嵌套的 C++ 类型名中，作用域、模板参数和尖括号连续出现。

patterns.name: 专利背景中的复杂、昂贵或低效问题描述
patterns.context: 描述既有装置、流程或测试程序的不足，尤其强调结构复杂、耗时、低效或成本高。

patterns.name: 解压及密码脚本
patterns.context: Python 脚本从压缩文件提取内容，使用密码并捕获异常。

patterns.name: Markdown 代码围栏与残缺文本
patterns.context: 帖子含 Markdown 围栏，周围是拼写异常、断裂或未完成的文字。

patterns.name: JSX 危险按钮及移除操作
patterns.context: React/JSX 界面代码定义危险样式按钮，点击后移除元素或盒子。

en.concept: Problem and drawback descriptions (with domain-specific triggers)
en.description: Primarily responds to descriptions of drawbacks, negative effects, and costs of existing solutions; there are also sporadic responses to “abuse of discretion” in legal writing, rounding results in mathematics, Python exception handling, and layered structures in patents.

patterns.name: Trouble, defects, or adverse consequences
patterns.context: Describes problems, shortcomings, costs, or negative effects caused by existing practices, devices, or structures; common pairings include evaluative words followed by effects, expensive, or disadvantage.

patterns.name: Legal discretion terminology
patterns.context: States a party’s argument in a legal opinion, often followed by a court taking or declining to take an action; the phrase is repeated in two passages.

patterns.name: Numbers in rounding results
patterns.context: A math exercise asks for a value to be rounded; activation falls within the number given as the result of a negative-number rounding problem. The same passage also includes other values and answer formatting.

patterns.name: Exception handling in code
patterns.context: In Python-style code, an exception-handling keyword is followed by a colon and appears within an indented code block.

patterns.name: Description of a layered structure
patterns.context: A technical description uses ordinals and component names to describe the relative positions of substrates and their layered arrangement.

6_1511.concept: 问题与缺陷表述（兼有领域特异触发）
6_1511.description: 主要响应对现有方案缺陷、负面影响与成本的描述；另对法律中的“滥用裁量”、数学舍入结果、Python异常处理及专利层间结构有零散响应。

patterns.name: 麻烦、缺陷或不良后果
patterns.context: 描述现有做法、设备或结构带来的问题、缺点、成本或负面影响；常见搭配是评价词后接 effects、expensive、disadvantage 等。

patterns.name: 法律裁量用语
patterns.context: 法律意见书中陈述当事人的主张，常接法院采取或拒绝某项行动；该短语在两段中重复出现。

patterns.name: 舍入结果中的数字
patterns.context: 数学练习题要求将数值舍入，激活落在负数舍入题给出的结果数字内部；同段还出现其他数值与答案格式。

patterns.name: 代码中的异常处理
patterns.context: Python 风格代码中，异常处理关键词后接冒号，并位于缩进代码块内。

patterns.name: 层间结构描述
patterns.context: 技术说明以序数和部件名称描述基板相对位置及夹层关系。

en.concept: Mixed subword fragments and character patterns
en.description: Strong activation often falls on word-initial V, especially transliterated spellings of V in names; other segments also activate on numbers, blood-typing, airways/interstitium, and Cyrillic fragments, with no unified semantic trigger.

patterns.name: V in Cyrillic names
patterns.context: V occurs within a personal name or transliterated name, followed by the rest of the name; sometimes repeated in the same heading and body text.

patterns.name: Numbers and identifiers
patterns.context: Numbers occur in structures such as identifiers, citations, or years; activation also involves punctuation or letters after numbers.

patterns.name: The “typ” subword fragment in patent terminology
patterns.context: Occurs in “blood-typing,” with activation concentrated on the segmented suffix fragment.

patterns.name: Airways and interstitium in medical texts
patterns.context: Subword fragments in related terms activate when describing anatomical structures in interstitial lung disease.

patterns.name: V-initial fragments in headings or names
patterns.context: Activation occurs on words or name fragments beginning with V in headings; it is not limited to personal names.

patterns.name: V-initial fragments in other words
patterns.context: Begins with numbers and punctuation, followed by a Cyrillic word; the specific language and meaning are unclear.

6_1723.concept: 混合的词片段与字符模式
6_1723.description: 强激活常落在词首 V，尤其是姓名中 V 的转写拼写；但其他段还激活数字、blood-typing、airways/interstitium 及西里尔字母片段，缺乏统一语义触发条件。

patterns.name: 西里尔字母姓名中的 V
patterns.context: V 出现在人名或转写姓名的中间，后接姓名的其余部分；有时同一标题与正文中重复出现。

patterns.name: 数字与编号
patterns.context: 数字出现在编号、引文或年份等结构中，激活也涉及数字后的标点或字母。

patterns.name: 专利术语中 typ 的分词片段
patterns.context: 出现在“blood-typing”中，激活集中在被拆分的词尾片段。

patterns.name: 医学文本中的 airways 及 interstitium
patterns.context: 描述间质性肺病的解剖结构时，相关词的子词片段激活。

patterns.name: 标题或名称中的 V 起始片段
patterns.context: 激活出现在标题中以 V 开头的词或名称片段；并非只见于人物姓名。

patterns.name: V 起始片段在其他词中的出现
patterns.context: 开头有数字及标点，随后为西里尔字母词；具体语言和词义不明。

en.concept: The letter V and fragmented text
en.description: Activations are distributed across letters and subword fragments: several spans highlight the standalone uppercase V, while others contain Cyrillic letters and transliterations, word-internal fragments, and uppercase abbreviations in legal citations; line breaks often accompany title or entry boundaries.

patterns.name: Uppercase Latin letter V
patterns.context: V appears as a standalone uppercase letter at the beginning or within a word; in the provided spans, it is often followed by split character fragments.

patterns.name: Mixed Cyrillic letters and transliteration
patterns.context: Non-English names appear as mixed or fragmented letter tokens; some content is in Cyrillic, and some is Latin transliteration.

patterns.name: Word-internal subword fragments
patterns.context: Ordinary words are split into multiple subword tokens, with activations on internal fragments; no consistent semantic or part-of-speech condition is apparent.

patterns.name: Numbers and abbreviations in legal citations
patterns.context: After legal case citations, abbreviated uppercase fragments appear in court names or parties' names.

patterns.name: Line breaks at title and paragraph boundaries
patterns.context: One or more line breaks follow a title or entry name, often adjacent to a repeated title or the start of the body text; this alone is insufficient to explain all activations.
patterns.domain: Webpage titles, encyclopedia entries, paper texts

6_1723.concept: 字母 V 与碎片化文本
6_1723.description: 激活分散在字母与子词碎片上：多段突出独立大写 V，另有西里尔字母及转写、词内切分片段、法律引文大写缩写；标题或条目边界常伴随换行。

patterns.name: 大写拉丁字母 V
patterns.context: V 作为一个独立的大写字母出现在词首或词内；所给片段中后续常接被拆分的字符片段。
patterns.domain: 百科标题与人物、地名条目

patterns.name: 西里尔字母与转写混合
patterns.context: 非英语名称以混合或碎片化的字母 token 呈现；部分内容为西里尔字母，部分为拉丁字母转写。

patterns.name: 单词内部子词片段
patterns.context: 普通词被切分为多个子词 token，激活落在词内片段上；未见一致的词义或词类条件。
patterns.domain: 专利、医学论文、网页标题

patterns.name: 法律引文中的数字与缩写
patterns.context: 法律案件引文之后出现法院名称或当事人姓名的缩写式大写片段。

patterns.name: 标题及段落边界换行
patterns.context: 标题或条目名称后出现一个或多个换行，常与重复标题、正文起始相邻；单独不足以解释全部激活。
patterns.domain: 网页标题、百科条目、论文文本

en.concept: Cross-corpus subword fragments and boundary patterns
en.description: Activations span different corpora, often landing on word-internal subword fragments, proper nouns/abbreviations, numbers, punctuation, and line breaks; medical, technical, title, and legal texts each show local patterns, with no unified semantic theme.

patterns.name: Word-internal letters and subword boundaries
patterns.context: Highlights often fall on internal word fragments, word boundaries, or formatting symbols, but the specific meanings and positions vary.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain: Russian, webpage titles, medicine, patents, Q&A, encyclopedias, legal citations, etc.

patterns.name: Medical terms and body parts
patterns.context: Appears in lung disease abstracts or technical descriptions of blood group systems, with activations on medical terms and their internal fragments.
patterns.domain: PubMed medical abstracts; USPTO patent backgrounds.

patterns.name: Proper noun and place-name fragments
patterns.context: Fragments form Russian words, radio station names, or U.S. place names; activations also involve punctuation around the names.
patterns.domain: Russian parliamentary texts; encyclopedia entries about proper nouns.

patterns.name: Abbreviations, technical identifiers, and interface names
patterns.context: Abbreviations, protocol names, interface names, or URL fragments occur in technical discussions or documentation URLs.
patterns.domain: StackExchange and HackerNews technical Q&A and comments.

patterns.name: Titles and title case
patterns.context: Webpage titles use title case, with activations on word fragments in the title, often accompanied by line breaks.
patterns.domain: Pile-CC webpage titles or marketing copy.

patterns.name: Legal citations and name abbreviations
patterns.context: Volume and page numbers, state abbreviations, and uppercase fragments of parties' names in case citations.

patterns.name: Q&A formatting and sentence-final punctuation
patterns.context: Punctuation and line breaks activate in questions, answers, or paragraph boundaries in Q&A posts; topics are not uniform.
patterns.domain: StackExchange Q&A and other webpage texts.

6_1723.concept: 跨语料词片段与边界模式
6_1723.description: 激活遍及不同语料，常落在词内子词片段、专名/缩写、数字、标点和换行；医学、技术、标题及法律文本各有局部模式，缺少统一语义主题。

patterns.name: 词内字母与子词边界
patterns.context: 高亮常落在词的内部片段、词界或格式符号上，但具体词义和所处位置各不相同。
patterns.domain: 跨领域：俄语、网页标题、医学、专利、问答、百科、法律引文等。

patterns.name: 医疗术语与身体部位
patterns.context: 出现在肺部疾病摘要或血液分型系统的技术描述中，医学词语及其词内片段被激活。

patterns.name: 专名及地名片段
patterns.context: 词片段组成俄语词、广播电台名称或美国地名；激活还涉及名称周围的标点。
patterns.domain: 俄语议会文本；百科专名介绍。

patterns.name: 缩写、技术标识与接口名称
patterns.context: 技术讨论或文档网址中出现缩写、协议名、接口名或URL片段。

patterns.name: 标题与标题式大小写
patterns.context: 网页标题采用标题式大小写，激活落在标题中的词片段，常伴随换行。

patterns.name: 法律引文与姓名缩写
patterns.context: 判例引用中的卷页码、州名缩写及当事人姓名大写片段。

patterns.name: 问答格式与句末标点
patterns.context: 问答帖的提问、回答或段落边界中，标点与换行有激活；内容主题不统一。

en.description: Activation falls on several unrelated substrings or words: Russian “ан,” “ing” in blood-typing, air, APIs, “ing” in Landing, and “ocratic” in Democratic. These words span multiple topics and styles, with no consistent semantic or grammatical condition.

patterns.name: The “ан” fragment within a Russian word
patterns.context: An internal substring of a Cyrillic word; the token is split into multiple parts, with strong activation on “ан”.

patterns.name: “ing” in blood-typing
patterns.context: The ending of the English compound blood-typing; the hyphen also has moderate activation.

patterns.name: The “air” substring
patterns.context: The complete English word air; appears in titles of studies related to air quality and temperature, and in body text about lung airways.

patterns.name: “APIs” in an HTML5 heading
patterns.context: Located in the heading phrase “More HTML5 APIs -”.

patterns.name: “ing” in “Landing”
patterns.context: The ending ing occurs in Landing in a proper name or article heading; both contexts have a Land/ing split.

patterns.name: “ocratic” in “Democratic”
patterns.context: The adjective Democratic in an organization name, split into Dem and ocratic.

patterns.name: A second activation of “APIs” in an answer
patterns.context: Appears as a noun for a software interface category in a StackExchange answer discussing accessible interfaces.

6_1723.concept: none
6_1723.description: 激活落在若干彼此不同的子串或词上：俄语“ан”、blood-typing 的“ing”、air、APIs、Landing 的“ing”及 Democratic 的“ocratic”。这些词分属多个主题与文体，未见一致的语义或语法条件。

patterns.name: 俄语词内的“ан”片段
patterns.context: 西里尔字母单词的词内子串；该 token 被拆成多段，强激活落在“ан”。

patterns.name: blood-typing 中的“ing”
patterns.context: 英语复合词 blood-typing 的词尾；连字符也有中等激活。

patterns.name: “air”子串
patterns.context: 英文中的完整单词 air；分别出现在空气质量、气温相关研究标题，以及 lung airways 的正文中。

patterns.name: HTML5 标题中的“APIs”
patterns.context: 位于标题短语“More HTML5 APIs -”中。

patterns.name: “Landing”中的“ing”
patterns.context: 词尾 ing 出现在专名或条目标题中的 Landing；两个上下文均有 Land/ing 切分。

patterns.name: “Democratic”中的“ocratic”
patterns.context: 政治组织名称中的形容词 Democratic，被切分为 Dem 与 ocratic。

patterns.name: “APIs”在回答中的再次激活
patterns.context: 作为软件接口类别名词，出现在 StackExchange 答案讨论无障碍接口的句子中。

en.description: Activations are scattered across Russian word fragments, English technical words, decimals and digit strings, and medical terms; there is no stable cross-corpus triggering condition, and activations may also be affected by subword tokenization or local character form.

patterns.name: Internal Cyrillic fragments
patterns.context: Activations fall on letters or subword tokens within Russian words; the fragments cannot be identified as complete words on their own.

patterns.name: English technical terms and product names
patterns.context: Embedded in English technical discussions or webpage content, triggers are distributed across different parts of technical terms, abbreviations, and names rather than fixed word forms.
patterns.domain: Hardware recommendations, HTML/API blogs, programming Q&A

patterns.name: Decimals and digit strings
patterns.context: Activations concentrate on numeric fragments composed of decimal digits and punctuation; one span also contains a line break and other numbers.
patterns.domain: ArXiv texts, mathematical discussions, code or data formats

patterns.name: Medical term fragments
patterns.context: Activations occur on fragments of diseases, organs, or research topics in medical titles or abstracts, with no stable single-word pattern.

6_1723.concept: none
6_1723.description: 激活分散在俄语词片段、英文技术词、小数与数字串及医学术语中；没有跨语料稳定的共同触发条件，亦可能受子词切分或局部字符形态影响。

patterns.name: 西里尔字母内部片段
patterns.context: 激活落在俄语词的字母或子词元片段上；片段本身无法确定为完整词。

patterns.name: 英文技术词与产品名
patterns.context: 嵌在英文技术讨论或网页内容中，触发点分散在技术词、缩写和名称的不同部分，并非固定词形。
patterns.domain: 硬件推荐、HTML/API博客、编程问答

patterns.name: 小数与数字串
patterns.context: 激活集中在小数数字及标点组成的数值片段中；其中一段还夹有换行和其他数字。
patterns.domain: ArXiv文本、数学讨论、代码或数据格式

patterns.name: 医学术语片段
patterns.context: 激活位于医学标题或摘要里的疾病、器官、研究主题词片段，未显示稳定的单一词汇模式。

en.concept: Subword fragments and local text patterns
en.description: Activation often falls on subword-segmented proper names, terms, or suffix fragments, and also occurs on a fixed license phrase, a UTF-8 modifier, and Russian words; it spans languages and domains, with no unified semantic theme.

patterns.name: Internal subword fragments in names or entities
patterns.context: Subwords in long personal or organization names are strongly activated; surrounding text introduces the St Thomas transit agency and its operators.

patterns.name: UTF-8 / u modifier
patterns.context: Discusses regular expressions for handling UTF-8 strings; activation falls on the modifier phrase, and the context contains Chinese characters.

patterns.name: Fixed phrase in license text
patterns.context: A copyright and BSD-style license notice cites instructions to view the AUTHORS file.

patterns.name: Biomedical word fragments related to body parts or tissue
patterns.context: Macrophages and their cell populations in injured muscle; other activations occur on internal fragments of biomedical terms, such as «mid»3«p»5«regn»9.

patterns.name: Internal syllables in Russian words
patterns.context: Russian words in Cyrillic are split into multiple subword fragments; there is not enough context to determine their semantic function.

patterns.name: Internal fragment of a blood-typing term
patterns.context: Occurs in the patent background phrase “column blood-typing systems”; activation falls on an internal fragment of typing.

patterns.name: Subword fragment in a protein name
patterns.context: The abbreviation NEMO, for the IKK complex component NF-κB essential modifier, activates after being segmented.

patterns.name: Word fragments related to grounding structures
patterns.context: Design of grounding structures and spatial constraints for mobile-terminal LCDs; the suffix fragment of grounding activates repeatedly.

patterns.name: Formatting remnants or no clear trigger pattern
patterns.context: The Portuguese text begins with a numeric identifier, a line break, and a segmented word; activation distribution is not explained by a clear semantic pattern.

patterns.name: Activation on high-frequency function words or general word fragments
patterns.context: These words occur in varied academic contexts, but no stable shared semantic or syntactic condition can be confirmed from the examples.

6_1723.concept: 词片段与局部文本模式
6_1723.description: 激活多落在被子词切分的专名、术语或词尾片段，也见许可证固定短语、UTF-8修饰符和俄语词；跨语种、跨领域，未见统一语义主题。

patterns.name: 姓名或实体词的内部词片
patterns.context: 长人名/组织名中的子词片受到强激活，周围是圣托马斯公交机构及运营者的介绍。

patterns.name: UTF-8 / u 修饰符
patterns.context: 讨论正则表达式处理 UTF-8 字符串；激活落在修饰符短语，且上下文含中文字符。

patterns.name: 许可证文本中的固定短语
patterns.context: 版权与 BSD 风格许可证声明中，引用查看 AUTHORS 文件的指引。

patterns.name: 与身体部位或组织相关的生物医学词片
patterns.context: 受伤肌肉中的巨噬细胞及其细胞群；另有生物医学术语内部片段激活，如 «mid»3«p»5«regn»9。

patterns.name: 俄语词内部音节
patterns.context: 西里尔字母构成的俄语词被拆分为多个子词片段；无足够上下文判定其语义作用。

patterns.name: 血型分型术语内部片段
patterns.context: 出现在“column blood-typing systems”这一专利背景技术短语中，激活落在 typing 的词内片段。

patterns.name: 蛋白质名称的分词片段
patterns.context: IKK 复合物组分名称 NF-κB essential modifier 的缩写 NEMO 被拆分后激活。

patterns.name: 接地结构相关词片段
patterns.context: 移动终端 LCD 的接地结构设计及空间限制；grounding 的后缀片段反复激活。

patterns.name: 格式残片或无明确触发模式
patterns.context: 葡萄牙语文本开头含数字编号、换行及被拆分的词；激活分布无法由明确语义模式解释。

patterns.name: 激活落在高频功能词或一般词片上
patterns.context: 这些词位于多种学术语境中，但没有稳定共同的语义或句法条件可从样例确认。
patterns.domain: 生物医学摘要及其他文本

en.description: Activation is concentrated on several distinct highlighted fragments: the fixed legal phrase “dispense with oral argument,” dispense in legal enumerations, mediated in a cannabis abstract, Check in code identifiers, and emphatic uppercase ZERO in a personal narrative. They span different meanings and styles, with no unified word sense or stable contextual feature.

patterns.name: dispense with oral argument
patterns.context: A fixed phrase in legal appellate opinions, often followed by because the facts and legal...; also appears in expressions adjacent to judicial terms such as deny and dismiss.

patterns.name: Other legal uses of dispense
patterns.context: In paragraph 3, dispense is coordinated with verbs for drug offenses such as manufacture, distribute, and possess; in paragraph 5, the highlighted word is mediated, describing the mechanism of cannabis action, not dispense.

patterns.name: The Check code identifier
patterns.context: Check is part of a camel-case class name or template helper name; surrounding text consists of Java import statements or Razor/HTML template code.
patterns.domain: GitHub Java code; StackExchange C#／Razor examples

patterns.name: The uppercase substring ERO
patterns.context: An emphatic uppercase spelling of ZER0/ ZERO in a personal narrative, expressing no shame or regret about failure; activation is concentrated on an internal substring.

6_1723.concept: none
6_1723.description: 激活集中在若干不同的高亮片段：法律判决固定短语“dispense with oral argument”、法律列举中的 dispense、大麻摘要中的 mediated、代码标识符中的 Check，以及个人叙述里大写强调的 ZERO。它们分属不同语义和文体，未见统一的词义或稳定上下文特征。

patterns.name: dispense with oral argument
patterns.trigger: «dispense»10« with»3« oral»1« argument»（部分段落中 argument 未标记）
patterns.context: 法律上诉意见的固定句式，常接 because the facts and legal...；也出现与 deny、dismiss 等裁判用语相邻的表达。

patterns.name: dispense 的其他法律用法
patterns.context: 第3段中 dispense 与制造、分发、持有等列举的毒品犯罪动词并列；第5段中高亮词为 mediated，描述大麻作用机制，不是 dispense。
patterns.domain: 刑事起诉书；医学研究摘要

patterns.name: Check 的代码标识符
patterns.context: 驼峰式类名或模板助手名中，Check 作为标识符组成部分；周围是 Java 导入语句或 Razor/HTML 模板代码。
patterns.domain: Github Java 代码；StackExchange C#／Razor 示例

patterns.name: ERO 的大写子串
patterns.context: 个人叙述中 ZER0/ ZERO 的强调式大写拼写，表达对失败毫无羞愧或后悔；激活集中在词内子串。

en.description: Primarily sensitive to the string “perfect”: it can occur independently or within Imperfect, perfect solution, perfect formatting, or a URL, across several styles. There is also local activation on the legal term Disqualification, the name Sweeney, and Executors; the reasons are unclear.

patterns.name: The perfect word form
patterns.context: The morpheme “perfect” itself or embedded in a word, phrase, or URL containing it; capitalization forms include “Imperfect” and “perfect”.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain: technology discussions, medicine, law, personal narratives, business events

patterns.name: A term in legal contexts
patterns.context: Occurs in a court opinion discussing a motion for judicial recusal and its denial; “qual” has no obvious surface relation to “perfect” and may be an additional activation.

patterns.name: A substring in a name
patterns.context: Occurs in the personal name “Sweeney” in a list; the triggered substring has no clear semantic connection to other passages.

patterns.name: A designation for executors in a name
patterns.context: Occurs in the party designation “as Executors” in an estate case caption; its relation to the main pattern is unclear.

6_1723.concept: perfect词项
6_1723.description: 主要对字符串“perfect”敏感：它可独立出现，也可嵌在Imperfect、perfect solution、perfect formatting或网址中，跨多种文体。另有法律术语Disqualification、姓名Sweeney及Executors中的局部激活，原因不明。

patterns.name: perfect词项
patterns.context: 词素“perfect”本身或嵌在包含它的词、短语、网址中；大小写形态包括“Imperfect”“perfect”。
patterns.domain: 跨领域：科技讨论、医学、法律、个人叙述、商业活动

patterns.name: 法律术语中的词项
patterns.context: 出现在法院意见中关于法官回避申请及其被驳回的语境；其中“qual”与“perfect”并无明显词面关系，可能是额外激活。

patterns.name: 姓名中的子串
patterns.context: 出现在名单中的人名“Sweeney”，触发子串与其他段落缺乏明确语义联系。
patterns.domain: 法律文书中的姓名列表

patterns.name: 姓名中的执行人称谓
patterns.context: 遗产案件标题中，出现在“as Executors”这一当事人身份称谓内；与主模式的关系不明。

en.description: Primarily responds to the rig/id substring in rigid/non-rigid terms; it also activates in two contexts for perfect, the Go return type chan, and the test string gallant. No clear trigger pattern is apparent in email passage [8].

patterns.name: Rigidity/non-rigidity terms containing rig
patterns.context: The rig/id substring in words such as rigid, non-rigid, and semi-rigid is highlighted; these occur in object descriptions, technical methods, or material classifications.
patterns.domain: Computer vision, medical imaging, patents, and other technical texts

patterns.name: The perfect word form
patterns.context: Occurs in “non-perfect fluid” or “perfect execution”; the two instances have different meanings and contexts, but activate on the same word form.

patterns.name: chan in Go code
patterns.context: Occurs as the return type in a Go function signature, denoting a channel.

patterns.name: gallant in Go test code
patterns.context: Occurs in a test case string; it has no obvious connection to other activation patterns.

6_1723.concept: 技术术语中的 rig/id 子串
6_1723.description: 主要响应 rigid/non-rigid 术语中的 rig/id 子串；另在 perfect 的两种语境、Go 返回类型 chan 和测试字符串 gallant 中激活。邮件段[8]未见清晰触发模式。

patterns.name: 含 rig 的刚性/非刚性术语
patterns.context: rigid、non-rigid 或 semi-rigid 等词中的 rig/id 子串被突出；出现在对象描述、技术方法或材料分类中。
patterns.domain: 计算机视觉、医学影像、专利及其他技术文本

patterns.name: perfect 词形
patterns.context: 出现在“non-perfect fluid”或“perfect execution”中；两处语义和语境不同，激活落在同一词形上。

patterns.name: Go 代码中的 chan
patterns.context: 出现在 Go 函数签名的返回类型中，表示 channel。

patterns.name: Go 测试代码中的 gallant
patterns.context: 出现在测试用例的字符串数据中；没有明显联系到其他激活模式。

en.concept: Heterogeneous patterns including items following other and code imports
en.description: Activation does not reflect a single semantic concept: multiple instances match items following other; code passages cover Java and Python imports, package paths, and line breaks. The remaining patterns involve a business analogy, legal terminology, political-economic phrasing, and fragments of chemical names.

patterns.name: A modifier following the word other
patterns.context: After other, especially when followed by a comma or noun phrase introducing other entities or categories; in these examples, common following terms are regions, industries, legal entity, and instrument.
patterns.domain: Legal, technology discussions, and social science prose

patterns.name: Java import statements
patterns.context: Consecutive package/import paths and class names in Java source code; high activation is distributed across import, package path segments, punctuation, and line-break boundaries.

patterns.name: Python imports and documentation comments
patterns.context: Import statements in Python modules and adjacent Sphinx autodoc configuration comments; activation spans identifiers, paths, and line breaks.

patterns.name: Watership Down analogy
patterns.context: Compares a new company to a Watership Down-style organization and explains its formation through departures from a declining company and recruitment of talent or customers.

patterns.name: Compensation and settlement language in legal provisions
patterns.context: Legal provisions discuss state claims to assets, court orders, or insurance/claim settlement documents. These co-occur with the other substring, but there are also explicit legal-context terms that may trigger activation.

patterns.name: The maf ia spelling fragment in political-economic discussion
patterns.context: Discusses elite control of the economy and mafia methods entering industries such as retail; activation points include common preposition fragments and the segmented spelling of mafia.

patterns.name: Compound fragments in chemical literature
patterns.context: Patent background text mentions acridizinium perchlorate, cycloaddition products, and literature citations; activation is concentrated on subword fragments in chemical terms.

6_1723.concept: other 后接项及代码导入等异质模式
6_1723.description: 激活并非单一语义概念：多处命中 other 后接类别/实体；代码段则覆盖 Java、Python 导入、包路径与换行。其余分别对应商业类比、法律术语、政治经济词句及化学名称片段。

patterns.name: 词尾 other 后接限定语
patterns.trigger: « other»10«,»3 well« established»3；« other»10« legal»3« entity»1；« other»10« regions»1；« other»10« instrument»1；« other»9« industries»3
patterns.context: 在 other 后，尤其其后跟逗号或名词短语、用于引出其他实体/类别时；这几个例子中其他常见的后续词是 regions、industries、legal entity、instrument。
patterns.domain: 法律、科技讨论及社会科学 prose

patterns.name: Java import 声明
patterns.context: Java 源码中连续的 package/import 路径和类名；高激活分散在 import、包路径分段、标点及换行边界。

patterns.name: Python 导入及文档注释
patterns.context: Python 模块的导入语句以及相邻的 Sphinx autodoc 配置注释，激活覆盖标识符、路径和换行。

patterns.name: Watership Down 类比
patterns.context: 把新公司类比为 Watership Down 式组织，并解释其从衰败公司出走、招募人才或客户的形成过程。

patterns.name: 法律条文中的受偿及和解措辞
patterns.trigger: «prison»1er；« the»2 claim；« issue»2« an»3 order；« release»；« covenant»；« settlement»
patterns.context: 法律条文讨论国家对资产的请求、法院命令，或保险/索赔和解文件。与 other 子串同现，但另有明确法律语境词触发。

patterns.name: 政治经济论述中的 maf ia 拼写片段
patterns.context: 论述精英对经济的控制及 mafia 方法进入零售等产业；激活点包括常见介词片段和被拆分的 mafia 拼写。
patterns.domain: 社会科学/政治经济 prose

patterns.name: 化学文献中的化合物词片段
patterns.context: 化学专利背景中出现 acridizinium perchlorate、环加成物及文献引文；激活集中在化学名词的子词片段。

en.description: Activation is distributed across internal word substrings, code identifiers and formatting symbols, as well as domain-specific terms; there is no stable semantic or syntactic pattern that covers all examples.

patterns.name: Morpheme fragments within specific words
patterns.context: Activation falls on local substrings within longer words, and the same fragment can occur in different words and domains; this may reflect shared character/morpheme features rather than complete word meanings.

patterns.name: Code header files and identifier fragments
patterns.context: Occurs in code structures such as C/C++ header filenames, preprocessor directives, configuration/XML attributes, or class names; trigger locations are scattered, with no single stable API pattern.

patterns.name: Line-break markers
patterns.context: Activation occurs on line breaks or adjacent whitespace, often in code lines, headings, and paragraph-formatted text; this appears in multiple passages but activation strength varies.
patterns.domain: Code, papers, and other formatted text

patterns.name: Local fragments in proper names and citations
patterns.context: Occurs on local tokens in journal names, chemical reaction names, literature abbreviations, or author names, with no unified semantic trigger.

patterns.name: Common words in paper titles and discussion
patterns.context: Occurs in paper titles, introductions, and body text, with activation distributed across subword fragments of common words; there is no consistency in topic words or syntactic position.

patterns.name: Financial report phrase
patterns.context: Located in descriptions of options-expiration trading reports, such as “real-time top day trade information”.

patterns.name: Participant recruitment and consent language in human studies
patterns.context: Occurs in clinical research descriptions of site approval, participants signing informed consent, and enrollment numbers.

patterns.name: Words related to quantum materials
patterns.context: Located in descriptions and citations concerning electron transfer, fullerenes, and alkali-metal-doped fullerides.

patterns.name: Code structure symbols marked individually
patterns.context: Indentation, preprocessor symbols, and statement separators in code or code snippets also activate, but there are too few examples to determine specific conditions.

6_1723.concept: 局部子串与格式特征
6_1723.description: 激活分散在词内子串、代码标识符与格式符号，以及若干领域特定词语上；看不出能覆盖全部样本的稳定语义或句法模式。

patterns.name: 特定词内的词素片段
patterns.context: 激活落在较长词内部的局部子串上，且同一片段可出现在不同词和领域；可能是共享字符/词素特征，而非完整词义。
patterns.domain: 专利、医学、科学论文、代码

patterns.name: 代码头文件与标识符片段
patterns.context: 出现在 C/C++ 头文件名、预处理指令、配置/XML 属性或类名等代码结构中；触发位置分散，未见单一稳定 API 模式。

patterns.name: 排版换行标记
patterns.context: 激活出现在换行或相邻空白处，常见于代码行、标题和分段文本；多个段落虽有此现象，但激活强度并不一致。
patterns.domain: 代码、论文及其他带格式文本

patterns.name: 专名与引用中的局部片段
patterns.context: 出现在期刊名、化学反应名、文献缩写或作者名的局部 token 上，未显示统一语义触发条件。

patterns.name: 论文标题及论述中的普通词
patterns.context: 出现在论文标题、引言和正文叙述中，激活分布于普通词的子词片段；没有明显主题词或句法位置的一致性。

patterns.name: 金融报告短语
patterns.context: 位于“real-time top day trade information”一类期权到期交易报告说明中。
patterns.domain: 企业邮件、金融业务说明

patterns.name: 人体研究招募与同意表述
patterns.context: 出现在研究地点审批、参与者签署知情同意及入组人数的临床研究叙述中。

patterns.name: 量子材料相关词语
patterns.context: 位于电子转移、富勒烯及碱金属掺杂富勒化物的描述和引文中。
patterns.domain: 凝聚态物理/材料科学论文

patterns.name: 单独标记的代码结构符号
patterns.context: 代码或代码片段中的缩进、预处理符号和语句分隔符也有激活，但样本不足以确定具体条件。

en.description: Activations are scattered across multiple text types and mainly fall on subword fragments of particular words: Ethernet, long-time, dud on, with, margin-top, project, cured, intreaties; no unified semantic or grammatical context is apparent.

patterns.name: Ethernet term
patterns.context: Ethernet appears in a category label or network protocol entry, with activations concentrated on internal subword fragments.

patterns.name: Token fragments in long-time practice
patterns.context: In expressions such as “long-time common practice,” the hyphen and time fragment activate; the surrounding text discusses an advertising request process and how long it takes.

patterns.name: dud-on collocation
patterns.context: Appears in the legal phrase “a dud on its face,” with activation across the dud-on subword boundary.

patterns.name: Strong activation on with
patterns.context: In “rests first with the emigrants,” with indicates responsibility; the same passage also discusses taxes, emigration, and remedies for losses.
patterns.domain: Academic text in philosophy or political theory

patterns.name: HTML/CSS markup and attributes
patterns.context: In HTML page source, activations occur near the CSS margin-top value and px unit; the same passage also contains tags and Java page text.

patterns.name: Adverse expression with with
patterns.context: Appears in “fraught with pitfalls,” where with introduces problems or risks; the surrounding text is an academic discussion of privacy and data publication.

patterns.name: Tokenization of project
patterns.context: In “project was to house,” project is split into subwords and refers to a project providing temporary housing for families.
patterns.domain: Legal documents or social services case materials

patterns.name: Token fragment in cured
patterns.context: A legal text discusses an ambiguity being “cured” by a legislative analysis report; strong activation falls on a subword fragment of cured.
patterns.domain: California case law or legal interpretation

patterns.name: Word-internal -ties fragment
patterns.context: Appears in the word “his intreaties”; the archaic spelling means pleas, and the surrounding text is historical narrative and moral description.

6_1723.concept: none
6_1723.description: 激活散落于多类文本，主要落在特定词的子词片段：Ethernet、long-time、dud on、with、margin-top、project、cured、intreaties；缺少统一语义或语法情境。

patterns.name: Ethernet 词项
patterns.context: 分类标签或网络协议条目中出现 Ethernet，激活集中在词内子词片段。

patterns.name: 长时实践的分词片段
patterns.context: “long-time common practice”一类表达中，连字符与 time 片段激活；周围谈及广告请求流程及其耗时。

patterns.name: dud-on 搭配
patterns.context: 出现在法律论述“a dud on its face”中，激活跨子词边界的 dud-on 片段。

patterns.name: with 的强激活
patterns.context: 在“rests first with the emigrants”中，with 表示责任归属；同段另有税款、移民及损失补救内容。
patterns.domain: 哲学或政治理论学术文本

patterns.name: HTML/CSS 标记与属性
patterns.context: HTML 页面源码中，CSS 的 margin-top 数值及 px 单位附近激活；同段还包含标签和 Java 页面文字。

patterns.name: 带 with 的不利表达
patterns.context: 出现在“fraught with pitfalls”中，with 引出问题或风险；周围是隐私与数据发布的学术论述。

patterns.name: 项目的 project 分词
patterns.context: “project was to house”中 project 被切分，指为家庭提供临时住所的项目。
patterns.domain: 法律文书或社会服务案件材料

patterns.name: cured 的分词片段
patterns.context: 法律文本讨论歧义被立法分析报告所“治愈”，强激活落在 cured 的子词片段。
patterns.domain: 加利福尼亚判例或法律解释

patterns.name: 词内 -ties 片段
patterns.context: 出现在“his intreaties”一词中；古旧拼法表示恳求，附近为历史叙述和道德性描写。

en.description: Activation is distributed across multilingual text, code, and different styles, often marking subword fragments within words; “reat” appears in two English literary passages, but the other markers lack a unified visible meaning or contextual pattern.

patterns.name: The “reat” fragment within words
patterns.context: Occurs within English words: int«reat»ies, w«reat»he; both instances show relatively strong activation.

patterns.name: Russian Cyrillic fragments
patterns.context: Internal or word-final fragments of several words in Russian sentences are marked, with varying strength.

patterns.name: French internal-word and word-boundary fragments
patterns.context: Words such as détail, intérêts, États, petits, and anciens in a French political context are marked in segmented form.

patterns.name: Go code identifiers and type fragments
patterns.context: Several subword fragments in type names, field names, and numeric types in a Go struct definition are marked; the marks span code structures.

patterns.name: The “ud” fragment in legal English
patterns.context: Occurs in the phrase “a dud on its face”; other contract-law terms in the same sentence are also weakly marked, but there is no apparent shared trigger pattern.

patterns.name: Shakespearean English fragments
patterns.context: Occurs within poetic words such as Unthrifty, dost, and doth; a few common words are also marked.

patterns.name: Time-related words in research text
patterns.context: Occurs in the research training context “Full time dissertation research”; time activates most strongly, while dissertation is weakly marked.

patterns.name: Physics terms and chemical formula fragments
patterns.context: Occurs near herbertsmithite, mineral chemical formulas, and related physics terms; the specific trigger condition is unclear.

patterns.name: Estonian word fragments
