patterns.context: 不放回抽取字母并计算特定序列概率；激活涉及字母及序列描述

patterns.name: 爱沙尼亚语词片段
patterns.context: 爱沙尼亚语连续文本中，多处词被拆成子词片段标记

patterns.name: Java 版本标题
patterns.context: HTML 页面中 Java SE/JDK 12 的标题与导航内容

patterns.name: 强调最大化表达
patterns.context: 建议把机会用尽可能大的方式讲述和包装；激活于强调规模的短语

patterns.name: 合同免责声明固定措辞
patterns.context: 声明材料不构成合同、不得作为合同依据的免责声明；重复模板措辞

en.description: Coverage is primarily of code identifiers and structural fragments; sporadic word-fragment activations also occur in multilingual parliamentary texts, English literature, and probability problems. Samples show no stable cross-domain semantic trigger.

patterns.name: Types and network identifiers in source code
patterns.context: In code syntax, type/field declarations, or HTML markup, activations are distributed across identifier fragments and structural tokens; no specific fixed identifier is required.
patterns.domain: C/C++, Go, Java/HTML, and other code on GitHub and StackExchange

patterns.name: Internal word fragments in multilingual parliamentary texts
patterns.context: Activations fall on internal subword fragments in non-English texts such as Romanian and Estonian; the examples are mainly continuous prose.

patterns.name: Word fragments in English literary prose
patterns.context: Fragments of ordinary English words in narrative sentences, including descriptions of ghosts and tolling bells.

patterns.name: Sequences and combinatorial expressions in probability problems
patterns.context: In probability word problems and their short numerical answers, activations fall on words in the prompts and letter sequences.

6_1723.concept: 多领域词片段激活
6_1723.description: 主要覆盖代码标识符与结构片段；另在多语言议会文本、英语文学和概率题中也有零散词片段激活。样本未显示跨领域稳定的语义触发条件。

patterns.name: 源代码中的类型与网络标识符
patterns.context: 代码语法、类型/字段声明或 HTML 标记中，激活分布在标识符片段和结构性 token 上；不要求出现某个固定标识符。
patterns.domain: Github、StackExchange 中的 C/C++、Go、Java/HTML 等代码

patterns.name: 多语言议会文本中的词内片段
patterns.context: 激活落在罗马尼亚语、爱沙尼亚语等非英语文本的词内子词片段；样例主要是连续散文。

patterns.name: 英语文学散文中的词片段
patterns.context: 叙述性句子中的普通英语词语片段，包含对幽灵及丧钟的描写。

patterns.name: 概率题中的序列与组合表达
patterns.context: 概率文字题及其简短数值答案中，激活落在题干词语和字母序列上。

en.description: Activation samples span nested HTML markup, code identifiers and type declarations, license terms, agricultural explanations, programming Q&A, and Czech and Polish parliamentary texts; there is no reliable common semantic trigger pattern.

patterns.name: Nested markup in HTML
patterns.context: HTML documents or source code contain nested, summary, or similar tags or class names; activations are scattered across tag-name fragments and near newlines.

patterns.name: Nested-related fragments in code identifiers
patterns.context: Identifiers in C++ templates or library source contain naming fragments such as NESTED and impl.

patterns.name: Type and struct field declarations
patterns.context: Go source declares structs and their fields and integer types; activation falls on type and field names.

patterns.name: Unix build and system-interface source
patterns.context: Go generated files or platform-specific source contain build tags, Unix/BSD platform names, and system-call packages.

patterns.name: Distribution and notice wording in license text
patterns.context: Legal terms requiring copyright and license notices to be retained when copying or distributing materials.

patterns.name: Breeding and seed-propagation explanations
patterns.context: Discussion of replanting, seed germination, and breeding methods for different crop traits.
patterns.domain: Patent background or agricultural technical explanations

patterns.name: Many-to-many form field names
patterns.context: Question titles juxtapose Django-style form components and many-to-many fields.

patterns.name: Czech political and aviation-related wording
patterns.context: Czech parliamentary context discussing attempts over the past fifteen years, reconciling interests, and airports in a particular field.

patterns.name: Polish parliamentary discussion of statistics
patterns.context: A Polish parliamentary speech mentions repeated discussion of inflation and then turns to statistical data.

6_1723.concept: none
6_1723.description: 激活样本横跨 HTML 嵌套标记、代码标识符与类型声明、许可条款、农业说明、编程问答及捷克语和波兰语议会文本；没有可靠的共同语义触发模式。

patterns.name: HTML 中的嵌套标记
patterns.context: HTML 文档或源码中出现嵌套、summary 等标签或类名；激活分散在标签名片段及换行附近。
patterns.domain: GitHub 上的 HTML/Javadoc 标记

patterns.name: 代码标识符中的嵌套相关片段
patterns.context: C++ 模板或库源码里的标识符含有 NESTED、impl 等命名片段。

patterns.name: 类型与结构体字段声明
patterns.context: Go 源码中声明 struct 及其字段、整数类型；激活落在类型名和字段名。

patterns.name: Unix 构建与系统接口源码
patterns.context: Go 生成文件或平台相关源码中出现构建标记、Unix/BSD 平台名和系统调用包。

patterns.name: 许可文本中的分发与声明措辞
patterns.context: 要求复制、发布材料时保留版权和许可通知的法律条款。

patterns.name: 育种与种子繁殖说明
patterns.context: 讨论补种、种子发芽及不同作物性状的育种方法。
patterns.domain: 专利背景或农业技术说明

patterns.name: 多对多表单字段名称
patterns.context: 问题标题中并列 Django 风格的表单组件与多对多字段。

patterns.name: 捷克语政治与航空相关表述
patterns.context: 捷克语议会语境，谈过去十五年的尝试、利益调和及某领域的机场。

patterns.name: 波兰语议会统计讨论
patterns.context: 波兰语议会发言中提到通货膨胀问题反复讨论，并转向统计数据。

en.description: Activations span multiple languages and code texts, often falling on local string fragments: these include INET, Go's unix package name, commemorative word forms, and several sporadic markers. Aside from a few repeated fragments, no unified semantic pattern explains all samples.

patterns.name: IN/ET string fragments
patterns.context: Appears in the AF_INET network address family constant (segment 4) and SOCK_STREAM call argument (segment 5); it also appears in the IETF text in an HTML doctype (segment 9) and USTC in a U.S. Code citation (segment 10), so the trigger is not limited to network programming.
patterns.domain: Systems programming, network code, HTML markup, legal citations

patterns.name: Commemoration and remembrance word forms
patterns.context: In a Slovak sentence, activation occurs near uctiť si pamiatku (to remember, commemorate); the context mentions shared duties and commemoration.

patterns.name: Internal Bulgarian word fragments
patterns.context: Occurs within the word «преден план» (foreground); the paragraph discusses recent events and their significance. Other highlighted fragments are scattered across Bulgarian words.

patterns.name: unix package path in Go-generated code
patterns.context: Both occur in Go source code package unix declarations; the context includes generated-code comments, build constraints, or system-call-related content.

patterns.name: Generated code and build markers
patterns.context: Build tags, generated-code notices, and package unix appear in the headers of generated Go source files; however, these are not the only activated markers, and triggers may overlap with code content such as unix.

patterns.name: Object-relational mapping annotations
patterns.context: Appears in annotations on PHP/Symfony-style entity properties, indicating a one-to-many relationship; nearby identifiers include Entity, Kpi, and countryWeights.

patterns.name: Local fragments in names and biographical entries
patterns.context: The highlighted fragment occurs within the name Eifion; the same passage is an encyclopedia-style list of people, while other names and occupational descriptions show no equally prominent activation.

6_1723.concept: none
6_1723.description: 激活横跨多种语言与代码文本，常落在局部字符串片段：包括 INET、Go 的 unix 包名、纪念词形及若干偶发标记。除少数重复片段外，未见能解释全部样本的统一语义模式。

patterns.name: IN/ET 字符串片段
patterns.context: 出现在 AF_INET 网络地址族常量（段4）和 SOCK_STREAM 调用参数（段5）中；也出现在 HTML doctype 的 IETF 字样（段9）及美国法典引文的 USTC（段10）中，故触发不局限于网络编程。
patterns.domain: 系统编程、网络代码、HTML 标记、法律引文

patterns.name: 纪念、记忆相关词形
patterns.context: 斯洛伐克语句中，uctiť si pamiatku（缅怀、纪念）附近激活；上下文提到共同义务与纪念。
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会文本，斯洛伐克语

patterns.name: 保加利亚语词内片段
patterns.context: 出现在「преден план」（前景）一词内，段落讨论近年来事件及其重要性；其他高亮片段分散于保加利亚语词中。
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会文本，保加利亚语

patterns.name: Go 生成代码中的 unix 包路径
patterns.context: 均位于 Go 源码的 package unix 声明；上下文含生成代码注释、构建约束或系统调用相关内容。

patterns.name: 生成代码及构建标记
patterns.context: 生成的 Go 源文件头部出现构建标签、生成说明和 package unix；但不只这些标记被激活，触发因素可能与 unix 等代码内容重叠。

patterns.name: 实体关系映射标注
patterns.context: 出现在 PHP/Symfony 风格的实体属性注解中，表示一对多关系；周围还有 Entity、Kpi、countryWeights 等标识符。

patterns.name: 姓名与人物条目中的局部片段
patterns.context: 高亮片段落在人物名 Eifion 内；同段是百科式人物列表，其他姓名和职业描述未见同样突出激活。
patterns.domain: 英文 Wikipedia 人物条目

en.concept: Hard-to-unify word fragments and code markup
en.description: Activations cluster in identifiers or place names containing split fragments such as “ie/ix/et,” including Erie, Unix, and Inet. They also cover HTML header markup and license action words; these contexts differ substantially on the surface.

patterns.name: Erie County in a fixed phrase
patterns.context: In legal case summaries such as “Appeal from a judgment/order of the Supreme Court, Erie County,” activation centers on the place name Erie, split into tokens.
patterns.domain: New York State appellate court decisions

patterns.name: Unix identifier suffix
patterns.context: Unix appears as part of package or type names in Go system code; activation especially falls on the split token ix.

patterns.name: HTML table column-header markup
patterns.context: In HTML document tables, activation occurs near the CSS class name colFirst and the header Modifier.

patterns.name: Inet in a Java network class name
patterns.context: In the Java networking class name InetSocketAddress, activation falls on the split token Inet.

patterns.name: Wording in MIT license terms
patterns.context: Several action words activate in software license text listing rights to handle or distribute software; publish is strongest.

6_1723.concept: 难以统一的词片段与代码标记
6_1723.description: 激活集中于 Erie、Unix、Inet 等包含“ie/ix/et”等拆分词片段的标识或地名，也覆盖 HTML 表头标记和许可证动作词；这些上下文表面上差异较大。

patterns.name: 固定词组中的 Erie County
patterns.context: “Appeal from a judgment/order of the Supreme Court, Erie County”一类法律判决摘要中，激活集中在被拆分成 token 的地名 Erie。
patterns.domain: 纽约州上诉法院判决文本

patterns.name: Unix 标识符后缀
patterns.context: 在 Go 系统代码的 package 名或类型名中，Unix 作为标识符的一部分出现；尤其激活落在拆分出的 ix token。

patterns.name: HTML 表格列标题标记
patterns.context: HTML 文档表格中，列标题的 CSS 类名 colFirst 以及表头 Modifier 附近激活。
patterns.domain: Github 生成的 API 文档 HTML

patterns.name: Java 网络类名中的 Inet
patterns.context: Java 网络代码的 InetSocketAddress 类名中，激活落在拆分后的 Inet。

patterns.name: MIT 许可条款用词
patterns.context: 软件许可文本列举对软件进行处理或分发的权利时，若干动作词激活，publish 最强。

en.description: Primarily responds to INET/AF_INET identifiers in network code; also activates in Erie County case contexts, appellate decision wording, and legal/financial terms in disclaimers, with sporadic responses to HTML identifier fragments.

patterns.name: IPv4 network constants and address families
patterns.context: When socket creation or address-structure code appears, activations concentrate on fragments of INET, AF_INET, and related network API identifiers; UDP/IP constants are also included.
patterns.domain: Go/C network programming code, technical Q&A

patterns.name: Erie in legal texts
patterns.context: Activates in the court name “Supreme Court, Erie County”; similar court-procedure wording also shows weaker activation.
patterns.domain: U.S. appellate decisions and legal opinions

patterns.name: Legal disclaimer wording
patterns.context: In financial-material disclaimers explaining that opinions are the author's own and may differ materially from others' opinions; material also appears in “material fact” in legal disputes.

patterns.name: Appeal from in legal titles
patterns.context: Appears at the beginning of case titles or procedural quotations; it co-occurs with court and judgment vocabulary in legal documents.

patterns.name: Code identifier fragment First
patterns.context: In the HTML table-heading attribute class="colFirst", as part of a concatenated identifier.

6_1723.concept: INET 标识符及法律文书词片
6_1723.description: 主要响应网络代码中的 INET/AF_INET 标识符；另对 Erie County 判例语境、上诉判决措辞和免责声明中的法律金融词汇激活，并零星响应 HTML 标识符片段。

patterns.name: IPv4 网络常量与地址族
patterns.context: 出现 socket 创建或地址结构代码时，激活集中在 INET、AF_INET 及相关网络 API 标识符的片段；也包括 UDP/IP 常量。
patterns.domain: Go/C 等网络编程代码、技术问答

patterns.name: 法律文本中的 Erie
patterns.context: 在法院名称“Supreme Court, Erie County”中激活；同类法院程序措辞也有较弱激活。
patterns.domain: 美国上诉判决与法律意见书

patterns.name: 法律免责声明措辞
patterns.context: 金融材料免责声明中说明意见仅属作者本人、可能与他人意见存在重大差异时；其中 material 也出现在法律争议的“material fact”中。
patterns.domain: 邮件免责声明及法律文书

patterns.name: 法律标题中的 Appeal from
patterns.context: 出现在案件标题或程序性引述开头；和法律文书中的法院、判决词汇共同出现。

patterns.name: 代码标识符片段 First
patterns.context: HTML 表格标题属性 class="colFirst" 中，作为拼接标识符的一部分。

en.concept: Local word fragments and formatting markers
en.description: Activations are scattered across multilingual word fragments, code identifiers and paths, HTML class names, legal proper nouns and boilerplate phrases, and medical journal names. The most prominent commonality is local text fragments rather than stable semantics; the legal samples also repeatedly contain “material fact.”

patterns.name: “material” in English legal phrases
patterns.context: Appears in legal discussion, especially summary judgment standards and the phrase “no genuine issue of material fact”; also appears in paragraph 6 as “material respects”
patterns.domain: U.S. case law, civil procedure, and legal-financial disclaimers

patterns.name: Identifier boundaries in formatted code
patterns.context: CamelCase names and package-path identifiers in Go code or import paths are split into subwords/tokens; triggers fall within identifiers or package-name fragments

patterns.name: Column markers in table HTML
patterns.context: Column class names such as class="col First" appear in HTML table headers/cells
patterns.domain: GitHub documentation or webpage source code

patterns.name: Letter fragments in proper nouns
patterns.context: Appears in the proper noun “Erie County,” the location of a court

patterns.name: Word-internal fragments in Slavic and Nordic languages
patterns.context: Triggers fall within non-English word forms or endings; the samples involve parliamentary texts. Evidence is sporadic, making it difficult to confirm a shared linguistic condition

patterns.name: Journal-title fragments in references
patterns.context: Appears in the medical journal title “Emerg Infect Dis” in a citation

6_1723.concept: 局部词片段与格式标记
6_1723.description: 激活分散在多语种词片段、代码标识符/路径、HTML 类名、法律专名与法律固定短语、医学期刊名中。较突出的共同点是局部文本片段而非稳定语义；法律段另反复出现 material fact。

patterns.name: 英语法律短语中的 material
patterns.trigger: «material»9，常与“genuine issue of material fact”连用
patterns.context: 出现在法律论述中，尤其是 summary judgment 标准及“no genuine issue of material fact”表述里；也有第6段“material respects”
patterns.domain: 美国判例、民事诉讼及法律金融免责声明

patterns.name: 格式化代码中的标识符边界
patterns.context: Go 代码或导入路径中的 CamelCase 名称、包路径标识符被拆分为子词/token；触发点落在标识符内部或包名片段

patterns.name: 表格 HTML 的列标记
patterns.context: HTML 表头/单元格中出现 class="col First" 一类列类名

patterns.name: 专名中的字母片段
patterns.context: 出现在法院所在地专名“Erie County”中

patterns.name: 斯拉夫语及北欧语中的词内片段
patterns.context: 触发点位于非英语词形或外语词尾内部，材料分别涉及议会文本；证据零散，难以确认统一语言学条件

patterns.name: 参考文献中的刊名片段
patterns.context: 出现在医学文献引用的期刊名“Emerg Infect Dis”中

en.concept: Structured terminology in technical and institutional texts
en.description: Activations occur in two HTML snippets with table headers, patent technology and prior-art text, contract disclaimers, software license terms, and multilingual parliamentary statements; the latter patent snippets and legal texts each share only local features.

patterns.name: HTML table headers and labels
patterns.context: caption, column headers, and class attributes in HTML table markup; both snippets contain the header “Modifier”.

patterns.name: N-body and function terminology
patterns.context: A passage describing planetary motion and chaotic changes includes “N-body problem” and “one way function”.
patterns.domain: Patent background, scientific, or technical text

patterns.name: Contract-effect disclaimer
patterns.context: Legal disclaimer stating that the explanatory text does not constitute a contract and cannot be relied upon as a contract.

patterns.name: Program license terms
patterns.context: Discusses when outputs produced by running a Program are covered by the license, and whether a work is based on the program.

patterns.name: Patent prior-art phrasing
patterns.context: The patent background begins with “Description of the Prior Art” and states that a type of device is known and its structure is obvious.

patterns.name: Multilingual parliamentary political phrasing
patterns.context: In Bulgarian and Romanian parliamentary contexts, discusses member states, parliament, representatives, support, or social progress; trigger words are sporadic, with no single stable lexical item.
patterns.domain: European Parliament political speeches and resolutions

6_1723.concept: 技术与制度文本中的结构化术语
6_1723.description: 激活见于两段含表格标题的HTML、专利技术与现有技术文本、合同免责声明、软件许可条款，以及多语种议会发言；后两类专利片段和法律文本各自只有局部共性。

patterns.name: HTML 表格标题与标签
patterns.context: HTML 表格标记中的 caption、列标题及 class 属性；两个片段都出现表头“Modifier”。

patterns.name: N-body 与函数术语
patterns.context: 描述行星运动和混沌变化的段落中，出现“N-body problem”及“one way function”。
patterns.domain: 专利背景、科学或技术文本

patterns.name: 合同效力免责声明
patterns.context: 说明文字不构成合同，也不能作为合同依据的法律免责声明。
patterns.domain: 企业邮件中的法律声明

patterns.name: 程序许可条款
patterns.context: 讨论运行 Program 产生的输出何时受许可覆盖，以及作品是否基于该程序。

patterns.name: 专利现有技术表述
patterns.context: 专利背景部分以“Description of the Prior Art”起头，并称某类装置已知、结构显而易见。

patterns.name: 多语种议会政治表述
patterns.context: 保加利亚语、罗马尼亚语议会语境中，谈及成员国、议会、代表、支持或社会进步；触发词分散，未见唯一稳定词项。
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会政治发言与决议

en.description: Activations are scattered: they appear frequently in LaTeX math commands and formula symbols, and also in expressions relating things “between” across multiple fields. There are also local fragments in code types, identifiers, and linguistic terms, with no stable, unified semantic trigger condition.

patterns.name: Math-font commands in mathematical formulas
patterns.context: Triggers often occur in LaTeX mathematical expressions, especially math-font or sizing commands and nearby formula symbols; however, the specific commands and formula topics differ across passages.

patterns.name: “between” and nearby comparative or relational expressions
patterns.context: Appears when describing a relationship between two objects, values, or categories; contexts include magnitude classifications, adjacent intervals, probability laws, and contractual relationships.
patterns.domain: Law, physics, popular mathematics, and business email

patterns.name: Local fragments of technical terms or identifiers
patterns.context: Activation falls on code types or identifier fragments, word-internal fragments, and linguistic abbreviations; there is insufficient evidence that they share a stable semantic condition.
patterns.domain: Code, linguistics Q&A, and identifier text

6_1723.concept: none
6_1723.description: 激活分布较散：多见于 LaTeX 数学命令及公式符号，也在多领域的 between 关系表达中出现；另有代码类型、标识符和语言学词语的局部片段，未呈现稳定统一的语义触发条件。

patterns.name: 数学公式中的数学字体命令
patterns.trigger: «\mathrm»、«\big»、«\frac»、«\left»、«\mu»、«\mathrm»，以及公式里的括号、上下标和符号
patterns.context: 触发点多在 LaTeX 数学表达式中，尤其是数学字体或尺寸命令及其邻近的公式符号；但不同段落中的具体命令和公式主题并不相同。

patterns.name: “between”及其邻近比较或关系表达
patterns.trigger: «between»，以及« in»« between»、« between»« adjacent»、« between» Enron Corp.
patterns.context: 出现在描述两个对象、数值或类别之间的关系时；语境分别涉及量级分类、相邻间隔、概率定律和合同关系。
patterns.domain: 法律、物理、数学科普及商务邮件

patterns.name: 局部技术词或标识符片段
patterns.context: 激活落在代码类型或标识符片段、单词内部片段，以及语言学缩写上；没有足够证据表明它们共享一个稳定的语义条件。
patterns.domain: 代码、语言学问答及标识符文本

en.description: Activations are broadly distributed: they involve code dependencies, mappings from names to objects, mathematical formulas and notation, as well as qualifying/emphatic elements, changes in motion, and taxonomic redefinition; there is no clear single trigger pattern covering all snippets.

patterns.name: Boundaries of markers or qualifiers
patterns.context: A marker word precedes a name, explanatory content, or mathematical object; it often has an emphatic, qualifying, or deictic function.
patterns.domain: Code documentation, legal argument, mathematical text

patterns.name: Dependency syntax
patterns.context: Occurs in dependency declarations, followed by the resource or package being depended on.

patterns.name: Mapping between names and objects
patterns.context: Code comments describing how to look up, return, or identify the corresponding object based on a name.

patterns.name: Mathematical quantities and formula notation
patterns.context: Occurs in mathematical formulas and participates in definitions, scaling relationships, or probability distribution expressions.

patterns.name: Descriptions of changes in time and motion
patterns.context: States how motion changes over time, particularly mentioning chaotic changes.

patterns.name: Taxonomic boundaries and conceptual redefinition
patterns.context: States that a group of objects is heterogeneous and difficult to classify, and describes its taxonomic boundaries being redefined.

6_1723.concept: none
6_1723.description: 激活分布较散：涉及代码依赖、名称到对象的对应、数学公式与记号，也涉及限定/强调成分、运动变化和分类重界定；没有明显覆盖全部片段的单一触发模式。

patterns.name: 标记或限定成分的边界
patterns.context: 标记词位于后续名称、解释性内容或数学对象之前；常带有强调、限定或指示作用。
patterns.domain: 代码文档、法律论述、数学文本

patterns.name: 依赖关系语法
patterns.context: 出现在依赖声明中，后接被依赖的资源或包。

patterns.name: 名称与对象的对应
patterns.context: 描述根据名称查找、返回或标识对应对象的代码注释。

patterns.name: 数学量及公式记号
patterns.context: 出现在数学公式中，参与定义、缩放关系或概率分布表达。

patterns.name: 时间与运动变化描述
patterns.context: 陈述运动随时间发生的变化，特别提及混沌变化。

patterns.name: 分类边界及概念重界定
patterns.context: 指出一组对象异质、难以归类，并叙述其分类边界被重新界定。

en.concept: Mixed formula and code syntax features
en.description: Activations are concentrated mainly in LaTeX mathematical expressions containing commands such as left/right, and also cover several other formula commands and symbols; additional activations occur in Terraform dependency configurations, Go function comments/declarations, and words in a historical prose passage, with no unified explanation yet.

patterns.name: LaTeX left parenthesis commands
patterns.context: Mathematical formulas use LaTeX commands to represent delimiters, with activations often on the commands themselves; the parenthesized content after some commands and the formula structures vary.
patterns.domain: Mathematical typesetting, papers, and formulas in Q&A

patterns.name: Specific commands and symbols in scientific formulas
patterns.context: Mathematical or physical formulas contain sized braces, exponential functions, radicals, or norm symbols; these commands are not all the same and often co-occur with left/right.

patterns.name: Variables and operators in formulas
patterns.context: Activations involve mathematical/physical notation, but variables, formula contents, and contexts are not consistent; this may overlap with formula typesetting patterns.

patterns.name: Terraform resource dependency configuration
patterns.context: A resource block declares an AWS instance and uses depends_on to specify a dependency on a web instance; activations highlight configuration tokens and dependency syntax.

patterns.name: Function comments and identifiers in Go code
patterns.context: A Go source comment describes the purpose of a Get function, followed by a function declaration; highlights cover comment wording and code tokens.

patterns.name: English word formation and vocabulary
patterns.context: Continuous prose contains affix fragments and words related to negotiation, but this is insufficient to show that the words share the same semantic trigger condition.

6_1723.concept: 混合的公式与代码语法特征
6_1723.description: 激活主要集中于含 left/right 等命令的 LaTeX 数学表达式，也覆盖若干其他公式命令与符号；另有 Terraform 依赖配置、Go 函数注释/声明及一段历史散文中的词语激活，尚无统一解释。

patterns.name: 左圆括号 LaTeX 命令
patterns.context: 数学公式中用 LaTeX 命令表示括号，激活常落在命令本身；部分命令后的括号内容与公式结构各异。
patterns.domain: 数学排版、论文及问答中的公式

patterns.name: 科学公式中的特定命令与符号
patterns.context: 数学或物理公式中出现大括号尺寸、指数函数、根号或范数符号；这些命令不都相同，且常与 left/right 同现。

patterns.name: 公式中的变量与运算符
patterns.context: 激活涉及数学/物理记号，但变量、公式内容和上下文并不统一；可能与公式排版模式重叠。

patterns.name: Terraform 资源依赖配置
patterns.context: 资源块声明 AWS 实例，并用 depends_on 指定对 web 实例的依赖；激活突出配置 token 与依赖语法。
patterns.domain: GitHub 上的 Terraform/HCL 代码

patterns.name: Go 代码中的函数注释及标识符
patterns.context: Go 源码注释描述 Get 函数用途，随后出现函数声明；高亮覆盖注释用语及代码 token。
patterns.domain: GitHub 上的 Go 代码

patterns.name: 英语词语构形与词汇
patterns.context: 连续散文中出现词缀片段与协商相关词语，但不足以证明这些词共享同一语义触发条件。

en.concept: Relational and boundary markers in structured text
en.description: Activations occur at structured-text boundaries, in code dependency fields and HTML navigation, legal precedent and judgment formatting, as well as in a Danish policy sentence and Go comments; no single semantic theme explains all passages.

patterns.name: Newline/indentation whitespace
patterns.context: Activation falls on newlines and indentation whitespace in code, HTML, or legal documents; commonly found at line boundaries in structured text.

patterns.name: depends_on dependency declaration
patterns.context: A dependency relationship field/key appears in configuration or code, especially depends_on.

patterns.name: Nested navigation HTML
patterns.context: HTML fragments for navigation lists, especially those containing subNav, subNavList, and Nested.

patterns.name: Normative sentence structure in Danish
patterns.context: Danish sentences describe regulatory measures, preventing disease transmission, and intervention costs.

patterns.name: Citation effect and precedent in law
patterns.context: Discusses whether a judgment, order, or legal rule can be cited as precedent, and its binding or preclusive effect.

patterns.name: Legal document headings and case numbers
patterns.context: Court names, rule titles, case numbers, or outcomes in excerpts from court decisions; activation also falls on formatting whitespace.

patterns.name: Function descriptions and error returns in code comments
patterns.context: Go-style comments describe a function’s purpose, parameters/objects, and error return, followed by the function definition.

patterns.name: Build target configuration
patterns.context: A package name and build-target marker follow a dependency configuration entry.

6_1723.concept: 结构化文本中的关系与边界标记
6_1723.description: 激活分布于结构化文本边界、代码依赖字段与 HTML 导航、法律先例及判决格式，也出现在丹麦语政策句和 Go 注释；没有一个语义主题能解释全部段落。

patterns.name: 换行/缩进空白
patterns.context: 代码、HTML 或法律文书中，激活落在换行和缩进空白上；常见于结构化文本的行边界。
patterns.domain: Github 代码、FreeLaw 法律文书

patterns.name: depends_on 依赖声明
patterns.context: 配置或代码中出现依赖关系字段/键，尤其是 depends_on。

patterns.name: 嵌套导航 HTML
patterns.context: 导航列表的 HTML 片段，尤其包含 subNav、subNavList 与 Nested 标签。

patterns.name: 丹麦语规范性句式
patterns.context: 丹麦语句子描述监管措施、防止疾病传播及干预成本。

patterns.name: 法律中的引用效力与先例
patterns.context: 讨论判决、命令或法律规则能否引用为先例，以及其约束或排除效力。

patterns.name: 法律文书标题及案件编号
patterns.context: 法院判决摘录中的法院名称、规则标题、案件编号或裁判结果；激活还落在排版空白处。

patterns.name: 代码注释中的函数说明与错误返回
patterns.trigger: « Get»、« of»、« the»、« and»、« error»、« if»
patterns.context: Go 风格注释说明函数用途、参数/对象及错误返回，随后接函数定义。

patterns.name: 构建目标配置
patterns.context: 依赖配置项后出现包名及构建目标标记。

en.concept: Local word forms and formatting fragments from multiple categories
en.description: Activations fall on various local word forms and symbols: legal collocations and sentencing/insurance phrasing, code types and HTML tags, financial in-between, mathematical \left and level terminology, as well as Polish fragments; overall, there is no single semantic pattern.

patterns.name: Fixed collocations in legal standards of review
patterns.context: Legal phrasing in federal decisions or standards of review; related phrases often occur in statutory or case-law sentences.

patterns.name: Type names and struct fields in code
patterns.context: Go-style struct declarations where type names, field names, and numeric types occur adjacently.

patterns.name: Degree of participation and sentencing reduction levels
patterns.context: Distinguishes sentencing reductions by the defendant’s degree of participation, often using level with participant/minimal/minor.

patterns.name: left in mathematical expressions
patterns.context: Appears as a delimiter command in mathematical typesetting, followed by a parenthesis or expression; this passage also contains right and pi.

patterns.name: HTML table markup and attributes
patterns.context: Table tags, attributes, and class names in HTML document snippets.

patterns.name: Between phrasing in a financial context
patterns.context: Describes a stock as being between two prices or categories.

patterns.name: Internal fragments of Polish parliamentary words
patterns.context: Polish parliamentary headings and minutes; activations seem to fall on subword fragments, making it difficult to group them with other passages.

patterns.name: Insured amounts and good faith in insurance clauses
patterns.context: Conditions concerning whether an insurer issues a policy or provides a corresponding limit/coverage.

patterns.name: Probability and energy-level spacing terminology
patterns.context: Describes the statistical distribution of energy levels and adjacent level spacings in a Poisson ensemble.

patterns.name: L in mathematical operators and function-space notation
patterns.context: A formula uses L to denote a function- or partition-related quantity and employs the left command for typesetting.

6_1723.concept: 多类局部词形与格式片段
6_1723.description: 激活落在多种局部词形与符号上：法律固定搭配及量刑/保险措辞、代码类型和HTML标签、金融in-between、数学\left与level术语；另有波兰语片段，整体缺乏单一语义模式。

patterns.name: 法律判决标准中的固定搭配
patterns.trigger: “unreasonable application”“determined by”“based on”“determination”“in light of the evidence presented”
patterns.context: 联邦判决或审查标准的法律表述；相关词组常出现在法条或判例句中。

patterns.name: 代码中的类型名与结构体字段
patterns.context: Go 风格结构体声明中，类型名、字段名及数字类型相邻出现。

patterns.name: 刑事量刑中的参与程度与减刑级数
patterns.context: 按被告参与程度区分量刑减免幅度，常见 level 与 participant/minimal/minor 搭配。

patterns.name: 数学表达式中的 left
patterns.context: 数学排版中作为括号命令出现，后接括号或表达式；本段还出现 right、pi。

patterns.name: HTML 表格标记与属性
patterns.context: HTML 文档片段中的表格标签、属性和类名。

patterns.name: 金融语境的 between 表述
patterns.context: 描述股票处于两种价格或类别之间的情形。

patterns.name: 波兰语议会词语内部片段
patterns.context: 波兰语议会标题及会议记录；激活似乎落在被分词切开的词片段上，难以与其他段落归并。

patterns.name: 保险条款中的承保金额与善意
patterns.context: 保险人是否签发保单或提供相应额度/保障的条件条款。

patterns.name: 概率与能级间距术语
patterns.context: 描述 Poisson ensemble 中能级及相邻能级间距的统计分布。

patterns.name: 数学算子中的 L 与函数空间记号
patterns.context: 公式中以 L 表示某个函数或分割相关量，并使用 left 命令排版。

en.description: Activations are distributed across line breaks, punctuation, within-word fragments, and structured fields; legal passages, code, academic texts, and privacy notices each have local triggers, with no single stable semantic pattern evident.

patterns.name: Non-word boundaries and within-word fragments
patterns.context: Activations often fall on line breaks, punctuation, code delimiters, or subword fragments of ordinary words; meanings and positions vary.
patterns.domain: Legal texts, code, mathematical discussion, and web content

patterns.name: Fields and markers in structured text
patterns.context: Occurs in code structures, configuration objects, or HTML documents; field names, tags, and adjacent whitespace or case boundaries may contribute to activation.

patterns.name: Qualifying and graded expressions in legal provisions
patterns.context: In legal decisions or sentencing materials, activations fall on word fragments in legal concepts, qualifiers, and graded phrasing.

patterns.name: Technical or academic term fragments
patterns.context: Subword fragments within terms are marked in contexts ranging from code import paths to mathematical formulas/statistical discussion.
patterns.domain: GitHub code, Wikipedia mathematics entries, ArXiv papers

patterns.name: Privacy and monitoring statements
patterns.context: Continuous text about website traffic monitoring, data collection, and anonymity statements; multiple semantically related words are marked.

6_1723.concept: 文本边界与结构片段
6_1723.description: 激活分散在换行、标点、词内片段及结构化字段上；法律段落、代码、学术文本和隐私说明各有局部触发，未显示单一稳定语义模式。

patterns.name: 非词边界与词内片段
patterns.context: 激活常落在换行、标点、代码分隔符或普通词的子词片段上；具体词义与位置并不统一。
patterns.domain: 法律文本、代码、数学论述及网页内容

patterns.name: 结构化文本中的字段与标记
patterns.context: 出现在代码结构、配置对象或 HTML 文档中，字段名、标签及其相邻空白或大小写边界可能参与激活。

patterns.name: 法律条文中的限定与分级表达
patterns.context: 法律判决或量刑材料中，激活落在法律概念、限定语及分级措辞的词片段上。

patterns.name: 技术或学术术语片段
patterns.context: 术语内部的子词片段被标记，分别处于代码导入路径或数学公式/统计论述中。
patterns.domain: GitHub 代码、Wikipedia 数学条目、ArXiv 论文

patterns.name: 隐私与监测表述
patterns.context: 围绕网站流量监测、数据收集及匿名性说明的连续文本；多个语义相关词被标记。

en.concept: Structured text fragments across multiple domains
en.description: Activations occur in various technical texts: code and metadata, bibliographies, privacy copy, legal fields, Swedish long words, and mathematical formulas; apart from formatted technical text, there is no clear trigger word common to all passages.

patterns.name: Go build directives and generated files
patterns.context: Near the generated-file notice, build tags, and package declaration at the start of a Go source file

patterns.name: Network struct fields
patterns.context: In comments and struct field definitions for the AF_LINK socket address type

patterns.name: IL metadata signatures
patterns.context: Descriptions of .NET member signatures in XML documents

patterns.name: Scientific names and bibliographic citations
patterns.context: In bibliography entries in zoological taxonomy literature

patterns.name: Traffic monitoring and privacy statements
patterns.context: In copy describing website traffic data collection, anonymity, and advertising uses

patterns.name: Court dates and case-number formats
patterns.context: Tabular fields such as dates, docket dates, and case numbers, followed by the body of an appeal

patterns.name: Swedish long-word fragments
patterns.context: A long word concerning unfair commercial practices is segmented and marked in a Swedish sentence

patterns.name: LaTeX left-delimiter expressions
patterns.context: Mathematical formulas use LaTeX delimiters and exponent expressions; segment 10 also contains \left

patterns.name: Go method chains and list comments
patterns.context: Go-style method calls or interface code, followed by a comment describing label and field selectors

6_1723.concept: 多领域结构化文本片段
6_1723.description: 激活分布于多种技术文本：代码及元数据、书目、隐私文案、法律字段、瑞典语长词和数学公式；除格式化技术文本外，没有贯穿所有段的明确触发词。

patterns.name: Go 构建指令与生成文件
patterns.context: Go 源文件开头的生成说明、构建标签和 package 声明附近

patterns.name: 网络结构体字段
patterns.context: AF_LINK socket 地址类型的注释和 struct 字段定义中

patterns.name: IL 元数据签名
patterns.context: XML 文档中的 .NET 成员签名描述

patterns.name: 学名与书目引文
patterns.context: 动物分类学文献的参考书目条目中

patterns.name: 流量监测与隐私声明
patterns.context: 说明网站流量数据收集、匿名性和广告用途的文案中

patterns.name: 法院日期与案号格式
patterns.context: 日期、档案日期、案号等表格化字段，随后进入上诉正文

patterns.name: 瑞典语长词片段
patterns.context: 瑞典语句子中，涉及不忠实商业做法的长词被切分标记

patterns.name: LaTeX 左括号表达式
patterns.context: 数学公式中使用 LaTeX 定界符和指数表达式；第10段也出现 \left

patterns.name: Go 方法链与列表注释
patterns.context: Go 风格方法调用或接口代码，随后有描述 label 和 field selectors 的注释

en.description: Activations are scattered across code declarations, comments, test frameworks, generated documentation, patent communications, privacy copy, and mathematical formulas; commonality is weak, mainly involving markers, terminology, and formatting boundaries in structured technical text.

patterns.name: Lists, interfaces, or function descriptions in code comments
patterns.context: Comments describe function inputs and outputs, list filtering, or type implementations, adjacent to code declarations.

patterns.name: Java/JUnit annotations and test imports
patterns.context: JUnit assertions, test annotations, or test runners appear in Java test code.

patterns.name: Identifiers, type names, and code documentation markup
patterns.context: Declarative markers, category labels, and uppercase documentation comments appear in structured code or HTML API documentation.
patterns.domain: Github code and generated HTML documentation

patterns.name: Communication systems and multi-user resource descriptions
patterns.context: Patent background describes communication-system deployment, access methods, and resource sharing.

patterns.name: Website traffic analytics and privacy disclosures
patterns.context: Describes third-party website traffic monitoring, advertising uses, and anonymous data processing.

patterns.name: Intervals and function expressions in mathematical formulas
patterns.context: Mathematical derivations express functions, intervals, and inequalities in LaTeX.

patterns.name: Scala internal API and immutable collection imports
patterns.context: Scala library source declares an internal API trait and imports related utilities and collections.

6_1723.concept: 结构化技术文本标记
6_1723.description: 激活分散于代码声明、注释、测试框架、生成式文档、专利通信、隐私文案及数学公式；共同点较弱，主要涉及结构化技术文本中的标记、术语与格式边界。

patterns.name: 代码注释中的列表、接口或功能说明
patterns.trigger: [2] «// List» … «takes» … «and» … «returns»；[9] «// SockaddrDatalink implements the Sockaddr interface»
patterns.context: 注释说明函数的输入输出、列表筛选或类型实现，紧邻代码声明。

patterns.name: Java/JUnit 注解与测试导入
patterns.context: Java 测试代码中出现 JUnit 断言、测试注解或测试运行器。

patterns.name: 标识符、类型名及代码文档标记
patterns.trigger: [1] «public»、«Nested»、«Collection»、«MemberSignature»、«Language»；[6] «END OF TOP NAV BAR»、«START OF CLASS DATA»
patterns.context: 结构化代码或 HTML API 文档中出现声明性标记、类别标签及大写文档注释。
patterns.domain: Github 代码及生成式 HTML 文档

patterns.name: 通信系统与多用户资源描述
patterns.context: 专利背景介绍通信系统的部署、接入方式及资源共享。

patterns.name: 网站流量分析与隐私说明
patterns.context: 说明第三方网站流量监测、广告用途和匿名数据处理。
patterns.domain: 网站隐私/广告说明文案

patterns.name: 数学公式中的区间与函数表达式
patterns.context: 数学推导中以 LaTeX 表达函数、区间和不等式。

patterns.name: Scala 内部 API 与不可变集合导入
patterns.context: Scala 库源码声明内部 API trait，并导入相关工具与集合。

en.concept: Heterogeneous text fragments and structural markers
en.description: Activations are distributed across code identifiers and syntax, test imports, formula typesetting, legal numbers, advertising copy, and patent boilerplate; triggers depend on local text in each passage, with no single semantic or lexical pattern spanning all samples.

patterns.name: Java/XML identifiers and delimiters
patterns.context: Occurs in .NET member signatures resembling XML documentation, combining visible XML tags, attributes, and method signatures.

patterns.name: Java tests and import statements
patterns.context: Package imports, assertions, or test-runner annotations in Java test code; activations concentrate on identifier fragments and statement boundaries.

patterns.name: Numbers and quantity expressions in legal citations
patterns.context: Case citations include years, volume/page numbers, and court information; subsequent text uses “as many separate claims” to express quantity.

patterns.name: LaTeX structure in mathematical formulas
patterns.context: Paired delimiters, fractions, and function definitions occur adjacently in formulas, between mathematical typesetting markers.

patterns.name: Website traffic monitoring and advertising copy
patterns.context: Describes third-party monitoring of website traffic, data anonymity, and advertising uses, followed by the heading “Local Targeting”.

patterns.name: C struct fields and type declarations
patterns.context: Fields are declared line by line in C-style structs, including combinations of variable names, types, and underscores.

patterns.name: Patent purpose and manufacturing-cost phrasing
patterns.context: In patent background or statements of purpose, “object of the present invention” introduces goals such as durability, reliability, and low-cost manufacturing.

patterns.name: Poisson distribution discussion and formula notation
patterns.context: Explains the independence of adjacent level spacings in a Poisson ensemble and gives a distribution formula.

patterns.name: Go network address types and fields
patterns.context: Go documentation comments introduce a type implementing an interface, followed by a struct declaration and its fields and integer types.

6_1723.concept: 异质文本片段与结构标记
6_1723.description: 激活分散于代码标识符与语法、测试导入、公式排版、法律数字、广告文案及专利套语；各段触发形式依赖局部文本，没有贯穿全部样本的单一语义或词法模式。

patterns.name: Java/XML 标识符与分隔符
patterns.context: 出现在类似 XML 文档的 .NET 成员签名中，混合可见 XML 标签、属性和方法签名。

patterns.name: Java 测试与导入语句
patterns.context: Java 测试代码中的包导入、断言或测试运行器注解；激活集中在标识符片段及语句边界。

patterns.name: 法律引文中的数字与数量表达
patterns.context: 判例引文包含年份、卷页码和法院信息；后续文字以“as many separate claims”表达数量。

patterns.name: 数学公式的 LaTeX 结构
patterns.context: 公式中括号配对、分数与函数定义相邻，处于数学排版标记之间。

patterns.name: 网站流量监测与广告文案
patterns.context: 说明第三方监测网站流量、数据匿名以及广告用途，随后出现“Local Targeting”标题。

patterns.name: C 结构体字段与类型声明
patterns.context: C 风格结构体中逐行声明字段，包含变量名、类型和下划线组合。

patterns.name: 专利目的与制造成本表述
patterns.context: 专利背景或发明目的段落，以“object of the present invention”引出耐用、可靠、低成本制造等目标。

patterns.name: 泊松分布论述与公式标记
patterns.context: 解释泊松系综中相邻能级间隔的独立性，并给出分布公式。

patterns.name: Go 网络地址类型与字段
patterns.context: Go 文档注释介绍类型实现接口，随后声明结构体及其字段和整数类型。

en.description: Activations are distributed across identifiers, framework names, and explanatory words in code and technical text; there is also a single literary-context instance of reason. There is no unified lexical or semantic trigger condition; patterns are distinguished mainly by domain and local context.

patterns.name: Word segments within Go identifiers
patterns.context: Types, fields, functions, or identifiers in Go code, especially components of camelCase names; not all Go identifiers trigger activation.

patterns.name: JUnit and Java test identifiers
patterns.context: Class names or test-framework identifiers in Java imports, test assertions, and JUnit runner annotations.

patterns.name: C# / IL metadata and member signatures
patterns.context: In XML-document-style member signature snippets, activations concentrate on visibility, method attributes, and IL signature fields.

patterns.name: Generating, providing, and usage phrasing in patent texts
patterns.context: In patent background or invention descriptions, in contexts explaining breeding methods, system capabilities, or invention purposes; activations are distributed across ordinary explanatory wording rather than one fixed phrase.

patterns.name: Reasoning and choice expressions
patterns.context: In narrative dialogue, within the explanation “one reason for selecting so young a physician”.

6_1723.concept: 技术文本与标识符片段
6_1723.description: 激活分散在代码与技术文本的标识符、框架名和说明性词语上；另见单次文学语境中的 reason。没有统一的词形或语义触发条件，模式主要由领域和局部上下文区分。

patterns.name: Go 标识符内部词段
patterns.context: Go 代码中的类型、字段、函数或标识符，尤其是驼峰命名的组成部分；并非所有 Go 标识符都会触发。

patterns.name: JUnit 与 Java 测试标识符
patterns.context: Java 的 import、测试断言和 JUnit runner 注解中，出现在类名或测试框架标识符里。

patterns.name: C# / IL 元数据和成员签名
patterns.context: XML 文档式的成员签名片段中，触发集中在可见性、方法属性及 IL 签名字段。
patterns.domain: Github / .NET API 文档或元数据

patterns.name: 专利文本中的生成、提供及用途表述
patterns.context: 专利背景或发明说明中，以说明育种方法、系统能力或发明目的为语境；触发分布在普通说明性措辞中，并非单一固定短语。

patterns.name: 理由与选择表达
patterns.context: 叙事对话中，位于“one reason for selecting so young a physician”的理由说明里。

en.concept: Relationships and qualifiers in structured text
en.description: Activations often occur in structured technical texts describing relationships among objects, interfaces, parameters, and filters; other instances involve patent/legal qualifiers and case numbers, traffic statistics, art investment, and API metadata, with conditions that are not entirely consistent.

patterns.name: Relationships, selection, and lists in structured technical text
patterns.context: Technical documentation or code describing relationships among components, interfaces, parameters, and resources, or defining filters, returns, indexes, and struct fields; triggers are distributed across English explanatory prose, comments, and code identifiers.
patterns.domain: Patent background, software documentation, and code

patterns.name: Qualifiers or procedural phrasing in legal and patent texts
patterns.context: Claim scope, disclaimers, case citations, and formulaic fields such as dates and case numbers in formal legal or patent texts.

patterns.name: Traffic monitoring and statistical data statements
patterns.context: In descriptions of website traffic monitoring, advertising uses, and data anonymity, focusing on data collection, validation, and personal identifiability.

patterns.name: Investment thresholds and artwork preservation
patterns.context: Promotional context discussing investment in art, lowering barriers to participation, and preserving the integrity of works over the long term.

patterns.name: Object or entity names in technical documentation
patterns.context: Types, member signatures, and constructor metadata in XML/API documentation; these resemble formatted declaration fields, with no clear semantic relationship to the other passages.

6_1723.concept: 结构化文本中的关系与限定
6_1723.description: 激活多见于结构化技术文本中描述对象、接口、参数、筛选与返回关系；另涉及专利/法律限定和案号、流量统计、艺术投资，以及 API 元数据，触发条件并不完全一致。

patterns.name: 结构化技术文本中的关系、选择与列表
patterns.trigger: [1] “multiple-access systems”“supporting communication with multiple users by sharing available system resources”；[3] “REST Client”“communicate with API server”；[4] “List takes label and field selectors”“returns the list of Ingresses”；[6] “based on inputs”“submit_time_between”；[7] “implements the Sockaddr interface”“Family”“Index”“Type”
patterns.context: 技术文档或代码中描述组件、接口、参数、资源之间的关系，或定义筛选、返回、索引和结构字段；触发分布在英文说明文字、注释与代码标识符中。
patterns.domain: 专利背景、软件文档与代码

patterns.name: 法律与专利文本中的限定或程序性表述
patterns.trigger: [8] “abstract is neither intended to define the invention”“nor is it intended to be limiting as to the scope”；[10] “Citation Nr”“Decision Date”“Archive Date”“DOCKET NO.”
patterns.context: 正式法律或专利文本中的权利范围、免责声明、案件引用及日期/案号等程式化字段。

patterns.name: 流量监测与统计数据说明
patterns.trigger: [2] “monitor and externally verify our site traffic data”“Any data collected is anonymous statistical data”“cannot be traced back to an individual”
patterns.context: 说明网站流量监测、广告用途及数据匿名性时，围绕数据收集、验证和个人可识别性展开。

patterns.name: 投资门槛与艺术品保存
patterns.trigger: [5] “retain its integrity forever”“all levels of investment”“as few hurdles as possible”
patterns.context: 讨论投资艺术品及降低参与门槛、长期保存作品完整性的宣传性语境。

patterns.name: 技术文档中的对象或实体名称
patterns.context: XML/API 文档中的类型、成员签名及构造函数元数据；更像格式化的声明字段，和其他段的语义关系不明确。

en.description: Activations are scattered across the article “an,” communication wording, code identifiers, legal boilerplate, contact directories, “reason” in narrative, and mathematical formatting commands. Apart from the communication fragments, no reliable shared semantics appear across passages.

patterns.name: Boundary trigger for common token “an”
patterns.context: The strongest hit is the article an; and, parentheses, and other items containing the characters a/n or nearby boundaries also appear in other corpora, but these co-occurrences do not establish the same trigger mechanism.
patterns.domain: Web advertising text, communication patents, mathematical formulas

patterns.name: Communication expressions
patterns.context: Describes communication systems, users sharing resources, or clients communicating with API servers; triggers center on with and communication-related collocations.

patterns.name: API/list identifiers in program code
patterns.context: Code identifiers, method names, or API/entity names in comments; no stable shared lexical trigger is apparent.
patterns.domain: C#, Go, and other software code

patterns.name: Command wording in legal proceedings
patterns.context: Boilerplate legal phrase ordering a defendant to show why an application should not be granted.

patterns.name: Contact information and proper nouns
patterns.context: Service names and telephone numbers in a help directory; no semantic trigger shared with other passages is apparent.

patterns.name: Reasons and choices in narrative
patterns.context: First-person narrative explaining the reason for choosing a young doctor; the high-activation word is reason.

patterns.name: Mathematical formatting fragments
patterns.context: Parentheses, functions, and expression-formatting commands in LaTeX mathematical formulas; apart from formatting tokens, no clear shared semantics appear.

6_1723.concept: none
6_1723.description: 激活分散于冠词 an、通信措辞、代码标识符、法律固定语、联络目录、叙事中的 reason 与数学排版命令；除通信片段外，未见可靠的跨段共同语义。

patterns.name: 常见词元“an”的边界触发
patterns.context: 最强命中是冠词 an；其他语料中也可见 and、括号等含 a/n 字符或邻近边界，但这些共现不足以证明同一触发机制。
patterns.domain: 网页广告文本、通信专利、数学公式

patterns.name: 通信表达
patterns.context: 描述通信系统、用户共享资源，或客户端与 API 服务器通信；触发集中在 with 及通信相关搭配。
patterns.domain: 专利技术文本、代码注释

patterns.name: 程序代码中的 API/列表标识符
patterns.context: 代码标识符、方法名或注释中的 API/实体名称；未见稳定的共同词面触发。

patterns.name: 法律程序中的命令措辞
patterns.context: 法院命令被告说明为何不应批准申请的固定法律短语。

patterns.name: 联络信息与专名
patterns.context: 帮助目录中的服务名称及电话号码；未显现与其他段共有的语义触发。

patterns.name: 叙事中的理由与选择
patterns.context: 第一人称叙事说明选择年轻医生的理由；高激活词为 reason。

patterns.name: 数学排版片段
patterns.context: LaTeX 数学公式中括号、函数及表达式排版命令；除排版 token 外未见明确共同语义。

en.concept: Words related to relationships, reasons, and counts
en.description: Strong activations are distributed across code identifiers (One, Connection, Concurrent, PendingTransaction) and semantic text such as reason, communication, and counts of ad exposures; there is no single stable trigger word.

patterns.name: reason / reasons
patterns.context: In “reason for + doing/choice” constructions, reason means rationale

patterns.name: Connection-related identifiers
patterns.context: Database relationship configuration or call stacks in code; strong activations fall on subwords in One or connection/pool-connection identifiers

patterns.name: Communication-related wording
patterns.context: Describes communication between client and server, or communication between a wireless system and users

patterns.name: Concurrent in class names
patterns.context: Concurrent appears in Java package or class names, not in ordinary prose

patterns.name: PendingTransaction identifier
patterns.context: A pending transaction action type used as a method parameter in an Android interface

patterns.name: Ad exposure counts
patterns.context: Advertising technology documentation about how many times a user has seen a particular ad

6_1723.concept: 关系、理由与计数相关词
6_1723.description: 强激活分散于代码标识符（One、Connection、Concurrent、PendingTransaction）及语义文本中的 reason、通信和广告曝光次数；没有单一稳定触发词。

patterns.name: reason / reasons
patterns.context: “reason for + doing/选择”结构中，reason 表示理由

patterns.name: 连接相关标识符
patterns.context: 代码中的数据库关系配置或调用栈；强激活落在 One 或连接/池化连接标识符的子词上

patterns.name: 通信相关措辞
patterns.context: 描述客户端与服务器通信，或无线系统与用户通信

patterns.name: 并发类名中的 Concurrent
patterns.context: Java 包名或类名中出现 Concurrent，非普通散文用法

patterns.name: PendingTransaction 标识符
patterns.context: Android 接口方法参数中的待处理事务动作类型

patterns.name: 广告曝光次数
patterns.context: 广告技术说明用户看过某广告的次数

en.description: Activations are distributed across multiple genres: reason/necessity arguments are common in legal and narrative texts, alongside patent cost wording, website monitoring copy, code configuration and tests, license phrases, and mathematical endpoint notation. They cannot be reduced to a single clear semantic concept.

patterns.name: Cost and manufacturing in patent subject-matter statements
patterns.context: Patent background/invention-purpose statements discussing durable, reliable, low-cost manufacture of a new device

patterns.name: Website traffic monitoring and advertising data disclosures
patterns.context: Disclosures about website traffic monitoring, anonymous statistics, and uses by the advertising industry

patterns.name: Reason, purpose, or choice argumentation
patterns.context: Reason expresses the basis for a choice or the soundness of an evidentiary judgment in legal analysis; activation falls near reason

patterns.name: Reason and necessity in legal decisions
patterns.context: Judicial opinions address reasons for action, necessity, and whether to intervene in the exercise of discretion

patterns.name: Relationship configuration and method chaining in code
patterns.context: C# ORM/API code configures entity relationships through chained method calls

patterns.name: Haskell test entries and concurrency imports
patterns.context: A test list is followed by an import of a Haskell concurrency-delay module; triggers are scattered near code identifiers

patterns.name: “among other things” in license disclaimers
patterns.context: Software license/disclaimer discusses issues with copies and related terms
patterns.domain: Legal documents/license text included in Gutenberg

patterns.name: Mathematical interval and endpoint notation
patterns.context: LaTeX notation for intervals or left and right brackets in mathematical formulas

6_1723.concept: 异质文本中的关系/理由表达
6_1723.description: 激活分布于多种文体：法律与叙述中常见 reason/necessity 论证，另有专利成本措辞、网站监测文案、代码配置与测试、许可证短语及数学左右端点记号；无法归结为单一明确语义。

patterns.name: 专利客体陈述中的成本与制造
patterns.trigger: “low cost of manufacture with regard to both materials and labor”；邻近“a new plunger device”及“object of the present invention”
patterns.context: 专利背景/发明目的语句，谈新装置的耐用、可靠、低成本制造

patterns.name: 站点流量监测与广告数据说明
patterns.trigger: “monitor and externally verify our site traffic data”；“data collected is anonymous statistical data”
patterns.context: 网站流量监控、匿名统计数据及广告行业用途的说明

patterns.name: 理由、目的或选择的论证表达
patterns.trigger: “one reason for selecting so young a physician”；“any tendency in reason to prove”
patterns.context: 以 reason 表达选择原因或法律证据判断中的合理性；激活落在 reason 附近

patterns.name: 法律裁判中的理由与必要性
patterns.trigger: “only reason he gave for deciding to enter”；“no reason for interfering”；“any necessity for the default”
patterns.context: 司法意见围绕行动理由、必要性及是否干预裁量展开

patterns.name: 代码中的关系配置与方法链
patterns.context: C# ORM/API 代码，以连续方法调用配置实体关系

patterns.name: Haskell 测试项与并发导入
patterns.context: 测试列表后接 Haskell 并发延时模块导入；触发点分散于代码标识符附近

patterns.name: 许可证免责声明中的 among other things
patterns.context: 软件许可证/免责声明谈到复制品问题及相关条款
patterns.domain: Gutenberg 收录的法律文书/许可证文本

patterns.name: 数学区间与左右端点记号
patterns.context: 数学公式中表示区间或左右括号的 LaTeX 记号

en.concept: Derivative instructions and variables in differentiation problems
en.description: Responds primarily to “wrt” specifying the differentiation variable in derivative problems, derivative instructions, and combinations of algebraic expressions; also responds sporadically to wording about protocol implementation in lead-exposure studies and business emails.

patterns.name: Variable markers in differentiation tasks
patterns.context: Specifies the variable with respect to which to take a first, second, or third derivative in math problems; this local pattern activates most strongly across multiple passages.

patterns.name: Prompts in polynomial differentiation problems
patterns.context: A differentiation instruction appears next to an algebraic expression, usually specifying the variable with “wrt” at the end of the problem and possibly giving the answer.

patterns.name: Low-level prenatal and postnatal lead exposure
patterns.context: Activation concentrates on the word “lead” in research abstracts describing effects on rat immune function.

patterns.name: Protocols and their implementation
patterns.context: Emails discuss whether a named item has a protocol and whether the protocol has been sent for execution; “for execution” after “sent” is specific to the email context.

6_1909.concept: 求导题中的求导指令与变量
6_1909.description: 主要对求导题中指定求导变量的“wrt”及导数指令、代数表达式组合有反应；另对铅暴露研究和商务邮件中的协议执行措辞有零星反应。

patterns.name: 求导任务中的变量标记
patterns.trigger: “wrt”后接变量，如“wrt h”“wrt b”“wrt j”“wrt s”“wrt x”“wrt c”“wrt y”“wrt g”
patterns.context: 在要求求一阶、二阶或三阶导数的数学题中，指定对哪个变量求导；该局部模式在多段中激活最强。

patterns.name: 多项式导数题中的提示语
patterns.trigger: “derivative of”“Find the second derivative”“Find the third derivative”“What is the derivative”
patterns.context: 求导指令与代数表达式相邻，通常在题目末尾用“wrt”指定变量，并可能给出答案。

patterns.name: 低水平产前及产后铅暴露
patterns.trigger: “chronic, low level pre- and postnatal lead exposure”
patterns.context: 描述对大鼠免疫功能影响的研究摘要中，激活集中在“lead”一词。

patterns.name: 协议及其执行
patterns.context: 邮件讨论某个名称是否有协议，以及协议是否已发送执行；“sent”后的“for execution”是邮件语境。

en.description: Strongly responds to “wrt” specifying the differentiation variable, primarily in mathematical differentiation problems, across different orders and variables. Two additional examples are “lead” (the metal) in a biomedical context and “sent” in a business email; no unifying local trigger pattern is apparent.

patterns.name: Variable marker in differentiation instructions
patterns.context: Appears after a function or polynomial to specify the variable of differentiation; often immediately precedes a question mark or period, followed by a newline and the answer.
patterns.domain: Symbolic differentiation problems in DM Mathematics

patterns.name: “wrt” in the body of differentiation problems
patterns.context: Appears in problems requesting first, second, or third derivatives; activation does not depend on a particular derivative order or variable.

patterns.name: “lead” in a research description
patterns.context: In the phrase “prenatal lead exposure,” lead is a noun referring to the metal; the context describes research aims and experimental subjects.

patterns.name: “sent” in an agreement-execution context
patterns.context: In “An agreement was sent for execution,” describes an agreement being sent for execution; the preceding text mentions searching for the agreement.

6_1909.concept: 求导变量标记（兼有孤立词触发）
6_1909.description: 主要对数学求导题里指定求导变量的“wrt”强烈响应，涵盖不同阶数及变量；另有生物医学中的“lead”（铅）和商务邮件中的“sent”两例，未见可统一的局部触发模式。

patterns.name: 求导指令中的变量标记
patterns.context: 出现在函数或多项式之后，指定对哪个变量求导；常紧邻问号或句点，后面接换行与答案。
patterns.domain: DM Mathematics 的符号求导题

patterns.name: 求导题正文中的 wrt
patterns.context: 在题目要求计算一阶、二阶或三阶导数时出现；触发不依赖特定求导阶数或变量。

patterns.name: 研究描述中的 lead
patterns.context: 短语“prenatal lead exposure”中，lead 作名词，指铅；上下文为研究目的与实验对象。
patterns.domain: NIH ExPorter 生物医学摘要

patterns.name: 协议执行语境中的 sent
patterns.context: “An agreement was sent for execution”中，描述协议被送交执行；前文提到查找协议。

en.description: The activation pattern is not unified: “wrt” stands out in mathematical differentiation problems; other distinct local high-activation fragments appear in medical image labels, database fields, research abstracts, business agreement emails, and legal case citations.

patterns.name: “wrt” in differentiation instructions
patterns.context: Appears in instructions for differentiation, followed by a variable name, such as “wrt h,” “wrt b,” “wrt j,” or “wrt s”; usually near the end of the problem.

patterns.name: Image labels and numbered fields
patterns.context: Repeated Markdown image syntax containing filenames, image numbers, or attribute fields; activation spans labels, filenames, and numbers.
patterns.domain: Image labels in PubMed Central documents

patterns.name: Structured database fields and version dates
patterns.context: SQL/database-dump-style fields, quoted dates, and version information; not natural-language sentences.
patterns.domain: GitHub code or database configuration text

patterns.name: Research-subject phrase in an abstract
patterns.context: Describes a study of chronic, low-level prenatal and postnatal lead exposure on rat immune function; high activation falls on the phrase “lead exposure.”

patterns.name: Wording about sending an agreement for execution
patterns.context: States that an agreement has been sent for signature/execution; the sentence continues across a line break.

patterns.name: Page numbers in legal case citations
patterns.context: Appears in the page-number position of a court case citation, following volume, reporter, and page information.

6_1909.description: 激活模式并不统一：数学求导题中特别突出“wrt”；另在医学图像标记、数据库字段、研究摘要、商务协议邮件及法律判例引证中，也出现不同的局部高激活片段。

patterns.name: 求导指令中的“wrt”
patterns.context: 出现在求导题的指令中，后接变量名，如“wrt h”“wrt b”“wrt j”“wrt s”；通常位于题目末尾。

patterns.name: 图像标记与编号字段
patterns.context: 重复的 Markdown 图片语法，包含文件名、图像编号或属性字段；激活分布在标记、文件名和编号等片段。
patterns.domain: PubMed Central 文档中的图像标记

patterns.name: 结构化数据库字段及版本日期
patterns.context: SQL/数据库转储式字段、带引号的日期和版本信息；不是自然语言句子。
patterns.domain: GitHub 代码或数据库配置文本

patterns.name: Image labels and resource paths

patterns.name: Database loading logs

patterns.name: Legal case citations

patterns.name: XML localization strings
patterns.context: XML string resource entries with msgid and name attributes

patterns.name: Hematology variable terminology
patterns.context: Medical abstracts listing red blood cell deformability and other hemorheological measures

6_1909.description: 激活涵盖求导题及结果、PubMed 图像标签、代码日志和 XML 资源、法律判例引文、血液学术语；除局部格式或专业词串外，未见贯穿各类文本的共同语义触发。

patterns.name: 图像标签与资源路径

patterns.name: 数据库加载日志

patterns.name: 法律判例引文

patterns.name: XML 本地化字符串

patterns.name: 血液学变量术语
patterns.context: 医学摘要中列举红细胞变形能力及其他血液流变学指标

en.description: Activation is strongest at periods across the examples, including sentence endings, abbreviations, numbering, and version numbers; it also occurs at line breaks and in structured image references such as patent figure numbers and Markdown image labels.

patterns.name: Period and following space
patterns.context: Activation is concentrated on period punctuation; sometimes a space or newline immediately follows. Examples include email sentences, legal citations, names, patent figure numbers, paper titles, and version numbers.

patterns.name: Line-break boundaries
patterns.context: Multiple tokens near line breaks activate; examples include citations followed by court names, name entries, paper abstracts, and image-label sequences.
patterns.domain: Structured text, papers, and encyclopedia entries

patterns.name: Image labels and figure numbers
patterns.context: FIG numbers in patent descriptions, or consecutive Markdown image references and caption anchors in papers; activation spans labels, numbers, and line breaks.

patterns.name: Periods in abbreviations, names, and numbers
patterns.context: Periods embedded in legal citations, personal names, or initials rather than at ordinary sentence endings.

patterns.name: Periods in software version numbers
patterns.context: Periods between digits in version numbers in build configurations.

patterns.name: Period in a paper title
patterns.context: Period at the end of an academic paper title, followed by a newline and the beginning of the abstract.

patterns.name: Period in email body text
patterns.context: Ends a short request sentence; a space and the following sentence come after the period.

6_1909.description: 各段主要在句点处强激活，涵盖句末、缩写、编号和版本号；另在换行边界及专利图号、Markdown 图片标记等结构化图像引用中激活。

patterns.name: 句点及其后空格
patterns.context: 激活集中在句点标点上；有时句点后紧跟空格或换行。见邮件句子、法律引文、姓名、专利图号、论文标题和版本号。

patterns.name: 换行边界
patterns.context: 换行附近多个 token 激活；见引文后接法院名称、姓名条目、论文摘要及图像标记序列。
patterns.domain: 结构化文本、论文及百科条目

patterns.name: 图像标记与图号
patterns.context: 专利描述中的 FIG 编号，或论文中连续的 Markdown 图片引用及图注锚点；激活覆盖标记、编号和换行。

patterns.name: 缩写、姓名与编号中的句点
patterns.context: 句点嵌在法律引证、人物姓名或首字母缩写中，而非普通句末。

patterns.name: 软件版本号句点
patterns.context: 句点位于构建配置中的版本号数字之间。

patterns.name: 论文标题中的句点

patterns.name: 邮件正文句点
patterns.context: 简短请求句结束，句点后接空格及后续句子。

en.description: Strongly responds to the substring Pointer in code and technical text, including pointer types, methods, unsafe.Pointer conversions, file pointers, and NullPointerException; also responds to specific pointer declarations, comparisons, and Qt smart-pointer code.

patterns.name: Pointer identifier
patterns.context: A type, method, or function name in code, often used in pointer conversion, access, or type declarations; the most stable trigger substring.
patterns.domain: Multilingual code (C/C++, Swift, Java, Go, Objective-C, etc.)

patterns.name: unsafe.Pointer calls
patterns.context: `.Pointer` follows `unsafe` in pointer conversions or system-call argument construction.

patterns.name: NullPointerException errors
patterns.context: Part of an exception class name in Android/Java error logs or problem descriptions.

patterns.name: File Pointer method
patterns.context: Reads the current position in file-stream operations, possibly followed by a seek.

patterns.name: clock pointer declaration and documentation
patterns.context: A C declaration of a pointer to clock, with a comment describing its parameters.
patterns.domain: Github C code and API comments

patterns.name: Pointer equality comparison
patterns.context: Compares pointers returned by two objects to determine whether they are identical.

patterns.name: QScopedPointer type
patterns.context: A member declaration in Qt/C++ uses a template type to hold a private object pointer.

patterns.name: Pointer-related log issues
patterns.context: An error log followed by a question or analysis of a runtime exception; distinct from general uses of the Pointer code identifier.

6_1909.description: 强烈响应代码与技术文本中的 Pointer 子串，涵盖指针类型、方法、unsafe.Pointer 转换、文件指针及 NullPointerException；还响应具体指针声明、比较和 Qt 智能指针代码。

patterns.name: 标识符 Pointer
patterns.context: 代码中的类型名、方法名或函数名，常见于指针转换、访问或类型声明；是最稳定的触发子串。

patterns.name: unsafe.Pointer 调用
patterns.context: `unsafe` 后接 `.Pointer`，出现在指针转换或系统调用参数构造中。

patterns.name: NullPointerException 异常
patterns.context: 异常类名的一部分，出现在 Android/Java 错误日志或问题描述中。

patterns.name: File Pointer 方法
patterns.context: 文件流操作代码中读取当前位置，随后可能进行 seek。

patterns.name: clock 指针声明与文档
patterns.context: C 声明中指向 clock 的指针，并在注释中说明其参数。
patterns.domain: Github C 代码及 API 注释

patterns.name: 指针相等比较
patterns.context: 比较两个对象返回的指针，以判断它们是否相同。

patterns.name: QScopedPointer 类型
patterns.context: Qt/C++ 成员声明中以模板类型持有私有对象指针。

patterns.name: 指针相关的日志问题
patterns.context: 错误日志后接对运行时异常的提问或分析；与代码标识符 Pointer 的一般用法不同。

en.description: The most prominent feature is the uppercase character sequence NET, appearing in names or technical/academic terms such as NETCO, NET_, NET461, NETSCAPE, and NETWORK; there is also a Sm-initial fragment and several local patterns triggered by formats such as code, titles, lists, and structured records.

patterns.name: NET string/word boundary
patterns.context: The uppercase sequence NET appears in names, identifiers, filenames, or phrases; it may span token fragments, with varying subsequent characters.
patterns.domain: Emails, paper titles, code, domain records, academic text

patterns.name: Smir/Smoky character sequence
patterns.context: An uppercase S followed by m appears in transliterated personal names or place names; it has no clear semantic connection to the NET pattern.

patterns.name: Structured data fields
patterns.context: Indented field names, colons, braces, numbers, and other key-value structures in serialized objects.

patterns.name: Standard legal disclaimer
patterns.context: All-caps or mostly uppercase legal disclaimer wording in software license/liability limitation text.

patterns.name: Conditional compilation and platform macros
patterns.context: C# conditional compilation directives and platform macros appear together around a cross-platform class declaration.

patterns.name: Project/organization contact list
patterns.context: Email-header-style name lists with semicolons, commas, and line breaks, followed by Subject.

patterns.name: Financial calculation email ending
patterns.context: Email body discussing NetScape growth rates and strategy, followed by a signature/filename.

patterns.name: Domain registration records
patterns.context: Field-based web text consisting of website domains, registrars, and contact information.

patterns.name: Mathematical symbols and neural network titles
patterns.context: A paper subsection title about neural network evaluation follows formula symbols.

patterns.name: Cancer apoptosis title
patterns.context: An all-caps section title mentioning a signaling pathway network follows a biomedical passage.

patterns.name: Substring within a domain string
patterns.context: Appears in the uppercase .COM domain BLASTERCORP.COM; it is not an obvious NET string, and the trigger is uncertain.

patterns.name: Legal names and Slavic transliteration
patterns.context: A biography presents a Latin transliteration alongside a Russian name, with a date range.

patterns.name: Geographic encyclopedia narrative
patterns.context: Ordinary prose about river obstacles and the confluence of two rivers; no clear shared trigger string is evident.

patterns.name: YAML/object-style hierarchical data
patterns.context: Newline-indented key-value and list structures containing fields such as Children, Father, and RootOrder.

6_1909.description: 最突出的是大小写 NET 字符序列，常处于 NETCO、NET_、NET461、NETSCAPE、NETWORK 等名称或技术/学术词中；另有 Sm 起始片段及若干由代码、标题、名单、结构化记录等格式触发的局部模式。

patterns.name: NET 字符串/词边界

patterns.name: Smir/Smoky 字符序列

patterns.name: 结构化数据字段
patterns.context: 序列化对象中的缩进字段名及冒号、花括号、数值等键值结构。

patterns.name: 制式法律免责声明

patterns.name: 条件编译与平台宏

patterns.name: 项目/组织联系人名单

patterns.name: 财务计算邮件结尾

patterns.name: 域名注册记录

patterns.name: 数学符号与神经网络标题

patterns.domain: 学术论文/PDF 抽取文本

patterns.name: 癌症凋亡标题
patterns.context: 生物医学段落后接全大写章节标题，标题提及信号通路网络。

patterns.name: 域名字符串内部片段
patterns.context: 出现在大写 .COM 域名 BLASTERCORP.COM 中；并非明显的 NET 字符串，触发原因不确定。

patterns.name: 法定姓名与斯拉夫语转写

en.description: Activations occur mainly in text with visible layout features: indentation, blank lines, aligned whitespace, numbering, and structured fields. Across corpora, these appear in legal documents, code, paper titles, business records, and directory formats.

en.description: Activations appear in blank lines and indentation in legal documents, as well as in structured snippets containing date metadata, code, formulas, XML, and scientific-paper values and terminology; their commonality across corpora is primarily formatting or specialized symbols.
