patterns.context: 百科页面的分类标签，列出出生年份、国籍、运动项目及俱乐部。

patterns.name: 代码或游戏命令式标识符
patterns.context: 换行缩进的命令/标识符序列，混有括号、分号和大小写混合的代码样式词。
patterns.domain: GitHub 代码或代码生成文本

patterns.name: 关于 ABX 测试与确定性的论述
patterns.trigger: “ABX test”, “The doubt forces to guess”, “deterministically or not”, “The sound”
patterns.context: 讨论无法从 ABX 测试辨别情况、猜测及声音属性；不是其他段落中的常见文体。

en.description: Activations are scattered across numbers and the unit h, algebraic variables, medical abbreviations, statistical markers, and formula symbols, as well as word-internal fragments and sporadic punctuation. Triggers are inconsistent across domains, with no clear unified semantic pattern.

patterns.name: Unit/time marker h next to numbers
patterns.context: h immediately follows a number to indicate hours or a time point; appears in time expressions such as “1 h and 6 h plasma,” “12 h a day,” and “8-h postoperative”

patterns.name: Letter h in scientific notation
patterns.context: The variable h appears in algebraic expressions, possibly adjacent to formula symbols or numbers; it has no clear natural-language time meaning

patterns.name: Local characters in formulas and numeric symbols
patterns.context: Activations are scattered across numbers and letters in statistics, formulas, and physical or particle symbols, with no unified specific symbol trigger
patterns.domain: Medical papers, math problems, physics/particle physics papers

patterns.name: Medical abbreviations and scale markers
patterns.context: Activations fall on letters and numbers in clinical scales, treatment abbreviations, biochemical measures, or statistical symbols, often mixed with punctuation and numbers

patterns.name: Sporadic fragments within or at the boundaries of English words
patterns.context: Activations sometimes cover a word-internal fragment or part of a word, but fragment positions and meanings are unstable; subword segmentation or local spelling may be involved
patterns.domain: Medical papers, math problems, financial physics papers

patterns.name: Physical symbols and mathematical formatting
patterns.context: Activations occur in formula-like particle/mathematical expressions with dollar signs, superscripts, and subscripts; however, not all similar symbols activate consistently

patterns.name: Punctuation and comparison structures in statistical expressions
patterns.context: Punctuation and comparison symbols near numbers, P-values, or statistical results activate, possibly as structural formatting features, but inconsistently

patterns.name: Local markers in nonspecific medical narrative
patterns.context: Activations occur near symptom descriptions and citation markers; shared lexical or semantic features with other passages are unclear

6_1909.description: 激活分散在数字与单位h、代数变量、医学缩写、统计标记和公式符号中，也有词内片段及零散标点；不同领域间触发不稳定，未形成清晰统一语义模式。

patterns.name: 数字旁的单位/时间标记 h
patterns.context: h 紧跟数字，表示小时或时间点；分别出现在“1 h and 6 h plasma”和“12 h a day”“8-h postoperative”等时间表达中

patterns.name: 科学符号中的字母 h
patterns.context: 变量 h 出现在代数表达式中，可能与公式符号、数字相邻；没有明显的自然语言时间含义

patterns.name: 公式与数字符号中的局部字符
patterns.context: 激活散落在统计量、公式、物理或粒子符号的数字和字母中，未见统一的具体符号触发条件
patterns.domain: 医学论文、数学题、物理/粒子物理论文

patterns.name: 医学缩写和量表标记
patterns.context: 激活落在临床量表、治疗缩写、生化指标或统计符号的字母与数字部分，常混有标点和数字

patterns.name: 英文词内部或词界的零散片段
patterns.context: 激活有时覆盖词内片段或词的一部分，但片段位置与词义不稳定；可能受子词切分或局部拼写影响
patterns.domain: 医学论文、数学题、金融物理论文

patterns.name: 物理符号与数学排版
patterns.context: 激活出现在带美元符号、上标、下标的公式化粒子/数学表达式中；但并非所有同类符号都一致激活
patterns.domain: 高能物理、粒子物理论文

patterns.name: 统计表达中的标点与比较结构
patterns.context: 数字、P 值或统计结果附近的标点和比较符号有激活，可能是结构性格式特征，触发并不一致

patterns.name: 非特异性医学叙述中的局部标记
patterns.context: 症状描述和引文标记附近有激活；与其他段落共享的词汇或语义特征不明确

en.description: Activation occurs around time values and units in scientific text, pagination and case numbers in legal documents, quantities, units, and answers in math conversion problems, and numeric subscripts in optimization formulas. These share prominent numbers, identifiers, or formatting symbols, but their domains and local patterns are not unified.

patterns.name: Time values and units
patterns.context: Time expressed in hours in scientific text, especially when a number is adjacent to h/hours and describes time after administration, infection, or an experiment; some activation falls on h or the number.

patterns.name: Pagination and formatting markers in legal documents
patterns.context: Pagination, case numbers, footnote continuations, and typeset content in court opinions or legal records.

patterns.name: Numbers and hyphens in legal case numbers
patterns.context: Identifier strings composed of numbers, letter abbreviations, and hyphens when case numbers are listed in legal documents.

patterns.name: Quantities, units, and numerical answers in math problems
patterns.context: Unit conversions in question-and-answer math problems; the prompt contains numerical values and units, and the answer is expressed as a number.

patterns.name: Numeric subscripts in mathematical optimization notation
patterns.context: Norm/optimization notation with numeric subscripts in mathematical discussion of sparse clustering; activation centers on 0 and neighboring symbols.

6_1909.description: 激活分布于科学文本中的小时数值与单位、法律文书的分页排版及案号、数学换算题的数量单位和答案，以及优化公式中的数字下标。它们共同包含突出的数字、编号或版式符号，但领域与局部模式并不统一。

patterns.name: 时间数值与单位表达
patterns.trigger: “24 h”、 “48 h”、“3 h”、“1 h and 6 h”、“3 h after”，以及数字与单位的组合
patterns.context: 科学文本中以小时为时间单位，尤其是数字紧邻 h/hours、描述给药、感染或实验后的时间；部分激活落在 h 或数字上

patterns.name: 法律文书分页与版式标记
patterns.context: 法院意见或法律记录中的分页、案号、脚注续页和版面排印内容

patterns.name: 法律案号中的数字与连接符
patterns.context: 法律文书列举案号时，数字、字母缩写和连字符组成的编号串

patterns.name: 数学题中的数量、单位与数值答案
patterns.context: 问答式数学题中进行单位换算，题干含数值和计量单位，答案以数字呈现

patterns.name: 数学优化符号中的下标数字
patterns.context: 稀疏聚类相关的数学论述中，范数/优化符号带有数字下标；激活集中在 0 及其邻近符号

en.concept: Heterogeneous text fragments and formatting markers
en.description: Responds primarily to hour units and time points in biomedical text; also activates sporadically on diplomatic solidarity language, protections for pro se litigants, supplementary-material links, and court docket formatting.

patterns.name: Hour values in biomedical experiments
patterns.context: Hour units and adjacent time points, intervals, or treatment durations in biomedical research; the subjects include drug infusion, cell treatment, animal isolation/treatment, stress treatment, infection, and postoperative recovery.
patterns.domain: PubMed/PubMed Central biomedical papers, abstracts, or body text

patterns.name: International obligations and solidarity language
patterns.context: Discusses the EU and the international community jointly supporting negotiation efforts, emphasizing the broadest possible solidarity.

patterns.name: Protections for pro se litigants
patterns.context: Summarizes the requirement that a court notify a self-represented litigant of the consequences of failing to respond to a summary judgment motion.

patterns.name: Crystallographic supplementary-material links
patterns.context: Links to crystallographic information in supplementary-material notes, embedded in filenames, URLs, and HTML/MIME markup.
patterns.domain: Biomedical paper supplementary materials and webpage markup

patterns.name: Court docket and legal citation format
patterns.context: Court-assigned judges, statutory citations, docket numbers, and pagination/line-break formatting appear in case documents.

6_1909.concept: 异质文本片段与格式标记
6_1909.description: 主要响应生物医学文本中的小时单位与时间点；另对外交团结措辞、无律师诉讼保护、补充材料链接及法院案卷格式有零散激活。

patterns.name: 生物医学实验中的小时数值
patterns.context: 在生物医学研究中，小时单位及其前后的时间点、时间区间或处理时长；对象分别涉及药物输注、细胞处理、动物隔离/治疗、应激处理、感染和术后恢复。
patterns.domain: PubMed/PubMed Central 生物医学论文摘要或正文

patterns.name: 国际义务与团结表述
patterns.context: 谈论欧盟、国际社会共同支持谈判努力时，强调尽可能广泛的团结。
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会政治/外交发言

patterns.name: 无律师当事人诉讼保护
patterns.context: 概述法院在针对自行诉讼当事人的简易判决动议中，须告知其不作为后果。

patterns.name: 晶体学补充材料链接
patterns.context: 补充材料说明中的晶体学信息链接，嵌在文件名、网址及 HTML/ MIME 标记中。
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文补充材料及网页标记

patterns.name: 法院案卷与法律引文格式
patterns.context: 法院指派法官、法条引文、案卷编号及分页/换行格式等内容出现在案件文书中。
patterns.domain: 宾夕法尼亚州法律文书/案卷

en.concept: Mixed: hour abbreviation and word-ending/identifier fragments
en.description: The most consistent activation occurs after the hour abbreviation h, commonly in biomedical experiment duration expressions; isolated activations also occur on code identifier endings, supplementary-file numbers, and English superlative/evaluative word endings.

patterns.name: h in time units
patterns.context: The letter h as an abbreviation for hours, near numbers, time intervals, or treatment/observation durations; the preceding number is not necessarily marked as active.

patterns.name: Autoscaling stem
patterns.context: The HorizontalPodAutoscaler identifier in Go code; activation falls at the end of the identifier stem.

patterns.name: Number in a supp filename
patterns.context: A numbered fragment in a supplementary-material hyperlink filename, within a crystallographic information link.

patterns.name: Ending in “toughest”
patterns.context: The ending portion of the English adjective toughest; the context discusses difficult issues facing young women.

patterns.name: Ending in “best”
patterns.context: best appears in the description “the state's best speaker.”

6_1909.concept: 混合：小时缩写与词尾/编号片段
6_1909.description: 激活最一致地出现在小时缩写 h 后，常见于生物医学实验的时长表达；另对代码标识符词尾、补充文件编号及英语最高级/评价词尾有孤立激活。

patterns.name: 时间单位中的 h
patterns.context: 字母 h 作为小时缩写，出现在数字、时间间隔或处理/观察时长附近；前置数字未必标记激活。

patterns.name: 自动扩缩容词干
patterns.context: Go 代码中的 HorizontalPodAutoscaler 标识符，激活落在标识符词干末尾。

patterns.name: supp 文件名中的数字
patterns.context: 补充材料超链接文件名中的编号片段，位于 crystallographic information 链接内。
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文补充材料

patterns.name: toughest 中的词尾
patterns.context: 英语形容词 toughest 的末尾部分；语境谈及年轻女性面对的棘手议题。

patterns.name: best 中的词尾
patterns.context: best 出现在“州最好的发言人”这一描述中。

en.concept: Hour unit h and legal numbers
en.description: Responds mainly and strongly to the hour unit h following values in biomedical text, including experimental periods and postoperative durations; also responds to page numbers in legal documents and spelled-out year counts in constitutional history.

patterns.name: Hour unit following a value
patterns.context: An hour count or time range is adjacent to h; contexts often involve fasting in animal experiments, light/dark cycles, postoperative monitoring, or duration of ventilation treatment.

patterns.name: Page numbers in legal documents
patterns.context: Numbers appear in headers/page numbering of appellate case materials, near Page 2 and a page break.

patterns.name: Numerals in constitutional year counts
patterns.context: A number word appears in a spelled-out historical year count for a state constitution, followed by the Arabic numeral “(144)” in parentheses.

6_1909.concept: 小时单位 h 及法律数字
6_1909.description: 主要对生物医学文本中数值后的小时单位 h 强烈反应，涵盖实验周期、术后时长等；另对法律文书中的页码数字及宪法历史年数拼写词有反应。

patterns.name: 数值后的小时单位
patterns.context: 小时数或时间范围紧邻 h；语境多为动物实验的禁食、明暗周期、术后观察或通气治疗时长。

patterns.name: 法律文书页码数字
patterns.context: 数字出现在上诉案卷材料的页眉/页码排版中，附近有 Page 2 和换页符。

patterns.name: 宪法年数中的数字
patterns.context: 数字词处在州宪法历史年数的拼写表达中，后接括号中的阿拉伯数字“(144)”。

en.description: The primary pattern is marking the hour unit h after time or cycle values in biomedical text, covering treatment duration, observation time, and light-dark cycles. There are also isolated activations on four at the end of a compound number in legal text and at a newline followed by indentation before a code query statement.

patterns.name: Time unit h
patterns.context: An independent h follows a number or time range, commonly for treatment duration, observation time, or light-dark cycles; typically occurs in a numerical unit expression.
patterns.domain: Biomedical papers, experimental methods and results

patterns.name: Spelled-out ordinal number in legal text
patterns.context: A number is spelled out in English in a statement of years in a legal judgment; activation falls on four at the end of the compound number.

patterns.name: Query statement after code indentation
patterns.context: An indented chained-call statement on a new line in PHP/Doctrine query builder code.

6_1909.description: 主要模式是在生物医学文本的时间或周期数值后标记小时单位 h，涉及处理时长、观察时间及光暗周期。另有法律复合数字末尾 four 和代码查询语句前换行缩进处的独立激活。

patterns.name: 时间单位 h
patterns.context: 数字或时间范围后出现独立的 h，常用于处理时长、观察时间或光暗周期；通常位于数值单位表达中。
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文、实验方法与结果

patterns.name: 法律文本中的序数词数字化表达
patterns.context: 数字以英文拼写构成法律判决中的年数表述，激活落在复合数字末尾的 four。

patterns.name: 代码缩进后的查询语句
patterns.context: PHP/Doctrine 查询构造器代码中，换行后缩进的链式调用语句。

en.concept: Medical units and duration expressions, with sporadic word-form triggers
en.description: Primarily sensitive to the “24 h” time window in medical texts and the size unit “cm” following a number; also shows isolated activations on the adverbial suffix “-ally,” the latter part of the mathematical term “Weyl,” and numbers in legal page references.

patterns.name: 24-hour treatment course or time window
patterns.context: The number 24 is adjacent to h, indicating treatment, postoperative assessment, duration of suppression, or dosing duration; sometimes embedded in parentheses or hyphenated expressions.

patterns.name: Centimeter measurement unit
patterns.context: cm follows a number to describe lesion size or the distance covered by a surgical mesh.
patterns.domain: Medical case reports and surgical papers

patterns.name: Adverbial suffix expressing abnormal degree
patterns.context: Appears in the adverbial suffix formed from an adjective, describing a subject as appearing unusually large.
patterns.domain: Photography advice and online forum posts

patterns.name: Mathematical character in a proper name
patterns.context: The mathematical physics term Weyl is split into tokens, with activation on its latter part.

patterns.name: Page numbers in legal citations
patterns.context: Appears in number strings such as page numbers in federal appellate court records or documents.

6_1909.concept: 医学单位与时长表达，兼有零散词形触发
6_1909.description: 主要对医学文本中“24 h”时间窗及数值后接“cm”的尺寸单位敏感；另有孤立激活于副词词尾“-ally”、数学术语“Weyl”后半及法律页码数字。

patterns.name: 24 小时疗程或时间窗
patterns.context: 数字 24 与 h 相邻，表示治疗、术后评估、抑制时长或给药时长；有时夹在括号或连字符表达中。

patterns.name: 厘米尺寸单位
patterns.context: 数值后接 cm，描述病灶尺寸或手术网片覆盖距离。

patterns.name: 异常程度副词词尾
patterns.context: 出现在形容词构成的副词词尾，描述主体特征看起来异常地大。
patterns.domain: 摄影建议、网络论坛文字

patterns.name: 专名中的数学字符
patterns.context: 数学物理术语 Weyl 被分词后，激活落在其后半部分。

patterns.name: 法律引证中的页码数字
patterns.context: 出现在联邦上诉法院案卷或文书页码一类的数字串中。

en.concept: Qualified assertions and precise contextual markers
en.description: Activations are scattered across scope-limiting and procedural-fairness language in legal opinions, time/dose values and negative comparisons in medical text, informal requests for verification, and film-award commentary. The medical examples do not show one clear semantic trigger.

patterns.name: Qualified legal ruling
patterns.context: Defines the scope of a legal opinion and emphasizes that the ruling is based only on the facts of the case; “that” in paragraph 3 is strongest.

patterns.name: Legal procedure and fairness language
patterns.context: Formal discussion of litigation procedure, witness testimony, or judicial fairness; markers are scattered across different legal contexts.

patterns.name: Experimental times and numerical units
patterns.context: Reports experimental treatment durations, postoperative time points, stimulation frequencies, or doses in medical research; expressions with adjacent numbers and units stand out in multiple places.

patterns.name: Negation and contrastive discussion
patterns.context: Uses negation, qualification, or comparison to explain conclusions and their limits; includes scientific results and argumentative language.
patterns.domain: Medical papers, legal arguments, online discussions

patterns.name: Informal requests for verification and clarification
patterns.context: The poster states their understanding and invites others to point out errors; the passage also discusses the strength and stiffness of carbon fiber and steel.

patterns.name: Film awards and actor commentary
patterns.context: Comments on actors and casting under award-category headings; also includes the actor name “Tommy Lee Jones.”

patterns.name: Local fragment “doesn’t”
patterns.context: Activation is concentrated on a fragment within a negative contraction, rather than an obviously independent semantic topic.

6_1909.concept: 受限断言与精确语境标记
6_1909.description: 激活分散于法律意见的范围限定与程序公正措辞、医学文本的时间/剂量数值及否定比较、网络求证语气和电影奖项评论；医学例子之间未见单一明确语义触发。

patterns.name: 限定范围的法律判断
patterns.context: 法律意见中界定裁判结论适用范围、强调仅依本案事实作出判断；第3段“that”最强。

patterns.name: 法律程序与公正措辞
patterns.context: 诉讼程序、证人证言或司法公正的正式论述；标记分散在不同法律语境中。

patterns.name: 实验时间与数值单位
patterns.context: 医学研究中报告实验处理时长、术后时间点、刺激频率或剂量；多处突出数字与单位相邻的表达。

patterns.name: 否定和对照式论述
patterns.trigger: “do not proliferate”, “no finding”, “doesn’t always mean”, “after … than under control conditions”
patterns.context: 用否定、限制或比较来说明结论及其边界；涵盖科学结果和论辩表达。
patterns.domain: 医学论文、法律论证、网络讨论

patterns.name: 非正式求证与澄清
patterns.trigger: “I’m just curious”, “how my understanding is incorrect”, “I was under the impression”
patterns.context: 发帖者陈述自己的理解，并邀请他人指出错误；本段还讨论碳纤维与钢的强度、刚度。

patterns.name: 电影奖项与演员评论
patterns.context: 以奖项类别为小标题，评论演员和选角；另有演员姓名“Tommy Lee Jones”。

patterns.name: 词内局部片段“doesn’t”
patterns.context: 激活集中在否定缩写内部片段，而非显然独立的语义主题。

en.description: Activations occur in source-code conditional expressions, number and duration formats, contrasts in political questions, philosophical abstractions, and medical terminology or experimental conditions. No single semantic theme is apparent; some commonality may involve structural symbols or tokenization boundaries.

patterns.name: Numbers, durations, and measurements
patterns.context: A measurement unit, time span, identifier, or hyphen appears near a number; also includes numeric formats in legal citations.
patterns.domain: Legal documents, medical papers, and code

patterns.name: Conditional expression structures in code
patterns.context: Boolean conditions, comparisons, and nested parentheses in source code; activation often falls on operators or words in conditional structures.

patterns.name: British political questions and policy contrasts
patterns.context: Parliamentary debates use questions to compare hardline measures with more moderate negotiation.

patterns.name: Conceptual long words in philosophical texts
patterns.context: Affix segments of long abstract words activate in discussions of etymology, existence, and substance.

patterns.name: Medical terminology and experimental conditions
patterns.context: Terminology, experimental treatments, and units of time co-occur in biomedical research texts.

6_1909.description: 激活分布在源码条件运算、数字与时长格式、政治问句对照、哲学抽象词及医学术语/实验条件中；未见单一语义主题，部分共性可能是结构符号或分词边界。

patterns.name: 数字、时长与量值
patterns.trigger: «forty»-«six»« months»10；« ten»2-；«24»4« h»9；« past»1« six»5« months»9；«0»6；«-»4
patterns.context: 数字附近出现计量单位、时间跨度、编号或连字符；也包括法律引用中的数字格式。
patterns.domain: 法律文书、医学论文及代码

patterns.name: 代码中的条件运算结构
patterns.context: 程序源码中布尔条件、比较和括号嵌套；激活常落在运算符或条件结构词上。

patterns.name: 英式政治问句与政策对照
patterns.trigger: « Do»1« you»4 believe« that»；«hard»-«h»«itting» measures or ... «softly»-«soft»«ly» approach
patterns.context: 议会辩论中以问句比较强硬措施与温和谈判方式。

patterns.name: 哲学文本中的概念性长词
patterns.context: 讨论词源、存在与实体等哲学概念时，长抽象词的词缀部分获得激活。

patterns.name: 医学术语及实验条件
patterns.context: 生物医学研究文本中，术语、实验处理条件与时间单位共同出现。

en.description: Primarily responds to judge signatures, case citations, and litigation-procedure language in legal opinions; scattered activations also occur around weekly work hours, C file-pointer checks, the distinction between professional and amateur, and contrasts between hard-line and moderate diplomatic measures.

patterns.name: Judge names and signature formats in legal opinions
patterns.context: Appears near opinion titles, lists of presiding judges, or opinion signatures, often alongside the court, parties, and line-break formatting.
patterns.domain: U.S. federal and state court opinions

patterns.name: Legal citations and case-number formats
patterns.context: Citations or case numbers composed of digits, hyphens, and case-reporter abbreviations, often in headers, titles, or pagination positions in legal opinions.
patterns.domain: Legal document formatting and case citations

patterns.name: Procedural and rights-related language in legal documents
patterns.context: Statements about litigants, procedural status, constitutional rights, or the admissibility of evidence; may occur in the body or header information.

patterns.name: Names, institutions, and organizational signatures
patterns.context: Personal or organization names in attorney representation details, case signatures, or institutional descriptions.

patterns.name: “week” describing weekly work hours
patterns.context: Job or internship descriptions that specify working hours per week.

patterns.name: C file-operation structure and conditional checks
patterns.context: Function parameters and null checks for file-operation pointers in kernel or driver code.

patterns.name: Contrast between professional and amateur skill levels
patterns.context: Uses the difference between amateur and professional as a metaphor when discussing ability or professional boundaries.

patterns.name: Contrast between patience, hard-line measures, and moderate negotiation
patterns.context: A question discussing whether to take a hard line against a country or pursue moderate negotiations.

6_1909.concept: 多种格式化文本与对比表达
6_1909.description: 主要响应法律判决书中的法官署名、案号引证及诉讼程序用语；另对每周工时、C语言文件指针检查、专业与业余之别，以及外交措施强硬与温和的对比有零散激活。

patterns.name: 法律判决书的法官姓名与署名格式
patterns.trigger: “Before:”, “Circuit Judges”, “Circuit Judge”, “J.”及法官姓名中的分段字母，如“«S»«IL»«ER»”“«M»«ART»«IN»”“«He»«avican»”
patterns.context: 出现在判决书标题、审理法官名单或意见署名附近，常伴随法院、当事人和换行排版
patterns.domain: 美国联邦及州法院判决书

patterns.name: 法律引证与案号格式
patterns.context: 数字、连字符及判例报告缩写组成的引证或案号，常处于判决书页眉、标题或分页位置
patterns.domain: 法律文书排版与判例引证

patterns.name: 法律文书中的程序及权利表述
patterns.trigger: “Defendant-Appellant”、“amicus curiae”、“Plaintiffs”、“no appearance for appellee”、“Fifth Amendment right to remain silent”、“unavailable to testify”
patterns.context: 诉讼参与方、程序身份、宪法权利或证据可用性的表述；可见于正文及页眉信息

patterns.name: 姓名、机构名及组织署名
patterns.trigger: “Sara J. Blockstadter”、“Webster County Attorney”、“American Civil Liberties Union of Ohio”
patterns.context: 人名或组织名出现在律师代理信息、案件署名或机构介绍中

patterns.name: 以“week”描述每周工时
patterns.context: 招聘或实习职位说明中，以每周小时数说明工作时长

patterns.name: C语言文件操作结构与条件判断
patterns.context: 内核或驱动代码中，函数参数及对文件操作指针的空值检查

patterns.name: 专业与业余水平的对比
patterns.context: 用业余与专业的差别作比喻，讨论能力或判断专业界限

patterns.name: 耐心、强硬措施与温和谈判的对比
patterns.context: 以疑问句讨论对某国采取强硬措施还是温和谈判
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会辩论／政治外交

en.description: Activations occur in code conditionals and structural markers, sentence quantities in legal rulings, and numbers or status expressions in patents and reviews. Other examples include patent process descriptions, an adjective suffix associated with diamonds, and statements about improving friendships; these are difficult to group into a single semantic feature.

patterns.name: Number or quantity followed by a sentence ending or boundary
patterns.context: Numbers, durations, or quantity expressions, especially near sentence endings, periods, or segment boundaries; no fixed numeric form is required.
patterns.domain: Legal rulings, patent descriptions, and reviews

patterns.name: Parentheses or control structures in code
patterns.context: Conditional expressions, parentheses or braces, and statement boundaries in code; activation falls on code punctuation and adjacent tokens.
patterns.domain: GitHub source code and StackExchange technical code

patterns.name: Change or status descriptions in patent backgrounds
patterns.context: Describes how a system behaves under certain conditions, or the state and process of a population after selection and development to a later stage.

patterns.name: Substring “less” in specific words
patterns.context: Appears in an adjective suffix describing the color or flaws of lab-grown diamonds; it is unclear whether this is independent of the number/boundary pattern.

patterns.name: Friendship and improvement statements
patterns.context: Advice or encouragement directed at readers, discussing rebuilding friendships and improving circumstances.

6_1909.description: 激活分布在代码条件与结构标记、法律判决中的刑期数量，以及专利/评论里的数字或状态表达；另见专利过程描述、钻石形容词后缀和友谊改善语句，难以归为单一语义特征。

patterns.name: 数字/数量后接句末或边界
patterns.trigger: “twenty-five years.”、“forty-six months’ imprisonment.”、“sixty-three months.”、“currently are”、“12 years”中的数字或其后续 token
patterns.context: 数字、时长或数量表达后，尤其接近句末、句号或句段边界时；不要求固定的数字形式。
patterns.domain: 法律判决、专利说明、评论文字

patterns.name: 代码中的括号或控制结构
patterns.trigger: “host ==”、“if”、“||”、“} else if”、“=== Chars.LineFeed”附近的标记 token
patterns.context: 代码中的条件表达式、括号/花括号结构或语句边界；激活落在代码标点及相邻 token 上。
patterns.domain: Github 源码、StackExchange 技术代码

patterns.name: 专利背景中的变化/状态描述
patterns.trigger: “adverse surface conditions”、“still deficient in a few traits”及“final step”附近
patterns.context: 描述系统在条件下的表现，或种群经过选择、发展至后续阶段的状态与过程。

patterns.name: 特定词内子串“less”
patterns.context: 出现在形容词后缀中，描述培育钻石的颜色或瑕疵特性；是否独立于数字/边界模式不明确。

patterns.name: 朋友关系与改善表述
patterns.trigger: “renew your friendships”、“reconnect with your friends”及“better than they ever have before”
patterns.context: 面向读者的建议或鼓励，谈重建友谊和情况改善。

en.concept: Multiple local patterns across domains, skewed toward legal documents
en.description: Activation is concentrated on hyphenated spelled-out sentence lengths and months/years in criminal judgments; it also covers line breaks, section headings, citations, and litigation vocabulary in legal documents. Other discrete patterns include political wording, biochemical terms, military narrative, and code ||.

patterns.name: Hyphenated number expressions for sentence lengths
patterns.context: In legal narratives, sentence lengths are expressed as hyphenated compound numbers spelled out in English, often immediately followed by months/years or sentenced; activation concentrates on the latter part of the number and the unit.

patterns.name: Layout and line breaks in legal documents
patterns.context: Formatted content such as signature/address blocks, pagination, or section headings in litigation documents; line breaks and indentation themselves activate strongly.

patterns.name: Numbered section headings in legal documents
patterns.context: Discussion-section headings in judgments and their subsequent hierarchical numbering; headings are surrounded by line breaks and decorative markers.

patterns.name: Reporter page-number format in legal citations
patterns.context: Citation format comprising volume, reporter abbreviation, page number, and court year in case citations.

patterns.name: Offense, sentencing, and procedure narratives in legal cases
patterns.context: Standard legal vocabulary describing charges, convictions, jury procedures, and sentencing in criminal judgments; overlaps with the specific sentence-length pattern but also occurs in contexts without prominent sentence lengths.

patterns.name: Contrastive hard-line wording in a political question
patterns.context: Rhetorical question about taking hard-line measures against a country or pursuing moderate negotiations in a diplomatic/political discussion.

patterns.name: Peroxidase in biochemical terminology
patterns.context: Abstract context discussing myeloperoxidase, lactoperoxidase, thyroid peroxidase, and bioactivation.

patterns.name: Personal names and military-rank narrative
patterns.context: Historical-fiction plot describing an officer receiving a commission, commanding soldiers, and pursuing cavalry.

patterns.name: Logical OR operator in code
patterns.context: Logical OR symbol joining two file-operation pointer checks in a C conditional expression.

6_1909.concept: 多领域局部模式，偏法律文书
6_1909.description: 激活最集中于刑事判决中英文拼写的连字符刑期数字及 months/years；也覆盖法律文书换行、章节标题、引文和诉讼词汇。另有政治措辞、生化术语、军事叙事及代码||等离散模式。

patterns.name: 刑期的连字符数字表达
patterns.context: 法律叙述中，数字刑期以英文拼写的连字符复合数表达，常紧接 months/years 或 sentenced；激活集中在数词后半部及单位。
patterns.domain: 判决、刑事案件法律文书

patterns.name: 法律文书中的版式与换行
patterns.context: 诉讼文书的签名/地址栏、分页或章节标题等格式化内容；换行及缩进本身明显激活。

patterns.name: 法律段落编号标题
patterns.context: 判决书的讨论部分标题及其后续层级编号，标题周围伴随换行和装饰性标记。

patterns.name: 法律引文中的报告页码格式
patterns.context: 判例引文中，卷号、报告简称、页码和法院年份组成的引用格式。

patterns.name: 法律案件中的罪名、量刑与程序叙述
patterns.context: 刑事判决叙述罪名、定罪、陪审团程序及量刑的固定法律语汇；与具体刑期模式有重叠，但此处亦见于不含显著刑期的上下文。

patterns.name: 政治问句中的强硬措辞对照
patterns.context: 以反问讨论对某国采取强硬措施还是温和谈判的外交/政治论述。

patterns.name: 生化术语中的过氧化物酶
patterns.context: 讨论髓过氧化物酶、乳过氧化物酶、甲状腺过氧化物酶及生物活化的摘要语境。

patterns.name: 人物姓名与军事职衔叙述
patterns.context: 叙述军官授予委任、指挥士兵及追击骑兵的历史小说剧情。

patterns.name: 代码中的逻辑或运算符
patterns.context: C 代码条件表达式中连接两个文件操作指针检查的逻辑或符号。

en.description: Activations occur on word-internal or word-final fragments across multilingual, cross-domain texts, with sporadic activations near numeric units, common function words, and technical terms. The segments are difficult to reduce to a stable semantic or stylistic pattern.

patterns.name: Word-final or word-internal letter fragments
patterns.context: Activation fragments often occur at the end of or within words, without a stable meaning for the same fragment; they appear in different word forms and languages.

patterns.name: Near numbers and units
patterns.context: In descriptions of medical experiments, activation appears near numbers, time, dosage, or weight units; the strongest activation is on «weight».

patterns.name: Local fragments of particular words
patterns.context: In Danish sentences about the EU Early Warning and Response System, activation falls on word-internal fragments, with no clear whole-word semantic pattern.

patterns.name: Fragments near syntax or contrast
patterns.context: In colloquial English comments, activation occurs near demonstratives, pronouns, or negation structures, but the markers are scattered and lack stable combinations.

patterns.name: Word-internal fragments in social and political discourse
patterns.context: Occurs in discussions of social security, capitalism, or society as a whole; activation still primarily corresponds to word-internal fragments, rather than consistent topic words.

patterns.name: Word-final fragment in a wood-related term
patterns.context: In an encyclopedia entry defining wood grain, activation falls on an adverbial suffix; its connection to the wood topic is unclear.

patterns.name: Word-internal fragments in biomedical terminology
patterns.context: In abstracts on tumor-cell invasion and protein expression, activation falls within an adverb and does not clearly point to a category of medical concepts.

patterns.name: Character fragment in a military figure's word
patterns.context: In a historical account describing a sniper, strong activation falls on a single character fragment within a word.

6_1909.description: 激活分布在多语种、多领域文本的词内或词尾片段上，也有数字单位、常见功能词及专业词附近的零散激活；各段难以归结为稳定的语义或文体模式。

patterns.name: 词尾或词内字母片段
patterns.context: 激活片段常位于词的末尾或词内部，且同一片段没有稳定的词义；可见于不同词形和多种语言。

patterns.name: 数字与单位附近
patterns.context: 医学实验描述中，数字、时间、剂量或体重单位附近出现激活；强激活落在«weight»。

patterns.name: 特定词语的局部片段
patterns.context: 欧盟预警与反应系统的丹麦语句子中，激活落在词内片段，未显示明确的整词语义模式。

patterns.name: 句法或转折附近的片段
patterns.context: 口语化英语评论中，激活出现在指示词、代词或否定结构附近，但标记分散，缺乏稳定组合。

patterns.name: 社会与政治论述中的词内片段
patterns.context: 涉及社会保障、资本主义或社会整体的论述中出现；激活仍主要对应词内片段，而非一致的主题词。

patterns.name: 木材术语中的词尾片段
patterns.context: 木纹定义的百科条目中，激活落在副词词尾；与木材主题的关联不明显。

patterns.name: 生物医学术语中的词内片段
patterns.context: 肿瘤细胞侵袭与蛋白表达的摘要中，激活落在一个副词内部，未明显指向某类医学概念。

patterns.name: 军事人物词中的字符片段
patterns.context: 历史叙述中描述狙击手时，强激活落在词内单字符片段。

en.concept: Local patterns in word fragments and code boundaries
en.description: High activation falls on fragments within words in multiple languages (French ci, Scandinavian suffixes, Russian е, English ever) and on the Python conditional keyword if; additional activations occur in various code structures. Trigger forms and styles are not unified.

patterns.name: Multilingual in-word fragment «ci»
patterns.context: Word ending in French demonstratives or fixed expressions such as “celle-ci” and “cette fois-ci”; activation falls on the ci fragment.

patterns.name: In-word fragments in Scandinavian languages
patterns.context: Activation occurs on in-word suffix fragments in Swedish “geografisk” and Danish “fredelig”; their meanings and syntax differ.
patterns.domain: European Parliament text, Swedish and Danish

patterns.name: Conditional keyword in code
patterns.context: Appears at the start of conditional statements in Python code; the conditions and coding tasks vary.

patterns.name: In-word fragment in English ever
patterns.context: Appears in the parenthetical English clause “if it ever fully existed.”

patterns.name: Russian word-ending fragment
patterns.context: Activation falls on the letter fragment at the end of “же,” near a Russian code example and its explanatory text.

patterns.name: Other code lexical fragments
patterns.context: Code contains varied structures including command arguments, assertions, method names, file handling, and loops; these do not show the same strongest trigger as if conditionals.

6_1909.concept: 词片段与代码边界的局部模式
6_1909.description: 高激活分别落在多语种词内片段（法语 ci、斯堪的纳维亚语后缀、俄语 е、英语 ever）以及 Python 条件关键字 if；另有多处代码结构激活。触发词形与文体不统一。

patterns.name: 多语言词内片段 «ci»
patterns.context: 法语中“celle-ci”“cette fois-ci”等指示代词或固定表达的词尾；激活落在 ci 片段。

patterns.name: 斯堪的纳维亚语词内片段
patterns.context: 激活出现在瑞典语“geografisk”和丹麦语“fredelig”的词内后缀片段，词义和句法并不相同。
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会文本，瑞典语与丹麦语

patterns.name: 代码中的条件关键字
patterns.context: 出现在 Python 代码的条件语句开头；条件和代码任务各不相同。

patterns.name: 英语 ever 的词内片段
patterns.context: 出现在括号中的英语从句“if it ever fully existed”里。

patterns.name: 俄语词尾片段
patterns.context: 激活落在“же”末尾的字母片段，邻近俄语代码示例及其说明文字。

patterns.name: 其他代码词法片段
patterns.context: 代码中有命令参数、断言、方法名、文件处理及循环等多种结构；不呈现与 if 条件相同的最高激活触发项。

en.description: High activations fall on word-internal fragments, word endings, and a few punctuation marks or symbols across languages: Nordic «isk», Russian «е/но», English «ever/ly», Swedish «en», and a percent sign in physics texts. No unified semantic or stylistic pattern is apparent.

patterns.name: Word-internal fragment «isk» in European Parliament texts
patterns.context: «isk» occurs within words in Nordic languages such as Swedish and Danish, usually as an adjectival or adverbial affix/final fragment.

patterns.name: Word-internal fragment «ever»
patterns.context: The emphatic adverb sequence “if it ever really did” in an English sentence.

patterns.name: Russian word-internal fragment «е»
patterns.context: The letter fragment in the Russian word “же,” appearing in explanatory text after a code example.

patterns.name: Russian word-internal fragment «но»
patterns.context: The letter fragment in the Russian word “можно,” appearing in a C++ Q&A reply.

patterns.name: English word-internal fragment «real»
patterns.context: An English adverbial suffix forming “refreshingly,” used in an evaluation of a person.

patterns.name: English word-internal fragment «en»
patterns.context: The word-internal fragment in the Swedish word “verkligen,” appearing in parliamentary text.

patterns.name: Percent sign in physics texts
patterns.context: A percent sign immediately follows a number describing the magnitude of axial anisotropy.

6_1909.concept: 多语种词内片段与符号
6_1909.description: 高激活落在多语种词内片段、词尾及少数标点/符号上：北欧语«isk»、俄语«е/но»、英语«ever/ly»、瑞典语«en»，另有物理文本中的百分号；未见统一语义或文体。

patterns.name: 欧洲议会文本中的词内片段 «isk»
patterns.context: «isk»出现在瑞典语、丹麦语等北欧语言的词内部；多为形容词或副词词缀/词尾片段。

patterns.name: 词内片段 «ever»
patterns.context: 英语句子中短语“if it ever really did”的强调性副词序列。

patterns.name: 俄语词内片段 «е»
patterns.context: 俄语词“же”中的字母片段，出现在代码示例后的解释性文字里。

patterns.name: 俄语词内片段 «но»
patterns.context: 俄语词“можно”中的字母片段，出现在 C++ 问答回复中。

patterns.name: 英文词内片段 «real»
patterns.context: 英语副词后缀，构成“refreshingly”，用于人物评价。

patterns.name: 英文词内片段 «en»
patterns.context: 瑞典语词“verkligen”中的词内片段，出现在议会文本中。

patterns.name: 物理文本中的百分号
patterns.context: 百分比符号紧跟数值，描述轴向各向异性的量级。

en.description: Activations are scattered across diverse text features: ever in philosophical sentences, fragments within Swedish words, Whig in biographies, pagination in court opinions, successively in patents, a in forum comparisons, and URL-encoded fragments; no consistent semantic or syntactic pattern is evident.

patterns.name: Emphasis at the end of statements about neatness, continuity, or generalization
patterns.context: Emphasizes a counterfactual or doubt about whether things were ever so in “Society does not fit together neatly any more ... if it ever really did”; nearby words include “neatly” and “any more”.

patterns.name: Word-final or word-internal Swedish fragments
patterns.context: In Swedish parliamentary speeches, activation falls on subword fragments within words, especially morphological or inflectional parts of adjectives and nouns; there is no clear shared meaning.
patterns.domain: European Parliament Swedish speech / translation text

patterns.name: Whig and political biography terminology
patterns.context: In biographical entries, activation concentrates on tokenized parts of the political affiliation name Whig, near political identity information such as “Liberal”, “Independent Irish Party”, and “Elected as a Whig”.

patterns.name: Isolated pagination in legal opinion formatting
patterns.context: The body of a court opinion is separated from case captions and page numbers by extensive whitespace, page breaks, and pagination; strong activation falls on or near layout markers rather than clear legal terminology.

patterns.name: successively in lithography process descriptions
patterns.context: Describes adjacent target regions on a substrate being patterned in sequence; the activation word expresses ordered, repeated process steps.

patterns.name: Comparative a in work-delegation contexts
patterns.context: Discusses reluctance to delegate work at startups and concerns that others will do it less well; activation falls on the indefinite article in the comparative construction “as good a job”.

patterns.name: Encoded fragments in URLs and tracking parameters
patterns.context: URLs, paths, and RSS tracking parameters in Hacker News posts; activation concentrates on percent-encoded and tokenized URL string fragments.

6_1909.description: 激活分散于多种文本特征：哲学句中的 ever，瑞典语词内片段，传记中的 Whig，判决书分页排版，专利中的 successively，论坛比较结构中的 a，以及 URL 编码片段；未见统一语义或句法模式。

patterns.name: 非整齐／持续／一般化表述中的末端强调
patterns.context: 在“Society does not fit together neatly any more ... if it ever really did”中，对过去是否曾如此的反事实或怀疑作强调；还出现“neatly”“any more”等近邻词。

patterns.name: 瑞典语词尾或词内片段
patterns.context: 瑞典语议会发言中，激活落在被分词标出的词内片段，尤其是形容词或名词的构词、屈折部分；没有清楚的共同词义。
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会瑞典语口语／翻译文本

patterns.name: Whig 及政治人物条目用语
patterns.context: 在传记条目中，激活集中于政治派别名称 Whig 的分词部分，附近有“Liberal”“Independent Irish Party”“Elected as a Whig”等政治身份信息。

patterns.name: 法律判决排版中的孤立分页符
patterns.context: 判决书正文与案名、页码之间出现大量空白、换页和分页符；强激活落在排版标记或其附近，而非明确的法律术语。

patterns.name: 光刻流程描述中的 successively
patterns.context: 描述基板上的相邻目标区域依次进行图案化；激活词表达有顺序的重复工艺步骤。

patterns.name: 工作委派语境中的比较词 a
patterns.context: 谈创业公司中不愿委派工作、担心他人做得不如自己；激活落在比较结构“as good a job”里的不定冠词。

patterns.name: 网址与追踪参数中的编码片段
patterns.context: Hacker News 帖文里的 URL、路径及 RSS 追踪参数；激活集中在百分号编码和拆分后的网址字符串片段。

en.description: Activation patterns are heterogeneous: most commonly punctuation, numbers, and fragments in URLs from HackerNews crawls; also seen are “ever” in a philosophical sentence, “breeder/cannot/same” in a breeding patent, and “pattern” and function words in a lithography patent.

patterns.name: Numbers, punctuation, and segmentation in strings and URLs
patterns.context: Often adjacent to numeric dates, domains, and encoded characters in long URLs, paths, query parameters, or seemingly random identifiers; activation falls on fragmented characters or substrings.

patterns.name: “ever” and its argumentative context
patterns.context: Appears in the rhetorical question/concessive structure “Society does not fit together neatly any more, if it ever really did”; the strongest response is concentrated on ever.

patterns.name: Breeders and statements of capability limits
patterns.context: Patent background statements about genetic combinations, breeders predicting outcomes, or repeatedly breeding the same variety; especially strong on a word-internal fragment of breeder.

patterns.name: Lithography patterns and substrate terminology
patterns.context: Process descriptions of patterns transferred by imaging onto radiation-sensitive material, substrates, and adjacent target areas; triggers are distributed across technical terms and common grammatical words.

6_1909.description: 激活模式异质：最常见于HackerNews抓取链接中的URL标点、数字和碎片；另见哲学句中ever、育种专利中的breeder/cannot/same，以及光刻专利中的pattern与功能词。

patterns.name: 字符串与URL中的数字、标点及分段
patterns.context: 在长URL、路径、查询参数或疑似随机标识符中，常与数字日期、域名和编码字符相邻；激活落在碎片化的字符或子串上。

patterns.name: “ever”及其论证语境
patterns.context: 出现在“Society does not fit together neatly any more, if it ever really did”这一反问/让步结构中；强响应集中在 ever。

patterns.name: 育种者与能力限制表述
patterns.context: 遗传组合、育种者预测结果或重复培育同一品种的专利背景陈述；对 breeder 的词内片段尤强。

patterns.name: 光刻图案与基板术语
patterns.context: 描述图案经成像转移到辐射敏感材料、基板及相邻目标区域的工艺说明；触发分布在技术术语和常见语法词上。

en.description: Activations are scattered across word-internal fragments in multiple languages, English function words, mathematical LaTeX symbols, and configuration-code identifiers; apart from local context, there is insufficient evidence for a unified semantic trigger.

patterns.name: Morpheme boundaries within English contractions
patterns.context: In continuous English text, activation falls within words or on common words; the first passage especially concentrates on morpheme fragments and contexts such as “ever really did”.

patterns.name: Tokenized parts of Polish names
patterns.context: Word-internal fragments of Polish names are marked, especially surname endings.

patterns.name: Romanian word-form fragments
patterns.context: Activations are distributed over word-internal fragments and high-frequency words in Romanian sentences.

patterns.name: Conditional words in code comments
patterns.context: Comments explain how to restore state after an application terminates; activation falls on comment symbols and English function words.

patterns.name: Symbols and fraction fragments in mathematical formulas
patterns.context: In formulas, set expressions, and inequalities, activation falls on LaTeX commands, mathematical symbols, and variables.

patterns.name: Punctuation and identifier fragments in configuration files
patterns.context: Key-value lines composed of GUIDs, platform configurations, and punctuation in build configuration files.

patterns.name: Modality and rule words in English arguments
patterns.context: A definitional argument about defiance, involving rules or expectations and descriptions of counterfactual behavior.

6_1909.description: 激活散布于多语种文本的词内片段、英语功能词、数学LaTeX符号及配置代码标识符；除各片段的局部语境外，没有足够证据支持统一语义触发条件。

patterns.name: 英语缩合词内部的词素边界
patterns.context: 在连续英语文本中，激活落在词内部或常见词上；第1段尤集中于词素片段及“ever really did”等语境。

patterns.name: 波兰语姓名的拆分部分
patterns.context: 波兰姓名的词内片段被标记，尤其姓氏末尾。

patterns.name: 罗马尼亚语词形片段
patterns.context: 激活分布于罗马尼亚语句子中的词内片段及高频词。

patterns.name: 代码注释中的条件词
patterns.context: 注释说明应用终止后如何恢复状态，激活落在注释符号和英语功能词上。

patterns.name: 数学公式中的符号与分式片段
patterns.context: 公式、集合表达式及不等式中，激活落在 LaTeX 命令、数学符号和变量上。

patterns.name: 配置文件标点与标识符片段
patterns.context: 构建配置文件中，GUID、平台配置和标点组成的键值行。

patterns.name: 英语论证中的情态与规则词
patterns.context: 关于 defiance 的定义性论证，出现规则或预期以及反事实行为表述。

en.description: Activations are scattered across several local patterns: negation, conditionals, comparison, and combination relations; code branches, legal rights or procedures, tokenized names, technical titles, and mathematical symbols. Some forum passages lack a stable shared trigger, making a unified semantic interpretation difficult.

patterns.name: Irregularity or quantity/relation expressions
patterns.context: Negation, conditional, or comparative structures discuss whether things are neat, equal, predictable, or involve different combinations; the trigger words vary across passages.
patterns.domain: Philosophical social theory, breeding patents, everyday discussion (1, 8, 9)

patterns.name: Conditional branches in code
patterns.context: Code checks rectangle width and height and enters a conditional branch.

patterns.name: Parties or patent procedures in legal text
patterns.context: Formal legal documents or explanations describe patent appeal procedures or defendants’ litigation rights.
patterns.domain: Patent law, criminal procedure legal texts (3, 7)

patterns.name: Names and their tokenized fragments
patterns.context: Names of Polish MEPs are split into multiple tokens in European Parliament speech records.

patterns.name: Performance and consistency in technical paper titles
patterns.context: A URL contains the title of a machine-learning paper discussing convolutional network performance and consistency.

patterns.name: Variables and constraints in mathematical expressions
patterns.context: Formulas and inequality constraints contain indexed variables and summations.

patterns.name: Mixed passages without a clear shared trigger
patterns.context: Forum comments discuss delegating work or product pricing; activations are scattered over common words and phrases, making it difficult to identify a specific semantic feature shared with other patterns.

6_1909.description: 激活分散于多类局部模式：否定、条件、比较及组合关系；代码分支、法律权利或程序、姓名分词、技术题目和数学符号。部分论坛片段缺少稳定共同触发，难以确定统一语义。

patterns.name: 不规则或数量/关系表达
patterns.context: 在否定、条件或比较结构中谈论是否整齐、相同、可预测，或涉及不同组合；各段触发词并不完全一致。
patterns.domain: 哲学社会理论、育种专利、日常讨论（1、8、9）

patterns.name: 代码中的条件分支
patterns.context: 程序代码里判断矩形宽高并进入条件分支。

patterns.name: 法律文本中的当事人或专利程序
patterns.context: 正式法律文书或法律说明，叙述专利上诉程序或被告的诉讼权利。
patterns.domain: 专利法、刑事诉讼法律文本（3、7）

patterns.name: 人名及其分词片段
patterns.context: 欧洲议会发言记录中，波兰议员姓名被切分为多个 token。

patterns.name: 技术论文题目中的性能与一致性
patterns.context: URL 中包含机器学习论文题目，讨论卷积网络性能和一致性。

patterns.name: 数学表达中的变量与约束
patterns.context: 公式及不等式约束中出现变量下标和求和式。

patterns.name: 缺少明确共同触发的混合片段
patterns.context: 论坛评论谈委派工作或产品定价；可见激活分散在常见词和短语上，难以归结为与其他模式相同的特定语义。

en.description: Activations are scattered across multilingual parliamentary texts, prose, webpages, and experimental literature. More salient examples include the letter strings ver/ing within words and numbers and punctuation in URLs, but the markers are unstable, alongside several isolated words and numbers.

patterns.name: The “ing” substring within words
patterns.context: Trigger positions are often within words split into subwords in multilingual texts; they do not correspond to a fixed meaning or syntactic position.

patterns.name: The “ver” substring within words
patterns.context: Appears responsive to different word forms or strings containing the letters ver, with inconsistent meanings and contexts.
patterns.domain: Philosophical prose, URLs/code, forum text, Swedish parliamentary texts

patterns.name: Numeric and punctuation sequences in URLs
patterns.context: Numeric dates, slashes, and hyphens occur adjacent to URL paths.

patterns.name: Swedish word-final or word-internal er
patterns.context: Appears in Swedish parliamentary texts and in names/word forms; the specific trigger boundary is unstable.

patterns.name: Sporadic token activations
patterns.context: Only local words or numbers are marked in each segment, with no shared semantic, grammatical, or formatting condition.
patterns.domain: Experimental methods, parliamentary speeches, forum discussions

6_1909.concept: 不稳定的子词/字符片段检测
6_1909.description: 激活分散于多语种议会文本、散文、网页和实验文献；较显眼的是词内 ver/ing 字母串及网址数字标点，但标记不稳定，另有若干孤立词和数字。

patterns.name: 整词内部的「ing」子串
patterns.trigger: 英文字词中的后缀/子串，如 «g»ens«id»ig（第2段）、«Animal»（第4段）、«optim»izing（第9段）和 «h»armon«ious»（第1段）
patterns.context: 触发位置多在多语种文本中由子词切分出来的词内部；并非固定词义或固定句法位置

patterns.name: 整词内部的「ver」子串
patterns.context: 似乎对包含字母串 ver 的不同词形或字符串有反应，词义与上下文不一致
patterns.domain: 哲学散文、网址/代码、论坛文本、瑞典语议会文本

patterns.name: 网址中的数字与标点序列
patterns.context: 数字日期、斜线、连字符及网址路径相邻出现

patterns.name: 瑞典语词尾或词内 er
patterns.trigger: «er»（第5段 Podkań«ski»9 前的姓名词尾区域）；第2段的 «re»、«ens» 等分词片段
patterns.context: 出现在瑞典语议会文本及姓名/词形中，具体触发边界不稳定

patterns.name: 零散 token 激活
patterns.trigger: «rats» 前的 «200»-«250» «g»（第4段）；«Não»«só»（第6段）；«piuttosto»（第7段）；«as»«a»（第8段）
patterns.context: 各段只有局部词或数字被标记，缺乏共同的语义、语法或格式条件
patterns.domain: 实验方法、议会发言、论坛讨论

en.concept: Local word forms and structures in heterogeneous text
en.description: High activations occur across heterogeneous text types: English emphasis with ever, code branches, numeric encoding and URLs, paper formulas and terminology, experimental methods, and Swedish parliamentary words; there is no clear shared trigger pattern spanning all passages.

patterns.name: Emphatic use of ever in English sentences
patterns.context: ever occurs in the structure if it ever really did, emphasizing doubt about whether the preceding situation was ever true; nearby sentences discuss the coordination of society and the self.

patterns.name: Numbers, punctuation, and encoded fragments
patterns.context: Long strings of apparently random numbers, letters, URL encoding, and path characters are interleaved, with little natural-language syntax.

patterns.name: JavaScript else branch
patterns.context: An else branch follows an if branch in code, creates an object, and handles module imports; highlighting concentrates on else.

patterns.name: Values and units in methods and materials sections
patterns.context: Animal experiment methods describe strain, sex, age, weight range, and units in close proximity; wavelengths and values also occur.

patterns.name: Web URL and domain paths
patterns.context: Web-scraped text consists mainly of domains, article-title paths joined by hyphens, and feed paths, mixed with residual web markup.

patterns.name: News article URL paths
patterns.context: News site links consist of a domain, section path, title words, and date, followed by an article-body delimiter.

patterns.name: LaTeX mathematical expressions
patterns.context: Sets, subscripts, superscripts, inequalities, fractions, and function symbols occur densely; this is formula text rather than natural language.

patterns.name: Swedish political parliamentary text
patterns.context: A Swedish parliamentary speech addresses the Speaker and mentions the foreign minister, the Council President, and members of parliament; activation falls on Swedish word forms and titles.

patterns.name: Dark matter physics terminology
patterns.context: Discusses ultralight dark matter particles as a classical field and their coherence time, with literature citations and formulas.

patterns.name: Swedish parliamentary titles and names
patterns.context: Swedish parliamentary records contain forms of address, country abbreviations, and members’ names; these belong to the same parliamentary corpus as passage 8, but the specific highlighted words differ.

6_1909.concept: 异质文本中的局部词形与结构
6_1909.description: 高激活分布在多类异质文本：英文 ever 强调、代码分支、数字编码与 URL、论文公式及术语、实验方法，以及瑞典语议会词句；没有贯穿所有段的明确共同触发模式。

patterns.name: 英语句中 ever 的强调用法
patterns.context: 句中 ever 位于 if it ever really did 结构，强调对前述情况是否曾经成立的怀疑；邻近句子谈社会与自我的协调。

patterns.name: 数字、标点与编码片段
patterns.context: 长串似随机的数字、字母、URL 编码和路径字符交错，缺少自然语言句法。

patterns.name: JavaScript else 分支
patterns.context: 代码中 if 分支之后出现 else 分支，创建对象并处理模块导入；高亮集中于 else。

patterns.name: 方法与材料小节中的数值和单位
patterns.context: 动物实验方法描述中，动物品系、性别年龄、体重范围和单位相邻出现；另有波长与数值。

patterns.name: 网页 URL 与域名路径
patterns.context: 网页抓取文本以域名、连字符连接的文章标题路径和 feed 路径为主，夹杂网页残留标记。

patterns.name: 新闻文章 URL 路径
patterns.context: 新闻网站链接由域名、栏目路径、标题词和日期构成，后接文章正文分隔符。

patterns.name: LaTeX 数学表达式
patterns.context: 集合、上下标、不等式、分数和函数符号密集出现，属于公式而非自然语言。

patterns.name: 瑞典语政治议会文本
patterns.trigger: « Jag»2 vill hälsa den fr«ans»1«ke»3 utri«kes»1ministern«,»2« r»2åd«ets»5 ordförande
patterns.context: 瑞典语议会发言，称呼议长并提及外交部长、理事会主席及议员；激活落在瑞典语词形和官职词。

patterns.name: 暗物质物理学术语
patterns.trigger: ultralight« DM»3« particles»1 behave as« a»1« classical»1 field
patterns.context: 讨论超轻暗物质粒子作为经典场及其相干时间，夹有文献引用和公式。

patterns.name: 瑞典语议会官职与姓名
patterns.context: 议会记录中的瑞典语发言称谓、国家缩写及议员姓名；与第 8 段同属议会语料，但具体高亮词不同。

en.description: Primarily responds to URL path structure, especially slugs ending in a slash; also covers dates and path fragments. Two isolated patterns involve Swedish word fragments and LaTeX formula closing markers.

patterns.name: Trailing slash in URL paths
patterns.context: Activation is strongest at the end of a URL title slug, followed by a newline or post body; often co-occurs with dates and hyphen-separated paths
patterns.domain: Article links in HackerNews and StackExchange posts

patterns.name: URL dates and path fragments
patterns.context: Occurs in URL paths after the domain; some fragments also cover article slugs, and the trailing slash may be absent or truncated

patterns.name: Swedish word fragments
patterns.context: Words are split into subword fragments in Swedish sentences; «verkligen» stands out

patterns.name: Mathematical formula closing markers
patterns.context: At the end of a LaTeX mathematical formula environment, near aligned formulas and symbol descriptions

6_1909.description: 主要响应文章 URL 的路径结构，尤其以斜杠结束的 slug；也覆盖日期及路径片段。另有瑞典语词片段和 LaTeX 公式结束标记两类孤立模式。

patterns.name: 网址路径末尾斜杠
patterns.trigger: URL 文章路径末尾的 «/»，如 «experience/»、«young-lawyers/»、«scientists/»、«ConvNets/»、«raspberry/»、«crash/»、«america/»
patterns.context: 网址标题 slug 结束、后接换行或帖子正文时激活最强；常与日期和连字符分隔的路径同现
patterns.domain: HackerNews、StackExchange 帖子中的文章链接

patterns.name: 网址日期及路径片段
patterns.context: 出现在域名后的 URL 路径中；部分片段也覆盖文章 slug，且路径末尾斜杠可能缺失或被截断

patterns.name: 瑞典语词片段
patterns.context: 瑞典语句子中，词被分词切开；突出词 «verkligen»

patterns.name: 数学公式收尾标记
patterns.context: LaTeX 数学公式环境结束处，邻近对齐公式和符号说明

en.concept: Structural boundaries and salient subword fragments
en.description: Activations occur in code conditional branches, structures in French sentences, English sentence boundaries, URLs and formula markers, and business-text keywords; they show a clear bias toward structural boundaries and salient subword fragments, but trigger conditions differ across domains.

patterns.name: Sentence-final and clause boundaries in English
patterns.context: Activations concentrate where clauses progress, sentences conclude, or sentences shift in English prose, especially in the parenthetical clause “if it ever really did”.

patterns.name: JavaScript conditional branches and line breaks
patterns.context: Code contains conditionals, especially else if branches; activations also occur near line breaks, indentation, and branch-ending punctuation.

patterns.name: Geometric dimension conditional branches in JavaScript
patterns.context: A conditional checks whether rectangle dimensions exist or are truthy, then updates geometric properties in an else if branch.

patterns.name: Emphatic words in French connective structures
patterns.context: Contrastive, additive, or demonstrative expressions in French sentences; activation falls on subword fragments and function words within sentences.

patterns.name: Retail and personalized manufacturing terms
patterns.context: Discusses small-batch custom manufacturing, personalized production, and their impact on retail.

patterns.name: Numbers and path separators in URLs
patterns.context: Protocols, paths, and date numbers in web links; activation is scattered across URL subword fragments.

patterns.name: URLs, news links, and separators
patterns.context: Path and date portions of news article URLs, followed by a separator line made of equals signs.

patterns.name: Commands and formula boundaries in LaTeX mathematical expressions
patterns.context: Formula layout commands, fractions, and mathematical symbols occur densely near document-ending markers and the transition to body text.

6_1909.concept: 结构边界与显著分词片段
6_1909.description: 激活分布于代码的条件分支、法语句中结构、英语句界、网址与公式标记，以及商业文本关键词；明显偏向结构边界和高显著分词片段，但跨领域触发条件不一致。

patterns.name: 英文句子中的句末与从句边界
patterns.context: 激活集中在英语散文中从句推进、句末收束或句子转折处，尤其是“if it ever really did”这一插入式从句。

patterns.name: JavaScript 条件分支与代码换行
patterns.context: 代码中出现条件判断，尤其是 else if 分支；也出现在换行、缩进以及分支结束的标点附近。

patterns.name: JavaScript 中几何尺寸条件分支
patterns.context: 条件判断检查矩形尺寸是否存在或为真，并在 else if 分支中更新几何属性。

patterns.name: 法语连接结构中的强调词
patterns.context: 法语句子中的对照、递进或指示表达；激活落在分词片段及句中功能词上。

patterns.name: 零售与个性化制造相关词
patterns.context: 讨论小批量定制制造、个性化生产及其对零售业的影响。

patterns.name: 网址中的数字与路径分隔符
patterns.context: 网页链接中的协议、路径和日期数字；激活分散在网址的分词片段。

patterns.name: 网址、新闻链接与分隔线
patterns.context: 新闻文章 URL 的路径和日期部分，后接由等号构成的分隔行。

patterns.name: LaTeX 数学表达式中的命令与公式边界
patterns.context: 公式排版命令、分式和数学符号密集出现，接近文档结束标记及正文衔接处。

en.description: Activations occur in Swedish word-form fragments, legal-document formatting and trial narratives, LaTeX formula structures, one in manufacturing texts, and JavaScript conditional code; these contexts lack a clear common trigger.

patterns.name: Swedish word forms and syntactic fragments
patterns.context: Activation occurs on subword fragments within Swedish words or in continuous Swedish text; word-form fragments cross marker boundaries.

patterns.name: Case and citation formats in legal documents
patterns.context: Formatted content in legal opinions, including case page markers, court and procedural information, and attorney or judge signatures.
patterns.domain: U.S. case law and legal documents

patterns.name: Structural markers in mathematical formulas
patterns.context: Formula environments, matrices, or fractions in LaTeX mathematical typesetting, as well as vectors, matrix elements, and physical quantities; activation often falls on formula-structure tokens.

patterns.name: Near the word one
patterns.context: Activation falls on one in the phrase runs-of-one for customized production; only one example is available.

patterns.name: day in trial narratives
patterns.context: In accounts of court proceedings, day modifies trial to indicate that the trial lasted one day.

patterns.name: JavaScript conditional branch
patterns.context: AMD/CommonJS module-compatibility code in a function factory checks the types of define and exports.

6_1909.description: 激活分布于瑞典语词形片段、法律文书格式与审判叙述、LaTeX 公式结构、制造业文本中的 one，以及 JavaScript 条件代码；这些上下文缺少明确共同触发因素。

patterns.name: 瑞典语词形与句法片段
patterns.context: 激活出现在瑞典语词内部的分词片段，或瑞典语连续文本中；词形片段跨越标记边界。

patterns.name: 法律文书中的案件与引文格式
patterns.context: 法律意见书中，案件页码标记、法院与程序信息、律师或法官署名等格式化内容。

patterns.name: 数学公式的结构标记
patterns.context: LaTeX 数学排版中的公式环境、矩阵或分式，以及向量、矩阵元素和物理量；激活常落在公式结构 token 上。

patterns.name: 单词 one 附近
patterns.context: 定制化生产的 runs-of-one 表述中，激活落在 one；证据仅此一例。
patterns.domain: 制造业与零售业说明性文本

patterns.name: 审判叙述中的 day
patterns.context: 法院审理经过的叙述中，day 修饰 trial，表示审判持续一天。

patterns.name: JavaScript 条件分支
patterns.context: 函数工厂的 AMD/CommonJS 模块兼容代码中，检查 define 与 exports 的类型。

en.concept: Heterogeneous text fragments and emphatic expressions
en.description: Activations concentrate on expressions emphasizing truth, such as indeed and really; procedural steps or quantity distinctions in legal text, case captions, and lists of personal and institutional names; URLs also contain numeric paths.

patterns.name: Truth/emphasis
patterns.context: The word-final fragment of the Swedish adverb “verkligen” (indeed, really), or words emphasizing truth in the English expression “if it ever really did”
patterns.domain: Swedish parliamentary speech; English philosophical argument

patterns.name: Procedural steps and quantity distinctions
patterns.context: Describes the sequence of legal procedure steps, or distinguishes two offenses and whether they should be punished together
patterns.domain: Legal arguments in U.S. court opinions

patterns.name: Case-caption and litigation information format
patterns.context: Structured information at the beginning of a court opinion, including the case caption, docket number, hearing and decision dates

patterns.name: Numbers and path fragments in URLs
patterns.context: Date numbers, slashes, and hyphens tokenized into fragments in web links

patterns.name: Lists of case-related personal and institutional names
patterns.context: Lists lawyers, parties, or representative organizations in court opinions, often accompanied by commas, titles, and “for ...” descriptions
patterns.domain: U.S. court opinion captions or attorney appearance information

6_1909.concept: 异质文本片段与强调表达
6_1909.description: 激活集中于确实、真的等强调真实性表达；法律文本中的步骤或数量区分、判决标题与人名机构名列举；另见网址数字路径。

patterns.name: 真实/强调语气
patterns.context: 瑞典语副词“verkligen”（确实、真的）的词尾片段，或英语表达“if it ever really did”中的强调真实性词语
patterns.domain: 瑞典语议会发言；英语哲学论述

patterns.name: 程序步骤与数量区分
patterns.context: 描述法律程序的先后步骤，或区分两项犯罪及其是否应合并处罚

patterns.name: 判例标题与诉讼信息格式
patterns.context: 法院判决开头的案件标题、案号、审理与裁决日期等结构化信息

patterns.name: 网址中的数字与路径片段
patterns.context: 网页链接中按片段切分的日期数字、斜杠和连字符

patterns.name: 案件相关人名与机构名列举
patterns.trigger: «Waters»、«Kelly»、«Luti»、«Kapgan»、«Lockyer»等姓名片段，以及公司、机构名称
patterns.context: 判决书中列出律师、当事人或代理机构，通常伴随逗号、职位和“for ...”说明
patterns.domain: 美国判决书标题或律师出庭信息

en.description: Activations are concentrated mainly on punctuation, domains, and date paths in web URLs; they also occur on English ever, C loop index bounds checks, legal lists and docket markers, post separators, and possessive 's. These patterns span genres and show no single stable semantics.

patterns.name: Domains and paths in URLs
patterns.context: Web links, especially continuous URLs containing a domain, slashes, years, and dates; activation concentrates near path separators and numeric fragments
patterns.domain: Web headlines, blogs, and news links

patterns.name: English adverb ever
patterns.context: ever occurs in English clauses to emphasize whether something has ever happened or will happen; nearby contexts involve social judgment or hypotheses

patterns.name: Indexing and bounds checks in code
patterns.context: A C-style for loop compares array elements, increments an index, and ends the loop condition with a semicolon

patterns.name: People, institutions, and docket markers in legal documents
patterns.context: Lists of names, law firms, companies, and locations in legal documents; mixed with asterisks and numeric docket or page markers
patterns.domain: Court opinions, legal dockets, and party/attorney lists

patterns.name: Separators after web headlines or usernames
patterns.context: In HackerNews-style link-sharing text, headlines, URLs, and poster usernames are separated by newlines or equals signs; this co-occurs with the URL pattern, though the separator may contribute independently

patterns.name: Possessive or contraction apostrophes in noun phrases
patterns.context: A suffix in English possessives or contractions, following a noun

6_1909.concept: 异质文本中的结构标记
6_1909.description: 激活最集中于网页 URL 的标点、域名和日期路径，也见于英语 ever、C 循环索引边界检查、法律名单及案卷标记、帖子分隔符和所有格 's；这些模式跨文体，未显示单一稳定语义。

patterns.name: 网址中的域名与路径
patterns.trigger: “http://techcrunch.com/2010/05/24/…”、“crunch.com/2011/08/29/…”、“http://singularityhub.com/…”、“https://observer.com/…”中的 URL 标点、域名和日期路径
patterns.context: 网页链接，尤其是包含域名、斜线、年份及日期的连续 URL；激活集中在路径分隔符和数字片段附近
patterns.domain: 网页标题、博客与新闻链接

patterns.name: 英语副词 ever
patterns.trigger: “if it ever really did”及“should it ever decide”中的“ever”
patterns.context: ever 出现在英语从句中，用于强调某事是否曾经发生或将来是否发生；邻近语境涉及社会判断或假设

patterns.name: 代码中的索引与边界检查
patterns.trigger: “i < NUM_FREE_LISTS && size > size_class_limits[i]; i++”中的方括号索引“[i]”及分号
patterns.context: C 风格 for 循环中比较数组元素、递增索引并以分号结束循环条件

patterns.name: 法律文书中的人员、机构及案卷标记
patterns.trigger: “Grand River Equities”“Michigan Power Limited Partnership”“Jones, Day, Reavis & Pogue”及“*11”“*9534”
patterns.context: 姓名、律师事务所、公司和地点组成的法律文书列举；夹有星号与数字案卷或页码标记
patterns.domain: 法院意见、法律案卷与当事人/律师名单

patterns.name: 网页标题或用户名后的分隔符
patterns.trigger: “======”“↵”以及链接后出现的用户名，如“======↵yoshyosh”“======↵andrewcross”
patterns.context: HackerNews 风格的链接分享文本中，标题、URL 与发帖用户名以换行或等号分隔；此处与 URL 模式共现，但分隔符可能另有贡献

patterns.name: 名词短语中的所有格或缩写撇号
patterns.context: 英语名词所有格或缩写的后缀，位于名词之后

en.concept: Text structure boundaries and formatting markers
en.description: High activations concentrate mainly on hyphens, slashes, and other boundaries in URL paths, as well as footnote asterisks and judge-signature markers in the fixed format of court opinions; they also occur on sentence-final emphasis words, Swedish word-internal fragments, and matrix row separators, without a shared trigger condition.

patterns.name: Word-breaking boundaries and hyphenated prefixes
patterns.context: Occurs in continuous URL-like paths, dates, and hyphenated titles; activation often falls on hyphens, slashes, and adjacent word fragments.
patterns.domain: Web links, news headlines, blogs, and forum text

patterns.name: Court opinion formatting markers
patterns.context: Occurs in the fixed layout of court opinions, often alongside judges’ names, case parties, or docket numbers; footnote asterisks are especially prominent.

patterns.name: Sentence-final or clause-closing words
patterns.context: A few passages activate on English sentence-final emphasis words or Swedish word-internal fragments; there is no clear shared formatting condition.

patterns.name: Matrix separators in mathematical formulas
patterns.context: Located at row separators in LaTeX pmatrix matrices; some numbers and operators also occur, but their activation is relatively weak.

6_1909.concept: 文本结构边界与格式标记
6_1909.description: 高激活主要集中于网址路径中的连字符、斜杠等边界，以及判决书固定格式的脚注星号和法官署名标记；另见句末强调词、瑞典语词内片段和矩阵行分隔符，未能归入共同触发条件。

patterns.name: 断词边界与连字符前缀
patterns.trigger: «-»、«/»、«.»，以及 URL 中紧邻这些符号的片段，如 «-»«foot»、«-»«experience»
patterns.context: 出现在网址或类似网址的连续路径、日期和连字符标题中；激活常落在连字符、斜杠及相邻词片段上。
patterns.domain: 网页链接、新闻标题、博客与论坛文本

patterns.name: 法院判决格式标记
patterns.trigger: «*»«9»、«PER» CURIAM«:*»、«Before:»，以及法官姓名、«Circuit Judges» 周边
patterns.context: 出现在法院意见书的固定版式中，常伴随法官名单、案件当事人或案号；星号脚注标记尤其突出。
patterns.domain: 美国联邦法院判决文本

patterns.name: 句末或从句收束词
patterns.context: 少数段落在英文句末强调词或瑞典语词内片段处激活；没有明显统一的格式条件。
patterns.domain: 哲学论述；瑞典语议会文本

patterns.name: 数学公式中的矩阵分隔符
patterns.context: 位于 LaTeX pmatrix 中矩阵行的换行分隔符；同时有若干数字和运算符，但其激活相对较弱。

en.description: Activations commonly occur on boundary markers in structured text: URL paths and extensions, pagination in legal documents, paper headings and units, and loop syntax in code. Other examples include specific names and rare words in prose. A shared cross-domain factor is unclear.

patterns.name: URL paths and file extensions
patterns.context: When consecutive URLs, domains, or file paths occur, activation concentrates near path boundaries, numeric dates, and filenames at the end; some segments also activate on punctuation or line breaks after URLs.
patterns.domain: Web links, news links, StackExchange and HackerNews text

patterns.name: Legal ruling layout and pagination markers
patterns.context: Activation occurs at page numbers, asterisk pagination markers, headings, and aligned layouts in court opinions or rulings.
patterns.domain: U.S. court rulings and legal documents

patterns.name: Units and section structure in scientific paper methods
patterns.context: A paper transitions through a section heading into descriptions of experimental animals or methods, with measurement units, numbers, and Markdown-style heading separators.

patterns.name: Rare words and special names in prose
patterns.context: Specific names and rare words occur in natural-language paragraphs describing places, rivers, or ideas; this segment also contains line-break separators.

patterns.name: Loop boundaries and indices in C code
patterns.context: Near array indices, loop termination conditions, and statement punctuation in C-style for loops.

6_1909.description: 激活常见于结构化文本中的边界标记：网址路径与扩展名、法律文书的分页排版、论文标题和单位、代码循环语法；另有散文中特定名称及少见词。跨领域共同点不明确。

patterns.name: 网址路径与文件扩展名
patterns.trigger: 网址中的路径分隔符「/」、日期路径，以及结尾的「.com」「.pdf」等
patterns.context: 出现连续的 URL、域名或文件路径时，激活集中在路径边界、数字日期和末尾文件名附近；部分段也激活 URL 后的标点或换行
patterns.domain: 网页链接、新闻链接、StackExchange 和 HackerNews 文本

patterns.name: 法律判决排版与分页标记
patterns.trigger: 「*」「10」「369」以及「MEMORANDUM DECISION」前的版面空格、换行
patterns.context: 法院意见书或判决文本中的页码、星号分页标记、标题和对齐排版处激活
patterns.domain: 美国法院判决、法律文书

patterns.name: 科学论文方法部分的单位与章节结构
patterns.context: 论文以章节标题进入实验动物或方法描述，带有测量单位、数值和 Markdown 式标题分隔线

patterns.name: 散文中的少见词与特殊名称
patterns.context: 自然语言段落中，描述地点、河流或观念时出现特定名称和少见词；该段另有换行分隔

patterns.name: C 代码中的循环边界与索引
patterns.context: C 风格 for 循环中，数组索引、循环终止条件及语句标点附近

en.description: Activations are scattered across subword boundaries, URLs and mixed numeric strings, punctuation, and line breaks; they also occur in descriptions of research animals and legal document layouts, making them difficult to explain with a single semantic or grammatical feature.

patterns.name: Subword boundaries within or between words
patterns.context: Activation falls on tokenized fragments within words, word endings, or adjacent subword fragments such as numbers and hyphens; these examples span diverse corpora and show no stable semantic or grammatical condition.

patterns.name: Fragments in URLs, domains, and paths
patterns.context: Character fragments in URLs, domains, or paths, including punctuation, numbers, and letter sequences; passage 2 also contains hash-like mixed strings.

patterns.name: Numbers, punctuation, and special symbols
patterns.context: Activations occur near number strings, hyphens, percent signs, asterisks, decimal points, or line breaks; the specific combinations vary by passage.
patterns.domain: Mixed text, including URLs, legal text, and research papers

patterns.name: Experimental animals and methods descriptions in research papers
patterns.context: Methods sections describe rat strains, weights, ages, water supply, or animal sources; activations also occur near values and units.

patterns.name: Legal opinions and docket formatting
patterns.context: Court opinions, party names, or the body of a judgment; activation occurs in captions, name fragments, footnote markers, docket numbers, and line-break formatting, with no single legal term as a trigger.

6_1909.description: 激活分散在子词边界、网址与混合数字串、标点及换行等格式片段中；另见于论文实验动物描述和法律文书版式，难以由单一语义或语法特征解释。

patterns.name: 单词内部或相邻片段的子词边界
patterns.context: 激活落在被切分的词内片段、词尾，或数字与连字符等相邻子词片段上；但这些例子跨越多种语料，未显示稳定的词义或语法条件。
patterns.domain: 多领域文本与子词分词

patterns.name: URL、域名及路径中的片段
patterns.context: 网址、域名或路径中的字符片段，包括标点、数字及字母子串；第2段还包含类似哈希值的混合字符串。
patterns.domain: 网页、博客及代码相关文本

patterns.name: 数字、标点及特殊符号
patterns.context: 数字串、连字符、百分号、星号、小数点或换行符附近均有激活；各段具体组合不同。
patterns.domain: 混合文本；含网址、法律文本及科研论文

patterns.name: 科研论文中的实验动物与方法描述
patterns.trigger: 「Male adult« W»2istar alb«ino»1« rats」、「female« Spr»1ague-Daw«ley»2« rats」
patterns.context: 实验方法部分介绍大鼠品系、体重、年龄、供水或动物来源；同时在数值及单位附近出现激活。

patterns.name: 法律判决及案卷版式
patterns.context: 法院意见、当事人名称或判决正文；激活出现在标题、姓名片段、脚注标记、案号数字和换行排版处，未见单一法律术语触发。

en.description: Strong responses commonly occur on attorney signatures, case captions, and factual formats in legal documents. There are also responses to community-theory discourse, encoded strings on webpages, and device-orientation debugging text. Overall, legal text predominates, but there is no single trigger pattern.

patterns.name: Attorney names and counsel listings in legal documents
patterns.context: Appears in party and attorney appearance sections of rulings or legal documents; names, law firms, and locations commonly appear with “for [party]” and dense punctuation.

patterns.name: Legal case captions and court/date formats
patterns.context: Case captions or openings of rulings, containing fixed-format fields such as case numbers, court, date, and party identities.

patterns.name: Detainees and fees in legal case narratives
patterns.context: Factual narratives discussing detainees, prison services, and fee disputes.

patterns.name: Community norms and social-theory discourse
patterns.context: Academic discussions of community, norms, roles, and their breakdown.

patterns.name: URL-, hash-, or encoding-style strings
patterns.context: Long strings containing numbers, hexadecimal-like segments, hyphens, percent-encoding, and domains, resembling links or file identifiers.

patterns.name: Device orientation changes and debugging logs
patterns.context: Describes device orientation changes in a program and service/characteristic UUIDs, followed by debugging output.

6_1909.concept: 法律文书格式及专名密集文本
6_1909.description: 强响应常见于法律文书的律师署名、案件标题及案情格式；另对社区理论论述、网页编码字符串和设备方向调试文本也有响应，整体以法律文本为主但并非单一触发模式。

patterns.name: 法律文书中的律师姓名及代理方署名
patterns.trigger: 律师或律所姓名，后接逗号及“for”代理说明，如“David E.S. Marvin and Thomas J. Waters, for Dow Chemical Company”“Jones, Day, Reavis & Pogue”“for defendant Combustion Engineering, Inc.”
patterns.context: 出现在判决或法律文书的当事人、律师出庭信息部分；常见姓名、律所、地点与“for [当事方]”相连，标点密集。

patterns.name: 法律案件标题及法院和日期格式
patterns.trigger: “v.”、“Defendant.”、“No.”、“Supreme Court of Nebraska.”、“United States District Court, W.D. New York.”及日期
patterns.context: 案件标题或判决开头，包含案号、法院、日期、当事方身份等固定格式字段。

patterns.name: 法律案情中的被拘押者及费用
patterns.trigger: “pre-trial detainees incarcerated in the Marion County Jail”“charged … for medical and dental treatment”“one dollar per day for meal costs”
patterns.context: 讨论被羁押者、监狱服务及费用争议的案情叙述。

patterns.name: 社区规范与社会理论论述
patterns.trigger: “person able to locate their lives”“norms and roles of the community”“Some theorists mourn”
patterns.context: 探讨社区、规范、角色及其瓦解的学术论述。

patterns.name: URL、哈希或编码样式的字符串
patterns.context: 包含数字、十六进制样式片段、连字符、百分号编码及域名的长串，呈现为链接或文件标识。

patterns.name: 软件设备方向变化与调试日志
patterns.trigger: “device's orientation”“orientation change handler”“one last message will be printed”
patterns.context: 描述程序中设备方向变化及服务/特征 UUID，后接调试输出。

en.concept: Dutch articles and subword fragments, with heterogeneous examples
en.description: Primarily responds to Dutch text, especially the article «een», along with weak activation on Dutch word-internal fragments and prepositions; also includes a U.S. legal citation and an English genetics passage, each with a different activation pattern.

patterns.name: Indefinite article “een”
patterns.context: In Dutch sentences, the article is followed by a noun or noun phrase; in [2], it recurs in coordinated examples and descriptions of crises

patterns.name: Dutch word-internal fragments
patterns.context: Activation falls on substrings within Dutch words, including inflected forms, compounds, or subword fragments; the specific triggering contexts are inconsistent

patterns.name: Dutch prepositions and linking elements
patterns.context: Appears in sentences as a preposition, conjunction, or subword fragment; activation is weak, and some co-activates with surrounding Dutch fragments

patterns.name: Legal citation and case name
patterns.context: A citation consisting of a statute number, lettered subsections, and a U.S. litigation case name

patterns.name: Genetics and birth-defect statements
patterns.context: An English biomedical sentence mentioning mutations, human burden, inherited birth defects, and cancer

6_1988.concept: 荷兰语冠词与词片段，另有异质例
6_1988.description: 主要响应荷兰语文本，尤其是冠词«een»，并伴随荷兰语词内片段及介词等弱激活；另有一段美国法律引注和一段英语遗传学文本，触发模式各异。

patterns.name: 不定冠词“een”
patterns.context: 荷兰语句子中冠词后接名词或名词短语；[2] 中重复出现在并列举例和危机描述里
patterns.domain: 荷兰语议会发言、哲学文本

patterns.name: 荷兰语词内片段
patterns.context: 激活落在荷兰语词的子串上，涵盖屈折形式、复合词或词内片段；具体触发环境不统一
patterns.domain: 荷兰语议会文本及哲学文本

patterns.name: 荷兰语介词及连接成分
patterns.context: 在句中作为介词、连词或词内片段出现，强度较弱，部分与周围荷兰语片段同时激活

patterns.name: 法律引注与案件名
patterns.context: 一段由法规编号、字母分项和美国诉讼案件名构成的引注

patterns.name: 遗传学与出生缺陷表述
patterns.context: 英语生物医学句子，提及突变、人类负担、遗传性出生缺陷与癌症

en.concept: Dutch indefinite article and local word forms
en.description: Most samples are in Dutch, with the indefinite article «een» before nouns as the most stable trigger; there are also sporadic prepositions and within-word fragment activations. Two other passages respectively show legal citation formatting and English genetics terminology, which should not be grouped with the Dutch pattern.

patterns.name: Dutch article “een”
patterns.context: Used as an indefinite article before nouns, often in noun phrases such as “een prioriteit,” “een crisis,” “een belangrijke stap,” and “een lijn”; activation is concentrated on the word itself.
patterns.domain: Dutch parliamentary, academic, and general prose

patterns.name: Dutch “in” within or adjacent to words
patterns.context: Appears in the Dutch preposition “in” and adjacent word forms, such as “geweld in alle lidstaten,” “crisis in het zelfbegrip,” and “Akkoord inzake”; activation is weaker than for “een.”

patterns.name: Dutch compound-word or affix boundaries
patterns.context: Activation falls on fragments within Dutch words or on word endings, involving morphological components under subword segmentation; no consistent specific meaning is apparent.

patterns.name: Dutch grammatical or lexical fragments
patterns.context: Sporadic activation appears on various fragments or complete Dutch words, with no shared trigger more specific than the Dutch-language context.

patterns.name: Legal citation format
patterns.context: A U.S. case citation style made up of numbers, letters, and line breaks; distinct from the Dutch lexical pattern.

patterns.name: Genetics terminology and sentence-final connective
patterns.context: English medical sentences include genetics, genetic burden, and wording related to birth defects and cancer; activation spans multiple English subword fragments.
