patterns.context: In continuous Swedish text, activation falls on tokenized word fragments concerning evaluation, results, and further investigation; no stable single semantic word class is evident.

patterns.name: Variables and symbols in mathematical expressions
patterns.context: Formulas and function calls are interspersed with exponentiation; activation is distributed across variables, parentheses, equals signs, exponents, and nearby line breaks.

patterns.name: Activity and enhancement effects in drug research
patterns.context: A pharmacology abstract compares drugs and compounds and reports the fold increase in drug accumulation and relative comparisons.

patterns.name: Research progress and impact relations
patterns.context: A project description states that data collection has had a significant impact on ongoing research.

patterns.name: Personal evaluation and reputation
patterns.context: Biographical text assesses a sculptor’s standing, artistic identity, and international reputation.

patterns.name: Dimensional ratios and device design
patterns.context: A patent background describes device length and width and the design relationship between large and small devices.

6_1988.description: 激活分散于多语种文本、医学与专利术语、数学符号及人物评价中，常落在名词短语、比较关系、词内子词片段或结构标记；没有贯穿所有段的稳定语义模式。

patterns.name: 日语片假名与汉字中的「が／た」类助词或词素
patterns.context: 日语句子中，汉字与假名混排；激活落在词内字符或语法成分上，特别是「届いたらどう対…」附近。
patterns.domain: 日语问答／网络安全提醒

patterns.name: 名词短语的中心词及其修饰语
patterns.context: 医学摘要中的名词短语；多个连续 token 描述测量对象，中心词 head 激活最强。

patterns.name: 年龄范围与血小板相关术语
patterns.context: 描述某种物质被血小板摄取，并按亚群年龄范围限定；激活集中在年龄范围表达。
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文及公式附近

patterns.name: 适用性、制造过程与机器加工
patterns.context: 专利背景段落讨论移植物材料是否适合使用，以及不合适材料经加工造成的时间成本。

patterns.name: 瑞典语词内子词片段
patterns.context: 瑞典语连续文本中，激活落在切分后的词片段，涉及评估、结果与进一步调查；未见稳定的单一语义词类。

patterns.name: 数学表达式中的变量和符号
patterns.context: 公式、函数调用及幂运算混排，激活分布于变量、括号、等号、指数和换行附近。

patterns.name: 药物研究中的活性与增强效应
patterns.context: 药理学摘要对照药物及化合物，报告药物积累增强倍数和相对比较。

patterns.name: 研究进展与影响关系
patterns.context: 项目描述说明数据收集对仍在进行的研究产生显著影响。

patterns.name: 人物评价与声誉
patterns.context: 传记文字评价雕塑家的地位、艺术家身份和国际声誉。

patterns.name: 尺寸比例与器件设计
patterns.context: 专利背景描述器件长度、宽度及大小器件之间的尺寸设计关系。

en.description: Activation concentrates on biomedical research texts, especially accounts of recent or prior work, attribution to research teams, and research progress, as well as descriptions of mechanisms, disease associations, clinical effects, or health outcomes; some activation falls on generic academic words.

patterns.name: Research narrative using previous/recent work
patterns.context: In medical or biological papers, reviews earlier studies or introduces recent findings by a research team; work often occurs with by/our/team/group/collaborator.
patterns.domain: Biomedical papers and research grant abstracts

patterns.name: Attribution of research findings and progress
patterns.context: Describes links between disease, effects, or treatment progress and some factor, mechanism, or scientific understanding.

patterns.name: Biomedical mechanisms and cellular activity
patterns.context: Discusses the function, composition, development, or abnormal mechanisms of cells, tissues, or biological processes.
patterns.domain: Molecular biology, neuroscience, cardiac research, and plankton research

patterns.name: Clinical or health-related outcomes and risks
patterns.context: Concerns disease, exposure, injury, clinical outcomes, or health risks.
patterns.domain: Clinical medicine, epidemiology, and public health

patterns.name: Common words and affixes in research writing
patterns.context: These words recur in multiple passages describing research background or findings; activation falls on the words themselves or their tokenized fragments, without a single specific terminological condition.

patterns.name: Technical biological descriptions not fitting a stable pattern
patterns.context: Specific descriptions of sample sources, microscopic composition, or experimental subjects that do not clearly fit the research narrative and medical-outcome patterns above.
patterns.domain: Kidney research and aquatic microbial ecology

6_1988.description: 激活集中于生物医学研究文本，尤其是回顾近期或既往工作、引述研究团队与研究进展，并描述机制、疾病关联、临床效应或健康结果；部分激活落在通用学术词上。

patterns.name: previous/recent work 研究叙述
patterns.trigger: “Previous work by our team showed”“our previous work”“Recent work by our collaborator”“recent work by our group”
patterns.context: 在医学或生物学论文中，回顾先前研究或引出团队近期研究成果；常见 work 与 by/our/team/group/collaborator 连用。
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文与研究资助摘要

patterns.name: 研究成果与进展的引述
patterns.context: 描述疾病、效应或治疗进展与某种因素、机制或科学认识之间的联系。
patterns.domain: 生物医学及公共卫生文本

patterns.name: 生物医学机制与细胞活动
patterns.context: 讨论细胞、组织或生物过程的功能、组成、发育或异常机制。
patterns.domain: 分子生物学、神经科学、心脏研究及浮游生物研究

patterns.name: 临床或健康相关结果与风险
patterns.context: 涉及疾病、暴露、损伤、临床结果或健康风险的说明。
patterns.domain: 临床医学、流行病学与公共卫生

patterns.name: 研究性表达中的常见词及词缀
patterns.context: 这些词在多段研究背景或成果叙述中重复出现；激活落在词本身或其分词片段上，未显示单一具体术语条件。

patterns.name: 未能归入稳定模式的技术性生物描述
patterns.context: 具体描述样本来源、微观组成或实验对象，但不明显符合上述研究叙述与医学结果模式。
patterns.domain: 肾脏研究及水生微生物生态

en.concept: Research narratives and terminology fragments in scientific texts
en.description: Activation occurs mainly in scientific texts, especially biomedical research background, reviews of prior work, and expressions linking mechanisms and results; terminology and within-word fragments, Danish subwords, and section-formatting markers also appear. The triggers are not uniform.

patterns.name: Research-background transition pattern “Previous work/studies…by our…”
patterns.context: A research paper or NIH project abstract first reviews prior work by the team, then introduces the current study; activation centers on Previous, work, by, our, team/group, and similar transition words.
patterns.domain: Biomedical papers and research project abstracts

patterns.name: Fragments in scientific terminology and technical names
patterns.context: Specialized entities, compound terms, or rare words segmented into subwords; activation is scattered across within-word fragments and adjacent grammatical tokens, with no consistent semantic trigger.

patterns.name: Hyphens and word-form fragments
patterns.context: May be influenced by word forms, tokenization boundaries, or adjacent punctuation; examples have different contexts.
patterns.domain: Abbreviations, terminology, and word forms in scientific texts

patterns.name: Danish word forms/subword fragments
patterns.context: Activation falls on multiple subword fragments within Danish words in sentences about the EU Services Directive.

patterns.name: Section headings, separators, and paragraph-structure markers
patterns.context: Activation occurs near section headings and document formatting structures, including line breaks and separators; it is uncertain whether formatting itself is the trigger.

patterns.name: Expressions of causation, association, or impact
patterns.context: Phrasing in biomedical discussion that connects mechanisms, factors, and outcomes; not every word in each phrase activates, so this may be a local adjacency effect.

patterns.name: Local collocations in other scientific narratives
patterns.context: Local words in general methods, research approaches, or research-history narratives that cannot be grouped into a more specific and consistent trigger pattern.
patterns.domain: Physics, biology, and research project texts

6_1988.concept: 科学文本中的科研叙述与术语片段
6_1988.description: 激活主要出现在科学文本，尤其生物医学研究背景、既有工作回顾和机制／结果关联表达；另见术语与词内片段、丹麦语子词，以及章节排版标记。触发条件并不统一。

patterns.name: “Previous work/studies…by our…”研究背景过渡句式
patterns.trigger: «Previous» work by our team showed that（1）；Previous studies by our group and others have indicated that（3）；This study/project… created by our group（5）
patterns.context: 科研论文或 NIH 项目摘要中，先回顾本团队既有工作、再引出当前研究；激活集中在 Previous、work、by、our、team/group 及相近衔接词
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文与科研项目摘要

patterns.name: 科学术语及专业名词中的片段
patterns.trigger: “ferroportin”（4）、“Nachtmann”（2）、“keratinocytes”（3）、“mitotic process”（6）、“neurodegeneration”（10）等词内或词邻近的标记片段
patterns.context: 专业实体、复合术语或被子词切分的罕见词；激活分散在词内片段与邻近语法 token，未见统一语义触发条件

patterns.name: 连字符及词形片段
patterns.trigger: “A-T”（10）、“CRs”（2）、“25,”及“idin-”（4）等带标记的短词或词内片段
patterns.context: 可能受词形、分词边界或标点邻接影响；各例上下文不同
patterns.domain: 科学文本中的缩写、术语和词形

patterns.name: 丹麦语词形／词片段
patterns.trigger: “væ k st”（7）、“gl æ del igt”、“unders ø ger”、“gen nem f ø res”等
patterns.context: 激活落在丹麦语词内部的多个子词片段，出现在欧盟服务指令相关句子中

patterns.name: 章节标题、分隔线与段落结构标记
patterns.trigger: “↵”、长等号分隔线、“Forward and reverse genetic approaches…”（9）
patterns.context: 章节标题及文档排版结构附近出现激活，包含换行与分隔符；是否由格式本身触发不确定
patterns.domain: PubMed Central 论文排版文本

patterns.name: 表因果、关联或影响的表达
patterns.context: 生物医学论述中连接机制、因素与结果的句式；激活并非每个短语中的所有词，可能只是局部邻接现象

patterns.name: 其他科学叙述中的局部搭配
patterns.context: 一般方法、研究路径或研究史叙述中的局部词语，无法归并为更明确且一致的触发模式
patterns.domain: 物理学、生物学及科研项目文本

en.description: Primarily activates on “involves” and the descriptions of specific processes or steps that follow it; also activates on reviews of prior research or teams, genetic screening and mutant identification, historical and origin narratives, and reviews of early work after citations.

patterns.name: Process descriptions following “involves”
patterns.context: The word appears in sentences introducing a method, procedure, synthesis route, or plan, followed by specific operations or steps; the neuron activates on the word and the nearby process description.
patterns.domain: Patent backgrounds, medical/chemical research, online narratives, technical descriptions

patterns.name: Research work and team attribution
patterns.context: Reviews prior research and states that it was conducted by the authors’ team or research group; stronger activation concentrates on “Previous/work/by”, with weaker activation on adjacent words.

patterns.name: Genetic methods and identification
patterns.context: Discusses genetic screening or methods used to identify mutants; the sentence includes genetic methods and identification.

patterns.name: Historical review and origin narrative
patterns.context: Uses a historical or origin framework to explain the breeding source and formation process of a breed.

patterns.name: Review of work after an academic citation
patterns.context: Reviews earlier research after a reference; similar to prior-research descriptions in biomedicine, but this example is from a numerical methods paper.

6_1988.description: 主要对“involves”及其引出的具体过程或步骤说明激活；另对先前研究/团队回顾、遗传学筛选与突变体鉴定、历史和起源叙述，以及引文后的早期工作回顾有激活。

patterns.name: “involves” 后接过程说明
patterns.context: 该词出现在介绍某种方法、程序、合成路线或方案的句子中，后面紧接具体操作或步骤；神经元对词本身及其附近过程描述激活。
patterns.domain: 专利背景、医学/化学研究、网络叙述、技术说明

patterns.name: 研究工作与团队归属
patterns.trigger: “Previous work by our team” / “Previous studies by our group”
patterns.context: 回顾先前研究，并说明研究由作者团队或研究组完成；较强激活集中在“Previous/work/by”，相邻词也有较弱激活。

patterns.name: 遗传学方法与鉴定
patterns.trigger: “Forward and reverse genetic approaches for identification of mutants” / “with forward genetic screens”
patterns.context: 讨论遗传学筛选或方法用于识别突变体，句中包含遗传方法和 identification。

patterns.name: 历史回顾及起源叙述
patterns.context: 以历史或起源为框架，说明某品种的培育来源及其形成过程。
patterns.domain: 面向读者的猫品种介绍

patterns.name: 学术引文后的工作回顾
patterns.context: 参考文献之后回顾早期研究；与生物医学中的先前研究表述相似，但此处是数值方法论文。

en.concept: English relational prepositions and discourse links
en.description: Activation is distributed across several English prepositions and their academic uses: with often introduces a starting point, source, or accompanying entity; by, involves, through, via, and to respectively introduce researchers, methods, mechanisms, pathways, and outcomes. Their commonality is limited.

patterns.name: with introducing a source or starting point
patterns.context: Occurs near expressions of beginning such as began, began, and started, or introduces the source or starting point of work, methods, genetic screening, and so on; standalone with also activates weakly.
patterns.domain: Academic papers, historical narratives, and general expository prose

patterns.name: by introducing researchers or methods
patterns.context: by follows work and precedes a research team or author, introducing prior research.

patterns.name: involves introducing a method or approach
patterns.context: Used to describe what a method, process, or approach includes; activation occurs in rinsing and research-plan contexts.

patterns.name: through introducing a mechanism or pathway
patterns.context: through introduces a mechanism, signaling pathway, or process that leads to an outcome.

patterns.name: via introducing a mediating pathway
patterns.context: via introduces the viral sensing pathway on which immune activation depends.

patterns.name: to introducing an outcome or inference
patterns.context: Introduces a consequence or inference resulting from an activity in scientific argumentation, often in the structure should have led to.

6_1988.concept: 英语关系介词及论述连接
6_1988.description: 激活分布在若干英语介词及其学术用法上：with 常引出起点、来源或伴随对象；by、involves、through、via、to 分别引出研究者、方法、机制、途径和结果。共同点较弱。

patterns.name: with 引出来源或起点
patterns.context: 与 began、began、started 等表示开始的表达相邻，或用于引出工作、方法、遗传筛选等的来源或起点；单独的 with 也有较弱激活。
patterns.domain: 学术论文、历史叙述及一般说明文

patterns.name: by 引出研究者或方法
patterns.context: by 紧接 work，后接研究团队或作者，介绍既有研究。

patterns.name: involves 引出方法或方案
patterns.context: 用于说明一种方法、过程或方案包含、涉及什么；激活出现在 rinsing 和研究方案语境中。
patterns.domain: 专利技术说明、医学论文

patterns.name: through 引出机制或途径
patterns.context: through 引出导致结果的机制、信号通路或过程。
patterns.domain: 生物医学研究与资助摘要

patterns.name: via 引出介导途径
patterns.context: via 引出免疫激活所依赖的病毒感知途径。

patterns.name: to 引出结果或推论
patterns.context: 在科学论证中引出某种活动所导致的后果或推论，常见结构为 should have led to。

en.concept: Expressions of origin or backward reference
en.description: Strong activation often occurs on the prepositions to/with in expressions of retrospection or origin, especially “began/started with”, “originated with”, and “traced back to”; to also appears in restriction, inference, and range constructions, with meanings that do not fully align.

patterns.name: began/started with
patterns.context: Describes the origin, beginning, or early development of a field, technology, or process; activation concentrates on “with” and the following content.
patterns.domain: Scientific papers, patent backgrounds, philosophical discussions, online narratives

patterns.name: Originating with a person or idea
patterns.context: Explicitly states that an idea or hypothesis can be traced to a specific person or reference.

patterns.name: Tracing back to a constituent basis
patterns.context: States that a property or result can be traced back to its components; activation falls on “back to the”.

patterns.name: to introducing a restriction or object
patterns.context: Used in “limited to” to indicate a scope or object of restriction; activation mainly falls on “to”.

patterns.name: to introducing a result
patterns.context: Follows the inference structure “probably” and introduces a possible result; activation falls on “to”.

patterns.name: to in a temporal/prepositional construction
patterns.context: Appears in the comparative structure “intermediate- to high-redshift” before “in the last decade”; this may be an incidental pattern distinct from other uses of to.

6_1988.description: 强激活常见于回溯或起始表达中的介词 to/with，尤其 “began/started with”“originated with”“traced back to”；另见限制、推论及范围结构中的 to，语义并不完全一致。

patterns.name: began/started with
patterns.context: 描述某领域、技术或过程的起源、开端或早期发展；激活集中在 “with” 及后续内容。
patterns.domain: 科学论文、专利背景、哲学论述、网络叙事

patterns.name: 起源于某人或某观点
patterns.context: 明确指出某个思想或假说可追溯到特定人物或文献。

patterns.name: 回溯到组成基础
patterns.context: 说明性质或结果可追溯到其组成部分；激活落在 “back to the”。

patterns.name: to 引出的限制或对象
patterns.context: 用在 “limited to” 中表示适用范围或限制对象，激活主要落在 “to”。

patterns.name: to 引出的结果
patterns.context: 接在推论结构 “probably” 后，引出可能结果；激活落在 “to”。

patterns.name: 时间/介词结构中的 to
patterns.context: 出现在 “in the last decade” 之前的比较结构 “intermediate- to high-redshift” 中；可能是与其他 to 用法不同的偶然模式。

en.concept: Beginnings and progress in scientific narratives
en.description: Primarily responds to “with” introducing a process or condition and “advances” indicating scientific progress; it also responds to genetics/molecular science terminology, “Previously” in papers, and the end of Ruby test code blocks.

patterns.name: Strongest phrase following “with”
patterns.context: “with” is a preposition introducing a starting point, accompanying condition, or method, followed by a specific process or entity; the phrase sometimes spans paragraph boundaries.
patterns.domain: Academic papers, patent background, online narratives

patterns.name: “advances” and its modifiers
patterns.context: Describes progress in a field, often collocating with “recent,” “major,” or “substantial,” and may appear in a sentence as “advances continue to be reported.”

patterns.name: Genetics and molecular biology terminology
patterns.context: Occurs in technical discussions of genetic screening, gene manipulation, or molecular chemistry.

patterns.name: Research-progress statements in academic reviews
patterns.context: Research narratives use “Previously” to introduce earlier work; activation is concentrated on that word rather than clearly co-occurring words in context.
patterns.domain: Research paper abstracts or project descriptions

patterns.name: Closing structure in Ruby test code
patterns.context: In an RSpec-style test snippet, nested code blocks close with indentation and consecutive “end” statements.

6_1988.concept: 科学叙述中的起始与进展
6_1988.description: 主要响应“with”引入过程或条件，以及科学文本中表示研究进展的“advances”；另对遗传/分子科学术语、论文中的“Previously”和Ruby测试代码块结束处有响应。

patterns.name: “with”后接最高强度短语
patterns.context: “with”作为引入起始点、伴随条件或方法的介词，后接具体过程或对象；短语本身有时跨段落边界。
patterns.domain: 学术论文、专利背景、网络叙述

patterns.name: “advances”及其修饰语
patterns.context: 描述某领域取得进展，常与“recent”“major”“substantial”搭配，也可能在句中以“advances continue to be reported”出现。

patterns.name: 遗传与分子生物学术语
patterns.context: 出现在遗传筛选、基因操作或分子化学的专业阐述中。

patterns.name: 学术回顾中的研究进展表述
patterns.context: 科研叙述以“Previously”引出此前工作；其激活集中于该词，而非明显与上下文共现的词。
patterns.domain: 科研论文摘要或项目描述

patterns.name: Ruby 测试代码中的结束结构
patterns.context: RSpec 风格测试片段中，嵌套的代码块以缩进和连续的“end”闭合。

en.description: Activations are scattered across multiple contexts: initial or associative expressions introduced by with, subword fragments within Greek words, medical scope restrictions, Ruby test-code structures, and emotional descriptions using left her in sports reporting; there is no single stable trigger pattern.

patterns.name: Opening/accompanying phrase after “with”
patterns.context: When describing the starting point, components, or associated entities of a process, trend, or event; activation often falls near with and the following words.

patterns.name: Subword fragments within Greek word forms
patterns.context: In Greek parliamentary texts, activation falls on subword fragments within words composed of Greek letters; fragment positions vary across passages.

patterns.name: Continuous range in a restriction condition
patterns.context: When medical texts describe limits on the scope of applicable treatments or resources, activation increases along the restriction expression and the object defining the scope.

patterns.name: Ruby test-code structure
patterns.context: In Ruby test files, activation occurs at method declarations following class definitions and at code-block indentation.

patterns.name: Nested class declaration
patterns.context: When a nested class declaration appears in a Ruby source file, activation concentrates on the class keyword.

patterns.name: Emotions and pronouns after a transfer
patterns.context: Sports profiles describing someone as shocked or angry because of a transfer.

6_1988.description: 激活分散于多种语境：with 引出的起始或关联表达、希腊语词内片段、医学限制范围、Ruby 测试代码结构，以及体育报道中的 left her 情绪叙述；没有单一稳定触发模式。

patterns.name: “with”后的起始/伴随短语
patterns.trigger: “with”及其后的短语，如 “began with”, “started with”, “a trend ... for” 前文并含 “with”
patterns.context: 在叙述某过程、趋势或事件的起点、组成或关联对象时；激活常落在 with 附近及后续词上。

patterns.name: 希腊语词形内部片段
patterns.trigger: “αποφάσισε”中的分词片段 «σ»9，以及希腊语中的其他词内片段
patterns.context: 希腊语议会文本中，激活落在希腊字母构成的词内子词片段；不同段落片段位置不完全相同。

patterns.name: 限制条件中的连续范围
patterns.trigger: “has primarily been limited to small pediatric patients”
patterns.context: 医学文本描述治疗或资源适用范围受限时，激活沿限制表达及范围对象增强。

patterns.name: Ruby 测试代码结构
patterns.context: Ruby 测试文件中，类定义后的方法声明及代码块缩进处激活。

patterns.name: 嵌套类声明
patterns.context: Ruby 源文件中出现嵌套 class 声明时，激活集中在 class 关键字。

patterns.name: 转会后人物情绪与代词
patterns.context: 体育人物报道中，转会导致某人震惊或愤怒的叙述。

en.description: Primarily responds to the prepositional collocations with (origin, beginning) and to (referent being traced, person born, scope); there are also sporadic instances of involving, an email line break, and an unclear Hungarian activation.

patterns.name: with indicating origin or beginning
patterns.context: Occurs in collocations describing where something began or originated; also appears in narratives such as “began with following procedure.”
patterns.domain: Patents, news, philosophy, and astrophysics texts

patterns.name: to indicating attribution, object, or restriction
patterns.context: Occurs in verb or adjective collocations, connecting the referent being traced, the person born, or the applicable scope.

patterns.name: Procedural description involving animal experiments
patterns.context: The methods section states that animal experiments followed institutional guidelines.

patterns.name: Line break in an email
patterns.context: After arranging a meeting time in the email body, a line break precedes a question about whether the time is suitable.

patterns.name: Hungarian word-form fragments
patterns.context: Hungarian parliamentary text discussing opportunities for people still in custody to gain access; the specific lexical or semantic feature corresponding to activation is unclear.

6_1988.description: 主要响应介词搭配中的 with（起源、开端）和 to（追溯对象、出生对象、范围）；另见 involving、邮件换行及一段无法明确解释的匈牙利语激活。

patterns.name: with 表示起源或开端
patterns.context: 出现在描述某事物从何开始、由什么起源的搭配中；也见于“began with following procedure”这类叙述
patterns.domain: 专利、新闻、哲学及天体物理文本

patterns.name: to 表示归因、对象或限制
patterns.context: 位于动词或形容词搭配中，连接追溯对象、出生对象或适用范围
patterns.domain: 化学、传记、生物医学文本

patterns.name: 涉及动物实验的程序描述
patterns.context: 方法部分说明动物实验遵循机构规范

patterns.name: 邮件中的换行
patterns.context: 邮件正文中安排会议时间后，换行并询问时间是否合适

patterns.name: 匈牙利语词形片段
patterns.trigger: “felvétel”及其周围的匈牙利语词片段
patterns.context: 匈牙利语议会文本，讨论仍在羁押者可能获得接触的机会；激活具体对应何种词法或语义特征不明

en.description: Activations concentrate on several local forms: target phrases introduced by the prepositions to/toward, left expressing a vacancy, leading indentation spaces in code, and bring attention in community contexts. The trigger conditions are not uniform.

patterns.name: Preposition to in prepositions and prepositional phrases
patterns.context: Occurs after a verb or relational expression, linking a goal, result, or object; in all examples, to/toward is followed by a noun phrase
patterns.domain: Biomedical abstracts, chemical descriptions, patent backgrounds

patterns.name: left in expressions of absence or vacancy
patterns.context: Indicates that someone left a vacancy; followed by a person’s name or void; syntax and meaning are similar

patterns.name: Indentation spaces in program code
patterns.context: Leading indentation within code blocks, especially near Ruby tests or class definitions

patterns.name: bring expressing the evocation of memories
patterns.context: Linked to “revive the community,” indicating drawing attention or contributing to revival

6_1988.description: 激活集中于若干局部形式：介词 to/toward 引出的目标短语、表示留下空缺的 left、代码中的行首缩进空格，以及社区语境中 bring attention。触发条件并不统一。

patterns.name: 介词与介词短语中的 to
patterns.context: 出现在动词或关系表达之后，连接目标、结果或对象；各例中 to/toward 后接名词短语
patterns.domain: 生物医学摘要、化学说明、专利背景

patterns.name: 缺失或空缺表达中的 left
patterns.context: 表示某人离开后留下空缺，后接人名或 void；句法和意义相近

patterns.name: 程序代码中的缩进空格
patterns.context: 代码块内的行首缩进，尤其是 Ruby 测试或类定义附近

patterns.name: 表达唤起记忆的 bring
patterns.context: 与“revive the community”相连，表示带来关注或促成复兴
patterns.domain: 社区介绍或宣传性文字

en.description: Activation is heterogeneous: line breaks, indentation, and declarations in code are prominent; other fragments fall on word endings, function words, or word-break boundaries, with sporadic references to role identity, research modifiers, and music releases. Some high-activation positions are difficult to group into a shared semantic pattern.

patterns.name: Derivational suffixes or word-final fragments
patterns.context: Activation falls on suffixes, word endings, or subword fragments within English words; examples include derived nouns and plurals, as well as Bulgarian word-final fragments.
patterns.domain: Texts across fields, including patents, research, news, parliamentary texts, and code

patterns.name: Structure and indentation in code
patterns.context: In Ruby code, activation occurs near line breaks, indentation spaces, and declarations or import statements.

patterns.name: Function words and word-to-word collocations
patterns.context: Occurs on high-frequency function words such as prepositions and articles in English sentences; positions and collocations vary, and some are adjacent to key words or phrases.
patterns.domain: Patent, news, research, and astrophysics texts

patterns.name: Word-break boundaries and tokenized fragments
patterns.context: Activation occurs near underscores, hyphens, and within-word segmentation in code; it may relate to tokenization boundaries. This pattern does not cover most non-code passages.

patterns.name: Occupation, role, or identity statements
patterns.context: Activation occurs when describing a person's occupation, role, or leadership identity, but only sporadically.

patterns.name: Consecutive emphatic words
patterns.context: Consecutive modifiers of research results, quantity, or importance in formal descriptions of an institution's contributions or research outcomes.

patterns.name: Band- and release-related words
patterns.context: Activation occurs near phrases in narratives about music releases and bands gaining attention.

6_1988.description: 激活分布很杂：代码中的换行、缩进和声明较突出；其他片段落在词尾、功能词或断词边界，也零散涉及角色身份、科研修饰语和音乐发行。部分高激活位置难以归为共同语义模式。

patterns.name: 派生后缀或词尾片段
patterns.context: 激活落在英语单词内部的后缀、词尾或子词片段；含有派生名词和复数形式，也有保加利亚语词尾片段。
patterns.domain: 跨领域文本，含专利、科研、新闻、议会及代码

patterns.name: 代码中的结构与缩进
patterns.context: Ruby 代码中，换行、缩进空格及声明或导入语句附近激活。

patterns.name: 功能词与词间搭配
patterns.context: 在英语句子中位于介词、冠词等高频功能词处；各段位置和搭配不一致，部分相邻于重点词或短语。
patterns.domain: 专利、新闻、科研及天体物理文本

patterns.name: 断词边界及分词片段
patterns.context: 代码中的下划线、连字符及词内分段附近出现激活，可能与分词边界有关；此模式不涵盖大多数非代码段。
patterns.domain: 代码、英文及其他语言文本

patterns.name: 职业、角色或身份表述
patterns.context: 涉及人物从事的职业、担任的角色或领导身份时激活，但仅零散出现。

patterns.name: 连续强调性词语
patterns.context: 研究机构贡献或科研成果的正式叙述中，连续修饰研究成果、数量或重要性。

patterns.name: 乐队与发行相关词语
patterns.context: 音乐作品发行与乐队获得关注的叙述中，激活落在相关短语附近。

en.description: Activations are distributed across code structures, JSON fields, segmented Cyrillic words, and specific terms and narrative fragments in biomedical, physics, breeding, and biotechnology texts; no single stable semantic trigger pattern is evident.

patterns.name: Class and identifier structures in code
patterns.context: Code files containing a newline, comment, or require/import statement, followed by a path, class definition, or namespace

patterns.name: Subword fragments within Slavic words
patterns.context: Cyrillic words are segmented into multiple subword tokens in continuous Bulgarian text

patterns.name: Research outcomes and institutional descriptions
patterns.context: Describes research institutions, research culture, and their contributions to biomedical breakthroughs

patterns.name: JSON metadata fields
patterns.context: JSON objects containing field names that begin with an underscore and their values

patterns.name: Findings and follow-up research in papers
patterns.context: Scientific papers describing material properties, superconductivity discoveries, and further research enabled by them

patterns.name: Phenotype identification and research requirements
patterns.context: Discusses ASD, model organisms, and gene suppression, and describes methods needed to identify convergent phenotypes

patterns.name: Plant crosses and trait transfer
patterns.context: Describes crossing a donor parent with a recurrent parent, then selecting individuals with the target phenotype

patterns.name: Research progress reports
patterns.context: Summarizes research progress or scientific objectives using reporting period as the time frame

patterns.name: Biotechnology processes and costs
patterns.context: Mentions process factors such as biomass production, growth media, protein purification, yield, and heterologous expression

6_1988.description: 激活分布于代码结构、JSON 字段、切分的西里尔语词，以及生物医学、物理、育种和生物技术文本中的特定术语与叙述片段；未见单一稳定语义触发模式。

patterns.name: 代码中的类与标识符结构
patterns.context: 代码文件中出现换行、注释或 require/import 语句，并接续路径、类定义或命名空间

patterns.name: 斯拉夫语词内片段
patterns.context: 西里尔字母词语被切分为多个子词 token，出现在连续的保加利亚语文本中

patterns.name: 研究成果与机构表述
patterns.trigger: « vital»2« role»4« in»3« the»3 generation of« numerous»3« innovative»3
patterns.context: 描述研究机构、科研文化及其对生物医学突破的贡献

patterns.name: JSON 元数据字段
patterns.context: JSON 对象中出现以下划线开头的字段名及其值

patterns.name: 论文中的发现与后续研究
patterns.context: 科学论文叙述材料性质、超导发现及其促成的进一步研究

patterns.name: 表型识别与研究要求
patterns.context: 讨论 ASD、模型生物和基因抑制，并说明识别汇聚表型所需的方法
patterns.domain: NIH 生物医学研究文本

patterns.name: 植物杂交与性状转移
patterns.context: 描述供体亲本与轮回亲本杂交后，筛选具有目标表型的个体

patterns.name: 研究进展报告
patterns.context: 以 reporting period 为时间框架，概述研究进展或科学目标
patterns.domain: NIH 研究项目进展文本

patterns.name: 生物技术工艺与成本
patterns.context: 谈及生物质生产、培养基、蛋白质纯化、产率及异源表达等工艺因素

en.description: to recurs across several text types, especially in retrospective expressions such as date/record/traced back to; there are also sporadic triggers in has been, within-word fragments of finance, file extensions, and the segmentation of sentence-initial Atherosclerosis, which cannot be grouped into one stable pattern.

patterns.name: Token activation after to
patterns.context: Strong activation follows to, often in expressions for a time origin or tracing back, such as “dates back to”; it also occurs in other structures such as infinitives, so it is not limited to one collocation.
patterns.domain: Various genres: patent background, encyclopedias, medical papers, and web text

patterns.name: Collocation “has been linked”
patterns.context: Occurs in “has been linked to the pathogenesis,” with activation concentrated on has, been, and linked.

patterns.name: has been and researcher statements
patterns.context: A present perfect construction in a researcher biography: “background training has been primarily in ...”.

patterns.name: Within-word fragments of finance
patterns.context: A word form corresponding to finance/financial engineering in a Bulgarian sentence; strongest activation falls on a within-word fragment rather than an English to construction.

patterns.name: Code file extension
patterns.context: The filename confirmable.rb in a Ruby example; activation falls on the period and rb before the extension.

patterns.name: Segmentation of initial Atherosclerosis
patterns.context: Sentence-initial or new-sentence Atherosclerotic/Atherosclerosis is segmented, with activation concentrated on the initial A and subsequent subword fragments; this is not a stable whole-word trigger.

patterns.name: Historical retrospective structure in a classical text title
patterns.context: Describes the historical origin of the traditional medicine RC, embedded in a narrative tracing the earliest record.

patterns.name: back to in an Ink Jet narrative
patterns.context: Describes the history of inkjet printing technology; the full trigger structure is date back to.

patterns.name: Historical retrospective about Ballymaloe
patterns.context: Narrates the history of a house; strong activation falls on back to, with traced providing the retrospective context.

patterns.name: to in a public transportation funding sentence
patterns.context: Web text about funding a transportation system; activation is weaker and distributed across several common function words.

6_1988.description: 多类文本中反复出现 to，尤其是 date/record/traced back to 这类追溯表达；另有 has been、finance 词内片段、文件扩展名及句首 Atherosclerosis 切分等零散触发，无法归并为单一稳定模式。

patterns.name: to后续词的分词激活
patterns.context: 强激活紧随 to，常见于表示时间起点或追溯的 “dates back to”；也出现在不定式等其他结构中，因而不局限于单一搭配。
patterns.domain: 多种文体：专利背景、百科、医学论文及网页文本

patterns.name: has been linked 搭配
patterns.context: 出现在 “has been linked to the pathogenesis” 中，激活集中于 has、been、linked。
patterns.domain: NIH 公共卫生相关性摘要

patterns.name: has been 及研究者陈述
patterns.context: 研究者履历中 “background training has been primarily in ...” 的完成时结构。

patterns.name: finance 词内部片段
patterns.context: 保加利亚语句子中与 finance/financial engineering 对应的词形；最强激活落在词内片段，而非英语 to 结构。
patterns.domain: EuroParl 保加利亚语议会文本

patterns.name: 代码文件扩展名
patterns.context: Ruby 示例中的文件名 confirmable.rb，激活落在扩展名前的句点及 rb。

patterns.name: Atherosclerosis 开头的切分
patterns.context: 句首或新句开头的 Atherosclerotic/Atherosclerosis 被切分，激活集中在初始 A 与后续子词片段；这不是稳定的完整词触发。

patterns.name: 古籍名称中的日期回溯结构
patterns.context: 记载传统药物 RC 的历史起源，嵌在追溯最早记录的叙述中。

patterns.name: Ink Jet 叙述中的 back to
patterns.context: 描述喷墨打印技术的历史，完整触发结构为 date back to。

patterns.name: Ballymaloe 的历史追溯
patterns.context: 叙述房屋历史沿革；强激活落在 back to，且 traced 提供追溯语境。

patterns.name: 公共交通筹资句中的 to
patterns.context: 关于资助交通系统的网页文字；激活较弱，且分布在多处常见功能词。

en.description: Activations are distributed across several types of code templates (Ruby/Rails, gemspec, Objective-C), programming Q&A, academic historical accounts, and public transit funding text. Each group has local lexical and formatting cues, but there is no clear shared trigger covering all the material.

patterns.name: Ruby on Rails/Rake code context
patterns.context: Ruby source code containing task-file loading, helper imports, test descriptions, or Rails application initialization; activation often falls on newlines, indentation, or adjacent code tokens

patterns.name: Ruby gem configuration and loading template
patterns.context: The beginning of a Ruby gemspec or project configuration file, containing path setup, dependency loading, and gem specification declarations

patterns.name: Objective-C application delegate declaration
patterns.context: Header imports and interface or implementation declarations for an iOS application delegate class

patterns.name: Code explanations in English Q&A
patterns.context: StackExchange posts use natural language to explain a problem or code, interspersed with code snippets, sample output, or library names

patterns.name: Historical records and chronological narratives
patterns.context: States the historical origins, dates, or development of something

patterns.name: Public transit funding policy statements
patterns.context: Discusses transportation systems, light rail proposals, and local affordability

6_1988.description: 激活分布于多类代码样板（Ruby/Rails、gemspec、Objective-C）、编程问答、学术历史沿革和公共交通筹资文字。各组有局部词句与格式线索，但没有覆盖全部材料的明确共同触发特征。

patterns.name: Ruby on Rails／Rake 代码上下文
patterns.context: Ruby 源码中出现任务文件加载、helper 引入、测试描述或 Rails 应用初始化；激活常落在换行、缩进或相邻代码 token 上
patterns.domain: GitHub 上的 Ruby/Rails 代码

patterns.name: Ruby gem 配置与加载样板
patterns.context: Ruby gemspec 或项目配置文件的开头，包含路径设置、依赖加载和 gem 规格声明
patterns.domain: GitHub 上的 Ruby 项目配置

patterns.name: Objective-C 应用委托声明
patterns.context: iOS 应用委托类的头文件导入及接口、实现声明
patterns.domain: GitHub 上的 Objective-C 源码

patterns.name: 英文问答中的代码讲解
patterns.trigger: 「confirmable」「For reference:」「I coded the function as follows」「the output should be」
patterns.context: StackExchange 帖子以自然语言说明问题或代码，并夹杂代码片段、示例输出或库名

patterns.name: 历史记载与年代叙述
patterns.trigger: 「The earliest record」「dates back to」「to the end of 1920s」「since the 1970s」
patterns.context: 陈述某事物的历史起源、年代或发展沿革

patterns.name: 公共交通筹资政策表述
patterns.trigger: 「fund and finance」「transit system」「light rail」「local funding affordable」
patterns.context: 讨论交通系统、轻轨方案及地方资金可负担性
patterns.domain: 公共政策或社区沟通文本

en.concept: Progress and motivation in academic narratives
en.description: High responses often occur in academic narratives with has motivated/prompted research and progress expressions where has is followed by an adverb and participle; there are also references to historical time, to collocations, citation numbers, and isolated code or email contexts, so the patterns are not fully consistent.

patterns.name: motivated followed by research
patterns.context: Describes a finding, observation, or success prompting subsequent research; common trigger strings include motivated / prompted, near words such as studies and research.

patterns.name: has followed by a time or degree adverb
patterns.context: In academic narratives, has is followed by an adverb or participle to express change, limitation, application, or research progress; this pattern partly overlaps with “prompting research.”

patterns.name: Historical origins and retrospection
patterns.context: Expressions about the origin or historical point in time of something, or time up to the present; trigger words include dates back, dated back, since, and to date.
patterns.domain: Medical history, history of scholarship, personal commentary, and medical papers

patterns.name: to in formal contexts
patterns.context: to occurs in different structures for purpose, object, code calls, or historical retrospection; usage is not uniform and may be a local collocation.
patterns.domain: Medical papers, StackExchange, history of scholarship

patterns.name: Numeric markers in proper names or citations
patterns.context: Numbers occur adjacent to literature markers, years, or event names; it is unclear whether they are independent triggers.

patterns.name: Callback and Boolean return in a code block
patterns.context: A code example covers whether a callback executes, method redefinition, and Boolean values; this differs from the academic narratives elsewhere.

patterns.name: since in a personal name or statement
patterns.context: A personal email-style comment states the author's attitude since an event; this is a single example and differs from research motivation in papers.

6_1988.concept: 学术叙述中的进展与动机
6_1988.description: 高响应常见于学术叙述中的 has motivated/prompted research，以及 has 后接副词和分词的进展表达；另见回溯时间、to 搭配、引文数字与单例代码或邮件语境，模式并不完全一致。

patterns.name: motivated 后接研究
patterns.trigger: “has motivated further studies” [1]；“motivated by” [7]；“has motivated studies” [8]；“has prompted significant amounts of research” [10]
patterns.context: 描述某个发现、观察或成功促使后续研究；常见触发串为 motivated / prompted，附近出现 studies、research 等词

patterns.name: has 后接时间或程度副词
patterns.trigger: “has changed dramatically” [2]；“has primarily been limited” [4]；“has been successfully applied” [9]；以及“has motivated” [1,8,10]
patterns.context: 在学术叙述中，has 后接副词或分词，表达变化、限制、应用或研究进展；此模式与“促成研究”有部分重叠

patterns.name: 历史起点与回溯
patterns.trigger: “The earliest record of RC dates back to” [3]；“can be dated back to the end of 1920s” [9]；“since 9/11” [5]；“to date” [4]
patterns.context: 围绕某事物的起源、历史时间点或截至目前的时间表达；触发词包括 dates back、dated back、since、to date
patterns.domain: 医学史、学术史、个人评论及医学论文

patterns.name: 正式语境中的 to
patterns.trigger: “in … childhood”及“with the introduction of” [2]；“to small pediatric patients” [4]；“backs to generate” [6]；“back to” [9]
patterns.context: to 出现在目的、对象、代码调用或时间回溯等不同结构中；用法不统一，可能只是局部搭配

en.description: Most examples occur in Ruby/Rails or adjacent source-code contexts, with activation distributed across framework identifiers, code structure, and file/template boundaries; sporadic semantic patterns also include software-release news, biological satellite viruses, and commentary on patent innovation. No single stable lexical trigger is evident.

patterns.name: Markers in Rails/Ruby code
patterns.context: Ruby/Rails code, framework filenames, or related Q&A; activation falls on code identifiers, syntax words, and nearby structures.
patterns.domain: Ruby/Rails programming; StackExchange, GitHub, Hacker News

patterns.name: News of releases and arrivals

patterns.name: Specific local structure in Ruby code

patterns.name: File/license template fragments in code

patterns.domain: GitHub source code and license headers

patterns.name: VotesController record lookup code

patterns.name: HTML closing tags and script boundaries

en.description: Primarily responds to punctuation, newlines and indentation, identifiers, member access, and call/declaration structures in code text, across multiple languages and code-hosting contexts; there are also weak and sporadic lexical responses to Q&A markers, documentation terms, and a passage of virology narration, which cannot be explained by a single semantic rule.

patterns.name: Punctuation and syntax boundaries in code
patterns.context: Near multiple code passages or code fences, especially when punctuation is followed by a newline, indentation, expression, or statement boundary; triggers occur across multiple punctuation forms and do not correspond to a single language construct.

patterns.name: Identifiers and property/member access
patterns.context: Variables, properties, method names, or long underscore-separated names composed of identifiers; often adjacent to periods, calls, or assignments.
patterns.domain: Ruby, JavaScript/React, Objective-C, and other code

patterns.name: Code keywords and call structures
patterns.context: Declarations, control flow, function calls, imports, or DSL calls in code; often inside indented code lines.
patterns.domain: Multilingual source code and configuration/migration scripts

patterns.name: Code fences/comments and document headers
patterns.context: Copyright, license, or comment blocks at the beginning of files, followed immediately by source code after the comment ends.

patterns.name: Special strings and selector arguments
patterns.context: Package names, action names, selectors, or query strings enclosed in quotation marks in code calls or configuration; activation is scattered within strings and adjacent delimiters.

patterns.name: Answer markers and Q&A formatting
patterns.context: Near the body of a StackExchange answer or the end of an answer, often with blank lines, code examples, and answer labels; it is unclear whether these markers themselves are necessary conditions.

patterns.name: English come from structure

patterns.name: Language/framework proper names
patterns.context: Library and class names in code comments, imports, or UI calls; these are local lexical items and do not form a unified semantic trigger.

The commonality is broad, with distinct specific triggers.

patterns.name: HTML navigation bars and collapse controls
patterns.context: Brand links or toggle buttons and their collapse-target attributes in Bootstrap-style HTML navigation bars; covers [1], [6].

patterns.name: Ruby/Rails identifiers and code snippets
patterns.context: Ruby/Rails or Chef-related code, configuration paths, and Rails discussions on StackExchange; includes method names, underscore-separated identifiers, filenames, and code operations, not one shared specific function.

patterns.name: Bootstrap version comments
patterns.context: Bootstrap asset copyright or version headers appearing as comments.

patterns.name: Linux news narrative
patterns.context: English-language news reporting on the Steam Linux client and its support.

patterns.name: Swift button-event code

6_1988.concept: 软件开发文本中的标识符与代码

patterns.name: HTML 导航栏与折叠控件

patterns.name: Ruby/Rails 标识与代码片段
patterns.context: Ruby/Rails 或 Chef 相关代码、配置路径及 StackExchange 上的 Rails 讨论；包含方法名、下划线标识符、文件名和代码操作，彼此并非同一具体功能。

patterns.name: Bootstrap 版本注释
patterns.context: 以注释形式出现的 Bootstrap 资源版权或版本头部。

patterns.name: Linux 新闻叙述

patterns.name: Swift 按钮事件代码
patterns.context: 设置按钮颜色并为触摸事件绑定动作的 Swift/UIKit 代码。

en.concept: Mixed word forms and code patterns

patterns.name: come and its surrounding collocations
patterns.context: come occurs in a sentence, especially in the perfect construction “have come” or the future-time phrase “years/days to come”; activation falls on come or the preceding to

patterns.name: HTML navigation-bar data attributes

patterns.name: Chef code and identifiers

patterns.name: Rails controller and request code

patterns.name: Ruby tests, dependencies, and task files

patterns.name: Unexplained word in biological narrative

patterns.name: Unexplained isolated words and ordinary narrative
patterns.context: A forum article discusses the effect of an article on people's lives; apart from the come phrase, sporadic activations lack a shared context

6_1988.description: 激活覆盖“come”及 have/to 等搭配，也广泛出现在 HTML 属性、按钮事件、Chef/Ruby/Rails 代码、测试与任务文件中；部分叙述词及代码标识符的响应无法由单一语义模式解释。

patterns.name: 未解释的孤立词语与普通叙述
patterns.context: 论坛文章谈及文章对人们生活的影响；除 come 短语外，零散激活缺少共同语境

en.concept: Locally salient tokens and format/code triggers
en.description: Activation shows several local patterns: come means arrive, appear, or develop; high activation also occurs in UI/HTML control code, Q&A line-break formatting, and Ruby/Rails/Chef code; with and epidemiological wording also appear in an obesity-statistics passage.

patterns.name: come meaning arrive or appear
patterns.context: come expresses something arriving, appearing, or reaching a stage, often in the perfect tense or with has/have; it is the semantically prominent verb in the sentence.

patterns.name: button / Control-related code
patterns.context: Code contains a button control and its event, properties, or navigation-bar toggle markers; trigger locations vary across examples.

patterns.name: confirm-related answer formatting
patterns.context: Multiple line breaks, quote indicators, and answer labels occur near the end of an answer; strong activation is distributed across format markers and nearby content.

patterns.name: Rake / Rails configuration code
patterns.context: In Ruby/Rails code snippets, strong activation occurs near file references, require statements, and application-loading statements.

patterns.name: Hostname-query code
patterns.context: A Chef/Ruby-style helper function constructs a node query and retrieves the first fqdn; activation falls near query-string punctuation and indexing.

patterns.name: Health-statistics wording
patterns.context: A statistical passage describes the global obesity epidemic and its effects; activation centers on with and related epidemiological wording.

6_1988.concept: 局部显著 token 与格式/代码触发
6_1988.description: 激活呈多种局部模式：come 表示到来、出现或发展；UI/HTML 控件代码、问答换行格式及 Ruby/Rails/Chef 代码中也有高激活；另见肥胖统计段落中的 with 和流行病学措辞。

patterns.name: come 到达或出现
patterns.context: come 用于表示某事到来、出现、发展到某阶段，常处在完成时或与 has/have 连用；在句中作为语义突出的动词。
patterns.domain: 百科、新闻、科学/医学说明

patterns.name: button / Control 相关代码
patterns.context: 代码中出现 button 控件及其事件、属性或导航栏切换标记；但不同例子触发位置并不完全相同。

patterns.name: confirm 相关回答格式
patterns.context: 问答回复结尾附近出现多次换行、引用提示和答案标签；强激活分布在格式标记及邻近内容上。

patterns.name: Rake / Rails 配置代码
patterns.context: Ruby/Rails 代码片段中，文件引用、require、应用加载语句附近出现较强激活。
patterns.domain: GitHub 上的 Ruby/Rails 代码

patterns.name: 机器名查询代码
patterns.context: Chef/Ruby 风格 helper 函数中构造节点查询并取首项 fqdn；激活落在查询字符串标点和索引附近。
patterns.domain: StackExchange 技术问答中的代码

patterns.name: 健康统计表述
patterns.context: 描述全球肥胖流行及其影响的统计性段落；激活集中在 with 及相关流行病学措辞。

en.description: High-activation patterns are not uniform: several passages emphasize come/comes and the phrases that follow; others occur in HTML data- attributes, Q&A line breaks and answer markers, path version numbers, statistical quantity phrases, and Ruby class declarations and block structures.

patterns.name: Come expressions of completion/arrival
patterns.context: Activation concentrates on come/comes and the following prepositional or degree/article phrase; meanings include an issue emerging, origin, a day finally arriving, progress, or a time approaching. Tense and syntax vary across surrounding contexts.
patterns.domain: Academic papers, encyclopedias, technology news, general descriptions, sports reporting

patterns.name: data- attributes in code
patterns.context: In an HTML navigation-bar snippet, data is followed by a hyphen and an attribute name; activation falls on the attribute name data, not its use in ordinary prose.

patterns.name: Dialogue markers and newline formatting
patterns.context: In Q&A text, consecutive line breaks, blank lines, and A: answer labels; activation falls on formatting boundaries and answer markers.

patterns.name: Version-number punctuation in paths
patterns.context: Ruby gem paths in nginx error logs, where the digits, periods, and slashes in version numbers are tokenized separately.

patterns.name: with in ratio or quantity phrases
patterns.context: In an obesity epidemiology statement, with introduces deaths among at least a certain number of people; activation centers on with.

patterns.name: Ruby class declarations and block structures
patterns.context: In Ruby/Rails code, multiple tokens activate near class inheritance declarations and end block-closing markers.

6_1988.description: 高激活模式并不统一：多段突出 come/comes 及其后续短语；其余分别出现在 HTML data- 属性、问答换行与答案标记、路径版本号、统计数量短语，以及 Ruby 类声明和块结构中。

patterns.name: come 的完成/到来表达
patterns.trigger: «come»10« to»7« the»6« fore»4；«come»10« from»7；«day «has»5« finally»5« come»10；«has»2« come»9« a»6« long»4« way»7；«comes»9« a»6« lot»
patterns.context: 激活集中在 come/comes 及紧随其后的介词或程度/冠词短语；分别表示议题浮现、来源、某日终于到来、进展或某个时间点临近。周围时态与句法各异。
patterns.domain: 学术论文、百科、科技新闻、一般说明、体育报道

patterns.name: 代码中的 data- 属性
patterns.context: HTML 导航栏片段中，data 后接连字符及属性名；激活落在属性名 data，而非普通正文用法。

patterns.name: 对话标记与换行格式
patterns.context: 问答文本中连续换行、空行及 A: 答案标签，激活落在格式边界和答案标记。

patterns.name: 路径中的版本号标点
patterns.context: nginx 错误日志所含 Ruby gem 路径，版本号的数字、句点和斜线被分段标记。

patterns.name: 比例或数量短语中的 with
patterns.context: 肥胖流行病学陈述中，with 引出至少某数量的人口死亡；激活以 with 为中心。

patterns.name: Ruby 类声明及块结构
patterns.context: Ruby/Rails 代码中，类继承声明及 end 块结束标记附近多个 token 激活。

en.concept: Expressions of events appearing and progressing
en.description: Most passages activate on come/coming/came meaning appear, arrive, originate, or result, often extending to following words; other patterns include come a long way, gained momentum, marked the first, and activation on Ruby code symbols.

patterns.name: Semantic uses of come
patterns.context: The verb denotes an event appearing, arriving, originating, or resulting; local high activation often falls on come and its immediately following words, with the specific meaning varying by collocation
patterns.domain: Cross-domain narratives, news, academic writing, Q&A

patterns.name: Fixed phrase come a long way
patterns.context: come is followed by a long way, meaning progress or development; activation extends to way/in/field

patterns.name: Momentum-gaining collocation
patterns.context: Describes a method or trend gradually attracting attention and gaining traction; peak activation is on momentum

patterns.name: marked the first
patterns.context: marked combines with the first to narrate an event that occurred for the first time in a given year; subsequent text gives a specific tour stop, etc.

patterns.name: Code identifiers and structure
patterns.context: A Ruby/Rails code snippet involving class inheritance and a uniqueness-validation method; activation is distributed across code symbols and indentation, rather than ordinary narrative words

6_1988.description: 多数片段在 come/coming/came 表示出现、到来、起源或归结时激活，常扩展到搭配后续词；另有 come a long way、gained momentum、marked the first 等进展或事件表述，以及一段 Ruby 代码符号激活。

patterns.name: come 的语义用法
patterns.trigger: “come”或其变体 “coming”“came”，尤其是 “come to the fore”“come from”“day has come”“come down to”“phase came”
patterns.context: 动词用于事件出现、到来、起源或归结；局部强激活多落在 come 及其紧邻的后续词上，具体语义随搭配变化
patterns.domain: 跨领域叙述、新闻、学术、问答

patterns.name: come a long way 固定搭配
patterns.context: come 后接 a long way，表示进步或发展；激活延续至 way/in/field 一带

patterns.name: momentum 增长搭配
patterns.context: 描述某种方法或趋势逐渐获得关注、势头增强；峰值在 momentum

patterns.name: marked the first
patterns.context: marked 与 the first 连用，叙述某年首次出现的事件；后文给出 tour stop 等具体内容

patterns.name: 代码标识符与结构
patterns.context: Ruby/Rails 代码片段中类继承与唯一性验证方法；激活分布在代码符号和缩进处，而非普通叙述词

en.concept: Contextual collocations of come and code structure
en.description: Natural-language passages repeatedly activate come and its collocations (come to the fore/from, coming, has come a long way), but also include the unrelated momentum collocation; Rails code broadly activates line breaks, indentation, and syntax structures.

patterns.name: Participle and following function words in come to the fore
patterns.context: The fixed expression “come to the fore” means that something receives attention or becomes prominent; it appears only in a medical-paper passage

patterns.name: come in come from
patterns.context: Describes the origin of satellite RNA, preceded by “is said to have”

patterns.name: Present participle of come
patterns.context: “news is coming days after...” describes news arriving; another instance collocates with “trend coming,” meaning that a trend seems expected

patterns.name: Perfect-tense collocation with come
patterns.context: “has come a long way” means making significant progress; the subject is augmented reality technology

patterns.name: Co-occurrence of come and momentum
patterns.context: A medical abstract describes a management method gradually gaining attention; significant activation centers on gained momentum, not come

patterns.name: Structural token activation in Ruby/Rails code
patterns.context: Rails code examples; activation is distributed across line breaks, indentation, statement boundaries, and multiple code tokens, rather than natural-language come

6_1988.concept: come 的语境搭配及代码结构
6_1988.description: 自然语言段落中多次激活 come 及其搭配（come to the fore/from、coming、has come a long way），但也有非 come 的 momentum 搭配；Rails 代码中则广泛激活换行、缩进与语法结构。

patterns.name: come to the fore 的分词和后续虚词
patterns.context: 句中固定表达“come to the fore”，表示某事受到关注或变得突出；只在医学论文段落中出现

patterns.name: come from 的 come
patterns.context: 描述卫星 RNA 的起源，前有“is said to have”

patterns.name: come 的现在分词

patterns.name: come 的完成时固定搭配
patterns.context: “has come a long way”表示取得显著进展；主语为增强现实技术

patterns.name: come 与 momentum 的共现

patterns.name: Ruby/Rails 代码中的结构性 token 激活

patterns.context: Rails 代码示例；激活分布在换行、缩进、语句边界及多个代码 token 上，并非自然语言中的 come

en.description: Most passages activate on come and following phrases when narrating an event's arrival, appearance, or transition to an outcome state; there are also weaker or sporadic responses to gained momentum, a local Hungarian structure, and format symbols in code and links.

patterns.name: Event-related uses of come
patterns.context: come is followed by a directional, result, state, or abstract noun phrase, often forming an expression of an event arriving, appearing, or entering a state; activation mainly falls on come or the following phrase
patterns.domain: Encyclopedias, news, medical papers, general narrative

patterns.name: Fixed collocation gained momentum
patterns.context: Describes a method or trend gradually attracting attention and gaining traction; peak activation falls on momentum

patterns.name: Local lexical pattern before Iránnal in Hungarian
patterns.context: A Hungarian sentence discusses commonalities between certain fields and Iran; strong activation centers on participles and punctuation around ahol, with no clear semantic trigger directly corresponding to the English pattern

patterns.name: Code and markup syntax symbols
patterns.context: Line breaks, punctuation, operators, and indentation occur in code, Q&A formatting, or links; activation is scattered across these structural symbols, without a consistent lexical trigger
patterns.domain: StackExchange, HackerNews, code and web text

6_1988.description: 多数段落在叙述事件到来、出现或进入结果状态时激活 come 及其后续短语；另对 gained momentum、匈牙利语局部结构，以及代码和链接中的格式符号有较弱或零散响应。

patterns.name: come 的事件性用法
patterns.trigger: come, has come, have come, come to the fore, come a long way, come to an end
patterns.context: come 后接方向、结果、状态或抽象名词短语，常构成事件到来、出现或进入某种状态的表达；激活点主要落在 come 或紧随其后的短语上
patterns.domain: 百科、新闻、医学论文、通用叙述

patterns.name: gained momentum 固定搭配
patterns.context: 描述某种方法或趋势逐渐获得关注、发展势头；最高激活落在 momentum

patterns.name: 匈牙利语句中 Iránnal 前的局部词法模式
patterns.context: 匈牙利语句中谈及某些领域与伊朗的共同点；强激活集中在 ahol 前后的分词及标点，未见与英语模式直接对应的明显语义触发
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会文本，匈牙利语

patterns.name: 代码与标记语法符号
patterns.context: 代码、问答格式或链接中出现换行、标点、操作符和缩进；激活散布于这些结构符号，缺少一致的词义触发

en.concept: Multiple collocations and meanings of come
en.description: Primarily responds to come/comes and the prepositions, adverbs, or fixed expressions that follow, covering origin, arrival, emergence, progress, accompaniment, and delay; there are also sporadic activations for code, Released, mention, and other items.

patterns.name: come and its complements
patterns.context: come/comes occurs in a sentence to mean origin, arrival, emergence, accompaniment, or timing; in many examples, the word and the immediately following preposition or adverb activate strongly.
patterns.domain: Various genres, including encyclopedias, news, medicine, forum discussions, and biographies

patterns.name: came arrival expression
patterns.context: come refers to an anticipated event finally arriving, with day/has/finally preceding it.

patterns.name: come source expression
patterns.context: come is followed by from, introducing the source or cause of something.

patterns.name: come to the fore
patterns.context: Fixed expression meaning that an issue receives attention or becomes prominent.

patterns.name: comes with the territory
patterns.context: Fixed expression meaning that something is an inevitable accompaniment of a particular situation or role.

patterns.name: come meaning that a decision occurs
patterns.context: come indicates that a decision or realization emerges only at a particular time.

patterns.name: come with long-distance progress collocation
patterns.context: In the present perfect, come is paired with a long way to indicate significant progress or development.

patterns.name: Non-come arrival-like word form
patterns.context: The past participle Released appears in a software release headline; the connection to come may be only that an event occurs or is released, but the evidence is limited.

patterns.name: Non-come expression of mention
patterns.context: A personal blog discusses wanting to mention some people; there is no clear lexical connection to the main pattern.

patterns.name: Code and markup syntax
patterns.context: Several fragments in HTML/Apex code and URLs activate, with no clear connection to come.

patterns.name: Ruby test-code syntax
patterns.context: The loading statement and consecutive newlines at the beginning of a Ruby test file activate; there is no clear connection to the main come pattern.

6_1988.concept: come 的多种搭配与语义
6_1988.description: 主要对 come/comes 及其后接介词、副词或固定搭配有反应，涵盖来源、到来、显现、进步、伴随和延迟发生；另有代码、Released、mention 等零散激活。

patterns.name: come 与后续补语
patterns.trigger: “come”及其后续成分，如 “come from either”“come days after”“come to the fore”“comes with the territory”“did not come until”
patterns.context: 句中出现 come/comes，表示来源、到来、显现、伴随或发生时间；不少例子中该词及紧随其后的介词或副词激活较强。
patterns.domain: 百科、新闻、医学、论坛讨论及人物传记等多种文体

patterns.name: came 到来表达
patterns.trigger: “come”附近的时间或到来表达：“The day has finally come”
patterns.context: come 表示期待的事件终于到来，前有 day/has/finally。

patterns.name: come 的来源表达
patterns.context: come 后接 from，引出某事物的来源或成因。

patterns.name: come to the fore
patterns.context: 固定搭配，表示议题受到关注或凸显。

patterns.name: comes with the territory
patterns.context: 固定表达，表示某种情况是特定环境或角色不可避免的伴随现象。

patterns.name: come 表示决定发生
patterns.context: come 表示某种决定或认识直到某个时间才出现。

patterns.name: come 与长时间进步搭配

en.description: Activations most consistently fall on English function words and phrase boundaries, especially the and an article following is; they also involve prepositional phrases, sentence-initial Of the/Among the, title line breaks, and a few subword fragments or punctuation marks, across a wide range of domains.

patterns.name: Article following copula is
patterns.context: A sentence contains is immediately followed by an indefinite or definite article; activations mainly fall on is and the/a.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain English sentences, including biomedical, weather, biographical, and encyclopedic text

patterns.name: Definite article the
patterns.context: The definite article occurs at the start of a noun phrase or after a preposition; it is sometimes preceded by of, on, during, among, and similar words.
patterns.domain: Biomedical abstracts, popular science, and general text

patterns.name: the after a preposition
patterns.context: A preposition introduces a noun phrase with the definite article; a between phrase is additionally followed by an of the construction.

patterns.name: Other prepositional constructions
patterns.context: A preposition occurs in an ordinary noun phrase or place phrase, with varying collocations.

patterns.name: Sentence-initial Of the
patterns.context: A sentence begins with Of the, introducing a group of objects or categories.

patterns.name: Sentence-initial Among the
patterns.context: A sentence begins with Among the, introducing a set of objects of a given type.

patterns.name: Sentence-initial Here in
patterns.context: Here is followed by a locative prepositional phrase describing local conditions.
patterns.domain: Local popular science or weather descriptions

patterns.name: Repeated title separated by punctuation
patterns.context: A title is repeated and separated by a line break, possibly due to page or formatting conventions.

patterns.name: Colon and punctuation in names
patterns.context: Punctuation occurs within a short title or noun phrase; activations are weak and contexts vary.

patterns.name: Word-internal segmentation and hyphens
patterns.context: Activations fall near segmented subword fragments or word endings, with no stable semantic condition evident.

patterns.name: Anomalous or hard-to-interpret word strings
patterns.context: Isolated, semantically incoherent strings; only local triggers such as the, of, with, and new can be identified, and the overall condition is unclear.
patterns.domain: Pile-CC, general web or scraped text

patterns.name: between construction
patterns.context: A sentence begins with Relations between, introducing the relationship between two things.

patterns.name: Verb followed by the conclusion
patterns.context: In a description of research findings, a verb is followed by the conclusion.

6_2335.concept: 英语功能词与短语边界
6_2335.description: 激活最稳定地落在英语功能词与短语边界，尤其是 the，以及 is 后接冠词；还涉及介词短语、句首 Of the/Among the、标题换行和少量词片段或标点，领域跨度大。

patterns.name: 系词 is 后接冠词
patterns.trigger: « is» 后接 « a» 或 « the»
patterns.context: 句子中出现 is，紧接不定或定冠词；激活主要落在 is 和 the/a 上。
patterns.domain: 跨领域英语句子，包括生物医学、天气、人物介绍和百科文本

patterns.name: 定冠词 the
patterns.context: 定冠词位于名词短语开头或介词后；有时前面是 of、on、during、among 等。
patterns.domain: 生物医学摘要、科普及一般文本

patterns.name: 介词后的 the
patterns.trigger: « on» 或 « between»，随后出现 « the»
patterns.context: 介词引出带定冠词的名词短语；between 后另有 of the 结构。

patterns.name: 其他介词结构
patterns.context: 介词处于普通名词短语或地点短语中，具体搭配各异。
patterns.domain: 医学、科普及非正式文本

patterns.name: 句首 Of the
patterns.context: 句首以 Of the 引出一组对象或类别。

patterns.name: 句首 Among the
patterns.context: 句首 Among the 引出某类对象的集合。

patterns.name: 句首 Here in
patterns.context: Here 后接地点介词短语，描述当地情形。
patterns.domain: 地方性科普或天气描述

patterns.name: 标点分隔的标题重复
patterns.context: 标题重复并以换行分隔，可能是页面或排版格式造成。

patterns.name: 名称中的冒号与标点
patterns.context: 标点出现在短标题或名词短语内部；激活较弱，语境各异。
patterns.domain: 医学标题与生物医学文本

patterns.name: 词内分段与连字符
patterns.context: 激活落在被切分的词片段或词尾附近，未显示稳定的语义条件。

patterns.name: 异常或难解词串
patterns.trigger: “color« of»2 siris mic« with»4« new»2 jail”
patterns.context: 孤立且语义不连贯的词串；只能确认 the、of、with、new 等局部触发，无法确定整体条件。

patterns.name: between 结构
patterns.context: 句首以 Relations between 引出两个事物的关系。

patterns.name: 动词后接 the conclusion
patterns.context: 研究结果描述中，动词后接 the conclusion。

en.description: Activations often fall on sentence-initial The, subword fragments, or formatting markers; there is also a localized pattern involving ontology development. Trigger forms and semantics vary markedly across passages, with no unified, stable content feature evident.

patterns.name: Sentence-initial The
patterns.context: Occurs at the beginning of a sentence or a new sentence; followed by a statement about the preceding topic. The first passage also contains several unmarked instances of “The,” indicating selective triggering.
patterns.domain: English text in papers, abstracts, and code

patterns.name: Sentence-initial Humanized
patterns.context: The word is tokenized into Human and ized; strong activation falls on the ending ized, followed by biomedical terminology.

patterns.name: Italian word ending aly
patterns.context: Tokenization crosses Italy; activation falls on the ending aly, followed by the national team’s name.

patterns.name: Internal tokenization of BRCA1
patterns.context: The gene symbol BRCA1 is split into multiple tokens, with activations concentrated near CA and the following digits.

patterns.name: Ontology compound phrase
patterns.context: Appears when discussing methods, processes, or evaluation of ontology development; nearby repeated instances are also unmarked.

patterns.name: Special markers and delimiters
patterns.context: Weak activations occur near formatting markers, code brackets, line breaks, or section markers, without consistent semantic or positional conditions.
patterns.domain: Paper formatting, code, and document formats

6_2335.concept: 英文分词与句首片段
6_2335.description: 激活多落在句首 The、词内分词片段或格式标记上；另有 ontology development 等局部术语模式。各段触发形式与语义差异明显，未见统一稳定的内容特征。

patterns.name: 句首 The
patterns.context: 出现在句首或新句起始处；后面接对前文主题的陈述。第1段还出现多处未标记的“The”，因此触发具有选择性。
patterns.domain: 论文、摘要及代码中的英文文本

patterns.name: 句首 Humanized
patterns.context: 词被分词为 Human 与 ized，强激活落在词尾 ized；后接生物医学术语。

patterns.name: 意大利语词尾 aly
patterns.context: 分词跨越 Italy；激活落在词尾 aly，后接国家队名称。

patterns.name: BRCA1 内部分词
patterns.context: 基因符号 BRCA1 被拆成多个 token，激活集中在 CA 及后续数字附近。

patterns.name: Ontology 复合短语
patterns.context: 在讨论本体开发的方法、流程或评估时出现；附近也有未标记的重复用例。

patterns.name: 特殊标记及分隔符
patterns.context: 格式标记、代码括号、换行或章节标记附近出现弱激活，缺少一致的语义或位置条件。
patterns.domain: 论文排版、代码与文档格式

en.description: All passages activate on “appellate” in legal contexts; surrounding content concerns appellate records, courts, review, applications, attorneys, or appellate courts. No other independent trigger pattern is evident.

patterns.name: appellate in appellate
patterns.context: The word appellate occurs in legal text, often followed by record, applications, level, review, court, counsel, and similar terms; the word itself is marked, without requiring a fixed syntactic position.
patterns.domain: U.S. case law, legal opinions, and law-review-style text

6_2335.concept: 上诉法律语境中的 appellate
6_2335.description: 所有片段都激活在法律语境中的 “appellate”；周围内容涉及上诉记录、法院、审查、申请、律师或上诉法院。未见其他独立触发模式。

patterns.name: appellate 的 appellate
patterns.context: 法律文本中出现单词 appellate，常接 record、applications、level、review、court、counsel 等词；该词本身被标记，不要求固定句法位置。
patterns.domain: 美国判例、法律意见及法律论文式文本

en.concept: Source-code line structure and syntactic boundaries
en.description: Activations occur broadly in code, especially around statements following line breaks and indentation, structural markers, and identifiers; languages, libraries, and tasks vary. Comments, preprocessor lines, and punctuation also occur, but there is no unified theme or single lexical trigger.

patterns.name: Code line indentation and line-break structure
patterns.context: Occurs between code statements or preprocessor directives, especially after line breaks with clear indentation; not every line break triggers activation.
patterns.domain: Source code and snippets in multiple programming languages

patterns.name: Code structural boundaries
patterns.context: Functions, classes, conditions, imports, or preprocessor structures in code snippets, often near line breaks, indentation, or code-block boundaries.
patterns.domain: Python, C/C++, and other source code

patterns.name: Technical identifiers and delimiter combinations
patterns.context: Symbols connect variables, members, types, calls, or indices; activations are distributed across ordinary code expressions and are not specific to any particular operation.

patterns.name: Code comment markers
patterns.context: A hash sign starts a comment or preprocessor directive, followed by explanatory text or a header-file path; these have different purposes.
patterns.domain: Source code comments and C/C++ preprocessor directives

patterns.name: English technical explanatory text
patterns.context: Short English explanations in code comments or near code; the content does not form a unified theme.

patterns.name: Ordinary code lexical fragments
patterns.context: Common variables, keywords, or API names in technical code; there is no evidence that any specific word is a shared trigger.

6_2335.concept: 源码行结构与语法边界
6_2335.description: 激活广泛出现在代码中，尤见换行及缩进后的语句、结构标记和标识符周围；语言、库与任务各异。注释、预处理行及标点也出现，但无统一主题或单一词法触发。

patterns.name: 代码行间缩进与换行结构
patterns.context: 出现在代码语句或预处理指令之间，尤其是换行后有明显缩进；并非所有换行都会触发。
patterns.domain: 多种编程语言的源码与代码片段

patterns.name: 代码结构边界
patterns.context: 代码片段中的函数、类、条件、导入或预处理结构，常出现在换行、缩进或代码块边界附近。

patterns.name: 技术标识符与分隔符组合
patterns.context: 符号用于连接变量、成员、类型、调用或索引；激活散布在普通代码表达式中，并不专属于某种运算。

patterns.name: 代码注释标记
patterns.trigger: 「# Apply batch normalization」「# get time in UTC」「#include」
patterns.context: 井号开启注释或预处理指令，之后跟说明文字或头文件路径；二者用途不同。
patterns.domain: 源码注释与 C/C++ 预处理指令

patterns.name: 英文技术说明文字
patterns.trigger: 「Apply batch normalization」「get time in UTC」「Small explanation」「create callback」
patterns.context: 代码注释或代码附近的短英文说明；内容并不构成统一主题。
patterns.domain: 代码注释、StackExchange 技术问答

patterns.name: 普通代码词法片段
patterns.context: 技术代码中常见的变量、关键字或 API 名称；没有证据表明某个特定词本身是共同触发条件。

en.concept: Local structure and punctuation in technical text
en.description: Activations span the digit 2, punctuation, and formatting boundaries in code and technical prose; they also involve patent component relationships, material processes, code syntax, interface layout, programming discussions, and repair advice. No single semantic theme explains all samples.

patterns.name: Digit 2 and delimiters
patterns.context: The digit 2 often occurs as a divisor after a slash, in code arithmetic expressions, numerical values, or sequence text; local punctuation patterns are not fully consistent.
patterns.domain: Code, technical descriptions, patents, and forum text

patterns.name: Separating punctuation and formatting boundaries
patterns.context: Often occurs at item, clause, and sentence boundaries in code statements or technical descriptions; exact trigger positions vary across passages and may be adjacent to numbers.

patterns.name: Determiners before technical nouns in patents
patterns.context: Noun phrases in English patent backgrounds, often used to introduce or distinguish components, materials, processes, and their relationships; this pattern does not explain all activations.

patterns.name: Connections or mating relationships among components
patterns.context: Describes connections, conductive paths, or mechanical mating between components; local activations also cover ordinal words and punctuation near these relationships.

patterns.name: Materials, manufacturing, and process descriptions in patents
patterns.context: Describes electrode coatings, material processing, or circuit manufacturing steps and their effects.

patterns.name: Arithmetic expressions and punctuation in code
patterns.context: Numbers, operators, and statement terminators interleave in expressions or assignment statements.

patterns.name: Parenthesized calls and arguments in code
patterns.context: Parentheses, commas, and argument names occur together near function or parser calls.

patterns.name: Descriptions, explanations, and recommendation sentences
patterns.context: Used to offer operational advice, explain conditions, or signal contrast in tutorials or Q&A; specific trigger words and contexts vary.
patterns.domain: StackExchange technical Q&A and HackerNews discussions

patterns.name: String argument descriptions in code
patterns.context: Help text is written for arguments or subcommands in command-line parser code.

patterns.name: Image dimensions and interface layout
patterns.context: Positions are calculated from width and height to center interface elements; other activations also include nearby punctuation.

patterns.name: Ruby and Python ecosystem comparison
patterns.context: Discusses Ruby’s uses in web development and its scientific computing library ecosystem; triggers are scattered throughout the comment.

patterns.name: Brake friction diagnosis
patterns.context: Investigates whether friction is present and suggests checks or adjustments based on brake type.

patterns.name: Local activations not assigned to a clear pattern
patterns.context: These sporadic tokens occur in their respective contexts; the samples alone cannot establish a stable connection between them and other triggers.

6_2335.concept: 技术文本局部结构与标点
6_2335.description: 激活覆盖代码与技术散文中的数字2、标点和格式边界，也涉及专利部件关系、材料工艺、代码语法、界面布局、编程讨论及维修建议；未见单一语义主题解释所有样本。

patterns.name: 数字 2 与分隔符
patterns.context: 数字 2 常出现在斜杠后的除数、代码算术表达式、数值或序列文本中；局部标点形态不完全一致。
patterns.domain: 代码、技术说明、专利及论坛文本

patterns.name: 分隔标点与格式边界
patterns.trigger: 逗号 «,»、分号 «;»、右括号 «)»，以及换行 «↵»
patterns.context: 多出现在代码语句或技术描述中的项目、从句和句子边界；各段具体触发位置不同，可能与数字邻接。
patterns.domain: 代码、专利说明、论坛文本

patterns.name: 专利技术名词前的限定词
patterns.trigger: «the»、«a»、«an»，以及 «first»、«second»；例如 «the conduction path»、«a silicon chip»、«a first shaft»
patterns.context: 英语专利背景中的名词短语，常用于引入或区分部件、材料、工艺及其关系；此模式不解释全部激活。

patterns.name: 多部件连接或配合关系
patterns.context: 描述部件之间的连接、导电路径或机械配合；局部激活也覆盖这些关系附近的序数词和标点。
patterns.domain: 电气、半导体与机械专利

patterns.name: 专利中的材料、制造及工艺描述
patterns.context: 描述电极涂层、材料处理或线路制造步骤及其效果。

patterns.name: 代码中的算术表达式与标点
patterns.context: 表达式或赋值语句中，数字、运算符和语句终止符交错出现。

patterns.name: 代码中的括号调用与参数
patterns.context: 函数或解析器调用附近，括号、逗号及参数名共同出现。

patterns.name: 描述、解释及建议语句
patterns.context: 教程或问答中用于提出操作建议、条件说明或转折；具体触发词和上下文各异。
patterns.domain: StackExchange 技术问答与 HackerNews 讨论

patterns.name: 代码中的字符串参数说明
patterns.context: 命令行解析器代码里，为参数或子命令写帮助文本。

patterns.name: 图像尺寸与界面布局
patterns.context: 通过宽高尺寸计算位置，使界面元素居中；其他激活还包括邻近标点。

patterns.name: Ruby 与 Python 生态比较
patterns.context: 讨论 Ruby 的 Web 开发用途及其科学计算库生态；触发散落于整段评论。

patterns.name: 刹车摩擦诊断
patterns.context: 排查是否存在摩擦，并按刹车类型提出检查或调整建议。

patterns.name: 未能归入明确模式的局部激活
patterns.context: 这些零散 token 出现在各自语境中，无法仅凭样本确认它们与其他触发之间存在稳定联系。

en.description: Activations span various code snippets and technical text: they commonly occur around identifiers, imports/API names, and code boundaries, and also around technical nouns, structural descriptions, and process narratives in patents and papers. No single semantic trigger explains all examples.

patterns.name: Underscores and identifier boundaries in code
patterns.context: Around code, API names, or variables; underscores are often adjacent to letters, punctuation, whitespace, or line breaks.

patterns.name: Noun phrases and compounds in English technical text
patterns.context: In patent- or paper-style English prose, noun phrases occur in explanatory, structural, or process-descriptive contexts.

patterns.name: Code descriptions of lists/sequences and their operations
patterns.context: Discusses list construction or language features, or appears in code contexts involving list data structures.

patterns.name: Configuring output parameters in code
patterns.context: Database code creates and sets an output parameter, followed by a call that executes SQL.

patterns.name: Causal or process verbs in technical narratives
patterns.context: Sentences describe material formation, mechanical deformation, or tape transport processes.

patterns.name: Python visualization library imports and backend configuration
patterns.context: Configures a dynamically updating plotting program, consecutively importing NumPy, Tkinter, and Matplotlib.

patterns.name: Fortran/Cython build dependency imports
patterns.context: Comments and import statements explain how to compile an extension containing Fortran/NumPy.

patterns.name: Local code fragments that cannot be clearly categorized
patterns.context: Context is incomplete, so the code’s function cannot be determined; beyond the general code context, no stable correspondence with other trigger conditions is apparent.

patterns.name: Nested array assignment and conditional branches
patterns.context: PHP-style code assigns through multi-level array indexing and enters a conditional branch.

patterns.name: Head spacing and tape-track descriptions in patents
patterns.context: Compares the azimuth of a relative head and explains how tape tracks are formed sequentially.

patterns.name: Wafer probe testing and device packaging process
patterns.context: Introduces conventional testing procedures before chip dicing and packaging.

6_2335.concept: 技术文本中的结构化术语
6_2335.description: 激活覆盖多种代码片段和技术文本：常见于标识符、导入/API 名称及代码边界，也见于专利和论文中的技术名词、结构描述与过程叙述；没有单一语义触发器可解释全部例子。

patterns.name: 代码中的下划线及标识符边界
patterns.context: 代码、API 名称或变量周围；下划线前后常有字母，且与标点、空白或换行相邻

patterns.name: 英文技术文本中的名词短语与复合词
patterns.trigger: 技术名词或复合表达，如 “wafer probe testing”“liquid-liquid demixing”“annular ridge”“azimuth angles”
patterns.context: 专利或论文式英文叙述中，名词短语处于解释、描述结构或陈述过程的语境

patterns.name: 列表/序列及其操作的代码说明
patterns.trigger: “list-comprehensions”“Ruby”“LC”，以及代码中的数值列表片段“[1100, 0, 0]”
patterns.context: 讨论列表构造或语言特性，或出现列表数据结构的代码上下文

patterns.name: 代码中输出参数的配置
patterns.context: 数据库代码里创建并设置输出参数，后接执行 SQL 的调用

patterns.name: 技术叙述中的因果或过程动词
patterns.context: 句子描述材料形成、机械变形或磁带走带等技术过程

patterns.name: Python 可视化库导入及后端设置
patterns.context: 配置动态更新的绘图程序，连续导入 NumPy、Tkinter 和 Matplotlib

patterns.name: Fortran/Cython 构建依赖导入
patterns.context: 注释和导入语句说明如何编译含 Fortran/NumPy 的扩展

patterns.name: 无法明确归类的局部代码片段
patterns.trigger: 片段中的 `back`、`qn`、`l1`、`nblock` 等标识符及其周边代码
patterns.context: 上下文不完整，无法确定代码功能；除通用代码语境外看不出与其他触发条件的稳定对应

patterns.name: 嵌套数组赋值与条件分支
patterns.context: PHP 风格代码中通过多层数组索引赋值，并进入条件分支

patterns.name: 专利中的头部间距与磁带轨道描述
patterns.context: 比较相对磁头的方位角，并说明磁带轨道如何依次形成

patterns.name: 晶圆探针测试与器件封装流程
patterns.context: 介绍芯片切割、封装前的传统测试程序

en.concept: sed substitution commands and English text
en.description: The most prominent pattern is sed substitution expressions and their shell-command context; activations also occur in scattered English function words, relational expressions, patent technical descriptions, and several nominalized terms, with no stable shared condition among the latter.

patterns.name: sed substitution commands
patterns.context: Occurs in sed commands or shell command examples, especially the s in substitution expressions; surrounding text often includes file paths, regular expressions, or scripts.
patterns.domain: Command-line Q&A and code snippets on StackExchange/HackerNews

patterns.name: Shell scripts and command-line fragments
patterns.context: In executable commands, pipelines, options, or script assignments; segments 1, 2, 3, 7, and 8 also contain sed substitution, while segment 3 additionally has wget, tar, cd, sh.

patterns.name: Common function words such as pronouns and auxiliaries
patterns.context: Embedded in natural-language sentences across Q&A, patent background, technical discussions, and quoted text; these words have no clear shared local semantic condition.
patterns.domain: Various English prose and technical texts

patterns.name: Relational and comparative expressions in patent backgrounds
patterns.context: Appears in descriptions of cushions needing to accommodate individual differences and in technical explanations of increased nitrogen oxides as a combustion mixture approaches the stoichiometric ratio; both express relations or conditions.

patterns.name: Technical definitions and property descriptions in patents
patterns.context: Introduces an invention and defines terms, and describes the molecular weight, polymer properties, or general formula of CTFE telomers.
patterns.domain: Chemical process descriptions in USPTO patent backgrounds

patterns.name: Nominalized technical concepts and configurations
