patterns.name: Verbs in hardware code comments
patterns.context: A hardware driver comment describes function operations and write conditions, with activation on local verb fragments.

6_2335.concept: 异质文本片段与边界
6_2335.description: 激活分散在词内片段、英语功能词、代码/标记边界、公式符号、缩进换行及少数领域专用表达；跨语料未见稳定统一语义或单一语法触发条件。

patterns.name: 非惯用/分词词形内部边界
patterns.context: 激活落在词内部的片段或分词边界，常见于生僻词形、专名或词与代码串连接处；有时相邻片段也激活。
patterns.domain: 叙事对白、网络文本、论文、代码注释

patterns.name: 代码中的标点与结构边界
patterns.context: 代码或标记语言中，括号、运算符、标签边界附近出现激活，但具体语言和结构不一致。

patterns.name: 数学公式符号与记号
patterns.context: 公式定义和数学表达式中，数学符号、分隔符及公式片段附近激活。

patterns.name: 功能词及其邻接词
patterns.trigger: «ants»10« to»3« see»2；« a»2« big»1；« should»1 be« as»1；« to»9« a»3；« with»2
patterns.context: 普通英语短语中若干功能词、介词或邻接词被激活，但没有一致的语义或句法环境。
patterns.domain: 小说、论坛、摘要、哲学文本

patterns.name: 缩进空白和换行
patterns.context: 代码块或论坛引用/分隔格式里的换行、缩进空格及行首标记。

patterns.name: R 代码中的年龄模型片段
patterns.context: 统计代码中指数模型的参数与年龄变量表达式；激活集中在 theta 及其后公式局部。

patterns.name: Android 权限声明
patterns.context: AndroidManifest XML 中权限声明标签的局部片段。

patterns.name: 沙滩排球服装描述
patterns.trigger: « to»2« wear»3 'speedo'-type gear«,»1 which« is»2« as»2« close»3« to»9
patterns.context: 讨论男性沙滩排球运动员着装规则时，介词短语“close to”附近激活。

patterns.name: 编程硬件注释中的动词
patterns.context: 硬件驱动注释描述函数操作和写入条件，动词局部激活。

en.concept: Mixed word forms and code features
en.description: The clearest pattern is wants (often followed by to) and sporadic code words, punctuation, and boundaries in programming or technical text; ordinary words in fiction, news, and patents also trigger sporadically, without forming a unified semantic pattern.

patterns.name: “wants” expressions of desire or intent
patterns.context: Appears in “wants to …” constructions; may express a character’s wish to do something, or a country’s or other entity’s plans or intentions.
patterns.domain: Fictional dialogue, news headlines or links

patterns.name: “Gives me” error-introducing phrase
patterns.context: In programming Q&A, a fixed phrase introduces a terminal error.

patterns.name: Punctuation, boundaries, and formatting tokens in code
patterns.context: Across code snippets, activation is distributed over brackets, punctuation, line breaks, indentation, and operators; the content and languages vary.
patterns.domain: R, Go, XML, Python, and other code or technical documents

patterns.name: Word fragments in code and technical text
patterns.context: Activation falls on identifiers, keywords, or document words in different languages and uses; there is no clear shared semantic condition.
patterns.domain: Programming Q&A, source code, configuration files, and technical documents

patterns.name: Sporadic word fragments in non-code text
patterns.context: These words are scattered across narratives, news, and patent backgrounds; aside from the wants pattern in passages 1, 2, and 10, no stable shared trigger is apparent.

6_2335.concept: 混合词形与代码特征
6_2335.description: 最明显的规律是 wants（常接 to）及编程/技术文本中的零散代码词、标点和边界；另有小说、新闻、专利中的普通词零散激活，无法归入统一语义模式。

patterns.name: “wants”需求/意图表达
patterns.context: 出现在“wants to …”结构中；可表达人物希望做某事，也可表达国家或主体的计划、意图。
patterns.domain: 小说对白、新闻标题或链接

patterns.name: “Gives me”错误引出语
patterns.trigger: «G»«ives» me the following error in «the» terminal«:»
patterns.context: 编程问答中，以固定短语引出终端错误。

patterns.name: 代码中的标点、边界与格式 token
patterns.context: 多种代码片段中，激活分布在括号、标点、换行、缩进和运算符等位置；片段内容和语言并不相同。
patterns.domain: R、Go、XML、Python 等代码或技术文档

patterns.name: 代码与技术文本中的词片段
patterns.context: 激活落在不同语言和用途的代码标识符、关键字或文档词上；没有共同的明确语义条件。
patterns.domain: 编程问答、源码、配置文件及技术文档

patterns.name: 非代码文本中的零散词片段
patterns.context: 这些词分散在叙事、新闻、专利背景中；除第1、2、10段的 wants 结构外，看不出稳定的共同触发条件。

en.description: Activations are scattered across code, comments, documentation, advertising, and configuration text; a repeated cue is the English word and and its code/identifier contexts, though some hits may be incidental letter sequences and cannot be explained by a single semantic pattern.

patterns.name: Conjunction and in code
patterns.context: Connects two conditions, concepts, or nouns; occurs in code syntax as well as comments, titles, and ordinary descriptions.
patterns.domain: Software code, technical documentation, and descriptive text

patterns.name: and inside Java identifiers
patterns.context: Occurs incidentally only in Java code identifiers or ordinary English phrases; there is no unified semantic or contextual condition.

patterns.name: Ruby task and collection iteration code
patterns.context: Ruby/Rails-style task code iterates over expired announcements and processes their associated users.

patterns.name: C array initialization
patterns.context: A C example declares and initializes a two-dimensional array; the title mentions arrays and pointer addressing.

patterns.name: Graphics or bitmap terms in code comments
patterns.context: An assembly or low-level graphics code fragment contains diagonal bitmap-related identifiers and register notes; the triggering relation is unclear.
patterns.domain: Low-level graphics code or assembly comments

patterns.name: Conjunction in advertising copy
patterns.context: Lists product features in short sentences; “and” connects related attributes.

patterns.name: and and fields in JSON/configuration text
patterns.context: A title field in configuration or UI data; “and” connects two monitored items.
patterns.domain: JSON configuration or application UI data

6_2335.concept: and/并列连接线索
6_2335.description: 激活片段分散于代码、注释、文档、广告和配置文本；可见重复线索是英文 and 及其代码/标识符环境，但部分命中可能只是偶然字母序列，无法由单一语义模式解释。

patterns.name: 代码中的并列连接词 and
patterns.trigger: “and”（如 [2] 的 “err == nil && res.StatusCode == 200”、[5] 的 “same signalId and same eventId”、[8] 的 “padding bytes, which MUST be zero”附近的代码条件，以及 [9] 的 “array and pointer addressing”）
patterns.context: 连接两个条件、概念或名词；既出现于代码语法，也出现于注释、标题和普通描述中。
patterns.domain: 软件代码、技术文档与描述性文本

patterns.name: Java 标识符内部的 and
patterns.trigger: “Application”、“getDefaultToolkit”、“getImage”、“setDataSource”、“MeasurementUnit”等代码标识符中可能包含字母序列 and；[1] 另有 “to my knowledge”
patterns.context: 仅在 Java 代码标识符或普通英文短语中偶然出现；没有统一的语义或上下文条件。

patterns.name: Ruby 任务与集合迭代代码
patterns.context: Ruby/Rails 风格的任务代码，遍历过期公告并处理其所属用户。

patterns.name: C 语言数组初始化
patterns.context: C 示例中声明并初始化二维数组，标题提及数组和指针寻址。

patterns.name: 代码注释中的图形或位图术语
patterns.context: 汇编或低层图形代码片段，含对角线位图相关标识符和寄存器说明；触发关系不明确。
patterns.domain: 低层图形代码或汇编注释

patterns.name: 广告文案中的并列连接
patterns.trigger: “More durable than plain paper stickers”、“Much more affordable”、“Water and humidity resistant”
patterns.context: 以短句列举产品特性；“and”连接相关属性。

patterns.name: JSON/配置文本中的 and 与字段
patterns.context: 配置或界面数据中的标题字段；“and”连接两个监测对象。
patterns.domain: JSON 配置或应用界面数据

en.description: Primarily activates on the word-final -s fragment in English third-person singular verbs or related word forms, across technical genres; there are also sporadic activations near code identifiers and formatting.

patterns.name: English verb suffix -s
patterns.context: Activation concentrates on word-final -s in English verbs or derived forms; sometimes the marked substring spans the stem and suffix. Examples include Raises, validates, obviates, belongs, uses, and performs.
patterns.domain: Various genres, including code, news headlines, patents, papers, and technical descriptions

patterns.name: Word-final fragments in code identifiers
patterns.context: The marked span occurs within the identifier com.virosys.amd in an Android package name; it is not clearly an English verb suffix.

patterns.name: Activation near code formatting and indentation
patterns.context: Activation occurs near line breaks, semicolons, and indentation in a plotting code snippet, with no clear alignment to the word-final -s pattern.

6_2335.concept: 英文词尾 -s
6_2335.description: 主要对英文动词第三人称单数或相关词形中的 -s 词尾片段激活，跨技术文体出现；另有代码标识符及排版附近的零散激活。

patterns.name: 英文动词词尾 -s
patterns.context: 激活集中在英文动词或派生词的词尾 -s；有时标记跨越词干与词尾的子串。包括 Raises、validates、obviates、belongs、uses、performs。
patterns.domain: 代码、新闻标题、专利、论文及技术说明等多种文体

patterns.name: 代码标识符中的词尾片段
patterns.context: 标记出现在 Android 包名 com.virosys.amd 的标识符内部；并非清楚的英文动词词尾用法。

patterns.name: 代码排版与缩进附近激活
patterns.context: 激活出现在绘图代码片段中换行、分号和缩进附近，和词尾 -s 模式不明显一致。

en.concept: Local phrases and formatting features across domains
en.description: Activations are scattered across legal motions, poses/uses in technical text, and code indentation and line breaks; they also involve costs, judicial review, paper terminology, and imaging, with no unified stable trigger pattern.

patterns.name: Motions in legal documents
patterns.context: Legal rulings or litigation narratives mention motions being filed, heard, pending, or dismissed; this occurs in multiple legal passages.

patterns.name: poses in technical texts
patterns.context: poses is followed by negative consequences such as threats, risks, or safety concerns; used for environmental hazards and pollution safety risks, respectively.

patterns.name: Line endings and whitespace in code
patterns.context: Line breaks and indentation occur at statement, code-block, or module boundaries; activation also covers blank lines.

patterns.name: uses in technical literature
patterns.context: Describes a method or device using certain information, technology, or imaging modalities; occurs in method introductions and application descriptions.

patterns.name: costs in patent backgrounds
patterns.context: Describes production costs for a cultivation process and their high level, alongside factors such as expensive culture media.

patterns.name: de novo in judicial rulings
patterns.context: A court explains the standard of review and discusses motions in the same judicial context.

patterns.name: Gets in code
patterns.context: A comment in Ruby task code describes the operation of retrieving a user who owns an announcement.

patterns.name: wastewater in a paper abstract
patterns.context: Introduces wastewater contaminated with oil or organic compounds and its hazards at the start of a sentence.

patterns.name: PDF export module
patterns.context: JavaScript code implements PDF merging; activation also occurs at a line break at the end of the code.

patterns.name: Paper method name and citation
patterns.context: The paper introduces a smoothing method for spatial and directional information and provides a reference citation.

patterns.name: Imaging modalities in research text
patterns.context: Discusses MRI and motion, cardiovascular, or musculoskeletal applications, and mentions combining it with other imaging modalities.

6_2335.concept: 多领域局部词句与格式特征
6_2335.description: 激活分散在法律 motions、技术文本中的 poses/uses，以及代码缩进换行等局部词句；还涉及 costs、司法审查、论文术语与影像等，未见统一稳定触发模式。

patterns.name: 法律文书中的 motions
patterns.context: 法律判决或诉讼程序叙述中，提及提出、审理、待决或撤销 motions；在多个法律段落出现。

patterns.name: 技术文本中的 poses
patterns.context: poses 后接威胁、风险或安全顾虑等负面后果；分别用于环境危害和污染安全风险。

patterns.name: 代码中的行结束与空白
patterns.trigger: 换行符“↵”及其后的缩进空格（如 [8] 的 “↵»4  ”）
patterns.context: 代码块中在语句、代码块或模块边界处出现换行和缩进；激活也覆盖空行。

patterns.name: 技术文献中的 uses
patterns.context: 描述方法或设备采用某种信息、技术或成像种类；出现于方法介绍和应用说明。
patterns.domain: 学术论文、科研资助文本

patterns.name: 专利背景中的 costs
patterns.context: 描述培养工艺的生产成本及其高昂；该处伴随对昂贵培养基等因素的说明。

patterns.name: 司法裁定中的 de novo
patterns.context: 法院说明审查标准，并在同一司法语境中谈及 motions。

patterns.name: 代码中的 Gets
patterns.context: Ruby 任务代码中的注释，描述获取公告所有者用户的操作。

patterns.name: 论文摘要中的 wastewater
patterns.context: 句首引出受油或有机化合物污染的废水及其危害。

patterns.name: PDF 导出模块
patterns.context: JavaScript 代码导出 PDF 合并功能；激活还出现在该代码的结尾换行处。

patterns.name: 论文方法名称及引文
patterns.context: 论文正文介绍空间与方向信息的平滑方法，并附参考文献引文。

patterns.name: 科研文本中的影像种类
patterns.context: 讨论 MRI 与运动、心血管或肌骨应用，并提到与其他成像方式结合。

en.description: All passages activate near word-final s/es, covering different forms such as third-person singular verbs and plurals; domains and semantics vary widely, possibly reflecting sensitivity to suffix morphology or subword boundaries.

patterns.name: Word-final -s inflection
patterns.context: A plural or third-person singular suffix follows the stem; activation falls on part of the suffix rather than consistently on the whole word.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain text: code comments, academic papers, patents, legal text, and web text

6_2335.concept: 英语词尾 s/es 形态
6_2335.description: 各段激活都落在词尾 s/es 附近，涉及动词第三人称单数、复数等不同形态；领域和语义差异很大，可能反映对词尾形态或子词边界的敏感。

patterns.name: 词尾 -s 的词形变化
patterns.trigger: 高亮多出现在词尾 «s» 或 «es»，如 “F«rees»”“model«s»”“Merg«es»”“permit[«s»]”“uses”“Design«s»”“Prov«ides»”
patterns.context: 词根后接复数或第三人称单数等词尾；激活落在词尾的一部分，而非始终落在完整词上。
patterns.domain: 跨领域文本：代码注释、学术论文、专利、法律及网页文本

en.description: The most consistent cue is activation biased toward word-final s or word-final fragments containing s, covering verb forms and plural nouns; code also shows activation on word endings and boundary markers. A few short words, line breaks, and punctuation activate as well, without a clear unified explanation.

patterns.name: Verbs or roots ending in s
patterns.context: Occurs in third-person singular verb forms or words ending in s, such as plural nouns; activation often falls on the word ending but sometimes covers a longer final fragment.
patterns.domain: Across domains: code comments, news headlines, lyric lists, film reviews, and general narrative

patterns.name: Word endings and boundaries in Python/Ruby-style code
patterns.context: Word-final fragments in code indentation, identifiers, or labels; accompanied by spaces, punctuation, or hyphens, though these markers may simply reflect the word-final pattern in code.
patterns.domain: Code and configuration snippets on StackExchange

patterns.name: Short words or formatting tokens not classified above
patterns.context: Activation falls on common short words, formatting boundaries such as line breaks or hyphens, or punctuation; the local context is insufficient to determine whether they relate to the word-final pattern.

6_2335.concept: 词尾 s 及邻近边界
6_2335.description: 最一致的线索是激活偏向词尾 s 或包含 s 的词尾片段，涵盖动词词形和复数名词；代码中也有词尾及边界标记激活。另有少量短词、换行和标点激活，未见明确统一解释。

patterns.name: 动词或词根以 s 结尾
patterns.trigger: 多处标记在词尾 s 或带 s 的词尾片段上，如 [1] `Fix«es»10`、[3] `m«oves»10`、[4] `«F»1rees»9`、[5] `Draw«s»9`、[8] `«Sets»9`、[9] `perfect«s»9`、[10] `W»1arn«s»9`
patterns.context: 出现在动词第三人称单数形式，或名词复数等以 s 结尾的词中；激活常落在词尾，但有时覆盖更长词尾片段。
patterns.domain: 跨领域：代码注释、新闻标题、歌词列表、影评与一般叙述

patterns.name: Python/Ruby 风格代码中的词尾与边界
patterns.context: 代码缩进、标识符或标签中的词尾片段；伴随空格、标点或连字符等边界，但这些标记也可能只是词尾模式在代码中的体现。
patterns.domain: StackExchange 上的代码与配置片段

patterns.name: 未能归入上述模式的短词或格式 token
patterns.context: 激活落在常见短词、换行/连字符等格式边界或标点上；局部上下文不足以确认是否与词尾模式有关。
patterns.domain: 发布说明、XML 配置代码

en.concept: The letter s and its morphological cues
en.description: The most consistent cue is a response to word forms containing s, especially word-final s, as in third-person verbs or plurals; activation also occurs on possessives, s in proper nouns, a few code-formatting symbols, uppercase G, and common function words.

patterns.name: Word-final s / third-person verb forms
patterns.context: Activation falls on word-final s or within/at the end of a verb form containing s; lexical items and syntactic positions vary, with no single semantic or genre restriction.
patterns.domain: Code, technical papers, news headlines, legal text, patent backgrounds, emails, etc.

patterns.name: S in possessives or contractions
patterns.context: S occurs in possessive- or reflexive-pronoun-related forms or within proper nouns; it is not necessarily a verb suffix.
patterns.domain: Code comments, legal text, news headlines

patterns.name: Uppercase G followed by lowercase letters
patterns.context: Marks uppercase G followed by letters forming the beginning of a word; observed only in proper nouns and code comments.

patterns.name: Newline and whitespace tokens
patterns.context: Activation occurs on line breaks or indentation whitespace in code formatting; neighboring content is Java source code.

patterns.name: Quotation mark or square-bracket boundaries
patterns.context: Marks symbols such as array-index or comment boundaries in code; the context is Java source code.

patterns.name: Conjunctions and grammatical function words
patterns.context: Scattered across technical, legal, and news sentences, with no stable semantic or syntactic position explaining the activations.

6_2335.concept: 字母 s 及其词形线索
6_2335.description: 最一致的线索是对含 s 的词形（尤其词尾 s，如动词第三人称或复数）有反应；此外也激活于所有格、专名中的 s，以及少数代码格式符号、大写 G 和常见功能词。

patterns.name: 词尾 s/动词第三人称形式
patterns.context: 激活落在词尾 s，或带 s 的动词形式内部/末尾；词汇和句法位置各异，并非仅限一种语义或文体。
patterns.domain: 代码、技术论文、新闻标题、法律文本、专利背景、邮件等

patterns.name: 所有格或缩写中的 s
patterns.context: s 出现在所有格/反身代词相关形式或专名内部；不一定是动词词尾。
patterns.domain: 代码注释、法律文本、新闻标题

patterns.name: 大写 G 后接小写字母
patterns.context: 单独标记大写 G，后接构成词首的字母；这里只见于专名和代码注释。

patterns.name: 换行与空白 token
patterns.context: 激活出现在代码格式中的换行或缩进空白，邻近内容为 Java 源码。

patterns.name: 引号或方括号边界
patterns.context: 标记代码中的数组下标/注释边界等符号；上下文为 Java 源码。

patterns.name: 连接词和语法功能词
patterns.context: 零散出现在技术、法律和新闻语句中，没有稳定的语义或句法位置能解释各处激活。

en.description: Primarily activates the suffix -s on English third-person singular verbs and plural nouns, especially at the boundary between the stem and -s; also includes -ies plurals, code line breaks and indentation, and sporadic activations on word-internal fragments and function words.

patterns.name: Third-person singular verb suffix
patterns.context: Activation concentrates on the suffix -s, usually on verb stems. It occurs on third-person singular verb forms in sentences or code comments, with a few cases where the same ending appears on other parts of speech.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain: Java documentation and code, patents, medical papers, Ruby comments, and technical papers

patterns.name: Plural noun suffix
patterns.context: Activation falls on the plural suffix -s, on stems ending in -ment or other nouns.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain code, patents, and scientific text

patterns.name: English suffix -ies
patterns.context: Occurs in the plural nouns Universities and Spies, with activation spanning the suffix -ies.

patterns.name: Punctuation and indentation in code
patterns.context: Several adjacent line breaks and indentation occur at the end of a Java method; activation is marked on parentheses, line breaks, and whitespace, not just English word endings.

patterns.name: Sporadic English fragments that are difficult to group
patterns.context: Short function words or single-letter fragments are marked, with no stable semantic or syntactic condition evident.
patterns.domain: Patent background sections, medical papers, and compressed-file code comments

patterns.name: Unexplained word-internal fragments
patterns.context: A word-initial letter within Ruby comments activates independently and cannot be directly explained by the common -s suffix pattern.

6_2335.concept: 英语词形变化的 s 词尾
6_2335.description: 主要对英语动词第三人称单数和复数名词的词尾 -s 激活，尤其是词干后缀与 s 的边界；另有 -ies 复数、代码换行缩进，以及若干零散词内片段和功能词激活。

patterns.name: 动词第三人称单数词尾
patterns.context: 激活集中在词尾 -s，词根通常是动词；出现在句子或代码注释中的第三人称单数动词形式，也有少数词尾相同但词性不同的情况
patterns.domain: 跨领域：Java 文档与代码、专利、医学论文、Ruby 注释、科技论文

patterns.name: 复数名词词尾
patterns.context: 激活落在名词复数后缀 -s，词根可为 -ment 结尾或其他名词
patterns.domain: 跨领域的代码、专利与科学文本

patterns.name: 英语词尾 -ies
patterns.context: 出现在复数名词 Universities、Spies 中，激活覆盖词尾 -ies

patterns.name: 代码中的标点及缩进
patterns.trigger: «();» 后的换行、缩进空格、花括号和 «↵↵»
patterns.context: Java 方法结束处，多个换行与缩进相邻；激活标注在括号、换行和空白上，而非仅英语词尾

patterns.name: 难以归并的零散英文片段
patterns.trigger: « with»、« Thus»、« in»、« is»、« a»、« the»、« M»
patterns.context: 短功能词或单字母片段被标记，未显示出稳定的语义或句法条件
patterns.domain: 专利背景技术、医学论文、压缩文件代码注释

patterns.name: 未解释的词内片段
patterns.context: Ruby 注释中词内首字母单独激活，不能由常见的 -s 词尾模式直接解释

en.description: Activation mainly falls on English third-person singular verb suffixes and plural noun suffixes; it also appears in C++ build configuration, color-scheme names, and URL letter fragments, whose relation to the suffix pattern is uncertain.

patterns.name: Third-person singular verb suffix -s/-es
patterns.context: A third-person singular suffix follows a verb stem, often in code documentation comments or news headlines; “Prints” in [9] may be a suffix in standalone output text.
patterns.domain: Code comments, news headlines, and mixed text

patterns.name: Plural suffix -s
patterns.context: A plural noun suffix; activation falls within or near the word ending, surrounded by noun phrases or code variables.

patterns.name: C++ build configuration syntax
patterns.context: Makefile-style variable assignments, compilers, and compiler options.

patterns.name: Letters in URLs
patterns.context: A letter sequence in a news-link URL path coincides with an English verb suffix fragment, but does not form a clearly identifiable independent semantic pattern.

patterns.name: Near color-scheme names
patterns.context: Color map/color-scheme code examples; activation may involve a name fragment or a nearby string, with unclear relation to other patterns.

6_2335.concept: 英语屈折词尾（偏 s）
6_2335.description: 激活主要落在英语动词第三人称单数词尾及名词复数词尾；另见 C++ 构建配置、颜色方案名称和 URL 字母片段，后几类与词尾模式的联系不确定。

patterns.name: 第三人称单数动词词尾 s/ es
patterns.context: 动词词干后接第三人称单数词尾，常出现在代码文档注释或新闻标题中；[9]的 “Prints” 可能是独立输出文本中的词尾
patterns.domain: 代码注释、新闻标题及混合文本

patterns.name: 复数词尾 s
patterns.context: 名词复数后缀；激活落在词尾内部或词尾附近，周围有名词短语或代码变量

patterns.name: C++ 构建配置语法
patterns.context: Makefile 风格的变量赋值及编译器、编译选项

patterns.name: URL 中的字母
patterns.context: 新闻链接的 URL 路径中，字母序列恰与英语动词词尾片段相同，但不构成可确定的独立语义模式

patterns.name: 颜色方案名称附近
patterns.context: 颜色映射/色彩方案代码示例；激活可能涉及名称片段或邻近字符串，和其他模式的关系不明

en.description: Primarily sensitive to word-final s: examples include third-person singular verbs, plural nouns, and possessives/contractions after apostrophes, across code, chat, news, and encyclopedic text. A few positions may be affected by word boundaries or tokenization.

patterns.name: Third-person plural verb suffix s
patterns.context: Occurs on third-person singular verbs, with the stem unmarked or weakly activated; s strongly activates at the local word-form boundary.
patterns.domain: Various styles, including code, narrative, chat, news, and encyclopedic text

patterns.name: Plural noun suffix s
patterns.context: Occurs at the end of plural noun forms; in some words, s is a suffix rather than a standalone word.

patterns.name: S in possessives or contractions
patterns.context: s occurs after an apostrophe in colloquial contractions or possessive forms.
patterns.domain: IRC chat and entertainment plot summaries

patterns.name: Plural noun/verb suffix s and word boundaries
patterns.context: Activation falls on verbs or plural forms ending in s; nearby word boundaries and syntactic structure may also contribute. The specific morphological analysis is not fully certain.

patterns.name: Unexplained word-internal or boundary activation
patterns.context: Activation positions do not fit a clear word-final s pattern and may be affected by segmentation or local context.
patterns.domain: Java code comments and forum text

6_2335.concept: 词尾 s 形态标记
6_2335.description: 主要对词尾 s 敏感：第三人称单数动词、名词复数及撇号后的所有格/缩写均有例证，跨代码、聊天、新闻与百科。少数位置可能受词界或分词影响。

patterns.name: 复数第三人称动词词尾 s
patterns.context: 出现在第三人称单数动词上，词干未标记或激活较弱；局部词形边界处的 s 强烈激活。
patterns.domain: 代码、叙事、聊天、新闻、百科等多种文体

patterns.name: 名词复数词尾 s
patterns.context: 出现在名词复数形式末尾；部分词中 s 并非独立词而是词尾。

patterns.name: 所有格或缩写中的 s
patterns.context: s 位于撇号后，分别出现在口语缩写或所有格形式中。

patterns.name: 名词复数/动词词尾 s 与词界
patterns.context: 激活落在以 s 结尾的动词或复数形式上，邻近词界及句法结构可能共同起作用；具体词形分析不完全确定。

patterns.name: 未解释的词内或边界激活
patterns.trigger: «SQLTimeoutException»中的空格边界标记 « »；以及 «attivation»中的 «s»
patterns.context: 激活位置不符合清楚的词尾 s 模式，可能受切分或局部上下文影响。

en.description: Most strong activations fall on words ending in s/es, including plurals, third-person verbs, and word-internal letters. Sporadic triggers also occur in code, technical terms, proper names, and scrolling contexts; the overall pattern is limited.

patterns.name: Plural forms or word-final s
patterns.context: Activation often occurs on word-final s/es rather than the whole word; examples include plural nouns, third-person singular verbs, and other forms ending in s. Marked boundaries vary across examples.
patterns.domain: Code, technical documentation, forum discussions, news, and general text

patterns.name: Structural markers in programming and technical text
patterns.context: In these passages, some high-activation positions fall on word endings, while others occur near code identifiers, abbreviations, or technical terms. A shared trigger is unclear, so the examples do not support grouping them under a single technical concept.
patterns.domain: Code, data plotting documentation, Java documentation, and electronic circuit patents

patterns.name: Local activation in proper names or entity names
patterns.context: Occurs in an account about card decks and characters; the marked “hes” is inside “brainwashes.” Other positive activations also occur near entity names, but their precise triggering boundaries are unclear.

patterns.name: Web and interface scrolling contexts
patterns.context: Describes scrolling through tables or web pages, with the marker on the ending of “scrolls.” This may relate to other word-final s activations, but there are only two examples and the context is narrow.
patterns.domain: Web code comments and web interaction descriptions

patterns.name: Color scales and cells in RGB/plotting code
patterns.context: Explains color mapping, color-scale labels, and cell assignment; activation is spread across multiple tokens, so it is unclear whether a shared substring triggers it.

6_2335.concept: 词尾 s/es（倾向）
6_2335.description: 多数强激活落在 s/es 结尾，涵盖复数、第三人称动词及词内字母；另有代码、技术术语、专名和滚动语境等零散触发，整体规律有限。

patterns.name: 复数词形或词尾 s
patterns.trigger: »9 主要落在复数或第三人称形式的末尾，如“scroll«s»10”“Construct«s»9”“switch«es»9”“reboot«s»9”“spreads»9”；也见“bookeen-sh«ows»9-off”“count«s»9”
patterns.context: 激活常位于词尾 s/es，而非整个词；可出现在名词复数、动词第三人称单数或其他以 s 结尾的词形中。不同例子中的标记边界并不完全一致。
patterns.domain: 代码、技术说明、论坛讨论、新闻及一般文本

patterns.name: 程序与技术文本中的结构性标记
patterns.trigger: [1] CSS 注释末尾“*/”；[2] 颜色映射名“GnBu”“OrRd”及“cells”；[4] “SQLTimeoutException”；[6] “synchronous rectifier (SR)”
patterns.context: 这些段落中的高激活位置有的落在词尾，有的与代码标识符、缩写或技术术语相邻；共同触发条件不明确，不能仅凭这些例子归为单一技术概念。
patterns.domain: 代码、数据绘图说明、Java 文档、电子电路专利

patterns.name: 专名或实体名称中的局部激活
patterns.trigger: “Chaos Emperor Dragon-Envoy of the End”“Black Luster Soldier-Envoy of the Beginning”“Rex”“Weevil”“Mai”
patterns.context: 出现在关于卡牌牌组和人物的叙述中；所标记的“hes”位于“brainwashes”内部，其他实体名称附近也有正激活，但其具体触发边界不清楚。

patterns.name: 网页与界面滚动语境
patterns.context: 描述表格或网页页面滚动，标记落在“scrolls”的词尾；与其他词尾 s 激活可能有关，但仅两例且语境较窄。
patterns.domain: 网页代码注释、网页交互说明

patterns.name: RGB/绘图代码中的色标与单元格
patterns.context: 解释颜色映射、色标标签与单元格赋值；激活分散在多个 token，无法确定是否由某个共同子串触发。

en.description: All passages mark within-word fragments, commonly word endings such as s/es, and also proper nouns and other affix boundaries; activation positions lack a unified semantic or syntactic function.

patterns.name: Within-word fragments or word endings
patterns.context: Activation falls within or at the end of complete words, covering plurals, verb forms, proper-noun spellings, and affix boundaries; there is no consistent syntactic position or semantic category.
patterns.domain: Various genres, including IRC, patents, game discussions, encyclopedias, emails, papers, news headlines, Q&A, and technology links

6_2335.concept: 词内子词片段
6_2335.description: 所有片段都标记了词内片段，常见于 s/es 等词尾，也见于专名和其他词缀边界；激活位置缺乏统一的语义或句法功能。

patterns.name: 词中片段或词尾
patterns.context: 激活落在完整词的内部或词尾，涵盖复数、动词词形、专名拼写及词缀边界；没有一致的句法位置或语义类别。
patterns.domain: IRC、专利、游戏讨论、百科、邮件、论文、新闻标题、问答、科技链接等多种文体

en.description: Activation often falls on word-final or internal fragments, especially plurals, verb endings, and character sequences in names. It also occurs in email headers, technical operation descriptions, code comments, and news headlines. The semantic and stylistic range is broad, making it difficult to group under a single semantic feature.

patterns.name: “-ers” endings/plural forms
patterns.context: Activation often falls on word endings or internal word fragments, including plural nouns, verb endings, and letter sequences in proper names; it is not limited to a single stem.
patterns.domain: Email, technical patents, news headlines, game narratives, and code comments

patterns.name: Local substrings in email names and addresses
patterns.context: In recipient lists, sender/recipient fields, or email headers, names and addresses are listed consecutively; activation covers only some of their characters or endings.

patterns.name: Transfer, retry, and quantity in technical descriptions
patterns.context: Descriptions of viral spread, SMS queue retries, bus transfer, or fluid transport include verbs for operations, transmission, or outcomes, as well as quantity or plural nouns.
patterns.domain: News reports and USPTO technical patents

patterns.name: Scrolling and plural elements in code comments
patterns.context: HTML/CSS example code is adjacent to English comments mentioning demo table scrolling; activation falls on code markers, tabs, and English inflectional forms.

patterns.name: Plural nouns and verb endings in news headlines
patterns.context: Telegraphic headlines list military and diplomatic news in compact phrases; activation covers plural nouns or internal fragments of verb forms.

patterns.name: Inflectional fragments in game characters and proper names
patterns.context: Yu-Gi-Oh!-related narratives contain character names and verbs ending in -hes; the activated fragment resembles local word forms in email names, but the semantic connection is unclear.

6_2335.concept: 词形后缀与字符片段
6_2335.description: 激活多落在词形末尾或内部片段，尤见复数、动词词尾及人名中的字符序列；它也出现在邮件抬头、技术操作描述、代码注释与新闻标题中。语义与文体跨度大，难以归为单一语义特征。

patterns.name: 词尾「-ers」/复数词形
patterns.trigger: 词尾 «ers»，出现在 «King»ers«ki»、«que»ues（实际为 -ues）、「microlit«ers»」和「pow«ers」等标记位置；另有 «planes»、«targets»、«positions»、«missiles»
patterns.context: 激活常落在词尾或词形内部，包含复数名词、动词词尾及专名中的字母序列；并不局限于单一词根。
patterns.domain: 邮件、技术专利、新闻标题、游戏叙述及代码注释

patterns.name: 邮件姓名与地址中的局部子串
patterns.trigger: «Ke»、«D»、«S»及 «King»ers«ki»，以及姓名、部门和邮件地址串
patterns.context: 在收件人列表、发件人/收件人字段或邮件抬头中，姓名及其地址被连续列出；激活只覆盖其中部分字符或词尾。

patterns.name: 技术性描述中的传递、重试与数量
patterns.context: 描述病毒扩散、短信排队重试、总线传递或流体输送时，出现表示操作、传送或结果的动词，以及数量/复数名词。
patterns.domain: 新闻报道与 USPTO 技术专利

patterns.name: 代码注释中的滚动与复数元素
patterns.context: HTML/CSS 示例代码与英文注释相邻，注释提到 demo table 滚动；激活同时落在代码标记、制表符和英语词形上。

patterns.name: 新闻标题中的复数名词及动词词尾
patterns.context: 电讯式标题以紧凑短句罗列军事、外交新闻；激活覆盖复数名词或动词词形内部。

patterns.name: 游戏人物与专名中的词形片段
patterns.context: 《游戏王》相关叙述中出现角色名和以 -hes 结尾的动词；激活片段与邮件姓名中的局部词形相似，但语义联系不明显。

en.description: Primarily activates the s/es suffix on English third-person singular verbs. It also strongly activates the “ers” fragment in the surname Kingerski in an email, possibly due to morphological or orthographic similarity.

patterns.name: Third-person singular verb suffix
patterns.context: Occurs in present-simple third-person singular verbs, including narrative sentences and technical descriptions.
patterns.domain: Patent technical text, code comments, news and forum text, and IRC conversations

patterns.name: “ers” fragment in a surname
patterns.context: The Enron email recipient or contact name “Harry Kingerski” is split into multiple tokens; this is not an obvious grammatical suffix.
patterns.domain: Email headers, email addresses, and contact lists

6_2335.concept: 英语词尾 s/es
6_2335.description: 主要激活英语第三人称单数动词的 s/es 词尾；另在邮件中的 Kingerski 姓氏片段“ers”上强烈激活，可能是形态或拼写层面的相似触发。

patterns.name: 动词第三人称单数词尾
patterns.context: 出现在一般现在时的第三人称单数动词中；包括句子叙述和技术说明。
patterns.domain: 专利技术文本、代码注释、新闻与论坛文字、IRC 对话

patterns.name: 姓氏中的“ers”片段
patterns.context: Enron 邮件收件人或联系人姓名“Harry Kingerski”被拆分成多个 token；不是明显的语法词尾。
patterns.domain: 邮件头、邮件地址与联系人列表

en.description: Activation is concentrated on word-final s/es: plural forms, third-person forms, and plural markers in technical abbreviations. It also occurs on monitors and displays in a diagnostic-display passage; the word-final pattern may be relevant, but the examples are not all obviously consistent.

patterns.name: Plural-form endings -s/-es
patterns.context: A stem takes a suffix marking a plural noun or third-person singular form, although this does not explain every passage.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain text, especially technical literature and code examples

patterns.name: Plural markers in technical abbreviations
patterns.context: In technical contexts such as optics, memory, or proteomics, s in an abbreviation indicates a plural or is part of a unit or term.
patterns.domain: Patents, medical text, and research abstracts

patterns.name: Word-final s in program/API identifiers
patterns.context: In code comments or programming documentation, word-final s is part of a method name or marks a grammatical verb/noun form.

patterns.name: Word-final s in specific terms or proper names
patterns.context: The ending occurs in plural optical terms or biological verb forms.

patterns.name: Diagnostic-display terms
patterns.context: Describes displays for an examiner and examinee, along with what each displays; activation falls on plural nouns and verb forms.

6_2335.concept: 词尾 s/es 及复数标记
6_2335.description: 激活多集中于词尾 s/es：复数、第三人称形式及技术缩写中的复数标记；另在诊断显示段的 monitors、displays 上激活，词尾规律或许有关，但并非全部显然一致。

patterns.name: 复数形式词尾 -s/-es
patterns.trigger: 多处高激活落在单词末尾的复数或第三人称词尾，如 «Ms»（DIMMs、RPPAs）、«s»（finds、sets、blooms、achromats）
patterns.context: 词干后接表示复数名词或第三人称单数的词尾；但并非所有段都能由此解释
patterns.domain: 跨领域文本，尤见技术文献与代码示例

patterns.name: 技术缩写中的复数标记
patterns.trigger: «Ms»，见“FWH«Ms»”和“dual inline memory «modules» (…DIM«Ms»)”，以及“protein« arrays» (…RPP«As»)”中的缩写末尾
patterns.context: 光学、存储器或蛋白质组学等技术语境中，缩写以 s 表示复数或单位/术语的一部分

patterns.name: 程序/API 标识符中的词尾 s
patterns.context: 代码注释或编程说明中，词尾 s 属于方法名，或标记动词/名词的语法形式

patterns.name: 特定术语或专名中的词尾 s
patterns.context: 词尾嵌在光学术语复数或生物学动词形式中

patterns.name: 诊断显示相关词语
patterns.context: 描述检查者与受检者的显示器及各自显示内容；激活落在复数名词和动词形式上

en.concept: Determiners and -s morphology in English technical text
en.description: Activation is relatively scattered: patent text often features expressions of quantity, range, and qualification, while word-final -s recurs across many domains in both third-person verbs and plural nouns. Engineering transfer actions are a weaker accompanying cue.

patterns.name: Comparisons and qualifications of quantity, degree, or range
patterns.context: When describing technical effects, quantities, dimensions, or information displays, numerals, degree words, or range qualifiers indicate increase or decrease, minima, selectivity, or similarity.
patterns.domain: Patent backgrounds and technical descriptions; also diagnostic display instructions

patterns.name: -s suffix in third-person singular verbs
patterns.context: In English narration, verbs following third-person singular subjects; activation falls on word-final -s, with the word form split in annotation.
patterns.domain: News, forum headlines, fiction/game narratives, and patent text

patterns.name: Plural -s suffix in technical terminology
patterns.context: Nouns appear in plural form in technical descriptions, with activation on word-final -s; this may share a morphological cue with the verb-suffix pattern.

patterns.name: Actions denoting transfer or distribution in technical text
patterns.context: Describes devices conveying fluid, distributing driving force, or transmitting signals between modules; these words have clear agentive and transfer-related meanings.

patterns.name: -s endings across nontechnical narratives
patterns.context: Third-person verbs also end in -s in non-patent contexts; this pattern is independent of the specific domain of technical corpora.

6_2335.concept: 英语技术文本中的限定与 -s 形态
6_2335.description: 激活较分散：专利文本常见数量、范围和限定表达；多种领域又反复出现词尾 -s，既包括第三人称动词，也包括复数名词。工程传递动作是较弱的伴随线索。

patterns.name: 数量、程度或范围的比较与限定
patterns.trigger: “reduced by 1/Ns”“greater amounts”“at least 100”“only the required amounts”“similar diameter”“all necessary information … only an image”
patterns.context: 在描述技术效果、用量、尺寸或信息显示时，用数量词、程度词或范围限定来说明增减、最低值、选择性或相似性。
patterns.domain: 专利背景及技术说明；也见诊断显示说明

patterns.name: 第三人称单数动词的 -s 词尾
patterns.context: 英语叙述中第三人称单数主语后的动词，激活落在词尾 -s 上；词形被拆分标注。
patterns.domain: 新闻、论坛标题、小说/游戏叙述及专利文本

patterns.name: 技术术语中的复数 -s 词尾
patterns.context: 技术说明中名词以复数形式出现，激活落在词尾 -s；与动词词尾模式可能有共同的形态线索。

patterns.name: 技术文本中表示传递或分配的动作
patterns.context: 描述装置输送流体、驱动力分配或模块间信号传递；这些词带有明显的施动、传递含义。

patterns.name: 跨非技术叙述出现的 -s 词尾
patterns.context: 非专利语境中，第三人称动词同样以 -s 结尾；与技术语料的具体领域无关。
patterns.domain: 角色扮演游戏叙述、网页标题

en.description: Activation is dispersed across cross-domain text, often falling on word-final subwords, plurals, or function words. It also occurs in quantitative expressions, technical terms, and code/action descriptions; no stable, single semantic theme is evident.

patterns.name: Various plural forms or word-final fragments
patterns.context: Triggers are often word-final subwords or plural forms, typically following a stem; specific meanings and syntactic positions vary.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain: patents, medicine, physics, philosophy, programming Q&A, and research funding

patterns.name: Function words and syntactic links
patterns.context: Occurs in ordinary syntactic positions in continuous technical or argumentative text, without a unified semantic condition in isolation.

patterns.name: Technical quantities and symbolic expressions
patterns.context: Embedded in units, formulas, or experimental values; only a few fragments are clearly of this type.

patterns.name: Code or web-operation words
patterns.context: Occurs in descriptions of page scrolling, program assignment, or circuit-drive signals; trigger positions are often verb endings or verbs.

patterns.name: Specific term ending
patterns.context: An optics passage refers to achromatic lenses, with activation on the term’s ending; the semantic connection to other passages is unclear.

6_2335.concept: 词形与句法片段
6_2335.description: 激活分散在跨领域文本中，常落在词尾子词、复数或功能词，也见于量式、技术术语和代码/操作描述；未显出稳定单一语义主题。

patterns.name: 多词形复数或词尾片段
patterns.context: 触发点多为词的末尾子词或复数形式，前面常有词干；具体词义和句法位置各异。
patterns.domain: 跨领域：专利、医学、物理、哲学、编程问答、科研资助

patterns.name: 功能词与句法连接
patterns.context: 出现在连续技术或论述文本的普通句法位置；单独看并无统一的语义条件。
patterns.domain: 跨领域说明文与学术文本

patterns.name: 技术量值与符号化表达
patterns.context: 嵌在单位、公式或实验数值表达中；仅少数片段明显呈现。

patterns.name: 代码或网页操作词
patterns.context: 出现在页面滚动、程序赋值或电路驱动信号的动作描述中，触发位置多为动词词尾或动词。

patterns.name: 特定术语词尾
patterns.context: 光学段落中指消色差透镜，激活落在术语词尾；与其他段落的语义联系不明确。

en.description: Primarily sensitive to word-final s: it responds to both third-person singular verbs and plural nouns. A few activations fall on possessives, contractions, or forms that are difficult to classify.

patterns.name: Third-person singular verb suffix
patterns.context: Word-final s attaches to a verb stem, commonly in the present-simple third-person singular; examples also include “mel«ts»” and “«lays»”.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain; narratives, technical descriptions, news, and code documentation

patterns.name: Plural noun suffix
patterns.context: Word-final s forms a plural noun, appearing in lists of objects, technical terms, or news headlines.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain; colloquial narratives, software documentation, patents, scientific papers, and news

patterns.name: S in possessives or contractions
patterns.context: The marker may fall on s in a possessive or contraction spelling, but local text or tokenization is irregular, making the exact form uncertain.

patterns.name: Other words or proper-name fragments ending in s
patterns.context: Triggers occur on various forms; some may still be verb endings or noun plurals. Unclear segmentation and marking positions make their relationship to the first two categories uncertain.
patterns.domain: Mixed corpus: card-game narratives, software documentation, and mining news

6_2335.concept: 词尾 s 形态
6_2335.description: 主要对词尾 s 敏感：既响应第三人称单数动词，也响应复数名词；少数落在所有格、缩写或难以判定的词形中。

patterns.name: 动词第三人称单数词尾
patterns.context: 词尾 s 附着在动词词干上，常见于一般现在时第三人称单数；也包括 “mel«ts»”“«lays»” 等。
patterns.domain: 跨领域；叙述、技术说明、新闻及代码文档

patterns.name: 名词复数词尾
patterns.context: 词尾 s 构成复数名词，出现在列举对象、技术术语或新闻标题中。
patterns.domain: 跨领域；口语叙述、软件文档、专利、科学论文及新闻

patterns.name: 所有格或缩写中的 s
patterns.context: 标记可能落在所有格/缩写拼写中的 s，但局部文本或分词不规范，具体形态不确定。

patterns.name: 其他以 s 结尾的词或专名片段
patterns.trigger: “Chaos”, “uses”, “Weevil”, “OZ Find«s» New High-grade”中的标记位置
patterns.context: 可见触发落在不同词形上，部分可能仍是动词词尾或名词复数；由于切分和标注位置不清，无法确认与前两类的关系。
patterns.domain: 混合语料：卡牌叙述、软件说明、矿业新闻

en.concept: English word endings and boundary fragments
en.description: Activation often occurs on English word endings or complete forms with endings, such as plural nouns and verbs. It also appears sporadically on line breaks, ordinary word fragments, and uppercase fragments with nonstandard tokenization; domains and semantics are not unified.

patterns.name: Word endings or stem fragments
patterns.context: Activation falls on English word endings or subword fragments, often plurals, third-person forms, or other suffixes; these fragments do not all carry the same meaning.

patterns.name: Verb forms and nearby boundaries
patterns.context: Activation may cover a complete suffixed verb or its ending; in some contexts, the suffix is adjacent to punctuation, a space, or a line break.

patterns.name: Plural noun suffix
patterns.context: The ending occurs in plural nouns; stems and domains vary, and the words do not form a single lexical or semantic category.
patterns.domain: Mathematical physics, games, patents, and consumer electronics discussions

patterns.name: Tokens near spaces or line breaks
patterns.context: In addition to word-internal fragments, activation also falls on line breaks or very short fragments of ordinary words, showing that the pattern is not limited to word endings.

patterns.name: Local fragments in proper names or labels
patterns.context: Activation occurs in letter fragments with nonstandard tokenization; the context is uppercase text in sports commentary, with no clear semantic association.

patterns.name: Raises in a named entity
patterns.context: The word appears in a technology-news headline about a company financing event. It may be formally similar to other word-ending activations, but there are only two examples.

6_2335.concept: 英语词尾及边界片段
6_2335.description: 激活多见于英语词尾或带词尾的完整形式，如复数名词和动词；也散见于换行、普通词片段及非标准分词的大写片段，领域和语义不统一。

patterns.name: 词尾或词干片段
patterns.context: 激活落在英语词形的词尾或子词片段上，常见复数、第三人称形式或其他后缀；这些片段并非都承载相同语义。

patterns.name: 动词形式及其附近边界
patterns.context: 激活可覆盖带词尾的完整动词或其词尾；有的上下文中词尾紧邻标点、空格或换行。

patterns.name: 名词复数词尾
patterns.context: 词尾位于复数名词中；被激活的词干和领域各异，并非同一种词汇或语义类别。
patterns.domain: 数学物理、游戏、专利及消费电子讨论

patterns.name: 空格或换行附近的 token
patterns.context: 除了词内片段，也有激活落在换行或普通词的极短片段上，显示模式并不只限于词尾。

patterns.name: 专名或标记的局部片段
patterns.context: 激活出现在非标准分词的字母片段中；上下文是球赛评论中的大写字样，语义关联不明显。

patterns.name: 标记实体中的 Raises
patterns.context: 词语位于公司融资新闻标题中，描述融资事件；与其他词尾激活可能有形式相似性，但仅有两例。

en.concept: English word-final s and local function words
en.description: Activation most consistently falls on English word-final s/plural or third-person forms, and also marks several common function words; domains vary widely, while some hyphens and unusual word endings are difficult to explain individually.

patterns.name: Word-final -s / plural or third-person forms
patterns.context: Activation falls on word-final s attached to either plural nouns or third-person verbs; preceding content varies, with no stable semantic condition.
patterns.domain: Various genres, including patents, sci-fi/game narratives, mining news, code documentation, scientific papers, and Q&A

patterns.name: Relational words and short function words
patterns.context: These words appear in ordinary syntactic contexts in technical descriptions; they co-occur with the main triggers in several passages but do not form a specific semantic or collocational pattern.
patterns.domain: Patent backgrounds, technical descriptions, and scientific text

patterns.name: S endings other than plural -s
patterns.context: The marked span sometimes covers part of a complete word or its ending; it includes both plural nouns and third-person singular verbs, without a unified meaning.
patterns.domain: Game narratives, patents, mining news, code, and Q&A

patterns.name: Ending fragment in a compound verb
patterns.context: Activation occurs at the end of a verb, in the passage annotated as brainwas + hes; it may relate to suffix morphology, but this is an isolated example.

patterns.name: Plural nouns and word-final s in a patent sentence
patterns.context: Describes multiple annular components and their pitch-circle diameters; activation concentrates on plural markers or s-containing endings.

patterns.name: Letter s in an entity name
patterns.context: A company name/headline in a news link; activation falls on the ending of Raises. The hyphen is also marked, possibly due to s morphology or URL tokenization.

6_2335.concept: 英语词尾 s 及局部功能词
6_2335.description: 激活最一致地落在英语词尾 s/复数或第三人称形式上，也标记若干常见功能词；领域跨度很大，个别连字符及特殊词尾难以单独解释。

patterns.name: 词尾 -s / 复数或第三人称形式
patterns.context: 激活落在词尾 s 上，所依附的词可为名词复数，也可为第三人称动词形式；前文内容不一致，未见稳定的语义条件。
patterns.domain: 专利、科幻/游戏叙述、矿业新闻、代码文档、科学论文及问答等多种文体

patterns.name: 关系词和短功能词
patterns.context: 这些词出现在技术说明的普通句法环境中；多处与主要触发同时出现，但本身未形成特定的语义或搭配模式。
patterns.domain: 专利背景、技术说明及科学文本

patterns.name: 复数形式 -s 之外的 s 结尾
patterns.context: 标记有时覆盖完整词的一部分或词尾；既包括复数名词，也包括动词的第三人称单数形式，未显示统一词义。
patterns.domain: 游戏叙述、专利、矿业新闻、代码与问答

patterns.name: 复合动词中的词尾片段
patterns.context: 激活位于动词词尾，且在该词被标注为 brainwas + hes 的分词处；可能与词尾形态有关，但该例单独出现。

patterns.name: 专利句中的名词复数与词尾 s
patterns.context: 描述多个环状部件及其节圆直径；激活集中于复数标记或带 s 的词尾。

patterns.name: 实体名称中的字母 s
patterns.context: 新闻链接中的公司名称/标题文本，激活落在 Raises 的词尾；连字符本身也被标记，可能与 s 形态或 URL 分词有关。

en.description: All passages activate on the s character or its subword fragment inside a word. Third-person singular verb endings are most prominent, but plural nouns and other forms containing s are also covered, making a strict grammatical category difficult to assign.

patterns.name: Third-person singular suffix -s
patterns.context: Activation falls on a final letter or subword fragment of a verb or noun, commonly in third-person singular verbs; some examples may also be plural nouns or spelling fragments.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain: job descriptions, Java/code comments, physics papers, sports commentary, animal encyclopedias, patents, and game discussions

patterns.name: Local morphology of possessive/plural s in English
patterns.context: Activation corresponds to the s character, but some positions occur in adjectives, plural nouns, or other forms rather than third-person singular verbs; this is related to word-final subword tokenization.

6_2335.concept: 英语词内 s 形态片段
6_2335.description: 所有段都在词内的 s 字符或其子词片段上激活，最突出的是第三人称单数动词词尾；也覆盖复数名词及其他含 s 的词形，难以归为严格的语法类别。

patterns.name: 第三人称单数词尾 -s
patterns.context: 激活落在动词或名词的词尾字母/子词片段上，常见于第三人称单数动词；个别例子也可能是名词复数或拼写片段。
patterns.domain: 跨领域：职位描述、Java/代码注释、物理论文、体育评论、动物百科、专利、游戏讨论

patterns.name: 英语所有格/复数 s 的局部形态
patterns.trigger: «s»，如 «various» 中的 s、«physicians» 中的 s、«wells» 中的 s、«systems» 中的 s
patterns.context: 激活对应 s 字符，但部分位置处于形容词、复数名词或其他词形中，并非第三人称单数动词；与词尾子词切分相关。
patterns.domain: 跨领域自然语言与技术文本

en.description: Primarily sensitive to English word-final s/es, especially plural nouns and third-person singular verbs, across many genres. Sporadic within-word fragments, short phrase words, and punctuation also activate and cannot be explained uniformly.

patterns.name: Plural suffixes on English verbs or nouns
patterns.context: Activation concentrates on word-final s/es attached to a complete stem; it usually marks English third-person singular verbs or plural nouns. Also occurs in patents, papers, encyclopedias, forums, and link text.

patterns.name: Plural markers in patent technical terminology
patterns.context: Appears in patent specifications, referring to multiple components or dimensions; often occurs in “of” or “respective” constructions.

patterns.name: Descriptive plural nouns
patterns.context: Used for body parts, spots, or habitats in encyclopedia descriptions of animals; similar to the plural noun forms in patents, but in a different context.

patterns.name: Plural endings in age-group expressions
patterns.context: A medical paper discusses the mean ages of two groups of participants; the same passage also contains unmarked “participants”.

patterns.name: Word endings not readily explained as plural or verbal inflection
patterns.context: Occurs in the “ians” fragment in a mathematical text and “Ra«ises»” in a news link; these may be within-word suffixes or segmentation-boundary effects and are not fully explained by the plural pattern.

patterns.name: Unmarked local word-ending fragments
patterns.context: Occurs in an optics formula abbreviation, garbled text, or forum uppercase fragments, with no clear consistent semantic or morphological pattern.

patterns.name: Isolated paper phrases and prepositions
patterns.context: Fragments from a paper comparing results; these activations do not fit the main s/es word-ending pattern.

patterns.name: Isolated punctuation and phrase components
patterns.context: Occurs in patent optics or circuit descriptions, with activations scattered across conjunctions, articles, prepositions, and verbs; no clear shared trigger is apparent.

6_2335.concept: 英语词尾 s/es
6_2335.description: 主要对英语词尾 s/es 敏感，尤其是复数名词和第三人称单数动词；跨多种文体出现。另有零散词内片段、短语词及标点激活，不能统一解释。

patterns.name: 英语动词或名词的复数后缀
patterns.context: 激活集中在词尾 s/es，附着于完整词干；通常表示英语第三人称单数动词或复数名词。也出现在专利、论文、百科、论坛及链接文本中。

patterns.name: 专利技术术语中的复数标记
patterns.context: 出现在专利说明书中，指多个部件或尺寸；常置于“of”“respective”等结构中。

patterns.name: 描述性复数名词
patterns.context: 用于百科动物描述中的身体部位、斑点或栖息处；与专利中的复数名词形式相似，但语境不同。

patterns.name: 分组年龄表达中的复数词尾
patterns.context: 医学论文中谈论两组参与者的平均年龄；同段另有未标记的 “participants”。

patterns.name: 不易归入复数或动词屈折的词尾
patterns.context: 出现在数学文本的 “ians” 片段及新闻链接中的 “Ra«ises»”；可能是词内后缀或分词边界效应，无法由复数模式充分解释。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 数学文本；HackerNews 链接

patterns.name: 未标记的局部词尾片段
patterns.context: 出现在光学公式缩写、乱码或论坛大写词片段中，不呈现清晰一致的语义或形态模式。
patterns.domain: 专利公式；Pile-CC 论坛文本

patterns.name: 孤立的论文短语与介词
patterns.context: 学术论文比较结果的片段；这些激活不符合主要的词尾 s/es 模式。

patterns.name: 孤立标点与短语成分
patterns.trigger: « and»、« at»、« the»、« by»、« exceeds»、« loads»
patterns.context: 出现在专利光学或电路叙述中，激活分散于连词、冠词、介词和动词，缺少明确共同触发特征。

en.description: Activations are distributed across metric/index and mathematical-factor expressions, several segmented long words or terms, growth hormone research, and gel-folding passages; these contexts do not share a unified, stable semantic trigger.

patterns.name: Metrics, indices, and their values
patterns.context: In quantitative, mathematical, or scientific descriptions, denotes a computable or classificatory metric, index, or factor; in passage 4, “factors” occurs in a problem about prime factors.
patterns.domain: Scientific abstracts, economic geography, patent background, math problems

patterns.name: Long words or word-form fragments in specific terms
patterns.context: Activations fall on segmented long words, stems, or compound terms; no stable semantic connection to the “indices” pattern is apparent.
patterns.domain: Regulatory announcements, code, encyclopedia text related to Japanese place names

patterns.name: Growth hormone and biomedical research
patterns.context: Mentions growth hormone, its binding protein, or the effect of injections on bone quality.

patterns.name: Spontaneous folding of gel films
patterns.context: Describes alginate-related bilayer gels or planar gel films spontaneously folding along their long axis into tubes.

patterns.name: Multidimensional assessment and depression remission measures
patterns.context: Discusses assessment questionnaires for remission of major depressive disorder and contrasts them with definitions of symptom measures.
patterns.domain: NIH project descriptions, mental health research

6_2571.description: 激活分布于指标/指数及数学因子表述、若干切分长词或术语、生长激素研究和凝胶折叠等片段；这些语境并无统一、稳定的语义触发规律。

patterns.name: 指标、指数及其数值
patterns.context: 在数量、数学问题或科学描述中，表示可计算或分类的指标、指数、因子；第4段的“factors”出现在求素因子的题目中。
patterns.domain: 科学摘要、经济地理、专利背景、数学题

patterns.name: 特定术语中的长词或词形片段
patterns.context: 激活落在被切分的长词、词干或复合术语上；看不出与“indices”模式有稳定语义联系。
patterns.domain: 监管公告、代码、日文地名相关百科文本

patterns.name: 生长激素及其生物医学研究
patterns.context: 提及生长激素、其结合蛋白或注射对骨骼质量的影响。

patterns.name: 凝胶薄膜的自发折叠
patterns.context: 描述藻酸盐相关双层凝胶或平面凝胶薄膜沿长轴自发折叠成管。

patterns.name: 多维评估与抑郁症缓解指标
patterns.context: 讨论重度抑郁症缓解的评估问卷，并与症状指标定义作对比。
patterns.domain: NIH 项目描述、精神健康研究

en.description: Activations span heterogeneous fragments from science, medicine, economics, mathematics, and code. The most visible recurring cues are the measurement term “indices/index” and the medical topic “Growth hormone”; the rest are distinct technical phrases or structures.

patterns.name: Indices and quantitative measures
patterns.context: A metric, index, or measurement result appears in a technical statement; examples include physical measurements, economic indicators, and symptom-based definitions.
patterns.domain: Medicine, economics, optics, and scientific papers

patterns.name: Growth hormone-related phrases
patterns.context: A research topic in a medical paper abstract, followed by content such as “binding protein” or “injections”.

patterns.name: Drug-control classification phrase
patterns.context: A formal, title-like phrase followed by a description of a drug's placement in a controlled class.

patterns.name: Mathematical symbol operations
patterns.context: Variable equations and operations form a math problem, followed by a question about prime factors.

patterns.name: Parser fields in code
patterns.context: Properties and function definitions in code objects or configuration snippets; a Hindi year string also appears in the same passage.

patterns.name: Spontaneous gel folding
patterns.context: Describes an alginate bilayer gel or gel film folding along its long axis to form a tubular structure.

6_2571.description: 激活覆盖科学、医学、经济、数学与代码等异质片段；较可见的重复线索是“indices/index”指标用语及“Growth hormone”医学主题，其余为各自独特的技术短语或结构。

patterns.name: indices 及量化指标
patterns.context: 指标、指数或测量结果出现在技术性陈述中；包括物理测量、经济指标和基于症状的定义。
patterns.domain: 医学、经济、光学及科学论文

patterns.name: 生长激素相关短语
patterns.context: 作为医学论文摘要中的研究主题，后接“binding protein”“injections”等内容。

patterns.name: 药物管制分类短语

patterns.domain: 生物医学论文及研究计划

patterns.name: 医学结果与疾病结局
patterns.context: 报告移植后病例、组织学侵袭、复发及生存结局

patterns.name: 其他方法与描述性短语
patterns.context: 零散出现于研究方法或医学描述中的词组，未呈现更明确的共同触发条件

en.concept: Biomedical paper terminology and structural markers
en.description: Activations span apposition, crystallographic data table labels, meta-analysis effect sizes, clinical statistics and prognosis, metabolomics figure captions, and genetic phenotype descriptions. Few stable word forms or themes are shared across passages.

patterns.name: apposition / juxtaposition
patterns.context: Appears in descriptions of the proximity of nerve fibers and GnRH neurons, and of stent apposition and expansion; the shared salient substring is apposition.

patterns.name: Data collection table labels
patterns.context: Structured labels or markers near crystallographic data tables, containing a split instance of data collection.

patterns.name: Meta-analysis and effect sizes
patterns.context: Statistical analyses calculate pooled effect sizes, confidence intervals, or risk ratios, and mention random/fixed-effects models.

patterns.name: Clinical statistical analysis subsection
patterns.context: Subsection headings in paper methods or results, and descriptions of survival analysis models.

patterns.name: Clinical prediction and prognosis
patterns.context: Assesses whether physiological measures independently predict survival or prognosis after adjusting for covariates.
patterns.domain: Clinical research on pulmonary vascular disease

patterns.name: Metabolomics workflow figure title
patterns.context: Figure caption or text outlining workflows for global and targeted metabolomics and isotope kinetics analyses.
patterns.domain: Cancer metabolism research and paper figures

patterns.name: Genetic regions and phenotypes
patterns.context: Describes associations between genetic regions or polymorphisms and phenotypes such as blood pressure, salt sensitivity, and kidney injury.

6_2571.concept: 生物医学论文术语与结构标记
6_2571.description: 激活覆盖生物医学论文中的 apposition、晶体学数据表标签、荟萃分析效应量、临床统计与预后、代谢组学图注及遗传表型描述；跨段共享的稳定词形或主题有限。

patterns.name: apposition / juxtaposition
patterns.context: 分别出现在神经纤维与 GnRH 神经元的接近关系，以及支架贴合和扩张的描述中；共同显著子串为 apposition。
patterns.domain: 神经科学、介入心血管医学

patterns.name: 数据收集表格标签
patterns.context: 晶体学数据表格附近的结构化标签或标记，带有被拆分的 data collection 字样。

patterns.name: 荟萃分析与效应量
patterns.context: 统计分析中计算合并效应量、置信区间或风险比，并提及随机/固定效应模型。
patterns.domain: 医学系统综述与荟萃分析

patterns.name: 临床统计分析小节
patterns.context: 论文方法或结果部分的小节标题及生存分析模型描述。

patterns.name: 临床预测与预后
patterns.context: 评估生理指标在调整协变量后能否独立预测生存或预后。

patterns.name: 代谢组学流程图标题
patterns.trigger: «The»3« workflow»5« of»3« global»5«,»5« targeted»6« metabol»9«omics»2« analysis»3
patterns.context: 图注或图中文字，概述全局、靶向代谢组学及同位素动力学分析流程。
patterns.domain: 癌症代谢研究及论文图注

patterns.name: 遗传区域与表型
patterns.context: 描述遗传区域或多态性与血压、盐敏感性、肾损伤等表型的关系。
patterns.domain: 遗传学与高血压研究摘要

en.description: The most stable pattern is the hyphen in the compound “follow-up” in medical text, appearing in diagnostic, long-term follow-up, monitoring, and clinical research contexts; scattered activations also occur in predictors, candidate genes, and legal titles.

patterns.name: follow-up hyphen structure
patterns.context: The compound “follow-up” appears in medical text, often describing a follow-up period, follow-up monitoring, or follow-up after diagnosis; activations concentrate on the hyphen and adjacent words.
patterns.domain: Medical papers, especially clinical research, case management, and diagnostic monitoring

patterns.name: Predictors and clinical efficacy
patterns.context: Discusses the predictive role of patient characteristics or clinical variables for treatment effects and disease outcomes; no follow-up hyphen appears.

patterns.name: Candidate gene validation
patterns.context: A research project description mentions that differentially expressed or candidate genes will be validated; no follow-up hyphen appears.
patterns.domain: Genetics and biomedical research project descriptions

patterns.name: affected in a compilation title
patterns.context: A legal text cites a compilation title; activation falls on the capital letter A in the title, not in a medical follow-up context.

6_2571.description: 最稳定的模式是医学文本中复合词“follow-up”的连字符，见诊断、长期随访、监测及临床研究等语境；另有预测因子、候选基因和法律标题中的零散激活。

patterns.name: follow-up 连字符结构
patterns.trigger: “follow” 后接 “-” 再接 “up”，其中 “-” 激活最强（多为 9 或 10）
patterns.context: 医学文本中出现复合词 “follow-up”，常用于描述随访期、随访监测或诊断后的随访；激活集中在连字符及紧邻词上。
patterns.domain: 医学论文，尤其临床研究、病例管理和诊断监测

patterns.name: 预测因子与临床疗效
patterns.context: 讨论患者特征或临床变量对治疗效果、疾病结局的预测作用；未出现 follow-up 连字符。

patterns.name: 候选基因验证
patterns.context: 科研项目描述中提及差异表达基因或候选基因将接受验证；未出现 follow-up 连字符。
patterns.domain: 遗传学与生物医学研究项目说明

patterns.name: 法规汇编标题中的 affected
patterns.trigger: “A” 后接强激活的 “A”以及 “Affected” 所在标题片段：“A Summary and Compilation of Statutes Amended and Affected”
patterns.context: 法律文本引用法规汇编标题；激活落在标题中的大写字母 A，而非医学随访语境。

en.description: The most salient local activation cues are scattered: live, the hyphen in decision-making, an immunoassay term fragment, prognoses, and follow-up. Other examples involve blood-cell outreach, medical papers, and legal texts; some strong or weak activations fall on common words or subword fragments.

patterns.name: Verb live
patterns.context: The word “live” appears directly in sentences describing blood cells helping people stay alive and the preciousness of life; the sentence structures are not fixed or identical.

patterns.name: making in a decision phrase
patterns.context: Studies the effect of an intervention on informed decision-making in a clinical trial; activation falls on the hyphenated token, not making.

patterns.name: immunosorbent in an immunoassay term
patterns.context: Appears in the names “sandwich linked immunosorbent assay” or “enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay”.

patterns.name: progn in a prognosis word
patterns.context: Refers to the prognosis of cancer patients in a discussion of tumor angiogenesis and metastasis.

patterns.name: follow-up term
patterns.context: A list of postoperative cancer data requirements requests complete follow-up data, including recurrence and metastasis.

patterns.name: Descriptions of blood cells and their functions
patterns.context: Explains how body signals cause blood cells to grow and develop, and how different cells have different functions.

patterns.name: Medical cancer and pathology research context
patterns.context: Medical text about disease, tumors, pathology, or clinical data; this is only a broad contextual cue and cannot explain the strongly activated tokens in each passage.
patterns.domain: Biomedical papers, clinical research, and project descriptions

patterns.name: Text and amendment phrasing in legal citations
patterns.context: Legal text about at least two tests to ensure readings are accurate, citing a bill and regulations affected by its amendments.

patterns.name: Diffusion time-dependence phrasing
patterns.context: Describes abnormal diffusion in ex vivo tissue and characterizes diffusion time-dependence through MR signals.

patterns.name: Neurochemistry and a specific research project description
patterns.context: Describes a laboratory's contribution to research on MPS chemical pathology and neurochemistry; strong activation falls on the preposition in.

6_2571.description: 激活最突出的局部线索分散：live、decision-making中的连字符、免疫测定术语片段、prognoses与follow-up；其余涉及血细胞科普、医学论文和法律文本，部分强弱激活落在常见词或词片段上。

patterns.name: 活体动词 live
patterns.context: 句中直接出现“live”，分别描述血细胞帮助人活着、生命珍贵；不是同一种固定句式。
patterns.domain: 面向大众的科普；个人叙述

patterns.name: 决策短语中的 making
patterns.context: 临床试验研究干预对 informed decision-making 的影响；激活落在连字符 token 上，而非 making。
patterns.domain: 临床研究摘要／项目描述

patterns.name: 免疫测定术语中的 immunosorbent
patterns.context: 出现在“sandwich linked immunosorbent assay”或“enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay”这一检测方法名称中。

patterns.name: 预后词中的 progn
patterns.context: 肿瘤血管生成及转移的讨论中，指癌症患者的预后。

patterns.name: 随访词中的 follow-up
patterns.context: 癌症术后资料清单中，要求完整随访数据，包括复发与转移。
patterns.domain: 肿瘤学临床研究方法／资料清单

patterns.name: 血细胞与功能的表述
patterns.context: 解释身体信号如何使血细胞生长发育，以及不同细胞有不同功能。

patterns.name: 医学癌症与病理研究语境
patterns.trigger: “cancer”/“carcinogenesis”“hematologic malignancies”“metastasis”“adenocarcinoma”“MPS”等词；这些语境中另有«in»、«and»等较弱激活
patterns.context: 疾病、肿瘤、病理或临床资料的医学文本；仅能作为宽泛语境线索，不能解释各处强激活 token。
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文、临床研究及项目描述

patterns.name: 法律引文中的文本与修订表述
patterns.context: 关于至少两项测试以确保 readings 准确性的法律文本，并引用法案及其修订、影响的法规。

patterns.name: 扩散时间依赖表述
patterns.context: 描述离体组织中异常扩散，并通过 MR 信号表征扩散时间依赖性。

patterns.name: 神经化学与特定研究项目描述
patterns.context: 说明实验室对 MPS 化学病理及神经化学的研究贡献；强激活落在介词 in 上。
patterns.domain: 医学研究项目／机构描述

en.description: Activations occur on code tokens, medical and legal term fragments, and hyphenated compounds across different domains. A notable shared feature is sensitivity to segmentation boundaries, hyphens, and split word fragments, but the contexts vary considerably across passages.

patterns.name: JSON construction code
patterns.context: Java code creates a JSON array and returns it when input is empty or initializes it with a string.

patterns.name: Hyphens in English compounds
patterns.context: Hyphenated compound terms, fixed expressions, or technical names; activations often fall on the hyphen and adjacent word segments.
patterns.domain: Medical research, patents, legal, and other texts

patterns.name: Internal word fragments in medical text
patterns.context: In medical or research contexts, markers fall within segmented word fragments or phrases; includes rare word forms, hyphenation, or hyphenated expressions.

patterns.name: Code identifiers and member access
patterns.context: In Python data-processing code, activations cover object names, periods, class names, and variable assignments as code tokens.

patterns.name: Titles and name fragments in legal citations
patterns.context: Bill titles, summaries, or citations in legal text, with activations distributed across title words and segmented word fragments.

6_2571.description: 激活分布在不同领域的代码 token、医学与法律术语片段及连字符复合词上。较显著的共同现象是对分词边界、连字符和被拆分的词片段敏感，但各段上下文差异较大。

patterns.name: JSON 构造代码
patterns.context: Java 代码中创建 JSON 数组，并在输入为空时返回或用字符串初始化数组。

patterns.name: 英文复合词中的连字符
patterns.trigger: «-»，尤其连字符后接被标记的词段，如«-»«assisted»、«-»«and»«-»«forward»、«-»«polymer»
patterns.context: 连字符连接的复合术语、固定表达或技术名称；激活常落在连字符及紧邻词段。
patterns.domain: 医学科研、专利、法律等文本

patterns.name: 医学文本中的词内片段
patterns.context: 医学或科研语境中，标记落在被拆分的词片段或词组内部；包含罕见词形、断词或连字符表达。
patterns.domain: 生物医学摘要与科研文本

patterns.name: 代码标识符与成员访问
patterns.context: Python 数据处理代码中，激活覆盖对象名、点号、类名及变量赋值等代码 token。

patterns.name: 法律引文中的标题与名称片段
patterns.context: 法律文本中的法案标题、摘要或引文，激活分布在标题词和拆分的词片段上。

en.concept: English structure and subword fragments, semantically heterogeneous
en.description: Activations occur across English texts in many domains, often on function words, connective structures, and long word fragments. Also present are scientific generalizations, encyclopedia category headings, patent requirement statements, and varied medical terminology, making a single semantic trigger unlikely.

patterns.name: Function words, introductory words, and phrase structures
patterns.context: Occurs in continuous English prose, especially grammatical connectors and phrases introducing supplementary explanations, purposes, or qualifications; however, these words appear in widely varying contexts across passages.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain prose, abstracts, legal texts, and patent texts

patterns.name: Long words or internal fragments
patterns.context: Activations fall on varied long words, some with internal segmentation; no consistent meaning or affix condition is apparent.

patterns.name: Quantification or generalization in academic discourse
patterns.context: In philosophical writing about mathematical and scientific reasoning, emphasizes the scope of an argument.

patterns.name: Years and categories in list and category headings
patterns.context: In a category list at the end of an encyclopedia entry, a year is linked to a television series category heading.

patterns.name: Patent requirement/reliability wording
patterns.context: The patent background states a design need to be addressed and describes a switch that is reliable, easy to use, and does not affect appearance.

patterns.name: Medical mechanisms and disease-related terminology
patterns.context: Terms in medical or biomedical abstracts concern tumors, MPS neurochemistry, or matrix-cell interactions; the specific trigger words differ.

patterns.name: Specific fragments not identifiable from the shown activation markers
patterns.context: These fragments occur respectively in discussions of lung disease/epithelial injury and dietary ethics; the available examples are insufficient to determine whether they share a specific semantic trigger with other patterns.

6_2571.concept: 英文结构与词片段，语义异质
6_2571.description: 激活分布于多领域英文文本，常标在功能词、连接结构和长词片段上；另见科学普遍化表述、百科分类标题、专利需求句及不同医学术语，难以归结为单一语义触发器。

patterns.name: 功能词、引导词与短语结构
patterns.trigger: 如 «there»、«that»、«for»、«in»、«the»、«and»；有时连同后续结构如 «for» «all» 或 «that» «does»
patterns.context: 在连续英文叙述中，尤其是语法连接和引出补充说明、目的或限定的词组中；但这些词在各段所处语境差异很大
patterns.domain: 跨领域散文、摘要、法律及专利文本

patterns.name: 长词或词内片段
patterns.context: 激活落在多种长词上，部分带有词内切分；没有一致的词义或词缀条件可见

patterns.name: 学术论述中的量化或普遍化表述
patterns.trigger: «all» scientific thought；«all»科学思维并与 «mathematics»、«communication» 并列
patterns.context: 在讨论数学及科学推理的哲学性文字中，强调论述适用范围

patterns.name: 列表与分类标题中的年份、类别
patterns.context: 百科条目末尾的分类列表中，年份与电视系列类别标题相连

patterns.name: 专利需求／可靠性措辞
patterns.context: 专利背景中提出待解决的设计需求，并描述可靠、易用且不影响外观的开关

patterns.name: 医学机制与疾病相关术语
patterns.context: 医学或生物医学摘要中出现肿瘤、MPS神经化学或基质—细胞相互作用等术语；具体触发词彼此并不相同

patterns.name: 无法由所示激活标记确定的特异片段
patterns.context: 这些片段各自处于肺部疾病／上皮损伤和饮食伦理论述中；现有例子不足以判断它们与其他模式有共同的特定语义触发条件
patterns.domain: 生物医学；伦理／饮食论述

en.description: The most prominent activation pattern is the intraword fragment in the immunoprophylaxis/immunoprophylactic terms; the rest is scattered across biomedical citations, printing and binding patents, software lists, biosynthesis, and project reports, with no shared semantic or morphological feature.

patterns.name: Intraword fragment in “immunoprophylaxis”
patterns.context: Immunoprophylaxis or prophylactic immunization terms appear in medical or biomedical text; activation is concentrated on a segmented intraword fragment, especially “oproph”.

patterns.name: HEK and citation abbreviation formatting
patterns.context: Biomedical citations in patent background sections, including HEK-related sentences and the tokenization and punctuation of the journal name “Proc. Natl. Acad. Sci.”

patterns.name: Paper surfaces and image recording
patterns.context: Describes surfaces formed by glossy paper and pigment ink, and differences in rub resistance.

patterns.name: Sheet transport and folding/binding
patterns.context: Describes sheet transport, relative displacement, and folding or saddle-stitch binding processes.

patterns.name: Formatted names in academic software lists
patterns.context: Lists molecular graphics or publication-preparation software, with names marked by symbols such as asterisks.

patterns.name: Regulation of biosynthetic pathways
patterns.context: Describes adjusting pathway enzyme expression or promoters to increase yield, alter metabolic flux, and avoid intermediate accumulation.

patterns.name: Research projects and cross-disciplinary outcomes
patterns.context: Lists collaborative projects and cross-disciplinary research topics at a research center; activation here does not clearly correspond to specialized word forms in other passages.

6_2571.description: 激活最突出的模式是免疫预防术语“immunoprophylaxis/immunoprophylactic”中的词内片段；其余分散于生物医学引文、印刷与装订专利、软件清单、生物合成及项目报告，缺乏统一的语义或词形特征。

patterns.name: “immunoprophylaxis”的词内片段
patterns.context: 医学或生物医学文本中出现免疫预防/预防性免疫相关术语；激活集中在被拆分标记的词内片段，尤其是“oproph”部分。
patterns.domain: NIH 项目文本、PubMed 摘要

patterns.name: HEK 与文献缩写格式
patterns.trigger: HEK« in»；« Proc».« Nat»l«. Sci«. (以及相邻的期刊引文标点)
patterns.context: 专利背景技术中的生物医学引文；包括 HEK 相关句子，以及“Proc. Natl. Acad. Sci.”期刊名的分词与标点。
patterns.domain: USPTO 专利背景、学术引文

patterns.name: 纸张表面与图像记录
patterns.trigger: receiving layer of the glossy paper；image recorded；pigment ink
patterns.context: 描述光泽纸、颜料墨水形成的表面膜及耐擦性差异。
patterns.domain: USPTO 专利背景，印刷材料

patterns.name: 片材输送与折叠装订
patterns.trigger: sheets are conveyed；center-folding binding process；saddle-stitching binding process
patterns.context: 描述片材输送、相对移位以及折叠或骑马钉装订的工艺。
patterns.domain: USPTO 专利背景，装订设备

patterns.name: 学术软件清单中的格式化名称
patterns.trigger: molecular graphics；software used to prepare material for publication；*XPMA*、*ORTEP*、*publCIF*
patterns.context: 列举分子图形或出版准备软件，名称以星号等格式标记。

patterns.name: 生物合成通路调控
patterns.context: 说明调整通路酶表达或启动子以提高产率、改变代谢通量并避免中间产物积累。
patterns.domain: PubMed Central，生物工程/生物化学

patterns.name: 研究项目与跨领域成果概述
patterns.trigger: the Center completed 35 Collaboration and Service projects；assembly mechanism；drug resistance；DNA sequencing nanopores
patterns.context: 列举研究中心的合作项目和跨领域研究主题；该处激活未明显对应其他段落的专门词形。

en.concept: Word forms and formatting boundaries in technical text
en.description: Activations often occur on internal word segmentation, hyphenated compounds, headings, and coordinated lists in technical documents. They also appear in biomedical terminology, patent boilerplate, publication licenses, audiovisual playback, and Q&A narratives, with no single stable semantic category.

patterns.name: Internal suffixes and word-form boundaries
patterns.context: Activations cluster on internal word segmentation across tokens, especially in hyphenated compounds, derived words, and biomedical terminology; not all internal word boundaries trigger activation, and local word forms and contexts vary.
patterns.domain: Biomedical papers, patents, and general English text

patterns.name: Enumeration, coordinated items, and punctuation
patterns.context: Appears when noun phrases or multiple objects, attributes, or methods are listed in sequence; words near commas or conjunctions sometimes activate as well.
patterns.domain: Patent specifications, scientific papers, and technical text

patterns.name: Headings and fixed formats in technical literature
patterns.context: Appears in abstract headings, patent section headings, software/publication lists, or license descriptions in formatted technical documents, often alongside proper nouns, abbreviations, or layout markers.
patterns.domain: Medical abstracts, patents, software documentation, and academic publishing materials

patterns.name: Function words in relative clauses and Q&A narratives
patterns.context: Ordinary function words activate in clauses, explanations, or question-and-answer structures; triggers are scattered, with no stable lexical or semantic category.
patterns.domain: StackExchange Q&A, patents, and academic prose

patterns.name: Biomedical vocabulary
patterns.context: Specialized contexts involving genes, pathways, proteins, water transport, or angiogenesis; some activations fall inside segmented terms, others on surrounding words.

patterns.name: Recurring “form/supply” phrasing in patents
patterns.context: Patent descriptions of the invention, its uses, and equipment; this may relate to patent boilerplate and compound-word segmentation, but the vocabulary differs between passages.

patterns.name: Document metadata, licenses, and web citations
patterns.context: Publication information, software tool lists, addresses, license terms, URLs, and other document-edge content.
patterns.domain: GitHub license text and academic publishing materials

patterns.name: Audiovisual storage and playback terminology
patterns.context: Describes how directory information supplements recorded content and how equipment plays it back; these form a coherent set of terms in a patent-style technical description.
patterns.domain: Patents related to audiovisual recording and playback

patterns.name: Questioning activity words on Q&A sites
patterns.context: Describes the history of a question being asked, viewed, and commented on at a website, embedded in Q&A text explaining page behavior.

6_2571.concept: 技术文本中的词形与格式边界
6_2571.description: 激活常见于技术文档中的词内切分、连字符复合词、标题和并列列举；也散见于生物医学术语、专利套语、出版许可、音像回放及问答叙述，未形成单一稳定语义类别。

patterns.name: 词内后缀及词形边界
patterns.context: 激活集中在跨 token 的词内切分，尤其是连字符复合词、派生词和生物医学术语内部；并非所有词内切分都触发，局部词形与语境有差异。
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文、专利及一般英文文本

patterns.name: 枚举、并列项与标点
patterns.trigger: «,»及并列短语，例如«ink», and an image forming method, ...；«proteins» involved ... water transport；«levels» of ... enzymes
patterns.context: 在名词短语或多个对象、属性、方法连续列举时出现；逗号或连接词附近的词有时也激活。
patterns.domain: 专利说明书、科学论文及技术文本

patterns.name: 技术文献中的标题与固定格式
patterns.trigger: «The» third generation ...；«Technical» Field；«molecular» graphics ... *XPMA*；«interactive» user interfaces
patterns.context: 出现在摘要标题、专利章节标题、软件/出版物清单或许可证说明等格式化技术文档中，常伴随专名、缩写或版式标记。
patterns.domain: 医学摘要、专利、软件文档与学术出版材料

patterns.name: 相对从句及问答叙述中的功能词
patterns.trigger: «that» was asked, viewed, commented on；«Because» a question；«which» is played back；«for» improving
patterns.context: 普通功能词在从句、解释或问答句式中激活；触发分散，未见稳定的单一词汇或语义类别。

patterns.name: 生物医学领域词汇
patterns.context: 涉及基因、通路、蛋白、水运输或血管生成的专业语境；部分激活落在术语内部切分，部分落在术语周围词语。

patterns.name: 专利中反复出现的“形成/供给”表述
patterns.context: 专利对发明对象、用途和设备的描述；可能与专利套语及复合词切分有关，但两段词汇并不相同。

patterns.name: 文档元数据、许可与网页引用
patterns.trigger: «Boston», MA ... download the «license» ... URL；«software» used to prepare material for «publication»
patterns.context: 出版信息、软件工具清单、地址、许可条款及 URL 等文档边缘内容。
patterns.domain: GitHub许可文本与学术出版资料

patterns.name: 音像存储与回放术语
patterns.context: 描述目录信息如何补充录制内容、以及设备如何回放；是专利式技术描述中的一组连贯术语。
patterns.domain: 音像记录与播放相关专利

patterns.name: 问答网站的提问活动词
patterns.context: 描述问题在网站上的提问、浏览与评论历史，嵌在解释页面行为的问答文本中。

en.description: Activation is scattered: it includes in in software licenses and judicial contexts, you in conversational questions, roph within immunoprophylaxis terminology, patent-purpose boilerplate, plant-breeding objective sentences, and the initial in in inactivation. No single stable semantic or syntactic pattern covers all passages.

patterns.name: In in functional or purposive expressions
patterns.context: The trigger is in in the phrase «in modified source and object code versions», followed by a description of software versions or interfaces.

patterns.name: In in judicial opinions
patterns.context: Appears in the legal phrase «the judgment in a criminal case».

patterns.name: You in a question
patterns.context: Occurs in the conversational question «Why did you choose these colors?»

patterns.name: Specific subword in immunoprophylaxis terminology
patterns.context: Activation is concentrated on the tokenized «roph», embedded in immunoprophylactic / immunoprophylaxis terms.
patterns.domain: Biomedical, infectious disease, and experimental research

patterns.name: Plant-breeding objective statements
patterns.context: Appears in statements about the goal of developing new, unique, or superior crop varieties.

patterns.name: Patent-purpose boilerplate
patterns.context: Recurring patent-purpose sentence structure, followed by a description of the device to be provided by the invention and its properties.

patterns.name: In in a DNA replication-related word form
patterns.context: Occurs in the segmented «inactivation» in a discussion of shutting down DNA replication initiation activity.

6_2571.description: 激活模式分散：包括软件许可和判决语境中的 in、对话疑问句中的 you、免疫预防术语内部的 roph、专利目的套语、植物育种目标句式，以及 inactivation 的词首 in。没有单一稳定的语义或句法模式能覆盖全部段落。

patterns.name: 功能性或目的性表述中的 in
patterns.trigger: « in»10 modified « source»2 and « object»1 « code»3 « versions»1；« in»9 modified « source»2 and « object»2 « code»2 « versions»1
patterns.context: 触发点是短语 «in modified source and object code versions» 中的 in；后接对软件版本或接口的描述。

patterns.name: 司法判决句式中的 in
patterns.context: 出现在 «the judgment in a criminal case» 这一法律句式中。

patterns.name: 疑问句中的 you
patterns.context: 位于对话式疑问句 «Why did you choose these colors?» 中。

patterns.name: 免疫预防术语中的特定子词
patterns.context: 激活集中在分词后的 «roph»，嵌在 immunoprophylactic / immunoprophylaxis 这类免疫预防术语中。
patterns.domain: 生物医学、感染病与实验研究

patterns.name: 植物育种目标表述
patterns.context: 出现于关于培育新型、独特或优良作物品种的目标陈述。

patterns.name: 专利发明目的的套语
patterns.context: 重复出现的专利目的句式，随后说明发明要提供的装置及其性质。

patterns.name: DNA复制相关词形中的 in
patterns.context: 位于被分词的 «inactivation» 中，讨论 DNA 复制起始活性被关闭。

en.description: The most stable trigger context is a math problem asking about factoring or derivatives with What. Activations also occur on that introducing relative clauses, process descriptions, and question structures. An isolated occurrence of time is difficult to classify.

patterns.name: Question phrasing in math problems
patterns.context: After an algebraic expression, function, or variable definition is given, a question beginning with What asks for a factorization or derivative; this strongly triggers across multiple math passages.
patterns.domain: Automatically generated math problems and answers

patterns.name: Relative subordinator and relative clause
patterns.context: that introduces a relative clause modifying a noun or adding an explanation; activation falls on that and subsequent clause elements.
patterns.domain: Legal texts, expository writing, technology, and biographical prose

patterns.name: Technical or organizational process descriptions
patterns.context: Narrates product development, experimental comparisons, or team research and development; wording and domains vary.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedia descriptions, biomedical project abstracts, historical biographies

patterns.name: Word-by-word activation at the start of questions
patterns.context: Interrogative words and the following question structure activate consecutively; What questions in math problems are most consistent, with one additional Why question in everyday conversation.

patterns.name: Ordinary English time
