patterns.context: Describes a home setting where two people work at the same time and can still host guests; this occurs only in this passage, so a stable semantic pattern cannot be determined.

6_2571.concept: 英语疑问与关系从句结构
6_2571.description: 最稳定的触发环境是数学题中以 What 询问因式分解或导数；另对 that 引出的关系从句、过程描述及问句结构有激活。单独出现的 time 难以归类。

patterns.name: 数学题中的提问句式
patterns.trigger: What are the prime factors of；What is the third derivative of
patterns.context: 在给定代数表达式、函数或变量定义后，以 What 开始询问因式分解或导数；多个数学段落中触发强烈。
patterns.domain: 自动生成的数学题及答案

patterns.name: 关系从属词与关系从句
patterns.trigger: that formed the basis；that created the product；that gave us；team that developed
patterns.context: that 引出修饰名词或补充说明的关系从句；激活落在 that 及其后续从句成分上。
patterns.domain: 法律、说明文、科技与人物传记散文

patterns.name: 技术或组织过程描述
patterns.trigger: products evolve from abstract ideas into primitive objects；will be compared by Northern blot analysis；team that developed Rover's gas turbines
patterns.context: 叙述产品演进、实验比较或团队研发等过程；具体措辞和领域各异。
patterns.domain: 百科说明、生物医学项目摘要、历史传记

patterns.name: 问句开头的逐词激活
patterns.trigger: Why did you choose these colors?；What are the prime factors；What is the third derivative
patterns.context: 疑问词及其后的问句结构连续出现激活；数学题中的 What 问句最一致，另有一个日常对话中的 Why 问句。

patterns.name: 普通英语中的 time
patterns.context: 描述两人同时工作、且仍可接待客人的家居场景；只有此段出现，无法确定是否属于稳定语义模式。

en.concept: Immunoprophylaxis subword fragment, with sporadic triggers
en.description: The clearest pattern is the subword fragment “roph” in the immunology terms immunoprophylaxis/immunoprophylactic, found in three passages. The other high activations are scattered across code, patents, agriculture, molecular biology, business, and mathematics, appearing on in, commas, coding, that, an, created the, What, and other items, with no shared semantic or syntactic pattern.

patterns.name: Final syllable in immunoprophylaxis terminology
patterns.context: Follows an “immuno-”-related stem to form immunoprophylactic / immunoprophylaxis; activation is concentrated on the segmented “roph” subword fragment, in contexts involving vaccines, passive or active immunization, and infection prevention
patterns.domain: NIH research abstracts, PubMed medical abstracts

patterns.name: Preposition in in interface documentation
patterns.context: Appears in a sentence describing an interactive user interface in modified source code and object code versions; unrelated to immunoprophylaxis terminology here

patterns.name: Adjective coordination in breeding objectives
patterns.context: After “goal of plant breeding is to develop…”, adjectives modify new varieties in a coordinated list; the comma and following coordination are prominent

patterns.name: Subword fragment in coding
patterns.context: Appears in a research sentence about a chromosomal gene encoding a debranching enzyme; occurs once and has no clear semantic link to the other highly activated fragments

patterns.name: Description of a matching list in code
patterns.context: A function comment says that a list function returns Ingress objects matching a selector; that is highlighted in the relative clause

patterns.name: Electronic-device phrase in a patent title
patterns.context: Lists device categories in a patent “Field of the Invention” section; the highlighted item is an article rather than a technical noun

patterns.name: Created the in a product narrative
patterns.context: A narrative about a startup product gradually evolving and gaining customers, where the verb is followed by a definite article; no clear connection to other patterns

patterns.name: Question word What in a math problem
patterns.context: A differentiation problem asks “What is the derivative…”; activation is concentrated on the question word

6_2571.concept: 免疫预防词片段，兼有零散触发
6_2571.description: 最清晰的模式是免疫学词 immunoprophylaxis/immunoprophylactic 中的子词片段“roph”，见于三段。其余高激活分散在代码、专利、农业、分子生物学、商业和数学文本中，分别落在 in、逗号、coding、that、an、created the、What 等处，缺乏共同语义或句法模式。

patterns.name: 免疫预防术语中的末尾音节
patterns.context: 紧跟“immuno-”相关词干，组成 immunoprophylactic / immunoprophylaxis；激活集中在被拆分的“roph”子词片段，周围是疫苗、被动或主动免疫、感染预防语境
patterns.domain: NIH 研究摘要、PubMed 医学摘要

patterns.name: 接口文档中的介词 in
patterns.context: 出现在描述修改后的源代码和目标代码版本中的交互式用户界面的句子里；此处与免疫预防词无关

patterns.name: 育种目标中的形容词并列
patterns.context: “goal of plant breeding is to develop…”之后，形容词并列修饰新品种；突出逗号及其后续并列结构

patterns.name: 编码一词的子词片段
patterns.context: 出现在关于染色体基因编码脱分支酶的科研句子中；单独一次，无法与其他高激活片段建立明确语义联系
patterns.domain: NIH 分子生物学研究摘要

patterns.name: 代码中的匹配列表描述
patterns.context: 函数注释说明列表函数返回符合选择器的 Ingress；高亮的是关系从句中的 that

patterns.name: 专利标题中的电子设备短语
patterns.context: 专利“Field of the Invention”标题段落中，列举器件类别；高亮冠词而非技术名词

patterns.name: 产品叙述中的 created the
patterns.context: 创业产品逐步演化并获得顾客的叙述中，动词后接定冠词；与其他模式无明显联系

patterns.name: 数学题中的疑问词 What
patterns.context: 求导题目以“What is the derivative…”提问；强激活落在疑问词

en.concept: Structural and relational expressions in formal texts
en.description: Activations are broadly distributed and often occur near commas and function words such as articles, prepositions, and conjunctions. They also appear in diverse local contexts involving defining objectives, process descriptions, matching/samples, legal texts, code, and patent technology, making a single semantic theme unlikely.

patterns.name: Broad activation on function words and near commas
patterns.context: Occurs in varied grammatical contexts, often near commas, articles, prepositions, or conjunctions; no single fixed collocation explains all activations.

patterns.name: Defining, proposing, or describing objectives
patterns.context: Introduces a theory, research objective, invention purpose, or method, commonly in formal statements.

patterns.name: Novelty and superiority statements
patterns.context: Emphasizes the objectives, advantages, and novelty of breeding a new variety or proposing an invention.

patterns.name: Processing, formation, or evolution processes
patterns.context: Describes information processing and transmission, or the gradual development and improvement of a product from an idea.
patterns.domain: Technical descriptions, business and product narratives

patterns.name: Matching, similarity, and sample concepts
patterns.context: Discusses selecting matching conditions, similarity in experimental data, or samples, populations, and sampling error.

patterns.name: Legal rulings and issues
patterns.context: Discusses administrative law judge findings, issues, and claim preclusion.

patterns.name: Semiconductor device fabrication
patterns.context: Describes an embodiment for forming electronic devices on a semiconductor wafer.

patterns.name: List operations and return values
patterns.context: Code comments and function implementations describe filtering and returning entries using tag and field selectors.

patterns.name: Variational problems on function spaces
patterns.context: Introduces constrained minimization and existence theory on function spaces or metric measure spaces.

patterns.name: Material and device embodiments
patterns.context: Lists materials and then introduces invention embodiments and device fabrication methods.

patterns.name: Sample similarity analysis
patterns.context: Compares enrichment patterns in experimental data and describes methodological limitations.

patterns.name: Patent-style plunger device objective statement
patterns.context: Uses an “another/further object” construction to state the ease of manufacture and reliability of a device.

6_2571.concept: 正式文本中的结构与关系表达
6_2571.description: 激活分布广泛，常落在逗号及冠词、介词、连词等功能词附近；同时见于定义目标、过程描述、匹配/样本、法律、代码及专利技术等多种局部语境，难以归为单一语义主题。

patterns.name: 功能词与逗号附近的广泛激活
patterns.trigger: «,»、« a»、« the»、« of»、« for»、« on»、« and»
patterns.context: 多种语法语境中出现，常在逗号、冠词、介词或连词附近；未见单一固定搭配能解释全部激活。

patterns.name: 定义、提出或描述目标
patterns.context: 介绍理论、研究目标、发明目的或方法时；常见于正式陈述。
patterns.domain: 学术论文、专利、技术文档

patterns.name: 新颖性与优越性表述
patterns.context: 强调培育新品种或提出发明的目标、优点与新颖性。

patterns.name: 处理、形成或演变过程
patterns.context: 描述信息处理与传输，或产品从想法逐步发展、改进的过程。
patterns.domain: 技术说明、商业与产品叙述

patterns.name: 匹配、相似性与样本概念
patterns.context: 讨论选择条件匹配、实验数据相似性，或样本与总体及抽样误差。
patterns.domain: 软件文档、科研方法、生物医学

patterns.name: 法律裁判与争点
patterns.trigger: «issue»、«decided»；«the»（法律争点、裁判机关及警察行为语境）
patterns.context: 论述行政法官认定、争点及既判事项。

patterns.name: 半导体器件制造
patterns.context: 描述在半导体晶圆上形成电子器件的实施方式。

patterns.name: 列表操作与返回值
patterns.context: 代码注释和函数实现中，描述按标签与字段选择器筛选并返回条目。
patterns.domain: Go 语言代码与软件文档

patterns.name: 函数空间上的变分问题
patterns.context: 介绍函数空间或度量测度空间上的受约束极小化与存在性理论。

patterns.name: 材料与器件实施例
patterns.context: 列举材料后引出发明实施例及器件制造方法。
patterns.domain: 专利材料与半导体技术

patterns.name: 样本相似性分析
patterns.context: 比较实验数据中的富集模式，并说明方法局限。

patterns.name: 专利式 plunger 器件目的陈述
patterns.trigger: «present invention»、«plunger device»、«easily and efficiently manufactured»、«durable and reliable construction»
patterns.context: 以“another/further object”句式陈述装置的制造便利性与可靠性。

en.description: Activation is scattered across relational words, purpose and condition expressions in expository writing, and also occurs in code interface comments, breeding process terminology, and product evolution narratives; an isolated webpage narrative cannot be reliably unified with the main pattern.

patterns.name: Relational words in function words and noun phrases
patterns.context: In consecutive sentences or comments explaining an object, purpose, condition, or relation, relational words and nearby nouns and verbs activate together; specific words and positions vary.
patterns.domain: Academic papers, technical documentation, webpages, and general expository writing

patterns.name: Breeding and seed propagation terminology
patterns.context: Activation occurs in discussions of seed harvest, germination, breeding methods, parent lines, or agronomic traits; several instances involve passive or process descriptions.

patterns.name: Development or evolution process
patterns.context: Appears when describing a product evolving from an idea to its realization and gaining users, or when proposing and implementing a solution; no specific domain is required.

patterns.name: Names/identifiers and code-document metadata
patterns.context: Appears near comments or metadata headings in project configuration files; activation is concentrated on explanatory template text.

patterns.name: Interface and return-value descriptions
patterns.context: Code comments or nearby functions describe interface behavior, returned objects, and matching conditions.

patterns.name: Local activation near a proper noun
patterns.context: Appears in an account of a sheepdog’s abilities; no domain vocabulary or structure clearly shared with other passages is evident.

6_2571.concept: 说明性关系与过程表达
6_2571.description: 激活分散于说明性文字中的关系词、用途与条件表达，也见于代码接口注释、育种过程术语及产品演变叙述；个别网页叙事无法与主模式可靠统一。

patterns.name: 功能词与名词短语中的关系词
patterns.context: 在说明对象、用途、条件或关系的连续句子/注释中，关系词及其附近名词、动词会共同激活；具体词项和位置不完全一致。
patterns.domain: 学术论文、技术文档、网页与一般说明性文字

patterns.name: 育种与种子繁殖术语
patterns.context: 讨论种子收获、发芽、育种方法、亲本系或农艺性状时激活；多处伴随被动或过程描述。
patterns.domain: 农业、植物育种专利背景

patterns.name: 开发或演变过程
patterns.context: 描述产品从构想到形成、获得用户，或提出并实施某项方案时出现；不要求固定领域。

patterns.name: 名称/标识与代码文档元信息
patterns.trigger: “General information about the project”, “version info for the project”, “index”
patterns.context: 出现在项目配置文件的注释或元数据标题附近，激活集中在说明性模板文字。
patterns.domain: GitHub 项目文档/配置代码

patterns.name: 接口与返回值说明
patterns.context: 代码注释或函数附近描述接口行为、返回对象及匹配条件。

patterns.name: 专有名词附近的局部激活
patterns.context: 关于一只牧羊犬能力的叙述中出现；未见与其他片段明确共享的领域词汇或结构。
patterns.domain: 人物/动物纪事、新闻类网页文本

en.description: Activations occur in patent-text enumerations and punctuation, fixed question patterns in math problems, relative pronouns in fundraising copy, and a few hyphens in compounds; these trigger forms are not uniform.

patterns.name: Coordinated descriptions and commas in patent text
patterns.context: Describes differences in information processing across applications, users, or systems, listing processing methods, quantity, storage, communications, or speed; paragraph 1 instead uses coordinated modifiers for variety characteristics.
patterns.domain: USPTO patent background; paragraph 1 concerns plant breeding

patterns.name: Math problem question template
patterns.context: After a function or algebraic expression is given, a fixed template asks for a value or factor; the question word and question mark both activate strongly.

patterns.name: Relative pronoun who
patterns.context: Occurs in the relative clause “those readers who have come forward”, referring to donor readers.

patterns.name: Hyphens in compounds
patterns.context: A hyphen connects a proper noun or compound modifier; evidence is limited, and activation positions involve texts from different domains.
patterns.domain: Medical research grant description and physics abstract

6_2571.description: 激活分布于专利文本的并列列举与标点、数学题固定问句、募款文案中的关系代词，以及少数复合词连字符；这些触发形式并不统一。

patterns.name: 专利文本中的并列说明与逗号
patterns.trigger: “how the information is handled”, “how much information is processed, stored, or communicated”及其间的逗号；另有“new, unique and superior”中的逗号
patterns.context: 描述不同应用、用户或系统的信息处理差异时，连续列举处理方式、数量、存储、通信或速度；第1段则是品种特征的并列修饰语
patterns.domain: USPTO专利背景，段1为植物育种

patterns.name: 数学题的问句模板
patterns.context: 函数或代数表达式给定后，以固定模板询问求值或因数；问句词和问号均有较强激活

patterns.name: 关系代词 who
patterns.context: 出现在指向捐赠读者的关系从句“those readers who have come forward”中
patterns.domain: 公益组织募款网页文案

patterns.name: 复合词中的连字符
patterns.context: 连字符连接专名或复合修饰词；证据有限，激活位置涉及不同领域文本
patterns.domain: 医疗研究资助说明与物理学摘要

en.concept: Specific task questions and conventional phrasing
en.description: Primarily responds to fixed question wording in math problems asking about prime factors or digits of a function value; also activates on conventional patent language stating the scope of an invention and its purpose. The math subpatterns share a problem template, while the patent pattern belongs to a different genre.

patterns.name: Question about prime factors in a math problem
patterns.context: Appears at the end of an algebra problem defining a function or giving an equation, asking for the prime factors of the function’s value at a specified input; activation is concentrated on the question wording, while function names and inputs vary.

patterns.name: Question about a digit in a math problem
patterns.context: After giving a polynomial or equation, asks for the ones or hundreds digit of a function value; it shares the math problem format with prime-factor questions but has a different target.

patterns.name: Patent language stating the purpose and scope of an invention
patterns.context: Patent background text first states that the scope of the invention is not limited, then shifts to conventional language describing the purpose, device, or method of the invention.

6_2571.concept: 特定任务问句与惯用措辞
6_2571.description: 主要响应数学题中询问函数值质因数或数位的固定问句；另对专利中声明发明范围及陈述发明目的的惯用语有明显激活。数学子模式共享题目模板，专利模式属不同文体。

patterns.name: 数学题中的质因数提问
patterns.context: 出现在定义函数或给出方程的代数题末尾，询问某函数在指定输入处的值的质因数；触发集中于问题措辞，函数名和输入各异。

patterns.name: 数学题中的数位提问
patterns.trigger: “What is the units digit of”／“What is the hundreds digit of”
patterns.context: 在给出多项式或方程后，询问函数值的个位或百位数字；与质因数题同属数学题格式，但具体目标不同。

patterns.name: 专利文本中的发明目的与范围措辞
patterns.trigger: “not intended to be limiting as to the scope of the invention”及“it is therefore an object of the present invention to provide”
patterns.context: 专利背景文本先声明不限制发明范围，再转入陈述发明目的、装置或方法的惯用表述。
patterns.domain: USPTO 专利文本，法律／技术文体

en.description: Activation spans questions, legal rulings, planned goals, discourse enumeration, scientific mechanism questions, and personal and event-related text; there is no single clear semantic trigger, and it often occurs near function words and question phrasing.

patterns.name: What/How/Do/I in questions
patterns.context: Interrogative words and following auxiliaries, subjects, and other elements in questions; activation occurs at different positions and is not necessarily adjacent to the beginning of a sentence.
patterns.domain: Website descriptions, interviews, research proposals, event information

patterns.name: Rulings and issues in legal reasoning
patterns.context: Formal expressions describing issues, rulings, or legal principles; activation falls on local words such as “decided,” “by,” and “the.”

patterns.name: Planned statements of goals, definitions, and choices
patterns.context: First defines a problem or goal, then describes subsequent choice steps; includes a restrictive relation introduced by “that.”

patterns.name: Second as a discourse enumeration marker
patterns.context: An ordinal introduces a subsequent argument, followed by discussion of a viewpoint or podcast content.

patterns.name: Research subjects and mechanism questions in academic text
patterns.context: Research questions in scientific abstracts or proposals involving methods, genetic elements, or molecular mechanisms.
patterns.domain: Gene-editing research and research grant proposals

patterns.name: Conversation about interethnic relations and personal dating
patterns.context: Informal first-person conversation discussing a writing topic and the speaker’s personal dating partner.

patterns.name: Guidance for readers or visitors and environmental statements
patterns.context: An event webpage tells visitors what to do and answers questions about exhibit applications.

6_2571.description: 激活例子横跨问句、法律裁判表述、计划目标、篇章列举、科研机制问题及个人和活动文本；没有单一明显语义触发点，常出现在功能词与问题表述附近。

patterns.name: 疑问句中的 What/How/Do/I
patterns.trigger: “What is a Cookie?”, “What should readers take away…?”, “What are the specific…?”, “How do I apply…?”
patterns.context: 问句中疑问词及其后的助动词、主语等成分；激活分布在疑问句的不同位置，不一定紧邻句首。
patterns.domain: 网站说明、采访、科研申请文本、活动信息

patterns.name: 法律论证中的裁判与争点表达
patterns.trigger: “the issue decided by the administrative law judge”, “issues of claim preclusion”, “decision of the Court”
patterns.context: 法律文本中描述争点、裁判或法律原则的正式表达；激活落在“decided”“by”“the”等局部词上。

patterns.name: 目标、定义与选择的计划性表述
patterns.trigger: “definition of problems”, “program goals”, “definition of specific breeding objectives”, “selection of germplasm that possess…”
patterns.context: 先界定问题或目标，再说明后续选择步骤；包含“that”引出的限定关系。

patterns.name: Second 的篇章列举标记
patterns.context: 以序数词引出后续论点，后接对观点或播客内容的讨论。

patterns.name: 学术文本中的研究对象与机制问句
patterns.trigger: “machine learning in the CRISPR/Cas9 system”, “What are the specific cis-acting elements…?”, “What is the identity of the transcription factors that bind…”
patterns.context: 科研摘要或申请书中提出研究问题，涉及方法、遗传元件或分子机制。
patterns.domain: 基因编辑研究与科研项目申请

patterns.name: 关于族际关系与个人约会的对话
patterns.context: 非正式第一人称对话，讨论写作主题及个人约会对象。

patterns.name: 面向读者或访客的指引及环保表述
patterns.trigger: “visitors to use the recycling cans”, “environmentally friendly”, “How do I apply for a booth”
patterns.context: 活动网页中告知访客行为，并回答参展申请问题。

en.concept: Explanatory and interrogative expressions across heterogeneous texts
en.description: Activation spans multiple genres: it is especially common in questions and explanatory expressions, and also covers patent boilerplate, item categorization, coordinated lists, algorithm descriptions, argumentative transitions, and descriptions of people; no single semantic theme explains all examples.

patterns.name: Women-and-business entries in a category heading
patterns.context: Wikipedia-like article headings and category metadata; the subject is American women and business, with a heading mentioning marketers and the Tupperware Party

patterns.name: Question in a webpage Cookie explanation
patterns.context: After a website asks to use cookies, it explains cookies in a question-and-answer format and continues with questions related to user choices

patterns.name: Agricultural traits in coordinated lists
patterns.context: Describes desirable traits that varieties or breeding materials inherit from parental germplasm, listing yield, resistance, tolerance, and similar traits

patterns.name: Classifier algorithms and cross-validation
patterns.context: Explains how to select the best-performing classifier in segmented modeling, based on cross-validation training error

patterns.name: Standard opening in patent disclosures
patterns.context: A patent specification opens with a technical field section and the conventional phrase “This disclosure relates to…”, introducing a computer-implemented method, apparatus, or program product

patterns.name: Biomedical project research questions
patterns.context: A project abstract or research plan poses a series of scientific questions about molecular mechanisms, protein structure, and intracellular transport

patterns.name: Exclamatory question about a person’s traits
patterns.context: After recounting a person’s experiences, a question introduces their unusual ability, described as an uncanny ability to understand a flock of sheep

patterns.name: Sequencing markers and viewpoint introduction in argumentation
patterns.context: The author develops a commentary or argument in points, then mentions a viewpoint raised in a podcast

patterns.name: Conversational questions and needs gathering
patterns.context: Recommends giving others a chance to express their needs, questions, and possible actions, and discusses the effect on the conversation partners

patterns.name: Definitional question in an event description
patterns.context: After introducing an arts festival and describing its free community activities, asks what its name means

6_2571.concept: 异质文本中的说明与提问表达
6_2571.description: 激活分布于多种文体：尤见问句与解释性表达，也覆盖专利套语、条目分类、并列列举、算法说明、论述衔接及人物描述；没有单一语义主题能解释全部例子。

patterns.name: 分类标题中的女性与商业条目
patterns.trigger: «Category»:«American» «women»« in» business；以及 «Magazine»、«The» Story« of» Brownie Wise
patterns.context: Wikipedia 类文章标题和分类元数据；主题是美国女性与商业，标题提到营销者和 Tupperware Party

patterns.name: 网页 Cookie 说明问句
patterns.context: 网站要求使用 cookies 后，以问答形式解释 Cookie，并延续到用户选择相关问题

patterns.name: 并列列举的农业性状
patterns.trigger: «higher» seed yield«,» resistance to diseases« and» insects«,» better stems« and» roots«,» tolerance» to« drought» and» heat
patterns.context: 描述品种或育种材料从亲本种质获得的优良性状，连续列举产量、抗性、耐受性等

patterns.name: 分类器算法与交叉验证
patterns.context: 说明分段建模时如何选择表现最佳的分类器，并以交叉验证训练误差为依据
patterns.domain: 学术论文／机器学习算法

patterns.name: 专利披露的标准开篇
patterns.trigger: «Field»；«The» present disclosure« relates» generally« to» an« improved» data processing system
patterns.context: 专利说明书以技术领域和“本公开涉及……”的固定句式引出计算机实现的方法、装置或程序产品

patterns.name: 生物医学项目研究问题
patterns.trigger: «What» are« the» roles« of» molecular machineries；«What» is« the» structure« of» uroplakins
patterns.context: 项目摘要或研究计划连续提出关于分子机制、蛋白结构和细胞内运输的科学问题

patterns.name: 人物特质的赞叹式提问
patterns.context: 叙述人物经历后，以问句引出其特殊能力，并用 uncanny ability 描述读懂羊群的本领

patterns.name: 论述中的顺序标记与观点引入
patterns.context: 作者在评论或论证中分点展开，接续提及播客中提出的观点

patterns.name: 对话式提问与需求收集
patterns.context: 建议给他人机会表达需求、问题和可采取的行动，并谈及这对交谈者的影响

patterns.name: 活动说明中的定义式问句
patterns.context: 介绍艺术节及其免费社区活动性质后，提出名称含义的问题

en.description: Primarily responds to English interrogative expressions, especially questions formed with interrogative words and do/does; also covers question lists, FAQs, direct or indirect questions introduced by tell, and evaluative questions of the form what’s so….

patterns.name: Do-interrogative structure in questions
patterns.context: Do/does appears in questions introduced by an interrogative word, often with a subject and verb; activation often falls on do/does or a neighboring interrogative word.
patterns.domain: Forum conversations, website FAQs, popular science and academic texts, article titles

patterns.name: What’s so… importance/evaluation questions
patterns.context: What’s so is followed by an adjective and asks about the merit or importance of something.

patterns.name: Question lists in titles or outlines
patterns.context: Questions are organized as numbered items or consecutive FAQ entries.

patterns.name: Function-word combinations in English questions
patterns.context: A clause or phrase in declarative order appears before a question mark, presenting a question about an issue; there is no clear do-interrogative structure.

patterns.name: Imperative tell and indirect questions
patterns.context: Tell is followed by an object and content introduced by what/why, or a colon introduces a direct question.

patterns.name: Standalone interrogative word and auxiliary combinations
patterns.context: In complex academic questions, an interrogative word, auxiliary, and subject form a subsequent question; the sentence spans multiple phrases.

6_2571.description: 主要响应英语疑问表达，尤其是疑问词与 do/does 构成的问句；也覆盖问题列表、FAQ、tell 引出的间接或直接提问，以及 what’s so… 的评价问句。

patterns.name: 疑问句中的 do 疑问结构
patterns.trigger: “who do I talk to”“who do I personally date”“How do we identify”“Why do you continue”“What does”“how do they contribute”“why do so many learners hate”
patterns.context: 疑问词引出的疑问句中出现 do/does，常带主语及动词；激活常落在 do/does 或相邻疑问词上。
patterns.domain: 论坛对话、网页 FAQ、科普与学术文本、文章标题

patterns.name: What’s so…的重要性/评价问句
patterns.trigger: “What’s so good about cash?”“what’s so important to understand”
patterns.context: what’s so 后接形容词，并询问某事的优点或重要性。

patterns.name: 标题或提纲中的问题列表
patterns.trigger: “the following questions”“1. What are…”“2. How do…”
patterns.context: 问题以编号或连续 FAQ 项目形式组织。
patterns.domain: 学术论文提纲、网站 FAQ

patterns.name: 英语问句中的功能词组合
patterns.context: 问号前出现陈述语序的从句或短语，呈现对某议题的提问；没有明确的 do 疑问结构。

patterns.name: 命令式的 tell 与间接疑问
patterns.trigger: “tell you what they need”“tell me: Why did…”
patterns.context: tell 后接对象及 what/why 引出的内容，或以冒号引出直接问题。

patterns.name: 独立出现的疑问词与助动词搭配
patterns.trigger: “Which … are important … and how do they contribute”
patterns.context: 复杂学术问题中疑问词、助动词与主语构成后续问句；句子跨越多个短语。

en.description: Activation is distributed across multiple syntactic structures, with stronger responses in interrogatives such as “who do I” and “how do,” as well as relative clauses, source phrases, and fixed expressions in papers or patents; there is no clear semantic theme shared across domains.

patterns.name: “who do I” question structure
patterns.context: Questions ask whom the speaker should talk to or whom the speaker is personally dating; the former directly activates “talk,” the latter activates “personally,” but the strongest activation is mainly on “do”

patterns.name: Questions about how something is done
patterns.context: Research questions ask how a process is implemented or works, followed by content such as “they contribute” or “we determine”

patterns.name: “made in” relative structure
patterns.context: A relative clause refers to a previously stated opinion and is followed by the source “the podcast”

patterns.name: “from the” source structure
patterns.context: Identifies the source of data or gains, followed by nouns such as “data” or “efforts”

patterns.name: “of a method” in method descriptions
patterns.context: Introduces a display device and its driving method in a patent’s technical background

patterns.name: “leading to this result” in acknowledgments
patterns.context: A paper’s acknowledgments explain that the work contributed to the research result

patterns.name: “of this paper” in noun phrases
patterns.context: Summarizes the main results of a mathematics paper, near a theorem name

6_2571.concept: 含 do 的疑问结构与学术搭配
6_2571.description: 激活分散于多类句法结构，较强处包括疑问结构“who do I”“how do”，以及关系从句、来源短语和论文或专利中的固定表达；没有跨领域统一的明显语义主题。

patterns.name: “who do I”问句结构
patterns.context: 疑问句中询问说话者要找谁交谈或个人约会对象；前者直接激活“talk”，后者激活“personally”，但主要强激活落在“do”

patterns.name: 关于如何进行的疑问
patterns.context: 研究问题询问某过程如何实现或发挥作用，后接“they contribute”或“we determine”等内容

patterns.name: “made in”关系结构
patterns.context: 关系从句中指向先前提出的观点，并接来源“the podcast”

patterns.name: “from the”来源结构
patterns.context: 说明数据或收益的来源，后接“data”或“efforts”等名词
patterns.domain: 学术论文、公共事务陈述

patterns.name: 方法描述中的“of a method”
patterns.context: 专利技术背景中介绍显示装置及其驱动方法

patterns.name: 致谢中的“leading to this result”
patterns.context: 论文致谢说明工作促成研究结果

patterns.name: 名词短语中的“of this paper”
patterns.context: 数学论文概述主要结果，邻近定理名称

en.description: Activation is scattered across lists and coordination, the built-in compound, sentence-final prepositions, patent phrasing, legal terminology and rank lists, as well as user-facing forms of address and thanks. The examples span domains and include many local patterns, so they cannot be grouped into a single semantic function.

patterns.name: Coordination and transitions in lists
patterns.context: Activation appears in sentences listing multiple objects, properties, or functions, often with commas and and; list items may be noun phrases or coordinated constituents.
patterns.domain: Forum text, patent backgrounds, research papers

patterns.name: Fixed compound built-in
patterns.context: A hyphen and the following in occur between built and a subsequent noun or noun phrase; the trigger spans the word-formation boundary and is not limited to a specific collocation.
patterns.domain: Biomedical papers, legal business promotions, technical forums, data analysis papers

patterns.name: To in a question
patterns.context: To occurs at the end of a question as a preposition associated with the interrogative structure at the beginning of the sentence.

patterns.name: Highlighted segment after punctuation
patterns.context: A long coordinated sequence continues after a comma; this may overlap with the list pattern, but may also respond to the comma and following tokens.

patterns.name: Legal citation terminology
patterns.context: A legal sentence says that a nonprecedential opinion or order does not foreclose the application of other defenses or legal principles; the specific activation is concentrated near nonprecedential.

patterns.name: Rank and name lists
patterns.context: Attorney or party names are listed with military rank titles, alongside legal document markers such as JA and brief.

patterns.name: Patent title-style technical phrasing
patterns.context: A patent specification’s field or invention-summary phrasing; methods and devices are coordinated.

patterns.name: Polite thanks and service language
patterns.context: User-facing product pages or notices express thanks and refer to the service being used.

patterns.name: Addressing the reader as You and describing capabilities
patterns.context: Directly addresses the reader as You to describe benefits, needs, or recommendations; the two occurrences have different semantic functions, and whether they share a mechanism is uncertain.

6_2571.description: 激活分散于列举与并列结构、built-in 构词、句末介词、专利表述、法律术语和军衔列表，以及面向用户的称呼和致谢。跨领域且局部模式多，无法归为单一语义功能。

patterns.name: 并列列举与项目衔接
patterns.trigger: “the questions they have, the things you can do”（1）；“seed yield, resistance … and insects, better stems and roots, tolerance … and heat, and better agronomic quality”（3）；“importers for many other biometric data formats, including eye-tracking and pupillometric data”（10）
patterns.context: 激活出现在列举多个对象、属性或功能的语句中，常伴随逗号和 and；列举项可能是名词短语或并列成分。
patterns.domain: 论坛文字、专利背景、科研论文

patterns.name: 固定搭配 built-in
patterns.context: 连字符及其后的 in 位于 built 与后续名词或名词短语之间；触发跨越构词边界，不限于某一具体搭配。
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文、法律业务宣传、技术论坛、数据分析论文

patterns.name: 问句中的 to
patterns.context: to 出现在疑问句末尾，作为介词与句首疑问结构相关联。

patterns.name: 标点后的高亮局部
patterns.context: 逗号后继续推进长串并列内容；可能与列举模式重合，但也可能响应逗号及其后续 token。

patterns.name: 法律引证术语
patterns.context: 法律句中说明非先例性意见或命令不排除其他抗辩或法律原则的适用；具体激活点集中在 nonprecedential 附近。

patterns.name: 军衔与姓名列表
patterns.context: 以军衔称谓排列律师或当事人姓名，并伴随 JA、brief 等法律文书标记。

patterns.name: 专利标题式技术表述
patterns.trigger: “an organic light emitting display and a method of driving the same”（7）
patterns.context: 专利说明书的领域或发明概述句式；方法与设备并列。

patterns.name: 礼貌性致谢及服务措辞
patterns.context: 面向用户的产品页面或通知语句，表达感谢并指称正在使用的服务。

patterns.name: 称呼式 You 及能力描述
patterns.trigger: “You have work to do right away”“You gain access”（8）；“You’re looking for accessibility tools”（9）
patterns.context: 直接以第二人称 You 面向读者说明优势、需求或建议；这两处的语义功能不同，是否共享机制不确定。

en.concept: Field introductions and local function-word collocations
en.description: Primarily responds to fixed phrasing in patent field introductions, especially “relates to” a technology/device and coordinated methods and apparatuses; also responds to do in a dating question and in in the people category “women in business.”

patterns.name: Patent technical-field introduction
patterns.context: A heading in a patent background or the opening of a specification introduces the subject of the invention/disclosure; often continues by listing apparatuses, methods, or devices.

patterns.name: Display devices and their manufacturing/control methods
patterns.context: Patent field introductions coordinate a display apparatus and control method, or a display device and manufacturing method; includes specific types such as OLED and LCD.

patterns.name: Imaging, ink, and detection technology
patterns.context: Patent field introductions present imaging, ink-related equipment, or detection technology, often coordinating methods and apparatuses.

patterns.name: Question in a personal dating context
patterns.context: A colloquial first-person question asks whom the speaker is personally dating; strong activation is concentrated on «do» in the interrogative structure.

patterns.name: Business figure category entry
patterns.context: A category tag on a biographical page gives a professional or field category; strong activation falls on the preposition «in».

6_2571.concept: 领域引言及功能词局部搭配
6_2571.description: 主要响应专利领域引言的固定句式，尤其是“涉及某技术/设备”及方法、装置并列；另有约会疑问句中的 do，以及人物分类“women in business”中的 in。

patterns.name: 专利技术领域引言
patterns.trigger: «Field»、«Technical Field»、«Field of the Invention»；随后常见 «relate» / «relates» «to» «a/an»
patterns.context: 专利背景或说明书开头，以领域标题引出发明/披露涉及的对象；常继续列举装置、方法或设备。
patterns.domain: USPTO 专利背景/技术领域

patterns.name: 显示设备及其制造/控制方法
patterns.context: 专利领域引言中并列说明显示装置与控制方法，或显示设备及其制造方法；包含 OLED、LCD 等具体类型。

patterns.name: 成像、墨水与检测技术
patterns.context: 专利领域引言中介绍成像、墨水相关设备或检测技术，常以方法和装置并列。

patterns.name: 个人约会话题中的疑问句
patterns.context: 口语化第一人称问句，询问说话者个人与谁约会；强激活集中在疑问结构中的 «do»。

patterns.name: 商业人物分类条目
patterns.context: 人物传记页面的分类标签中出现职业或领域类别；强激活落在介词 «in»。

en.description: Primarily responds to patent opening statements defining a field, phrasing about inventions, and coordinated apparatus/method subjects; also responds to the hyphenated portion of built-in in HackerNews, as well as Wikipedia category tags and people categories.

patterns.name: Patent field opening phrasing
patterns.context: The beginning of a patent background or specification outlines the field of the invention; often followed by “to an/a” and subjects such as apparatuses and methods.

patterns.name: Coordinated invention subjects and function descriptions
patterns.context: A patent sentence coordinates apparatuses, methods, or functions with and, often including terms such as image/display/apparatus/method.

patterns.name: Category tags and people categories
patterns.context: A list of categories at the end of a biographical entry, with tags followed by identity, region, or profession categories.

patterns.name: Built-in in discussions of technical language
patterns.context: Discussion of programming language features, libraries, or alternatives; activation falls near “in” after the hyphen.

patterns.name: Built-in in accessibility tool recommendations
patterns.context: Discussion of accessibility tools in desktop or mobile operating systems; activation likewise falls near “in” after the hyphen.

6_2571.concept: 专利领域与发明对象句式
6_2571.description: 主要响应专利开篇的领域界定、发明相关句式及并列装置/方法对象；另响应 HackerNews 中 built-in 的连字符后部分，以及 Wikipedia 分类标签与人物类别。

patterns.name: 专利领域开篇句式
patterns.trigger: “Field”“Technical Field”“Field of the Invention”“The present invention relates to”“One or more embodiments relate to”
patterns.context: 专利背景或说明书开头，概述发明所属领域；常接“to an/a”及装置、方法等对象。

patterns.name: 并列发明对象与功能描述
patterns.trigger: “and an apparatus”“and an image forming method”“and a method of driving”“and a method of controlling”
patterns.context: 专利句中用 and 并列装置、方法或功能，常出现 image/display/apparatus/method 等术语。

patterns.name: 类别标签与人物分类
patterns.context: 人物条目末尾的分类列表，标签后接身份、地域或职业类别。

patterns.name: 技术语言讨论中的 built-in
patterns.context: 讨论编程语言特性、库或替代方案；激活落在连字符后的“in”附近。

patterns.name: 无障碍工具建议中的 built-in
patterns.context: 讨论桌面或移动操作系统的无障碍工具；激活同样落在连字符后的“in”附近。

en.concept: Patent invention topics and apparatus/method phrasing
en.description: Primarily responds to expressions introducing the subject of an invention in patent text, especially “relates to an” and category terms such as apparatus and method; topics include image display and formation, computer processing, electronic measurement, engine control, and unclogging devices. It also activates on a passage of informal interpersonal text.

patterns.name: Invention-subject phrasing in patent backgrounds
patterns.context: A sentence in a USPTO background technology or technical-field paragraph introduces the invention and its subject; several highly activated words fall on the topic noun and technical categories such as method and apparatus.
patterns.domain: Patent text, especially invention backgrounds and technical fields

patterns.name: Image formation and display technology
patterns.context: Discusses image formation, image processing, or display devices, describing technical solutions as apparatuses, methods, or associated materials.
patterns.domain: Printing, image formation, and display technologies in patents

patterns.name: Computer and image-encoding processing
patterns.context: Describes data, image encoding, or program modification performed by a computer, processor, or program.
patterns.domain: Computers, digital signal processing, and software in patents

patterns.name: Specific electronic or electromechanical devices and control
patterns.context: Focuses on device measurement or control methods, involving electromagnetic interference measurement or engine control.
patterns.domain: Electronic measurement and automotive engine control in patents

patterns.name: Informal discussion of interpersonal relationships and dating
patterns.context: First-person question-and-answer context about a writing topic and the speaker’s personal dating partner; does not fit patent invention-introduction phrasing.

patterns.name: Functional description of a toilet unclogging device
patterns.context: Explains how a device moves air and forces water into a drain to unclog a toilet, then shifts to patent-style “present invention” phrasing.
patterns.domain: Patent description of a household plumbing unclogging device

6_2571.concept: 专利发明主题与装置方法表述
6_2571.description: 主要响应专利文本中介绍发明主题的表述，尤其是“relates to an”、装置、方法等类别词；主题涵盖图像显示与形成、计算机处理、电子测量、发动机控制及疏通装置。另对一段人际关系口语文本有激活。

patterns.name: 专利背景中的发明主题句式
patterns.trigger: “relates to an”以及“method”“apparatus”“device”等发明主题名词；常见片段为“a method of”“an apparatus for”“a … device and … method”
patterns.context: 在 USPTO 背景技术或技术领域段落中，句子介绍发明及其对象；若干高激活词落在主题名词和方法、装置等技术类别上。
patterns.domain: 专利文本，尤其是发明背景和技术领域

patterns.name: 图像形成与显示技术
patterns.trigger: “image forming”“toner image”“varnish applicator”“display apparatus”及“method of controlling the display apparatus”
patterns.context: 讨论图像形成、图像处理或显示设备，并以装置、方法或配套材料描述技术方案。
patterns.domain: 专利中的打印、图像形成和显示技术

patterns.name: 计算机与图像编码处理
patterns.trigger: “compressing/encoding an image code”“CPU”“DSP”“data processing system”“computer-implemented method”“computer program”
patterns.context: 描述计算机、处理器或程序执行的数据、图像编码或程序修改操作。
patterns.domain: 专利中的计算机、数字信号处理和软件

patterns.name: 特定电子或机电设备及控制
patterns.trigger: “electromagnetic interference measuring device”“electromagnetic interference measuring method”“controller”“control method”“internal combustion engine”
patterns.context: 以设备测量或控制方法为主题，涉及电磁干扰测量或发动机控制。
patterns.domain: 专利中的电子测量与汽车发动机控制

patterns.name: 人际关系与约会的口语讨论
patterns.context: 第一人称问答式语境，谈及写作主题、个人约会对象；不符合专利主题介绍句式。

patterns.name: 马桶疏通装置的功能说明
patterns.context: 解释装置如何移动空气、迫使水进入排水管以疏通马桶，随后转入专利式“present invention”表述。
patterns.domain: 专利中的家用管道疏通装置说明

en.description: Activation spans multiple genres and often falls on specific terms, numbering, or introductory expressions: patent-purpose sentences, physical mode notation, student-promotion controversy, fluid evaporation, encyclopedia categories, legal charges, narratives of personal success, and corporate competitiveness. There is no single clear semantic theme.

patterns.name: Patent background and statement of invention purpose
patterns.context: Patent text introduces a field, device, or method and states the invention’s purpose; words near the relevant phrases often activate strongly.

patterns.name: Mode and parameter notation in mathematical physics
patterns.context: A theoretical physics paper discusses phase diagrams, correlations, or momentum modes, with formula symbols adjacent to technical terms.

patterns.name: Discussion of student responses and potential harm
patterns.context: A commentary describes students taking part in a promotional activity and potential harm caused by the activity.

patterns.name: Fluid phase transition and interface process
patterns.context: A technical description tracks a working fluid passing a specific point and evaporating.

patterns.name: Encyclopedia biographical categories and metadata
patterns.context: Category directories and occupational categories in a biography entry or related materials.

patterns.name: Criminal rulings and charge numbers
patterns.context: A court opinion discusses evidence, a motion for acquittal, or convictions organized by charge number.

patterns.name: Inspirational biography and career success
patterns.context: Recounts a celebrity’s humble origins, hard work, and success in an entertainment career.

patterns.name: Corporate competitiveness and international markets
patterns.context: Discusses corporate capability building, value chains, and export or international competitiveness.

6_2571.description: 激活分布于多种体裁，常落在具体术语、编号或引导性表达上：专利目的句、物理模式记号、学生宣传争议、流体蒸发、百科分类、法律罪名、人物成功叙述及企业竞争力。没有单一清晰的语义主题。

patterns.name: 技术专利背景与发明目的表述
patterns.trigger: “relates to”, “More particularly”, “It is a further object of the present invention to provide”
patterns.context: 专利文本中介绍发明领域、装置或方法，并陈述发明目的；相关短语附近的词语常有较强激活。
patterns.domain: USPTO 专利背景/技术说明

patterns.name: 数学物理中的模式与参数记号
patterns.context: 理论物理论文讨论相图、关联或动量模式时，公式符号与技术术语相邻。

patterns.name: 学生响应与潜在伤害的论述
patterns.trigger: “who responded to the pr campaign”, “cause harm to students”
patterns.context: 评论文章描述学生参与某项宣传活动，以及活动可能造成的伤害。

patterns.name: 流体相变及界面过程
patterns.context: 技术描述追踪工质经过特定点并蒸发的过程。

patterns.name: 百科人物分类与传记元数据
patterns.context: 人物条目或相关资料中的分类目录与人物职业类别。

patterns.name: 刑事案件裁判与罪名编号
patterns.trigger: “Count 3”, “motion for judgment of acquittal”, “possession of cocaine base”
patterns.context: 法院意见按罪名编号讨论证据、无罪判决动议或定罪事项。

patterns.name: 人物励志传记与事业成功
patterns.context: 叙述名人出身贫寒、努力发展并取得演艺事业成就。

patterns.name: 企业竞争力与国际市场
patterns.context: 讨论企业能力建设、价值链与出口或国际竞争力。

en.description: Activation is distributed across business competitiveness, patent phrasing “and a method,” paper structure and results, medical titles, competition rankings, legal claims, breeding adjectives, and webpage links; no unified semantic or syntactic feature is apparent.

patterns.name: “and a method” in patent titles
patterns.context: A patent title or technical-field statement coordinates an apparatus and method with “and a method”; [2] also includes “method of driving the same”.

patterns.name: Competitiveness word family
patterns.context: Context discusses corporate capabilities, competitiveness, and international markets; the word root may be split across subword fragments.

patterns.name: Research paper structure and result navigation
patterns.context: Structural expressions such as section and results appear in descriptions of paper organization, section references, or result summaries.

patterns.name: Research title-style questions
patterns.context: A medical paper uses a title-style question to introduce clinical significance or a discussion section.

patterns.name: Competition ranking / third place
patterns.context: Describes a sheepdog competition and participants’ rankings; the ordinal third appears in the competition results.
patterns.domain: People or animal stories / event narratives

patterns.name: Second claim in a legal case
patterns.context: A criminal ruling presents, in order, the defendant’s argument against the second claim and the second charge.

patterns.name: New and variety listings in plant breeding
patterns.context: Introduces soybean varieties and hybrids and breeding goals, with adjectives describing new varieties in a series.
patterns.domain: Agriculture / plant breeding patents or technical text

patterns.name: Webpage title and URL digit strings
patterns.context: A blog link title and URL; activation is distributed over numbers and symbols in the link path.

patterns.name: No clear shared trigger pattern
patterns.context: Highlighted words occur in different sentence structures, including legal and medical texts; the excerpts do not establish a stable cross-domain trigger condition.

6_2571.description: 激活分散于商业竞争力、专利的“and a method”、论文结构与结果、医学标题、竞赛名次、法律主张、育种形容词及网页链接等，未见统一语义或句法特征。

patterns.name: 专利标题中的 and a method
patterns.trigger: “and»7 a»10 method»7”[2]；“device»3 and»7 a»9 manufacturing»3 method»5”[10]
patterns.context: 专利文本的标题或技术领域句式中，出现“and a method”并列列举装置与方法；[2]还含“method of driving the same”。

patterns.name: 竞争力词族
patterns.context: 讲述企业能力、竞争力及国际市场的语境，词根可能跨子词边界分词。

patterns.name: 科研论文结构与结果导航
patterns.context: 论文组织结构、章节引用或结果概述中，出现 section、results 等结构性表达。

patterns.name: 科研标题式问句
patterns.context: 医学论文中以标题式问句引出临床意义或讨论小节。

patterns.name: 竞赛名次／第三名
patterns.context: 描述牧羊犬比赛及参赛者名次，序数词 third 出现在比赛结果中。
patterns.domain: 人物或动物故事／赛事叙述

patterns.name: 法律案件的第二项主张
patterns.context: 刑事判决论述中，按序说明被告针对第二项主张及第二项罪名的论证。

patterns.name: 植物育种中的 new 与品种列举
patterns.context: 介绍大豆品种和杂交种的育种目标，形容词并列描述新品种。
patterns.domain: 农业／植物育种专利或技术文本

patterns.name: 网页标题与链接数字串
patterns.trigger: “↵A letter to my daughter, Augusta, in ruby - pacbard”；链接中的“post/39935683274”
patterns.context: 博客链接标题及 URL，激活分布在链接路径的数字和符号上。

patterns.name: 无明显共同触发模式
patterns.trigger: “As to the second claim”“What Are the Clinical Implications?”等局部高亮
patterns.context: 高亮词分布在法律、医学等不同句式中；无法从片段确定稳定、跨领域的触发条件。

en.description: Activation patterns are mixed: HackerNews repeatedly features built-in hyphenated expressions (including one instance of collections); the rest occur in patent wording and clause numbering, paper section links, mathematical statements of solvability, and count two in a ruling.

patterns.name: Built-in hyphenated structure
patterns.context: The hyphen token in built-in is most strongly activated; surrounding words refer to API, accessibility tools, ad blocking, and in-car navigation. Across contexts, it describes a feature as built in.

patterns.name: Patent claim step numbering
patterns.context: In legal-style patent text, claim steps or subclauses are marked with parenthesized letters; temporary access information, authentication markers, and device reading also appear.

patterns.name: Patent apparatus and invention phrasing
patterns.context: A fixed legal-technical expression in a patent background or invention description—according to the above aspect of the invention—is followed by device.

patterns.name: Paper results section reference
patterns.context: The paper body cites Section 5 with a Markdown anchor link; nearby content summarizes network performance results and future work.

patterns.name: Built-in collections in programming languages
patterns.context: When discussing language features and platform development efficiency, built-in modifies collections; it is coordinated with dynamic typing, class libraries, and related terms.

patterns.name: Solvability conclusion in a mathematical proof
patterns.context: A number theory paper states that group G is solvable after a formula and assumption, and gives an affirmative answer to a conjecture.

patterns.name: Count two in judicial case reasoning
patterns.context: A court ruling discusses Gonzalez’s argument regarding the second claim; count two refers to the case’s second charge.

6_2571.description: 激活模式混杂：HackerNews 多次出现 built-in 连字符表达（含一处 collections）；其余分别落在专利措辞与条款编号、论文章节链接、数学可解性表述及判决中的 count two。

patterns.name: built-in 连字符结构
patterns.context: 短语 built-in 中连字符 token 激活最强，周围词语分别涉及 API、无障碍工具、广告拦截、车载导航；不同语境下均是把功能描述为内置的表达。

patterns.name: 专利权利要求步骤标号
patterns.context: 法律式专利文本中，以括号字母标记的权利要求步骤或子条款；还出现临时访问信息、认证标记与设备读取。

patterns.name: 专利装置与发明表述
patterns.context: 专利背景或发明说明中，固定法律技术表达 according to the above aspect of the invention，后接 device。

patterns.name: 论文结果章节引用
patterns.context: 论文正文以 Markdown 锚点链接引用 Section 5，邻近内容总结网络性能结果及未来工作。

patterns.name: 编程语言内置集合
patterns.context: 讨论语言特性与平台开发效率时，built-in 修饰 collections；与动态类型、类库等并列。

patterns.name: 数学证明中的可解性结论
patterns.context: 数论论文中，公式假设之后陈述群 G is solvable，并给出猜想的肯定答案。

patterns.name: 司法案件论证中的 count two
patterns.context: 法院判决讨论 Gonzalez 对第二项主张的论证，count two 指案件中的第二项指控。

en.description: Activation is distributed across cookie copy, mathematical conclusions, technical links and built-in usage, patent terminology, blog links, and breeding text; there is no shared trigger form that consistently covers these contexts.

patterns.name: Built-in in hyphenated compounds
patterns.context: The adjective built-in precedes nouns such as collections, features, or APIs; activation is concentrated on the hyphen and neighboring tokens.
patterns.domain: Technical discussions, programming languages, and software documentation

patterns.name: Website cookie consent copy
patterns.context: Describes cookie use, personalization, and online advertising; activation falls especially on advertisements.

patterns.name: Concluding language in mathematics papers
patterns.context: A mathematics paper states the proof result for a conjecture and gives affirmative or negative answers to questions one by one.

patterns.name: Technical documentation and URL path punctuation
patterns.context: The text includes a URL for a Microsoft download page; activation falls on URL separators and punctuation.

patterns.name: Accessibility tool recommendations
patterns.context: Discusses accessibility features built into desktop and mobile operating systems.

patterns.name: Measurement apparatus and method in patent backgrounds
patterns.context: A patent-style background statement says the invention relates to a measurement apparatus and method.

patterns.name: Blog title and URL
patterns.context: A forum post cites a blog title and link; activation falls on the paragraph-opening newline marker.

patterns.name: Soybean breeding and variety evaluation
patterns.context: Describes trial observations, genetic value evaluation, and breeding goals.
patterns.domain: Agriculture and plant breeding patent text

patterns.name: Software community recommendations and built-in APIs
patterns.context: Compares software libraries recommended by the community with a platform’s built-in JSON API.

6_2571.description: 激活分散于 cookie 文案、数学结论、技术链接与 built-in 用法、专利术语、博客链接及育种文本；没有稳定覆盖这些语境的共同触发形式。

patterns.name: 连字符复合词中的 built-in
patterns.trigger: «built»-«-»«in»（第2、5、10段；第5段的 in 未标记）
patterns.context: 形容词 built-in 后接集合、功能、API 等名词；激活集中在连字符及其邻近 token。
patterns.domain: 技术讨论、编程语言与软件文档

patterns.name: 网页 cookie 同意文案
patterns.context: 描述 cookie 用途、个性化及在线广告，激活尤其落在 advertisements。
patterns.domain: 网站隐私或 cookie 提示

patterns.name: 数学论文中的结论措辞
patterns.trigger: «positive answer»、«solvable»，以及「answers to questions … are negative/affirmative」
patterns.context: 数学论文陈述猜想的证明结果，并逐项说明问题答案的正负。

patterns.name: 技术文档与网址路径标点
patterns.trigger: «.»、«?»、«/»，出现在 microsoft.com 下载链接中
patterns.context: 正文附带微软下载页面的 URL，激活落在网址分隔符及标点。

patterns.name: 无障碍工具建议
patterns.context: 讨论桌面和移动操作系统内置的无障碍功能。

patterns.name: 专利背景中的测量装置与方法
patterns.context: 专利式背景陈述发明涉及某种测量装置及方法。

patterns.name: 博客标题与网址
patterns.trigger: 行首«↵»及标题「A letter to my daughter」，随后是 Tumblr URL
patterns.context: 论坛帖子引用博客标题和链接，激活落在段首换行标记。

patterns.name: 大豆育种与品种评估
patterns.trigger: «widely»、«grown»、«replicated»，及「new, unique and superior soybean cultivars and hybrids」
patterns.context: 描述试验观察、遗传价值评估及育种目标。
patterns.domain: 农业与植物育种专利文本

patterns.name: 软件社区推荐与内置 API
patterns.context: 比较社区推荐的软件库与平台内置 JSON API。

en.description: The most prominent activations are words and commas used to introduce an invention’s field, describe a technical solution, and list items in patent text; activation also occurs on topic words or list punctuation in breeding, research objectives, mathematical-paper conclusions, website Cookie explanations, and programming-language discussions.

patterns.name: Introducing a patent field/invention topic
patterns.context: In patent text, appears as a section heading or opening sentence, followed by an overview of the technical field, system, or method to which the invention belongs.
patterns.domain: USPTO patent backgrounds and technical fields

patterns.name: Commas in lists of patent topics
patterns.context: Commas activate strongly when patent or technical text lists invention components, technical objects, or coordinated properties; a strong activation also occurs after “new,” in paragraph 1.
patterns.domain: Patent technical writing; also plant-breeding text

patterns.name: Introducing a technical solution with “according to”
patterns.context: In a patent embodiment description, “according to the above aspect” is followed by the invention’s content; “according” and “to” are the strongest activations in the passage.

patterns.name: Plant-breeding objectives and variety evaluation
patterns.context: Discusses evaluating the genetic value of standard varieties, repeated observations, and breeding new, unique, and superior soybean varieties and hybrids.

patterns.name: Results and answers to questions in mathematical papers
patterns.context: A mathematical paper uses a theorem or corollary to state that the answers to several questions are negative or affirmative; activation is concentrated on the answers and judgment words.

patterns.name: Funded research objectives and disease etiology
patterns.context: A research grant abstract states the objectives of a supplemental award and investigates genetic factors, interactions, disease etiology, and prevention.

patterns.name: Cookie personalization and list of uses
patterns.context: A website explains that cookies are used for personalization, tailored online advertisements, and other purposes; “advertisements,” activates strongly.

patterns.name: Conjectures and affirmative results in mathematical papers
patterns.context: A mathematical paper announces an affirmative answer to a conjecture and further improves the result; earlier it presents formulas and propositions about primes and group solvability.

patterns.name: Programming-language features and platform comparisons
patterns.context: Discusses language features, libraries, and platforms, especially comparing the speed of implementing functionality and language features such as dynamic typing and built-in collections; activations are scattered and do not form a stable sentence pattern.

6_2571.description: 最突出的是专利文本中引入发明领域、描述技术方案和列举对象时的词语与逗号；此外也响应育种、研究目标、数学论文结论、网站Cookie说明及编程语言讨论中的主题词或列举标点。

patterns.name: 专利领域/发明主题的引入
patterns.trigger: “Field”“Field of the Invention”“Technical Field”及“The present disclosure relates to”“The present invention relates to”
patterns.context: 专利文本中，作为小节标题或开篇句，随后概述发明所属技术领域、系统或方法。
patterns.domain: USPTO 专利背景与技术领域

patterns.name: 专利主题列举中的逗号
patterns.context: 专利或技术文本在列举发明构成、技术对象或并列性质时，逗号标点激活明显；第1段也在“new,”后出现强激活。
patterns.domain: 专利技术写作；另见植物育种文本

patterns.name: 按“according to”引入技术方案
patterns.context: 专利实施方案描述中，短语“according to the above aspect”后接发明内容；“according”与“to”均为该段最强激活。

patterns.name: 植物育种目标与品种评价
patterns.context: 讨论标准品种的遗传价值评估、重复观察，以及培育新的、独特且优良的大豆品种和杂交种。

patterns.name: 数学论文中的结果与问题回答
patterns.context: 数学论文通过定理或推论说明若干问题的答案为否或肯定；激活集中在问题答案和判断词。

patterns.name: 资助研究目标与疾病病因
patterns.context: 研究资助摘要陈述补充拨款的研究目标，探究遗传因素、交互作用、疾病病因和预防。

patterns.name: Cookie 个性化与用途列表
patterns.context: 网站说明使用 cookies 进行个性化、定制在线广告及其他用途；“advertisements,”处激活较强。
patterns.domain: 网站隐私或 Cookie 说明

patterns.name: 数学论文的猜想与肯定结果
patterns.context: 数学论文宣布对猜想给出肯定答案并进一步改进结果；此前另有关于素数、群可解性的公式和命题。

patterns.name: 编程语言特性与平台比较
patterns.context: 讨论语言特性、库和平台，尤其比较实现功能的速度及动态类型、内置集合等语言特性；激活点零散，未形成稳定句式。

en.description: Activation spans multiple genres, with clearer clusters around commas and coordinating conjunctions, patent-style background statements, and paper structure markers; other instances include theorem answers, compounds, website privacy notices, French academic text, and plant breeding. No single semantic theme covers all samples.

patterns.name: Comma and and coordination structure
patterns.context: Multiple function words and punctuation near commas and coordinating conjunctions are marked, especially patent background phrasing with a comma followed by and or more; also occurs in ordinary coordination in technical texts.

patterns.name: Conclusion and section cross-references
patterns.context: In paper conclusions or section-navigation paragraphs, section titles, conclusion wording, citation markers, and document anchors appear together.
patterns.domain: ArXiv academic papers and structured markup

patterns.name: Statements answering questions and theorems
patterns.context: A paper gives affirmative or negative answers to research questions one by one and organizes the argument with theorems, corollaries, and citation labels.

patterns.name: Introducing invention subjects in patent backgrounds
patterns.context: A fixed opening phrase common in patent backgrounds is followed by the invention topic, such as semiconductor devices or video processing.

patterns.name: Hyphenated compounds
patterns.context: A hyphen connects the components of a compound term; the triggered items range across general technical expressions and academic terminology.

patterns.name: Website notices about privacy and advertising
patterns.context: A website explains that it uses cookies for personalization, customized online advertising, and other purposes.

patterns.name: French academic descriptions and use cases
patterns.context: A French passage discusses entities, variables, data structures, and the contexts in which a technology applies.

patterns.name: Plant breeding and variety selection
patterns.context: Evaluates genetic value using experimental observations and describes goals for developing new varieties or hybrids.

patterns.name: New variety discovery and vegetative propagation records
patterns.context: A patent-style plant variety description records discovery, breeding, parent crosses, controlled environments, and propagation methods.

patterns.name: Built-in camera feature descriptions
patterns.context: Describes camera features missing relative to the needs of professional users, while also mentioning designs such as built-in grips.

6_2571.description: 激活跨多种文体，较明显聚集于逗号和并列连接词、专利式背景陈述及论文结构标记；其余包括定理答案、复合词、网页隐私提示、法语学术文本和植物育种等具体内容，未见单一语义主题覆盖全部样本。

patterns.name: 相邻逗号与 and 的连接结构
patterns.context: 逗号和并列连词附近多个功能词及标点被标记，尤其是逗号后接 and 或 more 的专利背景句式；也出现在科技文本中的普通并列结构。

patterns.name: 结论与章节交叉引用
patterns.context: 论文结尾或章节导航段落中，章节标题、结论用语、引用标记及文档锚点同时出现。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 学术论文与结构化标记

patterns.name: 问题与定理的答案陈述
patterns.context: 论文逐项说明研究问题的肯定或否定答案，并以定理、推论和引用标签组织论证。

patterns.name: 专利背景中的发明主题引入
patterns.context: 专利背景常见的固定开篇句式，随后点明半导体器件或视频处理等发明主题。

patterns.name: 连字符复合词
patterns.context: 连字符将复合术语的组成部分连接起来；触发对象跨一般技术表达与学术术语。

patterns.name: 隐私与广告用途的网页提示
patterns.context: 网站说明使用 cookie 进行个性化、定制在线广告及其他用途。

patterns.name: 法语学术描述与适用情境
patterns.context: 法语段落讨论实体、变量、数据结构及某种技术适用的情境。

patterns.name: 植物育种与品种选育
patterns.context: 以实验观察评估遗传价值，并描述培育新品种或杂交种的目标。

patterns.name: 新品种发现与无性繁殖记录
patterns.context: 专利式植物品种说明，记载发现、选育、亲本交配、受控环境及繁殖方式。

patterns.name: 相机内置功能描述
patterns.context: 描述相机相对专业用户需求所缺少的功能，同时提及内置握柄等设计。

en.description: Activation is heterogeneous: it includes questions, coordination and punctuation, paragraph or heading openings, patent boilerplate, research objectives and abstracts, theorem conclusions, forum language, and URLs and link titles. Most passages are structured text, but no single word meaning or genre explains all activations.

patterns.name: Introducing questions and interrogative words
patterns.context: When a question is posed or discussed in an interrogative sentence or academic text; the strongest activation is do in a HackerNews sentence.

patterns.name: Line breaks at heading or paragraph starts
patterns.context: At the start of text headings, patent section headings, or new paragraphs, often immediately before a capitalized opening word.
patterns.domain: Online headings, patent text, technical writing

patterns.name: Coordinating conjunctions and commas
patterns.context: Nouns, adjectives, or clauses are coordinated, with conjunctions and commas recurring; “, more particularly/specifically” in patent titles also activates.

patterns.name: Patent invention-description boilerplate
patterns.context: A patent specification opens with “the present invention/disclosure relates to…” to introduce a technical field or specific subject.

patterns.name: Research objectives and development in scholarly writing
patterns.context: States research objectives, research content, development processes, or expected contributions, often using abstract nouns and verbs.

patterns.name: Punctuation in webpage links and paths
patterns.context: Slashes, periods, hyphens, question marks, and numeric sequences in URLs, URL paths, or query parameters.

patterns.name: Language about a website’s introduction and purpose
patterns.context: Introduces a developer community and the resources or purposes it serves for users.

patterns.name: Words for imagination and fictional mental states
patterns.context: Discusses young children’s understanding of imagination, fiction, and their relationship to reality.

patterns.name: Disaster research and intervention outcomes
patterns.context: Describes post-disaster assessment, disaster impacts, and interventions developed based on research findings, involving older adults.

patterns.name: Theorems and conclusions in mathematical papers
patterns.context: States answers to questions by section and marks mathematical conclusions with corollaries or theorems.

patterns.name: Jokes, positions, and edit notes in forum posts
patterns.context: An online commenter first expresses a position in a joking manner, then clarifies it in an edit and asks readers a follow-up question.

patterns.name: Earnings-call transcript link titles
patterns.context: A webpage link path forms a title from keywords such as company, fiscal quarter, earnings, and conference call transcript.

6_2571.description: 激活分布很杂：包括提问、并列连接与标点、段落或标题起始、专利套语、科研目标和摘要内容、定理结论、论坛表达，以及 URL 与链接标题。多数段落是结构化文本，但无法由单一词义或文体解释全部激活。

patterns.name: 引出问题及提问词
patterns.context: 疑问句或学术文本中提出、讨论具体问题时；最强处是 HackerNews 句中 do。

patterns.name: 标题或段落起始的换行
patterns.context: 文本标题、专利章节标题或新段落开始处，常紧接大写开头词。
patterns.domain: 网络标题、专利文本、科技写作

patterns.name: 并列连接词及逗号
patterns.context: 名词、形容词或分句并列，连接词和逗号反复出现；专利标题中的“, more particularly/specifically”也有激活。
patterns.domain: 专利、科研摘要及一般文本

patterns.name: 专利中的发明描述套语
patterns.trigger: “Field of the Invention”“The present invention relates to”“The present disclosure relates to”“more particularly”“more specifically”
patterns.context: 专利说明书开头以“本发明/本公开涉及……”引入技术领域或具体对象。

patterns.name: 科研写作中的研究目标与发展
patterns.context: 说明研究目标、研究内容、发展过程或预期贡献，常含抽象名词及动词。
patterns.domain: 专利背景、NIH 项目摘要

patterns.name: 网页链接及路径标点
patterns.context: 网址、URL 路径或查询参数中的斜杠、点、连字符、问号及数字序列。
patterns.domain: 网页抓取文本、论坛帖子

patterns.name: 网站介绍中的成立与用途措辞
patterns.trigger: “was founded by developers, for developers”“valuable resource”“make the most of their mobile devices”
patterns.context: 介绍开发者社区及其面向用户的资源或用途。

patterns.name: 表示想象与虚构心理状态的词语
patterns.context: 讨论幼儿对想象、虚构及其与现实关系的理解。

patterns.name: 灾害研究与干预成效
patterns.context: 描述灾后评估、灾害影响及据研究结果制定干预措施，涉及老年人群。

patterns.name: 数学论文的定理与结论表述
patterns.trigger: “Section”“answers to questions B and C are negative”“Corollary”“Theorem”“affirmative”
patterns.context: 按章节陈述问题答案，并用推论或定理标示数学结论。

patterns.name: 论坛中的玩笑、立场及编辑说明
patterns.context: 网络评论者先表达带玩笑性质的立场，后以编辑说明澄清并追问读者。

patterns.name: 财报电话会链接标题
patterns.context: 网页链接路径以公司、财季、业绩及电话会文字稿等关键词构成标题。

en.description: Primarily responds to strings containing point, including PowerPoint, points/breakpoints in programming, medical endpoints, and the idiom case-in-point; also responds to hmm in IRC and the convolution stem in convolutional.

patterns.name: point / PowerPoint strings
patterns.context: point occurs at the end of a word or as a standalone noun; includes different forms or phrases such as PowerPoint, point, breakpoint, endpoint, and case-in-point.
patterns.domain: Webpage titles, programming Q&A and debugging, medical papers, product reviews

patterns.name: hmm in IRC
patterns.context: Used as a standalone response or an interjection with a question mark in chat conversations.

patterns.name: The -al suffix in convolutional
patterns.context: convolutional appears in academic papers; strong activation falls on the stem convolution, followed by al.

6_2674.concept: 包含 point 的字符串
6_2674.description: 主要响应 point 字符串，涵盖 PowerPoint、编程中的点/断点、医学 endpoint 和习语 case-in-point；另响应 IRC 的 hmm，以及 convolutional 中的 convolution 词干。

patterns.name: point / PowerPoint 字符串
patterns.context: point 出现在词尾或独立名词中；包括 PowerPoint、point、breakpoint、endpoint、case-in-point 等不同词形或短语。
patterns.domain: 网页标题、编程问答与调试、医学论文、产品评论

patterns.name: IRC 中的 hmm
patterns.context: 聊天对话中作为独立回应或带问号的语气词。

patterns.name: 卷积的 -al 词尾
patterns.context: 学术论文中出现 convolutional；强激活落在词干 convolution，后接 al。

en.concept: point word forms and local within-word patterns
en.description: Activation is most consistently associated with point and its compounds, including PowerPoint, point objects, breakpoints, endpoints, and examples; it also appears on the final m in hmm in IRC and at a within-word boundary in convolutional.

patterns.name: point-related word forms
patterns.context: Activation falls on the word point, which can refer to presentation software, a point object in an array, a debugging breakpoint, a period/endpoint, or a key point in an example; the meanings vary.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain: forum titles, programming Q&A and logs, academic abstracts, product reviews

patterns.name: Final-m continuation in hmm
patterns.context: The hesitation word hmm appears in IRC conversations; activation is especially strong on the final m.

patterns.name: al in convolutional
patterns.context: In academic papers, activation falls near the boundary between the stem and suffix of convolutional; it has no apparent semantic connection to other point examples.

6_2674.concept: point 词形及局部词内模式
6_2674.description: 激活最稳定地出现在 point 及其复合表达中，涵盖 PowerPoint、点对象、断点、终点和例证；另见 IRC 中 hmm 末尾的 m，以及 convolutional 中的词内边界。

patterns.name: point 相关词形
patterns.context: 激活落在 point 这个词上；它可指演示文稿、数组中的点对象、调试断点、句点/终点，或例证中的要点，语义并不一致。
patterns.domain: 跨领域：论坛标题、编程问答与日志、学术摘要、产品评论

patterns.name: hmm 的 m 延续
patterns.context: IRC 对话中出现犹豫语气词 hmm；激活尤其落在末尾的 m 上。

patterns.name: 卷积词中的 al
patterns.context: 学术论文中，激活落在 convolutional 的词干与后缀边界附近；与其他 point 用例没有明显语义联系。

en.description: Activation is primarily associated with the word form point across code identifiers, breakpoints, points in arrays, study endpoints, and uses such as case-in-point; it also responds strongly to hmm in IRC.

patterns.name: point followed by a number or punctuation
patterns.context: The word point appears as an ordinary word in code or text, followed by parentheses, a number, a period, or quotation marks; no specific meaning is required.
patterns.domain: StackExchange technical Q&A, PubMed abstracts, HackerNews discussions, and forum chat

patterns.name: hmm in chat
patterns.context: The response word hmm in IRC conversations, possibly followed by punctuation or other text.

6_2674.description: 主要对词形 point 激活，跨代码标识符、断点、数组中的 point、研究终点及 case-in-point 等用法；另对 IRC 中的 hmm 强烈激活。

patterns.name: point 后接数字或标点
patterns.context: 单词 point 作为代码或文本中的普通词出现，后接括号、数字、句点或引号；不要求特定语义。
patterns.domain: StackExchange 技术问答、PubMed 摘要、HackerNews 讨论及论坛聊天

patterns.name: 聊天中的 hmm
patterns.context: IRC 对话中的回应词 hmm，后面可接标点或其他内容。

en.description: All segments activate on point or its compound fragments: Powerpoint, point, point-free, breakpoint, floating-point, three-point, and others. The forms that trigger are consistent despite differences in meaning and style.

patterns.name: point in compounds
patterns.context: Activation falls on point and adjacent compound fragments; includes proper nouns, common nouns, and technical terms, with inconsistent capitalization.
patterns.domain: Mixed: titles, academic papers, Q&A, and code

6_2674.description: 所有段都在 point 或其复合词片段上激活：Powerpoint、point、point-free、breakpoint、floating-point、three-point 等。虽语义和文体各异，触发形式一致。

patterns.name: 复合词中的 point
patterns.context: 激活落在 point 及与其相邻的复合词片段；涵盖专名、普通名词和技术术语，大小写不一致。
patterns.domain: 混合：标题、学术论文、问答及代码

en.description: Activation is scattered across name fragments such as Ray/Raymond, Dalio, and Ryba, as well as line breaks at title, entry, or code-block boundaries; isolated word fragments also appear in PowerPoint, Quantifying, MUDFlap, legal citations, and Python class declarations. No single stable semantic condition is apparent.

patterns.name: Ray names and entity entries
patterns.context: Activation may occur at the start of a name or within it; it also appears in the split form of “Raymond” and in title-style entries.

patterns.name: Line breaks separating titles and entries
patterns.context: Often appears at a line break before the start of a title or entry; however, not all occurrences accompany a Ray-like name.

patterns.name: PowerPoint title word
patterns.context: Appears in the title “Why designers hate PowerPoint”, with activation concentrated in the latter part of the software name.

patterns.name: Quantifying title word
patterns.context: Appears at the beginning of a title, followed by “ifying and Time Tracking”.

patterns.name: Within-word fragment in MUDFlap
patterns.context: Appears in the tool or project name “Mudﬂap: Pointer Use Checking”, with activation on a character fragment within the word.

patterns.name: Legal citation fragment
patterns.context: Appears at the start of a legal citation number after a line break, followed by a state abbreviation and a number.

patterns.name: Code exception class declaration
patterns.context: Appears in Python class declarations, parentheses, and line breaks in class bodies; also includes exception names and pass.

patterns.name: Ryba surname fragment
patterns.context: Appears in the name “John Joseph Ryba”, repeated across line breaks.

6_2674.description: 激活分散在 Ray/Raymond、Dalio、Ryba 等姓名片段，以及标题、条目或代码块的换行边界；另有 PowerPoint、Quantifying、MUDFlap、法律编号和 Python 类声明等孤立词片段。未见单一稳定语义条件。

patterns.name: Ray 姓名与实体条目
patterns.context: 激活可出现在人名开头或名字的一部分；也见于“Raymond”拆分及标题式条目。
patterns.domain: 邮件、百科全书、HackerNews 标题

patterns.name: 标题与条目分隔换行
patterns.trigger: «↵»7，部分段落连续出现两个 «↵»7 或 «↵»8
patterns.context: 常见于标题或条目内容开始前的换行；但并非所有出现都伴随 Ray 类人名。

patterns.name: PowerPoint 标题词
patterns.context: 出现在标题“Why designers hate PowerPoint”中，激活集中于软件名的后半部分。

patterns.name: Quantifying 标题词
patterns.context: 作为标题开头，后接“ifying and Time Tracking”。

patterns.name: MUDFlap 词内片段
patterns.context: 出现在“Mudﬂap: Pointer Use Checking”这一工具或项目名中，激活落在词内字符片段。

patterns.name: 法律编号片段
patterns.context: 位于换行后的法律引用编号开头，后接州名缩写及编号。

patterns.name: 代码异常类声明
patterns.context: 出现在 Python 类声明、括号及类体换行中；还包括异常名和 pass。

patterns.name: Ryba 姓氏片段
patterns.context: 出现在人物姓名“John Joseph Ryba”中，跨换行重复出现。

en.description: The most prominent reproducible cue is bg-related background-style tokens, appearing in HTML/CSS attributes and discussions; other local patterns include code line breaks and structural boundaries, formatting/decoding identifiers, program variables, legal-title typography, and table delimiters. Segment 3 cannot yet be explained by these cues.

patterns.name: HTML/CSS background properties
patterns.context: Appears in HTML/CSS attributes or discussions of styling; includes background colors in comments, background color values, framework class names, and navigation-link background images.
patterns.domain: Web development, HTML/CSS code or discussion

patterns.name: Code lines and structural boundaries
patterns.context: Structured code follows a newline in code or markup text; activation also covers some indentation and brackets.

patterns.name: Formatting/decoding interfaces in code
patterns.context: Formatting- or decoding-related identifiers appear in function or interface definitions and calls; no direct association with background properties is evident.

patterns.name: Legal-document headings and name typography
patterns.context: Centered, uppercase text for courts, regions, locations, and parties' names.

patterns.name: Table separators / column layout
patterns.context: Text tables divided into columns by vertical bars and separated by horizontal lines, containing field names and data.

patterns.name: Specific code logic identifiers
patterns.context: Result-prompt strings, variable names, and integer-loop handling in program code; insufficient evidence connects these to other trigger patterns.

6_2674.concept: 背景样式与结构化文本线索
6_2674.description: 最突出的可复现线索是 bg 背景样式相关 token，出现于 HTML/CSS 属性及讨论中；另有代码换行与结构边界、格式化/解码标识符、程序变量、法律标题排版和表格分隔符等局部模式。第3段暂无法由这些线索解释。

patterns.name: HTML/CSS背景属性
patterns.context: 出现在HTML/CSS属性或讨论样式的语境中；包括注释中的背景颜色、背景色值、框架类名及导航链接背景图。

patterns.name: 代码行与结构边界
patterns.context: 代码或标记文本中，换行后紧接结构化代码；激活还覆盖部分缩进和括号。

patterns.name: 代码中的格式化/解码接口
patterns.context: 函数或接口定义、调用中出现格式化或解码相关标识符；未见与背景属性直接关联。

patterns.name: 法律文书标题与姓名排版
patterns.context: 居中排版的大写法院、地区、地点和当事人姓名文本。

patterns.name: 表格分隔线/列布局
patterns.context: 以竖线分列并用横线分隔的文本表格，包含字段名和数据。

patterns.name: 特定代码逻辑标识符
patterns.context: 程序代码中的结果提示字符串、变量名及整数循环处理；没有充分证据与其他触发模式相连。

en.description: Strongly responds to newlines, indentation, and structural boundaries; most examples are code in different languages, accompanied by brackets, semicolons, declarations, and method calls. Also responds to email unsubscribe text and links, and explanations of hockey-stat abbreviations.

patterns.name: Newlines and code-indentation boundaries
patterns.context: Newlines, indentation, and block boundaries in code or structured text; often adjacent to the end or beginning of code lines.
patterns.domain: Software code, email text, and structured lists

patterns.name: Punctuation and delimiters in code blocks
patterns.context: Punctuation used to delimit statements, functions, or object structures in code; no fixed punctuation combination appears necessary.

patterns.name: Code statements and identifiers
patterns.context: Around code statements, declarations, or method calls; languages, identifiers, and tasks vary.

patterns.name: Email unsubscribe instructions and URLs
patterns.context: Email body instructions directing recipients to visit an unsubscribe link in a browser; «postmaster» in the URL is prominent.

patterns.name: Test and assertion code
patterns.context: A test method parses a Docker image name and performs an assertion.

patterns.name: Decoder stream implementation
patterns.context: Defines a function and creates a decoder stream based on an encoding.

patterns.name: Mobile-app click handling
patterns.context: Android-style application code in a UI click listener.

patterns.name: UI scrolling and focus callbacks
patterns.context: Scrolls to a target and sets focus in an animation callback.

patterns.name: Certificate chains and XML types
patterns.context: Constructs a list of XML chain items and retrieves a certificate by ID.

patterns.name: Grid layout and adding controls
patterns.context: Sets automatic row heights and adds a test button to a UI container.

patterns.name: No-results UI branch
patterns.context: Creates and adds a “no results” prompt when content is empty.

patterns.name: Abbreviations in hockey statistics tables
patterns.context: Table notes explain abbreviations for games, minutes, wins and losses, scoring, and other statistics.

6_2674.concept: 结构化文本边界，尤以代码为主
6_2674.description: 强烈响应换行、缩进和结构边界；多数例子是不同语言的代码，伴随括号、分号、声明及方法调用。另对邮件退订文字与链接、冰球统计缩写释义也有响应。

patterns.name: 换行与代码缩进边界
patterns.trigger: «↵»、«↵»及其后的空格或制表缩进，如 «        »、«    »
patterns.context: 代码或结构化文本中的换行、缩进和块边界；常与代码行的结束、开始相邻。
patterns.domain: 软件代码、邮件文本及结构化列表

patterns.name: 代码块标点与分隔符
patterns.context: 代码中用于界定语句、函数或对象结构的标点；未见某个固定标点组合是必要条件。

patterns.name: 代码语句与标识符
patterns.context: 代码语句、声明或方法调用周围；涉及多种语言，标识符和任务各不相同。
patterns.domain: Github 与 StackExchange 代码片段

patterns.name: 邮件退订说明与网址
patterns.trigger: «To remove yourself from this mailing list»、«point»、«browser»、«http»
patterns.context: 邮件正文中指导收件人通过浏览器访问退订链接；突出网址中的 «postmaster»。

patterns.name: 测试与断言代码
patterns.context: 测试方法中解析 Docker 镜像名称并进行断言。

patterns.name: 解码器流实现
patterns.context: 定义函数并根据编码创建解码器流。

patterns.name: 移动应用点击处理
patterns.context: 界面点击监听器中的 Android 风格应用代码。

patterns.name: 界面滚动与焦点回调
patterns.context: 动画回调中滚动到目标并设置焦点。

patterns.name: 证书链与 XML 类型
patterns.context: 构造 XML 链项目列表并按 ID 获取证书。

patterns.name: 网格布局与控件添加
patterns.context: 设置自动行高并将测试按钮加入界面容器。
patterns.domain: StackExchange UI / XAML 风格代码

patterns.name: 无结果 UI 分支
patterns.context: 内容为空时创建并添加“无结果”提示。

patterns.name: 冰球统计表缩写
patterns.context: 统计表注释逐项解释比赛、分钟、胜负及得分等缩写。

en.description: Primarily responds to HTML/XML tags, attributes, angle brackets, and newline structure in source code, especially when co-occurring with JavaScript code; other isolated triggers include table markup, type/configuration snippets, political terms, legal dates, and names.

patterns.name: Structural markup in code and markup languages
patterns.context: Code or web markup is embedded directly in text; trigger points often fall on tag boundaries, attributes, newlines, and indentation. No specific language is required.

patterns.name: JavaScript syntax and operations
patterns.context: Loops, array operations, variable assignments, and other code syntax in JavaScript examples or discussions; overlaps with the HTML-tag pattern but also occurs in code itself.

patterns.name: Angle brackets and configuration snippets in XML/HTML style
patterns.context: Angle-bracket expressions in structured configurations, type representations, or tagged content; triggers are not limited to the web and also appear in type-error messages and configuration output.
patterns.domain: Software configuration, error messages, source code

patterns.name: Table- or list-like HTML document structure
patterns.context: Repeated structures with attributes in HTML table cells and document entries.

patterns.name: Newline and indentation structure related to code
patterns.context: Source code appears on multiple lines, with newlines and whitespace adjacent to syntax markers; this is a formatting feature and cannot explain all activations on its own.
patterns.domain: Source code and embedded code text

patterns.name: Specific numbered expression in legal text
patterns.context: A legal provision describes an extension lasting until after a particular date; this numbered phrase is an isolated local trigger with no obvious source-code structure.

patterns.name: Contrasting concepts in English commentary
patterns.context: Commentary on political freedom in the United States and China; activation is concentrated on subword fragments of “tyranny”.

patterns.name: Subword fragments in proper nouns
patterns.context: The name «Junichiro» appears in markup with small-caps styling; its relation to the code pattern is unclear.
patterns.domain: Academic text or typeset proper names

6_2674.concept: 源码标记与结构化文本边界
6_2674.description: 主要响应源码中的 HTML/XML 标签、属性、尖括号及换行结构，尤其常与 JavaScript 代码共现；另有表格标记、类型/配置片段，以及政治词、法律日期和人名等孤立触发。

patterns.name: 代码与标记语言中的结构性标记
patterns.trigger: HTML/XML 片段中的 «<», «>», «</», «/>», 属性和值，以及 «↵»；包括 «<script>», «</head>», «<body>», «<span style=...>»
patterns.context: 代码或网页标记被直接嵌入文本，触发点常落在标签边界、属性、换行和缩进；不要求特定语言。

patterns.name: JavaScript 代码语法与操作
patterns.context: JavaScript 示例或讨论中出现循环、数组操作、变量赋值等代码语法；与 HTML 标签模式有重叠，但也能在代码本身出现。

patterns.name: XML/HTML 风格的尖括号与配置片段
patterns.context: 结构化配置、类型表示或标签化内容中的尖括号表达；触发不局限于网页，也见于类型错误信息和配置输出。
patterns.domain: 软件配置、错误信息、源码

patterns.name: 表格或列表型 HTML 文档结构
patterns.context: HTML 表格单元格和文档条目中带属性的重复结构。
patterns.domain: GitHub 文档或 HTML 表格

patterns.name: 代码相关的换行与缩进结构
