patterns.trigger: 多处 «↵» 后的缩进，以及代码/标记片段间的换行
patterns.context: 源码以多行形式呈现，换行和空白与语法标记相邻；本模式是格式特征，不能单独解释所有激活。
patterns.domain: 源码及嵌入式代码文本

patterns.name: 法律文本中的特定编号表达
patterns.context: 法律条文描述延期持续至某个日期之后；该编号短语是局部孤立触发，没有明显源码结构。

patterns.name: 英文论述中的对立概念
patterns.context: 关于美国与中国政治自由的评论性论述；触发集中在“tyranny”一词的分词片段。

patterns.name: 专名的分词片段
patterns.context: 人名 «Junichiro» 出现在带小型大写样式的排版标记中；与代码模式关系不明。
patterns.domain: 学术文本或排版后的专名

en.concept: Markup and code structure in formatted technical text
en.description: Activations occur broadly in formatted, multiline technical text, especially HTML/XML tags, markup boundaries, and JavaScript code structure; other local triggers include table styles, LaTeX documents, and system paths.

patterns.name: HTML/XML markup structure
patterns.context: Tag boundaries, closing tags, and nearby tag contents in embedded markup languages; several segments also contain templates or configuration text.
patterns.domain: HTML, XML, XSLT, plist, and documents containing markup

patterns.name: JavaScript code structure
patterns.context: Function bodies, conditional branches, object-member access, and statement boundaries in code; often mixed with HTML.

patterns.name: Formatted whitespace and newlines
patterns.context: Newlines followed by indentation or structurally aligned whitespace in multiline code or markup; activations are distributed across code and document snippets.
patterns.domain: Source code, markup languages, and formatted documents

patterns.name: Specific HTML table formatting
patterns.context: Height attributes and dimensions in pt units appear in inline styles for table rows.

patterns.name: LaTeX and operating-system vocabulary
patterns.context: Ordinary document prose about writing LaTeX papers on Windows; not code semantics.

patterns.name: Unix configuration path fragments
patterns.context: The /etc/sysconfig/network-scripts path and filename prefixes in template output or configuration scripts.

patterns.name: Local English words and identifiers
patterns.context: Common words, attribute names, and camelCase identifiers in markup, code, or documents; these are semantically diverse and do not form a single lexical pattern.

6_2674.concept: 格式化技术文本中的标记与代码结构
6_2674.description: 激活广泛出现在格式化的多行技术文本中，尤其是 HTML/XML 标签、标记边界与 JavaScript 代码结构；另有表格样式、LaTeX 文档和系统路径等局部触发。

patterns.name: HTML/XML 标记结构
patterns.context: 嵌入式标记语言中的标签边界、闭合标签及标签内容附近；多个片段也包含模板或配置文本。

patterns.name: JavaScript 代码结构
patterns.context: 代码中的函数体、条件分支、对象成员访问与语句边界；常与 HTML 混合。

patterns.name: 格式化空白与换行
patterns.context: 多行代码或标记文本中，换行后接缩进或结构对齐空白；激活分布在代码和文档片段中。
patterns.domain: 源代码、标记语言及格式化文档

patterns.name: 特定 HTML 表格排版
patterns.context: 表格行的内联样式中出现高度属性及以 pt 为单位的尺寸。

patterns.name: LaTeX 与操作系统词汇
patterns.context: 介绍在 Windows 上撰写 LaTeX 论文的普通文档正文；并非代码语义。

patterns.name: Unix 配置路径片段
patterns.context: 模板输出或配置脚本中的 /etc/sysconfig/network-scripts 路径及文件名前缀。

patterns.name: 局部英文词与标识符
patterns.context: 在标记、代码或文档中出现的普通词、属性名与驼峰式标识符；这些内容彼此语义不一，不能归为单一词义模式。

en.description: Activations are distributed across various code and English technical text: commonly around code identifiers, member calls, indentation, newlines, and assertions; also present in space-separated English, quoted examples, and domain, UI, patent, and solver contexts.

patterns.name: Code identifiers and member access
patterns.context: Around variables, object members, or method calls in code such as PHP; often adjacent to parentheses, commas, and semicolons.

patterns.name: Code-line structure and indentation
patterns.context: When code is presented across multiple lines, especially between indented statements, closing brackets, or chained calls.
patterns.domain: JavaScript, PHP, C++, and other code snippets

patterns.name: Logic and check calls in code
patterns.context: Conditional branches, assertions, or test checks that verify results, types, or variable states.

patterns.name: Word spacing in English phrases
patterns.context: Near space-separated word groups or function words in natural English sentences; appears in both technical explanations and patent text.

patterns.name: Literals or examples in quotation marks
patterns.context: Specific values in code strings, domain-name examples, or explanatory text marked with quotation marks.
patterns.domain: Code comments, network-configuration Q&A, table descriptions

patterns.name: UI and DOM attributes in code
patterns.context: Discussion of element attributes or cell configuration in a collection view, including direct attribute access or setting a view.

patterns.name: Specific naming and technical patent description
patterns.context: Technical statement describing the relationship between vehicle speed, acceleration, and torque.

patterns.name: Domain hierarchy and subdomain examples
patterns.context: Explains the composition of subdomains under a valid domain and contrasts invalid or incorrectly layered forms.

patterns.name: Minimum and maximum values in a math solver
patterns.context: Constructs a solver expression and checks the expected minimum and maximum values to validate the result.

6_2674.description: 激活分布于多种代码与英文技术文本：常见于代码标识符、成员调用、缩进换行和断言，也见于空格分隔的英文、引号示例及域名、UI、专利和求解器语境。

patterns.name: 代码标识符与成员访问
patterns.context: 出现在 PHP 等代码中，变量、对象成员或方法调用周围；常与括号、逗号和分号相邻。
patterns.domain: PHP/GitHub 或 StackExchange 代码片段

patterns.name: 代码行结构与缩进
patterns.trigger: 换行符 `↵`、缩进空格，以及 `});`、`});` 等行尾结构
patterns.context: 代码被按多行格式呈现时，尤其是缩进语句、闭合括号或连续调用之间。

patterns.name: 代码中的逻辑与检查调用
patterns.context: 以条件分支、断言或测试检查验证结果、类型或变量状态。

patterns.name: 英文短语中的词间空格
patterns.trigger: 如 `to be`, `that`, `in`, `you` 等前后带空格的常见词
patterns.context: 英语自然语言句子中，空格分隔的词组或功能词附近；在技术说明与专利文字中均出现。
patterns.domain: StackExchange 英文问答、专利文本

patterns.name: 引号中的字面值或示例
patterns.context: 用引号标示代码字符串、域名示例或解释性文本中的具体值。
patterns.domain: 代码注释、网络配置问答、表格说明

patterns.name: 代码中的 UI 与 DOM 属性
patterns.context: 讨论元素属性或集合视图中的单元格配置，包含直接访问属性或设置视图。

patterns.name: 特定命名与专利技术描述
patterns.context: 描述车辆速度、加速度与扭矩之间关系的技术性陈述。

patterns.name: 域名层级与子域名示例
patterns.context: 说明有效域名下子域名的组成，并对照不合法或错误层级写法。

patterns.name: 数学求解器的最小值与最大值
patterns.context: 构造求解表达式后，通过检查期望最小值和最大值来验证结果。

en.concept: Identifiers and word forms in heterogeneous text
en.description: Activations span medical values and abbreviations, drug research, VA tables/code, text revisions, URLs, EU policy, and accounts of people's positions; there is no single stable semantic pattern, and the feature may favor specific word forms, abbreviations, and identifier fragments.

patterns.name: Medical scores, ages, and statistical values
patterns.context: Medical abstracts report demographic data, scale scores, correlations, or biomarker expression; numbers, abbreviations, and statistical results are interleaved.

patterns.name: Drug targets and efficacy research
patterns.context: Describes a drug inhibiting molecular expression or evaluating clinical research objectives.

patterns.name: VA and text related to numbers and fields
patterns.context: VA appears in institution names, tables, or administrative records; code field names and accessors also occur, possibly related to abbreviation/identifier forms but in different contexts.
patterns.domain: Legal documents and Visual Basic code

patterns.name: Text edits and word comparisons
patterns.context: Describes crossing out one word in a document or letter and handwriting a replacement.

patterns.name: Web links and path fragments
patterns.context: Domains, dates, and split strings appear in links and URL paths.

patterns.name: Institutional policy and counterterrorism
patterns.context: EU policy context discussing information exchange among member states and counterterrorism cooperation.

patterns.name: Months and accounts of changing positions
patterns.context: Recounts how someone defended and then criticized an institution or issue in consecutive months.

6_2674.concept: 异质文本中的标识符与词形
6_2674.description: 激活分布跨医学数值与缩写、药物研究、VA表格/代码、文字修订、URL、欧盟政策及人物立场叙述；没有单一稳定语义，可能偏向特定词形、缩写和标识符片段。

patterns.name: 医学评分、年龄与统计数值
patterns.trigger: « Age» « mean» « 47»、« BMI»、« scale»、« correlated»、« depression»、« anxiety»、« expression»、« NC» «AM»
patterns.context: 医学摘要中报告人口统计数据、量表分数、相关性或生物标志物表达；数字、缩写和统计结果交错出现。

patterns.name: 药物靶点与疗效研究
patterns.trigger: « inter»cellular« adhesion» molecule-1、« ISIS» 2«302»、« safety»、« efficacy»
patterns.context: 介绍药物抑制分子表达或评估临床研究目标。
patterns.domain: 生物医学研究摘要/项目描述

patterns.name: VA及编号、字段相关文本
patterns.context: VA出现在机构名称、表格或行政记录中；另有代码字段名与属性访问器，可能与缩写/标识符形式相关，但语境不同。
patterns.domain: 法律文书与 Visual Basic 代码

patterns.name: 文字修改及词语对照
patterns.context: 描述文件或信件中划掉一个词并手写替换为另一个词。

patterns.name: 网页链接与路径片段
patterns.context: 链接及 URL 路径中出现域名、日期和被拆分的字符串。

patterns.name: 机构政策与反恐议题
patterns.context: 欧盟政策语境，谈成员国间信息交换及反恐合作。

patterns.name: 月份与立场转变叙述
patterns.context: 叙述某人在相邻月份对某机构或议题先辩护、后批评的变化。

en.description: Activation is scattered across split uppercase word fragments, abbreviations, and code markers; it also appears in HTML/SQL/C# code, medical abstracts, and legal documents. No clear cross-domain commonality is apparent; some high activation may be related to subword fragment boundaries or capitalization.

patterns.name: Internal uppercase fragments and abbreviations
patterns.context: Activation falls on fragments of split strings or strings with internal uppercase letters; these include abbreviations, proper nouns, and uppercase fragments within ordinary words, which do not point to a single meaning.
patterns.domain: Across medical abstracts, legal text, and database/code text

patterns.name: HTML forms and quantity fields
patterns.context: Appears in form markup containing a quantity field, especially near input fields or submit buttons.

patterns.name: HTML layout and placeholder code
patterns.context: Appears in webpage layout markup and ASP.NET/Razor-style dynamic placeholder expressions.

patterns.name: SQL updates and string processing
patterns.context: In SQL UPDATE statements, case or string processing is applied to a username column and a prefix is matched.

patterns.name: C# connections and dropdown binding
patterns.context: In code snippets, connections are closed, result text is set, or ASP.NET dropdown-list server controls appear.

patterns.name: Dispute/negation language in legal text
patterns.context: Appears in legal arguments involving relevance, contractual rights, or employment relationships; activation mainly falls on proper nouns and split word fragments, so a shared semantic trigger cannot be confirmed.

patterns.name: Abbreviations and experimental terms in medical papers
patterns.context: Medical abstracts contain scale, drug, or experimental abbreviations and nearby clinical or biomedical terms; activation within abbreviation fragments is prominent.

patterns.name: Sports player statistics narrative
patterns.context: In sentences about a player's performance after changing teams and their fantasy sports value for the season, activation is concentrated on pronouns and their subsequent abbreviated forms.
patterns.domain: Sports commentary or fantasy sports text, samples from Enron Emails

6_2674.description: 激活分散在拆分的大写词片段、缩写及代码标记上；另见 HTML/SQL/C# 代码、医学摘要和法律文书。跨领域共性不明确，部分高激活可能与词片段边界或大小写形式有关。

patterns.name: 内部大写片段与缩写
patterns.context: 激活落在被拆分或内部带大写字母的词串片段上；涉及缩写、专名及普通词中的大写片段，无法据此归为单一词义。
patterns.domain: 跨医学摘要、法律文本及数据库/代码文本

patterns.name: HTML表单与数量字段
patterns.trigger: «quantity»、«Quantity»，以及 «form»、«input»、«submit»、«form» 的 HTML 标签片段
patterns.context: 出现在包含 quantity 字段的表单标记中，尤其是输入框或提交按钮附近。

patterns.name: HTML布局与占位符代码
patterns.context: 出现在网页布局标记及 ASP.NET/Razor 风格的动态占位符表达式中。

patterns.name: SQL更新与字符串处理
patterns.context: SQL 更新语句中，围绕用户名列执行大小写或字符串处理，并匹配前缀。

patterns.name: C#连接与下拉列表绑定
patterns.context: 在代码片段中关闭连接、设置结果文本，或出现 ASP.NET 下拉列表服务器控件。

patterns.name: 法律文本中的争议/否定措辞
patterns.context: 出现在法律论述中，涉及相关性、合同权利或雇佣关系；激活主要落在专名和被拆分词片段上，不能确认这些内容有共同语义触发条件。

patterns.name: 医学论文中的缩写和实验术语
patterns.context: 医学摘要中出现量表、药物或实验缩写及其附近的临床或生物医学术语；缩写内部片段的激活较显著。

patterns.name: 体育球员统计叙述
patterns.context: 在关于球员转队后表现和赛季幻想体育价值的句子中，激活集中于代词及其后续缩写形式。
patterns.domain: 体育评论或幻想体育文字，样本来自 Enron Emails

en.description: Activations are scattered across English copula forms is/’s, internal fragments of medical words, code identifiers, bone and legal terms, and the Submit control; they also involve various function words and formatting boundaries. The segments do not show a stable, unified semantic trigger.

patterns.name: is within or adjacent to a word
patterns.context: English copula forms is or ’s, following the subject and preceding the complement; appears in different corpora and sentence structures.
patterns.domain: Legal text, forum conversations, narrative text

patterns.name: ic in English spelling fragments
patterns.context: In biomedical English, activation falls on letter fragments within words such as anaemic, microcytic, anaemia, and climacteric, near hematology or gynecological research terms.

patterns.name: Internal fragments in technical terms or code
patterns.context: Activations occur within code identifiers, abbreviations, or technical words; some are near punctuation, HTML tags, or hyphens, with no unified semantic condition evident.

patterns.name: Bone-related words
patterns.context: Statements about bone mass, bone density, and bone strength; activation falls on the word bone.

patterns.name: Submit interaction term
patterns.context: Discusses two Submit controls that trigger different actions, with jQuery/JSON code.

patterns.name: Legal damages and permanence statements
patterns.context: Discusses damages and whether harm is reparable or permanent; multiple words besides is activate.

patterns.name: Specific nouns and numbers in records
patterns.context: Veterans Affairs records, rating decisions, and PTSD treatment records; activation is distributed across words, with no clear shared trigger.

patterns.name: No stable pattern apparent
patterns.context: Biomedical discussion of HIV/FIV infection and alveolar macrophages; apart from internal fragments of technical terms, the trigger is unclear.

patterns.name: Local function words and formatting fragments
patterns.context: Scattered activations on common words, HTML/markup boundaries, and nearby newlines across multiple corpora; no confirmed shared semantic pattern.

6_2674.description: 激活分散在英语系词 is/’s、医学词内部片段、代码标识符、骨与法律术语及 Submit 控件等；也涉及多种功能词和格式边界。各段未显示稳定统一的语义触发条件。

patterns.name: 词内或紧邻位置的 is
patterns.trigger: «is»（[8] 中为 “damage “«is»5 permanent”；[6]、[10] 中激活落在 ’«s»8）
patterns.context: 英语系词形式 is 或 ’s，位于主语之后、补语之前；不同语料与句型中均出现。
patterns.domain: 法律文本、论坛对话、叙事文本

patterns.name: 英语拼写片段中的 ic
patterns.context: 生物医学英语中，激活落在 anaemic、microcytic、anaemia、climacteric 等词内部的字母片段，邻近血液学或妇科研究术语。

patterns.name: 技术名词或代码内部片段
patterns.context: 激活分布于代码标识符、缩写或技术词内部；有的位于标点、HTML 标签或连字符附近，未见统一的语义条件。

patterns.name: 骨相关词语
patterns.context: 骨量、骨密度与骨强度相关表述；激活落在 bone 词上。

patterns.name: Submit 交互词
patterns.context: 讨论两个 Submit 控件分别触发不同操作，并附 jQuery/JSON 代码。

patterns.name: 法律损害与永久性表述
patterns.context: 讨论损害赔偿及损害是否可修复、是否永久；除 is 外多个词均有激活。

patterns.name: 记录中的特定名词与数字
patterns.context: 退伍军人事务记录、评级决定与 PTSD 治疗记录语境；激活词分散，未见明确共同触发条件。

patterns.name: 未显现稳定模式
patterns.context: 关于 HIV/FIV 感染及肺泡巨噬细胞的生物医学论述；除技术词内部片段外，触发条件不清楚。

patterns.name: 局部功能词与格式碎片
patterns.trigger: « HS»、« and»、« with»、« to»、« the»、« he» 等
patterns.context: 多种语料中零散激活于常见词、HTML/标记边界及换行附近，未形成可确认的共同语义模式。

en.concept: local word forms and code-fragment triggers
en.description: The most prominent pattern is he's (usually a contraction of is) and is in conditional clauses; there are also local triggers such as SQL column names, string splitting, URL fragments, code field names, and medical morphemes. Some passages cannot be explained by a single semantic pattern.

patterns.name: Contracted is after a third-person singular subject
patterns.context: Activation mainly falls on 's in he's, followed by verbs or adjectives such as visiting, averaging, and interested, indicating is.

patterns.name: is in conditional clauses
patterns.context: In if-clauses, is follows the subject; paragraph 4 focuses on quoted “is”, while paragraph 6 has is after anemia.

patterns.name: Column in SQL identifiers
patterns.context: In SQL UPDATE statements, the column name username_column is split into tokens; activation is concentrated around the parts before and after the underscore, especially _ .

patterns.name: URL path fragments
patterns.context: A slash-separated alt directory or fragment appears in a URL path; activation falls on path text such as ref and alt.

patterns.name: Hypertext field identifier
patterns.context: JavaScript uses getElementById to query a numbered field element; activation is concentrated between field and the number.

patterns.name: Accounts string split across words
patterns.context: In SQL string constants, Accounts is split into multiple tokens and appears with functions such as LOWER and SUBSTRING and a LIKE condition.

patterns.name: Anemia morpheme in medical words
patterns.context: In medical abstracts discussing HS patients and chronic inflammation-related diseases, activation falls on the word segment anaemia.

patterns.name: Leprosy morpheme in medical words
patterns.context: In an abstract describing skin pigmentation in patients with leprosy, activation falls on the word segment leprosy.

patterns.name: Unclear in-sentence or punctuation trigger
patterns.context: Although paragraph 10 contains he’s, activation is more prominent on adjacent words such as Cyr­sby and move forward; this does not fully match the he’s pattern in the first three paragraphs.

6_2674.concept: 局部词形与代码片段触发
6_2674.description: 最显著模式是 he's（多为 is 缩写）及条件句中的 is；另有SQL列名、字符串拆分、URL片段、代码字段名，以及医学词素等局部触发，部分段落无法由单一语义模式解释。

patterns.name: 第三人称单数主语后的缩写 is
patterns.context: 激活主要落在 he's 中的 's；其后接 visiting、averaging、interested 等动词或形容词，表示 is。

patterns.name: 条件句中的 is
patterns.context: 在 if 条件从句中，is 位于主语之后；第4段重点落在引号内的 “is”，第6段则是 anemia 后的 is。

patterns.name: SQL 标识符中的列
patterns.context: SQL 更新语句中，列名 username_column 被拆分标记；激活集中在下划线前后的部分，尤其是 _。
patterns.domain: StackExchange 技术问答、SQL 代码

patterns.name: URL 路径片段
patterns.context: 网址路径中出现斜杠分隔的 alt 目录或片段，激活落在 ref、alt 等路径文本上。

patterns.name: 超文本字段标识符
patterns.context: JavaScript 通过 getElementById 查询带编号的 field 元素，激活集中在 field 与数字之间。
patterns.domain: StackExchange 技术问答、JavaScript 代码

patterns.name: 跨词拆分的 Accounts 字符串
patterns.context: SQL 字符串常量中 Accounts 被分成多个 token，并与 LOWER、SUBSTRING 等函数及 LIKE 条件同现。
patterns.domain: StackExchange 技术问答、SQL 代码

patterns.name: 医学词中的贫血词素
patterns.context: 在讨论 HS 患者及慢性炎症相关疾病的医学摘要中，激活落在 anaemia 的词段上。

patterns.name: 医学词中的 leprosy 词素
patterns.context: 在描述麻风病患者皮损色素沉着的摘要中，激活落在 leprosy 的词段上。

patterns.name: 不明句内或标点触发
patterns.trigger: “he’s better equipped”中的 “’s”，以及“he’s likely going”中的 “’s”之外的邻接上下文
patterns.context: 第10段虽有 he’s，但激活更显著地落在 Cyr­sby 及 move forward 等相邻词上；与前三段的 he’s 模式不完全吻合。

en.concept: Mixed code and text subword fragments
en.description: Activations are most concentrated in tables, forms, and SQL phrases in web and database code; they also occur sporadically in legal contracts, economic and medical reporting, sports commentary, and personal narratives, and are difficult to explain through a single meaning.

patterns.name: table / table-related strings in code
patterns.context: Appears in program code or HTML/JavaScript snippets, often near table controls, database tables, or selectors; not all code segments contain it.
patterns.domain: StackExchange technical Q&A, SQL, JavaScript, HTML

patterns.name: Form controls and input-field code
patterns.context: Near HTML form input fields and their attributes, IDs, and placeholders; activation spans tags and attribute values.

patterns.name: SQL queries and database identifiers
patterns.context: In SQL statements or query strings embedded in programs; identifiers, keywords, and string literals may all trigger.

patterns.name: Proper nouns and contract wording in legal text
patterns.context: Sentences describing a company obtaining a particular status under a law and entering into a service contract; proper nouns, dates, and contract-related words activate strongly.
patterns.domain: FreeLaw legal judgments or legal documents

patterns.name: Personal pronouns and abbreviated forms
patterns.context: Personal pronouns or abbreviations marked as subword fragments in ordinary narrative sentences; no stable topic or lexical condition can be confirmed from the samples.
patterns.domain: Pile-CC web text, sports commentary, and personal blogs

patterns.name: Economic-statistics narratives
patterns.context: Appears when comparing economic performance across countries or regions and reporting indicators such as unemployment rates; whether it shares a cause with other ordinary narrative activations is unclear.

patterns.name: Anemia terms and values in medical research
patterns.context: Activates when an abstract compares study and control groups and reports the proportions of anemia types or explains them.

patterns.name: Sports commentary wording in non-code narratives
patterns.context: Discusses someone's ability to cope when performing poorly, with direct quotations; no obvious common trigger with the code or legal patterns.

6_2674.concept: 混合的代码与文本词片段
6_2674.description: 激活最集中于网页与数据库代码中的表格、表单和SQL词句；此外零散见于法律合同、经济与医学报道、体育评论及人称叙述，难以由单一词义解释。

patterns.name: 代码中的 table / 表格相关字符串
patterns.context: 出现在程序代码或 HTML/JavaScript 片段中，常与表格控件、数据库表或选择器相邻；并非所有代码段都出现。

patterns.name: 表单控件与输入框代码
patterns.context: HTML 表单输入框及其属性、ID、占位符附近；激活跨越标签和属性值。

patterns.name: SQL 查询与数据库标识符
patterns.context: SQL 语句或嵌入程序的查询字符串中；标识符、关键字和字符串字面量均可能触发。
patterns.domain: StackExchange 数据库与编程问答

patterns.name: 法律文本中的专名与合同措辞
patterns.context: 叙述企业依据法规取得某种身份并订立服务合同的句子；专名、日期及合同相关词有较强激活。
patterns.domain: FreeLaw 法律判决或法律文书

patterns.name: 人称代词与缩写形式
patterns.context: 普通叙述句中，人称代词或缩写被分词标记；没有稳定的主题或词义条件可从样本确认。
patterns.domain: Pile-CC 网页文本，体育评论与个人博客

patterns.name: 经济统计叙述
patterns.context: 比较国家或地区经济表现，并报告失业率等指标时出现；与其他普通叙述激活是否同因不明。

patterns.name: 医学研究中的贫血术语与数值
patterns.context: 摘要报告研究组与对照组比较，并给出贫血类型比例或解释时激活。

patterns.name: 非代码叙述中的体育评论措辞
patterns.context: 讨论某人表现不佳时的应对能力，夹有直接引语；与代码、法律等模式无明显共同触发词。

en.description: Activation mainly falls on disease or research-topic terms in medical text (leprosy, stroke/brain injury, metabolic syndrome); it also responds to institutional abbreviations and denial of mental illness in legal text, and to form identifiers and quantity fields in code. No single stable semantic pattern is apparent.

patterns.name: Stroke-related words
patterns.context: In descriptions of rehabilitation, neurological function, family impact, brain injury, or related study populations; trigger words vary across contexts

patterns.name: Leprosy and related words
patterns.context: When describing leprosy lesions, patients, or immune responses

patterns.name: Metabolic syndrome abbreviation
patterns.context: When studying associations between metabolic syndrome and physical function or inflammation

patterns.name: Statutory agency abbreviations
patterns.context: Appears in legal narratives about federal savings and loan associations and deposit insurance institutions

patterns.name: Legal statement denying mental illness
patterns.context: A party states that they are not a person with schizophrenia

patterns.name: Form markup
patterns.context: Near field and form identifiers in HTML/Wicket form code

patterns.name: Quantity field label
patterns.context: Near a form input and its submit button, denoting a quantity field

patterns.name: Unclear word fragment
patterns.context: Appears within the abbreviation “MetS”; it is difficult to determine whether this fragment triggers independently

6_2674.description: 激活主要落在医学文本中的疾病或研究主题词（麻风、卒中/脑损伤、代谢综合征），也响应法律文本中的机构缩写与精神疾病否认，以及代码中的表单标识和数量字段；未见单一稳定语义模式。

patterns.name: 脑卒中相关词语
patterns.context: 在描述康复、神经功能、家庭影响、脑损伤或相关研究对象时；触发词在不同上下文中出现

patterns.name: 麻风及相关词语
patterns.context: 描述麻风病变、患者或免疫反应时
patterns.domain: 医学摘要、免疫学研究计划

patterns.name: 代谢综合征缩写
patterns.context: 研究代谢综合征与身体功能、炎症的关联时

patterns.name: 法定机构缩写
patterns.context: 出现在联邦储蓄贷款协会及存款保险机构的法律叙述中

patterns.name: 否认精神疾病的法律陈述
patterns.context: 当事人陈述自己并非精神分裂症患者

patterns.name: 表单标记
patterns.context: HTML/Wicket 表单代码中，字段与表单标识符附近

patterns.name: 数量字段标签
patterns.context: 表单输入框及其提交按钮附近，表示数量字段

patterns.name: 不明词片段
patterns.context: 出现在“MetS”缩写内部，难以判断该片段是否独立触发

en.concept: Local patterns at word endings and code boundaries
en.description: Activation is not a single semantic feature: medical passages often involve word endings or subword fragments containing s, while programming passages focus on HTML/ASP.NET attribute markers. There are also sporadic triggers in legal citations and philosophical uses of to; overall, the pattern is cross-domain and heterogeneous.

patterns.name: s at the end of a word or subword
patterns.context: Activation often falls on a final s or a subword fragment containing s; word forms and meanings vary widely, including plurals, proper nouns, abbreviations, and common words.

patterns.name: HTML attribute assignment symbols
patterns.context: In code snippets, activation clusters around quotation marks, equals signs, and attribute-value boundaries near HTML tags and attributes.

patterns.name: ASP.NET control markup
patterns.context: In ASP.NET dropdown-list tags and their attributes; similar to markup-symbol patterns in other web code snippets.

patterns.name: Numbers and legal citation formatting
patterns.context: Near legal citations and section numbers; the strongest activation falls on the common preposition «to», rather than on consistent legal terminology.

patterns.name: Infinitive marker in philosophical writing
patterns.context: In the structure “«to» that extent,” where to precedes a demonstrative; activation is strong but differs from the clear patterns in code and medical samples.

6_2674.concept: 词尾/代码边界局部模式
6_2674.description: 激活并非单一语义特征：医学段落多落在词尾或含 s 的子词片段；编程段落集中于 HTML/ASP.NET 属性标记。另有法律引文与哲学中的 to 等零散触发，整体跨领域且异质。

patterns.name: 单词或子词末尾的 s
patterns.context: 激活常落在词尾 s 或包含 s 的子词片段；词形和语义差异很大，既见于复数，也见于专名、缩写或普通词。

patterns.name: HTML 属性赋值符号
patterns.context: 代码片段中的 HTML 标签及属性赋值附近，激活集中在引号、等号和属性值边界。

patterns.name: ASP.NET 控件标记
patterns.context: ASP.NET 下拉列表标签及其属性中；与其他网页代码片段的标记符号模式相近。

patterns.name: 数字与法律条文格式
patterns.context: 法律引文和条文编号附近；其中最强激活落在普通介词 «to»，而非一致的法律术语。

patterns.name: 哲学论述中的不定式标记
patterns.context: “«to» that extent”结构中，to 后接指示词；激活强，但与代码及医学样本的明显模式不同。

en.description: Activation spans many unrelated types of content: within-word IC in book titles, code structure symbols and keywords, search parameters, philosophical arguments, Portuguese web code, legal accident testimony, source-header comments, and enzyme abstracts. No clear semantic theme runs across the passages.

patterns.name: Within-word IC in historical spelling
patterns.context: An English word in an uppercase title, with activation concentrated on the letter sequence IC within the word, especially the IC in HISTORIC; not all within-word IC occurrences are equally strong.
patterns.domain: Gutenberg book titles and front matter

patterns.name: Structural delimiters in code
patterns.context: In code, markup, or queries, delimiters and keywords occur within function calls, HTML attributes, or SQL conditional structures.
patterns.domain: StackExchange technical Q&A and code snippets

patterns.name: English search parameters and expansions
patterns.context: When discussing search processes, resolution and search width are compared; mathematical symbols and fixed parameter conditions are common.

patterns.name: Arguments about self-respect and justice
patterns.context: A philosophical argument introduces an author's view and conclusion about whether arrangements of justice secure citizens' self-respect.

patterns.name: Object embedding in Portuguese web code
patterns.context: After a Portuguese question describes access methods such as AJAX, it provides jQuery/HTML code embedding a login page.

patterns.name: Traffic accident and alcohol testimony
patterns.context: A case narrative records whether the parties to an accident were under the influence of alcohol and includes police testimony, then describes a witness's or defendant's actions.

patterns.name: Autogenerated markers and license
patterns.context: License declarations and autogenerated notices at the top of source files.

patterns.name: Antibodies and CYP enzyme activity
patterns.context: Experimental results describe antibody inhibition of metabolite formation and use this to infer CYP enzyme involvement in hydroxylation.

6_2674.description: 激活覆盖多种互不相同的内容：书名中的词内 IC、代码结构符号与关键字，以及搜索参数、哲学论证、葡语网页代码、法律事故证词、源码头注释和酶学摘要；没有贯穿各段的明确语义主题。

patterns.name: 历史拼写中的词内 IC
patterns.context: 大写标题中的英文词，激活集中在词内字母串 IC，尤其是 HISTORIC 的 IC；并非所有词内 IC 都同样强。
patterns.domain: Gutenberg 书籍标题与前置页

patterns.name: 代码中的结构分隔符
patterns.context: 代码、标记语言或查询语句中，分隔符及关键字处于函数调用、HTML 属性或 SQL 条件结构中。
patterns.domain: StackExchange 技术问答及代码片段

patterns.name: 英文搜索参数与扩展
patterns.context: 讨论搜索过程时，对比分辨率和搜索宽度的变化，常见数学符号及固定参数条件。

patterns.name: 自尊与正义论述
patterns.context: 哲学论证中，介绍某作者关于正义安排是否保障公民自尊的观点与结论。

patterns.name: 葡语网页代码中的对象嵌入
patterns.context: 葡萄牙语提问叙述 AJAX 等访问方式后，给出 jQuery/HTML 代码嵌入登录页面。

patterns.name: 交通事故与酒精证词
patterns.context: 案件叙述中记录事故当事人是否受酒精影响及警方证词，随后叙述证人或被告行动。

patterns.name: 自动生成标记与许可证
patterns.context: 源代码文件头部的许可证声明和自动生成说明。

patterns.name: 抗体与 CYP 酶活性
patterns.context: 实验结果描述抗体抑制代谢产物形成，并据此推断 CYP 酶参与羟化过程。

en.concept: Local tokens in cross-domain text and code
en.description: Responses are scattered across mathematical symbols and their English connective text, as well as medical and public-health reports and code snippets. Triggering content varies considerably by domain, with no single stable theme apparent.

patterns.name: Mathematical formulas and symbolic derivations
patterns.context: Formulas and adjacent explanatory text in ArXiv mathematics or physics passages; variables alone are insufficient to characterize all passages.

patterns.name: English function words connecting to formulas
patterns.context: In continuous English text, especially next to formulas or variable definitions; these words also occur outside formula contexts and cannot alone explain all activation.
patterns.domain: Academic papers and general English prose

patterns.name: Medical, brain-function, and rehabilitation vocabulary
patterns.context: When discussing central nervous system function, learning, or rehabilitation improvements in people with cerebral palsy.

patterns.name: Project feedback, management, and public-health terminology
patterns.context: In reports describing regular national-level feedback, system development, and polio legacy work.

patterns.name: Code generation and license comments
patterns.context: Header comments in Github source files indicating that the file was automatically generated; the snippet also contains an Apache-2.0 license identifier.

patterns.name: Category selection interface in a PHP template
patterns.context: PHP/HTML code that sets a category list and outputs a dropdown selection box.

patterns.name: User editing and updating in a Ruby controller
patterns.context: Ruby-style controller methods that find a user from the session and handle update parameters.

patterns.name: Domain-specific proper nouns not belonging to a single semantic theme
patterns.context: Embedded in local contexts from different domains, with no shared proper noun or thematic trigger; retained as a sporadic lexical phenomenon.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain proper nouns, appearing in software, public health, and physics

6_2674.concept: 跨领域文本与代码中的局部词符
6_2674.description: 响应分散于公式符号及其英语衔接语，也出现在医学、公共卫生报告和代码片段。各领域触发内容差异很大，未见单一稳定主题。

patterns.name: 数学公式与符号化推导
patterns.trigger: «F»、«U»、«V»、«q»、«B»、«delta»、«epsilon»、«sigma»，以及公式中的变量、上下标和括号
patterns.context: ArXiv 数学或物理文本中，公式及其邻接的解释性文字；仅有变量并不足以概括各段内容
patterns.domain: 学术论文（数学、物理、搜索算法）

patterns.name: 英语功能词与公式衔接
patterns.context: 英语连续文本中，尤其紧邻公式或变量定义时；这些词也出现在非公式语境，不能单独解释全部激活
patterns.domain: 学术论文及一般英语散文

patterns.name: 医学及脑功能、康复词汇
patterns.context: 讨论脑瘫患者中枢神经系统功能、学习或康复改善时

patterns.name: 项目反馈与管理、公共卫生术语
patterns.context: 描述国家层面的定期反馈、系统建设及脊灰遗留工作的报告语境

patterns.name: 代码生成与许可证注释
patterns.context: Github 源码文件的头部注释，标明文件由工具自动生成；片段还含 Apache-2.0 许可证标识

patterns.name: PHP 模板中的类别选择界面
patterns.context: PHP/HTML 代码中设置类别列表并输出下拉选择框

patterns.name: Ruby 控制器的用户编辑与更新
patterns.context: Ruby 风格控制器方法中从 session 查找用户并处理更新参数

patterns.name: 无法归入单一语义主题的领域专名
patterns.context: 各自嵌在不同领域的局部语境中，没有共同的专名或主题触发条件；保留为零散词汇现象
patterns.domain: 跨领域专名，分别见软件、公共卫生及物理

en.concept: attribute and value binding in code
en.description: Activation is concentrated mainly on attribute assignments, model binding, and form controls in HTML/template code; it also appears on Vue list keys, Rails submit buttons, the SQL identity-value function, and the word form follow in English project descriptions.

patterns.name: id attribute assignment in HTML/templates
patterns.context: An id is assigned to an element in an HTML tag; the value may be a static string or dynamically concatenated content from a PHP/Ruby or other template. High activation points are often around the quotation mark or value after `id`.
patterns.domain: Web development code and technical Q&A

patterns.name: AngularJS form control binding
patterns.context: An AngularJS directive binds a model on an HTML form element such as `<select>`; the attribute value is a dot-separated data path.

patterns.name: Submit button tag in templates
patterns.context: A Rails-style template uses a form builder to generate a submit button, near an edit-page form.

patterns.name: Dynamic list key in Vue templates
patterns.context: A Vue template iterates over a collection with `v-for` and binds the list-item index as the key.

patterns.name: Tracking or following (follow)
patterns.context: Ordinary English prose describes tracking or following a process in a study or project; the word form appears in a sentence rather than as a code attribute.
patterns.domain: Biomedical abstracts and public health project descriptions

patterns.name: Identity-value function for database connections
patterns.context: Discusses retrieving the primary key value most recently generated by a statement in SQL Server and comparing it with `@@Identity`.

6_2674.concept: 代码中的属性与值绑定
6_2674.description: 激活主要集中于 HTML/模板代码中的属性赋值、模型绑定和表单控件；另有 Vue 列表键、Rails 提交按钮、SQL 身份值函数，以及英文项目叙述中的 follow 词形。

patterns.name: HTML/模板中的 id 属性赋值
patterns.trigger: `id="`，尤其是后接变量、控件名或编号
patterns.context: 在 HTML 标签属性中给元素设置 id，值可能是静态字符串或 PHP/Ruby 等模板动态拼接的内容；高激活点多在 `id` 后的引号或值附近。
patterns.domain: 网页开发代码与技术问答

patterns.name: AngularJS 绑定表单控件
patterns.context: HTML 的 `<select>` 等表单元素上，以 AngularJS 指令绑定模型；属性值是点分隔的数据路径。

patterns.name: 模板中的提交按钮标签
patterns.context: Rails 风格模板中用表单构建器生成提交按钮，位于编辑页面表单附近。

patterns.name: Vue 模板中的动态列表键
patterns.context: Vue 模板通过 `v-for` 遍历集合，并将列表项索引绑定为 key。

patterns.name: 跟踪或遵循（follow）
patterns.context: 普通英文叙述中描述研究或项目中的跟踪、遵循流程；词形出现在句子中，而非代码属性。
patterns.domain: 生物医学摘要与公共卫生项目说明

patterns.name: 数据库连接的身份值函数
patterns.context: 讨论 SQL Server 中获取最近语句生成的主键值，并与 `@@Identity` 作比较。

en.description: Primarily responds to syntactic structures in code snippets, object or instance-variable access, and method definitions and calls. There are also sporadic activations in template attributes, code identifiers, discussions, medical statistics, and legal citations, which cannot be grouped into one specific trigger pattern.

patterns.name: Code identifiers and structural symbols
patterns.context: Appears in program code or snippets, especially near method definitions, calls, assignments, and control structures; activation often falls on these syntax symbols or adjacent identifiers.
patterns.domain: Programming Q&A and code (Ruby, PHP, HTML/Vue, etc.)

patterns.name: Ruby instance variables and method definitions
patterns.context: In Ruby/Rails code, defining methods or referencing instance variables, often alongside calls such as `User.find` and `Interest.new`.

patterns.name: PHP object/form-processing syntax
patterns.context: In PHP code, accessing methods through object properties and performing form validation, entity persistence, or controller workflows.

patterns.name: Template attributes and loop syntax
patterns.context: Attributes and loop directives inside HTML/Vue template tags.

patterns.name: Prominent specific interfaces/identifiers in code
patterns.context: Interface names, method names, or domain identifiers in PHP/HTML snippets; may be local instances of a code-syntax pattern.

patterns.name: Specific words in discussion workflows
patterns.context: In ordinary English sentences describing conditions after following guidelines; no clear link to surrounding code patterns.

patterns.name: Medical statistical result statements
patterns.context: Medical abstract sentences reporting values, means, and percentage changes.

patterns.name: Legal documents and dates/identifiers
patterns.context: Formal legal descriptions citing correspondence, dates, and exhibit numbers.

6_2674.description: 主要对代码片段中的语法结构、对象/实例变量访问、方法定义与调用等产生响应；另有模板属性、代码标识符，以及讨论、医学统计和法律引文中的零散激活，不能归为同一具体触发模式。

patterns.name: 代码标识符及结构符号
patterns.context: 出现在程序代码或代码片段中，尤其是方法定义、调用、赋值和控制结构附近；激活常落在这些语法符号或相邻标识符上
patterns.domain: 编程问答与代码（Ruby、PHP、HTML/Vue 等）

patterns.name: Ruby 实例变量与方法定义
patterns.context: Ruby/Rails 代码中，定义方法或引用实例变量，常伴随 `User.find`、`Interest.new` 等调用

patterns.name: PHP 对象/表单处理语法
patterns.context: PHP 代码中通过对象属性访问方法，执行表单校验、实体持久化或控制器流程

patterns.name: 模板属性与循环语法
patterns.context: HTML/Vue 模板标签内的属性及循环指令

patterns.name: 代码中醒目的特定接口/标识符
patterns.context: PHP/HTML 片段中的接口名、方法名或领域标识符；可能只是代码语法模式的局部实例

patterns.name: 讨论流程中的特定词语
patterns.context: 普通英语句子中描述遵守 guidelines 后的条件；与周边代码模式无明显联系

patterns.name: 医学统计结果陈述
patterns.context: 报告数值、均值及百分比变化的医学摘要语句

patterns.name: 法律文件与日期/编号
patterns.context: 正式法律叙述中引用照会、日期和证物编号

en.description: Primarily responds to PHP/HTML/JavaScript code and syntax, indentation, and punctuation in templates; it also responds to legal exhibit numbers, numerical units in medical and astronomy text, and sample and figure narratives in materials papers.

patterns.name: PHP/HTML code and template syntax
patterns.context: PHP variables, method calls, class definitions, require statements, and templates mixing PHP with HTML/JavaScript; activation often falls around code indentation, punctuation, identifiers, and keywords.
patterns.domain: Software development code, mainly PHP, HTML, and JavaScript; Github or StackExchange code snippets

patterns.name: Numerical and unit expressions
patterns.context: Quantitative statements consisting of numbers, percentages, measurement units, or mathematical symbols; they occur in research results and parameter definitions, respectively.
patterns.domain: PubMed medical abstracts, ArXiv academic papers

patterns.name: Citations and numbering in legal documents
patterns.context: Legal records listing document and exhibit numbers, with formal document names and dates nearby.

patterns.name: Research materials and figure references
patterns.context: Discusses samples, experimental materials, and their parameters, with results cited by figure number; unlike ordinary numerical expressions, this is materials-science paper narrative.

6_2674.concept: 代码与结构化技术文本
6_2674.description: 主要响应 PHP/HTML/JavaScript 代码及模板中的语法、缩进和标点；也响应法律证物编号、医学和天文学的数值单位表达，以及材料论文中的样品与图表叙述。

patterns.name: PHP/HTML 代码与模板语法
patterns.context: PHP 变量、方法调用、类定义、require 语句，以及 PHP 与 HTML/JavaScript 混合模板；激活常落在代码缩进、标点、标识符和关键字周边。
patterns.domain: 软件开发代码，主要是 PHP、HTML、JavaScript；Github 或 StackExchange 代码片段

patterns.name: 数值与单位表达
patterns.context: 数值、百分比、测量单位或数学符号组成的定量陈述；分别处于研究结果和参数定义中。
patterns.domain: PubMed 医学摘要、ArXiv 学术论文

patterns.name: 法律文书中的引用与编号
patterns.context: 法律记录中列举文件编号及证物编号，周围出现正式文书名称和日期。

patterns.name: 科研材料与图表引用
patterns.context: 讨论样品、实验材料及其参数，并以图号引用结果；与普通数值表达不同，是材料科学论文叙述。

en.description: Activation is distributed across several types of code punctuation, idiomatic PHP statements, and number-related wording in legal and medical texts. Some code snippets have specific syntax or callback patterns, but there is no unified cross-domain semantic trigger.

patterns.name: PHP session startup
patterns.context: Directly calling a session startup function in PHP code, often with indentation and a statement terminator.

patterns.name: PHP file inclusion
patterns.context: Locating and including files in PHP source code using the current-directory constant; the path may be concatenated further.

patterns.name: PHP file-content test
patterns.context: Test code reading file contents from a relative resources path.

patterns.name: Code identifiers and syntax boundaries
patterns.context: Near variables, member access, function calls, and structural boundaries in code; triggers are scattered, with no single semantic condition apparent.

patterns.name: Numbers and letters in legal citations
patterns.context: Numbers and alphanumeric strings near dates, exhibit numbers, statutes, or case names in legal documents.

patterns.name: Significance and statistical results
patterns.context: When abstracts report changes in measurements, significance wording is adjacent to values, percentages, or units.

patterns.name: Ruby permission-check structure
patterns.context: An authorization method in a model definition, using nested unless checks for the current user and a private attribute.

patterns.name: AngularJS request error callback
patterns.context: An error-handling callback defined after a successful HTTP request callback in frontend code.

patterns.name: JavaScript click handling and this properties
patterns.context: Example code first presents the this keyword, then accesses an object or element property in a click-event callback.

6_2674.description: 激活分布于多类代码标点、PHP惯用语句及法律和医学文本中的编号、数值措辞；部分代码片段有具体语法或回调模式，但跨领域未见统一语义触发。

patterns.name: PHP会话启动
patterns.context: PHP 代码中直接调用会话启动函数，常伴随缩进和语句结束符

patterns.name: PHP文件引入
patterns.context: PHP 源码中通过当前目录常量定位并引入文件，路径可能继续拼接

patterns.name: PHP文件内容测试
patterns.context: 测试代码读取相对 resources 路径的文件内容

patterns.name: 代码标识符与语法边界
patterns.context: 代码上下文中变量、成员访问、函数调用及结构边界附近；触发分散，未显示单一语义条件

patterns.name: 法律引文中的编号与字母
patterns.context: 法律文书中日期、证物编号、法条或案名附近出现的数字和字母数字串

patterns.name: 显著性与统计数值结果
patterns.context: 摘要报告测量结果变化时，显著性措辞与数值、百分比或单位相邻

patterns.name: Ruby权限判断结构
patterns.context: 模型定义中的权限控制方法，以嵌套 unless 检查当前用户与私有属性

patterns.name: AngularJS请求错误回调
patterns.context: 前端代码中 HTTP 请求成功回调之后定义错误处理回调

patterns.name: JavaScript点击处理与this属性
patterns.context: 示例代码先展示 this 关键字，再在点击事件回调中访问对象或元素属性

en.description: Activation spans legal, code, genetics, biomedical, and materials science text, with no stable single semantic theme. Code passages are common, but activation falls on varied syntax, identifiers, and boundaries; other passages each show domain-specific triggers.

patterns.name: Structural boundaries in PHP code
patterns.context: Near PHP tags, statements, and mixed HTML/PHP code; common in examples, debugging, or web implementation questions.

patterns.name: Code syntax and identifier fragments
patterns.context: PHP, JavaScript, or ORM code contains member access, method names, keywords, or strings; trigger points are not consistent.

patterns.name: Numbers and mutation markers
patterns.context: Variant coordinates, nucleotide substitutions, or repeat markers in genotype tables.

patterns.name: Disease outcome description
patterns.context: Describes changes in disease scores and the proportion of non-responders after animals receive a therapeutic diet.

patterns.name: Suffixes and punctuation in legal citations
patterns.context: When legal documents cite diplomatic notes, dates, and exhibit numbers, activation falls on word endings, numbers, and quotation markers.

patterns.name: Materials science terms and figure references
patterns.context: Discusses strontium-substituted compounds, europium concentrations, and lattice constants, and cites figures.

6_2674.description: 激活分布跨法律、代码、遗传学、生物医学和材料科学文本；没有稳定的单一语义主题。代码段较多，激活却落在多种语法、标识符和边界上，其余段各呈领域特异触发。

patterns.name: PHP 代码中的结构边界
patterns.context: PHP 标签、语句及 HTML/PHP 混合代码附近；常见于示例、调试或网页实现问题。

patterns.name: 代码语法与标识符片段
patterns.context: PHP、JavaScript 或 ORM 代码中，包含成员访问、方法名、关键字或字符串；触发点并不统一。

patterns.name: 数字与变异标记
patterns.context: 基因型表格中的变异坐标、核苷酸替换或重复标记。

patterns.name: 疾病结果描述
patterns.context: 描述动物接受治疗性饮食后疾病评分变化及无响应比例。

patterns.name: 法务引文中的尾缀与标点
patterns.context: 法律文书引述外交照会、日期及证物编号时，激活落在词尾、数字和引文标记上。

patterns.name: 材料科学术语与图表引用
patterns.context: 讨论锶取代化合物、铕浓度及晶格常数，并引用图表。

en.description: Activation is scattered across PHP identifiers/path constants and rules, clauses, page numbers, and exhibit numbers in legal texts; it also appears on subscripts, variables, and dimensional symbols in theoretical physics formulas. The commonality is structured identifiers and numbering rather than a single semantic theme.

patterns.name: PHP constant suffixes and path separators
patterns.context: In PHP code, a require_once expression for loading files, especially when concatenating __DIR__ and DIRECTORY_SEPARATOR to form a path; activation falls on subword fragments of these identifiers.

patterns.name: Case citations in appellate rulings
patterns.context: A circuit rule citation immediately after a court ruling announces dismissal of an appeal or an attorney's withdrawal; activation clusters on the rule number and punctuation.

patterns.name: Legal document numbers and citation digits
patterns.context: A statement of facts cites an exhibit or record page; digits and hyphens form a page range, near a description of a medical event.
patterns.domain: FreeLaw / findings of fact and exhibit citations

patterns.name: Numbers and hyphens in legal rule citations
patterns.context: References to the Federal Rules of Appellate Procedure and circuit rules when explaining that a case does not require oral argument; activation mainly falls on hyphens and digits in rule numbers.

patterns.name: Exhibit numbers in legal citations
patterns.context: Document numbers, exhibit letters, and identifiers appear in descriptions of diplomatic notes and exhibits; activation favors numbers and alphanumeric combinations.
patterns.domain: FreeLaw / evidence and diplomatic document descriptions

patterns.name: Sentencing-guideline clause citations
patterns.context: Discusses the number of illegal immigrants as an aggravating factor and cites sections, notes, and years in the United States Sentencing Guidelines.

patterns.name: Paragraph numbers in legal documents
patterns.context: After the parties agree to a settlement, a ruling determines compensation under a specific paragraph of the settlement terms; activation falls near the paragraph number.

patterns.name: Subscripts and dimensional symbols in mathematical formulas
patterns.context: After a physics formula, text explains the strong coupling constant and spacetime dimensions; activation clusters on variables, subscripts, and numeric symbols.

patterns.name: PHP parameter-checking function identifiers
patterns.context: A PHP method checks whether a parameter name is an integer and retrieves a value from the parameter array; activation falls on fragments of camel-case identifiers and underscore-separated function names.
patterns.domain: GitHub / PHP source code and documentation comments

6_2674.description: 激活分散在 PHP 标识符/路径常量，以及法律文本中的规则、条款、页码和展品编号；另见理论物理公式的下标、变量与维数符号。共同点偏向结构化标识符和编号，而非单一语义主题。

patterns.name: PHP 常量名尾部与路径分隔符
patterns.context: PHP 代码中加载文件的 require_once 表达式，尤其是 __DIR__ 与 DIRECTORY_SEPARATOR 拼接路径时；激活落在这些标识符的子词片段上。

patterns.name: 上诉裁定中的判例引注
patterns.context: 法院裁定宣布上诉驳回或律师退出后，紧随其后的巡回法院规则引注；激活集中于规则编号及标点。
patterns.domain: FreeLaw / 联邦上诉法院裁定

patterns.name: 法律文书编号与引注数字
patterns.context: 事实陈述引用证物页码或记录页码，数字与连字符构成页码范围；附近描述医疗事件。
patterns.domain: FreeLaw / 判决事实与证物引注

patterns.name: 法律规则编号中的数字和连字符
patterns.context: 说明案件无需口头辩论时引用联邦上诉程序规则及巡回法院规则，激活主要落在规则编号的连字符和数字。
patterns.domain: FreeLaw / 上诉法院程序说明

patterns.name: 法律引注中的展品编号
patterns.context: 外交照会及证物说明中出现文件号、展品字母与编号；激活偏向编号及字母数字组合。
patterns.domain: FreeLaw / 证据与外交文件叙述

patterns.name: 刑事量刑指南条款引注
patterns.context: 讨论非法移民人数作为加重因素，并引用美国量刑指南条款、附注及年份。
patterns.domain: FreeLaw / 刑事量刑法律论述

patterns.name: 法律文书的段落编号
patterns.context: 双方同意和解后，裁定按和解条款的特定段落确定补偿；激活落在段落编号附近。

patterns.name: 数学公式中的下标与维数符号
patterns.context: 物理公式后解释强耦合常数及空间时间维数，激活集中于变量、下标和数字符号。
patterns.domain: arXiv / 理论物理学术文本

patterns.name: PHP 参数检查函数标识符
patterns.context: PHP 方法检查参数名是否为整数并从参数数组取值；激活落在驼峰标识符及下划线分隔函数名的片段。
patterns.domain: GitHub / PHP 源码与文档注释

en.description: Activations occur near structured markers in heterogeneous text: legal clause numbers, code syntax and identifiers, research-plan Aim/year numbering, paper figure references, and numbered course titles. Their main commonality is numbering or formatting structure.

patterns.name: Clauses and numbering in legal documents
patterns.context: Citations to statutes, paragraphs, and subparagraph numbers in legal discussions or agreements, often accompanied by punctuation and numerals.

patterns.name: JavaScript code and identifiers
patterns.context: JavaScript examples or source-code snippets, especially variables, loops, and object prototype operations.

patterns.name: Aim numbering in research plans
patterns.context: Descriptions of specific aims, management tasks, and timelines in research project plans or grant applications.

patterns.name: Figure references in papers
patterns.context: The main text of academic papers cites figures or structures within figures, then goes on to describe experimental results.

patterns.name: Numbered course titles
patterns.context: Courses or instructional materials organized by number and title.

6_2674.description: 激活出现在异质文本中的结构化标记附近：法律条款编号、代码语法与标识符、研究计划的 Aim/年份编号、论文图引用及课程编号标题；共同点主要是编号或格式化结构。

patterns.name: 法律文书中的条款与编号
patterns.context: 法律论述或协议中，引用法规、段落及子段编号，常伴随标点和数字。

patterns.name: JavaScript 代码与标识符
patterns.context: JavaScript 示例或源码片段，尤其是变量、循环及对象原型操作。

patterns.name: 研究计划中的 Aim 编号
patterns.context: 研究项目计划或资助申请中，描述具体目标、管理任务及时间安排。

patterns.name: 论文中的图表引用
patterns.context: 学术论文正文引用图或图中结构，并继续描述实验结果。

patterns.name: 编号课程标题
patterns.context: 以编号和标题组织的课程或教学材料。

en.description: Activation is distributed across text boundaries and code indentation, digits and punctuation in legal citations, subword boundaries within English words, and procedural statements in legal rulings. It also appears in JavaScript/PHP syntax and the “Yes” in novel dialogue.

patterns.name: Newline and indentation boundaries
patterns.context: After newlines or code indentation, especially at paragraph, citation, and code-block boundaries; activation often falls on newline or whitespace tokens.

patterns.name: Numbers and punctuation in legal citations
patterns.context: Digits, parentheses, hyphens, and commas occur together in citations to legal cases, rules, or statutes.

patterns.name: Subword boundaries within English words
patterns.context: When English words are split into tokens, activation falls near stems, affixes, or their boundaries; also includes hyphens in compound words.

patterns.name: Dispute resolution and judicial phrasing
patterns.context: In statements describing agreements, parties reaching a settlement, court rulings, or summary judgment, often accompanied by commas and periods.

patterns.name: JavaScript module-call syntax
patterns.context: Module names, quotation marks, parentheses, and call syntax appear together in Node.js/Express code.

patterns.name: PHP file constants and inclusion syntax
patterns.context: In PHP code, require_once appears next to a magic constant surrounded by double underscores and a path constant.

patterns.name: foreach and conditional code blocks
patterns.context: PHP code iterating over objects, comparing IDs, branching conditionally, and assigning values; indentation and newlines also show clear activation.

patterns.name: Affirmative reply in Spanish dialogue
patterns.context: In novel dialogue, answering a question about language ability; activation clusters on the affirmative word Yes.

patterns.name: Judicial discretion and procedural review
patterns.context: The Court of Appeals for the Armed Forces discusses review, due process, appeals, and whether to exercise discretion.

6_2674.concept: 文本与代码边界/结构标记
6_2674.description: 激活分布在文本边界与代码缩进、法律引文的数字标点、英语词内分词边界，以及法律裁判程序语句；另见 JavaScript/PHP 语法和小说对话中的“Yes”。

patterns.name: 换行与缩进边界
patterns.context: 换行或代码缩进后，尤其段落、引文、代码块等边界处；激活常落在换行或空白 token 上。

patterns.name: 法律引用中的编号与标点
patterns.context: 法律判例、规则或法规引用中，数字、括号、连字符及逗号相邻。

patterns.name: 英文词内的子词边界
patterns.context: 英语词语被分词切开时，激活落在词干、词缀或其边界附近；也包括复合词中的连字符。

patterns.name: 争议处理与裁判表述
patterns.trigger: « agreement»、« parties»、« settled»、« decision»、« compensation»、« summary judgment»
patterns.context: 描述协议、当事方达成和解、法院裁判或简易判决的语句中，常伴随逗号和句号。

patterns.name: JavaScript 模块调用语法
patterns.context: Node.js/Express 代码中，模块名、引号、括号与调用语法相邻。

patterns.name: PHP 文件常量及包含语法
patterns.context: PHP 代码中，require_once 与由双下划线包围的魔术常量及路径常量相邻。

patterns.name: foreach 与条件判断代码块
patterns.context: PHP 代码中，循环遍历对象、比较 ID、条件分支及赋值；缩进和换行也有明显激活。

patterns.name: 西语对话中的肯定回答
patterns.context: 小说对话中，回答对方关于语言能力的提问；激活集中在肯定词 Yes。

patterns.name: 法院裁量权与程序审查
patterns.context: 军事上诉法院讨论审查、正当程序、上诉和是否行使裁量权。

en.description: Activations cluster around two kinds of formatting cues: indentation, statement boundaries, and control-flow markers in PHP code; and Figure references, figure numbers, and panel anchors in papers. Activations also occur at numbered legal-document paragraphs, possibly reflecting structured numbering and indentation.

patterns.name: PHP syntax markers and indentation
patterns.context: Statement boundaries, control-flow keywords, and their leading indentation in PHP code blocks; activations also occur on indentation at the beginning of statements.

patterns.name: Figure references and figure-number anchors
patterns.context: Figure references in paper text or supplementary materials, accompanied by Markdown links, panel letters, or ref-type markers.

patterns.name: Legal paragraph numbering and indentation
patterns.context: Indented court-document paragraph numbers followed by the body of a ruling.

6_2674.description: 激活集中在两类格式线索：PHP 代码的缩进、语句边界和控制流标记；论文中的 Figure 引用、图号及面板锚点。另在法律文书段落编号处激活，可能也响应结构化编号与缩进。

patterns.name: PHP 语法标记与缩进
patterns.context: PHP 代码块中的语句边界、控制流关键字及其前导缩进；激活位置也包括语句开头的缩进。
patterns.domain: Github / StackExchange 上的 PHP 代码

patterns.name: Figure 引用及图号锚点
patterns.trigger: «Figure»，以及如« 1»«C»、« S»«1»、« 1»«9»这样的图号或面板标记
patterns.context: 论文正文或补充材料中，Figure 引用附带 Markdown 链接、面板字母或 ref-type 标记。

patterns.name: 法律段落编号与缩进
patterns.context: 缩进后的法院文书段落编号，后接裁定正文。

en.concept: References and numbering in structured documents
en.description: Activations occur across academic and legal texts: they highlight figure/table and citation markers, numbering, and numerical expressions, and also cover medical terminology, experimental results, and legal clauses and ruling language. The different lexical patterns are not fully consistent.

patterns.name: Image/figure references and markers
patterns.context: Near figure/table names, numbers, lettered subfigures, or image references, often accompanied by Markdown or XML citation markers in web/paper corpora.
patterns.domain: Academic papers, especially PubMed Central; also ArXiv

patterns.name: Clause numbering in legal documents
patterns.context: Clauses, appendices, and table numbers adjacent to numerals in legal rulings or bankruptcy documents.

patterns.name: Numerical values and units/currency expressions
patterns.context: Numerical values embedded in measurements, financial expressions, or physical quantities, adjacent to units, currency symbols, or formulas.
patterns.domain: Medical case reports, legal financial materials, physics papers

patterns.name: Specific paper citations and discussion of sparsity
patterns.context: Discussion of ICA separating Gaussian sources, with citations to relevant papers or figure legends.

patterns.name: Tokenized fragments in medical terminology
patterns.context: Medical text mentions amyloidosis or related rheumatic manifestations; activations fall on term fragments and nearby punctuation/words.

patterns.name: Descriptions of medical research results
patterns.context: Experimental or database comparison results involving tissues, gene/protein expression, and cell migration and invasion.

patterns.name: Approval language in rulings
patterns.context: An item ruling in a court order approves the amount requested by the applicant, followed by a mention of a motion for reconsideration.

patterns.name: Immigration-related criminal sentencing factors
patterns.context: A judicial decision cites a statute stating that the number of people illegally entering the country is an aggravating factor.

6_2674.concept: 结构化文档中的引用与编号
6_2674.description: 激活散见于学术与法律文本：突出图表/引用标记、编号和数值表达，也覆盖医学术语、实验结果及法律条款、裁判措辞。不同词汇模式并不完全统一。

patterns.name: 图片/图表引用及标记
patterns.context: 图表名称、编号、字母子图或图像引用附近，常伴随网页/论文语料中的 Markdown 或 XML 引用标记。
patterns.domain: 学术论文，尤其 PubMed Central；也有 ArXiv

patterns.name: 法律文书中的条款编号
patterns.context: 法律裁判或破产文书中，条款、附录、表格编号与数字相邻。

patterns.name: 数字与单位/金额表达
patterns.context: 数值嵌在测量、财务或物理量表达中，数字与单位、货币符号或公式相邻。
patterns.domain: 医学病例、法律财务材料、物理论文

patterns.name: 特定论文引用与稀疏性论述
patterns.context: 讨论 ICA 对高斯源的分离，并引用相关论文或图例。
patterns.domain: 学术论文，信号处理/统计方法

patterns.name: 医学术语中的分词片段
patterns.context: 医学文本出现淀粉样变或相关风湿病表现；激活落在术语片段及附近标点/词上。

patterns.name: 医学研究结果描述
patterns.context: 实验或数据库比较结果，涉及组织、基因/蛋白表达及细胞迁移侵袭。

patterns.name: 裁判结论中的批准措辞
patterns.context: 法院命令中批准申请人所请求金额的项目裁定，后续提及复核动议。

patterns.name: 移民刑事量刑因素
patterns.context: 司法判决援引法规，称非法入境人数是加重因素。

en.description: The most stable signal is structured figure citations in academic text, especially figure labels, subfigure A, and their associated markers. There are also sporadic responses to code path separators, legal section numbers, experiment identifiers, and numeric strings, which are difficult to group into one local semantic pattern.

patterns.name: Figure numbers and subfigure labels
patterns.context: Figure references in the text, especially numbered figures with subfigure A; enclosed by parentheses, square brackets, or XML citation markers.

patterns.name: Combinations of digits and the letter A
patterns.context: Common in figure/subfigure citations, with A often at the end of the figure number; activation falls on or near the number or A.

patterns.name: Machine-readable markers in figure citations
patterns.context: Structured markers and numbers occur near figure citations; may not appear in every passage.

patterns.name: PHP include statements
patterns.context: In PHP code, require_once is followed by a directory constant and a path separator.

patterns.name: Legal section numbers and age figures
patterns.context: A factual statement in a legal text concerns a minor being present, followed by a citation to a state statute.

patterns.name: Numeric strings in data or technical terminology
patterns.context: Appears in descriptions of biomedical experiments, genes, or transcripts; not always directly connected to figure citations.

patterns.name: Sparsity and mathematical literature terminology
patterns.context: Discusses separating Gaussian sources with independent component analysis and cites a mathematical methods paper.

patterns.name: General numeric chart or statistical descriptions
patterns.context: Quantifiers appear in papers describing categories, proportions, or samples, without a consistent local syntactic condition.

6_2674.description: 最稳定的线索是学术文本中图号、子图A及其结构化引用标记；另对代码路径分隔符、法律条文编号、实验编号和数量串有零散响应，难以归为同一局部语义模式。

patterns.name: 图号与子图标记
patterns.context: 正文中的图注引用，尤其是带子图 A 的编号；被括号、方括号或 XML 引用标记包围

patterns.name: 数字与字母A的组合
patterns.trigger: 数字串中出现“1…A”，如“518A”“518A”式图号，或«1»后接«A»
patterns.context: 多见于图号/子图引用，A 常处于图号末尾；激活落在编号或 A 附近

patterns.name: 图引用的机器标记
patterns.context: 图引用附近的结构化标记与编号相邻；未必每段都出现

patterns.name: PHP包含语句
patterns.context: PHP 代码中 require_once 后接目录常量和路径分隔符

patterns.name: 法律条文编号与年龄数字
patterns.trigger: “less than sixteen years of age”及“Code § 35-42-2-1”中的数字、连字符和条款符号
patterns.context: 法律文本中涉及未成年人在场的事实陈述，随后引用州法条文

patterns.name: 数值或技术术语中的数字串
patterns.context: 出现在生物医学实验、基因/转录本描述中；不总与图引用直接相连

patterns.name: 稀疏性与数学文献术语
patterns.trigger: “sparsity”“ICA”“Gaussian sources”及作者年份/文献编号中的数字
patterns.context: 讨论独立成分分析分离高斯源，引用数学方法论文

patterns.name: 一般数字化图表或统计描述
patterns.context: 数量词出现在论文对类别、比例或样本的描述中，但没有统一局部句法条件

en.description: All excerpts contain figure numbers or panel-letter references; activations cluster on figure numbers, panel markers such as A–H, and their links/formatting markers. A few body-text words and punctuation marks are also flagged, but there is no stable commonality.

patterns.name: Figure numbers and panel markers
patterns.context: References to figures in paper text or captions, especially near brackets, link anchors, or supplementary-material citations; no specific discipline is required.
patterns.domain: Academic papers, mainly biomedical literature, also patents

patterns.name: Citation numbers in square brackets
patterns.context: Figure numbers, panel letters, and link text occur next to each other; activations fall on the numbers and letters in these combinations.
patterns.domain: PubMed Central paper text, captions, and supplementary-material markers

patterns.name: Figure-reference links and formatting markers
patterns.context: Occurs when figure references are represented in the corpus with link anchors or XML/Markdown markers; often adjacent to figure numbers and panel letters.
patterns.domain: PubMed Central converted text; patent “FIG” references have a similar format

patterns.name: Local words outside figure references
patterns.context: These words or punctuation marks each occur near figure references, but have no stable, consistent local semantics or shared contextual condition.
patterns.domain: Mixed: patents, biomedical papers, and chapter text

patterns.name: Body-text/chapter boundaries before figure references
patterns.context: Activations occur near line breaks, chapter headings, or trailing figure-reference markers; it is unclear whether this is independent of the figure-reference pattern.
patterns.domain: PubMed Central converted text and paper chapter structure

6_2674.concept: 学术文本中的图表引用标记
6_2674.description: 所有片段都含图表编号或面板字母引用；激活集中于图号、A–H 等面板标记及其链接/格式标记。少数正文词和标点也被标记，但缺少稳定共性。

patterns.name: 图表编号及面板标记
patterns.trigger: «Figure»、«Fig»、«[»、«1»k«A»k / «B»k / «C»k，以及相邻的图号与面板字母
patterns.context: 论文正文或图注中引用图表，尤其在方括号、链接锚点、补充材料引用附近；不要求特定学科。
patterns.domain: 学术论文，主要是生物医学文献，也见专利

patterns.name: 方括号中的引用编号
patterns.context: 图号、面板字母及链接文本紧邻出现；激活落在组合中的编号和字母上。
patterns.domain: PubMed Central 的论文正文、图注及补充材料标记

patterns.name: 图引用链接与格式化标记
patterns.context: 图表引用被转换为带链接锚点或 XML/Markdown 标记的语料格式时出现；常与图号、面板字母相邻。
patterns.domain: PubMed Central 转换文本；专利中的“FIG”引用也有相近格式

patterns.name: 图表引用之外的局部词语
patterns.context: 这些词或标点各自出现在图引用附近，但没有稳定一致的局部语义或共同上下文条件。
patterns.domain: 混合：专利、生物医学论文及章节正文

patterns.name: 图引用前的正文/章节边界
patterns.context: 换行、章节标题或图引用尾部标记附近激活，是否独立于图引用模式不确定。
patterns.domain: PubMed Central 转换文本与论文章节结构

en.description: Mostly paper-style technical text and specialized terminology, often accompanied by experimental or comparative results and figure references; isolated patterns also involve anatomical mechanics, quantum physics, business email, and PHP code, and cannot be unified under a single topic.

patterns.name: Paper figure references and numbering
patterns.context: In biomedical paper text, results are supported by parenthetical figure references, or panel numbers follow figure references.

patterns.name: Biomedical experimental results narrative
patterns.context: Descriptions of gene or protein expression, cell experiments, detection, and validation results, often involving cell lines, tissues, or experimental methods.

patterns.name: Gene/protein and biomedical entity names
patterns.context: Specialized entity names appear in biological statements, often alongside descriptions of expression, function, infection, or differentiation.
patterns.domain: Microbiology, virology, neurobiology, and cell biology papers

patterns.name: Quantitative and comparative results
patterns.context: Statements of relative proportions, expression levels, sample counts, or dose-dependent relationships.

patterns.name: Musculoskeletal anatomy and mechanics
patterns.context: Explains muscle attachment locations and their relationships to joint movement and changes in torque.

patterns.name: Quantum physics terminology and equation references
patterns.context: Discusses measurements and experiments, and the effect of a certain energy-level shift on spin-conserving dynamics, with an equation reference.

patterns.name: Cautious self-assessment and policy criticism in email
patterns.context: Email tone: the sender reflects that they may have been too forceful in publicly criticizing policy.

patterns.name: PHP file inclusion code
patterns.context: PHP code uses require_once to include a path, along with the current-directory constant and directory separator.

6_2674.description: 以论文式技术文本及专业术语为主，常伴实验或比较结果和图表引用；另有解剖力学、量子物理、商务邮件与 PHP 代码等孤立模式，不能统一归为单一主题。

patterns.name: 论文图表引用与编号
patterns.context: 生物医学论文正文中，结果陈述后以括号中的图表引用为证据，或引用图表后接面板编号。
patterns.domain: PubMed Central 生物医学论文

patterns.name: 生物医学实验结果叙述
patterns.trigger: “mRNA were detected”“were validated”“expression pattern”“cells infected”“responded to purified Wnt3A”
patterns.context: 描述基因或蛋白表达、细胞实验、检测与验证结果，常涉及细胞系、组织或实验方法。

patterns.name: 基因／蛋白与生物医学实体名称
patterns.context: 专业实体名称出现在生物学陈述中，往往伴随表达、功能、感染或分化描述。
patterns.domain: 微生物学、病毒学、神经生物学及细胞生物学论文

patterns.name: 定量与比较性结果
patterns.trigger: “a larger proportion”“Levels of expression”“in five CRC cell lines”“dose-dependent manner”
patterns.context: 陈述相对比例、表达水平、样本数量或剂量依赖关系。

patterns.name: 肌肉骨骼解剖与力学
patterns.trigger: “muscles attached to bone”“joint movement”“human shank”“tibia or fibula”
patterns.context: 解释肌肉附着位置及其与关节运动、力矩变化的关系。
patterns.domain: 人体解剖、生物力学论文

patterns.name: 量子物理术语与方程引用
patterns.context: 讨论测量、实验以及某种能级位移对自旋守恒动力学的影响，并引用方程。

patterns.name: 邮件中的谨慎自我评价与政策批评
patterns.trigger: “I was too assertive”“press criticizing”“stupidity of revoking Annex V”“setting caps on spot”
patterns.context: 邮件语气，发件人回顾自己公开批评政策时可能过于强硬。
patterns.domain: 商务邮件／能源政策讨论

patterns.name: PHP 文件包含代码
patterns.context: PHP 代码以 require_once 引入路径，并使用当前目录常量和目录分隔符。

en.description: Primarily sensitive to figure references and subfigure labels (especially a number followed by A), often occurring in biomedical results and descriptions of proportions and distributions; also occurs in patent figure references. A passage in a contract email contains clause and attachment numbers and may represent a separate pattern.

patterns.name: Figure references and figure-number letter labels
patterns.context: Activates when the body text refers to a figure or subpanel; figure numbers, letters, and adjacent markers are often split into multiple tokens.

patterns.name: Results statements following figure references
patterns.context: Describes cell, gene, protein, or experimental analysis results supported by figure references; the experiment need not be the same.

patterns.name: Comparisons or distribution descriptions following figure references
patterns.context: Figure-reference contexts discuss the quantity, proportion, or distribution of different components, cell types, or anatomical structures.

patterns.name: Figure-number labels outside biomedicine
patterns.context: Technical descriptions in patents refer to figures and subfigures; there is no biological experimental context.

patterns.name: Contract revisions and clause numbering
patterns.context: A revision-draft email discusses comments, contract sections, and attachments; it has no clear connection to the paper figure-reference pattern.

6_2674.description: 主要对图表引用及子图标注（尤其编号后接A）敏感，常见于生物医学结果、比例和分布描述；也出现在专利图示引用。另有一段合同邮件中的条款、附件标号，可能是独立模式。

patterns.name: 图表引用及图号字母标注
patterns.context: 正文在引用图或图中子面板时激活；图号、字母及相邻标记常被拆成多个 token。
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文及专利说明书

patterns.name: 图引用后的结果陈述
patterns.trigger: 图引用附近的实验结果用语，如“expressed”“were validated”“analysis”“Results are presented”
patterns.context: 描述细胞、基因、蛋白或实验分析结果，并以图表引用支撑；不要求具体实验相同。

patterns.name: 图引用后的比较或分布描述
patterns.context: 图引用上下文讨论不同组分、细胞类型或解剖结构的数量、比例或分布。

patterns.name: 非生物医学文档中的图号标注
patterns.context: 专利技术描述中引用图及子图；未出现生物实验语境。

patterns.name: 合同修订与条款标号
patterns.context: 修订草稿邮件中讨论意见、合同章节及附件；与论文图表模式无明显联系。

en.description: Sensitive to numbers, identifiers, figure or section citations, and their surrounding formatting markers; also common in code punctuation, proper nouns, technical terms, formal documents, and expressions of quantities and units. Triggers vary by genre, with no single stable semantic theme apparent.

patterns.name: Numbers and identifiers
patterns.context: Numbers appear in prose, code, or marked figure/section references; often adjacent to letters, hyphens, or formatting markers.
patterns.domain: Academic papers, legal texts, emails, and code

patterns.name: Figures and cross-references
patterns.context: The main text of a paper cites figures, tables, or bibliographic locations, often with XML/Markdown tags and numbering.

patterns.name: Punctuation and syntax boundaries in code
patterns.context: Operators, parentheses, statement terminators, or comment boundaries in code syntax.

patterns.name: Proper nouns and technical terminology
patterns.context: Proper names or technical terms intermixed with numbers, abbreviations, hyphens, and similar elements.

patterns.name: Legal document formatting and wording
patterns.context: Headings, party designations, and clause numbers in formal legal texts.

patterns.name: Revisions and contract text
patterns.context: Emails describing document revisions, comments, and contract attachments, with section and specification numbers.

patterns.name: Quantities, proportions, and units
patterns.context: Quantities, proportions, units, and quantitative comparisons in scientific or business writing.

6_2674.description: 对数字、编号、图表或条款引用及其周边格式标记敏感；也常见于代码标点、专名术语、正式文书和数量单位表达。触发形式随文体变化，未见单一稳定语义主题。

patterns.name: 数字与编号
patterns.trigger: 数字及编号片段，如“Section 10”“Figure 3”“HCT116”“10 Mpc”“6”
patterns.context: 数字出现在正文、代码或带标记的图表/章节引用中；常与字母、连字符或格式标记相邻。
patterns.domain: 学术论文、法律文本、邮件及代码

patterns.name: 图表与交叉引用
patterns.context: 论文正文引用图表、表格或文献位置，常带 XML/Markdown 标签和编号。

patterns.name: 代码中的标点与语法边界
patterns.context: 代码语法中的运算符、括号、语句结束符或注释边界。

patterns.name: 专名与技术术语
patterns.context: 专有名称或专业术语与数字、缩写、连字符等混排。
patterns.domain: 生物医学与天文学论文

patterns.name: 法律文书格式与措辞
patterns.context: 正式法律文本中的标题、当事人称谓及条款编号。

patterns.name: 修订与合同文本
patterns.context: 邮件中描述文件修订、意见及合同附件，夹有章节和规格编号。

patterns.name: 数量、比例及单位表达
patterns.context: 科学或商务叙述中的数量、比例、单位及定量比较。

en.description: All passages contain figure or table cross-references in academic contexts; activations cluster on figure/table names, numbers, punctuation, and structured link markers. The subject areas vary, and only some body-text expressions are shared.

patterns.name: Figure/table references and numbering
patterns.context: Figure/table names and numbers appear in paper text or captions, often with brackets, cross-reference links, or subpanel markers; activations are especially concentrated on the numbers and adjacent punctuation.
patterns.domain: Academic papers across biomedicine, physics, astronomy, and other research fields

patterns.name: Markup syntax for figure/table citations
patterns.context: Figure/table numbers appear as structured citations or converted XML/Markdown markers; these markers are adjacent to figure/table titles, anchors, or subfigure letters.
patterns.domain: Structured annotation/web-conversion formats in academic paper corpora

patterns.name: Expressions indicating figures/tables in body text
patterns.context: The body text introduces or explains figure/table content with demonstrative expressions, usually adjacent to a figure/table cross-reference; these words do not occur in every passage and may be contextual.

6_2674.description: 所有段落均含学术语境中的图表或表格交叉引用；激活集中于图表名称、编号、标点及结构化链接标记。主题领域各异，正文表达仅部分共享。

patterns.name: 图表引用及编号
patterns.context: 论文正文或图表说明中，出现图/表名称及其编号，常带方括号、交叉引用链接或图表子面板标记；激活尤其集中在编号中的数字及相邻标点。
patterns.domain: 学术论文，涵盖生物医学、物理、天文学及其他研究领域

patterns.name: 图表引文的标记语法
patterns.context: 图表编号以结构化引文或转换后的 XML/Markdown 标记呈现；这些标记与图表标题、锚点或子图字母相邻。
patterns.domain: 学术论文语料的结构化标注/网页转换格式

patterns.name: 正文中的图表指示表达
patterns.context: 正文通过指示语引出或解释图表内容，通常紧邻图表交叉引用；这些词本身并非各段都出现，可能是伴随上下文。

en.description: Activations often occur in numbered academic figure/table cross-references, and also in legal subdivisions, LaTeX equation labels, precision structural measurements, and asset amount lists; the commonality is weak, but all are structured, numbered, or citation-dense written text.

patterns.name: Figures, tables, and cross-references in scientific literature
patterns.context: The body text points to evidence or supplementary information in a paper using numbered figures, tables, or “see” references; often accompanied by citation markers and parentheses.
patterns.domain: Academic papers, especially biomedicine and astrophysics

patterns.name: Numbered legal subdivisions
patterns.context: Roman numerals, letters, and subparagraph markers organize exceptions, calculation rules, or clauses in statutes or legal text.

patterns.name: Mathematical equation labels and variable notation
patterns.context: A labeled equation appears after a displayed formula, followed by an explanation of its parameters.

patterns.name: Precise numerical values and measurement units
patterns.context: High-precision decimals and units report atomic positions or geometric measurements of molecular structures.

patterns.name: Account assets and amount lists
patterns.context: Lists a debtor’s assets, accounts, and amounts, and states whether the assets are exempt.

6_2674.description: 激活多见于带编号的学术图表交叉引用，也见于法律分项、LaTeX 方程标签、精密结构测量及资产金额清单；共同点较弱，都是结构化、编号或引用密集的书面文本。

patterns.name: 科学文献中的图表与交叉引用
patterns.context: 正文通过编号图表、表格或“see”引用来指向论文中的证据或补充说明；常伴随引用标记和括号。
patterns.domain: 学术论文，尤其生物医学及天体物理

patterns.name: 法律条款的编号分项
patterns.context: 法规或法律文本中，以罗马数字、字母和子段落标记组织例外、计算规则或条款。

patterns.name: 数学公式的标签与变量记号
patterns.context: 显示公式之后出现带标签的方程，并在后文说明公式中的参数。
patterns.domain: 物理学论文，LaTeX 数学排版

patterns.name: 精密数值与测量单位
patterns.context: 以高精度小数和单位报告分子结构的原子位置或几何测量。
patterns.domain: 结构化学、生物医学论文

patterns.name: 账户资产与金额清单
patterns.context: 列举债务人资产、账户及金额，并说明资产是否豁免。
patterns.domain: 破产或财务相关法律文本

en.description: Activations are scattered across function words, chapter structure, code control flow, figure references, formula numbers, domain terminology, and punctuation boundaries; no single semantic trigger is consistently shared across corpora.

patterns.name: Sentence-initial or medial function words
patterns.context: Activations occur on grammatical connectives and nearby positions, especially in sequences of explanatory or summary sentences; however, the same words are not necessarily flagged in other passages.

patterns.name: Paper structure and section headings
patterns.context: Activations are stronger near section numbers and headings when introducing paper organization, section contents, or methods-section titles.

patterns.name: Code control flow and variable operations
patterns.context: PHP code iterates over webhooks, checks conditions, and sets variables; activations cluster on control-flow and variable-related tokens.

patterns.name: Figure references and cross-reference markers
patterns.context: Occurs when patent or paper text refers to figures, figure numbers, and XML/document cross-reference markers.

patterns.name: Numerical and formula-structure fragments
patterns.context: Activations fall on numbers, formula symbols, or numbering; contexts respectively concern protein purification, mathematical models, study phases, and section numbering, without consistent semantics.

patterns.name: Scientific/technical terminology or key phrases
patterns.context: A small number of activations occur near domain-specific terms or topic phrases; no unified domain semantics are evident.
patterns.domain: Telecommunications patents, biomedicine, cosmology, music theory, microbiology

patterns.name: Methods, results, and research-plan narrative
patterns.context: Some words and nearby tokens are flagged in descriptions of research methods, results, or project-phase aims.
patterns.domain: Academic papers and research grant applications

patterns.name: Local punctuation or formatting boundaries
patterns.context: Occurs at code semicolons and at paper sentence endings, section headings, and line-break boundaries, possibly related to local structural markers.

6_2674.description: 激活分散于功能词、章节结构、代码控制流、图表引用、公式数字、领域术语及标点边界；不同语料中没有稳定共享的单一语义触发条件。

patterns.name: 句首或句中功能词
patterns.context: 激活出现在语法连接词及其邻近位置，尤其是连续说明或概述性句子中；但同类词在其他段落未必被标记。

patterns.name: 论文结构与章节标题
patterns.trigger: «Section» «III»、«Section» «II»、«Method»ology、«The rest of the paper is sketched as follows»
patterns.context: 介绍论文安排、章节内容或方法部分标题时，章节编号和标题附近激活较强。

patterns.name: 代码控制流与变量操作
patterns.context: PHP 代码中遍历 webhook、检查条件并设置变量；激活集中在控制流和变量相关 token。

patterns.name: 图表引用与交叉引用标记
patterns.context: 专利或论文正文引用图、图号及 XML/文档交叉引用标记时出现。

patterns.name: 数值与公式结构片段
patterns.context: 激活落在数字、公式符号或编号上；所在上下文分别涉及蛋白纯化、数学模型、研究阶段和章节编号，语义并不一致。

patterns.name: 科学/技术领域术语或关键短语
patterns.context: 少量激活出现在领域专有名词或特定主题短语附近；未见统一的领域语义。
patterns.domain: 通信专利、生物医学、宇宙学、音乐理论、微生物学

patterns.name: 方法、结果与研究计划叙述
patterns.context: 概述研究方法、结果或项目阶段目标的叙述中，部分词及邻近 token 被标记。
patterns.domain: 学术论文与科研项目申请

patterns.name: 局部标点或排版边界
patterns.context: 在代码分号以及论文句末、章节标题和换行边界处出现，可能与局部结构标记相关。

en.concept: Numerical symbols in scientific and technical texts
en.description: Activation is concentrated mainly in formulas and adjacent symbols in scientific and engineering texts, especially numeric subscripts, exponents, dimensions, and identifiers; it also covers figure/table and section references, technical abbreviations, and proper nouns. Paragraph 9 concerns a company name and revenue in a business review, which is difficult to unify with the formula pattern.

patterns.name: Numeric subscripts in mathematical formulas
patterns.context: Appears in physics or mathematics formulas, especially parameters, constants, dimensions, and their subscripts; activation often falls on subscript digits, letters, or nearby formula punctuation.

patterns.name: Exponents and operation structure in formulas
patterns.context: Mathematical symbols and values are activated when formulas express functions, powers, or numeric relationships; also includes explanatory text after formulas.
patterns.domain: PubMed Central mathematical models and ArXiv scientific papers

patterns.name: Figures, numbering, and cross-references
patterns.context: References to equations, figures, panels, or sections in papers or patents; activation clusters on numbers, letter labels, and citation markers.

patterns.name: Numbers, units, and measurements
patterns.context: Numbers in experimental descriptions, physical dimensions, astronomical parameters, or equipment identifiers; sometimes embedded in proper nouns or citations.
patterns.domain: Academic papers, patents, and experimental descriptions

patterns.name: Rare numeric proper nouns or labels
patterns.context: MM96 is a bibliographic or object label; SignalFX is a company name, and activation also falls on sentences about its founders, revenue, and transactions.

patterns.name: Alphanumeric strings in technical terminology
patterns.context: Appears when technical or scientific terms contain uppercase abbreviations, alphanumeric labels, or parameter markers adjacent to formulas.
patterns.domain: Condensed matter physics and telecommunications patents

6_2674.concept: 科学技术文本中的数字符号
6_2674.description: 激活主要分布于科学、工程文本的公式及其邻近符号，尤其数字下标、指数、量纲和编号；也覆盖图表/章节引用、技术缩写与专名。第9段是商业评论中的公司名与收益叙述，难与公式模式统一。

patterns.name: 数学公式中的数字下标
patterns.trigger: 如“_{0}”“_{00}”“_{BKT}”“_{e}”，以及公式中的数字与参数字母
patterns.context: 出现在物理或数学公式中，尤其是参数、常数、量纲及其下标；激活常落在下标数字、字母或紧邻公式标点上

patterns.name: 公式中的指数与运算结构
patterns.context: 公式表达函数、幂次或数值关系时，相关数学符号和数值被激活；也包括公式之后的解释文字
patterns.domain: PubMed Central 数学模型及 ArXiv 科学论文

patterns.name: 图表、编号及交叉引用
