patterns.context: 论文或专利中引用方程、图、面板或章节，激活集中在编号、字母标签及引用标记

patterns.name: 数字与单位、测量量
patterns.context: 实验描述、物理量纲、天文参数或设备编号中的数字；有时数字嵌在专名或引用中
patterns.domain: 学术论文、专利及实验说明

patterns.name: 稀有的数字化专名或标签
patterns.context: MM96 是文献或对象标记；SignalFX 是公司名，激活还落在谈论创始人、收益与交易的句子中
patterns.domain: 天文学论文；HackerNews 网络讨论

patterns.name: 专业术语中的字母数字混合串
patterns.context: 技术或科学术语含大写字母缩写、字母数字标签或紧邻公式的参数标记时出现
patterns.domain: 凝聚态物理与通信专利

en.description: Activations occur across academic-paper sections, figure and equation references, and research-result narratives, as well as PHP foreach array-iteration code; the domains span widely, local trigger words are inconsistent, and some passages are difficult to explain through shared semantics.

patterns.name: Structured numbering and cross-references
patterns.context: Occurs in paper text, figure captions, or methods descriptions, often accompanied by section/figure cross-references and markers such as parentheses and square brackets.
patterns.domain: Academic papers, especially PMC and ArXiv

patterns.name: PHP code iteration syntax
patterns.context: In PHP examples or test code, iterates over arrays or sets of rows; activations fall on loop keywords and nearby code tokens.
patterns.domain: StackExchange programming Q&A, GitHub PHP test code

patterns.name: Results and data-presentation contexts
patterns.context: Discusses research results, numerical data, figures, or measurements; some instances also contain section/figure references, but not all share the same reference format.

patterns.name: Experimental methods and analysis descriptions
patterns.context: Describes experimental samples, detection methods, physical conditions, or research processes; there is no single stable domain-specific trigger term.

patterns.name: Standalone PHP query example
patterns.context: Explains database query results and the role of a left join, then provides a PHP loop example.

patterns.name: Clinical trial efficacy report
patterns.context: Reports patient enrollment and lesion changes in a clinical study, with figure references.

patterns.name: Medical table and figure navigation
patterns.context: Prompts readers to consult tables and figures at a paragraph transition, with nearby mention of drug examples.

patterns.name: Quantum chain model calculation
patterns.context: Describes numerical data and fitting for a one-dimensional spin chain, and points to a later section.

patterns.name: Astrophysical metallicity figure
patterns.context: Compares metallicity trends and supports the discussion with a figure.

patterns.name: Serialized markers and equation numbering
patterns.context: The context begins with a truncated formula or numbering fragment, making its specific semantics difficult to determine from the fragment alone.

6_2674.description: 激活散见于学术论文的章节、图表和公式引用及研究结果叙述，也见PHP foreach数组迭代代码；领域跨度大，局部触发词不统一，部分片段难以由共同语义解释。

patterns.name: 结构编号与交叉引用
patterns.context: 出现在论文正文、图表标题或方法描述中，常伴随章节/图表交叉引用和括号、方括号等标记。
patterns.domain: 学术论文，尤其是 PMC 与 ArXiv

patterns.name: PHP 代码迭代语法
patterns.context: PHP 示例或测试代码中，迭代数组或行集合；激活落在循环关键字及邻近代码 token 上。
patterns.domain: StackExchange 编程问答、GitHub PHP 测试代码

patterns.name: 结果与数据呈现语境
patterns.context: 讨论研究结果、数值数据、图示或测量；部分实例同时含章节/图表引用，但并非都有同一引用形式。

patterns.name: 实验方法与分析描述
patterns.context: 描述实验样品、检测方法、物理条件或研究过程；没有单一稳定的领域术语触发词。
patterns.domain: 生物医学与物理学论文

patterns.name: 单独出现的 PHP 查询示例
patterns.context: 解释数据库查询结果及左连接的作用，随后给出 PHP 循环示例。

patterns.name: 医学试验疗效报告
patterns.context: 临床研究中报告患者入组情况及病灶变化，并引用图表。

patterns.name: 医学表格与图示导航
patterns.context: 在段落衔接处提示读者查看表格和图，附近提及药物例子。

patterns.name: 量子链模型计算
patterns.context: 描述一维自旋链数值数据及拟合，并指向后续章节。

patterns.name: 天体物理金属丰度图示
patterns.context: 比较金属丰度趋势，并以图示支持论述。

patterns.name: 序列化标记与公式编号
patterns.context: 上下文开头是被截断的公式或编号片段，难以从片段本身确定具体语义。

en.description: Across biomedical, physics, and astronomy papers, activation often falls on syntactic connectives, figure references, and numeric symbols; scientific topics vary, with no single discipline-specific pattern apparent.

patterns.name: Prepositions/connectives within sentences
patterns.context: Appears in continuous explanatory English sentences, connecting methods, conditions, locations, or contrasts; activation often falls on short prepositions or connectives.

patterns.name: Figure, table, and cross-reference markers
patterns.context: Near figure and table numbers, parenthetical citations, and XML/HTML-style figure-reference markers; may co-occur with ordinary syntactic words.

patterns.name: Numerical values, units, and symbols
patterns.context: Numbers, units, or mathematical/physical symbols embedded in discussion, measurement results, or formulas; activation locations are not fixed and may involve adjacent punctuation and formatting symbols.
patterns.domain: Scientific papers, especially quantitative results and formulas

patterns.name: Biomedical terminology and experimental descriptions
patterns.context: Describes protein purification, cell types, gene expression, or experimental analysis; these passages also contain general syntactic words and figure references.

patterns.name: Physical processes and model terminology
patterns.context: Discusses physical quantities, dynamics, or astronomical models, often alongside formulas, variables, and figure numbers.

patterns.name: Specific chemical structure descriptions
patterns.context: Describes the position of a molecular fragment relative to a plane and its distance, with atom numbers and coordinate-style values interspersed.

6_2674.description: 跨生物医学、物理和天体论文，激活常落在句法连接词、图表引用及数字符号上；科学术语主题多样，未见单一学科特异性。

patterns.name: 句中介词/连接词
patterns.context: 出现在连续说明性英文句子中，连接方法、条件、位置或转折；激活点常落在短介词或连接词上。

patterns.name: 图表与交叉引用标记
patterns.context: 图表编号、括号引用及 XML/HTML 风格的图表引用标记附近；可与普通句法词共同出现。

patterns.name: 数值、单位与符号表达
patterns.context: 数字、单位或数学/物理符号嵌入论述、测量结果或公式中；本模式触发位置不固定，可能涉及相邻标点与格式符号。
patterns.domain: 科学论文，尤其定量结果与公式

patterns.name: 生物医学术语及实验叙述
patterns.context: 描述蛋白纯化、细胞类型、基因表达或实验分析；这些内容同时含一般句法词和图表引用。

patterns.name: 物理过程与模型术语
patterns.context: 讨论物理量、动力学或天体模型，常伴公式、变量和图表编号。

patterns.name: 特定化学结构描述
patterns.context: 描述分子片段相对平面的结构与距离，夹杂原子编号和坐标式数值。

en.concept: Specific phrase and template instruction triggers
en.description: The most stable pattern is the phrase “trying to,” covering attempts, intentions, or understanding. Activations also occur on block and raw in `{% ... %}` template instructions, as well as on several isolated fragments.

patterns.name: trying to
patterns.context: In the fixed phrase “trying to,” to immediately follows trying; the phrase is followed by a verb phrase expressing intention, attempt, or understanding.
patterns.domain: Various styles, including forum discussions, Q&A, and email

patterns.name: Template block instructions
patterns.context: Jinja/Liquid-style `{% block ... %}` instructions in template languages; variable names may include storm_install, content, footer, and others.

patterns.name: Template raw/loop instructions
patterns.context: Used with the template tag `{% raw %}`, with a template loop `{% for ...` nearby.

patterns.name: Unexplained word prefixes or fragments
patterns.context: Activations fall on words, symbols, or text fragments, with no stable relationship to template instructions or trying to apparent from the available context.
patterns.domain: News paraphrases, math Q&A, email headers, etc.

6_2728.concept: 特定短语与模板指令触发
6_2728.description: 最稳定的模式是短语“trying to”，涵盖尝试、意图或理解；另有模板 `{% ... %}` 指令中的 block、raw，以及若干孤立片段激活。

patterns.name: trying to
patterns.context: 固定短语“trying to”中，trying 后紧接 to；后续为表达意图、尝试或理解的动词短语。
patterns.domain: 论坛对话、问答、邮件等多种文体

patterns.name: 模板块指令
patterns.context: 模板语言中，Jinja/Liquid 风格的 `{% block ... %}` 指令；变量名可为 storm_install、content、footer 等。

patterns.name: 模板 raw/循环指令
patterns.context: 与模板标记 `{% raw %}` 连用，附近出现模板循环 `{% for ...`。

patterns.name: 未解释的单词前缀或片段
patterns.context: 激活落在单词、符号或文本片段上，现有上下文看不出与模板指令或 trying to 的稳定关系。
patterns.domain: 新闻转述、数学问答、邮件头等

en.concept: Template markers and the trying to structure
en.description: Strong patterns include template tags ({%), source-code markers, and the recurring trying to + verb structure across news, forums, mathematics, email, and chat; their semantics vary by domain. There are also local patterns such as email headers and forum clarifications.

patterns.name: Template block markers
patterns.context: Tags such as block, raw, and for in Jinja/Django-style templates; tags often occur at newline or code-structure boundaries.
patterns.domain: GitHub templates and StackExchange code examples

patterns.name: trying to infinitive structure
patterns.context: The English progressive structure trying to + verb; following purposes vary, with activation concentrated on trying.
patterns.domain: Forums, email, chat, and academic texts

patterns.name: Mixed code and markup languages
patterns.context: Non-natural-language code, template tags, HTML tags, and adjacent whitespace and newlines; the first segment also contains encoding- or hash-like strings.

patterns.name: Email header fields
patterns.context: Header fields such as email addresses, recipients, cc, and subject, followed by the email body.

patterns.name: Expressions in emphasis or rebuttal
patterns.context: Conversational contexts involving responding to someone and clarifying whether one is suppressing them.

patterns.name: Attempts in mathematical discussion
patterns.context: A questioner describes the process of understanding or proving a mathematical proposition; nearby content concerns group theory or continuous functions.

patterns.name: Attempts in technical proposals or constructions
patterns.context: Describes attempting to implement a policy goal or adjust a property in a mathematical construction.

patterns.name: Attempts in collaborative problem-solving
patterns.context: First-person plural descriptions of working on a practical problem.

patterns.name: Self-description in chat
patterns.context: Discussing efforts to remain honest in instant messaging.

6_2728.concept: 模板标记与 trying to 结构
6_2728.description: 强模式包括模板标签（{%）、源码标记，以及跨新闻、论坛、数学、邮件和聊天反复出现的 trying to + 动词结构；其语义与领域多变。另有邮件头和论坛澄清等局部模式。

patterns.name: 模板块标记
patterns.context: Jinja/Django 风格模板中的 block、raw、for 等标签；标签常位于换行或代码结构边界。
patterns.domain: GitHub 模板与 StackExchange 代码示例

patterns.name: trying to 不定式结构
patterns.context: 英语进行时结构 trying to + 动词；后续目的各异，激活集中在 trying。
patterns.domain: 论坛、邮件、聊天及学术文本

patterns.name: 代码与标记语言混合
patterns.context: 非自然语言的代码、模板标签、HTML 标签及其紧邻空白和换行；首段还含类似编码或哈希的字符串。

patterns.name: 邮件头字段
patterns.context: 邮件地址、收件人抄送和主题等头部字段，随后出现邮件正文。

patterns.name: 强调或反驳中的表达
patterns.context: 回应对方、澄清是否在压制对方的对话语境。

patterns.name: 数学论述中的尝试
patterns.context: 提问者描述理解或证明数学命题的过程；相邻内容涉及群论或连续函数。

patterns.name: 技术方案或构造中的尝试
patterns.context: 说明正在尝试实现政策目标或在数学构造中调整性质。

patterns.name: 协作问题解决中的尝试
patterns.context: 第一人称复数描述正在处理实际问题。

patterns.name: 聊天中的自我描述
patterns.context: 即时聊天中谈论自己努力保持诚实。

en.description: Activation is concentrated mainly on trying (especially when followed by a to-infinitive) and {% block markers in template syntax; there is also activation on multiple character fragments in one long hash string. The first two categories have no evident semantic connection.

patterns.name: trying with an ongoing action
patterns.context: The word «trying» followed by an infinitive or other complement; expresses attempting, striving, or trying to do something in a sentence.
patterns.domain: General English text, including news, Q&A, email, and forums

patterns.name: block markers in templates
patterns.context: In Jinja/Django-style template syntax, the marker is followed by a block name and %}; [2] also contains «{%»10 endblock %}.

patterns.name: Character fragments in an alphanumeric hash string
patterns.context: A continuous hexadecimal-style identifier is split into multiple tokens; no clear natural-language syntactic condition.

6_2728.concept: 多类局部 token 模式
6_2728.description: 激活主要落在 trying（尤其接 to 不定式）和模板语法的 {% block 标记；另有一次长哈希串中多种字符片段激活。前两类彼此无明显语义联系。

patterns.name: trying 搭配进行中的动作
patterns.trigger: «trying»10 to + 动词或动词短语，如 «trying»10 to move、«trying»10 for、«trying»10 to understand
patterns.context: 词 «trying» 后接不定式或其他补语；在句中表达尝试、努力或试图做某事。
patterns.domain: 新闻、问答、邮件、论坛等一般英语文本

patterns.name: 模板中的 block 标记
patterns.context: Jinja/Django 风格模板语法中，标记后接 block 名称及 %}；[2] 还出现 «{%»10 endblock %}。

patterns.name: 字母数字哈希串中的字符片段
patterns.context: 一串连续的十六进制样式标识符被拆成多个 token；没有明显自然语言句法条件。

en.description: Activations primarily fall on partial subwords in personal names, and also on subwords in Postnatal and Robotic/Robust, as well as one HTML template tag. The triggers are inconsistent and cannot be attributed to a single meaning or domain.

patterns.name: Specific segments in names
patterns.context: Activations fall on partial tokens in personal names, often in name entries, headlines, or names in sentences; the segmentation points vary.
patterns.domain: Names in Wikipedia, news headlines, PubMed abstracts, and other corpora

patterns.name: Subwords in Postnatal
patterns.context: Both PubMed excerpts begin with Postnatal, with activations concentrated on its subwords.

patterns.name: Rob- subwords in Robotic and Robust
patterns.context: Two PubMed abstracts contain Robotic and Robust, respectively; activations cover the initial Rob subword and subsequent subwords in each word.

patterns.name: HTML template tag
patterns.context: Activations occur near the head of an HTML document and template syntax, most notably on the template opening symbol.

patterns.name: Final subword in boxer
patterns.context: The word boxer in parentheses is split, with both subwords activating; the same passage also contains the name Stephen Wilson.

6_2728.description: 激活主要落在人名的部分子词上，也出现在 Postnatal、Robotic/Robust 等词的子词及一处 HTML 模板标记；触发条件并不统一，无法归为单一词义或领域。

patterns.name: 姓名中的特定词段
patterns.context: 激活落在人物姓名的部分 token 上，常见于姓名条目、标题或句子中的人名；被切分的位置不统一。
patterns.domain: Wikipedia、新闻标题、PubMed 摘要及其他语料中的人名

patterns.name: Postnatal 的子词
patterns.context: 两个 PubMed 片段均以 Postnatal 开头，激活集中在该词的子词上。

patterns.name: Robotic 与 Robust 的 Rob- 子词
patterns.context: 两个 PubMed 摘要分别出现 Robotic 和 Robust；激活覆盖各自开头的 Rob 子词及后续子词。

patterns.name: HTML 模板标记
patterns.context: 激活出现在 HTML 文档头部及模板语法附近，最明显的是模板起始符号。
patterns.domain: Github 上的 HTML/模板代码

patterns.name: boxer 的词尾子词
patterns.context: 括号中的 boxer 一词被拆分，两个子词均有激活；同段另有 Stephen Wilson 姓名。

en.concept: No stable unified concept; biased toward subword fragments
en.description: Activation falls mainly on subword fragments within names and paper titles/abstracts; there is also one instance involving an actor's name and one involving the expression “for 15 years.” No clear shared semantic or syntactic trigger spans the passages.

patterns.name: Specific subword fragments in names
patterns.context: Activation often falls on subword fragments within names; sometimes the same name is repeated in adjacent text. No clear shared pattern among different names.

patterns.name: Subword fragments in paper titles
patterns.context: Activation is distributed across subword fragments in paper titles or the opening of abstracts, including title case, technical terms, and common words; no unified semantic trigger is evident.

patterns.name: Actor's name in a news context
patterns.context: Appears in an entertainment-news sentence about actor Chloe Grace Moretz attending a film premiere; activation is concentrated on part of her name.

patterns.name: Number fragment in an age expression
patterns.context: Also activates in “for 15 years” at the beginning of a biographical passage; may respond to this fixed phrase or numerical expression, but there is only one example.

6_2728.concept: 无稳定统一概念；偏向词内片段
6_2728.description: 激活主要落在人名及论文标题/摘要中的词内片段；另有一次演员姓名与一次“for 15 years”表达。跨段没有明确共享的语义或句法触发条件。

patterns.name: 人名中的特定词片段
patterns.context: 激活常落在姓名的词内子词片段；有时同一姓名在相邻文本中重复出现。不同名字共享的规律不明显。
patterns.domain: Wikipedia 人物条目及 Pile-CC 人物报道

patterns.name: 论文标题中的词内片段
patterns.context: 激活分布在论文标题或摘要开头的词内片段，包含标题式大小写、专业词以及常见词；未见统一的语义触发词。

patterns.name: 新闻语境中的演员姓名
patterns.context: 出现在演员 Chloe Grace Moretz 出席电影首映的娱乐新闻句子中；激活集中于其姓名的一部分。

patterns.name: 年龄表达中的数字片段
patterns.context: 在人物段落开头的“for 15 years”中同时激活；可能是对该固定短语或数字表达的反应，证据仅一例。

en.description: Activations primarily fall on internal subword fragments in proper names or technical terms, including personal names, place names, and chemical terms. Keywords also occur in reproductive development, mathematical symbolism, and gene-mutation contexts, with no unified semantic pattern.

patterns.name: Subword fragments in proper and technical terms
patterns.context: Activations fall within proper names or technical terms, especially when the English tokenizer splits a word into multiple subwords. The words may be personal names, place names, surnames, or chemical terms, with no shared meaning.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedia entries, paper titles or abstracts, and news about people

patterns.name: Reproductive and puberty-related vocabulary
patterns.context: Occurs in research contexts describing pubertal development in male monkeys or female fertility; activations concentrate on fragments within pubertal and infertile.

patterns.name: Symbolism and mathematics
patterns.context: Discusses the nature of mathematics and its symbolic properties; activations fall not only on subword fragments but also on complete concept words.

patterns.name: Mutation-related expressions
patterns.context: Occurs in abstracts about gene mutations and predicting drug resistance; activations cover the beginning of the word mutation and subsequent fragments.

6_2728.description: 激活主要落在专名或专业词的内部子词片段，涉及人名、地名、化学词等；另见生殖发育、数学符号性和基因突变语境中的关键词，尚无统一语义规律。

patterns.name: 专名中的子词片段
patterns.context: 激活落在专名或专业词内部，特别是英语分词器将词切成多个子词时；词本身可能是人名、地名、姓氏或化学术语，并无共同词义。
patterns.domain: 百科条目、论文标题或摘要、人物新闻

patterns.name: 生殖与青春期词汇
patterns.context: 出现在描述雄性猴子青春期发育或女性生育状况的研究语境，激活集中于 pubertal 和 infertile 的词内片段。
patterns.domain: 生物医学摘要、研究计划

patterns.name: 符号性与数学
patterns.context: 谈论数学本质及其符号属性；激活不只落在分词片段，也包括完整概念词。

patterns.name: 突变相关表达
patterns.context: 位于关于基因突变及药物抗性预测的摘要中，激活覆盖突变一词的开头及后续片段。

en.description: Activations are distributed across various technical texts, including the rearr- stem, ANCOVA statistical analysis, and several unrelated terms from physics, biomedicine, and patents. No single semantic pattern explains all fragments.

patterns.name: rearrange stem
patterns.context: The stem rearr- appears in “rearrange” in a mathematical/physics derivation or “rearranged” in an immunology method; the meanings differ by context.

patterns.name: ANCOVA statistical analysis
patterns.context: Discusses group comparisons, differences in means, or experimental data analysis.

patterns.name: Two-dimensional Lorentz transformation
patterns.context: Describes transformation properties inherited by a model, in a theoretical physics context involving gauges and extra dimensions.

patterns.name: Bosons and Standard Model particles
patterns.context: Discusses photon mass and particles and fields in the Standard Model.

patterns.name: Derivation of energy conservation under a gauge condition
patterns.context: Rearranges the energy-conservation equation after imposing the cosmic gauge condition.

patterns.name: Opioid addiction education and treatment
patterns.context: Describes a low-cost remote course to train physicians and improve their ability to identify and treat addiction.

patterns.name: Spin-anisotropy perturbation
patterns.context: Perturbation calculations of total-spin state splitting under weak onsite anisotropy.

patterns.name: T-cell receptor rearrangement amplification
patterns.context: Multiplex PCR amplifies rearranged CD3R3 regions, followed by high-throughput sequencing.

patterns.name: Evaluation of an aggression-scale intervention
patterns.context: Experimental and control groups are measured with a scale before and after treatment, with follow-up and statistical tests reported.

patterns.name: Horizontal defects in glass containers
patterns.context: Describes difficult-to-detect horizontal linear or mirror-like defects in glass container manufacturing.

6_2728.concept: 专业术语与技术论文词汇
6_2728.description: 激活分布于多种专业文本，包含 rearr- 词干、ANCOVA 统计分析，以及若干彼此不同的物理、生物医学和专利术语；未见能解释全部片段的单一语义模式。

patterns.name: rearrange 词干
patterns.context: 词干 rearr- 出现在数学/物理推导中的“rearrange”或免疫学方法中的“rearranged”；上下文意义不同。
patterns.domain: 理论物理；生物医学论文

patterns.name: ANCOVA 统计分析
patterns.context: 讨论分组比较、均值差异或实验数据分析。

patterns.name: 二维洛伦兹变换
patterns.context: 描述模型继承的变换性质，并涉及规范、额外维度等理论物理语境。

patterns.name: 玻色子与标准模型粒子
patterns.context: 讨论光子质量以及标准模型中的粒子和场。

patterns.name: 规范条件下能量守恒推导
patterns.context: 施加 cosmic gauge 条件后重排能量守恒方程。

patterns.name: 阿片成瘾教育与治疗
patterns.context: 描述培训医生、提升识别和治疗能力的低成本远程课程。

patterns.name: 自旋各向异性微扰
patterns.context: 弱的 onsite 各向异性条件下，微扰计算总自旋态分裂。

patterns.name: T细胞受体重排扩增
patterns.context: 多重 PCR 扩增重排的 CD3R3 区域并进行高通量测序。

patterns.name: 攻击量表干预评估
patterns.context: 实验组与对照组在治疗前后接受量表测量，并报告随访和统计检验。

patterns.name: 玻璃容器水平缺陷
patterns.context: 描述玻璃容器制造中难以检测的水平线状或镜面状缺陷。

en.description: Strong activations occur mainly on “Suppose” in mathematical hypothesis sentences and “important,” which emphasizes effects or motivation in interdisciplinary papers. Other triggers include scattered technical terms, statistics, and words, as well as isolated activations in an automotive essay; the overall pattern is inconsistent.

patterns.name: “Suppose” hypothesis sentences in mathematics
patterns.context: “Suppose” introduces a mathematical hypothesis at the beginning or within a sentence, followed by a symbolic expression; activations concentrate on “Suppose”

patterns.name: Statements of importance in technical papers
patterns.context: Academic prose emphasizes an effect or research motivation; “important” itself has the strongest activation
patterns.domain: Academic texts, including ArXiv, PubMed, NIH ExPorter, etc.

patterns.name: Other local word triggers in academic texts
patterns.context: These words are scattered across papers on different topics, with no unified local sentence pattern; they occur in theoretical introductions, compound identification, statistical analysis, and descriptions of computational methods

patterns.name: Multiword scientific terms and their components
patterns.context: Activations occur near terms in research texts across multiple fields, with inconsistent trigger locations; some fall within term words, while others fall on neighboring words
patterns.domain: Mathematical analysis, evolutionary biology, cell biology, hematology

patterns.name: Scattered words in automotive photography narratives
patterns.context: An essay describes photographing a Porsche; its pattern does not clearly match the other academic data

6_2728.description: 主要在数学假设句的“Suppose”和跨学科论文强调作用或动机的“important”处强激活；另有若干分散术语、统计及词语触发，以及汽车随笔中的孤立激活，整体不统一。

patterns.name: 数学中的“Suppose”假设句
patterns.trigger: « Suppose»；后接变量、表达式或等式，如«0»« =»« -»«a»、« -»«s» +»« 25»
patterns.context: 句首或句中用“Suppose”引入数学假设，后续是符号化表达式；激活集中在“Suppose”

patterns.name: 技术论文中的重要性表述
patterns.trigger: « important»，以及相邻的« role»或« motivation»
patterns.context: 学术叙述中强调某种作用或研究动机；“important”本身激活最强

patterns.name: 学术文本中的其他局部词语触发
patterns.context: 这些词分散在不同主题的论文中，未见统一的局部句式；分别出现于理论介绍、化合物鉴定、统计分析及计算方法描述

patterns.name: 多词科学术语及其组成部分
patterns.trigger: « heat»« kernel»、« convergent»« evolution»、« potassium»« channels»、« co»-«transport»
patterns.context: 多领域科研文本中的术语附近出现激活，触发位置并不一致；其中有些激活落在术语词内，有些落在邻近词上
patterns.domain: 数学分析、进化生物学、细胞生物学、血液学

patterns.name: 汽车摄影叙述中的零散词语
patterns.context: 描述拍摄到一辆 Porsche 的随笔语境；与其余学术语料的模式不明显一致

en.description: The clearest recurring pattern is the fixed discourse marker “Of course” in academic and Q&A texts, appearing across number theory, astrophysics, math Q&A, and combinatorics. Other activations are scattered across applications, words such as line/full, and different disciplinary contexts, with no common trigger condition.

patterns.name: Sentence-initial or discourse-marker “Of course”
patterns.context: A fixed phrase used at the beginning of a sentence or between clauses to concede or add a point; followed by a comma or directly by further discussion

patterns.name: “world” in research-application contexts
patterns.context: “world” occurs in the phrase “real world applications,” discussing the use of a method in practical applications

patterns.name: “line” in structural analysis
patterns.context: “line” occurs with “Command-” to refer to a command-line tool
patterns.domain: ArXiv academic papers, computational materials/software tools

patterns.name: Inline content in programs
patterns.context: “line” occurs with “In-” as part of an experimental method or procedure name
patterns.domain: PubMed Central, molecular biology experimental methods

patterns.name: “full” in expressions
patterns.context: Used as a compound suffix in mathematical terminology to describe a divisibility property of numbers

patterns.name: Words related to “line” in descriptions of significance or strength
patterns.context: Occurs when cautiously qualifying the attribution of astronomical absorption features

patterns.name: General background or connective words
patterns.context: Technical Q&A explains memory deallocation, reuse, and paging; the trigger points do not form a stable phrase

patterns.name: Terms related to researchers and applications
patterns.context: Discusses the relationship between researchers and research applications, and its limitations

6_2728.description: 最清楚的重复模式是学术与问答文本中的固定话语标记“Of course”，跨数论、天体物理、数学问答及组合数学出现。其余激活分散在应用、line/full等词及不同学科语境中，缺乏共同触发条件。

patterns.name: 句首或话语标记“Of course”
patterns.trigger: “Of” + “ course”；最强出现在 [2] 的 “Of course”
patterns.context: 作为句首或句间让步、补充说明的固定短语，后面接逗号或直接接续论述
patterns.domain: 跨领域学术及问答文本

patterns.name: 研究应用语境中的“world”
patterns.context: “world”处于“real world applications”这一短语内，讨论方法在现实应用中的使用
patterns.domain: ArXiv 学术论文，应用建模

patterns.name: 结构分析中的“line”
patterns.context: “line”与“Command-”连用，指命令行工具
patterns.domain: ArXiv 学术论文，计算材料/软件工具

patterns.name: 程序中的行内内容
patterns.context: “line”与“In-”连用，作为实验方法或步骤名称的一部分
patterns.domain: PubMed Central，分子生物学实验方法

patterns.name: 表达式中的“full”
patterns.context: 数学术语中作为复合词后缀，描述数的整除性质

patterns.name: 显著性或强度描述中的“line”相关词
patterns.context: 在对天文吸收特征的归因进行审慎限定时出现

patterns.name: 背景性或顺承的普通词项
patterns.context: 技术问答中解释内存释放、复用和分页过程；触发点彼此并不形成稳定短语

patterns.name: 研究者群体及应用相关词项
patterns.trigger: “Relatively few researchers are engaged with the application”中的 “Relatively”
patterns.context: 论述研究者与研究应用之间的关联及其不足

en.concept: Emphatic modifiers and connective expressions in academic discourse
en.description: Activations often occur on sentence-initial connectors or evaluative adverbs in academic paragraphs, as well as expressions such as Better, Relatively, and sufficiently high. A few also fall on importance, linear polarization, rare mathematical words, and astrophysical descriptions. The trigger meanings are not uniform.

patterns.name: Sentence-initial connector For
patterns.context: Connects to preceding text at the beginning of a sentence, then introduces a condition, case, or discussion; sections 2 and 8 are followed by “sufficiently high,” while section 7 is followed by “linearly polarized light.”
patterns.domain: Academic papers, physics and materials science

patterns.name: Sentence-initial comparative Better
patterns.context: Begins a comparison or introduces an improvement, followed by a noun phrase; section 1 has “Better understanding,” and section 4 has “Better fits.”

patterns.name: Sentence-initial evaluative adverb -ably
patterns.context: Introduces an explanation, observation, or evaluation at the beginning or within a sentence; activations fall on adverb fragments split at token boundaries.
patterns.domain: Patent technical descriptions, medical abstracts, astrophysics papers

patterns.name: Sentence-initial Relatively
patterns.context: Qualifies degree, followed by a description of a property or quantity; section 4 has “relatively narrow,” and section 6 has “Relatively weak.”

patterns.name: Morpheme fragment -ably within an uncommon word
patterns.context: Modifies “many inverse images” in a mathematical context; activations primarily correspond to the latter part of a rare adverb.

patterns.name: Statement of importance in section 1
patterns.context: A research proposal lists important information the study will provide; the same section also contains “Better understanding.”

patterns.name: Sufficiently high condition in section 2
patterns.context: Sentence-initial For introduces a condition or outcome that applies when a sufficiently high threshold is reached.

patterns.name: Sufficiently high condition in section 8
patterns.context: Sentence-initial For describes the case where the dielectric constant is sufficiently high.

patterns.name: Linear-polarization condition in section 7
patterns.context: The conditional clause introduced by For describes the polarization state of light.

patterns.name: Order-of-magnitude and cooling description in section 10
patterns.context: Describes galactic nuclear activity, hot gas cooling, and star formation; activations are scattered across quantities, split word fragments, and sentence-initial Remarkably.

6_2728.concept: 学术论述中的突出修饰与承接表达
6_2728.description: 激活多见于学术段落中的句首连接或评价副词，以及 Better、Relatively、sufficiently high 等表达；也有少数落在重要、线偏振、数学罕词和天体物理描述上。触发词义并不统一。

patterns.name: 句首连接词 For
patterns.context: 句首承接前文，随后引出条件、情形或论述；段 2、8 后接 “sufficiently high”，段 7 后接 “linearly polarized light”。
patterns.domain: 学术论文，物理与材料科学

patterns.name: 句首比较级 Better
patterns.context: 句首比较或引出改进效果，后接名词短语；段 1 为 “Better understanding”，段 4 为 “Better fits”。

patterns.name: 句首评价副词 -ably
patterns.context: 在句首或句中引入说明、观察结果或评价；激活落在由分词边界拆开的副词片段上。
patterns.domain: 专利技术描述、医学摘要、天体物理论文

patterns.name: 句首 Relatively
patterns.context: 限定程度，后接性质或数量描述；段 4 为 “relatively narrow”，段 6 为 “Relatively weak”。
patterns.domain: 天体物理与生物医学论文

patterns.name: 不常见词内部的词素片段 -ably
patterns.context: 数学语境中修饰 “many inverse images”；激活主要对应罕见副词的后半部分。

patterns.name: 段 1 的重要性表述
patterns.context: 研究计划列出研究将提供的重要信息；同段还出现 “Better understanding”。

patterns.name: 段 2 的充分高条件
patterns.context: 句首 For 后引出达到足够高阈值时的条件或结果。

patterns.name: 段 8 的充分高条件
patterns.context: 句首 For 后描述介电常数取值足够高的情形。

patterns.name: 段 7 的线偏振条件
patterns.context: For 引出的条件从句中描述光的偏振状态。

patterns.name: 段 10 的数量级与冷却描述
patterns.trigger: “eight orders of magnitude larger”；«cop» + «ious»（“copious”）；“cooling to low temperatures”
patterns.context: 描述星系核活动、热气体冷却及恒星形成；激活分散在数量表达、拆分词片段及句首 Remarkably。

en.description: All excerpts strongly activate on the sentence-initial speculative words Maybe and Perhaps, often used to introduce uncertain explanations, suggestions, counterfactuals, or qualified judgments. Other activations vary with topic, including technical problem-solving, evaluation, careers, products, statistics, interfaces, and investment discussions.

patterns.name: Sentence-initial speculation or qualified judgment
patterns.context: Often occurs at the beginning of a sentence or new turn, introducing an uncertain explanation, suggestion, possibility, or qualification of a preceding argument; it is often followed by subjects such as it/you/the, but is not limited to one syntax.
patterns.domain: Forum discussions, Q&A, technical and career advice

patterns.name: Progression or temporal development expressions
patterns.context: Activates when describing development over time, future directions, or ongoing improvement; adjacent to a speculative sentence in section 1.

patterns.name: Problem solving and questions about possibilities
patterns.context: In technical Q&A, expresses uncertainty, asks whether something can be done, or requests a solution; activations are scattered before and after speculative words.

patterns.name: Cautious evaluation of a technical approach or proposal
patterns.context: First qualifies an understanding of someone else's claim, then raises possible shortcomings or technical concerns.

patterns.name: Nonnegative interpretation of experiences or choices
patterns.context: When discussing personal experiences such as a resume gap, suggests what others might assume and softens the judgment with “not a bad thing.”

patterns.name: Product-market fit and value judgments
patterns.context: Discusses whether a product is worth paying for and whether a problem should be blamed on the company or the market.

patterns.name: Counterfactual scenarios and conditional speculation
patterns.context: Responds to a point by questioning whether the hypothesized world could exist, then shifts to a conditional sentence.

patterns.name: Qualified stance after citing a source
patterns.context: After citing a ranking or statistic, first indicates that it seems reasonable, while adding reservations about the data source or statistical method.

patterns.name: Comparisons and open-ended questions
patterns.context: Compares technical approaches or asks a sincere question, then turns to an explanation of a mobile interface.

patterns.name: Nonbinary conclusion about an investment decision
patterns.context: First asks whether a particular advertising spend is the best choice, then uses repeated maybe to indicate an uncertain conclusion.

6_2728.description: 全部片段都强烈激活于句首推测词 Maybe、Perhaps，常用于引入不确定解释、建议、反事实或保留判断；其余激活随各自话题而异，涵盖技术求解、评估、职业、产品、统计、界面与投资讨论。

patterns.name: 句首的推测或保留判断
patterns.context: 常出现在句首或新句开头，引入不确定解释、建议、可能性或对前文论点的限定；后续常接 it/you/the 等主语，但不限于某一种句法。
patterns.domain: 论坛讨论、问答、技术与职业建议

patterns.name: 递进或时间推进表达
patterns.context: 在描述随时间发展、未来走向或持续改善时激活；与段1的推测句相邻。

patterns.name: 问题求解与可能性询问
patterns.context: 技术问答中表达不确定、询问某事能否实现，或请求解决方案；激活分散在推测词前后。

patterns.name: 对技术路径或方案的审慎评估
patterns.context: 先限定对他人主张的理解，再提出可能的缺陷或技术疑虑。

patterns.name: 对经历或选择作非负面解释
patterns.context: 讨论简历空档等个人经历时，提出他人可能的猜测，并以“not a bad thing”缓和评价。

patterns.name: 产品市场适配与价值判断
patterns.context: 讨论产品是否足以让用户付费，以及问题是否应归咎于公司或市场。

patterns.name: 反事实情景与条件推测
patterns.context: 回应一个观点后，质疑假设世界是否可能存在，并转入条件句。

patterns.name: 引述来源后的保留态度
patterns.context: 引用排名或统计后先表示看似合理，同时补充对数据来源或统计方法的保留。

patterns.name: 比较与开放式问题
patterns.context: 提出技术方案比较或诚恳询问，随后转向对移动界面的解释。

patterns.name: 投资决策的非二元结论
patterns.context: 先问某项广告投入是否为最佳选择，再用重复的 maybe 表示结论不确定。

en.description: The strongest pattern is “In brief” introducing a procedure in methods passages; another group uses “In practice” to introduce real-world circumstances in technical or patent contexts. The rest concern requesting technical resources, evaluating a career break, and compensating for performance degradation.

patterns.name: Introduction to method steps
patterns.context: Appears in sentences describing experimental or analytical procedures, followed by a brief explanation of specific steps; activation is concentrated on brief and nearby punctuation.
patterns.domain: Paper methods sections, biomedical studies, and materials/analytical experiments

patterns.name: The expression “In practice”
patterns.context: Introduces behavior, effects, or parameters in actual operation or application.
patterns.domain: Technical discussions, software/hardware documentation, and patent text

patterns.name: Requesting resources and understanding a technical topic
patterns.context: A forum poster says they know little about a technical topic and asks others for learning resources.

patterns.name: Tolerant assessment of a sabbatical
patterns.context: Discusses a work gap on a resume, says taking time off is not bad, and speculates about what someone may have done during the break.

patterns.name: Compensating for performance degradation
patterns.context: Explains that material slows performance, followed by a compensatory measure; this is not the preceding fixed-phrase pattern.

6_2728.description: 最强模式是方法段落用“In brief”引出流程；另一组在技术或专利语境用“In practice”引出实际情况。其余分别涉及求技术资料、评价职业空档及补偿性能下降。

patterns.name: 方法步骤导入语
patterns.context: 出现在描述实验或分析流程的句子中，后接简要说明具体操作步骤；激活集中于 brief 及其标点附近。
patterns.domain: 论文方法部分、生物医学与材料/分析实验

patterns.name: 实践中这一表达
patterns.trigger: « In»…« practice»（[6]« In»1« practice»8,；[7]« In»2« practice»8«,»；[9]« In»1« practice»8«,»）
patterns.context: 用来引出实际运行或应用中的行为、效果或参数情况。
patterns.domain: 技术讨论、软件/硬件文档、专利文本

patterns.name: 请求资源与理解技术主题
patterns.context: 论坛发帖者表示自己对某技术主题了解不足，并向他人索取学习资料。

patterns.name: 对休假经历的宽容评价
patterns.context: 讨论简历中工作空档，认为休假并非坏事，并猜测休假期间可能做了什么。

patterns.name: 补偿性能下降
patterns.context: 说明因材料导致性能变慢，继而采取补偿措施；不是前述固定短语模式。

en.description: Primarily favors procedural cues and conditional phrases in methods or explanatory texts, especially “In brief,” and “For sufficiently.” It also responds sporadically to line breaks, progression/inference connectors, code safety and comments, and fragments of statistical and biomedical terms.

patterns.name: Opening a methods step
patterns.context: Introduces a specific experimental or analytical procedure, or gives an explanation with conditions; the trigger word is often followed by a comma and detailed steps.
patterns.domain: Paper methods, scientific and technical explanations

patterns.name: Contrast or progression after procedural steps
patterns.context: Uses an ordinal word to introduce the next task when stating a research question or experimental plan.

patterns.name: Sentence-initial connector for an inference
patterns.context: Introduces a conclusion after a preceding comparison or argument, followed by conditions such as dose-grid spacing.

patterns.name: Line breaks and paragraph boundaries
patterns.context: Activations occur near newline markers, especially at methods-paragraph or code-line boundaries; they may also co-occur with a nearby “In brief” or a change in content.

patterns.name: Safe-use constraints
patterns.context: Describes safety conditions that concurrent program components must satisfy.

patterns.name: Missing data and distribution assumptions
patterns.context: A sentence begins by proposing a method for handling missing data and states that no particular distribution shape is assumed.

patterns.name: Explanatory guidance in code comments
patterns.context: A code comment directs readers to an external explanation or link.

patterns.name: Possible domain-specific term fragments
patterns.context: These terms occur respectively in quantitative analysis, lesion sampling, and dose-distribution descriptions; only local words are marked, with no stable shared syntax.

patterns.name: SADs terminology marker
patterns.context: The gene or protein name SADs is split and marked in a statement about synaptic development.

6_2728.concept: 程序说明与条件引导语
6_2728.description: 主要偏好方法或说明性文本中的程序引导与条件短语，尤其“In brief,”和“For sufficiently”；另对换行、递进/推论连接词、代码安全与注释、统计和生物医学术语片段有零散响应。

patterns.name: 方法步骤的开头
patterns.context: 引出实验或分析的具体流程，或给出带条件限制的说明；触发词后常接逗号和详细步骤。
patterns.domain: 论文方法、科学技术说明

patterns.name: 程序化步骤后的转折或递进
patterns.context: 在陈述研究问题或实验计划时，以序数词引出下一项工作。

patterns.name: 结果推论的句首连接词
patterns.context: 在前文比较或论证后引出结论，后接剂量网格间距等条件。

patterns.name: 换行与段落边界
patterns.context: 激活出现在换行标记附近，尤其是方法段落或代码行边界；也可能与相邻的“In brief”或内容切换共同出现。

patterns.name: 安全使用约束
patterns.context: 描述并发程序组件必须满足的使用安全条件。

patterns.name: 数据缺失与分布假设
patterns.context: 句首提出缺失数据处理方法，并说明不作特定分布形状假设。

patterns.name: 代码注释中的解释指引
patterns.context: 代码注释引导读者查看外部说明或链接。

patterns.name: 可能的领域术语片段
patterns.context: 这些术语分别出现在定量分析、病变取样和剂量分布描述中；仅局部词语被标记，未显示稳定共同句法。
patterns.domain: 生物医学与剂量学论文

patterns.name: SADs术语标记
patterns.context: 基因或蛋白名称SADs在研究突触发育的陈述中被拆分标记。

en.description: Activation is dispersed across various expressions: degree, practical explanation, conversational response, examples and sequencing, as well as supplementary notes or later reminders in code; no clear unified morphological or domain pattern is evident.

patterns.name: “sufficiently” modifying degree
patterns.context: The degree adverb “sufficiently” is followed by an adjective, expressing that a condition or degree has been reached.
patterns.domain: Academic papers and medical/physics technical writing

patterns.name: “In practice” introducing real-world circumstances
patterns.context: The phrase “In practice” serves as a sentence-initial or medial transition/explanatory marker, introducing practical circumstances.

patterns.name: Repeated “Okay” discourse marker
patterns.context: In conversation, repeatedly opens a response, transition, or confirmation with Okay or Ok.

patterns.name: Example introducer
patterns.context: Uses “For instance” to introduce a specific example.

patterns.name: Sequencing marker “Second”
patterns.context: Uses “Second” to introduce the next item in a list or argument.

patterns.name: “For further explanation” introducing supplementary explanation
patterns.context: In code comments, directs readers to an external link for more explanation.

patterns.name: “Remember for later” prompting future use
patterns.context: In code comments, reminds readers to save information for later use.

6_2728.description: 激活分散在多种表达中：充分程度、实践说明、对话回应、举例与顺序标记，以及代码中的补充说明或后续提醒；没有明显统一的词形或领域模式。

patterns.name: “sufficiently”修饰程度
patterns.context: 程度副词“sufficiently”后接形容词，表达达到某种条件或程度。
patterns.domain: 学术论文、医学/物理技术文体

patterns.name: “In practice”引出实际情形
patterns.context: 短语“In practice”作为句首或句中转折/说明语，引出实践中的情况。

patterns.name: 重复的“Okay”话语标记
patterns.context: 对话中反复以Okay或Ok开启回应、转折或确认。

patterns.name: 举例引导语
patterns.context: 用“For instance”引入具体例子。
patterns.domain: 技术说明、数学/算法文档

patterns.name: 顺序标记“Second”
patterns.context: 列举或推进论述时，以“Second”引出下一项。

patterns.name: “For further explanation”引导补充说明
patterns.context: 代码注释中提示读者查看外部链接以了解更多解释。

patterns.name: “Remember for later”提示后续使用
patterns.context: 代码注释中提醒将信息留待后续使用。

en.description: The strongest pattern across multiple excerpts is the contrastive-additive phrase “That said.” There are also degree conditions involving sufficiently and scattered technical, comparative, forum, and personal expressions, with no unified semantic pattern.

patterns.name: Concessive transition “That said”
patterns.context: Introduces an addition, qualification, or contrast after a preceding statement or concession; across multiple sections, That and said are adjacent and form the primary trigger sequence
patterns.domain: Forums, technical discussions, personal commentary, and general narratives

patterns.name: Condition qualifier “sufficiently”
patterns.context: Sufficiently modifies degree or a condition, often in technical statements

patterns.name: than in a price comparison
patterns.context: Compares the prices of different sizes of fries; no other clear context is evident

patterns.name: list and post in an online forum
patterns.context: Discusses a post being removed from a moderation list, whether it is displayed directly, and compliance with guidelines

patterns.name: frameworks in a technical context
patterns.context: Discusses whether frameworks using process-level concurrency are configured for multiprocessing

patterns.name: Course and expressions of imagination
patterns.context: A concessive or additive expression beginning with course, followed by an expression of imagining someone else's view

patterns.name: Screen space and rule
patterns.context: Describes an Emacs window layout, then turns to a principle of screen space

patterns.name: where in a scientific formula
patterns.context: After a formula, where introduces definitions of variables or parameters, near a sufficiently high condition

patterns.name: Gaming preferences and way
patterns.context: Personal discussion of gaming preferences, whether others can understand them, and related matters

patterns.name: Rust language advice
patterns.context: Discusses whether to keep up with changes to the Rust language and advises whether to use Rust for a project

patterns.name: Focal points and color in interior design
patterns.context: Describes spatial design, an island as a gathering focal point, and the effect of a dark charcoal color

6_2728.description: 最强且跨多段的模式是转折补充短语 “That said”；另有 sufficiently 程度条件，以及若干分散的技术、比较、论坛和个人叙述词组，未形成统一语义模式。

patterns.name: 让步转折语「That said」
patterns.context: 前文陈述或让步后，用来引出补充、限制或转折；在多个段落中，That 与 said 邻接并成为主要触发串
patterns.domain: 论坛、技术讨论、个人评论及一般叙述

patterns.name: 限定条件「sufficiently」
patterns.trigger: «sufficiently»，后接形容词，如 «sufficiently»10« small»2、« sufficiently»9« high»4
patterns.context: 以 sufficiently 修饰程度或条件，常位于技术陈述中

patterns.name: 价格比较中的 than
patterns.trigger: «than»，与 «regular»、价格及 «as opposed» 等比较表达同现
patterns.context: 比较不同规格薯条的价格；未见其他明显语境

patterns.name: 在线论坛中的 list 与 post
patterns.context: 谈论帖子被移出 moderation list、是否直接显示及遵守指南

patterns.name: 技术语境中的 frameworks
patterns.context: 讨论使用进程级并发的框架是否配置为多进程

patterns.name: 课程与想象表达
patterns.context: 以 course 开头的让步或补充语气，随后表达对他人观点的想象

patterns.name: 屏幕空间与 rule
patterns.context: 描述 Emacs 窗口布局后转入屏幕空间的原则

patterns.name: 科学公式中的 where
patterns.context: 公式后用 where 引入变量或参数定义，邻近 sufficiently high 条件

patterns.name: 游戏偏好与 way
patterns.context: 个人谈论游戏偏好、他人是否能理解及相关事物

patterns.name: Rust 语言建议
patterns.context: 讨论是否跟进 Rust 语言变化，并给出是否用 Rust 写项目的建议

patterns.name: 室内设计的焦点与色彩
patterns.context: 描述空间设计、岛台作为聚会焦点，以及深炭色效果

en.description: Activation often falls on adverbs and phrases that qualify degree or conditions, such as optionally, sufficiently, adequately, successful, and otherwise; discourse transition markers also appear. Other items are sporadic, span domains, and lack a unified syntactic pattern.

patterns.name: Optional items and qualifying phrases
patterns.context: “Optionally” is followed by optional materials, processing, or combinations; “as …” phrases also introduce conditions or manner.
patterns.domain: Patent technical background concerning material formulations and oil/gas processing

patterns.name: Threshold conditions introduced by sufficiently
patterns.context: “Sufficiently” is followed by degree terms such as small or high, qualifying a calculation or physical condition as being adequate.
patterns.domain: Medical dosimetry, philosophy/probability theory, and physics papers

patterns.name: Adequacy requirements introduced by adequately
patterns.context: Modifies a study or trial, indicating that its statistical power should be adequate.

patterns.name: Success conditions introduced by successful
patterns.context: “Successful” modifies construction; the following text describes compilation and integration of software components.
patterns.domain: Patent technical background and software builds

patterns.name: Otherwise and licensing restrictions
patterns.context: Appears in license terms and refers to copying, modification, sublicensing, or distribution except as expressly permitted.

patterns.name: Concessive or contrastive discourse markers
patterns.context: Used to express acceptance of an outcome or to make a transition before introducing an additional point.

patterns.name: Possible degree adverbs/qualifiers
patterns.context: Occur respectively in comparative structures, duration conditions, and phrases indicating sequence; no clear shared trigger token.
patterns.domain: Medical and philosophy papers, and software patents

patterns.name: Domain terms or sporadic collocations
patterns.context: These words occur in routine sentences in their respective domains, with no stable shared local trigger structure.

6_2728.description: 激活多落在限定程度或条件的副词及短语，如 optionally、sufficiently、adequately、successful、otherwise，也见语篇转折标记；另有零散词项，跨领域且缺乏统一句法模式。

patterns.name: 可选项与限定短语
patterns.context: “Optionally”后接可选的材料、处理或组合；也出现“as …”引导的条件或方式短语。
patterns.domain: 专利技术背景，涉及材料配方和油气处理

patterns.name: sufficiently 引导的阈值条件
patterns.context: “sufficiently”后接 small、high 等程度词，限定某项计算或物理条件达到足够程度。
patterns.domain: 医学剂量学、哲学/概率论、物理学论文

patterns.name: adequately 引导的充分性要求
patterns.context: 修饰研究或试验，表示其统计效能应达到充分水平。

patterns.name: successful 引导的成功条件
patterns.context: “successful”修饰构建，后文描述程序组件的编译与集成。
patterns.domain: 专利技术背景，软件构建

patterns.name: otherwise 及许可限制
patterns.context: 出现在许可证条款中，指除明确许可外的复制、修改、再许可或分发行为。

patterns.name: 让步或转折语篇标记
patterns.context: 用于表达接受某种结果，或在提出补充观点前作转折。

patterns.name: 可能的程度副词/限定语
patterns.context: 分别处于比较结构、持续时间条件，以及表示先后顺序的短语中；共享触发 token 不明显。
patterns.domain: 医学、哲学论文与软件专利

patterns.name: 领域词或零散搭配
patterns.context: 这些词出现在各自领域的常规句子中，未见稳定的共同局部触发结构。

en.description: Activations concentrate on expressions involving conditions, thresholds, and exceptions or contrasts, and also cover research adequacy, phase completion, operational timing cues, and conversational confirmation. These uses are scattered across legal, academic, technical, and forum texts.

patterns.name: otherwise conditional contrast
patterns.context: Introduces a contrary case or exception after a condition, permission, or rule; in [1], “Any attempt…” precedes otherwise, while [9] uses it to introduce “Otherwise, it is permitted…”

patterns.name: sufficiently high threshold condition
patterns.context: Describes a property or outcome that holds once a quantity reaches a sufficiently high threshold
patterns.domain: Academic papers, physics and materials science

patterns.name: appropriate conditional modifier
patterns.context: Qualifies whether an initial value, covariance, or probability distribution is suitable; includes both appropriate and inappropriate choices
patterns.domain: Academic papers, statistical inference and modeling

patterns.name: adequately powered research adequacy
patterns.context: In discussions of evidence, uncertainty, and future research, states that studies need sufficient statistical power

patterns.name: Timing condition cue
patterns.context: Instructs readers to note any time an operation occurs, followed by instructions for connecting dual monitors

patterns.name: successful completion of a phase
patterns.context: Describes a project or clinical phase being completed successfully, followed by entry into the next phase
patterns.domain: Research grants or biomedical development programs

patterns.name: Ok turn confirmation
patterns.context: In informal conversation, uses a brief question to seek confirmation or a response

6_2728.description: 激活集中于限定条件、阈值和例外转折等表达，也覆盖研究充分性、阶段完成、操作时间提示及对话确认；这些用法分散于法律、学术、技术和论坛文本。

patterns.name: otherwise 条件转折
patterns.context: 在条件、许可或规定之后引出相反情形或例外；[1] 中 otherwise 前有“Any attempt…”，[9] 中引出“Otherwise, it is permitted…”
patterns.domain: 软件许可证与法律式条款

patterns.name: sufficiently high 阈值条件
patterns.context: 描述某量达到足够高的阈值后，性质或结果成立
patterns.domain: 学术论文，物理与材料科学

patterns.name: appropriate 条件修饰
patterns.context: 对初始值、协方差或概率分布是否合适作限定；既包括适当选择，也包括不恰当选择
patterns.domain: 学术论文，统计推断与建模

patterns.name: adequately powered 研究充分性
patterns.context: 在讨论证据、不确定性与后续研究时，说明研究需要有足够统计效能

patterns.name: 时间条件提示
patterns.context: 指导读者留意某种操作发生的任何时刻，后接连接双显示器的说明

patterns.name: successful completion 阶段完成
patterns.context: 描述项目或临床阶段顺利完成，随后进入下一阶段
patterns.domain: 科研资助或生物医学研发计划

patterns.name: Ok 话轮确认
patterns.context: 非正式对话中，以简短问句寻求确认或回应

en.concept: Common function words and fixed collocations
en.description: The main response is to matter in the concessive structure “No matter …”; there is also strong activation for time in “any time soon/that,” patent-preferred adverbs, and otherwise in licenses.

patterns.name: No matter concessive structure
patterns.context: Followed by what, how, or a restricted noun phrase, indicating regardless of the conditions; often appears mid-sentence or sentence-initially
patterns.domain: Forum discussions, Q&A, technical commentary, and general articles

patterns.name: Fixed expression “any time ... soon”
patterns.context: “any time soon” means something is unlikely to happen in the near future; often surrounded by unlikely, doubt, or a negative prediction

patterns.name: Time-condition phrase any time that
patterns.context: Introduces a condition for an operation such as connecting a device, followed by a that-clause

patterns.name: Preferably / Ideally in patent writing
patterns.context: Functions as a sentence-initial or medial adverb in patent descriptions, introducing preferred or ideal embodiments

patterns.name: otherwise in licenses
patterns.context: Restricts behavior not explicitly authorized in legal license terms

6_2728.concept: 常见功能词与固定搭配
6_2728.description: 主要响应 matter 出现在“No matter …”让步结构中；另对“any time soon/that”里的 time，以及专利偏好副词和许可证 otherwise 有强激活。

patterns.name: no matter 不管怎样
patterns.context: 后接 what、how 或限定名词短语，表示无论条件如何；多出现在句中或句首
patterns.domain: 论坛讨论、问答、技术评论及一般文章

patterns.name: any time ... soon 固定表达
patterns.context: “any time soon”表示短期内不太可能发生；周围常有 unlikely、doubt 或否定预测

patterns.name: 时间条件短语 any time that
patterns.context: 引出连接设备等操作发生时的条件，后接 that 从句

patterns.name: 专利文体的 Preferably / Ideally
patterns.context: 在专利描述中作为句首或句中副词，引出优选或理想实施方式

patterns.name: 许可证中的 otherwise
patterns.context: 法律许可条款中限定未获明确授权时的行为

en.description: The most stable pattern is the “No matter what” concessive construction, especially matter/what. Other activations are scattered across that/demonstrative connectives and several comparative, evaluative, or technical words, with no consistent semantic or syntactic condition.

patterns.name: “no matter what” concessive construction
patterns.context: Introduces, at the beginning or within a sentence, a concessive/emphatic construction meaning that the following conclusion holds regardless of what happens; in paragraph 2, “No matter what” is split across lines, and the final word itself also has high activation.
patterns.domain: Informal discussions such as forums, Q&A, and email; also legal texts

patterns.name: “that” clauses or demonstrative constructions
patterns.context: Across passages, that/this-like relational or demonstrative connectives, prepositional phrases, or nominalized expressions appear; trigger locations vary, with no consistent local syntactic condition.
patterns.domain: Technical explanations, forum posts, patents, and open-source license texts

patterns.name: Emphasis words in degree or comparative expressions
patterns.context: Strong activation falls on a subword fragment within a word or on an adjective, used respectively to compare peaks, evaluate a successful build, and describe incomplete draining; their semantic functions are not fully aligned.

patterns.name: Other sporadic lexical activations
patterns.context: Only isolated low-intensity activations occur, and the surrounding contexts do not form a stable shared condition with other passages.
patterns.domain: Academic job-search discussions, programming discussions, license texts, everyday advice, and fantasy Q&A

6_2728.concept: 让步表达及零散衔接词
6_2728.description: 最稳定的模式是“No matter what”让步句式，尤其是 matter/what；其余激活分散在 that/指示衔接及若干比较、评价或技术词中，缺少一致的语义或句法条件。

patterns.name: “no matter what”让步结构
patterns.trigger: «matter»9/10« what»2/3，常见完整子串“No matter what”
patterns.context: 在句首或句中引出不论发生什么、后续结论仍成立的让步/强调结构；第2段为“No matter what”跨行断开，末尾词本身也有高激活。
patterns.domain: 论坛、问答、邮件等非正式论述，也见法律文本

patterns.name: “that”从句或指示结构
patterns.trigger: 第1段«time»10及«that»5；第3段«Failing»10及«that»4；第4段«during»5后接«a»2；第7段«mere»9；第9段«building»5
patterns.context: 各段中出现 that/this 类关系或指示性衔接、介词短语，或名词化表达；触发位置并不一致，未见统一的局部句法条件。
patterns.domain: 技术说明、论坛帖子、专利、开源许可证文本

patterns.name: 程度或比较表达中的强调词
patterns.context: 强激活落在词内子词或形容词上，分别用于比较峰值、评价成功构建，以及描述未完成的排空；语义功能不完全相同。

patterns.name: 其他零散词项激活
patterns.context: 仅有低强度单次激活，周围语境与其他段落难以形成稳定共同条件。
patterns.domain: 学术求职讨论、编程讨论、许可证文本、生活建议、奇幻问答

en.description: Activation often occurs in phrases introducing time, conditions, circumstances, steps, or argumentative consequences, and also within words such as “Failing” and “Incorrect”; it spans various technical, academic, and legal styles, with no uniform specific trigger.

patterns.name: Time, condition, or circumstance introducers
patterns.context: Often introduce a time, condition, circumstance, or step mid-sentence; many activations fall on the introductory phrase or the word immediately following it.
patterns.domain: Technical explanations, academic papers, and patents

patterns.name: Phrase complements and statements of results
patterns.context: In technical or argumentative text, phrases explain consequences, limitations, permitted operations, or implementation conditions; some strong activations fall within words such as “Failing” and “Incorrect”.
patterns.domain: Technical forum discussions, research papers, and patents

patterns.name: Position statements in legal argument
patterns.context: Introduces an argument raised by one party in a legal judgment or litigation material.

patterns.name: No stable local trigger word evident
patterns.context: These activations may relate to the semantics or syntax of the sentences in which they occur, but there is insufficient evidence to classify them as a stable, independent trigger pattern.

6_2728.description: 激活多见于引出时间、条件、情形、步骤或论证后果的短语，也见于“Failing”“Incorrect”等词内；覆盖多种技术、学术及法律文体，具体触发并不统一。

patterns.name: 时间、条件或情形引导语
patterns.trigger: “time that”[1]、“when”[5]、“In cases”[5][6]、“Close to”[7]、“In addition”[8]、“In building”[10]、“prior to”[10]
patterns.context: 常在句中引出时间、条件、情形或步骤；不少激活落在引导短语或紧随其后的词上。
patterns.domain: 技术说明、学术论文、专利

patterns.name: 短语补足与结果表述
patterns.trigger: “Failing that”[2]、“Incorrect results would represent”[3]、“missed cleavages were allowed”[4]、“successfully construction”[10]
patterns.context: 技术或论证文本中，以短语说明后果、限制、允许的操作或实现条件；部分强激活落在词内，如“Failing”“Incorrect”。
patterns.domain: 论坛技术讨论、科研论文、专利

patterns.name: 法律论证中的立场表达
patterns.context: 法律判决或诉讼材料中，引出一方提出某项论点。

patterns.name: 未见稳定的局部触发词
patterns.context: 这些激活可能与所在句子的语义或句法有关，但不足以归入稳定、独立的触发模式。

en.concept: Local function words and process expressions
en.description: Strong activations are scattered across several phrase types and word forms: “up to” recurs, alongside temporal limits, conditional clauses, incompleteness/failure, and outcome expressions. The rest are mostly domain-specific collocations, with limited cross-genre consistency.

patterns.name: Fixed phrase “up to”
patterns.context: up to is followed by quantities, deadlines, phases, and similar items, often indicating a limit or degree; includes both sentence-initial capitalization and mid-sentence forms.
patterns.domain: Science, patents, forums, and general expository prose

patterns.name: Responses and objections in legal proceedings
patterns.context: Specifies a response deadline and states the consequences of not responding or a party's objection to a settlement agreement.

patterns.name: “until” temporal boundary
patterns.context: Describes a state lasting up to a point in time, or a mechanism continuing until a specific event occurs.
patterns.domain: Forum explanations and patent technical texts

patterns.name: Conditional word “that”
patterns.context: that introduces a clause or temporal condition; this is the strongest activation in the provided snippets.
patterns.domain: Informal forum language and technical explanations

patterns.name: Incompleteness and its consequences
patterns.context: Describes an incompletely performed action or an erroneous prefetch, followed by its effects or handling.

patterns.name: Time/phase progression expressions
patterns.context: Uses during or upon to mark the period when an operation occurs or the time when an event occurs.

patterns.name: Outcome or result words
patterns.context: Mentions failure, inability to do something, or an outcome caused by a situation; these occur in different semantic structures.
patterns.domain: Legal documents, forum discussions, and patent texts

patterns.name: “as” in collocations
patterns.context: Uses as to mark a use or assigned property, appearing in a description of experimental methods.

patterns.name: Polymerization process and degree of completion
patterns.context: Describes a polymerization reaction progressing over time, gradually completing, or being interrupted.

patterns.name: Word forms related to objections
patterns.context: Concerns whether an objection is raised and its procedural consequences.

patterns.name: Local “it” reference
patterns.context: it refers to a preceding reaction or technical object and introduces a state, process, or temporal boundary.

6_2728.concept: 局部功能词与过程表达
6_2728.description: 强激活分散在多类短语与词形上：反复出现“up to”，另有时间界限、条件从句、不完全/失败及结果表达；其余多为领域局部搭配，跨文体统一性有限。

patterns.name: 固定短语“up to”
patterns.context: up to 后接数量、期限、阶段等，常表示上限或程度；包括句首大写和句中形式。
patterns.domain: 科学、专利、论坛及一般说明文

patterns.name: 法律程序中的回应与异议
patterns.context: 规定回应期限，并说明未回应的后果或当事人对和解协议提出异议。

patterns.name: “until”时间界限
patterns.context: 描述截至某时点的状态，或某机制持续到特定事件发生为止。
patterns.domain: 论坛说明、专利技术文本

patterns.name: 条件词“that”
patterns.context: that 引出从句或时间条件；所给片段中该处激活最强。

patterns.name: 不完全及其后果
patterns.context: 描述未完全完成的动作或错误预取，并接续说明其影响或处理方式。

patterns.name: 时间/阶段推进表达
patterns.context: 以 during 或 upon 标示操作发生期间或某事件发生时。

patterns.name: 结果或结局词
patterns.context: 提及失败、未能做到或由某情况导致的结果；分散在不同语义结构中。
patterns.domain: 法律文书、论坛讨论、专利文本

patterns.name: 搭配中的“as”
patterns.context: 用 as 标记用途或设定属性，出现在实验方法描述中。

patterns.name: 聚合过程与完成程度
patterns.context: 描述聚合反应随持续时间推进、逐渐完成或被中断。

patterns.name: 反对意见相关词形
patterns.context: 围绕是否提出异议及其程序性后果。

patterns.name: 局部“it”指代
patterns.trigger: « it»，如“«it» is carried out”“«it» is actually returned”
patterns.context: it 指代前文的反应或技术对象，并引出状态、过程或时间界限。

en.description: Activation is dispersed across several common words and fragments: plural group nouns, legal objections, genetic crosses, continued website use, erroneous results, statistical significance, and “places” in a book review. Only statistical significance and some group references recur locally; overall, there is no unified trigger pattern.

patterns.name: Plural group nouns in negative or non-category contexts
patterns.context: In “to persons not infected with the habit,” refers to a category of people; in “Persons claiming liens,” refers to people asserting claims.

patterns.name: Legal objections and party statements
patterns.context: Contexts involving settlement agreement notices, consequences of failing to respond, and procedures for parties to raise objections.

patterns.name: Heterozygosity and crossing in genetics
patterns.context: Describes crossing plants of different genotypes and the genetic composition of their offspring.

patterns.name: Website use and continued consent
patterns.context: In a website cookie notice, continued use of the service is treated as consent.

patterns.name: Erroneous results and their limitations
patterns.context: Discusses how inadequate handling of missing values may lead to erroneous results.

patterns.name: Statistical significance determination
patterns.context: Reports a p-value threshold in research methods or results and states that it is considered significant.

patterns.name: Technicality and accessibility to general readers
patterns.context: Evaluates part of a book as too technical for general readers.

6_2728.description: 激活分散于若干高频词和片段：人群名词复数、法律异议、遗传杂交、网站持续使用、错误结果、统计显著性及书评中的“places”。仅统计显著性和部分人群表述有局部重复，整体缺乏统一触发模式。

patterns.name: 否定或非某类的群体名词复数
patterns.context: 在“to persons not infected with the habit”中指某类人；在“Persons claiming liens”中指提出权利主张的人。

patterns.name: 法律异议与当事人表述
patterns.context: 和解协议通知、未回应的后果及当事人提出异议的程序语境。

patterns.name: 遗传学中的杂合与杂交表述
patterns.context: 描述不同基因型植株杂交及其后代的遗传组成。

patterns.name: 网站使用与持续同意
patterns.context: 网站 cookie 提示中，继续使用服务被视为同意。

patterns.name: 错误结果及其局限
patterns.context: 讨论缺失值处理能力不足可能造成错误结果。

patterns.name: 统计显著性判定
patterns.context: 研究方法或结果中报告 p 值阈值，并说明其被视为显著。

patterns.name: 技术性与普通读者可及性
patterns.trigger: «places»；同句含“too technical for the general reader”
patterns.context: 评价一本书部分内容过于技术化，不适合一般读者。

en.description: Activations are scattered across varied semantics and genres, involving completeness, aggregation, registered objects, habits, any person/thing/time/action, and individuals in legal contexts. The commonality is unclear, though markers often fall on generic or conceptual expressions.

patterns.name: Completeness/intactness and antonym forms
patterns.context: Describes a dose not being fully emptied from a pocket, reducing efficiency; the word for completeness is split into marked fragments, with activation concentrated on “incomplete”.

patterns.name: Aggregation and collection terms
patterns.context: Discusses a collection or aggregation of works; “mere aggregation” in the same passage has especially strong activation.

patterns.name: Registered/known objects and traffic control
patterns.context: Describes allowing only known, registered virtual machines to send network traffic, involving ACL filtering.

patterns.name: habit and affected people
patterns.context: Discusses the effect of a habit on tobacco use and the aversion to it among those who have not acquired the habit.

patterns.name: anyone / any person
patterns.context: Discusses Christianity as directed toward all humanity, with anyone able to become a Christian.

patterns.name: anything / any thing
patterns.context: Explains that the C standard does not guarantee consistent behavior, so any outcome may occur.

patterns.name: any time / at any time
patterns.context: Discusses possible system behavior when connecting dual monitors; activation falls on the phrase “any time”.

patterns.name: person / individual and individual differences
patterns.context: Refers to an individual generically and discusses differences in individual intoxication and tolerance.

patterns.name: any act / any action
patterns.context: In a discussion of surety law, refers to any action by a creditor that may deprive a surety of subrogation rights.

6_2728.description: 激活分散于多种语义与文体：涉及完整性、聚合、注册对象、习惯、任意人/事/时/行为及法律中的个人。共同点不明确，且标记常落在泛指或概念性表达上。

patterns.name: 完整/完好及其反义形式
patterns.context: 描述剂量从口袋排出时未能完全排空，导致效率下降；完整词被拆分标记，激活集中于“incomplete”。

patterns.name: 聚合及集合类词语
patterns.context: 谈论作品的集合或聚合；同段中“mere aggregation”激活尤强。

patterns.name: 注册/已知对象与流量控制
patterns.context: 描述仅允许已知、注册的虚拟机发送网络流量，并涉及 ACL 过滤。

patterns.name: habit 与受影响者
patterns.context: 讨论习惯对使用烟草的影响，以及未染上该习惯者对其的厌恶。

patterns.name: anyone / 任何人
patterns.context: 讨论基督教面向全人类、任何人都可以成为基督徒。

patterns.name: anything / 任何事情
patterns.context: 说明 C 标准不保证行为一致，因此任何结果都可能发生。

patterns.name: any time / 任何时候
patterns.context: 讨论连接双显示器时可能遇到的系统行为；激活落在“any time”短语上。

patterns.name: person / 人及个体差异
patterns.context: 泛指个人，并讨论个人醉酒程度与耐受度之间的差异。

patterns.name: any act / 任何行为
patterns.context: 担保法论述中指债权人可能剥夺担保人代位权的任何行为。

en.description: Patterns are dispersed: activation occurs with generic references to individuals or groups in legal and explanatory prose, descriptions of entities in software and breeding documentation, and several domain-specific expressions; no single stable trigger word or unified semantic theme is evident.

patterns.name: Reference to a person/individual
patterns.context: An indefinite article is followed by person or individual, typically in statements about personal traits, abilities, classifications, or experiences.
patterns.domain: Legal, medical, and general explanatory prose

patterns.name: Activation near the noun person
patterns.context: person(s) appears in sentences judging someone's response, state, or category; activation is distributed over person and nearby words.

patterns.name: Generic referents and statements of attributes
patterns.context: Refers generically to a class of people and describes their qualifications, behavior, or institutional arrangements.

patterns.name: Entity descriptions in relative clauses
patterns.context: Technical documentation describes program objects, types, and their behavior; activation falls near entity names and subsequent explanations.

patterns.name: Sentence-initial connectors and assertions in legal text
patterns.context: In formal legal text, a connector or article is followed by statements of legal requirements, sentencing, and similar matters; activation is diffuse.

patterns.name: Copyright legal terminology and supplementary discussion
patterns.context: Copyright license text transitions to supplementary explanations and discusses compilations of works and their relation to original works.

patterns.name: Abstract nouns after an indefinite article
patterns.context: Statistical papers use abstract nouns to describe variables, missing data, limitations, or erroneous results; no clear common semantic trigger.

patterns.name: Bad advice and failure conditions
patterns.context: First evaluates advice or a standard library as bad, then proposes an alternative if the approach cannot be implemented.

patterns.name: Breeding and crossbreeding terminology
patterns.context: Describes crossing homozygous plants and offspring genotypes; activation is concentrated on genetic terminology and sentences describing mating.

6_2728.description: 模式分散：法律与说明文中泛指个人或群体、软件及育种文档中的实体描述，以及若干领域特有词句均有激活；未见单一稳定触发词或统一语义主题。

patterns.name: 人/个体指称
patterns.context: 不定冠词后接 person 或 individual，通常进入关于个人特征、能力、分类或经历的陈述。
patterns.domain: 法律、医学及一般说明文

patterns.name: 名词 person 附近激活
patterns.context: person(s) 出现在判断某人的反应、状态或类别的句子中；激活分布在 person 及邻近词上。
patterns.domain: 19 世纪论说文与法律陈述

patterns.name: 泛指对象及属性陈述
patterns.context: 泛指一类人，并说明其资格、行为或制度安排。

patterns.name: 关系从句中的实体描述
patterns.context: 技术文档描述程序对象、类型及其行为，激活落在实体名称及其后续说明附近。

patterns.name: 法律文本中的句首连接及断言
patterns.context: 正式法律文本中，连接语或冠词后接法定要求、量刑等陈述；激活较分散。

patterns.name: 著作权法律术语与补充论述
patterns.context: 版权许可文本中转入补充说明，并讨论作品汇编及其与原作品的关系。

patterns.name: 泛指冠词后接抽象名词
patterns.context: 统计论文中以抽象名词描述变量、缺失数据、局限或错误结果；并无明显共同的词义触发。

patterns.name: 坏建议与失败条件
patterns.context: 先评价建议或标准库为 bad，再提出若未能实现方案时的替代做法。

patterns.name: 育种与杂交术语
patterns.context: 说明纯合植物杂交及后代基因型，激活集中于遗传学术语和描述交配的句子。

en.description: Activations often fall on generic groups or objects (person(s), students, classes, action) and descriptions of their conditions, classifications, or rules. Other local patterns involve legal rights-holders, technical rules, and statistical error terminology. The commonality may be generic reference and qualifying statements, but is not complete.

patterns.name: Generic people and descriptions classifying individuals
patterns.context: In general statements or rules, person(s), students, and similar terms refer to a class of people and describe their state, eligibility, behavior, or classification; activation often falls on generic nouns such as person(s), students, and action.
patterns.domain: Legal, medical, educational, and other expository texts

patterns.name: Generic entities or actions in conditional clauses
patterns.context: A noun is followed by a that/who/which clause that conditionally qualifies, classifies, or regulates the entity or action.
patterns.domain: Technical documentation, educational regulations, medical assessments, and philosophical or normative discussions

patterns.name: Rights-holders, claimants, or responsible parties in law
patterns.context: Discusses legal rules concerning a specific party's actions, assertion of rights, or property and rights in works; activation occurs on related words such as act, persons, and works.
patterns.domain: Case law and legal texts; also software license texts

patterns.name: Recurring singular generic noun person
patterns.context: Uses person/persons as a generic reference to human individuals, often in constructions involving articles, possessives, or classification judgments.

patterns.name: Class and value-conversion rules in technical documentation
patterns.context: Describes .NET types, conversion capabilities, and serialization handling when conversion is unsupported; activation concentrates on Classes and its qualifying clause.

patterns.name: Incorrect results and methodological deficiencies in data analysis
patterns.context: Explains how inadequate handling of missing values can lead to incorrect results; activation falls on Incorrect.

patterns.name: Contrast between habits and those unaffected by them
patterns.context: Literary discussion contrasts those who form a habit with people unaffected by it; activation falls on persons.

patterns.name: Obligatory or normative statements about actions
patterns.context: Uses generic action as the subject to state whether an action should be taken or what practice it may promote.
patterns.domain: Religious, ethical, or philosophical discussions on StackExchange

6_2728.description: 激活多落在泛指人群或对象（person(s)、students、classes、action）及其条件、分类或规则描述中；另有法律权利主体、技术类规则和统计错误用语等局部模式。共同点可能是类属指称与限定性陈述，但并非完全一致。

patterns.name: 泛指人物与个体的分类描述
patterns.trigger: “a person’s intoxication”“a person’s tolerance”“Persons claiming”“A person is classified”“All students wishing”
patterns.context: 在一般陈述或规则中，以 person(s)、students 等指称一类人，并描述其状态、资格、行为或分类；激活常落在 person(s)、students、action 等泛指名词上。
patterns.domain: 法律、医学、教育及其他说明性文本

patterns.name: 条件句中的类属对象或行为
patterns.trigger: “Classes that don’t support this”“Students who are members”“a person is classified as”“an action which conduces”
patterns.context: 名词后接 that/who/which 从句，对对象或行为作条件限定、分类或规定。
patterns.domain: 技术文档、教育规定、医学判定、哲学或规范性论述

patterns.name: 法律中的权利、请求或责任主体
patterns.trigger: “any act by the creditor”“persons claiming adverse title”“Persons claiming liens”“derivative or collective works”
patterns.context: 讨论特定主体实施行为、主张权利或涉及财产、作品权利的法律规则；激活出现在 act、persons、works 等相关词上。
patterns.domain: 判例与法律文本；亦见软件许可证文本

patterns.name: 反复出现的单数类属名词 person
patterns.trigger: “a person’s”“a person”“A person is classified”“persons not infected”
patterns.context: 以 person/persons 作一般化的人类个体指称，常处于冠词、所有格或分类判断结构中。

patterns.name: 技术文档中的类与值转换规则
patterns.context: 描述 .NET 类型、转换能力及不支持转换时的序列化处理；激活集中在 Classes 及其限定从句。

patterns.name: 数据分析中的错误结果与方法缺陷
patterns.context: 解释缺失值处理能力不足如何导致不正确结果；激活落在 Incorrect。

patterns.name: 习惯与未受其影响者的对照
patterns.context: 文学论述中将形成某种习惯者与未受习惯影响的人作对照；激活落在 persons。

patterns.name: 义务性或规范性行动陈述
patterns.trigger: “Any action which conduces”“an action which conduces”
patterns.context: 以泛指 action 为主语，说明某行为应否实施或会促成何种实践。
patterns.domain: StackExchange 上的宗教、伦理或哲学论述

en.description: Activations occur on various fixed collocations or syntactic fragments: Further introducing discussion, Classes that/Subclasses should, generic person’s, mere aggregation, any delay, Students who are, with a true solution, and An exception to this. Domains and meanings are diverse, with no single semantic theme evident.

patterns.name: Specific sentence-initial connective Further
patterns.context: Further introduces additional discussion at the start of a paragraph; one example is followed by a comma and a legal proposition, another by a comma and a statutory sentencing statement.

patterns.name: Classes that in a relative clause
patterns.context: Describes a type of software class and the behaviors it supports or does not support; don’t support this appears nearby.

patterns.name: Subclasses should in normative documentation
patterns.context: In a list of interface or class implementation requirements, states rules that subclasses should follow.

patterns.name: Generic individual and possessive
patterns.context: Uses generic person’s to describe an individual’s condition and its effects; nearby discussion concerns intoxication, tolerance, and capacity for behavior.

patterns.name: mere aggregation
patterns.context: GPL license text discusses the distinction between mere aggregation of works and derivative works.

patterns.name: any delay
patterns.context: Discusses the possible consequences of delaying action after identifying an abnormal indicator.

patterns.name: Students and relative clause
patterns.context: In a university honors program description, Students who are introduces student eligibility or status requirements.

patterns.name: with a true solution
patterns.context: Compares colloids with true solutions and describes the properties of dissolved ions or molecules.

patterns.name: An exception to this
patterns.context: States the general meaning of rating symbols, then introduces an exception for a BBB rating.

6_2728.description: 激活落在多种固定搭配或句法片段上：Further 衔接论述、Classes that/Subclasses should、泛指 person’s、mere aggregation、any delay、Students who are、with a true solution、An exception to this。领域和含义分散，未见单一语义主题。

patterns.name: 特定句首衔接语 Further
patterns.context: 段落开头用 Further 引出补充论述；一例接逗号及法律命题，另一例接逗号及法定刑句子。

patterns.name: 关系从句中的 Classes that
patterns.context: 描述某类软件类及其支持或不支持的行为；邻近出现 don’t support this。

patterns.name: 规范性文档中的 Subclasses should
patterns.context: 接口或类实现要求列表中，对子类提出应遵守的规范。

patterns.name: 泛指个人及所有格
patterns.context: 以泛指 person’s 描述个人状况及其影响，附近谈醉酒、耐受度和行为能力。

patterns.name: mere aggregation
patterns.context: GPL 许可文本中讨论作品的 mere aggregation 与衍生作品的区别。

patterns.name: any delay
patterns.context: 讨论识别异常指标后，延迟处置可能造成的后果。

patterns.name: 学生与从句关系词
patterns.context: 高校荣誉项目说明中，以 Students who are 引出学生资格或身份条件。

patterns.name: with a true solution
patterns.context: 对比胶体与真溶液，说明溶解离子或分子的性质。

patterns.name: An exception to this
patterns.context: 先说明评级标记的一般含义，再引出 BBB 评级的例外。

en.concept: Objects or judgments in formal explanations
en.description: Activations are scattered across software classes and subclasses, paper conclusions about significance, legal and financial explanations, and expressions such as “anyone”. A more consistent feature is that formal expository prose introduces objects, categories, or judgments, but there is no single stable trigger word.

patterns.name: Classes and subclasses
patterns.context: Discusses class implementation, serialization, conversion, or thread-safety requirements in software documentation; strong activation often falls on Classes/Subclasses.

patterns.name: Statistical significance conclusion
patterns.context: In statistical tests or analysis results, states that the result is significant after the p-value falls below 0.05.

patterns.name: Rating exception explanation
patterns.context: Introduces an exception to a rating rule in a financial rating explanation.

patterns.name: Generic anyone
patterns.context: Emphasizes that anyone can become a Christian when discussing that a population or eligibility is not restricted by origin.
patterns.domain: Wikipedia, discussions of religion and antisemitism

patterns.name: People and their states or abilities
patterns.context: Legal testimony discusses an individual's intoxication, tolerance, and their effects on capacity to act.

patterns.name: Creditor actions affecting a surety
patterns.context: In a discussion of surety subrogation rights, explains that an action by a creditor may harm the surety.

patterns.name: Mere aggregation of works
patterns.context: Open-source license terms distinguish derivative works from other works merely assembled together.

patterns.name: Statutory sentencing
patterns.context: Sentencing discussions mention a punishment that the law requires to be imposed.

6_2728.concept: 正式说明中的对象或判定
6_2728.description: 激活分散在软件类与子类、论文显著性结论、法律与金融说明，以及“任何人”等表述；较一致的是正式说明文中引出对象、类别或判定，但没有单一稳定触发词。

patterns.name: 类与子类
patterns.context: 在软件文档中讨论类的实现、序列化、转换或线程安全要求；强激活常落在 Classes/Subclasses。

patterns.name: 统计显著性结论
patterns.context: 统计检验或分析结果中，说明 p 值低于 0.05 后将结果判定为显著。

patterns.name: 评级例外说明
patterns.context: 金融评级解释中引出某项评级规则的例外。

patterns.name: 泛指任何人
patterns.context: 论述人群或资格不受出身限制时，强调任何人都可以成为基督徒。
patterns.domain: 维基百科，宗教与反犹主义论述

patterns.name: 人及其状态或能力
patterns.context: 法律证词讨论个体的醉酒、耐受程度及其对行为能力的影响。

patterns.name: 债权人行为影响担保人
patterns.context: 担保代位权论述中，说明债权人的某项行为可能使担保人受损。

patterns.name: 作品的单纯聚合
patterns.context: 开源许可证条款区分衍生作品与仅仅汇集在一起的其他作品。

patterns.name: 法定量刑
patterns.context: 量刑讨论中提及法律规定必须适用的刑罚。

en.description: Activations are distributed across various fixed constructions: articles followed by nouns, generic or need-related expressions introduced by Anyone/People, cross-breeding, work aggregation, sensor comparisons, rating exceptions, statistical significance, and transitions in legal arguments; no unified semantic trigger is apparent.

patterns.name: People or things following an article
patterns.context: A noun or nominal possessive follows an indefinite article; activations center on the noun itself, with a few on the article.

patterns.name: Anyone and following modal constructions
patterns.context: Refers to any person, followed by a modal verb expressing ability or possibility; the following verb also activates.

patterns.name: Aggregation and derivative-work statements
patterns.context: In copyright licensing contexts, describes a collection or aggregation of works; activations occur on mere, aggregation, and of.

patterns.name: Small sensors and their properties
patterns.context: Compares sensor size and noise, mentioning smaller sensors and their noise performance.

patterns.name: Cross-breeding and genetic crosses
