patterns.context: Describes crosses between plants of different genotypes and the genetic traits of their offspring; the transition word Conversely also activates.

patterns.name: People followed by a relative clause
patterns.context: People who want introduces user needs or preferences, followed by a description of desired functionality.

patterns.name: Rating exception explanation
patterns.context: Explains exceptions to rating rules.

patterns.name: Statistical significance threshold
patterns.context: A P-value threshold is used to state that a result is considered statistically significant.

patterns.name: Further after a case citation
patterns.context: Further introduces an additional reason or argument after a case citation.

6_2728.description: 激活分散于多种固定句式：冠词与名词、Anyone/People 引出的泛指或需求表达、cross 杂交、作品聚合、传感器比较、评级例外、统计显著性及法律论证衔接；未见统一语义触发条件。

patterns.name: 冠词后的人或事物名词
patterns.context: 不定冠词后接名词或名词性所有格；激活集中在名词本身，也有少量落在冠词上。
patterns.domain: 法律论述、一般说明文字

patterns.name: Anyone 及其后续情态结构
patterns.context: 泛指任何人，后接表示能力或可能性的情态动词；后续动词也会激活。
patterns.domain: 宗教历史说明、软件介绍

patterns.name: 聚合及衍生作品表述
patterns.context: 版权许可语境中，描述作品的集合或聚合；激活落在 mere、aggregation 及 of 上。

patterns.name: 小型传感器及其性质
patterns.context: 比较传感器尺寸与噪声，提到较小传感器及其噪声表现。

patterns.name: 杂交与遗传交叉
patterns.context: 描述不同基因型植物的杂交及后代遗传特征；转折词 Conversely 也有激活。

patterns.name: People 后接关系从句
patterns.context: 以 People who want 引出用户需求或偏好，后续描述希望得到的功能。
patterns.domain: 软件功能讨论、论坛文字

patterns.name: 评级例外说明
patterns.context: 解释评级规则中的例外情形。

patterns.name: 统计显著性阈值
patterns.context: 以 P 值阈值说明结果被视为统计学显著。

patterns.name: 判决引证后的 Further
patterns.context: 判决引证后用 Further 引出追加理由或论点。

en.concept: Around generic references and relational expressions
en.description: Activations are distributed across different domains, often occurring near generic or quantified expressions, connectives or contrast words, and noun phrases; some fragments have local semantic patterns, but no single semantic feature explains them all.

patterns.name: Generic people and possessives
patterns.context: In statements about a generic individual and their attributes, abilities, or state, person follows the article a and is followed by a possessive; [2] also has the generic human expression “anyone could become a Christian”.
patterns.domain: Explanatory prose, such as legal testimony and religious history

patterns.name: Transitions and generic actions in legal arguments
patterns.context: Legal arguments use connectives to advance or restate a point or introduce a condition, and use any/even to introduce generic actions or concessive conditions.

patterns.name: Highly heritable traits and breeding selection
patterns.context: Contrasts trait heritability, site assessments, and crossbreeding strategies.

patterns.name: Small-sensor noise
patterns.context: Compares sensor size and noise levels, describing higher noise in smaller sensors.

patterns.name: Work aggregation in license text
patterns.context: Discusses whether a work is based on a program, a derivative work, or a collective work, and the boundaries of mere aggregation.

patterns.name: Generic server operators
patterns.context: Introduces a server and explains that anyone can run it.

patterns.name: Medical delays and risk
patterns.context: Discusses the delay between identifying an abnormal indicator and subsequent action, and its clinical significance.

6_2728.description: 激活分散于不同领域，常落在泛指或量化表达、连接/对比词及名词短语附近；部分片段有局部语义模式，但无法由单一语义特征统一解释。

patterns.name: 泛指人物与所有格
patterns.context: 在泛指个人及其属性、能力或状态的陈述中，冠词 a 后出现 person，随后接所有格；[2]也有“anyone could become a Christian”的泛指人类表达。
patterns.domain: 法律证词、宗教史等说明性 prose

patterns.name: 法律论证中的承接与泛指行为
patterns.context: 法律论证中用连接语推进、改述或引出条件，并以 any/even 引入泛指行为或让步条件。

patterns.name: 高遗传性状及育种选择
patterns.context: 对性状遗传力、地点评估和杂交育种策略作对比说明。

patterns.name: 小型传感器噪声
patterns.context: 比较传感器尺寸与噪声水平，描述小型传感器噪声较高。

patterns.name: 许可证文本中的作品聚合
patterns.context: 讨论作品是否基于程序、衍生作品或集合作品，以及单纯聚合的边界。

patterns.name: 泛指服务器运营者
patterns.context: 介绍一种服务器并说明任何人都能运行它。

patterns.name: 医学延迟与风险
patterns.context: 讨论识别异常指标与后续处置之间的延迟及其临床意义。

en.concept: Statistical significance constructions and sporadic generic-word triggers
en.description: The strong pattern is that biomedical papers classify results as statistically significant after a p/P value falls below 0.05. There are also generic uses of any/anyone and sporadic triggers in legal, medical, animal-description, software, and religious texts, which are difficult to group under a single semantic mechanism.

patterns.name: Statistical significance judgment construction
patterns.context: In the methods or results sections of biomedical papers, uses a p-value threshold to indicate statistical significance; formatting varies in p/P, hyphens, spaces, and punctuation.

patterns.name: Generic use of anyone/any
patterns.context: Used as a generic determiner or pronoun to refer to any person or object; includes different semantic and syntactic contexts.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedia entries, technical explanations, and academic texts

patterns.name: Possessive person and tolerance
patterns.context: Legal testimony discusses an individual's intoxication as affected by alcohol tolerance.

patterns.name: Comparative lower and increased quantity
patterns.context: Medical discussion notes that lowering a clinical threshold increases the number of subsequent examinations or tests.

patterns.name: Fur description and atypical features
patterns.context: Describes animal fur and eye color and notes cases that do not fit typical features.

patterns.name: Pond server introduction
patterns.context: Explains the purpose of the Pond server and that anyone can run it.

patterns.name: Antisemitism and Christian identity
patterns.context: Discusses the universality of Christianity and belonging to it irrespective of ethnicity.

6_2728.concept: 统计显著性句式及零散泛指词触发
6_2728.description: 强模式是医学论文中 p/P 值低于 0.05 后被判为统计显著；另有 any/anyone 泛指，以及法律、医学、动物描述、软件和宗教文本中的零散触发，难以归为同一语义机制。

patterns.name: 统计显著性判定句式
patterns.context: 医学论文方法或结果部分，用 p 值阈值说明统计显著性；p/P、连字符、空格和标点格式有所变化。

patterns.name: anyone/any 的泛指用法
patterns.context: 作为泛指限定词或代词，指任何人或任何对象；其中包含不同语义和句法环境。
patterns.domain: 百科、技术说明及学术文本

patterns.name: 所有格 person 与 tolerance
patterns.context: 讨论个体醉酒状态受酒精耐受度影响的法律证词语境。

patterns.name: 比较级 lower 与数量增加
patterns.context: 讨论降低临床阈值会增加后续检查或检测数量的医学论述。

patterns.name: 毛皮描述及异常特征
patterns.context: 描述动物毛皮与眼睛颜色，并指出不符合典型特征的情况。

patterns.name: Pond server 介绍
patterns.context: 解释 Pond 服务器的用途及其可由任何人运行。

patterns.name: 反犹主义与基督教身份
patterns.context: 论述基督教普世性及其与族裔无关的归属。

en.concept: Judgment and qualification expressions in medical papers
en.description: Primarily responds to statistical judgment sentences in medical papers using P/p<0.05 (or less than 0.05) and calling the result significant, as well as their formatting; also responds to generic conditions with any, individual attributes with person’s, and emphatic uses of even.

patterns.name: Statistical significance judgment format
patterns.context: In a paper’s methods or results section, states the significance threshold for a statistical test; numbers, punctuation, and formula formatting also often activate.

patterns.name: Generic condition or delay introduced by any
patterns.context: Any is followed by a noun phrase to indicate an unspecified situation; one example describes a cat’s appearance, another a delay in clinical care.

patterns.name: Generic individual and attributes with person’s
patterns.context: The possessive person’s introduces an individual’s state or trait, within a discussion of alcohol tolerance and behavioral capacity.

patterns.name: even emphasizing a minor degree
patterns.context: even emphasizes a relatively minor situation or highlights that a tool also has limitations; the two examples differ in their specific meanings.

6_2728.concept: 医学论文中的判定与限定表达
6_2728.description: 主要响应医学论文中以 P/p<0.05（或 less than 0.05）并称为显著的统计判定句及其排版；另响应 any 泛指条件、person’s 个体属性和 even 强调用法。

patterns.name: 统计显著性判定格式
patterns.trigger: “P”/“p” + “<”或“less than” + “0.05”，随后出现“was considered”及“statistically significant”或“significant”
patterns.context: 论文方法或结果部分，陈述统计检验的显著性阈值；数字、标点及公式排版也常被激活。

patterns.name: any 引出的泛指条件或延误
patterns.trigger: “Any white patches of fur or yellow eyes”及“any delay”
patterns.context: any 后接名词短语，表示不特定的情况；前者描述猫的外观特征，后者描述临床处置延误。

patterns.name: person’s 泛指个体与属性
patterns.context: 所有格 person’s 引出个体状态或特征，嵌在关于酒精耐受和行为能力的论述中。

patterns.name: even 强调轻微程度
patterns.context: even 用于强调程度较轻的情况，或突出某种工具也有局限；两例具体语义不同。

en.description: Activations center on several high-information collocations: generic notices introduced by Any, considered in statistical results, the legal phrase mere aggregation, and local phrases such as person’s, a disease, values that, and any delay; no unified theme is apparent.

patterns.name: Generic rule or notice introduced by “Any”
patterns.context: A sentence begins with Any to introduce a class of objects, situations, or actions; it typically follows a rule, restriction, or reminder

patterns.name: Statistical judgment introduced by “considered”
patterns.context: In a statistical methods or results section, explains how a threshold is considered significant or different

patterns.name: “mere” emphasizing a limited or merely qualifying case
patterns.context: In defining whether combining works constitutes restricted conduct, legal text uses mere to modify aggregation

patterns.name: person in “a person’s tolerance”
patterns.context: Discusses the effect of alcohol tolerance on intoxication or behavioral capacity

patterns.name: Indefinite article phrase in sex-specific health problems
patterns.context: Describes sexual function problems in men and women and mentions disease-specific scales

patterns.name: values that in configuration value descriptions

6_2728.description: 激活集中在若干高信息度搭配：Any 引出的泛指告知、统计结果中的 considered、法律用语 mere aggregation，以及 person’s、a disease、values that、any delay 等局部短语；未见统一主题。

patterns.name: “Any”引出的泛指规则或告知

en.concept: Function words and judgment expressions in generic and emphatic arguments
en.description: Activations center on generic possibility expressions, individual differences with person's, p<0.05 significance judgments in medical papers, and illustrative emphasis introduced by even; there are also local words about fur texture and religious-historical arguments.

patterns.name: Possibility or generic statements following any/anyone
patterns.context: The trigger appears in statements about generic referents, possible events, or general abilities, often in subject position; activations are distributed across following words.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedias, medical papers, legal and technical explanations

patterns.name: person's possessive and individual differences
patterns.context: Generic singular person is followed by a possessive and then a description of an individual's state or differences and their effects.

patterns.name: Statistical significance judgment sentence
patterns.context: In medical research results, a p-value below 0.05 is the criterion for statistical significance; the significance phrase and surrounding words activate.

patterns.name: Emphasis or concession following even
patterns.context: even introduces an extreme or unexpected example, or one insufficient to change the conclusion; the following constituent is, respectively, a disease-specific tool, trial sample size, or minor leak.

patterns.name: touch／softest silk in tactile descriptions
patterns.context: Comparative statements describe fur texture, softness, and material; activations occur on local subword fragments within the phrase.

patterns.name: No clear shared trigger pattern

patterns.name: person's 所有格与个体差异

en.description: Activations occur in generic Any constructions, statistical significance reporting, descriptions of women's symptoms, and selection of heritable traits. These patterns differ considerably in form and meaning and cannot be summarized by a single clear trigger.

patterns.name: Any used generically or universally

patterns.name: Statistical significance threshold

patterns.name: Words related to women

patterns.name: Heritability and trait selection

6_2728.description: 激活分布于 Any 泛指句式、统计显著性报告、女性症状描述及遗传力性状选择；这些模式在词形和语义上差异明显，不能由单一明确触发概括。

patterns.name: 遗传力与性状选择
patterns.context: 对比高、低遗传力性状，并讨论育种中的选择效果

en.concept: Common local words and syntactic fragments

6_2728.concept: 局部常见词与句式片段
6_2728.description: 主要响应论文中“P/p < 0.05 was considered statistically significant”的显著性判定句式；另对评分阈值、个体耐受性、动物毛色、服务器说明及响度讨论中的局部词句有激活。

patterns.name: 统计显著性判定句式
patterns.context: 统计方法或结果段落中，说明显著性阈值；常在 P 值阈值后出现 was、considered、statistically、significant

patterns.name: 样本评分与蛋白表达分组

en.concept: Terms in generic and comparative contexts
en.description: Activations are not triggered by a single domain or fixed semantics. Salient cues include generic referent expressions (Any/any, Anyone, person/persons), as well as statistical significance, scale scores, comparative constructions, and several domain-specific terms; many highly activated fragments remain difficult to group together.

patterns.name: Generic noun phrase following “Any”
patterns.context: any acts as a determiner introducing a generic or indefinite referent, usually immediately followed by a noun phrase; activation is on Any/any.
patterns.domain: Descriptive text, web discussions, medical papers

patterns.name: “person” and possession
patterns.context: General statements about people or participant categories in scales; activations center on person/persons rather than adjacent determiners or other nouns.

patterns.name: “Anyone” as an unspecified agent
patterns.context: A generic pronoun at the beginning of a sentence or clause, followed by can run, expressing that anyone can perform an action.

patterns.name: Significance statements in medical statistical results
patterns.context: After a P-value threshold, considered introduces a judgment of statistical significance; activation is primarily on considered.

patterns.name: Statements relating scale scores to degree of difficulty
patterns.context: Explains the relationship between higher or lower scores and degree of functional difficulty; activations occur on Higher, scores, and with.

patterns.name: “while” in a parallel comparison
patterns.context: Contrasts the experiences of men and women on the same topic; activation occurs on while, which connects the contrasting clauses.

patterns.name: “than” in numerical comparisons
patterns.context: In an adjectival comparative construction, than introduces the comparison target.

patterns.name: Web referential use of ordinal first
patterns.context: A web discussion uses first to refer to the first link in search results.

patterns.name: Alcohol tolerance in legal testimony
patterns.context: Explains how individual alcohol tolerance affects intoxication or behavioral capacity; the passage also contains highly activated person.

patterns.name: Indefinite article meaning “one”
patterns.context: Activation is on the indefinite article a, but following nouns and syntactic contexts vary, with no stable domain or semantic condition.

patterns.name: Terms near classifications or thresholds
patterns.context: Highly activated words appear in explanations of immunoreactivity score thresholds; aside from the medical scoring context, no shared trigger word or syntactic condition is apparent.

patterns.name: “Odd numbers” in an algorithm explanation
patterns.context: A programming Q&A explains even/odd number checking; activations occur on Odd and numbers, with don't need nearby.

6_2728.concept: 泛指与比较语境中的词项
6_2728.description: 激活并不由单一领域或固定语义触发。较显眼的线索是泛指对象表达（Any/any、Anyone、person/persons），另有统计显著性、量表分数、比较结构及若干领域特有词项；多个高激活片段仍彼此难以归并。

patterns.name: “Any”后的泛指名词短语
patterns.context: any 作限定词，引出泛指或不定的对象，通常紧接名词短语；激活标记落在 Any/any 上。
patterns.domain: 描述性文字、网页讨论、医学论文

patterns.name: “person”及所属关系
patterns.context: 涉及人的一般陈述或量表中的受试者类别；激活集中在 person/persons，而非其相邻的限定词或其他名词。

patterns.name: “Anyone”表示不特定施事者
patterns.context: 句首或分句开头的泛指代词，后接 can run，表达任何人都可以执行的动作。

patterns.name: 医学统计结果中的显著性表述
patterns.context: P 值阈值之后，以 considered 引出统计显著性的判断；主要激活在 considered。

patterns.name: 量表分数与困难程度的对应表述

patterns.name: 数值比较中的“than”

patterns.name: 序数词 first 的网页指代用法

patterns.name: 酒精耐受度的法律证词

patterns.name: 泛指“一个”的冠词
patterns.context: 激活落在不定冠词 a，但后续名词和句法环境差异较大，缺少稳定的领域或语义条件。

patterns.name: 分类或阈值附近的词项
patterns.context: 免疫反应评分的阈值解释中出现高激活词；除医学评分语境外，目前看不出共同触发词或句法条件。

patterns.name: 算法说明中的“Odd numbers”

en.description: Activations often occur on generic terms any, anyone, those and the emphatic word even, especially when these introduce noun phrases, conditions, or scope; there are also sporadic examples of a multiplication substring and sentence-initial A, whose relation is uncertain.

patterns.name: any followed by a quantifier or determiner
patterns.context: any is directly followed by a noun or noun phrase, often expressing generic possibility or scope; it can also be followed by delay, other, and similar terms.

patterns.name: even followed by degree, scope, or condition
patterns.context: even introduces emphasis or concession, followed by a noun phrase, adjective, or degree change.

patterns.name: anyone followed by a modal or action
patterns.context: anyone functions as a generic subject, followed by predicates such as can/run or could/become.

patterns.name: those followed by comparison or a qualifying condition
patterns.context: those refers to a group, then is qualified by phrases such as with or >.

patterns.name: Sentence-initial or medial generic pronoun any
patterns.context: any modifies a singular noun to mean any or whichever; it shares a lexical trigger with the other any examples, but the contextual functions differ.

patterns.name: even in a particular phrase
patterns.context: even emphasizes that a particular instrument also has limitations; the highlight is on a, and the unmarked even may simply be part of a local collocation.

patterns.name: Multiplication-related word form
patterns.context: The word-internal substring multiplication appears in an explanation of an immunohistochemistry scoring formula; its relation to the pronoun pattern is unclear.

patterns.name: Article A and proper noun Pond
patterns.context: The proper noun Pond follows a sentence-initial article; activation centers on the article A, possibly triggered by sentence-initial position or the article.

6_2728.description: 激活多落在泛指词 any、anyone、those 及强调词 even 上，尤其是这些词引出名词短语、条件或范围时；另有 multiplication 子串和句首 A 的零散例子，未能确定是否相关。

patterns.name: those 后接比较或限定条件

patterns.name: 句首或句中泛指不定代词 any

patterns.name: 特殊短语中的 even

patterns.name: 乘法相关词形

en.description: Activations are scattered across heterogeneous corpora, with no single theme. en.description: Activations are scattered across formatting and tokenization boundaries, numeric fragments, and several domain-specific terms. accounting and inspiring each recur in two passages; other single-passage patterns concern web performance, tax deferral, paint stripping, and variable billing. patterns.name: Word-initial On
patterns.context: Activation falls on On at the beginning of a sentence or title; continuations include “Onset of…” and “On the Possibility…”

patterns.name: Segmented spelling of names or proper nouns
patterns.context: Activation spans multiple consecutive subword fragments that form a name or place; [1] also contains a repeated instance of the same name.

patterns.name: Internal fragments of scientific terms
patterns.context: Words are split into multiple tokens, with activation on the initial or subsequent subword fragments of scientific terms; not all fragments activate equally.

patterns.name: persistent in a disease term
patterns.context: Occurs as part of a disease or clinical phrase in NIH project text.

patterns.name: Name at the start of an email
patterns.context: The email body begins with a name and comma as a salutation or sender identification, followed by a blank line and “To”.

patterns.name: Fragments of legal citation numbers
patterns.context: Activation falls on fragments such as the volume number, reporter name, and page number in a legal case citation, followed by a person’s name.

6_2960.description: 激活分布于句首 On、专名的分词片段、科学术语片段，以及临床短语、邮件姓名和法律引文编号；各上下文条件并不统一。

patterns.name: 词首 On
patterns.context: 激活落在句首或标题开头的 On；后续分别形成“Onset of…”和“On the Possibility…”
patterns.domain: PubMed 标题与一般文章标题

patterns.name: 人名或专名的分段拼写
patterns.context: 激活分布在多个连续子词片段上，组合成姓名或地名；[1]还出现同一姓名的重复

patterns.name: 科学术语内部片段
patterns.context: 词被切成多个 token，激活出现在科学术语的词首或后续子词片段；并非所有术语片段都同等激活

patterns.name: 疾病术语中的 persistent
patterns.context: 在 NIH 项目文本里作为疾病/临床术语短语的一部分

patterns.name: 邮件开头姓名
patterns.context: 邮件正文开头以姓名及逗号标出称呼或发件人，后接空行和“To”

patterns.name: 法律引文编号片段
patterns.context: 激活落在法律判例引文的卷号、记者名称及页码等编号和缩写片段中，后接人名

en.description: Responds strongly primarily to the void function return type in code, across multiple languages and declaration forms; also activates on name fragments in personal-name text and persistent in a medical phrase.

patterns.name: void return type in C/C++/C#
patterns.context: Occurs in the return-type position of a function declaration or definition, followed by a function name, parameters, or function body; includes C/C++ and C# code.
patterns.domain: Source code, API declarations, and template instantiations

patterns.name: Personal names and name lists
patterns.context: Word fragments within names activate in biographical entries or name lists; strong activation falls on initials or name fragments.

patterns.name: persistent in medical terminology
patterns.context: Occurs in a medical phrase describing long-term pain conditions, modifying pain conditions.

6_2960.concept: void 函数返回类型（主模式）
6_2960.description: 主要对代码中的 void 函数返回类型强烈响应，覆盖多种语言和声明形式；另有姓名文本中的姓名片段，以及医学短语中的 persistent。

patterns.name: C/C++/C# 的 void 返回类型
patterns.context: 出现在函数声明或定义的返回类型位置，后接函数名、参数或函数体；包括 C/C++ 和 C# 代码。
patterns.domain: 源代码、API 声明及模板实例化

patterns.name: 人名及姓名列表
patterns.context: 姓名内部的词片段被激活，出现在人物条目或姓名列表中；强激活落在姓名首字母或姓名片段上。

patterns.name: 医学术语中的 persistent
patterns.context: 出现在描述长期疼痛状况的医学短语中，修饰 pain conditions。

en.description: Activations are scattered across proper nouns, people and organization names, title fragments, and texts from different domains. A few passages concern pain terminology, transcription errors, and Swedish parliamentary text, respectively. No stable lexical or stylistic trigger is apparent across passages.

patterns.name: Repeated entity names
patterns.context: Proper nouns recur in entries or texts; activation falls on several tokens within the names rather than a single consistent word form.

patterns.name: Word fragments across word boundaries
patterns.context: Activation is scattered across words or subword fragments in paper titles, with no consistent semantic trigger.

patterns.name: Croatian names and biographical descriptions
patterns.context: Lists or biographical entries include Croatian names and descriptions of occupations and nationality; activation locations vary.

patterns.name: Discussion of text transcription and spelling errors
patterns.context: Words near discussion of webpage transcription errors activate; the same passage also has scattered activation fragments, with no clear common trigger.

patterns.name: Persistent pain terminology
patterns.context: Describes chronic or persistent pain conditions in medical or research contexts.

patterns.name: Swedish parliamentary text
patterns.context: Activation spans multiple Swedish words and intraword fragments; the text concerns the next item on the parliamentary agenda and a committee.

patterns.name: Deutsche Telekom subsidiary names
patterns.context: Names and related word fragments activate in lists of Deutsche Telekom businesses or subsidiaries.

6_2960.description: 激活分散于专名、人物与机构名称、标题词片段及不同领域文本；少数段落分别涉及疼痛术语、转录错误和瑞典语议会文本。跨段尚无稳定的词义或文体触发规律。

patterns.name: 重复出现的实体名称
patterns.context: 专名在条目或文本中重复出现；激活落在名称内部的若干 token，而非统一固定的词形。

patterns.name: 跨词边界的词语片段
patterns.context: 激活散布在论文标题中的词语或子词片段，未见统一的语义触发词。

patterns.name: 克罗地亚人名及人物介绍
patterns.context: 人物名单或传记式条目中出现克罗地亚人名及职业、国籍描述；激活位置不完全一致。

patterns.name: 文本转录与拼写错误讨论
patterns.context: 评论网页转录错误时，相关词语附近出现激活；同段还有零散激活片段，无法确定是否同一触发。

patterns.name: 持续性疼痛术语
patterns.context: 医疗或研究语境中描述慢性、持续性疼痛状况。

patterns.name: 瑞典语议会文本
patterns.context: 激活覆盖多个瑞典语词及词内片段，文本谈及议会下一项议程和委员会。

patterns.name: 德国电信子公司名称
patterns.context: 列举 Deutsche Telekom 旗下业务或子公司时，名称及相关词片段出现激活。

en.description: Every passage has strong activation on tokens beginning with uppercase O, followed by words, proper nouns, or punctuation in different languages; no stable thematic or stylistic condition is evident.

patterns.name: Tokens beginning with uppercase O
patterns.context: The uppercase letter O appears at the beginning of a word or as an independent initial, followed by arbitrary letters, punctuation, or a word boundary; no specific semantics are required.
patterns.domain: Multilingual parliamentary texts, encyclopedias, web content, and personal names/proper nouns; covers all passages

6_2960.description: 所有段落都在大写 O 开始的 token 处强激活，后续分别接不同语言的词、专名或标点；未见稳定的主题或文体条件。

patterns.name: 大写 O 起始 token
patterns.context: 大写字母 O 作为词首或独立首字母出现，后续可接任意字母、标点或词界；不要求特定语义。
patterns.domain: 多语种议会文本、百科、网页内容及人名/专名；覆盖全部段落

en.concept: Weakly related proper-name fragments and domain-specific word triggers
en.description: Activations show several local patterns: O before the surname O’Connell is strongest in two name lists; other instances occur in O-initial proper-name fragments, including place names, personal names, wine names, and the scientific name Oryza. Remaining passages activate on words related to materials, lakes/ducks, chip packaging, and semiconductor processes, which are difficult to group into a single semantic pattern.

patterns.name: Metal-soap particles and materials
patterns.context: Patent background describes particles formed from metal soap powder and lists metal stearates.

patterns.name: Lakes, ducks, and place names
patterns.context: Encyclopedic text contains lakes, lake ducks, and geographic proper nouns; trigger locations vary.

patterns.name: Packaging and potato chips
patterns.context: Patent background describes equipment for stacking snack bags on a conveyor belt.

patterns.name: O’Connell in name lists
patterns.context: In alphabetized email recipient or contact lists, the initial O before the surname O’Connell activates most strongly.

patterns.name: Semiconductor processes and plasma
patterns.context: Patent background discusses photoresist removal, via oxide etching, and oxidation caused by O2 plasma.

patterns.name: Wine names and winery-style titles
patterns.context: Proper nouns appear in lists of grape varieties or wines; other titles containing Val d’Argan and Mogador do not activate noticeably.

patterns.name: O’/O-initial forms in catalogs and proper nouns
patterns.context: The former is a place-related proper noun in a book catalog; the latter is the genus name for rice in a paper abstract. These resemble the initial position in name lists but occur in different contexts.

6_2960.concept: 弱相关的专名片段与领域词触发
6_2960.description: 激活呈现多种局部模式：O’Connell 姓氏前的 O 在两份姓名名录中最强；另在地名、人名、酒名及 Oryza 学名等 O 开头专名片段出现。其余段落分别激活于材料、湖泊/鸭类、薯片包装和半导体工艺词语，难以归为同一语义模式。

patterns.name: 金属皂颗粒与材料
patterns.context: 专利背景中描述由金属皂粉末形成颗粒，并列举金属硬脂酸盐

patterns.name: 湖泊、鸭类与地名专名
patterns.context: 百科正文中出现湖泊、湖鸭及地理专名；触发位置并不完全相同

patterns.name: 包装与薯片产品
patterns.context: 专利背景描述输送带堆叠零食包装袋的设备

patterns.name: 姓名名录中的 O’Connell
patterns.context: 邮件收件人或联系人姓名的字母顺序名录中，姓氏 O’Connell 前的首字母 O 激活最强

patterns.name: 半导体工艺与等离子体
patterns.context: 专利背景讨论光刻胶去除、通孔氧化物刻蚀及 O2 等离子体导致的氧化

patterns.name: 葡萄酒名与酒庄式标题
patterns.context: 葡萄酒品种或酒款名称的列表中出现专名；其余标题中的 Val d’Argan、Mogador 等未明显触发

patterns.name: 目录与专名中的 O’/O 开头
patterns.context: 前者为书籍目录中的地名相关专名，后者为论文摘要中的水稻属学名；与姓名名录的首字母位置相似，但语境不同
patterns.domain: 书籍目录；生物医学摘要

en.concept: Biological and agricultural terminology and potatoes
en.description: Responds primarily to RNA-related terms associated with RNA interference, and often to potatoes and food, starch, or agricultural contexts; also activates on crop lists, a pest-bait patent, and metabolic enzyme names.

patterns.name: siRNA/RNA interference terminology
patterns.context: Specialized descriptions of RNA types, RNA interference, or gene silencing; may describe molecular structure, mechanism of action, or related domains.
patterns.domain: Molecular biology, NIH/PubMed, and patent texts

patterns.name: Potatoes and potato products
patterns.context: Potatoes appear as snack ingredients, crops, feed components, or subjects of agricultural labor; activation concentrates on the name itself and nearby food or agricultural context.
patterns.domain: Patents, agriculture and livestock nutrition, literary narrative

patterns.name: Crop lists related to plant pathogens
patterns.context: Lists cereal crops and describes nitrogen-fixing bacteria associated with them or their agricultural importance.

patterns.name: Pest-control materials and starch extrusion
patterns.context: A patent describes bait containing insecticidal or pest-control ingredients, its starch matrix, and a coextrusion process.

patterns.name: Other metabolic enzyme names
patterns.context: Lists metabolic enzymes that use pyridine nucleotide cofactors; no clear connection to RNA or potatoes.

patterns.name: Temporary work picking potatoes
patterns.context: Narrates a person’s willingness to do seasonal odd jobs but lack of enthusiasm for steady work.

6_2960.concept: 生物农业术语及马铃薯
6_2960.description: 主要响应RNA干扰相关RNA术语，也常响应马铃薯及其食品、淀粉或农业语境；另对作物列举、害虫诱饵专利和代谢酶名称有激活。

patterns.name: siRNA/RNA干扰术语
patterns.context: 出现RNA种类、RNA干扰或基因沉默的专业说明；可能描述分子结构、作用机制或相关结构域。
patterns.domain: 分子生物学、NIH/PubMed及专利文本

patterns.name: 马铃薯及其制品
patterns.context: 马铃薯作为零食原料、农作物、饲料成分或农业劳动对象出现；激活集中在名称本身及邻近食物/农业语境。
patterns.domain: 专利、农业与畜牧营养、文学叙述

patterns.name: 植物病原相关作物列举
patterns.context: 列举禾本科作物，说明与其相关的固氮菌或农业重要性。

patterns.name: 害虫控制材料与淀粉挤出
patterns.context: 专利描述含杀虫/防虫成分的诱饵及其淀粉基质、共挤出工艺。

patterns.name: 其他代谢酶名称
patterns.context: 列举使用吡啶核苷酸辅酶的代谢酶；与RNA和马铃薯主题不明显相连。

patterns.name: 捡拾马铃薯的临时劳动
patterns.context: 叙述人物愿意做季节性零工、但不热衷固定工作。

en.description: Activations commonly occur on names of plants, crops, seeds, and food ingredients, especially grains, oil crops, fruits, and vegetables in lists. They also appear in food menus, packaged foods, and a few patent abbreviations and networking terms.

patterns.name: Grain and crop vocabulary
patterns.context: Crop names occur in lists of nouns related to agriculture, botany, or food; sometimes paired with ingredients such as oil, bran, or seeds.
patterns.domain: Agriculture, botany, biomedicine, food, and patent texts

patterns.name: Ingredients and food names in menus
patterns.context: Food vocabulary appears in lists of snacks, menu items, or food categories.

patterns.name: Fruit and source lists
patterns.context: Fruit names are listed as edible sources or fruit categories; the text mentions obtaining a substance from food.

patterns.name: Repeated IHS abbreviation
patterns.context: A patent text discusses replacing an existing IHS with an improved IHS.

patterns.name: Networking and communication terminology
patterns.context: Network types and protocols are listed as technical examples.

patterns.name: Lists of ingredients and oil sources
patterns.context: Lists of low-cost carbon sources or plant-oil ingredients.
patterns.domain: Bioprocessing, food, or patent technical texts

patterns.name: Grain processing and flour
patterns.context: Mentions milling, grinding, and plant seeds; adjacent to text interpreting dreams.
patterns.domain: Mixed text; folk or dream interpretation and plant processing

patterns.name: Growing plants at home
patterns.context: A personal account of trying to grow potatoes for the first time, alongside past experiences of lacking life skills.

patterns.name: Packaged food conveyance
patterns.context: A patent describes a conveyor belt that reduces bag bounce, using potato chip packaging as an example.

6_2960.description: 激活常见于植物、农作物、种子及食品原料的名称，尤其是列举中的谷物、油料与果蔬；也见于食品菜单、包装食品，以及少数专利缩写和网络术语。

patterns.name: 谷物与农作物词汇
patterns.context: 作物名称出现在农业、植物学或食品相关的名词列举中；有时与油、麸、种子等原料搭配。
patterns.domain: 农业、植物学、生物医学、食品与专利文本

patterns.name: 食材与菜单中的食品名称
patterns.context: 食品词汇出现在零食、菜单或食物类别的并列列举中。

patterns.name: 水果及其来源列举
patterns.context: 水果名称作为可食用来源或水果类别列举，文中提及从食物获得某种物质。

patterns.name: IHS缩写重复
patterns.context: 专利文本讨论用改进的IHS替换既有IHS。

patterns.name: 网络与通信术语
patterns.trigger: “communications network”“telecommunications network”“data network”“Transmission Control Protocol/Internet Protocol”
patterns.context: 网络类型及协议作为技术例子列举。
patterns.domain: 专利技术背景、通信技术

patterns.name: 原料及油脂来源列举
patterns.context: 低成本碳源或植物油原料的并列列举。
patterns.domain: 生物工艺、食品或专利技术文本

patterns.name: 谷物加工与面粉
patterns.context: 提及磨粉、研磨及植物种子；与梦境解释文字相邻。
patterns.domain: 混合文本；民俗或梦境解释与植物加工

patterns.name: 居家生活中的种植
patterns.context: 个人叙述首次尝试种植马铃薯，与此前缺乏生活技能的经历并列。

patterns.name: 包装食品输送
patterns.context: 专利描述输送带减少包装袋弹跳，并以薯片包装为例。

en.description: Activations primarily fall on names of foods, ingredients, crops, and plant materials, especially specific terms in lists; there are also legal misconduct terms, plant molecular biology terminology, bacterial species genes and disease names, and commercial product categories.

patterns.name: Lists of food and ingredient names
patterns.context: Terms appear in lists or examples in food, menu, or agricultural texts; some activate within words at segmentation points, commonly in ingredient, dish, crop, and seed names.
patterns.domain: Menus, food descriptions, agriculture and crop texts

patterns.name: Legal misconduct terminology
patterns.context: Legal provisions or cases list dishonest, fraudulent, or false-statement conduct prohibited by professional standards; activations cluster on legal terms and connectives.
patterns.domain: Legal cases and professional ethics rules

patterns.name: Plant molecular biology terminology
patterns.context: Occurs at the beginning of an abstract introducing plant responses to stress and regulation of gene expression.

patterns.name: Microbial species and disease biology terminology
patterns.context: Scientific texts mention bacteria, genes, or diseases; activation falls on names of bacteria, agriculture-related terms, and disease names, among other proper or technical terms.
patterns.domain: Microbiology, plant pathology, and chloroplast genomics

patterns.name: Food manufacturing in company and product information
patterns.context: A company profile or business email introduces company ownership and manufactured products, with activation on product categories.

patterns.name: Plant materials in dream-interpretation text
patterns.context: After interpreting dream symbolism, the text shifts to a list of plant seeds and materials; the passage differs from the scientific and menu contexts of the others.

6_2960.concept: 具体食品与植物相关词项
6_2960.description: 激活主要落在食品、食材、作物及植物材料名称，尤其是清单中的具体词项；另有法律不端术语、植物分子生物学术语、菌种基因及病害名称，以及商业产品类别。

patterns.name: 食物及食材名称清单
patterns.trigger: «av»«ocado»、«del»«i»« turkey»、«beans»、«cheese»、«tort»«illas»、«ban»«anas»、«p»«ears»、«potatoes»、«crack»«ers»、«gr»«its»、«butter»« chocolate»« chip»、«blue»«berry»、«banana»« pe»«can»、«fro»«zen»« meats»、«bak»«ery»« products»、«snack»« products»、«potato»« chips»、«wheat»、«rice»、«maize»、«lup»«ine»« seeds»、«hen»«na»« seeds»、«salt»«wort»、«pot»«ash»
patterns.context: 食物、菜单或农产品文本中，词项以清单或举例形式出现；部分词在词内分段处激活，常见于食材、菜品、作物和种子名称。
patterns.domain: 菜单、食品介绍、农业与作物文本

patterns.name: 法律不端行为术语
patterns.context: 法律条文或判例中，列举职业行为规范所禁止的不诚实、欺诈或虚假陈述行为；激活词集中在法律术语及连接词。
patterns.domain: 法律判例与职业道德规则

patterns.name: 植物分子生物学术语
patterns.context: 摘要开头介绍植物对胁迫的响应及基因表达调控时出现。

patterns.name: 菌种及病害生物学术语
patterns.context: 科学文本中提及细菌、基因或病害；激活落在菌名、农业相关术语及病害名称等专名或专业词中。
patterns.domain: 微生物学、植物病理学与叶绿体基因组学

patterns.name: 企业与产品信息中的食品制造
patterns.context: 企业简介或商业邮件介绍公司所有权及其制造产品，产品类别处激活。

patterns.name: 磨粉占卜文本中的植物材料
patterns.context: 解释梦境象征后转入植物种子及材料的列举；该段主题和其他段的科学、菜单语境不同。
patterns.domain: 梦境释义及植物材料清单

en.concept: Lists of food and plant categories
en.description: Responds to vocabulary and lists related to food, plants, and crops, especially starch, potatoes, and grains; also occurs in contexts involving red-algal polysaccharides and lists of legal misconduct.

patterns.name: Starch and starchy foods
patterns.context: Directly mentions starch or gives starchy foods such as potatoes as examples; sometimes embedded in descriptions of food processing, feed, or materials
patterns.domain: Biomedical, food, and patent technical texts

patterns.name: Red algae and their polysaccharides
patterns.context: Describes red algae and their cellular components or polysaccharide classes

patterns.name: Examples of fruits, berries, and foods
patterns.context: Lists edible fruits or berries in contexts concerning natural sources and diet

patterns.name: Lists of food and crop categories
patterns.context: Lists foods, crops, or agricultural products in product lists or agricultural accounts
patterns.domain: Company profiles, historical diets, agriculture, and microbiology papers

patterns.name: Lists of seeds and plant materials
patterns.context: Plants or seeds occur alongside milling and traditional uses

patterns.name: Lists in legal conduct provisions
patterns.context: Lists misconduct in parallel within professional conduct provisions

6_2960.description: 对食物、植物及农作物相关词汇和清单有反应，尤其是淀粉、马铃薯及谷物；也见于红藻多糖、法律不当行为列举等语境。

patterns.name: 淀粉及淀粉类食物
patterns.context: 直接提及淀粉，或以马铃薯等淀粉类食品举例；有时嵌在食品加工、饲料或材料说明中
patterns.domain: 生物医学、食品与专利技术文本

patterns.name: 红藻及其多糖
patterns.context: 描述红藻及其细胞成分或多糖类别

patterns.name: 水果、浆果与食物举例
patterns.context: 列举可食水果或浆果，语境涉及天然来源及饮食

patterns.name: 食品及农作物品类列举
patterns.context: 在产品清单或农业叙述中列举食品、农作物或农产品
patterns.domain: 企业介绍、历史饮食、农业与微生物论文

patterns.name: 种子及植物材料列举
patterns.context: 植物或种子与研磨、传统用途等内容并列出现
patterns.domain: 梦境释义或植物用途文本

patterns.name: 法律行为条款中的列举
patterns.context: 在职业行为规范条款中并列列出不当行为

en.description: Responds primarily to names of plants, crops, and food ingredients or products, especially texts listing crops, foods, and their uses; also covers plant breeding, pest host crops, rhizosphere bacteria, and phytochemicals. A company profile and an NF-kappaB/marine natural-products context are difficult to unify with the main pattern.

patterns.name: Names of plants, crops, and agricultural products
patterns.context: Occurs in lists of plants, crops, foods, or agricultural objects, often alongside terms for varieties, uses, ingredients, or cultivation; includes segmented forms of the same word, such as “buck”/“whe”/“at”.
patterns.domain: Agriculture, biology, food descriptions, and patent texts

patterns.name: Food processing or food categories
patterns.context: Occurs in product lists or descriptions of processing and ingredients; some are specific foods, others food ingredients.
patterns.domain: Food industry, food tables, and industrial wastewater patents

patterns.name: Plant chemistry and dietary supplements
patterns.context: Discusses plant-derived compounds, their properties, or their use as health-product ingredients.
patterns.domain: Biomedical research, nutrition, and phytochemistry papers

patterns.name: Host crops for insects and pests
patterns.context: Immediately after describing a pest, the text lists the crops or plant species it feeds on.

patterns.name: Plant propagation and cultivars
patterns.context: Concerns plant trait inheritance, propagation, or commercial cultivars.

patterns.name: Rhizosphere microbes and crop associations
patterns.context: Describes nitrogen-fixing bacteria associated with crop roots and lists the cereal crops associated with them.

patterns.name: Other biomedical objects or natural products
patterns.context: Medical research mentions a signaling pathway or a marine-derived compound; the connection to the plant and food lists in other passages is unclear.

patterns.name: Company profiles and family ownership
patterns.context: A company profile describes ownership, management, and manufactured products; it does not clearly share a pattern with the other agricultural and biomedical content.

6_2960.description: 主要响应植物、农作物及食品原料或产品名称，尤其是列举作物、食品及其用途的文本；也覆盖植物育种、害虫寄主作物、根际细菌和植物化学物质。另有公司简介及NF-kappaB/海洋天然产物语境，难与主模式统一。

patterns.name: 植物、作物及农产品名称
patterns.context: 出现在植物、作物、食品或农业对象的列举中，常与品种、用途、成分或栽培相关词并列；包括同一词的分词形式，如“buck”/“whe”/“at”。
patterns.domain: 农业、生物学、食品描述与专利文本

patterns.name: 食品加工或食品类别
patterns.context: 在产品清单或加工、原料描述中出现，部分是具体食品，部分是食品原料。
patterns.domain: 食品产业、食品表格及工业废水专利

patterns.name: 植物化学与膳食补充剂
patterns.context: 讨论植物来源化合物、其性质或作为保健品成分的用途。
patterns.domain: 生物医学、营养与植物化学论文

patterns.name: 昆虫及害虫的寄主作物
patterns.context: 害虫描述后直接列出其取食的作物或植物种类。

patterns.name: 植物繁殖与栽培品种
patterns.context: 围绕植物性状遗传、繁殖或商业栽培品种展开。

patterns.name: 根际微生物与作物关联
patterns.trigger: “root-associated nitrogen fixing bacterium”“members of the Graminae family”
patterns.context: 描述与作物根部相关的固氮细菌，并列举其关联的禾本科作物。

patterns.name: 其他生物医学对象或自然产物
patterns.context: 医学研究叙述中提到信号通路或海洋来源化合物；与其他段的植物、食品列举模式联系不明确。

patterns.name: 企业简介及家族所有权
patterns.context: 公司介绍中说明企业归属、经营者及制造产品；与其余农业和生物医学内容不明显相同。

en.description: Activations often fall on fragments within words or at compound-word boundaries, covering plants and agriculture, biological classification, and experimental chemistry terminology. They also occur on regional and institutional proper nouns, legal entities, and a parody title. No single semantic theme explains all highlighted text.

patterns.name: Fragmentary high activation within words
patterns.context: Highlighted fragments often fall within a word rather than on the whole word, especially at within-word splits, uncommon spellings, or morphological fragments.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain; scientific, patent, commercial, and other texts

patterns.name: Plant and crop terminology
patterns.context: Nouns related to plants, crops, or cultivation; activations fall on parts of crop names or plant-breeding terms.

patterns.name: Place names and regions of origin
patterns.context: Describes the regional origin, distribution, or geographic association of species, materials, or products.
patterns.domain: Biology, agriculture, commercial, and related texts

patterns.name: Biological classification and species descriptions
patterns.context: Includes microbial taxonomic names, new species names, or formal descriptions of plant morphology.

patterns.name: Chemical, biochemical, and experimental terminology
patterns.context: Compounds, metabolites, microbial physiological types, or experimental procedures; activations may also occur within terms.

patterns.name: Proper nouns, institutions, and legal entities
patterns.context: Names and abbreviations of companies or legal parties; activations may fall on proper nouns or abbreviation fragments.

patterns.name: Compound words and word-form segmentation
patterns.context: Long words or compound terms are split into within-word fragments, including morphological suffixes and stems.

patterns.name: Puns and parodic terms in titles
patterns.context: A title or short phrase uses near-rhymes, substitutions, or blends to create a humorous parody; activations involve the altered word fragments.

patterns.name: Formulas and miscellaneous experimental expressions
patterns.context: Local formatted expressions such as parenthetical examples, variety categories, concentration units, or strain labels; these do not form a single semantic theme.

patterns.name: Unexplained local signals
patterns.context: Although these passages exhibit other identifiable patterns, the relationship between some highlighted positions (such as proper nouns, line breaks, or abbreviations) and a shared trigger is uncertain.

6_2960.description: 激活常落在词内碎片或复合词切分处，覆盖植物与农业、生物分类和实验化学术语，也见地区与机构专名、法律实体及一段仿拟标题；没有单一语义主题能解释全部高亮。

patterns.name: 单词内部的碎片式高激活
patterns.context: 高亮片段常落在一个单词内部，而非完整词；尤其出现词内切分、较少见的拼写或形态片段。
patterns.domain: 跨领域；科学文本、专利、商业文本等

patterns.name: 植物及农作物术语
patterns.context: 植物、作物或栽培相关名词；激活落在作物名称或植物育种术语的部分上。

patterns.name: 地名与来源地区
patterns.trigger: «Taiwan»3、«Asian»4、«African»3、«tropical Asia, the Philippines, Papua New Guinea and tropical Africa»
patterns.context: 描述物种、材料或产品的地域来源、分布或关联地区。
patterns.domain: 生物学、农业、商业及相关文本

patterns.name: 生物分类及物种描述
patterns.context: 出现微生物分类名称、新种命名，或对植物形态特征的正式描述。
patterns.domain: 微生物学与植物分类学论文

patterns.name: 化学、生化及实验术语
patterns.context: 化合物、代谢物、菌的生理类型或实验处理步骤；术语中部也可激活。

patterns.name: 专名、机构及法律实体
patterns.context: 公司或法律当事方的名称及缩写；激活可落在专名或缩写片段。

patterns.name: 复合词与词形切分
patterns.context: 长词或复合术语被拆成词内片段，包含形态学后缀及词干。

patterns.name: 双关标题与仿拟词
patterns.trigger: «Cit»2rus« For»1 a Recordkeeper of« Asian»4« Cook»1ware、«O»2«uchy»2 Milk Farm、«Hur»3«ty»1« D»5«airy»3
patterns.context: 标题或短句以近音、替换或拼接形成幽默仿拟；激活涉及被改写的词片段。
patterns.domain: StackExchange 问答中的文字游戏

patterns.name: 公式与杂项实验表达
patterns.context: 括号内例示、品种类别、浓度单位或菌株标记等局部格式化表达；不足以归入单一语义主题。

patterns.name: 未能解释的局部信号
patterns.context: 这些段落虽有其他可辨模式，但部分高亮位置（如专名、换行附近或缩写）与共同触发条件的关系不确定。

en.description: Strong activations primarily occur on buckwheat/wheat and plant-based foods, compounds, and food ingredients. They also cover beverage examples, lists of people and occupations, and financial litigation terminology, so no single theme fully explains them.

patterns.name: buckwheat terms
patterns.context: Buckwheat and its products, or forage descriptions containing wheat; includes body text, catalogs, and food descriptions, with no required syntactic position

patterns.name: Plant-based foods and plant compounds
patterns.context: Plant-derived compounds, foods, beverages, or nutritional supplements; common in phytochemistry, oxidative stress, and health-related contexts

patterns.name: Food ingredients and recipes
patterns.context: Specific foods or ingredients appear in food names, recipes, or ingredient lists

patterns.name: Alcoholic beverages and beverage examples
patterns.context: Beverage examples as sources of plant components such as polyphenols

patterns.name: Names and occupations in proper-name lists
patterns.context: Person entries or lists where names are followed by roles, occupations, or descriptions

patterns.name: Financial litigation context
patterns.context: Legal descriptions of banking or brokerage services, stock trading, and client litigation facts

6_2960.concept: 植物性食物与相关词汇
6_2960.description: 强激活主要落在 buckwheat/wheat 及植物性食物、化合物和食品原料；也覆盖饮品举例、人物职业名单与金融诉讼词汇，无法由单一主题完全解释。

patterns.name: buckwheat 词项
patterns.trigger: “buckwheat”及其被拆分的 token，如 «whe»at、«buck»whe«at»；也包括相关词组 “buckwheat cakes”“buckwheat hulls”“ryegrass-wheat”
patterns.context: 出现荞麦及其制品，或含 wheat 的草料描述；包括正文、目录和食物叙述，不要求特定句法位置
patterns.domain: 生物医学、畜牧、文学、目录

patterns.name: 植物性食物与植物化合物
patterns.context: 植物来源的化合物、食品、饮料或营养补充剂；常见于植物化学、氧化应激和健康相关语境

patterns.name: 食物原料与配方
patterns.context: 食物名称、食品配方或食材清单中出现具体食物或原料
patterns.domain: 文学饮食描写、食品科学

patterns.name: 酒类及饮品举例
patterns.context: 作为多酚等植物成分来源的饮料举例

patterns.name: 专名列表中的人名与职业
patterns.context: 人物条目或名单中，姓名后接身份、职业或简介

patterns.name: 金融诉讼语境
patterns.context: 银行或经纪业务、股票交易及客户诉讼事实的法律叙述

en.description: Activations commonly occur on subword fragments of food, ingredient, and crop names, especially pizza, crackers, and grains; there is also strong activation on If in the “email received in error” disclaimer construction.

patterns.name: Food vocabulary split within words
patterns.context: Activations often fall within food names, ingredient names, or beverage brands split into multiple subwords; some examples mention food in context rather than in a specific syntactic position.
patterns.domain: Different genres including food, menus, agriculture, legal facts, and sports venues

patterns.name: Legal email disclaimer
patterns.context: Appears after confidentiality or legal privilege statements at the end of emails; triggers include hypothetical constructions about receiving an email in error.

patterns.name: Food and agricultural products
patterns.context: When discussing crops, grain, food production, or storage, activations fall on crop names or food-related words.
patterns.domain: Agriculture, food science, and patent background

patterns.name: Pizza shop or pizza-related cases
patterns.context: Legal accounts involve pizza shop robberies or pizza theft; activations concentrate on subword fragments of pizza-related terms.

patterns.name: Crackers and baked goods
patterns.context: Crackers occur in lists of menu items or baked goods production.

6_2960.concept: 食品词汇及邮件误收声明
6_2960.description: 激活多见于食品、食材及农作物名称的子词片段，尤其披萨、饼干和谷物；另在邮件免责声明“误收邮件”句式的 If 上强烈激活。

patterns.name: 词内切分的食品词汇
patterns.context: 激活常落在被分成多个子词的食品名、食材名或饮料品牌内部；部分例子是上下文中提及食品而非特定句法位置。
patterns.domain: 食品、菜单、农业、法律事实、体育场馆等不同文体

patterns.name: 法律邮件免责声明
patterns.trigger: «If»10« you»4« have»6« received»8 it»2 in error、«If»10« it»5 has»3« been»4« sent»3« to»5« you»3« in»4« error
patterns.context: 出现在邮件末尾的保密或法律特权声明之后，触发条件包括误收邮件的假设句式。

patterns.name: 食物及农产品
patterns.trigger: « cal»1ab«aza»2、« cass»2«ava»5、« sweet»10« potatoes»5、« soybean»4« cultivars»4、amber« dur»3«um»9« wheat»6
patterns.context: 谈及作物、粮食、食品生产或储存时，激活落在作物名称或食品相关词上。
patterns.domain: 农业、食品科学及专利背景

patterns.name: 披萨店或披萨相关案件
patterns.context: 法律叙述中涉及披萨店抢劫或披萨盗窃；激活集中于披萨相关词的子词片段。

patterns.name: 饼干及烘焙食品
patterns.context: 菜单或烘焙食品生产的列举中出现 crackers。

en.concept: Proper names and technical markers across domains
en.description: Activations are distributed across fragments within proper names, crop and grain names, medicinal plant names, network address structure fields, and boilerplate software license language. They span multiple domains and are not adequately explained by a single theme.

patterns.name: Subword fragments within proper names
patterns.context: Activations fall on fragments within proper nouns or organization names, often names of parties, judges, or companies in legal documents, and people’s names in emails; token boundaries do not necessarily correspond to complete words.

patterns.name: Crop and grain names
patterns.context: Triggered by crop, grain, and variety names in hybrid breeding or grain storage and mycotoxin research contexts.
patterns.domain: Agricultural patent background, agricultural and food science abstracts

patterns.name: Scientific and medicinal plant names
patterns.context: Triggered by common names or Latin-name fragments for milk thistle in statements introducing alternative therapies and active ingredients.

patterns.name: Network address structure fields
patterns.context: Triggered by fields, types, and array declarations in Go code related to network addresses or sockets; field combinations include Family, Port, Addr, etc.

patterns.name: License and legal notice format
patterns.context: Triggered by copyright, license, and terms-of-use notices at the beginning of source files, especially uppercase legal boilerplate.

6_2960.concept: 多领域专名与技术标记
6_2960.description: 激活分散于专名内部片段、作物与谷物名称、药用植物名、网络地址结构字段，以及源码许可证套语；涉及多领域，无法由单一主题充分解释。

patterns.name: 专名内部子词片段
patterns.context: 激活落在专有名词或机构名称的词内片段，常处于法律文书中的当事人、法官或公司名称，以及邮件中的人名；分词边界不一定对应完整词。

patterns.name: 作物与谷物名称
patterns.context: 触发于农作物、谷物及其品种名称，出现在杂交育种或谷物储存、霉菌毒素研究语境中。
patterns.domain: 农业专利背景、农业与食品科学摘要

patterns.name: 学名与药用植物名称
patterns.context: 触发于水飞蓟的普通名或拉丁学名片段，出现在介绍替代疗法及活性成分的语句中。

patterns.name: 网络地址结构字段
patterns.context: 触发于 Go 代码中网络地址或套接字相关结构体的字段、类型与数组声明；字段组合包括 Family、Port、Addr 等。

patterns.name: 许可证与法律声明格式
patterns.context: 触发于源码文件头部的版权、许可及使用条款声明，尤其是大写法律套语。
patterns.domain: Github 源代码许可证文本

en.concept: Split proper nouns and document entity fragments
en.description: Activations span legal, patent, paper, web, and code texts, often falling on split fragments of proper nouns, brands, and scientific names. Other local patterns involve legal boilerplate, patent function words, marketing disclosures, and struct code.

patterns.name: Capitalization fragments in entity names
patterns.context: Proper nouns are split into multiple tokens, especially at capitalization, word-segment, or abbreviation boundaries within names; the response is not limited to any particular name.
patterns.domain: Company, place, institution, or species names in legal, web, and academic texts

patterns.name: Trademarks and brand names
patterns.context: Trademarks or brands are mentioned, often in contexts involving ownership, sponsorship, appeals, or trademark notices; strong triggers occur on internal brand fragments.
patterns.domain: Legal decisions, sports business, contracts, and corporate disclaimers

patterns.name: Plant and biological terminology in patents and research
patterns.context: Plants, crops, compounds, or fungi appear in technical descriptions; activations fall on split fragments of scientific names and terms.
patterns.domain: Patent background, botany/biochemistry papers, and abstracts

patterns.name: Word endings and connectives in legal sentences
patterns.context: Legal prose discusses infringement or death litigation, liable parties, or court decisions; activations are scattered across legal boilerplate and ordinary connectives.

patterns.name: Common function words and numbers in patent texts
patterns.context: In patent background paragraphs describing hybridization, gene loci, crops, and examples, several common words and numbers also show positive activation, without forming a clear specialized terminology trigger.

patterns.name: Web media and affiliate marketing language
patterns.context: A media site describes its affiliate marketing relationships and commissions earned from purchases through links; activations fall on both fragments of the site name and commercial disclosure terms.

patterns.name: Code structure and field types
patterns.context: In a Go-style struct declaration, activations occur on field names, types, line breaks, and closing braces; both code tokens and punctuation respond.

6_2960.concept: 切分专名与文档实体片段
6_2960.description: 激活分布跨法律、专利、论文、网页与代码，常落在被切分的专名、品牌和科学名称片段；另有法律套语、专利功能词、营销披露及结构体代码等局部模式。

patterns.name: 实体名称中的大小写片段
patterns.context: 专名被切分为多个 token，尤其是名称内部的大小写、词段或缩写边界；并非只对某个具体名称有反应。
patterns.domain: 法律、网页、学术文本中的公司、地点、机构或物种专名

patterns.name: 商标及品牌名称
patterns.context: 商标或品牌被提及，常见于所有权、赞助、上诉或商标声明等语境；触发较强的品牌内部片段。
patterns.domain: 法律判决、体育商业、合同与公司免责声明

patterns.name: 专利/科研中的植物与生物术语
patterns.context: 植物、作物、化合物或真菌名称出现在技术描述中；激活落在被切分的科学名称和术语片段上。
patterns.domain: 专利背景、植物学/生物化学论文与摘要

patterns.name: 法律句中的词尾及连接成分
patterns.trigger: «thought»；« heat»；« of»；« passion»；« against»；« and»；« inter»；« alia»；« which»
patterns.context: 法律 prose 中涉及侵权/死亡诉讼、责任主体或法院裁决的句子；激活分散在法律套语和普通连接词上。

patterns.name: 专利文本中的普通功能词与数字
patterns.context: 专利背景段落描述杂交、基因位点、作物及其例子时，多个常见词和数字也有正激活，未形成明显专属术语触发。

patterns.name: 网页媒体与联盟营销措辞
patterns.context: 媒体网站介绍自身的联盟营销关系和通过链接购买所获佣金；激活同时落在站名片段和商业说明词上。
patterns.domain: 娱乐网站说明/商业披露

patterns.name: 代码结构与字段类型
patterns.context: Go 风格的结构体声明中，字段名、类型、换行和闭合花括号出现激活；代码 token 与标点均有响应。

en.description: Activations are distributed across company and legal proper names, confidentiality disclaimers, web form notices, UDP code, product formulas, and dessert flavor lists; they are difficult to group under a single semantic or lexical trigger pattern.

patterns.name: Legal or commercial entity names and company suffixes
patterns.context: Company names appear in proper names, company names, or case citations; activations often fall near parts of company names and punctuation
patterns.domain: Patents, legal texts, copyright notices, business emails

patterns.name: Legal confidentiality disclaimer
patterns.context: Email disclaimers state that information is confidential or privileged and prohibit unauthorized disclosure or use

patterns.name: Web form and disclaimer wording
patterns.context: Website comment form prompts and general disclaimers concerning content, trademarks, or materials

patterns.name: Network programming and address configuration
patterns.context: Code configures UDP network addresses and ports and creates sockets

patterns.name: Product formulas and ingredient proportions
patterns.context: Describes a preparation or product extract and lists mixed ingredients and their weight proportions

patterns.name: Dessert names and flavor lists
patterns.context: Dessert-themed text listing preparation experiences and multiple flavors

6_2960.description: 激活分布于公司与法律专名、保密免责声明、网页表单声明、UDP代码、产品配方及甜点口味列表；难以归为单一语义或词法触发模式。

patterns.name: 法律或商业实体名称及公司后缀
patterns.context: 专名、公司名称或判例引文中出现企业名；激活常落在公司名各部分及标点附近
patterns.domain: 专利、法律文本、版权声明、商业邮件

patterns.name: 法律保密免责声明
patterns.trigger: “confidential and may be privileged. Unauthorized disclosure, copying, distribution or use”
patterns.context: 邮件免责声明中说明信息保密或受特权保护，并禁止未经授权的披露或使用
patterns.domain: 电子邮件法律免责声明

patterns.name: 网页表单及免责声明措辞
patterns.trigger: “Your email address will not be published.”、“Required fields are marked *”、“Any content, trademarks or other material”
patterns.context: 网站评论表单提示与针对内容、商标或材料的通用声明

patterns.name: 网络编程与地址配置
patterns.context: 代码中配置 UDP 网络地址、端口并创建 socket

patterns.name: 产品配方与成分比例
patterns.trigger: “an extract from a mixture of ginseng radix, processed ginger, and Japanese green pepper (30%, 50%, 20% by weight)”
patterns.context: 描述制剂或产品提取物，并列出混合成分及重量比例
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文、产品成分说明

patterns.name: 甜点名称及口味列表
patterns.trigger: “crème brûlée”及“lavender, banana, cherry, masala chai, matcha green tea, lemon, chocolate, vanilla”
patterns.context: 以甜点为主题，列举制作经验与多种口味

en.description: Most strong activations come from U.S. decisions, especially case citations using “v.” and wording in legal opinions about facts, rules, and review of the record. Other patterns include closing Go structs, web comment forms/disclaimers, affiliate marketing disclosures, and arguments about perpetual rights. Short words and token fragments also trigger sporadically.

patterns.name: Citation format in judicial opinions
patterns.context: “v.” in case names, followed by the opposing party name, commas, and court reporter citations; often appears at the end of legal argument or factual narrative paragraphs.

patterns.name: Set argumentative language in legal opinions
patterns.context: Standards for reviewing the record in judicial opinions, headings for legal analysis, and statements of legal rules.

patterns.name: Statements of facts and rules in litigation
patterns.context: Describes parties' identities or conduct, financial disputes, and accident facts, with embedded case citations.
patterns.domain: Judicial opinions and litigation fact statements

patterns.name: Closing symbols in code structs
patterns.context: A right brace following the end of a struct definition in Go code, followed by consecutive line breaks; nearby are type and field declarations.

patterns.name: Web comment forms and disclaimer language
patterns.context: Web comment form fields and notices in comment content that may involve trademarks or other materials.

patterns.name: Website affiliate marketing disclosure
patterns.context: Explains that a website participates in an affiliate marketing program and earns commissions from purchases through links.

patterns.name: Perpetual rights and public policy in law
patterns.context: Discusses arrangements that can be renewed indefinitely and their conflict with legal public policy, followed by case citations.

patterns.name: Local activations on adjacent word fragments and short function words
patterns.context: Triggers are distributed across texts in different domains; they may relate to short words, tokenization boundaries, or local word fragments, but the samples do not establish a unified condition.

6_2960.description: 多数强激活来自美国判决，尤其判例引证“v.”及法律意见的事实、规则和记录审查措辞；另有Go结构体闭合、网页评论表单/免责声明、联盟营销披露和永久权利论述。短词与分词片段也零散触发。

patterns.name: 司法判决中的引证格式
patterns.context: 判例名称中的“v.”及其后案件名、逗号和法院报告引文；常出现在法律论证或事实叙述段落末尾。

patterns.name: 法律意见的固定论证措辞
patterns.trigger: «the»…« record»；«the»…« light most favorable»；«LAW AND DISCUSSION»；«recoverability of attorney fees»
patterns.context: 司法意见中的记录审查标准、法律分析标题和法律规则表述。

patterns.name: 法律诉讼中的事实与规则表述
patterns.context: 描述当事人身份或行为、财务争议及事故事实，并嵌入判例引证。
patterns.domain: 司法意见及诉讼事实陈述

patterns.name: 代码中的结构体闭合符号
patterns.context: Go 代码中结构体定义结束后的右花括号及连续换行，附近包含类型和字段声明。

patterns.name: 网页评论表单与免责声明文字
patterns.context: 网页评论表单字段及评论内容可能涉及商标或其他材料的告知语。

patterns.name: 网站联盟营销披露
patterns.context: 说明网站参加联盟营销计划、通过链接购买获得佣金。
patterns.domain: 娱乐媒体网站披露文案

patterns.name: 法律中的永久权利与公共政策
patterns.trigger: «creation» of« a» perpetuity；«against the policy» of« the» law
patterns.context: 讨论可无限续期的安排及其与法律公共政策的冲突，随后附判例引证。

patterns.name: 相邻词片段与短功能词的局部激活
patterns.context: 触发分布在不同领域文本中；可能与短词、分词边界或局部字词片段有关，但无法从样本确定统一条件。

en.description: Primarily sensitive to the “v.” case citation format in legal texts and the surrounding party names; also appears in legal rules, contracts, and litigation discussions. Website forms and press release copyright terms also occur.

patterns.name: Adversarial marker in case citations
patterns.context: Case names in legal opinions or legal dictionary citations, especially the “X v. Y” format; this marker has the strongest activations across multiple passages

patterns.name: Legal arguments and statements of rules
patterns.context: Body text discussing legal rules, contract offers, litigation, or standards of judgment; some fragments have no obvious “v.” citation trigger

patterns.name: Website forms and materials notices
patterns.context: Comment form prompts and disclaimers about trademarks or other materials

patterns.name: Press release copyright and republication terms
patterns.context: Text specifying responsibility for press release information and restrictions on republication

6_2960.description: 主要对法律文本中的“v.”案件引用格式及其周边当事人名称敏感，也出现在法律规则、合同与诉讼论述中；另见网站表单和新闻稿版权条款。

patterns.name: 判例引用中的对抗标记
patterns.context: 法律判决或法律词典引文中的案件名称，尤其是“X v. Y”格式；该标记在多段中激活最强

patterns.name: 法律论证与规则陈述
patterns.context: 讨论法律规则、合同要约、诉讼或判决标准的正文；部分片段不含明显的“v.”引用触发

patterns.name: 网站表单与材料声明
patterns.context: 评论表单提示及关于商标或其他材料的免责声明

patterns.name: 新闻稿版权与转载条款
patterns.context: 规定新闻稿信息责任及转载限制的文字

en.concept: Rules and restrictions in formal texts
en.description: Activations concentrate on review standards and case citations in legal texts, as well as several specific legal issues; they also respond to e-book usage licenses and copyright restriction notices. The commonality is the expression of rules, rights, or restrictions in formal texts, though the specific patterns in legal and copyright texts differ.

patterns.name: Standards of review in legal decisions
patterns.context: Describes how a court reviews the record or evidence, stating which party receives the favorable interpretation; usually a standard of review in an appeal or motion ruling.

patterns.name: Case citation format
patterns.context: A legal sentence ends with “v.” followed by the opposing party's name or institution, then case information such as volume and page; often adjacent to statements of standards of review.

patterns.name: Perpetual renewal and public policy in law
patterns.context: Argues that a contract or rights arrangement may be renewed indefinitely and therefore violates legal policy; cites and relies on precedent.

patterns.name: Bank account withdrawals and security interests
patterns.context: Distinguishes disputes over unauthorized withdrawals from those over an unperfected security interest; appears in a response to cases cited by the defendant.

patterns.name: Agency status and personal liability
patterns.context: Contrasts a party acting in an individual capacity with acting in a representative capacity, citing written documents as evidence of knowledge.

patterns.name: Subrogation for mortgage debt
patterns.context: After paying a debt, a mortgagor acquires the mortgagee's right to make a claim against the person assuming the mortgage debt.

patterns.name: E-book use and distribution license notices
patterns.context: Prominent uppercase warnings and license explanations inform readers of the terms for using, reading, or distributing electronic texts.

patterns.name: Copyright copying and distribution restrictions
patterns.context: A copyright page lists ways the work may not be copied, stored, or distributed, and requires explicit permission from the author.

6_2960.concept: 正式文本中的规则与限制
6_2960.description: 激活集中于法律文本中的判决审查标准、判例引证及若干具体法律争点；另对电子书使用许可和版权限制声明有反应。共同点是正式文本里的规则、权利或限制表达，但法律与版权文本的具体模式并不相同。

patterns.name: 法律判决审查标准
patterns.trigger: “in a light most favorable to the plaintiff / party”“resolve all reasonable doubts against the defendant”“benefit of all inferences”“substantial support”
patterns.context: 描述法院审查记录或证据时，说明对哪一方作有利解释；通常是上诉或动议裁决中的审查标准。

patterns.name: 判例引证格式
patterns.trigger: “v»2«.»10”“v»1«.»10”及其后的当事人姓名、公司名和引证信息
patterns.context: 法律句子末尾出现“v.”后接对方姓名或机构、再接卷页等判例信息；常与判决审查语句相邻。

patterns.name: 法律中的永久续期与公共政策
patterns.trigger: “creation of a perpetuity”“renew forever”“against the policy of the law”
patterns.context: 论证合同或权利安排可无限续期，因而违反法律政策；引述并援引先例。

patterns.name: 银行账户提款与担保权益
patterns.context: 区分未经授权提款与未完善担保权益两种争议；出现在对被告所引判例的回应中。

patterns.name: 代理身份与个人责任
patterns.trigger: “acting in an individual capacity”“acting only in a representative capacity”
patterns.context: 对比当事人以个人身份还是代表身份行事，并援引书面文件作为认知依据。

patterns.name: 抵押债务代位求偿
patterns.trigger: “mortgagor pays the debt”“is subrogated to the rights of the mortgagee”“person who assumed the mortgage”
patterns.context: 抵押人清偿债务后，取得抵押权人向承担抵押债务者主张权利的地位。

patterns.name: 电子书使用与分发许可声明
patterns.trigger: “distribute copies”“BEFORE YOU USE OR READ THIS ETEXT”“By using or reading any part”
patterns.context: 以醒目的大写警示和许可说明告知读者使用、阅读或分发电子文本的条件。
patterns.domain: Project Gutenberg电子书前言/版权说明

patterns.name: 版权复制与传播限制
patterns.trigger: “No part of this book may be reproduced”“stored in a retrieval system”“transmitted”“without express permission”
patterns.context: 版权页列举禁止复制、存储或传播作品的方式，并要求作者明确许可。

en.concept: Legal texts and case citation formats
en.description: Primarily responds to “v.” in case citation formats and frequent legal English function words (the, to, and); also covers judgment topics such as mortgage security, representative capacity, evidentiary review, remedies, and compliance, plus one press release disclaimer.

patterns.name: v. marker in legal citations
patterns.context: Connects parties or sides in a case name, usually followed by the cited case name and citation

patterns.name: to in legal collocations
patterns.context: Infinitives or collocations involving rights and obligations in legal argumentation

patterns.name: the before legal nouns
patterns.context: Definite articles in legal noun phrases; frequent in the excerpts, often adjacent to terms for rights, obligations, records, or procedures

patterns.name: and in legal relationships
patterns.context: Coordinates legal parties, conditions, or documents
patterns.domain: Legal argumentation; also press release disclaimers

patterns.name: Security interests in personal property and account withdrawals
patterns.context: Describes unauthorized withdrawals from a particular account and distinguishes this conduct from failure to perfect a security interest

patterns.name: Proceeds applied to interest
patterns.context: Proceeds generated by collateral during litigation or a pending sale are used to pay interest
patterns.domain: Mortgage and secured transaction legal texts

patterns.name: Representative capacity contrasted with individual capacity
patterns.context: Compares whether a party acted individually or in a representative capacity and cites the written record

patterns.name: Evidence review and appellate review standard
patterns.context: The court determines whether the trial court’s action is supported by substantial evidence

patterns.name: Press release copyright and liability disclaimer
patterns.context: States that the press release information provider is responsible for its content and restricts actions such as copying
patterns.domain: Business Wire press release disclaimer, not case law text

patterns.name: Damages and injunctive relief
patterns.context: Discusses whether a court may award damages at trial when they were not requested and whether this would prejudice the other party

patterns.name: Substantial compliance standard
patterns.context: Explains substantial compliance with contractual or statutory requirements and includes case citations

6_2960.description: 主要对判例引用格式中的“v.”及法律英语高频功能词（the、to、and）响应；另覆盖抵押担保、代理身份、证据审查、救济与合规等判决主题，并有一段新闻稿免责声明。

patterns.name: 法律引文中的 v. 标记
patterns.context: 判例名称中连接当事人或案件双方，通常后接被引案件名与引文

patterns.name: 法律固定搭配中的 to
patterns.context: 法律论述中的不定式或权利、义务关系搭配

patterns.name: 法律名词前的 the
patterns.context: 法律名词短语中的定冠词；片段中频繁出现，往往邻接权利、义务、记录或程序术语

patterns.name: 法律关系中的 and
patterns.context: 并列法律主体、条件或法律文件
patterns.domain: 法律论述；另见新闻稿免责声明

patterns.name: 动产担保及账户提款
patterns.context: 描述未经授权从特定账户提款，并区分该行为与未完善担保权益
patterns.domain: 担保交易／债权法律判决

patterns.name: 收益抵偿利息
patterns.context: 诉讼或出售待决期间，抵押物产生的收益用于支付利息

patterns.name: 代理身份与个人身份对比
patterns.context: 比较当事人以个人身份还是代表身份行事，并援引书面记录

patterns.name: 证据审查及上诉审查标准
patterns.context: 法院判断审判法院行动是否有实质证据支持

patterns.name: 新闻稿版权与责任免责声明
patterns.context: 说明新闻稿信息提供者对内容负责，并限制复制等行为
patterns.domain: Business Wire 新闻稿免责声明，非判例正文

patterns.name: 损害赔偿与禁令救济
patterns.context: 讨论未请求损害赔偿时，法院能否在审判中判给以及是否造成对方不利

patterns.name: 实质遵守标准
patterns.context: 解释合同或法规要求的实质遵守，并附判例引用

en.concept: Legal citations and rights notices in formal texts
en.description: Activations appear in citation punctuation, volume and page numbers, and case-name formats in legal texts; in recipient, confidentiality, and privilege language in email disclaimers; and in publication copyright notices and case-title typography. The commonality is the formatting and wording of formal legal or rights-restriction texts.

patterns.name: Periods in legal citations
patterns.context: Appears in citation formats between names of case parties or companies, often adjacent to a case name, citation, or case reference.

patterns.name: Numbers and abbreviation punctuation in legal citations
patterns.context: Years, state abbreviations, volume and page numbers, and intervening typographic marks such as periods, commas, and parentheses in legal case citations.
patterns.domain: FreeLaw legal opinions and case citations

patterns.name: Confidentiality and privilege language in email disclaimers
patterns.context: Appears in an email body or footer disclaimer stating that the email is for designated recipients only; activations center on recipient, confidentiality, and privilege language.

patterns.name: Content-source and confidentiality warnings in email disclaimers
patterns.context: An email footer states that the content is from CERA, is confidential or may be privileged, and lists unauthorized disclosure, copying, distribution, or use.

patterns.name: Copyright notices and copying restrictions
patterns.context: A book copyright page or publication notice states that rights are reserved, international copyright protection applies, and copying, storage, or distribution without permission is prohibited.

patterns.name: Party labels and line breaks in litigation captions
patterns.context: A typographic fragment from a case caption or the first page of an opinion, including line breaks, party-role labels, and the names of both sides.
patterns.domain: FreeLaw case captions and opinion formatting

6_2960.concept: 正式文本中的法律引文与权利声明
6_2960.description: 激活出现在法律文本的引文标点、卷页与案名格式，也出现在邮件免责声明中的收件人、保密和特权措辞，以及出版物版权声明和案件标题排版；共同点偏向正式法律或权利限制文本的格式与措辞。

patterns.name: 法律引文中的句点
patterns.context: 出现在案件当事人或公司名称之间的引用格式中，常与案名、引文或判例出处相邻。

patterns.name: 法律引文中的数字与缩写标点
patterns.context: 法律判例引文中的年份、州名缩写、卷页号及其间的句点、逗号、括号等排版标记。
patterns.domain: FreeLaw 法律判决及案件引文

patterns.name: 邮件免责声明中的保密与特权措辞
patterns.trigger: “intended only for use by the … addressee(s) named herein”“legally privileged and/or confidential information”“not the intended recipient”
patterns.context: 作为邮件正文或页脚免责声明，说明邮件仅供指定收件人使用；激活集中在收件人、保密及特权相关措辞。
patterns.domain: Enron 企业邮件免责声明

patterns.name: 邮件免责声明中的内容来源与保密警告
patterns.trigger: “contain information from Cambridge Energy Research Associates, Inc. (CERA)”“confidential and may be privileged”“Unauthorized disclosure, copying, distribution or use”
patterns.context: 邮件页脚指出内容来自 CERA、属于保密或可能受特权保护，并列举未经授权的披露、复制、分发或使用。
patterns.domain: Enron 企业邮件免责声明

patterns.name: 版权声明与复制限制
patterns.trigger: “All rights reserved”“Protected by international copyright conventions”“may be reproduced”“without express permission”
patterns.context: 书籍版权页或出版物声明中，说明权利保留、国际版权保护及未经许可不得复制、存储或传播。

patterns.name: 诉讼标题中的当事人标签与换行
patterns.context: 案件标题或判决首页的排版片段，包含换行、当事人身份标签和双方姓名。
patterns.domain: FreeLaw 案件标题与判决排版

en.description: Primarily responds to periods and proper-name fragments in legal case citations, and weakly responds to common function words in legal prose; also responds to software license distribution instructions and specialized account-withdrawal terminology, the latter two being rare out-of-domain examples.

patterns.name: Period in legal citations
patterns.context: A period after “v.” in a case citation, or near citations and abbreviations in legal text; the activation primarily falls on the period token itself.
patterns.domain: FreeLaw case law and legal documents

patterns.name: Common function words in legal texts
patterns.context: Occur between statements about contracts, rights, liabilities, or litigation procedures in ordinary legal sentences; these words recur but have weaker activations.

patterns.name: Distribution instructions in software licenses
patterns.context: Describes providing rights to recipients when distributing or modifying software copies; trigger words cluster in instruction sentences and examples.

patterns.name: Account or withdrawal-related terms
patterns.context: Mentions unauthorized withdrawals from a specialized account and contrasts them with whether a security interest was perfected.
patterns.domain: FreeLaw financial and security interest disputes

patterns.name: Proper-name fragments in citations
patterns.context: Occurs in case names, organization names, or case citations; many activated fragments are split subwords of proper names and cannot be grouped into a single semantic category.

6_2960.description: 主要对法律判例引注中的句点及专名片段有反应，也弱响应法律文句里的常见功能词；另对软件许可分发指令和专门账户提款术语响应，后两者属少数异域样例。

patterns.name: 法律引文中的句点
patterns.context: 句点位于判例引用中的“v.”之后，或法律引文、缩写附近；激活主要落在句点 token 本身。

patterns.name: 法律文本中的常见功能词
patterns.context: 普通法律句子中夹在合同、权利、责任或诉讼程序表述之间；这些词出现多次，但激活较弱。

patterns.name: 软件许可中的分发指令
patterns.context: 描述分发或修改软件副本时，要求向接收者提供权利；触发词集中在指令句和举例中。

patterns.name: 账目或提款相关术语
patterns.context: 提及未经授权从专门账户提款，并与担保权益是否完善相对照。
patterns.domain: FreeLaw 金融、担保权益争议

patterns.name: 激活落在引文中的专名片段
patterns.context: 出现在判例名称、机构名或案件引用中；不少激活片段是被拆分的专名子词，无法归并为单一语义类别。

en.description: The most stable activation pattern is “v.” and the names of the parties or institutions in U.S. case citations; a few ordinary text words and names of people in opinions also activate, and do not fully unify with the citation pattern.

patterns.name: v. separator in case citations
patterns.context: Appears in case names, connecting the parties to a lawsuit; often adjacent to a given name, surname, or institution name, followed by the cited court or case facts.

patterns.name: Court, institution, and insurance company names in case names
patterns.context: Part of the names of case parties, commonly appearing before or after v.; institution names may be split into multiple tokens.

patterns.name: Proper names and partial surnames in case names
patterns.context: Appears in names of litigants, often adjacent to v., a possessive, or a case-type term; some surnames consist of multiple tokens.

patterns.name: People’s names in opinion narratives
patterns.context: Name fragments activate in factual accounts in opinions; in this example, the person is subsequently associated with a contract and a home-sale dispute.

patterns.name: Local fragments difficult to classify as names or citations
patterns.context: Appears respectively in legal discussion of disputed account funds, assumption of mortgage debt, and the summary judgment standard; these words do not themselves show a consistent citation or name function.

6_2960.description: 最稳定的激活模式是美国判例引证中的“v.”及双方姓名、机构名；另有少量正文词和判决书人物姓名激活，难与引证模式完全统一。

patterns.name: 判例引证中的 v. 分隔符
patterns.context: 出现在案件名称中，连接诉讼双方；常紧邻人名、姓氏或机构名，后面接被引法院或案情。

patterns.name: 判例名称中的法院、机构与保险公司名称
patterns.context: 作为案件当事人名称的一部分，常见于 v. 前后；机构名内部可能被拆成多个 token。

patterns.name: 案件名称中的专名及部分姓氏
patterns.context: 出现在诉讼当事人姓名中，往往邻接 v.、所有格或案件类型词；有的姓氏由多个 token 构成。

patterns.name: 判决书叙事中的人物姓名
patterns.context: 判决书事实陈述中，激活覆盖姓名片段；本例人物随后与合同及房屋买卖纠纷相关。

patterns.name: 难以归入姓名或引证的局部片段
patterns.context: 分别出现在账户资金争议、抵押债务承接和简易判决标准的法律论述中；这些词本身未呈现一致的引证或姓名功能。

en.concept: Ownership and entity information in legal texts
en.description: Covers copyright/content ownership and prohibitions on copying, email confidentiality and privilege notices, names and party information in legal opinions, and lists of vegetable oils in patent texts; the only commonality is a legal or formal-document context.

patterns.name: Copyright and website content ownership notices
patterns.context: Copyright, republication, or content ownership notices, commonly found in website disclaimers or information-integrity clauses; also includes references to copyright infringement as a defect type.
patterns.domain: Website legal notices, book copyrights, or data defect descriptions

patterns.name: Confidentiality and privilege email disclaimers
patterns.context: Email footers state that information is for intended recipients only and prohibit review, forwarding, disclosure, or unauthorized use; often accompanied by language about company property and written consent.

patterns.name: Names and titles of parties in legal opinions
patterns.context: Names, company names, party roles, and judicial titles in court opinions or case captions; activations are distributed across names and legal text, with no single clear name pattern.

patterns.name: Lists of vegetable oil varieties
patterns.context: Lists various vegetable oils and their uses or prior descriptions in patent background material.

6_2960.concept: 法律文本中的权属与实体信息
6_2960.description: 涵盖版权/内容权属与禁止复制、邮件保密特权声明、法律判决中的人名和当事人信息，以及专利文本中的植物油列举；共同点仅是法律或正式文书语境。

patterns.name: 版权与网站内容所有权声明
patterns.trigger: “copyright of its respective owner”“copyright owner”“copyright or other intellectual property infringement”
patterns.context: 版权、转载或内容权属声明中，常见于网站免责声明或信息完整性条款；也包括对版权侵权作为缺陷类型的提及。
patterns.domain: 网站法律声明、书籍版权或数据缺陷说明

patterns.name: 保密及特权邮件免责声明
patterns.trigger: “confidential and privileged material”“intended recipient(s)”“privileged and disclosed in confidence”
patterns.context: 邮件页脚声明信息仅供预期收件人使用，禁止审阅、传播、披露或未经许可使用；常伴随公司财产和书面同意措辞。
patterns.domain: 企业电子邮件法律免责声明

patterns.name: 法律判决中的当事人姓名与称谓
patterns.trigger: “Sawyer, Horace K.”“Edward and Alison Yo”“Dennis McDaniel”“Russell A. Chabaud”
patterns.context: 法院意见或案件标题中出现姓名、公司名、当事人身份及法官称谓；激活分布在姓名和法律文本中，没有明显单一姓名模式。

patterns.name: 植物油品种列举
patterns.context: 专利背景材料中列举多种植物油及其用途或既有描述。

en.description: Primarily responds to words related to copyright, ownership, and intellectual property, especially in email disclaimers and website copyright notices; it also appears in infringement categories, company ownership, and plant-breeding material contexts.

patterns.name: Confidential email disclaimer
patterns.context: Email footer or disclaimer stating that the email is for the intended recipient only and restricting unauthorized distribution; often co-occurs with company names, attachments, or email formatting

patterns.name: Website copyright notice
patterns.context: Website terms or copyright notices stating that site content and trademarks belong to their respective owners

patterns.name: Intellectual property infringement category
patterns.context: Copyright or intellectual property infringement is listed as one type of defect or loss involving data, media, etc.

patterns.name: Ownership in patent cases
patterns.context: Describes the legal fact that a decedent acquired a company and became its sole shareholder and owner

patterns.name: Breeding materials and variety rights context
patterns.context: Describes selecting and crossing soybean breeding parents to develop new varieties
