6_2960.description: 主要响应版权、所有权及知识产权相关词语，尤其是邮件免责声明和网站版权声明；也出现在侵权类别、公司所有权及植物育种材料语境中。

patterns.name: 保密邮件免责声明
patterns.trigger: “confidential and privileged material”“intended recipient”“Any review, use, distribution or disclosure”
patterns.context: 邮件页脚或免责声明，说明邮件仅供指定收件人使用，并限制未授权传播；常与公司名、附件或邮件格式并现

patterns.name: 网站版权声明
patterns.trigger: “Any content, trademark’s or other material”“remains the copyright of its respective owner/s”
patterns.context: 网站条款或版权声明，说明网站内容及商标等归各自所有者所有

patterns.name: 知识产权侵权类别
patterns.trigger: “a copyright or other intellectual property infringement”
patterns.context: 列举数据、介质等缺陷或损失类型时，版权或知识产权侵权作为其中一项

patterns.name: 专利法律案件中的所有权
patterns.trigger: “sole shareholder and proprietor of the company”
patterns.context: 叙述死者取得公司并成为唯一股东及所有人的法律事实

patterns.name: 育种材料与品种权语境
patterns.context: 描述大豆育种中选择、杂交亲本并培育新品种的过程

en.description: Activations occur in legal/copyright notices, corporate email confidentiality footers, accounts of property transactions in case law, copyright-law definitions of derivative works, and RNA experimental methods; there is no reliable common lexical or semantic cue spanning all the material.

patterns.name: Copyright and property ownership disclaimers
patterns.context: A website disclaimer states that website content and trademarks are not owned by the site and that copyright remains with the respective owners; strong activations cluster around “of” and “owner.”

patterns.name: Email confidentiality and privilege disclaimers
patterns.context: An email footer or disclaimer describes email ownership, confidentiality/privilege, and use by intended recipients only; often accompanied by “and/or its affiliate(s)” and subsequent restrictions on use or disclosure.

patterns.name: Home purchases and residential transactions in case law
patterns.context: An opinion describes parties purchasing a home or firearm, or a residential sale contract and breach facts; shared lexical cues include “purchased,” “to,” and “a,” but the specific transaction objects and legal issues differ.

patterns.name: Copyright-law definition of derivative works
patterns.context: A license or legal text defines a program and its derivative works, listing forms such as copying, modification, and translation.

patterns.name: RNA experimental methods
patterns.context: The methods section describes extracting RNA from tissue or cells and reverse-transcribing it into cDNA.

6_2960.description: 激活见于法律/版权声明、企业邮件保密页脚、判例中的财产交易叙述、版权法衍生作品定义及RNA实验方法；缺少贯穿全部材料的可靠共同词面或语义线索。

patterns.name: 版权与财产权属免责声明
patterns.trigger: “Any content”, “trademark’s”, “other material”, “remains the copyright of its respective owner/s”
patterns.context: 网站免责声明说明网站内容及商标等材料不属于本站、版权仍归各自所有者；强激活集中在“of”及“owner”附近。

patterns.name: 邮件保密与特权免责声明
patterns.trigger: “property of Enron Corp.”、“confidential and privileged material”、“sole use of the intended recipient(s)”
patterns.context: 邮件页脚或免责声明说明邮件归属、保密/特权性质及仅供预定收件人使用；常伴随“and/or its affiliate(s)”及后续限制使用、披露的文字。

patterns.name: 判例中的购房与住宅交易
patterns.trigger: “purchased a home”、“purchased a firearm”、“contract to sell their residence”
patterns.context: 判决叙述当事人购买房屋、枪支，或住宅买卖合同及违约事实；共同词面线索包括“purchased”“to”“a”，但具体交易对象与法律争点不同。

patterns.name: 版权法对衍生作品的定义
patterns.trigger: “derivative work under copyright law”、“verbatim”、“with modifications”、“translated into another language”
patterns.context: 许可证或法律文本界定程序及其衍生作品，列举复制、修改、翻译等形式。
patterns.domain: 开源许可证/版权法律文本

patterns.name: RNA实验方法
patterns.trigger: “RNA was extracted”、“RNAiso”、“converted to cDNA”、“oligo dT primers”
patterns.context: 实验方法部分描述从组织或细胞提取RNA并逆转录为cDNA的操作。
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文方法部分

en.description: Activations cover copyright notices and license definitions, case law and legal arguments, names and purchase facts, as well as the scientific name Zea mays in a botany paper; other isolated narrative fragments are difficult to assign to a stable trigger pattern.

patterns.name: Copyright and ownership notices
patterns.context: Lists website content, trademarks, or other materials and states that copyright belongs to the respective owners; common in website legal notices.

patterns.name: Definitions and derivative works in legal provisions
patterns.context: Legal text defines the scope of a program or work and describes forms such as inclusion, modification, or translation.

patterns.name: Case citations and legal document formatting
patterns.context: Appears in court opinion titles, factual accounts, citations, or legal analysis; the specific trigger locations are not entirely consistent.
patterns.domain: U.S. case law and legal documents

patterns.name: Latin botanical scientific names
patterns.context: A scientific name appears in parentheses in crop or plant tissue research and may be split by tokenization.

patterns.name: Token fragments within personal names
patterns.context: Names in biographical or legal case facts; activations fall within or near the names.

patterns.name: Factual/evidentiary statements in legal arguments
patterns.context: Describes evidence, factual disputes, or standards applied by a court; belongs to the same legal context as case citations but does not manifest as a single fixed phrase.

patterns.name: Narrative purchase facts
patterns.context: Describes a purchase in case facts; occurs only twice and concerns different objects, so it may be a local pattern in legal narratives.

patterns.name: Unclear isolated fragments
patterns.context: The fragments are narrative sentences with no obvious connection, and the activation pattern is unclear.

6_2960.description: 激活覆盖版权声明与许可定义、判例及法律论证、人名和购买事实，也覆盖植物学论文中的 Zea mays 学名；另有孤立叙事片段，难归入稳定触发模式。

patterns.name: 版权与权属声明
patterns.context: 列举网站内容、商标或其他材料，并声明其版权归各自所有者；常见于网站法律声明。

patterns.name: 法律条文中的定义与衍生作品
patterns.context: 法律文本定义程序或作品范围，并说明包含、修改或翻译等形式。
patterns.domain: 开源许可/版权法律文本

patterns.name: 判例引用与法律文书格式
patterns.context: 出现在法院判决的标题、事实陈述、引文或法律分析中；具体触发位置并不完全一致。

patterns.name: 植物学拉丁学名
patterns.trigger: “Zea mays”及其缩写、种名分词片段，如“Z”“m”“ays”
patterns.context: 作物或植物组织研究中，学名在括号内出现，可能被分词切开。
patterns.domain: 农业与植物学论文摘要

patterns.name: 人名中的分词片段
patterns.context: 人物传记或法律案件事实部分的人名；激活落在姓名内部或邻近位置。

patterns.name: 法律论证中的事实/证据表述
patterns.context: 描述证据、事实争议或法院适用的审查标准；与判例引文同属法律语境，但不体现为单一固定短语。

patterns.name: 叙事性购买事实
patterns.context: 判例事实叙述中陈述购买行为；仅两处且对象不同，可能只是法律叙事的局部模式。

patterns.name: 未明确的孤立片段
patterns.context: 片段是无明显关联的叙事性语句，激活模式不清楚。

en.concept: Domain-specific proper names and structured text
en.description: Activations occur in variety descriptions and breeding in plant patents, case names, personal names, and factual narratives in case law, copyright-license definitions, and DNA polymer notation; overall, they show multiple local patterns involving domain vocabulary and proper names/structured legal text.

patterns.name: Plant variety names in patents
patterns.context: Describes new varieties or cultivars in plant patent background material; plant names may be split into multiple tokens. Paragraph 2 also contains the variety name Rosanna.

patterns.name: Case captions and personal names in legal documents
patterns.context: Near titles, citations, or party names in court opinions; personal names and legal roles may appear as subword fragments with mixed capitalization.
patterns.domain: U.S. case law and legal documents

patterns.name: Names and case facts in legal text
patterns.context: When the opinion body recounts case facts, claims, or cited precedent; triggers are not limited to title formatting.
patterns.domain: U.S. case law and legal documents

patterns.name: Copyright derivative-work language in legal definitions
patterns.context: A license or copyright text uses a definitional sentence to explain the scope of a program or its derivative works.

patterns.name: DNA polymer symbols and chemical notation
patterns.context: Polymer and base notation appears in a scientific abstract describing synthetic DNA molecules and binding measurements.

patterns.name: Plant-breeding narratives without clear specific triggers
patterns.context: Discusses breeding goals, selection, and hybridization; it shares a plant topic with plant-variety descriptions in patents, but the passage does not show the variety-naming pattern above.

6_2960.concept: 领域专名与结构化文本
6_2960.description: 激活分布于植物专利中的品种描述与育种、判例中的案名人名和事实叙述、版权许可证定义，以及DNA聚合物记法；主要呈现领域词汇与专名/结构化法律文本的多种局部模式。

patterns.name: 专利植物品种名称
patterns.context: 植物专利背景中描述新品种或栽培品种，植物名可能被拆成多个 token；第2段还出现品种名 Rosanna。

patterns.name: 法律文书中的案件标题与人名
patterns.trigger: «v»«.»、«Appellant»、«Appellee»、«Plaintiff in Error»，以及分段拼写的人名，如«P»«atti»« J»«.»« F»«RE»«EM»«AN»
patterns.context: 法院判决的标题、引注或当事人姓名附近；人名和法律角色可能以大小写混杂的子词形式出现。

patterns.name: 法律正文中的人名与案件事实
patterns.context: 判决正文叙述案件事实、诉讼主张或引用先例时；触发不只限于标题格式。

patterns.name: 法律定义中的版权派生作品表述
patterns.context: 许可证或版权文本以定义句解释程序或其派生作品的范围。
patterns.domain: 软件许可证／版权法律文本

patterns.name: DNA 聚合物符号与化学记法
patterns.context: 科学摘要描述合成 DNA 分子及结合测量时，出现聚合物和碱基记法。
patterns.domain: 生物物理／生物化学论文摘要

patterns.name: 未见明显专属触发的植物育种叙述
patterns.context: 讨论育种目标、选择和杂交；与植物专利品种描述同属植物主题，但该段未显示前述品种命名形式。

en.concept: Proper names and legal text fragments
en.description: Activations primarily fall on subword fragments of proper names, especially personal names, surnames, and Latin plant names. Some words and formats also activate in legal transaction narratives, plant breeding, and copyright definitions; no single stable semantic trigger is evident.

patterns.name: Surname/person-name tokenization in proper names
patterns.context: Activations fall on subword fragments of personal names or surnames, often uncommon names; especially common for names in legal documents and signatures, and also found in biographical prose.

patterns.name: Morpheme fragments in plant genus and species names
patterns.context: Triggers are tokenized fragments within Latin botanical genus or species names, occurring in plant descriptions or classification introductions.

patterns.name: Common phrases and collocations in legal texts
patterns.context: Words in legal narratives related to purchases, transaction objects, or transaction destinations; activations do not consistently fall on the same word.

patterns.name: Plant-breeding terminology
patterns.context: Technical sentences discussing selection, crossing, and variety development.

patterns.name: Expressions in copyright license definitions
patterns.context: Explanations, coordination, and alternative expressions in copyright license clauses defining or listing programs and derivative works.

patterns.name: Encyclopedia entry title/classification structure
patterns.context: A passage is part of an encyclopedia entry, with a botanical name and explanation following the heading; significant activations are concentrated on name fragments.

patterns.name: Case names and party signature format in legal documents
patterns.context: Party names, litigation roles, and representation information near case citations or attorney signatures.

6_2960.description: 激活主要落在专名的子词片段，尤其是人名、姓氏和植物拉丁学名；此外在法律交易叙述、植物育种及版权定义中也激活若干词语或格式，未见单一稳定语义触发条件。

patterns.name: 专名中的姓氏／人名分词
patterns.context: 激活落在个人姓名或姓氏的子词片段上，常为不常见姓名；法律文书的人名、署名尤多，也见传记正文。

patterns.name: 植物属种名中的词素片段
patterns.context: 触发点是植物学拉丁属名或种名内部的分词片段，位于植物描述或分类介绍中。
patterns.domain: 专利植物品种说明、植物百科

patterns.name: 法律文本中的常见词组及搭配
patterns.trigger: « purchased»、« from»、« firearm»、« federally»…« licensed»、« vehicle»…« to»…« dealership»
patterns.context: 法律叙述中涉及购买、交易对象或交易去向的词语；激活并非始终落在同一个词上。

patterns.name: 植物育种用语
patterns.trigger: « plant breeding»、« develop»、« unique»、« soybean»、« cultivars»
patterns.context: 讨论选育、杂交及品种开发的技术性句子。

patterns.name: 版权许可定义中的表达
patterns.context: 版权许可条款对程序及其衍生作品作定义或列举时，出现解释、并列及替代表达。

patterns.name: 百科条目标题／分类结构
patterns.context: 段落处于百科条目结构中，标题后接植物学名称及说明；实际显著激活集中在名称片段。

patterns.name: 法律文书的案名与当事人署名格式
patterns.context: 判例引证或律师署名附近的当事人姓名、诉讼身份和代理信息。

en.concept: Proper names and formulaic language in formal documents
en.description: Activations occur across legal, patent, encyclopedic, and website texts: notable patterns include legal wording and numbering/punctuation, fragments of proper and company names, plant-variety terminology, and references to trademarks, materials, and ownership in copyright disclaimers. There is no single stable lexical trigger pattern.

patterns.name: Articles/conjunctions and definitional language in legal texts
patterns.context: Connects definitions, supplementary explanations, and lists in legal definition clauses, at line breaks or within sentences; paragraph 1 is especially concentrated around “means … either … or … that is to say”.

patterns.name: Patent-abstract language for inventions and new varieties
patterns.context: Describes new plant varieties, crop varieties, and breeding goals in patent background material or plant-breeding descriptions; triggers are often variety adjectives, crop names, and proper-name fragments.

patterns.name: Names, case facts, and proper names in legal opinions
patterns.context: Fragments of names, locations, and entity proper names activate when opinions recount case facts, parties, or biographical information; not limited to one particular person or cause of action.

patterns.name: Ownership language in copyright notices
patterns.context: Website disclaimers or copyright notices state that content, trademarks, and other materials remain the property of their respective rights holders; different website names and spellings may occur.

patterns.name: Lists of corporate/entity names
patterns.context: A continuous list of companies, shops, and their abbreviated forms in opinions or legal material, including split entity names, punctuation, and company suffixes.

patterns.name: Section and number markers in legal provisions
patterns.context: Appears near section headings or numbering in opinions, between case narratives and body paragraphs.
patterns.domain: Formatting and numbering in court opinions

patterns.name: Document-structure markers and biographical headings
patterns.context: Near line breaks and section headings in encyclopedia entries, followed by an account of a person’s early life.

patterns.name: Mailing address fields in legal facts
patterns.context: An opinion states a home or mailing address, consisting of abbreviations, punctuation, and place names.

patterns.name: Lists of trademarks/materials in website disclaimers
patterns.context: A copyright notice begins by listing website content, trademarks, or other materials; connected to the subsequent ownership statement.

6_2960.concept: 正式文书中的专名与套语
6_2960.description: 激活分布于法律、专利、百科和网站文本：突出法律措辞及编号/标点、专名与公司名称片段、植物品种术语，以及版权免责声明中商标、材料和权属表达；没有单一稳定的词汇触发模式。

patterns.name: 法律文本中的冠词/连接词及定义措辞
patterns.trigger: «↵»、«means»、« either»、« the»、« or»、«that»、« is»、« to»、« work» 等
patterns.context: 法律定义条款中，在换行或句子内部连接定义、补充解释及列举；第1段尤其集中于“means … either … or … that is to say”。
patterns.domain: 开源许可证/版权法律文本

patterns.name: 专利摘要式发明与新品种措辞
patterns.context: 专利背景或植物育种说明中，描述新植物品种、作物品种及育种目标；触发词常为品种形容词、作物名和专名片段。

patterns.name: 法律判决中的姓名、案情与专名
patterns.context: 判决书叙述案件事实、当事人或传记式身份信息时，对姓名、地点和实体专名的片段有激活；并非只限一种固定人物或案由。

patterns.name: 版权声明中的所有权措辞
patterns.context: 网站免责声明或版权声明中，说明内容及商标等材料仍归各自权利人所有；不同网站名称和拼写均可出现。

patterns.name: 企业/商号名称列表
patterns.context: 判决或法律材料中连续列举公司、商铺及其缩写形式，含被拆分的实体名、标点和公司后缀。
patterns.domain: 法律文书中的实体/公司列表

patterns.name: 法律条文的章节与数字标记
patterns.context: 判决书中章节标题或编号附近出现，位于案情叙述与正文段落之间。
patterns.domain: 法院判决的版式与编号

patterns.name: 文档结构标记与传记标题
patterns.context: 百科条目中换行及章节标题附近，随后进入人物早年经历叙述。

patterns.name: 法律事实中的邮寄地址字段
patterns.context: 判决中陈述家庭住址或邮寄地址，地址由缩写、标点及地名构成。

patterns.name: 网站免责声明中的商标/材料列举
patterns.context: 版权声明开头列出网站上的内容、商标或其他材料；与后续所有权声明相连。

en.concept: Proper names and citation formats in formal documents
en.description: Activations occur in formal legal and intellectual-property texts, as well as encyclopedias and patent material: citation punctuation, case names and formatting, copyright ownership, and occasional plant varieties, breeding terminology, and biographical structure.

patterns.name: Quotation marks and citation punctuation
patterns.context: Quotation marks or special punctuation appear in quoted passages from legal texts, license texts, and similar material; activations sometimes fall on punctuation or line-break tokens.

patterns.name: Names of parties in legal cases
patterns.context: Names and surnames, including capitalization and tokenized forms, in titles, factual accounts, or party names in legal case law.

patterns.name: Case titles and citation formats
patterns.context: Near case names, party roles, and volume/page citation formats in reported cases.

patterns.name: Plant variety names and classification terms in patents
patterns.context: Describes the plant variety to which an invention belongs or a botanical name; names are split into subwords.

patterns.name: Soybean breeding terminology
patterns.context: In technical descriptions discussing crop breeding, parental lines, and development of new varieties.

patterns.name: Names and life-story structure in biographies
patterns.context: An entry title and early-life paragraph in a biographical entry, including a person’s name, birth information, and family information.

patterns.name: Copyright notices and ownership language
patterns.context: States the trademark, copyright, or ownership status of website materials; semantically adjacent to copyright in license texts but a different style.
patterns.domain: Website legal notices, copyright license texts

6_2960.concept: 正式文献中的专名与引文格式
6_2960.description: 激活分布于正式法律与知识产权文本及百科、专利材料中：涉及引文标点、判例姓名和格式、版权归属，也零星涉及植物品种、育种术语和传记结构。

patterns.name: 引文中的引号与引文标点
patterns.context: 引号或特殊标点出现在法律文本、许可证文本等引文片段中；激活有时落在标点或换行 token 上。
patterns.domain: 法律文本、版权许可文本

patterns.name: 法律案件当事人姓名
patterns.context: 法律判例的标题、案情叙述或当事人姓名中，常见姓名及姓氏的大小写、分词形式。

patterns.name: 判例标题与引证格式
patterns.context: 报告判例的案名、当事人角色和卷页引证格式附近。

patterns.name: 专利植物品种名称及分类词
patterns.context: 描述发明所属植物品种、植物学名称时，名称被拆分为子词。

patterns.name: 大豆育种术语
patterns.context: 谈论作物育种、亲本品系及培育新品种的技术说明中。
patterns.domain: 农业与植物育种专利文本

patterns.name: 人物传记中的姓名与生平结构
patterns.context: 传记条目标题及早年经历段落，包含人物姓名、出生信息和亲属信息。

patterns.name: 版权声明与所有权措辞
patterns.context: 声明网站材料的商标、版权或所有权归属；与许可证文本中的版权语义相邻但文体不同。
patterns.domain: 网站法律声明、版权许可文本

en.concept: Proper names and legal language in formal documents
en.description: Activations commonly occur in formal rights notices, licenses, and legal documents; they also appear in chemical/botanical proper names, biographies, and document boundaries. Proper-name subwords and boundary signals may be secondary co-occurrence patterns.

patterns.name: Legal and copyright clauses
patterns.context: Near formal legal language defining works/rights ownership, reserving rights, or giving disclaimers; also includes legal headings and case narratives in opinions
patterns.domain: Open-source licenses, website copyright notices, corporate email disclaimers, legal opinions

patterns.name: Tokenized fragments in English proper names
patterns.context: When a long proper name or chemical term is split into multiple subwords, activations often fall on an internal word fragment or adjacent punctuation; the context need not be legal
patterns.domain: Personal and company names in legal texts, compound names in chemical abstracts

patterns.name: Biography headings and names
patterns.context: In encyclopedia entries, a heading is followed by information about a person’s birth, family, or life

patterns.name: Botanical names and taxonomic descriptions
patterns.context: A botanical name or plant-variety name appears in an abstract title, research description, or patent background

patterns.name: Formatting boundaries and document markers
patterns.context: Near document-structure boundaries such as paragraph openings, headings, or email disclaimers; activations are weaker and do not occur in every passage
patterns.domain: Legal texts, emails, academic abstracts, licenses

6_2960.concept: 正式文档中的专名与法律措辞
6_2960.description: 激活常见于正式权利声明、许可证和法律文书；另见化学/植物学专名、人物传记，以及文档边界。专名子词和边界信号可能是次要共现模式。

patterns.name: 法律与版权条款
patterns.trigger: “either the Program or any derivative work under copyright law”, “copyright of its respective owner/s”, “All rights reserved”, “WITHOUT ANY WARRANTY”
patterns.context: 在定义作品/权利归属、保留权利或免责声明等正式法律措辞附近；也包括判决书中的法律标题和案件叙述
patterns.domain: 开源许可证、网站版权声明、企业邮件免责声明、法律判决

patterns.name: 英文专名中的切分片段
patterns.context: 较长专名或化学术语被切分成多个子词时，激活常落在词内片段或其邻近标点；上下文并不要求法律语义
patterns.domain: 法律文本中的人名与公司名、化学摘要中的化合物名

patterns.name: 人物传记标题及姓名
patterns.context: 百科条目中，章节标题后接人物出生、家庭或生平信息

patterns.name: 植物学名称与分类描述
patterns.context: 植物学名或植物品种名称出现在摘要标题、研究描述或专利背景中

patterns.name: 格式边界与文档标记
patterns.context: 段首、标题或邮件免责声明等文档结构边界附近；激活较弱且并非每段都有
patterns.domain: 法律文本、邮件、学术摘要、许可证

en.description: Activations concentrate on fixed language in legal and licensing texts: software copyright and licensing, restrictions on endorsement by name, email confidentiality, succession of rights, court documents, and ebook distribution terms.

patterns.name: Definition of derivative works in software licenses
patterns.context: Explains the meanings of Program and derivative work in a license and lists cases such as copying, modification, or translation

patterns.name: Court case titles and opinion summaries
patterns.context: Attorneys, judges, case topics, and factual statements appear in court opinions or judgment summaries

patterns.name: Listing successors in interest in legal documents
patterns.context: Contracts or legal documents use a fixed enumeration of heirs, representatives, and assigns to whom rights and obligations apply
patterns.domain: Contracts, affidavits, or other legal documents

patterns.name: Restrictions on name use in software copyright notices
patterns.context: Software licenses or copyright notices prohibit using project or contributor names to endorse or promote derivative products without written permission, often following software disclaimers
patterns.domain: Open-source software licenses and source code comments

patterns.name: Email confidentiality and disclosure restrictions
patterns.context: Email footers remind readers that content is for the intended recipient only and restrict review, use, distribution, or disclosure

patterns.name: Gutenberg copying, distribution, and trademark terms
patterns.context: Explains project terms applicable when copying or distributing electronic texts and mentions trademarks and the effort involved in producing the texts

patterns.name: License compliance and exception clauses
patterns.context: Source code license comments require compliance with AGPL and describe specific exceptions and their conditions

6_2960.concept: 法律许可与免责声明措辞
6_2960.description: 激活集中于法律与许可类固定措辞：软件版权和许可、名称背书限制、邮件保密、权利承继、法院文本及电子书分发条款。

patterns.name: 软件许可证中的衍生作品定义
patterns.trigger: “means either the Program or any derivative work under copyright law”及“with modifications and/or translated into another language”
patterns.context: 解释许可证中 Program 与 derivative work 的含义，列举复制、修改或翻译等情况

patterns.name: 法院案件标题与判决摘要
patterns.trigger: “Chief Judge”“Summary Judgment — Corporate Veil”“purchased a home”
patterns.context: 法院意见或判决摘要中出现律师、法官、案件主题及事实陈述

patterns.name: 法律文书中的权利承继列举
patterns.trigger: “her heirs, executors, administrators, successors and/or assigns”及“forever irrevocably”
patterns.context: 合同或法律文书以固定列举语说明权利义务涉及的继承人、代理人及受让人
patterns.domain: 合同、宣誓或其他法律文书

patterns.name: 软件版权声明中的名称使用限制
patterns.trigger: “Neither the name of Google Inc. nor the names of its contributors may be used to endorse or promote products”及“without specific prior written permission”
patterns.context: 软件许可证或版权声明禁止未经书面许可使用项目或贡献者名称背书、推广衍生产品，常接续软件免责声明
patterns.domain: 开源软件许可证及源码注释

patterns.name: 邮件保密与披露限制
patterns.trigger: “confidential and privileged material”“intended recipient(s)”及“review, use, distribution or disclosure”
patterns.context: 邮件页脚提醒内容仅供指定收件人使用，并限制审阅、使用、分发或披露
patterns.domain: 商务邮件法律免责声明

patterns.name: Gutenberg复制分发与商标条款
patterns.trigger: “copy and distribute this etext”及“PROJECT GUTENBERG trademark”
patterns.context: 说明复制、分发电子文本时适用的项目条款，并提及商标及制作文本所付出的努力

patterns.name: 许可证遵守及例外条款
patterns.trigger: “must comply with the GNU Affero General Public License”“If you modify file(s) with this exception”
patterns.context: 源码许可证注释要求遵守 AGPL，并说明特定例外及其适用条件

en.concept: Formulaic language in legal and license texts
en.description: Activations occur in software licenses and legal texts, email legal disclaimers, and case law material; they also appear in botanical-name abstracts. Local salient features include legal boilerplate, formal names and identities, disclaimer phrases, and split proper names.

patterns.name: Legal definition clauses in licenses
patterns.context: Defines the Program or its derivative works and lists cases such as verbatim copying, modification, or translation

patterns.name: Email confidentiality disclaimers
patterns.context: Confidentiality and privilege warnings in email signatures or footers, describing restrictions or procedures for misdirected emails

patterns.name: Names and litigation roles in case captions
patterns.context: Lawyers, judges, parties, and litigation roles in court opinions or case citations; names may have unusual capitalization or split spellings

patterns.name: Botanical names and abstract titles
patterns.context: A Latin scientific name in a plant chemistry abstract title is split into multiple subwords

patterns.name: Open-source license disclaimers and liability clauses
patterns.context: Restrictions on use of names and endorsements, warranty disclaimers, and liability disclaimers in software licenses or copyright documents

patterns.name: Lists of successors in legal documents
patterns.context: A legal assignment or disposition-of-rights clause lists successor entities and describes an irrevocable effect

6_2960.concept: 法律与许可证文本中的正式套语
6_2960.description: 激活分布于软件许可证及法律文本、邮件法律免责声明和判例材料；也出现于植物学名摘要。局部显著点包括法律套语、正式名称与身份、免责声明词组及被拆分的专名。

patterns.name: 许可证法律定义条款
patterns.context: 定义 Program 或其衍生作品，并列举逐字复制、修改或翻译等情况

patterns.name: 邮件保密免责声明
patterns.context: 邮件签名或页脚中的保密与特权信息警告，说明误收邮件后的限制或处理方式
patterns.domain: 电子邮件法律免责声明

patterns.name: 判例标题中的姓名与诉讼身份
patterns.context: 法院意见或判例引文中的律师、法官、当事人和诉讼身份；姓名包含不寻常大小写或拆分拼写

patterns.name: 植物学名与摘要标题
patterns.context: 植物化学摘要标题中的拉丁学名被拆分为多个子词

patterns.name: 开源许可证免责声明与责任条款
patterns.context: 软件许可证或版权文件中的名称使用限制、背书限制、无担保及责任免责声明

patterns.name: 法律文书中的权利承继人列举
patterns.context: 法律转让或权利处分条款列举承继主体，并描述不可撤销的效力

en.concept: Proper names and boilerplate in formal texts
en.description: Primarily responds to formatted boilerplate, enumerations, and rights attribution language in legal and copyright texts; it also responds to email disclaimers and proper names, classifications, or biochemical terminology in academic texts. The trigger for the third passage is unclear.

patterns.name: Copyright and derivative-work wording
patterns.context: Copyright notices or license text describing works, derivative works, translations, and attribution of rights.

patterns.name: Enumerations and legal boilerplate in legal documents
patterns.context: Legal texts enumerate parties, successors in interest, or legal relationships; includes opinion titles and contract clauses.

patterns.name: Confidential email disclaimer
patterns.context: Email signature or disclaimer stating that confidential material is for the intended recipient only and listing prohibited actions.

patterns.name: Biological names and taxonomic descriptions
patterns.context: Proposes a new species name and gives the type strain identifier.

patterns.name: Protein modification and biological mechanism terms
patterns.context: Discusses mechanisms regulating exit from HSV latency, phosphorylation, and glycosylation.

6_2960.concept: 正式文本中的专名与套语
6_2960.description: 主要响应法律与版权文本中的格式化套语、并列列举及权利归属措辞；也响应邮件免责声明和学术文本中的专名、分类或生化术语。第3段触发点不明确。

patterns.name: 版权与衍生作品措辞
patterns.context: 版权声明或许可证文本，描述作品、衍生作品、翻译及权利归属。
patterns.domain: 开源许可证、网站版权声明

patterns.name: 法律文书中的列举与法律套语
patterns.context: 法律文本中并列罗列当事人、权利继受者或法律关系，含判决标题和合同条款。
patterns.domain: 法院意见、合同、诉讼文书

patterns.name: 保密邮件免责声明
patterns.context: 邮件签名或免责声明，说明机密材料仅供指定收件人使用，并列举禁止行为。

patterns.name: 生物学名称及分类描述
patterns.context: 提出新物种名称并给出模式菌株编号。

patterns.name: 蛋白修饰与生物机制术语
patterns.context: 讨论 HSV 潜伏期退出及磷酸化、糖基化调控机制。
